tgt: Le Mithetho esaYilwayo yinxalenye yamanyathelo ayilwa ukuze anike uMzantsi Afrika uxanduva phantsi kweMithetho yokuziPhatha yaseLwandle yaMazwe ngaMazwe we-1992.1 Injongo yoMthetho osaYilwayo woRhwebo ngeeNqanawe (iNgqungquthela yeTyala kuLuntu) kukumisela iMithetho yokuziPhatha yoMbutho waseLwandle waMazwe ngaMazwe, we-1992 kunye nokuphumeza sibe ngumthetho isihlomelo seNgqungquthela yaMazwe ngaMazwe seTyala kuLuntu loMonakalo ngenxa yoNgcoliseko yi-oli, we-1969.

src: Tumellano ya Boikarabelo ho Setjhaba e theha le ho laola boikarabelo ba monga sekepe ya ngodisitsweng.
tgt: INgqungquthela yeTyala kuLuntu iseka kwaye ilawula ityala lomnini nqanawe obhalisiweyo.2 Injongo yoMthetho osaYilwayo woRhwebo ngeeNqanawe (INgxowamali yeMbuyekezo yoNgcoliseko yi-oli yaMazwe ngaMazwe) kukuphumeza iMithetho yokuziPhatha yowe-1992 kwiNgqungquthela yaMazwe ngaMazwe yokuSekwa kweNgxowamali yaMazwe ngaMazwe yeMbuyekezo ngoMonakalo woNgcoliseko yi-Oli, we-1971 (iNgqungquthela yeNgxowamali).INgqungquthela yeNgxowamali iseka iNgxowamali yaMazwe ngaMazwe, ebizwa ngokuthi yiNgxowamali yaMazwe ngaMazwe yeMbuyekezo yoNgcoliseko yi-Oli (IOPC).

src: Sepheo sa Sehlomathiso sa Molao wa Dikepe tsa Kgwebo (Letlole la Matjhaba la Ditlhapiso tsa Tshilafatso ya Oli) ke ho: kenya tshebetsong Protokhole ya 1992 ho Tumellano ya Matjhaba bakeng sa ho Thehwa ha Letlole la Matjhaba bakeng sa Tshenyo ya Tshilafatso ka Oli, ya 1971 (Tumellano ya Letlole).Tumellano ya Letlole e theha Letlole la Matjhaba, le bitswang Letlole la Matjhaba la Ditlhapiso tsa Tshilafatso ya Oli (IOPC).
tgt: Injongo yeNgxowamali kukuhlawula imbuyekezo kumaxhoba omonakalo wongcoliseko (ngokwentsingiselo yeNgqungquthela yeTyala kuLuntu) apho bangakwazanga ukufumana imbuyekezo, okanye imbuyekezo epheleleyo, phantsi kwezibonelelo zeNgqungquthela yeTyala kuLuntu, INgxowamali ye-IOPC ifumana inkxaso yayo kubanini bemithwalo.

src: Sepheo sa Letlole ke ho lefella ditlhapiso ho mahlatsipa a tshenyo ka tshilafatso (ka hara moelelo wa Tumellano ya Boikarabelo ho Setjhaba) moo ba sa kgonang ho thola ditlhapiso, kapa ditlhapiso ka botlalo, tlasa dipehelo tsa Tumellano ya Boikarabelo ho Setjhaba.
tgt: IMithetho esaYilwayo yeTyala kuLuntu kunye neNgqungquthela yeNgxowamali ijongene nemibuzo yamatyala kunye nembuyekezo yokulahlekelwa okanye ukonakaliswa okwenziwe kukungcola okusisiphumo sokuvuza kwe-oli okungaguqukiyo kwimikhumbi ethwele i-oli.3 UMthetho osaYilwayo woRhwebo ngeeNqanawe (INgxowamali yaMazwe ngaMazwe yeMbuyekezo yoNgcoliseko yi-oli) woMrhumo kunye noMthetho osaYilwayo woRhwebo ngeeNqanawe (INgxowamali yaMazwe ngaMazwe yeMbuyekezo yoNgcoliseko yi-oli) woLawulo ubonelela ngokuphunyezwa kweMithetho yokuziPhatha koMbutho waseLwandle waMazwe ngaMazwe we-1992 ukuze kuhlonyelwe kwiNgqungquthela yaMazwe ngaMazwe yokuSekwa kweNgxowamali yaMazwe ngaMazwe yoMonakala luNgcoliseko yi-Oli, nguMzantsi Afrika.

src: Letlole la IOPC le fumana ditjhelete ho tswa ho beng ba thepa.
tgt: UMthetho osaYilwayo woLawulo uza kubonelela ngegunya lezomthetho elifunekayo ukuze iiNkonzo zeNgeniso zaseMzantsi Afrika (SARS) zilawule ukuqokelelwa kwerhafu zemirhumo kwiNgxowamali yaMazwe ngaMazwe yeMbuyekezo yoNgcoliseko yi-Oli.

src: Dihlomathiso tsa Boikarabelo ho Setjhaba le Letlole la Ditumellano di sebetsana le mabaka a boikarabelo le ditlhapiso bakeng sa tahlehelo kapa tshenyo e bakilweng ke tshwaetso ka lebaka la ho tsholoha kapa ho dutla ha oli e tswang ditankeng tsa oli.
tgt: UMthetho osaYilwayo weMirhumo nguMthetho osaYilwayo weziMali obonelela ngokuhlawuliswa kunye nokuqokelelwa kwemirhumo ekufuneka ihlawulwe kwiNgxowamali.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Molao wa Dinyehelo wa Dikepe tsa Kgwebo (Letlole la Matjhaba la Ditlhapiso tsa Tshilafatso ya Oli) le Sehlomathiso sa Molao wa Tsamaiso ya Dikepe tsa Kgwebo (Letlole la Matjhaba la Ditlhapiso tsa Tshilafatso ya Oli) di fana ka ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Protokhole ya Mokgatlo wa Mawatle wa Matjhaba ya 1992 ho ntlafatsa botjha Tumellano ya Matjhaba bakeng sa ho Thehwa ha Letlole la Matjhaba bakeng sa Tshenyo ka Tshilafatso ka Oli, ke Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Izikhundla.1 IKhabhinethi ivume ukuqeshwa kwamalungu asixhenxe iminyaka emihlanu ukususela kumhla we-12 kweyeSilimela wama-2013, ukuba asebenze kwi-Arhente yoLwabiwo lweziMali zezeMidlalo kunye nezoLonwabo, ngokwemiqathango yoMthetho weLotho (Nombolo 57 we-1997).a.

src: Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa bohlokwa maemong a ha jwale.
tgt: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba ebalulekileyo kwiimeko ezigqubayo nezingundabamlonyeni.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le setjhaba le ba matjhabeng bakeng sa ho rapella ntate wa setjhaba, Mopresidente wa mehlengNelson Mandela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izibandakanya nesizwe kunye noluntu lwamazwe ngamazwe ekuthandazeleni utata wesizwe, owayesakuba nguMongameli uNelson Mandela.

src: Nakong ena e boima, ha re bontsheng lerato le kutlwelobohloko mme re etse Madiba motlotlo.
tgt: Ngeli xesha lobunzima, sisonke masibonise uthando novelwano ukuze simenze uMadiba azingce ngathi.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho ketekwa ha selemo sa bo 58 sa ho tekenwa ha Tjhata ya Tokoloho e neng e tekenwe ka la 26 Phuptjane 1955 e leng motheo wa demokerasi le Molaotheo wa rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphele isikhumbuzo seminyaka engama-58 sokutyikitywa koMqulu wamaLungelo oLuntu ngomhla wama-26 kweyeSilimela we-1955 osisiseko sentando yesininzi yethu kunye noMgaqo-siseko wethu.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa oohle ho ‘Bapala karolo ya lona’ mabapi le ho isa naha haufiufi le pono ya Aforika Borwa e kopaneng, e hlokang semorabe, e hlokang kgethollo ka bong, ya demokerasi le e tswetseng pele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubo bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba ‘Badlale iNdima Yabo’ ekusondezeni eli lizwe kumbono woluntu loMzantsi Afrika olumanyeneyo, olungenabuhlanga, olungacalucaluli ngokwesini, lwentando yesininzi kunye nolunenkqubela phambili.

src: Kabinete e amohela boitlamo bo botjha ba Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle, mmoho le bafuputsi bakeng sa ho tobana le dintlha tse hlahisang diphepetso bakeng sa mekutu e kopanetsweng ya ntwa kgahlanong le HIKabinete hape e amohela boitokisetso ba Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle ba ho hlahisa boikenyako bo atisitsweng ho mefuta e teng e kenyeletsang tlhokomediso e ekeditsweng mabapi le HIV le AIDS, le mehato bakeng sa ho fokotsa kotsi ya tshwaetso ya HIKabinete e lebisa matshediso ho Kompone ya Setjhaba e Mogadishu ho la Somalia ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) ho latela tlhaselo e mpe ya ka la 19 Phuptjane 2013 eo ho yona ho shweleng batho ba 15 ho kenyeletswa maAforika Borwa a mabedi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkele ukuzinikela ngokutsha kweSebe lezeMpilo, likunye nabaphandi ukuba bajongane ngqo nemiba engumngeni kwiinzame zabo ezihlangeneyo zokulwa neNtsholongwane kaGawulayo (i-HIV).

src: Re etsa boipiletso ho dihlopha tsohle tsa dipolotiki tse ka thoko ho ditsamaiso tsa dipolotiki ho la Somalia ho nyahlatsa dikgoka le ho hlahisa ditletlebo tsa yona Mmusongwa Bofederale wa Somalia ka tsela e bopang le e nang le moya wa poelano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isekwamkela amalungiselelo eSebe lezeMpilo okwazisa imiba eliqela yokungenelela kwiinzame ezikhoyo eziquka ukufundisa ukuqonda ngakumbi i-HIV noGuwulayo (i-AIDS), kunye namanyathelo okunciphisa umngcipheko wokosuleleka yi-HIIKhabhinethi idlulisa umyalezo wovelwano kulandela ukuhlaselwa okumasikizi kwiNdawo yoncedo lweeMbacu yeZizwe eziManyeneyo eMogadishu, eSomalia ngomhla we-19 kweyeSilimela wama-2013 oluthe lwashiya abantu abali-15 beswelekile kuquka abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ababini.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa oohle ho ithaopa ka metsotso e 67 ya nako ya ona ka Letsatsi la Nelson Mandela (18 Phupu) bakeng sa ho thusa ho tlisa phethoho dibakeng tsa ona le Aforika Borwa bakeng sa ntlafatso ya bophelo.
tgt: Sihlaba ikhwelo kuwo onke amaqela ezopolitiko angaphandle kwenkqubo yezopolitiko eSomalia ukuba agxeke ubundlobongela baze bazise inkxalabo yabo kuRhulumente waseSomalia ngendlela eyakhayo nedala uxolelwaniso.

src: Ketsahalo ya selemong sena e tla tswela pele tlasa sehloho se reng “Etsa ho hong tlisa phethoho etsa letsatsi ka leng ebe Letsatsi la Mandela” maikutlo a tsepamisitswe ho hlahiso e sa haelleng ya dijo, bodulo le ho tseba ho bala.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba banikezele ngexesha labo ngoSuku lukaNelson Mandela (umhla we-18 kweyeKhala) ukuze bancede baguqule uluntu abahlala kulo kunye nokwenza uMzantsi Afrika ube ngcono.

src: Kabinete e lemohile hore, jwaloka karolo ya Letsatsi laNelson Mandela, ho tla thakgolwa mokgahlelo wa pele wa Karete ya Boitsebiso.
tgt: Lo mbhiyozo uza kubanjwa phantsi komxholo othi “Thatha amanyathelo phembelela inguqu yenza yonke imihla ibe luSuku lukaMandela” kugxininiswa kubukho bokutya, indawo yokuhlala kunye nokwazi ukufunda nokubhala.

src: Ho thakgolwa hona ke karohano ya bohlokwa mehleng ya rona e fetileng le ho qetello ya mehla ya ho jara dipasa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphele ukuba njengenxalenye yoSuku lukaNelson Mandela, kuza kusungulwa ukunatyiselwa ngokwamanqanaba kokunikezelwa kwecwecwe leSazisi esiliKhadi.

src: Karete ya Boitsebiso ke karete e sa hlokeng ho hlahiswa mme e nang le bokgoni ba ho tshwara tlhahisoleseding e tswang ho bankakarolo ba fapafapaneng ba ha jwale le ba isao.
tgt: Oku kusungulwa linyathelo elibalulekileyo lokwahlukana kwethu nexesha nobomi obudlulileyo kunye nokufikelela esiphelweni kwexesha lamapasi eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Letona la Merero ya Lehae le tla fana ka dintlha tse batsi pitsong e tlang ho tshwarwa haufinyana.
tgt: ISazisi esiliKhadi licwecwe elikwaziyo ukugcina ulwazi neenkcukacha ezivela kwiqela labachaphazelekayo ngoku nakwixesha elizayo.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa ha letsholo la Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo le bitswang Diprojeke tse 94+ bakeng sa Madiba ho keteka letsatsi la tswalo la Nelson Mandela le lefa la hae.
tgt: UMphathiswa weSebe lezeKhaya uza kunikezela ngeenkcukacha ezithe vetshe kwindibano emfutshane ecwangcisiweyo ekuhambeni kwexesha.

src: Sepheo sa letsholo lena ke ho ntlafatsa meralo ya motheo dikolong tse fetang 94 hore e be dibaka tsa mankgonthe tsa ho ithuta le tsa boleng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkela ukusungulwa kwephulo leSebe lezeMfundo esiSiseko elibizwa ngokuthi iiProjekthi ezingaphezu kwezingama-94 zikaMadiba ukubhiyozela umhla wokuzalwa kukaNelson Mandela kunye nelifa asishiya nalo.

src: Letsholo lena le fana ka tshepo le seriti dikolong ho phatlalla le naha.
tgt: Eli phulo lijolise ekuphuculeni iziseko zophuhliso neziluncedo kwizikolo ezingaphezu kwama-94 ukuze zibe ngamaziko anobuchwepheshe bale mihla nawemfundo esemgangathweni.

src: Nakong ya Kgwedi ya Mandela ho tloha ka Phupu 2013, lefapha le tla be le eteletse pele phano ya sekolo se setjha se phethetsweng beke ka nngwe e le karolo ya boitlamo ba ho ntlafatsa boleng ba thuto ya motheo.
tgt: Eli phulo linika ithemba nesidima ezikolweni kwilizwe ngokubanzi.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho phethelwa le phano ya Borokgo ba Lefa la Morena Dalibhunga Mandela ho badudi ba Mvezo ba eteletsweng pele ke Morena Mandla Mandela, e leng setloholo sa Mopresidente wa mehleng Nelson Mandela, ka la 18 Phupu 2013.
tgt: Ngexesha leNyanga kaMandela ukususela kweyeKhala wama-2013, isebe liza kukhokela ekunikezeleni izikolo ezitsha ezigqityiweyo rhoqo ngeveki njengenxalenye yokuzinikezela imfundo esisiseko ephucukileyo nesemgangathweni.

src: Phano ena e tla tsamaelana le letsatsi la tswalo la Mopresidente wa mehleng Monghadi Nelson Mandela, eo a tla beng a qeta dilemo tse 95 ka letsatsi lena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkele ukugqitywa kunye nokunikezelwa kweBhulorho yeLifa likaMandela eyaziwa ngokuba yiNkosi Dalibhunga eya eMvezo ekhokelwa nguNkosi Mandla Mandela, umzukulwana walowo wayesakuba nguMongameli ngomhla we-18 kweyeKhala wama-2013.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho hopola hwa Aforika Borwa hwa Letsatsi la Matjhaba a Kopaneng le kgahlanong le Tshebediso e mpe ya Dithethefatsi le ho Rekiswa ha batho ho seng Molaong ka la 26 Phuptjane 2013, ho la Kimberley.
tgt: Oku kunikezelwa kuza kungqinelana nosuku lokuzalwa lwalowo wayesakuba nguMongameli uMnu Nelson Mandela, oza kugqiba iminyaka engama-95 ngolo suku.

src: Letsatsi lena le ile la sebediswa ho toboketsa bohlokwa ba ho sebetsana le diphephetso tse tobileng lefatshe, tse kenyeletsang botlokotsebe, HIV le AIDS, boitshwaro bo hlephileng, dikgoka tsa malapeng le ho ima ha barwetsana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphele isikhumbuzo soMzantsi Afrika soSuku lwaMazwe ngaMazwe lweZizwe eziManyeneyo oluchasene nokuSetyenziswa gwenxa kweZiyobisi kunye nokuThutyeleziswa kwazo ngokungekho mthethweni ngomhla wama-26 kweyeSilimela wama-2013, eKimberley.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho tshwarwa ha Seboka sa Saense, Theknoloji le Ntjhafatsose tla tshwarwaho tloha ka la 20 ho ya ho la 21 Phupu.
tgt: Olu Suku lwasetyenziswa ukugxininisa ukubaluleka kokujongana nemingeni ehlabathini kuquka ulwaphulo-mthetho, i-HIV ne-AIDS, ukuphela kwezimilo, ubundlobongela basemakhaya kunye nokukhulelwa kwabafikisayo.

src: Seboka se tla shebana le kgothaletso ya tlaleho ya Komiti ya Tekolo ya Matona, kgokahano e ntlafetseng le kopanelo ka hara Mokgwa wa Naha wa Ntjhafatso le dipuisano tse matlafaditsweng mahareng a mmuso, indasteri le borathuto.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkele ukusindlekwa kweNtlanganiso yaBaphathi baMazwe yeNzululwazi, uBuchwepheshe kunye neeNguqu eza kubanjwa ukususela ngomhla wama-20 ukuya kumhla wama-21 kweyeKhala.

src: Kabinete e amohetse tlaleho mabapi le tswelopele e entsweng motsaneng wa Muyexe ho la Giyani, Profenseng ya Limpopo, ho kenngweng tshebetsong ha boitlamo ba mmuso ba ho ntlafatsa bophelo ba batho.
tgt: Le ntlanganiso iza kushukuxa icebo eliqulethwe kwingxelo yeKomiti yaBaphathiswa yoHlalutyo, iphucule ukulungelelanisa kunye nokuhlangana kweNkqubo yeSizwe yeNguqu ize yomeleze nengxoxo phakathi korhulumente, ezorhwebo kunye nabemfundo ephakamileyo.

src: Ho feta moo, Kabinete e phetile ngongoreho ya Mopresidente ya hore makala oohle a mmuso a lokela ho potlakisa phano ya ditshebeletso ho ya ka meralo eo ho dumellanweng ka yona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkele ingxelo ngenkqubela eyenziwe kwilali yaseMuyexe, eGiyani, kwiphondo laseLimpopo yokuqalisa kokuzinikela kukarhulumente ekuphuculeni ubomi babantu.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa ha Projeke ya Mawala a Meralo ya Motheo ya bo 18 ka Moqebelo, 29 Phupu 2013 e tsamaelanang le mabaka a meralo ya motheo bakeng sa ho fana ka metsi le bohlweki ba ona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ingqine inkxalabo kaMongameli yokuba onke amanqanaba karhulumente kufuneka akhawulezise ukuziswa kweenkonzo njengezicwangciso ekuvunyelenwe ngazo.

src: Projeke e tla netefatsa phano ya ka nako e telele ya metsi bakeng sa ho kgotsofatsa ditlhoko tsa kahisano le ho tshehetsa kgolo ya moruo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkele ukusungulwa ngoMgqibelo, umhla wama-29 kweyeSilimela wama-2013 kwe-SIP 18 enxulumene nemiba yeziseko zophuhliso neziluncedo ngeenjongo zokuziswa kwamanzi kunye nokuhanjiswa kogutyulo.

src: Kabinete e amohetse lesedi leo e le fumaneng mabapi le diketso tsa mmomori wa lekala la tsa kaho.
tgt: Le projekthi iza kuqinisekisa ukubonelelwa ngamanzi okuzinzileyo ukuze kufikelele kwimfuno zoluntu kunye nokuxhasa ukukhula koqoqosho.

src: Kabinete e amohela sephetho sa diphuputso tse hlahisitseng bopaki ba ditheko tse fosahetseng, mmomori le bobodu indasteringya kaho ya poraefete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkele inkcazelo emfutshane eyifumene kwicandelo lezokwakha malunga nezivumelwano eziphakathi kweenkampani eziza kunciphisa zithintele ukhuphiswano.

src: Sekgahla sa mmomori se batla letsoho le matla la ba ka sehloohong ho tsa phehisano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkele isiphumo sophando esibonise ukuba kukho ukumiselwa kwamaxabiso okungekho mthethweni, izivumelwano ezingekho mthethweni nezilahlekisayo zokuthintela ukhuphiswano kunye norhwaphilizo kurhwebo lwezokwakha lwabucala.

src: Kabinete e emetse tsamaiso ya sephethosa Lekgotla la Diphehisano empa e lemohile hore bopaki bo supa hore ho bile le tshenyo e kgolo kgahlehong ya setjhaba ka lebaka la ditheko tse phahamisitsweng tseo mmuso o di lefileng ka lebaka la mmomori ona.
tgt: Ubungakanani bezi zivumelwano zingekho mthethweni nezilahlekisayo zokuthintela ukhuphiswano bungqina ukuba kufuneka kuthathwe amanyathelo aqatha ligunyabantu lezokhuphiswano.

src: Kabinete e tjhaeletse monwana Moralo wa Mankgonthe wa Naha wa Dithethefatsi (2013-2017) le hore o kenngwe tshebetsong bakeng sa dilemo tse hlano tse tlang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilindele isiphumo senkqubo yenkundla yamatyala okhuphiswano kodwa iqaphela ukuba ubungqina bubonisa ukonakala kakhulu komdla woluntu ngamaxabiso anyuswe kakhulu urhulumente athe wawahlawula ngenxa yezivumelwano ezingekho mthethweni nezilahlekisayo zokuthintela ukhuphiswano.

src: Moralo o sebetsa jwaloka lewa la mmuso bakeng sa ho thibela le ho fokotsa tshebediso e mpe ya tahi le dithethefatsi le ditlamorao tse tsamaelanang le tsona tsa bophelo ba kahisano le moruo setjhabeng sa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume isiCwangciso esinguNdoqo seSizwe seZiyobisi (2013–2017) kunye nokuqaliswa kwaso kwiminyaka emihlanu ezayo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaeletse monwana Ho tshwarwa ha Seboka sa Naha sa Matlafatso Moruong e Pharaletseng ya Batho ba Batsho ka Mphalane 2013.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso sisebenza njengoyilo olusephepheni noluphambili lwelizwe lokuthintela kunye nokunciphisa ukusetyenziswa gwenxa kotywala neziyobisi kunye neziphumo ezinxulumene nezentlalo nezoqoqosho kuluntu lwaseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Seboka sa Naha se tla bontsha dipale tsa katleho le ho namalatsa boikenyako ba mmuso tshehetsong ya bonkakarolo bo hlwahlwa le phumantsho ya batho ba batsho ho tsa moruo ka hara moruo o phatlaletseng, ka tsela e tlang ho nyehela moruong o kopanetsweng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukuSindlekwa kweMbizo yokuXhotyiswa kwabaNtsundu ngokuBanzi kwezoQoqosho ngowama-2013.

src: Kabinete e tjhaeletse monwana hore Aforika Borwa e tshwarisane le Lenaneo la Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng la Bodulo ba Batho (UN-HABITAT) ka ho tshwara Khonferense ya “Ho etella pele Phethoho ya Motsemoholo”ka la 5 le 6 Loetse 2013.
tgt: Le ntlanganiso iza kuqhayisa ngamabali ayimpumelelo kunye nokucacisa ukungenelela kukarhulumente ngenkxaso esebenza kakuhle kunye nokuthatha inxaxheba kuqoqosho oluzinzileyo kunye nokufikelela kwabantu abantsundu kuqoqosho olungundoqo, ngendlela eza kuba negalelo ekukhuleni koqoqosho oluqukayo.

src: Tabakgolo ya khonferense e hodima bonkakarolo ba basadi bophelong ba motsesetoropo ho la Aforika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumele uMzantsi Afrika ukuba ubambisane nenkqubo yokuHlaliswa kwaBantu yeZizwe eziManyeneyo (UN-HABITAT) ngomhla we-5 kunye nowe-6 kweyoMsintsi wama-2013 ekusindlekeni iNkomfa esihloko sithi “Ukukhokela inguqu eSixekweni”.

src: Khonferense e tla fana ka lepatlelo bakeng sa Aforika hore e tobane ka botlalo le diphephetso tsa ho dula ditoropong le ho qhaneha ho dula ditoropong bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya batho.
tgt: Le nkomfa iza kugxininisa ekuthatheni inxaxheba kwabasetyhini kubomi basezidolophini e-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e tjhaeletse monwana Pampiri e Tshweu ya Moralo mabapi le Malapa le Moralo wa ho kenngwa Tshebetsong.
tgt: Le nkomfa iza kubonelela ngeqonga ukuze i-Afrika ikwazi ukushukuxa ngokwaneleyo imingeni yokuhlala ezidolophini kunye nokulawula ukuhlala kwabantu ezidolophini ngeenjongo zokuphuhlisa uluntu.

src: Pampiri e Tshweu ya Moralo Mabapi le Malapa e tla kgontsha Mmuso le bankakarolo ba bang ho sebedisa lelapa e le motheo wa ho fihlella bophelo ba mankgonthe ba setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume iPhepha elisaYilwayo leNgcaciso yoMgaqo-nkqubo woSapho kunye nokuqaliswa kwesiCwangciso.

src: Pampiri e Tshweu e sisinya mawala a mararo a ka sehloohong, Kgothaletso ya bophelo bo botle ba lelapa, matlafatso ya Lelapa le paballo ya Lelapa.
tgt: Eli Phepha elisaYilwayo leNgcaciso yoMgaqo-nkqubo liza kwenza ukuba urhulumente kunye nabachaphazelekayo basebenzise usapho njengendawo yokuqala yokuqonda impilo entle yoluntu.

src: Kabinete e tjhaeletse monwana phethelo le ho kenngwa lesedinyaneng la molao ha Lewa la bobedi la Mohlodi wa Naha wa Metsi.
tgt: Eli Phepha elisaYilwayo leNgcaciso yoMgaqo-nkqubo lenza isindululo sezinto ezintathu ezingundoqo ezizezi, ukuXhasa ubomi bosapho olusempilweni, ukomelezwa koSapho kunye nokulondoloza uSapho.

src: Lewa lena le ahelletswe hodima Lewa la Mohlodi wa Naha wa Metsi la 2004.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukugqityezelwa kunye nokufakwa kwiphephandaba lakwarhulumente kweSicwangciso soBuchule sesibini soMthombo waManzi eSizwe.

src: Lewa la bobedi la Mohlodi wa Naha wa Metsi le fanaka mohlophollo ho karolo eo metsi a e bapalang moruong le ho hlwaya diphephetso tse teng, menyetla ya ntshetsopele le diketsahalo tse supisang moralo o dumellanweng ka ona bakeng sa dibaka tsa bohlokwa tsa naha.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso sobuchule songeza kweso sowama-2004.

src: Lewa la bobedi hape le batla ho netefatsa boteng ba metsi ba nako e telele, a lekanang bohle le a bolokehileng bakeng sa bophelo bo betere le tikoloho e betere bakeng sa bohle le hore metsi a laolwa hantle le ka makgethe bakeng sa kgolo e lekanang ya nako e telele le ntshetsopele.
tgt: ISiCwangciso soBuchule seSibini soMthombo waManzi eSizwe sibonelela ngohlalutyo lwendima yamanzi kuqoqosho kunye nokuchonga eyona mingeni, amathuba ophuhliso kunye nezenzo ezithi zichaze isikhokelo-nkqubo ekuvunyelwene ngaso kwimimandla ebalulekileyo yelizwe.

src: Kabinete e tjhaeletse monwana tlaleho ka Diphetho tsa kopano ya bo 16 ya Khonferense ya Mekga bakeng sa Seboka sa Kgwebo ya Matjhaba bakeng sa Dibopuwa tse Kotsing tsa Diphoofolo le Dimela tse Hlaha (CITES CoP 16), e neng e tshwaretswe Bangkok, ho la Thailand ho tloha ka la 3 – 14 Hlakubele 2013.
tgt: Isicwangciso sobuchule sesibini sikwafuna ukuqinisekisa ubukho bamanzi ngokuzinzileyo, ngokulinganayo nangokukhuselekileyo ukuze kubekho ubomi obungcono kunye nokusingqongileyo kunye nokuqinisekisa ukuba amanzi alawulwa kakuhle nangoku ngeenjongo zokukhula nophuhliso oluzinzileyo nolulinganayo.

src: Ho feta moo Kabinete e tjhaeletse monwana hore Aforika Borwa e lokise le ho kenya tshisinyo e lokelang ho tsepamisetswa maikutlo kopanong ya CITES CoP 17 ka 2016 ho la Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ingxelo yeZiphumo zeNtlanganiso ye-16 yeNkomfa yeZizwe ngeZizwe yoRhwebo lwaMazwe ngaMazwe ngeZilwanyana neziTyalo eziseMngciphekweni wokuTshabalala (CITES CoP 16), ebanjwe eBangkok, eThailand ukususela kumhla we-3 ukuya kowe-14 kweyoKwindla wama-2013.

src: Kabinete e ananetse memo e tswang ho Banka ya Ntshetsopele ya Aforika bakeng sa Aforika Borwa ya ho ba setho sa Lemulwana la Dikaho tsa Motheo bakeng sa Aforika (ICA) le ileng la thakgolwa Sebokeng sa G8 ho la Gleneagles ka 2005.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ikwavume ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ulungiselela kwaye ufake isicelo sezorhwebo ukuba sichotshelwe kwiCITES CoP 17 ngowama-2016 eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Letsete le leholo la Aforika Borwa ho dikaho tsa motheo bakeng sa nako e mahareng le tla ntlafatswa ke ho ba setho sa ICA haholoholo tlhahisong ya tshedimosetsole dihlahiswa tsa tsebo le kgokahano ya maano a ntshetsopele pakeng tsa dinaha tsa G20 le tsa Aforika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkele isimemo esivela kwiBanki yoPhuhliso lwe-Afrika eJongene noMzantsi Afrika ukuba ube lilungu leQela lase-Afrika leZiseko zoNcedo noPhuhliso (i-ICA) elasungulwa kwiNtlanganiso yaBaphathi baMazwe eG8 eGleneagles ngowama-2005.

src: Kabinete e tjhaeletse monwana ho hlahiswa ha Protokhole ya Setjhaba sa Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tsa Borwa ba Aforika (SADC) bakeng sa Kgwebisano Ditshebeletsong Palamenteng bakeng sa tshekatsheko, ho ya ka karolo ya 231 ya Molaotheo.
tgt: Utyalomali olubonakayo loMzantsi Afrika kwiziseko zophuhliso neziluncedo kwixesha laphakathi enyakeni luza kuqaqambisa ubulungu bayo kwi-ICA ingakumbi xa kusenziwa iinkcukacha kunye nemveliso zolwazi kunye nokulungelelanisa imigaqo-nkqubo yophuhliso phakathi kwamazwe e-G20 kunye namazwe ase-Afrika.

src: Merero ya Protokhole ke ho lokolla kgwebo ya ditshebeletso ka hara mabatowa ho itshetlehilwe hodima tekatekano, botsitso le ho kgola molemo mmoho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukufakwa kweMithetho yokuZiphatha kweCandelo loPhuhliso lwaMazwe e-Afrika eseMazantsi (i-SADC) kwiiNkonzo zoRhwebo ePalamente ukuze kuphunyezwe ukuqinisekisa, ngokuhambelana necandelo lama-231 loMgaqo-siseko.

src: Protokhole ena hape e qaqisa moralo bakeng sa tokoloho ya kgwebisano ditshebeletsong pakeng tsa dinaha tseo e leng ditho tsa SADC le ho sebetsa e le motheo wa ditherisano.
tgt: Iinjongo zeMithetho yokuZiphatha kukukhulula urhwebo phakathi kwengingqi kwiinkonzo ngokukhokelwa kukulingana, ukulinganiswa kunye nokuzuza macala omabini.

src: Kabinete e ananetseho thakgolwa ha lengolo la thuto la Batjhela ya Ntshetsopele ya Dibaka tsa Bodulo tsa Batho (BHSD) kakopanelo le Lefapha la Thuto le Thupello e Phahameng le Yunivesithi ya Nelson Mandela Metro.
tgt: Le Mithetho yokuZiphatha isekwaseka isikhokelo-nkqubo sokukhululeka korhwebo kwiinkonzo eziphakathi kwamazwe angamalungu eSADC kunye nokusebenza njengesiseko sothethathethwano.

src: Lengolo lena la thuto la BHSD morero wa lona ke ho ntshetsapele balaodi le bahlanka ba hlwahlwa ba Dibaka tsa Bodulo ba tla ba le tsebo le bokgoni bo hlokahalang bakeng sa ho bopa, ho ntlafatsa le ho potlakisa ntshetsopele ya bodulo ba batho bakeng sa nako e telele Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphele ukusungulwa kwezifundo zeSidanga soPhuhliso lokuHlaliswa koLuntu (i-BHSD) ngokuphathisana phakathi kweSebe lezeMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho kunye neDyunivesithi yeSixeko iNelson Mandela.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho mafapha oohle a mmuso, bomasepala le makala a mmuso a sebetsang Gauteng ho ngodisa dipalangwang tsohle tsa mmuso bakeng sa dipapetlwana tsa di e-tag.
tgt: Ezi zifundo zesi sidanga zijolise ekuphuhliseni abalawuli nabasebenzi kwezokuhlaliswa koluntu abaza kuba nolwazi olufanelekileyo nezakhono ezifunekayo ukudala, ukuphucula nokukhawulezisa ukuhlaliswa koluntu okuzinzileyo eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e tjhaeletse monwana mehato ya ho kenngwa tshebetsong e sisintsweng bakeng sa ho thehwa ha Lekala la Bolaodi ba Meedi (BMA).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kuwo onke amasebe karhulumente, oomasipala kunye namashishini karhulumente azinze eGauteng ukuba babhalise zonke izithuthi zikarhulumente kuhlelo lwe-e-tags.

src: BMA e tla laola phallo, madiboho le ho laola metjha e naheng ya ditshebeletso tsa meedi le ho hokahanya tshebeletso ya mafapha oohle madibohong a ho kena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume amanyathelo okuqalisa acetywayo ukuseka i-Arhente yoLawulo lweMida (i-BMA).

src: Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae e tla ba Lefapha le eteletseng pele ho thehwa ha BMKabinete e tjhaeletse monwana dibili tse latelang bakeng sa ho hlahiswa Palamenteng:.
tgt: I-BMA iza kulawula ukungena nokuphuma, kunye neenkonzo zolawulo lwemida esemhlabeni ize ilungelelanise iinkonzo zesebe kuyo yonke imida yokungena kweli.

src: Bili ya Taolo ya Madiboho, Bili ya Lekgetho la Madiboho, ya 2013 le Sehlomathiso sa Molao wa Madiboho le Ditefello, wa 2013 – Dibili tsena di fana ka motheo bakeng sa tsamaiso ya kgwebo ya matjhaba le tshireletso ya moruo le setjhaba, kahoo di bopa botsitso pakeng tsa taolo ya madiboho le tsamaiso ya kgwebo.
tgt: ISebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya liza kukhokela ekusekeni le arhente.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Diphuputso tsa Metsi – Sepheo sa Sehlomathiso sena ke ho se matahanya le diphethoho tse kgolo ho diinstitjute, leano, saense ya metsi le tikoloho ya tsa molao hape le ho eketsa nyehelo ya Khomishene ya Diphuputso tsa Metsi bakeng sa ditlhoko tsa diphuputso tsa metsi tsa Aforika Borwa le ho netefatsa hore naha e eme hantle bakeng sa ho arabela ditlhoko le diphephetso tsa naha e nang le bothata ba metsi jwaloka Aforika Borwa.
tgt: UMthetho osaYilwayo woLawulo lokuNgena nokuPhuma kwaBantu, uMthetho osaYilwayo weRhafu yokuNgena nokuPhuma, 2013 kunye noMthetho siHlomelo weRhafu yeZinto zaseKhaya, 2013 – Le mithetho isaYilwayo ibonelela ngesiseko sokuququzelela urhwebo lwamazwe ngamazwe kunye nokukhuselwa koqoqosho kunye noluntu, ize ngalo ndlela idale ulingano phakathi kolawulo lokungena nokuququzelelwa korhwebo.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Melao ya Naha ya Taolo ya Tikoloho, sa 2013 –Bili ena e sisinya dihlomathiso dipehelong tse itseng tlasa Molao wa Taolo ya Tikoloho, wa 1998 (Molao wa 107 wa 1998) le ho feta moo ho netefatsa hore mehlodi ya naha ya tlhaho e tshireleditswe bakeng sa moloko wa jwale le o tlang jwaloka ha ho labalabelwa ke Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha.
tgt: UMthetho siHlomelo ongoPhando ngaManzi – Lo Mthetho Sihlomelo ujolise ekubeni ulungelelanise iinguqu kumaziko, umgaqo-nkqubo, inzululwazi ngamanzi kunye nokusingqongileyo okusemthethweni kwakunye nokwandisa igalelo leKomishoni yoPhando ngaManzi kwiimfuno zophando ngamanzi zaseMzantsi Afrika kunye nokuqinisekisa ukuba ilizwe lisendaweni efanelekileyo yobuchule ukuze liphendule kwiimfuno nemingeni yelizwe elinqatyelwe ngamanzi elifana noMzantsi Afrika.

src: Moralo wa Naha wa Taolo ya Tikoloho: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Boleng ba Moya, sa 2013 – Bili ena e fetola dipehelo tse itseng tlasa Taolo ya Tikoloho ya Naha: Molao wa Boleng ba Moya, wa 2004 o laolang boleng ba moya ka hara naha bakeng sa ho tshireletsa tikoloho ka ho fana ka mekgwa e kgonehang bakeng sa thibelo ya tshilafatso le ho thefula maemo a tlhaho ho ntse ho kgothaletswa ntshetsopele e lokileng ya moruo le kahisano.
tgt: UMthetho siHlomelo ongeMithetho yoLawulo lokusiNgqongileyo kweSizwe, wama-2013 – Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo uceba izihlomelo kwizibonelelo ezithile eziphantsi koMthetho woLawulo lokusiNgqongileyo kweSizwe, we-1998 (uMthetho Nombolo 107 we-1998) uze uqinisekise ukuba ubuncwane bendalo belizwe bukhuselekile kwisizukulwana sangoku nesexesha elizayo njengokuba oko kuqulethwe kwisiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe.

src: Taolo ya Naha ya Tikoloho: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Matlakala, sa 2013 – Bili ena e fetola Taolo ya Naha ya Tikoloho: Molao wa Matlakala, wa 2008 (Molao wa 59 wa 2008) o laolang taolo ya matlakala bakeng sa ho tshireletsa bophelo bo botle le tikoloho.
tgt: ULawulo olusaCetywayo lokusiNgqongileyo kweSizwe: uMthetho siHlomelo woMgangatho woMoya, wama-2013 – Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo uhlomela izibonelelo ezithile eziphantsi koLawulo lokusiNgqongileyo kweSizwe: uMthetho woMgangatho woMoya, wama-2004 olawula umgangatho womoya elizweni ukukhusela okusingqongileyo ngokubonelela ngamanyathelo afanelekileyo okuthintela ungcoliseko kunye nokuhla komgangatho wezendalo lo gama uxhasa uphuhliso lwezoqoqosho nezentlalo.

src: Taolo ya Naha ya Tikoloho: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Dibaka tse Tshireleditsweng, sa 2013 – Bili ena e fetola Taolo ya Naha ya Tikoloho: Molao wa Dibaka tseTshireleditsweng, wa 2003 (Molao wa 57 wa 2003).
tgt: ULawulo lokusiNgqongileyo kweSizwe: uMthetho siHlomelo weNkunkuma, wama-2013 - Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo uhlomela uLawulo lokusiNgqongileyo kweSizwe: uMthetho weNkunkuma, wama-2008 (uMthetho Nombolo 59 wama-2008) ojongene nokulawulwa kwenkunkuma ukuze kukhuselwe impilo kunye nokusingqongileyo.

src: Diphethoho di kenyeletsa taolo ya Dibaka tsa Lewatle tse Tshireleditsweng mokgweng wa taolo ya dibaka tse ding tse Tshireleditsweng le ho fana ka sefutho ho Diphatlalatso tsa Mopresidente tse arolang mesebetsi pakeng tsa mabaka a botshwasi ba ditlhapi le taolo ya tikoloho.
tgt: ULawulo lokusiNgqongileyo kweSizwe: uMthetho siHlomelo ongeMimandla eKhuselweyo, wama-2013 – Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo uhlomela uLawulo lokusiNgqongileyo kweSizwe: uMthetho weMimandla eKhuselweyo wama-2003 (uMthetho Nombolo 57 wama-2003).

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Banka ya Poso ya Aforika Borwa – Sepheo se seholo sa Molao wa Banka ya Poso ya Aforika Borwa, wa 2010 (Molao wa 9 wa 2010) ke ho theha setsha sa ditjhelete bakeng sa ho kgothaletsa batho ka bongata ho boloka le ho tsetela le ho bopa banka ya kgetho ya mantlha bakeng sa sehlopha se fumanang meputso e tlase.
tgt: Izihlomelo ziquka ulawulo lwemimandla ekhuselweyo yaseLwandle kwinkqubo yolawulo lweminye imimandla ekhuselweyo kwakunye nokunika ingqalelo kwiZibhengezo zikaMongameli ezohlula imisebenzi phakathi koshishino lwezokuloba kunye nolawulo lokusingqongileyo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaeletse monwana Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Inshorense ya Tlhoko ya Mosebetsi sa 2012 bakeng sa ho nonya maikutlo a setjhaba le bakeng sa tjhebisano le Bomphato ba Kahisano ba Lekgotla la Naha la tsa Moru le Mesebetsi.
tgt: UMthetho siHlomelo weBhanki yePosi yaseMzantsi Afrika – Eyona njongo yoMthetho weBhanki yePosi, wama-2010 (uMthetho Nombolo 9 wama-2010) kukuseka iziko lezezimali eliza kugaya uluntu kangangoko ukuba longa kwaye lutyale imali kunye nokudala ibhanki ekhethwa kuqala ngamaqela oluntu anengeniso ephantsi.

src: Bili ena e fetola Molao wa Inshorense ya Tlhoko ya Mosebetsi, wa 63 wa 2001.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuma uMthetho siHlomelo weNgxowa-mali ye-Inshorensi yabaNgesaphangeliyo wama-2012 ukuze uluntu luphefumle kunye nothethathethwano namaqabane ezentlalo eBhunga leSizwe lokuPhuhlisa uQoqosho nezabaSebenzi.

src: Sehlomathiso sena se tobana le ntlha ya basebetsi bao mothating wa jwale ba teetsweng ka thoko Molaong ona le ho ntlafatsa ditefello tsa menyetla ho ba nyehelang, ho eketsa nako ya tefo ya menyetla ho ba nyehelang ho tloha dikgweding tse robedi ho ya ho tse leshome le metso e mmedi le ho fana ka kgetho ya bakgolamolemo haeba ho lokelwa ho fanwa ditlhapiso ha lefu le ka hlaha.
tgt: Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo uhlomela uMthetho weNgxowa-mali ye-Inshorensi yabaNgesaphangeliyo, uMthetho Nombolo 63 wama-2001.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili se batla ho fana ka dikgetho tse ikgethang dikgethong tsa Seboka sa Naha, le ho fana ka boingodiso ba bakgethi bao ka tlwaelo e leng batho ba dulang ka ntle ho Riphaboliki ho ba kgontsha ho kenya kgethoe ikgethang.
tgt: Esi sihlomelo sishukuxa umba wabasebenzi ababekelwe bucala ngulo Mthetho ngoku kwaye uphucula ukuhlawulwa kwenzuzo kwabo banegalelo kule inshorensi, wandisa nexesha lokuhlawulwa kwenzuzo ukususela kwiinyanga ezisibhozo ukuya kwezili-12 kwaye ubonelela ngokonyulwa kwabaxhamli xa kuthe kwasweleka lowo ubenegalelo ngokuhlawula le inshorensi.

src: Kabinete e dumellana le ho thonngwa ha MonghadiRomeo Adams maemong a Motlatsa Motsamaisi-Kakaretso: Ditshebeletsong tsa Kgwebo ho Lefapha la Toka le Ntshetsopele ya Molaotheo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukufakwa koMthetho Sihlomelo wezoNyulo, wama-2013 ePalamente.

src: Kabinete e dumellana le ho thonngwa ha Mofumahadi Irene RofhiwaSingo maemong a Mohlanka ya ka Sehloohong wa Ditjhelete ho Lefapha la Mehlodi ya Diminerale.
tgt: Lo Mthetho Sihlomelo ufuna ukubonelela ngeevoti ezikhethekileyo kunyulo lweNdlu yoWiso-mthetho, kwakunye nokubonelela ngobhaliso lwabavoti abahlala ngaphaya kwemida yaseMzantsi Afrika ukuze bakwazi ukuvota ngokukhethekileyo.

src: Kabinete e dumellana le ho thonngwa haMofumahadi Kalayvani Pillay maemong a Motlatsa Motsamaisi-Kakaretso: Ntshetsopeleng ya Theramelao ho Lefapha la Toka le Ntshetsopele ya Molaotheo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumelana nokuqeshwa kukaMnu.

src: Kabinete e dumellana le ho thonngwa ha Ngaka Bismark Tyobeka maemong a Mohlanka ya ka Sehloohong wa Phethahatso wa Taolo ya Naha ya Matla a Nyutlelere ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Romeo Adams kwisikhundla sokuba nguSekela Mlawuli-Jikelele: iiNkonzo zokuXhasa ukuPhathwa kweMisebenzi kwiSebe lezoBulungisa noPhuhliso loMgaqo-siseko.

src: Kabinete e dumellana le ho thonngwa botjha hape ha Monghadi Tsietsi Mokhele jwaloka Mohlanka ya ka Sehloohong wa Phethahatso wa Bolaodi ba Polokeho Mawatleng bakeng sa nako ya dilemo tse hlano ho tloha ka la 1 Mmesa 2013.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumelana nokuqeshwa kukaNks.

src: Kabinete e dumellana le ho thonngwa botjha hapeha ditho tseo e seng tsa phethahatso tse latelang ho boto ya Mekgwa ya Ditumello ya Naha ya Aforika Borwa, bao nako ya bona ya tshebetso e tla fela ka la 30 Pudungwana 2013, ho sebetsa lekgetlo la bobedi ho tloha ka la 1 Tshitwe 2013 ho ya ka la 30 Pudungwana 2018.• Monghadi Vernon Roderick Seymour• Monghadi PhakamisaZonke.
tgt: Irene Rofhiwa Singo kwisikhundla sokuba liGosa eliyiNtloko kwezeziMali kwiSebe leziMbiwa.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho thonngwa botjha hape ha ditho tse leshome le metso e meraro ho Lekgotla la Aforika Borwa la Merero ya Sepakapaka ho tloha ka la 24 Phuptjane 2013 ho ya ho la 24 Phuptjane 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumelana nokuqeshwa kukaNks.

src: Kabinete hape e ananetse ho thonngwa ha baemedi ho tswa ho Lefapha la Tshireletso, Lekgotla la Diphuputso tsa Saense le Indasteri (CSIR) le Lefapha la Dikamano le Tshebedisano ya Matjhaba ho tloha ka la 24 Phuptjane 2013 ho ya ho la 24 Phuptjane 2015.a.
tgt: Kalayvani Pillay kwisikhundla sokuba nguSekela Mlawuli-Jikelele: uPhuhliso lwezoMthetho kwiSebe lezoBulungisa noPhuhliso loMgaqo-siseko.

tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumelana nokuqeshwa kukaGqr.

src: Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa bohlokwa maemong a ha jwale.
tgt: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba ebalulekileyo kwiimeko ezigqubayo nezingundabamlonyeni.

src: Kabinete e thoholeditse batho ba Zimbabwe le mekga ya dipolotiki ka ho tshwara dikgetho tse hlophisitsweng hantle tsa palamente le tsa dibaka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisene nabantu baseZimbabwe namaqela ezopolitiko ekubambeni ukhetho lwepalamente noloomasipala olube nemvisiswano nempumelelo.

src: Kabinete e rorisitse matsapa a Mopresidente Jacob Zuma e le Monamodi ya emetseng Selekane sa Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tsa Borwa ba Aforika Ditherisanong tsa Zimbabwe, ho netefatseng hore mekga yohle ya dipolotiki e ikitlaelleditse dikgetho tse nang le kgotso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi income iinzame zikaMongameli Jacob Zuma njengoMququzeleli weCandelo loPhuhliso lwamaZwe e-Afrika eseMazantsi ngoThethathethwano lwaseZimbabwe ekuqinisekiseni ukuba onke amaqela ezopolitiko ebezinikele kukhetho olunoxolo.

src: Kabinete e seollotse tlhaselo ya qhomane moahong o sebediswang ke basebetsi ba Boqosa ba Turkey mane Mogadishu, Somalia, ya ba ya fetisa melaetsa ya matshediso Mebusong ya Somalia le Turkey.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igxeke uhlaselo ngesiqhushumbisi kwisakhiwo esihlala abasebenzi boZakuzo baseTurkey eMogadishu, eSomalia, kwaye ivakalise amazwi ovelwano kooRhulumente nabantu baseSomalia nabaseTurkey.

src: Selemong se etellang pele phethelo ya Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho, kabinete e ikamahanya le setjhaba ho ketekeng Kgwedi ya Basadi tlasa mookotaba o reng “Dilemokgolo tsa ho Sebetsa Mmoho Matlafatsong ya Basadi ya Nako e Telele le Tekano ya Bong.”Dilemokgolo di tlotla dintwa tsa tokoloho tse lwannweng ke basadi haesale ho tloha ha moitseki ya qollehang, Charlotte Maxeke, a ile a etella pele sehlopha sa basadi mohwantong wa Bloemfontein o neng o hanana le melao ya dipasa ka 1913.Seabo se entsweng ke basadi twantshong ya melao ya dipasa esita le dikarolong tse ding tsa ntwa ya tokoloho ke ntho ya bohlokwa ya kgothatso Kareteng ya Boitsebiso e sa tswa thakgolwa.
tgt: Phambi kokubhiyozela imiNyaka engama-20 eNkululeko yethu, iKhabhinethi izibandakanya nesizwe ekubhiyozeleni iNyanga yabaseTyhini phantsi komxholo othi “IKhulu leMinyaka yokuSebenzisana ngasekuXhobiseni kwabaseTyhini okuZinzileyo nokuLingana ngokweSini”.IKhulu leminyaka linika ingqalelo imigushuzo eyasungulwa ngabasetyhini ukusukela ngexesha itshantliziyo uCharlotte Maxeke, wathi wakhokela iqela labasetyhini kumngcelele woqhankqalazo eBloemfontein eyayichasene nemithetho yamapasi ngowe-1913.Igalelo elenziwa ngabasetyhini ekulweni imithetho yamapasi nakwezinye iinkalo zomzabalazo wenkululeko ziyinxalenye ebalulekileyo yempembelelo evuselele ukuba kwenziwe iSazisi esiliKhadi esisanda kusungulwa.

src: Jwaloka ha setjhaba se keteka basadi, Kabinete e boela e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho satalla kgahlanong le tlhekefetso efe kapa efe ya basadi le bana esita le ho hlompha ditokelo tsa basadi jwaloka ha di fuperwe ke Molaotheo.
tgt: Njengoko isizwe sibhiyozela abasetyhini, iKhabhinethi ikwahlaba ikhwelo kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika balwe naluphi na uhlobo lokuxhatshazwa kwabasetyhini nabantwana kwaye bahloniphe amalungelo abasetyhini akhuselwe kuMgaqo-siseko wethu.

src: Kabinete e ile ya pheta teboho ya pejana ya Mopresidente Jacob Zuma setjhabeng esita le matjhabeng ka ho etsa Letsatsi la Matjhaba la Nelson Mandela hore e be letsatsi le leholohadi ho fihlela jwale la keteko ya matswalo a Madiba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphindaphinde umbulelo wangaphambili kaMongameli Jacob Zuma kwisizwe kunye nakuluntu lwamazwe ngamazwe ngokwenza uSuku lukaNelson Mandela lwaMazwe ngamazwe lube ngowona mbhiyoza mkhulu womhla wokuzalwa kukaMadiba owakhe wakho.

src: Mohla la 18 Phupu, diketekete tsa batho Aforika Borwa ka bophara le lefatsheng di ile tsa ipha nako ya ho ya thusa batho ba sotlehang.
tgt: Ngomhla we-18 kweyeKhala, amawaka abantu kuMzantsi Afrika uphela nakwihlabathi athatha ixesha lokubhinqa omfutshane anceda abantu abangathathi ntweni.

src: Kabinete e ipileditse ho maAforika Borwa ho tshehetsa tlhomamiso ya Letsatsi la Dipapadi le Botjhaba la Nelson Mandela Lebaleng la FNB, Johannesburg, mohla la 17 Phato.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlabe ikhwelo kubemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba baxhase ukusungulwa koSuku lukaNelson Mandela lwezeMidlalo neNkcubeko Kwibala lezeMidlalo iFNB, eRhawutini, ngomhla we-17 kweyeThupha.

src: Di-Springbok di tla bapala le Argentina, Bafana Bafana yona e tla thulana le Burkina Faso athe sehlopha sa bolo ya maoto sa Mekaubere sa Aforika Borwa se tla bapala le sa Italy, ho tla latela khonsarete ya mmino e tletseng dikgalala tsa dibini ka phirimana.
tgt: Amabhokobhoko aza kudlala ne-Argentina, aBafana Bafana baza kudlala neBurkina Faso ize iqela loompondo zihlanjiwe beBhola eKhatywayo baseMzantsi Afrika lidlale ne-Italy, ngokuhlwa ulandelwe yikonsathi yomculo enoludwe lweemvumi ezininzi.

src: Tjhelete yohle e bokelletsweng moo e tla iswa projekeng ya kaho ya sepetlele sa Bana sa Nelson Mandela.
tgt: Yonke ingeniso iza kuya kwiprojekthi yesibhedlele sabantwana kaNelson Mandela.

src: Kabinete e ile ya boela ya pheta kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa ho “Nka Kgato ho Kgothalletsa Phetoho (le) ho Etsa hore Letsatsi le leng le le leng e be Letsatsi la Mandela”.Kabinete e tswelapele ho ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ohle hore a tswelepele ho bea Mopresidente wa mehleng Nelson Mandela menahanong le merapelong ya wona jwaloka ha a ntse a hlaphohelwa tshebedisong ya meriana ya kalafo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphindaphinde ikhwelo kubemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba “baThathe amaNyathelo Baphembelele iNguqu beNze Yonke iMihla ibe luSuku lukaMandela”.

src: Kabinete e mahlonokong ka ho hlokahala ha Moahlodi e Moholo wa mehleng Pius Langa, ya bolokilweng ka la 3 Phato nakong ya Lepato le Kgethehileng la Semmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqhubeka nokuhlaba ikhwelo kubemi bonke boMzantsi Afrika ukuba baqhubeke nokucinga kunye nokubeka owayesakuba nguMongameli uNelson Mandela emithandazweni njengoko elulama kunyango anikwa lona.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso ho lelapa la hae, metswalle le basebetsimmoho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilusizi ngokusweleka kwalowo owayesakuba yiJaji eyiNtloko uPius Langa ongcwatywe ngomhla wesi-3 kweyeThupha wama-2013 ngoMgcwabo wasebuRhulumenteni Owodwa.

src: Moahlodi e Moholo wa mehleng Pius Langa o tla hopolwa ka seabo sa hae Ntweng ya tokoloho, tshireletso ya hae ya demokrasi ya rona e tataiswang ke molaotheo, athe morao tjena, le ka mosebetsi wa hae Khomisheneng ya Bolokolohi ba Ditaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano kusapho, kubahlobo nakoogxa bakhe.

src: Kabinete e hlokomela boteng ba dikgatelopele tse ntle lekaleng la thuto, haholoholo matlafatsong ya Setatemente sa Leano la Kharikhulamo le Tekanyetso esita le tshehetso e ntseng e tswelapele ya matitjhere ho kenngweng tshebetsong ha sona.
tgt: Owayesakuba yiJaji eyiNtloko uPius Langa uya kukhunjulwa ngegalelo lakhe kuMzabalazo wenkululeko, ukukhusela kwakhe intando yesininzi esekelezelwe kumgaqo-siseko wethu, kwaye kutshanje, umsebenzi wakhe kwiKomishoni yeNkululeko yamaPhepha-ndaba.6 IKhabhinethi yamkela amanyathelo athembisayo kwicandelo lezemfundo, ingakumbi ukuxhotyiswa kweNkcazelo yePolisi yeKharityhulam nokuHlola nenkxaso eqhubekekayo yootitshala ekufezekisweni kwayo.

src: Kabinete e amohetse ho thewa ha Setlamo sa Tshebetso se filweng mosebetsi wa ho tsamaisa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha kharikhulamo ya Puo ya Matsoho ya Aforika Borwa ka 2013 ho tloha Kereiting ya R ho isa ho ya 12, ho ya ka kgoeletso ya Mopresidente ya hore puo ya matsoho e ananelwe e le ya semmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkele ukusungulwa kweQela elijongene noMsebenzi wokulawula ufezekiso lwekharityhulam yoLwimi lweZandla loMzantsi Afrika ngowama-2014 ukusukela kumaBanga R ukuya kwele-12, ngokuhambelana nekhwelo likaMongameli lokuba ulwimi lwezandla lubhengezwe njengelisesikweni.

src: Kharikhulamo e ntjha e tla fana ka phihlello etomanyana menyetleng ya thuto bakeng sa bohle.
tgt: Ikharityhulam entsha iza kubonelela ngofikelelo lwamathuba angcono ezemfundo kumntu wonke.7 IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubo bonke abafundi abenza imatriki ngowama-2013 ukuba babhalisele ngoku ukufunda kowama-2014 kumaziko ezemfundo ephakamileyo ngokuhambelana nePhulo iKhetha loKwenza iSicelo Ngoku!

src: la Lefapha la Thuto e Phahameng le Thupelo.
tgt: leSebe lezeMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho.

src: Baithuti ba kgothalletswa ho ba sedi ha ba kgetha seo ba batlang ho ithutela sona, ba be ba sekaseke ditlhoko tsa bona tsa ditjhelete.
tgt: Abafundi bakhuthazwa ukuba baqwalasele ngononophelo amakhondo omsebenzi abanokukhetha kuwo kwaye bahlole iimfuneko zabo zezimali.

src: Baithuti ba hopotswa ka Sekema sa Setjhaba sa Thuso ya Baithuti ka Ditjhelete, se fanang ka thuso ya ditjhelete ho ba tshwanelehileng ho ya ka mesebetsi ya bona e metle dithutong esita le baithuti ba hlokang ditjhelete.
tgt: Abafundi bakhunjuzwa ngeSkimu soNcedo lwezeziMali saBafundi seSizwe esibonelela ngoncedo lwezezimali kubafundi bemfundo ephakamileyo abafanele ukuncedwa nabadingayo ngokwezimali.8 IKhabhinethi ivuyisana nokusungulwa yiBhodi yeQumrhu yoSasazo yoMzantsi Afrika kwejelo leendaba likamabonakude elisebenza iiyure ezingama-24 elisabela kwimfuno emandla yosasazo lweendaba ezisematheni ngokubaluleka kweziganeko zesizwe nezamazwe ngamazwe kwaye inika ilizwi neqonga kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika.9 IKhabhinethi ivuyisana neendadi uCameron van der Burgh, uChad le Clos noGiulio Zorzi abenze ilizwe laneqhayiya ngokuphumelela kuMnyhadala weHlabathi weManyano yezokuQubha yeZizwe ngezizwe eBarcelona (i-FINA).10 IKhabhinethi ivakalise iminqweno emihle kuma-Muslim oMzantsi Afrika njengoko ebhiyozela i-Eid.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa thakgolo ya kanale ya ditaba tsa thelevishene tsa ka nako tsohle ya Lekgotla la Kgaso la Aforika Borwa e rarollang tlhokeho e dulang e eketseha ya kgaso ya ditaba tsa moraorao diketsahalong tsa bohlokwa tsa naha le tsa matjhaba ebile e fa maAforika Borwa ohle lepatlelo la ho hlahisa maikutlo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwanqwenela uLuntu lwamaJuda oMzantsi Afrika iminqweno emihle yenyanga u-Elul.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Cameron van der Burgh, Chad le Clos le Giulio Zorzi disesi tse entseng hore naha e be motlotlo ka ho hapa dikgau Ditlhodisanong tsa Lefatshe tsa 15 tsa Mokgatlo wa Matjhabatjhaba wa ho Sesa Barcelona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukuqaliswa kwenkqubo yofakano-milomo yeziKhundla zeSizwe zoMgaqo-nkqubo waManzi liSebe leMicimbi yezaManzi.

src: Kabinete e lakaleditse Mamoseleme a Aforika Borwa mahlohonolo jwaloka ha a keteka Eid.
tgt: Injongo yolu phononongo lomgaqo-nkqubo kukusungula kunye nokulungisa nazo naziphi na iziphumo ebezingalindelekanga nemisantsa kwimigaqo-nkqubo yangoku yezamanzi.

src: Kabinete e boela e lakaletsa Setjhaba sa Majuda a Aforika Borwa hore se natefelwe ke kgwedi ya Elul.
tgt: Oku kujoliswe ekufikeleleni kwinjongo kaRhulumente yofikelelo olulinganayo noluzinzileyo emanzini.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho thakgolwa ha mosebetsi wa dipuisano wa Lefapha la Merero ya Metsi bakeng sa Maemo a Maano a Naha a Metsi.
tgt: Izikhundla zomgaqo-nkqubo ezihlaziweyo ziza kuncedisa kulwabiwo ngokutsha lwamanzi phakathi kwabanye, abasebenzisi bamanzi abebekade behlelelekile ngaphambili.

src: Sepheo sa tjhebolobotjha ya leano lena ke ho fumana le ho lokisa ditlamorao dife kapa dife tse sa rerwang esita le dikgeo maanong a jwale a metsi.
tgt: Kananjalo ziza kuqinisekisa ukuba akukho zisekelo ezingundoqo zamanzi ezizakudlula eluntwini, ingakumbi kuluntu lwasemaphandleni ngaphandle kwemithombo yamanzi.

src: Sena se reretswe ho fihlella sepheo sa Mmuso sa phihlello e lekanang ya metsi ebile e le ya nako e telele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukupapashwa koMgaqo-nkqubo weSizwe wobuNini boBukrelekrele, ukuba uluntu luvakalise izimvo zalo kangangeentsuku ezingama-30.UMgaqo-nkqubo ujolise ukulungelelanisa ngokupheleleyo kunye nokulungisa imiba ngemiba enxulumene nobunini bobukrelekrele, ochaphazela imigaqo ngemigaqo, kuquka: ezorhwebelwano, ezenzululwazi, ezolimo kunye nezempilo.

src: Maemo a lekotsweng botjha a maano a tla thusa ho ajweng botjha ha metsi ho basebedisi ba metsi ba neng ba kotetswe nakong e fetileng.
tgt: Ngoko ke kukho isidingo sokulandela umgaqo-nkqubo omnye kwinqanaba lesizwe kunye nelamazwe ngamazwe ukusuka kuRhulumente.

src: A tla boela a netefatsa hore ha ho meralo ya motheo ya metsi e tla kwekwetla setjhaba, haholoholo setjhaba sa mahaeng se hlokang mehlodi metsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume isikhokelo-nkqubo somgaqo-nkqubo sohlolo olusekelezwe kubemmi esinesihloko esithi “Isikhokelo-nkqubo sokuXhobisa intsebenziswano phakathi kwaBemmi noRhulumente sokuHlola Ngaphambili ukuHanjiswa kweeNkonzo”.Amasebe karhulumente abandakanyeka ekuhanjisweni kweenkonzo eluntwini, kufuneka alungise izikhokelo-nkqubo zawo zokuhlola nokuvavanya ziquke izixhobo zokubandakanya izimvo namava abemi ngokuhanjiswa kweenkonzo.

src: Kabinete e ananetse phatlalatso ya Leano la Naha la Boithuelo ba Thepa, bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba ka nako ya matsatsi a 30.Leano le habile ho amanya le ho rarolla kahohlehohle dintlha tse fapafapaneng tse amanang le boithuelo ba thepa, bo phopholetsang hohle dinthong tse fapafapaneng, ho akga: kgwebisano, saense, temo le bophelo bo botle.
tgt: Oku kumisela isiseko sokubandakanya uhlolo olusekelezwe kubemi kwindlela karhulumente yokuhlola.

src: Kahoo ho na le tlhokeho ya mokgwatshebetso o le mong wa leano boemong ba naha le ba matjhaba ho tswa Mmusong.
tgt: Kwesi sikhokelo-nkqubo, uhlolo olusekelezwe kubemi lucacisa indlela yokuhlola ukusebenza kukarhulumente egqalisa kumava abemi abaqhelekileyo ukuze kuxhotyiswe ukuphendula eluntwini nokukhokelisa ukuphucula ukuhanjiswa kweenkonzo.

src: Kabinete e ananetse moralo wa leano bakeng sa tiso eo motheo wa yona e leng baahi ka sehlooho se reng “Moralo wa ho Matlafatsa dilekane tsa Baahi le Mmuso bakeng sa Tiso Phanong ya Ditshebeletso tsa Mantlha”.Mafapha a mmuso a amehang phanong ya ditshebeletso setjhabeng, a lebelletswe ho fetofetola tiso ya wona le meralo ya tlhahlobo ho kenyelletsa mekgwa ya ho kopanya maikutlo le malebela a baahi phanong ya ditshebeletso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume iMigomo yoLawulo loLuntu nooGunyaziwe boLawulo lweziMali.

src: Sena se rala motheo wa ho kopanya tiso eo motheo wa yona e leng baahi le mokgwa wa tiso wa mmuso.
tgt: IMigomo ibonelela ngesikhokelo ngendlela amagunya eSigqeba soLawulo esinika ngayo amagunya kwiGosa eliPhendulayo nakumaqonga asezantsi njengoko kumiselwe kuMthetho weeNkonzo zoLuntu (i-PSA) noMthetho woLawulo lweeMali zoLuntu (i-PFMA).IMigomo yenza inkqubo yokunika amagunya ibe lula noko, nto leyo ezakukhuthaza ukuhanjiswa kweenkonzo ngendlela esebenza ngokuthe chatha nenempumelelo.

src: Sena se rala motheo bakeng sa ho kopanya tiso eo motheo wa yona e leng setjhaba mokgweng wa tiso wa mmuso.
tgt: UMphathiswa weeNkonzo zikaRhulumente noLawulo uza kucacisa ngakumbi iMigomo nemiphumela yayo ekuhambeni kwexesha.

src: Moralong ona, tiso eo motheo wa yona e leng baahi o hlalosa mokgwa wa tiso tshebetsong ya mmuso e tsepamisang maikutlo malebeleng a baahi ho matlafatsa boikarabelo ba setjhaba le ho sututsa dintlafatso phanong ya ditshebeletso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukuba ezi zivumelwano zilandelayo zivunywe kwiPalamente ngokweCandelo lama-231 loMgaqo-siseko woMzantsi Afrika: Okokuqala, ukufikelela koMzantsi Afrika kwiSivumelwano sokusungula iKomishoni ye-Tuna yoLwandlekazi i-Indiya (i-IOTC), okweSibini iNkomfa yoLondolozo lwe-Bluefin Tuna yaseMazantsi (i-CCSBT) kwaye okweSithathu siVumelwano samaNyathelo wamaZibuko kaRhulumente okuThintela nokuPhelisa ukuLoba okuNgekho mthethweni nokuNgalawulwayo (i-IUU) soMbutho woKutya nezoLimo weZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-FAO).UMphathiswa weZolimo, amaHlathi nezokuLoba naye uzibandakanye kule ndibano imfutshane ecwangcisiweyo ukuze anabe ngexabiso oku okuzokuza nalo kwishishini lokuloba nakwigalelo lako ekuhlumiseni uqoqosho lwethu.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Mekgwatsamaiso ya Tsamaiso ya Setjhaba le Dithomo tsa Bolaodi ba Ditjhelete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukuba uMzantsi Afrika uza kusindleka iNkomfa yamaQela (i-COP) ye-11 kwiNkomfa yase-Abidjan eKapa ukusukela ngomhla wama-24 ukuya kowama-28 kweyoKwindla kowama-2014.INkomfa yase-Abidjan yenye yeeNkomfa zeeLwandle zeNgingqi ezili-18 apho izicwangciso zokuthatha amanyathelo zayilwa yiNkqubo yokusiNgqongileyo yeZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UNEP) njengenxalenye yofezekiso lwe-Agenda yaseStockholm yowe-1972.INkomfa ibonelela ngesikhokelo-nkqubo sezomthetho sentsebenziswano yengingqi phakathi kooRhulemente abaxhalabileyo bathathe amanyathelo besebenzisana ngasekusombululeni iingxaki ezibadibanisayo zonxweme nokusingqongileyo kweelwandle ababelana ngazo.

src: Mekgwatshebetso e fana ka tataiso ya kamoo matla a Tshusumetso ya Phethahatso a neanwang ka teng ho Mohlanka ya Ikarabellang esita le ho ya boemong bo tlasenyana jwaloka ha ho hlakisitswe Molaong wa Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba le Molao wa Tsamaiso ya Ditjhelete tsa Setjhaba.
tgt: Owona mbutho uphezulu othatha isigqibo se-COP yase-Abidjan, intlanganiso yonyaka-mbini ehlanganisa aBaphathiswa bezokusiNgqongileyo neengcaphephe zobuxhakaxhaka ezisuka kumaqela akwiSivumelwano, kwakunye noRhulumente abakhe umkhanyo, okanye ii-arhente zeZizwe eziManyeneyo nemibutho engajonganga nzuzo.

src: Mekgwatshebetso e nolofatsa mosebetsi wa neano ya matla, o tla kgothalletsa phano ya ditshebeletso e sebetsang haholwanyane.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iye yachazelwa ngamafutshane ngengxelo yokuthatha inxaxheba kwabathunywa boMzantsi Afrika kwiSeshoni yama-57 yeKomishoni yeZizwe eziManyeneyo ngoBume babaseTyhini ebibanjwe ngomhla wesi-4 ukuya kowe-15 kweyoKwindla kowama-2013.Iseshoni yama-57 ibibanjwe kuNdlunkulu weZizwe eZimanyeneko eNew York, kwaye umxholo obuphambili ubusithi “Ukuphelisa ubuNdlobongela obuJoliswe kwabaseTyhini namaNtombazana”.Izibophelelo eziliqela zenziwa zaze zamkelwa njengezindululo ngabathathi-nxaxheba ekupheliseni ubundlobongela obujoliswe kwabasetyhini nakumantombazana.

src: Letona la Tshebeletso le Tsamaiso ya Setjhaba le tla tswelapele ho manolla Mekgwatshebetso le dipelaelo tsa yona hamorao.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlabe ikhwelo kuwo onke amasebe karhulumente ukuba abe negalelo ngasekufezekiseni ezi zibophelelo.

src: Kabinete e se e ananetse ditumellano tse latelang hore di amohelwa Palamenteng ho ya ka Karolo ya 231 ya Molaotheo wa Aforika Borwa: Ya pele, phihlello ya Aforika Borwa Tumellanong ya ho thewa ha Khomishene ya Tjhuna Lewatleng la India (IOTC), Ya bobedi ke Seboka se Seholo sa Poloko ya Tuna ya Bluefin ka Borwa (CCSBT) le Ya boraro, e leng Mokgatlo wa Dijo le Temo (FAO) wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng Tumellanong ya Mekgwatsamaiso ya Lediboho la Naha ho Thibela, ho se Kgothalletse le ho Fedisa Botshwasi ba Ditlhapi bo seng Molaong, bo sa Tlalehwang bo bile bo sa Laolwe (IUU).Letona la Temothuo, Meru le tsa Ditlhapi le lona le se le ikamahantse le kopano ena e le ho thatoloha ka boleng bo tla tliswa ke sena indastering ya botshwasi ba ditlhapi le seabo sa yona ho hodiseng moruo wa rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukufakwa kwengxelo yenkqubela-phambili yokuPhonononga iMeko kaGawulayo yeHlabathi yeXesha eliphakathi yoMzantsi Afrika kwiNgqungquthela-Jikelele yeZizwe eziManyeneyo.

src: Kabinete e ananetse hore Aforika Borwa e tla tshwara Seboka sa 11 sa Mekgatlo (COP) se hlahlamang Seboka se seholo sa Abidjan Cape Town ho tloha mohla la 24-28 Hlakubele 2014.Seboka se seholo sa Abidjan ke se seng sa tse 18 tsa Diboka tse Kgolo tsa Mabatowa a Mawatleng moo merero ya Tshebetso e ileng ya thewa ke Lenaneo la Tikoloho la Matjhaba a Kopaneng e le karolo ya ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Lenanetsamaiso la Stockholm la 1972.Seboka se Seholo se fana ka moralo wa molao bakeng sa tshebedisano mmoho ya mabatowa Dinaheng tse amehang ho ikatlaelletsa tshebetso e kopanetsweng mabapi le ho rarolla mathata a nyalanang a tikoloho ya mabopo le mawatle ao di abelanang ka wona.
tgt: Ingxelo iphendula kwiSibhengezo sezoPolitiko ngezinto ekujoliswe kuzo zeNtsholongwane kaGawulayo kunye noGawulayo ezilishumi ezisuka kwiqela lweempawu ezingundoqo.

src: Setheo se hodimodimo sa Seboka se Seholo sa Abidjan se etsang diqeto, ke COP, e leng kopano ya ka morao a dilemo tse pedi e kgobokanyang Matona a Tikoloho le ditsebi tsa dintho tse sa utlwisiseheng habobebe tse tswang mekgatlong e Dumellanang, esita le dinaha tsa bolemohi, dieijensi tse ding tsa Matjhaba a Kopaneng le mekgatlo eo e seng ya mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi income isebe lezeMpilo ngengxelo ebonisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika usekhondweni lokufikelela kwiimpawu ezingundoqo ezininzi ngexesha elimiselweyo lowama-20.9 IKhabhinethi iye yachazelwa ngamafutshane ngofezekiso lweCandelo le-100 (1)

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha tlaleho ya Nakong e Bohareng ya Aforika Borwa ya kgatelopele Seemeng se Akaretsang sa Matjhaba a Kopaneng ka Tjhebobotjha ya AIDS Lefatsheng.
tgt: Yaziswe ngeziphumo ezibalulekileyo ngengxelo yokuhlaba amadlala, ungenelelo olucetywayo olwenziweyo nenkqubela-phambili eyenziweyo kude kube ngoku.

src: Kabinete e rorisitse Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle ka tlaleho e bontshang hore Aforika Borwa e motjheng wa ho fihlella bongata ba matshwao ka nako e sehilweng ya 20.9 Kabinete e ile ya kumelwa ka ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Karolo ya 100 (1)
tgt: Ngokomhla wama-31 kweyeKhala yowama-2013 ikhredit bhalansi ibiziBhiliyoni ezi-R3,3 xa uthelekisa ne-overdraft yeBhiliyoni e-R1,7 xa ibisiya phantsi kolawulo lwesizwe kweyoMnga wama-2011.Ikhabhinethi iwancomile amanyathelo okulungisa asetyenziswe kumasebe amahlanu aphantsi kolawulo lwesizwe, iKhabhinethi ivume ukuba iKomiti yaBaphathiswa iqalise nenkqubo yenguqu yeenyanga ezintandathu yokunikezela ulawulo lwaseLimpopo kwiNkulumbuso nakwiSigqeba soLawulo esitsha.

src: Ba ile ba hlokomediswa ka diphumano tse ka sehloohong tse tlalehong ya tlhahlobo, mehato ya thusetso e sisintsweng le kgatelopele e seng e entswe ho fihlela jwale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba olunye uphando kufanele luqhube kwimiba efuna ukusungula ukungalungelelani nalapho abantu bathe bafunyaniswa bebhude imigaqo yokufumana inkqubo yokululekwa iza kusebenza.

src: Ba ile ba boela ba hlokomediswa ka dintho tse ntseng di salletse tse ntseng di tshwanela ho phethelwa.
tgt: Inkcazelo engekho mfutshane yeKomiti yaBaphathiswa iza kuqhuba ngexesha elifanelekileyo.

src: Kabinete e dumetse hore dipatlisiso tse tomanyana di tshwanela ho tswelapele dinthong tse tobaneng le ho utolla mesebetsi e mebe mme moo batho ba fumanwang ba ile ba sitisa mekgwatsamaiso ya phumantsho, dikgato tse tshwanelehileng tsa kgalemo di tla nkuwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumele ukuba uMthetho osayiLwayo we-Legal Metrology ukuba ufakwe ePalamente.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya tsa Molao ya Meteroloji Palamenteng.
tgt: Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo uza kulungisa ukungangqinelani koMthetho we-Trade Metrology we-1973 okhoyo.

src: Bili e reretswe ho tataisa ho metha ho entsweng ke indasteri ha ho hwebisanwa ho sebediswa dikala, dimithara le disebediswa tse ding tsa ho metha ho botsekeng.
tgt: UMthetho osaYilwayo yinto efunekayo kwinkqubo yokusebenzisa iSisekelo esingundoqo sobuxhakaxhaka soMzantsi Afrika esiquka iMigangatho, ukuQinisekiswa koBulunga, iziQinisekiso neSixokelelwano sezikali nemilinganiselo (i-SQAM).

src: Sepheo sa Bili ke ho kgothalletsa kgwebisano e hlokang leeme, le ho tshireletsa bophelo bo botle le polokeho le tikoloho setjhabeng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukufakwa koMthetho-Sihlomelo waMachiza noLwelo oluNxulumeneyo wama-2012 ePalamente.

src: Bili ena e tla boela e rarolla pherekano e Molaong wa jwale wa Meteroloji ya Kgwebisano (1973).Bili ena ke ntho ya bohlokwa tshebedisong e ntlehadi ya meralo ya motheo ya setekgeniki e fupereng Maemo, Tiiso ya Boleng, Kamohelo le Mekgwatshebediso ya meteroloji (SQAM) Aforika Borwa.
tgt: UMthetho osaYilwayo uhlomela uMthetho waMachiza noLwelo oluNxulumeneyo we-1965 (uMthetho Nombolo 101 we-1965) njengoko uhlonyelwe nguMthetho wama-72 wama-2008.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya Sehlomathiso ya Meriana le Dithethefatsi tse Amanang le yona, 2012 Palamenteng.
tgt: UMthetho osaYilwayo ujonge ukusungula ugunyaziwe onamadla,osebenzayo nonempumelelo olawula amachiza.

src: DithonyoKabinete e ananetse dithonyo tse latelang:.
tgt: IzikhundlaIKhabhinethi ivumelene nokuqeshwa kwaba bantu balandelayo kwezi zikhundla:.

src: Moprofesara Edith Veronica Vries o hirilwe e le Motsamaisi e Moholo Lefapheng la Temo, Meru le tsa Ditlhapi.
tgt: UNjingalwazi Edith Veronica Vries kwisikhundla sokuba nguMlawuli-Jikelele kwiSebe lezoLimo, amaHlathi nezokuLoba.

src: Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa bohlokwa maemong a ha jwale.
tgt: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba ebalulekileyo kwiimeko ezigqubayo nezingundabamlonyeni.

src: Kabinete e amohetse ho kgakolwa phatlalatsa ha kgatiso ya botshelela ya Matshwao a Ntshetsopele ke Letona la Bopresidenteng la Bodisa le Tlhahlobo ya Tshebetso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkela ukusungulwa esidlangalaleni koshicilelo lwesithandathu lweeMpawu zoPhuhliso nguMphathiswa kuBongameli woHlolo noVavanyo lweNtsebenzo kwakunye noLawulo.

src: Jwaloka ha setjhaba se hlophisetsa ho keteka Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho, maAforika Borwa a tshwanela ho ba motlotlo ka hore bophelo bo fetohile ba ba ba ntlafala haesale ho tloha ka 1994.Matshwao a bontsha ntlafalo dinthong tsa bohlokwa athe a boela a supa mosebetsi o boima o ntseng o tshwanela ho etswa ho sebetsana le tse ding tsa diphephetso tsa rona tse ntseng di iphetapheta.
tgt: Njengoko isizwe silungiselela ukubhiyozela iMinyaka engama-20 eNkululeko, aBemi boMzantsi Afrika kufanele babeneqhayiya kuba ubomi butshintshe bangcono ukusukela ngowe-1994.Iimpawu zibonisa impucuko kwiindawo ezibalulekileyo kwaye ngaxeshanye zolatha umsebenzi onzima ekusafuneka wenziwe ukujongana neminye imingeni yethu egquba ngakumbi.

src: Ho feta moo, matshwao a kgothalletsa ngangisano ka diphephetso tseo naha ya rona e tobaneng le tsona mme a boela a sebetsa ho thusa leetong la rona la kgatelopele ya moruo le phedisano.
tgt: Ngaphezu koko, iimpawu zikhuthaza ingxoxo ngemingeni ejongene nelizwe lethu kwaye zikwasebenza njengeziphawuli apha kuhambo lwethu lwenkqubela-phambili kwezoqoqosho nentlalo.

src: Kabinete e rorisitse 41% (115) ya bomasepala ba fumanweng ba se na diphoso ditsamaisong tsa ditjhelete ha ho ne ho etswa bahlahlobi ba dibuka tsa ditjhelete ba 2011/2012.
tgt: IKhabhinethi income ama-41% (115) oomasipala abafumene iingxelo zophicotho-zincwadi zezimali ezingenachaphaza kunyaka-mali wama-2011/2012.

src: E boetse ya ananela ntlafalo e entsweng ke bomasepala ba 21 bao nakong e fetileng ba ileng ba fumana ditsheollo tse amanang le selemo se fetileng.
tgt: Ikwavume impucuko eyenziwe ngoomasipala abangama-21 ababefumene iingxelo ezingachanekanga okanye okungakhange kwenziwe ingxelo kubo kunyaka ophelileyo.

src: Kabinete e ananela mosebetsi o entsweng ke Kantoro ya Mohlakisi Kakaretso ka ho thusa bomasepala ho ntlafatsa ditlhoko tsa bona tsa boikamahanyo pusong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawubulela umsebenzi owenziwe nguMphicothi-zincwadi Jikelele ekuncediseni oomasipala ukuba baphucule iimfuneko zothotyelo lolawulo lwezimali.

src: E ile ya boela ya ananela boikitlaetso bo entsweng ke boetapele ba bomasepala hore ba tswele pele ho sebeletsa ntlafalo dinthong tse hlakisitsweng ke Kantoro ya Mohlakisi Kakaretso.3 Kabinete e lebohile maAforika Borwa ohle ka ho tshehetsa Letsatsi la Dipapadi le Botjhaba la Nelson Mandela le neng le tshwaretswe ho thusa projeke ya Sepetlele sa Bana sa Nelson Mandela.
tgt: Kananjalo, ikwavume ukuzinikela okwenziwe ziinkokeli zoomasipala ngokuqhubeka zisebenzela ukuphucula iziphene eziqaqanjiswe nguMphicothi-zincwadi-Jikelele.3 IKhabhinethi ibulele bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ngenkxaso yabo yoSuku lwezeMidlalo neNkcubeko lukaNelson Mandela ebelusingathwe ukunceda iprojekthi yeSibhedlele saBantwana iNelson Mandela.

src: MaAforika Borwa a kgothalletswa ho tswelapele ho sebetsa dibakeng tsa bona le ho sebedisana le mmuso ho ntlafatsa maphelo a baahi esita le ho kenya tshebetsong mehopolo eo Madiba a ileng a nyehela bophelo ba hae ka lebaka la yona.4 Kabinete e nketse hloohong leeto le tlang la Mopresidente Jacob Zuma la ho ya Rephaboliking ya Russia.
tgt: Abemi boMzantsi Afrika bayakhuthazwa ukuba baqhubeke besebenza eluntwini baze basebenzisane norhulumente ukuphucula ubomi babemi baze bafezekise izinto uMadiba ebenikele ubomi bakhe kuzo.4 IKhabhinethi iqaphele utyelelo oluzayo lukaMongameli Jacob Zuma kwiRiphabliki yaseRashiya.

src: O tla be a ya Sebokeng sa Setlamo sa 20 (G20) St Petersburg mohla la 5 le 6 Loetse 2013 e le karolo ya ho phahamisa ditabatabelo tsa Aforika Borwa tsa sepolotiki le tsa moruo.
tgt: Ngolu tyelelo uza kuzimasa iNgqungquthela yeeNtloko zaMazwe, aBaphathiswa bezeziMali neeRhuluneli zeBhanki (iG20) eSt Petersburg ngomhla we-5 nowe-6 kweyoMsintsi wama-2013 njengenxalenye yokukhuthaza umdla woMzantsi Afrika kwezopolitiko noqoqosho.

src: Aforika Borwa e tswelapele ho tshehetsa morero wa G20 wa ntshetsopele o ntshetsang pele botsitso ba moruo lefatsheng esita le kgolo le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi tse tla itjara ka nako e telele.5 Kabinete e rorisitse kopano ya pele ya Lekgotla la Kgwebo la Brazil, Russia, India, China le Aforika Borwa (BRICS), moo baetapele ba kgwebo ho tswa dinaheng tsena ba neng ba kgobokana Aforika Borwa.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uqhubeka nokuxhasa i-ajenda yophuhliso yeG20 eqhubela phambili uzinzo loqoqosho lwehlabathi nohlumo oluzinzileyo lwexesha elide nokudala imisebenzi.5 IKhabhinethi income intlanganiso yokuqala yeBhunga lezoShishino yeBrazil, iRashiya, i-Indiya, iTshayina noMzantsi Afrika (iBRICS), apho bekudibene iinkokeli zoshishino ezivela kula mazwe eMzantsi Afrika .

src: Kopanong ena ho ile ha boela ha eba teng baetapele ba bohlokwa ba kgwebo ba tswang dinaheng tse ding tse 19 tsa Aforika.6 Kabinete e amohetse tiisetso e fanweng Foramong ya bo12 ya Molao wa Kgolo le Monyetla wa Aforika (AGOA) ya ho ntjhafatsa AGOA pele e fellwa ke nako ka 2015.
tgt: Intlanganiso ibikwazinyaswe ziinkokeli zoshishino ezibalulekileyo nezaziwayo ezivela kwamanye amazwe ase-Afrika ali-.6 IKhabhinethi yamkele isiqinisekiso esenziwe kwiQonga lonyaka le-12 loMthetho woHlumo lwe-Afrika namaThuba lokuvuselela i-AGOA phambi kokuba iphelelwe lixesha ngowama-2015.

src: AGOA e foletse molemo ho tswa nahakgolo ya Amerika le ya Aforika ya ba ya tshehetsa kgwebisano ya naha tse pedi dipakeng tsa Aforika Borwa le Amerika e ntseng e hola ebile e tsitsa.
tgt: I-AGOA ixhamle e-United States nakwizwekazi i-Afrika kwaye ixhase ukuhluma nobudlelwane obulinganayo borhwebelwano obunamacala amabini phakathi koMzantsi Afrika ne-United States (US).UMzantsi Afrika ukholelwa ukuba i-AGOA ibonelela ngesikhokelo-nkqubo esifanelekileyo sokwakha urhwebelwano oluluqilima oluxhamlisa macala omabini nakubudlelwane botyalo-zimali nokuxhobisa intsebenziswano phakathi kwe-US nezwekazi i-Afrika ngokubanzi.7 Njengenxalenye yesikhumbuzo seNyanga yabaseTyhini esiqhutywa kwisizwe ngokubanzi, uSekela Mongameli uKgalema Motlanthe uza kutyelela iLali iGombani ekuMasipala iMutale ngoLwesihlanu, umhla wama-23 kweyeThupha wama-2013 eLimpopo ukuze anikezele ngezindlu eluntwini.

src: Aforika Borwa e dumela hore AGOA ke moralo o nepahetseng wa ho aha dikamano tse matla, tumellano ya kgwebisano ya dinaha tse pedi le matsete mme e matlafatsa tshebedisanommoho dipakeng tsa Amerika le nahakgolo ya Aforika ka bophara..7 E le karolo ya naha ka bophara ya ho keteka Kgwedi ya Basadi, Motlatsi wa Mopresidente Kgalema Motlanthe o tla etela Motsaneng wa Gombani o Masepaleng wa Mutale, Limpopo, ka Labohlano mohla la 23 Phato 2013 ho ya neelana ka matlo setjhabeng.
tgt: Abasetyhini baseGombani bathathe inxaheba ekwakheni ezi zindlu.

src: 05 Sep Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa bohlokwa maemong a ha jwale.
tgt: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba ebalulekileyo kwiimeko ezigqubayo nezingundabamlonyeni.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa ha Tokomane ya Tshebetso ya Setjhaba ebile e thoholetsa mekgatlo ya basebetsi tshebeletsong ya setjhaba esita le Mmuso e le mohiri boikitlaetsong bo entsweng Tokomaneng ena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkela ukusungulwa koMqulu weeNkonzo zikaRhulumente kwaye incoma iimanyano zeenkonzo zikarhulumente noRhulumente njengomqeshi kwizibophelelo ezenziwe ngalo Mqulu.

src: Tokomane e teka maemo a tshebeletso kahara tshebeletso ya setjhaba moo mekgatlo ya basebetsi tshebeletsong ya setjhaba e itlamang ho tshehetsa maemo a tshebeletso.
tgt: Lo Mqulu wazisa imigangatho yeenkonzo kwakwiinkonzo karhulumente neemanyano zabasebenzi bakarhulumente zibonakalisa ukuzinikela ekuxhaseni kwazo imigangatho yeenkonzo.

src: Kabinete e hlokomela hore hajwale makala a mangata a kene kapa a ile a kena ditherisanong tsa meputso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphela ukuba amacandelo amaninzi akwiingxoxo zothethathethwano ngonyuso lwemivuzo okanye ebekade ekuzo.

src: Kabinete e amohela ditumellano tse fihlelletsweng makaleng a mang mme e a tseba ka ditherisano tse ntseng di tswelapele makaleng a mang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkela izivumelwano ekufikelelwe kuzo kwamanye amacandelo kwaye iqaphela ukuba iingxoxo zothethathethwano zisaqhubeka kwamanye.

src: Kabinete e a ananela hore moo demokrasi e leng teng, basebetsi ba na le tokelo ya ho ipelaetsa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqonda ukuba kulawulo lwentando yesininzi, abasebenzi banelungelo lokugwayimba.

src: Kabinete e thasisetsa hore tokelo e jwalo e tlameha ho etswa ka mokgwa o se nang dikgoka ebile e le o ikamahanyang le molao ka hohlehohle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igxininisa ukuba ilungelo elinjalo kufanele lisetyenziswe ngendlela engenadushe nokuthotyelwa komthetho ngokupheleleyo.

src: Ho na le boikarabelo baetapeleng ba mekgatlo ya basebetsi, bahiri le ditshebeletso tsa naha tsa tshireletso ho netefatsa hore molao ha o tlolwe, ho qojwa diketso tsa ho e lata letailana le hore mehwanto e etswe ka kgotso.
tgt: Kukho uxanduva olujongene neenkokeli zeemanyano, abaqeshi neenkonzo zokhuseleko zikarhulumente lokuqinisekisa ukuba umthetho ugciniwe, kwaye amanyathelo axhokonxayo kufanele aphetshwe nentshukumo yokugwayimba yenziwa ngendlela enoxolo.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa mekgatlong yohle ho sebedisa matsapa a yona ho phethela ditherisano kapelepele esita le ho qoba diqhwebeshano tsa nako e telele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kuwo onke amaqela ukuba asebenzise iinzame zawo afikelele kwisivumelwano seengxoxo ngokukhawuleza kwaye aphephe iimbambano ezithatha ixesha elide.

src: Ditumellano tseo tsa kapelepele di tla thusa ho fokotsa ditjeo moruong di be di kgothaletse katleho ya naha sepheong sa mesebetsi le kgolo.
tgt: Izivumelwano ezikhawulezayo ezinjalo ziza kunceda ekunciphiseni iindleko kwezoqoqosho kwaye zikhuthaze ukufikelela kwiinjongo zelizwe zemisebenzi nohlumo.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Lekgotla la bobedi la Merafo la Selemo le selemo le neng le tshwerwe bekeng e fetileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume iLekgotla yezeMigodi yoNyaka yesibini ebibanjwe kwiveki ephelileyo.

src: Lekgotla le hlahisitse monyetla o mong bakeng sa ba ka sehloohong ba amehang indastering ya merafo ho tswelapele ho fumaneng ditharollo tsa nako e telele diphephetsong tse thefulang lekala lena.
tgt: Le Lekgotla ize nelinye ithuba lokuba abadlala indima ebalulekileyo nabachaphazelekayo kwishishini lezemigodi baqhubeke ukuzibandakanya ekufumaneni izisombululo eziza kusebenza ixesha elide kwimingeni ehlupha eli candelo.

src: Tlasa boetapele ba Motlatsi wa Mopresidente Kgalema Motlanthe, mmuso le wona o tswelapele ho tshehetsa tumellano ya moralo esita le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha lekala la merafo le nang le boitjaro ba nako e telele le bile le tsitsitse.
tgt: Phantsi kwesikhokelo sikaSekela Mongameli uKgalema Motlanthe urhulumente usekwaqhubeka nokuxhasa isivumelwano senkqubo-sikhokelo nokufezekiswa kwaso ukuze kubekho icandelo lezemigodi elomeleleyo nelizinzileyo.

src: Ditokisetsong tsa Tokoloho ya Dilemo tse 20 mohla la 27 Mmesa 2014, Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho hopola nalane ya rona le ho keteka botjhaba ba rona bo kopaneng ka ho se tshwane nakong ya Kgwedi ya Letlotlo la Setjhaba.
tgt: Kwingabula-zigcawu ekhokelela kwiMinyaka engama-20 yeNkululeko ngomhla wama-27 kuTshazimpunzi wama-2014, iKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubemi bonke boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bakhumbule imbali yethu kwaye babhiyozele iinkcubeko zethu ezohlukileyo ngexesha leNyanga yaMagugu.

src: Mekete ya monongwaha e tla tshwauwa tlasa mookotaba o reng: “Ho tseka botjha, ho Kgutlisa le ho Keteka Letlotlo la rona la Setjhaba le Phelang”.Mekete ya Letsatsi la Letlotlo la Setjhaba e tla tshwarelwa Lebaleng la Dipapadi la Sisa Dukashe le Mdantsane, Masepaleng wa Toropokgolo ya Buffalo, Porofenseng ya Kapa Botjhabela mohla la 24 Loetse 2013.E le karolo ya Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho, selekane sa dikgokahanyo tsa naha se tla etella pele ho kgakolwa ha ‘Labohlano la Tokoloho’ mohla la 20 Loetse 2013, se tla fanang ka lepatlelo ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho baballa tokoloho e lwanetsweng ka thata, ho netefatsa hore meloko e tlang e kgona ho fola molemo demokrasing ya rona e ntseng e hola.
tgt: Imibhiyozo yalo nyaka iza qatshelwa phantsi komxholo othi: "Ukuzuza kwakhona, ukuBuyisela nokuBhiyozela aMagugu Ethu aPhilayo”.

src: Nakong ya Loetse, ho tshehetsa matsapa a bahahlaudi ba rona ba kahare, Kabinete e kgothalletsa maAforika Borwa ho etela ditsha tsa Letlotlo la naha ho re hopotsa ka leeto la rona la ho ya tokolohong.
tgt: Imibhiyozo yoSuku lwaMagugu iza kubanjelwa kwiBala lezeMidlalo iSisa Dukashe eMdantsane, kuMasipala oMbaxa weSixeko iBuffalo, kwiPhondo leMpuma Koloni ngomhla wama-24 kweyoMsintsi wama-2013.

src: Hape, ho tshehetsa letlotlo la rona la tlholeho ka ho etela dipaka tsa naha mahala ho tloha mohla la 9 ho ya ho la 13 Loetse 2013 e le karolo ya borobedi ya selemo le selemo ya Beke ya Dipaka tsa Naha tsa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Njengenxalenye yephulo leMinyaka engama-20 yeNkululeko, intsebenziswano kunxibelelwano lwesizwe iza kuqaphela ukusungulwa kuka ‘Lwesihlanu weNkululeko’ ngomhla wama-20 kweyoMsintsi wama-2013, oza kubonelela ngeqonga kubemi boMzantsi Afrika lokuba baxabise inkululeko yethu elwelwe nzima ukuqinisekisa ukuba izizukulwana ezizayo ziza kukwazi ukuxhamla kulawulo lwethu lwentando yesininzi olusaphuhlayo.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa batswadi le bahlokomedi bohle ho tshehetsa bana ba bona ditlhophisetsong tse tlang tsa Ditekolo tsa Naha tsa Selemo le Selemo (ANA), mokgahlelong wa ho bala le ho ngola esita le dipalo, tse tla tshwarwa dipakeng tsa mohla la 10 le 13 Loetse 2013.Batswadi le bahlokomedi ba tlameha ho netefatsa hore ba henahenana le diphetho tsa ANA tsa 2013 jwaloka ha di sebetsa e le sesebediswa sa bohlokwa sa tlhahlobo ya baithuti ya moo ba leng matla kapa moo ba fokolang teng.
tgt: Ngenyanga yoMsintsi, ukuxhasa iinzame zokhenketho lwethu lwasekhaya, iKhabhinethi ikhuthaza abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba batyelele iziza zamagugu ukuze sizikhumbuze ngohambo lwethu oluya enkululekweni.

src: Boitlhophisetsong ba ANA e tlang batswadi, bahlokomedi le baithuti ba kotjwa ho sebedisa disebediswa tseo ba di filweng ke Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo.
tgt: Kananjalo, baxhase amagugu ethu endalo ngokutyelela imimandla emiselwe ukubuka ubuhle bendalo simahla ukususela ngomhla we-9 ukuya kowe-13 kweyoMsintsi kowama-2013 njengenxalenye yemibhiyozo yonyaka wesi-8 weVeki yeePaki zeSizwe zoMzantsi Afrika esingathwa rhoqo ngonyaka.

src: Tsena di ka fumanwa websaeteng ya Lefapha (WEBTOKEN).
tgt: (iSANParks).

src: Kabinete e fetisa molaetsa wa tshehetso masoleng a Lebotho la Naha la Tshireletso la Aforika Borwa, a isitsweng Rephaboliking ya Demokrasi ya Congo nakong ya la 13 Phuptjane 2013 ho ya ho 31 Hlakubele 2014.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza bonke abazali nabagcini babantwana ngokusemthethweni ukuba baxhase abantwana babo kumalungiselelo azayo oHlolo loNyaka lweSizwe (ANA) kubuchule bokufunda nokubhala kunye nezibalo olubanjwa phakathi komhla we-10 nowe-13 kweyoMsintsi kowama-2013.

src: MaAforika Borwa a kopjwa ho tshehetsa le ho ananela masole ana a etsang mosebetsi wa bohlokwa o phethahatsang boikitlaetso ba Aforika Borwa ba kgotso, botsitso le matlafatso ya demokrasi kontinenteng ya Aforika.
tgt: Abazali nabagcini babantwana ngokusemthethweni kufuneka baqinisekise ukuba bayaxoxa ngeziphumo ze-ANA zowama-2013 njengoko oku kusebenza njengesixhobo sokuxilonga amandla okufunda nobubhetyebhetye babafundi.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa dikgiro tsa Mopresidente tsa Ntate Mxolisi Sandile Oliver Nxasana e le Motsamaisi e Moholo Botjhotjhising ba Setjhaba ba Naha le Vasantri Soni (SC) e le Hlooho ya Yuniti e Ikgethileng ya Dipatlisiso.
tgt: Ekulungiseleleni i-ANA ezayo, abazali, abagcini babantwana ngokusethethweni nabafundi bayakhuthazwa ukuba basebenzise izixhobo abazinikwe liSebe lezeMfundo esiSiseko.

src: Kabinete e lakaletsa setjhaba sa Majuda a Aforika Borwa Rosh Hashanah e monatenate (5-6 Loetse 2013).
tgt: Zona zingafunyanwa kwiwebhusayithi yeSebe kule dilesi: (WEBTOKEN).

src: Rosh Hashanah e na le tshusumetso ya bohlokwa setjhabeng sa Majuda hobane e bontsha qalo ya mosebetsi wa boitlhahlobo le boitekolo eo sethatho sa yona e leng Yom Kippur, Letsatsi la Tshwarelano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa umyalezo wenkxaso kumajoni oMkhosi woKhuselo weSizwe woMzantsi Afrika atyalwe empuma yeDemocratic Republic of the Congo ukususela kumhla we-13 kweyeSilimela kowama-2013 ukuya kowama-31 kweyoKwindla wama-2014.

src: Kabinete e fetisa molaetsa wa matshediso ho Letona Mthethwa le ba lelapa labo ka ho hlokahallwa ke mmae, Mme Nurse Gumbi ka la 03 Loetse Dipuisano le diqeto tsa bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Kuhlatywa ikhwelo kubemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba baxhase kwaye banike ingqwalasela kula majoni abaluleke kangaka nanceda ekuqondiseni ngendlela uMzantsi Afrika ozinikele ngayo kuxolo, kuzinzo nasekomelezeni intando yesininzi kwizwekazi i-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e amohetse tlaleho ka diphetho tsa Sesebediswa sa Ditekolo tsa Tshebetso ya Bolaodi (MPAT) sa mafapha a naha le a diporofense bakeng sa selemo sa ditjhelete sa 2012/13.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana nokuqeshwa ngumongameli kukaMnu.

src: Tlaleho ke sesebediswa se seng se habileng ho ntlafatsa boleng ba ditshebeletso tseo mafapha a fanang ka tsona.
tgt: Mxolisi Sandile Oliver Nxasana njengoMlawuli weGunya-bantu loTshutshiso lweSizwe noVasantrai Soni (SC) njengeNtloko yeCandelo loPhando oluLodwa.

src: E lekola dibaka tse nne tse batsi tsa bolaodi e leng bolaodi ba phano ya disebediswa bolaodi ba basebetsi merero ya mawa mmoho le ntlafatso ya phano ya ditshebeletso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inqwenela uluntu lwamaJuda loMzantsi Afrika iRosh Hashanah emnandi kakhulu (ngomhla wesi-5 ukuya kowesi-6 kweyoMsintsi wama-2013).

src: Tekolo e etswa mehatong e meraro, boitekolo ka bowena ho latele tlhahlobo ya mosebetsi ya bohlakisi ba kahare ba dibuka tsa ditjhelete ho qetelwe ka ya ho lekolwa ke sehlopha se ikemetseng sa balekodi.
tgt: I-Rosh Hashanah inentsingiselo enzulu kuLuntu lwamaJuda kuba iqaphela inkqubo yesiqalo sokuzigocagoca nokucinga nzulu okukhokela nokuphelela kwiYom Kippur, kuSuku lweNtlawulelo.

src: Tlaleho e tla boela e tsenkollwa ke Lefapha la Bodisa le Tlhahlobo ya Tshebetso nakong ya ho thakgolwa ho seng ho hlophisitswe ha MPAT bekeng e tlang Cape Town.
