tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano kuMphathiswa uMthethwa nakusapho lwakhe ngokusweleka kukamama wakhe uNks Nurse Gumbi ngomhla wesi-3 kweyoMsintsi wama-20.

src: Kabinete e amohetse ya ba ya ananela ditlaleho tsa kotare ya pele ya 2013/14 ho kenngweng tshebetsong ha Ditumellano tsa Phano bakeng sa Diphetho.
tgt: Iingxoxo kunye nezigqibo zeKhabhinethi ezingundoqo IKhabhinethi ifumene ingxelo ngeziphumo zeSixhobo sokuHlola uLawulo lokuSebenza (MPAT) yamasebe kazwelonke nawamaphondo kunyaka-mali wama-2012/13.

src: Ditlaleho tsena di tla tsenkollwa nakong ya lethathamo le rerilweng la dipuisano le ba mehlodi ya ditaba bakeng sa se seng le se seng sa Diphetho tse Kabinete e bone tlaleho e tswang ho ‘Projeke ya ho Tloswa ha Lesedi le Lebe la Sekoloto’ mme ya ananela ditshisinyo tsa Komiti e Kgethehileng ya Kgwebisano le Dikamano tsa Matjhaba.
tgt: Le ngxelo sesinye isixhobo esifuna ukuphucula umgangatho weenkonzo ezibonelelwa ngamasebe.

src: Sena se habile ho rarolla qaka ya phihlello ya sekoloto ho maAforika Borwa ao a ka kgonang sekoloto.
tgt: Sihlola imimandla emine nebanzi yolawulo eyile ulawulo lothungelwano lwemisebenzi ulawulo lwabasebenzi isicwangciso sobuchule nokuphuculwa kokuhanjiswa kweenkonzo.

src: Bana ke bareki bao e ka nnang yaba ba qetile ho lefa dikoloto tsa bona ka botlalo mme ba boemong boo ba ka kgonang sekoloto empa hajwale, phihlello ya bona e hakureditswe ke lesedi le lebe la sekoloto direkotong tsa bona.
tgt: Uhlolo lwenziwa kumanqanaba amathathu, elokuzihlola ize ibe yinkqubo ehlolwa luphicotho-zincwadi lwangaphakathi ekugqibeleni ibe luhlolo olwenziwa liqela labahloli abazimeleyo.

src: Sena se habile ho netefatsa hore Molao wa Naha wa Sekoloto (Molao 34 wa 2005) o sebetsa ho ya kamoo o rerilweng ka teng ho netefatsa hore bareki ba ka kgonang sekoloto ba se ke ba kolotelwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ifumene yaze yaphumeza iingxelo zekota yokuqala zowama-2013/14 ezingofezekiso lweZivumelwano zokuHanjiswa kweZiphumo.

src: Phihlello mmarakeng wa sekoloto wa nako e telele e a hlokeha sepheong sohle sa ntshetsopele.
tgt: Ezi ngxelo ziza kucazululwa ngexesha lothotho olucwangcisiweyo lwamagqabantshintshi koonondaba ngeSiphumo ngasinye kwezili-12.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Pampiri e Tshweu ya ho Busetsa Ditlamong esita le ho tekwa ha yona Palamenteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphele ingxelo ‘yeProjekthi yokuSuswa kweeNkcukacha zeNtengo ngeTyala eziChaseneyo’ yaze yaphumeza izindululo zeKomiti ejongene neMicimbi yoRhwebo neNtsebenziswano yaMazwe ngamazwe.

src: Moralo wa nakwana wa Pampiri e Tshweu o habile ho ntlafatsa ho laolwa ha mokgwatshebetso wa ho emela ho bua nyewe motho a le ditlamong ditjhankaneng tsa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Le ngxelo ijonge ukushukuxa umba wokufikelela kwintengo ngetyala kwabemi boMzantsi Afrika abanako ukuhlawula ityala.

src: Pampiri e hlakisa mekgwatshebetso e tla susumetsa bolaodi ba ditlamong ba ho busetsa ditlamong.
tgt: Aba ngabathengi mhlawumbi abawahlawula ngokupheleleyo amatyala abo kwaye ngoku bakwimeko apho bangathi babenako ukulihlawula ityala kodwa abakwazi ukufikelela ngenxa yeenkcukacha zentengo ngetyala ezisemagameni abo ezenza ukuba bangavunyelwa bathenge ngetyala kwakhona kuba babonwa njengabangathembekanga.

src: Kabinete e tshehetsa ho senngwa ha thepa ya sehlopha sa dihlomo e le ho ikamahanya le Mmoka ona.
tgt: Okubalulekileyo kukuba oku kuqinisekisa ukuba uMthetho weNtengo ngeTyala weSizwe, uMthetho Nombolo wama-34 wama-2005 usebenza ngokweenjongo zawo ukuqinisekisa ukuba abathengi abanakho ukulihlawula ityala bangakwazi ukulenza.

src: Ka Pudungwana ya 2006 seboka sa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) ha se a ka sa fihlella tumellano ya kamoo sefutho sa botho sa ho rarolla bothata ba dihlomo tsena se leng kateng.
tgt: Ukungafikeleli okanye intengo ngetyala exabisa kakhulu ithintela uhlumo.

src: Sena se ile sa lebisa moo sehlopha sa dinaha tse 46, ho akga le Aforika Borwa, se ileng sa eba motjheng o mong o kathoko ho UN, o bitswang Mosebetsi wa Oslo, ho kwala sehlopha sa dihlomo.
tgt: Ukufikelela kwintengo ngetyala kubaluleke kuzo zonke iinjongo zophuhliso.

src: Aforika Borwa mmoho le dinaha tse ding tse 93 e tekenne Mokgwatshebetso ka Tshitwe ya 2008.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume iPhepha loMgaqo-nkqubo lokuMiswa kwetyala useluValelweni nokwaziswa kwalo ePalamente.

src: Mokgwatshebetso o kwala tshebediso, tlhahiso, poloko ya thepa le phetiso ya mofuta o itseng wa sehlopha sa dihlomo.
tgt: Iphepha loMgaqo-nkqubo eliyilwayo lijonge ukuphucula ulawulo lwenkqubo yokuvalelwa kwabalinde ukuxoxa ityala kwiintolongo zoMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kananelo ya Mokgwatshebetso e tsamaisana le boikitlaetso ba Aforika Borwa ba ho boloka ditokelo tsa botho le molao wa botho ha e sebetsana le dintwa.
tgt: Eli phepha lizoba imithetho-siseko eza kunyanzelisa ulawulo lokuvalelwa kwabo bavalelwe besalinde ukuxoxa amatyala abo.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha tlaleho ya Tlhahlobo ya Dibuka tsa Ngodiso ya Mobu wa Mmuso le tshekatsheko e sa tebang ya Boithuelo ba Poraefete ba Mobu Aforika Borwa, e entsweng ke Mohlahlobikakaretso e Moholo wa tsa Mobu, Palamenteng.
tgt: Le ngxelo iza kukhutshwa ngokulandela iinkqubo zasePalamente.

src: Lesedi le mabapi le mobu le bohlokwa haholo dintshetsopeleng tsohle tse amanang le mobu naheng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yavuma ukuba iNkomfa yeQela engeziXhobo zemfazwe eziNinzi eziHlasela ngexesha elinye ithunyelwe ePalamente ukuze iphunyezwe.

src: Sepheo sa tlhahlobo ya dibuka tsa ngodiso ya mobu wa mmuso ke ho fumana hore na mmuso o na le mobu o mokae, o sebedisetswa eng le hore na basebedisi ba wona ke bomang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ixhasa ukutshatyalaliswa kweentlobo-ntlobo zezixhobo zemfazwe eziselugcinweni zeqela ukuthobela imithetho yale Nkomfa.

src: Sena se tla sebedisetswa ho ntlafatsa botshepehi ba rejistara ya mobu, e tla sebetsa e le motheo bakeng sa thero le tsamaiso tsa mobu tse ntlafaditsweng, ho akga le mesebetsi e meng e amanang le bolaodi ba tshebetso ya thepa esita le phano e ntlafaditsweng ya ditshebeletso.
tgt: Oku kwakhokelela kwiqela lamazwe angama-46, kuquka uMzantsi Afrika, elathi laqalisa inkqubo ngaphandle kwe-UN, ebizwa ngokuba yi-Oslo Process, yokuyeka ukusetyenziswa kwezixhobo zemfazwe ezininzi ezihlasela ngexesha elinye.

src: Kabinete e ananetse metako ya Khamphane ya Popo ya Tjhelete Aforika Borwa bakeng sa lethathamo la sehopotso sa tjhelete e lewana ya 24 ct ya kgauta ya R2 ya 2013 (1/4 oz) le lethathamo la sehopotso sa tjhelete e lewana ya 24 ct ya kgauta ya R1 (1/10 oz).Motako wa tjhelete e lewana ya kgauta ya R2 ya 2013 o tla ngolwa ka puo ya Sekgothu athe motako wa tjhelete e lewana ya kgauta ya R1 ya 2013 e tla ba tlhoka ya boraro – Mohlampepe wa Ditholwana.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika kunye namanye aMazwe angama-93 batyikitya iSivumelwano kweyoMnga wama-2008.

src: Metako ya tjhelete e lewana mmoho le Mahlalosi a tsona di tla hatiswa Koranteng ya Melawana ya Mmuso.
tgt: Ngomhla woku-1 kweyeThupha yowama-2010 iSivumelwano saba sisinyanzeliso.

src: Kamorao ho moo, di tla etswa mme di rekiswe ka metjha e tlwaelehileng.
tgt: Isivumelwano siphelisa ukusetyenziswa, ukuveliswa, ukugcinwa nokugqithiselwa kweendidi ezithile zezixhobo zemfazwe.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha ditlaleho tse tharo tse amanang le kgatelopele e entsweng tshireletsong ya ditokelo le bophelo bo botle ba bana Komiting ya Matjhaba a Kopaneng ya Ditokelo tsa Ngwana le Komiti ya Boqhetseke ya Kopano ya Aforika.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweNkomfa kuyahambisana nezibophelelo zoMzantsi Afrika zokugcina amalungelo oluntu nomthetho wobulungisa xa kusiliwa imfazwe.

src: Ditlaleho di fana ka monyetla wa bohlokwa o nang le ponaletso bakeng sa Aforika Borwa ho sekaseka kgatelopele eo e seng e e entse dintlheng tsenaa) Tlaleho ya Naha ka Prothokhole e sa Tlameng ka Thekiso ya Bana, Bootswa ba Bana le ho Nyweka ha Bana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yavuma ukufakwa kwengxelo engoPhicotho loMhlaba kaRhulumente oBhalisiweyo nohlalutyo lwe-desktop kuBumnini boMhlaba waBucala eMzantsi Afrika, nguMvavanyi Jikelele oyiNtloko, ePalamente.

src: Kabinete e leboha lethathama la mekgatlo ya setjhaba ka boikitlaetso esita le balekane ba matjhaba ba ikopantseng le mmuso ka ho hlokomela boikitlaetso bo entsweng ke Molaotheo wa rona baneng.
tgt: Injongo yokupicotha umhlaba karhulumente obhalisiweyo kukuqinisekisa ukuba ungakanani ongokarhulumente, usetyenziselwa ntoni kwaye ngubani ohlala kuwo/owusebenzisayo.

src: Bili e hlomathisa Molao wa Pusetso ho eketsa letsatsi la ho qetela bakeng sa ho kenngwa ha ditseko tsa pusetso ya mobu ho ya fihla ho la 31 Tshitwe 2018 ho etsetsa hore e be tlolo ya molao ho kenngwa ha tseko ka bolotsana nolofatso ya tsamaiso bakeng sa ho kgethwa ha Baahlodi Lekgotleng la Ditseko tsa Mobu esita le ho hlomathiswa ha dikarolwana tse itseng tse reretsweng ho kgothalletsa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Molao ka bokgabane.
tgt: Oku kuza kusetyenziswa ukuncedisa ekumiseleni isidima sencwadi ekubhaliswe kuyo wonke umhlaba, neza kusebenza njengentsika yokuncedisa ucwangciso nolawulo lomhlaba, kuquka eminye imisebenzi enxulumene nolawulo lwezemihlaba nokuziswa kweenkonzo.

src: Ho bulwa botjha ha ho kenngwa ha ditseko ho tataiswa ke tjhebelopele ya Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP) esita le Lenaneo le Phethahetseng la Ntshetsopele ya Dibaka tsa Mahaeng le mawa a mang a kgolo a reretsweng ho kgothalletsa poelano ya setjhaba le momahano ya setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yavuma uyilo loShicilelo lweengqekembe zemali yoMzantsi Afrika lowama-2013 R2 (1/4 oz) uthotho lweengqekembe zegolide yesikhumbuzo zama-24 ct olusisikhumbuzo nolwama-2013 R1 (1/10 oz) uthotho lweengqekembe zegolide zama-24 ct zesikhumbuzo.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya Sehlomathiso ya Melao ya Saense le Theknoloji, 2013 Palamenteng.
tgt: Uyilo lwengqekembe yegolide exabisa R2 lwama-2013 luza kuqaqambisa ulwimi lamaSAN luze uyilo lwengqekembe yegolide exabisa R1 lowama-2013 noluza kuba lolwesithathu ushicilelo luqaqambise iLulwane lesiQhamo.

src: Bili ya Sehlomathiso e sebetsana le dihlomathiso tsa lethathama la Melao e laolang tshebetso ya ditheo (makgotla a saense) tse neng di thewe ho ya ka Melao eo.
tgt: Uyilo lwezi ngqekembe kunye neziBhengezo zalo ziza kubhalwa kwiPhepha likaRhulumente elibizwa ngokuthi yi-Government Gazzette.

src: Bili e habile ho nolofatsa mosebetsi wa ho thonngwa le ho kgethwa ha ditho esita le ho kwalwa ha dikgeo Dibotong kapa Makgotleng a ditheo tseo.
tgt: Emva koko ziza kuveliswa zize zithengiswe ngamajelo aqhelekileyo.

src: Bili e ntlafatsa tshebetso e ntle le tshwano mosebetsing le taolong ya ditheo tsa setjhaba tse tlalehang ho Letona la Saense le Theknoloji.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yavuma ukufakwa kwiKomiti ye-UN yamaLungelo oMntwana neKomiti yeNgcali zeManyano ye-Afrika iingxelo ezi-3 ezinxulumene nenkqubela eyenziweyo ekufumaneni amalungelo nentlalo-ntle yabantwana.

src: Ho matlafatseng seabo sa tekolo sa Palamente, Bili e habile ho lokolla Palamente boikarabelong bo itseng ba phethahatso bo amanang le ho kgethwa ha ditho esita le ho kwalwa ha dikgeo Dibotong tseo kapa Makgotleng ao.
tgt: Ezi ngxelo zibonelela ngethuba eliselubala nelibalulekileyo kuMzantsi Afrika ukuba uhlole inkqubela oyenzileyo kule mimandla:	a) INgxelo yeLizwe kuMgaqo wokuziKhethela kwiNtengiso yaBantwana, ubuHenyu obuqhutywa kusetyenziswa aBantwana naManyala akwaqhutywa kusetyenziswa aBantwanab) Ingxelo yesibini, eyesithathu neyesine ezidityanisiweyo zeNkomfa ye-UN yamaLungelo oMntwana.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho phatlalatswa ha Bili ya Ditaba tsa Setso Koranteng Melawana ya ya Mmuso bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba.
tgt: UMqulu we-Afrika ongamaLungelo neNtlalo-ntle yoMntwana: Ingxelo yokuqala yeLizwe kwiKomiti yeNgcali zeManyano ye-Afrika ngamaLungelo neNtlalo-ntle yoMntwana.

src: Bili e fana ka dintlha tsa molao bakeng sa kananelo ya Bakgothu ebile e rarolla bothata ba ho kgoneha molaong o seng o le teng o amanang le boetapele ba setso le puso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibulela uthotho lwemibutho yoluntu yasekuhlaleni ezinikezeleyo namaqabane amazwe ngamazwe asebenzisana norhulumente ekufezekiseni izibophelelo kubantwana ezikuMgaqo-siseko wethu.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Moralo wa Tjhebobotjha ya Leano la Molao wa Naha wa Sekoloto le Bili ya Sehlomathiso ya Naha ya Sekoloto bakeng sa ho tekwa Palamenteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yavuma ukufakwa koMthetho-Sihlomelo wamaLungelo okuBuyiselwa koMhlaba.

src: Molao wa Naha wa Sekoloto, 2005 (Molao 34 wa 2005) o kene tshebetsong ka botlalo ka la 1 Phuptjane 2007 mme wa hlahisa boemo bo botjha ba ditaolo tsa sekoloto tshebetsong ya molao ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lo Mthetho oYilwayo uhlomela uMthetho woBuyiselo ukuze kubhekeliswe 2875 453 umhla wokufakwa kwamabango okubuyiselwa umhlaba kude kube ngumhla wama-31 kuDisemba wama-2018 ukwenziwa ibe lulwaphulo-mthetho ukufakwa kwebango lobuqhinga ukwenziwa lula kwenkqubo yokonyulwa kweJaji kwiNkundla yaMabango oMhlabo kunye nesihlomelo sezibonelelo ezithile ezijolise ekukhuthazeni ukuqalisa kokusebenza kwalo Mthetho kakuhle.

src: Sepheo sa Bili ke ho matlafatsa bokgoni ba Molaodi wa Naha wa Sekoloto (NCR) ho rarolla diphephetso tse itseng haholoholo mabapi le mesebetsi ya lekgotla la dinyewe esita le ho matlafatsa ho qobella le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha dikateng tsa Molao wa Naha wa Sekoloto wa 34 wa 2005.Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Indasteri (dti) le lona le qetile ka hore moralo wa leano wa Sekoloto sa Bareki, moo Molao wa Naha wa Sekoloto wa 34 wa 2005 o fumanweng teng, o motle ebile o nepahetse.
tgt: Ukuvulwa ngokutsha kokufakwa kwamabango kukhokelwa ngumbono weSicwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe kwakunye neNkqubo yoPhuhliso lwaMaphandle ngokuBanzi nezinye izicwangciso zobuchule zokukhula ekujongwe ukukhuthaza uxolelwaniso lwesizwe nentlalo-ntle ngazo.

src: Sena se latela tjhebobotjha e phethahetseng ya 2012, e entsweng ke dti.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yavuma ukwaziswa koMthetho weNzululwazi noBugcisa, uMthetho-siHlomelo wama-2013 kwiPalamente.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya Sehlomathiso ya ho Nka Qeto ka Tefo ya Meputso ya Ditho tsa Ditaba tsa Ditheo tsa Molaotheo, 2013.Sepheo sa Bili ke ho thea tshwano mabapi le ho nka qeto ka tefo ya meputso, melemo e fumanwang mosebetsing le melawana e meng le dipehelo tsa kgiro ya ditho tsa ditheo tsa Kgaolo ya 9, moo e matlafatsang tshebetso e ntle le tshwano mesebetsing ya puso ditheong tsena tsa bohlokwa.
tgt: UMthetho-siHlomelo ujongene nezihlomelo zokuphuculwa kweMithetho elawula ukusebenza kwamaqumrhu karhulumente (amabhunga enzululwazi) awasekwa ngokweMithetho ekhankanyiweyo.

src: Kabinete e ananetse kgiro ya Ntate Mokutule Joseph Kgobokoe mosebetsing wa Motlatsi wa Motsamaisi e Moholo: Hlahisong e sa Kgaelleng ya Dijo le Ntlafatso ya Temo Lefapheng la Temo, Meru le Botshwasi ba Ditlhapi.
tgt: UMthetho oYilwayo ufuna ukufezekisa inkqubo yokumiswa nokunyulwa kwamalungu kwakunye nokuvalwa kwezithuba zomsebenzi kwiiBhodi okanye amaBhunga ala mashishini karhulumente.

src: Kabinete e ananetse kgiro ya Mme Zandile Yvonne Mathe mosebetsing wa Motlatsi wa Motsamaisi e Moholo: Meralo ya Motheo ya Mehlodi ya Metsi ya Naha e Lefapheng la Merero ya Metsi.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uqaqambisa imfezeko nokungagungqi ekusebenzeni nolawulo lwamashishini karhulumente anika ingxelo ngemisebenzi yawo kuMphathiswa wezeNzululwazi noBugcisa.

src: Kabinete e ananetse kgiro ya batho ba latelang e le ditho tsa boto tsa Eijensi ya Ntshetsopele ya Dibanka tse Kopaneng:a) Sethe Patricia Makhesha (Modulasetulo)b) Peter Koch (kgiro hape e le Motlatsi wa Modulasetulo)c) Venete Jarlene Kleind) Lufuno Nevondwee) Thabo Vaughan Shenxanef) Samuel Senalor Akrongg) David Ginsburgh) Renganayagee Kisten.
tgt: Ekomelezeni umsebenzi wokongamela wePalamente, uMthetho oYilwayo ufuna ukukhulula iPalamente kolunye uxanduva lokulawula isigqeba olunxulumene nokunyulwa kwamalunga nokuzaliswa kwezithuba zomsebenzi kwiiBhodi okanye kumaBhunga.

src: Kabinete e ananetse kgetho ya ditho tse latelang Lekgotleng la Diphuphutso tsa Temo ho ya ka karolo 9(1) ya Molao wa Diphuphutso tsa Temo, 1990 Molao wa 86 wa 1990 nakong e sa feteng dilemo tse tharo.
tgt: Oku kuhambelana nemithetho-siseko yoMgaqo-siseko yokwahlukana kwamagunya olawulo ngamacandelo ombuso azimeleyo.

src: a) Ntate Jonathan Winston Alexander Godden (o kgirilwe hape)b) Moprofesara Michael Jeffrey Kahn (o kgirilwe hape)c) Moprofesara Sibusiso Vil-Nkomo (o kgirilwe hape)d) Ngaka Joyce Chitja (o kgirilwee hape)e) Mme Wilna Jansen Van Rijssen (o kgirilwe hape)f) Mme Dudu Msomi (o kgirilwe hape)a) Ntate Mzolisi Dyasi (o kgirilwe hape)b) Moprofesara Frans J.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yavuma upapasho loMthetho oYilwayo weMicimbi yezeMveli kwiPhepha ezibhengezo likaRhulumente ukuze uluntu luphefumle.

src: Kabinete e dumellana le ho kgethwa ha batho ba latelang Lekgotleng la Matla a Taolo ya Indasteri ya Tshireletso ya Poraefete, nakong e sa feteng dilemo tse tharo:a) Ntate Daniel Claude Mojalefa Rathebe (Motlatsi wa Modulasetulo)b) Brigadier Cynthia Lindiwe Philison (Molekgotla)c) Ntate Benjamin Somangamane Ntuli (Molekgotla)d) Mme Nontokoza Mthembu (Molekgotla).
tgt: UMthetho oYilwayo ubonelela ngokusemthethweni ngokwamkelwa kwamaKhoi-San kwaye ushukuxa unyino nemida yomthetho olawulayo ngokuphathelele kubunkokeli bemveli nolawulo.

src: Kabinete e ananetse keketso ya nako ya konteraka ya kgiro ya Ngaka Vuyelwa Nhlapo e le Mohlanka e Moholo wa Phethahatso wa Eijensi ya Ntshetsopele ya Naha, bakeng sa sehla sa dilemo tse pedi ho tloha mohla la 1 Loetse 2013 ho ya ho la 31 Phato 2015.
tgt: Ukususela kowe-1994 urhulumente unike ingqalelo imingeni enxulumene namaKhoi-San kwaye ngokukodwa, ulwamkelo loluntu lwamaKhoi-San neenkokheli zawo.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho hirwa ha Ntate Mokadi Max Mathye e le Mohlanka e Moholo wa Phethahatso wa Lekala la Matla a Thuto le Thupelo la Dijo le Dino.
tgt: Lo Mthetho oYilwayo uza kubanegalelo kokujoliswe kuko okungundoqo kwiSicwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe ngokunxulumene nokwandiswa kwentlalo-ntle nobunye lo gama kushukuxwa ukungalingani kwexesha elidlulileyo.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho kgethwa hape ha ditho tseo tse tiisitseng ka boteng ba tsona ho tswelapele ho sebetsa Lekgotleng la Ntshetsopele ya Basebetsi la Aforika Borwa ho tloha ka Loetse 2013 ho ya ho Phato 2018.Motlatsi wa Mopresidente Kgalema Motlanthe ke modulasetulo wa lekgotla lena la boeletsi le makala a mangata le nang le Matona a 13 a dulang ka nako tsohle a bile a emetse mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yavuma isiKhokelo-nkqubo semithetho-siseko yoHlaziyo loMthetho weSizwe weNtengo noMthetho Sihlomelo weNtengo yeSizwe ukuba waziswe ePalamente.

src: Le boetse le na le baemedi ba tswang lehlakoreng la kgwebo le la basebetsi, barutehi, setjhaba le ditho tse hoketsweng morao.
tgt: UMthetho weNtengo weSizwe, wama-2005 (uMthetho Nombolo wama-34 wama-2005) waqalisa ngokupheleleyo ngowoku-1 kweyeSilimela wama-2007 usazisa ixesha elitsha lemimiselo yentengo kwinkqubo yomthetho yaseMzantsi Afrika.

src: 23 Sep Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa bohlokwa maemong a ha jwale.1 Tlasa boetapele ba Mopresidente Jacob Zuma, mmuso o sebetsa ka lenaneo la naha la meralo ya motheo ya setjhaba la ditrilione tse ngata ngata tsa diranta le reretsweng ho utolla menyetla ya mesebetsi le ho tlisa ditshebeletso ho maAforika Borwa ohle.
tgt: 23 Sep Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba ebalulekileyo kwiimeko ezigqubayo nezingundabamlonyeni.1 Phantsi kobunkokheli bukaMongameli uJacob Zuma, urhulumente uqalisa inkqubo yezisekelo ezingundoqo zoluntu exabisa izigidi zetriliyoni ejoliswe ekuvuleleni amathuba emisebenzi nokuzisa iinkonzo kubemi bonke boMzantsi Afrika.

src: Ka mananeo ana, mmuso o tsitlallela boikitlaetsong ba wona ba ho thea mesebetsi e mengata le ho feta.
tgt: Ngezi nkqubo urhulumente unikezela ngeenkonzo kwisibophelelo sakhe sokudala amathuba emisebenzi emininzi.

src: Haesale ho tloha kananelong ya Mokgwa o Motjha wa Kgolo mesebetsi e eketsehile ka 750 000, mme katlasenyana ho halofo ya mesebetsi ena e hlahisitswe tshebeletsong ya setjhaba, haholoholo basebetsing ba tsa bophelo bo botle, matitjhere le mapolesa.
tgt: Ukusukela kwathi kwamkelwa uMgaqo-nkqubo weNdlela eNtsha yoHlumo lwezoQoqosho imisebenzi yande ngama-750 000, ngaphantsi nje kwesiqingatha sale misebenzi, iveliswe kwicandelo leenkonzo zabasebenzi, ingakumbi phakathi kwezikhundla zabasebenzi bezempilo, ezootitshala nezamapolisa.<Ezi nkqubo zibeka phambili uphuhliso lwamashishini amancinci alicandelo elibalulekileyo lokuvula amathuba ezoqoqosho.

src: Mananeo ana a bea ntshetsopele ya dikgwebo tse nyenyane ka sehloohong, e leng ntho ya bohlokwa ya ho utolla menyetla ya moruo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ombulelo kulo macandelo abehlulelani asebenzisana norhulumente ukuze kufezekiswe olu phuhliso lukhulu lweziseko ezingundoqo kwaye ihlaba ikhwelo lentsebenziswano ngakumbi yokukhawulezisa iinzame zokudala amathuba emisebenzi nokwenza inguqu kuqoqosho nakuluntu lwethu.

src: Kabinete e leboha makala ao a ikamahanyang le mmuso ho kenya tshebetsong lenaneo lena le leholohadi la ntshetsopele ya meralo ya motheo mme e etsa kgoeletso tshebedisanong ya ho potlakisa matsapa a ho thea mesebetsi le ho fetola moruo esita le setjhaba sa habo rona.
tgt: Njengenxalenye yokuqaliswa kweziseko ezingundoqo zoluntu uMongameli uJacob Zuma ngomhla wama-20 kweyoMsintsi uza kuba evula iSikhululo saMandla oMbane saseGrootvlei aze ahlole isiza solwakhiwo lomzila kaloliwe eMpumalanga.

src: Mopresidente Jacob Zuma o tla bula Seteishene sa Motlakase sa Grootvlei ka la 20 Loetse 2013 a be a hlahlobe le setsha sa kaho ya seporo sa terene kwana Mpumalanga, e le karolo ya boikitlaetso ba neelano ya meralo ya motheo ya setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhibethi iyakwamkela ukwakhiwa kweDyunivesithi i-Sol Plaatjie entsha eKimberley eMntla Koloni ekulindeleke ukuba luqalise phambi kokuba kuphele eyoMsintsi wama-2013.Esi sisiganeko esibalulekileyo kuhlumo nakuphuhliso lwecandelo lwezemfundo ephakamileyo yoMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e ananetse kaho ya Yunivesithi e ntjha ya Sol Plaatjie Kimberly, Kapa Leboya, e lebeletsweng ho qala pele ho mafelo a Loetse 2013.
tgt: Umsitho wokuphethulwa kwesoyi uphawule ukuqaliswa ngokusesikweni kokwakhiwa kweli ziko.

src: Ena ke katleho e kgolo kgolong le ntshetsopeleng ya lekala la thuto e phahameng Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Uphuhliso lwedyunivesithi entsha luchongiwe lwaze lwabekwa phambili kwakwiiProjekthi eziDityanisiweyo zesiCwangciso-qhinga (i-SIP 14) yiKomiti yokuQuquzelela iziSeko ezinguNdoqo kaMongameli (i-PICC).2 UMongameli uJacob Zuma kunye neKhabhinethi yakhe baza kunika imbeko kubemi abasebekhulile boMzantsi Afrika kwiNdlu yokwaMkela iiNdwendwe kaMongameli i-Sefako Makgatho ePitoli ngomhla wama-29 kweyoMsintsi yowama-2013.

src: Ketsahalo ya ho phethelwa ha mobu e bile sesupo sa ho thakgolwa ha kaho ya khamphase semmuso.
tgt: Oku kuyinxalenye yokubhiyoza igalelo elenziwe ngabemi abasebekhulile kuphuhliso loluntu nolwelizwe lethu.

src: Kaho ya yunivesithi e ntjha e ile ya hlwauwa yaba ya bewa ka sehloohong kahara Diprojeke tsa Lewa le Momahantsweng (SIP 14) ke Khomishene ya Mopresidente e Hlophisang Dikaho tsa Motheo (PICC).2 Mopresidente Jacob Zuma hammoho le Kabinete ya hae ba tla be ba tlotla metsofe ya Aforika Borwa Tlung ya Baeti ya Mopresidente ya Sefako Makgatho e Pretoria ka la 29 Loetse 2013.
tgt: Oku kuphawula isiqalo seVeki yabaNtu aBadala, ephela ngomhla we-6 kweyeDwarha, oluluSuku looMawokhulu.3 UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kuba esenza intetho kwiNgxongxo Jikelele yeSeshoni yama-68 yeNgqungquthela Jikelele yeZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UNGA68) eNew York ngomhla wama-24 kweyoMsintsi wama-2013.Umxholo walo nyaka uthi: “I-Ajenda yoPhuhliso eMva kowama-2015: Ukulungiselela iQonga!” neengqwalasela kwixesha elibekiweyo lowama-2015, kwiiNjongo zoPhuhliso zeMileniyam (ii-MDG) kwakunye ne-Ajenda yoPhuhliso ukuya phambili.

src: Sena se bopa karolo ya ho keteka seabo sa metsofe ya rona ntshetsopeleng ya setjhaba sa habo rona esita le ya naha.
tgt: I-UNGA68 ibonelela uMzantsi Afrika ngeqonga lokuqhubela phambili nendlela yethu yezicwangciso-qhinga ekufezekiseni ii-MDG ne-Ajenda yoPhuhliso eMva kowama-2015.

src: Sena e tla be e le sesupo sa qalo ya Beke ya Batho ba Baholo, e tla fela ka la 6 Mphalane, e leng Letsatsi la Bonkgono le Bontatemoholo.3 Mopresidente Jacob Zuma o tla tshetleha puo Ngangisanong e Akaretsang ya Phutheo ya bo68 ya Sebokakakaretso sa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UNGA68) New York ka la 24 Loetse 2013.
tgt: Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwethu nako kuza kuxhomekeka kwiimfunozesizwe nemiba ephambili, kwakunye nezibophelelo zethu zommandla nezelizwekazi.4 IKhabhinethi ikugxeka kakhulu ukonakaliswa ngabom kwegridi yombane ngabagwayimbi abangekho semthethweni okubangele ukuba kungabikho mbane kwiindawo eziseRhawutini.

src: Mookotaba wa monongwaha ke: “Lenanetsamaiso la Ntshetsopele la Kamora 2015: Ho Bula Sebaya!” mme o habile nakong e beilweng ya 2015 ya Maikemisetso a Ntshetsopele ya Dilemokete (MDGs), esita le Lenanetsamaiso la Ntshetsopele kamorao ho moo, ho ya pele.
tgt: Izenzo ezinjalo ezenzeka ngexesha ilizwe lisiya ngasekuzinziseni ukubonelelwa ngombane azinakho ukutyeshelwa kwaye kufuneka ziphathwe ngendlela yokuba umthetho udlale indima yawo.5 Ukukhutshwa kweeNkcukacha-manani zolwaPhulo-mthetho zeSizwe zoMzantsi Afrika zonyaka wama-2012/13 kuqinisekisa ngokutsha isiqinisekiso sethu sokuba xa sisebenza kunye siza kuyiphumeza injongo yethu yoluntu olungenalwaphulo-mthetho, olutsala utyalo-mali oluqinisekisa uxolo nozinzo kuluntu lwethu.

src: UNAG68 e fa Aforika Borwa lepatlelo la ho ntshetsapele mokgwa wa lewa la rona la ho fihlella di-MDG le Lenanetsamaiso la Ntshetsopele la Kamora 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubo bonke abadlali ndima ababalulekileyo ukuba bazibandakanye ngendlela eyakhayo nezi ziphumo.

src: Seabo sa rona se tla boela se susumetswa ke ditabatabelo le dintho tse ka sehloohong tsa Aforika Borwa, esita le boikitlaetso ba rona ba lebatowa le ba kontinente.4 Kabinete e seolla kahohlehohle ditshitiso tsa marangrang a motlakase, tse entsweng ke batho ba neng ba le seteraekeng se seng molaong, tse ileng tsa baka ho kgaoha ha phepelo ya motlakase dikarolong tsa Johannesburg.
tgt: URhulumente ukhupha ezi nkcukacha-manani kanye ngonyaka ngeenjongo zokubonelela uluntu ngolwazi oluhlaziweyo lomlo wokulwa nolwaphulo-mthetho elizweni, kananjalo nokuqwalasela ezinye izicwangciso-qhinga ezikhoyo ekulweni ulwaphulo-mthetho.

src: Diketso tse jwalo di ke ke tsa tlodiswa mahlo hodimo nakong ena eo naha e hahamallang botsitsong ba phepelo ya yona ya motlakase, mme di tlameha ho thibelwa kahohlehohle ka tshebediso ya molao.5 Ho ntshuwa ha Dipalopalo tsa selemo le selemo tsa 2012/13 tsa Ditlolo tsa Molao Aforika Borwa ho boela ho thasisetsa boitshepo ba rona ba hore ha re sebetsa mmoho re tla fihlella sepheo sa rona sa setjhaba se sa angweng ke ditlolo tsa molao, se hohelang matsete a netefatsang kgotso le botsitso dibakeng tsa rona.
tgt: Iinkcukacha-manani zolwaphulo-mthetho zikwasetyenziswa imihla yonke njengesixhobo sezolawulo ukukhokela izicwangciso zokusebenza kweNkonzo yezobuPolisa yaseMzantsi Afrika (i-SAPS).IKhabhinethi iyayincoma imizamo yokungadinwa kwabe-SAPS kunye nayo yonke imibutho ehleliweyo noluntu olusebenzisana norhulumente kumlo wokulwa nolwaphulo-mthetho.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho bohle ba amehang ho tshohla ka botebo diphumano tsena ka moya o motle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubo bonke abantu baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba bazibandakanye kumlo wokulwa nolwaphulo-mthetho.

src: Mmuso o ntsha dipalopalo tsena hang ka selemo ka sepheo sa ho fa setjhaba lesedi la moraorao twantshong ya ditlolo tsa molao, esita le ho sheba botjha mawa a jwale a ho lwantsha ditlolo tsa molao.
tgt: Xa sisebenzisana siza kuqinisekisa ngoMzantsi Afrika apho wonke ummi woMzantsi Afrika eziva ekhuselekile kwaye engenaxhala.6 IKhabhinethi ivakalise inkxalabo enkulu ngenyhikityha yeengozi zezithuthi zendlela yakutsha nje.

src: Dipalopalo tsa ditlolo tsa molao di boela di sebediswa kamehla e le sesebediswa sa ho tataisa merero ya ho sebetsa ya Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa sa Aforika Borwa (SAPS).Kabinete e thoholetsa matsapa a matla a SAPS le mekgatlo yohle e ipopileng esita le setjhaba ka ho sebedisana le mmuso twantshong ya ditlolo tsa molao.
tgt: Iingozi ezinjalo zishiye ezinye iintsapho zilambatha kwaye zinempembelelo embi enobuzaza kwezoqoqosho.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho ikamahanya le twantsho ya ditlolo tsa molao.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubo bonke abaqhubi beemoto ukuba baqinisekise ukuba iimoto zabo zikulungele ukusetyenziswa esitratweni kwaye baqiniseke ukuba banoxanduva xa beqhuba.

src: Ha re sebetsa mmoho re tla netefatsa boteng ba Aforika Borwa moo moAforika Borwa a tla ikutlwa a bolokehile a bile a tshireletsehile.6 Kabinete e bontshitse ho ngongoreha ho hoholo ka dikotsi tsa moraorao tsa mebileng tse mpempe.
tgt: Kangangokuba iKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo koogunyazisiwe bezendlela ukuba baqhubekeke ukungazinyamezeli tu izithuthi ezingalungelanga ukuba sezindleleni nokuqhuba phantsi kweempembelelo zotywala.

src: Dikotsi tse jwalo di siile malapa a mang a saretswe ebile di thefula moruo haholo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwahlaba ikhwelo kubahambi ngeenyawo bahloniphe imithetho yendlela.7 IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba babhiyozele uSuku lwaMagugu, lwama-24 kweyoMsintsi wama-2013 ngokutyelela amaziko awohlukahlukeneyo wamagugu wethu atyebileyo nawohlukileyo mbombo-zone zeli lizwe kubhiyozelwa imiNyaka yeNkululeko engama-20.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho beng bohle ba makoloi ho netefatsa hore makoloi a bona a boemong bo amohelehileng ba ho tsamaya mebileng ba be ba kganne ka boikarabelo.
tgt: Bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika, izikolo, amashishini noluntu bayacelwa baphephezelisele ibhanile yethu phezulu njengophawu lombhiyozo wethu wemiNyaka yeNkululeko engama-20 baze baxhase iphulo lika‘Lwesihlanu weNkululeko’ osungulwe ngowama-20 kweyoMsintsi wama-20.8 IKhabhinethi ivuyisana noLucas Sithole ngokuphumelela intshinga yabadlala bebanye yomdlalo wesitulo esinamavili kuMnyhadala weNtenetya obizwa i-US Open eNew York.

src: Kahoo Kabinete e ipiletsa ho balaola sephethephethe ho tswelapele ka ho se amohele ho hang makoloi a seng boemong bo amohelehileng ba ho tsamaya mebileng esita le ba kgannang ba tahilwe.
tgt: Isikhundla sehlabathi sikaSithole senyukele kwindawo yesibini kulandela uloyiso lwakhe, iyeyokuqala intshinga enkulu yeManyano yeNtenetya yeZizwe-ngezizwe ukuba iphunyelelwe ngumdlali wase-Afrika naseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e boela e ipiletsa ho ditaaso ho hlompha melao ya tsela.7 Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho keteka Letsatsi la Letlotlo la Botjhaba, 24 Loetse 2013, ka ho etela dibaka tse fupereng letlotlo la botjhaba bo sa tshwaneng naha ka bophara e le ho keteka Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho ya rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba baxhase abadlali abakhubazekileyo bethu abaqhubekeka besenza ilizwe lethu libe nebhongo ngokubonakalisa umdlalo wodidi lwehlabathi kwaye besikhuthaza sonke ukuba sifikelele kumaqondo aphezulu.9 IKhabhinethi yamkela iMbizo yokuPhuhliswa kwabaNtsundu kwezoQoqosho ngokuBanzi yeSizwe (i-BBBEE) ezakubanjwa usuka kowe-3 ukuya kowe-5 kweyeDwarha wama-2013 phantsi komxholo: “ImiNyaka eliShumi yokuXhotyiswa kwezoQoqosho”.Isixhobo somgaqo-nkqubo wokuPhuhliswa kwabaNtsundu kwezoQoqosho ngokuyimfuneko sisicwangciso-qhinga esibalulekileyo sohlumo olujongiswe ekwenzeni banzi isiseko sezoqoqosho selizwe ngokujolisa ekungalingani okuhlala kuyinto ebuthathaka kuqoqosho loMzantsi Afrika.

src: Ho kopjwa maAforika Borwa ohle, dikolo, dikgwebo le dibaka tsohle ho phahamisa folakga ya rona e le sesupo sa rona sa ho keteka Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho esita le ho tshehetsa letsholo la ‘Bolabohlano ba Tokoloho’ le kgakolwang ka la 20 Lwetse 20.8 Kabinete e thoholetsa Lucas Sithole ka ho hapa papadi e bapalwang ka bonngwe ke ba sebedisang dituloteti ya Thonamente ya Tenese ya Amerika New York.
tgt: Le mbizo iza kuhlola inkqubela-phambili yokufezekiswa kwe-BBBEE emva kwesikhumbuzo seminyaka eli-10 sukela kwathi kwamiselwa uMthetho we-BBBEE ngowama-2003.

src: Maemo a Sithole a lefatshe a nyolohile ka kgato e le nngwe hore e be wa bobedi kamora tlholo ena, eo e neng e le ya pele ya maemo a hodimo ya Setlamo sa Tenese ya Matjhaba bakeng sa moAforika ebile e le moAforika Borwa.
tgt: Abadlali ndima ababalulekileyo bamaQumrhu, abameli bemibutho yabasebenzi, amaqela opolitiko nemibutho yoluntu yasekuhlaleni iza kuthatha inxaxheba ekunikeni uMzantsi Afrika amalungelo okuphindaphindwa kathathu kophuhliso lwabantsundu kwezoqoqosho ngoMthetho ohlonyelweyo we-BBBEE noMgaqo wokuziPhatha kaKuhle we-BBBEE.10 IKhabhinethi iqhwabela izandla iSebe loPhuhliso lwezeNtlalo kwisicwangciso-qhinga sokuphucula ukuziswa kweenkonzo olubizwa iProjekthi Mikondzo eza kongeza ukufikelela kweenkonzo zezentlalo kwabahluphekileyo nabahlelelekileyo mbombo-zone zoMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ho tshehetse baatlelete ba rona ba holofetseng, ba tswelang pele ho etsa hore naha ya rona e be motlotlo ka ho intsha sehlabelo le ho re kgothatsa bohle hore re fihlelle ditabatabelo tsa rona.9 Kabinete e ananela Seboka sa Naha sa Motheo o Batsi wa Matlafatso ya ba Batsho Moruong (BBBEE) se tla tshwarwa ho tloha ka la 3 ho ya ho la 5 Mphalane tlasa mookotaba o reng: “Selemoshome sa Matlafatso Moruong”.Sesebediswa sa leano la Matlafatso ya ba Batsho Moruong hantlentle ke lewa la kgolo le reretsweng ho etsa hore motheo wa moruo wa naha o be batsi ka ho tsepamisa maikutlo tlhokehong ya tekano, e leng bofokodi bo boholo ba moruo wa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Ngexesha leNyanga yoPhuhliso lwezeNtlalo, iSebe loPhuhliso lwezeNtlalo likunye namaqurhu alo, i-Arhente yoKhuseleko lwezeNtlalo yoMzantsi Afrika ne-Arhente yoPhuhliso lweSizwe, liza kuqhubekeka nokuqalisa iProjekthi Mikondzo kwezona wadi zisokolayo ezili-1 300 kwiZithili zooMasipala ezingama-23 njengoko zichongiwe zaza zabekwa phambili yiKhabhinethi.11 IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bathathe inxaxheba kwiVeki yeMbizo yokuGqalisisa ezayo phakathi komhla we-7 nowe-13 kweyeDwarha kowama-2013.Kulandela impumelelo yeVeki yeMbizo yokuGqalisisa yeSizwe kweyeSilimela yowama-2013, le Veki yokuGqalisisa yesibini iza kubonelela ngeqonga iiNkokeli zezoPolitiko ukuba zizibandakanye ngakumbi noluntu.

src: Seboka se tla sekaseka kgatelopele ya ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha BBBEE kamora ho ketekwa ha dilemo tse 10 haesale ha na ho kgakolwa Molao wa BBBEE ka 2003.
tgt: Eli thuba libonelela abemi ngenye indlela ukuba badibane naMalungu eKhabhinethi, ukuze babhiyozele izinto abaphumelele kuzo baye bathethe ngemingeni esekuphunyezweni kweenkqubo zikarhulumente.

src: Setlamo sa ba amehang, baemedi ba mekgatlo ya basebetsi, mekga ya dipolotiki le mekgatlo ya setjhabeng ba tla ba le seabo ho kutlweng ha thasisetso ya boraro ya matlafatso ya ba batsho moruong ya Aforika Borwa, ka Molao wa BBBEE o hlomathisitsweng le Mekgwa e ntlafaditsweng ya Tshebetso e Ntle.10 Kabinete e thoholetsa Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba leanong la lona le letjha le ntlafaditsweng la phano ya ditshebeletso le bitswang Projeke ya Mikondzo, le tla atolla phihlello ya ditshebeletso tsa setjhaba ho ya bafutsaneng esita le bao ba kotsing dikgutlwaneng tsohle tsa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Iindawo neenkqubo zeVeki ziza kupapashwa xa sele kusondele ixesha.2 Iingxoxo kunye nezigqibo zeKhabhinethi ezingundoqo.1 IKhabhinethi iphumeze uMgaqo-Nkqubo weSizwe ongokuFumaneka koKutya neSondlo, isiCwangciso-qhinga sokuFumaneka koKutya neSondlo kwiMizi kunye nongenelelo lweMveliso yoKutya i-Fetsa Tlala.

src: Nakong ya Kgwedi ya Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba, Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba hammoho le ditheo tsa yona, Ejensi ya Tshireletso ya Setjhaba ya Aforika Borwa le Eiensi ya Ntshetsopele ya Naha, di tla tswelapele ho neelana ka ditshebeletso tsa Projeke ya Mikondzo mabatoweng a 1 300 a futsanehileng ka ho fetisisa ho Bomasepala ba Ditereke ba 23 jwaloka ha ba hlwailwe ba bile ba beilwe ka sehloohong ke Kabinete.11 Kabinete e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa ho ba le seabo Bekeng ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo ya Imbizo e tla ba dipakeng tsa la 7 le la 13 Mphalane 2013.Kamora katleho ya Beke ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo ya Imbizo e neng e le ka Phuptjane, Beke ya bobedi ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo e tla fana ka sebaya ho Dikokonono tsa Dipolotiki hore di boele di bontshane le setjhaba.
tgt: Uxhaswa zizicwangciso-qhinga zongenelelo ezithile ukuze kuhlaselwe imingeni yokunsilela kokutya emakhaya kwanokwandisa imveliso yokutya, ukuze kupheliswe indlala ngowama-2030.

src: Nako ena e fana ka monyetla o mong ho baahi hore ba buisane ba shebane mahlong le Ditho tsa Phethahatso, ho keteka dikatleho esita le ho rarolla diphephetso tsa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha mananeo a mmuso.
tgt: IsiCwangciso-qhinga neMveliso yoKutya i-Fetsa Tlala ziinkqubo eziphakathi kwaMasebe ngaMasebe axhasa lo Mgaqo-nkqubo.

src: Dibaka tseo ho tla kopanelwa ho tsona esita le lenaneo la beke di tla tsebiswa ha nako e atamela.
tgt: Kuza kubakho ukusungulwa okuzakwenziwa ukuze kucaciswe lo Mgaqo-nkqubo neeNkqubo.2 IKhabhinethi wamkele iNkqubo-sikhokelo yoMzantsi Afrika yokudibana noMbutho weNtsebenziswano kwezoQoqosho noPhuhliso (i-OECD) kwisithuba sowama-2013/14 – 2016/17.UMzantsi Afrika ufuna ukusebenzisa obu budlelwane ukuze uphumeze iinjongo ezintathu ezibalulekileyo:i) uhlumo lwezoqoqosho oluphezulu oluquka konke, imfuno yokuhlangabezana nentswela-ngqesho, ubuhlwempu nokungalinganiii) abasebenzi abanezakhono nabanakho ukusebenza, ukuxhasa kokunikezelwa kwamaxesha asikiweyo ophuhliso noiii) kuQhubela phambili ne-Ajenda yase-Afrika, apho uMzantsi Afrika uza kufuna ukusebenzisa kakhulu impembelelo ye-ajenda yehlabathi apho uqoqosho lwamazwe ase-Afrika lungaxhamlayo khona.

src: Dipuisano le diqeto tsa bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.1 Kabinete e ananetse ho kena dipakeng ha Leano la Naha Tshireletsong ya Dijo le Phepo, Lewa la Tshireletso ya Dijo le Phepo ya Malapeng esita le ho kena dipakeng ha Tlhahiso ya Dijo ya Fetsa Tlala.
tgt: Amazwe e-OECD ahlala elurhwebo olubalulekileyo noomahlulelane botyalo-mali kuMzantsi Afrika.

src: Leano la Naha le habile ho arabela diphephetsong tse ngata tse amanang le ho se be teng ha tshireletso ya dijo Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Kuqikelelwa ukuba amazwe e-OECD enza igalelo elingaphezulu kwama-65% kwiMveliso yaNgaphakathi iPhelele kwihlabathi jikelele ngowama-2011.Le ndlela ibonelela inkqubo-sokhokelo kumasebe karhulumente ukuze alawule ukuzibandakanya kwawo ngokwahlukeneyo ne-OECLe ntsebenziswano ixhotyisiweyo kurhulumente iza kubangela ukuba kubekho iinzuzo enokuxhanyulwa kangangoko kule ntsebenziswano.3 IMithetho eYilwayo.1 IKhabhinethi iphumeze uMthetho oYilwayo weRhafu yeNkuthazo yeNgqesho ukuba upapashwe ukuze uluntu luvakalise izimvo zalo ngawo.

src: Le tsheheditswe ke mawa a totobetseng a ho kena dipakeng e le ho rarolla diphephetso tsa dikgaello tsa dijo malapeng hammoho le ho eketsa tlhahiso ya dijo, ka sepheo sa ho fedisa tlala ka 2030.
tgt: Lo mthetho uyilwayo wazisa inkuthazo ejolise ingakumbi ekukhuthazeni abasebenzi ukuba baqeshe ulutsha olufuna imisebenzi nelinamava angabheke phi.

src: Lewa mmoho le Tlhahiso ya Fetsa Tlala ke mananeo a ho matlafatsa Leano a Kopanetsweng ke Mafapha.
tgt: Le nkuthazo yenye kwezininzi eza kuba phantsi kwesicwangciso-qhinga sikaRhulumente sokuqesha ulutsha kwaye iza kuhambelana neenkqubo esele zikho zikarhulumente.

src: Kgakolo e tla etsuwa ho qhoqholla Leano le Mananeo.2 Kabinete e ananetse Moralo wa dipuisano tsa Aforika Borwa le Mokgatlo wa Ntshetsopele ya Tshebedisanommoho Moruong (OECD) bakeng sa nako ya 2013/14-2016/17.Aforika Borwa e habile ho sebedisa selekane sena ho fihlella dipheo tse tharo tsa bohlokwa:i) kgolo ya moruo e phahameng e kenyeletsang bohle, e leng tlhokeho e kgolo ya ho rarolla tlhokeho ya mesebetsi, bofuma le ho hloka tekatekanoii) basebetsi ba nang le boqhetseke le bokgoni, ho tshehetsa neelano ya dipehelo tsa ntshetsopele ya naha leiii) ho Ntshetsapele lenanetsamaiso la Aforika moo meruo ya Aforika e ka folang molemo.
tgt: Irhafu yenkuthazo yengqesho yolutsha ijoliswe kubantu abatsha abangena kumrhibe wezemisebenzi nabamkela ngaphantsi kwabantu abahlawuliswa irhafu.

src: Dinaha tsa OECD di dula e le tsona balekane ba bohlokwa ba kgwebisano le matsete ho Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Ekwenzeni njalo, ijolisa kubantu abanesakhono esingabheke phi, abamkela imivuzo engabheke phi.

src: Ho hakanngwa hore dinaha tsa OECD di kentse letsoho ka sekgahla se fetang 65% ho Motjha wa Ntshetsopele ya Kgolo ka 2011 lefatsheng.
tgt: Inkuthazo iza kudala iimeko ezinceda ukudalwa kwamathuba emisebenzi kunye nokuphucula izithembiso zengqesho kubasebenzi abahleleleke njalo.

src: Mokgwa ona o fana ka moralo bakeng sa mafapaha a mmuso ho laola dipuisano tsa wona le OECTlhophiso ena e ntlafaditsweng mmusong, e tla thusa hore ho folwe melemo e metle ka ho fetisisa selekaneng sena.
tgt: Ukukhutshwa kwamagqabantshintshi okucwangcisiweyo kuza kuqhutywa ukuze kucaciswe uMthetho oYilwayo.2 IKhabhinethi iphumeze uMthetho oYilwayo weKomishoni yoLawulo lweMihlaba, wama-2013 ukuba khutshwe ukuze uluntu luvakalise izimvo zalo ngawo.

src: Dibili.1 Kabinete e ananetse Bili ya Meropotso ya Lekgetho la Mesebetsi e tla ntshwa hore setjhaba se tshwaele ka yona.
tgt: Phakathi kokunye, uMthetho oYilwayo wekoMishini yoLawulo lweMihlaba wama-2013 ujolise ekusekeni iKomishoni yoLawulo lweMihlaba.

src: Bili e teka meropotso haholoholo ka sepheo sa ho kgothaletsa bahiri ho hira batjha ba tsomang mesebetsi ba bile ba se na boiphihlelo bo bokaalo.
tgt: IKomishoni yoLawulo lweMihlaba kuza kufuneka igwebe kwiimbambano zobunini bemihlaba apho iziqinisekiso zobunini ezimbini okanye ezingaphezulu ezinokuthi zibe zikhutshelwe umhlaba omnye.

src: Moropotso ke enngwe ya dintho tse ngata tse welang tlasa bonamelo ba lewa la Mmuso la mesebetsi ya batjha mme le tla thusa ho tshehetsa maano a mmuso.
tgt: IKomishini kananjalo kuza kufuneka isungule ize igcine uvimba weenkcukacha obanzi karhulumente womhlaba karhulumente uwonke obhaliswe egameni lesebe kuquka nawo nawuphi na umhlaba karhulumente ocandiweyo ongabhaliswanga.3 IKhabhinethi iphumeze ukufakwa koMthetho oYilwayo woNcedo lwezoMthetho ukuba ufakwe ePalamente.

src: Meropotso ya lekgetho la mesebetsi ya batjha e tobile batho ba batjha ba qalang ho sebetsa mme ba amohela meputso e katlase ho sekepele sa lekeno la motho ka mong le pukutlwang lekgetho.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ujoliswe ekuguzulweni koMthetho woNcedo lwezoMthetho, we-1969 (uMthetho ongunombolo 22 we-1969) ngokwemeko ezigqubayo, ingakumbi ngexesha elitsha elilawulwa ngokomgaqo-siseko, nokwenza lula ngakumbi ukusetyenziswa kwawo.

src: Ka ho etsa jwalo, e tobile ba nang le tsebo e fokolang, ba amohelang meputso e tlase ba bile ba na le menyetla e fokolang ya ho fumana mesebetsi.
tgt: UMthetho oYilwayo ujoliswe ukuba uxhobise impumelelo yokusebenza nokuvelisa iziphumo ezifunwayo zoNcedo lwezoMthetho lwaseMzantsi Afrika, ezakuthi nayo ibe neziphumo zexesha elide ezintle kuluntu luphela.

src: Meropotso e tla thea maemo a matle a ho hlahisa mesebetsi le ho ntlafatsa menyetla ya mesebetsi bakeng sa basebetsi bao ba kotetsweng.
tgt: Ingadityaniswa nexesha elimiselweyo elibalulekileyo lokukhusela inkqubo yokhuseleko ekuhlaleni nokhuseleko lwasekuhlaleni lwabahluphekayo namanye amaqela ahlelelekileyo, nokuqondakala korhulumente ophuhlayo, okwaziyo nokufanelekileyo ophatha abemi bakhe ngesidima.4 IKhabhinethi iphumeze ukupapashwa koMthetho oYilwayo weMigaqo yezeMpilo yeZizwe-ngezizwe wama-2013, kwiPhephandaba loMbuso ukwazisa uluntu ukuba luvakalise izimvo zalo.

src: Ho tla tshwarwa pontshano e reretsweng ho qhaqholla Bili.2 Kabinete e ananetse Bili ya Moralo wa Khomishene ya Bolaodi ba Mobu, 2013, e tla ntshuwa bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele ka yona.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ujonge ukuguzula uMthetho weMigaqo yezeMpilo yeZizwe-ngezizwe we-1974 (uMthetho onguNombolo 28 we-1974) kwanokuquka iMigaqo yezeMpilo yeZizwe-ngezizwe wama-2005 kumthetho wesizwe.

src: Ho tse ding, Bili ya Khomishene ya Bolaodi ba Mobu, 2013, e habile ho thea Khomishene ya Bolaodi ba Mobu.
tgt: Imigaqo yezeMpilo yeZizwe -gezizwe (2005) ngumthetho wezizwe-ngezizwe onceda amazwe ukuba asebenze kunye ekuphuculeni ubomi neendlela zokuphila kwiziganeko ezibangelwe kukusasazwa kwezifo ehlabathini nezinye iingozi zempilo.5 IKhabhinethi iphumeze ukwaziswa koMthetho-sihlomelo waMayeza noLwelo oluNxulumeneyo wama-2012 ePalamente.

src: Khomishene ya Bolaodi ba Mobu e tla lebellwa ho diya kahlolo qhwebeshanong ya boithuelo ba mobu moo e ka nnang ya ba mangolo a mabedi kapa a fetang bobedi a boithuelo ba thepa a ntshitswe bakeng sa setsha se le seng.
tgt: Lo Mthetho-sihlomelo ulungisa uMthetho waMayeza noLwelo olunxulumeneyo we-1965 (uMthetho onguNombolo 101 we-1965) njengoko uhlonyelwe nguMthetho wama-72 wama-2008.Ukufikelela kumayeza akhuselekileyo, afikelelekayo nakhuselekileyo nakwizixhobo zonyango ezisemgangathweni yintsika ebalulekileyo yempilo yoluntu kwaye kunegalelo kwinzuzo yenjongo kaRhulumente yokwandisa ixesha lokuphila lwabemi boMzantsi Afrika.6 IKhabhinethi iphumeze ukupapashwa koMthetho oYilwayo woLawulo lokuThengiswa kweZiselo ezinoTywala wama-2013, kwiPhephandaba loMbuso ukwazisa uluntu ukuba luvakalise izimvo zalo.

src: Bili e reretswe ho ntlafatsa tshebetso e ntle ya Dithuso tsa Molao Aforika Borwa, moo kgabareng e tla ba le ditlamorao tse ntle setjhabeng ka kakaretso.
tgt: Utywala sisithintelo esikhulu ekufikeleleni kwisiphumo sikarhulumente sokuzuza ubomi obude nobunempilo kubantu bonke.

src: E ka nna ya amanngwa le dipehelo tsa mokgwa wa tshireletso ya setjhaba ka kakaretso le tshireletso ya setjhaba bakeng sa bafutsana le dihlophana tse ding tse e hlokang ka sebele, le kelohloko ya naha e ntseng e thuthua, e nang le bokgoni le boitshwaro bo botle ebile e tshwara baahi ba yona ka seriti.4 Kabinete e ananetse phatlalatso ya Bili ya Ditaolo tsa Matjhaba ho tsa Bophelo bo Botle, 2013, Koranteng ya Mmuso bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele ka yona.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ufuna ukunciphisa umonakalo onxulunyaniswa notywala ngokulawula ukuthengiswa iziselo ezinotywala.

src: Bili e habile ho hlakola Molao wa Ditaolo tsa Matjhaba ho tsa Bophelo bo Botle, 1974 (Molao wa 28 wa 1974) esita le ho kenyeletsa Ditaolo tsa Matjhaba ho tsa Bophelo bo Botle, 2005, ketsong ya melao ya naha.
tgt: Ngeli xesha urhulumente engenakho ukuvala ukuthengiswa kotywala kananjalo akanakho ukuvumela ngokusesikweni akhuthaze ukusetyenziswa kotywala ngokuvumela uluntu ingakumbi ulutsha ukuba lukholelwe ukuba ubomi babo buza kuphucuka ekubeni ngokwenene luza kuba nomphumela ongemhle.

src: Ditaolo tsa Matjhaba ho tsa Bophelo bo Botle (2005) ke molao wa matjhaba o thusang dinaha ho sebedisana e le ho pholosa maphelo le boiphediso kgahlanong le diketsahalo tse bakwang ke ho phasalla ha malwetse le dikotsi tse ding tsa bophelo bo botle matjhabeng.5 Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya Sehlomathiso sa Meriana le Meriana e Meng e Jwalo ka Yona, 2012, Palamenteng.
tgt: Olu ngenelelo akufunekanga lubonwe lulodwa kodwa njengenxalenye yamanyathelo apheleleyo karhulumente okunciphisa umonakalo onxulunyaniswa notywala.

src: Bili ya Sehlomathiso e hlomathisa Molao wa Meriana le Meriana e Meng e Jwalo ka Yona, 1965 (Molao wa 101 wa 1965) jwaloka ha o hlomathisitswe ke Molao wa 72 wa 2008.Phihlello merianeng ya boleng, e fihlellehang ebile e bolokehile mmoho le disebediswa tse thusang ho ntlafatsa bophelo bo botle ke tshiya ya bohlokwa bophelong bo botle ba setjhaba, mme e thusa ka ho kenya letsoho phihlellong ya maikemisetso a Mmuso a ho eketsa tebello ya ho phela halelele ha maAforika Borwa.6 Kabinete e ananetse ho phatlalatswa ha Bili ya Taolo ya Thekiso ya Dino tse Tahang, 2013, Koranteng ya Mmuso bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele ka yona.
tgt: Ukukhutshwa kwamagqabantshintshi okucwangcisiweyo kuza kuqhutywa ukuze kucaciswe uMthetho oYilwayo.7 IKhabhinethi iphumeze ukupapashwa kweMithetho eYilwayo emibini, yomibini ehlomela uMthetho waBantwana wama-2005, (uMthetho onguNombolo wama-38 wama-2005) njengoko uhlonyelwe nguMthetho wama-41 wama-2007 ngokweCandelo lama-75 loMgaqo-siseko neCandelo lama-76 ukuba uluntu luvakalise izimvo zalo.

src: Leha e le hore mmuso o ke ke wa kwala thekiso ya jwala, o boela o ke ke wa dumella kgothaletso ya ho nowa ha jwala ka ho dumella setjhaba, haholoholo batjha, ho dumela hore maphelo a bona a ka ntlafala haele hore bonneteng ho tla ba le ditlamorao tse mpe ho ba bangata.
tgt: Lo mthetho uyilwayo ufuna ukufakela inkcazelo yolwaphulo-mthetho yokwabelana ngesondo ukuqinisekisa ukuba nawuphi na umntu ofunyaniswe enetyala lwalo naluphi na ulwaphulo-mthetho njengoko lucaciswe kuMthetho sihlomelo (uLwaphulo-mthetho lokwaBelana ngesondo neMiba enxulumeneyo) woLwaphulo-mthetho onguNombolo 32 wama-2007, uthathwa njengongafanelekanga ukusebenza ngabantwana.

src: Ho kena dipakeng hona ha ho a tlameha ho bonwa e le pudumo ya seemanosi, empa e le karolo ya mekgwa e momahantsweng ke mmuso ho fokotsa thefuleho e amanang le jwala.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uhambelanisa isigwebo esithathwe yiNkundla yoMthetho noMgaqo-siseko sokubonelela ngophononongo lwezigwebo ezithathwe zijaji isigqibo sokususa nokubeka umntwana kwindawo ekhuselekileyo yokhathalelo lomntwana yexeshana ngomyalelo wenkundla nangaphandle kwayo kwakwixesha elithile elichaziweyo.

src: Ho tla tshwarwa pontshano e reretsweng ho qhaqholla Bili.7 Kabinete e ananetse ho phatlalatswa ha Dibili tse pedi, tseo ka bobedi ba tsona di hlomathisang Molao wa Bana, 2005 (Molao wa 38 wa 2005) jwaloka ha o hlomathisitswe ke Molao wa 41 wa 2007 ho ya ka Karolo ya 75 ya Molaotheo le Karolo ya 76, hore setjhaba se tshwaele ka tsona.
tgt: UMthetho-sihlomelo wesiBini waBantwana wama-2013 ujolise ukuqinisekisa ukuba bonke abantwana bayaxhamla kwiinkonzo nezibonelelo ezijoliswe ekuququzeleleni ufikelelo kukhuseleko nokhathalelo lwezentlalo nokudala inkqubo esebenzayo yezentlalontle yoluntu.

src: Bili e habile ho kenya tlhaloso ya tlolo ya molao ya motabo ho netefatsa hore motho ofe kapa ofe ya tshwaretsweng tlolo efe kapa efe ya molao ya motabo jwaloka ha e hlalositswe Sehlomathisong sa Molao wa Ditlolo tsa Molao (Ditlolo tsa Molao tsa Motabo le dintho tse Amanang le tsona), wa 32 wa 2007, o nkuwa a sa tshwaneleha ho sebetsa le bana.
tgt: Ukwafuna ukubonelela ngendawo ekhuselekileyo nekhuselayo yokubekwa kwabantwana abafunyaniswa bedinga ukhathalelo nokhuselo.4 Izikhundla.1 IKhabhinethi iphumeze ezi zikhundla zilandelayo kwiSebe leMicimbi yezaManzi:a) uMnu.

src: Bili e boetse e amanya Molao le kahlolo ya Lekgotla la Molaotheo e le ho fana ka tjhebobotjha ya molao ya qeto ya ho tlosa le ho bea ngwana tlhokomelong e bolokehileng ya nakwana ho le teng kapa ho le siyo taelo ya lekgotla la dinyewe ka nakwana e totobaditsweng.
tgt: uJohannes David Mahlangu kwisikhundla sikaSekela Mlawuli-Jikelele: IiNkonzo zeQumrhub) uMnu.

src: Bili ya Sehlomathiso ya Bobedi ya Bana, 2013, e reretswe ho netefatsa hore bana bohle ba fumana ditshebeletso le melemo e reretsweng ho nolofatsa phihlello tlhokomelong le polokeho setjhabeng, esita le ho thea mokgwa o sebetsang hantle wa thekolohelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: U-Anil Bijman Singh kwisikhundla sikaSekela Mlawuli-Jikelele: Imigaqo noThotyeloc) uNkszn uDeborah Gabaakelwe Mochotlhi kwisikhundla sikaSekela Mlawuli-Jikelele: UCwangciso neeNkcukacha.2 IKhabhinethi iphumeze ezi zikhundla zilandelayo kwiSebe lezeMisebenzi:a) uNkszn.

src: 10 Oct Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa bohlokwa maemong a ha jwale.
tgt: 10 Oct Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba ebalulekileyo kwiimeko ezigqubayo nezingundabamlonyeni.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho tekenwa ha Bili ya Tlhomathiso ya Melao ya Dipalangwang le Dintho tse Amanang le Yona hore e be molaong, esita le ho qhalwa ha maipiletso a e-toll (tefiso ya tshebediso ya mebila) a Setlamo se Hanyetsanang le Tefiso ya Tshebediso ya Mebila Ditoropong (Outa) kgahlanong le Eijensi ya Mebila ya Naha ya Aforika Borwa (Sanral) ho entsweng ke Lekgotla le Phahameng la Maipiletso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkela ukutyikwa koMthetho-siHlomelo wezoThutho neMiba eNxulumeneyo nayo nguMongameli uJacob Zuma kwakunye nokuchithwa kwesibheno seManyano eChasene nokuRhafelwa kweeNdlela eziDolophini (i-Outa) kwiphulo layo lokuchasa i-e-toll ye-Arente yeSizwe ejongene neeNdlela yaseMzantsi Afrika yiNkundla ePhakamileyo yeziBheno (i-Sanral).IKhabhinethi ikholelwa ukuba oku kutsha kuvelayo ngoku kuvumela abantu baseGauteng nabemi boMzantsi Afrika ngokubanzi baqwalasele kwizinto eziluncedo esele sizizuzile – nezo siza kuzizuza – ekuphuculeni oohola bendlela kumbindi wezoqoqosho woMzantsi Afrika nowe-Afrika eseMazantsi.

src: Kabinete e kgolwa hore jwale dikgatelopele tsena di dumella batho ba Gauteng le maAforika Borwa ka kakaretso ho tsepamiso maikutlo melemong eo re seng re e fumane – esita le eo re leng boemong ba ho e fumana – dintlafalong tsa mebila e meholo kgubung ya moruo wa Aforika Borwa le Aforika e ka Borwa.
tgt: Inkqubo yokurhafelwa kwendlela (i-e-tolling) ngomnye umba weProjekthi yokuPhucula uHola wendlela yaseGauteng exhobise ukuhamba kwabantu nemithwalo kwaye iza kwenza uqoqosho lwephondo nolwesizwe lube namandla ngakumbi kwixesha elizayo.

src: Mokgwa wa tefiso mebileng ke ntho e le nngwe ya Projeke ya Ntlafatso ya Mebila e Meholo Gauteng e nolofaditseng ho tsamaya ha batho le thepa mme e tla etsa hore moruo wa porofense le wa naha o sebetse hantle kamoso.
tgt: Izintlu zamaxabiso e-e-toll ancitshiswe ngenxa yoluvo loluntuabakhweli abahluphekayo babonelelwe ngokukhululwa kwabaqhubi bezithuthi zikawonkewonke ekuhlawuleni imirhumo ye-toll intlawulo yenyanga eqingqiweyo yazisiwe, nenkqubo yesaphulelo semali ikhona kwiinkampani zezithuthi.

src: Ditefiso tsa mebileng di fokoditswe ka lebaka la ditshwaelo tse entsweng ke setjhaba bapalami bao e leng bafutsana ba nketswe hloohong ka hore beng ba dipalangwang tsa setjhaba ba teelwe ka thoko ditefisong tsa mebileng sekepele sa tefiso ya kgwedi le kgwedi se se se entswe, mme ho teng mokgwa wa phokoletso bakeng sa dikhamphane tsa dipalangwang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubasebenzisi boohola beendlela baseGauteng ukuba bathobele umthetho, babonise ubumi obulungileyo kwaye benze igalelo labo kuMzantsi Afrika ongcono ngokubhalisela i-e-tag bahlawulele ukusetyenziswa kwezi ndlela zodidi oluphezulu.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho basebedisi ba mebila e meholo ya Gauteng ho ikamahanya le molao, ho bontsha moya o motle wa boahi le ho kenya letsoho ntlafatsong ya Aforika Borwa ka ho ingodisetsa ditekete tsa boitsebahatso mme ba lefelle tshebediso ya mebila ena ya maemo a hodimo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibhena kubemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bahlangane baze basebenze kunye ekwenzeni iProjekthi yokuPhucula uHola wendlela waseGauteng ibe yimpumelelo baze baxabise uhlumo olubalaseleyo lwezisekelo ezingundoqo zalamaxesha angoku elizweni.

src: Kabinete e kopa maAforika Borwa ho hulela hlakoreng le le leng esita le ho sebetsa mmoho ho etsa hore Projeke ya Ntlafatso ya Mebila e Meholo Gauteng e be katleho, mme ba tsebe ho leboha kgolo e babatsehang ya kaho ya meralo ya motheo ya sejwalejwale naheng.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezoThutho uza kubhengeza umhla eza sebenza ngayo i-e-tolling.

src: Letona la Dipalangwang le tla etsa tsebiso ka letsatsi leo tefiso ya mebileng e tla qala ka lona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabhena kubo bonke abaqhubi beemoto abasebenzisa rhoqo oohola bendlela zaseGauteng ukuba babhalise kwinkqubo baze bathenge ii-e-tag zabo ukuze baxhamle kwisaphulelo sezintlu zamaxabiso.

src: Kabinete e kopa beng ba makoloi bohle ba sebedisang mebila e meholo ya Gauteng kgafetsa ho ingodisa tsamaisong esita le ho reka ditekete tsa boitsebahatso ho etsetsa hore ba be boemong bo botle ba ho fumana ditheolelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqhwabela izandla ukuqhubela phambili kokuqaliswa kwenkqubo yezigidi ngezigidi zeerandi yezisekelo ezingundoqo zikawonkewonke, phantsi kwesikhokelo sikaMongameli uJacob Zuma equka ukusungulwa kutshanje kuka-R1 no-R8 ukuba baqhagamshelane nePolokwane ukuya kwidolophu yaseGiyani nokuvulwa kweprojekthi yeBrorho yeSixeko noQhagamshelo loMzila KwaZulu-Natal ngomhla we-19 kweyeDwarha kowama-2013.

src: Kabinete e rorisa phano e ntseng e tswelapele ya ditshebeletso tlasa boetapele ba Mopresidente Jacob Zuma, ya lenaneo la meralo ya motheo ya setjhaba ya diterilioneterilione tsa diranta, e akgang le ho kgakolwa ha moraorao ha mebila ya R71 le R81 e kopanyang Polokwane le toropo ya Giyani esita le ho bulwa ha projeke ya Borokgo bo Boholo le Seporo sa Lehokela e KwaZulu-Natal ka la 19 Mphalane 2013.
tgt: Uthungelwano oludityanisiweyo lwendlela luyinto ebalulekileyo etsala ukutyalwa kwemali elizweni nakwizwekazi.

src: Marangrang a kopantsweng a mebila ke ntho ya bohlokwa ho hoheleng matsete naheng le kontinenteng.
tgt: Njengoko sisenza iindlela zilungele amaxesha angoku kwilizwe ngokubanzi, iKhabhinethi iyabhena kubo bonke abasebenzisi ukuba babenonophelo xa besebenzisa iindlela.

src: Jwaloka ha re ntlafatsa mebila naha ka bophara, Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho basebedisi bohle ho ba sedi ha ba sebedisa mebila.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ixhalabile ngokwanda kweengozi ezindleleni ezibandakanya abahambi ngeenyawo koohola bendlela abangenelelayo.

src: Kabinete e ngongorehile ka keketseho ya diketsahalo tse amanang le ditaaso mebileng.
tgt: Abahambi ngeenyawo benza ama-46% ubuncinane babantu abathi baphulukane nobomi babo ezindleleni.

src: Ditaaso di etsa 46% ya batho ba shwellang mebileng.
tgt: Abaqhubi beemoto banoxanduva lokuba bakhathalelane endleleni.

src: Beng ba makoloi le ditaaso ba na le boikarabelo ba ho hlomphana mebileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabhena kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba babe yinxalenye yeNtshukumo yemiNyaka elishumi yeZizwe eziManyeneyo yoKhuseleko eziNdleleni (2011-2020) ekhokelwa liSebe lezoThutho.

src: Kabinete e kopa maAforika Borwa ohle ho ba karolo ya Selemoshome sa Matjhaba a Kopaneng sa ho nka Kgato bakeng sa Polokeho ya Mebileng (2011-2020) e etelletsweng pele ke Lefapha la Dipalangwang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabhena kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bathathe inxaxheba kwiVeki yeMbizo yoGqaliso eqhuba de kube ngumhla we-13 kweyeDwarha kowama-2013.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho ba le seabo Bekeng ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo ya Imbizo eo ha jwale e tswelang pele, ho fihlela ka la 13 Mphalane 2013.
tgt: Egameni labantu boMzantsi Afrika, iKhabhinethi ibulela iNgxowa-mali yeHlabathi ngenkxaso yabo kuMzantsi Afrika ngexesha apho kukho imfuno exhalisayo yenkxaso-mali eyongezelelweyo.

src: Sena se fa setjhaba monyetla wa ho buisana le ba Phethahatso ka dintho tse sa se tshwarang hantle esita le ka hore mmuso o tsebise setjhaba ka mosebetsi wa wona.
tgt: Esi sesona sibonelelo esikhulu esinye seNtsholongwane kaGawulayo (HIV) neTB esisuka kubabinzi abaninzi kwimbali yokusabela kuGawulayo (AIDS).Ngaphezulu nje kwesiqingatha (esingama-52%) e-R3 bhiliyoni ezakubekelwa iSebe leSizwe lezeMpilo.

src: Bohatong ba batho ba Aforika Borwa, Kabinete e leboha Letlole la Lefatshe Lohle bakeng sa tshehetso ya lona ho Aforika Borwa nakong eo ho neng ho e na le tlhokeho e kgolo ya keketso ya ditjhelete.
tgt: Phakathi kwezinye iinkqubo, ezi nkxaso-mali ziza kusetyenziselwa oku kulandelayo: Ukufumana amayeza okuthomalalisa i-AIDS ezigulane ezingama-350 000, inkxaso-mali yokuqalisa isibonelelo samayeza athomalalisa i-AIDS ngesigidimi kumakhaya ezigulane okanye kwiindawo athathwa kuyo ekuhlaleni, iinkonzo zokuhlola iTB zawo onke amabanjwa kuzo zonke iitrongo eMzantsi Afrika, nezokuhlola iTB neHIV kubasebenzi-mgodini abangama-100 000 kwimigodi emincinci engenazo iinkonzo zempilo zayo.

src: Ena ke thuso ya ditjhelete e kgolo ka ho fetisisa e tsamayang e le nngwe bakeng sa HIV le TB e tswang mofaning wa ntho tse ngata nalaneng ya dithuso tsa AIDS.
tgt: IKhabhinethi incoma iinzuzo eziqhubekayo zeNtsebenziswano elwa i-HIV ne-AIDS, ebibhiyozela iminyaka yayo eli-15 ngomhla kweyeDwarha kowama-2013.

src: Kabinete e rorisa dikatleho tse ntseng di tswelapele tsa Selekane se kgahlanong le HIV le AIDS, se ketekileng sehopotso sa bo 15 ka la 9 Mphalane 2013.Ha jwale Aforika Borwa e kenya tshebetsong lenaneo le leholohadi lefatsheng la kalafo ya diantiretrovaerale.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika ngoku ufezekisa eyona nkqubo yonyango inkulu yokuthomalalisa i-AIDS ehlabathini.

src: Selekane se ile sa boela sa eba le seabo se seholo ntshetsopeleng ya Morero wa Lewa la Naha (NSP) 2012-2016.
tgt: Intsebenziswano kananjalo idlale indima ebalulekileyo ekuphuhlisweni kwesiCwangciso-qhinga seSizwe (i-NSP) 2012-20.5 IKhabhinethi incoma umoya ezithe zaqhutywa ngawo iingxoxo zemivuzo neziqukunjelwe ngawo kulo macandelo apho kuthe kwafikelelwa kwizisombululo zobuhlobo nezikhawulezileyo.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa moya oo ditherisano tsa meputso di neng di tshwerwe tsa ba tsa phethelwa ka wona makaleng ao a amehileng, moo ditharollo tsa kutlwisisano ebile e le tsa ka potlako di ileng tsa fihlellwa.
tgt: Ingxoxo yoluntu kwakwisikhokelo-nkqubo somthetho wezemisebenzi ihlala ibalulekile ekuthinteleni ugwayimbo olunobundlobongela.

src: Dipuisano tsa setjhaba moralong wa ketso ya melao ya tsa basebetsi di dula di le bohlokwa thibelong ya merusu e amanang le boipelaetso.
tgt: Njengoko abasebenzi bebuyela emsebenzini, iKhabhinethi idomboza abaqeshi nabasebenzi ukuba basebenze kunye, ingakumbi uqoqosho lwezehlabathi luhlala luphantsi koxinzelelo, benze uqoqosho loMzantsi Afrika lube nempumelelo ngakumbi, lubenemveliso kwaye luzinzise imisebenzi enesidima.6 IKhabhinethi yamkela iNgqungquthela yeSizwe yokuThintela ukuziBulala kwiNkonzo yezobuPolisa yoMzantsi Afrika (i-SAPS) ezakubanjwa ngomhla we-16 ukuya kowe-18 kweyeDwarha.

src: Jwaloka ha basebetsi ba kgutlela mosebetsing, Kabinete e kopa bahiri le bahiruwa ho sebetsa mmoho, haholoholo jwaloka ha moruo wa lefatshe o dula o le tebetebeng, ho etsa hore moruo wa Aforika Borwa o sebetse hantle, o be le tlhahiso o be o boloke mesebetsi e metle ka nako tsohle.
tgt: Le nkqubo ijonge ukuphuhlisa isiCwangciso seSizwe sokuThintela ukuziBulala kwi-SAPS.7 UMongameli uJacob Zuma uzakwamkela uMongameli uFrancois Hollande weRiphabliki yaseFransi kuTyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni kwi-Union Buildings ukusuka ngomhla we-14 ukuya kowe-15 kweyeDwarha kowama-2013.UTyelelo lukaRhulumente luzakukwandisa ubudlelwane bethu bezopolitiko nezoQoqosho phakathi kwamazwe amabini neFransi luqinise intsebenziswano yaseMntla Mzantsi kananjalo nokuqhubela phambili i-Ajenda yase-Afrika.2 Iingxoxo kunye nezigqibo zeKhabhinethi ezingundoqo.1 IKhabhinethi ivume iMimiselo yooMatshini bokuKhangela nokuSetyenziswa kwePetrliyam ukuba ipapashelwe kwiPhepha likaRhulumente lokwaZisa, ukuze uluntu lunike izimvo zalo.2 IKhabhinethi yavuma ukusindlekwa koCweyo olungeSivumelwano soThungelwano loKhuphiswano lweZizwe-ngeZizwe (i-ICN) yiKhomishini yoKhuphiswano yoMzantsi Afrika ukusuka ngomhla we-16 ukuya kowe-18 kweyeDwarha kowama-2013, eKapa.

src: Mosebetsi ona o reretswe ho ntshetsa pele Morero wa Naha wa Thibelo ya ho ipolaya bakeng sa SAPMopresidente Jacob Zuma o tla amohela Mopresidente Francois Hollande wa Rephaboliki ya France bakeng sa Ketelo ya Naha Meahong ya Kopanong ho tloha ka la 14 ho ya ho la 15 Mphalane 2013.Ketelo ya Naha e tla tebisa dikamano tsa rona le France tsa sepolotiki le moruo e matlafatse tshebedisanommoho ya Leboya-Borwa esita le ho ntshetsa pele maikemisetso a rona a seAforika.
tgt: UCweyo lweQumrhu labarhwebi lwe-ICN lwenza kubekho utshintshiselwano lwezimvo nothungelwano kwimiba enxulumene neenkqubo zorhwebo phakathi kwamalungu athatha inxaxheba alo nee-Arhente eziNgezizo ezikaRhulumente kwihlabathi jikelele.3 IKhabhinethi iye yachazelwa ngenkqubela-phambili eyenziwe kwikota yokuqala kweyowama-2013/14 ngeSivumelwano sokuQeshwa koLutsha esisayinwe ngowe-18 kuTshazimpunzi ngowama-2013.Awona manqaku mathandathu esi Sivumelwano ngala (1) yimfundo noqeqesho, (2) ubhentsiswa kumsebenzi, (3) imikhosi yolutsha, (4) ujoliso kulutsha lubekelwe ecaleni, (5) ubushishini bolutsha nokopolotyeni na (6) manyathelo okuqala ecandelo labucala.

src: Dipuisano le diqeto tsa bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.1 Kabinete e ananetse Melawana ya Setekhinikale ya ho Fuputsa le ho Honya Peteroliamo e tla phatlalatswa koranteng ya Mmuso bakeng sa ditshwaelo.2 Kabinete e ananetse ho tshwarwa ha Wekshopo ya Setlamo sa Neanotaba ya Tlhodisano ya Matjhaba (ICN) ke Khomishene ya Tlhodisano ya Aforika Borwa ho tloha ka la 16 ho ya ho la 18 Mphalane, Motsekapa.
tgt: Inzuzo engundoqo yekota yokuqala iquka upicotho-zimali lokuqala lwentshukumo namanyathelo okuqala olutsha kwilizwe ngokubanzi nentshukumo ethile eyenziwa kwicandelo labucala.3 IMithetho esaYilwayo.1 IKhabhinethi ivume ukupapashwa koYilo loMthetho-siHlomelo wokwaNdiswa kweXesha lokuHlala kuMhlaba oThile ukuze uluntu lunike izimvo zalo.

src: Wekshopo ya Setlamo ya ICN e thusa ka phapanyetsano ya maikutlo le neanotaba dinthong tse amanang le ditlamo hara ditho tsa yona tse nkang seabo le Dieijensi tseo e Seng tsa Mmuso lefatshe ka bophara.3 Kabinete e ile ya bewa sehlohlolong sa ditaba ka kgatelopele e entsweng kotareng ya pele ya 2013/14 ka Selekane sa Kgiro ya Batjha se tekennweng ka la 18 Mmesa 2013.Dintho tse tsheletseng tse ka sehloohong tsa Selekane sena ke (1) thuto le thupelo, (2) malebela a mosebetsi, (3) mekgatlo ya batjha, (4) pehelo ya batjha e teetsweng ka thoko, (5) bohwebi le dikoporasi tsa batjha esita le (6) dikgato tse nkwang ke lekala la poraefete.
tgt: UMthetho-siHlomelo uhlomela ukwaNdiswa kweXesha loMthetho wokuHlala kuMhlaba oThile, wowe-1997 (uMthetho Nombolo wama-62 wowe-1997) ukuze kuqiniswe, kucaciswe ze kukhuselwe amalungelo okuhlala kumhlaba othile wabahlali (abahlali basefama).UMthetho oYilwayo ujonge ekufumaneni isisombululo sexesha elide sokungafumaneki komhlaba wokuhlala ngokudibanisa amanyathelo okubuyiselwa komhlaba nokhuseleko lomthetho olusebenzayo neendlela zokusombulula imbambano.

src: Katleho e kgolokgolo bakeng sa kotare ya pele e fupere tlhahlobo ya sethathong ya dibuka tsa ditjhelete ya diketsahalo le dikgato tsa batjha tse nkilweng ho phunyeletsa le naha yohle esita le kgato enngwe e nkuwang lekaleng la poraefete.
tgt: UMthetho oYilwayo ufuna ukuphucula amalungelo abasebenzi basefama nabahlali bakhona.

src: Dibili.1 Kabinete e ananetse ho phatlalatswa ha Moralo wa Bili ya Tlhomathiso ya wa Katoloso ya Netefaletso ya Bodudi bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele.
tgt: Abahlali basefama bodidi lwesibini uninzi lwabo ngabasetyhini nabantwana.2 IKhabhinethi ivume ukupapashwa koYilo loMthetho-siHlomelo osaYilwayo woMthetho wezeMpilo noKhuseleko eMigodini, wama-2013 kwiPhepha likaRhulumente lokwaZisa, ukuze uluntu lunike izimvo zalo.

src: Bili ya Tlhomathiso e fetola Molao wa Katoloso ya Netefaletso ya Bodudi, 1997, (Molao wa 62 wa 1997) ho matlafatsa, ho hlakisa le ho tshireletsa ditokelo tsa bodudi tsa ba dulang sebakeng seo (badudi ba mapolasing).Sepheo sa Bili ke ho fumana tharollo ya nako e telele ditlhokehong tsa tshireletso ya bodudi ka ho kopanya mekgwa ya kabobotjha ya mobu le tshireletso ya molao, esita le mekgwa ya tharollo ya dikgohlano.
tgt: UMthetho oYilwayo ufuna ukuhlomela uMthetho wezeMpilo noKhuseleko emiGodini wama-29 we-1996 ukuze kuqwalaselwe kwakhona amalungiselelo onyanzeliso, ngokwenza lula indlela yomrhumo nokuqinisa izohlwayo.

src: Bili e habile ho ntlafatsa ditokelo tsa basebetsi le badudi ba mapolasing.
tgt: Ekuphuculeni impilo nokhuseleko lwabasebenzi basemgodini, uMthetho-siHlomelo nawo ufuna ukugcina indawo yasemgodini isempilweni nekhuselekileyo enempembelelo elungileyo kuzinzo nokomelela kwendawo ekuhambeleni nesiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe.4 Izikhundla.1 IKhabhinethi ivume ezi zikhundla zilandelayo kwiSebe loPhuhliso lwezeNtlalo:a) uMnu.

src: Badudi ba mapolasing bao e seng basebetsi e atisa ho ba basadi le bana.2 Kabinete e ananetse ho phatlalatswa ha Moralo wa Bili ya Tlhomathiso ya Molao wa Bophelo bo Botle le Polokeho Merafong, 2013, Koranteng ya Mmuso bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele.
tgt: uThokozani William Magwaza kwisikhundla sikaSekela Mlawuli Jikelele: Ukhuseleko lwezeNtlalo oluPheleleyob) uNksz.

src: Bili e habile ho fetola Molao wa Bophelo bo Botle le Polokeho Merafong wa 29 wa 1996 e le ho sheba botjha mekgwa ya qobello, mokgwa wa kahlolo ka tefiso le ho matlafatsa dikotlo.
tgt: Nelisiwe Ignatia Vilakazi kwisikhundla sikaSekela Mlawuli Jikelele: isiCwangciso-qhinga neNguqu kwiSebe.2 IKhabhinethi ivume ukuqeshwa kukaMnu.

src: Ho ntlafatseng bophelo bo botle le polokeho ho basebetsi ba merafong, Bili ya Nakwana ya Phetolo e boetse e habile ho boloka bophelo bo botle le polokeho tikolohong ya merafong ka sekgahla se setle botsitsong ba nako e telele ba tikoloho ho ya ka Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha.
tgt: Caiphus Ramushau kwisikhundla segosa eliyiNtloko leziMali/ iNtloko leeNkonzo zeNtsebenziswano kwiSebe loBudlelwane neNtsebenziswano yaMazwe ngamazwe.3 IKhabhinethi ivume ezi zikhundla zilandelayo kwiBhodi yeBhanki yezeMihlaba:a) uNksz uDuma Motaub) uNksz.

src: 24 Oct 2013Kabinete e ile ya tshwara kopano ya yona e tlwaelehileng Motse Kapa ka la 23 Mphalane Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa bohlokwa maemong a ha jwale.
tgt: 24 Oct 2013IKhabhinethi ibambe intlanganiso yayo yesiqhelo eKapa ngomhla wama-23 kweyeDwarha kowama-20.

src: Kabinete e amohetse kgatelopele eo re e bonang letsholong la kaho ya meralo ya motheo ya setjhaba e hlophiswang ke Khomishene ya Moporesidente ya Tlhophiso ya Meralo ya Motheo (PICC).
tgt: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba ebalulekileyo kwiimeko ezigqubayo nezingundabamlonyeni.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o sa tswa kgakola diprojeke tse ngatanyana tse phethetsweng e le karolo ya lenaneo la Kaho ya Meralo ya Motheo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele inkqubela-phambili esiyibona kwiphulo lesizwe lokuqaliswa kweziseko ezingundoqo zoluntu eliququzelelwa yiKomishini kaMongameli yokuLungelelanisa iziSeko ezinguNdoqo (i-PICC).

src: Tsena di akga mosebetsi o entsweng mebileng ya R81 le R71 Limpopo, seteishene sa terene sa Bridge City se tla thusa batho ba Umlazi, Durban, esita le mokete wa setletle o neng o le Morafong wa De Beers wa Venetia o Vhembe, Limpopo.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma kutshanje usungule iiprojekthi ezigqityiweyo ezininzi njengenxalenye yenkqubo yokuPhuhlisa iziSeko ezinguNdoqo.

src: Moporesidente o boetse o mathuleng a ho kgakola mananeo a mang a meralo ya motheo a kang Lebatowa la Ntshetsopele ya Diindasteri le Koung ya Saldanha (IDZ) Kapa Bophirima ho etela setsha sa Letamo la De Hoop, Limpopo, ho kgakola makoloi a pele a entsweng Aforika Borwa kwana Kapa Botjhabela, le ho bula semmuso Sepetlele sa Ladybrand Foreistata.
tgt: Ezi ziquka umsebenzi kwiindlela engu-R81 nengu-R-71 eLimpopo, isitishi sikaloliwe i-Bridge City esizakunceda Umlazi eDurban nomsitho wokuphethulwa kwesoyi kuMgodi i-De Beers' Venetia eVhembe, eLimpopo.

src: Kabinete e boetse ya amohela kgatelopele ya mekgwatsamaiso ya Dipalangwang tsa Dibese tse Potlakang (BRT) Johannesburg, Tshwane le Rusternburg.
tgt: UMongameli ulindeleke ukuba asungule ezinye iinkqubo zeziseko ezingundoqo ezifana noMmandla woPhuhliso lwaMashishini (i-IDZ) waseSaldanha Bay eNtshona Koloni andwendwele isiza kwiDama i-De Hoop, asungule iinqwelo zemoto zokuqala ezakhiwe eMzantsi Afrika eMpuma Koloni, aze avule ngokusesikweni iSibhedlele i-Ladybrand eFreystata.

src: Lenaneo lena la meralo ya motheo la diterilioneterilione tsa diranta le bopa botjha moruo le mokgwatsamaiso wa dipalangwang naheng ya rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yakwamkele nenkqubela-phambili kwiinkqubo zeeBhasi eziQuqa ziBuyelela (i-BRT) zaseRhawutini, eTshwane, eKapa naseRustenburg.

src: Diprojeke tsena di bile le sephetho sa ho bea moruo motjheng wa kgolo e hodimo mme di tla tswelapele ho kenya letsoho ntshetsopeleng ya moruo le tlhahisong ya mesebetsi.2 Kabinete e amohela Pehelo ya Leano la Ditekanyetso tsa Nako e Bohareng e takilweng ke Letona la tsa Ditjhelete.
tgt: Le nkqubo yeziseko ezingundoqo eqhutywa kwilizwe ngokubanzi exabisa iitriliyoni ezininzi zeerandi ivuselela uqoqosho nenkqubo yezothutho kwilizwe lethu.

src: Kabinete e tshehetsa mehato e matla ya tokiso e sisintsweng bakeng sa mmuso.
tgt: Ezi projekthi zibe nefuthe lokubeka uqoqosho kwisimo sotshintsho lohlumo oluphezulwana kwaye ziza kuqhubeka zisiba negalelo kuphuhliso loqoqosho nasekudalweni kwamathuba emisebenzi.2 IKhabhinethi iyalwamkela uHlahlo lwaBiwo-mali lwesiGaba esiPhakathi oluvakaliswe nguMphathiswa wezeZimali.

src: Mehato ena e tla thusa ka nako e telele phokotsehong ya tshenyo efe kapa efe tshebedisong ya tjhelete ya mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawaxhasa amanyathelo angqongqo aziziphakamiso kurhulumente.

src: Mehato eo e tla netefatsa hore mmuso o sebedisa disebediswa tsa wona ka bokgabane.
tgt: La manyathelo aza kuhamba indlela ende ekunciphiseni nayiphi na inkcitho kwinkcitho-mali karhulumente.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho mafapha ohle a naha le a diporofense, bomasepala, ditheo tsa setjhaba le ditheo tsa molaotheo ho kenya mehato ena tshebetsong.3 Kabinete e ikamahantse le Moporesidente Jacob Zuma mmoho le setjhaba sa Aforika Borwa ho seolleng tlhekefetso, dikgoka le ho se tsotelle bana.
tgt: Amanyathelo anjalo aza kuqinisekisa ukuba urhulumente usebenzisa imithombo yakhe kakuhle nagobuchule.

src: Kabinete e thoholeditse sepolesa ka mekgahlelo ya sona ka ho nka dikgato tse potlakileng ditlolong tsa molao tse sa tswa tlalehwa haufinyane.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kuwo onke amasebe esizwe nawamaphondo, koomasipala, kumaqumrhu oluntu namaziko akhuthaza umgaqo-siseko ukuba afezekise la manyathelo.3 IKhabhinethi izibandakanye noMongameli uJacob Zuma noluntu loMzantsi Afrika ekugxekeni impatho-gadalala, ubundlobongela nokungahoywa kwabantwana.

src: Jwaloka ha re tla be re e na le Letsatsi la Naha la Bana ka la 2 Pudungwana, Kabinete e kopa maAforika Borwa ohle ho sireletsa bana jwaloka ha e le baetapele ba rona ba kamoso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi income amaziko amele ukuphunyezwa komthetho ngokukhawuleza athathe amanyathelo akhawulezileyo kumatyala achazwe kutshanje.

src: Kabinete e boela e etsa kgoeletso setjhabeng ho tswelapele ho sebedisana le sepolesa twantshong ya ditlolo tsa molao kahara WEBTOKEN tshwanela le ho ba sedi ka taba ya hore tshireletso ya bana ke boikarabelo ba batswadi le setjhaba.
tgt: Njengoko sizakuphawula uSuku lwaBantwana leSizwe ngomhla we-2 kweyeNkanga, iKhabhinethi ibongoza bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bakhusele abantwana njengoko bezinkokheli zangomso.

src: Re tshwanela ho thusa bomme ba hlokang thuso ya ho hodisa bana ba bona.4 Kabinete e amohetse tsebiso e entsweng ke Umalusi ya hore naha ke malalaalaotswe bakeng sa ditlhahlobo tsa Materiki ho tloha ka la 28 Mphalane ho sia ho la 29 Pudungwana 2013.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwahlaba ikhwelo kuluntu ukuba luqhubekeke nokusebenzisana namaziko amele ukuphunyezwa komthetho ekulweni ulwaphulo-mthetho eluntwini.

src: Batswadi le bahlokomedi ba kopjwa ho tshehetsa bana ba bona jwaloka ha ba ntse ba itlhophisetsa ditlhahlobo.
tgt: Kufanele sikhumbule kananjalo ukuba ukukhuselwa kwabantwana luxanduva lwabazali noluntu.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho Sehlopha sa 2013 ho etsa naha hore e be motlotlo.5 Kabinete e ananetse ho kgakolwa, ke Moporesidente, ha lenaneo la tshireletso ya dijo la Fetsa Tlala Kuruman Kapa Leboya ka la 24 Mphalane 2013.
tgt: Kufanele sinikezele ngoncedo koomama abadinga uncedo ekukhuliseni abantwana babo.4 IKhabhinethi yamkele isibhengezo esenziwe liziko Umalusi sokuba ilizwe lizilungele iimviwo zeBanga leShumi ukusukela ngomhla wama-28 kweyeDwarha ukuya kowama-29 kweyeNkanga yowama-2013.

src: Lenaneo le tla thusa setjhaba ho hlahisa dijo mobung wa setjhaba esita le o mong o sa sebedisweng hakaalo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibanqwenelela okuhle bonke abafundi abangama-707 136, kuquka nabafundi abangafundi sigxina abali-130 000, kwiimviwo zaboAbazali nabalondolozi babantwana ngokusemthethweni bayabongozwa ukuba baxhase abantwana babo njengoko belungiselela iimviwo zabo.

src: E tla tshehetsa borapolasi ba banyenyane ka meralo ya motheo, kaho ya disebediswa tsa tlhahiso ya dihlahiswa tsa temo esita le kaho ya mebaraka e metjha, ho akga le phumantsho ya mmuso.6 Kabinete e ananela ho hlomamiswa ha Indaba ya Mawatleng a Aforika e tla ba Sandton, Johannesburg, ka la 24 le 25 Mphalane 2013.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kuBafundi beBanga leShumi lowama-2013 ukuba mabenze ilizwe libe neqhayiya nebhongo ngabo.5 IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukusungulwa kwenkqubo yokufumaneka kokutya i-Fetsa Tlala (iPhelisa iNdlala) nguMongameli uJacob Zuma eKuruman eMntla Koloni ngomhla wama-24 kweyeDwarha yowama-2013.

src: Indaba e tla be e tshwerwe ke Lekgotla la Polokeho ya Mawatleng la Aforika Borwa esita le indasteri ya mawatleng.
tgt: Le nkqubo iza kunceda uluntu luvelise ukutya kumhlaba woluntu nakomnye umhlaba ongasetyenziswanga.

src: Seboka se tla fana ka lepatlelo bakeng sa banka karolo ba fapafapaneng ho kutla tsela ya ntshetsopele bakeng sa diindasteri tsa mawatleng a Aforika se be se thee Selekane sa Dinaha Tsohle tsa Aforika bakeng sa kaho ya moruo o tswetseng pele wa Aforika.7 Kabinete e tsebile ka Ketelo ya ho Emela Naha ya Moporesidente Zuma ya ho ya Rephaboliki ya Demokrasing ya Congo (DRC) ka la 29 le la 30 Mphalane 2013.
tgt: Iza kunceda amafama anemihlatyana emincinci ngeziseko ezingundoqo, ngophuhliso lwenkqubo yezolimo nangophuhliso lweemarike ezintsha, kuquka nokufumana kurhulumente.6 IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuvulwa kwe-Indaba ngezeLwandle yase-Afrika ezakuqhutywa eSandton, eRhawutini, ngomhla wama-24 nowama-25 kweyeDwarha yowama-2013.Le Indaba iza kusingathwa nguGunyaziwe woKhuseleko kwezeLwandle zoMzantsi Afrika namashishini ezelwandle.

src: Ketelo e tla matlafatsa maemo a rona a sepolotiki sa naha tse pedi le dikamano tsa moruo le DRC, ho feta moo e ntlafatse boikitlaetso ba rona ba matsapa a ho boloka kgotso esita le lenaneo la Kahobotjha le Ntshetsopele Kamora Dikgohlano (PCRD) naheng eo.8 Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho tshehetsa Kgwedi ya Naha ya Tlhokomediso ya Ditokelo tsa ba Holofetseng ho tloha ka la 3 Pudungwana ho ya ho la 3 Tshitwe, e boelang e ba Letsatsi la Matjhabatjhaba la Batho ba Holofetseng.
tgt: Le nkomfa iza kubonelela abantu abadlala indima ebalulekileyo abaninzi ngeqonga ukuba bayile indlela yokuphuhlisa yeelwandle zase-Afrika baze basungule ubuDlelwane bama-Afrika ukuze kuphuhliswe uqoqosho olusele luphambili ekuphuhleni lwase-Afrika.7 IKhabhinethi iluqaphele uTyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni oluzayo lukaMongameli uZuma kwi-Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) ngomhla wama-29 nama-30 kweyeDwarha.

src: Kgwedi e tla ketekwa tlasa mookotaba o reng: “Tlosa ditshita, bula menyetla: bakeng sa setjhaba se kenyeletsang bohle”.9 Kabinete e tsebile ya ba ya ngongorehiswa ke tsosoloso ya merusu le dikgoka Rephaboliking ya Mozambique.
tgt: Utyelelo luza kuqinisa ubudlelwane bethu bezopolitiko nobezoqoqosho obuphakathi kwala mazwe mabini luphinde luqinise ukuzibophelela kwethu kwiinzame zokugcina uxolo nenkqubo yoKwakha ngoKutsha noPhuhliso eMva kweNgxubakaxaka (i-PCRD) kwela lizwe.8 IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba baxhase iNyanga yokwaZisa ngamaLungelo waBakhubazekileyo yeSizwe ukusukela ngomhla we-3 kweyeNkanga ukuya kowe-3 kweyoMnga yowama-2013, ekwaphawula uSuku lwaBantu abaKhubazekileyo leZizwe.

src: Kabinete e batla ho thasisetsa hore Mozambique e na le mmuso o molaong mme ho tsohela matla hofe kapa hofe ho nyatsa boipuiso ba mmuso wa Mozambique le batho ba yona.
tgt: Inyanga le iza kubhiyozelwa phantsi komxholo othi: "Susa imiqobo, vulela uluntu oluquka abantu bonke iingcango ”.9 IKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ngenkxalabo ukuvuka kwakho kobundlobongela neemeko ezingentlanga kwiRiphabliki yaseMozambique.

src: Kabinete e seolla kahohlehohle ditlhaselo tsa ho tsohela mmuso matla.2 Dipuisano le diqeto tsa bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.1 Kabinete e ananetse kamohelo ya Sehlomathiso sa Doha ho Porothokhole ya Kyoto.
