tgt: Phakathi kweendlela zokugweba ezisetyenzisiweyo ukuthatha isigqibo malunga noku ibezezi zilandelayo:imfuno yesantya kutshintshelo kwimivo ingakumbi ukukhulula iindidi zamaza omoya oonomathotholoukuqinisekisa ukuba isibonelelo sikarhulumente sisetyenziswa ngendlela enemvelisoukuvuselela ushishino lwee-elektroniki zakweli nokudala imisebenziukuxhamlisa oosomashishini abasakhulayoukunciphisa amathuba emarike yoMzantsi Afrika okuba izaliswe zii-STB ezixabisa phantsi nezingasebenzi ngokupheleleyoukukhusela umdla weQumrhu loSasazo loMzantsi Afrikaukusabela ngononophelo kwiinguqu ezikhawulezayo kwicandelo losasazo nele-ICT liphelaukunciphisa inqanaba lokubanga konke nokukhuthaza ukhuphiswano ngokudala isithuba sabadlali abatsha kwimarike kamabonakude ohlawulelwayo ngaphandle kokuxhamla ngendlela engenabulungisa kwinkxaso-mali kaRhulumenteUkunciphisa amathuba okuthatha amanyathelo omthetho okwenziwa ngabasasazi noosomashishini okubamba inkqubo yokutshintshela kwimivo.

src: Sena se akga ho fana ka lenaneo le kopaneng la dikgato tse sebetsang hantle la ho thusa malapa ao e bang hona jwale a se a ntse a le tebetebeng ya dikoloto hore a se ke a tetebela ka ho fetisisa dikolotong kamoso.
tgt: Xa uthatha ezi nezinye iindlela zokugweba ezisetyenzisiweyo, iKhabhinethi igqibe ukuba ukusetyenziswa kwenkqubo yokulawula kufanele inganyanzelisi.

src: Letona la tsa Ditjhelete le tla boela le nka dikgato tsa ho kgothatsa bahiri ho thusa bahiruwa ba bona ba tetebetseng haholo dikolotong ka ho fuputsa ditokomane tsa qobello ya tefo ho bona hore na ke nnete ho le hokae, esita le ho fa bahiruwa mekgwa ya dikeletso ka tsa ditjhelete.5 Kabinete e ananetse Pampiri e Tshweu ya Leano la Naha la Bolaodi ba Tikoloho ya Mawatleng.
tgt: Ii-STB noko kunjalo, zinenkqubo yokulawula ekhusela utyalo-mali lukaRhulumente kwimarike yeSTB exhaswe ngemali noshishino lwee-elektroniki lwalapha, ngeenguqu ezikhawulezayo zobuchwepheshe, ukuba isetyenziswe kwixesha elizayo ngabasasazi abanokufuna ukungayisebenzisi ngoku.

src: Leano le teka mokgwa wa bolaodi bo hlophisitsweng ba lekala ho ya bolaoding ba tikoloho ya mawatleng.
tgt: Ukuphepha abasasazi abarhumayo ukuba bangaxhamli ngendlela engenabulungisa kwinkqubo yokulawula yeSTB, utyalo-mali lukarhulumente kwiNkqubo yokuLawula yeSTB luza kubuyiswa kwabo basasazi barhumayo abakhetha ukusebenzisa inkqubo yokuLawula yeSTB.

src: Sena se tla dumella Aforika Borwa ho rarolla ka bokgabane diphephetso tse holang tse bakwang ke tshenyo e etswang ke batho tikolohong ya mawatleng, ha ka lehlakoreng le leng e thusa kahohlehohle bokgoning ba ntshetsopele ya moruo boo mawatle a fanang ka bona.6 Kabinete e ananetse Maemo a makgaolakgang a Leano la Naha la Metsi yaba ya ela hloko mesebetsi ya dipuisano tsa setjhaba e entsweng ho phethelaTjhebobotjha ya Leano la Naha la Metsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imemela onke amaqela ukuba ayeke iyantlukwano yangaphambili yawo koko asebenze kunye norhulumente ekuqalisweni kokutshintshelwa kwimivo kwakamsinya ngenxa yomdla welizwe.4 IKhabhinethi ivume amanyathelo ajoliswe ekuncediseni amakhaya anamatyala ngokugqithisileyo nokuqinisa uzinzo kwezezimali.

src: Maemo a matjha a Leano la Metsi a amohela ntlha ya ntshetsopele ya bolaodi ba metsi, e rarollang dikgohlano dipakeng tsa bolaodi ba metsi le ntshetsopele esita le sepheo sa mmuso sa diphetoho.
tgt: ABaphathiswa bezeziMali nezoRhwebo nezoShishino bagunyaziswe ukuba bafezekise amanyathelo athintelayo ukunciphisa umngcipheko wokuba sematyaleni ngendlela egqithisileyo ngenxa yemali-mboleko.

src: Sena se lekodisisa boleng ba tsamaiso ya metsi ka kakaretso mabapi le kamoo metsi a ka thusang ka teng ntshetsopeleng ya tekano, ya ho fola molemo le ya nako e telele naha ka bophara.7 Kabinete e ananetse mosebetsi wa ho amahanya botjha Diboto tsa Metsi ho ba Ditheo tsa Mabatowa tsa Metsi tse robong.
tgt: Oku kuquka ukubonelela inkqubo ehlangeneyo yamanyathelo asebenzayo okuncedisa amakhaya asematyaleni ngokugqithisileyo, kwanokuthintela amakhaya ukuba angangeni ematyaleni ngokugqithisileyo kwixesha elizayo.

src: Sena se latela tlaleho ya ho qetela kahong botjha e sisintsweng ya Diboto tsa Metsi.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezeziMali naye uza kuthatha amanyathelo okukhuthaza abaqeshi ukuba bancede abo basebenzi basematyaleni ngokugqithisileyo ngokuphanda ngokubasemthethweni kwemiyalelo yokutsala imali emivuzweni yabasebenzi, kwaye babonelele abasebenzi ngeendlela zokuphatha nokusebenzisa imali.5 IKhabhinethi ivume iPhepha leNgcaciso loMgaqo-nkqubo kuMgaqo-nkqubo woLawulo lokusiNgqongileyo weSizwe weLwandlekazi.

src: Mosebetsi wa bohlokwahlokwa wa Ditheo tsa Mabatowa tsa Metsi e tla ba ho aha le ho laola moqeqeko wa meralo ya motheo ya mabatowa (phepelo ya metsi le mohlodi wa metsi) ho akga le ditjhelete, ntshetsopele ya projeke le mesebetsi e tswelang pele le poloko ya disebediswa di le maemong a matle.
tgt: Umgaqo-nkqubo uyila indlela yolawulo lwecandelo ehambelanayo nolawulo lolwandlekazi olusingqongileyo.

src: Sena se tla thusa ka phano e betetshana ya tshehetso mmusong wa dibaka, e leng tlhokeho ya bohlokwa ya popobotjha ya lekala ka kakaretso.8 Kabinete e ananetse ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha ho entelwa Kokwanahloko ya Papiloma Bathong, eo tsamaiso ya yona e tla laolwa ka dikgwedi tse tsheletseng tse qadikaneng, ka 2014, bananeng ba dilemong tse pakeng tsa tse robong le tse 10 ka Lenaneo la Kopantsweng la Bophelo bo Botle Dikolong.
tgt: Oku kuza kuvumela uMzantsi Afrika ushukuxe imingeni ekhulayo ebangelwa lifuthe labantu kulwandlekazi olusingqongileyo usebenze ngakumbi, ngaxesha linye uza kwandisa amandla okuphuhlisa uqoqosho aza nolwandlekazi.6 IKhabhinethi ivume iiNdawo zokugqibela zeSizwe zoMgaqo-nkqubo waManzi yaze yaqaphela iinkqubo zofakano-milomo eziqhutywe ukuze kuqukunjelwe uPhononongo lweSizwe loMgaqo-nkqubo waManzi.

src: Sena se tsamaisana le tshisinyo ya Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Bophelo bo Botle.
tgt: IiNdawo ezintsha zoMgaqo-nkqubo waManzi zamkela indawo yophuhliso lolawulo lwamanzi, olushukuxa amakhonkco aphakathi kolawulo lwamanzi neenjongo zikarhulumente zophuhliso nezokwenza inguqu.

src: Sepheo ke ho fokotsa kotsi ya ho ba le mofetshe wa popelo hamorao bophelong ba banana, mme e tla thusa ntlafalong ya bophelo ba boleng basading e be e eketse tebello ya dilemo tsa bona tsa ho phela, athe e boetse e fokotsa haholo boteng ba mafu a diqebo.
tgt: Oku kuqwalasela ityathanga lokuxabiseka kwamanzi ngokupheleleyo malunga nendlela amanzi anokuthi abenegalelo ngayo ekuzuzeni uphuhliso olulinganayo, oluxhamlisayo noluzinzileyo kwilizwe ngokubanzi.7 IKhabhinethi ivume inkqubo yokuhambelana kweeBhodi zaManzi kwiiNgingqi eziluNcedo zaManzi ezilithoba.

src: Dibili.1 Kabinete e ananetse ho kenngwa koranteng ya mmuso ha Bili ya nakwana ya Agrément ya Aforika Borwa, ya 2013 le Memorandamo o mabapi le sepheo sa Bili hore setjhaba se tshwaele.
tgt: Oku kulandela ingxelo yokugqibela kuphuculo olucetywayo lweeBhodi zaManzi.

src: Bili ya nakwana e hlekela kananelo ya Agrément ya Aforika Borwa e le setheo.
tgt: Umsebenzi ophambili weeNgiqngi zaManzi eziluNcedo uza kuba kukuphuhlisa nokulawula iziseko zophuhliso ezingundoqo zengingqi zamanzi amaninzi (ukubonelelwa ngamanzi nomthombo wamanzi) kuquka nokuxhaswa ngezimali, uphuhliso lweprojekthi nemisebenzi eqhubekayo kunye nokulungisa.

src: Boto ya Agrément ya Aforika Borwa e filwe thomo, ho tse ding, ya ho hlahloba ho lokela mosebetsi ha dihlahiswa tse sa amohelwang semmuso tse amanang le kaho kapa mekgwa ya ho di sebedisa indastering ya kaho, moo e bang ho hang ha ho maemo a naha a beilweng.
tgt: Oku kuza kwenza ukuba kubekho ubonelelo olungcono lwenkxaso kurhumente wasekhaya, nto leyo eyimfuneko ebalulekileyo kuphuculo lwecandelo lilonke.8 IKhabhinethi yamkele ukufezekiswa kwechiza lokugonya iHuman Papiloma Virus (iHPV) (iNtsholongwane ebangela uMhlaza), eliza kusetyenziswa iinyanga ezintandathu ezohlukeneyo ngowama-2014, kumantombazana aneminyaka eli-9 ukuya kweli-10 ngeNkqubo yeZikolo nezeMpilo eDityanisiweyo.

src: Sena se tla thusa ho theweng ha indasteri ya kaho e hatelang pele ebile e le ya maemo e tla thusa tlhahisong ya mesebetsi ha ka ho le leng e tla be e kenya letsoho mererong ya meralo ya motheo ya Mmuso.2 Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya Sehlomathiso ya Banka ya Ntshetsopele ya Aforika e ka Borwa, ya 2013 Palamenteng.
tgt: Oku kuhambelana necebiso loMbutho wezeMpilo weHlabathi .Injongo kukunciphisa umngcipheko wokuba nomhlaza wesibeleko ebudaleni babo, kwaye liza kubanegalelo ekuphuculeni umgangatho wobomi babasetyhini nokwandisa ixesha labo lokuphila kananjalo lunciphise ngokubalulekileyo ukuxhaphaka kwezifo ezendeleyo ezingosuleliyo.

src: Bili e hlomathisa Molao wa Banka ya Ntshetsopele ya Aforika e ka Borwa, wa 1997.Leqheka la tjhadimo ya Bili ya Sehlomathiso ke ho kgontsha katoloso ya Banka ya Ntshetsopele ya Aforika e ka Borwa ho ya naheng efe kapa efe e kontinenteng ya Aforika esita le dihlekehlekeng tse mawatleng a yona.
tgt: IMithetho esaYilwayo.1 IKhabhinethi ivume ukupapashwa kwiphephandaba likarhulumente uMthetho osaYilwayo weSivumelwano sokuyila soMzantsi Afrika, wama-2013 neNqaku elingeeNjongo zoMthetho osaYilwayo ukuze uluntu luvakalise izimvo zalo.

src: Sena se tla kgontsha Banka ho ba le seabo meralong e meholo ya motheo le diprojeke tse ding kantle ho lebatowa la Dinaha tse Tswelang pele tsa Aforika e ka Borwa tse nang le bokgoni ba ho ntlafatsa kgwebisano le kgolo ya moruo kontinenteng esita le ho tshehetsa boitelo le boikitlaetso ba naha tse pedi momahanong ya -3.3 Kabinete e ananetse hore Bili ya nakwana ya Bolaodi ba Lekala la tsa Ditjhelete e ntshuwe bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele ka yona, ho thusa boikitlaetsong ba Aforika Borwa ba G-20.Sepheo sa Bili ke ho etsa hore lekala la tsa ditjhelete le bolokehe ka ho kenya tshebetsong mokgwa wa taolo wa ‘tlhoro pedi’ e leng ho thewa ha balaodi ba babedi: e mong o ikarabela polokehong le botsitsong ba ditheo tsa ditjhelete ha e mong a ikarabela mokgweng oo ditheo tsa ditjhelete di etsang mosebetsi wa tsona ka teng.
tgt: UMthetho osaYilwayo ulungiselela ukuqondwa kwe-Agrément South Africa, njengeshishini likarhulumente.

src: Dithonyo.1 Kabinete e ananetse ho thonngwa ha Esther Sarah Makau mosebetsing wa Mohlanka e Moholo wa tsa Ditjhelete Lefapheng la Bonono le Botjhaba.2 Kabinete e ananetse dithonyo tse latelang Lefapheng la Dokgokahanyo:a) Reneva Fourie mosebetsing wa Motlatsi wa Molaodikakaretso: Lesedi la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba le Diphuputsob) Tinyiko Moses Ngobeni mosebetsing wa Motlatsi wa Molaodikakaretso: Kaho ya Meralo ya Motheo ya ICTc) Sibongile Vulikhaya Makopi mosebetsing wa Motlatsi wa Molaodikakaretso: Tekolo ya Dikhamphane tseo e leng tsa Mmuso le Kaho ya Dikgwebo tsa ICT.3 Kabinete e ananetse ho thonngwa ha Siyakhula Paradise Simelane mosebetsing wa Mohlanka e Moholo wa tsa Ditjhelete Lefapheng la Ntshetsopele ya Dibaka tsa Mahae le Tlhabollo ya Naha.4 Kabinete e ananetse ho thonngwabotjha ha Siyabulela Thomas Tsengiwe mosebetsing wa Mokomishenara e Moholo wa Khomishene ya Tsamaiso ya Kgwebisano ya Matjhaba.5 Kabinete e ananetse ho thonngwa ha Mme Thezi Rosemary Mabuza e le Motlatsi wa Mokhomishenara wa Khomishene ya Naha ya Bareki.6 Kabinete e ananetse ho thonngwa ha Ntate Themba Thomas Cyril Dlamini e le Mohlanka e Moholo wa Phethahatso (CEO) Botong ya Dipapadi ya Naha.7 Kabinete e ananetse ho thonngwa ha Moadvokheiti Solomon Makhosini Msibi e le CEO ya Koporasi ya Taolo ya Sephethephethe Mebileng.8 Kabinete e ananetse dithonyo tse latelang tsa ditho tseo e seng sa Phethahatso Botong ya Koporasi ya Taolo ya Sephethephethe Mebileng.
tgt: Ibhodi ye-Agrément South Africa igunyaziswe phakathi kwezinye izinto, ukuba ihlole ukomelela-nokumelana kwenjongo zemveliso ezinxulumene nolwakhiwo olungekho semgangathweni okanye izixokelelwano ezisetyenziswa kushishino lolwakhiwo, apho kungekho mgangatho wesizwe umiselweyo khona.

src: Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa bohlokwa maemong a ha jwale.1 Polelo ya Maemo a Naha ya bo 24 (SoNA) esale ho ba le demokrasi e fane ka tekolo ya bohlokwa ya pheletso ya nako mabapi le ho kengwa tshebetsong ha maikemisetso a mmuso bakeng sa 2009-2014.
tgt: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba ebalulekileyo kwiimeko ezigqubayo nezingundabamlonyeni.1 INtetho yama-24 engoBume beSizwe oko kwathi kwakho inkululeko yentando yesininzi inike ithuba lovavanyo olubalulekileyo lokuphela kwexesha lePalamente yesine ngokuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente eziphambili zeminyaka wama-2009 ukuya kowama-2014.

src: Tsebiso ya sistimi ya diphetho ka 2009 e dumelletse hore ho be le tshalomorao e thehilweng hodima bopaki le diphetho ya ho kenya dintho tshebetsong ho netefatsa hore mmuso o sebetsa hantle le ka tokelo.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kwenkqubo esekelwe kwiziphumo ngowama-2009 kwanika ithuba indlela yokuhlola esekelwe kubungqina negxininisa kwiziphumo zokuphumeza ukuqinisekisa ukuba urhulumente usebenza ngokukuko nangokubonakalayo.2 Kulandela iNtetho engoBume beSizwe kwakunye neNgxoxo-mpikiswano ngeNtetho engoBume beSizwe, olu thotho lukhoyo lweeNtlanganiso zabaPhathiswa namajelo eendaba lunika ithuba lokudlana indlebe naBaphathiswa abohlukeneyo abaza kuyicacisa ngakumbi iNtetho kaMongameli.

src: Kamora Polelo ya Maemo a Naha le Ngangisano mabapi le Polelo ya Maemo a Naha, letoto la hajwale la ditsebiso tsa Matona ho boraditaba le fana ka monyetla bakeng sa puisano le Matona a fapaneng a tla hlalosa Polelo ya Mopresidente.
tgt: Ingxelo yokuphela kwexesha lePalamente yesine ukususela kunyaka wama-2009 ukuya kowama-2014 iza kutyetyiswa yiNgxelo yokuHlola yeMinyaka engama-20 esekelwe kubungqina eyinxalenye yephulo lethu lokubhiyozela iMinyaka engama-20 yeNkululeko.

src: Tlaleho ya pheletso ya nako bakeng sa 2009 ho isa 2014 e tla tlatseletswa ka Tlaleho ya Tekolobotjha ya Dilemo tse 20 e thehilweng hodima bopaki e leng karolo ya letsholo la rona la ketekelo ya Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho.
tgt: Bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika bamenyelelwa kwiphulo elisihloko sithi Dlala Indima Yakho ngeenjongo zokulwa umonakalo wemisebenzi karhulumente wocalucalulo ngokubhiyozela iMinyaka engama-20 yeNkululeko, ebonisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ngokungathandabuzekiyo lilizwe elingcono kunento elaliyiyo ngowama-1994.IKhabinethi iyawubethelela kwakhona umyalezo kaMongameli uJacob Zuma ngoqhankqalazo.

src: MaAforika Borwa ohle a kotjwa ho Bapala Karalo ya Bona ho fetoleng lefa ka kgethollo ka ho keteka Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho, ho bontshang hore Aforika Borwa ehlile ke naha e betere hona le kamoo e neng e le ka teng ka 1994.
tgt: Uqhankqalazo olubeka emngciphekweni ubomi nempahla nolutshabalalisa iziseko zophuhliso ezibalulekileyo zokunceda uluntu, ludelela kwale nkululeko yentando yesininzi ekhusela ilungelo elo lokuqhankqalaza.

src: Boipelaetso bo tshosetsa maphelo le thepa mme bo senya ditheo tsa bohlokwa tse reretsweng ho sebeletsa ditjhaba, hape bo nyenyefatsa demokrasi e sireletsang tokelo ya ho ipelaetsa.
tgt: Njengabemi boMzantsi Afrika sonke sinoxanduva lokwakha isizwe esiwuthobelayo umthetho, esihloniphanayo omnye nomnye kunye nesihlonipha ubomi nempahla.

src: Jwalo ka MaAforika Borwa re na le boikarabello mmoho ba ho aha setjhaba se hlomphang molao, se hlomphanang hape se hlomphang bophelo le thepa.
tgt: IKhabinethi iyaluqinisekisa uluntu ukuba ukubulawa kwabantu ngenxa yokungabinankathalo kwamapolisa ngethuba ejongene nezixholoxholo ezihamba noqhankqalazo akuzi kubethiswa ngoyaba okanye kukhuthazwe.

src: Kabinete e tiisetsa setjhaba hore tahlehelo ya maphelo ka bohlaswa ba sepolesa nakong ya ho sebetsana le boipelaetso e ke ke ya lebalwa kapa ya amohelwa.
tgt: Kananjalo, abaqhankqalazi abaphethe izixhobo okanye abafunyenwe betshisa izakhiwo zoluntu okanye bebeke ubomi babanye abantu emngciphekweni baza kujongana nengalo yomthetho.

src: Ka tsela e jwalo, baipelaetsi ba nang le dibetsa kapa ba fumanwang ba tjhesa meaho ya setjhaba kapa ba beha maphelo a batho ba bang kotsing ba tla ahlolwa ka matla a felletseng a molao.
tgt: Urhulumente uza kusebenzisana noluntu ukuphucula iimeko zabo zokuhlala mbombo zone zeli lizwe.

src: Mmuso o tla sebetsa le ditjhaba ho ntlafatsa maemo a bophelo dikarolong tsohle tsa naha mme ditjhaba di kgothaletswa ho buisana le makhanselara tekong ya ho rarolla mathata a phano ya ditshebeletso mmoho le ka kgotso.
tgt: Uluntu luyacelwa ukuba lusebenzisane nooceba ngeenjongo zokusombulula iingxaki neengxabano zokuhanjiswa kweenkonzo ngokusebenzisana nangaphandle kokujongana ngezikhondo zamehlo.4 Iingxoxo ngemivuzo phakathi kwemigodi yeplatinam kunye nombutho i-Association of Mineworkers and Construction Union (i-AMCU) zingenelelwe yi-CCMI-CCMA yonyule ookomishinala abaphezulu ukuba bachophele ezi ngxoxo.

src: Ditshekatsheko mabapi le mekgolo pakeng tsa dimmaene tsa polathinamo le Mokgatlo wa Basebetsi ba Dimmaene le Yunione ya (AMCU)) di ntse di tsamaiswa ke CCMCCMA e beile makhomishenara a maholo hore a tsamaise tshebetso eo.
tgt: Ikhabinethi iqinisekile ukuba onke amaqela aza kuza nesivumelwano esiza kuba lulutho macala onke nesiza kukhusela amalungelo abasebenzi sikhusele noqoqosho lwelizwe.5 IKhabinethi ikwamkela ngochulumanco ukubhaliswa kwabantu abanelungelo lokuvota abangaphezu kwama-80% ngenxa yephulo lokubhalisa elibe yimpumelelo leKomishoni eziMeleyo yoNyulo.

src: Kabinete e na tle tshepo ya hore mahlakore ohle a tla hlahisa tumellano e molemo ho bohle e tla sireletsa ditokelo tsa basebetsi le ho sireletsa moruo wa naha.
tgt: Ngomoya wokubhiyozela nesikhumbuzo seMinyaka engama-20 yeNkululeko, iKhabinethi iyothulela umnqwazi i-IEC, imibutho yezopolitiko kunye noluntu abathe ngeenzame zabo bebonke baqinisekisa ukuba abantu abaselungelweni lokuvota babhalisile.

src: Kabinete e amohela boingodiso ba bakgethi ba tshwanelehang ba fetang 80% ka lebaka la letsholo le atlehileng la boingodiso la Khomishene e Ikemetseng ya Dikgetho (IEC).
tgt: IKhabinethi isekwabamba ngazibini kwabo bemi baye baqinisekisa ukuba amagama abo akuluhlu labavoti.

src: Moyeng wa ho keteka le ho hopola Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho, Kabinete e rorisa IEC, mekgatlo ya dipolotiki le ditho tsa setjhaba tseo mesebetsi ya bona e kopaneng e netefaditseng hore bakgethi ba bangata le ho feta ba tshwanelehang baa ingodisa.
tgt: Abemi abaselungelweni lokuvota abasafuna ukuqinisekisa iinkcukacha zabo abazibhalisileyo kunye nabo basafuna ukubhalisa mabaye kwii-ofisi zabo ze-IEC ezisekuhlaleni phambi kokuba uluhlu lwabavoti luvalwe.

src: Kabinete e boetse e rorisa bonkakarolo ba baahi ba netefaditseng hore mabitso a bona a teng lenaneng la bakgethi.
tgt: Uluhlu lwabavoti luza kuvalwa xa uMongameli ebhengeza (epapasha kwiGazethi kaRhulumente) ukuba umhla we-7 kuCanzibe lusuku lokuvota.

src: MaAforika Borwa ohle a tshwanelehang a kotjwa hore a sebedise tokelo ya bona ya ho kgetha nakong ya Dikgetho tsa bohlano tsa Naha.
tgt: Bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika abanelungelo lokuvota bamenyelelwa ukuba baze kuxhamla ilungelo labo lokuvota kuNyulo lweSizwe lwesihlanu.

src: Kabinete e bitsa baetapele bohle ba dipolotiki hore ba hatelle taba ya boitshwaro dipolotiking hara mekga le batshehetsi ba bona.
tgt: IKhabinethi icela iinkokheli zezopolitiko ukuba zikhuthaze unyamezelwano ngezopolitiko kumaqela kunye nakubalandeli bazo.

src: Sena se bohlokwa ho netefatsa dikgetho tse lokolohileng hape tse nang le tekatekano ho sireletsa ditumelo tsa Molaotheo wa rona.
tgt: Oku kubalulekile ukuze sibe nonyulo olukhululekileyo kwaye sihlonele negunya loMgaqo-siseko wethu.6 IKhabinethi iyawamkela umjikelo wokuqala wephulo lokugonyela intsholongwane ebangela umhlaza i-Human Papilllomavirus Vaccination (i-HPV), oza kuqala ngomhla we-7 kweyoKwindla kowama-2014.

src: Kabinete e amohela karolo ya pele ya letsholo la kentelo ya Human Papillomavirus Vaccination (HPV), e tla qala ka la 7 Hlakubele 2014.
tgt: Abantwana abangamantombaza abaneminyaka ephakathi kwe-9 ne-10 baza kugonyelwa umhlaza womlomo wesibeleko.

src: Kentelo kgahlano le mofetshe wa popelo e tla fuwa banana ba pakeng tsa dilemo tse 9 le Batswadi le bahlokomedi ba banana ba sekolo ba Kereite ya 4 ba kgothaletswa ho tshehetsa letsholo lena ka ho fana ka tumello ya bona le ho buisana le bana ba bona ka bohlokwa ba ente ena.
tgt: Abazali babantwana abangamantombazana abakwiBanga 4 abaminyaka ili-9 neli-10 bayakhuthazwa ukuba baxhase eli phulo ngokunika imvume kunye nokuncokola nabantwana babo ngokubaluleka kolu gonyo.

src: Kgatelopele ena ya bophelo bo botle ba setjhaba, e tsamaisanang le kgothaletso ya Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Bophelo bo botle, ho lebelletswe hore e tla fokotsa mofetshe wa popelo hara basadi le ho fokotsa ho shwa ho tsamaisanang le hona.
tgt: Lo msebenzi mkhulu kangaka wezempilo yoluntu, ohambelana neziphakamiso zoMbutho wezeMpilo weHlabathi, ulindeleke ukuba ube negalelo kangangoko kwiphulo lokunciphisa umhlaza womlomo wesibeleko kunye nenani lababhubhayo ngenxa yawo.7 IKhabinethi kananjalo yamkele ukuphehlelelwa koMgaqo-nkqubo woCwangciso-ntsapho nokuCwangciswa kokuQhama neziKhokelo zokuHanjiswa kweeNkonzo ngomhla wama-27 kweyoMdumba kowama-2014 nguMphathiswa wezeMpilo.

src: Hape Kabinete e amohetse tsebiso ya Molawana o shebilweng botjha wa Thero ya Dithibelapelehi le ho Tswala le Ditataiso tsa Phano ya Tshebeletso ka la 27 Hlakola 2014 ke Letona la Bophelo bo botle.
tgt: (Oku kuza kunceda amantombazana aselula ukuba agqibe ukufunda alandela amaphupha awo engaphazanyiswa luxanduva lokuba ngabazali bengakucwangcisanga oko.

src: (Sena se tla dumella basadi ba batjha ho phethela dithuto tsa bona le ho sala ditoro tsa bona morao ntle le tshitiso ya botswadi bo sa rerwang.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezeMpilo uza kuphehlelela uhlobo locwangciso-ntsapho ngotyando olufakelwa phantsi kwesikhumba.

src: Letona la Bophelo bo botle le boetse le tla tsebisa kenyo ya ka tlaase ho letlalo e leng sesebediswa sa ho thibela pelehi se setjha se sebetsang ka nako e telele bakeng sa basadi.
tgt: Olu luhlobo locwangciso-ntsapho loomama olusebenza ixesha elide.8 UMongameli uJacob Zuma, njengoMphathi weMikhosi Jikelele woMkhosi wezoKhuselo weSizwe woMzantsi Afrika, uza kuzimasa uSuku lwezoMkhosi eBloemfontein ngomhla wama-21 kweyoMdumba kowama-2014.Lo mbhiyozo waminyaka le uhlonipha umsebenzi wokuzinikela kwamajoni eli kwaye unika imbeko kwabo bawele edabini.

src: Mopresidente Jacob Zuma, jwalo ka Kgosi e ka Sehloohong ya Sesole sa Tshireletso sa Aforika Borwa (SANDF), o tla ba teng ho Letsatsi la Mabotho a Hlometseng ho la Lejwe Leputswa ka la 21 Hlakola 2014.Ketsahalo ena ya selemo le selemo e tlotla tshebeletso ya boinehelo ya banna le basadi ba rona ba yunifomo hape e rorisa ba weleng ba le tshebetsong.
tgt: Usekwanika ithuba nakuluntu ukuba luzibonele ngokwalo lufunde nangomsebenzi noxanduva lomkhosi weli, i-SANDF.

src: Kabinete e thabetse palo ya matsholo a atlehileng ao SANDF e a entseng kontinenteng ka bophara, jwalo ka ho la Burundi eo kajeno e nang le mmuso o tsitsitseng DRC e botjhabela, moo SANDF, jwalo ka karolo ya Force Intervention Brigade (FIB), e thefutseng dihlopha tse hlometseng, le neelano ya yona ho pholoseng maphelo a makgolo a dikete sebakeng sa Darfur, Sudan.
tgt: IKhabinethi ichulumancile linani lamaphulo ayimpumelelo athatyathwe yi-SANDF kweli lizwekazi, umzekelo, eBurundi ekunamhlanje nayo inorhulumente ozinzileyo impuma ye-DRC apho i-SANDF, njengenxalenye yeButho loMkhosi lokuNgenelela, yatywatyusha kanobomi amaqela axhobileyo, kwakunye nendima yayo ukuhlanguleni amakhulu-khulu amawaka abantu kummandla waseDarfur eSudan.

src: Ho feta moo, Kabinete e ananetse thibelo e atlehileng ya bophaerete bo atamelang Aforika e Borwa ke SANDF ka ho lebela le ho paterola Lebopo la Mozambique.
tgt: Ngaphezulu, iKhabinethi ikuqaphele ukuthintelwa ngempumelelo yi-SANDF kophango elwandle olufuna ukugonyamela ummandla oseMazantsi e-Afrika ngokutyala amajoni okugada umjelo waseMozambique.9 UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kuthatha uhambo ngomsebenzi oluya e-United Kingdom ukusuka ngomhla we-2 ukuya kowe-4 kweyoKwindla kowama-2014, apho aza kuthi azimase iNkonzo yeSizwe yoMbulelo yokubhiyozela ubomi nemisebenzi yowayesakuba nguMongameli uNelson Mandela e-Westminster Abbey, eLondon ngomhla we-3 kweyoKwindla kowama-20.10 USekela-Mongameli uKgalema Motlante uza kuzimasa isiKhumbuzo semiNyaka eli-100 sokuDityaniswa koMntla noMzantsi weNigeria e-Abuja ngomhla wama-27 kweyoMdumba kowama-2014.

src: Mopresident Jacob Zuma o tla nka leeto la mosebetsi ho ya United Kingdom ho tloha ka la 2 ho isa la 4 Hlakubele 2014, moo a tlang ho ya ho Tshebeletso ya Naha ya Teboho ho ketekela bophelo le mesebetsi ya Mopresidente wa mehleng Nelson Mandela ho la Westminster Abbey, London ka la 3 Hlakubele 2014.
tgt: IKhabinethi iqhwabela izandla abantu base-Federal Republic of Nigeria ngeli theko libaluleke kangaka liza kubanjwa ngonyaka omnye neloMzantsi Afrika libhiyozela imiNyaka engama-20 yeNkululeko.

src: Motlatsa Mopresidente Kgalema Motlanthe o tla ya ho Mokete wa Dilemo tse 100 tsa Kopano-hape ya Nigeria e Leboya le Borwa e Abuja ka la 27 Hlakola 2014.
tgt: INyanga yamaLungelo oLuntu iza kubhiyozelwa phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukubhiyozela iminyaka engama-20 yokutshintsha ubomi babantu kusetyenziswa amalungelo oluntu”.UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kunika intetho ephambili ngoSuku lwamaLungelo oLuntu (ngomhla wama-21 kweyoKwindla kowe-2014) kowona msitho mkhulu e-Sharpville.

src: Kabinete e lebohisa batho ba Riphaboliki ya Federale ya Nigeria ka ketsahalo ena ya boiphihlelo e etsahalang ka selemo se le seng le ha Aforika Borwa e keteka Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho.
tgt: Inkqubo kaRhulumente iza kuxhasa iphulo leMinyaka engama-20 yeNkululeko ngokuqaqambisa imiba ekhuthaza uzinzo ekuhlaleni, eyakha isizwe kunye nomanyano kuMzantsi Afrika wethu.

src: Kgwedi ya Ditokelo tsa Botho e tla ketekelwa tlasa tema ya: “Ho keteka dilemo tse 20 tsa ho fetola maphelo ka ditokelo tsa botho”.Mopresidente Jacob Zuma o tla fana ka puo ya sehlooho bakeng sa Letsatsi la Ditokelo tsa Botho (21 Hlakubele 2014) ketsahalong ya sehlooho ho la Sharpeville.
tgt: ISebe lezoPhuhliso loQoqosho, I-Arente yeSizwe yoPhuhliso loLutsha kunye ne-ofisi yobuMongameli ziza kusingatha iNtlanganiso kaMongameli ngezoLutsha engeMisebenzi nezaKhono kwiZiko leeNkomfa iBirchwood, eBoksburg, ukususela ngomhla wama-28 kweyoMdumba ukuya kowe-3 kweyiKwindla kowama-2014 phantsi komxholo othi: “Sisebenza sisonke ukuxhobisa kunye nokunika ithemba kulutsha loMzantsi Afrika.”Kule minyaka ingama-20 idlulileyo urhulumente usebenzisa iqhinga elimbaxa ukulwa nentswelo-misebenzi kulutsha.

src: Lenaneo la mmuso le tla matlafatsa letsholo la Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho ka ho toboketsa ditaba tse ahang le ho ntlafatsa kopano ya setjhaba, kaho ya naha le bonngwe setjhabeng sa rona sa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Izivumelwano zeZakhono zeSizwe, iMfundo esiSiseko kunye nokuQeshwa koLutsha zigxininisa ukuzibophelela okungqingqwa ngamahlakani okuhlala, zincediswa ziNkqubo zokuQeshwa koLuntu ezohlukeneyo kwakunye nomthetho ofana noMthetho weNkuthazo weRhafu yeNgqesho, uMthetho Nombolo 26 wowama-2013.

src: Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Moruo, Setsi sa Naha sa Ntshetsopele ya Batjha (NYDA) le Bopresidente di tla tshwara Indaba ya Bopresidente ya Batjha e mabapi le Mesebetsi le Bokgoni ho Setsi sa Dikopano sa Birchwood, Boksburg, ho tloha la 28 Hlakola ho isa la 3 Hlakubele 2014 tlasa tema ya: “Ho sebetsa mmoho ho matlafatsa le ho fana ka tshepo ho batjha ba Aforika Borwa.”Dilemong tse 20 tse fetileng mmuso o kentse tshebetsong moralo o makala a fapaneng ho sebetsana le tlhokeho ya mosebetsi batjheng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukubizelwa kwamaqela akwicandelo lezentlalo onke kwiNkomfa yeMisebenzi kaRhulumente eyaNdisiweyo yeCandelo lezeNtlalo ezayo ukuhlola inkqubela ye-EPWP nokuba ingandiswa njani ngakumbi.

src: Ditumellano tsa Bokgoni ba Naha, Thuto ya Motheo le Matlafatso ya Batjha di ananela boitlamo bo matla ba balekane ba setjhaba, hammoho le ba Mananeo a fapaneng a Khiro ya Setjhaba le molao jwalo ka Molao wa Kgohelo ya Lekgetho la Khiro No 26 wa 2013.
tgt: Le nkomfa iza kubanjelwa phantsi komxholo othi: “Sisebenza sonke simanyene ukunyusa isantya sokudalwa kwemisebenzi kwicandelo lezentlalo le-EPWP.”I-EPWP yaphehlelelwa ngowama-2004 kwaye iselelona phulo likarhulumente lidalela izigidi zabantu boMzantsi Afrika amathuba emisebenzi yexeshana elifutshane ukuya kweliphakathi.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho kopana ha balekane bohle ba makala a setjhaba Kopanong e Atolositsweng ya Mesebetsi ya Setjhaba (EPWP) ya Makala a Setjhaba ho lekola tswelopele ya EPWP le hore na e ka atoloswa jwang le ho feta.
tgt: IKhabinethi inqwenelela aBafana Bafana okuhle kumdlalo wabo wamazwe ngamazwe wobuhlobo ozayo bedlala nabo baza kusingatha iNdebe yeHlabathi iBrazil noza kube ukwibala lezemidlalo i-FNB ngomhla we-5 kweyoKwindla kowama-2014.IKhabinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bamkele ezi ndwendwe ngezandla ezishushu noBuntu kwaye baxhase iqela lethu lesizwe.

src: Dipuisano le diqeto tsa bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Iingxoxo kunye nezigqibo zeKhabhinethi ezingundoqo.

src: Kabinete e amohetse ntshetsopele ya molawana wa Tshebeletso ya Naha ya Ntshetsopele ya Mesebetsi, ho kengwa tshebetsong ha morero le tshebetso ya puisano makaleng ohle a mmuso.
tgt: Ikhabinethi yamkele ukuqulunqwa komgaqo-nkqubo weeNkonzo zokuPhuhliswa kwamaKhondo eSizwe, iqhinga lokuwuphumeza kunye nenkqubo yokudlana indlebe nawo onke amanqanaba karhulumente.

src: Tshebeletso e hokahantsweng ya ntshetsopele ya mesebetsi e hlokahala ka potlako ho netefatsa hore batjha, baithuti, le basebetsi ba sa sebetseng le baahi ba se nang mesebetsi ba na le phihlello ho tlhahisoleseding ya maemo ya mesebetsi le ditshebeletso tse amanang le mesebetsi.
tgt: Inkqubo yeenkonzo zokuphuhlisa amakhondo elungelelanisiweyo ifuneka ngokungxamisekileyo ukuqinisekisa ukuba ulutsha, abafundi, abasebenzi abangasetyenziswa ngokwaneleyo kwakunye nabemi beli abangaphangeliyo kufuneka bakwazi ukulufumana ulwazi neenkonzo ezisemgangathweni ngamakhondo.

src: Sena se tla ba dumella hore ba etse dikgetho tse ntle ho feta hape tse nang le tsebo tsa mesebetsi tse fanang ka maemo a hodimo ho feta a mesebetsi hape e thuse ho eketsa kgolo ya nako e telele ya moruo kahare ho naha.
tgt: Oku kuza kubanceda bakwazi ukukhetha amakhondo afanelekileyo nabalungeleyo aza kuwaphucula amathuba abo okufumana umsebenzi kwaye oku kuncede ukukhulisa uqoqosho oluzinzileyo kweli lizwe.

src: Kabinete e tshehetsa ho kengwa tshebetsong ha sistimi ya eDisclosure Ditshebeletsong tsa Setjhaba ho tloha ka Mmesa 2014, e nkang sebaka sa sistimi ya matsoho ya phano, tshebetso le netefatso ya ditsebiso.
tgt: IKhabinethi iyakuxhasa ukuzalisekiswa kwenkqubo yokuXela ngekhompyutha kwabasebenzi bakarhulumente kwiSebe leeNkonzo zabaSebenzi basebuRhulumenteni noLawulo ukususela kuTshazimpunzi wowama-2014, engena endaweni yenkqubo esetyenziswayo yokufaka ngezandla, ukuhlela kunye nokuqinisekisa ezo zinto zixeliweyo.

src: eDisclosure ke ngodiso ya elektroniki e amohelang le ho laola ditsebiso tsa ditjhelete tsa bahiruwa ba kgethilweng (ditho tsa SMS) ba hlokwang hore ba tsebise dikgahleho tsa bona tse ka ngodiswang ho ba Boholong ba Phethahatso ka la 30 Mmesa selemo le selemo.
tgt: Inkqubo yokuxela ngekhompyutha sisixhobo sobuxhaka-xhaka bale mihla sokubhalisa ngokufaka nokugcina iingxelo ezixeliweyo zezimali abasebenzi abakhethiweyo (amalungu olawulo akwizikhundla eziphezulu SMS) ekufuneka bexele konke abanako okunokubhaliswa kubaPhathi abasemaGunyeni ngomhla wama-30 kuTshazimpunzi unyaka nonyaka.

src: Sistimi ya eDisclosure e fumanwa leqepheng la lehae la webosaete ya Lefapha la Ditshebeletso tsa Setjhaba le Tsamaiso – WEBTOKEN - mme e hokahantswe le didathabeise tse ding tse teng tse jwalo ka Khomishene ya Dikhamphani le Thepa ya Kelello, diofisi tsa ngodiso ya ditokomane tsa semolao le eNatis bakeng sa mabaka a netefatso le tiisetso.
tgt: Inkqubo yokuxela yeKhompyutha ikwiwebhusayithi yeSebe leeNkonzo zabaSebenzi basebuRhulumenteni noLawulo – WEBTOKEN – kwaye ikwadibene nabanye oovimba beenkcukacha abafana neKomishoni yeeNkampani kunye noLwazi lweNgqondo, ii-ofisi zokubhalisa umhlaba kunye nenkqubo i-eNatis ngeenjongo zokuqinisekisa nokungqinisisa.

src: Sepheo sa sistimi ke ho matlafatsa boikarabello tatellong ya leano la mmuso la ho se mamelle bomenemene le ho bo fedisa.
tgt: Le nkqubo ijonge ukwenza ngqingqwa uxanduva lokuphendula ngokuhambelana nephulo likarhulumente lokulwa ubuqhophololo.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tshwarwa ha Kopano ya Banamolli ba Aforika le diketsahalo tse amanang tse Gauteng ho tloha la 24 ho isa la 27 Hlakola 2014.
tgt: IKhabinethi iqaphele ukusindlekwa kweNgqungquthelo yooNozikhalazo base-Afrika kwakunye neminye imisitho ehambelana nayo eGauteng ukususela kumhla wama-24 ukuya kowama-27 kweyoMdumba kowama-2014.

src: Setsi sa Dipatlisiso sa Banamolli ba Aforika se tla tshwara kopano tlasa tema ya: “Ho Matlafatsa Puso e Ntle Aforika ka Mosebetsi wa Monamolli”.Sepheo sa Kopano ke ho sibolla ditlatsetso tseo ditsi tsa Banamolli di di etsang ho kopanya demokrasi le puso e ntle, mme kahoo ba tlatsetsa kgotso le botsitso kontinenteng.
tgt: IZiko loPhando looNozikhalazo base-Afrika liza kusindleka ingqungquthela phantsi komxholo othi: “UkuQinisa uLawulo oluLulo e-Afrika ngeNdima kaNozikhalazo.”Injongo yale ngqungquthela kukuphendla igalelo nendima amaziko ezikhalazo ayidlalayo ekukhuthazeni ulawulo lwentando yesininzi kunye nolawulo lukarhulumente olufanelekileyo, ngolo hlobo encedisa kuxolo nozinzo kweli lizwekazi.

src: E boetse e fana ka sebae sa ho buisana ka ho matlafatsa mohopolo wa Monamolli ho la Aforika.
tgt: Isekwabonelela ngeqonga lokuxoxa ngeendlela zokuqinisa le nto kuthiwa nguNozikhalazo e-Afrika.

src: Kopano e tla ka nako eo ka yona ho bewang kgatello e fetang hodima puso e hlwekileng, boikarabello le phano e loketseng ya ditshebeletso ho batho ba tlwaelehileng ba dinaha tsa Aforika.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ibanjwa kanye ngexesha kugxininiswa kakhulu kulawulo lukarhulumente olufanelekileyo, ukuphendula uthatha uxanduva kwakunye nokuhanjiswa kweenkonzo ngobulungisa kubantu jikelele kumazwe ase-Afrika.

src: Dibili.
tgt: IMithetho esaYilwayo.

src: Kabinete e amohetse Molao wa Tokiso wa Dikepe tsa Thekiso, 2014 o tlo hlahiswa Palamenteng.
tgt: IKhabinethi iphumeze ukuba uMthetho siHlomelo osaYilwayo woRhwebo ngeeNqanawa wowama-2014 uthiwe thaca ePalamente.

src: Molao o rera ho lokisa Molao wa Dikepe tsa Thekiso, wa bo 57 wa 1951 o tlang pele ho Molaotheo, 1996 o etsang hore ho be bohlokwa ho matahanya boleng le dipehelo tsa Molaotheo le ho matahanya Ditumellano tsa hajwale tsa Matjhaba.
tgt: Lo Mthetho usaYilwayo ujolise ekutshintsheni uMthetho woRhwebo ngeeNqanawa, uMthetho Nombolo 57 wowe-1951 wona waphunyezwa phambi koMgaqo-siseko wowe-1996, owenze ukuba ulungelelaniswe neenqobo nezibonelelo zoMgaqo-siseko kwakunye nokuwulungelelanisa neziVumelwano ezikhoyo zaMazwe ngaMazwe.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa ha jwale le diketsahalo tse tlang.1 Kabinete e hatella kgoeletso ya Mopresidente Jacob Zuma ho mmuso, kgwebo le mesebetsi ho sebetsa mmoho ho hodisa moruo wa rona ka sekgahla se kgonang ho hlahisa mesebetsi e meng.
tgt: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba egqubayo neziganeko ezizayo.1 IKhabinethi iyalibethelela kwakhona ikhwelo elihlatywe nguMongameli uJacob Zuma kurhulumente, abezoshishino kunye nabasebenzi ukuba basebenzisane ukukhulisa uqoqosho ngeqondo elinokubanakho ukudala eminye imisebenzi.

src: Puo ya Boemo ba Naha le Puo ya Ditekanyetso di beile motheo bakeng sa ho kengwa tshebetsong ho potlakileng ha Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha nakong ya kotara e tlang ya tsamaiso e ntjha.
tgt: INtetho engoBume beSizwe kunye noHlahlo-lwabiwo-mali zakhe isiseko sokuba isiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe siphunyezwe ngaphezulu kumbuso wolawulo omtsha wePalamente ezayoUHlahlo-lwabiwo-mali lwama-21 lwalo rhulumente wentando yesininzi ngokwenene lubalisa ibali elincumisayo ngendlela esiliguqula siliphucula ngayo eli lizwe kunye nendlela esiqhubela phambili ngayo ukulwa nemingeni yendlala, ukungalingani kunye nentswelo-ngqesho – kwaye, okubalulekileyo, sikwenza oku ngoko kuncinane sinako.2 IKhabinethi ivakalise ukubindeka kwayo ngokungcola nokubulawa kwamantombazana aselula amabini kutshanje kumkhwa ekutyholwa ukuba udibene nonqulo.

src: Diketso tse tjena ha di amohelwe naheng ya rona.
tgt: Imikhwa enjalo ayinandawo kwilizwe lethu.

src: Ka hore Molaotheo o hatella tokelo ya bophelo, motho mang kapa mang ya fumanwang a tlotse molao o tla qoswa ka matla a felletseng a molao.3 Kabinete e leboha maAforika Borwa ohle le dikhamphani bakeng sa diteko tsa bona tsa poloko ya motlakase, haholo ha phepelo ya naha e le tlasa kgatello.
tgt: Njengoko uMgaqo-siseko ulikhusela ilungelo lobomi, nabani na ofunyenwe esaphula umthetho uza kujongana nengalo yomthetho.3 IKhabinethi ibamba ngazibini kubo bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika kunye nabezoshishino ngamaphulo okonga amandla ombane, ingakumbi xa iziko lesizwe leenkonzo zombane beliphantsi konxinzelelo.

src: Leha naha e na le bokgoni ba ho kgotsofatsa tlhoko ya ha jwale, basebedisi bohle ba motlakase ba kgothaletswa ho kenyeletsa poloko ya motlakase jwalo ka mokgwa wa bophelo.4 Kabinete e lebohela dikolo le matitjhere ohle ba thongweng bakeng sa Dikgau tsa Naha tsa ho Ruta 2013: Dikgau tsa Via Afrika People's Choice tse tla tshwarwa ka la 6 Hlakubele 2014 Setsing sa Dikopano sa Birchwood se Gauteng.
tgt: Nangona ilizwe linakho ukuvelisa umbane owaneleyo ofunekayo, bonke abasebenzisi bombane bayakhuthazwa ukuba baziqhelise iindlela zokonga umbane kwaye bakuphile oko.4 IKhabinethi ivuyisana nezikolo nootitshala abaye boyulelwa ukufumana iiMbasa zobuTitshala zeSizwe yowama-2013: IiMbasa zakwa-Via Afrika zabaKhethwe ngaBantu, theko elo liza kubanjwa ngomhla we-6 kweyoKwindla kowama-2014 kwiZiko leeNkomfa iBirchwood eGauteng.

src: Dikgau tsena ke tsela e le nngwe feela eo ka yona Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo le tlotlang le ho kgothaletsa matitjhere a kgothetseng a tsotellang ditekong tsa bona tsa ho ntshetsapele baithuti jwalo ka baahi ba nang le boikarabello ba Aforika Borwa e nang le demokrasi, e se nang kgethollo ya morabe kapa ya bong.
tgt: Ezi mbasa zeyenye indlela iSebe lezeMfundo esiSiseko elibulela nelikhuthaza ngayo ootitshala abazinikeleyo nabanenkathalo kwiinzame zabo zokuphuhlisa abafundi ukuba babe ngabemi abanoxanduva besizwe soMzantsi Afrika esilawulwa yintando yesininzi, esinganabuhlanga nesingacalucaluli ngokwesini.

src: Kabinete hape e thatisella ditokelo tsa bana tsa ho ithuta tikolohong e bolokehileng hape e kgothaletsang thuto.5 Kabinete e amohela tshehetso e tswellang ya Lefapha la Saense le Theknoloji ya Mokete wa Naha wa Saense, o bitswang Scifest Africa, o tla tshwarwa ho tloha ho la 12 ho isa ho la 18 Hlakubele 2014 ho la Grahamstown e Kapa Botjhabela tlasa tema ya “Ho kena Sebakeng.” Ketsahalo ena ya selemo le selemo e tsebahatsa saense, theknoloji, boenjineri le mmetse jwalo ka menyetla ya mesebetsi ho batjha ba rona hape e theha kutlwisiso e ntlafetseng ya mafapha ana hara maAforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabinethi iyawagxininisa kwakhona amalungelo abantwana okufunda kwindawo ekhuselekileyo nefanelekileyo.5 IKhabinethi ibulela iSebe lezeNzululwazi nobuChwepheshe ngokuqhubeka lixhasa uMnyhadala weNzululwazi weSizwe, obizwa ngokuba yi-Scifest Africa, oza kubanjwa ngomhla we-12 ukuya kowe-18 kweyoKwindla kowama-2014 eRhini eMpuma Koloni phantsi komxholo othi “Sisinge eMajukujukwini”.

src: Mmuso o tswelapele ho beha kapele le ho tsebahatsa kgetho ya Mmetse le Disaense tsa Tshwaro jwalo ka karolo ya ho ntshetsapele bokgoni ba bohlokwa bo hlokwang ke moruo wa rona o ntseng o hola.6 Kabinete e amohela phatlalatso e entsweng ke Mokgatlo wa Setsha sa Lenaneo la Dipatlisiso tsa AIDS ka hare ho Aforika Borwa ka tshibollo ya dianthibodi tse matla tsa HIPatlisiso e mabapi le kamoo mmele wa mosadi wa KwaZulu-Natal o ileng wa arabela tshwaetso ya hae ya HIV ka ho etsa dianthibodi tse matla.
tgt: Lo mnyhadala waminyaka le ukhuthaza inzululwazi, ubuchwepheshe, ubunjineli kunye nezibalo njengamakhondo ulutsha lwethu olunokuwalandela kwaye uzama nokunceda uluntu loMzantsi Afrika ukuba luwaqonde ngcono la macandelo.

src: Phuputso, e hatisitsweng ho jenaleng ya maemo a hodimo ya saense e bitswang, Nature, e hlalosa kamoo sehlopha sa patlisiso se fumaneng sa ba sa supa dianthibodi tseo mading a mosadi eo ya ba ba etsa dianthibodi tse tshwanang le tseo hantle ka laborathoring.
tgt: URhulumente uyaqhubeka ukukuthatha njengokubalulekileyo kunye nokukuxhasa ukulandelwa kweZibalo kunye neNzululwazi njengenxalenye yokuphuhlisa izakhono ezinqongopheleyo ezibalulekileyo nezifunekeyo kolu qoqosho lwethu lusakhulayo.6 IKhabinethi isichulumancele isibhengezo esenziwe nguMbutho i-CAPRISA ngokufunyanwa kwezithinteli-ntsholongwane ezinamandla ezintsha zentsholongwane i-HIOlu phando lubonisa indlela umzimba womfazi waKwaZulu-Natal owalwa ngayo wakuba wosulelwa yintsholongwane i-HIV ngokuzenzela izithinteli-ntsholongwane.

src: Dianthibodi tsena tse iketseditsweng di ile tsa sebediswa letotong la diteko ka laborathoring ho hlakisa tsela e latetsweng ke masole a mmele wa mosadi eo ho etsa dianthibodi tsena tse matla.
tgt: Olu phando, olupapashwe kwijenali yenzululwazi ehlonitshwe kakhulu esihloko sithi Nature, luchaza indlela iqela lengcaphephe zabaphandi elafumana laze lachonga ngayo ezi zithinteli-ntsholongwane kwigazi lalo mfazi laze lenza amawele afana twatse nazo elebhu.

src: Ditsebo tse ntjha tse fumanweng ho tswa ho mosadi enwa wa KwaZulu-Natal mabapi le dikarabelo tsa masole a mmele kgahlano le HIV di tlisa tshepo bakeng sa thibelo ya HIV le maano a kalafo a nako e tlang.
tgt: Ezi zithinteli-ntsholongwane zingamawele afana twatse zaye zasetyenziswa kumalinge emifuniselo amaninzi elebhu ngeenjongo zokucacisa indlela amajoni omzimba alo mfazi azenza ngayo ezi zithinteli-ntsholongwane zinamandla.

src: Tshibollo ena ha se pheko ya HIV/AIDS ka tsela efe kapa efe mme kahoo mmuso o kopa maAforika Borwa ho tswelapele ho etsa diteko bakeng sa HIV kapa ho tswelapele ka kalafo ya dianthiretrovaerale e fuwang batho bao diteko tsa bona di hlahisang hore ba na le HIV.7 Mopresidente Jacob Zuma o tla bua ketekelong ya Letsatsi la Ditokelo tsa Botho tsa selemo sena ka la 21 Hlakubele 2014 tlasa tema ya “Ho ketekela Dilemo tse 20 tsa ho fetola maphelo ka ditokelo tsa botho!” Lebaleng la Kirikete la Sharpeville le Gauteng.
tgt: Ulwazi olutsha olufunyenwe ngophando kulo mfazi waKwaZulu-Natal ngendlela amajoni omzimba alwa ngayo intsholongwane i-HIV lunika ithemba ngeendlela zobuchule ezizayo zokuthintela nokunyanga intsholongwane kaGawulayo.

src: Kabinete e kopa maAforika Borwa ho ketekela ho phela naheng e netefatsang hore le ka mohla botho ba rona bo ke ke ba nkuwa ho moAforika Borwa ofe kapa kapa, ho sa natswe morabe, bong, bodumedi kapa tshekamelo ya ho ratana.
tgt: Kodwa ke, oku kufunyenweyo akuthethi ukuba iNtsholongwane kaGawulayo noGawulayo ziyanyangeka, (HIV/AIDS) kwaye urhulumente ke ngoko usahlaba ikhwelo kubemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba baqhubeke bezivavanyela intsholongwane kaGawulayo okanye baqhubeke besebenzisa amayeza athomalalisa ulwamvila lwentsholongwane kaGawulayo anikwa abo bafunyaniswe benale ntsholongwane emva kovavanyo.7 UMongameli uJacob Zuma kulo nyaka uza kwenza intetho kwimibhiyozo yoSuku lwamaLungelo oLuntu ngomhla wama-21 kweyoKwindla kowama-2014 phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukubhiyozela iminyaka engama-20 yokutshintsha ubomi babantu sisebenzisa amalungelo oluntu!” kumaBala eQakamba aseSharpeville eGauteng.

src: Kaofela re na le boikarabello ba ho netefatsa hore rekote ya rona ya ditokelo tsa botho le nalane di bolokwa le ho matlafatswa bakeng sa meloko e tlang.8 Beke ya Naha ya Metsi e tla phatlalatswa ho la Bushbuckridge ka la 14 Hlakubele mme e tla tswelapele ka diketsahalo tse mmalwa ho fihlela la 23 Hlakubele 2014.
tgt: IKhabinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba babhiyozele ukuphila kwilizwe eliqinisekisa ukuba abusoze ubuntu bethu buthathwe kuye nawuphi na ummi woMzantsi Afrika, nokuba ungowoluphi na uhlanga, isini, inkolo okanye umntu okhetha ukuthandana nasiphi na isini.

src: Ketsahalo ya phatlalatso e tla be e le mabapi le ho theolwa ha dipompo Mokoting wa South Vertical e leng mmaene wa kgale wa ERPM ho sebetsana le taba ya Phallo ya Asiti ya Mmaene ho Central Witwatersrand Basin.
tgt: Sonke sinoxanduva lokuqinisekisa ukuba imbali yethu yamalungelo oluntu igciniwe kwaye iyabethelelwa ukulungiselela izizukulwana ezizayo.8 IVeki yaManzi yeSizwe iza kuphehlelelwa eBushbuckridge ngomhla we-14 kweyoKwindla kowama-2014.

src: Matsatsing a mang a beke eo ho tla fanwa ka tshebeletso ya tlhwekiso ya metsi a ditshila le merero ya phepelo ya metsi ka bongata diporofenseng tse itseng.
tgt: Eli theko lokusungula liza kube limalunga nokuthotywa kweempompo kwi-South Vertical Shaft yomgodi omdala i-ERPM ukuze kujongwane nengxaki yaManzi ane-Asidi atsitsa eMgodini kwiCentral Witwatersrand Basin.

src: Tema ya selemo sena ke “Metsi ke Bophelo – Dilemo tse 20 tsa Phepelo ya Metsi bakeng sa Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba le Moruo.” Kabinete e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa ho boloka metsi hape e hatella tlhokomelo ya tsamaiso ya nako e telele ya sesebediswa sena se fokolang, ele ho ka atolosa phihlello ho maAforika Borwa a mangata.9 Kabinete e bolelletswe ka Presidential Youth Indaba e atlehileng ya pele e tshwaretsweng ho la Ekurhuleni ho tloha la 28 Hlakola ho isa la 03 Hlakubele 2014.
tgt: Ngezinye intsuku zale veki kuza kunikezelwa ngezixhobo zokucoca amanzi amdaka kunye neeprojekthi zokubonelela ngamanzi amaninzi kumaphondo aliqela.

src: Indaba e ne e tshwerwe ke Kantoro ya Mopresidente, Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Moruo (EDD) le Akgente ya Ntshetsopele ya Batjha ba Naha (NYDA).
tgt: Umxholo walo nyaka uthi “Amanzi abuBomi – ImiNyaka engama-20 yokuNikezelwa kwaManzi kuPhuhliso lweNtlalo noQoqosho”.

src: Indaba e kentse tshebetsong Tumellano ya Khiro ya Batjha e tekennwe ka Mmesa 2013 ke mmuso, kgwebo le mesebetsi.
tgt: IKhabinethi icela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba balondoloze amanzi kwaye iyakubethelela kwakhona ukubaluleka kokulawulwa ngokuzinzileyo kwemithombo yawo ebalulekileyo nenqongopheleyo, ukuze zifikelelwe kwaye zixhanyulwe ngabemi boMzantsi Afrika abangaphezulu.9 IKhabinethi yaziswe ngempumelelo yeNgqungquthela yoLutsha kaMongameli ebanjelwe e-Ekurhuleni ukususela ngomhla wama-28 kweyoMdumba ukuya kowe-3 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2014.

src: Mopresidente Jacob Zuma o fane ka puo ya sehlooho ho Indaba, moo teng ho bileng le bonyane batjha ba 500 ho tswa diporofenseng tsohle.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ibisindlekwe yi-ofisi yoBongameli, iSebe loPhuhliso lwezoQoqosho kunye ne-Arhente yeSizwe yoPhuhliso loLutsha.

src: Matona a fapaneng a nkile karolo dipuisanong ho hlalosetsa batjha ka mananeo a mmuso bakeng sa khiro ya batjha.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela iphumeze iSivumelwano seNgqesho yoLutsha esasityikitywe kuTshazimpunzi wama-2013 ngurhulumente, abazoshishino nabasebenzi.

src: Ho feta moo, meralo e tiileng e ile ya amohelwa e tla etsa hore Mopresidente le Matona a fapaneng ba dule ba sebetsa mmoho le batjha ho netefatsa theho ya mesebetsi.10 Kabinete e lemohile Kopano ya Naha ya Tshekatsheko moo ho ileng batho ba bangata hape e atlehileng e neng e le mabapi le Pampiri e Tala ya Molawana wa Thekenoloji ya Kgokahanyo ya Tlhahisoleseding (ICT) o Kopaneng wa Naha, e neng e le ka la 3 Hlakubele 2014.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma ebesisithethi sembeko kule ngqungquthela, ebizinyaswe ngabantu abatsha abamalunga nama-500 bephuma kuwo onke amaphondo eli.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa setjhaba ho nka karolo dipuisanong tsa Pampiri e Tala diporofenseng tse qalang ho la Rustenburg ka la 7 Hlakubele.
tgt: Abaphathiswa abohlukeneyo bathathe inxaxheba kwiingxoxo zamaqela ngeenjongo zokwenza amagqabantshintshi becacisela ulutsha ngeenkqubo zikarhulumente ezijongene nokuqeshwa kolutsha.

src: Pampiri e Tala e tla lebisa ho phethelo ya Pampiri e Tshweu hara selemo, e tlang ho fana ka moralo wa ho fetola molao ka ditsela tse tla ananela diphetoho tse kgolo lekaleng la ICT dilemong tsa morao tjena.11 Kabinete e thabetse hore esale ho amohelwa “SA Connect”, e leng Morero wa Broadband ka la 4 Tshitwe 2013, dikolo tse 782 di se di hoketswe ka dikhomphutha le dilaborathori tsa inthanete Setsi sa Ikamva e-Skills se tsebisitswe le Lekgotla la Naha la Boeletsi ba Broadband le thehilwe.12 Lefapha la Merero ya Tikoloho le tla tshwara Kopano ya Mekgatlo ya bo 11 (COP11) ho tloha la 17 ho isa la 21 Hlakubele 2014, Setsing sa Matjhaba sa Motse Kapa, tlasa tema ya: “Tsebahatso ya Kgolo e Putswa Aforika: Ho isa Tsamaisong ya Nako e Telele ya Dihlahiswa tsa Mawatleng.” COP11 e tlang hanngwe kamora dilemo tse pedi e kgobokanya matona a tikoloho ho tswa dinaheng tse 22 tse tlasa Tumellano ya Tshebedisanommoho Tshireletsong, Tsamaisong le Ntshetsopeleng ya Tikoloho ya Mawatle le Mabopo a Lebopo la Atlelanthiki a Sebaka sa Aforika e Bophirima, Bohareng le e Borwa.
tgt: Ukongeza koku, kwavunyelwana ngamacebo amatsha nabambekayo apho uMongameli kunye naBaphathiswa abohlukeneyo baza kusebenzisana rhoqo nolutsha kwiphulo lokudala imisebenzi ngokwenene.10 IKhabinethi iqaphele ukuzinyaswa ngamanani avisayo nempumelelo yeNkomfa yeSizwe yokuCebisana ngePhepha loGayo-zimvo olungoMgaqo-nkqubo oHlanganisiweyo woBuchwepheshe boLwazi noNxibelelwano (i-ICT) weSizwe, ebibanjwe ngomhla we-3 kweyoKwindla kowama-2014.

src: Kopano ya 2014 e tla sheba botjha mesebetsi le diqeto tse nkilweng nakong ya sebaka sa 2012/13 tekanyetso ya 2014/15, hape e nke qeto mabapi le ketso e hlokehang ho kenya tshebetsong Tumellano le Morero wa yona wa Tshebetso.
tgt: IKhabinethi iyalukhuthaza uluntu ukuba luthathe inxaxheba kwiindibano zovakaliso-zimvo zamaphondo zePhepha loGayo-zimvo eziza kuqala eRustenburg ngomhla we-7 kweyoKwindla.

src: E boetse e tla nka qeto ya hore na mahlakore a amohela mohopolo wa “Kgolo e Putswa” jwang jwalo ka mokgwa wa ho tsamaisa dihlahiswa tsa mawatle le mabopo ka nako e telele.13 Kabinete e lebohetse sehlopha sa Aforika Borwa sa kirekete sa ba Tlasa 19 ka boiphihlelo ba bona bo makatsang ka ho hapa Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Kirekete (ICC) wa ba Tlasa 19 wa pele ho la Dubai.
tgt: IPhepha loGayo-zimvo liza kukhokelela ekugqityezelweni kwePhepha leNgcaciso yoMgaqo-nkqubo phakathi kulo nyaka, lona liza kubonelela ngenkqubo-sikhokelo yokutshintsha umthetho ngeendlela ezakuthathela ingqalelo izinto ezininzi ezitshintshileyo kushishino lwe-ICT kule minyaka imbalwa idlulileyo.11 IKhabinethi ichulumancile kukwazi ukuba ukususela oko kwamkelwa i-“SA Connect”, IsiCwangciso-qhinga noMgaqo-nkqubo wobuXhaka-xhaka boNxibelelwano, ngomhla we-4 kweyoMnga wama-2013, izikolo ezingama-782 zineekhompyutha ezisebenzayo kunye namagumbi okuzisebenzisa iziko elibizwa ngokuthi i-Ikamva e-Skills Institute laphehlelelwa, laze iBhunga leeNgcebiso ngobuXhaka-xhaka boNxibelelwano lweSizwe lasekwa.12 ISebe lezeNdalo liza kusingatha iNkomfa yaMazwe ngaMazwe ye-11 (i-COP11) ukususela ngomhla we-17 ukuya kowama-21 kweyoKwindla kowama-2014, kwiZiko leNgqungquthela laMazwe ngamazwe laseKapa, phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukuxhasa ukuKhula kwezoLwandle e-Afrika: Indlela eya kuLawulo oluZinzileyo lweZidalwa zaseLwandle”.

src: Tshebetso ya sehlopha e kgothatsang e lokela ho kgothaletsa dibapadi tsohle tsa batjha ho sebeletsa ho fihlela maemo a hodimo le ho feta.14 Kabinete e amohetse Letsatsi la Matjhaba la Basadi – la 8 Hlakubele 2014.
tgt: Le nkomfa, i-COP11, ibanjwa rhoqo emva kweminyaka emibini, idibanisa aBaphathiswa bokusingqongileyo abasuka kumazwe angama-22 atyikitya iSivumelwano seNtsebenziswano soKhuselo, uLawulo noPhuhliso lwezaseLwandle noNxweme lwe-Atlantic olukuMmandla oseNtshona, eMbindini naseMazantsi e-Afrika.

src: Letsatsi leo le fana ka monyetla wa ho maAforika Borwa hore a tlotle boiphehlelo le boinehelo ba basadi ba maAforika Borwa ditjhabeng tsa bo rona.
tgt: Le nkomfa yowama-2014 iza kuhlaziya imisebenzi nezigqibo ezazithathwe kunyaka wama-2012 nowama-2013 uhlahlo-lwabiwo-mali lowama-2014 nowama-2015, ithathe nesigqibo ngamanyathelo afunekayo ukuphumeza isiVumelwano kwakunye noMkhomba-ndlela waso.

src: Aforika Borwa e hloka ho nahana ka tswelopele e entsweng ke ditjhaba, matjhaba le naha ka bophara ho ntshetseng pele ditokelo tsa basadi.
tgt: Iza kucebisa nokuba amazwe ngamazwe angenza njani ukwamkela lo mxholo wokuKhula kwezoLwandle njengendlela yokulawula ubuncwane baselwandle naselunxwemeni ngokuzinzileyo.13 IKhabinethi iyavuyisana neqela loMzantsi Afrika leQakamba labangaPhantsi kweminyaka eli-19 ngomsebenzi omhle kakhulu wokuphumelela iNdebe yeHlabathi yabo yokuqala yabangaPhantsi kweminyaka eli-19 yeBhunga laMazwe ngaMazwe leQakamba eDubai.

src: Leha Molaotheo o fana ka motheo wa boleng le melawana, ke boikarabello ba rona bohle ho boloka le ho sireletsa basadi le ho netefatsa hore ba fuwa matla a ho nka karolo jwalo ka baahi ba lekanang le bohle ntshetsopeleng ya moruo le naha ya rona.2 Dipuisano le dikamohelo tsa Kabinete.1 Kabinete e amohetse qaleho ya tshebetso ya puisano ka maikemisetso a ho hlahisa baithuti ba dikolo tse kgolo ba nang le boporofeshenale ho feta.
tgt: Ukudlala weli qela okuvuselelayo kudlala indima enkulu yokukhathaza zonke iimbaleki ezilula ukuba nazo zizeke mzekweni, basebenzele ukunqandwa zinkwenkwezi.14 IKhabinethi iqaphele uSuku lwaMazwe ngaMazwe looMama oluzayo – ngomhla we-8 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2014.

src: Sena se tla tsebisa moralo wa tshebedisanommoho e eketsehileng, kgokahanyo le kopano pakeng tsa mekgatlo ya seporofeshenale, dikhansele tsa boleng, indasteri, ditsi tsa thuto e phahameng le mmuso.
tgt: Olu suku lubonelela ngethuba lokuba abemi boMzantsi Afrika bancome impumelelo nokuzincama kwabasetyhini kuluntu lwethu.

src: Sena se tla kenya letsoho ho ntshetsopele ya basebetsi ba nang le bokgoni hape ba kgonang ho sebetsa ho tshehetsa tsela e akaretsang ya kgolo.2 Kabinete e amohetse Bili ya Tokiso ya Inshorense ya Tlhoko ya Mosebetsi ya 2014 bakeng sa ho iswa Palamente.
tgt: Abemi boMzantsi Afrika kufuneka bacinge ngenkqubela eyenziwe ngabahlali, uluhlu ngokubanzi kunye nelizwe lonke ekuqhubeleni phambili idabi lamalungelo abasetyhini.15 Nangona uMgaqo-siseko usibonelela ngeenqobo ezisisiseko nemithetho-sisekelo, luxanduva lwethu sonke ukukhusela abasetyhini nokuqinisekisa ukuba bayaxhotyiswa ukuze bakwazi ukuthatha inxaxheba kuphuhliso loqoqosho nelizwe lethu njengabemi abalingana nomntu wonke.

src: Ena ke tokiso ya bobedi ho Molao wa Tokiso wa Inshorense ya Tlhoko ya Mosebetsi, wa bo 63 wa 2001.Ditokiso di tla tswelapele ho fokotsa dikamo tse mpe tsa moruo le setjhaba tsa tlhoko ya mesebetsi, ka ho latela maemo a Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Mesebetsi, a ho kenyeletsa baithuti ba ithutang mesebetsing le basebeletsi ba mmuso bao ha jwale ba sa kenyeletswang ho latela Molao.
tgt: Iingxoxo kunye nezigqibo zeKhabhinethi.1 IKhabinethi ikuphumezile ukuqaliswa kwenkqubo yothethathethwano ebanzi yeengcebiso ngenjongo yokuvelisa iingcali ezinezidanga ezingaphezulu.

src: Ho kengwa tshebetsong ha Bili ya Tokiso, 2014, hara tse ding, ho tla eketsa nako ya tefo ya ditsiane ho monka karolo ho tloha ho dikgwedi tse 8 ho ya ho tse 12, mme hoo ho tla mo dumella hore a batle mosebetsi o mong e bile hape a kgole ditsiane nakong e telele ho feta.
tgt: Oku kuza kuqalisa isicwangciso-nkqubo sokusebenzisana ngamandla nokululungelelanisa intsebenziswano ngokuphucukileyo phakathi kwamaqumrhu ezifundiswa, amabhunga okuhlola umgangatho, urhwebo, amaziko ezemfundo ephakamileyo kunye norhulumente.

src: Molefi o boetse o tla ba le nako e eketsehileng ya ho kenya tseko, ho tloha ho dikgwedi tse 6 ho ya ho dikgwedi tse E boetse e tla dumella thonyo ya bajalefa sebakeng sa ditsiane tsa lefu.3 DithonyoKabinete e amohetse dithonyo tse latelang:3.1 Monghadi Daan du Toit jwalo ka Motlatsi wa Motsamaisi e Moholo: Kgokahanyo ya Matjhaba le Dihlahiswa Lefapheng la Saense le Theknoloji.2 Monghadi Garth Strachan jwalo ka Motlatsi wa Motsamaisi e Moholo: Ntshetsopele ya Melawana ya Indasteri Lefapheng la Kgwebisano le Indasteri.3 Mofumadi Malebo Mabitje-Thompson Motlatsi wa Motsamaisi e Moholo: Ntshetsopele ya Indasteri ho Tsamaiso ya Ditsiane Lefapheng la Kgwebisano le Indasteri.4 Boto ya Aforika Borwa ya Mokgatlo wa Inshorense ya Kotsi e Kgethehileng (SASRIA) Khamphani ya Mmuso (SOC) Limiteda) Thonyo botjha ya Monghadi Cedrick Mnwabisi Masondo jwalo ka Motsamaisi e Moholo le Motsamaisi wa Phethahatso ho Boto.
tgt: Oku kuza kuba negalelo kwiphulo lokuphuhlisa abasebenzi abanezakhono nabakwaziyo ukusebenza ukuze kuxhaswe ukuhluma okubandakanya wonke ubani.2 IKhabinethi iwamkele uMthetho Sihlomelo we-Inshorensi yabaNgasebenziyo wowama-2014 ukuba ungeniswe ePalamente.

src: b) Thonyo botjha ya Mofumadi Karen Pepler jwalo ka Motsamaisi wa Phethahatso ho Boto.
tgt: Esi sisilungiso sesibini kuMthetho we-Inshorensi yabaNgasebenziyo, uMthetho Nombolo 63 wowama-2001.Izilungiso ziyanaba ngokubangula ifuthe elinobungozi kwezoqoqosho nakwezentlalo elibangelwa kukungaphangeli, ngokulandela uMbutho wabaSebenzi waMazwe ngaMazwe, ngokuthi kubandakanywe abafundi abasagqibezela izifundo besemisebenzini kunye nabasebenzi bakarhulumente bona abangakhankanywanga ngokwalo Mthetho.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa ha jwale le diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba egqubayo neziganeko ezizayo.1 IKhabinethi iyakwamkela ukukhutshwa kweNgxelo ngoPhononongo loMzantsi Afrika lwemiNyaka engamaShumi amaBini yeyowama-1994 ukuya kowama-2014, nguMongameli Jacob Zuma, ebubungqina benkqubela phambili urhulumente ayenzileyo ukuqinisekisa ubomi obungcono babo bonke abantu.

src: Kabinete e amohetse ho tokollo ya Tlaleho ya Aforika Borwa ya Tjhebisiso ya Dilemo tse Mashome a Mabedi 1994–2014, ka Mopresidente Jacob Zuma e le sesupo sa kgatelopele eo Mmuso e se entseng ho netefatsa bophelo bo botle bakeng sa bohle.
tgt: Njengoko le Ngxelo iza kusetyenziswa njengesinikezelo sokukhumbula ongasekhoyo nowayesakuba nguMongameli uNelson Mandela, isiGqeba sihlaba ikhwelo kuwo onke amacandelo oluntu ukuba ayifunde ayixoxe le ngxelo, aze abe yinxalenye yemibhiyozo yemiNyaka engama-20 yeNkululeko kwaye abe phambili kumaphulo esizwe okugwadla nokuxoxa ngempumelelo kunye nemingeni esisajongene nayo.

src: Moyeng wa hore Tjhebisiso e na e hlomphe Mopresidente wa mehleng Nelson Mandela, Phethahatso e kopa makala ohle a setjhaba ho sebetsana le tlaleho, ba be karolo ya diketekelo tsa Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho mme ba thuse ho bopa dipuisano tsa naha hodima boiphihlelo le diphephetso tsa rona.
tgt: Le Ngxelo ibubungqina benkqubela phambiliesele yenziwe ekwakheni uhlobo lwenkululeko engenacalu-calulo ngokobuhlanga nangokwesini, eqhubela phambili nedlamkileyo yentando yesininzi exhaswa nguMgaqo-siseko ukuqinisekisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ngenene lilizwe elingcono ubani anokuphila kulo.2 IKhabinethi ikhumbuza onke amacandelo oluntu ukuba unyaka wama-2014 ubekelwe bucala njengonyaka wephulo leNkululeko yemiNyaka engama-20.UTshazimpunzi yiNyanga yeNkululeko.

src: Tjhebisiso e netefatsa kgatelopele eo re e entseng ho aha demokrasi ya molaotheo e se nang kgethollo ya mmala, kgethollo ya bong, e phetseng hantle hape e hlasimolohileng, e etsang Aforika Borwa naha e betere eo re ka phelang ho yona.
tgt: Bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika kunye namahlakani nabachaphazelekayo bamazwe ngamazwe bayamenywa ukuba babe yinxalenye yemibhiyozo yeNyanga yeNkululeko ngokubalisa awabo amabali okuba sibutshintshe bangcono njani ubomi babemi boMzantsi Afrika ngokusebenzisana.

src: Kabinete e hopotsa makala ohle a setjhaba hore 2014 e reretswe letsholo la Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho.
tgt: Njengoko siza kuqokoza sisiya kwizikhululo zokuvota ngomhla we-7 kuCanzibe kowama-2014, masiphinde kwakhona sibonakalise ukuba ulawulo lwethu lwentando yesininzi lunoxolo, ludlamkile kwaye sisalulangazelela.

src: MaAforika Borwa le balekane ba matjhaba le baamehi ba memelwa ho nka karolo ketekelong ya Kgwedi ya Tokoloho ka ho bolela pale tsa bona tsa hore na, ka ho sebetsa mmoho, re fetotse maphelo a maAforika Borwa jwang hore a be betere.
tgt: IKhabinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba nabo bathathe inxaxheba kumaphulo okugaya iivoti kodwa bakwenze oko ngoxolo kunye nokunyamezelana okuhlonela amalungelo abo bonke abavoti okuvakalisa izimvo zabo esidlangalaleni nokukhetha elo qela balithandayo kunyulo ekhusini kwindlwana yokuvotela.

src: Ha re ya re lebileng diteishene tsa dikgetho ka la 7 Motsheanong 2014, ha re bontsheng hape hape hore re demokrasi e hlasimolohileng, e nang le tjantjello le kgotso.
tgt: I-arente ezinyanzelisa ukuthotyelwa komthetho ziza kusebenza ukukhusela eli lungelo, ukuqinisekisa ukuba yonke imimandla kweli lizwe ithatha inxaxheba kule nkqubo yentando yesininzi, esisiphumo soMzabalazo wethu wenkululeko.3 Njengenxalenye yesicwangciso sokunatyiswa kweziseko zoncedo nophuhliso ezingundoqo zesizwe seKhomishoni kaMongameli yokuLungelelanisa iziSeko ezinguNdoqo, iKhabinethi icela isizwe ukuba siqwalasele le misebenzi incumisayo ilandelayo:.1 IDama i-De Hoop, eLimpopo, liza kusebenza ngokusesikweni ekupheleni kweyoKwindla kowama-2014.

src: Kabinete e kopa maAforika Borwa ohle hore ebe bankakarolo ba bonahalang dikgethong empa ba etse jwalo ka kgotso le mamello bakeng sa tokelo ya bakgethi bohle ba bang ya ho hlahisa maikutlo a bona setjhabeng le ho etsa kgetho ya bona sephiring sebakeng sa ho kgetha.
tgt: Eli lidama lesine ngobukhulu ukwakhiwa emva kolawulo lwentando yesininzi.

src: Ditsi tsa molao di tla be di sebeletsa ho sireletsa tokelo ena, ho netefatsa hore dibaka tsohle naheng di nka karolo tshebetsong ena ya demokrasi, e leng sephetho sa Toanelo ya rona ya tokoloho.
tgt: Eli Dama liza kuphuhlisa uqoqosho, lidale imisebenzi kwaye lincedise nasekuhanjisweni kweenkonzo kweli phondo nakwilizwe ngokubanzi.

src: Jwalo ka karolo ya morero wa naha wa tlhahiso ya meaho ya Khomishene ya Mopresidente ya Tlhophiso ya Meralo ya Motheo, Kabinete e supisa naha dintshetsopele tse latelang tse ntle:1.
tgt: Abantu abangaphezu kwama-800 000 kummandla waseSekhukhune baza kuxhamla kumanzi acocekileyo nasisigxina ukanti imigodi emitsha kunye nabalimi nabo baza kuxhamla kula manzi eli dama.

src: Letamo la De Hoop le Limpopo le tla bulwa ho ya mafelong a Hlakubele 2014.
tgt: Oomasipala kulo mmandla, bexhaswa ngurhulumente kandlukulu nowephondo, batyale imali eyongezelelweyo ezibhiliyoni ezintathu zeerandi kwiziseko zoncedo nophuhliso zokucoca nokusa amanzi kubantu basemaphandleni nasezidolophini.2 IKhabinethi ivakalise ukoneliseka ngokusungulwa okucetywayo kwesiGaba II se-Lesotho Highlands Water Project ngomhla wama-27 kweyoKwindla kowama-2014.

src: Lena ke letamo la bone ka boholo le kileng la ahwa kamora phumano ya demokrasi.
tgt: Le Projekthi ingumzekelo omhle wokunokuba sisiphumo xa amazwe ameleneyo esebenzisana kwaye esengela thungeni linye.

src: Letamo le tla thusa ho ntshetsa moruo pele, ho theha mesebetsi le ho thusa phano ya ditshebeletso porofenseng le kantle ho WEBTOKEN batho ba fetang 800 000 ba sebakeng sa Sekhukhune ba tla unang molemo ho tswa ho phepelo e ntlafetseng ya metsi a lapeng ha mesebetsi e metjha ya dimmaene le temo le yona e tla una molemo wa phepelo ya metsi.
tgt: Ukuphuhliswa kwemithombo yamanzi kunegalelo elibalulekileyo kuxolo nakuhlumo lommandla waMazantsi e-Afrika kwakunye nobomi babantu balo mmandla.3 IKhabinethi ivuya kakhulu ngumsebenzi wokuhlaziya imizila kaloliwe yoMzantsi Afrika, ngokutyikitya isivumelwano esixabisa ama-50 eebhiliyoni zeerandi ngabakwa-Transnet sokwakhiwa koololiwe abali-1 064 bale mihla nabanobuxhakaxhaka bobuchwepheshe obukwizinga eliphezulu .Indima yeCandelo lezoBunjineli lakwaTransnet kwesi sivumelwano kukuqinisekisa ukuba emva kwethuba eli candelo liza kutshintsha libe ngumzi ovelisa izixhobo ezizezokuqala.

src: Dimmasepala tse sebakeng sena, ka tshehetso ya mmuso wa naha le wa porofense, di tsetetse R3 bilione e eketsehileng ya meaho ho hlwekisa le ho fepela metsi ho basebedisi ba mahaeng le ba diteropo.
tgt: Esi sivumelwano sentengiselwano sijolise ekuguquleni ushishino ngezololiwe ngokukhulisa amashishini amancinci asele ekho nokuseka amashishini amatsha.4 IKhabinethi iyakwamkela ukuphehlelelwa kwesitya sokuqala sokujonga emajukujukwini sesibonakude i-MeerKAT liSebe lezeNzululwazi noBuchwepheshe kwiBala elisisiza eliyiKhilomitha ubuDe nobuBanzi, ebizwa ngokuba yi-SKA ngaseCarnavon, eMntla Koloni ngomhla wama-27 kweyoKwindla kowama-2014.Isibonakude i-MeerKAT, ebubuxhakaxhaka obayilwa bakhiwa kweli ubuninzi babo, iyabonisa kwakhona ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ungakhuphisana noompondo zihlanjiwe xa kuthethwa ngezophando, ezobunjineli, ezenzululwazi kunye nobuchwepheshwe.

src: Kabinete e bontshitse kgotsofalo mabapi le tsebiso e rerilweng ya Morero wa Metsi wa Dithabeng tsa Lesotho wa Mokgahlelo wa II ka la 27 Hlakubele 2014.
tgt: Esi sibonakude siza kuba ngama-25 ekhulwini esiGaba sokuQala se-SKA.5 IKhabinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano kwiintsapho nezihlobo zabo baphulukene nobomi babo kwiimvula ezinkulu zakutsha nje.

src: Projeke ke mohlala wa bohlokwa wa se ka fihlellwang ha dinaha tse mabapi di sebedisana mmoho ho fihlella sepheo se le seng.
tgt: IKhabinethi iyabaqinisekisa abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba iZiko loLawulo lweeNtlekelo leSizwe – lisebenzisana necandelo lezobuNtlola nokuSebenza ngoBambiswano leSizwe – liza kuqhubeka ngeenzame zokukhangela nokuhlangula kwakunye namalinge okuncedisa abantu abachaphazelekileyo.

src: Ntshetsopele ya dihlahiswa tsa mahlakore a mabedi e etsa tlatsetso e kgolo ho kgotso le nala ya sebaka sa Aforika e Borwa le bophelo ba batho ba yona.
tgt: IKhabinethi iyababulela ibancoma abezokhuselo ngokuncedisa kwiinzame zohlangulo.

src: Kabinete e thabetse mehato ya ho ntlafatsa tshebetso ya diporo tsa Aforika Borwa, ha Transnet e fane ka konteraka ya R50 bilione bakeng sa kaho ya diterene tsa sejwalejwale hape tse hatetseng pele ka theknoloji.
tgt: Bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika, ingakumbi abo bahlala kwiindawo ezithandwa zizikhukula, bayacelwa ukuba bahlale belumkile kumaxa emozulu enyeke-nyeke.

src: Karolo ya Bonjineri ba Transnet tumellanong ena ke ho netefatsa hore lekala le fetolwa moetsi wa pele wa thepa wa lefatshe ha nako e ntse e ya.
tgt: Abazali nabagcini-bantwana kufuneka bathathe amanyathelo okuqinisekisa ukuba abantwana bakhuselekile.

src: Tshebetso ena e reretswe ho fetola indasteri ya Aforika Borwa ya diporo ka ho hodisa dikgwebo tse teng tse nyenyane le ho theha tse ntjha.
tgt: Ukongeza koku, abaqhubi-zimoto nabahambi ngeenyawo nabo kufuneka bahlale bephaphile xa besebenzisa iindlela kumanzi.6 IKhabinethi ibulela uluntu ngenxaxheba oluyithathileyo ukusebenzisa umbane ngononophelo ngethuba iziko leenkozo zezombane lesizwe liphantsi koxinzelelo kule nyanga iphelileyo.

src: Kabinete e amohela tsebiso ya lesiba la pele la MeerKAT ke Lefapha la Saense le Theknoloji ho setsi sa mantlha sa Square Kilometre Array (SKA) haufi le Carnarvon, ho la Kapa Leboya ka la 27 Hlakubele 2014.MeerKAT, eo moetso wa yona boholo o radilweng le ho ahwa mona hae, e boetse e bontsha hore Aforika Borwa e ka hlodisana le ba tswang pele ha ho tluwa ho tsa dipatlisiso, boenjineri, saense le theknoloji.
tgt: Abantu kunye namashishini bayakhuthazwa ukuba baqhubeke besebenzisa umbane ngobunono kwaye bawonge xa kukho indlela, ingakumbi kwezi meko zemozulu zigqubayo ngoku.7 UMzantsi Afrika uza kuzimasa iNgqungquthela yesiNe yeeNkokeli zaMazwe ngaMazwe yeMbumba yase-Yurophu ne-Afrika eza kubanjelwa eBrussels, eBelgium ngomhla we-2 nowe-3 kuTshazimpunzi ngowama-2014.

src: E tla etsa 25% yaMokgahlelo wa I wa SKKabinete e fane ka matshediso ho malapa le metswalle ya ba lahlehetsweng ke maphelo ka lebaka la dipula tse sa tswa feta tse boima.
tgt: Umxholo wale Ngqungquthela yeNkokeli zaMazwe ngaMazwe uthi “Ukuzibophelela eBantwini, kuHlumo nakuXolo”.Le Ngqungquthela iza kugxininisa kwimfundo noqeqesho, abasetyhini nolutsha kwakunye nabafuduki abasemthethweni nabangekho mthethweni abangena kula mazwekazi mabini.8 Ngomhla wama-24 kweyoKwindla kowama-2014, iza kuba sisikhumbuzo saminyaka le soSuku lweSifo sePhepha lweHlabathi.

src: Kabinete e netefaletsa maAforika Borwa hore Setsi sa Naha sa Tsamaiso ya Dikoduwa – le sebopeho sa Naha sa Kopanelo sa Tshebetso le Mahlale – di tla tswelapele ka mesebetsi ya ho batla le ho pholosa le ya thuso ya botho.
tgt: IKhabinethi inqwenela ukukhuthaza bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba basebenzisane norhulumente ukulwa esi sifo.

src: MaAforika Borwa ohle, haholo ditjhaba tse dulang dibakeng tsa dikgohola, ba kgothaletswa ho ba sedi dinakong tsa maemo a mabe haholo a maemo a lehodimo.
tgt: Ubhubhani weSifo sePhepha (i-TB) wayengagqugqisi nje kuphela eMzantsi Afrika koko nakuwo wonke uMmandla osemaZantsi eSahara.

src: Batswadi le bahlokomedi ba lokela ho ba sedi ho netefatsa polokeho ya bana.
tgt: Amanyathelo karhulumente okuphumeza eyona nkqubo yakhe yankulu kwiHlabathi yokunyanga nokukhusela intsholongwane i-HIV noGawulayo alenze layimpumelelo idabi lokulwa ne-TIinkqubo zikarhulumente zokulwa ne-TB zikwaquka namaphulo okukhangela abo bagulayo bengazazi nokukhangela nabo bathe bahlangana naba bangazaziyo ukuba banesi sifo, nokusetyenziswa kobuxhakaxhaka be-GeneExpert ukuze sibonwe ngokukhawuleza isifo se-TSiyazingca ngokuba uMzantsi Afrika uhamba phambili kwihlabathi liphela kumbandela wokusetyenziswa kobuxhakaxhaka beGeneXpert kumaziko ezempilo.

src: Ho feta moo, bakganni le batho ba tsamayang ka maoto ba lokela ho dula ba le sedi ha ba sebedisa mebila ha pula e nele.
tgt: IKhabinethi iyayamkela le Ntlanganiso yaBaphathiswa izayo ngokuDityaniswa kwaMacebo eNgingqi nokuSabela ekuLweni ne-TB kwiCandelo lezeMigodi kuMazantsi e-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e leboha setjhaba bakeng sa karolo eo ba e bapetseng ho fokotsa kgatello ho keriti ya naha ya motlakase kgweding e fetileng.
tgt: Le Ntlanganiso iza kubanjelwa kwiZiko leeNgqungquthela laseSandton ngomhla wama-25 kweyoKwindla kowama-2014 kwaye iza kudibanisa bonke abadlala iindima koorhulumente balo Mmandla, iCandelo lezeMigodi eMzantsi Afrika, imibutho yabasebenzi, Amaqabane kwezoPhuhliso kunye neMibutho yoLuntu.9 IKhabinethi ivuyisena nabo bonke abafikelele kumagqibela kankqoyi nabo baphumelele iiMbasa zezoShishino olukuMgangatho oPhezulu zoMzantsi Afrika zoNyaka wesiBini.

src: Bareki ka bo mong le dikhamphi ba kgothaletswa ho tswelapele ho sebedisa motlakase ka hloko le ho boloka motlakase hohle moo ho kgonahalang, haholoholo maemong a hajwale a bolepi.
tgt: Ezi Mbasa ziwonga amashishini ngendlela aqhube ngayo kumacandelo ohlukeneyo kwaye zinikezelwe kwitheko ebelizinyaswe nguMongameli Jacob Zuma.

src: Mookotaba wa Kopano ke “Ho tsetela ho Batho, Nala le Kgotso.”Kopano e tla shebana le thuto le thupello, basadi le batjha, hammoho le phallo ya matswantle a molaong le a seng molaong pakeng tsa dikontinente tsena tse pedi.
tgt: Phakathi kwabo bawongwe ngeembasa nevuyisana nabo iKhabinethi nguMnu Sam Motsuenyane ofumene iMbasa yoBomi emfaneleyo yeMisebenzi eMihle.10 IKhabinethi iyiqaphele ingxelo yophando-nzulu eyayigunyaziswe liSebe lezeziMali kwiKhomishoni yoNyulo Ezimeleyo.

src: Ka la 24 Hlakubele 2014, e tla be e le kgopolo ya selemo ya Letsatsi la Lefatshe la Lefuba (TB).
tgt: Oku kulandela isiphakamiso esenziwa kwingxelo yoMkhuseli woLuntu.

src: Kabinete e lakatsa ho kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa ho sebetsa mmoho le Mmuso ho lwantsha sewa sena.
tgt: Iye yacela uMphathiswa weMicimbi yezeKhaya ukuba awulandele lo mba aze acebise iKhabinethi.11 IKhabinethi iwagxeka kakhulu amaqela emigulukudu athe gqolo eNtshona Koloni, abonakala ngemikhuba yokuhlasela ngenkohlakalo nangobundladiya uluntu, ingakumbi abantwana.

src: Diketso tsa Mmuso tsa ho kenya tshebetsong kalafo e kgolo ho fetisisa lefatsheng ya HIV le AIDS le lenaneo la thibelo di fokoditse leqhubu la TB.
tgt: IKhabinethi iyawuvuma iwubulela umsebenzi owenziwa ngabeeNkonzo zamaPolisa zoMzantsi Afrika ekulweni amaqela emigulukudu kwaye ihlaba ikhwelo kuluntu oluchaphazelekayo ukuba lusebenzisane namapolisa ukukhusela uluntu kulo mkhuba.12 IKhabinethi ivakalisa usizi namazwi ayo ovelwano kusapho nezihlobo zikaNksk Martha Mahlangu obengumama wowayesakuba lijoni loMkhonto weSizwe uSolomon Mahlangu.

src: Kopano ena e tla tshwarelwa Setsing sa Dikopano sa Sandton ka la 25 Hlakubele 2014 e tla kopanya bankakarolo mebusong ya Lebatowa, Lekaleng la Dimmaene Aforika Borwa, Lekala le hlophisitsweng la Mesebetsi, Balekane ba Ntshetsopele le Setjhaba.
tgt: UNksk Mahlangu uza kubekwa kwikhaya lakhe lokugqibela ngoMgqibelo umhla wama-22 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2014.

src: Kabinete e lebohisitse bahlodisani le baamohedi bohle ba Dikgau tsa Bobedi tsa Selemo tsa Kgwebo tsa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IsiXeko saseTshwane siza kuwuqhuba ngokomgcwabo webhunga likamasipala umfihlo wakhe kwaye neeflegi ziza kuthotywa ukubonakalisa imbeko kuye.

src: Dikgau tsena di ananela tshebetso ya dikgwebo mekgahlelong e fapaneng mme di fanwe moketeng oo ho ona Mopresidente Jacob Zuma a bileng teng.
tgt: Iingxoxo kunye nezigqibo zeKhabhinethi ezingundoqo.1 IKhabinethi ifumene ingxelo ngoMnxeba oNgxamisekileyo kaMongameli yale minyaka mine usebenza.

src: Hara baamohedi ba lebohisitsweng ke Kabinete ke Monghadi Sam Motsuenyane ya fumaneng Kgau e mo tshwanetseng ya Boiphihlelo ba Bophelo Bohle.
tgt: Iziphumo zokusonjululwa kweengxaki, nendlela oqhuba ngayo ziye ziphucuka xa kuthelekiswa le minyaka ngolu hlobo: ama-64,03% unyaka wokuqala, ama-77,79% kunyaka wesibini ama-87,47% kunyaka wesithathu, kulo unyaka ngama-94,7%.

src: Kabinete e lemohile tlaleho ya forensiki e batlilweng ke Lefapha la Naha la Ditjhelete ka Khomishene e Ikemetseng ya Dikgetho.
tgt: Injongo ephambili ye-IPAP kukunqanda ukuhla kwezoshishino, ukuxhasa uhlumo kunye nokuxutywa kwecandelo lezinto eziveliswayo eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Sena se latela kgothaletso e entsweng ho tlaleho ya Mosireletsi wa Sejthaba.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezoRhwebo noShishino uza kuthetha namajelo eendaba xa i-IPAP iphehlelelwa kule nyanga izayo.3 IKhabinethi iyamkele indlela ekuchotshelwe ngayo ukusondela kosuku lokuphelelwa kwamaphepha-mvume akhutshwe phantsi kweprojekthi yesiBonelelo esiSodwa sabemi baseZimbabwe (i-DZP).

src: E file Letona la Merero ya Lehae hore a latele taba ena mme a eletse Kabinete.
tgt: Abo baneempepha-mvume baza kulindeleka ukuba baphinde bafake izicelo zokuhlaziywa kwamaphepha-mvume kwilizwe labo lokuzalwa.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe maqunwane a tswelang pele ho la Kapa Bophirima, bo tsamaellanang le ditlhaselo tse soto hape tse mpe setjhabeng haholo baneng.
tgt: UMphathiswa weMicimbi yezeKhaya uza kunika ingcaciso ethe vetshe kwalapha ekuhambeni kwexesha ngenkqubo eza kulandelwa kunye nosuku ekuza kuqalwa ngalo.4 IKhabinethi ivume ukuba iCandelo le-100 (1)

src: Sena se ka se mamellwe kaha se phephetsa dikgatelopele tse re di entseng demokrasing ya rona.
tgt: elingongenelelo eLimpopo lihlale liqhuba, ukuze libe nakho ukuphinda lihlaziywe kweyeSilimela kowama-2014 emva kokuba kukho umbuso wolawulo omtsha.

src: Kabinete e ananela mosebetsi wa Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa sa Aforika Borwa ho lwantsheng maqunwane mme e kopa ditjhaba tse amehang ho sebetsa le sepolesa ho sireletsa setjhaba ho sewa sena.
tgt: Oku kuza kwenza ukuba kusoloko kukho amaphulo okungenelela ukulwa nemingeni esaseleyo.

src: Kabinete e isa kutlwelobohloko le matshediso ho lelapa le metswalle ya Mofumahadi Martha Mahlangu eo e neng e le mme wa lesole la MK la mehleng Solomon Mahlangu.
tgt: Oku kuza kuqinisekisa ukuba ukuphucuka kweemeko zezimali kumaphondo kunye nokuhanjiswa kweenkonzo kwiinkonzo zoluntu nakumanye amacandelo zihlala zihleli.5 IKhabinethi iluphumezile uHlaziyo lwezoKhuselo loMzantsi Afrika lowama-2014, yaze yayalela nokuba luthiwe thaca ePalamente.

src: Motseteropo wa Tshwane o tlo fa Mofumahadi Mahlangu lepato la setjhaba mme difolakga di tla fofela fatshe ho mo tlotla.
tgt: Olu Hlaziyo luza kucacisa umgaqo-nkqubo wezokhuselo wexesha elide kunye nendlela yezokhuselo enobuchule ezakulandelwa lilizwe kule minyaka mine yeSicwangciso-nkqubo soBuchule seXesha eliPhakathi.

src: Tharollo ya kgetsi, tshebetso e ntlafetse selemo le selemo ka tsela ena 64.03% selemo sa pele 77.79% ka selemo sa bobedi 87.46% ka selemo sa boraro mme hajwale e ho 94.7%.
tgt: Olu xwebhu kuza kwabelwana ngalo noluntu, njengoko uluntu lwaluthathe inxaxheba kwiintlanganiso zovakaliso-zimvo ezazibanjwe kwimbombo zonke zelizwe kulo nyaka uphelileyo.6 IKhabinethi ivumile ukuba iNgxelo yeKomiti yaBaphathiswa ngeNgcaciso yoMgaqo-nkqubo ipapashwe kwiPhephandaba lakwaRhulumente ukuze noluntu luhlomle.

src: Kabinete e kopa mafapha le diprofense ho tswelapele ho ntlafatsa boleng le potlako ya patlisiso ya ditletlebo kaha kgotsofalo ya baahi e le bohlokwa bakeng sa serit sa Mohala wa Bopresidente.
tgt: Le ngxelo ihlalutya imfundo ephakamileyo kunye nefuthe lenkqubo yezoqeqesho kwezentlalo nezoqoqosho.

src: Kabinete e amohetse Morero wa bo 6 wa Selemo o Iphetang wa Pholisi ya Leano la Tshebetso ya Indasteri (IPAP) 2014/15-2016/17 bakeng sa ho kengwa tshebetsong.
tgt: Inika uMphathiswa weMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho iziphakamiso ngendlela ekunokususwa ngayo imiqobo ekungekho mfuneko yayo nethintela okanye enika abafundi ubunzima ukuba baqhube kakuhle.

src: Sepheo sa mantlha sa IPAP ke ho thibela ho wa ha indasteri le ho tshehetsa kgolo le phapano ya lekala la tlhahiso la Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Umgaqo-nkqubo wengcaciso ubhekisa kwiphulo lokulungelelanisa amaziko ezemfundo, iinkqubo zezemfundo kunye neziqinisekiso zezemfundo ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukufundela loo makhondo bawakhethileyo ngendlela elula.7 IKhabinethi ivumile ukuba iNgxelo esuka kwiQela laBaphathiswa ebeliChophele iiNkqubo ezisiSiseko zeZibalo neNzululwazi mayipapashwe kwiPhephandaba lakwaRhulumente, ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: Letona la Kgwebo le Indasteri le tla bua le boraditaba ha IPAP e tsebiswa kgweding e tlang.
tgt: IQela laBaphathiswa eliChophele uMcimbi lagunyaziswa ukuba liqulunqe iNkqubo esiSiseko yeZibalo neNzululwazi esekelwe kwiMfundo yobuGcisa bobuChule neKholeji yoQeqesho.

src: Kabinete e amohetse katamelo ho ho fellwa ke nako ya mangolo a tumello a fanweng tlasa morero wa Kemo e Kgethehileng bakeng sa maZimbabwe (DZP).
tgt: Oku kuza kunceda ukwandisa inani labafundi abakhetha iNzululwazi neZibalo edyunivesiti kwaye iqaqambise nabanobungcali bokuyila izinto ezintsha njengoko kucacisiwe kwisiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe.

src: tse Limpopo di dule di le teng, ho dumella tjhebisiso ka Phupu 2014 kamora hore tsamaiso e ntjha e kene tshebetsong.
tgt: Oku kubonakalisa ukunyuka kumyinge weminyaka emine we-2.9% phakathi kowama-2008/09 ukuya kowama-2011/12.Kukho nobungqina bokuba urhulumente uxhasa ngemali amaphulo amaninzi ophando lwezenzululwazi aqhubeka eMzantsi Afrika, nokuba uninzi lweeprojekthi zokufezekiswa kweziphumo zophando aluqhutywa kumasebe esizwe, koko kumabhunga enzululwazi kunye namaziko emfundo ephakamileyo.9 IKhabinethi yazisiwe ngohlalutyo oluqhutywe liSebe lokuVavanywa nokuHlola uMsebenzi ‘Ngefuthe lokuQaliswa kweBanga R kwiziPhumo zokuFunda’.Ukuthathela ingqalelo kwangethuba umbandela wokukhula nokuphuhla kwabantwana abaselula kungakunciphisa ukungalingani kunyuse nomgangatho wemveliso, ingakumbi kubantwana abaselula abasuka kumakhaya ahlelelekileyo.

src: Sena se tla netefatsa ntshetsopele ya dikeno dipakeng ho shebana le mathata a ntseng a le teng.
tgt: IKhabinethi iyawamkela umsebenzi oncumisayo wokwandiswa kakhulu kweBanga R ekufuneka lisebenzise amandla alo kangangoko ukuze libe nefuthe elibonakalayo kwindlela abaqhuba ngayo abafundi kwizifundo zabo.10 IKhabinethi inikwe amagqqabantshintshi ngeziphumo zeNkqubo eNgaphambili yokuHlola ukuZiswa kweeNkonzo yonyaka wama-2013.IKhabinethi iyancoma kwaye ikhuthazwa ziziphumo ezincumisayo ezisuka kumasebe karhulumente anoxanduva , ngendlela alawula ngobuchule ngayo kunye nokongamela iindawo nokusebenza kwezixhobo zomsebenzi.

src: Sena se tla netefatsa hore dintlafatso maemong a ditjhelete a profense le phano ya ditshebeletso ho ditshebeletso tsa setjhaba le makaleng a mang di dula di le teng.
