tgt: Onke amasebe kaRhulumente kuza kufuneka amkele indlela efanayo yokuxhasa uphuhliso lwezakhono olufanelekileyo nolusisinyanzelo kwiiNkonzo zabaLawuli abaPhezulu.3 IKhabhinethi iphumeze ukuba iSebe lokuHlolwa kokuSebenza noVavanyo lithi thaca uyilo loXwebhu lweeNgxoxo ngeMithetho-siseko neNdlela yenkqubo yokuHlolwa kokuSebenza noVavanyo kwiKomiti yasePalamente yeMicimbi yeSebe lezabaSebenzi bakaRhulumente noLawulo kunye noCwangciso loHlolo noVavanyo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana bakeng sa Lefapha la Bodisa le Tlhatlhobo ya Tshebetso ho fana ka moralo wa Tokomane ya Puisano mabapi le Dipehelo le Katamelo tsa Bodisa le Tlhatlhobo ya Tshebetso ho di behela Komiti ya Potefolio ya Palamente mabapi le Tsamaiso ya Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba le Meralo, Bodisa le Tlhatlhobo.
tgt: Olu xwebhu luphakamisa uluhlu lwemithetho-siseko engundoqo kunye nendlela yokuHlolwa kokuSebenza noVavanyo (i-M&E) olumiselwe ukuze lube lukhokelele kukuphucuka okuqhubekayo kumsebenzi karhulumente kunye nokwandisa ukuphendula kwakhe.

src: Tokomane e sisinya pokello ya dipehelo tsa mantlha le katamelo ho Lefapha la Bodisa le Tlhatlhobo ya Tshebetso (M&E) e reretsweng ho baka hore ho be le ntlafatso e tswellang tshebetsong ya mmuso le boikarabelo bo eketsehileng.
tgt: Eyona njongo ibalulekileyo kukusebenzela ukuba kuvunyelwane ngeenjongo ze-M&E kunye nendlela enokuphunyezwa ngayo.

src: Sepheo sa yona se seholo ke ho aha tumellano mabapi le dipheo tsa M&E, le kamoo e tshwanetseng ho kenngwa tshebetsong.
tgt: Oku kunegalelo ekuphumezeni isiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe (i-NDP) ngokuphathelele kukwakha isizwe esisebenzayo nesikhulayo kwakunye nokukhuthaza ukuba abantu babe ngabemi abakhutheleyo kunye neenkokeli ezinomqolo.

src: Makgabane a M&E ke karolo ya mokgubo wa makgabane a bolaodi a hlokahalang bakeng sa puso e kgonang le e tswelang pele.
tgt: Ubuchule nezakhono ze-M&E ziyinxalenye yobuchule nezakhono zolawulo olungundoqo nolufunekayo kwisizwe esikwaziyo ukusebenza nesikhulayo.4 IKhabhinethi iwaphumezile amanqaku uMzantsi Afrika oza kuxolela phezu kwawo kwiNkomfa yaMazwe ngaMazwe engoLondolozo lweZilwanyana zaseNdle eziFudukayo eza kubanjelwa eQuinto, Ecuador, ukususela ngomhla we-4 ukuya kowe-9 kweyeNkanga wama-2014.Ukuthatha inxaxheba koMzantsi Afrika ekushukuxeni imingeni yotshintsho lwemozulu kunye nolondolozo lwendalo nezilwanyana ezinxulumene noko kusekwe kumthetho-siseko wophuhliso oluzinzileyo kunye nozinzo lokusingqongileyo, kwaye kuhambelana neemfuneko zeCandelo 24 loMqulu wamaLungelo oLuntu.5 IKhabhinethi iphumeze imiba uMzantsi Afrika oza kuxoxela phezu kwayo kwiseshoni yama-20 yeNkomfa yaMazwe ngaMazwe kwi-UNFCCC (i-COP 20), kunye neNkomfa yaMazwe ngaMazwe ye-10 eza kusebenza njengentlanganiso yaMazwe ngaMazwe kwi-Kyoto Protocol (i-CMP 10), ukususela kumhla woku-1 ukuya kowe-12 kweyoMnga wama-2014, eLima, ePeru.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana maemo a Aforika Borwa a ho kena ditherisanong bakeng sa Paballo ya Mefuta e Fallang ya Diphoofolo tse Hlaha (CMS COP11) e tla tshwarelwa Quinto, ho la Ecuador, ho tloha ka la 4 ho ya ho la 9 Pudungwana 2014.Bonkakarolo bo matla ba Aforika Borwa tabeng ya ho shebana le diphephetso tsa ho fetofetoha ha tlelaemete le paballo ya tlhaho le mefuta e amehang bo itshetlehile hodima pehelo ya ntshetsopele ya moshwelella le tikoloho ya moshwelella, mme bo tsamaelana le ditlhoko tsa Karolo 24 ya Bili ya Ditokelo.
tgt: Uluvo loMzantsi Afrika luhambelana neemfuno zesizwe, kunye nokuthethwa kukubandakanyeka koMzantsi Afrika kwiingxoxo ezingotshintsho lwemozulu zamazwe ngamazwe kunjengoko kuchaziwe kwisiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe.6 IKhabhinethi iphumeze ukufakwa kweSivumelwano saseKapa sowama-2012 sokuphunyezwa kwezibonelelo zeTorremolinos Protocol yowe-1993 esinxulumene neNgqungquthela yaMazwe ngaMazwe engoKhuseleko lweziKhephe zokuLoba, sowe-1977 ukuze sivunywe ngokusesikweni yiPalamente.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana thomo ya ho kena ditherisanong e tla sebetsa e le motheo bakeng sa hore Aforika Borwa e kene ho tulo ya bo 20 ya Seboka sa Mekgatlo ho UNFCCC (COP 20), le Seboka sa Mekgatlo ya bo 10 e sebetsang jwaloka kopano ya Mekgatlo ho Porotokhole ya Kyoto (CMP 10), ho tloha ka la 1 ho ya ho la 12 Tshitwe 2014, ho la Lima, Peru.
tgt: INgqungquthela yaseTorremonilos neSivumelwano sowama-1993 zimisela imiqathango yokhuseleko, efana nezixhobo zokusindisa ubomi, unxibelelwano ngonomathotholo, ukhuseleko emlilweni, oomatshini kunye nokufakwa kombane, kwakunye neemfuneko zezikhephe eziloba elwandle ezibude bungangeemitha ezingama-24 nangaphezulu.

src: Maemo a Aforika Borwa a tsamaelana le dikgahleho tsa naha, le dikateng bakeng sa ho kena ha Aforika Borwa ditherisanong tsa matjhaba tsa ho fetofetoha ha tlelaemete jwaloka ha di tekilwe ho NDKabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tekwa ha Tumellano ya Motse Kapa ya 2012 mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha dipehelo tsa Porotokhole ya Torremolinos ya 1993 e mabapi le Seboka sa Matjhaba bakeng sa Polokeho ya Dikepe tsa Botshwasi ba Ditlhapi, ya 1977 bakeng sa ho sekaseka ke Palamente.
tgt: Le miqathango ibophelelayo yokhuseleko yamazwe ngamazwe iza kuba negalelo ekuphuculeni imigangatho yokhuseleko ukuze inciphise inani labantu abasweleka elwandle, eliqikelelwa kuma-24 000 ngonyaka kwihlabathi liphela.

src: Seboka sa Torremolinos le Porotokhole ya sona ya 1993 di hlahisa maemo a polokeho, a kang disebediswa tse bolokang bophelo, dikgokahanyo ka radio, tshireletso mollong, ho kenngwa ha metjhini le kgokelo tsa motlakase, mmoho le ditlhoko tse itseng bakeng sa dikepe tsa botshwasi ba ditlhapi tse lebang metsing tsa bolelele ba dimithara tse 24 le ho feta.
tgt: Izikhephe zaseMzantsi Afrika ziza kuba phantsi kolawulo lwemiqathango yesivumelwano xa ziloba kumanzi esizwe esiyinxalenye yesivumelwano saseTorremolinos.

src: Tumellano ena e tlamang ya polokeho ya matjhaba e tla nyehela bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa maemo a polokeho ho fokotsa palo ya mafu lewatleng, e akanyetswang ho mafu a 24 000 ka selemo lefatsheng ka bophara.
tgt: Oku kuhambelana neenjongo ze-Operation Phakisa zokuphuhlisa inkqubo-sikhokelo yamaziko olawulo lommandla wolwandle, ukuphucula ukukhuseleka kweelwandle zaseMzantsi Afrika, ingakumbi ezingqonge iinkqubo zokusingqongileyo ezisemngciphekweni wokutshabalala, kunye nokushukuxa ukusilela kwezakhono, phakathi kwezinye.7 IKhabinethi iphumeze ukuba uMzantsi Afrika uvume ukuba yinxalenye yeNgqungquthela yaMazwe ngaMazwe yeMigangatho yoQeqesho, iZiqinisekiso kunye nokuba nguKhala wabaSebenzi kwiMikhumbi yokuLoba, ngowama-1995 (STCWF).

src: Dikepe tsa Aforika Borwa tsa botshwasi ba ditlhapi di tla sebetsa ho ya ka dipehelo tsa porotokhole ha di le metsing a mokgatlo wa Puso o teng ho porotokhole ya Torremolinos ya 1993.Sena se tsamaelana le dipheo tsa Operation Phakisa tsa ho ntshetsapele moralo wa mmuso bakeng sa bolaodi ba sebaka sa lewatle sa Aforika Borwa, ho ntlafatsa tshireletso ya mawatle a Aforika Borwa, haholoholo ditheong tsa tlhaho tse tsietsing ka tsela e hlokolosi, le ho shebana le sekgeo sa bokgoni, hara tse ding.
tgt: Eli lilinge lokuqala lokuseka imigangatho enyanzeliswayo yoqeqesho yamazwe ngamazwe yabasebenzi kwimikhumbi yokuloba elwandle ebude buzimitha ezingama-24 okanye ngaphezulu.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana bakeng sa Aforika Borwa ho dumellana le Seboka sa Matjhaba mabapi le Maemo a Thupello, Phano ya ditifikeiti le Peho-leihlo bakeng sa Basebeletsi ba Dikepe tsa Botshwasi ba Ditlhapi (STWC-F), ya 1995.Sena ke boiteko ba pele ba ho theha maemo a matjhaba a tlamang a thupello bakeng sa meifo ya dikepe tsa botshwasi ba ditlhapi tse yang lewatleng tsa bolelele ba dimithara tse 24 kapa ho feta.
tgt: Oku kuza kuphucula ukhuseleko lobomi kunye nempahla elwandle, kwakunye nokuthintela ungcoliseko lolwandle ngabezoshishino lokuloba.

src: Sena se tla ntlafatsa polokeho ya bophelo le thepa lewatleng, mmoho le ho thibela tshilafalo ya tikoloho ya mawatle ke indaseteri ya botshwasi ba ditlhapi.
tgt: Kwixesha elidlulileyo, ukusebenza elwandle ixesha elide kwakubonwa njengendlela yokufumana amava nezakhono ezifanelekileyo.

src: Mehleng, dinako tse telele tsa tshebeletso ya lewatleng di ne di bonwa e le tsela ya ho thola boiphihlelo le bokgoni bo nepahetseng.
tgt: Le nkqubo yoqeqesho usemsebenzini ayivelisanga isiphumo esingabasebenzi abanezakhono ezisemgangathweni.

src: Mokgwa ona wa ho rupellwa ka hara mosebetsi ha o so hlahise sephetho sa boleng bakeng sa bokgoni ba moifo o motjha.
tgt: Le nkqubo intsha yakhiwe ngokudibanisa uqeqesho oluncitshisiweyo ngokufumana amava kunye nemfundo ephuculwe ngaphezulu nelandela imigaqo yokwandisa ulwazi.

src: Mokgwa o motjha o ahilwe ho potoloha motswako wa ho fokotsa thupello ya boiphihlelo ka thuto e ntlafaditsweng le ho hlophiswa hantle bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa tsebo.
tgt: Oku kuza kwenza ukuba abalobi bakwazi ukuqhubela phambili baze emva kwexesha bayeke ukusebenza kwimikhumbi emincinane bagqithele ekusebenzeni kwemikhumbi yokuloba emikhulu baze ekugqibeleni basebenze kwimikhumbi yorhwebo yamazwe ngamazwe.

src: Sena se tla etsa hore ho kgonahale bakeng sa batshwasi ho tswela pele hanyane-hanyane ho tloha dikepeng tse nyane ho ya ho tse kgolo mme qetellong ho ya ho dikepe tse hwebang matjhabeng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphumeze uyilo lwezi ngqekembe zisisikhumbuzo zilandelayo kowama-2015 ziyilwa yiNkampani yoKwenza iMali yaseMzantsi Afrika, ukuba zibe semthethweni ngokupapashwa kwiphephandaba likarhulumente.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana bakeng sa moralo wa dikhoine tse latelang tsa sehopotso tsa 2015 ke Khamphani ya Aforika Borwa ya Mente, hore o phatlalatswe Koranteng ya Mmuso.
tgt: Uthotho lweengqekembe ezineSiqwane: “Ubomi beNgqanga: uN R Mandela” UThotho lweengqekembe zeNdalo “Izilwanyana ezizingela ebusuku – uDyakalashe onoMqolo oMnyama” UThotho lweengqekembe ze-R1 zeGolide: “Izirhubuluzi zaseMzantsi Afrika – iNgwenya yoMlambo i-Nile” UThotho lweengqekembe ze-R2 zeGolide: “iProjekthi ye-UNESCO: uMntu neNdalo” UThotho lweengqekembe zeSilivere zesiThsaba neTiki: “Oololiwe baseMzantsi Afrika”, kunye NoThotho lweeNgqekembe zeSilivere yohlobo lwe-Sterling: “Imimandla yaseLwandle eKhuselweyo yaseMzantsi Afrika”1.9 IKhabhinethi ichazelwe ngokufutshane ngoHlengahlengiso lweZithili zooMantyi kunye nemimandla yoLawulo lwezoBulungisa kumaCandelo kunye neziHlalo zaseKhaya kwiNkundla ePhakamileyo yoMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka Tokisobotjha ya Makgotla a Bomasepala a Ditereke le Dibaka tsa Bolaodi tsa Dikarolo le dibaka tsa Bodulo tsa Lehae tsa Lekgotla le Phahameng la Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Iprojekthi yokuhlengahlengiswa kweenkundla ibuyisela umva imbali yokungalingani kunye nokungabikho kobulungisa.

src: Porojeke ya tokisobotjha ya makgotla a dinyewe e busetsa morao lefa la ho hloka tekatekano le toka.
tgt: Iseka iqalelo eliza kukhokela onke amasebe achaphazelekayo, ii-arhente ezinyanzelisa ukuthotyelwa komthetho kunye namaziko ezobulungisa ukuze ahambelane nendlela olusebenza ngayo ngokufanelekileyo.

src: E theha mohlala o tla tataisa mafapha ohle a amehang, makala a thibelo ya ditlolo tsa molao le ditsha tsa toka bakeng sa ho momahanya ditshebetso tsa ona ka tshwanelo.
tgt: Uluntu olwaluhlelelekile ngaphambili oluhlala kwindawo ezazingamaphandle, amazwe ayengozimele-geqe kunye neelali ziza kuzuza kwiziphumo zale nkqubo yohlengahlengiso.

src: Badudi ba neng ba tinngwe menyetla pele dibakeng tsa mehleng tsa mahae, dipuso tse neng di ipusa le metsana ya mahae jwale di tla kgola molemo ho tswa ho diphetho tsa tsamaiso ya tokisobotjha.
tgt: Ziza kukwazi ukufikelela ezinkundleni ngeendleko ezincitshisiweyo.

src: Ba tla kgona ho fihlella makgotla a dinyewe ka ditjeho tse fokotsehileng.
tgt: Xa kubonelelwa ngokufikelela ezinkundleni, kubalulekile ukuhlengahlengiswa kwemimandla yolawulo lwazo zonke iinkundla ezazimiselwe ngurhulumente wengcinezelo, kuquka nokwakhiwa kwazo kunye nezakhiwo zazo.

src: Bakeng sa ho fana ka phumantsho ho tsa toka, ho a hlokahala ho lokisa botjha dibaka tsa bolaodi ba makgotla a dinyewe tse neng di thehilwe ke mmuso wa kgethollo, ho kenyeletswa le popo le sebopeho sa ona.
tgt: Inkqubo yohlengahlengiso iqinisekisa ukuba kukho ukusasazwa okulinganayo kweenkundla kulo lonke eli, ukomeleza ukufikelela ezinkundleni, okulilungelo loluntu elisisiseko neligcinwe kwiCandelo lama-34 loMqulu wamaLungelo oLuntu kuMgaqo-siseko.

src: Tsamaiso ya tokiso botjha e netefatsa hore ho na le karolelano e lekalekanang ya makgotla a dinyewe ka hara naha, bakeng sa ntlafatso ya ho fihlella makgotla a dinyewe, e leng tokelo ya motheo ya botho jwaloka ha e hlahella ho Karolo 34 ya Bili ya Ditokelo ka hara Molao wa Motheo.
tgt: IMithetho esaYilwayo.1 IKhabhinethi iphumeze ukwaziswa koMthetho siHlomelo weSondlo, wama-2014 ePalamente.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho hlahiswa ha Maintenance Amendment Bill (Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Tlhokomelo), ya 2014 Palamenteng.
tgt: Lo Mthetho usaYilwayo ulungisa uMthetho weSondlo, wama-1998 (uMthetho 99 wama-1998) ukuze uphucule inkqubo yesondlo kunye nokomeleza ukufikelela kwezobulungisa kwabasetyhini kunye nabantwana.

src: Bili e fetola Maintenance Act (Molao wa Tlhokomelo), wa 1998 (Molao 99 wa 1998) ho ntlafatsa tsamaiso ya Tlhokomelo le ho ntlafatsa phumantsho ya toka bakeng sa basadi le bana.
tgt: Ezi zihlomelo zinciphisa imingeni, yezomthetho nolawulo, abahlangabezana nayo abo bazuza imali yesondlo, uninzi lwabo ingabasetyhini nabantwana.

src: Dihlomathiso di tlosa diphephetso, tsa molao le tsamaiso, tse etsahalang ho bakgolamolemo ba Tlhokomelo, bao boholo e leng basadi le bana.
tgt: Oku kuqhagamshelana ngqo nokujoliswe kuko nokubalulekileyo kwesiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe kwinguqu kwezoqoqosho kunye nokhuseleko kwezentlalo.

src: Sena se momahana ka kotloloho le dipheo tsa sehlooho tsa NDP hodima phethoho ya moruo le tshireletso ho tsa kahisano.
tgt: Ezinye izibonelelo zalo Mthetho Sihlomelo ziquka: ukuthintela abo basilelayo ekuhlawuleni imali yesondlo ukuze bangaqhubeki bekwazi ukuthenga ngetyala lo gama benetyala lesondlo, ukubophelela iinkampani zeeselula ukuba zinikezele ngeenkcukacha zoqhagamshelwano kwinkundla zesondlo zabo kufuneka bephendule kumatyala okungondli nabo basilelayo kwisondlo ukuba inkundla yonelisiwe ukuba kwenziwe zonke iinzame ezifanelekileyo ukubafumana kwaye abafumaneki, kunye nokwenza lowo mntu uphunyelwe ngumyalelo wenkundla wesondlo, ahlawule imali asemva ngayo kwisondlo.

src: Tse ding tsa dipehelo tsa Sehlomathiso sa Bili di kenyeletsa: ho thibela ba sa lefeng ditjhelete tsa Tlhokomelo hore ba se fuwe mekitlane ha ba ntse ba kolota tjhelete ya Tlhokomelo, ho hatella beng ba ditshebeletso tsa diselefounu ho fana ka dinomoro tsa mohala tsa ba amehang le ba sa lefeng ditjhelete tsa kotlo ho makgotla a dinyewe a Tlhokomelo haeba lekgotla le ikgotsofaditse hore le entse mekutu yohle e hlokahalang ya ho fumana batho bao, le ho etsa hore motho ya pharilweng ka molato wa Tlhokomelo, a lefe tjhelete e saletseng morao ya Tlhokomelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphumeze ukufakwa koMthetho osaYilwayo we-Agrément yoMzantsi Afrika kunye neMemorandam ngeeNjongo zoMthetho osaYilwayo ePalamente.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tekwa ha Agrément South Africa Bill (Bili ya Tumellano ya Aforika Borwa) le Memorandamo mabapi la Dipheo tsa Bili Palamenteng.
tgt: Ukusekwa kwe-Agrément yoMzantsi Afrika, njengokuba kucetywa kuMthetho osaYilwayo woMzantsi Afrika, wama-2014 kuza kuba negalelo lokudala icandelo lezokwakha elishukumisa ngamandla nelakha izinto ezintsha neliza kuba nefuthe elakhayo ekudaleni imisebenzi lo gama linegalelo kwizicwangciso zeziseko zophuhliso nezingundoqo zikaRhulumente.

src: Ho thehwa ha Tumellano ya Aforika Borwa, jwaloka ha ho sisintswe ho Bili ya Tumellano ya Aforika Borwa, ya 2014 ho tla nyehela bakeng sa tswalo ya lekala le matla le ntjhafatsang la kaho le tla amang ka tshwanelo tlhahiso ya mesebetsi ha le nyehela ho merero ya Mmuso ya dikaho tsa motheo.
tgt: Ukongezwa kwexabiso kuza kuquka ukususela kuphando ukuya ekungenisweni kwezinto ezintsha, imisebenzi eyandileyo yokwenza iimveliso, ukudala imisebenzi kunye nokunciphisa intlupheko.3 IKhabhinethi iphumeze ukwaziswa koyilo loMthetho siHlomelo woMsebenzi wobuNgcali kuPhicotho-zincwadi ePalamente.

src: Keketso ya molemo e tla phatlalla ho tloha ho diphuputso ho ya ntlafatsong, mesebetsing ya tlhahiso e ekeditsweng, tlhahiso ya mesebetsi le phediso ya bofuma.
tgt: Lo Mthetho Sihlomelo uceba izilungiso zoMthetho woMsebenzi wobuNgcali kuPhicotho-zincwadi, wama-2005, ukulawula abaphicothi-zincwadi abangabafundi ukuba bahlaziye abantu ekunokubuzwa kubo ngomsebenzi wabo ngokubhekiselele kuMthetho weeNkampani, we-1973 ukuze uhambelane noMthetho woMsebenzi wobuNgcali kuPhicotho-zincwadi, wama-2008 (uMthetho Nombolo 71 wama-2008).Injongo kukuzisa abaphicothi-zincwadi (abafundi abafundela ukuba ngabaphicothi-zincwadi), phambi kokuba babhalise, phantsi koMthetho woMsebenzi wobuNgcali kuPhicotho-zincwadi wama-2005 ukuze balawulwe yiBhodi yoLawulo eziMeleyo yabaPhicothi-zincwadi, ngendlela efanayo naleyo abaphicothi-zincwadi ababhalisiweyo balawulwa ngayo, kunye nokwenza izilungiso ezibalulekileyo neziyimfuneko kuMthetho weeNkampani wama-2008.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana tsebiso ya moralo wa Auditing Profession Amendment Bill (Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Lekala la Bohlakisi) Palamenteng.
tgt: Oku kuza kukhusela noluntu emsebenzini owenziwa ngabo bafundela ukuba ngabaphicothi-zincwadi.4 IKhabhinethi iphumeze ukwaziswa ngokuBhangiswa kweMithetho yoKhuselo kunye noMthetho Sihlomelo, wama-2014 ePalamente.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili se sisinya diphethoho ho Auditing Profession Act (Molao wa Lekala la Bohlakisi), wa 2005, ho laola baiketi ba bohlahlobi le ho ntlafatsa tjhebo ho Companies Act (Molao wa Dikhamphani), wa 1973 hore Molao wa Lekala la Bohlakisi o ipapise le Molao wa Dikhamphani wa 2008 (Molao wa 71 wa 2008).Sepheo ke ho tlisa ba lakatsang ho ba bahlahlobi (bahlahlobi ba iketang), pele ho boingodiso, tlasa Molao wa Lekala la Bohlakisi, wa 2005 hore ba tle ba laolwe ke Boto e Ikemetseng bakeng sa Bahlahlobi, ka tsela e tshwanang le eo bahlahlobi ba ngodisitsweng ba laolwang ka yona, le ho etsa diphetho tse bonahalang tse batlwang ke Molao wa Dikhamphani wa 2008.
tgt: Oku kujolise ekubhangiseni nasekulungiseni imithetho ethile yokhuselo ebonwa njengengasasetyenziswayo nengafunekiyo njengokuba ichongwe yiKomishoni yoHlengahlengiso loMthetho yaseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tsebiswa ha Defence Laws Repeal and Amendment Bill (Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Melao ya Tshireletso le Suthiso), wa 2014 Palamenteng.
tgt: IKomishoni yayalelwa ukuba iqhube uphicotho-zincwadi lwayo yonke imithetho yaseMzantsi Afrika ukuze icebise ngokubhangiswa kwengasasetyenziswayo, engeyomfuneko okanye enezibonelelo ezingahambelaniyo noMgaqo-siseko.

src: Tsena di batla ho suthisa le ho hlomathisa melao e itseng ya tshireletso e bonwang e se na thuso le ho se hlokahale jwaloka ha e hlauwe ke Khomishene ya Phethoho ya Melao ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo ujolise ekuzalisekiseni lo msebenzi kwezokhuseleko.

src: Khomishene e laetswe ho etsa tlhatlhobo ya melao yohle ya Aforika Borwa bakeng sa ho eletsa mabapi le ho fetolwa ha dipehelo tse sa hlokahaleng, ho batleha kapa tse sa tsamaelaneng le molao wa motheo.
tgt: Lo Mthetho usaYilwayo ubhangisa imithetho yokhuselo eli-16 engasasetyenziswayo kwaye uceba ukulungisa uMthetho omnye, ongalithobeliyo iCandelo le-9 loMgaqo-siseko (igatya lokulingana).

src: Bili e rerile ho phetha mosebetsi ona ka hara tikoloho ya tshireletso.
tgt: Oku kuza kuzisa imithetho yokhuselo ehambelana nomoya woMgaqo-siseko ngokususa izibonelelo zocalucalulo ezikwincwadi yomthetho.

src: Bili e sisinya ho suthisa melao e 16 ya tshireletso e sa hlokahaleng mme ho fetafeta moo e sisinya ho fetolwa ha Molao o le mong, o sa tsamaelaneng le Karolo 9 ya Molao wa Motheo (polelo ya tekatekano).
tgt: Ukufezekiswa kweeNkqubo ezinguNdoqo zikaRhulumente IKhabhinethi izimanya nabemi baseMzantsi Afrika ekubhiyozeleni uSuku lweNkululeko yamaJelo eeNdaba ngomhla we-19 kweyeDwarha wama-2014 xa uMongameli uJacob Zuma ethe wabamba intlanganiso namagqala eentatheli kunye nabahleli njengenxalenye yokubhiyozela iminyaka engama-20 yenkululeko yamajelo eendaba eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Ho Kenngwa Tshebetsong ha Mananeo a Bohlokwa a Mmuso.1 Kabinete e imatahanya le maAforika Borwa moketeng wa Letsatsi la Tokoloho ya Bophatlalatsi ka la 19 Mphalane 2014 ha Moporesidente Jacob Zuma a memme mekaubere ya boraditaba le bahlophisi jwaloka karolo ya ho keteka dilemo tse 20 tsa tokoloho ya bophatlalatsi ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: USuku lweNkululeko yamaJelo eeNdaba lubhiyozela ukuthetha ngokukhululekileyo nenkululeko yamajelo eendaba njengoko iqinisekisiwe kuMgaqo-siseko wethu.2 UMongameli Zuma, ekhatshwa ngamalungu eKhabhinethi, iNkulumbuso yaKwaZulu-Natal kunye naBaphathiswa bamaPhondo baqhube Imbizo kaMongameli ngempumelelo kuMasipala waseMsunduzi nowaseMgungundlovu ngomhla wama-31 kweyoMsintsi wama-2014.

src: Letsatsi la Tokoloho ya Bophatlalatsi ke mokete wa bolokolohi ba tlhahiso ya maikutlo le tokoloho ya bophatlalatsi e tiiseditsweng ka hara molao wa motheo wa rona.2 Moporesidente Zuma, a tlatsitswe ke ditho tsa Kabinete, Tonakgolo ya KwaZulu-Natal le Ditho tsa Lekgotla la Phethahatso tsa porofense ba ile ba tsamaisa Imbizo ya Boporesidente ka katleho bomasepaleng ba Msunduzi le uMgungundlovu ka la 30 Loetse 2014.Jwaloka karolo ya dikgokahanyo tse tswelang pele le tse otlolohileng le badudi ba Aforika Borwa, Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o tla tsamaisa Siyahlola ya Boporesidente Giyani, ho la Limpopo, ka la 31 Mphalane 20.3 Kabinete e amohela tlaleho ya kgatelopele e mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Moralo wa Tumellano bakeng sa Indaseteri ya Merafo ya Moshwelella e tekilweng foramong ya haufinyane tjena ya Lekala la Naha la Ditherisano la Merafo.
tgt: Njengenxalenye yonxibelelwano oluqhubekayo noluthe ngqo noluntu lwaseMzantsi Afrika, uMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kuqhuba inkqubo kaMongameli iSiyahlola eGiyani, eLimpopo, ngomhla wama-31 kweyeDwarha wama-2014.

src: Foramo e bontsha boitlamo ba bankakarolo bohle ho bokamoso ba merafo Aforika Borwa, le tlhahiso le paballo ya botsitso bo lekalekaneng pakeng tsa ditlhoko tsa moruo wa kahisano le dipheo tsa matsete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkele ingxelo yenkqubela yokufezekiswa kweNkqubo-sikhokelo neSivumelwano soShishino lwezeMigodi oluZinzileyo ethiwe thaca kwiqumrhu loThethathethwano lukaZwelonke leCandelo leMigodi.

src: Kabinete e amohela boitlamo bo botjha ho Moralo wa Tumellano bakeng sa Indaseteri ya merafo ya Moshwelella le ho fumana ditharollo tsa nako e telele tsa diphephetso tse tobileng indaseteri ena.4 Kabinete e amohela tsebiso ya Moporesidente Jacob Zuma ka kgatelo pele e entsweng ka Operation Phakisa ho bula bokgoni ba moruo ba mawatle a Aforika Borwa ka tsela ya moshwelella.
tgt: Eli qumrhu libonakalisa ukuzinikela kwabo bonke abachaphazelekayo ngokumanyeneyo kwikamva lemigodi eMzantsi Afrika, kunye nokudala nokugcina ukulingana phakathi kwemiyalelo yezentlalo noqoqosho kunye neenjongo zotyalo-mali.

src: Moralo wa phano wa Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o re atametsa haufi le ho fihlelleng melemo ya moruo wa mawatle, e ka nyehelang R177 bilione ho Dihlahiswa Kaofela tsa Naha Selemong le ho hlahisa mesebetsi e ka bang milione.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkela ukuzinikela kwakhona kwabachaphazelekayo kwiSivumelwano seNkqubo-sikhokelo soShishino lweMigodi oluZinzileyo kunye nokufumana izisombululo zexesha elide kwimingeni ejongene nolu shishino.4 IKhabhinethi yamkele isibhengezo sikaMongameli uJacob Zuma ngenkqubela eyenziwa yinkqubo ebizwa ngokuthi yi-Operation Phakisa yokuvula amandla ezoqoqosho lweelwandle zaseMzantsi Afrika ngendlela ezinzileyo.

src: Makala a tshebetso nakong ya beke tse tsheletseng a tla shebisisa lekala lena le ho ntshetsapele meralo ya phano e tla lokollelwa setjhaba hang feela hae phethetswe.5 Kabinete e amohetse Pehelo ya Leano la Ditekanyetso tsa Nako e Bohareng (MTBPS), e fanang ka kgutsufatso ya moralo wa ditjeho eo ka hara ona ditekanyetso tsa naha le tsa diporofense di lokiswang.
tgt: Isicwangciso sokuziswa kweenkonzo esenziwe nguMongameli uJacob Zuma sisisondeza ekuqondeni iinzuzo zoqoqosho lwezaselwandle, olunokuba negalelo leebhiliyoni ezili-R177 kwisambuku semveliso yelizwe kwaye ludale ngaphezulu nje kwesigidi semisebenzi.

src: Kabinete e amohela mekgwa e phatlaladitsweng ka hara MTBPS ho thibela tshebediso ya ditjhelete ka hara Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba.
tgt: Iprojekthi yesibini yenkqubo ebizwa ngokuthi yi-Operation Phakisa yaqalisa ngomhla we-13 kweyeDwarha wama-2014 kwaye iza kugxininisa kwiikliniki ezisebenza kakuhle kwinkqubo yethu yezempilo.

src: Kabinete e rata ho tiisetsa maAforika Borwa botjha hore le ka hara maemo a thata a moruo mmuso o tla tswela pele ho tshehetsa mananeo a setjhaba ka matlole, matsete a dikaho tsa motheo le ditsiane tsa ho tshehetsa diindaseteri tsa bohlokwa.
tgt: Uluhlu lwemisebenzi luza kuphonononga eli candelo lize liphuhlise izicwangciso zokuziswa kweenkonzo eziza kubhengezwa kuluntu xa zigqityiwe.5 IKhabhinethi ifumene iNtetho ngoMqago-nkqubo woHlahlo-lwabiwo-mali lwesiGaba esiPhakathi (i-MTBPS), ebonelela ngesishwankathelo senkqubo-sikhokelo senkcitho ekuthi kulungiselelwe ngayo uhlahlo-lwabiwo-mali lwesizwe kunye nolwamaphondo.

src: Maemo a Kabinete Mabapi le Dintlha tsa Hajwale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkela amanyathelo abhengezwe ngexesha le-MTBPS okunqanda inkcitho kuRhulumente.

src: Kabinete e amohela mekgwa e kentsweng tshebetsong ke Lefapha la Eneji bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa polokeho ya eneji, ho mekamekana le ditlhoko tsa moruo le ho hlahisa mesebetsi e hlokehang haholo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqinisekisa abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba nangona sikwimeko yoqoqosho enzima urhulumente uza kuqhubeka efaka imali kwiinkqubo zakhe zezentlalo, kutyalo-mali lweziseko zophuhliso nezingundoqo kunye namaqithi-qithi okuxhasa amashishini abalulekileyo.

src: Tshaeno ya tumellano ya dikamano tsa nyutleleya ka hara mebuso ke mohato o isang tseleng e lokileng ya ho tiisetsa ditlhoko tsa eneji tsa naha.
tgt: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwiMiba eGqubayo.1 IKhabhinethi yamkele amanyathelo athathwe liSebe lezaMandla okuphucula ukhuseleko lwamandla, ukusabela kwiimfuno zoqoqosho kunye nokudala imisebenzi efunekayo.

src: Ditumellano tse saennweng ke keketseho ya letoto la bafani ba nyutleleya bao naha e ka kgethang ho bona bakeng sa lenaneo la yona la ho reka nyutleleya le ho tshwaya mokolokotwane o mong hape maikemisetsong a naha a ho beha tiisetso ya eneji ka sehloohong.
tgt: Ukutyikitywa kwezivumelwano zentsebenziswano phakathi koorhulumente linyathelo elilungileyo lokukhusela iimfuno zamandla zelizwe.

src: Tsamaiso ena e atametsa naha haufi le ho atleha ho polante e teng hona jwale Koeberg ho ya ho indaseteri ya nyutleleya e batlang e phatlalatseng, e itjarang e lebeletsweng ho nyehela GW tsa motlakase ho marangrang a naha.
tgt: Ezi zivumelwano zityikityiweyo zongeza kwelo nani lababoneleli ngenukliya ilizwe elinokukhetha phakathi kwabo kwinkqubo yalo yokuthenga inukliya kwaye ziphawula isiganeko esibalulekileyo sokubekwa kokhuseleko lwamandla kwindawo ephambili kweli.

src: NDP e tlama naha ho shebisisa mekgwa yohle e teng ya eneji bakeng sa ho boloka phano ya eneji ya bokamoso.
tgt: Le nkqubo ithatha ilizwe ilibeke kufutshane nokuba lihlelwe njengesikhululo esigqwesileyo esikhoyo samandla enukliya ngesikhululo iKoeberg lize lifikelele kushishino ngokubanzi lwenukliya oluzibonelayo nekulindeleke ukuba lube negalelo kumandla ombane ozigigawati (i-GW) ezi-9.6 kumbane welizwe uphela.

src: Kabinete e na le boitshepo ba hore motswako wa Aforika Borwa wa eneji - o kenyeletsang matla a mashala, letsatsi, moya, metsi, kgase le nyutleleya – a tla netefatsa mohlodi wa matla o tshepahalang o tla mekamekana le ditlhoko tsa naha tsa kgolo, a dumella botsitso pakeng tsa mehlodi ya eneji le ho re thusa ho fihlella dipheo tsa rona tsa phokotso ya khabone.
tgt: IsiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe sinikela ilizwe ukuba liphonononge zonke iindlela zokuvelisa amandla ezikhoyo ukuze zikhusele ukufumana kwethu amandla kwixesha elizayo.

src: Kabinete e amohela le ho thoholetsa mekgatlo yohle ka ho bula botjha Palamente ya Lesotho ka katleho bekeng e fetileng ho ipapisitswe le Tumellano ya Bonamodi ya Maseru e tsamaiswang ke Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithemba ukuba umxube wamandla oMzantsi Afrika, oquka amalahle, ilanga, umoya, amanzi, igesi kunye namandla enukliya – uza kuqinisekisa umthombo othembekileyo wamandla ukuhlangabezana neemfuno zokukhula kwelizwe, kuvumele ukulingana phakathi kwemithombo yamandla kuze kusincede sifikelele kwesijolise kuko ekunciphiseni ikhabhoni.3 IKhabhinethi yamkela kwaye ivuyisana nawo onke amaqela ezopolitiko ngokuhlanganisa kwakhona nangempumelelo iPalamente yaseLesotho kwiveki ephelileyo ngokuhambelana neSibhengezo soQuquzelelo saseMaseru ngokuququzelelwa nguSekela Mongameli uCyril Ramaphosa.4 IKhabhinethi iyaphinda ukuthi uMzantsi Afrika uthathe amanyathelo abalulekileyo okuthintela isifo se-Ebola ekubeni sisasazeke kweli lizwe.

src: Kabinete e boela e pheta hore Aforika Borwa e thehile mekgwa e hlokahalang bakeng sa ho thibela Ebola ho nama ka hara naha.
tgt: Ukugadwa kwawo onke amazibuko okungena komeleziwe ukuze kuchongwe imikhuhlane yeentsholongwane ezophisayo, ingakumbi i-Ebola.

src: Peho ya leihlo ho madiboho ohle a ho kena naheng e matlafaditswe bakeng sa ho hlwaya difeberu tsa madi, haholoholo Ebola.
tgt: Urhulumente useke iqela lesizwe lokusabela xa kungakho imeko yokuqhambuka kwesi sifo kwaye zizibhedlele ezili-11 ezilungiselelwe ukuba ngamaziko onyango lwe-Ebola.

src: Mmuso hape o thehile sehlopha sa naha sa ho arabela haeba ho ka ba le ho hlahella ha lefu lena mme dipetlele tse 11 di malala-a-laotswe jwaloka ditsha tsa phekolo ya Ebola.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ixhasa iinzame zoMbutho wezeMpilo weHlabathi ekusekeni amaziko okunyanga i-Ebola kunye nokomeleza umthamo weelebhu zokuvavanya, ukulandelela ukuba isigulane besihlangene nabani na, ukufundisa uluntu, imingcwabo ekhuselekileyo yababulewe sesi sifo kunye nokukhathalelwa kwezempilo yabo bangenaso isifo se-Ebola eNtshona Afrika.

src: Kabinete e tshehetsa mekutu ya Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Bophelo bo Botle wa ho theha ditsha tsa phekolo ya Ebola le ho matlafatsa bokgoni ba diteko tsa laboratori, ho latela mohlala wa kopano, tsebiso ya setjhaba, dipoloko tsa bafu tse bolokehileng le tlhokomelo ya kalafo eo e seng ya Ebola ho la Aforika Bophirima.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza abantu kunye nabezoshishino kwihlabathi liphela ukuba babe negalelo kwiNgxowamali yokuSabela kwisifo se-Ebola eyasekwa ukuncedisa onke amazwe aseNtshona Afrika achaphazelekayo ekulweni nesi sifo sitshabalalisayo.

src: Kabinete hape e ipiletsa ho batho ka bo mong le borakgwebo ka lefatshe lohle ho nyehela ho Letlole la Karabelo ya Ebola le thehilweng ho thusa dinaha tsa Aforika Bophirima tse amehang ntweng ya tsona kgahlanong le lefu lena le kotsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkele ukubanjwa kwabantu abathandathu abayanyaniswa nobusela beentambo zombane obuye banesiphumo sokungabikho kwamanzi kwinxalenye yephondo laseGauteng.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho tshwarwa ha batho ba tsheletseng ba amahanngwang le boshodu ba dikheibole bo bakileng ho hlokahala ha metsi dikarolong tsa Gauteng.
tgt: Aba bantu bayinxalenye yeqela lemigulukudu ekukholelwa ukuba amapolisa ayaphazamise kakhulu imisebenzi yawo ngokubamba aba bophuli-mthetho.

src: Batho bana ke karolo ya lequlwana leo sepolesa se tlalehwang se le qhadile ka ho tshwarwa hona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise uluvo lokuba ubusela beentambo zombane nezinye izenzo ezinxulumene noko – ukubiwa kweziciko zemingxuma abangena kuyo abasebenzi xa belungisa umonakalo, iintsimbi zokhuselo ezibhulorhweni, iintsimbi ezixhasa iingcingo zombane, iingcingo zokubiya, njalo njalo, zifana nokonakalisa ngabom inkqubo yelizwe yeziseko eziluncedo nezingundoqo.

src: Kabinete e hlahisitse mmono wa hore boshodu ba dikheibole le diketso tse amanang le bona tsa boshodu ba – dikwahelo tsa dikotopo, ditshepe tsa marokgo, diphaelone tsa motlakase, diterata, jj.
tgt: Urhulumente uza kuqinisekisa ukuba abenzi bobubi ababanjelwe ubusela ngokuthenga iintambo zombane ezibiweyo bafumana ezona zigwebo ziqatha umthetho onazo.

src: di amahanngwa le tshenyo ya mananeo a dikaho tsa motheo tsa naha.
tgt: Urhulumente uxhalabile ngulo mba kwaye akazi kuthandabuza ukuthatha amanyathelo aqatha ukuwuphelisa lo mkhwa.

src: Mmuso o tla nnetefatsa hore baetsi ba diketso tsena ba hlahlelwa tjhankaneng bakeng sa kamohelo ya dikheibole tse utsuweng ka kotlo tse matla tse fanwang ke molao.
tgt: Icandelo leSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino elibizwa ngokuthi luRhwebo noTyalo-mali lwaseMzantsi Afrika (i-TISA), lifumene imbasa kwiveki ephelileyo kwiNkomfa yeZizwe eziManyeneyo engoRhwebo noPhuhliso lweQumrhu loTyalo-mali lweHlabathi eGeneva ngokuxhasa utyalo-mali oluzinzileyo.

src: Mmuso o ngongorehile ke taba ena mme o keke wa qeaqea ho sebetsa ka matla ho lwantsha ketso ena.5 Setheo sa Kgwebo le Matsete sa Aforika Borwa (TISA), e leng karolo ya Lefapha la Kgwebo le Indaseteri (dti), bekeng e fetileng le amohetse kgau Sebokeng sa Matjhaba a Kopaneng se mabapi le Kgwebo le Ntshetsopele ya Foramo ya Lefatshe ya Matsete Geneva bakeng sa tshutshumetso ya matsete a moshwelella.
tgt: Le mbasa yeyomsebenzi owenziwe yiTISA wokuxhasa ukusekwa komzimveliso we-Unilever Indonesia eThekwini, ovulwe nguMphathiswa wezoRhwebo noShishino ngexesha uMzantsi Afrika ubusindleke iNkomfa yaMazwe ngaMazwe ye-17 (i-COP 17).6 IKhabhinethi ifumene iinkcukacha ezintsha ngokudilika kwesakhiwo eNigeria.

src: Pehelo e ikgethang e tla fanwa kamora kopano ena.
tgt: Enye ingxelo iza kunikwa emva kwale ntlanganiso.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o tla fana ka puo ya pulo ya sehlooho ka tlasa mookotaba “Lefatshe jwaloka Mmaraka o Moholo o Runyang”, Sebokeng sa innovaBRICS le ka Nnqane ho la London ka la 27 Mphalane 2014.
tgt: Imisitho esendleleni UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kuba sisithethi sembeko xa esenza intetho yakhe phantsi komxholo othi “IHlabathi njengeMarike enye esaKhasayo”, kwiNkomfa ye-innovaBRICS & Beyond eLondon ngomhla wama-27 kweyeDwarha wama-2014.

src: Seboka se kopanya baetapele ba mmuso le ba dikgwebo ba nang le ditshebetso kapa kgahleho ho dimmaraka tse runyang, ho shebisisa le ho buisana ka menyetla ya botsetedi le diphephetso ka hara mebaraka ena.
tgt: Le nkomfa idibanisa iinkokeli zikarhulumente nabezoshishino abasebenza okanye abanomdla kwimarike ezisakhasayo, ukuba baphonononge kwaye baxoxe ngamathuba otyalo-mali kunye nemingeni ekhoyo kwezi marike.

src: Kabinete e amohela Seboka sa innovaBRICS le ka Nnqane ho yona e le monyetla wa ho tsebisa Aforika Borwa e le sebaka sa matsete ho dikgwebo tsa United Kingdom le mebaraka e meng e runyang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkele iNkomfa ye-iinnovaBRICS & Beyond njengethuba lokubeka uMzantsi Afrika njengelizwe lotyalo-mali eliphambili kumashishini ase-United Kingdom kunye nezinye iimarike ezisakhasayo.2 UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kwamkela uMongameli uPierre Nkurunziza waseBurundi ngomhla we-4 kweyeNkanga eKapa.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla amohela Moporesidente wa Burundi Pierre Nkurunziza ka la 4 Pudungwana ho la Cape Town.
tgt: Olu tyelelo luza komeleza ubudlelwane obukhoyo nobusele bomelele phakathi kwala mazwe mabini luze luqhubele phambili ukurhwebelwana phakathi kwamazwe elizwekazi.3 ISebe lezaManzi noGutyulo lweLindle, ngentsebenziswano neBhunga laBaphathiswa base-Afrika bezaManzi (i-AMCOW), iKomishoni yoPhando ngezaManzi yoMzantsi Afrika, i-SADC kunye noMbutho wabaseTyhini weNtsebenziswano ngezaManzi, baza kusingatha iNkomfa yeSini, aManzi kunye noPhuhliso eMonti ukususela kumhla we-3 ukuya kowe-7 kweyeNkanga wama-2014 phantsi komxholo othi “ISini, aManzi noPhuhliso – ukuhlangana okungekabhaqwa”.I-ajenda yale nkomfa iza kumiselwa nguMgaqo-nkqubo kunye neNkqubo-sikhokelo yoHlengahlengiso lweSini kwiCandelo lezaManzi e-Afrika ze-AMCOW, eneenjongo ezisixhenxe ezigxininisa kumgaqo-nkqubo, imithombo, ubuchule bophando, ukwakha umthamo, intsebenziswano kunye nokovavanya nokuhlola, ukuze zifikelele kweyona njongo ibanzi ekukulingana ngesini kumgaqo-nkqubo wezamanzi.

src: Leeto lena le tla tiisa dikamano tsa rona tse ntseng di le teng tsa ka bobedi le Burundi le ho ntshetsapele kgwebisano ka hara kontinente.3 Lefapha la Metsi le Dikgwerekgwere, ka kopanelo le Lekgotla la Matona a Aforika mabapi le Metsi (AMCOW), Khomishene ya Diphuputso tsa Metsi ya Aforika Borwa, SADC le Bomphato ba Basadi le Metsi, le tla tshwara Seboka sa Bong, Metsi le Ntshetsopele East London ho tloha ka la 3 ho ya ka la 7 Pudungwana 2014 tlasa mookotaba: “Bong, Metsi le Ntshetsopele – kgokelo e tsepameng”.Lenane tsamaiso la seboka le tla hlophiswa ke Lekala la Ho kenyeletsa Bong ho Lekala la Metsi ka hara Aforika la Leano le Lewa la AMCOW, le nang le dipheo tse supileng tse tobileng ho leano, mehlodi, lewa la diphuputso, kaho ya bokgoni, tshebedisano mmoho le bodisa le tlhatlhobo, bakeng sa ho fihlella sepheo se akaretsang sa tekatekano ya bong ho leano la metsi.4 Kabinete e lakaletsa baithuti bohle mahlohonolo ha ba itokisetsa ditlhatlhobo tsa mafelo a selemo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inqwenelela bonke abafundi impumelelo njengokuba belungiselela iimviwo zokuphela konyaka.

src: Ditlhatlhobo tsena ke sesebediswa se setle sa ho lekanya boitshunyako ba rona thutong bo kang Ditekolo tsa Selemo le Selemo tsa Naha (ANA) le Setatemente sa Naha sa Leano la Kharikhulamo le Tekanyetso (CAPS).Kabinete e amohela tiisetso ya Umalusi ya hore naha e malala-a-laotswe ho ka tsamaisa ditlhatlhobo tsa Setifikeiti se Phahameng sa Naha pakeng tsa la 27 Mphalane le la 28 Pudungwana 2014.Batswadi bohle, bahlokomedi le badudi ba kgothaletswa ho tshehetsa baithuti ha ba itokisetsa ditlhatlhobo tsa bona.
tgt: Ezi mviwo zisisixhobo esisebenzayo sokulinganisa ukungenelela kwethu kwezemfundo okufana noHlolo loNyaka likaZwelonke (i-ANA) kunye neNkcazelo yoMgaqo-nkqubo weKharityhulam nokuHlola (i-CAPS).IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuqinisekiswa liqumrhu Umalusi ukuba eli lizwe likulungele ukuqhuba iimviwo zeBanga le-12 phakathi kwama-27 kweyeDwarha kunye nama-28 kweyeNkanga kowama-2014.Bonke abazali, kunye noluntu bayakhuthazwa ukuba baxhase abafundi njengokuba belungiselela iimviwo zabo.

src: Kabinete e tswela pele ho lakaletsa sehlopha sa materiki sa 2014 mahlohonolo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isekwanqwenelela iklasi yematriki yowama-2014 impumelelo kwiimviwo zabo ezizayo.

src: Kabinete hape e kgothaletsa batswadi le bahlokomedi ho tshehetsa Dikgetho tsa Makgotla a Taolo ya Dikolo tsa 2015 ho tloha ka la 6 ho ya ho la 28 Hlakubele 2015 ka ho iketa kapa ho vouta.5 Kabinete e hoeletsa maAforika Borwa ohle ho tshehetsa Kgwedi ya Naha ya Temoso ya Ditokelo tsa Diqhwala pakeng tsa la 3 Pudungwana le la 3 Tshitwe 2014 tlasa mookotaba: “Re keteka dilemo tse 20 tsa ditokelo tsa batho ba nang le boqhwala ka hara demokerasi ya rona”.Ho tloha ka 1994 re entse tse kgolo ka ho ntlafatsa ditokelo le boleng ba bophelo ba batho ba nang le boqhwala ka molao, maano le boitshunyako ho tsa kahisano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza abazali ukuba baxhase uNyulo lweQumrhu eliLawulayo eSikolweni lowama-2015 ukususela ngomhla we-6 ukuya kowama-28 kweyoKwindla ngokuthi babe ngabagqatswa okanye ngokuvota.

src: Ho ya ka Tjhebobotjha ya Dilemo tse Mashome a Mabedi 1994 – 2014, Kantoro e mabapi le Maemo a Batho ba nang le Boqhwala e ile ya thehwa, ha amohelwa Lewa la Naha le Kopanetsweng la Boqhwala, le tlhokomelo ya kalafo ya mahala, thuso ho tsa kahisano le thuto e kenyeletsang e fuwang batho ba nang le boqhwala.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubo bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba baxhase iNyanga yeSizwe yokuQonda amaLungelo abaKhubazekileyo phakathi komhla we-3 kweyeNkanga ukuya kowe-3 kweyoMnga wama-2014 phantsi komxholo othi “Ukubhiyozela iminyaka engama-20 yamalungelo abantu abakhubazekileyo phantsi kolawulo lwethu lwentando yesininzi”.Ukususela ngowe-1994 senze imitsi ebonakalayo ekuqhubeleni phambili amalungelo nomgangatho wobomi babantu abakhubazekileyo ngokuwisa imithetho, ngemiqago-nkqubo kunye nokungenelela kwezentlalo.

src: NDP e itlama jwaloka setjhaba ho etsa haholwanyane ho eketsa phumantsho ya ditshebeletso, haholoholo tsa thuto ya boleng le mesebetsi bakeng sa batho ba nang le boqhwala.6 Ka moya wa Kgwedi ya Dipalangwang, Kabinete e ipiletsa ho basebedisi bohle ba tsela ho fadimeha mebileng ya rona ka ho dula ba kganna ka moedi o behilweng wa lebelo le ho netefatsa hore dipalangwang di loketse tsela.
tgt: NgokoHlaziyo lwemiNyaka engamaShumi amaBini 1994- 2014, kwasekwa i-Ofisi yeWonga laBantu abaKhubazekileyo, kwamkelwa iNkqubo-sikhokelo eHlangeneyo yeSizwe yabaKhubazekileyo, kwabakho ukukhathalelwa kwezempilo simahla, ukuncediswa kwezentlalo kunye nemfundo equkayo ababonelelwa ngayo abantu abakhubazekileyo.

src: Mmuso o hoeletsa ditaaso ho sebedisa mebila ka hloko mme basebedisi bohle ba mebila ba hlomphane.
tgt: IsiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe sizinikele ukuba njengesizwe senze ngaphezulu ukwandisa ukufikelela kwiinkonzo, ingakumbi umgangatho wezemfundo kunye nengqesho yabantu abakhubazekileyo.6 Ngomoya weNyanga yezoThutho, iKhabhinethi ibongoza bonke abasebenzisa iindlela ukuba babenenkathalo ezindleleni zethu ngokugcina isantya esimiselweyo kunye nokuqinisekisa ukuba izithuthi zikwisimo esilungele ukuhamba endleleni.

src: Diqeto tsa Bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Izigqibo zeKhabinethi ezinguNdoqo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Letsholo la Matsatsi a 16 la Boitseko bo Matla tlasa mokotaba “Nkenyeletse: Mmoho re Ntshetsa Aforika Borwa e Hlokang Dikgoka pele.”Selemo sena (2014) se tshwaya kgopotso ya bo16 ya letsholo lena leo sepheo sa lona e leng ho tswela pele ho fehla temoso mabapi le tshireletso ya basadi le bana ho tsepamisitswe maikutlo haholo ho sebedisweng ha banna le ho ba etsa balekane hore le bona ba thuse ntweng e kgahlanong le leru lena le letsho la dikgoka ho basadi le bana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilivumile iPhulo leeNtsuku ezili-16 lobuTshantliziyo phantsi komxholo othi “Nam Nindibandakanye: Sisonke siqhubela uMzantsi Afrika ongenabuNdlobongela Phambili”.Kulo nyaka (wama-2014) siphawula iminyaka eli-16 yeli phulo lijonge ukuqhubeleka lifundisa ngokukhuselwa koomama nabantwana kugxininiswa kakhulu kumba wokubandakanya amadoda kusetyenziswane nawo ancedise kwidabi lokulwa ubundlobongela olujoliswe koomama nabantwana.

src: Letsholo le tla thakgolwa ka la 25 Pudungwana ho fihla ka la 10 Tshitwe 2014.
tgt: Eli phulo liza kuphehlelelwa ngomhla wama-25 kweyeNkanga liqhube kude kube ngumhla we-10 kweyoMnga ngowama-2014.

src: Ka nqane ho Matsatsi a 16 a Boitseko bo matla, ho na le lenaneo la selemo kaofela le tla beha leihlo le ho lekola kamoo bophelo bo ntlafetseng ka ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha melao le mananeo ao sepheo sa ona e leng ho fedisa dikgoka kgahlanong le basadi le bana.
tgt: Ukugqitha kwezi Ntsuku zili-16 zobuTshantliziyo, kukho inkqubo eza kuqhuba unyaka wonke eza kubeka phantsi kweliso ivavanye umgama ohanjiweyo ukuphucula ubomi babantu ngokufezekiswa kwemithetho neenkqubo ezijoliswe ekusiphuleni neengcambu ubundlobongela obujoliswe koomama nabantwana.2 IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi ngenkqubo engokuqulunqwa kweNdlela yokuHlola ekhokelwa ngabaHlali.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka tlaleho ya kgatelopele mabapi le ho ntshetsapele mokgwa wa Tlhatlhobo o thehilweng hodima bonkakarolo ba baahi.
tgt: Le projekthi iselilinge igxininisa ekuxhobiseni urhulumente ngezakhono ngokufuna izimvo zabahlali njengenxalenye yendlela yokuhlola.

src: Porojeke ya teko e tsepamisitse maikutlo hodima kaho ya bokgoni ba mmuso ba ho hlakisa maikutlo a baahi jwaloka karolo ya ona ya mekgwa ya tlhatlhobo.
tgt: Le projekthi isalingwayo iza kusebenzisa ezi nkqubo sele zikho zifana neNkqubo yeMisebenzi yoLuntu kunye nenkqubo yabaSebenzi boPhuhliso loLuntu ukuqalisa ukusebenzisa indlela yokuhlola ekhokelwa ngabahlali ngesithuba seNkqubo-sikhokelo yobuChule yesiGaba esiPhakathi.

src: Teko ena e tla sebedisa mananeo a ntseng a le teng a kang Lenaneo la Mesebetsi ya Badudi le lenaneo la Basebeletsi ba Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba ho hodisa tlhatlhobo e thehilweng hodima bonkakarolo ba baahi bakeng sa nako ya Moralo wa Lewa la Nako e Bohareng (MTSF).Teko e ne e tobisitswe ho makala a mafapha a bohlokwa a latelang: Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa sa Aforika Borwa (SAPS), Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle le la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba le Lekala la Tlhokomelo ya Setjhaba sa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Le projekthi isalingwayo iza kugxininisa kula masebe aphambili alandelayo: AbeNkonzo zesiPolisa boMzantsi Afrika, iSebe lezeMpilo kunye neloPhuhliso loLuntu kunye ne-Arhente yoMzantsi Afrika yeziBonelelo zikaRhulumente.

src: Sena se tla atolosetswa ho makala a mang ha MTSF e ntse e tswela pele.
tgt: Oku kuza kwandiswa kuye nakumanye amacandelo kwesi sithuba seNkqubo-sikhokelo yobuChule yesiGaba esiPhakathi.3 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukutyalwa kwamalungu ali-140 eeNkonzo zobuPolisa zoMzantsi Afrika kwilizwe lase-Lesotho ixeshana elizintsuku ezingama-90 kuqala elinokuphindwa landiswe ukuba kukho imfuneko yoko.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho romelwa ha ditho tse 140 tsa SAPS Naheng ya Lesotho bakeng sa matsatsi a 90 a tumellano a ka eketswang ha ho hlokahala.
tgt: Kwaye kwanyanzeleka ukuba uMbutho wezoPhuhliso waMazwe aseMazantsi e-Afrika (i-SADC) ungenelele ngokukhawuleza ngethuba kukho ukujamelana ngezikhondo zamehlo okwalandelwa kukuhexa kozinzo kwezopolitiko nokhuselo ngeyeThupha kowama-2014.

src: Boitshunyako bo potlakileng ba Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tsa Borwa ba Aforika (SADC) bo ne bo hlokahala ka hara Naha ya Lesotho ho latela ditsitsipano tse matla le ho putlama ha maemo a dipolotiki le polokeho tse ileng tsa latela ka la 21 Phato 2014.
tgt: Ukungenelela kwe-SADC kunenjongo zokuzisa uzinzo kwezopolitiko nezokhuselo isithuba eside.

src: Boitshunyako ba SADC bo reretswe haholoholo ho fihlellwa ha botsitso ba dipolotiki le polokeho ba nako e telele.
tgt: Amazwe amaThathu e-SADC ajongene nemiba yezoPolitiko, uKhuselo noKhuseleko uMzantsi Afrika onguSihlalo wawo acele urhulumente waseMzantsi Afrika ukuba uququzelele umsebenzi wokuphunyezwa kweSivumelwano seLizwe lase-Lesotho.

src: Mokgatlo wa Troika wa SADC ho tsa Dipolotiki, Tshireletso le Polokeho moo Aforika Borwa e leng Modulasetulo o ile wa kopa mmuso wa Aforika Borwa ho tshehetsa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Morero wa naha ya Lesotho wa ho ya botsitsong.
tgt: Ukutyalwa kwamalungu e-SAPS ali-140 kwaqala ngomhla wesi-2 kweyoMsintsi ngowama-2014 kwaye kulindeleke ukuba kumiswe ngomhla wama-30 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2014, ukuba akukho mfuneko yokuba eli xesha landiswe.

src: Ho romelwa ha ditho tse 140 tsa SAPS ho qadile ka la 2 Loetse 2014 mme ho lebeletswe ho emisa ka la 30 Pudungwana 2014, haeba ho sa hlokahale ho eketswa.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika utyale amaPolisa e-Lesotho ulandela uMthetho wabeNkonzo zesiPolisa boMzantsi Afrika we-1995 (UMthetho uNombolo 68 we-1995) onika amagunya uMkomishinala weSizwe wabeNkonzo zesiPolisa boMzantsi Afrika okuba atyale amapolisa ngaphandle kwemida yeRiphablikhi, ngemvume yoMphathiswa.

src: Aforika Borwa e rometse Mapolesa Lesotho ho ya ka Molao wa Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa sa Aforika Borwa wa 1995 (Molao wa bo68 wa 1995) o reng Mokhomishenara wa Naha wa SAPS a ka romela ditho tsa sepolesa kantle ho meedi ya Rephaboliki, ka tumello ya Letona.
tgt: Njengoko la mapolisa eza kutyalwa esiya kwenza umsebenzi we-SADC akuzikubakho siVumelwano sokuQondana phakathi koMzantsi Afrika noRhulumente wase-Lesotho.4 IKhabhinethi iyiphumezile imiba ekuza kuxoxelwa phezu kwayo ligqiza labathunywa boMzantsi Afrika eliza kuzimasa iNkomfa yaMazwe (i-COP) eHlangeneyo eza kutshayelela iNgqungquthela yase-Vienna neNdibano yaMazwe (i-MOP) yama-26 engesiVumelwano sase-Montreal esingeGesi eziTshisa uCwambu oluKhusela uMhlaba kwiMitha yeLanga eNqashayo (i-COP10-MOP26), ukusuka ngomhla we-17 ukuya kowama-21 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2014, e-Paris, e-France.

src: Kaha ditho di tla romelwa tlasa thomo ya SADC ho keke ha ba le Memorandamo wa Kutlwanelo pakeng tsa Aforika Borwa le Mmuso wa Lesotho.
tgt: INgqungquthela yase-Vienna kunye nesiVumelwano sase-Montreal zasekwa yiNkqubo yezokusiNgqongileyo yeZizwe eziManyeneyo njeenjongo zokukhusela uCwambu olukhusela uMhlaba kwiMitha yeLanga.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana thomo ya ditherisano bakeng sa baromuwa ba Aforika Borwa ba tla kenela Seboka se Kopanetsweng sa Mekgatlo (COP) ya bo10 ho Kopano ya Vienna ya bo26 Kopano ya Mekgatlo (MOP) ho Porothokhole ya Montreal mabapi le Dinthwana tse Senyang Moalo wa Ozouno (COP10-MOP26), ya la 17-21 Pudungwana 2014 ho la Paris, Fora.
tgt: Ukukhuselwa kokusingqongileyo kulungiselelwa esi isizukulwana nesizayo ngumba ophambili kunye nowokukhuselwa kocwambu olukhusela umhlaba.

src: Kopano ya Vienna le Porothokhole ya Montreal di thehilwe ke Lenaneo la Matjhaba a Kopaneng la Tikoloho ka Sepheo sa ho tshireletsa Moalo wa Ozouno.
tgt: Injongo ephambili kukusebenzela ukuba sifike kwimeko apho sisebenzisa iikhemikhali ngendlela engenabungozi kokusingqongileyo ngokuzinzileyo.5 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukusekwa koMqulu weBhunga leCandelo lezoThutho woPhuhliso oluMbaxa lwabaMyama kwezoQoqosho ukuze ube liliso uvavanye ukuphunyezwa kweenjongo ezimiselweyo zokuPhuhliswa kwabaMnyama kwezoQoqosho.

src: Tshireletso ya tikoloho bakeng sa meloko ya hajwale le e tlang ke ntlha e ka sehloohong mmoho le tshireletso ya Moalo wa Ozouno.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweNkqubo zikaRhulumente ezinguNdoqo.1 IKhabhinethi ilwamkele uTyelelo oliyinxalanye yeNkqubo yokuHlola ukuHanjiswa kweeNkonzo iSiyahlola nguMongameli uJacob Zuma kwisiThili sase-Mopani, e-Giyani kwiPhondo laseLimpopo.

src: Sepheo sa mantlha ke ho sebeletsa ho fihlella taolo e hlwahlwa ya dikhemikhale ka mokgwa wa moshwelella.
tgt: Iinkqubo zokuhanjiswa kweenkonzo zakhokelela ekubeni kubekho amanzi kwiilali ezingama-55 kwesi sithili nokulungiswa kweZiko lokuCoca Amanzi lase-Giyani, nto leyo yenyusa umthamo wamanzi ngezinye iilitha ezizigidi ezi-6,7 ngosuku.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho thehwa ha Lekgotla la Tjhata la Ntshetsopele e batsi ya matlafatso ya batho ba batsho Lekala la Dipalangwang bakeng sa ho beha leihlo le ho lekola ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha dipheo tsa Matlafatso ya Batho ba Batsho Moruong.
tgt: Ukuziswa kwala manzi kuza kuphucula uhanjiso lwelindle kuze ekugqibeleni kwenze ngcono impilo nobomi babahlali.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Leeto la Siyahlola la Tlhatlhobo ya Phano ya Ditshebeletso la Moporesidente Jacob Zuma Seterekeng sa Mopani, ho la Giyane Porofenseng ya Limpopo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwamkele amalinge akhokelwe nguSekela Mongameli u-Cyril Ramaphosa okudibanisa amalungu eBhunga leSizwe lokuPhuhlisa uQoqosho nezaBasebenzi (i-Nedlac) ngomhla wesi-4 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2014 ngeenjongo zokukhangela izisombululo ekuza kuvunyelwana ngazo kwiingxaki zokungavisisani emisebenzini kwi-Indaba engeMpathwano emSebenzini.

src: Mananeo a phano ya ditshebeletso a ile a baka hore ho fanwe ka metsi metsaneng e 55 ka hara setereke le tlhabollo ya Tshebetso ya Tokiso ya Metsi ya Giyane, e phahamiseditseng mothamo wa metsi ho ya ho dimekalitha tse ka letsatsi.
tgt: Abathunywa abebezimase le Indaba bazibophelela ngolu hlobo, “ukuba amalungu ayayiqonda imingeni yentswelangqesho, indlala nokungalingani uqoqosho noluntu loMzantsi Afrika elijamelene nawo.

src: Phano ena ya metsi e tla ntlafatsa tsamaiso ya dikgwerekgwere mme kahoo e be le kgahlamelo e ntle ho bophelo bo botle ho badudi.
tgt: Ingayilibalanga imingeni exine ezo ngxoxo zikhoyo ngoku, amalungu e-Nedlac athatha i-Nedlac njengequmrhu elibalulekileyo elinokuququzelela iingxoxo zamaqela ahlukeneyo, ke ngoko yiyo kuphela eza kukholela ezinye iingxoxo ezinokulandela i-Indaba engeMpathwano eMsebenzini.

src: Kabinete e ananetse boikitlaetso bo eteletsweng pele ke Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa bo kopantseng baemedi ba Ntshetsopele ya Naha ya Moruo le Lekgotla la Basebetsi ka la 4 Pudungwana 2014 ho fihlella ditharollo tsa kgotso dikgohlanong tsa dibaka tsa tshebetso ho Indaba ya Dikamano tsa Basebetsi.
tgt: I-Indaba yemibutho yezabasebenzi nezoqoqosho iza kusetyenziselwa ukuphehlelela inkqubo yokuqalisa ukubonisana, kusetyenziswa amaqela eza kukhethelwa oko, aza kukhangela iindlela zokusabela kwimingeni ephambili ebixovulwe ngethuba le-Indaba.

src: Baromuwa ba neng ba kenetse Indaba ba itlamme, “ka hore baemedi ba ananela diphephetso tsa tlhoko ya mesebetsi, bofuma le ho se lekalekane tse tobileng moru le setjhaba sa Aforika Borwa."
tgt: Isicwangciso esicacileyo senkqubo siza kuqulunqwa zingaphelanga iinyanga ezimbini emva kwe-Indaba, iingxoxo zona ziza kuqala kweyoMqungu ngowama-2015.IKhabhinethi iqinisekile ukuba iintlanganiso zokubonisana phakathi kukarhulumente, abezamashishini, imibutho yabasebenzi neyoluntu ziza kudlala indima kuhlumo olukhawulezayo loqoqosho.

src: Ho sa kgathaletsehe diphephetso dife kapa dife tse kginang puisano ya hajwale ya setjhaba, baemedi ba Nedlac ba ananela Nedlac jwaloka sebopeho seo tlasa sona ho etswang dipuisano tsa setjhaba, mme kahoo ke mohlokomedi wa ditsamaiso dife kapa dife tse ka latelang Indaba ya Dikamano tsa Basebetsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukungenelela kukaSekela Mongameli u-Cyril Ramaphosa kumba obusezindabeni wokukhutshwa ngesixhanti kwabantu kwiifama eNtshona Koloni.

src: Basemphato ba setjhaba ba indaba ba tla sibolla ho thakgolwa ha tsamaiso ya kopano ka meifo ya tshebetso, e tla hlwaya ditsela tsa ho sebetsana le diphephetso tsa bohlokwa tse ileng tsa elwa hloko nakong ya Indaba.
tgt: Iintlanganiso aye wanazo namafama kunye nabasebenzi ngalo mba zibe neziphumo ezincumisayo.4 IKhabhinethi ilwamkele utyelelo ngomsebenzi oluqhube kakuhle kakhulu lwabaPhathiswa e-United Kingdom ebelikhokelwa nguMphathiswa okwi-Ofisi kaMongameli, uJeff Radebe, ukusuka ngomhla wama-27 ukuya kowama-28 kweyeDwarha ngowama-2014.

src: Morero wa dintlha tse batsi tsa tsamaiso o tla ntshetswapele nakong ya dikgwedi tse pedi tsa Indaba, mme dipuisano di tla qala kgweding ya Pherekgong 2015.Kabinete e na le tshepo ya hore dikopano tse jwalo pakeng tsa mmuso, dikgwebo, basebetsi le badudi di tla nehela kgolong e phahameng ya moruo.
tgt: Isicwangciso senkqubo yabo, esasiquka iNkomfa i-innovaBRICS kunye nentlanganiso nabatyali-zimali e-Catham House e-London, sanika urhulumente neenkokeli zamashishini zoMzantsi Afrika ithuba lokuthengisa uMzantsi Afrika njengelizwe elilunge kakhulu lokuqhuba ushishino.5 IKhabhinethi iwamkele amagqabantshintshi anikwe nguMphicothi-zincwadi Jikelele ngeziphumo zophicotho-zincwadi lwama-2013/14 zikarhulumente weSizwe nowamaphondo njengoko oku kuyinxalenye yamalinge karhulumente okuqinisekisa ukuba kukho ulawulo olulungileyo.

src: Kabinete e ananetse boitshunyako ba Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramphosa mabapi le ho ntshuwa ha batho ka sheshe matlong mapolasing a Kapa Bophirima.
tgt: Urhulumente uza kuthatha amanyathelo okulungisa apho bekukho ukusilela ngokwengxelo zophicotho-zincwadi.

src: Dikopano tsa hae le borapolasi le basebeletsi di hlahisitse ditholwana tabeng ena.
tgt: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwiMiba eGqubayo.

src: Kabinete e ananetse leeto la Matona la tshebetso ho la United Kingdom ka katleho le neng le eteletswe pele ke Letona Kantorong ya Moporesidente, Jeff Radebe, ho tloha ka la 27 ho ya ka la 28 Mphalane 2014.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele iNgxelo yeBhanki yeHlabathi (ingxelo yesi-6 ngeZintsha ngoQoqosho loMzantsi Afrika, egxininisa kakhulu kumgaqo-nkqubo wezezimali nowokwabiwa kwakhona) eyabonisa ukuba mde umgama osele uhanjwe nguMzantsi Afrika kule minyaka ingama-20 idlulileyo.

src: Lenaneo lena, le neng le kenyeleditse Seboka sa innovaBRICS le Kopano ya Dijo tsa hoseng Ntlong e Hlomphehang ya Chatham ho la London, le file mmuso le baetapele ba dikgwebo ba Aforika Borwa monyetla wa ho tsebisa Aforika Borwa jwaloka sebaka sa mantlha sa kgwebo.
tgt: Ingxelo ngeZintsha ngoQoqosho loMzantsi Afrika, ekhutshwe ngoLwesibini, umhla we-4 kweyeNkanga kowama-2014, ifumanise ukuba imigaqo-nkqubo yezezimali yoMzantsi Afrika iyawaphungula amazinga endlala nokungalingani, nokuba irhafu nezibonelelo zezentlalo zikarhulumente ziyichaka ngokukuko ingeniso isuke kwabafumileyo iye kwabahluphekileyo.

src: Kabinete e ananetse tsebiso ya Mohlakisikakaretso wa Ditjhelete mabapi le diphetho tsa tlhatlhobo ya Mmuso wa Naha le wa Diporofense ya 2013/14 kaha sena ke karolo ya mekutu ya mmuso ya ho netefatsa puso e ntle.
tgt: Le ngxelo ibonisa ukuba umgaqo-nkqubo wezemali ubonakalisa inkqubelo njengoko uxhamlisa abantu abahluphekileyo.

src: Mmuso o tla nka mehato bakeng sa mosebetsi wa tokiso moo ho hlwailweng bofokodi ke hlakiso.
tgt: Le ngxelo iveze nokuba imigaqo-nkqubo yezemali yonyule abantu abazizigidi ezi-3,6 kumakhandela endlala ngowama-2010/11.

src: Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le Dintlha tsa hajwale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele imingeni ekhoyo ngombane ebangelwe zingxaki zoxhaka-xhaka neemeko zamanye amaziko ombane ethu.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Tlaleho ya Banka ya Lefatshe (tlaleho ya bo6 ya Pehosehlohlolong ya Moruo wa Aforika Borwa, ho tsepamisitswe maikutlo ka ho ikgetha ho leano la ditjhelete le phano botjha) e bontshitseng hore Aforika Borwa e fihlelletse tse ngata dilemong tse 20 tse fetileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bancedise kwiphulo lokonga umba njengoko iziko lombane lesizwe liphantsi koxinzelelo.

src: Pehosehlohlolong ya Moruo wa Aforika Borwa, e lokolotsweng ka Labobedi, la 4 Pudungwana 2014, e fumane hore maano a Aforika Borwa a ditjhelete a fokotsa sekgahla sa bofuma le ho se lekalekane, le hore lekgetho le dithuso tsa setjhaba di fana botjha lekeno ho tloha ho ba ruileng ho ya ho ba fumanehileng ka bokgabane.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ifuna ukuqinisekisa abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba kwenziwa konke okusemandleni ukusombulula ezi ngxaki.

src: Tlaleho e bontshitse hore leano la ditjhelete le hatela pele ka hara Aforika Borwa kaha le thusa ba futsanehileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele iNgxelo yeKota yoPhando ngezaBasebenzi ibonisa ukuba izinga lentswela-ngqesho elisesikweni kwikota yesithathu yalo nyaka lingama-25,4% lisuka kuma-24,7% ngeli xesha linye kulo nyaka uphelileyo nto leyo ibonakalisa ukuba uqoqosho lweli kufuneka lubhinqe umbhinqo omfutshane ukuze sikwazi ukulwa nala mawele mathathu ahluphayo: intswela-ngqesho, indlala kunye nokungalingani.

src: Tlaleho hape e bontsha hore maano ana a ditjhelete a inotse batho ba 3.6-milione ho tswa bofumeng ka 2010/11.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabaqinisekisa abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba idabi lokulwa nentswela-ngqesho isenguwona mba uphambili karhulumente.

src: Kabinete e lemohile diphephetso tsa hajwale mabapi le motlakase tse bakilweng ke mathata a setekginiki le dikaho tsa motheo ho tse ding tsa diteishene tsa rona tsa matla a motlakase.
tgt: Nangona iiNkqubo zeMisebenzi yoLuntu zineziphumo ezincumisayo, iKhabhinethi imemelela onke amahlakani ayo ukuba asebenzisane norhulumente ukuze kuqiniswe amaphulo okudala imisebenzi ngokukhangela amacebo angawethutyana naza kuba yinzuzo kwixesha elizayo kule ngxaki yokunqongophala kwemisebenzi.

src: Kabinete e lemohile Tekolo ya Kotara ka nngwe ya Basebetsi e bontshitseng tlhoko ya semmuso ya mesebetsi kotareng ya boraro ya selemong sena ho 25.4% ho tloha ho 24.7% nakong e tshwanang selemong se fetileng le ho hlakisa tlhokeho ya tshebetso e matla ka ho fetisisa hore re kgone ho sebetsana le diphephetso tse tharo tsa tlhoko ya mesebetsi, bofuma le ho se lekalekane.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isangqukruleka sisithwakumbe sokushiywa zintandane zezemidlalo ezine kwaye ivakalisa amazwi ayo ovelwano kwiintsapho nezihlobo zembethi manqindi yodidi labahlawulwayo uPhindile Mwelase, owaphumelela imbasa yegolide kwi-Olimpiki uMbulaeni Mulaudzi, owasekuba ngumdlali wamaBhokobhoko u-Tinus Linee kunye noKapteni we-Bafana Bafana uSenzo Meyiwa.

src: Kabinete e netefaletsa maAforika Borwa hore ho sebetsana le tlhoko ya mesebetsi e dula e le ntlha e ka sehloohong ya mmuso.
tgt: Inkxaso yoluntu ngethuba kubanjwe iinkonzo zesikhumbuzo kunye nokudandatheka kweentliziyo kuthi sonke kusenze sabambana sipholisana amanxeba sikhumbula la maqhawe.

src: Ha Mananeo a Kgiro ya Setjhaba a tswela pele ho hlahisa ditholwana, Kabinete e ipiletsa ho basemphato bohle ba setjhaba ho sebetsa le mmuso ho matlafatsa mekutu ya ho hlahisa mesebetsi le ho fumana ditharollo tsa nako e kgutshwane le e telele bakeng sa phephetso ya tlhoko ya mesebetsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuqhwabela izandla ukubanjwa ngokukhawuleza komrhanelwa omnye ngabeNkonzo zesiPolisa yoMzantsi Afrika kule veki iphelileyo ngokukrokreleka kugwinto likaKapteni we-Bafana Bafana uSenzo Meyiwa kwaye ibongoza noluntu ukuba luqhubeleke lusebenzisana namaPolisa ukuze bonke abarhanelwa babanjwe.

src: Kabinete e ananetse tekolo ya ntlafatso ya haufinyane tjena ya Koporasi ya Ntshetsopele ya Diindaseteri (IDC) ka Lekala la Ditekolo la Fitch.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamkela izigwebo zobomi ezisithoba ezinikwe uNtokozo Hadebe ngamatyala akhe amanyumnyezi awawenza kumantombazanana aselula amathathu e-Diepsloot, eRhawutini.

src: Kabinete e lebisa matshediso a yona ho mmuso le batho ba Rephaboliki ya Zambia kamora ho hlokahala ha Moporesidente Michael Chilufya Sata.
tgt: Iyasamkela nesigwebo esinikwe uMhlonishwa Elias Mathebula seminyaka engama-315 ethothoza entolongweni ngokugqugqisa endlandlathekisa abantu KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Kabinete e utlwisitswe bohloko ke mafu a dikgalala tsa dipapadi tse nne tsa naha mme e fetisa matshediso a yona ho ba malapa le metswalle ya maditebele wa porofeshenale Phindile Mwelase, Mohlodi wa metale wa gauta wa diolimpiki Mbulaeni Mulaudzi, sebapadi sa mehleng sa di-Springbok Tinus Linee le Mokapoteni wa Bafana Bafana Senzo Meyiwa.
tgt: Ukusuka ngowama-2008 ukuya kowama-2013, uMathebula wayegrogrisa abantu ababhinqileyo e-South Coast, ubukhulu becala e-Umzinto, eHibberdene, eDududu naseMsinsi ngokulandela echwechwela aze adlwengule amaxhoba ali-18, aneminyaka iphakathi kwe-14 nama-40 ubudala.

src: Tshehetso ya Setjhaba bakeng sa ditshebeletso tsa sehopotso le ho ntshuwa ha maikutlo a tswang botebong di ile tsa re kopanya bohlokong ba rona ha re hopola bahale ba rona ba dipapadi.
tgt: Ezi gwebo zixelela izaphuli-mthetho ukuba ulwaphulo-mthetho alizikunyanyezelwa.

src: Kabinete hape e thoholeditse ho tshwarwa ka potlako ha e mong wa babelaellwa ke SAPS polaong ya mokapotene wa Bafana Bafana Senzo Meyiwa mme e kopa badudi ho tswela pele ho sebetsa mmoho le sepolesa ho tshwara babelaellwa kaofela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqinisekisa abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba urhulumente wenza konke okusemandleni ukugcina wonke umntu ekhuselekile kwaye umemelela uluntu ukuba luncedise amapolisa ngokuxela izenzo zolwaphulo-mthetho kwiingingqi zabo.

src: Kabinete e ananela dikahlolo tsa bophelo bohle tjhankaneng tse robong tse filweng Ntokozo Hadebe bakeng sa botlokotsebe bo sehloho kgahlanong le bananyana ba bararo ba banyenyane ho la Diepsloot, Johannesburg, mmoho le kahlolo ya dilemo tse 315 tsa ho hlola tjhankaneng e filweng Mhlonishwa Elias Mathebula bakeng sa ho hlorisa batho Kwa-zulu Natal.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakubethelela kwakhona ukuba abasemagunyeni bezempilo nakumazibuko okungena kweli ahleli ebaze amehlo ukuze abone kwaye ayilawule i-Ebola xa inokubonwa.

src: Ho tloha ka 2008 - 2013, Mathebula o hlasetse batho ba basadi Lebopong le ka Borwa, haholoholo Umzinto, Hibberdene, Dududu le Msinsi ka ho lalla le ho beta diphofu tse 18, tsa dilemo tsa ho tloha ho 14 ho ya ho Dikahlolo tsena di romela molaetsa ho ditlokotsebe hore diketso tsa botlokotsebe di keke tsa amohelwa.
tgt: Ukuza kuthi ga ngoku malunga nama-525 abasebenzi bezempilo nabaselebhu kwizibhedlele ezili-13 (kuquka nezo zili-11 zichongiwe ukulungiselela oku) kunye namagosa alinganiselwa kuma-270 kumaziko okungena kweli angawona asengozini okudibana nesi sifo aqeqeshiwe ukuze akwazi ukumelana nayo nantoni na enokwenzeka ngokunxulumene nesi sifo.

src: Kabinete e netefaletsa maAforika Borwa hore mmuso wa Aforika Borwa o etsa sohle se matleng a ona ho etsa hore mang le mang a dule a bolokehile le ho ipiletsa ho badudi ho thusa sepolesa ka ho tlaleha diketso tsa botlokotsebe dibakeng tsa bona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inqwenelela okuhle iRhuluneli entsha yeBhanki enguVimba yoMzantsi Afrika, u-Lesetja Kganyago njengoko eza kuthatha esi sikhundla ngomhla wesi-9 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2014.

src: Kabinete e pheta hore basebeletsi ba ka sehloohong ba kalafo le ba madibohong ba dutse ba fadimehile ho hlwaya le ho sebetsana le Ebola.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibamba ngazibini nakuRhuluneli u-Gill Marcus oshiyayo ngokutatamisa ecenga umgaqo-nkqubo wezemali phantsi kweemeko zoqoqosho ezinzima.

src: Ho fihlela mona e ka ba basebeletsi ba 525 ba kalafo le dilaboratori dipetleleng tse 13 (ho kenyeletswa ditsha tse 11 tse ikgethileng) le bahlanka ba ka bang 270 dibakeng tse robong tse ka bang kotsing tsa madiboho ba rupeletswe ho sebetsana le bothata bofe kapa bofe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqhwabela izandla u-Chad Le Clos ngokuba ngomnye wababini abaphumelele konke kwimiDlalo yeeNdadi yeNdebe yeHlabathi yoMbutho wezokuDada waMazwe eHlabathi (i-FINA) egqityezelwe e-Singapore.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Motlotlehi Moporesidente Moleftenente Mokgenerale Ian Khama Seretse Khama, Moetapele wa Botswana Democratic Party, mabapi le ho kgethwa hape jwaloka Moporesidente wa Rephaboliki ya Botswana, ho latela dikgetho tse atlehileng tsa la 24 Mphalane 2014.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kuzimasa iNgqungquthela ye-G20 e-Brisbane, e-Australia ukusuka ngomhla we-15 ukuya kowe-16 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2014.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Motlotlehi Mofumahadi Dilma Rousseff, wa Mokgatlo wa Basebetsi ka ho kgethwa hape ka katleho jwaloka Moporesidente wa Rephaboliki ya Bofederale ya Brazil ho latela dikgetho tse atlehileng tsa la 26 Mphalane 2014.
tgt: Njengelizwe ekukuphela kwalo e-Afrika elililungu le-G20, ubulungu boMzantsi Afrika kweli qonga kuwunika ithuba lokuba ube nelizwi elivakalayo kwimiba yemigaqo-nkqubo ebalulekileyo yehlabathi enokuchaphazela uqoqosho lwethu, kule ngingqi yamazantsi e-Afrika nakweli lizwekazi.

src: Kabinete e lakaletsa mahlohonolo Mmusisi e motjha wa Banka ya Resefe ya Aforika Borwa, Lesetja Kganyago jwaloka ha a tla qala ka mosebetsi wa hae ka la 9 Pudungwana 2014.
tgt: Umxolelanisi we-SADC nonguSekela Mongameli u-Cyril Ramaphosa uza kutyelela e-Lesotho ukusuka ngomhla wesi-5 ukuya kowesi-6 kweyeNkanga njengenxalenye yamalinge okuzisa uxolo nokhuseleko kwilizwe lase-Lesotho.

src: Kabinete hape e hlahisa teboho ya yona ho Mmusisi ya tlohelang mosebetsi Gill Marcus bakeng sa ho tsamaisa leano la ditjhelete hantle dinakong tse boima tsa moruo.
tgt: Oku kulandela ukutyikitywa kutsha nje kwesivumelwano sentsebenziswano sase-Maseru kunye nesivumelwano sokhuselo sase-Maseru ezingumkhomba-ndlela wokubuyiselwa kwemeko yesiqhelo yezopolitiko kunye nozinzo kwezokhuselo kweliya lizwe.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Chad Le Clos jwaloka e mong wa ba babedi ba bahlodi ba kakaretso ba Letoto la Disesi tsa Mohope wa Lefatshe wa FINA (Fédération Internationale de Natation) o phethetsweng ho la Singapore.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuphehlelelwa kweBhulorho yaseMashunka neyaseNgubo, iProjekthi yoNkcenkceshelo yaseTugela kunye nokwakhiwa kweziko lefandesi uMsinga laseMsinga, KwaZulu-Natal, ngomhla wesi-8 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2014 liSebe loPhuhliso lwamaPhandle noBuyekezo lwemiHlaba.

src: Jwaloka naha e le nngwe e emetseng Aforika ho G20, botho ba Aforika Borwa bo fana ka monyetla wa ho susumetsa maano a bohlokwa a matjhaba a ka bang le kgahlamelo moruong wa rona, lebatowa le kontinente.
tgt: IProjekthi yoNkcenkceshelo yaseTugela iza kunceda amafama asakhulayo ali-1 716 kunye neyadi yokuthengisa imfuyo yaseMsinga idale amathuba emisebenzi.

src: Motsamaisi wa SADC le Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa o tla etela Lesotho ho tloha ka la 5 – 6 Pudungwana jwaloka karolo ya boitshunyako ba ho tlisa kgotso le polokeho ka hara Mmuso.
tgt: Ibhulorho ekuMlambo iTukela iza kuhlanganisa uluntu lwaseMashunka nolwaseNgubo lutsho lufumane iinkonzo namathuba oqoqosho.

src: Sena se latela ho saenwa ha Tumellano ya Bonamodi ya Maseru le kgotso le polokeho Maseru e behang motheo wa ho kgutla ha dipolotiki tse tlwaelehileng tsa Lesotho le maemo a tsitsitseng a polokeho ka hara naha.
tgt: La maphulo eziseko ezingundoqo kunye nophuhliso ahambelana neenjongo zikarhulumente zokwakha uluntu lwasemaphandleni oludlamkileyo, olulinganayo nolukwaziyo ukuziphilisa.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa ha Borokgo ba Mashunka le Ngubo, Sekema sa Nosetso sa Tugela Ferry le ditshebeletso tsa fantisi ya uMsinga ho la Msinga, KwaZulu-Natal, ka la 8 Pudungwana 2014 ka Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Dibaka tsa Mahae le Tlhabollo ya Naha.
tgt: ISebe lezeNdalo, kunye neKomiti yamaQoqo kaRhulumente ngoTshintsho lweMozulu, liza kubamba inkomfa NgeQhinga leSizwe lokuSabela kuTshintsho leMozulu loMzantsi Afrika phakathi komhla we-10 nowe-13 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2014 kwiZiko leeNgqungquthela i-Gallagher, e-Midrand, phantsi komxholo othi: UMzantsi Afrika utshintshela kumazinga esisi sekhabhoni asezantsi noqoqosho noluntu olukwaziyo ukumelana notshintsho kwimo yezulu.

src: Sekema sa Nosetso sa Tugela Ferry se tla thusa borapolasi ba dipolasi tse nyenyane ba 1 716 mme thekiso ya leruo ya jarete ya uMsinga e tla hlahisa menyetla ya mesebetsi.
tgt: Ngolo hlobo, iKhabhinethi iyakubethelela kwakhona ukuzinikela koMzantsi Afrika kwiphulo lokwakha uqoqosho olukhupha isisi sekhabhoni esincinci kwaye usebenzele kwiziphumo ezihle zenkomfa yaseThekwini eyayingokutshitsha kwemozulu.

src: Borokgo bo ka hodimo ho Noka ya Tugela bo tla hokanya setjhaba sa Mashunka le Ngubo ditshebeletsong le menyetleng ya moruo o betere.
tgt: Izikhundla.1 IKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukuqeshwa kwaba balandelayo kwi-ofisi kaNondyebo weSizwe:UMnu.

src: Dikaho tsena tsa motheo tsa mahae le diporojeke tsa ntshetsopele di tsamaelana le sepheo sa mmuso sa ho aha dibaka tsa mahae tse hlabolohileng, tse lekalekanang le tsa moshwelella.
tgt: M Sachs – USekeka Mlawuli-Jikelele – I-ofisi yoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali.

src: Ho Kenngwa Tshebetsong ha Mananeo a Bohlokwa a Mmuso Kabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa ha Operation Phakisa 2: Ho hodiswa ha Lenaneo la Phihlello ya Ditliliniki le Tokiso.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweeNkqubo zikaRhulumente ezinguNdoqo.

src: Sena se latela Operation Phakisa 1 e neng e tsepamisitse maikutlo ho bulweng ha bokgoni ba mawatle a Aforika Borwa ho tsa moruo.
tgt: IKhabinethi iyakwamkela ukuphehlelelwa kwe-Operation Phakisa 2: UkuKhawulezisa uMsebenzi woKwakhiwa kweeKlinikhi eziseMgangathweni neNkqubo yokuziLungisa.

src: Operation Phakisa 2 e batla ho ntlafatsa boleng ba tlhokomelo eo ho fanwang ka yona ditsheng tse 3 500 tsa tlhokomelo ya Mantlha tsa Kalafo, tse akgang ka hare ditliliniki tsa mmuso le Ditsi tsa Kalafo tsa Badudi.
tgt: Oku kulandela i-Operation Phakisa 1 ebigxininisa kumsebenzi wokizingela amathuba oqoqosho anokubhaqwa kwiilwandle zoMzantsi Afrika.

src: Diphetho tse lebeletsweng di kenyeletsa ho fetolwa ha ditliliniki tse ntseng di le teng le Ditsi tsa Kalafo tsa Badudi ho ba tsa boqhetseke, tse tla sebediswa ke maAforika Borwa kaofela, ka lebaka la boleng ba ditshebeletso tse ntlafaditsweng tseo di tla fanang ka tsona.
tgt: I-Operatin Phakisa 2 ijonge ekuphuculeni umgangatho weenkonzo zezempilo ezinikezelwa ngamaZiko eeNkonzo zezeMpilo angama-3 500, aquka iiklinikhi zikarhulumente kunye namaZiko ezeMpilo oLuntu.

src: Dikgau tsena di kgothaletsa boporofeshenale le ho lemoha boqhetseke ka hara tshebeletso ya setjhaba.
tgt: Iziphumo ezilindelweyo ziquka ukutshintshwa kwezi klinikhi namaZiko ezeMpilo oLuntu zibe ngamaziko angumzekelo womsebenzi omhle, aza kusetyenziswa ngabo bonke abantu boMzantsi Afrika, ngenxa yokuba umgangatho weenkonzo ezizihambisayo uza kube uphuculwe.

src: Kabinete e ananetse hore Letona la Dipapadi le Boikgathollo, Fikile Mbalula le tla tshwara mokete wa Dikgau tsa Aforika Borwa tsa Dipapadi wa 2014 Setsing sa Seboka sa Sandton ka la 30 Pudungwana 2014.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibaqhwabela izandla abaphumelele iiMbasa ze-Batho Pele zokuGqwesa, umsitho wazo obubanjwe ngomhla we-14 kweyoMqungu ngowama-2014.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa barati ba dipapadi ba Aforika Borwa ho ba karolo ya mokete wa Dikgau tsa Dipapadi tsa Aforika Borwa ka ho kgetha Kgalala ya Dipapadi ya Selemo.
tgt: Ezi mbasa zibethelela indlela yokusebenza ephucukileyo kwaye ziwonga abo basebenze ngokugqwesa kwiinkonzo zikarhulumente.3 IKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukuba uMphathiswa wezeMidlalo noLonwabo uFikile Mbalula uza kusingatha iiMbasa zezeMidlalo zoMzantsi Afrika zowama-2014 kwiZiko leeNgqungquthela laseSandton ngomhla wama-30 kweyoMnga ngowama-2014.

src: Tlhahisoleseding e teng ho WEBTOKEKabinete e thoholetsa dihlopha tsa rona tsa dipapadi Bafana Bafana, di-Springbok le di-Protea ka ho phahamisa folakga ya naha ka tshebetso e matla mafelong a beke le ho etsa Aforika Borwa motlotlo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza abemi boMzantsi Afrika abangabathandi bezemidlalo ukuba babe yinxalenye yeeMbasa zezeMidlalo zoMzantsi Afrika ngokuvotela iMbalasane yezeMidlalo yoNyaka.

src: Ho kgethwa ha Monghadi AB de Villiers jwaloka Sebapadi sa Kirikete sa Selemo ke Lekgotla la Matjhaba la Kirikete ya Letsatsi le le Leng (ODI) ka ho fihlella dirane tse 7 000 tsa ODI, ho a babatseha.
tgt: com.4 IKhabhinethi iqhwabela izandla amaqela ezemidlalo esizwe, iBafana Bafana, Amabhokobhoko kunye nee-Protea (iqela leqakamba) ngokudlala kakuhle kakhulu ngempelaveki asenzela udumo singuMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa ha ditshebeletso tsa Dipalangwang tsa Dibese tsa Potlako tsa A Re Yeng (BRT) ho la Tshwane, ho qadileng ho sebetsa ho tloha ka Mantaha wa la 17 Pudungwana 2014.
tgt: AB de Villiers njengoMdlali woNyaka oBalaseleyo kwiMidlalo yeHlabathi yoSuku oLunye (ii-ODI) yeBhunga leQakamba lezeHlabathi ngokuqokelela imitsi engama-7 000 kwii-ODI kuyancumisa.

src: A Re Yeng, jwaloka ditshebeletso tse ding tsa BRT naha ka bophara, e etsa karolo ya mawala a marangrang a dipalangwang tsa setjhaba a tla ntlafatsa bophelo ba bapalami ka ho ba neha mokgwa wa ho tsamaya o potlakang, o bolokehileng, o kgonehang le o phuthulohileng ditoropong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuphehlelelwa kwenkonzo yeeBhasi eziQuqa zibuYelela (i-BRT) i-A Re Yeng eTshwane, eziqale ukusebenza ngoMvulo, umhla we-17 kweyoNkanga ngowama-2014.

src: Kaho ya ditshebeletso tsena e etsa karolo ya phano ya lenaneo la mmuso la dikaho tsa motheo, leo morero wa lona e leng ho ntshetsapele dikaho tsa motheo tsa maemo a hodimo ka hara Aforika Borwa, ha ka ho le leng ho hlahiswa mesebetsi.
tgt: I-A Re Yeng ngokufanayo nezinye iinkonzo ze-BRT kweli lonke, iyinxalenye yesixokelelwano seendlela yezithuthi zikawonke-wonke ezinjongo yazo ikukuphucula ubomi babakhweli ngokuthi babenakho ukusebenzisa izithuthi ezidolophini ezikhawulezayo, ezikhuselekileyo, ezifikelelekayo nekumnandi ukuzisebenzisa.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha lenaneo le phatlaletseng ho netefatsa boimatahanyo le maano le melawana e ntseng e le teng ya matlafatso ya theko ya dihlahiswa tsa lehae.
tgt: Ukwakhiwa kwesi sixokelelewano seendlela kuyinxalenye yokuqaliswa kwenkqubo yokwakhiwa kweziseko ezingundoqo ngurhulumente, eneenjongo zokwakha iziseko ezingundoqo ezikumgangatho wehlabathi eMzantsi Afrika, ibe ngaxeshanye idala amathuba emisebenzi.

src: Sena se kenyeletsa tsamaiso ya ho matahanngwa ha leano la ho sheba botjha le ho matlafatsa Molao wa Moralo wa Leano la Ditheko tse Kgothaletswang, ka ho atolosa Lenaneo la Ntshetsopele ya Bafani ba Phehisanang ho Dikhamphani tsa Mmuso mmoho le ho matlafatsa melawana ya mafapha (haholoholo tjhata ya merafo) ho thusa thekong ya dihlahiswa tsa lehae.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkelwe ukuphunyezwa kwenkqubo ezeleyo yokuqinisekisa ukuthotyelwa kwemigaqo-nkqubo nemithetho yokuphucula amathuba okuthengwa kweempahla zalapha ekhaya.

src: Sena ke sesebediwa se matla bakeng sa diindaseteri tse tla matlafatsa phehisano ya diindaseteri tsa naha, ho thusa kgodiso ya bokgoni ho tsa diindaseteri le thekenoloji, ho eketsa diyantle le ho fihlella matlafatso ya batho ba batsho moruong o tebileng.
tgt: Oku kuquka inkqubo yokulungelelanisa umgaqo-nkqubo ukuze kuphononongwe ukuqiniswa koMthetho wesiCwangciso-sikhokelo soMgaqo-nkqubo wokuThengwa ngokoMkhethe, isandisa iNkqubo yokuKhuthaza uKhuphiswano phakathi kwabaNikezi zinkonzo kuwo onke amaShishini kaRhulumente kwakunye nokomeleza imithetho yamasebe (ingakumbi umqulu wezemigodi) ukuze kuthengwe iimpahla neenkonzo zalapha ekhaya.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa mabapi le Seboka sa Boporesidente sa Mebuso ya Lehae, mme ya tjhaella monwana Lenaneo la ho Boela ho tsa Motheo bakeng sa Mebuso ya Lehae, le itshetlehileng hodima ho aha lefapha la mmuso wa lehae le arabelang, le tsotellang, le le ikarabellang.
tgt: Eli lelinye lamanyathelo abalulekileyo okwenza uqoqosho lweli lube lolwale mihla nto leyo iza kwenza ukuba amashishini esizwe akwazi ukumelana nokhuphiswano, ikhuthaze ukukhula kwezakhono zokushishina nobuchwepheshe, kwandise iimpahla ethunyelwa ngaphandle kubethelelwe ngakumbi uphuhliso lwabamnyama kwezoqoqosho.

src: Lenaneo la ho Boela ho tsa Motheo le tla tsepamisa maikutlo hodima ho etsa meralo le ditshebetso tsa bomasepala bohle hodima phano e hlwahlwa ya ditshebeletso tsa motheo tsa bomasepala le ho buisana kgafetsa le badudi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ixelelwe ngeNgqungquthelo kaMongameli yooRhulumente baseKhaya, yayamkela iNkqubo yoKwenza izinto ngokuFanelekileyo yooRhulumente baseKhaya, esekelwe ekwakheni urhulumente wasekhaya osabelayo, onenkathalo nophendulayo.

src: Sepheo ke ho tloha ho maikemisetso ho ya ho tshebetso.
tgt: Inkqubo yoKwenza iziNto ngokuFanelekileyo iza kugxininisa kucwangciso nemisebenzi yabo bonke oomasipala ekuhambiseni ngokukuko iinkonzo ezisisiseko zikamasipala nokunxibelelana rhoqo nabahlali.

src: Dintlafatso tshebetsong ya bomasepala di tla ntlafatsa maemo a bodulo a maAforika Borwa ohle a itshetlehileng hodima bomasepala ba sebetsang hantle bakeng sa ho phela ka hlompho.
tgt: Imizamo yokuphucula iindlela abasebenza ngayo oomasipala iza kuphucula iimeko abaphila phantsi kwazo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afriika abaxhomekeke koomasipala abasebenza ngokungenamagingxi-gingxi ukuze baphila ubomi obuhloniphekileyo.

src: Ho tloha ka 1994, mmuso wa lehae esale e le sebaka sa mantlha sa phano ya tshebeletso.
tgt: Ukususela ngowe-1994, oorhulumente basemakhaya ngabo abasemehlweni abantu kumba wokuhanjiswa kweenkonzo.

src: Ha ho ntse ho na le kgatelopele e sa kgolahaleng ya phano ya metsi, motlakase, tsamaiso ya dikgwerekgwere le ho tloswa ha matlakala boemong ba lehae, dibakeng moo phano ya ditshebeletso e hlolehang re lokela ho beha batho le ditletlebo tsa bona pele.
tgt: Nangona uyimbali umsebenzi wokunikezelwa kwamanzi, umbane, ukuthuthwa kwelindle nenkunkuma koomasipala, kwiindawo apho ukuhanjiswa kwenkonzo kusasilelayo kufuneka sikhokelise abantu nezinto ezibahluphayo.

src: Sena se batla hore re suthe mokgweng wa rona wa kgale wa ho qala hodimo ebe re ya tlase wa phano ya ditshebeletso ho ya tlwaelong ya Batho Pele le ho sebeletsa badudi.
tgt: Oku kufuna sitshintshe kwindlela edlulelwe lixesha yangaphambili yokuhanjiswa kweenkonzo eyayikhokelwa ziziphathamandla zodwa siye kwindlela ekhokelisa abahlali, i-Batho Pele sisebenzele uluntu.

src: Se hlokolosi ka katamelo ena e ntjha ke mokgwa wa ho tlaleha, le ho ikarabella bakeng sa tshebetso.
tgt: Okuphambili kule ndlela intsha yinkqubo yokunika ingxelo nokuphendula ngomsebenzi owenziweyo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa ha Tlaleho ya Habedi ka Selemo ya Pehosehlohlolong ka Diphokotso Tsa Tlhahiso ya Dikgase Moyeng, ho kenyeletswa Dikateng tsa Naha tsa Kgase ya Sepakapakeng (GHG) ya ho qetela ya 2000-2010, ho Seboka sa Matjhaba a Kopaneng sa Meralo e mabapi le ho Fetofetoha ha Tlelaemete (UNFCCC).
