tgt: Lufuno Tokyo Nevondwe kunyee) NoNksz Fulufhelo Velda Mphuti.

src: Kabinete e ananela Puo ya Boemo ba Naha ya Moporesidente Jacob Zuma, e fileng maAforika Borwa monyetla wa ho utlwa ka Lenaneo la Tshebetso la mmuso.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweeNkqubo zikaRhulumente ezinguNdoqo IKhabhinethi yamkele iNtetho engoBume beSizwe (i-SoNA) kaMongameli uJacob Zuma, enike abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ithuba lokuva ngeNkqubo yokuSebenza kukarhulumente.

src: Mmuso o etsa kgoeletso ho bankakarolo bohle naheng ka bophara ho Sebetsa Mmoho hodima morero o ntlha di robong bakeng sa ho hotetsa kgolo le ho hlahisa mesebetsi.
tgt: URhulumente uhlaba ikhwelo kubo bonke abachaphazelekayo kulo lonke ilizwe ukuba baSebenzisane kwisiCwangciso esinamanqaku alithoba abalulekileyo ukuze badale ukuhluma kunye nemisebenzi.

src: Ho netefatsa hore maAforika Borwa a utlwisisa betere Lenaneo la Tshebetso la mmuso, boikitlaetso ba kgokahanyo ya kamora Puo ya Boemo ba Naha bo kentswe tshebetsong bakeng sa ho fana ka dintlha ka botlalo mabapi le ditsebiso tse entsweng ke Moporesidente.
tgt: Ukuqinisekisa ukuba abemi baseMzantsi Afrika bayiqonda ngcono iNkqubo yokuSebenza kukarhulumente, amalinge onxibelelwano asemva kwe-SoNA asekiwe ukunikela ngeenkcukacha eziphathelele nezibhengezo ezenziwe nguMongameli.

src: Tsena di kenyeletsa Sehlopha sa Matona sa ditsebiso sa Boraditaba se ileng sa bitsa dikopano ho tloha ka la 15 ho ya ka la 24 Hlakola 2015.Ho feta moo, Puo ya Ditekanyetso ya 2015/16 e reretsweng ho tshwarwa ka la 25 Hlakola 2015 e tla hlakisa phano ya mehlodi mananeong a fapafapaneng a mmuso jwaloka ha Moporesidente a tobokeditse.
tgt: La malinye aquka iintlanganiso nooNondaba ebezibanjwe ziNtlanganisela zabaPhathiswa ukususela ngomhla we-15 ukuya kowama-24 kweyoMdumba kowama-2015.Ukongeza koku, iNtetho yoHlahlo lwabiwo-mali yowama-2015/16 eza kwenziwe ngomhla wama-25 kweyoMdumba wama-2015 iza kuqaqambisa ukwabiwa kwezimali zisabelwa iinkqubo ezohlukileyo zikarhulumente njengoko uMongameli egxininisile.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe boitshwaro bo bobe le boo e seng ba bopalamente ba Ditho tsa Palamente tse ding nakong ya Pulo ya Palamente.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakugxeka ukuziphatha ngokungalawulekiyo okungayifanelanga iPalamente kwaMalungu ePalamente athile ngexesha lokuVulwa kwePalamente.

src: Ho a swabisa hore ditho tsena tse kgethilweng ho ba baemedi ba setjhaba di ile tsa kgetha ho hlompholla ho intsha sehlabelo le ntwa e lwannweng bakeng sa ho fumana demokerasi ya rona e thotsweng ka thata.2 Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka kgatelopele e entsweng ka moruo wa mawatleng wa Operation Phakisa.
tgt: Kuyadanisa ukuba la malungu anyulwe luluntu njengabameli babo akhetha ukungakuhloniphi ukuzinikela nokuzabalaza okwenziweyo ukuze kufezekiswe intando yesininzi esetyenzelwe nzima.2 IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi ngenkqubela esele yenziwe nge-Operation Phakisa kuqoqosho lwaselwandle .

src: ‘Laboratori’ kapa mokgahlelo wa ho rera o etsahetse ho la Durban ka Phupu le ka Phato 2014 mme wa tswala tlhahiso e tebileng ya ‘merero e bebofaditsweng’ bakeng sa ho hodisa moruo wa mawatleng.
tgt: I-Lab” okanye inqanaba lokucwangcisa iintlanganiso zalo ezaziqhutyelwa eDurban kweyeKhala neyeThupha kowama-2014 saze isiphumo soko saba kukuveliswa kwesicwangciso esineenkcukacha eziziqendwana eziphathekayo zokuhlumisa uqoqosho lwaselwandle.

src: Operation Phakisa jwale e se e le mokgahlelong wa ho kenngwa tshebetsong, o kenyeletsang bodisa le taolo ya ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha porojeke.
tgt: I-Operation Phakisa (yoqoqosho lwaselwandle) ngoku ikwinqanaba lokuqaliswa ukusetyenziswa eliquka ukubeka inkqubela phantsi kweliso nolawulo lweprojekthi ephunyezwayo.

src: Diyuniti tsa phano di se di theilwe mme le mekgwa ya bodisa le ntlafatso le ditsamaiso di se di theilwe.
tgt: Amacandelo okuqinisekisa ukuba kukho inkqubela asekiwe kwaye iindlela neenkqubo zokongamela nokukhawulezisa sezikho.

src: Hape ho ile ha fanwa ka tsebiso mabapi le Operation Phakisa ya bobedi e eteletsweng pele ke Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle, ho tsepamisitswe maikutlo hodima Phihlello ya Sebele ya Ditliliniki le Tokiso eo e leng motjheng mme e thakgotswe ke Moporesidente ka la 18 Pudungwana 20.3 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Morero wa Lewa la Naha wa Ditokelo tsa Bophelo bo Botle mabapi le Thuto ya Boikatiso le ya Thobalano ya ho Kena boholong.
tgt: Kwenziwe amagqabantshintshi nge-Operation Phakisa yesibini nekhokelwa liSebe lezeMpilo, egxininisa ekuFezekiseni eYona Kliniki iNqwenelwayo kunye nokuyiGcina iseMgangathweni esele iqhuba neyasungulwa nguMongameli ngomhla we-18 kweyeNkanga kowama-20.3 IKhabhinethi ivume uBuchule beNkqubo-sikhokelo yeSizwe yamaLungelo ezeSondo nezeMpilo ephathelele kwiNzala yabaFikisayo.

src: Lewa lena le tsepamisitse maikutlo bakeng sa ntshetsopele le kgodiso ya diphetho tsa kalafo eo eleng hore Thuto ya Bophelo bo Botle ya Thobalano le Boikatiso batjheng ke taba e bohlokwa.
tgt: Le Nkqubo yoBuchule igxininisa ekuqhubeleni phambili kunye nokuxhasa iziphumo zezempilo apho ezesondo nezempilo ephathelele kwinzala yabantu abatsha ingundoqo.

src: Lewa hape le tla netefatsa kgokahano e ntlafetseng, tsamaelano le boimatahanyo le lenaneo la mmuso, setjhaba le balekane ba ntshetsopele ba seng ba ntse ba sebetsa mabakeng a bophelo bo botle ba ho kena boholong ho tsa thobalano le boikatiso.
tgt: Le nkqubo yobuchule iza kuqinisekisa ngakumbi ulungelelwaniso oluphuculiweyo, intsebenziswano kunye nohlengahlengiso nenkqubo karhulumente, uluntu kunye namaqabane kwezophuhliso asele esebenza kwimiba ephathelele kwezempilo yesondo nenzala yabafikisayo.

src: Komiti ya kopanelo ya Matona bakeng sa Leano la Setjhaba e tla okamela ho kenngwa tshebetsong, bodisa le tekolo ya Lewa lena.4 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya moralo wa Leano la Ntlafatso ya Kgodiso ya Bana Koranteng ya Mmuso.
tgt: IKomiti yabaPhathiswa yoMgaqo-nkqubo weNani laBantu iza kubeka esweni ukuphunyezwa, ukongamela kunye nokuhlolwa kwale Nkqubo yoBuchule.4 IKhabhinethi ivume ukupapashwa koyilo loMgaqo-nkqubo woPhuhliso lwaBantwana abasaKhulayo kwiphephandaba lakwarhulumente.

src: Sena se etsa karolo ya Lenaneo la Tshebetso la Aforika Borwa le Kopanetsweng bakeng sa Ntlafatso ya Kgodiso ya Bana - Ho ya pele ka 2013-2016, le tjhaelletswe monwana ke Kabinete ka la 18 Loetse 2013.
tgt: Oku kuyinxalenye yeNkqubo yokuSebenza eHlangeneyo yaseMzantsi Afrika kuPhuhliso lwaBantwana abasaKhulayo–Siqhubela phambili yowama-2013-2016, neyavunywa yiKhabhinethi ngomhla we-18 kweyoMsintsi wama-2013.

src: Leano le fana ka moralo bakeng sa boikarabello ba mmuso ba ho fana ka pakana e pharaletseng ya ditshebeletso tsa Ntlafatso ya Kgodiso ya Bana ya boleng e tla ba teng bakeng sa bohle ka palo e lekaneng le sebaka hore bana kaofela ba fumane monyetla o lekalekanang wa ho di fihlella.
tgt: Lo Mgaqo-nkqubo inika inkqubo-sikhokelo yokuphendula kukarhulumente ekuboneleleni ngeenkonzo ngokubanzi zoPhuhliso lwaBantwana abasaKhulayo olusemgangathweni eziza kufumaneka kulo lonke ngokwaneleyo nakwiindawo ezifikeleleka lula ukuze bonke abantwana bonwabele amathuba alinganayo okufikelela kuzo.

src: Leano hape le hlahisa ditshebeletso tse mmalwa tse ntjha bakeng sa ho kwala dikgeo tse hlwailweng letotong la ditshebeletso tse teng hajwale haholoholo nakong ya matsatsi a pele a 1 000 a bophelo ba ngwana.
tgt: Lo Mgaqo-nkqubo usekwazisa iinkonzo ezintsha eziliqela ukuvala izikhewu ezibonwe kuthotho lweenkonzo ezifumanekayo ngoku ingakumbi kwiintsuku ezili-1 000 zokuqala ebomini bomntwana.

src: Kabinete hape e tjhaelletse monwana ho thehwa ha Komiti ya Kopanelo ya Matona (IMC), e tla netefatsa katamelo e momahaneng le ho hokahana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isekwavume ukusekwa kweKomiti yaBaphathiswa (i-IMC) eza kuqinisekisa indlela ecacileyo nelungeleleneyo.

src: E tla tsamaiswa ke Letona la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba.5 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho lokollwa ha tlaleho ya Moralo wa Pele wa nako le nako wa Naha mabapi le Seboka sa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) mabapi le Ditokelo tsa Batho ba Phelang ka Boqhwala, bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba nakong ya matsatsi a Tlaleho e akaretsa nako ya Mmesa 2012- Hlakubele 20.6 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana hore Aforika Borwa e nke karolo ho Selemo sa Matjhaba sa Mmapa ka 2015 le 2016 ka ho hlophisa diketsahalo maemong a naha ka maikemisetso a ho eketsa temoso ka dimmapa le tsebo Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Le komiti iza kukhokelwa nguMphathiswa woPhuhliso loLuntu.5 IKhabhinethi ivume ukukhutshwa koyilo lokuqala lwengxelo yexeshana yeNkomfa yeZizwe eziManyeneyo ngamaLungelo aBantu abaKhubazekileyo, ukuze uluntu luphefumle kulo isithuba seentsuku ezingama-20.

src: Dimmapa di thusa ho utlwisisa diqaka le dikgonahalo, tse jwaloka phano ya matlo, paballo ya mehlodi ya tlhaho, ho laola dikotsi le ho thusa nako e sa le teng dikahong tsa motheo tse pharaletseng tsa dipalangwang.
tgt: Le ngxelo iquka ixesha elisusela kuTshazimpunzi wama-2012 ukuya kweyoKwindla wama-20.6 IKhabhinethi ivume ukuba uMzantsi Afrika uthathe inxaxheba kuNyaka weHlabathi weMephu ngowama-2015 nowama-2016 ngokuququzelela imisitho kwilizwe lonke ngenjongo yokufundisa ngeemephu kunye nezakhono zokufunda nokubhala eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Ho utlwisisa tlhahisoleseding ya dibaka tsa boaho ho a thusa bakeng sa ho etsa meralo le ho nka diqeto bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Iimephu zinceda ukuqonda iingxaki kunye namathuba, okufana nokwakhelwa kwabantu izindlu, ukugcinwa kobutyebi bendalo, ulawulo lweengozi nokukhokela amaphulo okwakha iziseko ezibanzi zezothutho.

src: Sena se neha ba ka sehloohong lepatlelo la ho buisana ka kotloloho le maAforika Borwa, ho utlwa mathata a setjhaba ho tswa ho bona le ho beha leihlo kgatelopele ya mananeo a mmuso.3 Dibili.1 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya moralo wa Bili ya Tshireletso, Kgothaletso, Ntshetsopele le Bolaodi ba Ditsamaiso tsa Tsebo ya Ditsamaiso tsa Ka hara Naha Koranteng ya Mmuso mmoho le tsamaiso ya dipuisano le setjhaba.
tgt: Ukuqonda ulwazi lweendawo nobume bomhlaba kuyanceda ekucwangciseni nasekuthatheni izigqibo ngophuhliso loMzantsi Afrika.

src: Sepheo se seholo sa Bili ena ke ho thusa ka tshireletso ya Tsebo ya Ka hara Naha le paballo ya tsebo ya Ka hara Naha e amanang le, mme e le ya baahi ba lehae ba ka hara naha ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Izigqibo zeKhabhinethi ezinguNdoqo IKhabhinethi ivume uMyalelo wokufezekiswa kokuhlolwa okusekelezelwe kulwazi lomsebenzi lwamalungu eeNkonzo zaBaphathi abaPhezulu (i-SMS), okhutshwe ngokwemiqathango yeSahluko se-4 iCandelo II

src: E thusa ka ho hlabolla ditokelo le melemo tseo baahi ba lehae ba ka hara naha ba neng ba di tinngwe.2 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Taolo ya Dithunya, 2015 Koranteng ya Mmuso bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: kunye neSahluko se-4, iCandelo VI yeMimiselo yeNkonzo zaBasebenzi bakaRhulumente, yonyaka wama-2001.Lo Myalelo uhlonyelweyo uxhasa ukuchongwa ngokuzimeleyo kwezikhewu kuphuhliso lwaMalungu eeNkonzo zaBaphathi abaPhezulu, wazisa ukusetyenziswa kwemisebenzi yobugcisa kwaye unika nesikhokelo ngendlela amasebe angazisebenzisa ngayo iziphumo zokuhlola ulwazi lomsebenzi kudibene nezinye zonke iinkqubo zokuqeshwa nokukhethelwa ukusebenza kwisikhundla esithile.2 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukubanjwa kweVeki yeSizwe yeeMbizo ukususela kumhla we-7 ukuya kowe-12 kuTshazimpunzi wama-2015 phantsi komxholo othi: “Sisonke siqhubela uMzantsi Afrika phambili”.Le Veki iza kuphawulwa ngokutyelelwa kwikhaya nekhaya kuqokelelwa iinkcukacha ngamakhaya lawo, ukuhamba-hamba okanye ukutyelela iiprojekthi, iingxoxo nabachaphazelekayo, iingxoxo noluntu kunye neengxoxo namajelo eendaba oluntu nawezoshishino.

src: Bili e hlomathisa Molao wa Taolo ya Dithunya, 2000 le ho arabela ho Pono ya Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha ka ho batla ho ntlafatsa moralo wa molao le bolaodi bo tla laola dithunya.
tgt: Ezi ngxoxo zinika abaphathi iqonga lokubonisana nokubonana ngqo nabemi boMzantsi Afrika, beve imiba yoluntu ivela kuluntu ngokwalo kunye nokuhlola inkqubela yeenkqubo zikarhulumente.3 IMithetho esaYilwayo.1 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa koyilo loMthetho osaYilwayo woKhuseleko, ukuXhaswa, uPhuhliso kunye noLawulo lweeNkqubo zoLwazi lweMveli kwiPhephandaba likaRhulumente kwakunye nenkqubo yokungqubanisa iintloko noluntu.

src: Taolo ya dithunya ke ntlha ya bohlokwa ya katamelo ya mmuso ya ho lwantsha botlokotsebe.4 Maemo a Kabinete Mabapi le Dintlha tsa hajwale.1 Kabinete e kgothaletsa badudi le dibopeho tse itlhophisitseng ho sebetsa le mmuso, tlasa boetapele ba Lefapha la Kopanelo ya Puso le Merero ya Botjhaba, ho netefatsa hore diphephetso tse potapotileng Malamulele ho la Limpopo di a rarollwa.
tgt: Eyona njongo isisiseko yalo Mthetho usaYilwayo kukuququzelela ukukhuselwa koLwazi lweMveli kunye nokuvuselelwa nokwamkelwa koLwazi lweMveli lwabantu boMzantsi Afrika bomgquba.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe tshitiso ya dikolo ke dihlopha tse itseng e le tsela ya ho hlahisa ditletlebo.
tgt: Ukhokela iphulo lokubuyisela amalungelo nobutyebi abantu bothuthu beli abalahlekana nawo.2 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa koMthetho Sihlomelo woLawulo lweMipu, wama-2015 kwiPhephandaba liRhulumente ukuze uluntu luphefumle kuwo.

src: Sena se amohile bana tokelo ya bona ya thuto le ho thibela ba bang tokelo ya ho ingodisetsa dihlahlobo tsa bona tsa tlatsetso tsa Kereiti ya Ho thehwa ha masepala wa Malamulele ho tshwanela ho ba diatleng tsa molao jwaloka ha o behilwe ke Boto ya Karohanyo.2 Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe ditlhaselo tsa melata jwaloka tlolo ya molao mme e thathiselletsa ka hore makala a tsa molao a keke a qeaqea ho sebetsana ka matla kgahlanong le mang kapa mang ya tla fumanwa a rotetsa merusu e jwalo.
tgt: Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo uhlomela uMthetho woLawulo lweMipu wonyaka wama-2000 kwaye uphendula kuMbono weSicwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso ngokuzama ukuphucula isikhokelo-nkqubo solawulo nemithetho eza kulawula imipu.

src: Ha ho bothata bo jwang kapa jwang ba moruo le ho se kgotsofale tse amohelehang tse ka amantshwang le ditlhaselo tsena tsa botlokotsebe.
tgt: Ulawulo lwemipu ngumba obalulekileyo lwendlela urhulumente alulwa ngayo ulwaphulo-mthetho.4 ULuvo lweKhabhinethi kwiMiba eGqubayo.1 IKhabhinethi icela uluntu kunye nemibutho ukuba basebenze norhulumente, ephantsi kweSebe loLawulo lweNtsebenziswano neMicimbi yeMveli, ukuqinisekisa ukuba imingeni engqonge iMalamulele eLimpopo iyasonjululwa.

src: Aforika Borwa ke moitlami ka ho saena Porothokhole ya Geneva e mabapi le Baphaphathehi mme e itlamme ho tshireletsa melata yohle e ka hara naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakugxeka ukuphazanyiswa kokufunda ezikolweni ngamaqela athile njengendlela yokuvakalisa izikhalazo zawo.

src: Jwaloka moitlami ho Porothokhole ena, mme jwaloka naha e kgothaletsang ditokelo tsa botho, re tla tshireletsa ditokelo tsa motheo tsa motho ofe kapa ofe ya ka hara naha ya rona, ho kenyeletswa melata.3 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho hlahiswa Palamenteng bakeng sa tiisetso, Tumellano e Thehang Tumellano le Tlhophiso ya Mokgopi wa Resefe wa BRICS mabapi le Banka e Ntjha ya Ntshetsopele.
tgt: Oku kunyhasha ilungelo labantwana lokufunda kwaye lohlutha abanye ilungelo lokubhalisela iimviwo zokuxabangela zeBanga le-12.

src: Tlhophiso ya Mokgopi wa Resefe e thewa bakeng sa ho arabela ho dikgatello tsa tsepamiso ya ditefello tsa nako e kgutshwanyane.
tgt: Ukusekwa kukamasipala eMalamulele kufuneka kwenziwe ngokusemthethweni nangokwemimiselo yeBhodi yokuCandwa kweMida.2 IKhabhinethi iyakugxeka ukuhlaselwa kwabemi abavela kumazwe angaphandle yaye oku ikubona njengesenzo solwaphulo-mthetho kwaye igxininisa ukuba ii-arhente zogcino-mthetho aziyi kuthandabuza ukwenza umsebenzi wazo zibambe naye nabani na ofunyenwe ephembelela udushe.

src: Ho fetafeta moo, e tla sebetsa e le mokgwa wa temoso bakeng sa ho thusa dinaha tsa BRICS ho thibela dikgatello tsa nako e kgutshwanyane tsa phallo ya tjhelete, ho fana ka tshehetsano mmoho le ho tswella ho matlafatsa polokeho ya ditjhelete ya lefatshe.4 Kabinete e ananela ho fana ka marapo ha Modulasetulo wa moifo wa Aforika Borwa wa Lekgotla la Kgwebo la BRICS ho tswa ho Monghadi Patrice Motsepe ho ya ho Monghadi Brian Molefe.
tgt: Akukho ntsokolonakunganeliseki okunokusetyenziswa njengesizathu szenzo zolwaphulo-mthetho obe lujoliswe kwaba bemi bamazwe angaphandle.

src: Monghadi Motsepe e ne e le modulasetulo wa sethathong wa ka bobedi moifo wa Aforika Borwa le Lekgotla la Kgwebo la Brazil, Russia, India, China, Aforika Borwa (BRICS) ka kakaretso.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika lelinye lamazwe atyikitya isiVumelwano saseGeneva seeMbacu kwaye uzinikele ekukhuseleni bonke abemi bamazwe angaphandle abakweli lizwe.

src: Nakong ya tshebetso ya hae, Monghadi Motsepe o atlehile bakeng sa ho theha lekgotla lena la bohlokwa jwaloka karolo ya setheo sa BRICS le ho sebetsa jwaloka modulasetulo ka bokgabane.
tgt: Njengelinye lamazwe atyikitya esi siVumelwano, nanjengelizwe elixabise amalungelo oluntu, siza kuwakhusela amalungelo asisiseko omntu ngamnye ongaphakathi kwemida yeli, kuquka nabemi abavela kumazwe angaphandle.3 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukuthiwa thaca, ngenjongo zokuba iPalamente inike imvume, kwesiVumelwano sokuSekwa kwesiCwangciso se-BRICS sikaVimba wokuLalelisela kunye nesiVumelwano seBhanki eNtsha yoPhuhliso.

src: Kabinete e leboha Monghadi Motsepe ka mosebetsi wa hae le ho lakaletsa Monghadi Molefe tse molemo jwaloka ha a tla kallana le mosebetsi ona wa bohlokwa.5 Kabinete e thoholetsa Sehlopha sa Naha sa Kirikete ka tshebetso ya sona Mohopeng wa Lefatshe wa Kirikete mme e ba lakaletsa tse molemo jwaloka naha e ba tshehetsa bakeng sa thonamente e motjheng Australia le New Zealand.6 Kabinete e thoholetsa seletsi sa folutu Wouter Kellerman ya hapileng Kgau ya Grammy bakeng sa alebamo e kgabane ka ho fetisisa ya moloko o motjha.
tgt: Esi siVumelwano sikaVimba wokuLalelisela siqulunqelwe ukuze sincedise kwiingxaki zokubhatala amatyala exesha elifutshane.

src: Monghadi Kellerman o hatisitse Winds of Samsara le moqapi wa moIndia Ricky Kej, e ba hapetseng kgau bakeng sa kopanelo ya bona.7 Kabinete e hlahisa teboho ya yona ho basebedisi ba eneji ka ho arabela kgoeletso ya ho fokotsa tshebediso ya motlakase.
tgt: Ukongeza koko, aza kusebenza njengenyathelo elisisilumkiso sokunceda amazwe amahlanu e-BRICS akwazi ukuthintela uxinzelelo lokungabi nazimali lwexesha elifutshane, kubonelele nangenkxaso evela macala kunye nokomeleza ngaphezulu umnatha wokhuseleko lwezimali zehlabathi.4 IKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukunikezela iintambo kukaSihlalo wecandelo loMzantsi Afrika leBhunga loShishino le-BRICS uMnu Patrice Motsepe kuMnu Brian Molefe.

src: War Room e theilweng ke Kabinete ka Tshitwe 2014 e eteletsweng pele ke Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa e sebetsa ka thata ho akofisa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha morero o ntlha di hlano tsa ho fetola maemo a hajwale.
tgt: UMnu Motsepe wayengusihlalo wokuqala wawo omabini amacandelo, icandelo laseMzantsi Afrika kunye neBhunga loShishino le-BRICS liphelele.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le Moporesidente Zuma ka ho fetisetsa matshediso a yona ho ba lelapa le metswalle ya senatla sa bongodi ba Seaforikanse Moporofesara André Brink.
tgt: Ngexesha lolawulo lwakhe, uMnu Motsepe waphumelela ekusekeni eli bhunga libalulekileyo njengecandelo elifunekayo le-BRICS kwaye njengosihlalo usebenze ngokugqwesileyo.

src: O tla hopolwa jwaloka e mong wa bangodi ba ka sehloohong ba Seaforikanse ya sebedisitseng talente ya hae ya bongodi ho bua kgahlanong le mmuso wa kgethollo.5 Diketsahalo tse tlang.1 Kabinete e thathiselletsa kgoeletso ya Moporesidente Jacob Zuma bakeng sa mekga yohle Lesotho ho sebetsa ka tsela e tla bopa maemo a matle bakeng sa ho tshwara dikgetho tse nang le kgotso, ponaletso, tsa nnete, le tse lokolohileng le ho hloka leeme, mme kahoo di bontsha thato ya setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyambulela uMnu Motsepe ngomsebenzi wakhe kwaye inqwenelela uMnu Molefe okuhle kodwa njengokuba ethatha intambo kwesi sikhundla sibaluleke kangaka.5 IKhabhinethi incoma iqela leQakamba leSizwe ngendlela elidlale ngayo kwiNdebe yeHlabathi yeQakamba kwaye ibanqwenelela impumelelo njengoko ilizwe liphela libaxhasa kwitumente edlalelwa e-Australia nase-New Zealand.6 IKhabhinethi ivuyisana nomdlali wefleyiti uWouter Kellerman ophumelele iMbasa yeGrammy yelona cwecwe litsha lalemihla.

src: Kabinete hape e hlahisa boitshepo ba yona mosebetsing wa bonamodi ba Moifo wa Mokgatlo wa Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tse ka Borwa ba Aforika (SADC) wa Tekolo ya Dikgetho ho la Lesotho tlasa boetapele ba Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Ramaphosa.
tgt: UMnu Kellerman washicilela ingoma yakhe ethi Winds of Samsara kunye nomqambi wase-India uRicky Kej, nabathe ngentsebenziswano yabo kule ngoma baphumelela le mbasa.7 IKhabhinethi ivakalisa umbulelo wayo kubo bonke abasebenzisa amandla ombane ngokusabela ikhwelo lokunciphisa ukusetyenziswa kombane.

src: Jwaloka karolo ya diqeto tsa Dihlooho tsa Puso ya Troika tsa SADC le Mmuso, Aforika Borwa e tla bapala karolo ya yona ka ho eta pele le ho ba karolo ya Moifo wa SADC wa Tekolo ya Dikgetho ho Mmuso wa Lesotho, bakeng sa dikgetho tse rerilweng tsa la 28 Hlakola 20.2 Molaodi ya ka Sehloohong wa Sesole sa Naha sa Aforika Borwa, Moporesidente Jacob Zuma e tla ba mohlanka ya ka sehloohong moketeng wa Letsatsi la Mabotho a Hlometseng tlasa mookotaba “Lebotho la tshireletso la boporofeshenale le nang le bokgoni bakeng sa batho ba Aforika Borwa” ka la 21 Hlakola 2015, ho la Potchefstroom, Leboya Bophirima.
tgt: Inkqubo yokushukuxa imingeni yezamandla ombane ifumana eyona nqwalasela ibaluleke kakhulu.

src: Letsatsi la Mabotho a Hlometseng le ketekwa selemo ka seng ho hlompha banna le basadi ba junifomo ba iteletseng ho sebeletsa setjhaba lapeng le mose.3 Kabinete e kgothaletsa bahiri bohle ba imatahantseng le Molao wa Tekatekano ya Kgiro (EE) ho kenela Dikgau tsa Tekatekano ya Kgiro 2015 pele ho letsatsi la ho kwalwa la 13 Hlakubele 2015.Ketsahalo ena e tla tshwarwa ke Khomishene ya Tekatekano ya Kgiro, e ananela bahiri ba kentseng tshebetsong mawa a netefatsang tekatekano le phapang mosebetsing, ha ho tloswa ditshebetso tsohle tse leeme tse kgethollang.4 Letona la Bohahlaudi Derek Hanekom o tla fana ka puo ho Dikopano tsa Aforika e leng se tla etsahala Setsing sa Dikopano sa Sandton ho tloha ka la 23 ho isa ho la 25 Hlakola 2015 tlasa mookotaba: “Mmoho re tswellisa Aforika”.
tgt: IQela lokuGwadla iQhinga elamiselwa yiKhabhinethi ngeyoMnga wama-2014 likhokelwa nguSekela Mongameli uCyril Ramaphosa liyasebenza ukukhawulezisa ukuphunyezwa kwesicwangciso esinamanqaku amahlanu okusombulula le ngxaki.8 IKhabhinethi igxwala emswaneni kunye noMongameli Zuma ekudluliseni umyalezo wovelwano kusapho nezihlobo zenkunkqele yombhali weencwadi zesiAfrikaans uNjingalwazi André P Brink.

src: Tsena ke dipontsho tsa mantlha tsa kgwebisano tsa Lekgotla la Seboka sa Naha sa Aforika Borwa, tse bokanyang mmoho bapepesi le bareki ba Aforika bao e ka nnang ya ba na le kgahleho.5 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tshwarwa ha Foramo ya Lefatshe ya Moruo (WEF) – ho la Aforika, ke Aforika Borwa Setsing sa Matjhaba sa Dikopano sa Motse Kapa (CTCC) ho tloha ka la 3 ho isa ho la 5 Phuptjane 2015.
tgt: Uza kukhunjulwa njengomnye wababhali ababalulekileyo besi-Afrikaans abasebenzisa usiba ukugxeka urhulumente wengcinezelo.5 Imisitho ezayo.1 IKhabhinethi iyaliphinda ikhwelo elihlatywe nguMongameli uJacob Zuma kuwo onke amaqela aseLesotho lokwenza izinto ngendlela edala umoya okhokelela kunyulo olunoxolo, oluselubala, olukholelekayo, olukhululekileyo nolungenamkhethe, olubonisa intando yabantu.

src: Mookotaba e tla ba “Maoba le Kajeno: Re lohotha Botjha Bokamoso ba Aforika”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isekwavakalisa ukuwuthemba umsebenzi wokungenelela weGqiza laBakhi-mkhanyo be-SADC eLesotho elikhokelwa nguSekela Mongameli uRamaphosa.

src: WEF-Aforika ke foramo ya lebatowa e tsepamiseditseng maikutlo hodima foramo ya moruo e fanang ka monyetla bakeng sa dikgwebo tsa lehae le tsa lebatowa le batsetedi ba nang le thahasello ka hara lebatowa, ho fapanyetsana le ho aha bolekane le mebuso e fapaneng.
tgt: Njengenxalenye yezigqibo zeeNtloko zoMbuso kunye nooRhulumente be-SADC eziNtathu, uMzantsi Afrika uza kudlala indima yawo ngokukhokela kunye nokuba yinxalenye yeGqiza le-SADC laBakhi-mkhanyo boloNyulo kwilizwe laseLesotho, kunyulo olulungiselelwe umhla wama-28 kowama-20.2 INkumanda eyiNtloko yoMkhosi woKhuselo weSizwe waseMzantsi Afrika (i-SANDF), uMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kuba lelona gosa lisebenzayo kuSuku loMbhiyozo loMkhosi phantsi komxholo othi “Umkhosi wokhuselo weengcali nonesiphiwo okusebenzela abantu baseMzantsi Afrika” ngomhla wama-21 kweyoMdumba wama-2015, ePotchefstroom, eMntla Ntshona.

src: Kopano ya WEF-Aforika e tla neha hape Aforika Borwa monyetla wa tlatsetso wa ho kenella le ho qophella baetapele ba Aforika, dikgwebo tsa matjhabeng le tsa lebatowa mabapi le kgonahalo ya boitshunyako bakeng sa ho kopanya lebatowa le kgolo e ntlafetseng ka hara Aforika Borwa le ka hara lebatowa.6 DithonyoKabinete e tjhalletse monwana dithonyo tse latelang ho ya ka netefatso ya mangolo a lokelang le tumello e amehang:6.1 Katoloso ya konteraka bakeng sa dilemo tse tharo ya Ngaka Mphathi Philemon Mjwara jwaloka Molaodikakaretso: Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji.2 Monghadi Pule Godfrey Selepe jwaloka Molaodikakaretso wa Lefapha la Dipalangwang.3 Moambasatara Nonceba Nancy Losi-Tutu jwaloka Motlatsi wa Molaodikakaretso: Porothokhole ya DIRCO.4 Lekgotla la Maemo a Ditlaleho tsa Ditjhelete:a) Monghadi Suresh Kana (Modulasetulo ,o thontswe hape)b) Mofumahadi Christine Ramon (o thontswe hape)c) Monghadi Johan Brink (o thontswe hape)d) Monghadi Garth Coppin (o thontswe hape)e) Monghadi Bruce Mackenzie (o thontswe hape)f) Monghadi Khaya Dludla (o thontswe hape)g) Monghadi Dumisani Manana (o thontswe hape)h) Mofumahadi Dawn Earp (o thontswe hape)i) Mofumahadi Naidene Ford-Hoon (o thontswe hape)j) Mofumahadi Kim Bromfield (o thontswe hape)k) Moadvokheite Rory Wayne Vollerl) Mofumahadi Matshepo Faith Morem) Mofumahadi Anuradha Sing len) Mofumahadi Tania Wimberley.5 Monghadi Coceko Bambihlelo Johan Pakade jwaloka Mohlanka ya ka Sehloohong wa Phethahatso wa Matsete a Ikemetseng a Ntshetsopele.
tgt: USuku loMkhosi lubhiyozelwa rhoqo ngonyaka ukuhlonela amadoda nabasetyhini abasemkhosini nabazinikele ngokupheleleyo ekukhonzeni isizwe ekhaya nakumazwe aphesheya.3 IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza bonke abaqeshi abathe bathobela uMthetho wobuLungisa kwezeNgqesho (i-EE) ukuba bangenele ukufumana iMbasa yobuLungisa kwezeNgqesho yowama-2015 phambi komhla wokuvala we-13 kweyoKwindla kowama-2015.Lo mbhiyozo uza kusingathwa yiKomishoni yobuLungisa kwezeNgqesho, uwonga abaqeshi abazifezekisileyo iindlela zobuchule eziqinisekisa ubuLungisa kwezeNgqesho kunye nokwahlukahlukana, lo gama bephelisa umkhethe nezenzo zokujongelwa phantsi.4 UMphathiswa wezoKhenketho uDerek Hanekom uza kwenza intetho yokuvula kwindibano yeeNtlanganiso zase-Afrika eza kubanjelwa kwiZiko leeNkomfa laseSandton ukususela kumhla wama-23 ukuya kowama-25 kweyoMdumba kowama-2015 phantsi komxholo othi “Sisonke siqhubela i-Afrika Phambili”.

src: Ho kenngwa Tshebetsong ha Mananeo a Bohlokwa a Mmuso.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweeNkqubo ezinguNdoqo zikaRhulumente.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Tekanyetso ya Naha ya 2015 e tla kganna ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha morero o ntlha di robong tse ileng tsa tekwa ke Moporesidente nakong ya hae ya Puo ya Boemo ba Naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilwamkele uHlahlo lwabiwo-mali leSizwe lowama-2015 oluza kunceda xa kufezekiswa isicwangciso esinamanqaku alithoba ebesithiwe thaca nguMongameli ngethuba esenza iNtetho yakhe engoBume beSizwe (i-SoNA).

src: Tekanyetso ena e fana ka bonnete, botsitso le taolo e hlwahlwa ya ditjhelete tse hlokahalang bakeng sa ho tsamaisa moruo wa Aforika Borwa hara maemo ana a boima a moruo.
tgt: Olu hlahlo lwabiwo-mali lunika ithemba, uzinzo kunye nolawulo lwezezimali olubonakalisa ubulumko nokuhlakanipha olufunekayo ukuze luthantamise uqoqosho loMzantsi Afrika luphumele kwezi meko zigqubayo zinzima zoqoqosho.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa hore mekgwa ya lekgetho e tsebisitsweng Tekanyetsong ya Naha ya 2015 e ya hlokahala bakeng sa ho tshehetsa ditjhelete selemong sena se ka pele ho rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakubethelela kwakhona ukuba amanyathelo ochatha kwirhafu aziswe kuHlahlo lwabiwo-mali leSizwe lowama-2015 ayafuneka ukuncedisa kwizimali zeli kulo nyaka siya kuwo.

src: MaAforika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho sebetsa mmoho le mmuso ho lwantshana le maemo a hajwale a moruo bakeng sa ho susumetsa kgolo ya moruo ho ya pele.2 Kabinete e thoholetsa mosebetsi o kgabane o entsweng ke Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa ka ho thusa ka dikgetho tse lokolohileng le ho hloka leeme ka hara Lesotho mosebetsing wa hae jwaloka Motsamaisi wa Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tse ka Borwa ba Aforika (SADC).
tgt: Abemi boMzantsi Afrika bayakhuthazwa ukuba basebenzisane norhulumente ukulwa ezi meko zikhoyo zezoqoqosho ukuze bancedise ukukhuthaza uhlumo kuqoqosho.2 IKhabhinethi iyawubulela umsebenzi omhle owenziwe nguSekela Mongameli uCyril Ramaphosa ngokuququzelela olunyulo olukhululekileyo nolungenamakhwiniba eLesotho kwindima yakhe njengoMxolelanisi woMbutho wezoPhuhliso lwaMazwe aseMazantsi e-Afrika (i-SADC).

src: Kabinete hape e thoholetsa Lekgotla la Boeletsi la Dikgetho (EAC) la SADC, Khomishene ya Dikgetho ya Lesotho (LEC), Mabotho a Tshireletso le batho ba Lesotho bakeng sa ho tshwara dikgetho tsa kgotso, tse lokolohileng le ho hloka leeme.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iliqhwabela izandla iBhunga labaCebisi bezoloNyulo (i-EAC) be-SADC, iKomishini yoloNyulo yaseLesotho, imiKhosi yezoKhuselo kunye nabantu baseLesotho ngokubamba ulonyulo olunoxolo, olukhululekileyo nolungenamakhwiniba.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla sebetsa le mmuso o motjha o kgethilweng wa Lesotho ho ntshetsapele moruo wa dinaha tsena tse pedi, Lebatowa la Aforika e Borwa le Kontinente ka bophara.3 Kabinete e ananela le ho amohela bonkakarolo ba Aforika Borwa ho tshwayeng ha Letsatsi la Lefatshe la Diphoofolo tse hlaha ka la 3 Hlakubele 2015.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uza kusebenzisana norhulumente osandula ukwanyulwa waseLesotho baphuhlise uqoqosho lwala mazwe mabini, eloMmandla waMazantsi e-Afrika kunye noweli Lizwekazi lonke.

src: Tlasa boetapele ba Letona Molewa Aforika Borwa e tswela pele ho kenya tshebetsong mananeo a tshireletsang tikoloho ya naha le ntwa kgahlanong le botsomi bo seng molaong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazi kwaye iyakwamkela ukuthatha inxaxheba koMzantsi Afrika ekuphawuleni uSuku lweziLwanyana zaseNdle ngomhla wesi-3 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2015.

src: Sa bohlokwa hara tsena ke ho behwa ha Sepolesa sa tsa Tlhaho Boemafofaneng ba Matjhaba ba O. Tambo.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika, ukhokelwa nguMphathiswa uMolewa, uyaqhubeleka usiza neenkqubo ezikhusela okusingqongileyo sisisizwe kunye nedabi lokulwa nokuzingelwa ngaphandle kwemvume.

src: Sena ke ho netefatsa boimatahanyo le Melawana ya Mefuta e Kotsing kapa e Tshireleditsweng ya Diphoofolo, Melawana ya Khonferense ya Mekga bakeng sa Seboka sa Kgwebo ya Matjhaba bakeng sa Dibopuwa tse Kotsing tsa Diphoofolo le Dimela tse Hlaha (CITES), Botsomi naheng, Melawana ya Phumantsho le Karolelano ya Melemo le Melawana ya Mefuta ya Diphoofolo tsa Mekenella.
tgt: Iphulo eliphambili kweli dabi kukubekwa koonogada, beGreen Scorpions, kwisiKhululo seeNqwelo-moya saMazwe ngamazwe i-OR Tambo.

src: Aforika Borwa hape e bapetse karolo ya bohlokwa tshebedisanong le Interpol, haholoholo ho Boto ya Boeletsi ya Boimatahanyo le Tikoloho le Komiti ya Bophethahatsi, mme ka hara dihlopha tse tharo tsa Interpol tsa tshebetso tseo e leng Sehlopha sa Tshebetso sa Botlokotsebe ba Diphoofolo tse Hlaha, sa Botlokotsebe ba Botshwasi ba Ditlhapi le sa Botlokotsebe ba Tshilafatso ya Tikoloho.4 Kabinete e elelletswe hore Durban e entse boiketo ba ho tshwara Dipapadi tsa Matjhaba tsa Commonwealth tsa 2022, bo entsweng semmuso London ka la 2 Hlakubele 2015.
tgt: Sikwenza oku kuba sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuba siyayithobela imiMiselo yeziDalwa eziseMgciphekweni okanye eziKhuselweyo, imiMiselo ye-CITES, ukukhangelwa kwezinto zendalo, imiMiselo yokuFikelela nokwaBelana ngeNzuzo kunye nemiMiselo yeziDalwa eziyiMiduka nezingezozaMveli kulo ndawo.

src: Ho tshwarwa ha dipapadi tsena ho ka tla le bokgoni ba ho hlahisa mesebetsi e ka bang 11 650 le ho Phahamisa moruo wa naha ka tjhelete e akantsweng ho R20 bilione.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika ukwadlale indima ebalulekileyo ngokusebenzisana ne-Interpol, ingakumbi kwiBhodi yabaCebisi beKomiti yokuThobela ezokusiNgqongileyo nokuNyanzelisa ukuthotyelwa komthetho, kwakunye nakumaqela amathathu asebenza ngolwaphulo-mthetho e-Interpol angala: iQela eliSebenza ngoLwaphulo-mthetho kwiziLwanyana zasendle, iQela eliSebenza ngoLwaphulo-mthetho kwezokuLoba kunye neQela eliSebenza ngoLwaphulo-mthetho kwezoNgcoliseko.4 IKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukuba i-Durban iliphakamisile igama layo ukuba ifuna ukusingatha imiDlalo yamaZwe aye saya kuba ngamaThanga yowama-2022, oku ikwenze ngokusesikweni eLondon ngomhla wesi-2 kweyoKwindla kowama-2015.

src: Lefa le leng la Dipapadi e tla ba mokgwa wa dipalangwang tsa setjhaba o hokahantsweng bakeng sa Durban moo merero ya teng e seng e tjhaelletswe monwana.
tgt: Ukusingatha le midlalo kungadala imisebenzi emalunga nama-11 650 kuxume uqoqosho ngemali eqikelelwa kwibhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama-20.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Leano la Sehlomathiso sa ho Fetolwa ha Mokgwa wa Kgaso ka ho kenyeletswa ha mokgwa wa taolo ho Mabokose a kengwang Hodimo a Thelevishene (STB), o tla hlaloswa ka ho hlaka ha leano le se le phatlaladitswe.
tgt: Okunye okuza kuzuzwa ngokusingatha le miDlalo kukuphucuka kweendlela nezithuthi zikawonke-wonke eDurban, ezicwangciso sazo esele zivunyiwe.

src: Mmuso o tla fana ka STB mahala ho beng ba malapa a futsanehileng a fetang dimilione tse hlano.
tgt: Izigqibo zeKhabinethi ezingundoqo.1 IKhabhinethi iwuvumile uMgaqo-nkqubo oHlonyelweyo wokuTshintshela kuHlobo lokuSasaza lweDijithali ngokuqukwa kweeBhokisana ezineziTishi zikaMabonakude (ii-STB), eziza kucaciswa kakuhle xa lo mgaqo-nkqubo upapashwa.

src: Ho tla shejwa pele malapa a phelang dibakeng tsa mabatowa a meeding ya naha.
tgt: URhulumente uzakunika amakhaya anomabonakude angaphezulu kwezigidi ezihlanu angathathi ntweni ii-STB simahla.

src: Letona la Dikgokahanyo le tla tsebisa ka letsatsi la ho bulwa ha letshwao la dijithale le la ho kwalwa ha mokgwa wa Analoko haufinyane.2 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana morero wa dilemo tse hlano wa lewa la moralo wa Temo, Meru le Botshwasi ba Ditlhapi le Leano la Moralo wa Tshebetso wa Temo.
tgt: Amakhaya ekuza kuqalwa ngawo ngalawo akwimimandla emelene nemida yeli.

src: Moralo o teka diphephetso tsa bohlokwa tse tobilweng ke makala a mararo le ho sisinya boitshunyako dibakeng tse nne e leng Tekatekano le diphethoho kgolo e lekalekanang le phehisano, paballo ya tikoloho le taolo.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezoNxibelelwano uza kwazisa kungekudala umhla wokuqalisa ukusebenza kohlobo losasazo lwedijithali kunye nowokucinywa kohlobo losasazo lwe-analogue.2 IKhabhinethi iyivumile iNkqubo-sikhokelo eQiqisiweyo yezoLimo, ezamaHlathi nezokuLoba yeminyaka emihlanu kunye nesiCwangciso sokuSebenza soMgaqo-nkqubo wezoLimo.

src: Leha lenaneo la kahobotjha le ntshetsopele le tekile hore sepheo se seholo sa karolelano ya naha e ne e le ho fetola sebopeho sa Temo ya Aforika Borwa, hape e batla ho tshehetsa makala hore ho hodiswe moruo le ho hlahisa mesebetsi.3 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana bakeng sa Seboka sa Lefatshe sa Dipetlele sa bo40 sa Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Dipetlele se tla tshwarelwa Durban ho ya mafelong a 2016.
tgt: Le Nkqubo-sikhokelo icacisa iingxaki ezine la macandelo mathathu ajamelene nazo kwaye iphakamisa namanyathelo okungenelela kwimimandla emine, eyile: uLingwano, iinguqu, uhlumo olulinganayo kunye nokukwazi ukumelana nokhuphiswano, uzinzo kokusingqongileyo kunye nolawulo.

src: Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Dipetlele ke mokgatlo wa lefatshe o ikemetseng, o sa etseng phaello, oo e seng wa mmuso bakeng sa dipetlele le mokgatlo wa tlhokomelo ya kalafo.
tgt: Le nkqubo-sikhokelo kunye nesicwangciso sokusebenza ziza kuhlaziywa rhoqo ngonyaka.

src: Seboka sa selemo ka seng se neha basebeletsi ba kalafo monyetla wa ho arolelana mekgwa ya tshebetso ya dikatamelo tse hlwahlwa ka ho fetisisa tsa ho ntlafatsa diphetho tsa tlhokomelo ya kalafo.4 Kabinete e etsa boipiletso ho batswadi ho itahlela ka setotswana ho Dikgetho tsa Makgotlataolo a Dikolo (di-SGB) tsa 2015 tse tla tshwarwa dikolong tsohle tsa setjhaba ho tloha ka la 6 ho ya ho la 28 Hlakubele 2015.
tgt: Ukwabiwa komhlaba yenye yeenkqubo zikarhulumente ekhuthaza ulingwano, kodwa uza kuthi ga ngoku ayiqhubi kakuhle kumbandela wokuzisa iinguqu.

src: Di-SGB di nehela ntshetsopeleng ya maikutlo a matla a ho ba beng ba dikolo tsa rona.
tgt: Nangona inkqubo yophuhliso nokwakhiwa ngokutsha yathi injongo yokubuyekezwa komhlaba yayikukutshintsha indlela icandelo lezoLimo loMzantsi Afrika elime ngayo, ikwafuna nokuxhasa amacandelo ukuze akhulise uqoqosho adale nemisebenzi.3 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukuba iNkongolo yama-40 yeziBhedlele zeHlabathi yoMfelandawonye weziBhedlele zeHlabathi isingathelwe eDurban ekupheleni kowama-2016.

src: Tshebetso ya dikolo ka kakaretso ho kenyeletswa le ho sebetsa hantle dithutong ho a ntlafala ha batswadi ba itahletse ka setotswana le ho ba le kgahleho mererong ya sekolo.
tgt: UMfelandawonye weziBhedlele zeHlabathi ngumbutho wehlabathi oquka imibutho yoonompilo neyezibhedlela, ozimeleyo, ongenzi nzuzo nongekho phantsi kukarhulumente.

src: Ditho tsa SGB tse fetang 250 000 di kgethwa dilemong tse ding le tse ding tse tharo ho sebetsa dikolong tsa rona tsa setjhaba di kopane ka morero o tshwanang, ho etsa thuto ntlha ya mannete ya setjhaba.
tgt: Le nkongolo ibanjwa rhoqo minyaka le inika abo basebenze kwicandelo lezempilo ithuba lokuba babelane ngeendlela ezikumgangatho ophezulu zokusebenza ukuphucula iziphumo zezeenkonzo zempilo.4 IKhabhinethi imemelela abazali ukuba bathathe inxaxheba kulo nyulo lowama-2015 lweQumrhu eliLawula isiKolo (i-SGB) oluza kuqhutywa kuzo zonke izikolo zikarhulumente ukusuka ngomhla wesi-6 ukuya kowesi-8 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2015.

src: Dihlomathiso di arabela ho dikahlolo tsa makgotla a dinyewe, tse behileng hore dikarolo tse itseng tsa Molao di kgahlanong le Molao wa Motheo.
tgt: Ii-SGB zinceda ukuba abantu ekuhlaleni bazive ukuba isikolo nabo sesabo.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Bana, 2015 (karolo 75 ya Bili) – Dihlomathiso di shebana le tlhaloso ya “tlolo ya molao wa motabo” le ho imatahanya le Molao wa Botlokotsebe (ditlolo tsa molao wa motabo le mabaka a tsamaelanang) ya sehlomathiso sa Molao wa 32 wa 2007.
tgt: Indlela eziqhuba ngayo izikolo ingakumbi ezifundweni iyathanda ukubonakalisa ukuphucuka xa abazali bethatha inxaxheba kangangoko kwaye bezikhathaze ngemiba yesikolo.

src: Dihlomathiso hape di sebetsana le ho dumella batlodi ba molao ba bana ho etsa ditlhahiso pele mabitso a bona a kenyeletswa ho Rejisetara ya Naha ya Tshireletso.
tgt: Amalungu e-SGB angaphezulu kwama-250 000 akhethwa rhoqo emva kweminyaka emithathu ukuze asebenzele izikolo zikarhulumente edityaniswa yinto enye, ukwenza imfundo ibe ngumba wokuhlala ngokwenene.

src: Dihlomathiso tse sisintsweng hape di hlakisa tlhoko ya ho beha ngwana tlhokomelong le ho fana ka mekgahlelo ya tlatsetso bakeng sa bana ba ka nkuwang ke batswadi bao e seng ba bona ka madi.
tgt: ImiThetho esaYilwayo.1 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa kwemiThetho esaYilwayo emibini ePalamente, yomibini ilungisa uMthetho wezaBantwana, wama-2005 (uMthetho uNombolo 38 wama-2005) njengoko ulungiswe nguMthetho wama-41 wama-2007.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya bobedi ya Bana, 2015 (karolo 76 ya Bili) – se rerile ho netefatsa hore bana bohle ba fumana ditshebeletso le melemo e reretsweng ho thusa ka phumantsho ya tlhokomelo ya kahisano le tshireletso le ho bopa mokgwa wa thekolohelo ya kahisano o hlwahlwa.
tgt: Ezi zilungiso zisusela kwizigwebo zenkundla, ezigwebe ukuba amacandelo athile alo Mthetho awahambelani nomgaqo-siseko.

src: Hape e batla ho fana ka tikoloho e bolokehileng le e tshireletsehileng bakeng sa ho falliswa ha bana bao ho fumanehang hore ba hloka tlhokomelo le tshireletso.
tgt: Ezi zilungiso zikwacacisa nomba wokuvumela abo benze imikhuba yolwaphulo-mthetho olujoliswe ebantwaneni ukuba ukuba baze kuzingxengxezela phambi kokuba amagama wabo afakwe kuLuhlu Lwabo Baxhaphaze Abantwana.

src: Maemo a Kabinete Mabapi le Dintlha tsa Hajwale.
tgt: Ezi zilungiso ziphakanyisiweyo zikwacacisa nezinto ezifunekayo ukuze umntwana asiwe kwiziko logcino-bantwana kwaye zongeze nezinye iindidi zabantwana abanokuthathwa bakhuliswe ngabanye abazali abangebabo.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe ka matla, ho nyenyelepa ha ditokomane tse ka behang tshireletso ya naha tsietsing.
tgt: UMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo weSibini, wama-2015 (uMthetho osaYilwayo wecandelo lama-76) – ufuna ukuqinisekisa ukuba bonke abantwana bayazixhamla iinkonzo namanye amaqithi-qithi alungiselelwe ukubenza ukuba bakwazi ukufumana iinkonzo zezentlalo-ntle nokuba bakhuseleke kunye nokudala inkqubo yezentlalo-ntle esebenzayo.

src: Leha e le tshebetso ya matjhaba e tlwaelehileng bakeng sa dinaha ho arolelana mautlwela, hara tse ding, dintlha tse paroletsang tse amanang le menyetla ya moruo le mabaka a tshireletso, ho nyenyelepa ho bolelwang ha ditokomane tse hlahisang ditshebetso tsa Lekala la Tshireletso ya Puso ha ho molaong.
tgt: Iinjongo zayo ikwakukubonelela ngeendawo ekhuselekileyo yokugcinwa kwabantwana abangenabani abafuna ukukhathelelwa nokukhuselwa.

src: Kabinete e ananela dipatlisiso ka botlalo tsa Lekala la Tshireletso ya Puso tabeng ena le ho netefaletsa maAforika Borwa hore Lekala la Tshireletso ya Puso le tla tswela pele ho tsepamisa maikutlo thomong ya lona ya ho tshireletsa le ho baballa seriti sa naha, baahi ba yona le dikaho tsa motheo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugxeka kabukhali ukukhutshwa ngokungekho mthethweni kwamaxwebhu anokubeka ukhuseleko leli lizwe emngciphekweni.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa molaetsa wa Letona la Tshireletso ya Puso, Letona David Mahlobo, hore boitshwaro bo jwalo bo nyenyefatsa bohlwahlwa ba tshebetso ba mosebetsi wa ho baballa naha le meedi ya yona.
tgt: Nangona nje inguqhelekileyo kwihlabathi ukuba amazwe abelana ngolwazi lobuntlola, kwimiba ewachapahzela ngokufana ingakumbi enxulumene namathuba ezoqoqosho nokhuseleko, phakathi kweminye, kodwa oku kukhutshwa kwamaxwebhu aneenkcukacha ngemisebenzi ye-Arhente yoKhuseleko lweLizwe ngaphandle kokugunyaziswa akukho mthethweni.

src: Kabinete e ananela tsebiso ya Eskom ya hore Yuniti ya bo 6 ya Seteishene sa Motlakase sa Medupi e qadile ho hlahisa motlakase wa yona wa pele bekeng ena, ho e etsa ya pele ya diyuniti tsa yona tse tshelela hore e kenngwe tshebetsong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalwamkela uphando olugcweleyo oluqhutywa yi-Arhente yoKhuseleko lweLizwe ngalo mba kwaye iyabaqinisekisa abemi beli ukuba i-Arhente yoKhuseleko lweLizwe iza kuqhubeka nomsebenzi wayo wokukhusela igama, abemi kunye nezisiseko zophuhliso zeli lizwe.

src: Ho kenngwa tshebetsong ke tsela eo ka yona sefehlamatla se hokelwang ka motlakase ho marangrang a naha a motlakase.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawuphinda umyalezo woMphathiswa woKhuseleko lweLizwe, uDavid Mahlobo, othi oku kuphazamisana nomsebenzi wokukhusela eli lizwe kunye nemida yalo.2 IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isibhengezo esenziwe ngu-Eskom sokuba uYunithi 6 weZiko lokuPhehla uMbane, iMedupi, livelise umbane okokuqala kule veki, into eyenze ukuba ibe yiyunithi yokuqala ukusebenza kweli Ziko.

src: Ha re ntse re tswela pele ho sebeletsa tabeng ya ho eketswa ha phepelo ya motlakase ho marangrang a naha, Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho setjhaba ho tswela pele ho imatahanya le mekgwa ya ho baballa eneji.
tgt: Oku kuthetha ukuba ngoku idityanisiwe kuthungelwano lombane lesizwe.

src: Badudi ba kgothaletswa ho boloka motlakase, ha re tswella ho hlahisa mehlodi e meng ya eneji.3 Kabinete e thoholetsa sebete, boitlamo, boitelo le mosebetsi o matla wa banna le basadi ba sebetsang ka thata ho pholosa bophelo le ho thibela tshenyo ya thepa, mehlape le tikoloho ya tlhaho tse neng di kupeditswe ke mello e hlaha ho la Motse Kapa.
tgt: Nangona siqhubeka sisebenzela ukunyusa umthamo wombane esinawo sisisizwe, iKhabhinethi iyalucela uluntu ukuba luqhubeleke lusebenzisa umbane ngobunono.

src: Kabinete e hlahisa teboho ya yona ho badudi ka moya wa Botho, ka kopanelo le mmuso ka ho theha ditsha tsa tlhokomelo ya bongata ho thusa ba lahlehetsweng ke bodulo.
tgt: Uluntu luyakhuthazwa ukuba lungasebenzisi umbane kakhulu ngoku sisaqhuba sizama ukuqalisa eminye imithombo yamandla.3 IKhabhinethi ibamba ngazibini ‘kumaqobo namaqobokazana’ asebenze nzima ngokuzilahlela nokuzinikela esindisa abantu, ethintela umonakalo empahleni, kwimfuyo nakwindalo ecwengileyo ibihlaselwe ngumlilo wamadlelo eKapa.

src: Moya wa boithaopi o bontshitsweng ke batho ba neng ba thusa diphofu tsa mello ke o moholo le o kgothatsang.4 Kabinete e dula e ngongorehile ka ditlhaselo tsa melata mme e hlokomedisa hore makala a kgatello ya molao a tla tswela pele ho iponahatsa ka bongata dibakeng tse amehang, mme batlodi ba molao ba tla kopana le letsoho le matla la molao.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibulela ngokungazenzisiyo kuluntu ngokubonakalisa ubuntu, besebenzisana norhulumente ukuvula amaziko amakhulu okugcina abo baphulukene namakhaya abo kungoku nje bangcucalazayo ngenxa yalo mlilo.

src: Dikgoka kgahlanong le melata di shebuwe ka leihlo le ntjhotjho le ho sebetswa ka dibopeho tse fapaneng tse teng tsa Mmuso.5 Kabinete e thoholetsa Sehlopha sa bolo sa Aforika Borwa sa ba ka Tlasa Dilemo tse 17 (U17), Amajimbos, bakeng sa ho etsa naha motlotlo ka ho atleha ho kenela makgaolakgang a 2015 a Bompodi ba Aforika ba U17 Niamey, ho la Niger.
tgt: Umoya omhle wokufuna ukuncedisa nokufaka isandla ngokuzithandela oboniswe ngabantu abebenceda amaxhoba alo mlilo ukhuthaza ngenene.4 IKhabhinethi isaxhalabile ngeziganeko zokuhlaselwa kwabemi bamazwe angaphandle kwaye ithembisa ukuba ii-arhente zogcino-mthetho ziza kuqhubeka ngokuyibeka phantsi kweliso le mimandla ichaphazelekileyo, kwaye ityityimbisela umnwe abo baphula umthetho ibalumkisa ukuba baza kujongana nengalo yomthetho.

src: Mosebetsi wa bona o babatsehang ho Bompodi ba Batjha ba Aforika o ba dumella ho kenela Mohope wa Lefatshe wa FIFA wa U17 ho la Chile hamorao selemong sena.6 Kabinete e utlwisitswe bohloko ke ho hlokahala ha mohale wa mmino wa Aforika Borwa Zayn Adam, sephoko se hlwahlwa sa sehlopha se matla sa di-70 Pacific Express eo mosebetsi wa hae o nkileng ho feta dilemo tse E ne e le ntho e le nngwe le nalane ya mmino ya Motse Kapa.7 Kabinete e thabile hore, jwaloka letshwao la nnete la mmuso o kgathallang, mokgahlelo wa ho qetela wa ho busetsa masalla oohle a maAforika Borwa a ileng a timela ho putlameng ha ntlo ya baeti eo e leng ya Synagogue Church of All Nation (SCOAN) ho la Lagos o phethetswe.
tgt: Iingxaki yobundlobongela obujoliswe kubemi bamazwe angaphandle inikwa ingqwalasela ngamacandelo kaRhulumente afanelekileyo.5 IKhabhinethi iliqhwabela izandla iqela lebhola loMzantsi Afrika labaneminyaka engaphantsi kwe-17, Amajimbos, ngokuza nodumo kweli lizwe ngokuthi liphumelela ukuya kudlala kumdlalo wamagqibela kankqoyi kwiMidlalo ye-Afrika yowama-2015 yabaneminyaka engaphantsi kwe-17 eNiamey, eNiger.

src: Mehopolo ya rona e na le ba malapa ba lahlehetsweng ke baratuwa ba bona le ba lemetseng mahlomoleng ao.5 Diketsahalo tse tlang.1 Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o tla etsa puo pulong ya Ntlo ya Naha ya Baetapele ba Setso Palamenteng, Motse Kapa ka la 5 Hlakubele 2015 (kajeno).
tgt: Indlela abadlale ngayo kwiMidlalo ye-Afrika yoLutsha ibenze bafumana indawo yokuya kudlala kwimidlalo yeNdebe yeHlabathi i-FIFA U17 eChile emaphelweni alo nyaka.6 IKhabhinethi inxubile kukusweleka kwenye yeengqanga zomculo zoMzantsi Afrika uZayn Adam, imvumi ephambili eyaziwayo yeqela elalidumile kwisithuba seminyaka yowe-1970, i-Pacific Express.

src: Kamano dipakeng tsa mmuso le baetapele ba setso e hlokolosi bakeng sa ho aha metse ya mahae e kganyang, e lekalekanang le ya moshwelella.2 Kabinete e ananela ho kgutla ha bahale ba hlomphehang ba ntwa ya tokoloho J.
tgt: Imbali yezomculo yommandla waseKapa ayinakuphelela igama lakhe lingakhankanywanga.7 IKhabhinethi ichulumance kakhulu, njengorhulumente onenkathalo novelwano, kukuba isigaba sokugqibela sokubuyiswa kwemizimba yabemi boMzantsi Afrika abaphulukana nobomi babo kwindlu yeendwendwe eSynagogue Church of All Nations (i-SCOAN) eLagos siqukunjelwe.

src: Marks le Moses Kotane ho tla Aforika Borwa ho tswa Russia moo ba ileng ba bolokwa dilemo tse 42 tse fetileng.
tgt: Iintliziyo zethu zilila nezo ntsapho zihlakelwe ngabantu bazo kwakunye nabo bathi bonzakela kule ntlekele.

src: Baetapele bana ba neng ba itetse, ba nkuwang e le bontate ba ntwa ya tokoloho le ba kgothaditseng diqhoku tse kang Nelson Mandela, Oliver Tambo le Walter Sisulu, ba tla fumana mapato a ikgethileng a semmuso.
tgt: Imisitho ezayo.1 UMongameli Jacob Zuma uza kwenza intetho yokuvulwa kweNdlu yeSizwe yeeNkokeli zoMthonyama ePalamente, eKapa ngomhla wesi-5 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2015.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o laetse hore Folakga ya Naha e fofele hare ho tloha ka la 9 Hlakubele ho fihlela bosiung ba la 22 Hlakubele 2015.
tgt: Ubudlelwano phakathi kukarhulumente neenkokeli zomthonyama bubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuba sakha amaphandle alinganayo, angalelanga nazinzileyo.2 IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukubuyiselwa kwamathambo amaqhawe omzabalazo u-JB Marks noMoses Kotane eMzantsi Afrika esuka eRussia apho ayengcwatywelwe khona kwiminyaka engama-42 eyadlulayo.

src: Moses Kotane o tla patwa botjha ho la Pella, Leboya Bophirima ka la 14 Hlakubele 2015 mme J.
tgt: Ezi nkokeli zazizinikele, zithathwa njengeenkokeli zokuqala zomzabalazo wenkululeko weli kwaye zaziwa njengezo zaqeqesha zakhulisa amagqala afana noNelson Mandela, u-Oliver Tambo noWalter Sisulu.

src: Ho kgutla ha bona ke karolo ya boitlamo ba mmuso ba ho kgutlisa masalla oohle a bahale ba hlokafalletseng naheng disele.
tgt: La maqhawe aza kukhatshwa ngemingcwabo ekhethekileyo karhulumente.

src: Selemong se fetileng molwantshi wa kgethollo ya hlomphehang, raditaba Nat Nakasa o ile a busetswa ka katleho ho tswa New York hore a tlo patwa botjha Setsheng sa Bafu sa Bahale Chesterville, Durban.3 Kabinete e ananela letsholo le matla le pharaletseng la ho hlolwa le ho etsa diteko tsa Lefuba (TB) le tla thakgolwa ke Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa ka la 24 Hlakubele 2015 e leng Letsatsi la Lefatshe la TB, Seterekeng sa Ngaka Kenneth Kaunda sa Porofense ya Leboya Bophirima – tlasa mookotaba “Phediso ya lefu la TB Aforika Borwa: Ho akofisa karabelo ya rona Ditjhabeng tse ka Sehloohong”.
tgt: UMongameli Jacob Zuma ucele ukuba iflegi yesizwe ithotywe ukusuka ngomhla wesi-9 kweyoKwindla ukuya ngorhatya lwangomhla wama-22 kweyoKwindla kowama-2015.

src: Letsholo lena la nako e telele le tla susumetsa maAforika Borwa oohle haholoholo ba dulang metseng ya merafo, batshwaruwa ba leng tjhankaneng le ditsing tsa ntshetsopele ya thuto ya pele ya bana hore ba hlolwe le ho etswa diteko bakeng sa TDilemong tse hlano tse fetileng ho entswe mehato e meholo bakeng sa ho matlafatsa mawa a mmuso a taolo ya TB ka ho hlolwa le diteko tse ekeditsweng haholoholo ka Dikeletso tsa Kgothatso tsa HIV le letsholo la Diteko.
tgt: Amathambo kaMoses Kotane aza kungcwatywa kwakhona engcwatyelwa ePella, eMntla Ntshona ngomhla we-14 kweyoKwindla aka-JB Marks wona aza kubekwa eVentersdorp, eMntla Ntshona ngomhla wama-22 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2015.

src: Ho hlolwa le diteko di ile tsa boela tsa phahamiswa ka ho hlahiswa ha diteko tsa popolo tse potlakileng bakeng sa TB le TB e hanang pheko.4 Kabinete e thoholetsa boitelo le boitlamo ba matitjhere a rona, bao ntle le bona re ne re ke keng ra fihlella bongata ba dipheo tsa rona tsa naha.
tgt: Ukubuyiswa kwamathambo abo kuyinxalenye yesibhambathiso sikarhulumente sokubuyisa amathambo awo onke amaqhawe awela kumazwe angaphandle.

src: Dikgetho bakeng sa Dikgau tsa Botitjhere tsa Naha di ananela nehelo e kgethehileng eo matitjhere a e etsang bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya naha ya rona Mokete wa Dikgau o tla tshwarwa ka la 7 Hlakubele 2015 Gallagher Estate, ho la Midrand.
tgt: Kulo nyaka uphelileyo amathambo entatheli eyaziwayo eyayichasene nocalu-calulo uNat Nakasa abuyiswa ngempumelelo esuka eNew York aza kungcwatywa kwakhona eHeroes Acre eChesterville, eDurban.3 IKhabhinethi iyalamkela iphulo elikhulu lokuvavanya nokuhlola isifo sephepha (i-TB) eliza kuphehlelelwa nguSekela Mongamemi uCyril Ramaphosa ngomhla wama-24 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2015, oliSuku lwe-TB lweHlabathi, kwisiThili sase-Dr Kenneth Kaunda kwiPhondo laseMntla-Ntshona – phantsi komxholo othi “Ukuphelisa uBhubhane we-TB eMzantsi Afrika: Ukukhawulezisa indlela esisabela ngayo kuBantu abaseMngciphekweni oMkhulu wokuSuleleka”.

src: Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo le tshwara ketsahalo ena ya selemo ka seng ho isa tlhompho ho matitjhere a itetseng, a itlammeng, a sebetsang ka thata le a seporofeshenale.5 Letona la Metsi le Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere, Letona Nomvula Mokonyane le tla thakgola Beke ya Naha ya Metsi tulong e hlasetsweng ke komello ya KwaDukuza ho la KwaZulu-Natal ka la 16 Hlakubele 2015 tlasa mookotaba: “Ha ho se ka nkelang Metsi Sebaka”.
tgt: Eli phulo liza kuqhuba ubomi bonke likhuthaza bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ingakumbi abo bahlala kwimimandla ekufutshane nemigodi, amabanjwa kumaziko oluleko kunye nabo bakwizikolo-mpeleso baza kuhlolwa bavavanywe i-TKule minyaka mihlanu idlulileyo mde umgama ohanjiweyo ukuqinisa amacebo karhulumente okulawula i-TB ngokunyusa amaphulo okuvavanya nokuhlola ingakumbi iphulo lokuCebisa nokuVavanyela iNtsholongwane kaGawulayo (i-HIV).

src: Letsholo lena le tla ruta maAforika Borwa ka molemo wa metsi le tlhokeho ya ho laola bakeng sa moshwelella wa mohlodi ona o haellang.
tgt: Ukuhlola nokuVavanya kukhuthazwa kakhulu ngokuqaliswa kokuhlolela i-TB okukhawulezayo ne-TB ewalayo amayeza.4 IKhabhinethi ibaqhwabela izandla ootitshala beli abasebenza ngokuzinikela nokuzimisela, nesingenakukwazi ukuzifezekisa iinjongo zesizwe ngaphandle koncedo lwabo.

src: Kabinete e hopotsa maAforika Borwa oohle hore re phela naheng eo ho yona metsi a haellang le ho kgothaletsa bohle ho a boloka, ka ho lokisa ho dutla hwa dipeipi le ho phela ka ho hlalefela metsi.6 Sontaha, 8 Hlakubele, e tshwaya Letsatsi la Matjhaba la Basadi (IWD) e leng letsatsi le sebediswang selemo ka seng lefatshe ka bophara ho shebela morao kgatelongpele e entsweng, kgoeletso bakeng sa diphethoho le ho keteka diketso tsa sebete le maikemisetso ke basadi ba tlwaelehileng ba bapetseng karolo e kgolohadi nalaneng ya metse ya bona le dinaha tsa bona.
tgt: Ukukhethwa kwamagama abo baza kuba sethubeni lokufumana iiMbasa zeSizwe zokuFundisa kuhlonipha umsebenzi ogqwesileyo owenziwa ngootitshala kuphuhliso lweli lizwe umsitho wezi Mbasa uza kubanjwa ngomhla wesi-7 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2015 ubanjelwa eGallagher Estate, eMidrand.

src: Lefapha la Basadi le tla etella pele mekete ya IWD Sekolong se Phahameng sa Langa ho la Motse Kapa tlasa mookotaba, “Ditokelo tsa Basadi ke Ditokelo tsa Botho: Mmoho re Ntshetsa Aforika Borwa e hlokang Dikgoka pele”.
tgt: ISebe leMfundo esiSiseko lilo elisingatha lo msitho waminyaka le wokuhlonipha ootitshala abasebenza nzima ngokuzinikela, ngokuzimisela nangobuchule.5 UMphathiswa wezaManzi noGutyulo uNomvula Mokonyane uza kuphehlelela iVeki yeSizwe yaManzi kummandla othwaxwa yimbalela waKwaDukuza KwaZulu-Natal ngomhla we-16 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2015 phantsi komxholo othi: “Akukho Nto Inokuthatha Indawo Yamanzi”.

src: Mookotaba ona o imatahantse le mookotaba wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng wa: “Tekatekano bakeng sa Basadi ke tswelopele ya bohle!” le pehelo ya Kopano ya Aforika ya selemo sa 2015 e leng “Selemo sa Matlafatso ya Basadi le Ntshetsopele ho ya ho Lenanetsamaiso la Aforika la 2063”.
tgt: Le veki ibekelwe bucala sisizwe iza kuqukunjelwa ngoSuku lwaManzi lweHlabathi ngomhla wama-22 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2015.

src: Letsatsi lena le tla sebediswa ho thakgola lenaneo la Naha le la Diporofense la dipuisano le tla qala ho tloha kgweding ena ho fihlela ka Phuptjane.
tgt: Eli phulo liza kufundisa abemi boMzantsi Afrika ngokubaluleka kwamanzi nokuba kufuneka asetyenziswe ngobunono nobulumko kuba anqongophele.

src: Ho hlokahala ha Letona Ohm Collins Chabane.
tgt: Ukusweleka koMphathiswa u-Ohm Collins Chabane.

src: Kabinete e utlwisitswe bohloko ke ho hlokahala ka tshohanyetso ha Letona Chabane le batshireletsi ba hae, Bosajene Lesiba Samuel Sekele le Mareme Lawrence Lentsoane, ba hlokahetseng kotsing e sisimosang ya koloi ka Sontaha,sa 15 Hlakubele 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibuhlungu kakhulu ngokusweleka koMphathiswa uChabane ngesiquphe nabakhuseli bakhe, uSajini Lesiba Samuel Sekele noSajini Mareme Lawrence Letsoane, abathe basweleka kwingozi yemoto emasikizi ngeCawa, umhla we-15 kweyoKwindla yowama-2015.

src: Mmuso le batho ba Aforika Borwa ba tla hopola ka ho sarelwa nyehelo e entsweng ke mohlanka enwa wa setjhaba eo esale a itetse bakeng sa ho aha Aforika Borwa e betere ho isa lefung.
tgt: Urhulumente nabantu boMzantsi Afrika bayakuhlala belikhumbula igalelo lalo mkhonzi woluntu nothe wazinikela ekwakheni uMzantsi Afrika ongcono kwada kwangumhla wakhe wokugqibela.

src: Jwaloka setho saKabinete, mofu Letona la Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba le Tsamaiso o tla nehwa Lepato la Semmuso la Mokgahlelo wa Tshebeletso ya lepato e tla ba ka Moqebelo wa la 21 Hlakubele 2015 motsaneng wa Xikundu Malamulele, ho la Limpopo.
tgt: Njengelungu leKhabhinethi, ongasekhoyo uMphathiswa wezabaSebenzi bakaRhulumente noLawulo uzakuwongwa ngoMgcwabo oseSikweni woDidi loku-1.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o tla etella pele mekete ya sehopotso sabo-50 sa diphuputso tsa Aforika Borwa tsa rieketara yaSAFARI-1 e sebetswang ke Bolaodi ba Naha ba Eneji ba Aforika Borwa (NERSA) Pelindaba haufi le Pretoria.
tgt: Inkonzo yomngcwabo iza kuqhutywa ngoMgqibelo umhla wama-21 kweyoKwindla yowama-2015 kwilali iXikundu eMalamulele, eLimpopo.

src: Esale ho tloha ka ho thehwa ha yona ka la 18 Hlakubele 1965, rieketara ena, e leng mohlahisi e moholo wa diasothoupo tsa kalafo le tsa indaseteri bakeng sa tshebediso ka hara naha le matjhabeng, e fumane ditlatse tse ngata le ho ananelwa le ke matjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa ngovelwano olunzulu kwiintsapho, izihlobo nezalamane zongasekhoyo uMphathiswa nezabakhuseli bakhe ababini.

src: Mosebetsi wa Khomishene e ntjha e tla ba wa ho eletsa mmuso ka mokgwa o hlwahlwa ka ho fetisisa wa ho kenya tshebetsong Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ezingundoqo.

src: Hodima moo e tla boela e thusa ka ho ntshetsapele meralo e tebileng makaleng a kgethilweng a hlokang tsepamiso e matla ya maikutlo bakeng sa ho susumetsa kgolo ya moruo, phethoho e matla moruong le ntshetsopele ya moshwelella.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uzakuba ekhokela imibhiyozo yesikhumbuzo seminyaka engama-50 yenjini yophando lwenyukliya yaseMzantsi Afrika i-SAFARI-1 nesetyenziswa nguMlawuli wezaMandla weSizwe waseMzantsi Afrika (i-NERSA) ePelindaba kufutshane nePitoli.

src: Tlhahisoleseding e tomanyana mabapi le tsamaiso ya ho kgetha e fumaneha ho: www.
tgt: Ukususela ekugunyazisweni kwayo ngomhla we-18 kweyoKwindla yowe-1965, le njini, nengowona mvelisi uyintloko wamasuntswana wamachiza (i-isotopes) ezonyango nawemizi-mveliso asetyenziswa apha ekhaya nakumazwe angaphesheya, ifumene ukunconywa okuninzi nokuqinisekiswa ngamazwe ngamazwe.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa Palamenteng ha Dihlomathiso ho Molao wa Roma wa Lekgotla la Dinyewe la Matjhaba bakeng sa kamohelo.
tgt: Le khomishoni intsha iza kugxila ekucebiseni urhulumente ukuba angasiphumeza njani ngcono isiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe (i-NDP).

src: Dihlomathiso di kenyeletsa tlhaloso ya ditlolo tsa molao tsa dikgoka le diketsahalo tsa tlatsetso tse amanang le ditlolo tsa molao tsa dintwa ho Molao wa Roma o ileng wa amohelwa ke Kopano ya Mekga ya Dipuso (Kampala, ho la Uganda ka la 11 Phuptjane 2010).Kamohelo ya dihlomathiso tsena ho Molao wa Roma ke Aforika Borwa ho bontsha boitlamo ba mmuso ho lwantsha ditlolo tsa molao tse matla kgahlanong le batho le tlolo ya molao ya dikgoka e entsweng ka hare kapa ka ntle ho naha ya rona.
tgt: Ukongeza apho iza kuncedisa nasekuphuhliseni isicwangciso ezineenkcukhacha kumacandelo akhethekileyo adinga ingqwalasela emandla ukuze akwazi ukuqhuba uhlumo lwezoqoqosho, inguqu emandla yezoqoqosho nophuhliso olufanelekileyo.

src: Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le Dintlha tsa Hajwale.
tgt: Iinkcukhacha ezithe vetshe malunga nenkqubo yokuchonga ziyafumaneka kwa: www.

src: Diphethoho tse sisintsweng di hlahlojwa pele ke Boto ya Tsheho ya Meedi ya Bomasepala (MDB), e laetsweng ho beha meedi ya bomasepala ho ya ka Molao wa Tsheho ya Meedi wa 1998 (Molao 27 wa 1998) wa Bomasepala ba Mebuso ya Lehae le Molaotheowa Riphaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa 1996.Jwaloka mokgatlo o ikemetseng, ditsamaiso tsa MDB di a bonaletsa le ho kenyeletsa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuphumezile ukungeniswa kweziHlomelo zoMthetho waseRome weNkundla yamaTyala yeHlabathi (i-ICC) ePalamente ukuze zamkelwe.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe tshebediso ya mehwanto ya boipelaetso e tletseng dikgoka jwaloka mokgwa wa ho rarolla mathata a tsheho ya meedi.
tgt: Ukwamkelwa kwezi zihlomelo kuMthetho waseRome nguMzantsi Afrika kubonakalisa ukuzinikela kukarhulumente ekulweni ulwaphulo-mthetho oluxhomisa amehlo olubonakalisa intswela-buntu nolwaphulo-mthetho lokuhlasela xa luthe lwenziwa ngaphakathi elizweni lethu nangaphandle kwelizwe lethu.

src: Mosebetsi waMDB ke karolo ya mmuso ya katamelo ya Ho Boela ho tsa Motheo ho netefatsa phano ya ditshebeletso e betere ho badudi.
tgt: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba egqubayo.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Basotho ka phethisetso e bobebe ya puso mme e ba kgothaleditse ho sebetsa mmoho bakeng sa kgotso ya moshwelella le ntshetsopele ya moruo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele imiphumela yomjikelo wakutsha nje wocando-mida olusacetywayo kwaye iyavuma ukuba iingxoxo-mpikiswano ezidlamkileyo ziyinto ebaluleke kakhulu kulawulo lwethu lwentando yesininzi.

src: Kabinete hape e thoholeditse Tonakgolo e ntjha ya Mmuso wa Borena ba Lesotho, Mohlomphehi PakalithaMosisili ka ho kgethwa le tlhomamiso e atlehileng e etsahetseng ka Labobedi la 17 Hlakubele 2015, e neng e kenetswe ke Mohlomphehi Moporesidente Jacob Zuma le Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa.
tgt: Ngenxa yokuba kukho oomasipala abasokolayo ukunikezela iinkonzo kwaye bahlala bengakwazi ukuzenzela nto ngenxa yokungabi namali yaneleyo nokungabikho kolawulo olufanelekileyo, lo nto yenza ukuba imida yoomasipala isoloko iqwalaselwa ngokutsha.

src: Kabinete e thoholeditse Motlatsiwa Moporesidente ka karolo eo a e bapetseng ho iseng ho dikgetho tse atlehileng tsa Borena ba Lesotho.
tgt: Iinguqu ezicetywayo ziqala ziphicothwe yiBhodi yoCando-mida yooMasipala (i-MDB), ethwaliswe uxanduva lokumisela imida yoomasipala ngokuhambelana noMthetho woCando-mida wooMasipala, we-1998 (uMthetho 27 we-1998): wooRhulumente baseKhaya noMgaqo-siseko weRhiphabliki yoMzantsi Afrika we-1996.Njengebhodi ezimeleyo, iinkqubo ze-MDB ziselubala kwaye ziyaziqwalasela iingcebiso.

src: O tswetse pele ho ananela karolo e bapetsweng ke Dinaha tse Tswelang pele tsa Aforika e ka Borwa ka ho thusa ka moralo wa tsela bakeng sa kgotso le dikgetho tsa mmuso o motjha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi, iyalukhuthaza uluntu ukuba luthathe inxaxheba evakalayo kwezi nkqubo.

src: Kabinete e boeleditse boitlamo ba Aforika Borwa ba ho tswela pele ho sebetsa mmoho le Borena ba Lesotho ho ntlafatsa dikamano tse teng ka ho tsepamisa maikutlo ho matlafatseng ha tshebedisanommoho ho tsa moruo le kahisano e tla lebisa ntlafatsong ya bophelo ba batho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakugxeka ukusetyenziswa koqhankqalazo olunobundlongondlongo njengendlela yokusombulula iimbambano zocando-mida.

src: Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Ramaphosa o tla kenela Sehopotso sa bo-25 sa Boipuso ba Riphaboliki ya Namibia, ho kenyeletsa le Tlhomamiso ya Moporesidente Hage Geingob Windhoek ka la 21 Hlakubele 2015.
tgt: Umsebenzi we-MDB yinxalenye ebaluleke kakhulu karhulumente yendlela yokuBuyela kuNdalashe ukuqinisekisa ngonikezelo-nkonzo olungcono kuluntu.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Namibia letsatsing la ho keteka Jubile ya Silivera le Moporesidente Geingob ka ho ba Hlooho ya Puso ya boraro ya naha eo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana nabantu baseLesotho ngenguqu yolawulo engenamagingxigingxi kwaye ibacelile ukuba basebenzisane ukwenzela uxolo lwexesha elide nophuhliso lwezoqoqosho.

src: MoporesidenteZuma o tla amohela Moporesidente wa Zimbabwe Robert Mugabe ho tloha ka la 8 ho ya ho la 9 Mmesa 2015 Pretoria.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwavuyisana neNkulumbuso yelizwe laseLesotho entsha, oHloniphekileyo uPakalitha Mosisili ekonyulweni kwakhe nokubekwa ngokusesikweni okube yimpumelelo okuthe kwaqhubeka ngoLwesibini, umhla we-17 kweyoKwindla yowama-2015, nokuthe kwazinyaswa ngoHloniphekileyo uMongameli uJacob Zuma noSekela Mongameli uCyril Ramaphosa.

src: Leeto lena le tla qetella e le phihlello ya Foramo ya kgwebo ya Aforika Borwa-Zimbabwe e reretsweng mohla la 9 Mmesa 2015, e rerileng ho eketsa kgwebisano ya bobedi bona le matsete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imqhwabela izandla uSekela Mongameli ngendima ayidlalileyo nethe yakhokelela kunyulo olube yimpumelelo kwilizwe laseLesotho.

src: Moporesidente Zuma ka la 19 Mmesa 2015 o tla thakgola dihlooho tsa terene tse 95 Pretoria tse ahilweng e le karolo ya Lenaneo la R300 bilione ya matsete a tjhelete ya dikaho tsa bohlokwa laTransnet ho tsoseletsa dikaho tsa motheo tsa tsamaiso ya dithoto.
tgt: Kwakhona iyayibulela indima edlalwe nguMbutho woPhuhliso lwamazwe asemaZantsi e-Afrika (i-SADC) ngokuququzelela umlima-ndlela woxolo nonyulo lorhulumente omtsha.

src: Nakong ya lenaneo lena la matsetemesebetsi e mengata e tla hlahiswa le dikgwebo tsa lehae di tla una molemo ho tswa ho tshebediso ya mehlodi ya lehae, ntshetsopele ya bokgoni le phetisetso ya thekenoloji.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakuqinisekisa ukuzinikela koMzantsi Afrika ekuqhubekekeni ukusebenzisana nelizwe laseLesotho ukomeleza ngakumbi ubudlelwane obukhoyo ngokugxila ekomelezeni intsebenziswano yezoqoqosho neyezentlalo neyakuthi ikhokelele ekuphuculeni ubomi babantu.

src: Ho thakgolwa hona hape ho tshwaya phethoho ya Boenjineri ba Transnet ho ba mohlahisi wa thepa e felletseng ya mantlha kaha tse 85 tsa diterene di hlahisitswe setsheng sa bona se Koedoespoort, haufi le Pretoria.
tgt: USekela Mongameli uRamaphosa uza kuzimasa isiKhumbuzo semiNyaka engama-25 yeNkululeko yeRhiphabliki yaseNamibia, kuquka nomsitho wokuBekwa ngokuseSikweni kukaMongameli uHage Geingob eWindhoek ngomhla wama-2 kweyoKwindla yowama-2015.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla bulaIndaba ya Boraindaseteri ba Batho ba Batsho e tla tshwarwa ho tloha ka la 25 ho ya ka la 26 Hlakubele 2015 Setsing sa Dikopano sa Gallagher, Midrand, jwaloka karolo ya boitlamo ba mmuso ba ho ntshetsa pele boraindaseteri ba batho ba batsho ka hara naha.
tgt: IKhabhineti ivuyisana neNamibia ngemisitho yayo yokuBhiyozela isiKhumbuzo semiNyaka engama-25 noMongameli Geingbo ngokuba ethe waba nguMongameli wesithathu wela lizwe.

src: Indaba e tla fohla dipuisano pakeng tsa lekala la setjhaba le la poraefete ho ntshetsa pele boraindaseteri ba batho ba batsho, le ho fetola ka matla le ho bopa botjha moruo ho fihlella kgolo e kenyeletsang.
tgt: Ukususela ngomhla we-8 ukuya kowe-9 kuTshazimpunzi wama-2015 uMongameli uZuma uza kusindleka uMongameli uRobert Mugabe waseZimbabwe ePitoli.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla etsa puo ho Kopano ya Ditho tsa Naha (NMA) ya Mokgatlo wa Aforika Borwa wa Mebuso ya Lehae, e tla tshwarelwa Setsing sa Dikopano sa Gallagher, Midrand ho tloha ka la 24 ho ya ka la 26 Hlakubele 2015.
tgt: Olu tyelelo luza kuqukunjelwa ngokusekwa kweQonga lezoShishino loMzantsi Afrika neZimbabwe olumiselwe umhla we-9 kuTshazimpunzi wama-2015, olujoliswe ekwandiseni uthethathethwano lwezorhwebo noshishino phakathi kwala mazwe mabini.

src: NMA e tla lekola maemo a mebuso ya lehae kamora dilemo tse 15 le ho tshohla mawa a ho sebetsa ka bokgabane le phano ya ditshebeletso, kaho ya bokgoni, bobodu le dintlha tse mabapi le tsheho ya meedi ya bomasepala.
tgt: Ngomhla we-19 kweyoKwindla yowama-2015 uMongameli uZuma uza kunikezela ngeentloko zikaloliwe ezingama-95 ePitoli ezithe zakhiwa njengenxalenye yenkqubo yotyalo-mali ezibhiliyoni ezingama-300 zeerandi yakwa-Transnet yokuvuselela iziseko ezingundoqo zezothutho kweli lizwe.

src: Kopano e tla tshwarwa tlasa mookotaba: “Dilemotse15 tsa Mebuso ya Lehae ya Demokerasi – Re matlafatsa le ho Kenyeletsa Demokerasi ya Lehae e shebileng batho ya Ntshetsopele e Kganyang”.
tgt: Ngeli xesha lale nkqubo yotyalo-mali kuza kudalwa imisebenzi emitsha emininzi kwaye amashishini walapha ekhaya asethubeni lokuxhamla ngokusetyenziswa kwemveliso yalapha ekhaya, uphuhliso lwezakhono nokwabelana ngolwazi lwezobuchwephetshe.

src: MaAforika Borwa a tla keteka ketsahalo ya naha ya Letsatsi la Ditokelo tsa Bothoka la 21 Hlakubele 2015 Uitenhage, ho la Kapa Botjhabela tlasa mookotaba: “Re keteka Tjhata ya Tokoloho, Re ThabelaDitokelo tsa Botho tse Lekanang Bakeng sa Bohle”.
tgt: Abaloliwe batsha baza kuhlangabezana nokusilela okukhoyo kwinkqubo yoololiwe yeli lizwe kwaye bazakunceda ukuphucula izinga lemveliso nokusebenza kakuhle kothungelwano lwemizila yethu yoololiwe.

src: Diketsahalo tsena di tla fana ka lepatlelo bakeng sa maAforika Borwa oohle ho hopola ho intsha sehlabelo ho neng ho tsamaelana le ntwa bakeng sa demokerasi le boitelo ba rona ba ho ntshetsapele ditokelo tsa botho jwaloka ha di phuthetswe ka hara Molaotheo.
tgt: Oku kunikezelwa kukwabonakalisa ukuguquka kweCandelo lobuNjineli lakwa-Transnet ukuba libe lelipheleleyo lokuba ngumvelisi wezixhobo zoqobo kuba ama-85 woololiwe aveliswe kwiziko lakhe eliseKoedoespoort, kufutshane nePitoli.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa oohle ho keteka letsatsi lena la bohlokwa ka ho fohla momahano e matla ya kahisano le kaho ya setjhaba.
tgt: Ukususela ngomhla wama-25 ukuya kowama-26 kweyoKwindla yowama-2015 uMongameli uZuma uza kuba evula indibano ebizwa –Indaba yooSomashishini abaMnyama kwiZiko leNgqungquthela iGallagher, eMidrand, njengenxalenye yokuzinikela kukarhulumente ekuphuhliseni oosomashishini abamnyama kweli.

src: Jwaloka karolo ya Kgwedi ya Ditokelo tsa Botho, dipuisano tsa badudi di tla ba teng ho parola le diporofense tsohle ho kgothaletsa kopakopano ka hara badudi ba ditlwaelo tse fapaneng.
tgt: Le Indaba iza kukhuthaza ukubonisana nokufakana imilomo phakathi kukarhulumente namashishini abucala ukuba abaqhubele phambili oosomashishini abamnyama, kunye nokuguqula aseke ngamandla nangokutsha uqoqosho ukuze kuphumelele uhlumo oluxhanyulwa ngumntu wonke.

src: Sena se tla finyella ho Tlaleho ya Naha ya Momahano ya Setjhaba leSeboka sa Bodisa se tla tshwarwa ka la 30 Hlakubele 2015 Port Elizabeth.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uza kube esenza intetho kwiNdlu yeNdibano yamaLungu eSizwe (i-NMA) yoMbutho wooMasipala baseMzantsi Afrika (i-SALGA), nezakubanjelwa kwiZiko leNgqungquthela i-Gallagher , e-Midrand ukususela ngomhla wama-24 ukuya kowama-26 kweyoKwindla yowama-2015.

src: Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhabale tla tshwara Indaba ya Naha ya Mesebetsi ya Kahisanoho tloha ka la 24 ho ya ho la 26 Hlakubele 2015 Setsing sa Matjhaba sa Dikopano ho la Durban tlasa mookotaba: “Re tsoseletsa tsamaiso ya mesebetsi ya kahisano ka hara Aforika Borwa”.Indaba ena e tla hlahisa ditshisinyo le boitshunyako bakeng sa ho tobana le dintlha tse nang le kgahlamelo hodima tsamaiso ya mesebetsi ya kahisano le ho matahanya thomo ya ntshetsopele ya lekala bakeng sa ho tshehetsa phethoho e matla ya mmuso ya moruo wa kahisano.
tgt: I-NMA iza kuqwalasela ubume boorhulumente basekhaya emva kweminyaka eli-15 ize ixoxe ngamacebo okusebenza ngokuvakalayo ngonikezelo-nkonzo, ukuxhotyiswa ngezakhono, urhwaphilizo nemiba emalunga nokucandwa kwemida yoomasipala.

src: Ho fihlella sena, lefapha le fanne ka lenaneo la ho ithuta bakeng sa ho thusa ka ditjhelete baithuti ba ithutang mesebetsi ya kahisano diyunivesithing.
tgt: Le ndibano iza kubanjwa phansti komxholo othi: “ImiNyaka eli-15 yooRhulumente baseKhaya abaphantsi koLawulo lweNtando yesiNinzi – ukuHlanganisa nokuQinisa okuDlamkileyo koLawulo lweNtando yesiNinzi yaseKhaya eGxile eLuntwini nePhuhlisayo”.

src: Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba hape le tla tshwara Khonferense ya bo-2 e Kgahlanong le Boqhekanyetsi le Boboduho tloha ka la 30 ho ya ho la 31 Hlakubele 2015Hoteleng ya St George’s, Centurion tlasa mookotaba: “Re netefatsa ditokelo tsa botho tsa bohle ka tsamaiso e hlokang boqhekanyetsi ditjheleteng tsa dithuso tsa setjhaba”.
tgt: Abemi boMzantsi Afrika baza kubhiyozela umsitho woSuku lwamaLungelo oLuntu lwesizwe ngomhla wama-21 kweyoKwindla yowama-2015 eTinarha, eMpuma Koloni phantsi komxholo othi: “UkuBhiyozela uMqulu weNkululeko, ukuXhamla amaLungelo oLuntu aLinganayo kuMntu Wonke”.

src: Khonferense e tla lekola mekgwa ya hajwale ya ho hlaola bobodu ka hara tsamaiso ya dithuso tsa setjhaba.
tgt: Le misitho iza kunika bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ithuba lokukhumbula bahloniphe ukuzenza idini okwakuhamba nomzabalazo wolawulo lwentando yesininzi nokuzinikela kwethu ukuqhubela phambili amalungelo oluntu njengoko ekhuselwe kuMgaqo-siseko.

src: Sena se tlisa mmoho dihlopha tse kgolo tsa banna tsa Aforika Borwa, Nigeria, Mozambique le Kenya ho seo ho hopolwang hore e tla ba ketsahalo ya selemo ka seng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba babhiyozele olu suku lubalulekileyo ngokukhuthaza kakhulu intsebenziswano phakathi koluntu kunye nokwakhiwa kwesizwe.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa sehlopha sa rona sa kirikete, se tswetseng pele ho ya ho seka-makgaolakgang ka tlholo ya diwikete tse robong kgahlanong le Sri Lanka papading ya bona ya Mohope wa Lefatshe.
tgt: Njengenxalenye yeNyanga yamaLungelo oLuntu, kuza kubakho iintlanganiswano zeengxoxo phakathi koluntu kuwo onke amaphondo ukukhuthaza ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu abaneemvela-phi ezahlukahlukeneyo.

src: Re lakaletsa sehlopha le mokwetlisi mahlohonolo ha ba ntse ba tswela pele ka thonamente.
tgt: Oku kuza kuqukunjelwa ngeMbizo yokuHlola nokuFaka iNgxelo ngeNtsebenziswano phakathi koLuntu eza kubanjwa ngomhla wama-30 kweyoKwindla yowama-2015 eBhayi.

src: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di tla lokela ke ho netefatswa ha mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang.
tgt: Ukususela ngomhla wama-24 ukuya kowama-26 kweyoKwindla yowama-2015 iSebe loPhuhliso loLuntu liza kusingatha Indaba yezeNontlalo-ntle yeSizwe kwiZiko leNgqungquthela yeZizwe-ngezizwe yaseDurban phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukuvuselelwa komsebenzi wezentlalo-ntle eMzantsi Afrika”.Le Indaba iza kuza neziphakamiso namanyathelo okuhlangabezana nemiba enempembelelo kumsebenzi wezentlalo-ntle nokwenza ukuba isigunyaziso sezophuhliso solu bizo sixhase inguqu emandla yezentlalo noqoqosho karhulumente.

src: Makgotla a Dinyewe tsa Metsi:a. Moatefokate TintswaloAnnah Nana Makhubele (Modulasetulo)b. Mofumahadi Lindelwa Mbanjwa (Motlatsi wa Modulasetulo)c. Monghadi Pumezo Malik Mpumelelo Jonasd.
tgt: Ukufezekisa oku, eli sebe lisungule inkqubo yokuxhasa ukunceda abafundi basezidyunivesithi abenza izifundo zokuba ngoonontlalo-ntle.
