src: 1.Letoto la ditlhaselo tsa moraorao tjena tsa Melata.1 Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe ka matla diketso tsa merusu ya moraorao tjena kgahlanong le melata.
tgt: Uhlaselo lakutsha nje lwabemi bamazwe angaphandle.1 IKhabhinethi izigxeka kabukhali izenzo zobundlobongela ezijoliswe kubemi bamazwe angaphandle.

src: Ha jwale, Kabinete e rata ho fetisa matshediso a yona a tebileng ho malapa a bohle ba lahlehetsweng ke bophelo le pholo e potlakileng ho ba lemetseng.
tgt: Xa kulapha, iKhabhinethi ivakalisa uvelwano olunzulu kwiintsapho zabo baphulukene nobomi babo, yaye inqwenela ukuba abo benzakeleyo bachache msinya.

src: Ha ho boholo ba ho teneha le ho kgena bo ka dumellang ditlhaselo tsena le kgapo ya thepa ka mahahapa mabenkeleng.
tgt: Akukho kutshitshiswa okanye msindo nokuba ungakanani onokuthethelela olu hlaselo nokuphangwa kweevenkile.

src: Le ha re ananela mabaka a hlahiswang ke badudi, merusu kgahlanong le batho ba bang di keke tsa rarolla dintlha tsena.
tgt: Noxa siyiqaphele imiba evezwe ngabahlali, ubundlobongela malunga nomnye umntu ongumwenu soze buyisombulule le miba.

src: Empa, sena se re hlahisa hampe jwaloka batho, re le kgahlanong le mehopolo le metheo ya demokerasi ya rona.
tgt: Endaweni yoko, buthetha kakubi ngathi njengabantu, sibe ngathi siphikisana kanye nemizekelo emihle neziseko zolawulo lwentando yesininzi esiphila phantsi kwalo.

src: Aforika Borwa e lwanne kgahlanong le bokoloniale le Kgethollo mmoho le maAforika a bo rona hore batho bohle ka hara kontinente ya rona ba hlomphuwe le ho tshwarwa ka seriti.2 Kgahlamelo ya ditlhaselo tsena e na le ditlamorao tse matla hodima moruo wa rona, kahisano le ho dikamano tsa rona tsa sepolotiki kontinenteng le lefatsheng.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika wabulwa ubukoloniyale nolawulo localucalulo ukunye namawethu angama-Afrika ukuze lonke uluntu kweli lizwekazi lethu luhlonelwe yaye luphathwe ngesidima.2 Ifuthe lolu hlaselo lubuchaphazela kakubi ubudlelwane bethu bezoqoqosho, ezentlalo kunye nebezopolitiko neli lizwekazi nehlabathi liphela.

src: Dikhamphani tsa Aforika Borwa tse nang le dikgwebo tse atlehileng ka hara kontinente tse thusang ka ho nyehela lekenong la rona le ho tsitsisa moruo wa rona di ka tloha tsa iphumana di le maemong a tshwanang le ana.
tgt: Iinkampani zaseMzantsi Afrika ezishishina ngempumelelo kweli lizwekazi nezinceda kwingeniso yethu, zizinzise noqoqosho lwethu nazo zingazibhaqa zikule meko yokuhlaselwa.

src: Moraorao tjena, dibini tsa Aforika Borwa tse neng di lokela ho ya bontsha makgabane a tsona ka ntle ho meedi ya rona, tse kang BigNuz ho la Zimbabwe, Kelly Khumalo le Casper ho la London, dikonsarete tsa bona di phumutswe ka lebaka la ditlhaselo tsena.
tgt: Kutsha nje, abantu baseMzantsi Afrika abaphila ngokucula ababeza kutshila ngeziphiwo zabo ngaphaya kwemida yelizwe lethu, abafana noBigNuz eZimbabwe, uKelly Khumalo noCasper eLondon, iikonsathi zabo kwanyanzeleka zirhoxiswe ngenxa yolu hlaselo.. Uninzi lwabahlali kweli abaxhomekeke kwiivenkile zabemi bamazwe angaphandle ukuze batye ngoku lusengxakini.

src: Boholo ba badudi ba rona ba tshepileng mabenkele a melata bakeng sa ditlhoko tsa bona tsa letsatsi ka leng jwale ba tlaletswe ke naha.
tgt: Kungoku nje, abemi boMzantsi Afrika baxhamla ilizwe elikhululekileyo, inkululeko leyo eyeza ngenxa yegalelo lamazwe amaninzi aseAfrika.

src: Kajeno, maAforika Borwa a thabela ho ba naha e lokolohileng, e fihlelletsweng ka lebaka la nyehelo ya dinaha tse ngatanyana tsa Aforika.
tgt: Ongumzekelo omiyo wethu, ongasekhoyo uMongameli u-Oliver Tambo wamkelwa wahlala iminyaka esondele kuma-30 eZambia kunye nabanye abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ababeselubhacweni.

src: Mofu eo e neng e le qhoku ya rona, Moporesidente Oliver Tambo o dutse nako e ka etsang dilemo tse 30 Zambia le maAforika Borwa a mang a mangata a neng a le palehong.
tgt: Amanye amazwe ase-Afrika zange anele nje ukwamkela abantu beli, anikela nangobutyebi aze amanye abetheka kabuhlungu, abemi bawo baphulukana nobomi encedisa kwidabi lokulwela ulawulo lwentando yesininzi eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Dinaha tsa habo rona tsa Aforika ha di a fella feela ka ho amohela batho ba rona, hape di ile tsa nyehela ka mehlodi mme tse ding di ile tsa phehisa ha bohloko ka ho lahlehelwa ke baahi ba tsona tseleng ya Aforika Borwa ya ho fihlella demokerasi.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika soze ukhukuliseke ekulandeleni umbono we-Afrika kaWonke-wonke njengoko uqulethwe yi-Ajenda yeMbumba ye-Afrika (i-AU) ka-2063, eyathi yalandelwa ziinkonde zethu uKwame Nkrumah,uNnamdi Azikiwe, Mwalimu Julius Nyerere noNelson Mandela.

src: Aforika Borwa e keke ya kgeloswa ho fihlella pono ya BoAforika bo Tiileng jwaloka ha e kenyeleditswe ho Lenane la Kopano ya Aforika la 2063, eo esale e tsitlallelwa ke baholoholo ba rona ba kang Kwame Nkrumah, Nnamdi Azikiwe, Mwalimu Julius Nyerere le Nelson Mandela.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uthwalise uxanduva iNtlanganiselo yezoBulungisa, uThintelo loLwaphulo-Mthetho kunye noKhuseleko nabaPhathiswa boPhuhliso lwamaShishini amaNcinci, uRhwebo noShishino kunye noPhuhliso loLuntu.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o laetse Moifo wa Matona a Toka ya Thibelo ya Botlokotsebe le Tshireletso mmoho le Matona e leng la Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane, la Lefapha la Kgwebo le Indaseteri le la Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba ho kenyeletsa mekga yohle e amehang bakeng sa ho batla tharollo.
tgt: Olo xanduva lelokuba aba baPhathiswa basebenzisane nabo bonke abachaphazelekayo, kuziwe nesisombululo.

src: Matona a boetse a laetswe ho sebetsana le maemo a moruo wa kahisano a bonahalang eka a motsong wa ditlhaselo tsena, hore taba ena e sebetswe ka matla le ka botlalo.
tgt: Abaphathiswa aba baphinde banikwa noxanduva lokujongana neemeko zasekuhlaleni kunye nezoqoqosho ezingathi zingunozala wolu hlaselo ukuze lo mbandela kujongwane nawo ngokungangathizi nakabanzi.

src: Moporesidente o ile a tswela pele ho phatlalatsa ditsela tse nkuweng ke Lebotho la Naha la Tshireletso la Aforika Borwa bakeng sa ho tlisa maemo tlasa taolo meeding ya rona.
tgt: UMongameli uphinde wazisa namanyathelo athatyathwe nguMkhosi woKhuselo weSizwe waseMzantsi Afrika ukuba ulawule imida yethu.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho badudi bohle, mekgatlo le batho ka bo mong ho ipopa kgahlanong le ditlhaselo tsena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abahlali, imibutho nabantu ukuba babambisane kunqandwe olu hlaselo.

src: Aforika Borwa ha se naha ya merusu mme kahoo methwaela e seng mekae e keke ya dumellwa ho kenya naha yohle ditlamong.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika asilo lizwe lithanda ubundlobongela.

src: Meruru ha e ya tloha e le tharollo bakeng sa mathata setjhabeng sefe kapa sefe mme ho keke ha ba jwalo le ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Ngoko ke, abantu abambalwa abanakuvunyelwa ukuba bagrogrise ilizwe lonke.

src: E seng lebitsong la rona!2.
tgt: Soze egameni lethu!2.

src: Diemahale.1 Kabinete e lemohile qeto ya bolaodi ba yunivesithi ya ho tlosa seemahale sa Rhodes khamaphaseng ya Yunivesithi ya Motse Kapa.
tgt: Imifanekiso eqingqiweyo.1IKhabhinethi isiqaphele isigqibo sabaphathi beyunivesithi sokususa umfanekiso oqiqingqiweyo kaRhodes kwiYunivesithi yaseKapa.

src: Aforika Borwa dilemong tse mashome a mabedi tse fetileng e entse menyabuketso e meholo bakeng sa ho netefatsa hore matshwao a rona a nalane a bontsha maemo a baahi ba naha ya rona le tsamaiso ya demokerasi.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika kule minyaka ingamashumi amabini idluleyo wenze imitsi emikhulu ukuqinisekisa ukuba imiqondiso yembali yethu ibonakalisa iinkcukacha ezibalulekileyo zelizwe lethu nohlobo lolawulo lwentando yesininzi.

src: Kabinete le ha ho le jwalo, e ananetse hore leeto la ho tlosa matshwao a nalane a nyenyefatsang le mabitso ka hara naha ya rona ha le ya potlaka ho ya kamoo ho lebeletsweng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi phofu iyayivuma into yokuba uhambo lokususa imiqondiso namagama athukayo kwilizwe lethu alubanga lolukhawulezayo.

src: Kabinete e lemohile le ho kgothaletsa dingangisano tsa hajwale tse batsi tse qadileng mabapi le diphethoho ka hara setjhaba, le ho lemoha hore diphethoho ha di so ka di potlaka kamoo ho lebeletsweng mme re utlwisisa ho nyahama ha baithuti.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele yaye iyayikhuthaza le ngxoxo-mpikiswano ikhoyo malunga nenguqu kuluntu lwethu.

src: Kahoo re ba kgothaletsa ho latela ditsamaiso tse hlaloswang melaong ya rona.2 Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ho itahlela ka setotswana ditsamaisong tse ntseng di tswela pele tse eteletsweng pele ke Lefapha la Bonono le Botjhaba mabapi le botjhaba le kaho ya setjhaba.
tgt: Kungoko ke sibakhuthaza ukuba balandele iinkqubo njengoko zichazwa yimithetho yethu.

src: MaAforika Borwa a hopotswa hore Molao wa Naha wa Mehlodi ya Setso wa 1999 o totobatsa ditsamaiso tsa ditherisano tse lokelang ho latelwa moo ho tshwanelang ho tloswa kapa ho iswa ha diemahale sebakeng se seng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imemelela abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bazibandakanye neenkqubo eziqhubekayo ezikhokhelwa liSebe lezoBugcisa neNkcubeko mayelana namafa nokwakha isizwe.

src: Leeto la Puso la Zimbabwe.1 Kabinete e amohela leeto la puso la Zimbabwe le neng le eteletswe pele ke Moporesidente Robert Gabriel Mugabe.
tgt: Abemi boMzantsi Afrika bakhunjuzwa ukuba uMthetho waMafa eSizwe we-1999 uyazicacisa iinkqubo zothethathethwano ezimelwe kukulandelwa xa kususwa okanye naxa utshintshwa indawo okuyo umfanekiso oqingqiweyo.

src: Aforika Borwa le Zimbabwe, di na le nalane e telele ya bosemphato ba lebatowa le maqhama a botjhaba.
tgt: Utyelelo lweZimbabwe lasebuRhulumenteni.1 IKhabhinethi ivuyiswa lutyelelo lweZimbabwe lasebuRhulumenteni olube yimpumelelo nobelukhokhelwa nguMongameli uRobert Gabriel Mugabe.

src: Batho ba Zimbabwe ba bapetse karolo ya bohlokwa nalaneng ya ho tshehetsa ntwa ya tokoloho ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika neZimbabwe banembali ende yonxibelelwano apha engingqini namaqhina enkcubeko.

src: Leeto le ntlafaditse dikamano tsa dinaha ka bobedi ka ho theha Khomishene ya Naha tse pedi mmoho le ho saena ditumellano tse tharo le Dimemorandamo tse pedi tsa Kutlwisisano (MoU).Tumellano mabapi le Theho ya Khomishene ya Naha tse pedi e ntlafatsa tshebedisano ya rona ho ya maemong a phahameng ka ho fetisisa ka ho kopana ha Dihlooho tse pedi tsa Puso bakeng sa ho sheba botjha kgatelopele mabapi le ditumellano tsa bobedi bona tsa tshebedisanommoho tse ananetsweng.
tgt: Olu tyelelo lunyusele kwinqanaba eliphezulu ubudlelwane phakathi kwethu ngokuthi kusekwe iKomishoni yala Mazwe mabini nokutyikitywa kwezivumelano ezithathu kunye neziVumelwano ezibini zeNtsebenziswano.

src: Tumellano mabapi le Tshebedisanommoho ho Bolaodi ba Mehlodi ya Metsi le ho thehwa le ho sebetsa ha Khomishene e Kopanetsweng ya Metsi e tla ntlafatsa tshebedisanommoho meralong ya mehlodi ya metsi, ntshetsopele le bolaodi ka moya wa kutlwano le molemo.
tgt: ISivumelwano sokuSekwa kweKhomishoni yala Mazwe Mabini inyusela kowona mgangatho uphezulu uthethathethwano phakathi kweeNtloko zoMbuso ezimbini xa zithe zadibana ukuhlaziya inkqubela malunga nezivumelwano zentsebenziswano phakathi kwala mazwe mabini.

src: Dinaha tsena tse pedi ka kopanelo di tla etsa diphuputso mabapi le ho utlwisisa bokgoni ba ditsi tsa metsi ho la Zimbabwe bakeng sa ho fana ka metsi ho Rephaboliki ya Aforika Borwa mme ka kopanelo di thehe diporojeke tsa metsi, tse tla bang le molemo mabapi le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi, diphethoho ho tsa moruo le ntshetsopele ya bokgoni le phethisetso.
tgt: ISivumelwano malunga neNtsebenziswano ekuLawuleni uButyebi baManzi ukusekwa nokusebenza kweKhomishoni yaManzi edibanisa la mazwe mabini kuza kuqinisa intsebenziswano ekucwangciseni ubutyebi bamanzi, uphuhliso nolawulo ngomoya wemvano noncedo.

src: Tumellano mabapi le Thusano pakeng tsa Ditsamaiso tsa Madiboho- E ala motheo bakeng sa ho theha lediboho le nang le tsohle.
tgt: La mazwe mabini aza kudibana enze uphando lokuqonda ubutyebi bamanzi obungakho kwimilambo yaseZimbabwe bokunika uMzantsi Afrika amanzi, adibane aseke iiprojekthi zamanzi, eziza kuba luncedo malunga nokudala imisebenzi, inguqu kwezoqoqosho uphuhliso lwezakhono nokuzidlulisela kwabanye.

src: Sena ke boemo ba motheo wa matjhaba o kgothaletswang ke Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Madiboho.
tgt: ISivumelwano sokuNcedana phakathi kwamaCandelo oLawulo LweRhafu yoRhwebelwano phakathi kwamazwe - Sisiseko sendawo enye emdeni yokuchophela imicimbi ebunje.

src: Sepheo ke ho kgontsha ditsamaiso tse pedi tsena ho fapanyetsana ka tlhahisoleseding, ho tshehetsana ka thuso ya setekginiki, le ho sebetsa ka peho-leihlo, maeto le diphuputso mmoho le ho sebedisana mmoho mabapi le ho ntlafatsa bohlwahlwa ba ditshebetso.
tgt: Injongo kukunceda la macandelo mabini ukuba bananiselane ngolwazi, baxhasane kwezobuchwepheshe, bacuphe, batyelele baphande kunye, basebenzisane ukuze kuqine ukusebenza ngempumelelo.

src: MoU mabapi le Dipuisano tsa Bodipolomate o tla theha mokgwa bakeng sa dipuisano tsa kamehla tsa bodipolomate mabapi le dintlha tse ka hara Aforika le dintlha tse ding tsa dikgahleho tse tshwanang.
tgt: ISivumelwano seNtsebenziswano ngoThethathethwano ngezoZakuzo siza kuseka indlela yokuqhuba rhoqo iintetho ngozakuzo malunga nemiba ye-Afrika neminye echaphazela la mazwe mabini.

src: Sepheo se seholo sa MoU ke ho theha mokgwa bakeng sa dipuisano tsa bodipolomate kamehla mabapi le dintlha tsa ho matlafatsa dikamano tsa bobedi bona, tshireletso le tshebedisanommoho ka hara Aforika.
tgt: Injongo engundoqo yeSivumelwano seNtsebenziswano kukuseka indlela yothethathethwano rhoqo ngozakuzo malunga nemiba yokuqinisa ubudlelwane phakathi kwala mazwe mabini, ukhuseleko nentsebenziswano e-Afrika.

src: MoU mabapi le Tshebedisanommoho ya Kgwebisano o reretswe ho fana ka lepatlelo bakeng sa dinaha tse pedi ho buisana le ho arolelana diphihlello mabapi le ho hodisa ntshetsopele ya moruo.
tgt: ISivumelwano seNtsebenziswano ngoRhwebo injongo yaso kukuseka iqonga lala mazwe mabini lokuthethathethana nokwabelana ngamava ukuze kunyuke uphuhliso loqoqosho.

src: Bobedi bona bo dumellane ka ho sebedisana mmoho ka kgodiso ya kgwebisano, tharollo ya ditshita tsa ho hweba le ho ahuwa ha bokgoni ba setekginiki dibakeng tse hlwauweng mmoho le ntshetsopele ya bokgoni le boitsebelo.
tgt: La mazwe mabini avuma ukusebenzisana ngokukhuthaza urhwebo,ukusombulula izithintelo zorhwebo nokwakha izakhono zobuchwepheshe kwiindawo ngeendawo eziboniweyo kwakunye nokuphuhlisa izakhono jikelele.

src: Yunivesithi ya Disaense tsa Kalafo ya Sefako Makgatho (SMU)4.1 Kabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa ha SMU ke Moporesidente Jacob Zuma Ga-Rankuwa, ho la Gauteng ka la 14 Mmesa 2015.
tgt: ISefako Makgatho Health Sciences University.1 IKhabhinethi yamkela ukuvulwa ngokusesikweni kweSefako Makgatho Health Sciences University (i-SMU) nguMongameli uJacob Zuma eGa-Rankuwa, eGauteng ngomhla we-14 kuTshazimpunzi ngowama-2015.

src: Yunivesithi ena, e kenyeletsang khamphase ya mehleng ya MEDUNSA ya Yunivesithi ya Limpopo, e qadile selemo sa yona sa pele sa dithuto ka selemo sa 2015 ka baithuti ba 5 000.Ho thehwa ha SMU ho fana ka monyetla o hlwahlwa bakeng sa ntshetsopele le thupello ya moloko o motjha wa ditsebi ho tsa kalafo o tla fanang ka kgahlamelo e kgabane bophelong le boitekanelong ba maAforika Borwa a mangata a ntseng a kotetswe ke bofuma le kgaello ya ho fihlella ditshebeletso tsa kalafo.
tgt: Le yunivesithi nebandakanya icandelo elalisakuba lelase-Medunsa le Yunivesithi yaseLimpopo.

src: SMU ke yunivesithi ya pele e ikemetseng ya tsa kalafo ya ho thehwa ka hara naha.
tgt: IYUnivesithi le iqale ukufundisa ngo-2015 ngabafundi abangama-5 000.Ukusekwa kweYunivesithi iSefako Makgatho ibonelela ngethuba elihle kakhulu lokuphuhlisa nokuqeqesha iincutshe ezintsha kwezempilo eziza kuba negalelo elihle kwimpilo nobomi boninzi labemi boMzantsi Afrika abangahoyekanga nangoku ngenxa yentlupheko nokungabi nako ukufikelela kwiinkonzo zonyango.

src: Mmuso o tla tswela pele ho tsetela thutong le ntshetsopeleng ya bokgoni jwaloka mokgwa wa bohlokwa wa ho hotetsa kgolo ya moruo le ntshetsopele.
tgt: ISefako Makgatho Health Sciences University yiyunivesiti yokuqala ezimeleyo kwezobunzululwazi bezempilo nethe yavulwa kweli lizwe.

src: Beke ya Naha ya Imbizo ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo.1 Kabinete e hlahisitse teboho ya yona ho maAforika Borwa oohle a tlileng ka bongata bakeng sa ho nka karolo dipuisanong tse otlolohileng le baemedi ba setjhaba nakong ya Beke ya Naha ya Imbizo ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo eo mookotaba wa yona e neng e le “Mmoho re ntshetsa Aforika Borwa pele”.
tgt: URhulumente uya kusoloko eyixhasa imfundo nokuphuhliswa kwezakhono njengezinto ezingundoqo ekuqhubeni ukukhula nokuphuhliswa koqoqosho.

src: Sena ke pontsho ya demokerasi e holang moo baahi ba nkang karolo ka matla boikitlaetsong boo sepheo sa bona e leng ho etsa hore mmuso o ikarabelle jwaloka ha ho lebeletswe ho ya ka Morero wa Naha wa Ntshetsopele.
tgt: Iveki eGxila kwiiMbizo.1 IKhabhinethi ibulela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika abaphuma ngendlu ukuza kuthatha inxaxheba ekuthetheni ngqo nabameli boluntu ngexesha kubanjwe Iveki yeSizwe yokuGxila kwiiMbizo enesihloko esithi “Sisonke siqhubela uMzantsi Afrika Phambili”.

src: Boradipolotiki ba ka sehloohong ba ile ba buisana le badudi le ho phahlolla ditsebiso tse entsweng ke Moporesidente Jacob Zuma nakong ya Puo ya Pulo ya Palamente ya 20.2 Imbizo hape e fane ka monyetla ho boradipolotiki ba ka sehloohong ho arolelana le badudi merero ya mmuso ya ho ntlafatsa phano ya ditshebeletso le ho mamela dintlha tse tobileng badudi.
tgt: Le nto ibonisa ukuvuthwa kolawulo lwentanddo yesininzi apho abemi bathatha inxaxheba ngamandla kumalinge ajonge ekwenzeni urhulumente aziphendulele njengoko loo nto ingumbono wesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso.

src: Diketsahalo tse fetang 70 tsa di-Imbizo di etsahetse ho tloha ka la 07 Mmesa ho ya ka la 12 Mmesa 2015.
tgt: Iintloko zezopolitiko zanxibelelana nabahlali zachaza izinto ezathethwa nguMongameli uJacob Zuma xa wayesenza iNtetho ngoBume beSizwe yowama-20.2 Iimbizo zaphinda zanika iintloko zezopolitiko ithuba lokuba zabelane ngezicwangciso zikarhulumente zokuphucula ukunikezelwa keenkonzo nokumamela izinto ezidla umzi.

src: Diketsahalo di fihlile sehlohlolong ka la 12 Mmesa, ka ntjhafatso ya “Imbizo Lounge”, e neng e tshwerwe ka nako e le nngwe ke boradipolotiki ba bararo ba ka sehloohong diporofenseng tse tharo.
tgt: Ngaphaya kweembizo ezi- 70 zabakho ukususela ngomhla we-7 kuTshazimpunzi ukuya kowe-12 kuTshazimpunzi kowe-2015.

src: Diqeto tsa Bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.1 Kabinete e amohela diphetho tsa diphuputso tse entsweng mabapi le ditletlebo le dipatlisiso tse 161 091 tse amohetsweng ho Mohala wa Boporesidente ho tloha esale o thehwa mafelong a Hlakubele 2013.
tgt: Ezi mbizo ziye zaqukunjelwa ngomhla we-12 kuTshazimpunzi , apho kwabakho into entsha ebizwa “Imbizo Lounge”, eyayisingathwe ngaxesha nye ziintloko zezopolitiko kumaphondo amathathu.

src: Diphuputso di hlahlobile mofuta wa dinyewe tse kentsweng ke baahi, tsa hlwaya meokotaba e hlahellang le mekgwa ya tsamaiso ho parola le mafapha oohle a mmuso.
tgt: Izigqibo ezingundoqo zeKhabhinethi.1 IKhabhinethi iyazamkela iziphumo zophando olwenziwa ngezikhalazo nemibuzo engama-161 091 efunyenwe kwiNombolo ye-Ofisi kaMongameli oko yathi yasungulwa ukuza kuthi ga ekupheleni kweyoKwindla ngowama-2013.

src: Diphuputso di hlwaile dintlha tse ngatanyana tse ngongorehisang baahi tse tshwanang ho parola jwalo le mafapha a mmuso.
tgt: Uphando lwayibonisa imo yemiba abemi abatsalela ngayo umnxeba, lalatha nezihloko ezivelayo kunye nemiba engaphakathi kurhulumente ewonke.

src: Diphetho tsa diphuputso di tla thusa mafapha ho utlwisisa betere dintlha tse ngongorehisang badudi, le tlhahisoleseding e hlokahalang e batlwang ke badudi.
tgt: Iziphumo zolu phando ziza kunceda amasebe ayiqonde ngcono imiba edla umzi kubahlali, nolwazi olufanelekileyo olufunwa ngabahlali.

src: Boitshunyako bona bo tla ntlafatsa mokgwa oo re sebeletsang badudi ka ona.2 Kabinete e fumane tlaleho ya moraorao mabapi le mohlophollo wa tefo ya bafani ba ditshebeletso nakong ya matsatsi a 30 a ho thola setlankana se molaong sa tefo.
tgt: Ukungenelela kuza kuphucula indlela esisebenzela ngayo abahlali.2 IKhabhinethi ifumene ingxelo ngezakutsha nje ngohlalutyo ngokubhatalwa kweenkampani ezizimeleyo ezisebenzela urhulumente zingaphelanga iintsuku ezingama-30 ukususela mhla kwafakwa i-invoyisi esemthethweni .

src: Kabinete e lemohile kgatelopele e entsweng, empa e ile ya hlahisa dingongoreho mabapi le mafapha a mang a ntseng a tobane le diphephetso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele inkqubela eyenziweyo, kodwa yavakalisa unxunguphalo lwayo ngamasebe athile asenemingeni.

src: Mohlophollo wa papiso mabapi le Mafapha a Naha pakeng tsa 2013 Pherekgong ho ya ho Mphalane le 2014 Pherekgong ho ya ho Mphalane o bontshitse ntlafalo ya 39% mabapi le palohare ya palo ya dintlankana tsa tefo tse lefilweng nakong ya matsatsi a 30 le ntlafalo ya 32% mabapi le palohare ya palo ya ditlankana tsa tefo tse lefilweng kamora matsatsi a 30.Mafapha a Naha a tlalehile ditlankana tsa tefo tse 155 572 tsa boleng ba R3,8 bilione tse lefilweng kamora matsatsi a 30 mme ka nako eo, ditlankana tsa tefo tse 62 887 tsa boleng ba R2,1 bilione tse fetang matsatsi a 30 di ne di so lefuwe.
tgt: Uthelekiso lohlahlelo lwamaSebe kaZwelonke phakathi kweyoMqungu wowama-2013 ukuya kweyeDwarha wowama-2014 ubonise ukuphucuka okuyi-39% kumyinge wee-invoyisi ezibhatelweyo iintsuku ezingama-30 zingadlulanga kunye nokuphucuka okuyi-32% kumyinye wee-invoyisi ezabhatalwa emva kweentsuku ezingama-30.Amasebe kazwelonke axela ii-invoyisi ezingama-155 572 ezixabisa iibhiliyoni zeerandi ezi-3,8 ezabhatalwa emva kweentsuku ezingama-30 ngaxesha nye, neeinvoyisi ezingama-62 887 ezixabisa iibhiliyoni zeerandi ezi-2,1 ezingaphaya kweentsuku ezingama-30 ezingekabhatalwa.

src: Mafapha a diporofense bakeng sa nako e tshwanang a bontsha ntlafalo e seng kae ya 5% ho palohare ya palo ya ditlankana tsa tefo tse lefilweng nakong ya matsatsi a Diporofense di tlalehile ditlankana tsa tefo tse 241 332 tsa boleng ba R13,4 bilione tse lefilweng kamora matsatsi a 30 ditlankana tsa tefo tse 356 079 tsa boleng ba R21,8 bilione tse fetang matsatsi a 30 tse neng di so lefuwe.
tgt: Kwangeli xesha linye amasebe amaphondo abonisa ukuphucuka okuncinci okuyi- 5% kumyinge wee-invoyisi ezibhatelwe iintsuku ezingama-30 zingadlulanga.

src: Sena ke putlamo ya 52% ho palohare ya palo ya ditlankana tsa tefo tse fetang matsatsi a 30 le tse neng di so lefuwe.
tgt: Amaphondo axela ii-invoyisi ezingama-241 332 ezixabisa iibhiliyoni zeerandi ezili-13,4 ezabhatalwa emva kweentsuku ezingama-30 kunye nee-invoyisi ezingama-356 079 ezixabisa iibhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama21,8 ezingaphaya kweentsuku ezingama-30 ezingabhatalwanga.

src: Bakeng sa ho thusa mafapha a ntseng a sokola, Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho thehwa ha lekala le ikgethang ka hara Lefapha la Merero, Bodisa le Tlhatlhobo ya Tshebetso ho shebana le mafapha a ntseng a tswella ho sokola.
tgt: Oku kubonisa ukuphunguka okungama-52% kumyinge wee-invoyisi ezineentsuku ezingaphezulu kwezingama-30 zingahlawulwanga.

src: Lekala lena le tla sebetsa mmoho le Lefapha la Matlotlo a Setjhaba le Lefapha la Tshebeletso ya Mmuso le Taolo (DPSA).Ho phaella hodima moo ho tla phatlalatswa mohala wa naha o tla ba teng bakeng sa bafani ba ditshebeletso ho tlaleha maemo moo ditefello di diehisitsweng.
tgt: Ukunceda amasebe asatsala nzima, iKhabhinethi yavuma ukusekwa kwecandelo elilodwa kwiSebe lokuCwangcisa, ukuHlolwa kokuSebenza noVavanyo ukuze lilandelele amasebe asoloko etsala nzima.

src: Sena se tla iswa ho lefapha le amehang mme dikarabelo di tla tlalehwa.3 Kabinete e lemohile tlaleho mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Lenaneo la Ditsiane la Tlhatlhobo ya Thekiso ya ka Ntle le Thuso ya Matsete (EMIA) le ho boela e amohela karabelo le moralo wa bolaodi wa Lefapha la Kgwebo le Diindaseteri.
tgt: Eli Candelo liza kusebenzisana noNondyebo weSizwe kunye neSebe lezaBasebenzi bakaRhulumente noLawulo (i-DPSA).Ngaphezu koko, umnxeba kazwelonke wemibuzo uza kupapashwa yaye uza kufumaneka kwiinkampani ezizimeleyo ezisebenzela urhulumente ukuze zifake imiba yokungabhatalwa msinya.

src: Sena se entse karolo ya Morero wa Naha wa Tlhahlobo wa 2013/14 ho lekola bohlwahlwa ba Lenaneo bakeng sa ho tshehetsa bahlahisi ba Aforika Borwa le ba romelang thepa mafatsheng a ka ntle.
tgt: Loo miba iza kubhekiswa kwelo sebe lifanelekileyo kunikwe nengxelo yeempendulo.3 IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele ingxelo yokuHlolwa kokuQaliswa kweNkqubo yeziBonelelo zeNgxowa-mali yokuThengisa iiMpahla kuMazwe angaphandle (i-EMIA) yaza yaphinda yamkela isicwangciso sokuphucula seSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino.

src: EMIA e thusitse dikgwebo tse 6 766 tse romelang thepa mafatsheng a ka ntle ho parola le diporofense le ho ho lefa ditseko tsa palo ya boleng ba R510 milione ho tloha ka 2009/10 ho ya ka 2012/13.
tgt: Le yaba yinxalenye yesiCwangciso sokuVavanya seSizwe sowama-2013/2014 sokuhlola ukusebenza kwale Nkqubo ekuxhaseni abarhwebi boMzantsi Afrika abathumela iimpahla kwamanye amazwe.

src: Dikgwebo tsena tse tsheheditsweng di hlahisitse mesebetsi e 24 802.
tgt: I-EMIA incede amashishini athumela iimpahla kwamanye amazwe angama-6 766 kuwo onke amaphondo yaza yabhatala amabango axabisa izigidi zeerandi ezingama-510 ukususela ngowama- 2009/10 ukuya kowama-2012/13.

src: Tekolo ya bankakarolo ba EMIA e bontsha tshebediso e kgabane ya ditsiane tsa EMIA ke bongata ba batho ba neng ba Tinngwe Menyetla ho ya ka Nalane le difeme tseo beng ba tsona e leng basadi.4 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana moralo wa Tokomane ya Leano la Naha la ho Betjha e tla phatlalatswa ho Koranta ya Mmuso bakeng sa dipuisano tse pharaletseng le setjhaba.
tgt: Loo mashishini axhaswayo adale imisebenzi engama-24 802.

src: Sepheo sa yona ke ho ntlafatsa bohlwahlwa ba ho laola ho betjha, ho ntlafatsa kgokahano le tshebedisanommoho le diporofense le ho fetola maemo botjha a Boto ya Naha ya ho Betjha jwaloka molaodi bakeng sa sebetsana ka bokgabane le ho betjha ho seng molaong.5 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya moralo wa Leano la Tahi bakeng sa dipuisano tse pharaletseng le setjhaba.
tgt: Uvavanyo lwabathathi-nxaxheba be-EMIA lubonisa ukusetyenziswa okubalulekileyo kwezikhuthazi ze-EMIA ikakhulu ngabantu abesakuhleleleka ngaphambili yalapha kunye namashishini oomama.4 IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba idrafti yoXwebhu loMgaqo-nkqubo seSizwe wokuNgcakaza ipapashwe kwiphephandaba li lakwaRhulumente ukuze uluntu luhlomle kulo.

src: Moralo wa Leano la Tahi o tla ntlafatsa bohlwahlwa ba ho laola kgwebo ya tahi le ho thibela kgwebo e seng molaong.
tgt: Olu xwebhu lujonge ukuphucula ukusebenza kolawulo lokungcakaza ngemali, ukuphucula ukuthungelelana nentsebenziswano namaphondo yaye ibeka iBhodi yokuNgcakaza kaZwelonke kwimeko yobulawuli ukuze ijongane ngokucacileyo nokungcakaza okungekho mthethweni.5 IKhabhinethi ivume ukupapashwa kwedrafti yoMgaqo-nkqubo woTywala ukuze uluntu luhlomle kuyoLe drafti iza kuphucula ukusebenza kokulawula ishishini lokushishina ngotywala yaye lulwe ukushishina okungekho mthethweni.

src: Hara dintlha tse ding, ditshisinyo di tobane le kgahlamelo ya tahi ho moruo wa kahisano le ditholwana tsa tshebediso e mpe ya tahi mmoho le diphethoho indasetering ya tahi.6 Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka diphetho tsa tlhatlhobo e tebileng ya Ntlafatso ya Kgodiso ya Bana moo ditlhatlhobo tse tebileng di ileng tsa etswa bakeng sa Kereiti ya R le boitshunyako ba tsa phepo bakeng sa bana ba ka tlasa dilemo tse hlano.
tgt: Phakathi kweminye imiba izindululo ziza kujonga ifuthe lotywala entlalweni nakuqoqosho kunye neendleko zokusebenzisa gwenxa utywala kunye nenguqu kushishino ngotywala.6 IKhabhinethi yanikwa amagqabantshintshi ngeziphumo zovavanyo oluphengululayo loPhuhliso lwaBantwana abaNcinane apho iimvavanyo ezinenkcukacha zenziweyo kwiBanga R kunye namanyathelo okungenelela ngokutya okunesondlo kubantwana abaneminyaka engaphantsi kwemihlanu.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ntshetsopele ya Moralo o Kopanetsweng wa Naha wa Phepo bakeng sa Aforika Borwa, oo ka kakaretso o sebetsanang le phepo, ho kenyeletsa nako ya pele ho tswalo, matsatsi a 1 000 a pele a ho phela, ntlafatso ya kgodiso ya bana le Kereiti ya Moralo wa ntlafatso ho tloha ho tekolo mabapi le “Kgahlamelo ya ho Hlahiswa ha Kereiti ya R hodima Diphetho tsa ho Ithuta” o toboketsa ho ntlafatswa ha boleng ba Kereiti ya R bakeng sa ho phahamisa kgahlamelo ya ona ho bana ba futsanehileng le diporofense tse sa sebetseng hantle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuphumezile ukuphuhliswa kwesiCwangciso seSondlo sikaZwelonke esihlanganisiweyo, esijongene nesondlo ngokupheleleyo, kubandakanya ixesha lokukhawula, iintsuku zokuqala ebomini ezili-1 000, uphuhliso lwabantwana abancinane kunye neBanga Inkqubo yophuculo kuvavanyo “Lwempembelelo yokuqalisa iBanga R kwiziPhumo zokuFunda” igxininisa ukuphucula uhlobo lweBanga R ukwandisa kangangoko impembelelo yeli banga kubantwana abahlelelekileyo nakumaphondo angenaziphumo zihle.

src: Sena se kenyeletsa thupello le ntshetsopele ya matitjhere a Kereiti ya R le ho nkela hloohong thonyo ya batho ba nang le mangolo a phahameng (maemo a NQF a bo5) a amehang bakeng sa morero ona.
tgt: Oku kuquka uqeqesho nophuhliso lweetitshala zeBanga R, nengqwalasela ekuqeshweni kwabantu abaneziqinisekiso zemfundo ephakamileyo ezizizo (isigaba 5 se-NQF) kulo msebenzi.

src: Dibili.1 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho lokollwa ha Bili ya Inshorense, ya 2015 bakeng sa dipuisano le setjhaba.
tgt: Imithetho esaYilwayo.1 IKhabhinethi ikuphumezile ukukhutshwa koMthetho oyiLwayo we-Inshorensi, wowama-2015 ukuze uluntu luhlomle kuwo.

src: Bili ena e matahantswe le Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha, e netefatsa lekala le hlwahlwa le laolwang hantle la inshorense, le ho hodisa botsitso ho tsa ditjhelete bo tla tshehetsa kgolo ya moruo ya moshwelella ka ho fana ka kgahlamelo ho maemo a phahameng a toka a hlahisitsweng ha ho shejwa koduwa ya ditjhelete ya 2008.
tgt: Lo Mthetho usaYilwayo uhambelana neNkqubo yoPhuhliso yeSizwe (i-NDP), uqinisekisa icandelo le-inshorensi equlunqwe ngokukuko, ze ukhuthaze uzinzo kwezezimali oluxhasa uqoqosho olukhulayo oluzinzileyo ngokunika isiphumo kumazinga aphakamileyo anobulumko aveliswe kujongwe umbhodamo kuqoqosho lwehlabathi ngowama-2008.

src: E fana ka kgahlamelo ho moralo o lokileng o motjha bakeng sa lekala la inshorense.
tgt: Inika isiphumo kuqulunqo olunobulumko kwicandelo lwe-inshorensi.

src: Bolaodi ba Tekolo ya Bokgoni ba Paballo ya Tjhelete le Taolo bo batla ho hlahisa katamelo e ntjha, e nang le tjhebelopele e itshetlehileng hodima dikotsi tsa ho tjhona ka ho matahanya ditlhoko tsa tjhelete tse teng le dikotsi tsa ya fanang ka inshorense.
tgt: Uvavanyo lokuba neMali eyaneleyo nenkqubo yoLawulo, lujonge ukuvelisa indlela entsha ejonge phambili nengajongana nokungaphumeleli xa kushokoxeke izimali ngokungqamanisa iimfuno zezimali kunye nokuthatha amathuba komnini we-inshorensi.

src: Hape e fana ka ditsiane ho beng ba inshorense ho imatahanya le mekgwa e hlwahlwa ya ho beha leihlo le ho laola.
tgt: Ikwanika inkuthazo kubanini be-inshorensi bafumane izixhobo ezinqabileyo zokujonga zilawule oku kuthathwa kwamathuba.

src: Mekgwa ena e batla ho netefatsa tshireletso e betere ya beng ba dipholisi le bakgolamolemo le ho nyehela ho botsitso ho tsa ditjhelete.2 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya moralo wa Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Setsi sa Merero ya Mautlwela a tsa Ditjhelete, sa 2014 bakeng sa dipuisano le setjhaba.
tgt: La manyathelo ajonge ukuqinisekisa ukhuseleko olungcono lwabanini be-inshorensi kunye nabancedakala ngenxa yabo aze abe negalelo kuzinzo kwezezimali.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili se sisinya dihlomathiso ho Molao wa Setsi sa Merero ya Mautlwela a tsa Ditjhelete (Molao wa 38 wa 2001).
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphumeze upapasho lwedrafti yoMthetho-sihlomelo osaYilwayo weZiko lobuNtloli kwezezi- Mali lowama-2014 ukuze uluntu luphawule.

src: Sena ke ho sebetsana le ditshoso tsa botsitso ba tsamaiso ya rona ya tsa ditjhelete tse hlahiswang ke dikadimo tse bohlaswa tsa ditjhelete le thuso ya boferekanyi ka ditjhelete ka ho netefatsa boimatahanyo le mekgwa ya matjhaba le dipehelo, ka hara moralo wa melao ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Umthetho-sihlomelo usaYilwayo uphakamisa imibandela yofakelelo kuMthetho weZiko lobuNtloli kwezeZimali (uMthetho we-38 wowama-2001).

src: Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le Dintlha tsa Hajwale.1 Kabinete e lemohile ka ngongoreho keketseho e bohale ya mafu a mebileng nakong ya mafelo a beke ya Paseka, moo re boneng dikotsi tse 208 tse bakileng mafu a 287, ha ho bapiswa le palo ya mafu ya selemo se fetileng, e neng e eme ho mafu a 193 ho tswa dikotsing tse 148.Boipaballo mebileng ke boikarabelo ba maAforika Borwa oohle mme katleho ya matsholo a rona a boipaballo mebileng a itshetlehile ho basebedisi bohle ba mebila ba bapalang karolo ya bona.
tgt: Oku kukujongana nemiceli-mngeni kuzinzo lwendlela yethu yezimali eyenziwa kukwenza imali ngokubolekisa kunye nogrogriso ngokuqinisekisa ukuthobela amanyathelo namazinga ezizwe, ngokwendlela yemithetho yaseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Bakganni ba lokela ho latela melawana ya tsela, ba seke ba nwa le ho kganna, ba imatahanye le lebelo le lekanyeditsweng le ho netefatsa hore dipalangwang tsa bona di loketse tsela.2 Lebitsong la batho ba Aforika Borwa, Kabinete, e hlahisa matshediso a yona a tebileng ho mmuso le batho ba Rephaboliki ya Kenya, haholoholo malapa a mahlatsipa a hlokahetseng tlhaselong e hlokang kelello Kholetjheng ya Yunivesithi ya Garissa ka la 2 Mmesa 2015.Kabinete e kgema le Moporesidente Jacob Zuma tabeng ya ho tshwela ka mathe ketso ena ya boferekanyi le ho boeletsa hore Aforika Borwa e tshehetsa Kenya le mekutu ya baahi ba matjhaba ya kgotso, botsitso le demokerasi le kaho ya setjhaba ka hara Somalia.3 Kabinete e thoholetsa batho ba Nigeria bakeng sa ho tshwara dikgetho tse nang le kgotso, ponaletso, botshepehi le tse lokolohileng ka la 28 Hlkubele 2015, jwaloka ha di tiiseditswe ke Khomishene ya Naha ya Dikgetho ya Nigeria.
tgt: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba egqubayo.1 IKhabhinethi iqaphele ngenkxalabo ukunyuka ngamandla kokufa ezindleleni ngempela-veki yePasika, apho kwabakho iingozi ezingama-208 ezikhokhelele kukufa kwabantu abagama-287, xa uthelekisa nenani labantu abaphulukana nobomi kunyaka ophelileyo, elalikwi-193 kwiingozi ezili-148.Ukhuseleko ezindleleni luxanduva lomntu wonke waseMzantsi Afrika nempumelelo yamaphulo okhuseleko ezindleleni ixhomekeke kubasebenzisi bendlela bonke, umntu edlala indima yakhe.

src: Lebitsong la maAforika Borwa, Kabinete e thoholetsa Mokgenerale Muhammad Buhari ho kgethweng ha hae jwaloka Moporesidente wa Rephaboliki ya Bofederale ya Nigeria.4 Kabinete e thoholetsa Marlene van Niekerk bakeng sa ho ba moAforika Borwa wa pele ho ba letotong le lekgutshwane bakeng sa Moputso wa Matjhaba wa Man Booker.
tgt: Abaqhubi mabathobele imithetho yendlela, bangaseli baze baqhube, bagcine isantya esilindelekileyo baze baqinisekise ukuba izithuthi zabo zikulungele ukuba sendleleni.2 Egameni labantu boMzantsi Afrika, iKhabhinethi ivakalisa uvelwano olunzulu kuRhulumente kunye nabantu beRiphabliki yaseKenya, ngakumbi iintsapho zamaxhoba asweleke kuhlaselo olunobudenge kwiKholeji yeDyunivesithi yaseGarissa ngomhla we-2 kuTshazimpunzi kowama-2015.IKhabhinethi ikunye noMongameli uJacob Zuma ekugxekeni esi senzo sobugrogriso, yaye igxininisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika uyayixhasa iKenya kunye neenzame zamazwe angaphandle ekudaleni uxolo, uzinzo, ulawulo lwentando yesininzi kunye nokwakheka kobuzwe eSomalia.3 IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana nabantu baseNigeria ngokubamba unyulo olunoxolo, olungenamfihlo, oluthembekileyo, olukhululekileyo nolunobulungisa ngomhla wama-28 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2015, ngokubhengezwa yiKomishoni yoNyulo kaZwelonke ezimeleyo yaseNigeria.

src: O ananetswe bakeng sa phihlello e ipabotseng ya nako tsohle bongoding ba dipale, tse kenyeletsang mesebetsi e jwaloka Triomf le Agaat.
tgt: Egameni labantu baseMzantsi Afrika, iKhabhinethi ivuyisana noNjengele uMuhammad Buhari ngokunyulwa abe nguMongameli weRiphabliki yobuFederali yaseNigeria.4 IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana noMarlene Van Niekerk ngokuba abe ngowokuqala eMzantsi Afrika ukuba kuluhlu oluncitshisiweyo lwabaviwa beBhaso leMan Booker International.

src: Hape o amohetse Kgau ya Ikhamanga ka 2011 bakeng sa “nyehelo ya hae e ipabotseng ho bonono le botjhaba ho tsa dingolwa”.
tgt: Wavunywa ngenxa yempumelelo yakhe ebalasele ngokugqithisileyo kwiintsomi, oku kuquka iincwadi zakhe ezinjengo-Triomf no-Agaat.

src: Diketsahalo tse tlang.1 Kabinete e ananetse hore Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o tla be a araba dipotso Palamenteng ka Labone, 16 Mmesa 20.2 Kabinete e amohela Leeto la Puso ho ya Jakarta, Indonesia la Moporesidente Jacob Zuma ho tloha ka la 19 ho isa ho la 21 Mmesa 2015, le tla sheba botjha maemo a dikamano tsa bobedi bona ho netefatsa phihlello ya dilemo tse hlano tsa ‘Morero wa Tshebetso’, jwaloka ha o ile wa tshohlwa ke mahlakore ka bobedi Pretoria ka Pudungwana 2014.Moporesidente Jacob Zuma hape o tla kenela Seboka sa Asia-Aforika mahareng a la 22 ho isa ho la 23 Mmesa ho la Jakarta, se tla matlafatsa tshebedisanommoho ya dinaha tse ka borwa ba ekhweita e tla lebisa kgolong ya moruo wa kahisano bakeng sa mabatowa ka bobedi.
tgt: Kwakhona wafumana i-Order of iKhamanga ngowama-2011 ngenxa “yegalelo lakhe lengqondo elibalaseleyo kuncwadi lobugcisa nenkcubeko”.

src: Leeto lena le tla phethelwa ka Sehopotso sa bo60 sa Seboka sa Bandung sa 1955 le Sehopotso sa bo10 sa Bosemphato se Setjha sa Mawala (NAASP) ka la 24 Mmesa 2015, se tla tshwarwa Bandung, ho la West Java.
tgt: Imisitho ezayo.1 IKhabhinethi yaqwalasela ukuba uMongameli uJacob Zuma uya kuba ephendula imibuzo ePalamente ngoLwesine, umhla we-16 kuTshazimpunzi ngowama-20.2 IKhabhinethi iyalwamkela utyelelo lasebuRhulumenteni lukaMongameliuJacob Zuma oluya eJakarta, e-Indonesia ukusukela ngomhla we-19 ukuya ku-21 kuTshazimpunzi ngowama-2015.

src: E ne e le Bandung moo baetapele ba mokgatlo wa rona e leng Moses Kotane le Maulvi Cachalia ba ileng ba tlisa dipehelo tsa ho hloka semorabe le boikemelo lenaneong la lefatshe.3 Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa oohle ho kenela Mekete ya Kgwedi ya Tokoloho, e tlisang dilemo tse mashome a mararo tsa tokoloho ka ho kgothaletsa seriti sa botho le ho tsitlallela mohopolo o tshwanang o tla lebisa kahong ya Aforika Borwa e kopaneng le ho atleha.
tgt: Olu hambo luya kuhlaziya ubume bemicimbi yonxulumano lwamacala omabini ukuqinisekisa uphumezo ‘lwesiCwangciso sokuSebenza’ seminyaka emihlanu, njengoko kuxoxiwe ngamacala amabini ePitoli ngeyeNkanga kowama- 2014.UMongameli uJacob Zuma, kwakhona uza kubakho kwintlanganiso yeenkokeli zamazwe ase-Asia nawaseAfrika ukusukela kumhla wama-22 ukuya kuma-23 kuTshazimpunzi eJakarta.

src: Mokete wa rona wa naha o tla phethelwa ka Letsatsi la Tokoloho, 27 Mmesa 2015 tlasa mookotaba: “Re Keteka Qalo ya Dilemo tse Mashome a Mararo tsa Tokoloho ya rona ka ho Akofisa Diphethoho tse Matla tsa Moruo”.MaAforika Borwa a boela a hopotswa ka ho intsha sehlabelo ka matla ha batho ba bo rona le basadi ntweng kgahlanong le tsamaiso e soto ya kgethollo hore re tle re thabele tokoloho eo re nang le yona kajeno.
tgt: Le ntlanganiso yeenkokeli zamazwe iza kuqinisa intsebenziswano yamazwe asemazantsi e-Ikhweyitha ngokubhekisele ekukhuleni kwentlalo noqoqosho kula mazwekazi omabini.

src: Bakeng sa ho hlompha maAforika Borwa a nyehetseng ntshetsopeleng ya demokerasi ya rona, Moporesidente Jacob Zuma ka Letsatsi la Tokoloho o tla fana ka Dikgau tsa Naha moketeng o tla beng o tshwaretswe Meahong ya Kopano.
tgt: Utyelelo luya kuphetha ngesikhumbuzo seminyaka engama-60 seNkomfa yaseBandug yangonyaka we-1955 kunye nesikhumbuzo seminyaka eli-10 ye-New Asian-African Strategic Partenership (i-NAASP) ngomhla wama-24 kuTshazimpunzi ngowama-2015, esiya kuqhubeka eBandug, eWest Java.

src: Kabinete e fetisa thoholetso ho baamohedi bohle le ho etsa teboho ya yona bakeng sa nyehelo ya bona.4 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana hore Aforika Borwa e tla tshwara Ho dula ho Setlwaeding ha bo25 ha Kopano ya Aforika ho Lefapha la Dikamano le Tshebedisano ya Matjhaba le Setsing sa Matjhaba sa Dikopano sa Sandton Johannesburg, ho tloha ka la 7-15 Phuptjane 2015.
tgt: KwakuseBandug apho iinkokheli zombutho wethu ezinguMoses Kotane noMaulvi Cachalia zeza nemithetho-siseko yokungabandlululi ngokobuhlanga kunye nokuzimela kwi-ajenda yehlabathi.3 IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bazibandakanye nemibhiyozo yeNyanga yeNkululeko, esisikhokelo nepheleka ukuqala kwendlela eya kwiminyaka engamashumi amathathu yenkululeko ngokukhulisa isidima somntu nokulandela i-ajenda yomntu wonke kazwelonke eya ekwakheni uMzantsi Afrika omanyeneyo nonempumelelo.

src: Aforika Borwa e ithaopile ho tshwara seboka sena kamora hoba Rephaboliki ya Chad e ikgule.
tgt: Imibhiyozo yethu kazwelonke iza kuphelela kuSuku lweNkululeko, umhla wama-27 kuTshazimpunzi ngowama-2015 phantsi kwesihloko esithi: “Ukuvuyisana nesiQalo semiNyaka eliShumi yesiThathu yeNkululeko yethu ngokunyusa isantya seNguqu eGqibeleleyo yezoQoqosho”.Abemi boMzantsi Afrika kwakhona bayakhunjuzwa ngokuzincama kaninzi kwenzalelwane zeli lizwe kunye noomama ekulweni nenkqubo yocalucalulo olunobungonyama ukuze sikwazi ukuxhamla le nkululeko sinayo namhlanje.

src: Ditlhaselo tsa moraorao tjena tsa melata.
tgt: Uhlaselo lakutsha nje lwabemi bamazwe angaphandle.

src: Kabinete e ananela kgotso le kgutso e bonahalang e leng teng metseng e neng e anngwe ke ditlhaselo tsa moraorao tjena tsa melata.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaluvuyela uxolo nocwangco oluqalisa ukubakho kwiindawo ebezichatshazelwa luhlaselo lakutsha nje lwabemi bamazwe angaphandle.

src: Kabinete e thoholeditse mafapha a sebeditseng ka Setsi sa Naha sa Tshebetso sa Kopanelo bakeng sa ho fedisa diketso tsa merusu tse etsahetseng KwaZulu-Natal le Gauteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwancomile amasebe asebenzise iNational Joint Operation Centre ukunqanda izenzo zobundlobongela ezenzeka KwaZulu-Natal naseGauteng.

src: Kabinete e thoholeditse baetapele ba diporofense le bomasepala dibakeng tse neng di amehile bakeng sa karolo ya bona ya ho fana ka pebofaletso le ho etella pele morero wa ho kopanya botjha melata le badudi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi income iinkokheli zamaphondo nezikamasipala kwimimandla echaphazelekileyo ngendima yazo ekuncedeni nasekukhokheleni ukubuyiselwa kwabemi bamazwe angaphandle apho bebehlala khona.

src: Bekeng e fetileng, Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o ile a bitsa dikopano tsa bankakarolo le baemedi ba dikgwebo, dihlopha tsa bodumedi, mekgatlo ya basebetsi, ya setjhaba le ya melata.
tgt: Kule veki iphelileyo, uMongameli uJacob Zuma ubize intlanganiso yabameli bezoshoshino, amaqela ezenkolo, abasebenzi, abahlali kunye nabemi bamazwe angaphandle.

src: Dipuisano e ne e le tse ahang bakeng sa ho thusa tabeng ya ho ntshetsa tsamaiso ena pele.
tgt: Ezi ntlanganiso zanceda ekuqhubeleni phambili lo mcimbi.

src: Bankakarolo bohle ba ile ba dumellana ka lentswe le le leng tabeng ya ho hlahisa ho tshwela ka mathe ditlhaselo tsena le ho itlama ho sebetsa le mmuso ho fumaneng tharollo ya moshwelella.
tgt: Bonke abathathi-nxaxheba bavumelana ngazwi nye ekugxekeni olu hlaselo baza bazinikela ekusebenzeni norhulumente ekufumaneni isisombululo esiya kuhlala sihleli.

src: Komiti e Kopanetsweng ya Matona (IMC) e thontsweng moraorao tjena mabapi le Bofalli e sebetsa bakeng sa ho fumana tharollo ya moshwelella mabapi le dintlha tse hlahisitsweng ke badudi le melata.
tgt: IKomiti yabaPhathiswa yezeMfuduko esandula ukunyulwa iyasebenza ifuna isisombululo esiya kuhla sihleli semiba evezwe ngabahlali nabemi bamazwe angaphandle.

src: Diqeto tsa Bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Izigqibo ezingundoqo zeKhabhinethi.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka kgatelopele e entsweng mabapi le Rejisetara ya Thepa e sa Sutheng ya Mmuso wa Naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yaziswa ngenkqubela malunga neRejista yoMhlaba neZakhiwo kaRhulumente weSizwe.

src: Lekala la Ditshebeletso tsa Boingodiso ba Matlo le se le thehilwe ho tloha ka la 01 Mmesa 2015.
tgt: Icandelo leeNkonzo zeRejista yoMhlaba neZakhiwo Zawo lisekiwe ukususela ngomhla woku-01 kuTshazimpunzi ngowama-2015.

src: Lekala lena le tla laolwa ka hara Setheo sa Bolaodi ba Kgwebisano ya Thepa ya Bodulo mme le tla okamela thepa ya Puso e sa sutheng.
tgt: Eli candelo liza kulawulwa likwi-Property Management Trading Entity yaye liza kongamela iimpahla zikaRhulumente.

src: Le tla sebetsa jwaloka setsi sa poloko se le seng sa thepa e sa sutheng ya Puso, mme le tla fana ka bodisa, bolaodi le peho-leihlo ya Rejisetara ya Thepa e sa Sutheng ya Mmuso.
tgt: Liza kuba nguvimba ekukuphela kwakhe wezakhiwo nomhlaba kaRhulumente, longamele, lilawule, libeke iso kwiRejista yoMhlaba neZakhiwo zoMbuso.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho lokollwa ha Moralo wa Leano mabapi le Lebollo la Setso bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele ka ona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukukhutshwa kweDrafti yoMgaqo-nkqubo weSiko loLwaluko ukuze uluntu luhlomle kuyo.

src: Morero wa leano lena ke ho batla ho tshireletsa, ho kgothaletsa le ho laola lebollo ka ho sisinya mekgwa le maemo a amohelehang mme hape le ho qala mekgatlo boemong ba naha le ba diporofense.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo ukhusela, ukhuthaza yaye ulawula isiko lolwaluko ngokuthi ucebise malunga nezithethe nemigangatho eyamkelekileyo, yaye ubonelele nangamaziko kwinqanaba lesizwe nelamaphondo.

src: Le tla netefatsa hore mabollo a etsahala ka hara tikoloho e laolehang.
tgt: Uza kuqinisekisa ukuba ulwaluko lwenzeka kwimeko elawulekayo.

src: Sena se etsa karolo ya mehato e nkuwang ke mmuso ho hatella mekgwa e nepahetseng, e amohelehang ya mesebetsi ya setso le ho busetsa maemo a amohelehang a boikarabello ao esale a sebediswa bakeng sa dilemo tse telele.
tgt: Le yinxalenye yamanyathelo karhulumente okomeleza amasiko afanelekileyo namkelekileyo, nokuvuselela inqanaba elamkelekileyo lokuzimela elalisa kulondoloza eli siko eminyakeni emininzi.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Lenaneo le kopanetsweng la mmuso la Bodulo ba Batho bakeng sa Masepala wa Nelson Mandela Bay le tla sebedisa Lekala la Ntshetsopele ya Matlo jwaloka motjha wa ho kenya mesebetsi ya lona tshebetsong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume iNkqubo yoorhulumente abahlukeneyo yokuHlaliswa koLuntu kuMasipala waseNelson Mandela Bay neza kusebenzisa iZiko loPhuhliso lweZindlu njengearhente eza kuzalisekisa oku.4 IKhabhinethi ivume ukubanjelwa kweNkongolo yoNyaka yeHlabathi yoLwazi lwamaThala eeNcwadi yoMfelandawonye weMibutho namaZiko amaThala eeNcwadi eKapa ukususela ngomhla we-15 ukuya kowama-21 kweyeThupha ngowama-2015 phantsi kwesihloko esithi,"Amathala eeNcwadi ale Mihla: Ukufikelela, uPhuhliso neeNguqu”.5 IKhabhinethi ivume ukuthiwa thaca kweSivumelwano sokuPhelisa ukuShishina okungekho Mthethweni ngeeVeliso zeCuba.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tshwarwa ha Seboka sa Matjhaba sa Mekgatlo ya Dilaeborari le Ditheo tsa Seboka sa Selemo le Selemo sa Tlhahisoleseding ya Dilaeborari tsa Lefatshe ho la Motse Kapa ho tloha ka la 15 ho isa ho la 21 Phato 2015 tlasa mookotaba "Dilaeborari tse Hlwahlwa: Phihlello, Ntshetsopele le Diphethoho".
tgt: Oku kuhambelana nesiNkqubo-sikhokelo yeSivumelwano sokuLawulwa kweCuba soMbutho wezeMpilo weHlabathi esatyikitywa nguMzantsi Afrika ngoTshazimpunzi ngowama-2005.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tekwa ha Tumellano ya ho Fedisa Kgwebo e seng Molaong ya Dihlahiswa tsa Kwae.
tgt: Esi sivumelwano siza kunceda amazwe ukuba athathe amanyathelo edibene alwe ukurhweba ngeemveliso zecuba ngokungekho mthethweni ngokukodwa ngamazwe atyikitye esi Sivumelwano.

src: Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa hajwale.
tgt: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba egqubayo.

src: Kabinete e hlahisitse matshediso a yona ho malapa a bao ba hlokahalletseng dikotsing tsa dipalangwang tsa moraorao tjena tse ileng tsa kenyeletsa ho thulana ha dibese tse pedi Johannesburg bekeng e fetileng le ho thulana ha diterene bekeng ena Seteisheneng sa Denver ka borwa ho Johannesburg.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise amazwi ovelwano kwiintsapho zabo basweleke kutsha nje kwiingozi zezithuthi zikawonke-wonke eziquke ukutshayisana kweebhasi ezimbini eGoli kule veki iphelileyo kunye nokutshayisana koololiwe kule veki kwiSitishi saseDenver kumzantsi weGoli.

src: Kabinete e tshepa hore dipatlisiso ka mafapha a amehang di tla fatolla disosa tsa dikotsi tsena le ho netefatsa hore dikotsi tse kang tsena ha di etsahale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqinisekile okokuba uphando oluza kwenziwa ngamasebe afanelekileyo aza kumfumana unobangela wezi ngozi, aqinisekise okokuba iingozi ezinje aziphinde zenzeke.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le Moporesidente Zuma ka ho fetisa matshediso a yona ho lelapa, metswalle le ho barati bohle ba bolo ya maoto ka ho hlokahala ha qhoku ya mehleng ya Bafana Bafana John “Shoes” Moshoeu ya bolokuweng ka Mantaha, 27 Mmesa 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi njengoMongameli uZuma nayo ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano kusapho, abahlobo nabathandi bebhola ekhatywayo ngokushiywa ngowayesakuba yimbalasane yebhola ekhatywayo kwiBafana Bafana, uJohn “Shoes” Moshoeu, ongcwatywe ngoMvulo umhla wama-27 kuTshazimpunzi kowama-2015.

src: O tla dula a hopolwa jwaloka sebapadi sa bolo se neng se na le talente e babatsehang haholo se bapetseng karolo ya bohlokwa tlholong ya rona ya Mohope wa Dinaha tsa Aforika wa 1996.
tgt: Uya kusoloko ekhunjulwa njengoyena mdlali webhola ekhatywayo owayenesona siphiwo owadlala indima ebalulekileyo ekuphumeleleni kwethu iNdebe yeZizwe zase-Afrika ngowe-1996.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le Moporesidente Zuma ka ho fetisa matshediso ho Mmuso le batho ba Rephaboliki ya Demokerasi ya Bofederale ya Nepal, ho latela ho reketla ha lefatshe ho matla ka Moqebelo, 25 Mmesa 2015, ho nkileng maphelo a batho ba dikete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi njengoMongameli uZuma nayo ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano kuoRhulumente kunye nabantu belizwe laseNepal, emva kwenyikima enkulukazi ngoMgqibelo umhla wama-25 kuTshazimpunzi kowama-2015, eyasuba imiphefumlo engamawaka-waka.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa mekgatlo eo e seng ya mmuso ya Aforika Borwa eo e seng e rometse dithuso tsa botho Nepal.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithulela umnqwazi imibutho engekho phantsi kukarhulumente yaseMzantsi Afrika esele ithumele uncedo lwezentlalontle eNepal.

src: Kabinete e hlahisitse matshediso a tebileng ho lelapa la Moborikadiri Mokgenerale Bita ya hlokahetseng a le dilemo tse 75 ho la Tanzania.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano kusapho lukaBrigadier General Bita osweleke eneminyaka engama-75 eTanzania.

src: Moborikadiri Mokgenerale Bita o sebeditse jwaloka Mongodi wa Phethahatso wa Komiti ya Tokoloho ho Mokgatlo wa Kopano ya Aforika (OAU) wa mehleng.
tgt: UBrigadier General Bita usebenze njengoNobhala weSigqeba soLawulo weKomiti yeNkululeko yombutho owawusakwaziwa njengeMbumba ye-Afrika (i-OAU).

src: E ne e le moamohedi wa Kgau ya Metswalle ya O. Tambo ya Gauta, e leng tlhompho e kgolohadi eo Aforika Borwa e fanang ka yona ho melata.
tgt: Wafumana imbasa yeGolide ye-Order of the Companions of OR Tambo, elelona wonga liphezulu uMzantsi Afrika owonga ngalo abemi bamazwe angaphandle.

src: Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Imisitho ezayo.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla kenela Sehopotso sa bo70 sa Tlholo e Kgolo ya Ntwa ya Lerato la Naha (Ntwa ya Lefatshe ya II) Red Square ho la Moscow ka la 9 Motsheanong 2015.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uza kuya kwimibhiyozo yeminyaka yama-70 yeMpumelelo kwiMfazwe yesiBini yeHlabathi eRed Square eMoscow ngomhla we-9 kuCanzibe ngowama-2015.

src: O tla boela a tshware dipuisano tsa dinaha ka bobedi le Moporesidente wa Russia Vladimir Putin.
tgt: Uza kuba nentllanganiso yala mazwe mabini noMongameli waseRussia uVladimir Putin.

src: Leeto lena le tla ahella hodima dikamano tsa hajwale tsa bobedi bona le Mokgatlo wa Russia bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa ho ya pele tshebedisanommoho dintlheng tse ngatanyana.
tgt: Olu tyelelo luza kongeza kubudlelwane obukhoyo nelizwe laseRussia ukuqhubela phambili intsebenziswano kumacandelo amaninzi.

src: Bakeng sa ho keteka Letsatsi la Basebetsi (1 Motsheanong 2015), Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho basebetsi bohle ho kopana le ho aha moruo wa Aforika Borwa, le ho nehela ho kontinente le lefatshe.
tgt: Xa kubhiyozelwa uSuku lwaBasebenzi ngoumhla woku-1 kuCanzibe kowama-2015, iKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abasebenzi ukuba bamanyane bakhe uqoqosho loMzantsi Afrika yaye babe nalo negalelo kwilizwekazi nakwihlabathi liphela.

src: Ho tloha ka 1994 mmuso o ntsheditse pele ditokelo tsa basebetsi e leng se bakileng hore basebetsi ba kgole molemo ho tloha tlhahisong ya basebetsi ba tswelang pele le tshireletso ya melemo ya kahisano.
tgt: Ukususela kowe-1994 urhulumente uwaqhubele phambili amalungelo abasebenzi, nto leyo eyenze ukuba abasebenzi baxhamle kumaqithiqithi enkqubela okukhuselwa kwezemisebenzi nezentlalo.

src: Mafapha a Naha a tla teka dipuo tsa ona tsa ditekanyetso Palamenteng mahareng a la 5 le la 21 Motsheanong 2015 ho hlakisa mesebetsi ya ona e ka sehloohong bakeng sa selemo sa hajwale sa ditjhelete.
tgt: Amasebe esizwe aza kuthi thaca iivoti zohlahlo lwabiwo-mali zawo ePalamente phakathi komhla we-5 nowama-21 kuCanzibe kowama-2015 agqamise izinto eziphambili aza kuzenza kulo nyaka-mali sikuwo.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa oohle ho latela dipuo tsa ditekanyetso mapatlelong a fapafapaneng a boraditaba hore a tle a utlwisise betere ha Matona a hlahisa meralo bakeng sa Lenaneo la Tshebetso la Mmuso (PoA).
tgt: IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bazilandele ezi voti zohlahlo lwabiwo-mali kumaqonga ngamaqonga amajelo eendaba ukuze baqonde ngcono xa abaPhathiswa besandlala izicwangciso zabo zeNkqubo yokuSebenza kaRhulumente (i-PoA).

src: Lefapha la Bohahlaodi mmoho le ba Bohahlaodi ba Aforika Borwa ba tla tshwara INDABA 2015 ho tloha ka la 9 ho isa ho la 11 Motsheanong 2015 Setsing sa Matjhaba sa Dikopano sa Inkosi Albert Luthuli ho la Durban.
tgt: ISebe lezoKhenketho kunye nezoKhenketho zoMzantsi Afrika ziza kubamba INDABA 2015 ukususela ngomhla we-9 ukuya kowe-11 kowama-2015 kwiZiko leeNgqungquthela laMazwe ngamazwe i-Inkosi Albert Luthuli eDurban.

src: Ketsahalo ena ya seAforika ke lepatlelo le hlokolosi bakeng sa ho hodisa dihlahiswa tsa rona tsa bohahlaodi mmarakeng wa matjhaba.
tgt: Lo msitho waMazwe ase-Afrika Onke liqonga elibalulekileyo lokukhuthaza nokuthengisa iimveliso zethu zezokhenketho kumazwe ngamazwe.

src: Hape e tshehetsa pono ya mawala a Lekala la Naha la Mawala a Bohahlaodi bakeng sa ho hodisa palo ya baeti ba matjhaba ba kenang ka hara naha ho ya ho 15 milione ka 2020 mme kahoo ho hlahiswe mesebetsi e 225 000 e metjha.
tgt: Ukwaxhasa nombono obalulekileyo wesiCwangciso-qhinga seSizwe seCandelo lezoKhenketho wokunyusa inani labafikayo bevela kumazwe ngamazwe lifikelele kwizigidi ezili-15 ngonyaka wama-2020, ngaloo ndlela kudaleke imisebenzi emitsha engama-225 000.

src: Kabinete e ananela Seboka sa bo5 sa Bong sa Aforika, e leng sa pele ho tshwarelwa kontinenteng ya Aforika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkela iNgqungquthela yesiHlanu yezeSini yase-Afrika, eyeyokuqala ukubanjelwa kweli lizwekazi lase-Afrika.

src: Seboka se tshwaretswe Setsing sa Matjhaba sa Dikopano ho la Motse Kapa.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ibibanjelwa kwiZike leeNgqungquthela laMazwe ngamazwe laseKapa Le ngqungquthela liqonga lamaqela ngamaqela nemibutho ngemibutho eliquka onke amanqanaba ophandonzulu ngezonzululwazi.

src: Seboka ke lepatlelo bakeng sa dihlopha le mekgatlo ho parola le maemo oohle a diphuputso tsa saense bakeng sa ho sebetsana le dintlha tsa bong tse amang bohle.
tgt: Iza kujongana nemiba yesini echaphazela ngokufanayo.

src: Seboka sena se tshwarweng ke Lekgotla la Diphuputso tsa Disaense tsa Botho se matlafatsa lenaneo la Aforika la diphuputso hore saense, thekenoloji, dikaho tsa motheo, tjhelete, bokgoni le tlhahisoleseding di kgone ho tshehetsa betere ntshetsopele ya kontinente.
tgt: Intlanganiso iza kusingathwa liBhunga loPhando ngeNzululwazi yoLuntu yaye iqinisa i-ajenda ye-Afrika ukuze inzululwazi, ubuchwepheshe, amaziko akhoyo, imali, izakhono kunye novimba wolwazi zikwazi ukuxhasa ngcono uphuhliso lwelizwekazi.

src: Lefapha la Metsi le Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere le tla tshwaya Beke ya Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere le Bohlweki ho tloha ka la 11 ho isa ho la 15 Motsheanong 2015 tlasa mookotaba “Ha se feela ka ho folasha”.Beke ena, e ileng ya kgakolwa la pele Foramong ya Global WASH e neng e tshwaretswe Dakar, ho la Senegal ka 2004, e reretswe ho hlahisa temoso ka bohlokwa ba tsamaiso ya dikgwerekgwere le ho hodisa ditshebetso tse hlwahlwa tsa tsamaiso ya dikgwerekgwere.
tgt: ISebe laManzi noGutyulo liza kuphawula iVeki yoGutyulo noCoceko ukususela ngomhla we-11 ukuya kowe-15 kuCanzibe ngowama-2015 phantsi kwesihloko esithi, “Ayikokungxula kuphela” .Iveki le, eyaziswa okokuqala kwi-Global WASH Forum eyayibanjelwe eDakar, eSenegal ngowama-2004, injongo yayo kukufundisa ngokubaluleka kogutyulo yaye ikhuthaza nolona gutyulo lufanelekileyo.

src: Ho tloha ka 1994 mmuso o entse menyabuketso e meholo bakeng sa phano ya ho fihlella metsi le tsamaiso ya dikgwerekgwere.
tgt: Ukususela ngowe-1994 urhulumente wenze imitsi ebonakalayo yokubonelela ngamanzi nogutyulo.

src: Ho tloha ka Loetse 2013, Lefapha la Metsi le Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere le fedisitse tshebediso ya mabakete a 14 386 naheng ka bophara.
tgt: Ukususela kweyoMsintsi ngowama-2013, iSebe lezaManzi noGutyulo likuphelise nya ukusetyenziswa kwamabhakethe angama-14 386 elizweni liphela.

src: Mmuso o sa dutse o itlamme bakeng sa ho fedisa tshallomorao ya tshebediso ya mabakete ka hohlehohle ho badudi ba rona bohle.
tgt: Urhulumente umi ekuzinikeleni ekupheliseni nya amasalela enkqubo yamabhakethe kwiindawo ezihlala abantu bakuthi.

src: Dintlha tsa Bohlokwa ka hara tikoloho.
tgt: Imiba edla umzi.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o tla etella pele mekete ya Letsatsi la Aforika tlasa mookotaba: “Re Aforika – Re bula mamati a ho ithuta le botjhaba ho tloha Kapa ho ya Cairo” ka la 24 Motsheanong 2015 khemphaseng ya Mamelodi ya Yunivesithi ya Pretoria.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kukhokela imibhiyozo yoSuku lwe-Afrika phantsi komxholo othi: “Siyi-Afrika – Ukuvula amasango okufunda nenkcubeko ukusuka eKapa ukuya kuma ngeCairo” ngomhla wama-24 kuCanzibe ngowama-2015 kwiKhampasi eseMamelodi yeDyunivesiti yasePitoli.

src: Ka moya wa Letsatsi la Aforika, Kabinete e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa, ka ho qolleha batjha, ho sebetsa mmoho bakeng sa ho matlafatsa bonkakarolo ba bona mererong ya naha ya rona.
tgt: Ngomoya woSuku lwe-Afrika, iKhabinethi ikhuthaza abemi boMzantsi Afrika, ingakumbi ulutsha, ukuba basebenzisane ukuze bathathe inxaxheba ngamandla kwimiba edla ilizwe.

src: Kgwedi ya Aforika ke lepatlelo la ho hodisa kopano hara ditjhaba tsa Aforika le bana ba bo rona ba dulang ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Inyanga ye-Afrika ilithuba lokukhuthaza ubumbano kwizizwe zase-Afrika kunye naphakathi kwethu nabantakwethu noodade abahlala apha eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kopano ya kontinente e kgannwa ke mananeo a Kopano ya Aforika a ho fihlella pono ya yona jwaloka ha e tekilwe ho Lenaneo la 2063.
tgt: Ubumbano lweli lizwekazi lukhokelwa zinkqubo zeMbumba ye-Afrika zokufezekisa umbono ocaciswe kwi-Ajenda 2063.

src: Kontinente, e tataiswa ke baahi ba yona, e tla tsitlallela Aforika e momahaneng, e tswetseng pele le e nang le kgotso.
tgt: Eli lizwekazi, likhokelwa ngabemi balo, lisebenzela i-Afrika, edibineyo, enoxolo nenekamva eliqaqambileyo.

src: Letsatsi la Aforika hape le hlahisa monyetla bakeng sa maAforika Borwa hore a tsebane botjha le ho itlama botjha bakeng sa ho tshehetsa boitshunyako bohle ba mmuso ho ntshetsapele Aforika e betere le lefatshe le betere.
tgt: USuku lwe-Afrika lunika ithuba kubemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bavuselele ubambiswano futhi bazibophelele kwakhona ekuxhaseni onke amanyathelo okungenelela karhulumente ukuze kuphuhliswe i-Afrika engcono nehlabathi elingcono.

src: Mookotaba wa Kgwedi ya Aforika, “Re Aforika”, ke pehelo ya tiisetso le ya keteko ya boikgantsho bo kgothaletsang kenyeletso ho tswa ho bankakarolo bohle.
tgt: Umxholo weNyanga ye-Afrika,”Siyi-Afrika”, sisibhambathiso nezwi lokuzingca elibethelela ukungabukulani phakathi kwabo bonke abachaphazelekayo.

src: Hape ke kgoeletso ho batho ka bo mong le dihlopha ho tswa ka makgalo oohle a bophelo ho itahlela ka setotswana mohoong wa diphethoho.
tgt: Ikwalikhelo elijoliswe kumlisela nomthinajana nakumaqela aphuma mbombo zone zeli ukuba azibandakanye kweli phulo lokuzisa umahluko notshintsho.

src: Kabinete e ananela welcomes Operation Fiela\Reclaim 2015, e leng tshebetso ya dintlha tse ngatanyana ka dipopeho tse fapafapaneng tsa mmuso ho netefatsa ho imatahanya ka matla le melao e fapafapaneng le melawana e laolang setjhaba sa rona.
tgt: IKhabinethi iyayamkela i-Operation Fiela\Reclaim 2015, eliphulo logqogqo eliqhutywa ngamacandelo ahlukeneyo ombuso ukuqinisekisa ukuba imithetho nemimselo elawula eli lizwe iyathotyelwa.

src: Sepheo sa tshebetso ena ke ho sebetsana le dintlha tsa botlokotsebe tse kang dibetsa tse seng molaong, mahaha a dithethefatsi, maqulwana a bootswa le mesebetsi e meng ya botlokotsebe.
tgt: Eli phulo linenjongo zokulwa imikhuba yolwaphulo-mthetho efana nezixhobo ezingekho mthethweni, iindawo zemigulukudu yeziyobisi, izihange ezishishina ngabathengisa ngemizimba, kunye neminye imikhwa yolwaphulo-mthetho.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa hore tshebetso ena ha e ya lebiswa ho melata, empa diketsong tsa botlokotsebe ka hara naha ya rona jwaloka ha di utulutswe ka letoto la dipuisano le badudi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakubethelela ukuba eli phulo logqogqo alimiselwanga ukungcungcuthekisa kuzingelwa abemi bamazwe angaphandle, koko lisekelwe ukulwa ulwaphulo-mthetho kweli lizwe njengoko lukhalazelwe kakhulu kwiintlanganiso zokufakana imilomo noluntu.

src: Tabeng ena, Kabinete e hanana ka matla le mohopolo wa hore tshebetso ena e lebisitswe ho melata.
tgt: Ke ngoko, iKhabhinethi izikhaba ngawo omane izityholo zokuba eli phulo lijoliswe kubemi bangaphandle.

src: Jwaloka naha e ikgantshang ka ho ba le Molaotheo o lokolohileng ka ho fetisisa lefatsheng, re nkile ketapele e bohareng mabapi le dintlha tsa ditokelo tsa botho, kahoo re keke ra dumella tshebetso e tla tlola melao ya ditokelo tsa botho tsa motho ofe kapa ofe ka dihlopha dife kapa dife.
tgt: Njengelizwe elizingca ngokuba noMgaqo-siseko onguwona uwagade kakhulu amalungelo abantu nohlonitshwa kwihlabathi liphela, sakuhlala sidlala indima enkulu kwimiba engamalungelo oluntu, ke ngoko asisoze sivume iphulo eliza kunyhasha amalungelo oluntu alo naliphi na iqela okanye abantu.

src: Kabinete e thabetse kgatelopele e entsweng ka Operation Fiela, eo esale e thakgolwa e entseng hore ho be le ho tshwarwa ho ho ngatanyana matsholong a ho kgwasa dibaka tse nang le mathata haholo ho parola le naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yanelisekile yindlela eqhuba ngayo i-Operation Fiela, ekungoku ukusukela oko yaqaliswayo, esele ikhokelele ekubanjweni kwabantu abaninzi kwiindawo ezahlukeneyo ebezigqogqwa ezihamba phambili ngolwaphulo-mthetho neminye imikhuba.

src: Kabinete e ananela karabelo ho tswa ho setjhaba se imatahantseng le bahlanka ba molao bakeng sa ho etsa bonnete ba hore bohle ba bolokehile le ho ikutlwa ba bolokehile ka hara naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela indlela uluntu olulwamkele ngayo olu gqogqo ngokubambisana namagosa ogcino-mthetho ekuqinisekiseni ukuba wonke umntu uziva ekhuselekile kweli lizwe.

src: Tshebetso ena, e matlafatsang ntwa kgahlanong le botlokotsebe, e thusa hape ho hodisa le ho bopa Aforika Borwa e batlang e bolokehile le ho tshireletseha.
tgt: Eli phulo, eliqinisa nangakumbi idabi lokulwa nolwaphulo-mthetho, likwanceda nasekukhuthazeni nasekudaleni uMzantsi Afrika ukhuseleke nangakumbi.

src: Komiti e Kopanetsweng ya Matona ya Bofalli e tla kopana le boraditaba ho ba beha sehlohlolong ka mosebetsi wa yona ohle, ho kenyeletswa le Operation Fiela.
tgt: IKomiti yabaPhathiswa ngoFuduko iza kubamba intlanganiso noonondaba kule mpelaveki ngeenjongo zokubanika iingxelo ngeza kutsha nje ngawo wonke umsebenzi wayo, kuquka ne-Operation Fiela.

src: Ho Kenngwa Tshebetsong ha Mananeo a Bohlokwa a Mmuso.
tgt: Ukufezekiswa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ezingundoqo.

src: Kabinete e ananela dipuo tsa ditekanyetso tsa mafapha a fapafapaneng le ho thabela ditlaleho tse tebileng tseo Matona a fanneng ka tsona mabapi le kgatelopele eo a e entseng bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa bophelo ba batho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamkela iivoti zohlahlo lwabiwo-mali zamasebe ahlukeneyo kwaye yanelisekile zingxelo ezityebileyo ezinikwa ngabaPhathiswa ngendlela abaqhuba ngayo kwimizamo yabo yokuphucula iimpilo zabantu.

src: Ditsebiso di ile tsa hlalosa ho ya pele ka meralo ya mafapha a bona ka ho fapana bakeng sa selemo sena sa ditjhelete.
tgt: Ezi ngxelo zikwatyebise nezicwangciso zamasebe abo kulo nyaka-mali.

src: Kabinete e ananela ho thakgolwa ha Boikitlaetso ba Moetapele ke Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae kantorong ya lona ya Edenvale ka la 12 Motsheanong 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuphehlelelwa kwePhulo iMoetapele liSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya kwii-ofisi zalo ezise-Edenvale ngomhla we-12 kuCanzibe ngowama-2015.

src: Sepheo sa Boikitlaetso bona ke ho fetolela tse ding tsa dikantoro ho ‘dikantoro tsa popota’ jwaloka dithuthuhiso tsa mosebetsi o hlwahlwa ka ho fetisisa.
tgt: Eli phulo linenjongo yokuguqula ezinye zezi ofisi zibe ‘zi-ofisi ezingumzekelo’ wee-ofisi ezibonisa indlela yokusebenza ekwizinga eliphezulu.

src: Sena se tla matlafatsa phano ya ditshebeletso tse hlokolosi ho maAforika Borwa le ho ba thusa ho fumantshwa ditshebeletso tsa mmuso ka bokgabane.
tgt: Oku kuza kuba negalelo kumsebenzi wokuhanjiswa kweenkonzo ezibalulekileyo kubemi boMzantsi Afrika nokubanceda ukuba bakwazi ukufikelela kwiinkonzo zikarhulumente ngokulula.

src: Kabinete hape e ananela ho thakgolwa ha Dikgau tsa Bofalli tsa Aforika Borwa tse tla tlotla bafalli ba hlahelletseng ka mahetla ka hara Aforika Borwa le maAforika Borwa a sebetsang dinaheng tsa Aforika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamkela neMbasa zoMzantsi Afrika zabaFuduki eziza kubanjwa okokuqala kuwongwa abafuduki abanemisebenzi ebalaseleyo eMzantsi Afrika nabemi boMzantsi Afrika abasebenza kumanye amazwe ase-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e ipeletsa ho badudi ho kgetha ba ba nang le moya wa Botho e bile ba inehetse ntshetsopeleng ya kontinente ya Aforika ka ho romela imeile ho EMAILTOKEN di kwalwa ka la 20 Motsheanong 2015 mme bahlodi ba tla tsebiswa ka Letsatsi la Aforika (25 Motsheanong).
tgt: IKhabhinethi imemelela uluntu ukuba luphakamise amagama okanye lonyule abantu abangumzekelo omhle womoya wobuntu nabazinikele kwidabi lokuphuhlisa eli lizwekazi le-Afrika.

src: Mokgahlelo o kgahlisang ka ho fetisisa wa dikgau tsena ke o tla ananela badudi ba Aforika Borwa ba atlehileng ho amohela melata ka hara bona le ho phela mmoho ka kgotso.
tgt: Amagama abo banyuliwe mawathunyelwe kule imeyile: EMAILTOKEN amagama aphakanyisiweyo kuza kuvalwa ngomhla wama-20 kuCanzibe ngowama-2015, bona abo baphumeleleyo baza kwaziswa ngoSuku lwe-Afrika (umhla wama-25 kuCanzibe).

src: Kabinete e ananela ho ntshwa ha dikantoro tsa hloma-o-hlomolle naheng ka bophara bakeng sa ho thusa bohle ba lokelang ho kenya dittseko tsa bona tsa mobu.
tgt: Icandelo eliza kutsala umdla kakhulu kwezi mbasa leli liza kuwonga ummandla apha eMzantsi Afrika owamkele abemi bangaphandle ngempumelelo kuba babe yinxalenye yabahlali kwaye bahlalisana nabo ngoxolo.

src: Sena ke tlatsetso ya dikantoro tse 14 tsa ditseko tse teng diporofenseng kaofela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuqalisa kokusebenza kwee-ofisi ezingomahamba-nandlwana zamabango omhlaba kulo lonke eli ukuze kuncedwe abantu abanelungelo lokufaka ibango bawafake amabango.

src: Tsamaiso ena ke karolo e pharaletseng ya dikgokahanyo tsa naha tsa ho fihlella bohle ya ho kenya tshebetsong Sehlomathiso sa Molao wa Tlhabollo ya Ditokelo tsa Mobu wa 2014, se saennweng ho ba molao ke Mopresidente Zuma.
tgt: Ezi ofisi zongeza kwezi ofisi zamabango zikhoyo zili-14 kumaphondo onke eli.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Molao wa Tlhabollo ya Ditokelo tsa Mobu se fana ka puseletso kapa tlhabollo e lekalekanang ho batho le badudi ba ileng ba nkelwa ditokelo tsa mobu kamora 19 Phuptjane 1913.MaAforika oohle a nang le tokelo a fetilweng ke nako ya letsatsi le neng le behilwe e le la ho qetela la 31 Tshitwe 1998 bakeng sa ho kenya ditseko a na le monyetla o atolositsweng ho fihla ka la 30 Phuptjane 2019.
tgt: Le nkqubo iyinxalenye yeqhinga elizeleyo lesizwe lokunxibelelana elifezekisa uMthetho-sihlomelo wokuBuyiselwa kwamaLungelo oMhlaba wowama-2014, owatyikitywa wangumthetho nguMongameli Zuma.

src: Kabinete e ananela kopano ya Letona la Mehlodi ya Diminerale le baemedi ba indaseteri ya merafo le bankakarolo ba bang ho tshohla sephetho sa Tekolo ya Tlaleho ya Tjhata ya Merafo ya 2015.
tgt: UMthetho-sihlomelo wokuBuyiselwa kwamaLungelo oMhlaba unika igunya lokubuyiselwa okanye ukwabelwa ngokulinganayo komhlaba nabantu kunye noluntu olwaluhluthelwe amalungelo omhlaba emva komhla we-19 kweyoKwindla ngowe-1913.Bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika abanelungelo abawuphosayo umhla wokuqala owawumisiwe wama-31 kweyoMnga ngowe-1998 ukuba bafake amabango ukuba babe nelinye ithuba elongezelekileyo kude kube ngumhla wama-30 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2019 lokuba benze njalo.

src: Tlaleho ena e metha kgatelopele ya dintlha tse robong tsa bohlokwa tsa Tjhata ya Merafo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela intlanganiso yoMphathiswa wemiThombo yeziMbiwa kunye nabameli kunye namahlakani ecandelo lezemigodi yokuxoxa iziphumo zeNgxelo yoHlolo lowama-2014 loMqulu wezeMigodi.

src: Tjhata ya Merafo e ile ya hlahiswa ka morero wa ho kganna lenaneo la diphethoho ka hara lekala le hlokolosi la moruo wa naha.
tgt: Le ngxelo ihlola umgama ohanjiweyo kumasolotya aphambili oMqulu wezeMigodi.

src: Dintlha tse tshwanetseng ho methwa di tobile ho hlabolla ho se lekalekane ha nako e fetileng ka bobedi karolelanong ya leruo le ba neng ba tinngwe menyetla pele le ntshetsopele ya mehlodi ya batho le thuo ya merafo.
tgt: UMqulu wezeMigodi waqulunqwa ngenjongo yokukhokela umsebenzi wokuzisa iinguqu kwicandelo lemigodi, elilelibaluleke kakhulu kuqoqosho lweli lizwe.

src: Foramo ena ya matjhaba e bokanya mmoho ditsebi ho tsa boipaballo diporong ho tswa lefatsheng ka bophara ho kgaogana tlhahisoleseding, diphihlello, dithuto le ditshebetso tse hlwahlwa ka ho fetisisa bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa boipaballo diporong.
tgt: Imimandla ekuza kugxininiswa kuyo izama ukulungisa umonakalo oweza nemithetho yangaphambili eyayixhasa ukungalingani ngokwendlela ekwabelwana ngayo ngobutyebi nabo babehlelelekile ngaphambili nokuphuhliswa kwabo kunye nebango lobunini bemigodi.

src: Sena se fuwa sekgahla ho feta ke matsete a haufinyana tjena a Aforika Borwa ho makala a diterene tsa batho le thepa, e leng se ntseng hore naha e kgone ho hohela matsete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukusingathwa kweNtlanganiso yama-25 yaMazwe ngamazwe yeBhunga loKhuseleko kooLoliwe eza kubanjelwa kwiZiko leeNgqungquthela laMazwe ngamazwe laseSandton, eRhawutini ngomhla we-4 ukuya kowe-9 kweyeDwarha ngowama-2015.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Tjhata ya Dipalangwang tsa Mawatle a Aforika hore e tliswe ka hara Palamente bakeng sa ho amohelwa.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela yamazwe ngamazwe iza kudibanisa iingcali zezokhuseleko koololiwe eziphuma mbombo zone zomhlaba ukuze zizo kutyebiselana ngolwazi, amava, izinto ezifundiweyo kunye neendlela ezikumgamngatho ophezulu ngezokhuseleko ngeenjongo zokuphucula ukhuseleko koololiwe.

src: Sena ke tumellano ya matjhaba e fanang ka ho tsamaelana ha maano, bakeng sa ho hodisa kgolo ya moshwelella le ntshetsopele ya lethathama la dikepe tsa kgwebo tsa Aforika.
tgt: Ukusingatha lo msitho kungaliqonga elinokutsala amathuba otyalo-mali olusuka kumazwe angaphandle, nto leyo inokukhwezela uqoqosho ikhawulezise notyalo-mali kwiziseko zophuhliso zikarhulumente.

src: Hape e tla kgothaletsa kgwebisano e kopanetsweng ya Aforika ho thusa bakeng sa momahano ho tsa moruo le moruo wa kahisano kontinenteng.
tgt: Oku kunikwe ifuthe ngamaphulo oMzantsi Afrika akutsha nje otyalo-mali kwicandelo loololiwe bokuthutha iimpahla nabakhwelisa abantu, enze uMzantsi Afrika ukuba ube yindawo ethandwa kakhulu ngabatyali-zimali.

src: Kabinete tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa ha Sehlomathiso ho Tumellano ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Dikgokahanyo tsa Mehala ya Disathalaete (ITSO) Palamenteng bakeng sa ho amohelwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwuvumile uMqulu we-Afrka weziThuthi zaseLwandle ukuba ungeniswe ePalamente ukuze uphunyezwe.

src: ITSO ke mokgatlo o kopanetsweng wa mmuso o netefatsang hore Intelsat Ltd, e leng motsamaisi wa disathalaete, e fana ka ditshebeletso tsa dikgokahanyo tsa mehala tsa setjhaba – ho kenyeletsa mantswe, tshedimoso le dividio – ka mokgwa o kenyeletsang bohle le o hlokang kgethollo.
tgt: Esi sisivumelwano samazwe ngamazwe esinjongo yaso ikulungelelanisa imigaqo-nkqubo, ukuze kukhuthazwe uhlumo nophuhliso oluzinzileyo kwimikhumbi yabarhwebi base-Afrika.

src: Sehlomathiso se tshireletsa tshebetso e hlwahlwa ya nako e telele ya Lefa le Tshwanang la Mekgatlo, le ho netefatsa kakaretso ya dikgokahanyo le lefatshe.
tgt: Lo Mqulu uza kukhuthaza urhwebelwano phakathi kwamazwe ase-Afrika ukuze oku kukhokelele kwintsebenziswano kwezoqoqosho nezentlalo kweli lizwekazi.

src: Ho tjhaellwa monwana hape ke karolo ya dintlha tse ka Sehloohong tsa Aforika Borwa bakeng sa ho nyehela lefatsheng le betere le ho ntshetsopele ya Aforika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa kwesiHlomelo kwiSivumelwano soMbutho weHlabathi weSathelayithi yeziSeko zoNxibelelwano (i-ITSO) ePalamente ukuze uphunyezwe.

src: Maemo a Kabinete Mabapi le Dintlha tsa Hajwale.
tgt: I-ITSO ngumbutho woorhulumente abahlukeneyo oqinsekisa ukuba i-Intelsat Ltd, inkampani esebenza ngesathelayithi, inika uluntu iinkonzo zeziseko zonxibelelwano – eziquka ukuthetha, idata nevidiyo – ngokungenamkhethe.

src: Kabinete e utlwisitswe bohloko ke lefu la Seaparankwe, Ngaka Ruth Segomotsi Mompati mme e fetisa matshediso a yona ho lelapa la hae le metswalle.
tgt: Esi silungiso sikhusela ukuhlala kusebenza kobuTyebi beNdalo boLuntu Jikelele, kwaye siqinisekisa ukuba unxibelelwano nothungelwano aluqhawuki.

src: Jwaloka moemedi ya ka sehloohong wa ANC ho la United Kingdom e ile ya ba karolo ya kemedi e ileng ya bula dipuisano le mmuso wa nako eo wa Aforika Borwa Groote Schuur ka 1990.
tgt: Ukuphumeza esi silungiso kuyinxalenye yemiba ephambili yoMzantsi Afrika kweyezehlabathi ukuba ufake isandla kwihlabathi elingcono kunye nophuhliso lwe-Afrika.

src: Jwaloka mosebeletsi wa nnete wa batho, o bapetse karolo e kekeng ya hlakoha ntshetsopeleng ya naha ya rona a sebetsa jwaloka Setho sa Palamente, Moambasatara wa Aforika Borwa ho la Switzerland ho tloha ka 1996 ho fihlela ka 2000 le Meyara wa Vryburg (Naledi) ho la Leboya Bophirima.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yonzakele kukusweleka kweSithwalandwe, uGq Ruth Segomotsi Mompati kwaye ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano kusapho nabahlobo bakhe.

src: O nehetse bophelo ba hae bakeng sa tokoloho ya naha ya rona le ho bontsha maikemisetso a sa thekeseleng a ho sebeletsa batho ba habo.
tgt: UGq Mompati wanikela ngobomi bakhe kumzabalazo wokulwela inkululeko kwaye wayephambili kumaphulo namadabi amaninzi kuquka noMngcelele wabaseTyhini osezimbalini weyeThupha ngowe-1956.Ngowe-1954, waba lilungu le-African National Congress (i-ANC) waza wanyulwa kwiKomiti yesiGqeba yeSizwe (i-NEC) yePhiko lwabaseTyhini lwe-ANWasaba waya elubhacweni ngowe-1962 apha wafumana uqeqesho kwezomkhosi.

src: Kabinete e utlwisitswe bohloko ke lefu la Moleftenente Mokgenerale Bongani Isidore Mbatha mme e fetisa matshediso a yona ho ba lelapa la hae le metswalle.
tgt: Wayengunobhala nentloko yecandelo labasetyhini le-ANC eTanzania.

src: Mokgenerale Mbatha o kenetse Umkhonto we Sizwe, e leng karolo ya sesole ya ANC ka 1978 mme a sebetsa maemong a fapafapaneng, ho kenyeletswa le ho ba hlooho ya tsamaiso le tlhophiso ya thepa.
tgt: Njengonozaku-zaku ophezulu we-ANC e-United Kingdom waba yinxalenye yegqiza elaqalisa uthetha-thethwano norhulumente wangaphambili woMzantsi Afrika eGroote Schuur ngowe-1990.

src: Ka 1994, Mokgenerale Mbatha o ile a kenyeletswa ho Lebotho la Naha la Tshireletso la Aforika Borwa (SANDF) moo a ileng a kenela thupello e tebileng mafapheng a fapafapaneng.
tgt: NgeyeThuba ngowe-1992, wenza intetho kwiKomiti eKhethekileyo eChasene noCalu-calulo yeZizwe eziManyeneyo e-New York kumxholo ongabasetyhini.

src: O ile a nyoloha jwalo ka maemo ka hara SANDF, a sebetsa maemong a mangatanyana ho fihlela a phahamisetswa ho ba Moleftenente Mokgenerale ya ikarabellang ho tsa Taolo le Tlhophiso ya Thepa ka 2014, e leng maemo a ao tshwereng ho fihlela lefu le mo kgaoletsa.
tgt: Njengomntu ozinikele ngokwenyani ekusebenzeleni uluntu, wadlala indima enkulu kuphuhliso lwelizwe lethu esebenza njengeLungu lePalamente, uNozaku-zaku woMzantsi Afrika eSwitzerland ukusuka ngowe-1996 ukuya kowama-2000 nanjengoSodolophu waseVryburg (eNaledi) eMntla Ntshona.

src: Zwelonke) Motseng wa Borena wa Nqadu, Willowvale, Kapa Botjhabela ka la Motsheanong 2015.Kabinete e thoholetsa Morena Sigcawu ka ho behwa ha hae boreneng mme e ikemiseditse ho sebetsa le Borena ba AmaGcaleka bakeng sa ho aha metse e kganyang, e lekalekanang le ya moshwelella ya dibaka tsa mahae.
tgt: Wanikela ngobomi bakhe kumzabalazo wenkululeko wabonisa ukuzimisela okungahexiyo kubizo lokusebenzela abantu beli lizwe.

src: Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa o tla kenela Indaba ya Mekgwa e meng ya Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere e tla dula ka la 15 Motsheanong 2015 tlasa mookotaba: “ha se feela ka ho folaša”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxubile kukusweleka kukaLieutenant General Bongani Isidore Mbatha kwaye ivakalisa amazwi ayo ovelwano kusapho nezihlobo.

src: Indaba hape e tla fana ka monyetla bakeng sa bafani ba ditshebeletso ba thekenoloji ya dikgwerekgwere mabapi le mekgwa e meng ya thekenoloji ho bapatsa dihlahiswa tsa bona.
tgt: UNjengele uMbatha waba lijoni loMkhonto we Sizwe, iphiko lomkhosi ye-ANC ngowe-1978 waze wasebenza kwizikhundla ezahlukeneyo, kuquka ukuba yintloko yecandelo lokuthengwa kweenkonzo nezixhobo zokusebenza.

src: Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba, ka tshebedisano mmoho le Lekala la Tshireletso ya Setjhaba la Aforika Borwa (SASSA) le Lekala la Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDA), le tla thakgola Beke ya Tshireletso ya Bana Lebaleng la Dipapadi la Franklin Kokstad, KwaZulu-Natal ka la 25 Motsheanong 2015 tlasa mookotaba: “Re sebetsa mmoho ho tshireletsa bana”.
tgt: Ngowe-994, uNjengele uMbatha waba yinxalenye yoMkhosi weSizwe woKhuselo woMzantsi Afrika (i-SANDF) apha wafumana uqeqesho olunzulu ngamacandelo ahlukeneyo omkhosi.

src: Beke ena e tla fella ka la 31 Motsheanong 2015 Gauteng.
tgt: Waye wabamba izikhundla ezahlukeneyo kwi-SANDF, wathi wanyuselwa waba yiLeutenant General ejongene neCandelo lokuThengwa kweeNkonzo ngowama-2014, isikhundla ebekuso ngethuba esutywa kukufa.

src: Letsholo lena la temoso le reretswe ho fihlella makala oohle a setjhaba bakeng sa ho hlokomela le ho tshireletsa bana.
tgt: Zwelonke) kwiBhotwe laseNqadu kuGatyane, eMpuma-Koloni ngomhla we-15 kuCanzibe ngowama-2015.IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana noKumkani uSigcawu ngokubekwa kwakhe ngokusesikweni kwaye inethemba lokusebenzisana kakuhle neSizwe samaGcaleka kumsebenzi wokwakha imimandla esemaphandleni ethe qwa, exhamlisanayo kunye nezinzileyo.

src: Ho fetafeta moo, le rerile ho lemosa batho ba baholo le bana ka tshireletso ya molao e fuwang bana tlasa Molaotheo, melao, maano le disebediswa tsa matjhaba mabapi le sena.
tgt: USekela Mongameli uCyril Ramaphonsa uza kuzimasa i-Indaba yeZinye iNdlela zoGutyulo eza kubanjwa ngomhla we-15 kuCanzibe ngowama-2015 phantsi komxholo: Ayikokugungxula kuphela”.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho batswadi le bahlokomedi hore kamehla ba behe tshireletso ya bana ba bona pele le ho netefatsa hore ba hlokometswe ke batswadi ba nang le boikarabelo.
tgt: Le Indaba iza kunika ithuba kubahambisi-zinkonzo zezinye iindlela zobuchwephesha bogutyulo ukuba babonise iimveliso zabo.
