tgt: Imisitho ezayo UMongameli uZuma uza kuya kwiNgqungquthela yamazwe e-G20 ngomhla we-15 nowe-16 kweyeNkanga yowama-2015 e-Antalya, e-Turkey, apho kuza kugxilwa kuhlumo oluquka konke noludlamkileyo ngamanyathelo adibeneyo.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla nka Leeto la Semmuso la ho ya Berlin, ho la Jeremane ka la 10 Pudungwana 2015, moo a tla amohelwa ke Mokanseliri Angela Merkel.
tgt: Iinkokheli kule ntlanganiso ziza kuxoxa ukuquka konke, ukufezekisa notyalo-mali ukuze kuzuzwe uhlumo olomeleleyo, oluzinzileyo nolulinganisiweyo kwinqanaba lehlabathi.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla amohela Tonakgolo ya Netherlands Mark Rutte Meahong ya Kopano ka la 17 Pudungwana WEBTOKEN tla latela sena, ke hore Tonakgolo Rutte o tla etella pele kemedi ya dikgwebo Johannesburg le Motse Kapa e tla tsepamisa maikutlo hodima Temo, tlhokomelo ya kalafo, dipalangwang, meralo ya motheo, metsi le eneji.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uza kuya kuTyelelo lasebuRhulumenteni e-Berlin, eGermany ngomhla we-10 kweyeNkanga yowama-2015, apho uza kuba esindlekwa ngu-Chancellor Angela Merkel.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla tshwara Seboka sa Foramo ya Tshebedisano-mmoho ya China-Aforika ho la Johannesburg ka la 4 le 5 Tshitwe 2015.
tgt: UMongameli uza kuya kwenza notyelelo lwembeko kuMongameli u-Joachim Gauck.

src: Dipheo tsa seboka ke ho hlophisa Lenaneo la Lewa la Tshebedisano-mmoho la Dilemo tse the 5-10 pakeng tsa Aforika Borwa le China (2015-2024) le ho hodisa ditumellano tsa bobedi bona pakeng tsa dinaha tsena tse pedi.
tgt: Kolu tyelelo, la mazwe mabini aza kuqinisekisa kwakhona ukuzinikela kwawo ekomelezeni ubudlelwane bothethathethwano nobezoqoqosho phakathi kwala mazwe amabini.

src: Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa o tla etella pele kemedi ya maemo a hodimo Leetong la Semmuso la ho etela Riphaboliki ya Mamoseleme ya Iran ho tloha ka la 7 ho isa ka la 9 Pudungwana 2015, bakeng sa ho hodisetsa pele dikamano tsa bobedi bona tsa sepolotiki le moruo pakeng tsa dinaha tsena tse pedi.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uza kwamkela iNkulumbuso u-Mark Rutter waseNetherlands kwiZakhiwo zoMdibaniso ngomhla we-17 kweyeNkanga yowama-2015.Ukulandela oku, iNkulumbuso uRutte uza kukhokela igqiza loosomashishini ukuya eRhawutini naseKapa apho liza kugxila kwezolimo, inkathalelo yezempilo, ezothutho, iziseko ezingundoqo, amanzi nezamandla.

src: Moporesidente Zuma ka la 6 Pudungwana 2015 o tla hlophisa leeto la tlhatlhobo la Siyahlola Bushbuckridge ho la Mpumalanga, le tla tsepamisa maikutlo hodima metsi le tsamaiso ya dikgwerekgwere.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uza kusingatha iNgqunguthela yeQonga leNtsebenziswano phakathi kwe-China noMzantsi Afrika eRhawutini ngomhla we-4 nowe-5 kweyoMnga yowama-2015.

src: Palo e etsang malapa a 16 600 e kgola molemo ho tswa ho Mokgahlelo 1 wa porojeke ya metsi ya mmuso ka hara tulo ena, e fanang ka metsi metsaneng e 24 ka hara Masepala wa Lehae wa the Bushbuckridge.
tgt: USekela Mongameli uCyril Ramaphosa uza kukhokela igqiza elikwinqanaba eliphezulu kuTyelelo lasebuRhulumenteni kwi-Islamic Republic of Iran ukusuka ngomhla we-7 ukuya kowe-9 kweyeNkanga yowama-2015 , ukuya kuqhubela phambili ubudlelwane bezopolitiko nezoqoqosho phakathi kwala mazwe mabini.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla kenela ho behwa setulong ha Moporesidente ya sa tswa kgethwa wa Riphaboliki e Kopaneng ya Tanzania, Mohlomphehi Monghadi John Pembe Magufuli, ka la 5 Pudungwana Molaetsa wa Ditakaletso tsa Mahlohonolo.
tgt: Ngomhla we-6 kweyeNkanga yowama-2015 uMongameli uZuma uza kuqhuba utyelelo lokuhlola elibizwa iSiyahlola eBushbuckridge eMpumalanga, oluza kugxila kumanzi nogutyulo.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa basebeletsi ba setjhaba ba kgethilweng ho Dikgau tsa Boraro tsa Naha tsa Boqhetseke tsa Batho Pele.
tgt: Yimizi engama-16 600 exhamlayo kwiSigaba 1 seprojekthi yamanzi karhulumente kulo mmandla, nebonelela ngamanzi iilali ezingama-24 kuMasipala wasekuHlaleni waseBushbuckridge.

src: Mokete wa Dikgau o tshwarwa ka la 13 Pudungwana 2015 Emperor’s Palace, ho la Gauteng tlasa mookotaba: “Batho Pele – Re beha Batho Pele”.
tgt: Urhulumente usazibophelele ekuqinisekiseni ukuba bonke abantu baseMzantsi Afrika bafumana iinkonzo ezingundoqo.

src: Di putsa tshebetso e kgabane ka ho fetisisa, tshebetso e ntle mme di metha kgotsofalo ya baahi ho tshebetso ya mmuso.
tgt: Phakathi kowama-2002 nowama-2014, imizi efumana amanzi yande ukusuka kuma-80% ukuya kuma-86% , ngeli xesha iinkonzo zogutyulo zande ukusuka kuma-62% ukuya kuma-80%.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa mmuso le batho ka bobedi ba Riphaboliki ya Côte d’Ivoire le Riphaboliki e Kopaneng ya Tanzania ka ho tshwara dikgetho tse nang le kgotso.
tgt: UMongameli uZiuma uza kuzimasa umsitho wokubekwa ngokusesikweni koMongameli oza kumiselwa we-United Republic of Tanzania, oHloniphekileyo uMnu John Pembe Magufuli, ngomhla we-5 kweyeNkanga yowama-20.

src: Ho nka karolo ka bongata ha setjhaba sa Côte d’Ivoire le sa Tanzania dikgethong tsa kakaretso ho bontsha kutlwisiso ya bona ya bohlokwa ba ho etsa mosebetsi wa bona wa setjhaba le ho sebedisa ditokelo tsa bona tsa motheo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana nabasebenzi bakarhulumente abachongiweyo kumsitho wesi-3 weeMbasa zokuGqwesa iBatho Pele.

src: Ke sesupo sa kgolo ya tsamaiso ya ho kenya demokerasi tshebetsong ka hara kontinente.
tgt: Lo msitho wokuthweswa imbasa uza kuqhubeka ngomhla we-13 kweyeNkanga yowama-2015 e-Emperor’s Palace, eGauteng phantsi komxholo othi: “Batho Pele – Ukubeka Abantu Phambili”.Kuwongwa ukuziphatha kakuhle, ukusebenza kakuhle nokukhangela ukwaneliseka kwabemi ngendlela urhulumente asebenza ngayo.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa sehlopha sa Springbok ka tshebetso ya sona ho Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Boto ya Matjhaba ya Rakbi wa 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana norhulumente nabantu beRepublic of Côte d’Ivoire ne-United Republic of Tanzania ngokubamba unyulo olunoxolo.

src: Sehlopha se tlile lapeng le medale wa boronse.
tgt: Ukuthathwa kwenxaxheba kwabemi base-Ivory Coast nabaseTanzania ngobuninzi kunyulo lukawonkewonke kubonakalisa indlela abakuqonda ngayo ukubaluleka kokusebenzisa kwabo ilungelo lobumi nelingundoqo.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa sehlopha sa Aforika Borwa sa disesi ka ho phethela Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Disesi wa FINA Doha, ho la Qatar.
tgt: Liphawu lokubonisa ukuvuthwa kwenkqubo yolawulo lwentando yesininzi kweli lizwekazi.

src: Cameron van der Burgh o hapile medale wa gauta ho dimithara tse 100 tsa lebelo la ho sesa ka difuba, Chad le Clos ho dimithara tse 100 tsa serurubele hape o kgonne ho qetella maemong a bone a ho sesa ka ho hapa ho sesa ka mokokotlo tlholong ya dimithara tse 200.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana neqela lamaBhokobhoko ngendlela adlale ngayo kwiNdebe yeHlabathi yeBhodi yeHlabathi yeBhola yoMboxo yowama-2015.

src: Michael Meyer o hapile silivera ho dimithara tse 200 tsa lebelo la motswako la bo mong.
tgt: Eli qela lisiphathele imbasa yobhedu (ibronzi).

src: Douglas Erasmus o hapile medale wa boronse ho lebelo la boikgethelo le potlakileng la dimithara tse Kaylene Corbett e bile wa borobedi ho lebelo la makgaolakgang la dimithara tse 50 la ho sesa ka mokokotlo ha Calvyn Justus le yena a phethetse borobeding ho lebelo la dimithara tse 200 la boikgethelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana neqela leendadi laseMzantsi Afrika ngokuqukumbela iNdebe yeHlabathu yokuDada i-FINA/airweave eDoha, eQatar.

src: Kabinete e amohela kemedi e kenetseng Khonferense ya BRICS ya Bone ya Matjhaba ya Phehisano ho tloha ka la 12 ho isa ka la 13 Pudungwana WEBTOKENtsing sa Dikopano sa Inkosi Albert Luthuli, ho la Durban tlasa mookotaba: “Phehisano le Kgolo e Kenyeletsang”.Sena se bokanya mmoho ditsebi ho tsa molao wa phehisano bakeng sa ho sekaseka kamoo leano la phehisano le ka nyehelang ho kgolo e kenyeletsang le ntshetsopele ya moruo ka hara dinaha tsa BRICS (Brazil, Russia, India, China le Aforika Borwa).Taolo e matla ya diphehisano ya Aforika Borwa e kgontsha baahi ho nka karolo ka ho hloka leeme moruong wa naha.
tgt: UCameron van der Burgh uphumelele imbasa yegolide kumdyarho weemitha ezili-100 obizwa i-breaststroke, uChad le Clos kumdyarho weemitha ezili-100 obizwa i-butterfly waphinda waphumelela indawo yesine kumdyarho weemitha ezingama-200 obizwa i-backstroke.

src: E kgothaletsa ho itahlela ka setotswana ha batho ba batlang ba le bangata makaleng a tlhahiso a moruo le ho fedisa ho se utlwane ka hara dikgwebo.
tgt: UMichael Meyer uphumelele isilivere kumdyarho weemitha ezingama-200 kobizwa i-individual medley.

src: Taolo ya diphehisano ya Aforika Borwa e nyehela bonkakarolo bo batlang bo phahame ba baahi mme e entse menyabuketso e bonahalang bakeng sa ho lwantsha maqulwana le ho henahenana le ditheko.
tgt: UDouglas Erasmus uphumelele imbasa yobhedu (ibronzi) kwiimetha ezi-50 ezinesantya esikhawuleza kakhulu kobizwa i-freestyle.

src: E nkile ketapele bakeng sa ho sebedisa ditabatabelo tse mabapi le dimatahanyo le diphumantsho.
tgt: UKaylene Corbett uphume kwindawo yesibhozo kumdyarho wamagqibela kankqoyi weemitha ezili-50 obizwa i-breaststroke ngeli xesha uCalvyn Justus ekwagqibe kwindawo yesibhozo kumdyarho weemitha ezingama-200 obizwa i-freestyle.

src: Letona la Dipalangwang Dipuo Peters le tla kenela Khonferense ya Bobedi ya Lefatshe ya Matona a Dipalangwang ho tloha ka la 18 ho isa ho la 20 Pudungwana 2015 ho la Brazil, moo Aforika Borwa e tla teka Tlaleho ya Nako e Bohareng ya Naha mabapi le kgatelopele e entsweng bakeng sa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Moralo wa Lefatshe wa Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng wa Dilemo tse Leshome tsa ho Sebetsana le Boipaballo Mebileng wa 2011-2020.Aforika Borwa e itlamme ho fokotsa dikotsi tsa mebileng ka 50% ho tloha ho tse 13 967 ho ya ho tse ka tlase ho 7 000 ka 2020.
tgt: Iinkomfa IKhabhinethi iyabamkela abathunywa abaze kwiNgqungquthela ye-4 yoKhuphiswano lweZizwe-ngezizwe yamazwe e-BRICS ukususela ngomhla we-12 ukuya kowe-13 kweyeNkanga yowama-2015 kwiZiko leNgqungquthela Inkosi Albert Luthuli, eDurban phantsi komxholo othi: Ukhuphiswano noHlumo oluquka konke”.Oku kuhlanganisa ndawonye ingcaphephe kumthetho wokhuphiswano ukuhlola ukuba imigaqo-nkqubo yukhuphiswano ingalenza njani igalelo kuhlumo oluquka konke nophuhliso lezoqoqosho kumaze e-BRICS (i-Brazil, i-Russia, India, i-China noMzantsi Afrika).Imithetho yokhuphiswano eluqilima yaseMzantsi Afrika iyabavumela abemi ukuba bathathe inxaxheba ngokungenamkhethe kuqoqoshol wesizwe.

src: Aforika Borwa e etsa menyabuketso ya bohlokwa bakeng sa ho fihlella dipheo tsa yona jwaloka ka ha di hlahella ho Moralo wa Lefatshe wa Dilemo tse Leshome tsa ho Sebetsana le Boipaballo Mebileng wa 2011-2020, ho sa natswe diphephetso tseo hajwale naha e tobaneng le tsona.
tgt: Ikhuthaza ukubandakanyeka kwabantu abaninzi kwicandelo lokuvelisa lezoqoqosho kwaye yenza ukuba indlela yokwenza ushishino ifane kumntu wonke.

src: Maemo a Kabinete Mabapi le Dintlha tsa Bohlokwa Maemong a Hajwale Ho sebetsana le ditshita tsa tlhahiso ya mesebetsi e dula e le ntlha e ka sehloohong bakeng sa mmuso.
tgt: Imithetho yokhuphiswano yaseMzantsi Afrika yenza igalelo lokuba abemi bathathe inxaxheba ngobuninzi kwaye yenza imitsi ebonakalayo ekulweni amaqela afuna ukulawula ushishino nokunyuswa kwamaxabiso.

src: Leano la Pehelo ya Ditekanyetso tsa Nako e Bohareng le hlakisitse kgolo ya moruo ya lefatshe e tsamayang butle, ka ditheko tsa thepa tse tlasa kgatello le tlhokeho ya mesebetsi e phahameng dikarolong tse ngata tsa lefatshe.
tgt: Iyikhokele idlela ekubonakaliseni ukubaluleka kokuqwalaselwa kweemfuno zoluntu kwiindibanisela nasekuzuzeni.

src: Sena se ile sa bonahala ho Diphuputso tsa Kotara ka nngwe tsa Lebotho la Basebetsi, tseo bakeng sa kotara ya boraro ya 2015 di ngodisitseng tlhokeho ya mosebetsi ho 25.5%, haholo ho phahama ho tloha ho 25.4% kotareng e tshwanang selemong se fetileng.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezoThutho uDipuo Peters uza kuzimasa iNkomfa yeSibini yeHlabathi yabaPhathiswa bezoThutho ukususela ngomhla we-18 ukuya kowa-20 kweyeNkanga yowama-2015 eBrazil, apho uMzantsi Afrika uza kuthi thaca khona iNgxelo yeSigaba esiPhakathi yeli liZwe malunga nenkqubela eseyenziwe ekufezekiseni isiCwangciso seHlabathi semiNyaka eliShumi yoMsebenzi woKhuseleko lweNdlela yeZizwe eziManyaneyo sowama-2011 ukuya kowama-2020.UMzantsi Afrika uzinikele ekunciphiseni ukusweleka ezindleleni ngama-50% ukusuka kuma-13 967 ukuya ngaphantsi kwama-7 000 ngowama-2020.

src: Sena se hlakisa tlhokeho ya hore makala kaofela a sebetse le mmuso bakeng sa ho tshehetsa boikitlaetso ba naha ba ho hlahisa menyetla ya mesebetsi le ho etsa hore maAforika Borwa a mangata a sebetse.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika wenza imitsi encomekayo ekuphumezeni ummiselo omiselweyo kwisiCwangciso seHlabathi semiNyaka eliShumi yoMsebenzi woKhuseleko lweNdlela yeZizwe eziManyaneyo sowama-2011 ukuya kowama-2020, nangona kukhona imingeni elijongene nayo eli lizwe.

src: Mmuso, ka Moralo wa Dintlha tse Robong, o sebetsa ho hotetsa kgolo le ho hlahisa mesebetsi ka ho bula menyetla e metjha dibakeng tsa mawa a moruo.
tgt: Ukuhlangabezana nengxaki ekudaleni imisebenzi kohlala kungumba ophambili karhulumente.

src: Kabinete e amohela tsebiso ya Moporesidente Zuma ya ho se nyolle ditefello ditheong tsa thuto e phahameng bakeng sa selemo sa dithuto sa 2016.
tgt: INtetho yoHlahlo lwabiwo-mali lesiGaba esiPhakathi ibalule uhlumo lwezoqoqosho lwehlabathi oluthobe isantya, namaxabiso emveliso yorhwebo athotyiweyo nokwanda kwentswelo-ngqesho kwindawo ezininzi ehlabathini.

src: Qeto ena e tlisitse kimoloho e batlehang haholo ya ditjhelete, haholoholo ho ba fumanehileng, ba sebetsang le sehlopha sa malapa a mahareng a nang le baithuti.
tgt: Oku kubonakaliswe kuPhando-nzulu olwenziwa ngeKota ngezabaSebenzi, noluthe kwikota yesithathu yowama-2015 lwavelisa intswela-ngqesho ukuba imi kuma-25.5%, inyuke nje kancinci ukusuka kuma-25.4% kwikota efanayo kunyaka ophelileyo.

src: Kabinete e boela e amohela qeto ya Moporesidente ya ho theha khomishene e tla shebana le dintlha tsohle tse hlahisitsweng ke baithuti.
tgt: Oku kugxininisa imfuno yokuba onke amacandelo mawasebenzisane norhulumente ekuxhaseni iphulo lelizwe ekudaleni amathuba emisebenzi nokufaka abantu abaninzi baseMzantsi Afrika emisebenzini.

src: Moporesidente o tla tsebisa ka khomishene mmoho le dintlha tsa yona tsa tshebetso ha mmela o ntse o puta.
tgt: Urhulumente, ngesiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba, usebenzela ukuchukumisa uhlumo aze adale nimisebenzi ngokuvulela amathuba amatsha kwimimandla yobuchule kwezoqoqosho.

src: Kabinete e amohela boitshunyako ba Lefapha la Metsi le Dikgwerekgwere bakeng sa ho thusa badudi ho la KwaZulu-Natal le Foreistata ba anngweng ke komello ya moraorao tjena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isibhengezo esenziwe nguMongameli uZuma zokunganyuswa kwemali yokufunda kumaziko emfundo ephakamileyo ngonyaka wokufunda wama-2016.

src: Dibaka tse fepelwang ke matamo a maholwanyane a lebatowa a naha le dikema di dutse di ntse di bolokehile kaha ditsamaiso tsena hajwale di na le botsitso bo botle ba palohare ya poloko ya metsi a tletseng ka 66%.Kabinete e amohela ho thehwa ha Komiti e Kopanetsweng ya Matona (IMC) e mabapi le Polokeho ya Metsi bodulasetulong ba Letona la Kopanelo ya Puso le Merero ya Botjhaba Pravin Gordhan.
tgt: Esi sigqibo siza kuzisa umnyinyivu wezezimali odingeka kakhulu, ingakumbi kubasebenzi abahluphekileyo neentsapho ezifumana imivuzo ephantsi kwephakathi yabafundi basedyunivesithi.

src: IMC e bopilwe ka Matona a Ntshetsopele ya Dibaka tsa Mahae le Puseletso ya Mobu Metsi le Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere, le Temo, Meru le Ditlhapi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ukongeza apho iyasamkela isigqibo sikaMongameli sokusekwa kwekhomishini yokuqwalasela imiba evezwe ngabafundi.

src: Komiti e tla tshohla le ho sisinya boitshunyako bo bong ho badudi ba anngweng haholo ke komello.
tgt: UMongameli uza kuyibhengeza le khomishini kunye nomhlaba wayo wamagunya kungekudala.

src: Kabinete e lemohile se ntseng se etsahala ho la Nigeria mabapi le kotlo ya MTN ya US$5.2 bilione ke Khomishene ya Dikgokahanyo ya Nigeria.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalwamkela ungenelelo lweSebe lezaManzi noGutyulo lokunceda uluntu laKwaZulu-Natal nolwaseFreystata xa luchatshazelwe yimbalela yakutsha nje.

src: Kabinete e tshepa hore dipuisano tse ntseng di tswela pele pakeng tsa MTN le ba ka sehloohong ba Nigeria di tla baka hore ho be le tharollo e potlakileng ya ho se utlwane hore ho tle ho netefatswe hore MTN e tswela pele ka kgwebo ya yona ya ho tsetela ka hara moruo wa Nigeria.
tgt: Imimandla ebonelelwa ngamanzi ngamadama obonelelo lwemimandla emikhulu yeli lizwe ngamanzi nezikimu zisakhuselekile njengoko ezi nkqubo sithetha nje zisekumlinganiselo wamanzi othembisayo apho zikumyinge ongama-66% ukugcwala ukugcina amanzi wesizwe.

src: Kabinete e utlwisitswe bohloko ke lefu la tshohanyetso la Chumani Nqakula, mora wa Letona la Tshireletso le Mekaubere ya Ntwa Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula le Charles Nqakula, e leng Setho sa Palamente.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukusekwa kweKomiti yabaPhathiswa (i-IMC) yokuBakho kwaManzi esihlalo wayo inguMphathiswa woLawulo lweNtsebenziswano neMicimbi yezeMveli uPravin Gordham.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona a tebileng ho lelapa la Nqakula le metswalle.
tgt: I-IMC iquka uMphathiswa woPhuhliso lwaMaphandle noBuyekezo lweMihlaba owezaManzi noGutyulo nowezoLimo, amaHlathi nezokuLoba.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona a tebileng ho lelapa le ba leloko la Letona la Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba le Tsamaiso Ngoako Ramatlhodi, ka ho hlokahala ha mme wa hae ya dilemo tse 95, Mmatlou Elizabeth Ramatlhodi.
tgt: Le komiti iza kuxoxa ize yenze iziphakamiso olunye ungenelelo emalwenziwe kuluntu oluchatshazelwe ngamandla yimbalela.

src: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di tla lokelwa ke ho netefatswa ha mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuqaphele okwenzeke eNigeria kutsha nje ngokumalunga nesohlwayo se-US$5.2 seebhliyoni sika-MTN yiKhomishini yezoNxibelelwano yaseNigeria.

src: Monghadi Mogojare Richard Seleka jwaloka Motsamaisi e Moholo (DG) ho Lefapha la Dikgwebo tsa Setjhaba le.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyathemba ukuba iingxoxo eziqhubayo phakathi kuka-MTN nabasemagunyeni baseNigeria ziza kuvelisa izisombululo ezikhawulezileyo zale mbambano ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuqhubekeka kuka-MTN kushishino lokutyala imalim kuqoqosho lwaseNigeria.

src: Monghadi Robert Moeketsa Ramasodi jwaloka motlatsi wa DG: Tlhahiso ya tsa Temo, Bophelo bo Botle le Polokeho ya Dijo ho Lefapha la Temo, Meru le Ditlhapi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilusizi ngokusweleka kukaChumani Nqakula, nongunyana woMphathiswa wezoKhuselo namaGqala oMkhosi uNosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula noCharles Nqakula, olilungu lePalamente.

src: Boto ya Koporasi ya Taolo ya Sephethephethe sa Mebileng:a) Mofumahadi Daphline Harridene Charlotte-Ann Ewertse – Setho seo e seng sa Phethahatso leb) Monghadi Thulani Matiki Norman Kgomo – Setho seo e seng sa Phethahatso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulisa amazwi ovelwano kusapho lakwaNqakula izihlobo nezalamane.

src: Boto ya Koporasi ya Matsete a Setjhaba:a) Mofumahadi Lindiwe Toyi – Motsamaisi eo e seng wa Phethahatsob) Mofumahadi Sandra Beswick – Motsamaisi eo e seng wa Phethahatsoc) Ms Tantaswa Fubu – Motsamaisi eo e seng wa Phethahatsod) Ngaka Claudia Manning – Motsamaisi eo e seng wa Phethahatsoe) Monghadi Pitsi Paul Moloto – Motsamaisi eo e seng wa Phethahatso
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano kusapho nezalamane zoMphathiswa wezabaSebenzi bakaRhulumente noLawulo uNgoako Ramatlhodi, ngokusweleka komama wakhe obe neminyaka engama-95 ubudala, uMmatlou Elizabeth Ramatlhodi.

src: lef) Mofumahadi Matshepo Faith More – o thontswe hape jwaloka Mohlanka ya ka Sehloohong wa Ditjhelete.
tgt: IzikhundlaZonke izikhundla zixhomekeke ekuqinisekisweni kwamabakala emzemfundo kunye nokuqinisekiswa okufanelekileyo kwezokhuselo.

src: Boto ya Lekala la Ntshetsopele ya Matlo:a) Monghadi Mavuso Walter Msimang – Modulasetulob) Monghadi Maanda Emmanuel Mutheiwanac) Monghadi Pravin Amar Singhd) Monghadi Thuthuka Siphumezile Songelwa lee) Monghadi Nkululeko Nkosingiphile Vilakazi – moemedi wa Letona la Mesebetsi ya Setjhaba.
tgt: UMnu Mogojare Richard Seleka njengoMlawuli Jikelele (i-DG) kwiSebe lamaShishini kaRhulumente kunye.

src: Ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha mananeo a bohlokwa a mmuso.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ezingundoqo.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Lefapha la Bodulo ba Batho bakeng sa ho fana ka matlo porojekeng ya Bodulo ba Batho e Kopanetsweng ya Savanna City ka hara Masepala wa Setereke wa Sedibeng ho dihlopha tse dikojwana di mahetleng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalincoma iSebe lezokuHlaliswa koLuntu ngokunikezela ngezindlu kwiprojekthi yezokuHlaliswa koLuntu eDibeneyo yeSixeko i-Savanna kuMasipala weSithili saseSedibeng kubantu abasokolayo.

src: MaAforika Borwa a itlhommeng pele a ile a ikopanya le bankakrolo ba diindaseteri, ho kenyeletswa le bomeyara le bahlanka ba tswang Masepaleng wa Setereke wa Sedibeng, mabapi le ho penta matlo a phethetsweng mmoho le ho thusa ka ditshingwana nakong ya ho thakgolwa.
tgt: Ngabemi boMzantsi Afrika abaziwayo abathe bazibandakanya nabadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo kolushishino, kuquka oosodolophu kunye namagosa woMasipala weSithili saseSedibeng, ekupeyinteni nasekulimeni kwizindlu esezigqityiwe ukwakhiwa ngexesha bezimiselwa.

src: Ho ahilwe matlo a ka bang 18 000, a tswetseng molemo maqheku, batho ba qhwadileng, le malapa ao dihlooho tsa ona e leng bana le basadi.
tgt: Zimalunga nama-18 000 izindlu ezakhiweyo, ezixhamlisa abantu abadala, abakhubazekileyo, kunye namakhaya angesanabazali ondliwa ngabantwana nawondliwa ngabasetyhini.

src: Kabinete e boetse e amohela tsebiso ya hore selemong se tlang lefapha le tla thakgola porojeke, e tla etsa hore ho ahuwe matlo a 60 000.
tgt: Kwakhona iKhabhinethi iyasamkela isibhengezo sokuba kulo nyaka uzayo eli sebe liza kumisela iprojekthi ezakwakha izindlu ezingama-60 000.

src: Kabinete e amohela kgatelopele e entsweng ke porojeke ya Tshepo 10 000, e thusang ho fedisa tlhokeho ya mesebetsi bakeng sa batjha ka hara Motsemoholo wa Tshwane.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela inkqubela eyenziwe yiprojekthi i-Tshepo 10 000, encedisa ukuncothula intswela-ngqesho kulutsha kwiSixeko saseTshwane.

src: Porojeke ena ya dimilione-milione tsa diranta ya Motsemoholo, ka tshebedisanommoho le Yunivesithi ya Pretoria, e lebeletse ho rupella batjha ba 10 000 ba sa sebetseng ka ho ba neha maitsebelo le bokgoni tse batlehang bakeng sa ho etsa dikopo tsa ho fumantshwa diporojeke.
tgt: Le projekthi yezigidi ngezigidi zeerandi yeSixeko, ngentsebenziswano neDyunivesithi yasePitoli, izimisele ukuqeqesha ama-10 000 olutsha olungaphangeliyo ngokulunika izakhono nobuchwepheshe obudingekayo ukuze lukwazi ukungena kwiiprojekthi zeziniki-maxabiso.

src: Kamora ho phethela thupello batjha ba theha le ho tsamaisa dikoporasi tse atlehileng.
tgt: Emva kokugqiba uqeqesho olu lutsha lumisela luze luqhube ookopolotyeni ngokuyimpumelelo.

src: Ho fihlela mothating ona, dikoporasi tse fetang 190 di se di fanne ka menyetla ya mesebetsi ho batho ba batjha ba bangata.
tgt: Ukuza kutsho ngoku, bangaphezulu kwe-190 ookopolotyeni ababonelela uninzi lolutsha ngamathuba emisebenzi.

src: Hodima moo, mafapha a motsemoholo a hirile ba bang ba batjha ba rupelletsweng.
tgt: Ukongeza apho, amasebe esixeko aqesha olunye lolu lutsha selufumene uqeqesho.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho ntlafatswa ha tsela ya R25 (P6-1), e leng tsela ya dikilomithara tse 42 e kopanyang Gauteng le Limpopo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuphuculwa kwendlela engu-R25 (P6-1), indlela engama-42 eekhilomitha edibanisa iGauteng neLimpopo.

src: Porojeke ena, e tsamayang pakeng tsa Bapsfontein le Bronkhorstspruit, e hirile batho ba fetang 200.
tgt: Le ndlela, inqumla phakathi kweBapsfontein neBronkoro, iqeshe ngaphezulu kwabantu abangama-200.

src: Hape e tla tswela molemo makala a temo le merafo sebakeng seo ka ho hodisa motsamao o batlang o potlakile wa dilori tse tsamaisang thepa le ditshebeletso.
tgt: Iza kuxhamlisa nabecandelo lezolimo nelezemigodi kulo mmandla ngokunceda ukuhamba ngokukhawuleza kwezigadla ezithutha imithwalo emikhulu nokunikezelwa kweenkonzo.

src: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ke Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji, le tla tshwara beke ya saense ya setjhaba e kgolo: Foramo ya Saense ya Aforika Borwa 2015 tlasa mookotaba: “Re hotetsa moqoqo ka saense” ho tloha ka la 8 ho isa ka la 9 Tshitwe 2015, ho la Pretoria.
tgt: Izigqibo zeKhabhinethi ezingundoqo.1 IKhabhinethi iye yaziswa liSebe lezeNzululwazi nobuChwepheshe, ukuba liza kusingatha iveki yezenzululwazi yoluntu engundoqo: iQonga lezeNzululwazi loMzantsi Afrika lowama-2015 phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukuqalisa incoko ngezenzululwazi” ukususela ngomhla we-8 ukuya kowe-9 kweyoMnga yowama-2015, ePitoli.

src: Ketsahalo ena e neha bankakarolo ba tswang Aforika Borwa, ka hara kontinente le bomphato ba matjhaba lepatlelo bakeng sa dingangisano le ho ithuta ka maano mabapi le ho tsamaelana pakeng tsa saense le setjhaba.
tgt: Lo msitho unika iqonga abadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo baseMzantsi Afrika, amaqabane aphuma kweli lizwekazi nakumazwe ehlabathi lengxoxo-mpikiswano nokufunda imigaqo-nkqubo kumda wothungelwano phakathi kwenzululwazi noluntu.2 IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuba umsitho woMbutho woLwandle weHlabathi oBanjwa ngaXeshanye woMbutho woLwandle weHlabathi (i-IMO) ukuba mawubanjelwe eMzantsi Afrika ngowama-2020.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana hore Ketsahalo ya Letsatsi le Tsamaelanang le tsa Mawatle ya Lefatshe ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Mawatle (IMO) e tshwarelwe Aforika Borwa ka 2020.
tgt: Ngoko ke uMphathiswa wezoThutho uza kusiphalaza esi sigqibo seKhabhinethi kwintlanganiso yeBhunga le-IMO eza kubanjwa ukususela ngomhla wama-23 kweyeNkanga ukuya kowe-4 kweyoMnga yowama-20.

src: Lefapha la Dipalangwang ha ho le jwalo le tla fetisetsa qeto ena ya Kabinete ho kopano ya Lekgotla ya IMO e reretsweng ho etsahala ho tloha ka la 23 Pudungwana ho isa ka la 04 Tshitwe Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kundwendwelwa nguMongameli wase-China u- Xi Jinping kuTyelelo lasebuRhulumenteni oluntsuku-mbini ukususela ngomhla we-2 ukuya kowe-3 kweyoMnga.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o tla amohela wa mphato wa hae wa China Xi Jinping bakeng sa Leeto la Semmuso la matsatsi a mabedi ho tloha ka la 2 ho isa ka la 3 Tshitwe.
tgt: Iinjongo zolu tyelelo kukuqukumbela iNkqubo-sikhokelo yemiNyaka emi-5 ukuya kweli-10 kwiNtsebenziswano ye-China-noMzantsi Afrika eza kuqhubeka ukumisela ukufezekiswa kwezivumelwano zethu ukususela ekuqukunjelweni kwesiBhengezo sase-Beijing ngowama-2010.

src: Sepheo sa leeto ke ho phethela Moralo wa Tshebedisanommoho wa Dilemo tse 5-10 wa China-Aforika Borwa o tla thatiselletsa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha ditumellano tsa rona esale ho phethelwa Boitlamo ba Beijing ka 2010.
tgt: Iza kuqubeka ukwandisa nokunabisa ubuDlelwane bobuChule obuDibeneyo la mazwe mabini abelana ngabo.

src: Hape le tla tsebisa le ho hodisa Bosemphato bo Pharaletseng ba Mawa bo arolelwanang ke dinaha ka bobedi.
tgt: Ubudlelwane boMzantsi Afrika neChina buza kuhlala buphambili ekuqinisekiseni ngomba wawo wophuhliso ongemigaqo-nkqubo yawo yamazwe angaphandle njengokuba isandisa amalinge okufezekisa isiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP), intsebenziswano kwezolimo, imicimbi yezokusingqongileyo, urhwebo noshishino nezezimali njengokuba eli lizwe liqhubeka ukuqhuba umba wokuqhubela uMzantsi Afrika phambili.

src: Dikamano tsa Aforika Borwa le China e dula e le bohare ba ho fihlella lenaneo la yona la ntshetsopele ka leano la yona la matjhabeng kaha le eketsa mekutu ya ho kenya tshebetsong Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP), tshebedisanommoho ho tsa temo, merero ya tsa tikoloho, kgwebisano le diindaseteri le tsa ditjhelete jwaloka ha naha e tswela pele ho kganna lenaneo la ho ntshetsa Aforika Borwa pele.
tgt: Ikwabonelela ngethuba lokuhlola inkqubela eseyenziwe kwimimandla ekhoyo yezorhwebo nentsebenziswano phakathi kwezi zizwe zibini, nokukhawulezisa ukuqukumbela imimandla emitsha yentsebenziswano.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla etella pele Kemedi e tla kenela ho dula ha bo-21 ha Khonferense ya Mekga ho Seboka sa Meralo ya Phethoho ya Tlelaemete sa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UNFCCC) le ho dula ha bo-11 ha Khonferense ya Mekga e sebetsang jwaloka Kopano ya Mekga ho Porothokhole ya Kyoto (CMP11) e tla tshwarwa ho tloha ka la 30 Pudungwana ho isa ka la 11 Tshitwe 2015 Paris, ho la Fora.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uza kukhokela igqiza eliya kwiSeshoni yama-21 yeNkomfa yamaZwe kwiNkqubo-sikhokelo yeNgqungquthela engokuGuquguquka kweSimo seZulu yeZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UNFCCC) neSeshoni yayo ye-11 yeNkomfa yamaZwe esebenza njengeNtlanganiso yamaZwe kwiSivumelwano sase-Kyoto (i-CMP11) eza kubanjwa ukususela ngomhla wama-30 kweyeNkanga ukuya kowe-11 kweyoMnga yowama-2015 eParis, eFrance.

src: Ditherisano tsa matjhaba bakeng sa tumellano e ntjha ya semolao e tla hlophisa karabelo ho phethoho ya tlelaemete, e tla qala ho sebetsa ho tloha ka 2020 ho ya pele.
tgt: Iindibano zokubonisana zamazwe ngamazwe ngesivumelwano esitsha esisemthethweni ziuza kugwadlwa indlela emakuhlangatyezwane ngayo nokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu, neza kuqalisa ukusebenza ngowama-2020 ukubheka phambili.

src: Ho imatahantswe le ditabatabelo tsa naha tsa Aforika Borwa jwaloka naha ya Aforika e tswelang pele e tla batla tshehetso ya kamora 2020, Aforika Borwa e tla tswela pele ho tshireletsa dipehelo tsa mantlha tsa UNFCCC tsa tekatekano le phapantsho.
tgt: Ngokuhambelana nemfuno yoMzantsi Afrika yeSizwe njengelizwe lase-Afrika nelisaphuhlayo eliza kudinga inkxaso nasemva kowama-2020, uMzantsi Afrika uza kuqhubeka ukukhusela imigomo engundoqo ye-UNFCCC yomakulingwane nokuwazi umahluko.

src: Ho Sehlopha sa 77 sa kopano ya China, Aforika Borwa e tla tsitlallela ho boloka le ho matlafatsa bonngwe ba dinaha tse ntseng di tswela pele bakeng sa ho fumana Tumellano ya Paris e hlokang leeme, e nang le maikemisetso, e thehilweng hodima tsa saense le e hlahisang sebaka sa ntshetsopele sa dinaha tse ntseng di tswela pele.
tgt: Kwintlanganiso yamazwe angama-77 kunye ne-China, uMzantsi Afrika uza kufuna ukugcina nokomeleza umanyano lwamazwe asaphuhlayo ukugcina iSivumelwano sase-Paris esingenamkhethe, esinokuzingca, esigxile kwinzululwazi nesivelisela amazwe asaphuhlayo ithuba lokuba aphuhle.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla thakgola Letsholo la Matsatsi a 16 bakeng sa thibelo ya Dikgoka kgahlanong le Basadi le Bana ka la 25 Pudungwana 2015 Naauwpoort, ho la Mahikeng tlasa mookotaba: “Mpalle le nna: Mmoho re Ntshetsapele Aforika Borwa e hlokang Dikgoka.” Letsholo lena le hopolwa jwaloka karolo ya Matsatsi a 365 a Twantsho, leo e leng letsholo le tswellang le lemosang ka dikgoka kgahlanong le basadi le bana, le ho elellwisa batho hore ba balellwe twantshong ya selemo ho pota.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uza kumisela iPhulo lobuTshantliziyo leeNtsuku ezili-16 lokulwa ubuNdlobongela obujoliswe kwabaseTyhini naBantwana ngomhla wama-25 kweyeNkanga eNaauwpoort, eMahikeng phantsi komxholo othi: “Ndibale Nam: Sikunye siqhubela uMzantsi Afrika ongenabuNdlobongela Phambili.” Eli phulo libhiyozelwa njengenxalenye yeNtshukumo yeeNtsuku ezingama-365, neliphulo eliqhubekekayo elifundisa nelazisa ngokuliwa kobundlobongela obujoliswe kwabasetyhini nabantwana, nokuvuselela abantu ngabanye ukuba nabo babalwe kweli phulo lentshukumo yonyaka wonke.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho tshehetsa letsholo lena le ho sebedisa nako ena bakeng sa ho elellwisa badudi le ho imatahanya le mmuso ho fedisa dikgoka kgahlanong le basadi le bana - #Count me In.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba balixhase eli phulo baze basebenzise eli thuba ukuvuselela uluntu nokuzibandakanya norhulumente ekupheliseni ubundlobongela obujoliswe kubantu basetyhini nabantwana - #Count me In.

src: Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa o tla etella pele kemedi ya mmuso dipuisanong tsa yona tse setlwaeding le Foramo ya Bahlophisi ba Boraditaba ba Naha ya Aforika Borwa ka la 21 Pudungwana 2015 jwaloka boitlamo ba mmuso le lenaneo le tswellang la ho tiisa dikamano le boraditaba.
tgt: USekela-Mongameli uRamaphosa uza kukhokela igqiza likarhulumente kwiintlanganiso zakhe zarhoqo kunye neQonga leSizwe labaHleli baseMzantsi Afrika ngomhla wama-21 kweyeNkanga yowama-2015 njengenxalenye yokuzinikela kukarhulumente nenkqubo eqhubekayo yokomeleza ubudlelwane kunye namajelo eendaba.

src: Mmuso o tla tsebisa bahlophisi ka dintlha tsa bohlokwa le meralo e motjheng ha ho ntse ho fuwa bahlophisi monyetla wa ho hlahisa dibaka tsa kgahleho le mmuso.
tgt: Urhulumente uza kwazisa abahleli ngemiba engundoqo nezicwangciso zexesha elizayo kwangaxesha nye ebanika ithuba lokuba baveze iindawo abanomdla wokuba urhulumente abachazele ngazo.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla tshwaya Letsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDS tlasa mookotaba - “Ho isa Molokong o Hlokang HIV: PHAHAMSEBETSTSHIRELETSLETHO – e leng kgoeletso ya ho sebetsa ho setjhaba.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uza kuphawula uSuku lweHlabathi lukaGawulayo phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukujongisa kwisiZukulwana esingenayo iNtsholongwane kaGawulayo: QAQAMBTHATHA INYATHELKHUSELPHELISA NYA - osisimemo sokuba uluntu luthathe amanyathelo.

src: Mookotaba wa selemong sena o tsamaelana le mookotaba wa Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng wa Letsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDS bakeng sa 2011 ho isa ho 2015 e leng: “Ho fihlella ho Letho”.
tgt: Umxholo walo nyaka uhambelana nomxholo weZizwe eziManyeneyo woSuku lukaGawulayo lweHlabathi lonyaka wama-2011 ukuya kowama-2015 othi: Phelisa Nya”.

src: Letsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDS la 2015 le tla boela le matlafatsa puisano ka sekodi le kgethollo, le ho elelliswa ha badudi ka hore ba arabele le ho hodisa phumantsho ya thibelo, kalafo le tshehetso ya ditshebeletso.
tgt: USuku lukaGawulayo lweHlabathi lowama-2015 luza kuqhubeka ukomeleza uthethathethwano malunga nomdintsi nocalucalulo, nokuvuselela uluntu ukuba luhlangabezane nokhuselo nokwandisa ufikelelo kukhuselo, iinkonzo zonyango nezenkxaso.

src: Ketsahalo e kgolo ya ho hopola Letsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDS e tla tshwarelwa KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Umsitho omkhulu wesikhumbuzo soSuku lukaGawulayo lweHlabathi uza kubanjelwa KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Sena se tla etsa motheo bakeng sa Aforika Borwa ho tshwara Khonferense ya Matjhaba ya AIDS ya bo- 21 Setsing sa Dikopano sa Matjhaba sa Inkosi Albert Luthuli ho la Durban ho tloha ka la 17 ho isa ka la 22 Phupu 2016.
tgt: Oku kuza kuthathwa njengamalungiselelo okuqala okusingathwa kweNkomfa yeHlabathi kaGawulayo nguMzantsi Afrika kwiZiko leNgqungquthela leZizwe ngezizwe Inkosi Albert Luthuli eDurban ukususela ngomhla we-17 ukuya kowama-22 kweyeKhala yowama-2016.

src: Aforika Borwa e tswella ho etsa kgatelopele ho ntwa kgahlanong le HIV le AIDS, ebile e se e atolositse lenaneo la naha la kalafo ya HIV, moo batho ba dimilione di le tharo ba tholang kalafo ya meriana ya HIV, e le mohato wa ho fokotsa tshwaetso ya ho tloha ho mme ho ya ho lesea le ho rekota matshwao a ntlafetseng a lefuba.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uyaqhubeka ngokwenza inkqubela ekulweni iNtsholongwane kaGawulayo (i-HIV) noGawulayo (i-AIDS), ekubeni eyandisile inkqubo yokukhutshwa kwamachiza okuthomalalisa i-HIV yeli lizwe, apho ingabantu abangaphezulu kwezigidi ezithathu abawafumanayo, nokunciphisa ngakumbi ukosuleleka komntwana esosulelwa ngunina nokuphucuka kwendlela ekubonakala ngayo iimpawo zesifo sephepha (i-TB).

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa ho nka karolo diketsahalong tsa di-Imbizo tse rerilweng ho phatlalla le naha nakong ya Beke ya Imbizo ya Naha ya ho Tsepamisa Maikutlo ho tloha ka la 30 Pudungwana ho isa ka la 6 Tshitwe 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza abantu baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba bathathe inxaxheba kwimisitho yeeMbizo ecwangciswe kweli jikelele ngexesha leVeki yeSizwe eGxile kwiiMbizo ukususela ngomhla wama-30 kweyeNkanga ukuya kowe-6 kweyoMnga yowama-2015.

src: Lepatlelo lena le thusa baahi ho buisana le ditho tsa Phethahatso.
tgt: Eli liqonga elinika abemi ithuba lokuba bathethe namalungu eKhabhinethi.

src: Beke ya Imbizo ya Naha ya ho Tsepamisa Maikutlo e tla tshwarwa tlasa mookotaba: “Mmoho re ntshetsa Aforika Borwa pele” mme e tla beha badudi sehlohlolong ka ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Moralo wa Dintlha tse Robong ke mmuso bakeng sa ho hotetsa kgolo ya moruo le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi, jwaloka ha o tekilwe ke Moporesidente Zuma Puong ya hae ka Maemo a Setjhaba ya Tlhakola 2015.
tgt: IVeki yeSizwe eGxile kwiiMbizo iza kuqhuba phantsi komxholo othi: “Sisonke siqhubela uMzantsi Afrika phambili” kwaye iza kwazisa uluntu ngokufezekisa kukarhulumente isiCwangciso esiManqaku aliThoba ekuqaliseni uhlumo lwezoqoqosho nokudala imisebenzi, njengoko kuchazwe nguMongameli uZuma kwiNtetho kaMongameli engoBume beSizwe kweyoMdumba yowama-2015.

src: Ditho tsa Phethahatso di tla boela di sebedise monyetla ona ho kgothaletsa bonkakarolo ba badudi bakeng sa ho sebetsana le mathata a fapafapaneng a setjhaba, ho kenyeletswa dintlha tse tsamaelanang le dikgoka kgahlanong le basadi le bana.
tgt: Amalungu eKhabhinethi aza kusebenzisa eli thuba nasekuvuseni uluntu ukuba luthathe inxaxheba ekuqubisaneni nemikhwa eliqela engemihle yezentlalo, kuquka nemiba emayela nobundlobongela obujoliswe kubantu basetyhini nabantwana.

src: Tshitwe ke Kgwedi ya Poelano mme Aforika Borwa e tla tshwaya Letsatsi la Poelano la 16 Tshitwe Port Elizabeth, ho la Kapa Botjhabela tlasa mookotaba: “Re ngotla karohano: Re aha bosetjhaba bo tshwanang ba Aforika Borwa ho isa pusong ya naha e tswelang pele”.
tgt: Inyanga yoMnga yiNyanga yoXolelwaniso kwaye uMzantsi Afrika uza kuluphawula eBhayi, eMpuma Koloni uSuku loXolelwaniso ngomhla we-16 kweyoMnga, phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukuvala umsantsa weyantlukwano: Ukwakha ubuzwe boMzantsi Afrika obufanayo obubhekisele kumbuso wophuhliso wesizwe”.

src: Kgwedi ena e na le bohlokwa bo ikgethang bakeng sa setjhaba kaha e kgothaletsa poelano, kgotso le momahano ya setjhaba e leng motheo wa naha e ntjha ya tsamaiso ya demokerasi.
tgt: Le nyanga inokubaluleka okukhethekileyo kwisizwe kuba ikhuthaza uxolelwaniso, uxolo nokuhlalisana ngoxolo athe urhulumente omtsha olawulwa ngentando yesininzi wasekwa phezu kwayo.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa kaofela ho sebedisa kgwedi ena bakeng sa ho atamelana ha naha e ntse e tswella ho sebetsa mmoho bakeng sa ho aha setjhaba se le seng se atlehileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza bonke abantu baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba bolulelane isandla soxolo njengoko isizwe sisaqhubeka ukusebenzisana ukwakha isizwe esimanyeneyo nesihlumayo.

src: Kabinete e hopotsa balefi ba lekgetho ba so kang ba kenya ditokomane tsa bona tsa lekgetho bakeng sa selemo sa 2014/15 sa lekgetho hore letsatsi la ho qetela la ho kenya ditokomane ke la 27 Pudungwana 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhumbuza abahlawuli berhafu abangekawafaki amaxwebhu wabo werhafu wonyaka-rhafu wama-2014/15 ukuba usuku lokugqibela lokufaka amaxwebhu ngumhla wama-27 kweyeNkanga yowama-2015.

src: Kabinete e leboha balefi kaofela ba lekgetho bakeng sa ho imatahanya le mmuso mabapi le ho fana ka ditshebeletso tse hlokahalang ka matla tse thusang ho ntlafatsa bophelo ba diketekete tsa badudi ho phatlalla le naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibulela bonke abahlawuli berhafu ngokuzibandakanya kwabo norhulumente ekuboneleleni ngeenkonzo ezidingeka kakhulu ezinceda ekuphuculeni ubomi bamawaka-waka oluntu kweli jikelele.

src: Kabinete thoholetsa Setsha sa Mehala sa Bolaodi ba Dikgoka tse Amanang le Bong sa Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba (GBVCC) ka ho hapa Kgau ya Lefatshe ya Setsha sa Mehala se Hlwahlwa ka ho Fetisisa Las Vegas, ho la Amerika, ka Labone, la 5 Pudungwana 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana neZiko lokuLawula ubuNdlobongela obuGxile ngokweSini (i-GBVCC) leSebe loPhuhliso loLuntu ngokuphumelela iMbasa yeLona Ziko leMibuzo liGqwesileyo eHlabathini eLas Vegas, e-USA, ngoLwesine umhla we-5 kweyeNkanga yowama-2015.

src: GBVCC ke setsi sa mehala se sebetsang bosiu le motshehare se reretsweng ho fana ka tshehetso le boeletsi ho diphofu tsa dikgoka tse amanang le bong.
tgt: Iziko i-GBVCC liziko lomnxeba elivula iiyure ezingama-24 elizinikele ekuboneleleni ngenkxaso nentetho-ntuthuzelo kumaxhoba obundlobongela obugxile ngokwesini.

src: Sena ke e nngwe ya pale ya katleho e bontshang mmuso o kgathallang o ikemiseditseng ntweng ya ho kgina dikgoka tse amanang le Bong.
tgt: Eli lelinye lamabali ayimpumelelo elibonakalisa urhulumente okhathalayo ozimiseleyo ekulwela ukupheliswa kobundlobongela obugxile ngokwesini.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Eskom bakeng sa ho sebetsa ka matsatsi a 100 ntle le ho kgaola phepelo ya motlakase.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana no-Eskom ngokusebenza iintsuku ezili-100 ngaphandle kokunqamka kombane (ukucima kombane ngeenjongo zokuwunkinkisha).

src: Eskom e fihletse mokolokotwane ona ka Labobedi, la 17 Pudungwana 2015.
tgt: U-Eskom ufikelele kule mpumelelo iyimbali ngoLwesibini, umhla we-17 kweyeNkanga yowama-2015.

src: Matsatsi a 100 a phepelo ya motlakase e sa sitisehang ha ho bolele hore re ka qhanolla.
tgt: Ukugqiba iintsuku ezili-100 zokubonelelwa ngombane ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka akuthethi ukuba masithobe umxakatho.

src: Empa, Kabinete e ipiletsa ho badudi ho tswella ho lekola boishunyako ba ho baballa eneji.
tgt: Endaweni yoko, iKhabhinethi ibongoza uluntu ukuba luqhubekeke lusebenzisa amacebo okonga umbane.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa bakgethwa ba Dikgau tsa Dipapadi tsa Aforika Borwa tsa 2015 tse tla tshwarwa ka la 22 Pudungwana 2015 Theatereng ya Sand du Plessis Mangaung, ho la Foreisetata.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana nabo amagama aphakanyiselwe ukuphumelela iiMbasa zezeMidlalo zaseMzantsi Afrika zowama-2015, umsitho wazo oza kubanjelwa eSand du Plessis Theatre eMangaung, eFreystata ngomhla wama-22 kweyeNkanga yowama-2015.

src: Dikgau tsena, tse hlophisitsweng tlasa mookotaba: “Boqhetseke ha se ho ba hlwahlwa ho fetisisa ke ho etsa ho fetisisang”, di keteka dilemo tse 10 tsa ho ananela le ho hlompha batho ba sebeditseng ka bokgabane ka hare le ka ntle ho mabala a dipapadi.
tgt: Lo msitho wonikezelo-mbasa, uququzelelwe phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukugqwesha asikuko ukuba ube ungoyena ungcono koko kukwenza okona kungcono”, ubhiyozela iminyaka eli-10 yokuhlonipha nokuwonga abadlali namaqela agqwesileyo ebaleni nangaphandle kwebala.

src: MaAforika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho tshehetsa ketshalo ena ka ho kgetha Naledi ya Selemo ya Dipapadi ya Maemo a Kabinete Mabapi le Dintlha tsa Bohlokwa Maemong a Hajwale.
tgt: Abantu baseMzantsi Afrika bayakhuthazwa ukuba bawuxhase lo msitho ngokuvotela uMdlali ongoYena uGqwesileyo kuNyaka wama-20.

src: Kabinete e imatahantse le Moporesidente Zuma le badudi ba matjhabeng ka ho tshwela ka mathe ka matla ditlhaselo tsa boferekanyi tsa moraorao tjena tse etsahetseng Beirut (Lebanon), Baghdad (Iraq), Yola (Nigeria) le Paris (Fora), tse bakileng tahlehelo ya bophelo ba batho ba se nang molato le tshenyo ya thepa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi njengoMongameli kunye noluntu lwehlabathi ilugxeka kabukhali uhlaselo lobunqolobi oluthe lwaqhubeka e-Beirut (e-Lebanon), e-Baghdad (e-Iraq), eYola (e-Nigeria) nase-Paris (e-France), noluthe lwakhokelela ekulahlekeni kobomi babantu abamsulwa nokutshatyalaliswa kwempahla nezakhiwo.

src: Aforika Borwa e ema e tiile ho tshweleng ka mathe ha yona ha ditlhaselo kaofela tse tobileng badudi ba se nang molato mme e boeletsa mmono wa yona wa hore boferekanyi, ka sebopeho sefe kapa sefe le hore bo tswa hokae, bo keke ba amohelwa.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika ume awugungqi ekugxekeni lonke uhlaselo olugxile kubantu abamsulwa ukwayiphinda indawo yokuba ubunqolobi, nokuba buluhlobo luni na kwaye luvela phi na, alusokuze lunyamezeleke.

src: Kabinete e tshehetsa diketso tsa Komiti ya Matona a Mmuso e mabapi le Kgaello ya Metsi le Komello bakeng sa ho bebofatsa kgahlamelo ya komello le ho kgothaletsa badudi ho sebedisa metsi ka polokeho bakeng sa ho tiisetsa phepelo ya kamoso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawaxhasa amanyathelo eKomiti yabaPhathiswa kaRhulumente (i-IMC) engokuNqaba kwaManzi neMbalela ukuthibaza ifuthe negalelo lembalela ikwabongoza uluntu ukuba luwasebenzise ngobunono amanzi khona akwazi ukubakho ngokwaneleyo kwixesha elizayo.

src: Mmuso o ekeditse ka R96,6 milione ho R352,6 milione ya sethathong ho tshehetsa mekutu ya naha ya ho imolla mathata a komello.
tgt: Urhulumente wongeze imali ezizigidi zeerandin ezingama-96,6 kwezizigidi zeerandi ezingama-352,6 yakuqala ebekelwe bucala ukwenzela ukuxhasa amalinge okunika umnyenyevu kwimbalela kweli lizwe.

src: Sena se kenyeletsa ho rekwa ha ditanka tsa metsi tse 45 bakeng sa ho fuwa dibaka tse amehileng, ho epa dipetse le tlhabollo, papallo ya metsi le ho laola tlhokeho, le ho thusa ka mehlodi.
tgt: Oku kuquka ukuthengwa kwezigadla ezibeleke iitanki zamanzi ukwenzela ukuba kuhanjiswe amanzi kwimimandla echaphazelekileyo, ukubhola imingxuma yokutsala amanzi nokuyihlaziya, ukongiwa kwamanzi nolawulo lwendlela asetyenziswa ngayo nokwandiswa kwemithombo yamanzi.

src: Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Dibaka tsa Mahae le Tlhabollo ya Mobu le tla dumella hore ho falliswe mehlape ho tloha dibakeng tse thefulehileng ka ho fetisisa ho iswa mobung oo e leng wa mmuso moo ho ntseng ho na le makgulo a betere.
tgt: ISebe loPhuhliso lwamaPhandle noBuyekezo lwemiHlaba kwimimandla echaphazeleke kakhulu liza kuvumela ukuba kufuduselwe imfuyo kumhlaba karhulumente apho kusekho khona amadlelo angcono.

src: Hodima moo, Lefapha la Kopanelo ya Puso le Merero ya Botjhaba le hokahane le Bomeyara bakeng sa ho kenya tshebetsong ditsela tse fapafapaneng tsa ho baballa metsi tlasa tataiso ya Lefapha la Metsi le Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere.
tgt: Ukongeza apho, iSebe loLawulo lweNtsebenziswano neMicimbi yezeMveli nooSodolophu liququzelele ukufezekiswa kwamanyathelo awohlukahlukeneyo wokonga amanzi ngokukhokelwa liSebe lezaManzi noGutyulo.

src: Tsena di kenyeletsa ho hlahisa dithibelo tsa tshebediso ya metsi ho disa boimatahanyo le dithibelo tsa tshebediso ya metsi ho fana ka dikotlo moo ho hlokahalang ho beha ka sehloohong tokiso ya ho dutla ha metsi ho kgothaletsa dithekenoloji tse hlwahlwa tse jwaloka matlwana a sa sebediseng metsi a mangata ha a hulelwa ho bokella metsi a pula le ho sebedisa metsi a sebeditseng bakeng sa ho nosetsa.
tgt: Oku kuquka ukumiselwa kwemiqathango yokusetyenziswa kwamanzi ukuhlola ukuthotyelwa kwayo ukuwisa izohlwayo apho kukho imfuneko khona ukubeka phambili umba wokulungiswa kweempompo nemibhobho yamanzi evuzayo ukukhuthaza ubuchwepheshe bokusebenzisa ngobuchule amanzi ezifana nezigcini-manzi zamagumbi angasese ezikhupha amanzi amancinci xa kugungxulwa ukuqokelelwa kwamanzi emvula nokusebenzisa amanzi asebenzileyo ukunkcenkceshela.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o ile a etella pele kemedi ya Aforika Borwa ho Seboka sa Baetapele ba G20 Antalya, ho la Turkey ho tloha ka la 15 ho isa ka la 16 Pudungwana 2015.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma ebekhokele igqiza laseMzantsi Afrika ukuya kwiNgqungquthela yeeNkokheli ze-G20 e-Antalya, e-Turkey ukususela ngomhla we-15 ukuya kowe-16 kweyeNkanga yowama-2015, Umxholo wale ngqungquthela ubusithi ukuqukeka, utyalo-mali nokufezekisa.

src: Mookotaba wa seboka e ne e le kenyeletso, matsete le ho kenngwa tshebetsong.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uphakathi kwaMazwe angama-51 athe atyikitya iSivumelwano sokwaBelana ngokuZenzekelayo ngoLwazi lweRhafu e-Berlin, eGermany kweyeDwarha yowama-2015.

src: Aforika Borwa e hara dinaha tse 51 tse saenneng Tumello ya Phapanyetsano ya Tlhahisoleseding ya Lekgetho Berlin, ho la Jeremane ka Mphalane 2015.
tgt: Amazwe aza kuqalisa ukwabelana ngolwazi ngowama-2017, okuza kuxhaswa ngumthetho ophambi kwePalamente ngoku sithetha nje.

src: Dinaha di tla qala ho fapanyetsana tlhahisoleseding ka 2017, e tla hlakiswa ke molao oo hajwale o tekilweng ka hara Palamente.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma ukwamnkele ukuqukunjelwa kwemiba yokusebenza eli-15 ye-G20/uMbutho weNtsebenziswano yezoQoqosho noKhukuluseko lweziSeko zoPhuhliso neprojekthi yokuShenxisa iNgeniso, ebiyimiba ebaluleke kakhulu ukuqinisekisa ukungabikho komkhethe nokukhusela imithombo engenisa imali yamazwe e-Afrika esemazantsi eSahara.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o amohetse qeto ya dintlha tsa tshebetso tse15 tsa G20/Mokgatlo bakeng sa porojeke ya Tshebedisanommoho le Kgoholeho ya Motheo wa Ntshetsopele le ho Suthiswa ha Phaello, tseo di neng di le hlokolosi bakeng sa ho netefatsa ho hloka leeme le ho tiisetsa motheo wa lekeno wa dinaha tse ka Borwa ho Sahara.
tgt: Amalungu eBhunga labaPhathiswa yoMbutho weRhafu yoRhwebo we-Afrika aseMazantsi (i-SACU) ahlangene ngomhla we-11 kweyeNkanga yowama-2015 e-Windhoek, eNamibia kusuku olungaphambi kokumiselwa ngokusesikweni kwekomkhulu le-SACU nengxoxo ezingekho sesikweni zoMongameli neeNkokeli zoRhulumente ze-SACEli bhunga lisebenzise eli thuba ukukhumbuza ngenkqubela esele yenziwe kwiSicwangciso esiManqaku Maathandathu ukususela kwintlanganiso yalo yokugqibela nokugxininisa kwakhona ukuzinikela kwalo kwi-SACIbhunga livumile ukuba i-SACU kufanele ingoneli nje kukwabelana ngemali eyingeniso koko idlulele kwilinge lophuhliso eliza kuxhasa indibaniselwano kulo mmandla.

src: Ditho tsa Lekgotla la Matona a Kopano ya Makgetho a Madiboho a Aforika e Borwa (SACU) di kopane ka la 11 Pudungwana 2015 Windhoek, ho la Namibia letsatsing le eteletseng pele ho bulwa ha ntlokgolo ya SACU le dipuisano tseo e seng tsa semmuso tsa Dihlooho tsa Dipuso tsa SACU le Mmuso.
tgt: Amalungu amnkele isicwangciso sendlela emakwenziwe ngayo nesicwangciso sokusebenzela ukulungiselela imbizo eza kubanjwa kweyeSilimela yowama-2016.

src: Lekgotla le sebedisitse monyetla ona bakeng sa ho thuisa kgatelopele e entsweng mabapi le Moralo wa Dintlha tse Tsheletseng esale ho tshwere kopano ya ho qetela le ho toboketsa botjha boitlamo ba bona ho SACLekgotla le dumellane hore SACU e tshwanela ho sebetsa ho fihlella ka nqane ho karolelano ya lekeno ho ya boikitlaetsong ba ntshetsopele bo tla tshehetsa kopanelo ka hara lebatowa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamkela iziPhumo zoPhicotho-zincwadi lowama-2014/15 lorhulumente wesizwe nabamaphondo.

src: Kabinete e amohela Diphetho tsa Tlhatlhobo tsa 2014-15 tsa mmuso wa naha le wa porofense.
tgt: Le ngxelo ibonakalisa ukuphucuka okuqhubekayo phantse kuyo yonke imiba yophicotho-zincwadi lukarhulumente wesizwe nabamaphondo.

src: Tlaleho e bontsha ntlafalo e tsitsitseng mabakeng kaofela a diphetho tsa ditlhatlhobo tsa mmuso wa naha le wa porofense.
tgt: Kukhombisa uphuhliso olukekelele kulawulo olungcono nolawulo lwezezimali oluhle nokuxhasa ulawulo olungcono njengokuba amasebe amaninzi efumene iziphumo zophicotho-zincwadi eziungenachaphaza.

src: Di bontsha ho lebisa mokgweng o motle wa bolaodi le taolo e imametseng ya ditjhelete le ho matlafatsa bolaodi bo botle ka ha mafapha a mangatanyana a fumane ditlhatlhobo tse hlwahlwa.
tgt: Oku kuphucuka kukwabonisa ukuba urhulumente usebenza ngamandla ukuqinisekisa ngokuba kufanele akwazi ukuphendula acacise kuzo zonke iinkalo zomsebenzi wakhe.

src: Ntlafalo ena e boela e supa hore mmuso o sebetsa ka thata bakeng sa ho netefatsa boikarabelo dibakeng tsa ona tsohle tsa mosebetsi wa ona.
tgt: Nangona kukho oku ukuphucuka, urhulumente uthathe isigqibo sokuqhubekeka exhasa amasebe afumane iziphumo ezingezihle nokuqinisekisa ukuba yonke nje inkqubo karhulumente isebenza ngokugqibeleleyo.

src: Ntle le ntlafalo ena, mmuso o entse qeto ya ho tswella ho tshehetsa mafapha a nang le diphuputso tse sa kgahliseng le ho netefatsa hore mafapha oohle a mmuso a sebetsa ho ya ka tebello.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukubekwa esikhundle kukaJaji Mandisa Muriel Maya njengoSekela Mongameli weeJaji yeNkundla ePhakamileyo yeziBhenonguMongameli Zuma ngokwemimiselo yecandelo 174 (4) loMgaqo-siseko weRhiphabliki yoMzantsi Afrika wowe-1996 kunye noJaji Nonkosi Zoliswa Mhlantla njengejaji yeNkundla yoMgaqo-siseko ngokwemimiselo yecandelo 174 (4) loMgaqo-siseko weRhiphabliki yoMzantsi Afrika wowe-1996.Oku kubekwa esikhundleni komeleza ukuzinikela koMzantsi Afrika kumakulingwane ngokwesini kwelona nqanaba liphakamileyo nokuqhubela phambili ukudala inguqu kwiinkundla.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho thonngwa ha Moahlodi Mandisa Muriel Maya jwaloka Motlatsi wa Moporesidente wa Lekgotla le Phahameng la Maipiletso ke Moporesidente Zuma ho ya ka karolo 174(4) ya Molaotheo wa Riphaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa the 1996 le Moahlodi Nonkosi Zoliswa Mhlantla jwaloka moahlodi wa Lekgotla la Dinyewe la Molaotheo ho ya ka Karolo 174(3) ya Molaotheo wa Rephaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa 1996 ka tatelano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana nazo zombini ezi jaji izinqwenelela okuhle kodwa ekwenzeni lo msebenzi ubaluleke kakhulu kwicandelo leeNkundla laseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Dithonyo tsena di matlafatsa boitlamo ba Aforika Borwa ba tekatekano ya bong maemong a phahameng ka ho fetisisa le ho akofisa phethoho ya makgotla a dinyewe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana noGq S’thembile Ngidi nothe wenza imbali xa ephumelela imfundo enesidanga kwiKholeji yobuGqirha yaseMzantsi Afrika njengongowokuqala ugqirha oyingcali yesifo somhlaza ongumntu wasetyhini ontsundu aze abe ngowesibini kweli lizwe.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa baahlodi ka bobedi le ho ba lakaletsa tse molemo mabapi le ho phethahatsa boikarabelo bona bo hlokolosi ka hara Makgotla a Dinyewe a Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamncoma uMenzi weeFilimu waseMzantsi Afrika u-Reina-Marie Loader omboniso-bhanyabhanya wakhe u-‘Horn’ ufumane amawonga amaninzi, kuquka nokuchongelwa iMbasa yokuLondolozwa kweMikhombe yowama-2015 kweyeKhala phantsi kwecandelo: Eyona Filimu iLumnkisayo, iFundisayo neNkxaso-mali, nokuphumelela iMbasa yeYona Filimu yoLondolozo kuMsitho weFilimu weHlabathi e-New York, e-USIKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano olunzulu kusapho, izihlobo nezalamane zikaSekela-Mphathiswa wezaManzi noGutyulo, uNksz, Pamela Tshwete, ngokushiywa ngumama wakhe, uMama uRuth Nomzi Zondeki.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Ngaka S’thembile Ngidi ya entseng nalane ka ho fumana mangolo a thuto ho tswa ho Koletjhe ya tsa Kalafo ya Aforika Borwa jwaloka ngaka ya pele e alafang mofetshe ya mosadi ho tswa KwaZulu-Natal ebile e le wa bobedi feela ka hara naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano olunzulu kurhulumente waseNew Zealand, usapho, izihlobo nezalamane neManyano yeBhola yoMboxo yaseNew Zealand ngokushiywa ngumdlali womboxo oyimbalasane, uJonah Tali Lomu, nobe nefuthe elikhulu kulo mdlalo.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Moetsi wa difilimi wa Aforika Borwa Reina-Marie Loader eo tlhakisetso ya hae ‘Horn’ e fumaneng dithoholetso, ho kenyeletsa ho kgethwa bakeng sa Dikgau tsa Paballo ya Ditshukudu tsa 2015 ka Phupu mokgahlelong wa kgau ya Temoso, Thuto le Merero ya Ditjhelete e Hlwahlwa ka ho Fetisisa, le ho hapa kgau bakeng sa Filimi e Hlwahlwa ka ho Fetisisa ya Paballo ya Tlhaho ho Mokete wa Difilimi tsa Matjhaba wa 2015 New York City, ho la Amerika.
tgt: IzikhundlaZonke izikhundla zixhomekeke ekuqinisekisweni kwamabakala emzemfundo kunye nokuqinisekiswa okufanelekileyo kwezokhuselo.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona ho lelapa le metswalle ya Motlatsi wa Letona la Metsi le Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere, Ms Pamela Tshwete, ka ho lahlehelwa ke mme wa hae, Mama Ruth Nomzi Zondeki.
tgt: Ukwandiselwa iminyaka emihlanu kweSivumelwano seNgqesho sikaMnu Maswahle Diphofa – uMlawuli Jikelele (u-DG): kwiSebe lezabaSebenzi bakaRhulumente noLawulo.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona ho mmuso wa New Zealand, lelapa, metswalle le Mokgatlo wa Rakbi wa New Zealand ka ho lahlehelwa ke kgalala ya rakbi, Jonah Tali Lomu, ya entseng kgahlamelo e matla papading ena.
tgt: Ukwandiselwa iinyanga ezilishumi elinesibini kweSivumelwano seNgqesho sikaNksz Nonkululeko Sindane –u-DG: iSebe lezobuLungisa noPhuhliso loMgaqo-siseko.

src: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di tla lokelwa ke ho netefatswa ha mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang.
tgt: UMn uLivhuwani Tommy Makhode njengoSekela-DG: uCwangciso lweZiko neNkxaso kwiSebe lezeNzululwazi nobuChwepheshe.

src: Katoloso ya Konteraka bakeng sa dilemo tse hlano ya Monghadi Maswahle Diphofa – Motsamaisi Kakaretso (DG): Lefapha la Tshebeletso le Tsamaiso ya Setjhaba.
tgt: UMnu Rory Gallocher njengeGosa lesiGqeba eliyiNtloko soGunyaziwe woLawulo lezeziNdlu zoluntu.

src: Katoloso ya Konteraka bakeng sa dikgwedi tse leshome le metso e mmedi ya Mofumahadi Nonkululeko Sindane – DG: Lefapha la Toka le Ntshetsopele ya Molaotheo.
tgt: UGq Pradish Rampersadh njengoMlawuli okwisiGqeba soLawulo omtsha weBhunga lamaGcisa ezeNzululwazi yeNdalo lwaseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Monghadi Livhuwani Tommy Makhode jwaloka Motlatsi wa Motsamaisi Kakaretso (DDG): Meralo ya Ditheo le Tshehetso ka hara Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji.
tgt: UMnu Mark Barnes njengeGosa lesiGqeba eliyiNtloko lePosi yoMzantsi Afrika.

src: Monghadi Rory Gallocher jwaloka Mohlanka e Moholo wa Phethahatso (CEO) wa Bolaodi ba Taolo ya Matlo a Kahisano.
tgt: IBhodi yeBhanki yoPhuhliso ye-Afrika eseMazantsi:i. UMnu Jabulani Philip Moleketi – (uqeshiwe kwakhona ekwanguSihlalo)ii.

src: Ngaka Pradish Rampersadh jwaloka Molaodi wa Phethahatso e motjha bakeng sa Lekgotla la Aforika Borwa la Diporofeshene tsa Saense ya Tlhaho.
tgt: UMnu Msokoli Frans Baleni – (uqeshiwe ekwanguSekela- Sihlalo)iii.

src: Monghadi Mark Barnes jwaloka CEO wa Sehlopha sa Kantoro ya Poso ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: UNksz Martie Janse van Rensburg – (uMlawuli ongekho kwisigqeba soLawulo)iv.

src: Boto ya Banka ya Ntshetsopele ya Aforika e Borwa:i. Monghadi Jabulani Philip Moleketi – (o thontswe hape e le Modulasetulo)ii.
tgt: UNksz Malijeng Theresa Ngqaleni – (uMlawuli ongekho kwisigqeba soLawulo) no-v. UNksz Kameshni Naidoo – (uqeshiwe kwakhona njengoMlawuli okwisiGqeba soLawulo).

src: Ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha mananeo a bohlokwa a mmuso.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ezingundoqo.

src: Kabinete e amohetswe ho saenwa ha ditumellano tse 26 tsa boleng ba R94 bilione nakong ya Leeto la Puso la haufinyane tjena la Moporesidente wa China Xi Jinping.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyiswa kukutyikitywa kwezivumelwano ezingama-26 ezixabisa imali ezibhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama-94 ngethuba loTyelelo lasebuRhulumenteni nguMongameli waseChina u-Xi Jinping.

src: Ditumellano tse saennweng di kenyeleditse R12 bilione bakeng sa ho aha polante ya tlhahiso ya makoloi ka hara Aforika Borwa, thuso ya kadimo ya US$500 milione ho Eskom bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya meralo wa motheo le tiisetso ya thuso ya ditjhelete ya US$2.5 bilione bakeng sa Transnet ho tswa ho Banka ya Ntshetsopele ya China.
tgt: Ezi zivumelwano zityikityiweyo ziquka imali ezibhiliyoni zeerandi ezili-12 yokwakha umzi-mveliso weemoto eMzantsi Afrika, imali-mboleko ezizigidi ezingama-500 zeedola zaseMelika (i-US$) eya kwa-Eskom yokuphuhlisa iziseko ezingundoqo kunye nemali ezibhiliyoni eziyi-2.5 zeedola zaseMelika eqinisikiweyo eza kuya kwa-Transnet isuka kwiBhanki yoPhuhliso yaseChina.

src: Jwaloka karolo ya Foramo ya bo-2 e mabapi le Tshebedisano-mmoho ya China-Aforika (FOCAC), Moporesidente Xi Jinping o entse boitlamo ba US$60 bilione bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya Aforika.
tgt: Njengenxalenye yeQonga lesiBini leNtsebenziswano phakathi kweChina ne-Afrika (i-FOCAC), uMongameli u-Xi Jinping uthembise ngemali ezibhiliyoni ezingama-60 zeedola zaseMelika.

src: Kamohelo ya Tumellano le Moralo wa Tshebetso wa (2016-2018) ho FOCAC o matlafatsa bosemphato bo ntseng bo hola ba kutlwano pakeng tsa Aforika le China, bo tla bula menyetla e metjha ya kgwebisano le matsete bakeng sa ho rotetsa kgolo ya moruo.
tgt: Ukwamnkelwa kwesiBhambathiso esitsha kunye nesiCwangciso sokuSebenza (sowama-2016-2018) ngethuba le-FOCAC kuqinisa amatyathanga akhulayo entsebenziswano phakathi kwe-Afrika neChina, nto leyo iza kuvula amathuba amatsha orhwebo notyalo-mali aze ancede ukukhwezela uhlumo loqoqosho.

src: Moruo o boetse o fumane matlafatso ya moruo ka tsebiso ya Mokgatlo wa BMW wa Aforika Borwa ya matsete a R6 bilione polanteng ya ona e Rosslyn, ho la Pretoria, e leng bopaki ba semphato sa bohlokwa se teng pakeng tsa dikgwebo le mmuso, le karolo e bapalwang ke dikgwebo ntshetsopeleng ya moruo.
tgt: Uqoqosho lweli luphinde lafumana enye inkxaso ngokuthi icandelo eliseMzantsi Afrika leNkampani yakwa-BMW lazisa utyalo-mali oluzizigidi zeerandi ezithandathu kumzi-mveliso wayo oseRosslyn, ePitoli, into leyo ibubungqina obuchaza ubudlelwano bentsebenziswano obubalulekileyo obukhoyo phakathi kukarhulumente kunye namashishini, kunye nendima edlalwa licandelo lamashishini kuphuhliso loqoqosho.

src: Ka Labobedi la, 8 Tshitwe, Moporesidente Zuma o abile Ditlotlo tsa Naha ho baahi ba Aforika Borwa le melata e hlahelletseng ka mahetla ba nyehetseng bakeng sa matlafatso ya batho.
tgt: NgoLwesibini, umhla wesi-8 kweyoMngqa, uMongameli Zuma uwonge ngeeMbasa zeSizwe abemi boMzantsi Afrika kunye nezinye iingangalala zezikhulu zamazwe angaphandle ezidlala indima emandla kumaphulo okuphucula ubomi boluntu.

src: Ditlotlo tsa Naha ke motsotso wa ho sheba morao ho matla, ho keteka le ho ba motlotlo ka batho ba rona.
tgt: Ixesha lokunikezela ngeeMbasa zeSizwe lixesha lokuba sihlafune sicamngca, sigiye kwaye sizive sinelunda singabantu beli.

src: Di keteka phihlello ya botho, ho intsha sehlabelo ha botho le maiteko a botho tse etsang hore naha ya rona e be tulo e betere.
tgt: Ngezi mbasa sibulela ngemisebenzi yoluntu, iziganeko zokuzinikela kunye namalinge abo agqibeleleyo awenza ukuba eli lizwe libe lilizwe elingcono namhlanje.

src: Re hlompha baamohedi ba Ditlotlo tsa Naha ba 2015.
tgt: Sibothulela umnqwazi bonke abo bawongiweyo kwiMbasa zeSizwe zowama-2015.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho sebedisa metsi ka paballo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba basebenzise amanzi ngononophelo.

src: Sena ke bakeng sa ho tshehetsa mekgwa e nkuweng bakeng sa ho fedisa dikgaello tsa metsi, tse mpefaditsweng ke leqhubu la motjheso le fihlelletsweng ke naha dibekeng tse fetileng.
tgt: Ngokwenza oku bakube baxhasa amalinge athathiweyo ukuphungula ingxaki yokunqongophala kwamanzi, eya ifuna ukuthatha unyawo ngenxa yelanga ebelitshisa ngokumandla kulo lonke eli kwezi veki zimbalwa zidlulileyo.

src: Ha dipula tsa moraorao tjena dikarolong tse ding tsa naha di fane ka kimoloho e itseng, kgaello ya metsi ya naha e dula e le phephetso mme e batla hore bohle re sebedise metsi ka paballo le ka boikarabelo.
tgt: Nangona imvula kwindawo ezithile zeli zize nethontsana zaphungula ubuzaza bembalela, ingxaki yokunqongophala kwamanzi yona isemi kwaye ifuna ukuba sonke sisebenzise amanzi ngobunono nangenkathalo.

src: Kabinete e hlahisitse kananelo ya yona ho maAforika Borwa kaofela bakeng sa ho nka karolo ho letsholo la Matsatsi a 16 la Thibelo ya Merusu Kgahlanong le Basadi le Bana la selemong sena, le neng le fela ka la 10 Tshitwe 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyababulela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ngokuthatha inxaxheba kwiphulo leeNtsuku ezili-16 zokuLwa ubuNdlobongela obujoliswe kwabaseTyhini naBantwana, eliphele izolo.

src: Diphuphutso tsa moraorao di bontsha dipalo tse phahameng tsa ditshwaetso tse ntjha tsa HIV, haholoholo ka hara basadi ba batjha le banana ka hara Aforika ba mahareng a dilemo tse 15 le tse 24.MaAforika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho tswela pele ka tshebetso ya twantsho ena letsatsi ka leng jwaloka karolo ya ho ba le kgahlanong le Merusu ho Basadi le Bana ya #365 Days Campaign le ya #CountMeIn le tla tswela pele ho phatlalla le selemo se tlang.
tgt: Iziphumo zophando zakutsha nje zibonisa ukuba baninzi abantu abasulelwa okokuqala yiNtsholongwane kaGawulayo (i-HIV), ingakumbi kwabasetyhini abaselula kunye namantombazana e-Afrika abaphakathi kweminyaka eli-15 nama-24 ubudala.

src: Ka ho sebedisa #365 Days Campaign le #CountMeIn, naha e hloka ho tswela pele ho ngoka ditho tsa setjhaba, haholoholo banna, hore ba kopanye matsoho le mmuso bakeng sa ho sebetsana le koduwa WEBTOKEN boikarabelo ba setjhaba, bobedi ka bonngwe le ka kopanelo, ho kgina ho ata ha kokwanahloko ka ho ela hloko bophelo ba rona bo botle le ba ba bang.
tgt: Abemi beli bayakhuthazwa ukuba baliqhubele phambili eli phulo libe likhubalo labo kwizinto abazenza imihla ngemihla njengenxalenye yephulo le-#365 Days Campaign lokuLwa ubuNdlobongela obuJoliswe kwabaseTyhini naBantwana kunye nephulo i-#CountMeIn eliza kuqhubeka kuwo wonke lo nyaka uzayo.

src: Kabinete e ananetse kgatelopele e seng e entswe ke Lekgotla la Diphuputso tsa Saense le Indaseteri bakeng sa ho ntshetsapele tsamaiso ya tlhahiso ya tsa tlhaho ya masole a lwantshang HIV.
tgt: Ngamaphulo i-#365 Days Campaign kunye ne-#CountMeIn, eli lizwe kufuneka liqhubeleke likhuthaza abantu, ingakumbi amadoda, ukuba babambisane norhulumenete ukulwa lo bhubhane.

src: Sena se tlisa indaseteri ya kalafo haufi le pheko ya thibelo e sa bitsing tjhelete e ngata.
tgt: Luxanduva lesizwe, umntu emnye okanye thina sisonke, ukuphelisa ukunwenwa kwale ntsholongwane ngokuthi sizibophelele ekukhathaleleni impilo yethu neyabanye.

src: Ha naha e ntse e sokola ho fumana pheko ya HIV le AIDS, maAforika Borwa a ntse a lebeletswe ho etsa thobalano e bolokehileng le ho tsitlallela dipehelo tsa ABC (Abstain, Be faithful and Condomise) bakeng sa ho thibela ditshwaetso tse ntjha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawubulela umsebenzi owenziwe liBhunga loPhando ngezobuNzululwazi namaShishini (i-CSIR) ngokuza nenkqubo yokuvelisa yezobunzululwazi yamachiza okulwa ne-HIV.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa kaofela baithuti, barutwana, matitjhere, barupelli, le dikolo le ditheo tsa thuto e phahameng ka ho phethela selemo se atlehileng sa dithuto, ho sa natswe diphephetso tse fihlelletsweng hara selemo.
tgt: Oku kulinyathelo elikhulu kwiphulo lokuzama ukuza nechiza elingazikubiza mali ininzi lokuthintela i-HINangona eli lizwe lisasokola ukufumana ichiza eliza kunyanga i-HIV noGawulayo (i-Aids), abemi beli kulindeleke ukuba bazikhusele xa besabelana ngesondo kwaye balandela imiqathango ye-ABC (Ukungazibandanyi nesondo, Ukunyaniseka nokuSebenzisa iKhondom) ukuze kungabikho abantu abatsha abasulelekayo.6 IKhabhinethi ibaqhwabela izandla abafundi, ootitshala, abahlohli izikolo kunye namaziko emfundo ephakamileyo ngokuqukumbela lo nyaka ngempumelelo, nangona bekukho imingeni namagingxi-gingxi ebekudityenwe nayo apha enyakeni.

src: Kabinete hape e lakaletsa tse molemo ditlhatlhobong tse tlang tsa 2016 ho ba dumetseng hore ditlhatlhobo di tjhetjhiswe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inqwenelela okuhle kodwa nabo bavumileyo ukuzirhoxisa iimviwo zabo bavuma ukuzibhala ngowama-20.7 ISebe loPhuhliso loLuntu, lisebenzisana neSebe lezoKhuselo kunye ne-Arhente yeSizwe yoPhuhliso loLutsha (i-NYDA), liza kubamba iNgqungquthela yoLutsha yesiThandathu.

src: Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba, ka tshebedisano-mmoho le Lefapha la Tshireletso le Lekala la Naha la Ntshetsopele ya Batjha (NYDA), le tla tshwara Kampo ya Batjha ya bo-6.
tgt: Le yinkqubo yokuphuhlisa izakhono zobunkokeli zolutsha efuna ukutshintsha izimilo, iingqondo kunye nokukhuthaza ulutsha ukuba luxhamle amathuba la aphambi kwalo.

src: Sena ke lenaneo la ntshetsopele ya boetapele ba batjha le rerileng ho fetola boitshwaro, mmono wa bophelo le ho matlafatsa batjha ka menyetla e teng eo ba ka e tholang.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ikwaliqonga lokuqeqesha amakhwenkwana aselula aze akhule abe ngamadoda okwenyani abaxabisileyo nabahloniphileyo abantu basetyhini.8 Isivumelwano esityikitywe phakathi koMpathiswa weMfundo noQeqesho, uGq Blade Nzimande kunye namanya amazwe e-BRICS – iBrazil, iRussia, i-India kunye neChina – sineenjongo zokuqulunqa isicwangciso-sikhokelo sezivumelwano zentsebenziswano kwezemfundo zelixa elizayo.

src: Kampo e thusa hape ka ho lekola le ho ruta bashemane ba batjha ho hola hore e be banna ba ananelang le ho hlompha basadi.
tgt: Esi sivumelwano siquka imiba yezemfundo ngobubanzi, isicwangciso-qhinga somgaqo-nkqubo wezemfundo, iikholeji zeMfundo noQeqesho lobuGcisa nobuChule (i-TVET) kunye nemfundo ephakamileyo.

src: Tumellano e saenetsweng ka kopanelo pakeng tsa Letona la Thuto e Phahameng le Thupello, Ngaka Blade Nzimande, le bomphato ba BRICS – Brazil, Russia, India le China – e reretswe ho ntshetsapele moralo bakeng sa tshebedisano ya bokamoso thutong.
tgt: Iikholeji ze-TVET zingadlala indima enkulu ekuvuleleni abantu abatsha amathuba ezoqoqosho, zibe ngaxeshanye zisilwa imingeni yentswela-ngqesho, ukungalingani kunye nendlala ethwaxa uluntu lweli.

src: Tumellano e akaretsa thuto ya kakaretso, lewa la leano la thuto, Dikoletjhe tsa Thuto le Thupello ya Tekginiki le Mesebetsi (TVET) le thuto e phahameng.
tgt: Esi sivumelwano, esiza kuphucula umgagatho wokufundisa kunye nowemfundo yootitshala, sikwabophela iidyunivesiti zamazwe akwi-BRICKS ukuba zixhase amaphulo ophando ekubanjiswene ngawo kukhuthazwe iinkqubo zokufunda eziza kuqhutywa ngokusebenzisana nabo sele benaso isidanga sokuqala, abaqhuba izifundo zomgangatho wobugqirha nezabo sele beziphumele izidanga zobugqirha kunye nokupapasha ngokubambisana amaphepha neziphumo zophando zezobunzululwazi.9 ISebe lezeNzululwazi nobuChwepheshe belisingathe iNgqungquthela yaseMzantsi Afrika yezeNzululwazi phantsi komxholo othi: “ukukhuthaza inkcoko ngezenzululwazi”.

src: Dikoletjhe tsa TVET di na le bokgoni ba ho bula menyetla ya moruo bakeng sa batho ba batjha, ha ho ntse ho sebetsanwa le diphephetso tsa tlhokeho ya mesebetsi, ho se lekalekane, le bofuma bo amang badudi.
tgt: Ebengaphezulu kwama-45 amazwe athathe inxaxheba kwiingxoxo ebezingonxulumano phakathi kwenzululwazi, ubuchwepheshe kunye nokuyila izinto ezintsha noluntu, ngokubhekisele ingakumbi kuphuhliso.

src: Tumellano ena, e tla ntlafatsa boleng ba thuto le thuto ya matitjhere, hape e tlama diyunivesithi tsa BRICS ho tshehetsa diporojeke tse kopanetsweng tsa diphuputso, ho kgothaletsa mananeo a tshebedisano-mmoho maemong a dithuto tsa kamora yunivesithi, a bongaka le a dithuto tsa kamora bongaka le ho phatlalatsa mmoho diphetho tsa merero ya tsa saense.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ibisetyenziselwe ukuqinisa amatyathanga entsebenziswano kwezobunzululwazi, ubuchwepheshe kunye noyilo phakathi koMzantsi Afrika namazwe ehlabathi.10 UMzantsi Afrika uza kumelwa kwiBhunga loMbutho weHlabathi wezaseLwandle.

src: Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji le ne le tshwere Foramo ya Saense ya Aforika Borwa tlasa mookotaba “Re hotetsa dipuisano ka saense”.
tgt: Eli linyathelo lokuqala elibalulekileyo eliza kwenza eli lizwe kunye neli lizwekazi liwaxhamle amathuba akhoyo kwicandelo lezaselwandle.

src: Dinaha tse fetang 45 di ile tsa kenela dingangisano tse mabapi le tshebedisano mahareng a saense, thekenoloji le ntlafatso le setjhaba, haholoholo ntlheng ya ntshetsopele.
tgt: Lo mbutho nguwo owamnkela izigqibo ezingemiba yezaselwandle yehlabathi, ukusuka kuQoqosho lwaseLwandle, ukuya kumalinge ohlangulo kunye nemiba yezokhuselo nokhuseleko elwandle.

src: Foramo hape e sebeditse bakeng sa ho matlafatsa lewa la saense, thekenoloji le semphato sa ntjhafatso la matjhaba la Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Ukuthatha inxaxheba kulo mbutho kuza kuxhasa inkqubo karhulumente yokuvula amathuba kwicandelo lezaselwandle ngokusebenzisa isiCwangciso-qhinga soQoqosho lwaseLwandle olungenabuNgozi kwiNdalo kunye ne-Operation Phakisa, enjongo zayo ikukudala imisebenzi esisigidi ngowama-2033.‎1.11 UMkhosi weSizwe woMzantsi Afrika woKhuselo (i-SANDF) uqalisile ngenkqubo yokuhlaziya iSiqithi iSalisbury esisisiKhululo soMkhosi waManzi eDurban ukuba ube liziko lomkhosi wamanzi elisebenza ngokupheleleyo.

src: Sena ke mohato wa bohlokwa ho isa moo re tla bonang bokgoni ba naha le kontinente lekaleng la tsa mawatle.
tgt: Ukuhlaziywa kweli ziko kuza kuphucula ukhuselo kwaye kube negalelo kuqoqosho lwaselwandle.12 ISebe lezeMpilo, lisebenzisana neSoul City kunye neTimes Media, liphehlelele ijelo losasazo olulungiselwe ezempilo nendlela yokuziphatha, i-The Good Life Network kwijelo unombolo 199 ku-DStv.

src: Mokgatlo ona o ikarabella bakeng sa ho amohela diqeto tse mabapi le merero ya lefatshe ya tsa mawatle, ho tloha ho Moruo wa Mawatle, boikitlaetso ba pholoso le mabaka a polokeho le tshireletso lewatleng.
tgt: Eli jelo lisasaza iinkqubo ezahluka-hlukeneyo, ezonwabisayo nezididiyelwe apha ekhaya ngesondlo, impilo nokuphila qete, amalungelo oluntu, ezesondo zolutsha, i-HIV nesifo sephepha (i-TB) kunye namalungelo abathengi nawesini.

src: Bonkakarolo setheong sena bo tla tshehetsa lenaneo la mmuso la ho bula bokgoni ba naha ka Lewa la Moruo wa Mawatle le Operation Phakisa, tse rerileng ho hlahisa mesebetsi e fetang milione ka 2033.‎.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba balibukele eli jelo.

src: Lebotho la Naha la Aforika Borwa le qadile ka tsamaiso ya ho hlabolla Seteishene sa Sehlekehleke sa Lebotho la Lewatle sa Salisbury se Durban ho ba kampo ya lebotho la lewatle e sebetsang ka botlalo.
tgt: Izigqibo zeKhabhinethi ezingundoqo.1 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa kwePhepha lokuCacisa i-Inshorensi yeSizwe yezeMpilo (i-NHI) yoMzantsi Afrika, ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: Thlabollo ya dibaka tsena e tla ntlafatsa bokgoni ba tshireletso le ho nyehela bakeng sa moruo wa mawatle.
tgt: I-NHI iyinxalenye yeenguqu ezingundoqo ezize norhulumente kwicandelo lezempilo.

src: Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle, ka kopanelo le Soul City le Times Media, le thakgotse kanale e reretsweng tsa bophelo bo botle le mokgwa wa bophelo ya Good Life Network ho DStv kanaleng ya 199.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo uphakamisa ukuba kufuneka urhulumente abonelele ngeenkonzo zonyango wonke umntu oya kumaziko ezonyango karhulumente.

src: Kanale ena e fana ka dikateng tse fapafapaneng, tse thabisang le ho ba tse hlahisitsweng lapeng mabapi le phepo, bophelo bo botle le ho kwena, ditokelo tsa botho, tsa motabo ho batjha, HIV le TB, mmoho le ditokelo tsa bareki le tsa bong.
tgt: I-NHI iza kuxhaswa ngemali ephuma kurhulumente wezwelonke futhi ekuza kuhlawulwa ngayo kunye neengcali zonyango zabucala ezifuna ukuthatha inxaxheba kwi-NHWakuba uqukunjelwe lo mgaqo-nkqubo, uza kuqaliswa ukusetyenziswa ngezigaba ezahlukeneyo kodwa uza kugxininisa kakhulu kwiindawo ezineenkonzo zezempilo ezinqongopheleyo.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ho boha kanale ena.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezeMpilo, uGq Aaron Motsoaledi, namhlanje uza kubamba intlanganiso noonondaba ngendlela eza kuqaliswa ukusetyenziswa ngayo i-NHI.2 IKhabhinethi iwuvumile uMgaqo-nkqubo weSizwe woPhuhliso oluHlanganisiweyo lwaBantwana abaseLula (i-ECD).Lo mgaqo-nkqubo uqulunqwe kuboniswene nabadlali-ndima abaninzi kweli candelo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho phatlalatswa ha Pampiri e Tshweu ya Inshorense ya Naha ya Bophelo bo Botle (NHI) ya Aforika Borwa, hore setjhaba se tshwaele.
tgt: Wawuyile naseluntwini ngeyoMdumba kowama-2015 ukuba luhlomle ngawo.

src: NHI ke karolo ya mmuso ya ho etsa diphetho tse kgolo ho tsa kalafo.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo uhlanganisiweyo we-ECD uza kuqinisekisa ukuba bonke abantwana abaselula neempelesi zabo bayakwazi ukuba banakho ukufumana iinkonzo ze-ECD ezisemgangathweni nezizeleyo ukusuka besesiswini ukuba xa bekwiBanga Lo mgaqo-nkqubo ubethelela nokuba ezi nkonzo kufuneka ziquke nabantwana abaneenzima ngokukhula ababudala bunokude kufike kwesibhozo.

src: Leano lena le sisinya bokgoni ba mmuso ba ho fana ka ditshebeletso tsa bongaka ho bohle ba etelang dikaho tsa kalafo.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo ukwanaso nesicwangciso-sikhokelo sokuba liliso futhi sivavanye ukuqinisekisa ukuba izibonelelo zawo zixhanyulwa ngabo bonke abantwana ngokungakhethi bala, sini okanye nkolo.

src: Le tla tshehetswa ka ditjhelete ka letlole la bohareng leo hape le tla ba teng ho dingaka tsa poraefete tse batlang ho nka karolo sekemeng sena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilivumile iPhepha eliCacisa uMgaqo-nkqubo wamaLungelo abaNtu abaKhubazekileyo kunye nesiCwangciso sokuPhunyezwa kwayo.

src: Hang ha ho se ho phethetswe tsohle, leano le tla kenngwa tshebetsong ho ya jwalo le dilemo le ho tsepamisa maikutlo haholo hore le qale dibakeng tse fumanang ditshebeletso tse nyane.
tgt: Oku kuhambelana neeNjongo zoPhuhliso oluZinzileyo oluquka nabo bakhubazekileyo, ezamnkelwa yiNtlanganiso eNkulu yeZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UNGA) ngeyoMsintsi kowama-2015.Lo mgaqo-nkqubo uza kukhawulezisa iinguqu kunye nokulungiswa ngokubhekisele ekuqukeni ngokupheleleyo, ukuhlanganiswa kunye nolingwano kubantu abakhubazekileyo.4 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa koMgaqo-nkqubo weSizwe woGutyulo ukuze uluntu luhlomle kuwo.

src: Letona la Bophelo bo Botle, Ngaka Aaron Motsoaledi, kajeno le tla tsebisa boraditaba ka phano ya NHKabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Leano le Kopanetsweng la Naha la Ntshetsopele ya Thuto ya Qalo ya Bana (ECD).Leano lena le hlahisitswe ka ditherisano le bankakarolo ba fapafapaneng ka hara lekala lena.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo ukhokelisa phambili ubomi babantu ngokuthi uzame kangangoko ukuba ubekele bucala imali yokuxhasa amaphulo eenkonzo ezikumgangatho ophezulu, kubonelelwe ngeenkonzo amakhaya angafumani zinkonzo zaneleyo, ngelithuba uzama ngaxeshanye ukulungisa nokuhlaziya iziseko ezingundoqo zogutyulo ezikhoyo.5 IKhabhineti ikuvumile ukungeniswa ePalamente kweNgxelo yoMzantsi Afrika yesiHlanu yamaXesha aThile (yowama-2009-2014) malunga nokuFezekiswa kwesiVumelwano sokuLwa zonke iiNtlobo zoCalu-calulo oluJoliswe kwabaseTyhini.

src: Le ile la sekasekwa ka ditherisano le setjhaba ka Tlhakola 2015.Leano le kopanetsweng la ECD le tla netefatsa hore bana bohle ba banyenyane le bahlokomedi ba bona ba kgona ho fihlella ditshebeletso tse pharalletseng tsa ECD ho tloha tswalong ho fihla ho Kereiti ya Leano lena le atolosetsa tshebeletso ho bana ba dilemo tse robedi ba nang le mathata a kgolo.
tgt: Le ngxelo inika isishwankathelo sokuba ingaba uthotho lwemithetho, imigaqo-nkqubo neenkqubo ezisetyenziswayo iyasebenza na iphinde futhi inyathele kwizinto ezenziwe ngempumelelo lilizwe malunga nokuxhotyiswa kwabasetyhini kunye nolingwano ngokwesini.

src: Leano ho ya pele le fana ka moralo wa peho leihlo le tekolo ho netefatsa hore le kenngwa tshebetsong ka bokgabane ho banabohle ho sa kgathallwe morabe, bong kapa bodumedi.
tgt: Le ngxelo iyakwamnkela nokuba kukho imingeni nemiqobo engapheliyo esokolisa kwidabi lokulwa ukungalingani nocalu-calulo kweli lizwe.6 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa kweDrafti yesiCwangciso seSizwe sokuSebenza sokuLwa ubuHlanga, uCalu-calulo ngokobuHlanga, ukuBukulwa kwaBantu bangaPhandle kunye nokuNye ukungaNyamezelani okuFana Noku, ukuze uluntu luhlomle ngawo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Pampiri e Tshweu ya Ditokelo tsa Batho ba phelang ka Boqhwala le Moralo wa ho kenngwa tshebetsong.
tgt: Esi sisicwangciso licebo lesizwe elihlangeneyo neliqiqisisiweyo esinjongo zaso ikukulwa ubuhlanga nokwakha uMzantsi Afrika ongacaluli ngabuhlanga nangobuni.

src: Sena se matahantswe ho Merero ya Ntshetsopele ya Moshwelella e kenyeletsang ya boqhwala, e amohetsweng ke Kopano Kakaretso (UNGA) ya Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) ka Loetse 2015.Leano le tla akofisa diphethoho le ditokiso tse mabapi le kenyeletso e tletseng, kopanelo le tekatekano bakeng sa batho ba phelang ka boqhwala.
tgt: Sikwanika isikhokelo samanyathelo angazi kuphela sithubeni nahamba kunye aza kuthathwa sisizwe sisonke ukulwa ubuhlanga nocalulo-calulo ngokobuhlanga.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Leano la Naha la Dikgwerekgwere bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: Oku kuza kunceda uMzantsi Afrika ukuba uzalisekise izivumelwano zawo zehlabathi, zeli lizwekazi kunye nezesiwe, ingakumbi isiVumelwano saseDurban kunye nesiCwangciso sokuSebenza esamnkelwa yi-UN kwiNkomfa yeHlabathi yokulwa ubuHlanga ngowama-20.7 IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi ngomgama osele uhanjiwe ngenkqubo yokufudukela kwidijithali.

src: Leano lena le beha ho phela hantle ha setjhaba bohareng ba ntshetsopele ka ho tlisa botsitso mahareng a ho aba mehlodi ya ditjhelete bakeng sa ho tshehetsa matsete ho tshebeletso e phahameng, phano ya ditshebeletso ho malapa a sa sebeletsweng hantle, ha ka nqa e nngwe ho baballwa le ho ntlafatsa meralo ya motheo e ntseng e le teng.
