tgt: Ikuvumile ukuqaliswa kwexesha apho zombini indlela zosasazo le idijithali nale i-anologi ziza kusetyenziswa ngaxeshanye kusasazo olidijithali eMzantsi Afrika ngomhla woku-1 kweyoMdumba ngowama-2016.Ukufuduka kusukwa kuhlobo lokusasazo olu-analogi kuyiwe koludijithali kuza kuvulela amaza osasazo amaninzi afuneka kakhulu ukuze kukwazi ukuba kufumaneke usasazo ngeeselula olukhawuleza kakhulu.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana bakeng sa ho kenngwa Palamenteng ha Tlaleho ya Dinako tse itseng ya bo-5 ya Aforika Borwa (2009-2014) ya ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Khonvenshene e mabapi le Phediso ya Mefuta yohle ya Kgethollo kgahlanong le Basadi.
tgt: Oku kuza kwenza ukuba uqoqosho loMzantsi Afrika lukwazi nangakumbi ukumelana nokhuphiswano ngokuhlaziya icandelo lezosasazo loMzantsi Afrika, ukomeleza icandelo lokuveliswa kobuxhakaxhaka be-elektronikhi, kudale imisebenzi kuze kukhuthaze nokuba kudidiyelwe kuveliswe neenkqubo zosasazo ezahluka-hlukeneyo zalapha ekhaya.8 IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi ngeziphumo zeNgxelo yoMzantsi Afrika yowama-2014 yezaLathisi zobuNzululwazi, ubuChwepheshe kunye noYilo kunye nezinto ezingundaba-mlonyeni kwindlela eqhuba ngayo iNkqubo yeSizwe yokuYila (i-NSI), ebhalwa rhoqo ngonyaka liBhunga leSizwe lokuCebisa ngoYilo.

src: Tlaleho ena e fana ka kakaretso ya bohlwahlwa ba letoto la melao, maano le mananeo a kentsweng tshebetsong le ho hlakisa diphihlello tsa naha mabapi le matlafatso ya basadi le tekatekano ya bong.
tgt: Le ngxelo isebenzisa izalathisi ezingundoqo ukuvavanya inkqubo kunye negalelo le-NSI kwimiba engundoqo ephambili yesizwe ecaciswe kwisiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP) kunye namanye amaxwebhu ezicwangciso-nkqubo anegalelo kuphuhliso lwezentlalo nezoqoqsho.9 IKhabhinethi iluvumile uhlenga-hlengiso lwezithili zikamantyi eLimpopo naseMpumalanga, kunye nokubekwa ngokusesikweni kweNkundla kaMantyi yaseLephalale njengokuba yiyo eza kusebenza okwethutyana njengeNkundla ePhakamileyo yaseLimpopo kude kwakhiwe iNkundla ePhakamileyo endaweni yayo kulo mmandla.

src: Tlaleho hape e ananela hore ho na le diphephetso le ditshita tse ntseng di le teng bakeng sa ho hlola ho se lekalekane le kgethollo ka hara naha.
tgt: Ukuhlenga-hlengiswa kwezithili zikamantyi kunye nemimandla ezinkundla zamaCandelo eNkundla ePhakamileyo kuyinxalenye yeenguqu ezenziwayo kumgaqo-nkqubo ezineenjongo zokulungisa umonakalo wangaphambili wokwabiwa kwemihlaba.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Moralo wa Naha wa Tshebetso bakeng sa ho Lwantsha Bomorabe, Kgethollo ya Merabe, Lehloyo la Melata le ho hloka mamellano, bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele.
tgt: Kukwayinxalenye yamalinge okuzisa iinguqu ezibalulekileyo ukwenzela ukuba wonke ubani akwazi ukuzixhamla iinkonzo zobulungisa, nto leyo ihambelana nezithembiso zoMgaqo-siseko woMzantsi Afrika wowe-1996.

src: Moralo ona ke lewa le kopanetsweng le ho hlohlomiswa ka morero wa ho lwantsha bomorabe le ho aha Aforika Borwa ya demokerasi ya nnete e hlokang bomorabe le kgethollo ka bong.
tgt: 2.10 IKhabhinethi iyivumile ingxelo emalunga nomgama osele uhanjiwe ngomba wokuphunyezwa kwemiyalelo yeKhabhinethi eLimpopo ngokweCandelo 100 (1)

src: E fana ka moralo bakeng sa mekgwa ya moshwelella o hokahantsweng o lokelang ho etswa ke naha ka bophara ho sebetsana le lefa la bomorabe le kgethollo ya merabe.
tgt: okuza kwenziwa ngomhla wama-31 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016 kula masebe alandelayo ephondo laseLimpopo: elezeMpilo elezoThutho elezemiSebenzi kaRhulumente elezeeNdlela neziSeko ezinguNdoqo kunye nonoNdyebo wePhondo.

src: Sena se thusa Aforika Borwa ho kgema le ditshwanelo tsa yona tsa matjhaba, tsa lebatowa le tsa naha, haholoholo Boitlamo ba Durban le Lenaneo la Tshebetso le amohetsweng ke UN Khonferenseng ya Lefatshe kgahlanong le Bomorabe ka 2001.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwakuvumile nokurhoxiswa, phantsi kwemiqathango, kweCandelo 100 (1)

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka kgatatelopele e seng e entswe mabapi le lenaneo la ho fallela ho mokgwa wa dijithale.
tgt: kwiSebe lezeMfundo into leyo iza kuvulela indlela uNondyebo wePhondo, encediswa ngurhulumente kazwelonke, ukuba aqalise ngokwenyani ukusebenzisa iCandelo 18 loMthetho wokuLawulwa kweMali kaRhulumente, wowama-1999 (uMthetho uNombolo 1 wowama-1999) kwiSebe lezeMfundo lephondo laseLimpopo.

src: E tjhaelletse monwna qalo ya nako ya ho kgantshwa habedi ha tumello ya kgaso ya dijithale ka hara Aforika Borwa ka la 1 Tlhakola 2016.Ho falla ho tloha ho ditshebeletso tsa kgaso tsa analoko ho ya ho tsa kgaso ya dijithale ho lokolla mokgwa o batlehang haholo wa maqhubu a radio a loketseng bakeng sa phano ya ditshebeletso tsa kgaso tse phatlaletseng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyivumile le miqathango ilandelayo iya kwiNkulumbuso kunye noMphathiswa wePhondo (i-MEC) wezeMali kunye nowezeMfundo:a) Ukuxhobisa ngezakhono amasebe ephondo ngokuthi kuqeshwe abantu abanezakhono ezifanelekileyob) Ukuqukunjelwa komba wokuqeshwa kwabantu abaza kungena kwizikhundla zabalawuli abaphezuluc) Ukusonjululwa kwengxaki yorhwaphilizo kunye nezikhulu eziphezulu ezingawenzi kakuhle umsebenzi wazo.

src: Sena se tla eketsa bophehisani ba moruo wa Aforika Borwa ka ho tsoseletsa indaseteri ya kgaso, ho matlafatsa diindaseteri tse hlahisang disebediswa tsa elektroniki, ho hlahisa mesebetsi, le ho ntshetsapele dikateng tsa kgaso tsa lehae le tse fapafapaneng.
tgt: 2.11 IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba uMzantsi Afrika usingathe iNkomfa yeeNgxoxo ezingokuLwa iziYobisi ekwizinga eliphezulu ukusuka ngomhla we-11 ukuya kowe-12 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016, eza kube iququzelelwa yiMbumba ye-Afrika (i-AU).Le Nkomfa iza kusetyenziswa njengeseshoni elandela iiNgxoxo zeRussia ne-Afrika ezingokuLwa iziYobisi, enjongo zayo ikukunika ingxelo enye malunga nokulwa ingxaki yeziyobisi kwihlabathi.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka diphihlello tsa Tlaleho ya Matshwao a Ntlafatso ya Aforika Borwa ya Saense le Thekenoloji ya 2014 tse ntseng di etsahala tshebetsong ya Tshebeletso ya Naha ya Ntlafatso (NSI), e hlahiswang selemo ka seng ke Lekgotla la Naha la Boeletsi ka Ntlafatso.
tgt: Le ngxelo iza kuthiwa thaca kwiSeshoni eKhethekileyo ye-UNGA ngekaTshazimpunzi ngowama-2016.Umba wedabi lokulwa iziyobisi ezingekho mthethweni uhambelana ne-NDP kwaye ezi Ngxoxo ziza kunika ithuba lokuqinisa nangakumbi isiCwangciso esiBanzi seSizwe seziYobisi (sowama-2013-2017).

src: Tlaleho e sebedisa matshwao a hlokolosi bakeng sa ho lekola tshebetso le nyehelo ya NSI ho dintlha tse ka sehloohong tsa naha jwaloka ha di hlahisitswe ho Morero wa Naha wa Ntshetsopele (NDP) le ditokomaneng tse ding tsa leano tse nyehelang ho ntshetsopele ya moruo wa kahisano.
tgt: 2.12 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukuba iSebe lezokuHlaliswa koLuntu lisingathe kunye neNkqubo ye-UN yokuHlaliswa koLuntu iNkomfa yokuKhokela uTshintsho esiXekweni: Ukusuka kumaTyotyombe ukuya kwiNdawo zokuHlaliswa koLuntu ezingenaMkhethe, eziKhuselekileyo, ezoMoleleyo kunye neziZinzileyo, ngeyoKwindla ngowama-2016.Le nkomfa ixhasa amaphulo ehlabathi ophuhliso kunye nawalapha ekhaya ngokubethelela iNjongo ye-11 yeeNjongo zoPhuhliso eziZinzileyo ethi: ‘Yenza izixeko kunye neendawo zokuhlalisa uluntu zingabi namkhehe, zikhuseleke, zomelele kwaye zizinze.’Le nkomfa iyinxalenye yeengxoxo ezingokuphunyezwa kwe-Ajenda yoPhuhliso ye-UN yasemva konyaka wama-2015 kunye “ne-Ajenda eNtsha ngeeDolophu” eza kwamnkelwa yi-UN ngowama-20.13 IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba iBhunga loPhando lezoLimo lisingathe iNkomfa yesiThathu engoPhando ngezoLimo kuPhuhliso ngekaTshazimpunzi ngowama-2016.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho hlophiswa botjha ha ditereke tsa bomakgiseterata bakeng sa Limpopo le Mpumalanga, le ho theha Lekgotla la Dinyewe la Makgiseterata la Lephalale jwaloka tulo ya Karolo ya Lekgotla le Phahameng la Limpopo, jwaloka mokgwa wa nakwana ho fihlela ho ahuwa Karolo ya tulo ya moshwelella sebakeng seo.
tgt: Le nkomfa iza kukhetha: imiba ephambili yophando noyilo lwezinto ezintsha kwihlabathi kwaye nezinto ezifunekayo kwiinkqubo zesizwe zokuyila izinto ezintsha ukuze kufezekiswe injongo zexa elizayo, ingakumbi kumafama alimela nje ukuzondla wona neentsapho zawo kunye nemimandla engathathi ntweni.

src: Ho hlophiswa botjha ha ditereke tsa bomakgiseterata le dibaka tsa tshebetso tsa Dikarolo tsa Lekgotla le Phahameng la Dinyewe ke karolo ya ho fetola maano ka morero wa lokisa botjha lefa la ho hloka toka la mehleng la ho aha dibaka tsa bodulo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa koMthetho osaYilwayo wezokuCwangciswa kweMimandla eseLwandle wama-2015 ukuba uluntu luhlomle kuwo.

src: Hape ke karolo ya tshwanelo ya diphethoho tse pharaletseng bakeng sa ho matlafatsa phumantsho ya toka, e matahantsweng le Molaotheo wa Aforika Borwa wa 1996.
tgt: Lo Mthetho usaYilwayo ulikhubalo elisemthethweni elicacisa iindlela zokuvula amathuba kuqoqosho lwaselwandle ngokukhuthaza ucwangciso lwemimandla yaselwandle ekubanjiswanayo ngalo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana tlaleho ya kgatelopele mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha ditaelo tsa Kabinete Limpopo ho ya ka Karolo ya 100 (1)
tgt: Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo uza kuncedisa kumaziko e-Operation Phakisa la akhoyo.

src: ka 31 Tlhakubele 2016 mafapheng a porofense a Limpopo a latelang: Bophelo bo Botle Dipalangwang Mesebetsi ya Setjhaba Ditsela le Meralo ya motheo le la Matlotlo.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uza kukhokela imibhiyozo yoSuku loXolelwaniso ngomhla we-16 kweyoMnga eza kubanjelwa eBhayi, kwiphondo laseMpuma Koloni phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukuvala umsantsa: Ukwakha isizwe soMzantsi Afrika esibambeneyo kulungiselelwa isizwe esikhulayo”.

src: Kabinete hape e tjhaelletse monwana ho hulwa ntle le dipehelo ha Karolo 100 (1)
tgt: UMphathiswa weziSeko zoNxibelelwano neeNkonzo zePosi, uGq Siyabonga Cwele, uza kukhokela igqiza loMzantsi Afrika kwi-UNGA ngeNgqungquthela yeHlabathi yezobuChwepheshe ngoLwazi (i-WSIS) ukusuka ngomhla we-15 ukuya kowe-16 kweyoMnga ngowama-2015, apho kuza kunikwa ingxelo eluluvo loMzantsi Afrika, luncedisa kwi-WSIS+10 eyingxelo engeyonxalenye yeengxoxo ze-WSIUluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba egqubayo.

src: ho Lefapha la Thuto bakeng sa ho betla tsela bakeng sa lefapha la Matlotlo la Porofense ho kenya tshebetsong ka bokgabane Karolo 18 ya Molao wa Bolaodi ba Ditjhelete tsa Setjhaba, 1999 (Molao 1 wa 1999) ho Lefapha la Thuto la Limpopo, ka tshehetso e tswang ho mmuso wa naha.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika usingathe ngempumelelo iNgqungquthela yesiXhenxe yeziXeko zase-Afrika yezixeko noomasipala base-Afrika eRhawutini ukusuka ngomhla wama-29 kweyeNkanga ukuya ngomhla wesi-3 kweyoMnga ngowama-2015.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ditaelo tse latelang ho Tonakgolo le diMEC tsa Ditjhelete le Thuto:a) Matlafatso ya mafapha a porofense ka ho thaotha basebeletsi ba hlwahlwab) Ho phethela ho thonngwa ha batho bakeng sa mesebetsi ya batsamaisi ba ka sehloohong lec) Ho sebetsana ka matla le ho hloleha ha boetapele le bobodu.
tgt: Phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukulungiselela ikamva le-Afrika kubanjiswene nabantu: igalelo loomasipala base-Afrika kwiiNjongo zowama-2063 zeMbumba ye-Afrika”, le ngqungquthela, ibizinyaswe ngoosodolophi abangama-15 000 kunye nooceba abangama-500 000, yenye yamalinge abambekayo okwakha ubumbano e-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana hore Aforika Borwa e tshware Khonferense ya Dipuisano tse Kgahlanong le Dithethefatsi ya maemo a hodimo ho tloha ka la 11 ho isa ka la 12 Tlhakubele 2016, e tla ba tlasa bolaodi ba Kopano ya Aforika.
tgt: Le ngqungquthelo ibigxininisa kumba wokomeleza oorhulumente basekhaya kwilizwekazi le-Afrika, ingakumbi umba wokuphathwa kwemali kunye nokuqinisekisa ukuba kukho imithombo ezinzileyo yokwenza ingeniso, kulungiselelwa ukufezekiswa iiNjongo zowama-2063 – i-Afrika esiyifunayo.

src: Sena se sebetsa jwaloka kopano ya ho tswellisa Dipuisano tse Kgahlanong le Dithethefatsi tsa Russia le Aforika, ka morero wa ho fana maemo a kopanetsweng mabapi le ho lwantsha bothata ba lefatshe ba dithethefatsi.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ixhasa iinjongo ze-NDP apho izixeko kunye norhulumente wasekhaya zidlala indima ebalulekileyo kulo lonke uphuhliso.

src: Sena se tla tekwa ho Kopano e Ikgethang ya UNGA ka Mmesa 2016.Ntwa kgahlanong le dithethefatsi tse seng molaong e tsamaellana le NDP mme Dipuisano di tla fana ka lepatlelo la ho tswela pele ho matlafatsa Moralo Wa Naha o ka Sehloohong wa Dithethefatsi wa (2013-2017).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ayikalilahli ithemba lokuba iingxoxo eziqhubayo kwiseshoni yama-21 yeNkomfa yamaZwe athatha iNxaxheba (i-COP21) engeSivumelwano se-UN ngokuTshintsha kweMozulu (i-UNFCCC), ziza kufikelela kwisivumelwano esingazikudala makhwiniba nesiza kubophelela onke amazwe.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana hore Lefapha la Bodulo ba Batho le tshware mmoho le Lenaneo la UN la Bodulo ba Batho Khonferense ya “Re etella pele Diphethoho ka hara Motsemoholo: Ho tloha Bodulong bo Bohlaswa ho ya ho Bodulo ba Batho bo kenyeletsang, bo bolokehileng, bo Hlwahlwa le ba Moshwelella”, ka Tlhakubele 2016.Khonferense e tshehetsa ka bobedi lenaneo la matjhaba la ntshetsopele le la ntshetsopele ya lehae ka ho matlafatsa tshehetso bakeng sa Morero 11 wa Merero ya Ntshetsopele ya Moshwelella: Ho etsa metsemeholo le bodulo ba batho hore e be e kenyeletsang, e bolokehileng, e hlwahlwa le ho ba ya moshwelella.
tgt: Ingxaki yokutshintsha kwemozulu yingxaki yehlabathi lonke efuna izisombululo ezinokuphakanyiswa lihlabathi liphela, zithathwe ngamazwe ehlabathi ahlukeneyo amaninzi, ekhokelwa yi-UNFCC ehlonitshwa ivunywe lihlabathi ngobubanzi, futhi onke amazwe athatha inxaxheba efaka isandla.

src: Khonferense e etsa karolo ya dipuisano tse mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Lenaneo la Ntshetsopele la UN la kamora 2015 le “Lenaneo le Letjha la Metse ya Ditoropo” le tla amohelwa ke UN ka 2016.
tgt: EMzantsi Afrika, singatsho ngokungathandabuziyo, ukuba sinemigaqo-nkqubo ebonakalisa inkqubela, eqiqisiweyo kunye nehlakaniphileyo, kwaye nezicwangciso zokukwazi ukumelana neemeko zezulu ezitshintsha imihla nezolo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana hore Lekgotla la Diphuputso tsa Temo le tshware Khonferense ya bo-3 ya Lefatshe ya Diphuputso tsa Temo bakeng sa Ntshetsopele ka Mmesa 2016.
tgt: Le migaqo-nkqubo ingummiselo ongagungqiyo wophuhliso oluzinzileyo, oyintsika ephambili yoMbono wama-2030 okwi-NDP.3 Njengokuba le iyintlanganiso yeKhabhinethi yokugqibela yowama-2015, iKhabhinethi inqwenelela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika okuhle kodwa kwiholide zokuphela konyaka.

src: Khonferense e tla hlwaya: dintlha tse ka sehloohong tsa diphuputso tsa matjhaba le tsamaiso ya ntlafatso hore ho tle ho fihlellwe merero ya ntshetsopelo ya bokamoso, haholoholo ho borapolasi ba malapa le metseng e futsanehileng.
tgt: Ngomoya weli xesha loyolo kunye nathi njengabantu abakhonza Ubuntu, iKhabhinethi imelela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bancede abantu kunye neentsapho ezingathathi ntweni kwiindawo abahlala kuzo.

src: E batla ho kgothaletsa tshebedisano le taolo ya tlhophiso e nang le boikarabelo ya mawatle.
tgt: IzikhundlaUkuqeshwa kuzo zonke izikhundla kuxhomekeke ekuqinisekisweni kwezifundo nokuba msulwa okufaneleyo.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla etella pele mekete ya Letsatsi la Poelano ka la 16 December Port Elizabeth, ho la Kapa Botjhabela tlasa mookotaba: “Re ngotla karohano: Re aha bosetjhaba ba Aforika Borwa bo tshwanang ho ya ho puso ya naha e tswelang pele”.
tgt: IKomishini yoPhando ngaManzia) UGq Nozibele Mjoli (USihlalo)b) UNjing Sibusiso Vil-Nkomo (USekela-Sihlalo)c) UNjing Aldo Stroebeld) UNksz Nompumelelo Msezanee) UGq Mosidi Makgaef) UNksz Masaccha Khulekelwe Mbonambig) UMnu Mxolisi Adolphius Cassius Ndhlovuh) UGq Ntombifuthi Patience Nala andi) Omele iSebe lezeNzululwazi nezobuChwepheshe.

src: Letona la Dikgokahanyo tsa Mehala le Ditshebeletso tsa Poso, Ngaka Siyabonga Cwele, o tla etelle pele kemedi ya Aforika Borwa ho UNGA mabapi le Seboka sa Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Tlhahisoleseding (WSIS) ho tloha ka la 15 ho isa ka la 16 Tshitwe 2015, moo maemo a Aforika Borwa a naha, a nyehelang ho WSIS+10 a tla hlahiswa ka ntle le Pampiri.
tgt: IBhodi ye-Amatola Water:a) UNksz NN Mnqeta (USihlalo)b) UMnu A Hadebe (USekela-Sihlalo)c) UMnu EV Joosted) UMnu AP Le Rouxe) UMnu BE Hollingworthf) UMnu C Mbandeg) UNksz TF Maenetjah) UNksz M Nzimande kunyei) noNjing L Louw.

src: Tlasa mookotaba: “Re bopa bokamoso ba Aforika le batho: nyehelo ya mebuso ya mahae ya Aforika ho lenaneo la 2063 la Kopano ya Aforika”, seboka sena, se hohetseng bomeyara ba 15 000 le makhanselara a 500 000, ke se seng sa boikitlaetso bo tiileng ba ho aha Kopano ya maAforika.
tgt: IBhodi yeeNkonzo zeziKhalazo zeziKimu zoLuntua) UMnu Vukile Charles Mehana, (uqeshiwe kwakhona kwaye unguSihlalo)b) UNksz Beauty Nomhle Dambuzac) UMnu Bhekumusa Gorden Dlaminid) Taureen Dylan Holmese) Rajesh Jockf) Oupa Moshongoane Moshebi kunyeg) noNomazotsho Yvonne Memani (uqeshiwe kwakhona).

src: Seboka se ne se tsepamisitse maikutlo hodima ho matlafatsa mebuso ya lehae ho phatlalla le kontinente ya Aforika, haholoholo tsamaiso ya ditjhelete le ho theha motheo o tiileng wa lekeno, bakeng sa ho fihlella Lenaneo la 2063 – Aforika eo re e batlang.
tgt: IBhodi ye-Arhente yeSizwe yoPhuhliso:a) UNksz Judy Hermans (uSihlalo)b) UMnu Zolile Thando Ngcakani (uqeshiwe kwakhona kwaye unguSekela-Sihlalo)c) UNksz Suraya Bibi Khan (uqeshiwe kwakhona)d) UMnu Abram Stefanus Hanekome) UNksz Sebenzile Matsebulaf) UNksz Mashila Matlalag) UMnu Moses Mabokela Chikane (umele urhulumente)h) UNksz Bernice Makgoro Mannya (umele urhulumente)i) UNksz Thabitha Shange (umele urhulumente)j) UNksz Farzana Suliman Varachia (umele urhulumente).

src: Seboka sena se tshehetsa merero ya NDP eo ho yona metsemeholo le mebuso ya mahae e bapalang karolo ya bohlokwa ntshetsopeleng ya rona ka kakaretso.
tgt: IBhodi yoQumrhu loMzantsi Afrika loNcedo ngezoMthetho:a) UNjing Yousuf Abdoola Vawdab) UMnu Nkosana Mabhuti Francois Mvundlelac) UNksz Thulisile Mhlungud) UNksz Nonhlanhla Mgadzae) UNksz Marcella Naidoof) UMnu Matome Leseilane kunyeg) noNksz Adila Chowanh) UNksz Aneline Rhoda (ilungu elililalela) kunyei) noMnu Langelihle Ezrome Mtshali (ilungu elililalela).

src: Kabinete e dula e na le boitshepo ba hore ha ditherisano di ntse di tswela pele ho Tulo ya bo-21 ya Khonferense ya Mekga (COP21) ho Khonvenshene ya Meralo ya UN e mabapi le ho Fetofetoha ha Tlelaemete (UNFCCC), ho tla fihlellwa tumellano e hlokang leeme le e tlamang.
tgt: UKwandiswa kwesivumelwano sengqesho sikaMnu uThabane Wiseman Zulu njengoMlawuli-Jikelele (i-DG) kwiSebe lezaMandla.

src: Ho fetofetoha ha tlelaemete ke bothata ba lefatshe bo batlang tharollo ya lefatshe, boo ho ka sebetsanwang le bona feela ka kopanelo, tlasa tumello e phatlaletseng ya UNFCCC mme le mekga kaofela e etsa nyehelo.
tgt: UGq Mmaphaka Ephraim Tau njengeSekela-Mlawuli-Jikelele (i-DGG) kwezokuPhathwa kwezaMahlathi nobuTyebi beNdalo kwiSebe lezoLimo, amaHlathi nezokuLoba.

src: Maano ana a tataiswa ke pehelo e akaretsang ya ntshetsopele ya moshwelella, e leng lejwe la motheo la Pono ya 2030 jwaloka ha e hlahella ho NDKa ha sena ke kopano ya ho qetela ya Kabinete bakeng sa 2015, Kabinete e fetisetsa ditakaletso tse molemo ho maAforika Borwa kaofela bakeng sa sehla sa mekete e tlang.
tgt: UNksz Kelebogile Sybil Sethibelo njenge-DDG: uLawulo lweZiko kwiSebe lezobuGcisa neNkcubeko.

src: Ka moya wa sehla sena mme re ntse re imatahantse le moya wa Ubuntu, Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho thusa batho le malapa a hlokang ka hara metse ya bona.
tgt: UMnu Omega Shelembe njenge-DDG: uLawulo lwamaShishini kaRhulumente kunye neQumrhu loPhuhliso lobuChwepheshe boLwazi noNxibelelwano kwiSebe leziSeko zoNxibelelwano neeNkonzo zePosi (i-DTPS).

src: Re setjhaba se kgathallanang, se hlomphanang le ho tshehetsa ba seng lehlohonolo bophelong.
tgt: UMnu Edward Xolisa Makaya njenge-DDG: Afrika kwiSebe lezobuDlelwane bamaZwe ngamaZwe neNtsebenziswano.

src: Selemo se setjha se tlang se re tlela bohle ka kgonahalo ya hore re itlame botjha bakeng sa ho sebeletsa bokamoso bo betere bakeng sa bohle.
tgt: UNksz Thulisile Glory Manzini njenge-DDG: ezoLawulo kwi-DTPS.

src: Ho itela ha hae le ho nka karolo Ntweng kgahlanong le kgethollo di nyehetse bakeng sa tokoloho ya rona.
tgt: Eli nani liphezulu labo bafake iingxelo zabo zerhafu ngexesha kunceda urhulumente ukuba akwazi ukuhambisa iinkonzo futhi aphucule umgangatho wobomi babo bonke abemi beli.

src: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di tla lokelwa ke ho netefatswa ha mangolo a thuto le tumellano e amehang.
tgt: Ngeli thuba leeholide zokuphela konyaka, urhulumente uza kuqalisa ngamaphulo ahlukeneyo aza kufuna bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika nabo basindwendweleyo ukuba badlale eyabo indima ukuqinisekisa ukuba eli xesha leeholide zokuphela konyaka lonwatyelwa kwiimeko ezikhuselekileyo nezingenazingozi.

src: Khomishene ya Diphuputso tsa Metsi:a) Ngaka Nozibele Mjoli (Modulasetulo)b) Moporofesara Sibusiso Vil-Nkomo (Motlatsi wa Modulasetulo)c) Moporofesara Aldo Stroebeld) Mofumahadi Nompumelelo Msezanee) Ngaka Mosidi Makgaef) Mofumahadi Masaccha Khulekelwe Mbonambig) Monghadi Mxolisi Adolphius Cassius Ndhlovuh) Ngaka Ntombifuthi Patience Nala lei) Moemedi ho tswa ho Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kuye wonke umntu ukuba asebenzisane nabeNkonzo zesiPolisa zoMzantsi Afrika (i-SAPS) kwaye baxele kwabasemagunyeni zonke izenzo zolwaphulo-mthetho kumakhaya ethu neendawo esihlala kuzo.

src: Boto ya Dikema tsa Tshebeletso ya Bobuelli ba Badudi:a) Monghadi Vukile Charles Mehana, (o thontswe hape e le Modulasetulo)b) Mofumahadi Beauty Nomhle Dambuzac) Monghadi Bhekumusa Gorden Dlaminid) Taureen Dylan Holmese) Rajesh Jockf) Oupa Moshongoane Moshebi leg) Nomazotsho Yvonne Memani (o thontswe hape).
tgt: La masebe aquka elezeMpilo, elezoLimo, elezamaPolisa, eleMicimbi yezeKhaya kunye neeNkonzo zeRhafu zoMzantsi Afrika.

src: Moruo.
tgt: Uqoqosho.

src: Kabinete e ile ya kopana ho sekaseka maemo a moruo le dintlha tse amanang le ditekanyetso tsa ditjhelete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibihlangene ngeenjongo zokuxoxa ngobume bezoqoqosho nemiba enxulumene nohlahlo lwabiwo-mali.

src: Kabinete lemohile dintlha tse ngatanyana tse nang le kgahlamelo moruong wa naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele imiba eliqela enempembelelo kuqoqosho lweli lizwe.

src: Tjhebahalo ya lefatshe e theohile dikgweding tse sa tswa feta moraorao tjena.
tgt: Kwezi nyanga zakutsha nje imeko yoqoqosho lwehlabathi iye isiba mbi.

src: Kgolo e batlang e tsamaya butle ya moruo wa lefatshe e bontsha, ka ho qolleha, tshebetso e batlang e fokola le dikotsi tsa ho thefuleha ha moruo tse batlang di phahame ka hara dinaha tse itseng tse ntseng di tswela pele, ho kenyeletswa le China.
tgt: Uhlumo loqoqosho olucothayo ehlabathini jikelele, ingakumbi, lubonakalisa ukuqhuba kakubi kunye nemingcipheko ephezulu kumazwe abalulekileyo asakhulayo aliqela, aquka neChina.

src: Ho iphumana ho lemohilweng ho lebeletsweng ka hara Amerika ho ka nna ha baka ho phahama ha sekgahla sa tswala sa lefatshe.
tgt: Ukuphucuka kohlumo loqoqosho kwelizwe laseMelika (i-USA) obekulangazelelwa ngamazwe onke ehlabathi kulindeleke ukuba kungakhokelela ekunyukeni kwenzala kwimali-mboleko kwihlabathini jikelele.

src: Methamo ya kgwebisano e tetebetseng le ho tsukutleha ho teng ka hara mebaraka ya lefatshe ya ditjhelete e hlakisa tlhokeho ya ho aha botsitso le ho sebetsa ka hloko bakeng sa nako ena eo re e tobileng ka pele ho rona.
tgt: Umthamo ophantsi kurhwebo nombhodamo kurhwebo lwhlabathi kubethelelela ukubaluleka kokuba amazwe ehlabathi kufuneka aqine kwaye achule ukunyathela kwezi nyanga zimbalwa zizayo.

src: Kabinete e boetse e lemohile hore ho ne ho na le melemo e itseng ho tswa ho theko e tlase ya oli e tala.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwaqaphele ukuba iyeyakhona iinzuzo kwixabiso eliphantsi le-oli ekrwada.

src: Jwaloka moreki e moholo wa thepa e tswang mafatsheng a ka ntle, Aforika Borwa e ngongorehile ka ho fokola ho ntseng ho tswela dithekong tsa thepa.
tgt: Njengelizwe elithumela ikakhulu izimbiwa kumazwe angaphandle, uMzantsi Afrika uxhalabile kukuhla okuqhubekayo kwamaxabiso ezimbiwa.

src: Mmuso o tswelapele ho ahella hodima sebopeho sa naha se tswakatswakaneng sa moruo, mme kuno ya dihlahiswa tse romellwang dinaheng tsa ka ntle e tswela pele ho itshetleha haholo hodima ditshepe le thepa e tala e song ho lokiswe ka botlalo.
tgt: Urhulumente usaqhuba ekwakheni kwiziseko zoqoqosho ezahlukahlukeneyo zeli lizwe, kwaye ingeniso evela ekuthunyelweni kwemveliso kumazwe angaphandle kuyaqhuba ukuxhomekeka ikakhulu kwisinyithi kunye neempahla zorhwebo ezingalungiselelwanga ngokugqibeleleyo.

src: Ho wa ha ditheko tsa thepa ha ho bonahale e le ntho e tla tjhetjhang ka potlako.
tgt: Ukwehla kwamaxabiso ezimbiwa akukhangeleki ngathi kungatshintsha ngokukhawuleza.

src: Sena se tla ba le ditlamorao tsa nako e telele bakeng sa moruo wa Aforika Borwa le ho balekane ba rona kontinenteng ya Aforika.
tgt: Oku kuza kuba neziphumo ezibi kuqoqosho loMzantsi Afrika nakuninzi lamazwe esirhweba nawo kwilizwekazi le-Afrika..Ukwehla kwexabiso leRandi kule minyaka imbalwa idlulileyo kunika ithemba elingcono kuhlumo lwemveliso ethunyelwa kumazwe angaphandle kwaye, kudityaniswe nexabiso le-oli eliphantsi ehlabathini jikelele, kuye kwanceda kwanika isiqabu kuxinzelelo kwimali ekhoyo karhulumente.

src: Ho fokola ha Ranta dilemong tse mmalwa tse fetileng ho fana ka menyetla e batlang e ba betere bakeng sa kgolo ya thomello ya ka ntle ya thepa le, ha re kopanya le theko e batlang e ba tlase ya oli ya lefatshe, ho thusitse ho imolla kgatello hodima akhaonte ya rona ya hajwale ya matjhaba.
tgt: Nangona kunjalo, uhlumo olubuthathaka kumahlakani ezorhwebo aphambili oMzantsi Afrika luye lwathetha ukuhla kwezinga ezifunwa ngalo iimveliso zoMzantsi Afrika kumazwe angaphesheya.

src: Leha ho le jwalo, kgolo e fokolang ho balekane ba ka sehloohong ba kgwebisano ba Aforika Borwa ho bolela tlhoko e fokotsehileng ya dihlahiswa tsa Aforika Borwa mose.
tgt: Imeko yoqoqosho lwehlabathi jikelele ithathwa njengomngeni ingakumbi kumazwe asakhulayo, nanamaxabiso aphantsi ezimbiwa nokuqiniswa kwemigaqo-nkqubo yezezimali e-USA okubeka uxinizelelo ekungeneni nasekuphumeni kwemali namazinga ohlumo alindelekileyo.

src: Tikoloho ya matjhabeng e nkuwa e le e nang le phephetso e matla bakeng sa dimmaraka tse ntseng di thuthua, ka ditheko tse tlase tsa thepa le ho tiisa lebanta ha leano la ditjhelete la Amerika ho beha kgatello ho phallo ya ditjhelete le ditebello tsa kgolo.
tgt: Oku kukhokelele ekubeni kungabikho zinzo kuqoqosho lwehlabathi.

src: Sena se fetohetse ho tlhokahalo ya bohlokwa ya botsitso dimmarakeng tsa ditjhelete.
tgt: IRandi yaseMzantsi Afrika, neseyiphakathi kwezinye zeemali ekurhwetywa ngayo kakhulu yamazwe asakhulayo, ibethwe ngokukodwa zimeko zoqoqosho kwezi veki zisanda kudlula.

src: Ranta ya Aforika Borwa, eo e leng hara ditjhelete tse sebediswang haholo bakeng sa kgwebisano dimmarakeng tse ntseng di thuthua, e thefulehile haholo dibekeng tsa moraorao tjena.
tgt: Kule meko imaxongo kuqoqosho lwehlabathi, apho onke amazwe ajongene nemingeni enzima iKhabhinethi iphinde yakubethelela ukubaluleka kokuba urhulumente angenelele ngobuchule nangokupheleleyo ukubuyisela isantya uqoqosho obeluhluma ngayo.

src: Ka hara maemo ana a thata a lefatshe, moo meruo kaofela e tobaneng le diphephetso tse boima, Kabinete e tiisitse botjha tlhokahalo ya mmuso ya ho tla ka mawa a boitshunyako le ho etsa ka matla hore e busetse morao lebelo la kgolo ya moruo.
tgt: IsiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP) siwalungiselele la manyathelo okungenelela.

src: Lewa la Naha la Ntshetsopele (NDP) le fana ka ditsela tsena tsa boitshunyako.
tgt: Urhulumente uza kuthethana namahlakani akhe, ingakumbi abezoshishino nemibutho yezabasebenzi, ukuze kufikelelwe kwizivumelwano ngamanyathelo ekuza kubanjiswana ngawo ukomeleza uqoqosho, ukwakha ukuthembeka, ukunyusa izinga lotyalo-mali nokubuyisela uMzantsi Afrika kwindlela yohlumo lwezoqoqosho oluquka wonke umntu.

src: Puo ya Boemo ba Naha (SoNA) ka la 11 Tlhakola e tla nkela mosebetsi ona hloohong.
tgt: INtetho engoBume beSizwe (i-SoNA) eza kuba ngomhla we-11 kweyoMdumba iza kuwuthathela ingqalelo lo msebenzi.

src: Kabinete e thathiselleditse mekgwa e batlang e le matla bakeng sa ho busetsa morao motjha wa tshebediso ya matlotlo a mmuso wa moshwelella, ho ntse ho hlokometswe tjhebahalo e fokolang ya moruo wa lefatshe le ditlamorao tsa ona ka hara naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphumeze amanyathelo aluqilima ukubuyisela umzila wezezimali ozinzileyo, iyithathele ingqalelo inkangeleko ebuthathaka yoqoqosho lwehlabathi jikelele kunye nemiphumela yayo apha ekhaya.

src: Letona la Ditjhelete Pravin Gordhan le tla kgakola mekgwa e tla nkuwa ha a tla be a teka ditekanyetso tsa naha ka la 24 Tlhakola Matlole bakeng sa Thuto e PhahamengKabinete e tjhaelletse monwana dihlomathiso ho dikabo tsa ditekanyetso tsa naha tse tla suthisa mehlodi ya ho thusa diyunivesithi ka matlole ntle le ho tlola meedi ya tshebediso ya tjhelete e phatlaladitsweng pejana.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezeMali uPravin Gordhan uza kuwachaza la manyathelo xa esenza intetho yakhe yohlahlo lwabiwo-mali ngomhla wama-24 kweyoMdumba yowama-20.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma le Letona la Thuto e Phahameng le Thupello Blade Nzimande haufinyana tjena ba tshwaile hore dikabo tsena di tla akaretsa ho se nyolohe ha ditefello hoo ho dumellanweng ka hona bakeng sa selemo sa hajwale sa dithuto, ho tlosa mokitlane oo esale o bokellana o kolotwang ke baithuti ba Sekema sa Naha sa Dithuso tsa Ditjhelete tsa Baithuti (NSFAS) le ho thibela ho bokellana ha mokitlane o jwalo bakeng sa nako e bohareng.
tgt: Inkxaso-mali yezeMfundo ePhakamileyoIKhabhinethi iziphumezile izilungisokuhlahlo lwabiwo-mali lesizwe apho kuza kuxulwa imali ukuze ixhase iidyunivesithi kungakhange kophulwe izicwangciso zenkcitho ezasibhengezo esasenziwe somda wenkcitho.

src: Mekgwa ena ya boitshunyako ke karabelo ho ditherisano tse ngatanyana tse qadileng ka Phato2015 mme di ntse di tswella.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma noMphathiswa weMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho uBlade Nzimande kutsha nje bachaze ukuba ezi mali ziza kuvala isikroba esivelileyo ngenxa yokunganyuswa kwemali yokufunda ekuvunyelwene ngako kulo nyaka, ukucima amatyala asele ekhulile atyalwa ngabafundi beSkimu soNcedo lwezeZimali saBafundi seSizwe (i-NSFAS) nokuthintela ukukhula kwamatyala lawo kwisigaba WEBTOKEN manyathelo okua aziziphumo zothotho lweentlanganiso ezaqala kweyeDwarha yowama-2015 nezisaqhubekayo sithetha nje.

src: Letona la Thuto e Phahameng le Thupello mmoho le sehlopha sa hae sa bolaodi ba tshwere dikopano tse ngatanyana le ketapele ya SASCO, Makgotla kaofela a Baemedi ba Baithuti, Foramo ya Diyunivesithi ya Aforika Borwa, Kopano ya Baithuti ya Aforika Borwa, diCEO tsadiSETA, Mokgatlo wa Diphethoho tsa Thuto e Phahameng le komiti ya Palamente e ikarabellang bakeng sa thuto e phahameng.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezeMfundo noQeqesho neqela lakhe labalawuli ubambe iintlanganiso ezininzi neenkokheli ze--SASCO, onke amaBhunga abaMeli babaFundi (ii-SRC), uMbutho weeDyunivesithi zaseMzantsi Afrika, iManyano yabaFundi baseMzantsi Afrika , amaGosa aziNtloko zeziGqeba zoLawulo (ii-CEO) we-SETA, uMbutho weNguqu kwezeMfundo ePhakamileyo kunye nekomiti yasePalamente ejongene nezemfundo ephakamileyo.

src: Moporesidente hape o kopane le ketapele ya baithuti le ho phatlalatsa ho thehwa ha Khomishene e tla shebana le dintlha tse hlahisitsweng mabapi le Thuto e phahameng.
tgt: UMongameli naye ukwadibene kunye neenkokheli zabafundi waza wavakalisa ngokumiselwa kweKhomishini eza kuqwalasela imiba ephakanyiswe kwicandelo lezeMfundo ePhakamileyo.

src: Dipuisano tsena di ntse di tswela pela kaha re dumela jwaloka mmuso hore re lokela ho sebeletsa ho fumana tharollo ya moshwelella.
tgt: Ezi ndibano zisaqhuba kuba njengorhulumente sikholelwa ekubeni siyafuna ukusebenzela ekufumaneni isisombululo esiza kusabela kuzo zonke ezi ngxaki.

src: Ditseko tsa baithuti di imatahantse le morero wa lenaneo la mmuso le mabapi le thuto.
tgt: Izinyanzeliso zabafundi ziyahambelana neenjongo zenkqubo karhulumente ngokumalunga nezemfundo.

src: Jwaloka mokgwa o potlakileng, R.33 bilione e abilwe bakeng sa ho rarolla kgaello e mabapi le matlole a tshebetso a diyunivesithi ka lebaka la tumellano ya keketseho ya ditefello tsa 0% bakeng sa Selemong sa ditjhelete sa 2016/17, mmuso o phetile botjha ho beha ka sehloohongR.543 bilione ya matlole a mmuso a tla abelwa NSFAS bakeng sa ho fana ka dikadimo ho thusa baithuti ba 71 753 ba hlwailweng ho tshwanelwa ke dithuso tsa NSFAS empa ka mohlomong ba ile ba thola thuso e haellang kapa ba sa e tholang ho hang dilemong tse tharo tse fetileng tsa dithuto.
tgt: Njengenyathelo elikhawulezileyo, imali eyi-2.3 yeebhiliyoni zeerandi ibekelwe bucala ukuncedisa kwimali ethi yaphela esithubeni yemisebenzi yemihla ngemihla yeedyunivesithi ngenxa yesivumelwano sokunganyuswa kwemali yokufunda ngowama-20.

src: Sena se bolela hore baithuti bana ba tshwanelwang ke thuso ba keke ba thibelwa ho tswela pele ka dithuto tsa bona hobane ba kolota diyunivesithi ditjhelete tse saletseng morao.
tgt: Ngonyaka-mali wowama-2016/17, urhulumente uphinde wabekela bucala imali eyi-2.543 yeebhiliyoni zeerandi kwimali karhulumente ukuba iye kwi-NSFAS ukuze ibonelele ngemali-mboleko yokunceda abafundi abachongiweyo abangama-71 753 nabafanelekileyo ukuba bangafumana inkxaso-mali ye-NSFAS kodwa banikwa nje inkxaso-mali engaphelelanga okanye abayinikwa tu kule minyaka yabo mithathu idlulileyo.

src: Tlatsetso ya R.039 bilione e tla abelwa NSFAS selemong sa dithuto sa 2016/17 ho tshehetsa baithuti ba sa tholang thuso kapa ba thotseng thuso e haellang ba ntseng ba le ka hara tsamaiso ya diyunivesithi ka 2016 bakeng sa ho phethela mangolo a bona a thuto.
tgt: Oku kuthetha ukuthi aba bafundi bafanelekileyo abazokuthintelwa ekubeni baqhubekeke ngezifundo zabo ngenxa yokuba betyala idyunivesithi.

src: Matlole ana ke tlatsetso ya R10 bilione eo NSFAS e tla e laolang selemong sa dithuto sa 2016.Mmuso o itlamme bakeng sa ho fana ka thuto ya kamora sekolo bakeng sa baithuti kaofela ba tshwanelehang e sa lefellweng moo e fuwang ba futsanehileng le ba sebetsang mesebetsi e tlase, ka hara meedi ya ditjhelete tsa mmuso ya moshwelella.
tgt: Enye imali eyi-2.039 yeebhiliyoni zeerandi iza kwabelwa i-NSFAS kunyaka-mali wama-2016/17 ukuze ixhase abafundi abangaxhaswanga okanye abangaxhaswanga ngokupheleleyo abasesedyunivesithi ngowama-2016 ukuze bagqibe izifundo zabo.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho baithuti bohle, basebetsi, dirutehi le batsamaisi ba diyunivesithi ho sebetsa mmoho le mmuso bakeng sa ho fihlella sepheo sena.
tgt: Le nkxaso-mali yongeza imali ezibhiliyoni zeerandi ezili-10 eza kunikezelwa yi-NSFAS kunyaka wemfundo wama-2016.Urhulumente uzinikele ekuboneleleni ngemfundo yamabanga aphakamileyo yasimahla kubo bonke abafundi abafanelekileyo abangathatha ntweni abakumaziko emfundo ephakamileyo, kodwa oku ngokokuvuma kwepokotho karhulumente.

src: Diketso tse sitisang ho ithuta kapa tse bakang ditebello tse hlokang kellello le ho sa fihlellehe ha bonolo ha di na molemo wa letho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza abafundi, abasebenzi, abahlohli kumaziko emfundo ephakamileyo kunye nabalawuli basezidyunivesithi ukuba basebenzisane norhulumente ukufezekisa le njongo iphambili.

src: Dikgoka le ditshoso ha di batlehe.
tgt: Ubundlobongela nokugrogrisa akwamkelekanga tu kwaphela.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho MaAforika Borwa oohle ho ananela hore ho na le maemo a phephetso nakong eo re lebaneng le yona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba bakuqonde ukuba ukuba kukho iimeko eziyimingeni kweli xesha sijonge kulo.

src: Maemo a moruo wa lefatshe a se a fokola.
tgt: Uqoqosho lwehlabathini luyadodobala.

src: Kgahlamelo ya ditheko tsa thepa tse theohileng e se e utlwahala ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Iziphumo zamaxabiso aphantsi ezimbiwa sele zibonakala eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Mathata a ka hara naha a jwaloka motlakase o sa le lekanang a ntse a le teng ka hara rona.
tgt: Iingxaki zala ekhaya ezifana nokunqongophala kombane zisasombethe.

src: Komello e matla e baka mathata diporofenseng tse ding.
tgt: Imbalela emandla yenza kube nzima kumaphondo aliqela.

src: Kabinete e na le tshepo ya hore MaAforika Borwa a dula e le setjhaba se tsitsitseng se tsebang molemo wa ho sebetsa mmoho ka kgotso le kutlwano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqinisekile ukuba abemi baseMzantsi Afrika bayakuhlala besisizwe esikwaziyo ukumelana neenzima, ukusebenzisana ngoxolo nemvisiswano.

src: Ho pepeswa ha moraorao tjena ha batho ba nang le ditumelo tsa bosemorabe ho matlafaditse boitlamo ba rona bo kopanetsweng ba ho aha setjhaba se hlokang kgethollo ya merabe, kgethollo ya bong le se tswetseng pele.
tgt: Ukubhentsa kwabathile kutsha nje ukuba basakholelwa kubuhlanga kuye kwasenza sonke sazinikela nangakumbi ekwakheni isizwe esingenacalucalulo ngokobuhlanga, ngokwesini nesinekamva eliqaqambileyo.

src: DithonyoKabinete e tjhaelletse monwana dithonyo tse latelang:.
tgt: IzikhundlaIKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuqeshwa kwaba balandelayo:.

src: Monghadi Shonisani Mathews Munzhedzi jwaloka Motlatsi wa Molaodi Kakaretso (DDG): Metswako ya tsa Tlhaho le Paballo ka hara Lefapha la Merero ya Tikoloho.
tgt: UMnu Shonisani Mathews Munzhedzi njengoSekela-Mlawuli-Jikelele (i-DDG): IiNtlobo-ntlobo zeNdalo noLondolozo kwiSebe lezeNdalo.

src: Ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha mananeo a bohlokwa a mmuso.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ezingundoqo.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Puo ya Maemo a Setjhaba ya Moporesidente Jacob Zuma eo a e entseng ka Labone, 11 Hlakola.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele iNtetho engoBume beSizwe kaMongameli Jacob Zuma ayenze ngoLwesine umhla we-11 kweyoMdumba.

src: Puo ena e tekile motjha wa lewa la ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha lenaneo la tshebetso la mmuso.
tgt: Le ntetho ibonise indlela mayelana nokusebenza kwenkqubo karhulumente yokungena endimeni.

src: Moporesidente o ipileditse ho mmuso, basebetsi le borakgwebo ho sebetsa mmoho bakeng sa ho fumana ditharollo bakeng sa kgolo ya moruo ya moshwelella.
tgt: UMongameli umemelele urhulumente, abasebenzi namashishini ukuba basebenze ngokubambisana ukuze bafumane izisombululo eziza kunceda ekukhuliseni uqoqosho ngokuzingileyo.

src: Kabinete e tshehetsa mekgwa ya ho fokotsa ditjeho e phatlaladitsweng ke Moporesidente, e tla hlaloswa ho ya pele ke Letona la Ditjhelete ka la 24 Hlakola.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawaxhasa amanyathelo okuthoba inkcitho, manyathelo lawo aza kwaziswa nguMphathiswa wezeMali ngomhla wama-24 kweyoMdumba.

src: Puo ya Ditekanyetso ya 2016/17 e tla boela e fana ka moralo wa ho abuwa ha mehlodi ho mananeo a fapafapaneng a mmuso jwaloka ha Moporesidente a tobokeditse.
tgt: INtetho yoHlahlo Lwabiwo-malii lowama-2016/17 iza kuphinda ibonise indlela yokwabiwa kwamancedo ngokweenkqubo ngeenkqubo zikarhulumente, ngokokugxinisisa kukaMongameli.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Indaba ya Merafo e atlehileng, e neng e tshwaretswe Motse Kapa ho tloha ka la 8 ho isa ka la 11 Hlakola.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele iNgqungquthela yezeMigodi ebibanjelwe ngempumelelo eKapa ngomhla we-8 ukuya kowe-11 kweyoMdumba.

src: Baemedi ba ka sehloohong ho tswa ho lekala la merafo le mebuso e seng mekae ho tswa Aforika ba ile ba arolelana mehopolo ya bona ya kamoo lekala lena le ka kgannang matsete le ho sebedisa lesoba la menyetla e teng ka hara Aforika.
tgt: Abameli abaphambili becandelo lezemigodi noorhululumente abaninzi base-Afrika babelana ngeembono zabo malunga nendlela eli candelo elingaluqhuba ngayo utyalo-mali lixhamle nakumathuba akhoyo e-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e kgahlisitswe ke boitlamo bo entsweng ke mmuso wa Japane ba ho eketsa matsete ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuqhwabele izandla ukuzinikela korhulumente waseJapan ekunyuseni utyalo-mali lwayo eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e tiiseditse botjha boitlamo ba yona ba lekala la merafo le tsitsitseng le ho atleha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde yaqinisekisa ukuzinikela kwayo kwicandelo lezemigodi elizinzileyo neliphumelelayo.

src: Moralo wa Tumellano bakeng sa Indaseteri ya Merafo ya Moshwelella e tshehetsa indaseteri ya Merafo tikolohong ena ya hajwale e boima.
tgt: IsiCwangciso-sikhokelo sesiVumelwano seCandelo lezeMigodi eliZinzileyo sixhasa icandelo lezemigodi kule meko inzima igqubayo.

src: Mmuso o tswela pele ho fana ka bonnete ba taolo mme o tla netefatsa ho phethelwa ha Bili ya Ntshetsopele ya Taolo ya Mehlodi ya Diminerale le Peterole, e tekilweng ka pela Palamente.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isoloko inika ingcaciso kunye nesiqinisekiso ngemithetho elawula ezemigodi kwaye iza kuqinisekisa ukuqukunjelwa koMthetho osaYilwayo woPhuhliso lweziMbiwa nePetroliyam osePalamente kungoku nje.

src: Diqeto tsa bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Izigqibo ezingundoqo zeKhabhinethi.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Leano la ho Kembola la ho qetela, le shebaneng le diphephetso tse sitisang bohlwahlwa ba Molao wa Naha wa ho Kembola, 2004 (Molao 7 wa 2004).
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwuvumile uMgaqo-nkqubo wokugqibela weSizwe wokuNgcakaza ojongene nemingeni ethintela ukusebenza kakuhle koMthetho weSizwe wezokuNgcakaza, wowama-2004 (uMthetho uNombolo 7 wowama-2007).

src: Leano lena le se le ile la tekelwa setjhaba hore se tshwaele.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo sele kuboniswene ngawo noluntu.

src: Leano lena le sisinya dihlomathiso ho meralo ya dibopeho tsa taolo ya diboto tsa ho kembola le ho matlafatsa mekgwa ya taolo bakeng sa ho fokotsa tshebediso e mpe ya ho kembola.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo uza nezilungiso kwimithetho elawula iibhodi zokungcakaza, kwaye iqinisa imiqathango yolawulo ukuze kuhle ukusetyenziswa kakubi kokungcakaza.

src: E sebetsa ho dikhasino, bingo, metjhini e lekanyeditsweng tjhelete le ho dipetjho tsa mejaho ya dipere.
tgt: Usebenza kwiikhasino, kwi-bingo, koomatshini bokungcakaza abangahlawuli kakhulu nasekubhejeni emidyharhweni yamahashe.

src: Leano le tla kena bakeng sa Boto ya Naha ya ho Kembola le Bolaodi ba Naha ba ho Kembola bo tla tlaleha ka ho otloloha ho Lefapha la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo uza kutshintsha iBhodi yeSizwe yezokuNgcakaza, ijike ibe nguMlawuli weSizwe wezokuNgcakaza oza kuba phantsi kweSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa ha Tlaleho ya Tjhebo botjha ya Dilemo tsa ho Lokelwa ho Tshwarelwa Botlokotsebe ho Palamente, e batlehang ho ya ka Molao wa Toka wa Bana, 2008 (Molao 75 wa 2008).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukuba iNgxelo engokuPhononongwa kweYona miNyaka iVumelekileyo ukuba uBani angaBekwa iTyala loLwaphulo-mthetho ingeniswe ePalamente ngokommiselo woMthetho wezoBulungisa baBantwana, wowama-2008 (uMthetho uNombolo 75 wowama-2008).

src: Tlaleho e kgothaletsa hore naha e amohele ditshwanelo tsa matjhaba le tsa lebatowa tse mabapi le dilemo tsa ho lokelwa ho tshwarelwa botlokotsebe ha bana ba tlolang molao.
tgt: Le ngxelo ikhuthaza ukuba ilizwe eli lamkele izinyanzeliso zamazwe ngamazwe nezeengingqi malunga neyona minyaka mincinci ivumelekileyo yabantwana abanokuthi baphule ngayo umthetho.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa koranteng ya mmuso ha Dibaka tsa Ntshetsopele ya Eneji e ka Hlabollwang Botjha (REDZ).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukupapashwa kwiphephandaba lombuso kweZiza zokuPhuhliswa kwaMandla aHlaziyekayo (i-REDZ).

src: Tsena di tla tsamaisa mekgwa ya taolo ka motjha o le mong, ho hlwaya dibaka tsa tlhaho moo dithekenoloji tsa ho sebedisa matla a moya le a letsatsi bakeng sa motlakase di ka qalwang le moo katoloso ya marangrang a ‘tebileng’ a ka lebiswang teng.
tgt: Ezi ziza ziza kucwangcisa iinkqubo zokumisela imithetho, zichonge iindawo apho ubuxhakaxhaka bobuchwepheshe bomoya nelanga be-photovoltaic bungakhuthazwa khona nalapho bungalawulwa khona.

src: DiREDZ di tla netefatsa ho fetohela ho moruo wa khabone e tlase, ho akofisa ntshetsopele ya meralo ya motheo, le ho nyehela ho moralo wa taolo o kopaneng le ho kgonahala o tla fokotsa bolaodi bo tomanyana bo amanang le ditjeho tsa boimatahanyo.
tgt: Ezi REDZ ziza kuqinisekisa ukutshintshela kuqoqosho olusebenzisa ikharbon ephantsi, zikhawulezise uphuhliso lweziseko ezingundoqo, kwaye zibe negalelo kwimithetho evakalayo necacileyo eza kuphugula ubucukubhede obuhambelana nexabiso lokuthobela.. IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi ngeziphumo zowama-2014 zeNgxelo yoMzantsi Afrika yeziKhombisi zeNzululwazi, ubuChwephweshe nobuChule bokuYila yeBhunga leSizwe leeNgcebiso ngezokuYila.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka diphihlello tsa Tlaleho ya Ditshupane tsa 2014 tsa Saense, Thekenoloji le Dintjhafatso tsa Lekgotla la Naha la Boeletsi la Ntjhafatso.
tgt: Le yingxelo yezinto ezenzekayo ekusebenzeni kweNkqubo yeSizwe yezokuYila (i-NSI).

src: Tlaleho e fana ka diketsahalo ho tshebetso ya Tsamaiso ya Naha ya Dintlafatso (NSI).
tgt: Ihlola ukwenza umsebenzi negalelo le-NSI kwizinto eziphambili ezingundoqo kwisiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP).

src: E hlahloba tshebetso le nyehelo ya NSI ho dintlha tsa bohlokwa tse ka sehloohong tse tekilweng ho Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukusetyenziswa kwamagosa karhulumente adla umhlalaphantsi nalowo asaqeshiweyo njengabahlohli kwisiKolo sikaZwelonke sikaRhulumente (i-NSG).I-NSG yaqala ukusebenza ngowama-2013, sithatha indawo yeZiko lokuQeqesha ubuNkokeli noLawulo (i-PALAMA), kwaye sigunyaziswe ukuba sikhuthaze ukuphuhla okuphucukileyo kwezinto ezingundoqo nemithetho-siseko elawula ulawulo lwamagosa karhulumente kwaye sibe semgangathweni, sibe nefuthe ekuphuhliseni izakhono zabasebenzi kumaziko.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana tshebediso ya basebeletsi ba mmuso ba behileng meja fatshe le ba ntseng ba sebetsa jwaloka barupelli ho Sekolothupello sa Naha sa Mmuso (NSG).NSG e ile ya thakgolwa ka 2013, e nka sebaka sa Akhademi ya Boetapele ba Tsamaiso ya Setjhaba le Bolaodi (PALAMA), mme e romilwe ho hodisa temoho e tswetseng pele ya boleng le dipehelo tse laolang tsamaiso ya setjhaba le ho matlafatsa boleng, bophara le kgahlamelo ya ntshetsopele ya mehlodi ya bokgoni ba batho dikahong tsa mmuso.
tgt: Eli linge liza kukhe livavanywe kuqala nokusebenza kweNKqubo esisiNyanzelo yoQhelaniso yabasebenzi bakarhulumente.

src: Boikitlaetso bona bo tla lekwa ka ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Lenaneo le Tlamang la ho Rutwa Mosebetsi bakeng sa basebeletsi ba mmuso.
tgt: Le nkqubo yenza abasebenzi bakarhulumente babe lulutho kwinkonzo karhulumente.

src: Katamelo ena e thusa basebeletsi ba setjhaba ho eketsa boleng ho tshebeletso ya setjhaba.
tgt: Baza kwabelana ngamava abo, ubungcali, izakhono kunye nolwazi ukuze bacebise kwaye bancede abasebenzi bakarhulumente.

src: Ba tla fana ka boiphihlelo ba bona, botsebi, maitsebelo le tsebo ya ho tataisa le ho kwetlisa basebeletsi ba setjhaba.
tgt: Eli linge liza kuphinda liphucule kakuhle nangendlela eyonga inkcitho izinga leenkonzo esizinika uluntu.

src: Boikitlaetso bona bo tla ntlafatsa ho ya pele ka tsela e hlwahlwa e fokotsang ditjeho tsa boleng ba ditshebeletso tseo re di nehang setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume iNgxelo yoMzantsi Afrika yesiGaba sesi-3 sokuGqibela engokuPhunyezwa koMbutho weNtsebenziswano noPhuhliso loQoqosho (i-OECD) (iSivumelwano esiChasana nokuNyoba.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Tlaleho ya Qetelo ya Mokgahlelo 3 ya Aforika Borwa ya Naha ya ho Kenngwa Tshebetsong ya Mokgatlo wa Tshebedisano-mmoho le Ntshetsopele (OECD) (Khonvenshene e Kgahlanong le Tjotjo).Tlaleho e lokela ho kenngwa ho Sehlopha sa Tshebetso sa OECD sa Tjotjo.
tgt: Le ngxelo iza kungeniswa kwiQela eliSebenza ngokuNyoba.

src: Tlaleho e hlakisa kgatelopele e entsweng ke mmuso boitshunyakong ba ona ba ho thibela tjotjo dinaheng tsa ka ntle ka ho e fokisa, ho e fuputsa le ho e tjhutjhisa.
tgt: Ingxelo le icacisa nenkqubela karhulumente ekungeneleleni kwakhe athintele ukunyotywa ngabamanye amazwe, ngokukubona, ukukuphanda nokubutshutshisa.

src: Tlaleho hape e hlakisa boikitlaetso bo nkuweng ho hlahisa temoso ka botlokotsebe bona.7 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana hore Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae (DHA) le kenyeletswe ka tlasa Lepheo la Toka, Thibelo ya Botlokotsebe le Polokeho.
tgt: Ingxelo ikwagqamisa nelinge lokuvula abantu amehlo ngolu lwaphulo-mthetho.

src: Thomo ya Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae ke ho boloka rejisatara e tshireleditsweng, e nepahetseng ya boitsebiso le maemo a bohle ba ka hara meedi ya naha ya bo rona, e leng sethusi se hlokolosi sa mesebetsi e meng kaofela ya puso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukuba iSebe lemiCimbi yezeKhaya (i-DHA) lihlelwe ngokutsha libe phantsi kweNtlanganisela yezoBulungisa, uThintelo lolwaPhulo-mthetho noKhuseleko.

src: Hape le romilwe ho laola tsamaiso ya bofalli, bo nang le kgahlamelo e otlolohileng ho tshireletso ya naha, momahano ya kahisano le phihlello ya dipheo tsa ntshetsopele.
tgt: I-DHA igunyaziswe ukuba ligcine irejista eluqilima, echanekileyo yokuba ngoobani, isithini imeko yabo, bonke abangaphakathi kwemida yeli lizwe, nto leyo encedisa kakhulu kweminye imisebenzi karhulumente.

src: Mehleng DHA e ne e nkuwa jwaloka tshehetso e akaretsang ya ditshebeletso tsa tsamaiso tlasa lepheo la Taolo le Tsamaiso.
tgt: Isebe likwagunyaziswe ukuba liphathe inkqubo yemfuduko, enefuthe ngqo kukhuseleko lwesizwe, ukunamathelana koluntu nokuphumeleliswa kweenjongo zophuhliso.

src: Dibili.1 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa ha Bili ya Tshireletso, Kgothaletso, Ntshetsopele le Bolaodi ba Tsebo ya tsa Lapeng ho Palamente.
tgt: Kwilixa elingaphambili, eli Sebe lalihlelwe njengelixhasa ngeenkonzo zolawulo linqumbene nezokuPhatha kunye nezoLawulo.

src: Bili ena, e reretswe ho tshireletsa, ho kgothaletsa ntshetsopele le bolaodi ba ditsamaiso tsa Tsebo ya ka Lapeng.
tgt: Imithetho esaYilwayo.1 IKhabhinethi ivume ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho osaYilwayo wokuKhusela, ukuKhuthaza, ukuPhuhlisa nokuLawula uLwazi lweMveli.

src: E fana ka ho thehwa le mesebetsi ya kantoro ya ditsamaiso tsa Naha tsa Tsebo ya ka Lapeng, bolaodi ba batshwari ba ditokelo tsa tsebo ya tsa lapeng, ho thehwa le mesebetsi ya moifo wa Boeletsi wa ditsamaiso tsa tsebo ya tsa lapeng.
tgt: Lo mthetho osayilwayo injongo yawo kukukhusela, ukukhuthaza ukuphuhliswa nokulawulwa kweenkqubo zoLwazi lweMveli.

src: Hape e dumella phumantsho le dipehelo tsa phumantsho ya tsebo ya tsa lapeng le ho badudi ba lehae, ho thehwa ha tsamaiso ya naha ya direkoto tsa setjhaba tsa ditsamaiso tsa tsebo ya tsa lapeng, boingodiso, ho dumellwa le phano ya ditifikeiti tsa ditsebi tsa ka lapeng, thuso le kgokahanyo ya tsebo ya tsa lapeng e itshetlehileng hodima ntjhafatso.
tgt: Ubonelela ngokusekwa nangemisebenzi yeofisi yeeNkqubo zeSizwe zoLwazi lweMveli, ulawulo lamalungelo abo banolwazi lwemveli, ukusekwa nemisebenzi yabantu aBacebisi malunga neenkqubo zolwazi lwemveli.

src: Bili e tla tlatseletsa Sehlomathiso sa Molao wa Thuo ya Thepa, 2013 (Molao 28 wa 2013).Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Dingodiso tsa Mangolo a Matlo ya 2015 bakeng sa ho tshwaela ha setjhaba.
tgt: Ukwavumela ukufikelela kunye nemiqathango yokufikelela kulwazi ngabahlali bomthonyama nabendawo, ukusekwa kwenkqubo yesizwe yokurekhoda iinkqubo zolwazi lwemveli, ukubhalisa, ukugunyazisa nokunikwa kweencwadi ezifaneleyo iincutshe zemveli, ukulungiselela nokulungelelanisa ulwazi lwemveli olungqiyame ngezinto ezintsha.

src: Bili e hlomathisa Molao wa Dingodiso tsa Mangolo a Matlo, 1937 (Molao 47 wa 1937).
tgt: Lo mthetho osayilwayo uza kufezekisa iSilungiso seMithetho yoLwazi olungoloMqambi walo kuphela we- 2013 (uMthetho wama-28 we- 2013).IKhabhinethi ivume ukupapashwa kweSilungiso soMthetho osaYilwayo wokuBhaliswa kweeNcwadi zeZiqinisekiso zeMihlaba zowe-2015 ukuze uluntu luphefumle ngaso.

src: Bili e rerile ho hlomathisa Molao wa Dingodiso tsa Mangolo a Matlo, 1937 (Molao 47 wa 1937) bakeng sa ho falla ho tloha ho mekgwa ya pampiri ho ya ho ya elektroniki kantorong ya mangolo a matlo.
tgt: Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo ulungisa uMthetho wokuBhaliswa kweeNcwadi zeZiqinisekiso zoMhlaba we-1937 (uMthetho wama- 47 we-1937) ukuze iofisi yezi ncwadi ibe yala maxesha asebenzisa ubuxhakaxhaka beinthanethi.

src: E shebana le dintlha tsa polokeho ka ho fana ka boingodiso ba boramolao ba matlo jwaloka basebedisi ba tsamaiso ya elektroniki ya boingodiso ba mangolo a matlo.
tgt: Loo nto ijonga imiba yokhuseleko ngokubonelela ngokubhaliswa kwabo bancutsheza ngokususa umhlaba komnye umntu uye komnye njengabagunyaziswe ukusebenzisa le nkqubo yokubhaliswa kwemihlaba ngobuxhakaxhaka beinthanethi.2 IKhabhinethi ivume ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho osaYilwayo weMpilo yeZityalo yowe-2015.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa ha Bili ya Tshireletso ya Dimela (Bophelo bo botle ba dimela) ya 2015 ho Palamente.
tgt: Lo mthetho osayilwayo ulungelelanisa umthetho woMzantsi Afrika nezinyanzeliso kunye nemigangatho efaneleyo ukulungiselela urhwebo olukhuselekileyo nolungakhethi cala lamazwe ngamazwe ukuqinisa urhwebo lwasekhaya nolwamazwe ngamazwe lwezityalo neziveliso zezityalo.

src: Bili e matahanya molao wa Aforika Borwa le ditshwanelo le maemo a amehang ho thusa ka kgwebisano ya matjhaba e bolokehileng le e hlokang leeme ho tshireletsa kgwebo ya naha ya ka lapeng le ya matjhaba ya dimela le dihlahiswa tsa dimela.
tgt: Wakuba uphunyeziwe lo mthetho osayilwayo, uMzantsi Afrika uza kukwazi ukuthintela ukungena kwezitshabalalisi zasemazweni ezivalelweyo ngenxa yezifo ezibulalayo kwanezifo ezinokusasaza izitshabalalisi ezinobungozi nezifo zezityalo elizweni.

src: Hang ha bili e se e pasitse, Aforika Borwa e tla kgona ho thibela ho kena ha dikokonyana le mafu a ka ntle a thibetsweng a ka hasanyang dikokonyana le mafu a kotsi ka hara naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho osiSilungiso osaYilwayo weeNkundla zamaTyala we-2015.Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo ulungisa uMthetho weeNkundla zeeMantyi we-1944 (uMthetho wama-32 we-1944) noMthetho osiSilungiso weeNkundla eziPhakamileyo we-2013 (uMthetho we-10 we-2013).Ezi zilungiso zijonge ukwenza lula imeko yabakwelitayo abazifumana bengamaxhoba okuphathwa kakubi yinkqubo yokuqokelelwa kwamatyala kwiinkundla zemantyi.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa ha Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Molao wa Makgotla a Dinyewe wa 2015 ho Palamente.
tgt: Zikwajonge nokulungiselela iprojekthi yeSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino yokuguzula iinkcukacha ezimbi zesikweliti somthengi.

src: Bili e hlomathisa Molao wa Makgotla a Bomaseterata, 1944 (Molao 32 wa 1944) le Sehlomathiso sa Molao wa Makgotla a Maholo, 2013 (Molao 10 wa 2013).Dihlomathiso di rerile ho fedisa bothata ba boradikoloto ba iphumanang ba le lehlakoreng la tshebediso e mpe tsamaisong ya ho bokella mekitlane makgotleng a bomaseterata le ho amohela porojeke ya Lefapha la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri ho tlosa tlhahisoleseding e tlontlollang ya mekitlane ya bareki.
tgt: Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo ufuna ukulungisa amacandelo athile oMthetho weeNkundla zeeMantyi we-1994 (uMthetho wama-32 we-1994) ukuze ujongane nokuphathwa kakubi kwiziHlomelo zeMiyalelo yokuNyanzelisa ukuHlawulwa (i-EAO).

src: Bili e rerile ho hlomathisa dikarolo tsa Molao wa Makgotla a Bomaseterata, 1994 (Molao 32 wa 1994) (MCA), ho shebana le tshebediso e mpe ho Taelo ya Kgapo ya Thepa (EAO).
tgt: Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo ujonge kwanokuphelisa izigwebo eziwiswa ngokungekuko, isikakhulu ngoomabhalane abangenaliso lamthetho, kumaxa amaninzi ngenxa yokungabi namava okanye ngokwenza igumgedle nabakwelitwayo, amagqwetha abo okanye abaqokeleli bezikweliti.

src: Bili e rerile ho shebana le, le ho fedisa dikahlolo tse fanwang ka tsela e seng molaong, haholo ke ditlelereke tsa makgotla a dinyewe ntle le ho laelwa ke lekgotla, boholo ba nako ka lebaka la ho hloka boiphihlelo kapa ho sebetsa mmoho le ba kolotwang, babuelli ba bona kapa babokelli ba mekitlane.
tgt: Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo uza kuqinisekisa ukuba abakwelitwayo bagwetyelwa ngendela ehambelana nomyalelo wokuhlawula ngezavenge okanye i-Emoluments Attachment Order ekwimida esemthethweni yokuhlawula ngezavenge.

src: Bili e tla netefatsa hore boradikoloto ba fuwa kahlolo e imatahanyang le taelo ya setolomente kapa Taelo ya Kgapo ya Thepa e ka hara sekepele se molaong sa setolomente.
tgt: Imisitho ezayo.1 Impelaveki yokuqala yokubhaliswa kwabavoti bebhaliselwa uNyulo lowe-2016 loRhulumente waseKhaya iza kuba ngomhla we-5 ukuya kowe-6 kweyoKwindla kowe-2016.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho nka monyetla wa, le ho hlompha demokerasi ena e lwanetsweng ka thata ka ho tswa ho ya sebedisa tokelo ya bona ya demokerasi ya ho ingodisa le ho vouta dikgethong tse tlang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abahlali boMzantsi Afrika ukuba baluxhamle kwaye baluzimase olu lawulo lwentando yesininzi olufumaneke nzima ngokuthi baphume balisebenzise ilungelo labo lolawulo lwentando yesininzi babhalise kwaye bavote kolu nyulo luzayo.2 UMongameli Zuma uza kutyelela ngokwaseburhulumenteni e-Islamic Republic of Iran ukususela ngomhla wama- 28 ukuya kowama-29 kweyoMdumba ngowe- 2016.Olu tyelelo luza kuqinisa ukunxibelelana okusoloko kuqhubeka kwezopolitiko noqoqosho ne-Iran kwaye luvuselele nobudlelwane phakathi kwamazwe aseZantsi kunye naseNtla kwe-Ikhweyitha.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla nka Leeto la Mmuso ho etela Rephaboliki ya MaIsilamo ya Iran ho tloha ka la 28 ho isa ka la 29 Hlakola 2016.Leeto le tla matlafatsa dipuisano tsa rona tse ntseng di tswela pele tsa sepolotiki le moruo le Iran le ho matlafatsa dikamano tsa rona tsa Dinaha tse Borwa ba Ekhweita.
tgt: NjengeNkumanda ePhezulu yoMbutho weSizwe wezoKhuselo woMzantsi Afrika (i-SAND), uMongameli Zuma uza kuphatha umcimbi woSuku lwecandelo loMkhosi lesihlanu.

src: Jwaloka Molaodi-ya- ka-Sehloohong wa Lebotho la Naha la Tshireletso la Aforika Borwa (SANDF), Moporesidente Zuma e tla ba motshwara-marapo wa mekete ya karolo ya bohlano ya Letsatsi la Sesole Port Elizabeth, ho la Kapa Botjhabela, ka la 21 Hlakola 2016.
tgt: Kuza bhiyozwa eBhayi,eMpuma Koloni ngomhla wama-21 kweyoMdumba kowe-2016.

src: Mokete ona wa selemo ka seng o bontsha tshehetso le teboho ho banna le basadi ba SANDMoporesidente Zuma o tla tshetleha puo pulong ya Ntlo ya Naha ya Baetapele ba Setso Palamenteng, Motse Kapa ka la 26 Hlakola 2016.
tgt: Lo mbhiyozo owenziwa unyaka nonyaka ubonisa inkxaso nombulelo kumadoda namabhinqa oMkhosi weSizwe woKhuselo woMzantsi Afrika.3 UMongameli Zuma uza kuthetha xa kuvulwa iNdlu yeSizwe yeeNkokheli zeMveli ePalamente eKapa ngomhla wama-26 kweyoMdumba kowe-2016.

src: Dikamano pakeng tsa mmuso le baetapele ba setso di hlokolosi kaha di sebetsa ho lebiseng ntlafatsong ya bophelo ba batho.
tgt: Ubudlelwane phakathi korhulumente neenkokheli zemveli bubaluleke kakhulu kuba zisebenzela ukuphucula ubomi babantu.4 NgoMgqibelo umhla wama-20 kweyoMdumba kowe-2016, uSekela-Mongameli uCyril Ramaphosa uza kukhokhela igqiza laBaphathiswa ukuya kuMboniso kaMongameli woPhuhliso loLutsha eGrace Bible Church ePimville, eSoweto.

src: Dipontsho di tshehetswa ke mafapha a Merero ya Lehae, Mesebetsi, Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba le la Tshireletso.
tgt: Lo mboniso uxhaswa ngamasebe emiCimbi yaseKhaya, ezabaSebenzi, oPhuhliso loLuntu noKhuselo.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho batho ba batjha sebakeng sena ho kenela dipontsho tsena, tse tla fana ka tlhahisoleseding ya kamoo ba ka tswellisang dithuto tsa bona, ba ka iqallang dikgwebo kapa kamoo ba ka kgolang molemo boikitlaetsong ba tshehetso ya mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abantu abatsha baloo ndawo ukuba baye kulo mboniso oza kubonelela ngolwazi lokuqhubela phambili ezifundweni,ukuqala amashishini abo okanye ukuncedwa ngamalinge karhulumente enkxaso.

src: Kabinete tjhaelletse monwana ho tshwarwa ha Seminara ya Lebatowa la Aforika ya Tshireletso ya Batho e itshetlehileng ho Tshekamelo ya tsa Motabo, Boitsebiso ba Bong le ho Ipolela, ke Khomishene ya Ditokelo tsa Botho ya Aforika Borwa, ho tloha ka la 3 ho isa la 5 March 2016.Seminara e kgothaletsa dipuisano ho theha kutlwisiso e batlang e ba matla ya motso wa disosa le ho itjala ha diphephetso tsa hore ho tle ho fumanwe ditharollo tse kgonehang le mekgwa e meng e teng ho Puso ya ho sebetsana le ditlolo tsena tsa molao.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukubanjwa kweNdibano ye-Afrika engokuKhuselwa kwaBantu ngokweNdlela abaziBona, Abazichaza nabaZazi ngayo iSini sabi yiKhomishoni yoMzantsi Afrika yamaLungelo oLuntu ukususela ngomhla we-3 ukuya kowe-6 kweyoKwindla kowe-2016.

src: Kabinete e lakaletsa baithuti bohle ba ngolang dihlahlobo tsa Tlatsetso tsa Materiki tse molemo ka ho fetisisa.
tgt: Le semina iza kulungiselela uthethathethwano ukuze kubekho kuqondwe ngakumbi oyena nobangela ongundoqo wale mingeni nokuzibonakalisa kwayo ukuze kufumaneke izisombululo ezibonakalayo nezinto ezikhoyo okunokukhethwa kuzo nguRhulumente ukujongana nolu lwaphulo.6 IKhabhinethi inqwenelela impumelelo bonke abafundi ababhala iimviwo zabo zokuxabangela iBanga le-12.

src: Baithuti ba kgothaletswa ho iphumanela Lenaneo la monyetla wa bobedi le sa tswa thakgolwa la tshehetso le fumanehang diporofenseng kaofela le ho thusa baithuti ka dithuto tsa bona ka mehlodi e fapafapaneng.
tgt: Abafundi bakhuthazwa ukuxhamla iNkqubo esandula ukusungulwa enika abafundi umnyinyiva wesibini wokubhala iimviwo zebanga le-12.

src: Dihlahlobo tsa Tlatsetso di etsa karolo ya Lenaneo la Tshehetso la Monyetla wa Bobedi la lefapha le ho thusa baithuti ba sa fihlellang matshwao a hlokahalang a ho pasa le ho thola setifikeiti, empa ba hloka palo ya dithuto tse pedi ho fumana lengolo la NSC monyetla wa ho etsa seo.
tgt: Ikho kuwo onke amaphondo kwaye inceda abafundi ezifundweni zabo ngezixhobo.

src: Kabinete e ananela phatlalatso ya Moporesidente ya mabitso a ditho tsa Khomishene ya Dipatlisiso ya Thuto e Phahameng.
tgt: Injongo yeli Thuba lesiBini lokuBhala iBanga le-12 kukunika abantu abatsha abangaliphumelelanga ibanga le-12 umnyinyiva wesibini wokupasa, ngaloo ndlela baphucule izinga lobomi babo.

src: E ipiletsa ho bankakarolo bohle ba nang le kgahleho ho Thuto e Phahameng ho nyehela mosebetsing wa khomishene bakeng sa ho fumana ditharollo tsa moshwelella ho diphephetso tse tobileng Thuto e Phahameng.
tgt: Iimviwo zokuxabangela ziyinxalenye yeNkquba yokuNika iThuba lesiBini lokuBhala iiMviwo zeBanga le-12 yesebe kwaye inceda abo bangaphumelelanga nabangafumananga ziqinisekiso, kodwa befuna ubuncinane izifundo ezibini ukuze babe bapasile.

src: Maemo a Kabinete Mabapi le Dintlha tsa Bohlokwa Maemong a Hajwale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkela isibhengezo sikaMongameli samagama amalungu eKhomishoni yoPhando ngeMfundo ePhakamileyo.

src: Letona la Mehlodi ya Diminerale Mosebenzi Zwane, Letona Kantorong ya Moporesidente Susan Shabangu le Letona la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba Bathabile Dlamini – ba thontsweng ke Moporesidente Zuma ho fana ka tshehetso ho mebuso ya diporofense, beng ba morafo le malapa a amehang ho latela koduwa ya Morafong wa Gauta wa Lily ho la Barberton – ba tsebisitse Kabinete ka diketsahalo tsa moraorao tjena.
tgt: Imemelela bonke abanomdla nabachaphazelekayo kwiMfundo ePhakamileyo ukuba babe negalelo emsebenzini wekhomoshoni ukuze kufunyanwe isisombululo esiza kuhlala sihleli semingeni ejongene nayo iMfundo ePhakamileyo.1 Uluvo lweKhabhinethi malunga nemiba esematheniUMphathiswa weSebe lemiThombo yeziMbiwa uMosebenzi Zwane, ovela kwiSebe likaMongameli uSusan Shabangu noMphathiswa weSebe loPhuhliso loLuntu uBathabile Dlamini—abakhethwa nguMongameli Zuma ukubonelela ngenkxaso urhulumente wephondo, abasebenzi-mgodini neentsapho ezichaphazelekayo emva kwentlekele kuMgodi iLiily Gold Mine eBarberton – bachazele iKhabhinethi ngokutsha okwenzekayo.

src: Kabinete e imatahantse le Moporesidente kgoeletsong ya setjhaba ya ho dula se behile basebeletsi ba bararo ba morafo ba ntseng ba tshwasehile mokoting le ba malapa a bona menahanong le dithapelong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazibandakanya noMongameli ekumemeleleni isizwe ukuba sicinge ngabasebenzi-mgodini abathathu abasabambeke phantsi komhlaba kwaye sibathandazele.

src: Kabinete e ntse e ngongorehile ka komello e ntseng e ama dikarolo tse ding tsa naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isoloko ixhalabile yimbalela esachaphazela iindawo ezithile zelizwe.

src: E hlahisitse teboho ya yona ho maAforika Borwa kaofela, a tshehetsang mekutu ya pebofatso ya maemo a komello.
tgt: Ibulela bonke abahlali boMzantsi Afrika abaxhasa amalinge okunceda kule mbalela.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa kananelo ya yona ho ba mametseng kgoeletso ya ho tlaleha ho dutla hofe kapa hofe bakeng sa tshehetso ya Letsholo la Ntwa Kgahlanong le ho Dutla le eteletsweng pele ke Letona la Metsi le Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere Nomvula Mokonyane.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa uvuyo lwayo kwabo basabele ikhwelo lokuxela ukuvuza kwamanzi ngolo hlobo bexhasa iPhulo loMphathiswa waManzi noCoceko uNomvula Mokonyanene.

src: Kabinete e kgahliswa ke moya wa Ubuntu o bontshitsweng ke boikitlaetso bo eteletsweng pele ke Operation Hydrate bo entseng phapang ho badudi ba mathateng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyela umoya wobuntu obubonakaliswe liphulo elikhokhelwa yiOperation Hydrate nelenze umahluko kubahlali ababandezelekileyo.2 IKhabhinethi ixoxile yaqwalesela iziphumo ngokupheleleyo zokuqalisa koMthetho osisiLungiso seMithetho yeRhafu we-2014.

src: Kabinete e kene dingangisanong le ho sekaseka kgahlamelo ka botlalo ya ho qala ha Sehlomathiso sa Molao wa Melao ya Lekgetho, 2014.
tgt: Ngokwalo Mthetho, ukuhlawulwa kwemali esisigxina kwingxowamali egciniweyo kuza kuqalisa ngomhla wokuqala kweyoKwindla ngo-2016.

src: Ho ya ka Molao oo, tefo ya kgwedi ka nngwe e tla etswa ho tswa ho letlole la basebetsi ho basebetsi ba behang meja fatshe ho tloha ka la 1 Tlhakubele 2016.
tgt: Loo nto ithetha ukuthi ukususela ngaloo mhla amancedo aloo ngxowa aza kufana nawomhlala-phantsi lo uqhelekileyo kuba amalungu aloo ngxowamali xa athatha umhlalaphantsi aza kuvunyelwa ukuba athathe isambukru esiziinkozo esisinye esithathwini kumancedo.

src: Seo se bolela hore hore ho tloha mohlang oo ditjhelete tsa letlole la basebetsi le letlole la pentjhene di tla sebetswa ka ho tshwana moo ditho tsa letlole la basebetsi di tla dumellwang ho nka nngwe-borarong ya ditjhelete tsa bona tsa letlole e le tjhelete e sekolokoto mme pedi-tharong e setseng e tla lefuwa e le tjhelete ya kgwedi ka nngwe.
tgt: Imali esalayo kuza kufuneka amalungu ayisebenzise athenge imali enikwa umntu ngomnyaka ebomini bakhe bonke.

src: Pehelo yona ena e sebetsa ho ditho tsa letlole la pentjhene ya mmuso hajwale.
tgt: Kwalo mmiselo mnye nguwo osebenzayo kungoku nje kwingxowamali yomhlalaphantsi lo uqhelekileyo.

src: Diphethoho molaong ona di ama batho ba kgolang haholo le batho ba bang kaofela ba welang ho letlole la basebetsi.
tgt: Ezi nguqu emthethweni zichaphazela abo bamkela kakhulu nabanye abangamalungu engxowamali esisigxina.

src: Mekgatlo e mengata le batho ka bonngwe ba hlahisitse ngongoreho ya bona ka ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha diphethoho tse ntjha mme ba hlahisitse ditletlebo tsa bona ka ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha sena.
tgt: Imibutho eminizi nabantu bavakalise inkxalabo ngokusebanza kwalo mthetho mtsha kwaye bathethe norhulumente ngawo.

src: Ho bonahala e ka ntle le dipuisano tse batsi tseo ho ileng ha kenwa ho tsona pele molao ona o fetiswa ho ntse ho na le dingongoreho mme dingongoreho tseo di lokelwa ho sekasekwa ka potlako ho netefatsa hore ha molao o qala ho sebetsa diphetho ho ditjhelete tsa letlole la basebetsi di tla kenngwa tshebetsong ha bobebe le ka bokgabane.
tgt: Kuyacaca ukuba noxa kwathethathethwana kakhulu phambi kokuba lo mthetho uphunyezwe, kusekho inkxalabo kwaye kufuneka ijongwe ngokukhawuleza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba xa uqala ukusebenza lo mthetho iinguqu kumancedo engxowamali esisigxina zisebenza ngokulula nakakuhle.

src: Ka lebaka leo, Kabinete e entse qeto ya ho teka ka molao phethoho ho Sehlomathiso sa Molao wa Melao ya Lekgetho jwaloka taba e potlakileng ho diehisa letsatsi la qalo ho tloha ka la 1 Tlhakubele 2016 ho ya ka la 1 Tlhakubele 2018 ho fana ka sebaka bakeng sa ditherisano le bankakarolo kaofela.
tgt: Ngeso sizathu, iKhabhinethi igqibe kwelokuba yandlale ngokungxamiseke kakhulu isilungiso kuMthetho osiSilungiso seMithetho yeeRhafu ungaqalisi ukusebenza loo mthetho ngomhla wokuqa kweyoKwindla kowe-2016, koko uqale ukusebenza ngomhla wokuqala kweyoKwindla kowe-2018 ukwenzela ukuba kuphinde kuthethathethwane nabachaphazelekayo.

src: Ditherisano tseo di ka nna tsa baka hore ho be le diphethoho tse ding melaong.
tgt: Olo thethathethwano lungenza ukuba imithetho le iphinde ilungiswe.

src: Bili ya Sehlomathiso e tla tekwa Palamenteng nakong ya matsatsi a mmalwa a tlang.
tgt: UMthetho osaYilwayo osiSilungiso uza kuthiwa thaca ePalamente kungekudala.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona ka ho hlokahala haufinyana tjena ha Motlotsuwa Bishopo Glayton Modise wa Kereke ya International Pentecostal Holiness.
tgt: Amazwi ovelwano.1 IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano ngokubhubha koHloniphekileyo uBhishophu Glayton Modise weInternational Pentecostal Holiness Church.

src: Bishopo Modise o eteletse pele phutheho ena e nang le ditho tse fetang dimilione tse tharo ho phatlalla le Aforika e borwa, ho latela lefu la ntatae le mothehi wa kereke, Motlotsuwa Moemedi Frederick Modise ka 1996.
tgt: UBhishophu Modise ukhokhele ibandla elinamalungu angaphezu kweemiliyoni ezintathu kumazantsi eAfrika, emva kokubhubha kukayise nongumseki waloo cawe oHloniphekileyo uComforter Frederick Modise ngowe-19.2 IKhabhinethi ikwavakalisa uvelwano lwayo olunzulu ngokubhubha kutsha nje kwayesakuba nguNobhala-jikelele weZizwe eziManyeneyo, iNkosi Boutros Boutros-Ghali.

src: Kabinete hape e fetisa kutlwelo bohloko ya yona e tebileng ka ho hlokahala haufinyana tjena ha Mongodi-Kakaretso wa mehleng wa Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) Morena Boutros Boutros-Ghali.
tgt: Ungene kweso sikhundla ngowe-1992 xa ifuthe lo mbutho lo likhula emva kwemfazwe yeGulf, wasebenza iminyaka emihlanu.

src: O ile a nka marapo ka 1992 nakong eo kgahlamelo ya UN e neng e le matla bakeng sa karolo ya yona ho Ntwa ya Koung ya Persia, o sebeditse nako ya dilemo tse hlano.
tgt: Ubhubhe kwisibhedlele saseCairo eneminyaka engama- Uza kukhunjulwa ngegalelo lakhe kuxolo nolawulo lwentando yesininzi.

src: O hlokahaletse sepetleleng sa Cairo ka Labobedi a le dilemo tse O tla hopolwa ka nyehelo ya hae ho tsa kgotso le demokerasi.
tgt: Imiyalezo yokuvuyisana.1 IKhabhinethi ivuyisana noMnu.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Monghadi Kevin Govender ho tswa Kantorong ya Thuto ya Dinaledi bakeng sa Ntshetsopele le Kopano ya Matjhaba ya Thuto ya Dinaledi e Motse Kapa ya tla abelwa ka kopanelo kgau ya maemo a hodimo ya Medale wa Edinburgh wa 2016 bakeng sa ho theha Kantoro ya Thuto ya Dinaledi bakeng sa Ntshetsopele ho la Motse Kapa.
tgt: Kevin Govender we-Cape Town-based Office of Astronomy for Development and the International Astronomical Union oza kuwonga ngembasa enodumo iEdinburgh Medal yowe-2016 ngokuseka iOffice of Astronomy for Development eKapa.

src: Govender ke moAforika Borwa wa pele wa ho amohela kgau ena ya maemo a hodimo bakeng sa diphihlello tsa saense le thekenoloji tse nyehelang kutlwisisong le ho pheleng hantle ha batho.
tgt: UGovender ngummi wokuqala waseMzantsi Afrika ukufumana le mbasa yodumo ngempumelelo kwezenzululwazi netheknoloji, nto leyo ebenegalelo ekuqondeni uluntu nempilo yalo.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa setantshi se dilemo di 16 sa ballet Leroy Mokgatle ya hapileng kgau ya Audience Favourite le moputso wa ho ithuta ho Tlhodisano ya Matjhaba ya Ballet ya Prix de Lausanne ho la Switzerland.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithi halala kuLeroy Mokgatle ongumdanisi weballet nominyaka ili-16 owine imbasa iAudience Favourite nemali yokufunda kukhuphiswano i-International Ballet Competition eSwitzerland.

src: Ke moAforika Borwa wa pele wa ho hapa moputso wa ho ithuta dilemong tse 28 mme ke wa bobedi nalaneng ya naha ena.
tgt: Ngummi wokuqala waseMzantsi Afrika owine le mali yokufunda kwiminyaka engama- 28 kwaye ngowesibini ukwenza oko kwimbali yeli lizwe.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le Moporesidente Zuma bakeng sa ho thoholetsa bahlodi ba Dikgau tsa Bobedi tsa Selemo ka seng tsa Ubuntu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izibandakanya noMongameli Zuma ngokuvuyisana nabo baphumelele i-2nd Annual Ubuntu Awards.

src: Dikgau tsena di ananela baetapele ba diindaseteri ba Aforika Borwa le batho ba hlahelletseng ka mahetla bakeng sa nyehelo ya bona bakeng sa ho hodisa dikgahlehelo tsa rona tsa naha le melemo ho phatlalla le lefatshe.
tgt: Ezi zimbasa eziwonga iinkokheli zoshishino zaseMzantsi Afrika nabantu ababalaseleyo ngenxa yegalelo labo ekukhuthazeni izinto zethu zesizwe nezo zobomi ezingundoqo ehlabathini liphela.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa seletsi sa fulute Wouter Kellerman, sehlopha sa mmino wa setso sa Ladysmith Black Mambazo le sebini sa mmino wa bodumedi Neville D bakeng sa ho kgethwa bakeng sa dikgau tsa 2016 tsa Grammy.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana nombethi-mbande uWouter Kellerman, cappella group Ladysmith Black Mambazo nomculi wegospile uNeville D ngokuba ngabakhethiweyo kwiGrammy yowe-2016.

src: Dikgalala tsena ke kgothatso mme di fofisetsa folakga ya Aforika Borwa hodimo.
tgt: Ezi ngcali ziyakhuthaza kwaye zibeka uMzantsi Afrika emagqabini.

src: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di tla lokelwa ke ho netefatswa ha mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang.
tgt: IzikhundlaUkuqeshwa kuzo zonke izikhundla kuxhomekeke ekuqinisekisweni kwezifundo nokuba msulwa okufaneleyo.1 IBhodi yeLepelle Northern Watera) Obekekileyo uThovhele Tshivhase (USihlalo)b) UMnu.

src: Boto ya Metsi ya Lepelle Leboya:a) Motlotlehi Thovhele Tshivhase (Modulasetulo)b) Monghadi Matsebe Ivor Phasha (Motlatsi wa Modulasetulo)c) Mofumahadi Thandeka Thembekile Celiwe Hlongwa (setho)d) Monghadi Boxing Phillemon Sebola (setho)e) Monghadi Ntale Herold Matsepe (setho)f) Mofumahadi Mankone Mabataung Ntsaba (setho)g) Mofumahadi L Malamba (setho)h) Mofumahadi Josephine Mampheri Letsoalo (setho) lei) Mofumahadi Makgetsi Annabelle Mphahlele (setho).
tgt: Matsebe Ivor Phasha (uSekela-sihlao)c) UMnu.

src: Ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha mananeo a bohlokwa a mmuso.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ezingundoqo.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Puo ya Ditekanyetso ya 2016 e entsweng ke Letona la Ditjhelete Pravin Gordhan ka la 24 Hlakola 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele iNtetho yoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali yowama-2016 ethe yenziwa nguMphathiswa wezeMali uPravin Gordhan ngomhla wama-24 kweyoMdumba yama-2016.

src: Ditekanyetso tsena di bontsha bokgoni ba ho tsetsepela, boitlamo le malebaleba a rona jwaloka ha re itwanela ka hara nako e mpe ka ho fetisisa ya moruo nalaneng ya moraorao tjena.
tgt: Olu hlahlo lwabiwo-mali lubonakalisa ukomelela, ukuzinikela nokuba nobuchule njengoko sichankcatha kwelona xesha lakhe lanzima kwezoqoqosho ezimbalini.

src: Ditekanyetso di arabela ho se hlokwang ke naha le ho hlahisa boitshepo moruong ka ho beha naha motjheng wa kgolo ya moruo o kenyeletsang o tshepehang, wa moshwelella le o kgonahalang.
tgt: Olu hlahlo lwabiwo-mali luhlangabezana noko eli lizwe likudingayo kwaye lukwadala intembeko kwezoqoqosho ngokubeka eli lizwe kwindlela yohlumo lwezoqoqosho ethembakeleyo, ezinzileyo nedibene ngokuphilisayo.

src: Kabinete hape e ananela mekgwa e matla ya ho thibela ditjeho le ho itlama ho sebetsa mmoho le makala oohle bakeng sa ho inehela ho mekutu e kopanetsweng ya naha bakeng sa ho kenya tshebetsong mekgwa e tekilweng ke ditekanyetso tsena.
tgt: Kwakhona iKhabhinethi iyawamkela amanyathelo abalulekileyo okugcina iindleko ziphantsi kwemo elawulekayo kwaye ikwazibophelela ekusebenzisaneni nawo onke amacandelo ekwenzeni igalelo kwilinge elidibeneyo lesizwe ukuphumeza umlima-ndlela omiselwe luhlahlo lwabiwo-mali.

src: Kabinete e ananela ho thakgolwa ha Moifo wa Moporesidente wa Boraditaba (PPC) ke Moporesidente Jacob Zuma.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukumiselwa kweQela looNondaba likaMongameli (i-PPC) nguMongameli uJacob Zuma.

src: PPC e tla thehwa ka bahlophisi ba ditaba tsa dipolotiki, bangolli ba ditaba tsa dipolotiki, baqolotsi ba ditaba tsa dipolotiki le boraditaba ba tsa moruo ba nang le tumello ya ho akaretsa ditaba tsa Boporesidente ka nako tsohle le maemong a tswelang pele.
tgt: I-PPC izakuquka abahleli bezopolitiko, iintatheli zezopolitiko, oonondaba bezopolitiko neentatheli zezoqoqosho eziqinisekisiweyo ukuba zizo ezinegunya lokukhupha ingxelo nge-Ofisi kaMongameli ngokupheleleyo zihlale zisenza njalo rhoqo.

src: Sepheo sa PPC ke ho fana ka phumantsho ya tlhahisoleseding e ntlafaditseng ke boraditaba.
tgt: Injongo ye-PPC kukubonelela amajelo eendaba ngokufikelela okuphuculiweyo kulwazi.

src: Hape e tla ntlafatsa phihlello ya boraditaba ho Moporesidente le Kantoro ya Moporesidente, bakeng sa ho netefatsa hore baqolotsi ba ditaba le bona bo fumana tlhahisoleseding e tiileng le ditsamaiso ho matlafatsa kutlwisiso le botlalehi ba bona.
tgt: Iza kuphucula ukufikelela kwamajelo eendaba kuMongameli ne-Ofisi kaMongameli, khona ukuze iqinisekise ukuba iintatheli nazo zifumana ulwazi neenkqubo ezizeleyo ukuze kuphucuke indlela ababhala kunye nabazikhupha ngayo iindaba.

src: Ditho tsa moifo wa boraditaba le tsona di tla fumana ditsebiso ho tswa ho Motlatsi wa Moporesidente le ho Letona lefe kapa lefe leo Moporesidente a le memang bakeng sa ho arolelana le tsona mananeo a bohlokwa a naha.
tgt: Amalungu eliqelaloonondaba aza kuthatha inxaxheba kwiitlanganiso noSekela-Mongameli okanye nawuphi na uMphathiswa omenyiweyo nguMongameli ukuba babelane ngeenkqubo ezibalulekileyo kwisizwe.

src: Kabinete e hlahisitse kananelo ya nyehelo e entsweng ke Aforika Borwa mabapi le ho boloka kgotso ka hara Burundi, e ipapisitse le leano la rona la dinaha tsa ka ntle la boitlamo ba ho netefatsa kontinente e nang le kgotso le botsitso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilincomile igalelo elenziwe nguMzantsi Afrika ekubuyiseleni uxolo eBurundi, ngokuhambelana nesibophelelo somgaqo-nkqubo wethu wezangaphandle ukuqinisekisa uxolo nozinzo kweli lizwekazi.

src: Hape e ananetse sephetho sa Dipuisano tse kenyeletsang tsa Baahi ba Burundi ka kopanelo nakong ya leeto la Kopano ya Aforika (AU) ya kemedi ya maemo a hodimo ya Dihlooho tsa Dipuso le Mebuso Motsemoholong wa Bujumbura ho la Burundi, e neng e eteletswe pele ke Moporesidente Zuma.
tgt: Kwakhona izamkele iziphumo zoThethathethwano oluquka bonke abemi baseBurundi obelubanjwe ngethuba igqiza eliphezulu leeNtloko zemiBuso nooRhulumente leMbumba yase-Afrika (i-AU), ebelikhokelwa nguMongameli uZuma, belityelele eBujumbura eBurundi.

src: Kabinete e ananela thonyo ya Moporesidente Zuma ke Mongodi-Kakaretso wa Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) Ban Ki-moon, ho ba modulasetulo wa Khomishene ya Maemo a Hodimo ya Bophelo bo Botle, Mesebetsi le Kgolo ya Moruo mmoho le Moporesidente François Hollande wa Riphaboliki ya Fora.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuchongwa kukaMongameli uZuma nguNobhala Jikelele weZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) uBan Ki-moon, ukuba abe ngusihlalo wesibini kwiKhomishini ePhezulu yeNgqesho kwezeMpilo noHlumo lwezoQoqosho ebambisene noMongameli u-François Hollande weRhiphabliki yaseFrance.

src: Sena ha se lekgetlo la pele hore Moporesidente Zuma a thonngwe ke mokgatlo wa lefatshe ho sebetsa sethaleng sa lefatshe.
tgt: Asikuko okokuqala ukuba uMongameli uZuma achongwe ngumbutho wehlabathi ukuba enze umsebenzi kwimibutho yehlabathi.

src: Khomishene e tla hlasimolla ho hlahiswa ha menyetla ya mesebetsi e metjha ka hara lekala la kalafo ho phatlalla le dinaha kaofela, haholoholo tseo ntshetsopele ya tsona e leng tlase ka ho fetisisa.
tgt: Le khomishini iza kuvuselela ukudalwa kwamathuba amatsha emisebenzi kwicandelo lezempilo kuwo onke amazwe jikelele, ingakumbi kulawo aphuhliswe kancinci.

src: Sena hape se matlafatsa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Lenaneo la 2030 bakeng sa Ntshetsopele ya Moshwelella, le tla etsa ho hongata bakeng sa ho shebana le boraro ba diphephetso e leng tlhokeho ya mesebetsi, bofuma le ho se lekalekane.
tgt: Oku komeleza nokuphunyezwa kwe-Ajenda yoPhuhliso oluZinzileyo yowama-2030, eza kunceda kakhulu ukuhlangabezana nemingeni entlantlu-ntathu yentswela-ngqesho, indlala nokungalingani.
