src: Kabinete e ananela ho thakgolwa ha Tekolo ya Naha ya Badudi ya 2016 Mamelodi, ho la Pretoria ke Letona Kantorong ya Moporesidente Jeff Radebe le Radipalopalo Kakaretso Pali Lehohla.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukumiselwa koPhando lweSizwe loLuntu lowama-2016 eMamelodi ePitoli nguMphathiswa kwi-Ofisi kaMongameli uJeff Radebe noSonkcukhacha-manani Jikelele uPali Lehohla.

src: Tekolo ya selemong sena e etswa tlasa mookotaba:“MaAforika Borwa ao ke a tsebang, lehae leo ke le utlwisisang” mme e reretswe ho fihlella malapa a fetang 1,5 milione – e leng e kgolo e phahameng ka ho fetisisa ho feta e neng e tshwerwe dilemong tse hlano tse fetileng e ileng ya fihlella malapa a 300 000 feela.
tgt: Uhlolo lwalo nyaka lwenziwa phantsi komxholo othi: “UMzantsi Afrika endiwaziyo, ikhaya endiliqondayo” kwaye lujongiswe kwimizi engaphezu kwe-1,5 sezigidi – lilolona lukhulu ukuza kutsho ngoku xa luthelekiswa nolo lwalwenziwe kwiminyaka emihlanu edlulileyo elafikelela nje kwimizi engaphezulu kwama-300 000.

src: Tekolo e tla etswa ka Mmesa mme diphetho di tla tsebahatswa mafelong a Phuptjane 2016.
tgt: Olu hlolo luza kwenziwe kwinyaga kaTshazimpuzi zize iziphumo zifumaneke ekupheleni kweyeSilimela yowama-2016.

src: Kabinete e lemoha ka ngongoreho tlaleho e hlahisitsweng ke Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Bophelo bo Botle (WHO) le Mokgatlo wa Tshebedisano-mmoho le Ntshetsopele ho Dipatlisiso tsa Mmaraka wa Bophelo bo Botle e etellwang pele ke Moahlodi Sandile Ngcobo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele ngenkxalabo ingxelo enikzelwe nguMbutho wezeMpilo weHlabathi kunye noMbutho weNtsebenziswano noPhuhliso lwezoQoqosho kuPhando lweCandelo llezeMpilo olukhokelwa yiJaji uSandile Ngcobo.

src: Tlaleho e supa hore Aforika Borwa e fana ka ditshebeletso tsa kalafo tse bitsang ka ho fetisisa ha e bapiswa le mafatshe a mang.
tgt: Le ngxelo ibonisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ubonelela ngezona nkonzo zezonyango zibiza kakhulu xa uthelekiswa namanye amazwe.

src: Kabinete e tla emela qeto ya dipatlisiso pele e tshwaela tabeng ena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iza kulinda kuqukunjelwe olu phando phambi kokuba iphefumle ngalo mba.

src: Diqeto tse ka Sehloohong tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Izigqibo ezingundoqo zeKhabhinethi.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Lewa la Moralo bakeng sa Tshilafatso ya Moya Metseng e Teteaneng ya Badudi ba Lekeno le tlase ba Aforika Borwa bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukupapashwakweDrafti yesiCwangciso-qhinga sokuLwa iNgxaki yoNgcoliseko loMoya kwiiNdawo eziXineneyo Ezihlala Abantu abaMkela iMivuzo ePhantsi eMzantsi Afrika ukwenzela uluntu ukuba luhlomle.

src: Lewa lena le reretswe ho fana ka katamelo e inehetseng ho tobana le ho sebetsana le boemo bophahameng ba tshilafatso dibakeng tse ding tse teteaneng ka badudi ba lekeno le tlase.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga sigxile ekuboneleleni ngendlela egxile ekuzinikeleni ukusebenza ngezinga eliphezulu longcoliseko kolunye loluntu oluhlala kwiindawo ezixineneyo nolwamkela imivuzo ephantsi.

src: Le fana ka katamelo e hokahanetsweng ho taba ya ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha mekutu ya ho fokotsa mello e beswang malapeng.
tgt: Sibonelela ngendlela elungeleleneyo ekuphumezeni amalinge okunciphisa ukuvutha kwezibaso emakhayeni.

src: Boitshunyako bo reretswe ho netefatsa hore dibaka tsena di imatahanya le Maemo a Naha a Boleng ba Moya o Sebakeng.
tgt: Olu ngenelelo lelokuqinisekisa ukuba le mimandla iyathobelana neMimiselo yoMgangatho weziRhangqo yeSizwe.

src: Lewa lena le tjhorileng le tla tshehetsa lewa le ntseng le le teng la naha ho shebana le tshilafatso ka hara naha.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga sigxilileyo siza kuxhasa isicwangciso-qhinga sesizwe esikhoyo ukuhlangabezana nongcoliseko lomoya kweli lizwe.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tshwarwa mmoho ha Khonferense ya bo-21 ya Matjhaba ya AIDS (AIDS 2016) pakeng tsa mmuso le Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa AIDS Setsheng sa Matjhaba sa Dikopano (ICC) Durban ho tloha ka la 18 ho isa ka la 22 Phupu 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuba urhulumente abe lelinye lamahlakani aza kusingatha iNgqungquthela yeZizwe-ngezizwe kaGawulayo yama-21 (i-AIDS 2016) ndawonye noNombutho eHlabathi kaGawulayo kwiZiko leNgqungquthela yeZizwe ngezizwe (i-ICC) eDurban ukususela ngomhla we-18 ukuya kowama-22 kweyeKhala yowama-2016.

src: Ho tshwarwa ha khonferense ho tla hodisa karabelo ya naha ya rona ho HIV le lefuba ha ka ho le leng e tla be e hahlamela hodima diphephetso tsa bohlokwa ka ho fetisisa ka hara Aforika Borwa, lebatowa le lefatshe.
tgt: Ukusingatha le ngqungquthela kuza kuqhubela phambili indlela ilizwe lethu elihlangabezana ngayo neeNtsholongwane kaGawulayo (i-HIV) nesifo sephepha (i-TB) ngeli xesha kwangaxesha nye lisenza impembelelo komnye weyona mingeni iyeyona ibalulekileyo eMzantsi Afrika, kummandla welizwekazi nakwihlabathi.

src: Khonferense e tla fana ka lepatlelo bakeng sa bafuputsi ho tswa lefatsheng ka bophara ho arolelana ditswelopele tsa moraorao ntlheng ena, ho rutana botsebi le ho ntshetsapele mawa bakeng sa ho tswellisa mekgahlelo kaofela ya mekutu ya rona e kopanetsweng ya ho alafa le ho thibela HIDibili.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela iza kubonelela abaphandi abavela kwiinkalo zonke zehlabathi ngeqonga lokwabelana ngeenkqubo zobunzululwazi zala maxesha kweli candelo, ukufunda kubuchule bomnye nomnye nokuphuhlisa ubuchule bokuqhubela phambili onke amacala kumalinge wethu ahlangeneyo okunyanga nokuthintela i-HIUmthetho oYilwayo.

src: Kabinete tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa ha Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Naha ya Dipalangwang tsa Fatshe ya 2015 ho Palamente, e hlomathisang Molao wa Naha wa Dipalangwang tsa Fatshe, 2009 (Molao 5 wa 2009).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukungeniswa koMthetho-siHlomelo wezoThutho zaseMhlabeni weSizwe wama-2015 ePalamente, ohlomela uMthetho wezoThutho zaseMhlabeni weSizwe, wama-2009 (uMthetho we-5 wama-2009).

src: Dihlomathiso ho Molao wa Naha wa Dipalangwang tsa Fatshe o tla tswellisa tsamaiso ya ho fetola le ho bopa botjha mokgwa wa dipalangwang tsa naha tsa fatshe.
tgt: Ezi zilungisoo zoMthetho wezoThutho zaseMhlabeni wama-2009 ziza kuqhubela phambili inkqubo yokuguqula nokumisela ngokutsha inkqubo yezothutho zasemhlabeni yesizwe.

src: Sena se tla nyehela ho iseng ho tshebeletso ya dipalangwang tsa setjhaba e batlang e bolokehile, e fumaneha, e le hlwahlwa le ho ba kgabane.
tgt: Oku kuza kwenza igalelo kwinkonzo yezothutho kawonkewonke ekhuselekileyo, efikelelekayo, enobuchule nesebenzayo.

src: Bili e fana ka sebaka bakeng sa dintshetsopele tse ntjha lekaleng la dipalangwang tsa setjhaba.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ubonelela ngophuhliso olutsha kwicandelo lezothutho kawonkewonke.

src: Bili e fana ka tataiso ho, ha ra tse ding, dipalangwang tseo e seng tsa makoloi, ditshebeletso tsa dipalangwang tse hlophiswang ka inthanete le ho kenngwa dipapatso ho dipalangwang tsa setjhaba.
tgt: Ubonelela ngesikhokelo ekukho phakathi kwaso, izithuthi ezingezo moto iinkonzo zezothutho ezibizwa ngezixhobo zobuchwephetshe nokuphawulwa kwezithuthi zikawonkewonke ngokutsha ngokusebenza ngendlela ephucukileyo.

src: E boela e fana ka tlhakisetso ka matla ao ho fannweng ka wona le melawana e mabapi le ho ntshuwa ha dilaesense tsa tshebetso tsa dipalangwang tsa setjhaba.
tgt: Ukwabonelela ngokucacisa ngengcaciso kwinkqubo yokudluliselwa kwamagunya nemimiselo ngokumayela nokukhutshwa kweelayisenisi zokuqhuba izithuthi zikawonkewonke.

src: Bili ena hape e tla thusa ka phano ya Marangrang a Dipalangwang tsa Setjhaba a Kopanetsweng mme e bopa karolo ya Moralo wa Meralo ya Motheo ya Naha le Porojeke ya bo 7 ya Mawa a Kopanetsweng, o shebaneng le ho sebedisa ntshetsopele e hokahantsweng ya metse ya ditoropo le marangrang a dipalangwang a kopanetsweng bakeng sa ho theha metsemeholo jwaloka metjhini ya kgolo.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uza kubonelela ngokuqaliswa koThungelwano lwezoThutho lukaWonkewonke oluDibeneyo kwaye luyinxalenye yeProjekthi ye-7 yesiCwangciso seziSeko ezinguNdoqo seSizwe, sigxile ekusebenziseni uphuhliso olulungeleleyo ezidolophini nothungelwano lwezothutho oludibeneyo ukumisela izixeko njengonobangela wohlumo.

src: Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Imisitho ezayo.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla nka Leeto la Puso ho etela Riphaboliki ya Bofederale ya Nigeria ho tloha ka la 8 ho isa ka la 9 Hlakubele 2016.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uza kuya luTyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni kwiFederal Republic of Nigeria ukususela ngomhla we-8 ukuya kowe-9 kweyoKwindla yowama-2016.

src: Leeto lena la Puso le tla matlafatsa dikamano tsa bobedi bona tse ntseng di le teng le ho hodisa kgwebisano e kopanetsweng ya lebatowa.
tgt: Olu tyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni luza kuqinisa ubudlelwano obuphakathi kwalamazwe mabini nokuqhubela phambili urhwebo oluphakathi kwemimandla yala mazwe.

src: Kgwedi ya Ditokelo tsa Botho ka Hlakubele 2016 e tla ketekwa tlasa mookotaba: “Aforika Borwa e kopane kgahlanong le semorabe.” Lefapha la Bonono le Botjhaba le se le hlophisitse lenaneo la kgwedi kaofela le kenyeletsang lethathama la dipuisano tse mabapi le ho sebetsa mmoho ho aha setjhaba sa demokerasi se hlokang kgethollo ka morabe, ka bong le se lekalekanang.
tgt: INyanga yamaLungelo oLuntu kweyoKwindla yowama-2016 iza kubhiyozelwa phantsi komxholo othi: “UMzantsi Afrika umanyene ukulwa nobuhlanga.” ISebe lezobuGcisa neNkcubeko limisele inkqubo ebude buyinyanga equka iintlanganiso ezimalunga nokusebenzisana ukuze kwakhiwe isizwe esingenabuhlanga, esingacaluli ngokwesini, esilinganayo nesilawulwa ngentando yesininzi.

src: Kabinete e mema maAforika Borwa ho tshwaela ka Lewa la Naha la Tshebetso ho lwantsha Bosemorabe, Kgethollo ya Morabe, Lehloyo la Melata le Ho hloka Mamellano bakeng sa (2016-2021) pele ho la 30 Phuptjane 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bahlomle kwisiCwangciso sokuSebenza seSizwe sokulwa ubuHlanga, uCalucalulo ngokobuHlanga, iNtiyo yabaSuka kuMazwe angaPhandle kunye neminye imiKhuba yokungaNyamezelani (sowama-2016-2021) phambi komhla wama-30 kweyeSilimela yowama-2016.

src: Moralo o fana ka motheo bakeng sa leano la setjhaba kgahlanong le kgethollo ka morabe o tla thusa ka ho fana ka kgahlamelo ho boitlamo ba rona ba matjhaba ba ditokelo tsa botho.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso sibonelela ngesiseko somgaqo-nkqubo kawonkewonke wokulwa nocalucalulo ngokobuhlanga okuza kunceda ukunika impembelelo kwisibophelelo sethu samalungelo oluntu ezizwe-ngezizwe.

src: Puisano ya Russia-Africa e Kgahlanong le Dithethefatsi Durban ho tloha ka la 8 ho isa ka la 9 Hlakubele 2016 e fana ka lepatlelo ho matlafatsa Moralo o ka Sehloohong wa Naha wa Dithethefatsi (2013-2017).Ntwa kgahlanong le dithethefatsi tse seng molaong e tsamaelana le Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP) mme dipuisano di tlasa tataiso ya AU ho tsitlallela boitlamo ho ya kaDitumellano tsa UN tsa Botlokotsebe bo Hlophisitsweng ba Dithethefatsi ho Phatlalla le Dinaha, Moralo wa AU wa Tshebetso hodima Taolo ya Dithethefatsi (2013-2017) le ditumellano tsa BRICS (Brazil, Russia, India, China le Aforika Borwa).Khonferense ena e latelang ho dula ha Puisano ya Russia-Africa e Kgahlanong le Dithethefatsi, eo morero wa yona e leng ho fana ka boemo bo matlafaditsweng ba kamoo baetapele ba lefatshe ba ikemiseditseng ho sebetsana le bothata ba matjhaba ba dithethefatsi.
tgt: INgqungquthela ye-Russia ne-Afrika yokuLwa neziYobisi kwi-ICC yaseDurban ukususela ngomhla we-8 ukuya kowe-9 kweyoKwindla yowama-2016 lubonelela ngeqonga lokuqinisa isiCwangciso esiyiNtloko seziYobisi seSizwe (sowama-2013-2017).Umlo wokulwa iziyobisi ezingekho mthethweni uyahambelana neSicwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe kwaye le ngqungquthela iphantsi kwemiqondiso emihle ye-AU ukusebenzela isibophelelo ngokwemimiselo efanelekileyo ye-UN yeziVumelwano zoLwaphulo-mthetho oluHleliweyo Phakathi kwaMazwe amaBini neziYobisi, isiCwangciso soMsebenzi se-AU (2013-2017 nezindululo zamazwe e-BRICS (i-Brazil, Russia, India, China noMzantsi Afrika).

src: Sena se tla tekwa ho Tulo e Ikgethang ya Kopano ya Kakaretso ya UN ka Mmesa 2016.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ilandela iNgqungqthela ye-Russia ne-Afrika yokuLwa iziYobisi, eligxile ekubonakaliseni imo edibeneyo yokuba iinkokheli zehlabathi zizimisele kangakanani ukuqubisana neengxaki yeziyobisi phakathi kwezizwe ngezizwe.

src: Mmuso – ka bomphato le Bongodi ba Mokgatlo wa Moruo o Tshwanang, Yunivesithi ya Aforika Borwa (UNISA) le Lekala la Naha la Ntshetsopele ya Batjha – o tshwara Khonferense ya bo-2 ya Mokgatlo wa Moruo o Tshwanang e mabapi le Mosebetsi wa Batjha khemphaseng ya UNISA Pretoria ho tloha ka la 8 ho isa ka la10 Hlakubele 2016.Khonferense e tshwarwa tlasa mookotaba: “Re kenyeletsa Batho ba Batjha ho Kaho ya Setjhaba: Karolo ya Mosebeletsi wa Batjha” mme e tla hlahloba botjha karolo ya mosebetsi wa basebeletsi ba batjha le dirutehi bakeng sa ho kenyeletsa batho ba batjha ntshetsopeleng ya dinaha tsa bona.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso siza kuthiwe thaca kwiNdibano eNkulu eKhethekileyo ye-UN kwekaTshazimpunzi yowama-2016.

src: Maemo a Kabinete Mabapi le Dintlha tsa Bohlokwa Maemong a Hajwale.
tgt: Urhulumente – ngokusebenzisana ne-ofisi kaNobhala wamaZwe aye ngamaThanga, iDyunivesithi yaseMzantsi Afrika (i-UNISA) ne-Arhente yoPhuhliso loLutsha yeSizwe – uza kusingatha iNgqungquthela yesibini2 yamaZwe ayesakuba ngamaThanga ngoMsebenzi woLutsha kwikhampasi yase-UNISA ePitoli ukususela ngomhla- we-8 ukuya kowe-10 kweyoKwindla yowama-2016.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa molaetsa wa Moporesidente Zuma mabapi le tlhokeho ya ho hlompha dikaho le ditsamaiso tse bopilweng ho ya ka Molaotheo wa Riphaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa 1996 le molao.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela iqhubeka phantsi komxholo othi: “Bandakanya uLutsha eKwakheni iSizwe: iNdima yabaSebenzi abaluLutsha” nokuphinda kuhlolwe indima yamagcisa alulutsha olusebenzayo nabahlohli bamaziko emfundo ephakamileyo ekubandakanyeni ulutsha kuphuhliso lwamazwe walo.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o sebetsana le taba ya Mokhomishenara wa Tshebeletso ya Lekgetho ya Aforika Borwa le Letona la Ditjhelete ka metjha e nepahetseng ka ho sebedisa dipehelo tse nepahetseng tsa semolao.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izeka mzekweni kumyalezo kaMongameli uZuma ngokudingeka kokuhlonitshwa kwamaziko neenkqubo ezidalwe ngokwemimiselo yomgaqo-siseko weRhiphabliki yoMzantsi Afrika yowe-1996 nomthetho.

src: Moporesidente o hlophisa mekgwa ya ho sebetsana le mabaka ana ka boikarabelo le ka kutlwano molemong wa bohle.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uyasebenza ngemeko yoMkhomishinala weZiko loMzantsi Afrika leeNkonzo yezeRhafu yaseMzantsi Afrika noMphathiswa wezeMali ngokulandela iindlela ezifanelekileyo esebenzisa izikhokelo ezifanelekileyo zezomthetho.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho bohle ba nang le thahasello ho theola moya le ho itshwara, mme ba fane ka sebaka sa hore mabaka a rarollwe ka ho sebedisa metjha e nepahetseng.
tgt: UMongameli umisele iinkqubo zokuhlangabezana nalo mba ngokufanelekileyo nangoxolo ukwenzela uncedo lwethu sonke.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho ingodisa bakeng sa Dikgetho tsa Mebuso ya Lehae tsa 2016 ka la 5 le la 6 Hlakubele 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza onke amaqela achaphazelekayo ukuba azole azibambe, aze anikeze ithuba lokuba lo mba usonjululwe ngokusebenzisa iindlela ezifanelekileyo.

src: Ho fapana le dikgetho tsa naha, dikgetho tsa mebuso ya lehae di batla hore o ingodise ka hara wate eo o dulang ho yona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba babhalisele uNyulo looRhulumente baseKhaya lowama-2016 ngomhla we-5 nowe-6 kweyoKwindla yowama-2016.

src: Ho bohlokwa ho ba le Tokomane ya Boitsebiso (ID) – ka bobedi ID e tala e nang le bakhoutu le Karata ya Boitsebiso ditla amohelwa – mme bakeng sa ho hlahloba maemo a boingodiso ba hao, nomoro ya wate le moo seteishene sa ho kgetha se leng teng.
tgt: Unyulo loorhumente basekhaya, alufani nolwesizwe kuba koloorhulumente basekhaya kufanele ubhalise kwiwadi ohlala kuyo.

src: Dikantoro kaofela tsa Merero ya Lehae di tla bulwa ho tloha ka 08:00 ho ya ho 17:00 ka la 5 le la 6 Hlakubele 2016, e leng se tsamaelanang le dinako tsa tshebetso tsa Khomishene e Ikemetseng ya Dikgetho (IEC) matsatsing ao a mabedi.
tgt: Kubalulekile ukuba ube neNcwadi yeSazisi (i-ID) – ziza kwamkeleka zombini i-ID eluhlaza enebhakhodi kunye neKhadi-Sazisi – nokukhangela isimo sokuba ubhalisile na, iinombolo yewadi kunye nokuba simi phi isikhululo sakho sokuvota.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho batjha bohle le ba qalang ho vouta ho ingodisetsa dikgetho.
tgt: Zonke ii-ofisi zeSebe lemiCimbi yezeKhaya ziza kuba zivuliwe ukususela ngentsimbi ye-08:00 ukuya kweye-17:00 ngomhla we-5 nowe-6 kweyoKwindla yowama-2016, oku kuhambelana kunye namaxesha okusebenza eKhomishini yoNyulo eziMeleyo kwezi ntsuku zimbini.

src: Ka ho lahlela voutu ya hao o tla be o nkile mohato wa hore lentswe la hao le utlwahale diqetong tse amang wena le motse wa heno.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza lonke ulutsha kunye nabo baza kuqala ukuvota ukuba babhalisele ukuvota.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe boipelaetso bo tletseng merusu ba baithuti, bo sitisitseng dithuto diyunivesithing tse ding le ho lebisa tshenyong ya thepa.
tgt: Ngokuvota kwakho uthathe inyathelo elibhekisele ekubeni ilizwi lakho livakale ekuthathweni kwezigqibo ezikuchaphazelayo nendawo ohlala kuyo.

src: Boipelaetso bona bo tima baithuti ba tshwanelehang monyetla wa ho ntshetsa dithuto tsa bona pele le ho ama tokelo ya bona ya thuto e phahameng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalugxeka uqhankqalazo olunobundlobongela lwabafundi, noluthe lwaphazamisa izifundo kwezinye iidyunivesithi laze lakhokelela ekutshatyalalisweni kwezakhiwo nempahla.

src: Mmuso o butse metjha ya dikgokahanyo le bankakarolo bohle ba thuto e phahameng bakeng sa ditherisano le dipuisano.
tgt: Aba baqhankqalazi bathintela abafundi abanelungelo ilungelo lokuqhuba ngezifundo zabo kwaye oko kunempembelelo engekho ntle kwilungelo labo lokufumana imfundo ephakamileyo.

src: Sena se bakile hore ho be le ho busetsa dintho madulong le ho hodisa momahano ya kahisano ka hara diyunivesithi tsa rona tse batlang ditharollo tsa diphephetso tsa nako e mahareng le nako e telele tse amanang le diphethoho ho lekala lena jwaloka ha ho hlalositswe ho ditumellano tsa Seboka sa Diphethoho tsa Thuto e Phahameng tsa 2015.Kabinete e tshehetsa mekutu ya makala a ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha molao ho netefatsa hore tlwaelo ya ho ithuta e busetswa madulong, mme thepa le ditokelo tsa motho ka bo mong di a tshireletswa.
tgt: Urhulumente uvulele bonke abadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo kwezemfundo ephakamileyo iinkqubo zonxibelelwano ukwenzela iingxoxo nothethathethwano.

src: Tshebediso ya molao ke sa bohlokwa mme e lokelwa ho hlomphuwa ka dinako tsohle.
tgt: Oko kukhokelele ekubuyeleni kwisiqhelo nokukhuthazwa kwentalo-ntle kwiidyunivesithi zethu ezifuna ukufumana isisombululo kwimingeni yexesha eliphakathi ukuya kweyelide edibene nokudalwa kwenguqu kwelicandelo njengoko ichazwe kwizindululo zeMbizo yeNguqu kwezeMfundo ePhakamileyo yowama-2015.

src: Botsitso le kgutso di lokela ho kgutlela ka hara diyunivesithi tsa rona hore mananeo a dithuto a tswelepele ha diphephetso tsa nako e mahareng le ho isa ho nako e telele di ntse di sekasekwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawaxhasa amalinge awenziwe zi-arhente zogcino-mthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuba isithethe sokufunda sibuyiselwe, kunye nokukhuselwa kwempahla nesakhiwo namalungelo womntu ngamnye.

src: Re lokela ho tshireletsa kgatelopele eo le ho dumella hore molao o busetswe le ho baballwa diyunivesithing tsa rona kaofela.
tgt: Ukulawula komthetho kubaluleke kakhulu kwaye kufanele kuhlonitshwe ngamaxesha onke.

src: Kabinete hape e ipiletsa ho bankakarolo bohle ho sebetsa mmoho hore diyunivesithi tsa rona e be ketapele ya dipuisano tse kenyeletsang le ya diphethoho.
tgt: Ukubuyela esiqhelweni nenzolo kwiidyunivesithi kuyafuneka ukuze iinkqubo zezemfundo zikwazi ukuqhubeka ngeli xesha imingeni yexesha eliphakathi nelide kusazanywana nayo.

src: Kabinete e lemoha ho kopanngwa ha ditshebetso tse tharo tsa difeme tsa dinomaphodi tsa Khamphani ya Coca Cola ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabancoma abafundi abathe bema kunye bemanyene ukulwa ubuhlanga kunye nokulwa abo bazidla ngokuba nobuhlanga ngokugqithisileyo bechasa abamhlophe, oku kube ngumzekelo wokuba singasebenzisana sisonke ukwakha kwinkqubela neenzuzo ezenzwe kwicandelo lezemfundo ephakamileyo ukulungiselela lo nyaka wemfundo sikuwo.

src: Kabinete e lemohile hore taba ena e tla tshohlwa ka pele ho Lekgotla la Diphehisano.
tgt: Kufuneka siyikhusele le nkqubela size sivumele ukubuya kocwangco nokululondoloza kuzo zonke iidyunivesithi zethu.

src: Kabinete e hlahisa ngongoreho ya yona ka tahlehelo ya mesebetsi e lohothwang le phokotso ya kgiro ditumellanong tsa ho kopanngwa ha dikhamphani.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo ukuba basebenzisane ukuze iidyunivesithi zethu zibe ziinkokheli zomsebenzi oquka konke nenguqu.

src: Ka lebaka la maemo a hodimo a tlhokeho ya mesebetsi, Kabinete e ipiletsa ho dikhamphani ho netefatsa hore ha ho mesebetsi e lahlehang le hore maemo a palohare ya kgiro a ya baballwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukucetywa kokudibanisa iinkampani ezintathu ezenza iibhotile ukwenzela iNkampani ye-Coca Cola eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Moambasatara wa Aforika Borwa ho Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Kgwebo (WTO), Monghadi Xavier Carim, ya kgethilweng ho ba Modulasetulo wa Lekala la Ditharollo tsa Dikgohlano la Lekgotla la Kakaretso la WTLekgotla la Kakaretso ke lekala le phahameng ka ho fetisisa le nkang diqeto la WTO pakeng tsa Khonferense ya Matona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphele ukuba lo mba uza kuxoxwa kwiNkundla yoKhuphiswano.

src: Thonyo ya Moambasatara Carim ke karolo ya kananelo ya karolo ya bohlokwa eo Aforika Borwa e e bapalang ka hara WTO mme ka ho le leng ke bopaki ba bokgoni ba mosebetsi o kgabane wa Moambasatara Carim.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa ukuxhalaba kwayo ngokulahleka kwemisebenzi okucetywayo nokuncitshiswa komsebenzi kwiintengiselwano zokudityaniswa kwazo.

src: Kabinete e lemohile tsebiso ya PLC ya Barclays mabapi le maikemisetso a yona a ho fokotsa 62.3% tsa diabo ho Barclay Africa Group Limited (BAGL) nakong ya dilemo tse pedi ho isa ho tse tharo tse tlang.
tgt: Ngenxa yezinga eliphezulu lentswela-ngqesho, iKhabhinethi ibongoza ezi nkampani ukuba ziqiniseke ukuba akukho kulahleka kwemisebenzi kwaye kuze kugcinwe izinga eliphakathi lengqesho.

src: Barclays PLC, haholoholo Mohlanka e Moholo wa Phethahatso (CEO), e buisane ka bobedi le Lefapha la Naha la Matlotlo le Banka ya Risefe ya Aforika Borwa kopanong e bulehileng, mme re ananela boitlamo ba khamphani ba ho kenya tshebetsong lewa la yona le letjha ka tsela eo le tla fokotsa kgahlamelo ho meruo eo BAGL e sebetsang ka hara yona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana noNozakuzaku waseMzantsi Afrika kuMbutho woRhwebo weHlabathi (i-WTO), uMnu Xavier Carim, othe wonyulwa ukuba abe ngusihlalo weBhodi yokuLamla iMbambano yeBhunga Jikelele le-WTIBhunga Jikelele yeyona bhodi iphezulu ye-WTO yokuthatha izigqibo phakathi kweNgqungquthela yobuPhathiswa.

src: Banka ya Risefe ya Aforika Borwa e tla sebetsa le Barclays PLC le BAGL ho netefatsa hore dikotsi dife kapa dife tse ka nnang tsa hlaha ho tswa ho tumellano ena di a fokotswa mme mekgwa e nepahetseng e tla nkuwa bakeng sa ho laola phallo ya ditjhelete le thepa tse tla bakwa ke tumellano ena.
tgt: Ukuchongwa kukaNozakuzaku uCarim uyinxalenye yobungqina bokubaluleka kwendima edlalwa nguMzantsi Afrika kwi-WTO kwaye iyinxalenye yobungqina beempawu zikaNozakuzaku uCarim.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa ba kenetseng makgaolakgang le bahlodi ba Dikgau tsa Naha tsa Botitjhere tse etsahetseng ka la 27 Hlakola 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isiqaphele isibhengezo seBarclays PLC sokuba nenjongo zokunciphisa ubunini-zabelo bayo zingama-62.3%i kwi-Barclays Africa Group Limited (i-BAGL) kule minyaka mibini ukuya kwemithathu ezayo.

src: Matitjhere ana a itetseng a ntshetsa naha ya rona pele ka ho netefatsa hore diphaposi tsa ona tsa borutelo di hlahisa baithuti ba kgothetseng ba tla nyehela ntshetsopeleng ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: I-Baclays PLC, ngokukodwa iGosa eliyiNtloko yesiGqeba (i-CEO), lithetha kunye nabo bobabini uNdyebo weSizwe kunye ngeBhanka enguVimba kothethathethwano olungafihlekelanga, kwaye siyakkwamkela ukuzinikela kwale nkampani ukuba iphumeze isicwangciso-qhinga sayo esitsha ngendlela eza kunciphisa impembelelo kuqoqosho apho iBAGL isebenza khona.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Market Theatre ka hara Johannesburg bakeng sa ho keteka selemo sa yona sa bo- 40th e le teng.
tgt: IBhanka enguVimba iza kusebenza neBarclays PLC ne-BAGL ukuqinisekisa ukuba nayiphi na imingcipheko ekwintengiselwano iyathityazwa kuze kuthathwe amanyathelo afanelekileyo ukulawula ukungena nokuphuma kwemali kule ntengiselwano.

src: Nakong ya mmuso wa kgethollo theathara ena e ile ya ba letshwao la Boitseko ka ho bolela pale ya nnete ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibothulela umnqwazi bonke abo bafikelele kumagqibela kankqoyi nabo bathe baphumelela iMbasa yokuFundisa yeSizwe.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa titjhere ya mmino, Monghadi Chad Hendricks, ho tswa Retreat ho la Cape Flats bakeng sa ho hapa Phehisano ya Maemo ya Batsamaisi ba Dikhwaere ya Len van Zyl Motse Kapa.
tgt: Aba titshala bakhutheleyo baliqhubela phambili ilizwe lethu ngokuqinisekisa ukuba amagumbi wabo okufundela avelisa abafundi abakhuthazekileyo abazokwenza igalelo ekuphuhliseni uMzantsi Afrika.

src: Moputso wa hae o kenyeletsa ho ya ithuta bakeng sa dikgwedi tse tharo ho la Amerika mme nakong eo Monghadi Hendricks o tla ithuta ho Philadelphia Orchestra mme o tla rupellwa ke Moporofesara ya tsebahalang Victor Yampolsky ho la Chicago.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana neMarket Theatre eRhawutini ngokubhiyozela iminyaka engama-40 ikho.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa mohlahisi wa difilimi, Monghadi Anant Singh, bakeng sa ho putswa ka maemo a boraro bakeng sa filimi ya Shepherds and Butchers Ho Dikgau tsa Babohi tsa Panorama bakeng sa Fiction Film ho Mokete wa Matjhaba wa Difilimi wa Berlin.
tgt: Ngexesha lucalucalulo iMarket Theatre yaba luphawu lomzabalazo ngokubalisa ibali loMzantsi Afrika eliyinyaniso.

src: Sena ke phihlello e kgolo kaha filimi eo e ne e phehisana le difilimi tse ding tse 51 ho tswa dinaheng tse DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di tla lokelwa ke ho netefatswa ha mangolo a thuto le tumellano e amehang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana nootitshala womculo, uMnu Chad Hendricks, wase-Retreat kwi-Cape Flats ngokuphumelela uKhuphiswano lwabaCulisi oludumileyo i-Len van Zyl eKapa.

src: Katoloso ya konteraka bakeng sa Monghadi Lionel October jwaloka Molaodikakaretso (DG) ho Lefapha la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri, bakeng sa nako ya dilemo tse hlano.
tgt: Ibhaso lakhe liquka imali yokufunda yeenyanga ezintathu e-United States apho aza kufunda khona kwiPhiladelphia Orchestra aze aqeqeshwe ngodumileyo uNjingalwazi uVictor Yampolsky eChicago.

src: Thonyo ya Ngaka Mantlhake J Maboya jwaloka Motlatsi wa Molaodikakaretso (DDG): Leano la Kharikholamo le Bodisa ho Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana nomvelisi wemidlalo-bhanyabhanya, uMnu Anant Singh, ngokufumana iwonga elikwindawo yesithathu ngomdlalo-bhanyabhanya i-uShepherds and Butchers kumsitho wokuWongwa ngabaBukeli wasePanorama woMdlalo Bhanyabhanya obuNtsomi kuMbiyozo woMdlalo Bhanyabhanya weSizwe-ngezizwe waseBerlin.

src: Thonyo ya Mofumahadi Shamilla Chettiar jwaloka DDG: Ditshebeletso tsa Leano le Tsebo ho Lefapha la Bohahlaudi.
tgt: Le yeyona mpumelelo inkulu njengoko lo mdlalo bhanyabhanya ubukhuphisana nemidlalo bhanyabhanya ingama-51 ebonisiweyo enobude bayo evela kumazwe angama-.

src: Thonyo ya Monghadi MbuleloTshangana jwaloka DG ho Lefapha la Bodulo ba Batho.
tgt: IzikhundlaZonke izikhundla zixhomekeke ekuqinisekisweni kwamabakala ezemfundo kunye nokuqinisekiswa okufanelekileyo kwezokhuselo.

src: Ho thonngwa hape ha Monghadi Kutoane Obed Kutoane jwaloka Mohlanka e Moholo wa Phethahatso (CEO) wa Koporasi ya Inshorense ya Mekitlane ya Thepa e Rekiswang ka Ntle ya SOC ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Ukwandiswa kwesivumelwano sengqesho sikaMnu Lionel October njengoMlawuli-Jikelele (u-DG) kwiSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino, isithuba sexesha leminyaka emihlanu.

src: Thonyo ya Monghadi Vuyo Mafata jwaloka Mokomishenara wa Ditlhapiso: Letlole la Ditlhapiso ho Lefapha la Mesebetsi.
tgt: Ukuqeshwa kukaGq Mantlhake Mboya njengoSekela-Mlawuli-Jikelele: Umgaqo-nkqubo weKharityhulam noHlolo kwiSebe leMfundo esiSiseko.

src: Diqeto tsa bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Izigqibo ezingundoqo zeKhabhinethi.

src: Kabinete e lekotse Ditlaleho tsa Diphetho tsa Kgatelopele ya Kotara ya Boraro bakeng sa nako ya Phato ho isa ho Tshitwe 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlole iiNgxelo zeNkqubela yeziPhumo zeKota yesiThathu ukususela kweyeDwarha kuye kweyoMnga ngowama-2015.

src: Ditlaleho di bontsha kgatelopele ya bohlokwa mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha mananeo a mmuso a nang le kgahlamelo e otlolohileng hodima ntlafatso ya bophelo ba maAforika Borwa.
tgt: Ezi ngxelo zibonakalisa inkqubela ethe vetshe ekusebenziseni iinkqubo zikarhulumente ezinefuthe elingqalileyo ekuphuculeni ubomi babemi boMzantsi Afrika.

src: Ditlaleho tsa Diphetho tsa Kgatelopele di fana ka bopaki ba hore mmuso o entse kgatelopele mabapi le ho fihlella maikemisetso a behilweng ho Moralo wa Lewa la Nako e Bohareng wa 2014-2019.
tgt: Ezi Ngxelo zibubungqina bokuba urhulumente kukho inkqubela ayenzileyo ekuphumeleliseni izinto emakufikelelwe kuzo ngokwesiCwangciso-sikhokelo esibubuChule sesiGaba esiPhakathi sowama-2014-2019.

src: Hape di re atametsa ho fihlelleng Tjhebelopele ya 2030, jwaloka ha e lohothwa ho Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP), o morero wa lona e leng ho mekamekana le bofuma, tlhokeho ya mesebetsi le ho se lekalekane.
tgt: Zikwasisondeza ekufezekeni koMbono wama-2030, njengoko uthiwe thaca sisiCwangciso soPhuhliso lweSizwe, nonjongo wawo ikukuhlasela indlala, intswela-ngqesho nokungalingani.

src: Kabinete e lemohile kgatelopele e kgahlang e entsweng bakeng sa ho fihlella maikemisetso a bohlokwa le diphetho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele inkqubela ebonakalayo eyenziweyo ukuphumelelisa izinto ezingundoqo emakufikelelwe kuzo kwakunye neziqhamo.

src: Kabinete e lemohile hore ha kgatelopele ya bohlokwa e entswe mabapi le boholo ba ditshupane, ho ntse ho na le dibaka tse hlokang boitshunyako bo hokahanetsweng ke mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele into yokuba noxa kukho inkqubela ebonakalayo eyenzekileyo malunga nenkoliso yezinto ezalatha oko, kusekho imiba efuna ukungenelela kukarhulumente ngokulungeleleneyo.

src: Ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha mananeo a bohlokwa a mmuso.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo ezingundoqo zikarhulumente.

src: Kabinete e hlahisitse diteboho tsa yona ho maAforika Borwa kaofela a arabetseng boipiletšo bja Khomishene e Ikemetseng ya Dikgetho (IEC) ya hore batho ba ingodise, ba hlahlobe boemo ba boingodiso ba bona le ho lokisa dintlha tsa bona lenaneng la bakgethi mafelong a beke ya la 5 le 6 Hlakubele 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise umbulelo wayo kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika abalisabeleyo ikhwelo elenziwe yiKhomishini yoNyulo eZimeleyo (i-IEC) lokuba abantu babhalise, bajonge imeko yabo malunga nobhaliso kwaye bahlaziye iinkcukacha zabo ezikumqulu wabavoti.

src: Mafelo a beke a ho qetela a boingodiso a tla ba ka la 9 le 10 Mmesa 2016 ha diteishene tsohle tsa ho vouta di tla bulwa hape ho tloha ka 8:00 ho isa ka 17:00.
tgt: Loo nto yenzeke ngempelaveki yomhla we-5 nowe- 6 kweyoKwindla ngowama- 2016.

src: Sena e tla be e le monyetla wa ho qetela wa bakgethi wa ho ingodisa le ho lokisa boemo ba bona ba boingodiso diteisheneng tsa bona tsa ho vouta.
tgt: Abantu ababalelwa kwizigidi ezithathu baya kwiindawo ekubhaliselwa uvoto kuzo kulo lonke eli, kwaye abangama- 544 552 kwabo ibingabhalisa okokuqala (i-78.6%) kwaye beneminya yobudala engaphantsi kwengama-30.

src: Leha ho le jwalo, boingodiso bo ntse bo tswela pele dikantorong tsa lehae tsa IEC nakong ya dihora tsa tshebetso ho tloha Mantaha ho isa ka Labohlano, ho fihlela lenane la bakgethi le kwalwa bakeng sa Dikgetho tsa Bomasepala bakeng sa 2016 ka letsatsi leo ka lona ho tla beng ho phatlalatswa letsatsi la dikgetho.
tgt: Loo nto ibonisa ukuzimisela kwabemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuthatha inxaxheba ekwakheni ulawulo lwethu lwentando yesininzi.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe merusu dibakeng tse ding e sitisitseng mafelo a beke a boingodiso haufinyana tjena le ho boeletsa hore ha ho motho ya ka thibelang moAforika Borwa ofe kapa ofe bakeng sa ho sebedisa tokelo ya hae ya demokerasi ya ho ingodisetsa ho vouta.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba balixhamle ilungelo labo lomgaqo-siseko ngokuthi babhalise, kwaye icela abo ababhalisa kwixesha elidluleyo ukuba baqinisekise iinkcukacha zabo zobhaliso njengoko kubekho izinto ezininzi ezikhokhelele ekutshintsheni komqulu wabavoti.

src: Kabinete e boela e ipiletsa ho ba ikarabelang ho tlohela ho etsa diketso tse jwalo tsa botlokotsebe mme ba anngweng ke taba ena ba ba tlalehe makaleng a tiisetso ya molao.
tgt: Impelaveki yokugqibela yobhaliso iza kuba ngomhla we-9 ukuya kowe-10 kuTshazimpunzi ngowama-2016.

src: Mopresidente Jacob Zuma o tla etela Port Elizabeth ka la 8 Mmesa 2016 ho hlahloba kgatelopele e entsweng mabapi le ho ntshetsapele meralo ya motheo ya dipalangwang tsa mawatleng jwalo ka boikitlaetso ba naha ba Moruo wa Mawatleng.
tgt: Phofu, ubhaliso yinto esoloko iqhubeka kuzo zonke ii-ofisi ze-IEC ngamaxesha omsebenzi ukususela ngoMvulo kude kube ngoLwesihlanu, de umqulu wabavoti woNyulo looMasipala wama-2016 uvalwe mhla unyulo lwaziswayo ngokusemthethweni.

src: Moruo wa Mawatleng ke o mong wa metjha e meraro ya Operation Phakisa mme o atametsa naha haufi le ho bula bokgoni ba mawatle a Aforika Borwa, a nang le bokgoni ba ho nyehela se ka fihlang ho R177 bilione ho Tlhahiso Kakaretso ya Lehae (GDP) le ho hlahisa mesebetsi e metjha e fetang milione o le mong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalugxeka udushe kwiingingqi ezithile noluthe lagxobhagxobha impelaveki yobhaliso esandul’ukubakho.

src: Kabinete e ananela qeto e atlehileng ya Leeto la semmuso la Moporesidente Zuma Riphaboliking ya Bofederale ya Nigeria ho tloha ka la 8 ho is aka la 9 Hlakubele 2016, le matlafaditseng dikamano tse ntseng di le teng tsa bobedi bona tsa sepolotiki, moruo le kahisano.
tgt: Iyaphinda iyayithetha into yokuba akukho mntu omele ukuthintela nawuphi na ummi woMzantsi Afrika ukuba alixhamle ilungelo lakhe elibhalwe lacaca kuMgaqo-siseko lokubhalisela uvoto.

src: O mong wa mekolokotwane wa leeto lena e bile ho phahamiswa ha Khomishene ya Dinaha tse pedi ho ya ho boemo ba Hlooho ya Puso, e leng se behang ka sehloohong ntshetsopele ya moruo pakeng tsa dinaha tse pedi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamemelela bonke abenza loo nto ukuba bahlukane nezenzo zolwaphulo-mthetho ezinjengezo.

src: Kabinete e shebile ka tebello ho eketseha ha palo ya matsete a Nigeria ka hara Aforika Borwa a tla kgothaletsa kgwebisano ya metjha e mmedi pakeng tsa dinaha tsena tse pedi.
tgt: Uza kuhlola inkqubela eyenziweyo ekuphuhliseni iziseko zothutho zaselwandle njengenxalenye yelinge lesizwe mayelana noQoqosho lwaseLwandle.

src: Diphetho tsa dipuisano pakeng tsa meruo e mmedi e meholo ka ho fetisisa ka hara kontinente di tla kopanya meruo ya lebatowa, kahoo e tla be e eketsa mmaraka o tshwanang le ho phahamisa boikitlaetso bo teng bakeng sa kgolo ya moruo le kgiro ka hara Aforika.
tgt: Olu qoqosho lolunye lwamacandelo amathathu e-Operation Phakisa kwaye lusondeza ilizwe eli ekuboniseni amandla eelwandlekazi zoMzantsi Afrika.

src: Sena se bontsha hore Aforika Borwa e dula e le sebaka sa phehisano ya matsete ho sa natswe maemo a tsietsing a moruo wa lefatshe, se tla baka menyetla ya mesebetsi le ntshetsopele ya maitsebelo bakeng sa maAforika Borwa.
tgt: Loo nto inganegalelo lemali engafikelela kwiibhiliyoni zeerandi ezili-177 kwimveliso yasekhaya iyonke, nto leyo enokudala imisebenzi emitsha engaphaya kwesigidi.

src: Kabinete e ananetse hore Aforika Borwa e tla nka karolo ho Tulo ya bo-60 ya Khomishene ya Maemo a Basadi (CSW60) ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) e tla etsahala New York, ho la Amerika ho tloha ka la 14 ho isa ka la 24 Hlakubele 2016 tlasa mookotaba: “Matlafatso ya basadi le ho amana ha yona le ntshetsopele ya moshwelella”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkela utyelelo olube yimpumelelo lwaseBurhulumenteni lukaMongameli Zuma kwiFederal Republic of Nigeria ukususela kumhla we-8 ukuya kowe- 9 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016.

src: Tulo ena e etsahala ka selemo sa bohlokwa bakeng sa Aforika Borwa kaha e tshwaya mekolokotwane e meraro ya bohlokwa, e leng Sehopotso sa bo-20 sa Molaotheo wa Riphaboliki ya Aforika Borwa ya 1996, Sehopotso sa bo-40 sa Merusu ya Batjha ba Soweto le Sehopotso sa bo-60th sa mohwanto wa basadi wa 1956.Aforika Borwa e hlahisitse tlaleho ho UN CSW60 mme sena se re neha monyetla wa ho metha kgatelopele eo re e entseng esale ho tloha ka ho thwasa ha demokerasi.
tgt: Olo tyelelo lwaqinisa amakhonco akhoyo kula mazwe mabini kwezopolitiko, ezoqoqosho nezasentlalweni.

src: Ho bohlokwa ho lemoha hore esale ho tloha ka tsamaiso ya demokerasi ya Aforika Borwa, hara tse ding, e nkile karolo ho Khonferense ya Lefatshe ya Basadi ya bo-40 ka 1995, le ho saena Tumellano ya Beijing le Lepatlelo la Tshebetso selemong sona seo.
tgt: Elinye leziganeko ezibalulekileyo zolo tyelelo yaba kukunyuselwa kwesiVumelwano seNtsebenziswano saMazwe amaBini iye kwinqanaba leNtloko yoMbuso, nto leyo ebeka phambili ukuphuhliswa koqoqosho kula mazwe mabini.

src: Ho imatahantswe le qeto ya E/RES/2013/18 ya Lekgotla la Moruo le Kahisano la UN, Aforika Borwa e itlamme ho kenya tshebetsong Tumellano ya Beijing le Lepatlelo la Tshebetso, e leng moralo wa matlafatso ya basadi le ntshetsopele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuvuleleka koqoqosho lwaseNigeria kwiinkampani zaseMzantsi Afrika kumacandelo anjengobunjineli, eleziseko ezingundo zonxibelelwano, elezokwakha, elobuchule bokuhamba ngeenqwelo-moya, amajelo eendaba, ukubuka nokutenda iindwendwe, imiba yebhanki, ulonwabo, imihlaba nezindlu, intengiso kunye neenkonzo zokuphonononga nokuzingela i-oli negesi.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa ha Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Dibopeho tsa Bomasepala tsa Mebuso ya Lehae 2016 ho Palamente.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ijonge ukunyuka kwenani lotyalo-mali lweNigeria eMzantsi Afrika, nto leyo eza kukhuthaza urhwebo phakathi kwezi zizwe zimbini.

src: Dihlomathiso di a etswa ho Mebuso ya Lehae: Molao wa Dibopeho tsa Bomasepala, wa 1998 (Molao 117 wa 1998), o kentsweng tshebetsong pele ho dikgetho tsa pele tsa mebuso ya lehae tsa demokerasi tse etsahetseng ka la 5 Tshitwe 2000.Dihlomathiso di tla ntlafatsa tsamaiso ya dikgetho tsa mebuso ya lehae mme hara diphethoho tse ding, di rerile ho:a) hlomathisa maemo a bomasepala ba Mokgahlelo Ab) tlosa ditshupiso ho dibaka tsa bolaodi ba diterekec) hlakisa letsatsi la ho qala mosebetsing ha mokhanselarad) ho tiisetsa hore Moporesidente o tshwanela ho beha le ho phatlalatsa letsatsi la dikgetho tsa bomasepalae) dumella bakeng sa katoloso ho phatlalatso ya sephetho sa dikgethof) hloka hore motsamaisi wa masepala a tsebise IEC ka dikgeo tsa mosebetsi watengg) tiisetsa hore Setho sa Lekgotla la Phethahatso se phatlalatsa le ho beha letsatsi la dikgetho tsa tlatsetsoh) hlakisa ditlhoko tsa khoramo bakeng sa kopano ya lekgotlai) hlakisa maemo a ho vouta a mokhanselara ya tshwereng marapo nakong ya kopano ya lekgotlaj) eketsa phapang ya palo ya bakgethi wateng ka nngwe nakong ya kopano ya lekgotla lek) eketsa phapang ya palo ya bakgethi wateng ka nngwe nakong ya tsheho ya meedi ho hlakisa kabo ya ditulo tse ngata ho feta tekano ka hara bomasepala.
tgt: Iziphumo zoku kusebenzisana kwala mazwe mabini analona qoqosho lungamandla kweli lizwekazi ziza kudibanisa uqoqosho lwengingqi, ngaloo ndlela zinyuse izinga labathengi nabasebenzisi-zinkonzo abafanayo namalinge akhoyo okukhulisa uqoqosho nengqesho e-Afrika.

src: Moporesidente Zuma – jwaloka modulasetulo-mmoho le Moporesidente wa Fora François Hollande wa Khomishene ya Maemo a Hodimo ya Kgiro ya Bophelo bo Botle le Kgolo ya Moruo – o tla kenela thakgolo ya semmuso Lyon, ho la Fora ka Laboraro, 23 Hlakubele 2016.
tgt: Oku kubonisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika yindawo ekunokukhutshiswana ngayo ngotyalo-mali, noxa imeko yezoqoqosho ehlabathini imaxongo.

src: Khomishene e tsepamisetsa maikutlo ho tlhokeho ya diporofeshenale tsa ditaba tsa kalafo dinaheng tsa lekeno le mahareng le le tlase.
tgt: Iziphumo zako konke oku ngamathuba omsebenzi nokuphuhliswa kwezakhono zabemi boMzantsi Afrika.

src: Bikitlaetso bona ba UN bo lebeletswe ho eketsa polokeho ya kalafo lefatsheng ka bophara le ho hodisa kgolo ya moruo e kenyeletsang, e nyehelang bakeng sa ho kenngwa ha Lenaneo la 2030 la Ntshetsopele ya Moshwelella.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele into yokuba uMzantsi Afrika uza kuthatha inxaxheba kwiSeshoni yama-60 yeKomishini yeZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) ngeMeko yabaseTyhini (i-CSW60) eNew York, eMelika, ukususela ngomhla we-14 ukuya kowama-24 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016 phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukuxhotyiswa ngezakhono kwabasetyhini kunye nendlela okunxibelelana ngayo nophuhliso oluzinzileyo”.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla nka Leeto la Puso ho etela Mmuso Borena wa Saudi Arabia ho tloha ka la 27 ho isa ka la 28 Hlakubele 2016, le tla matlafatsa dikamano tse ntseng di le teng pakeng tsa dinaha tse pedi.
tgt: Le seshoni ibanjwa ngonyaka obalulekileyo eMzantsi Afrika kuba kukho iziganeko ezithathu ezibalulekleyo ezenzekayo ezizezi: iSikhumbuzo seminyaka engama-20 yokusekwa koMgaqo-siseko weRiphabliki yoMzantsi Afrika ngowe-1996, iSikhumbuzo seminyaka engama-40 sezidube-dube ezazikhokelwa luLutsha eSoweto ngowe-1976 kunye neSikhumbuzo seminyaka engama-60 somngcelele wamanina wangowe-1956.UMzantsi Afrika wenze ingxelo kwiUN CSW60 kwaye oku kusinika ithuba lokuthelekisa inkqubela esiyenzileyo oko kuthe kwabakho ulawulo lwentando yesininzi.

src: Moporesidente o tla kenela Seboka sa bo- 4th sa Tshireletso ya Nyutleleya Washington, ho la Amerika ho tloha ka la 31 Hlakubele ho isa ka la 1 Mmesa 2016.
tgt: Kubalulekile ukuyiqaphela into yokuba oko kwathi kwabakho ulawulo lwentando yesininzi, phakathi kwezinye izinto, uMzantsi Afika wathabatha inxaxheba kwiNkomfa yeHlabathi yesi-4 yabaseTyhini ngowe-1995,waza watyikitya isiVumelwano saseBeijing kunye neQonga lokuSebenza kwangalo nyaka mnye.

src: Seboka se tla tshohla ditshoso tse ntseng di runya tsa boferekanyi ba nyutleleya le ho hlakisa mehato e ka nkuwang ke badudi ba matjhaba ho fokotsa tshebediso ya uraniamo e ntlafaditsweng ka matla, ho tshireletsa thepa e tsietsing, ho lwantsha ho mokolwa ha nyutleleya le ho sitisa, ho lemoha le ho qhaqha maiteko a boferekanyi ba nyutleleya.
tgt: Uhambisana nesindululo E/RES/2013/18 seBhunga le-UN lezoQoqosho nezeNtlalo, uMzantsi Afrika uzinikezele ekuqhubeni ukusebenza kwesiVumelwano saseBeijing kunye neQonga lokuSebenza, nto leyo engumkhombandlela wokugunyaziswa kwabasetyhini kwanenkqubela yabo.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla etella pele mekete ya Letsatsi la Ditokelo tsa Botho Lebaleng la Dipapadi la Moses Mabhida KwaZulu-Natal ka Mantaha, 21 Hlakubele 2016 tlasa mookotaba: “Aforika Borwa e kopane kgahlanong le bomorabe.” Jwaloka ha ho phatlaladitswe ho Puo ka Maemo a Setjhaba ya 2016, Letsatsi la Ditokelo tsa Botho la selemong sena le tla beha motheo wa lenaneo la nako e telele la ho aha setjhaba se hlokang bomorabe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho-sihlomelo osaYilwayo wamaCandelo kaMasipala: uRhulumente weMimandla wonyaka wama- 2016.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa oohle ho kopana kgahlanong le ho tshweleng ka mathe ha bomorabe – e ka ba ka malapeng a rona, hara metse, dikopanong tsa kahisano, mesebetsing kapa ho marangrang a dikgokahanyo tsa kahisano.
tgt: Izilungiso ziyenziwa kuMthetho wamaCandelo kaMasipala: uRhulumente weMimandla, wonyaka we-1998 (uMthetho uNombolo 117 wowe-1998), owaqalisa ukusebenza phambi konyulo lokuqala lorhulumente wemimandla kulawulo lwentando yesininzi olwalungomhla wesi-5 kweyoMnga ngowama-2000.Ezi zilungiso ziza kuphucula ulawulo lonyulo lukarhulumente wemimandla, kwaye phakathi kweenguqulelo ezikhoyo, ziza kwenza oku:a) ukulungisa imigaqo yoomasipala abakwiCandelo Ab) ukususa yonke into ebhekisa kwimimandla yolawulo lwezithilic) ukucacisa umhla wokuqalisa kokusebenza kocebad) ukumisela ukuba uMongameli abeke umhla wonyulo loomasipalae) ukuvumela ukuba lolulwe ixesha lokubhengeza iziphumo zonyulof) ukufuna ukuba umphathi kamasipala azise i-IEC ngezithuba ezikhoyo kwiiwadig) ukumisela ukuba iLungu leBhunga eliLawulayo limisele umhla wonyulo lwelungu olwenziwa phakathi kwexesha lolawulo lweBhungah) ukucacisa isininzi esifunekayo ukuze ibekho intlanganiso yebhungai) ukucacisa iimeko zokuvota koceba ochophele intlanganiso yebhungaj) ukunyusa ukutshintsha kwamanani abavoti kwiwadi nganye ngelixa lentlanganiso yebhungak) ukunyusa ukutshintsha kwamanani abavoti xa kucandwa ukuze kucaciswe ukunikwa koomasipala basekhaya izihlalo ezingaphaya.

src: Ditho tsa Phethahatso di tla ikopanya le maAforika Borwa ho parola le naha nakong ya Beke ya Imbizo ya Naha ya ho tsepamisa Maikutlo pakeng tsa la 4 le 10 Mmesa 2016, tlasa mookotaba: “Mmoho re ntshetsa Aforika Borwa pele: Hola Aforika Borwa.” Beke ena e kopana le Beke ya Kopano ya Palamente le Setjhaba le sehopotso sa Kgwedi ya Tokoloho.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma – njengobambisane isihlalo noMongameli waseFrance uFrançois Hollande, kwiKomishini ePhezulu kwezeNgqesho kwezeMpilo noHlulo loQoqosho – uza kuya ekuphehlelelweni ngokusesikweni kwale Komishini eLyon, eFrance ngoLwesithathu umhla wama-23 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa ho nka karolo ka mafolofolo diketsahalong tsena le ho buisana le baetapele ba bona ba sepolotiki.
tgt: Ikhomishini le igxile kwisidingo seengcali zezempilo kumazwe anemivuzo ephakathi nephantsi.

src: Beke ya Imbizo ya ho Tsepamisa Maikutlo e tla hlakisa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Moralo wa Dintlha tse Robong oo morero wa ona e leng ho matlafatsa kgolo ya moruo le ho hlahisa mesebetsi e batlehang e le ka nnete.
tgt: Eli linge le-UN kulindeleke ukuba linyuse ukhuseleko ngokwasempilweni elizweni liphela kwaye likhuthaze ukukhula koqoqosho okubandakanyayo, nto leyo enegalelo ekusebenzeni kweNkqubo yoPhuhliso oluZinzileyo lowama-2030.

src: Hape e tla tsebisa ka dikatleho tsa mebuso ya lehae, ho kenyeletswa le diphihlello tse unnweng ka moralo wa ho hlasimolla botjha mebuso ya lehae – katamelo ya Ha ho Kgutlelweng Temeng.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uza kutyelela ngokwasebuRhulumenteni eSaudi Arabia ukususela ngomhla wama-27 ukuya kowama-28 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016, tyelelo olo oluza kuqinisa ubudlelwane obukhoyo phakathi kwala mazwe mabini.

src: Beke ena hape e tla kopana le boingodiso ba ho qetela bo eteletseng pele Dikgetho tsa Bomasepala tsa 2016, e le ho ya pele ho fana ka monyetla bakeng sa baetapele ho matlafatsa le ho thaotha maAforika Borwa ka matsholo a thuto ya dikgetho bakeng sa ho ingodisa le ho netefatsa dintlha tsa bona tsa ho vouta.
tgt: UMongameli uza kuya kwiNgqungquthela yesi- 4 engoKhuseleko lweNyukliya eWashington, eMelika, ukususela ngomhla wama-31 kweyoKwindla ukuya kumhla woku-1 kuTshazimpunzi ngowama-2016.

src: Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa o tla bula Seboka sa bo-2nd sa Lekgotla la Ntshetsopele ya Mehlodi ya Botho se tla tshwarelwa Setsing sa Dikopano sa Gallagher Midrand ka la 29 le la 30 Hlakubele 2016 tlasa mookotaba: “Bomphato bakeng sa maitsebelo – Kgoeletso ya ho Sebetsa”.
tgt: Ingqungquthela le iza kuxoxa ngomngcipheko okhulayo onokukhokelela kubunqolobi obunokuqhutywa kusetyenziswa izixhobo zenyukliya, kwaye iza kugqamisa amanyathelo anokuthathwa ngamazwe ngamazwe ukuthoba ukusetyenziswa kweyuraniyam enamandla amakhulu, ukugcinwa kwexhobo ezinobungozi, ukuchasa ukuthutyeleziswa kwenyukliya, ukuthintela, ukubona nokuphazamisa amalinge azama ukusebenzisa izixhobo zenyukliya kwizenzo zobunqolobi.

src: Seboka se bokanya mmoho bankakarolo ho phatlalla le lekala la thuto e phahameng bakeng sa ho thusa kgolong ya lona le ho fohla bomphato bo tla bopa dikaho tsa thuto tse tla ba malala-a-laotswe bakeng ho lokisetsa diindaseteri tse batlang di le matla.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uza kukhokhela imibhiyozo yoSuku lwamaLungelo oLuntu kwiBala iMoses Mabhida kwiphondo laKwaZulu-Natal ngoMvulo, umhla wama-21 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016 phantsi komxholo othi: “UMzantsi Afrika umanyene ekulweni ubuhlanga”.

src: Beke ya Naha ya Metsi 2016 e tla qala ho tloha ka la 14 ho isa ka la 22 Hlakubele tlasa mookotaba: “Metsi bakeng sa batho, metsi ka batho”.
tgt: Njengoko kwakwazisiwe kwiNtetho engoBume beSizwe yowe-2016, olu Suku kulo nyaka luza kubeka isiseko senkqubo yexesha elide yokwakha isizwe esingacalulani ngobuhlanga.

src: Beke ena e tla tsebahatsa metsi jwaloka tokelo ya botho ka ho phahamisa temoso ka mathata batho ba sa fihlelleng metsi a hlwekileng a nwehang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba babe banye ekulweni nasekuchaseni ubuhlanga – nokokuba busemakhayeni ethu, ekuhlaleni, kwimibutho yasekuhlaleni, emisebenzini okanye kunxibelelwano ngeselela.

src: Lefapha la Metsi le tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere le ntse le le motjheng wa ho fedisa mokgwa wa mabakete mme ho fihlela mona le se le fedisitse 78.8% ya mokgwa wa mabakete dibakeng tsa mekhukhu ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Kufuneka sisebenze kunye ukuze kufezeke ulawulo lwentando yesininzi oludibeneyo, olungacaluli ngabuhlanga nasini.

src: Le ha dipula tsa haufinyana tjena di tlisitse kimoloho e itseng, kgahlamelo ya komello e tswela pele ho utlwahala dikarolong tse ding tsa naha.
tgt: Le veki yeeMbizo iza kuphinda itshile ngempumelelo yorhulumente wemimandla, kubandakanywa nempumelelo eze ngecebo lokuvuselela urhulumente wasekhaya- inkqubo yokuBuyela kuNdalashe.

src: MaAforika Borwa a tshwanela ho tswela pele ho sebedisa metsi ka polokeho le ho kenya tshebetsong boikitlaetso ba ho baballa metsi.
tgt: Le veki iza kuphinda ingqamane nempelaveki yokugqibela yobhaliso phambi koNyulo looMasipala lowe-2016, nto leyo eza kuphinda inike abaphetheyo ithuba lokuqoqa nokuhlanganisa abemi boMzantsi Afrika ngokubafundisa ngezovoto ukuba babhalise kwaye baqinisekise iinkcukacha zabo zovoto.

src: Kabinete e amohela kgatelopele e seng e entswe ke lenaneo la Ntwa ya ho dutla tlasa mookotaba: “Lerothodi ka leng ke la bohlokwa.” Lenanaeo le rerile ho thaotha, ho rupella le ho jala batho ba batjha ba 15 000 ba nang le bonyane Kereiti 12 kapa N3 jwaloka boradipeipi, ditsebi le baemedi ba metsi.
tgt: USekela-Mongameli uCyril Ramaphosa uza kuvula iNgqungquthela yesiBini yokuPhuhliswa kwabaSebenzi eza kuba seGallagher Convention Centre eMidrand ngomhla wama-29 nowama- 30 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016 phantsi komxholo othi: “Intsebenziswano yezakhono – Ikhwelo lokuba kuSetyenzwe”.

src: Maemo a Kabinete Mabapi le Dintlha tsa Bohlokwa Maemong a Hajwale.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela iza kudibanisa bonke abachaphazelekayo kwicandelo lemfundo ephakamileyo liphela ukuze incede ekuliphuhliseni nasekudibaneni ngentsebenzisano edala amaziko emfundo ephakamileyo alungele ukusebenza.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho baipelaetsi ho sebetsa ka ho itshwara ho phethahetseng mme ba hlahise ditletlebo tsa bona ka hara ho ikobela molao le Molaotheo.
tgt: IVeki yeSizwe yezaManzi yowama-2016 iza kubakho ukususela ngomhla we-14 ukuya kowama-22 kweyoKwindla phantsi komxholo othi, “Amanzi abantu, amanzi ongiwa ngabantu”.

src: Ho tjhwatla le tshenyo ya thepa di ka nqane ho tokelo ya ho ipelaetsa le ho ba mosebetsi wa botlokotsebe o tswileng tseleng.
tgt: Le veki iza kutshila ngamanzi njengelungelo lomntu ngokuvusa abantu malunga nengxaki yabantu abangafikeleliyo emanzini acwengileyo aselwayo.

src: Makala a tiisetso ya molao a tla boloka molao ka ho tshwara le ho ahlola ba senyang thepa diyunivesithing, ditsheng tse ding tsa thuto e phahameng, ka hara metse le nakong ya diketso tsa boipelaetso.2 Letona la Ditjhelete le tsebisitse Kabinete ka matsholo a ho eta a haufinyana tjena ao le a nkileng ho ya Amerika le Engelane le bankakarolo ba fapafapaneng, ba kennyeletsang baetapele ba dikgwebo.
tgt: ISebe laManzi noGutyulo likwiphulo lokutshabalalisa inkqubo yamabhakethe elindle kwaye kungoku nje sele iphelise ukusetyenziswa kwamabhakethe kwiindawo ezingama--78.8% ezinezindlu ezihlala abantu eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Leeto le neha mmuso monyetla wa ho arola mekgahlelo e mengatanyana e fapaneng ya boikitlaetso e kentsweng tshebetsong ho sebetsana le diphephetso.
tgt: Amaphondo asixhenxe aqhube kakuhle kakhulu ngokuphelisa iindawo ezingumyinge ongama-90% ezisasebenzisa amabhakethe.

src: Tsena di kenyeletsa diketso tsa tshebedisano mmoho ho akofisa kgolo e kenyeletsang, mekgwa ya ho potlakisa matlafatso ya maemo a ditjhelete, ho potlakisa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Lenaneo la rona la Matsete a Meralo ya Motheo la R870 bilione, kgatelopele e entsweng mabapi le ho rarolla mathata a eneji, ho kenyeletswa le eneji e ka hlabollwang botjha.
tgt: Amaphondo aziphelise zonke iindawo ezinezindlu ezisebenzisa amabhakethe ukuzithumba yiKwaZulu-Natal, uMntla Ntshona, iMpumalanga neGauteng.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa hore ho itwanela ha moruo wa Aforika Borwa ho ahilwe hodima metheo e tsitsitseng le maano a kgonehang.
tgt: Abemi boMzantsi Afrika mabaqhube bachuleze ukusebenzisa amanzi kwaye basebenzise amalinge okugcina amanzi.

src: Kabinete e lemohile nyewe ya lekgotla la dinyewe e ritetsweng ke Tjhemba ya Merafo bakeng sa hore Tjhata ya Merafo e nkuwe e sa imatahanye le molaotheo le ho hloka motheo.
tgt: URhulumente selebonelele ngemali eyibhiliyoni yeerandi ukuhlangabezana nale ngxaki yembalela.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa ntlha ya hore dipehelo tsa Tjhata ya Merafo di reretswe ho fetola indaseteri ya merafo le ho lokisa botjha nalane ya ho se lekalekane ho bakilweng ke mmuso wa kgethollo hore indaseteri ena e kgeme le diphethoho tse teng ka hara Aforika Borwa tse akaretsang sebopeho sa kahisano, dipolotiki le moruo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela inkqubela eyenziwe yinkqubo yeDabi lokuLwa ukuVuza kwaManzi yeminyaka emihlanu phantsi komxholo othi: “Ithontsi ngalinye libalulekile).

src: Ntlafatso ya badudi le yona ke sebaka se tsepamiseditseng maikutlo ho netefatsa hore ntshetsopele ya merafo ha e qhelele ka thoko badudi ba amehang.
tgt: Injongo yayo le nkqubo kukufumana, ukuqeqesha nokusebenzisa abantu abatsha abali-15 000 abanesiqinisekiso semfundo ubuncinane seBanga le-12 okanye u-N3 ukuba babe ngabatywini, amagcisa nee-arhente zamanzi.

src: Phediso ya dikotsi tsa mebileng e ntse e le ntlha e ka sehloohong ya naha.
tgt: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba egqubayo ekuhlaleni.

src: Bakganni ba lokela ho fadimeha, ho ikobela melawana ya mebila, ho se nwe ba ntse ba kganna, ho tsamaya ka lebelo le behilweng le ho netefatsa hore makoloi a bona a loketse tsela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabacela abaqhankqalazi ukuba bazibambe kakhulu, kwaye izikhalazo zabo zilawulwe ngumthetho nanguMgaqo-siseko.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa bahlodi bohle ba Dikgau tsa Naha tsa Ditokelo tsa ba nang le Boqhwala tse neng di tshwerwe ka la 11 Hlakubele 2016.
tgt: Ukonakalisa okuyinkohlakalo nokonakalisa impahla yinto yokutsiba ilitye likaphungela malunga nelungelo lokuqhankqalaza kwaye loo nto ngumsebenzi wabaphuli-mthetho abalahlekileyo.

src: Dikgau tsena di ne di ananela batho ba phelang ka boqhwala le balwanedi ba ditokelo tsa batho ba phelang ka boqhwala ba ipabotseng ka makgabane selemong sa 2015.
tgt: Ii-arhente zogcino-mthetho aziza kuwugcina umthetho ngokubamba nokubeka ityala abo batshabalalisa impahla kwiidyunivesithi, kwanamanye amaziko emfundo ephakamileyo, ekuhlaleni nangexesha loqhankqalazo.. UMphathiswa wezeZimali wazise iKhabhinethi ngotyelelo asandula ukuba nalo eMelika naseNgilani apho athe wadibana nabachaphazelekayo, kuquka iinkokheli kwezoshishino.

src: Kabinete e tlotla bahlodi bohle ba Dikgau tsa bo-3 tsa Naha tsa Selemo ka seng tsa Boqhetseke tsa Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa ya Aforika Borwa (SAPS), tse lebisang hlompho ho boqhetseke ba ditho tsa SAPS, maresefe le diforamo tsa badudi tsa sepolesa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izinikele ekuqinisekiseni okokuba izinga lethu kwezoqoqosho alithotywa..Olo tyelelo lunika urhulumente ithuba lokwabelana ngamalinge athile aliqela asetyenzisiweyo ukuhlangabezana nemingeni.

src: MaAforika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho boha setlabolane sena sa dipolotiki ka ho fetohela ha mohlankana ya motjha ya dilemo di 19 ya hlahang Mamelodi, ka Botjhabela ho Pretoria, ho ba mohale wa Ntwa ya Tokoloho.
tgt: Loo malinge aquka intsebenziswano ukuze ukukhula okubandakanyayo kukhawuleze, ukukhawulezisa amanyathelo okuqinisa imicimbi yemali kaRhulumente nokukhawulezisa ukusebenza kweNkqubo yoTyalo-mali kwiziSeko ezinguNdoqo exabisa iibhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama-R870 kwakunye nenkqubela eyenziweyo ekusombululeni imiqathango yezamandla, kuquka ukusebenzisa amandla ahlaziyekayo.

src: Kabinete e boeleditse hore mmuso, ka Lefapha la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri le la Bonono le Setso, o tla tswela pele ho tshehetsa kgolo ya indaseteri ya bonono bakeng sa ho keteka le ho pheta pale ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imemelela onke amacandelo ukuba athethe ngazo zonke iinkqubo ezakhayo nangokungenelela okwenziweyo ukukhusela uqoqosho lwethu.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa molwanedi wa toka ya kahisano Moruti Michael Lapsley bakeng sa ho amohela Moputso wa Kgotso ya Setjhaba wa matjhaba wa 2016 mokgahlelong wa ‘Kgotso ya Lefatshe le Poelano – Mmopi wa Kgotso ya Babatswang ke Matjhaba’.
tgt: Kubalulekile ukuba onke amacandelo aqinisekise ukuba uqoqosho lwelizwe lomelele.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Pieter du Preez bakeng sa ho kgethwa bakeng sa Kgau ya Boqhwala ya Laureus ya Radipapadi wa Lefatshe wa Selemo, ho latela tshebetso ya hae e babatsehang ka 2015.
tgt: Ngokuphathelele kulo mba, iKhabhinethi ikwayalele iKomiti yaBaphathiswa yezoTyalo-mali ukuba ikhawulezise zonke izigqibo ezingundoqo ezayamana noqoqosho.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Wayde van Niekerk ya entseng nalane ya ho matha ka lebelo le fetisisang ka ho ba motho wa pele nalaneng wa ho matha mabelo kaofela a mararo: 100m ka tlasa metsotswana e 10‚ 200m ka tlasa metsotswana e 20 le 400m ka tlasa metsotswana e 44‚ jwaloka ha ho tiiseditswe ke Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Difedereishene tsa Mabelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayiphinda into yokuba ukomelela koqoqosho loMzantsi Afrika kusekelwe phezu kwezinto eziqinileyo nezingundoqo zoqoqosho kwaneenkqubo ezisebenzayo.

src: Ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha mananeo a bohlokwa a mmuso.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ezingundoqo.

src: Kabinete e amohela diphihlello tse hlakisitsweng ke Moporesidente Jacob Zuma ha a ne a etetse setsheng sa Boemakepe ba Port Elizabeth ho la Kapa Botjhabela,ho lekola kgatelopele e entsweng ho kenngweng tshebetsong ha boikitlaetso ba Operation Phakisa: Moruo wa Mawatle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamkela izinto ezibe yimpumelelo ezithe zakhankanywa nguMongameli uJacob Zuma ngexesha lokutyelela iziko eliseBhayi eMpuma Koloni, ukuza kuhlola inkqubela esele yenziwe ekuphunyezweni kwephulo elibizwa i-Operation Phakisa: uQoqosho lwezaseLwandle.

src: Mmuso o butse matsete a ka fihlang ho se ka etsang R17 bilione ho Moruo wa Mawatle.
tgt: Urhulumente uvule utyalo-mali olufikelela kwimali emalunga neebhiliyoni zeerandi ezili-17 kuQoqosho lwezaseLwandle.

src: Ho tloha esale e thehwa, ho se ho hlahisitswe mesebetsi e fetang 4500 makaleng a fapafapaneng.
tgt: Ukususela ekusungulweni kwayo, kudalwe imisebenzi engaphezulu kwama-4 500 kumacandelo aliqela.

src: Tse pedi tsa diketswana tse hulang tse ntseng di ahuwa ke Southern African Shipyards bakeng sa Bolaodi ba Maemakepe a Naha ba Transnet (TNPA) Boemakepeng ba Durban di tla lebiswa Boemakepeng ba Port Elizabeth.
tgt: Oodokolwana ababini kwabalithoba abakhiwa kuMzi weeNqanawa waseMazantsi e-Afrika, i-Southern African Shipyard, nesakhelwa uGunyaziwe waMazibuko eSizwe akwa-Transnet (i-TNPA) kwiZibuko laseDurban baza kuthunyelwa kwiZibuko laseBhayi.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o thakgotse seketswana sa pele se hulang ho la Port Elizabeth, se reheletsweng Mvezo, e leng tulo ya tswalo ya Moporesidente wa mehleng Nelson Mandela.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma umisele ngokusesikweni udokolwana wokuqala eBhayi, obizwa uMvezo, nothiywe ngendawo awazalelwa kuyo owayesakuba nguMongameli uNelson Mandela.

src: TNPA e beheletse ka thoko se ka fetang R7 bilione bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa maemakepe a rona.
tgt: I-TNPA ibekele bucala imali engaphezulu kweebhiliyoni zeerandi ezisixhenxe yokuphucula amazibuko eli.

src: Moporesidente o ile a sheba metjha ya dikepe e ntlafaditsweng le ho ahuwa botjha e kenang ka hara Boemakepe ba Port Elizabeth tse tla kgona ho amohela dikepe tse kgolo tse 12 ka hodimo papisong le tsa hajwale tse pedi.
tgt: UMongameli ukubona oku kuhlaziywa nokwakhiwa ngokutsha kwesangwana neebhulorho zokungena ekumisa kuzo iinqanawa kwiZibuko laseBhayi neziza kukwazi ukungenisa iinqanawa ezongezelelweyo ezili-12 xa kuthelekiswa nezo zimbini zikhoyo ngoku.

src: Kabinete e leboha balefi kaofela ba lekgetho ba ipapisitseng le mmuso selemong sa ditjhelete sa 2015/16 bakeng sa ho fihlisa pokeletso ya rona ya lekeno ho R1trilione lekgetlo la pele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyababulela abahlawuli berhafu abathe basebenzisana norhulumente kunyaka-mali wama-2015/16 ukwenza ukuba uqokelelo lwethu lwerhafu lufikelele okokuqala kwitriliyoni yeerandi.

src: Sena ke sesupo se hlakileng sa matla a moruo wa rona o hlabolohang le ka tlasa maemo a WEBTOKEN ka dinyehelo tsa lekgetho la maAforika Borwa a lokelang le pokeletso e hlwahlwa e etswang ke Ditshebeletso tsa Lekeno tsa Aforika Borwa hore mmuso o kgone betere ho fana ka ditshebeletso tse hlokahalang haholo tse nyehelang bakeng sa ntlafatso ya bophelo ba maAforika Borwa.
tgt: Lo ngumzekelo ocacileyo wamandla oqoqosho lweli oluphumelela naphantsi kweemeko ezinzima.

src: Kabinete e amohela tsebiso ya Moporesidente Zuma ya la 3 Phato 2016 jwaloka letsatsi la Dikgetho tsa Mebuso ya lehae tsa 2016.
tgt: Kungenxa yerhafu ehlawulwa ngabemi boMzantsi Afrika abathe bangenisa iingxelo zabo zerhafu ngethuba kunye nomsebenzi omhle wokuqokelela irhafu weZiko leeNkonzo zezeRhafu zaseMzantsi Afrika (i-SARS) okwenza ukuba urhulumente akwazi ukunikezela ngeenkonzo ezidingeka kakhulu nezidlala indima ekuphuculeni ubomi babemi baseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Mmuso o itumetse hore mafelo a beke a mabedi a boingodiso a la 5–6 Tlhakubele le la 9–10 Mmesa ho bonahetse ha batho ba ka nnang ba kgetha ba tlile ka bongata diteisheneng tsa ho kgetha,haholo-holo ba tla beng ba vouta lekgetlo la pele le batjha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isibhengezo esenziwe nguMongameli uZuma sokuba umhla wesi-3 kweyeThupha yowama-2016 njengomhla woNyulo looRhulumente beeNgingqi lowama-2016.

src: Kabinete e leboha bohle ba arabetseng kgoeletso ya hore ba ingodise le ho hlahloba dintlha tsa bona lenaneng la bakgethi.
tgt: Urhulumente uxolile kukuba iimpela-veki ezimbini ezingumhla we-5 ukuya kowe-6 kweyoKwindla nomhla we-9 ukuya kowe-10 kuTshazimpuzi zokubhalisela unyulo kubonakale inani elikhulu labo baselungelweni lokuvota, ingakumbi abo baza kuvota okokuqala kunye nolutsha.

src: Ke ka bonkakarolo ba rona ka kopanelo hore demokerasi ya rona e dule e matlafala.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyababulela bonke abo bathe basabela kwikhwelo lokuya kubhalisa nokuya kukhangela iinkcukhacha zabo kuluhlu lwabavoti.

src: Kabinete kgothaletsa baahi bohle ba so ka ba ingodisa kapa ho hlahloba dintlha tsa bona ho etela dikantoro tsa Khomishene e Ikemetseng ya Dikgetho ho bomasepala ba bona ho ya lokisa dintlha tsa bona lenaneng la bakgethi (fana ka diaterese) le ho ingodisetsa ho vouta dikgethong tsa la 3 Phato 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza bonke abemi abangekabhalisi okanye abangekazikhangeli iinkcukhacha zabo ukuba batyelele ii-ofisi zeKhomishini yoNyulo eziMeleyo koomasipala babo baze balungise iinkcukhacha zabo kumqulu woluhlu lwabavoti (banikezele ngeedilesi) baze babhalisele unyulo lomhla wesi-3 kweyeThupha.

src: Bakgethi hape ba ka romela dimoro sa bona tsadi boitsebiso ka SMS ho 3281.0 kapa ba letsetse setsi sa mehala ho 0800 11 8000 ho netefatsa maemo a bona.
tgt: Abavoti basenokuthumela iinombolo zabo zeZazisi nge-SMS ku-3281.0 okanye baqhagamshelane neziko loqhagamshelwano ku-0800 11 8000 ukuqinisekisa ukuba buthini ubume babo.

src: Boingodiso bo netefatsa lebitso la hao lenaneng la bakgethi hore o tle o kgone ho vouta.
tgt: Ubhaliso luqinisekisa ukuba igama lakho likhona kumqulu woluhlu lwabavoti ukuze ukwazi ukuvota.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho baahi ho sebedisa tokelo ya bona ya demokerasi e lwanetsweng ka thata ka ho vouta Dikgethong tsa Mebuso ya Lehae tsa 2016 ka la 3 Phato 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abemi ukuba basebenzise ilungelo labo lomgaqo-siseko lokuvota nesalufumana nzima ngokuthi bavote kuNyulo looRhulumente beeNgingqi lowama-2016 ngomhla wesi-3 kweyeThupha yowama-2016.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa semmuso ha Porojeke ya Teko ya eChannel ya Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae (DHA) ke Moporesidente Zuma.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukumiselwa ngokusesikweni kweProjekthi yokuLinga i-eChannel yeSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya (i-DHA) nguMongameli uZuma.

src: Tsamaisong ena e ntjha ya ntlafatso e dumella baahi ho etsa dikopo tsa bona tsa dikarete tsa boitsebiso ka inthanete ho phema mela e melelele.
tgt: Le nkqubo yala maxesha intsha ivumela ukuba abemi bafake izicelo zabo zamakhadi-sazisi, i-Smart ID, kwi-intanethi ukuze baphephe imigca emide.

src: Ka tshebedisano mmoho le dibanka tse nne tse kgolo – ABSA, FNB, Nedbank le Standard Bank – ho hlahisa lepatlelo la ho etsa dikopo tsa dikarete tsa boitsebiso le diphasepoto ho tla thusa basebedisi ho etela dintlwana tsa Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae ho fana ka dikgatiso tsa bona tsa menwana le dinepe kamora ho ba ba beheletse dibaka le ho lefa ka inthanete.
tgt: Le yintsebenziswano kunye neebhanki zeli ezine ezinkulu – i-ABSA, i-FNB, i-Nedbank kunye ne-Standard Bank ukuvelisa iqonga lokufaka isicelo samakhadi-sazisi nepaspothi ngokusebenzisa i-intanethi kuza kuvumela abemi beli ukuba batyelele i-ofisana ze-DHA ukuya kunyathelisa iminwe nemifanekiso yabo emva kokwenza idinga baze bahlawula nge-intanethi.

src: eChannel ke karolo ya lefapha ya kakaretso ya ho ntjhafatsa lewa la ho tlosa ditshebeletso ho tloha tshebedisong ya dipampiri ho ya ho tshebediso ya dijithale, e leng tsamaiso e tla kenyeletsa tlhwekiso ya rejisetara ya setjhaba.
tgt: I-eChannel iyinxalenye yesicwangciso-qhinga sokwenza eli sebe lihambelane nala maxesha xa lilonke ukutshintsha iinkonzo zisuke kwezokusetyenziswa kwamaphepha kusetyenziswa ubuchwepheshe bale mihla , inkqubo eza kuquka ukulungiswa kweziphene kuluhlu oluqulethe iinkcukacha zoluntu.

src: Kabinete e amohela katleho ya Beke ya Imbizo ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo e neng e etsahala haufinyana tlasa mookotaba ‘Mmoho re ntshetsa Aforika Borwa pele’, moo ho bonweng bahlanka ba mmuso ba ikopanya le badudi ho phatlalla le naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela iimpumelelo yokubanjwa kutsha nje kweVeki eGxile kwiiMbizo phantsi komxholo othi ‘Sisonke siqhubela uMzantsi Afrika phambili’, apho sibone khona amagosa karhulumente etyelela iindawo ezininzi zoluntu kweli jikelele.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa maAforika Borwa a nkileng karolo ho mananeo a fetang 36 ho phatlalla le naha, e leng se netefaditseng hore mmuso o arabetse ho ditlhoko tse hlwailweng tsa badudi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibothulela umnqwazi abo bemi boMzantsi Afrika bathe bathatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo ezingaphezulu kwama-36 kweli jikelele, nezithe zaqinisekisa ukuba urhulumente uyahlangabezana nezo mfuno zoluntu zichongiweyo.

src: Beke ya Imbizo ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo e matlafaditse badudi ka tlhahisoleseding e mabapi le mananeo a mmuso.
tgt: Le Veki iGxile kwiMbizo iye yaxhobisa uluntu ngolwazi lweenkqubo zikarhulumente.

src: Lefapha la Bodulo ba Batho le ne le tshwere seboka se atlehileng haholo sa Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) se sebetsanang le mekhukhu, se toboketsa sekgahla se matla sa kgolo ya metse ya ditoropo le kgolo ya mekhukhu.
tgt: ISebe lezokuHlaliswa koLuntu lisingathe ingqungquthela yeZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) ebeyimpumelelo enkulu ebigxile kwimiba yeendawo ezingamatyotyombe, futhi igxininisa nakwisantya esiphezulu sokufudukela kwabantu ezidolophini nokukhula ngokukhawuleza kwemimandla yamatyotyombe.

src: Hona jwale batho ba etsang bilione e le nngwe lefatsheng ba dula mekhukhung.
tgt: Ngoku ngabantu abayibhiliyoni ehlabathini jikelele abahlala kwimimandla yamatyotyombe.

src: Aforika Borwa e se e ahile dimilione tsa matlo esale ho tloha ka 1994 jwaloka karolo ya ho netefatsa bophelo bo botle bakeng sa bohle.
tgt: Ukususela ngowe-1994 uMzantsi Afrika wakhe izigidi zezindlu njengenxalenye yokuqinisekisa ngobomi obungcono kumntu wonke.

src: DibiliKabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Dibili tsa moralo tse latelang:.
tgt: IMithetho eYilwayoIKhabhinethi iphumeze le Mithetho iYilwayo ilandelayo:.

src: Bili ya Tshireletso ya Meralo ya Motheo e Hlokolosi ya 2016 e tla phatlalatswa Koranteng ya Mmuso bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: UMthetho oYilwayo ongokuKhuselwa kweZiseko ezinguNdoqo eziBaluleke kaKhulu wama-2016 oza kushicilelwa kwiPhephandaba loMbuso ukwenzela ukuba uluntu luhlomle kuwo.

src: Bili e fetola Molao wa Ditsi tsa Bohlokwa tsa Naha, 1980 (Molao 102 wa 1980), mme e batla ho matahanya tsamaiso ya ho hlwaya le ho hlahisa meralo ya motheo e hlokolosi ka mokgwa wa ponaletso le o nang le maikarabelo.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uguzula uMthetho waMaziko weSizwe anguNdoqo, we-1980 (uMthetho onguNombolo 102 we-1980, kwaye ugxile ekulungelelaniseni inkqubo yokuchonga nokubhengeza iziseko ezingundoqo ezibaluleke kakhulu ngendlela eselubala necacisekayo.

src: Hape e tla netefatsa hore meralo ya motheo kaofela e hlokolosi e ya hlwauwa le ho tshireletswa ka tshwanelo bakeng sa polokeho ya naha.
tgt: Kwakhona uza kuqinisekisa ukuba zonke iziseko ezingundoqo ezibaluleke kakhulu ziyachongwa zize zikhuselwe ngokufanelekileyo ukwenzela ukhuseleko lwesizwe.

src: Bili e fana ka ho tekwa ha moralo wa ditsi bakeng sa ho beha leihlo le ho tsamaisa tshireletso ya meralo ya motheo e hlokolosi.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ukwabonelela ngokumiselwa kwenkqubo-sikhokelo yeziko ukwenzela ukuhlolwa nokwenziwa kokhuseleko lweziseko ezingundoqo ezibaluleke kakhulu.

src: E boela e hlalosa mesebetsi ya lekala le tla eletsa Letona la Sepolesa tlhahisong ya meralo ya motheo e hlokolosi.
tgt: Ukwacacisa imisebenzi kweziko eliza kucebisa uMphathiswa wezamaPolisa ekubhengezweni kweziseko ezingundoqo.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Mekgatlo ya Thepa ya Bodulo bo Kopanetsweng ya 2016 e tla phatlalatswa bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: UMthetho-siHlomelo ongeMibutho yabaNikazi Mhlaba wowama-2016 uza kupapashwa ukwenzela ukuba uluntu lukwazi ukuhlomla kuwo.

src: Bili e fetola Molao wa hajwale wa Mekgatlo ya Thepa ya Bodulo bo Kopanetsweng,1996 (Molao 28 wa1996).Bili e tla matlafatsa tsamaiso ya taolo ya demokerasi ya Mekgatlo ya Thepa ya Bodulo bo Kopanetsweng e teng kapa dihlopha tsa Trust tse teng tse behang leihlo mobu wa bodulo bo kopanetsweng.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uyilwayo uhlomela uMthetho okhoyo ongeMibutho yabaNikazi Mhlaba, we-1996 (uMthetho uNombolo 28 we-1996).Lo Mthetho uYilwayo womeleza inkqubo yolawulo olulolwentando yesininzi yeMibutho yabaNikazi Mhlaba abaLuluntu okanye amaqumrhu eTrasti akhoyo athi ongamele umhlaba onabanikazi abaluluntu.

src: Bili e fetotsweng e fana ka ho thehwa ha Morejisetara ka hara Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Dibaka tsa Mahae le Tlhabollo ya Naha, mme e hlalosa mesebetsi ya kantoro ena.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uhlonyelweyo uvumela ukuba kumiselwe i-ofisi yoMgcini-ncwadi kwiSebe loPhuhliso lwamaPhandle noBuyekezo lweMihlaba, kwaye uyayicacisa imisebenzi yale ofisi.

src: Hang ha Bili ena e fetisitswe ho ba molao, e tla matlafatsa taolo ya ditsi tsa puso le ho matlafatsa tshehetso ya Mmuso ho tsona.
tgt: Xa sele upasisiwe lo Mthetho uYilwayo waba ngumthetho, uza komeleza imimiselo yamaziko olawulo uze uqinise inkxaso kaRhulumente kuwo.

src: E tla thusa badudi ho fumana, ho tshwara le ho laola thepa ya bodulo ka dihlopha tse hlwahlwa tse thehilweng semolao tse tshehetswang ke mmuso.
tgt: Uza kwenza ukuba uluntu lukwazi ukufumana, lubambe luze lulawule imihlaba ngokusebenzisa amaqumrhu olawulo asebenzayo nasekwe ngokomthetho naxhaswayo ngurhulumente.

src: Ho hlahiswa ha Bili ya Bonamodi ba Matjhaba ya 2016 ho Palamente.
tgt: Ukuthiwa thaca koMthetho oYilwayo ongoLamlo weHlabathi wowama-2016 ePalamente.

src: Tsamaiso ya matjhaba ya bonamodi ke sesebediswa sa bohlokwa bakeng sa ho kena kgwebong ho parola le meedi ya naha.
tgt: Inkqubo yolamlo lwehlabathi sisixhobo esibalulekileyo sokwenza ushishino ngaphaya kwemida yeli lizwe.

src: E tla ntlafatsa phumantsho ho ditshebeletso tsa toka bakeng sa dikhamphani tse nang le kgwebisano le tsa ka ntle ho naha le dikhamphani tsa melata tse ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Uza kwenza ukuba kube lula kwiinkampani ezenza ushishino kumazwe angaphandle kweli nezamazwe angaphandle ezishishina eMzantsi Afrika ukuba zifikelele kwiinkonzo zezobulungisa.

src: Bili e fetola Molao wa Kananelo le Tiisetso ya Phano ya Bonamodi ba Matjhaba, 1977 (Molao 40 wa 1977) mme hape e fetola Molao wa hajwale wa Tshireletso ya Kgwebo, 1978 (Molao 99 wa 1978).
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uguzula uMthetho wokwaMkelwa nokuSetyenziswa kokuNikezelwa koLamlo lwaMazwe angaPhandle, we-1977 (uMthetho uNombolo 40 we-1977) kwakunye nokuhlonyelwa koMthetho woKhuselo loShishino, we-1978 (uMthetho uNombolo 99 we-1978).Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uhambelana noMthetho woMfuziselo ongoLamlo kuRhwebo lweHlabathi, owamkelwa yiKhomishini yeZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) kuMthetho woRhwebo lweHlabathi.

src: Bili e sisintsweng e imatahanya le Molao wa Motlolo wa Bonamodi ba Matjhaba ba Dikgwebo, o amohetsweng ke Khomishene ya UN ya Molao wa Matjhaba wa Kgwebisano.
tgt: Ukupapashwa kwedrafti yoMthetho-siHlomelo weSiseko soPhando-nzulu seSizwe wowama-2016 kwiPhephandaba loMbuso ukwenzela ukuba uluntu luhlomle.

src: Phatlalatso ya Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Moralo ya Motheo wa Naha wa Diphuputso ya 2016 ho Koranta ya Mmuso bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uhlomela uMthetho weSiseko soPhando-nzulu weSizwe, we-1998 (uMthetho uNombolo 23 we-1998).Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uza kuphucula isakhono soMzantsi Afrika sokukwazi ukumelana nokhuphiswano kuphuhliso lwezophando-nzulu nokuvelisa okutsha ngolawullo olusebenzayo, olwaneleyo noluququzelelweyo lokubandakanywa koluntu kwezenzululwazi, nobonelelo lweziseko ezingundoqo zophando-nzulu eziphuculilweyo nofikeleleko.

src: Bili e fetola Molao wa Motheo wa Naha wa Diphuputso, 1998 (Molao 23 wa 1998).Bili e tla ntlafatsa bophehisani ba Aforika Borwa ntshetsopeleng le ntjhafatsong ya diphuputso ka tsamaiso e hlwahlwa, e nepahetseng le e hokahaneng ya boikopanyo ba setjhaba le tsa saense, le ho ntlafatsa le phumantsho ya meralo ya motheo ya diphuputso.
tgt: Kwakhona uza kuphucula indlela uphuhliso loPhando-nzulu olusabela nolusebenza ngokuvakalayo kwalo nokubonelela ukuveliswa kokutsha, ukuphucula umgangatho wobomi babemi baseMzantsi Afrika ngokuhambelana okungcono nemiba ephambili nengundoqo karhulumente.

src: Diqeto tsa bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Izigqibo ezingundoqo zeKhabhinethi.

src: Cabinet e amohetse Pampiri e Tshweu e Mabapi le Tshebetso ya Sepolesa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilamkele iPhepha leNgcaciso ngezobuPolisa.

src: Pampiri e Tshweu ya moralo e qadile ho phatlalatswa bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba ka Tlhakubele 2015.
tgt: Idrafti yeli Phepha leNgcaciso lapapashwa okokuqala kwinyanga yoKwindla yowama-2015 ukwenzela ukuba uluntu luhlomle.

src: Pampiri e teka ntlha ya sepolesa se sekametseng ka ho baahi ba itahlelang ka setotswana le ho arabela ho tikoloho e teng hajwale ya sepolesa.
tgt: Eli phepha libonelele ngenkonzo yezobupolisa ebacingela kakhulu abemi abasebenzayo ize ilandele neemeko ezikhoyo zezobupolisa.

src: Hape e teka ntlha ya Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa ya Aforika Borwa le Sepolesa sa Metse Meholo se nang le boikarabelo le ho ba sa seporofeshenale.
tgt: Ikwabonelela ngeNkonzo yezobuPolisa yaseMzantsi Afrika neyamapolisa kamasipala ekwaziyo ukuphendula icacise futhi nesebenza ngobuchule nondiliseko.

src: Pampiri e Tshweu e etsa boipiletso ba ho thehwa ha Boto ya Naha ya Sepolesa eo, hara mesebetsi e meng, e tla ikarabella bakeng sa ho tla ka mokgwa o se nang leeme wa ho thaotha, ho kgetha le ho thonya makolwane a matjha ka hara ditshebeletso tsa sepolesa.
tgt: Eli Phepha leNgcaciso likwafuna ukuba kumiselwe iBhodi yezobuPolisa yeSizwe eza kuthi, phakathi kweminye yemisebenzi yayo, ijongane nokumiselwa kwemimiselo nemigaqo yokukhupha izithuba zemisebenzi, ukukhethwa nokuqeshwa kwamalungu amatsha kwiinkonzo zezobupolisa.

src: Kabinete e amohetse Pampiri e Tshweu e mabapi le Polokeho le Tshireletso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilamkele iPhepha leNgcaciso elingoKhuseleko noKhuselo.

src: Pampiri ena e Tshweu, e seng e tswile bakeng sa tjhebisano le setjhaba ka Hlakola 2015, e tsepamisitse maikutlo hodima katamelo e kopanetsweng le ya ntshetsopele ya polokeho e shebileng ka nqane ho sepolesa.
tgt: Eli Phepha leNgcaciso, nebelikhutshwe kwinyanga yoMdumba yowama-2015 ukwenzela ukuba kufakwane imilomo noluntu malunga nalo, ligxile kwindlela edibeneyo neyophuhliso kukhuseleko ngaphaya kobupolisa.

src: E batla ho fana ka tataiso bakeng sa mekgwa ya polokeho ya ba badudi.
tgt: Linika isikhokelo kumanyathelo okhuseleko loluntu oluthintelayo.

src: Pampiri e Tshweu e hlwaya mafapha kaofela a amehang le mekgatlo ya badudi e nyeheleng bakeng sa polokeho ya badudi.
tgt: Eli Phepha leNgcaciso lichonge onke amasebe afanelekileyo nemibutho yasekuhlaleni yoLuntu enegalelo kukhuseleko loluntu.

src: Kabinete e tjhaellese monwana moralo wa Leano o mabapi le Ketso ya Moetlo wa lebollo ka hara Aforika Borwa le ho tjhaella monwana hore Lefapha la Merero ya Setso le qale ho rala molao wa naha wa tsa lebollo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele idrafti yoMgaqo-nkqubo woKwenziwa kweSiko loLwaluko eMzantsi Afrika yaza yakwamkela ukuba iSebe leMicimbi yeMveli maliqalise ukuyila umthetho wesizwe ongolwaluko.

src: Leano lena le se le sebeditswe haholo ka tsamaiso ya dipuisano le setjhaba le bankakarolo ba amehang.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo sele udlule kwinkqubo ebanzi yofakwano-mlomo loluntu kunye nabo bonke abadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo.

src: Leano le fana ka ditataiso tse netefatsang tshireletso ya meetlo ya setso ya lebollo la selemo ka seng la bashemane ntle le ho beha polokeho ya bona tsietsing.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo ubonelela ngesikhokelo esiqinisekisa ngokhuseleko lwesiko lemveli lolwaluko lwamakhwenkwe lwaminyaka le kungakhange kubekwe emngciphekweni ukhuseleko lwawo.

src: Sena se etsa karolo ya mehato eo mmuso e e nkang ho hatella meetlo e amohelehang e nepahetseng.
tgt: Le yinxalenye yamanyathelo athathwa ngurhulumente ukuqinisa ukwenziwa kweli siko ngendlela efanelekileyo neyamkelekileyo.

src: Le ho busetsa boemo bo amohelehang ba maikarabelo ho ba tsamaisang mabollo le batswadi ba romelang bana ba bona mabollong ana.
tgt: Ubuyisela izinga elamkelekileyo lokuphendula nokucacisa kwabo baphethe amabhoma nabazali abathumela abantwana babo kulo mabhoma.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana dikgothaletso tse entsweng ke Komiti ya Dipatlisiso e mabapi le kgwebisano ka manaka a ditshukudu e le e nngwe ya kgetho ya ho baballa mohlape wa naha wa ditshukudu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izamkele izindululo ezenziwe yiKomiti yoPhando lokuba kunokwenzeka na ukuba kwenziwe kurhwetywe ngeempondo zemikhombe njengenye yeendlela zokusindisa imikhombe yeli lizwe ingabi semngciphekweni wokutshabalala.

src: Dikgothaletso di ile tsa tshehetswa ke Komiti ya Boeletsi ba Setekginiki e Kopanetsweng ke Mafapha le Komiti e Kopanetsweng ya Matona e thontsweng ho batlisisa kgonahalo ya ho kenya molaong kgwebisano ya matjhaba ya manaka a ditshukudu.
