tgt: Ezi zindululo ziye zaxhaswa yiKomiti yabaCebisi bezobuChwephetshe yamaSebe aHlukeneyo kunye neKomiti yabaPhathiswa echongelwe ukuba yenze uphando lokuba kungenzeka na lwenziwe olusemthethweni ushishino lwehlabathi lorhwebo lweempondo zemikhombe.

src: Dikgothaletso di tshehetsa lewa le kopanetsweng la Aforka Borwa la katamelo ya bolaodi ba ho rarolla ho tsongwa ho seng molaong ha ditshukudu le kgwebisano e seng molaong ya manaka a ditshukudu.
tgt: Ezi zindululo zomeleze indlela yolawulo lobuchule edibeneyo uMzantsi Afrika oyiqwalasele ngayo lo mba ukusombulula ukuzingelwa kwemikhombe ngokungekho mthethweni nokurhweba ngemikhombe okungekhomthethweni.

src: Komiti e kgothaletsa hore mokgwa wa hajwale wa ho boloka mohlape o ntseng o le teng wa naha kgahlanong le kgwebisano ka manaka a ditshukudu.
tgt: Ikomiti icebisa ukuba le ndlela yangoku yokugcina izinga lomhlambi okhoyo ugcinwe unjalo kunokuba kushishinwe ngeempondo zemikhombe.

src: Lewa la katamelo la naha le kenyeletsa polokeho matlafatso ya badudi taolo ya tswadiso diphano tsa molao o tla kenngwang tshebetsong ka tsela e hlwahlwa le ho hatellwa le taolo ya ho batleha ha manaka a ditshukudu.
tgt: Indlela yobuchule eliyisebenzisayo eli lizwe iquka ukhuselo ukuxhotyiswa koluntu ulawulo lwezenzulu-lwazi ngezilwanyana imithetho esabela ngqo kulo mngeni nesetyenziswa futhi inyanzeliswe ngokubonakalayo nolawulo lwezinga lokufunwa kweemveliso zemikhombe.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana meralo ya dikhoine tsa 2016 tsa sehopotso tse latelang:a) Letoto la Naha la Khoine ya Tlhaho– Boikitlaetso ba BigCats : ‘The Cheetah’.b) Letoto la dikhoine tsa Sterling-silver crown le dikhoine tsa tickey ‘Ditshibollo tsa Aforika Borwa–‘Dolosse’.Meralo ya dikhoine,mmoho le diphatlalatso tsa tsona, di tla hatiswa Koranteng ya Mmuso, mme ebe di tla be se di hlahiswa ka metjha e tlwaelehileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuyilwa kweenkozo zemali zesikhumbuzo sowama-2016:a) UThotho lweeNkozo zeMali ze-National Geographic – Iphulo leeKati eziNkulu: ‘INgwenkala’.b) Uthotho lweeNkozo zeMali zesiThsaba sePonti neTiki sesilivere ‘izinto eziqanjwe eMzantsi Afrika’ – ‘i-Dolosse’Uyilo lweenkozo zemali, kunye nezibhengezo zazo, ziza kupapshwa kwiPhephandaba loMbuso, ize emva koko ziveliswe ize zithengiswe ngokweendlela zesiqhelo.

src: Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Imisitho ezayo.

src: Moporesidente Zuma dipakeng tsa la18 le 22 Mmesa 2016 o tla nka maeto a tshebetso ho ya mebusong ya ditho tsa Kopano ya Makgetho a Madiboho ya Aforika e Borwa (SACU) e kenyeletsang Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho le Swaziland.
tgt: Phakathi komhla we-18 nowama-22 kuTshazimpuzi uMongameli uZuma uza kuthatha utyelelo lwaseburhulumenteni kumazwe angamalungu oMbutho waseMazantsi e-Afrika waMazwe angaHlawulisani Rhafu yoRhwebo (i-SACU) noluza kuquka iNamibia, iBotswana, iLesotho neSwaziland.

src: Maeto a tla ntlafatsa karolo ya bohlokwae bapalwang ke SACU bakeng sa ho hodisa momahano ya lebatowa le ntshetsopele ya moruo wa ditho tsa yona kaofela.
tgt: Olu tyelelo luza kuqinisa indima ebalulekileyo edlalwa yi-SACU ekukhuthazeni ukudityaniswa kommandla nophuhliso lwezoqoqosho lwamazwe angamalungu wayo.

src: Moporesidente o tla nka leeto la Puso ho etela Riphaboliki ya MaIsilamo ya Iran ka la 23 le 24 Mmesa 2016 ho matlafatsa maqhama a sepolotiki le a moruo pakeng tsa dinaha tsena tse pedi.
tgt: Ngomhla wama-23 nowama-24 kuTshazimpuzi wowama-2016 uMongameli uza kuthatha uTyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni oluya kwi-Islamic Republic of Iran ukomeleza unxibelelwano lwezopolitiko nolwezoqoqosho phakathi kwala mazwe mabini.

src: Moporesidente o tla etella pele mekete ya Naha ya Letsatsi la Tokoloho ka la 27 Mmesa 2016 Limpopo, Lebaleng la dipapadi la Giyani tlasa mookotaba: “Mmoho re aha metse e betere–Mebuso ya le hae ke taba ya mang le mang”.Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela le makala a mang ho bontsha lerato la naha ka ho nka karolo diketsahalong tse fapafapaneng tsa ho hopola Kgwedi ya Tokoloho.
tgt: UMongameli uza kukhokela imibhiyozo yoSuku lweSizwe lweNkululeko ngomhla wama-27 kuTshazimpuzi wowama-2016 eLimpopo, kumaBala eMidlalo aseGiyani phantsi komxholo othi: “Sisonke sakha uluntu olungcono – ooRhulumente beeNgingqi yingxaki yomntu wonke”.IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika namacandelo ukuba babonakalise ukuba ngabathandi-besizwe ngokuthatha inxaxheba kwimisitho emininzi yokubhiyozela iNyanga yeNkululeko.

src: Dibekeng tse tlang,Palamente e tla be e tshwara Divoutu tsa Ditekanyetso tsa mafapa ka mafapha.
tgt: Kwezi veki zizayo, iPalamente izakuba iqhuba iiNgxoxo-mpikiswano zeVoti zoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali lwamasebe karhulumente.

src: Ba Phethahatso ba mafapha ka ho latelana ba tla be ba hlopholla meralo ya bona ya tshebetso bakeng sa selemo sa ditjhelete sa 2016/17.
tgt: Amalungu eKhabhinethi amasebe awohlukahlukeneyo aza kucacisa izicwangciso zawo zokusebenza zonyaka-mali wowama-2016/17.

src: Ditho tsa setjhaba di tla tsebiswa ka mananeo a mmuso a phano ya ditshebeletso.
tgt: Amalungu oluntu aza kwaziswa malunga neenkqubo zonikezelo-nkonzo zikarhulumente.

src: Maemo a Kabinete Mabapi le Dintlha tsa Bohlokwa Maemong a Hajwale Kabinete e amohetse karabelo le kopo ya tshwarelo e ileng ya latela ka Moporesidente Zuma ho kahlolo ya Lekgotla la Dinyewe la Molaotheo mabapi le boimatahanyo le diketso tsa ditokiso tse tekilweng tlalehong ya Mosireletsi wa Setjhaba.
tgt: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba esematheni.

src: Kabinete e ntse e hlahloba kahlolo bakeng sa ho sheba haeba ho na le mehato e ka nkuwang ho matlafatsa mosebetsi wa Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela impendulo elandelwe kukucelwa koxolo nguMongameli uZuma kwisiGwebo seNkundla yoMgaqo-siseko ngokumalunga nokuthotyelwa kwamanyathelo okulungisa acaciswe kwingxelo yoMkhuseli woLuntu.

src: Kahlolo ya Lekgotla la Dinyewe la Molaotheo e thathiselletsa le ho mafiella demokerasi ya molaotheo ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isasiphonononga esi sigwebo ukuze iqonde ukuba akhona na amanye amanyathelo ekufuneka athathwe ukuqinisa indima kaRhulumente.

src: Kabinete e lemohile ketso ya dibanka tse nne tse fanneng ka tsebiso ya ho kwala diakhaonte tsa banka tsa khamphani e nngwe.
tgt: Isigwebo seNkundla yoMgaqo-siseko someleza sikwaqinisekisa ngolawulo lwentando yesininzi lwaseMzantsi Afrika olusekelwe kumgaqo-siseko.

src: Leha Kabinete e ananela dipehelo le maemo a dibanka, diketso tsena di ka sitisa boramatsete ba ka nnang ba ba teng ba ka batlang ho tsamaisa dikgwebo ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwaqaphele amanyathelo eebhanki ezine ezithe zakhupha izaziso zokuvala ii-akhawunti zenkampani.

src: Kabinete e tsheheditse ntlha ya hore Matona a Ditjhelete, Mesebetsi le Mehlodi ya Diminerale a tshwanela ho bula dipuisano tse ahang le dibanka bakeng sa ho fihlella tharollo ya nako e telele tabeng ena.
tgt: Ngeli xesha iKhabhinethi iyiqonda imiselo nemiqathango yeebhanki, la manyathelo asenokugxotha abo bebesenokuba ngabatyali-mali kwixesha elizayo abasenokufuna ukwenza ushishino eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Letona la Bophelo bo Botle, Ngaka Aaron Motsoaledi, ya fumaneng kgau ya matjhaba ya Lefuba ya USAID-TB jwaloka kananelo ya boetapele ba hae mabapi le ntwa ya lefatshe kgahlanong le lefuba (TB) mmoho le ho etella pele boikitlaetso ba Aforika Borwa le ba lebatowa mabapi le ho hlahloba, kalafo le thibelo ya TB tshwaetso e kopaneng ya TB/HIV le TB e itwanelang ho meriana e mengata.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumelene ukuba uMphathiswa wezeMali, owezabaSebenzi noweMithombo yeziMbiwa ukuba baqale iingxoxo zokubonisana nokucweya kunye nezi bhanki ukufumana isisombululo esiyakuhlala simile ngalo mba.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho kgethwa ha Aforika Borwa ho ba moamohedi wa 2016 wa Kgau ya Tshebeletso e Ipabotseng ya Sedipolomate ke Lekgotla la Merero ya Lefatshe ho la Washington,DJwaloka naha ya pele ya Aforika ya ho amohela kgau ena, e ananela boitlamo bo babatsehang ba naha mabapi le thuto ya lefatshe, merero ya matjhaba le dikgokahanyo tsa lefatshe bakeng sa ho hodisa ditabatabelo tsa rona tsa naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana noMphathiswa wezeMpilo, uGq Aaron Motsoaledi, nothe wafumana imbasa yehlabathi i-USAID-TB ngenxa yendlela akhokele ngayo iphulo lehlabathi jikelele lokulwa isifo sephepha (i-TB) kwakunye nokuba nguvulindlela kumaphulo oMzantsi Afrika nawommandla ekuhlolweni, unyango nokuthintelwa kwe-TB usuleleko lwe-TB nayiNtsholongwane kaGawulayo (i-HIV) kunye ne-TB enganyangekiyo.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Letona la Dikamano tsa Matjhaba le Tshebedisano, Mofumahadi Maite Nkoana-Mashabane, bakeng sa nyehelo ya hae ho dipuisano tsa matjhaba tsa Aforika Borwa, tse kgannwang ke pono ya “kontinente ya Aforika e kopaneng e nang le kgotso, ya demokerasi, e hlokang semorabe, e hlokang kgethollo ya bong le e tswelang pele, le ho ba e nyehelang ho lefatshe le nang le toka le tekatekano.”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuphakanyiswa kwegama loMzantsi Afrika njengelizwe eliza kuwongwa ngeMbasa yeeNkonzo Zozakuzo ezikuDidi oluPhezulu liBhunga leMicimbi yeHlabathi eWashington DNjengelizwe lokuqala lase-Afrika ukufumana le mbasa, ingqina ukuzinikela okungathethekiyo kweli lizwe kwezemfundo yehlabathi jikelele, kwimicimbi yehlabathi nonxibelelwano nehlabathi ukuqhubela phambili iimfuno zethu zesizwe.

src: Kabinete e amohela thonyo ke Moporesidente Zuma ya Moatefokate Jan Lekhoa Mothibi, jwaloka Hlooho ya Lekala la Diphuputso tsa Sepolesa le Ikgethang, le ho mo lakaletsa tse molemo boikarabelong ba hae bo botjha ba ho lwantsa bobodu le tsamaiso e mamphemphe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imothulela umnqwazi uMphathiswa woBudlelwane bamaZwe ngamaZwe neNtsebenziswano, uNksz Maite Nkoana-Mashabane, ngegalelo lakhe kunxibelelwano loMzantsi Afrika namazwe ngamazwe, noluqhutywa ngumbono “welizwekazi le-Afrika elimanyeneyo nelinoxolo, elilawulwa ngentando yesininzi, olungenabuhlanga, olungenacalucalulo ngokwesini nelihlumayo, nelithi lenze igalelo kwihlabathi elilungileyo nekulinganwayo kulo.”.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso a tswang botebong ba pelo ho lelapa la Makwetu le Pan Africanist Congress ka ho hlokahala ha Monghadi Clarence Makwetu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuchongwa kuka-Advocate Jan Lekhoa Mothibi, njengentloko yeCandelo loPhando oluKhethekileyo (i-SIU) nguMongameli uZuma, kwaye imnqwenela okuhle kodwa kulo msebenzi wakhe umtsha wokulwa urhwaphilizo nolawulo olugwenxa.

src: Monghadi Makwetu o tla hopolwa ka nyehelo ya hae e matla le ho intsha sehlabelo bakeng sa mokgatlo wa tokoloho le ho thehwa ha Aforika Borwa e ntjha ya demokerasi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano kusapho lakwaMakwetu kunye nombutho i-Pan Africanist Congress ngokusweleka kukaMnu Clarence Makwetu.

src: Moporesidente o phatlaladitse Lepato le Ikgethang la Semmuso la Porofense bakeng sa mohale enwa wa ntwa ya tokoloho.
tgt: UMnu Makwetu uza kukhunjulwa ngegalelo lakhe elikhulukazi nokuzenza idini kumzabalazo wenkululeko nokusekwa koMzantsi Afrika omtsha wolawulo lwentando yesininzi.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso a yona a tswang botebong ba pelo ho lelapa la Naidoo ka ho hlokahala ha Monghadi Kumaran Naidoo.
tgt: UMongameli ubhengeze iinkonzo yoMngcwabo oseSikweni oKhethekileyo wePhondo kweli qhawe lomzabalazo wenkululeko.

src: Monghadi Naidoo e ne e le Motsamaisi-Kakaretso ya Tshwereng Mokobobo wa Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Moruo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano kusapho lakwaNaidoo ngokusweleka kukaMnu Kumaran Naidoo.

src: Pele o ne a sebetsa jwaloka Mohlanka ya ka Sehloohong wa Ditjhelete wa Lefapha la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri.
tgt: UMnu Naidoo ebenguMlawuli-Jikelele oliBambela weSebe loPhuhliso lwezoQoqosho.

src: Monghadi Naidoo o entse nyehelo e matla ho taolo ya ditjhelete ka hara Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba.
tgt: Ngaphambili ebesebenza njengeGosa lezeZimali eliyiNtloko leSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino.

src: Kabinete e hlahisa kananelo ya yona ka nyehelo e entsweng ke Monghadi William Smith, ya sebeditseng ho Bongodi ba Kabinete.
tgt: UMnu Naidoo ube negalelo elikhulukazi kulawulo lwezezimali kwiNkonzo kaRhulumente.

src: Monghadi Smith o behile meja fatshe mafelong a Tlhakubele kamora ho sebeletsa Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba dilemo tse 27.Kabinete e mo lakaletsa tse molemo phomolong ya hae.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ombulelo kwigalelo elenziwe nguMnu William Smith, obesenza kwiQonga looNobhala leKhabhinethi.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka Tlaleho ya Khomishene ya Dipatlisiso e mabapi le Dipelaelo tsa Boqhekanyetsi, Bobodu, Boitshwaro bo Bobe kapa Tsamaiso e Mpe ho Pakana ya Lewa la Ditheko la Tshireletso (Khomishene ya Ditheko tsa Dibetsa) e lokolotsweng ke Moporesidente hoseng hona.
tgt: UMnu Smith uthathe umhlala-phantsi ekupheleni kweyoKwindla emva kokuphangelela iNkonzo kaRhulumente iminyaka engama-27.

src: Tlaleho e fumane hore ha ho bopaki ba ketso e fosahetseng, tjotjo, boqhekanyetsi kapa bobodu tsamaisong ya theko ya dibetsa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imnqwenelela okuhle kodwa kumhlala-phantsi wakhe.

src: Re hlakotswe bobe kaha esale re bolela ka dilemo tse ngata hore ha ho letho le lebe le etsahetseng le hore theko ena e ne e se na WEBTOKEN tshepa hore sephetho se tla kwala taba ena e nkileng nako e WEBTOKEN kgema mmoho le Moporesidente Zuma mabapi le ho leboha Moahlodi Willie Seriti le Moahlodi Thekiso Musi, dipaki kaofela, ho kenyeletswa le Moporesidente wa mehleng Thabo Mbeki, baetapele ba bopaki, dihlopha tsa semolao, basebeletsi le ba nyehetseng bakeng sa ho etsa hore mosebetsi wa Khomishene o atlehe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe malunga neNgxelo yeKhomishini yoPhando malunga neziTyholo zobuQhetseba, uRhwaphilizo, iMposiso okanye iziPhene kwiSivumelwano seNtengo yeziXhobo zoMkhosi zobuChule (iKhomishini yeNtengo yeziXhobo) ethe yakhutshwa nguMongameli kusasa nje.

src: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di lokelwa ke ho netefatswa ha mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang.
tgt: Le Ngxelo ayifumanisanga bungqina bubonakalisa bugwenxa, kunyoba, buqhetseba okanye rhwaphilizo kwinkqubo yokuthengwa kwezixhobo.

src: Monghadi Siyabonga Gama jwaloka Mohlanka wa Phethahatso wa Sehlopha le Monghadi Garry Pita jwaloka Mohlanka ya ka Sehloohong wa Ditjhelete wa Sehlopha waTransnet.
tgt: NjengoRhulumente siyazamkela iziphumo zeKhomishini.

src: Monghadi Lufuno Leslie Nevhutalu jwaloka setho le Modulasetulo wa Boto ya Ntshetsopele ya Indaseteri ya Kaho.
tgt: Liye lahlanjwa igama lethu njengokuba besisoloko sisitsho kwiminyaka emininzi edlulileyo ukuba akukho bugwenxa kwaye le nkqubo yokuthengwa ibimsulwa ingenamakhwiniba.

src: Monghadi Andile Nongogo jwaloka Mohlanka ya ka Sehloohong wa Phethahatso wa Bolaodi ba Lekala la Ditshebeletso tsa Thuto.
tgt: Siyathemba ukuba ezi ziphumo ziza kuwuvala lo mba ubukade urhuqwa ixesha elide.

src: Ho kenngwa Tshebetsong ha Mananeo a Bohlokwa a Mmuso.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ezingundoqo.

src: Kabinete e amohela Leeto la Puso la Moporesidente Jacob Zuma la ho etela Rephaboliki ya maIsilamo ya Iran, le hodisang dikamano tsa moruo le kgwebisano dipakeng tsa dinaha ka bobedi, ka ho saenwa ha ditumellano le maitlamo a mmalwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalwamkela utyelelo lukaMongameli uJacob Zuma lwasebuRhulumenteni e-Islamic Republic of Iran, nolwandisa ubudlelwane bezoqoqosho norhwebo phakathi kwala mazwe omabini, ngokutyikitywa kwezivumelwano nezibhambathiso eziliqela.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma le Moporesidente Hasan Rouhani ba tiisitse tshebedisano-mmoho mapatlelong a kgwebisano, thuto le ntshetsopele ya maitsebelo saense le thekenoloji eneji, ho kenyeletswa le bokgoni ba ho tsoma kgase le ho e lokisetsa tshebediso temo merafo le bokgolamolemo ba diminerale ntshetsopele ya meralo ya motheo le dipalangwang ditjhelete, merero ya dibanka le inshorense le bohahlaudi.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma noMongameli uHasan Rouhani bayiqinisile intsebenziswano kumacandelo ezorhwebo, ezemfundo nophuhliso lwezakhono inzululwazi nobuchwepheshe ezamandla kuquka nokuhlolwa kwe-oli kunye namandla okucolwa kwayo ezolimo imigodi nezokuxhamlisa kwezemigodi uphuhliso lweziseko ezingundoqo kunye nezothutho ezezimali, ezebhanki neze-inshorensi nokhenketho.

src: E leng kaofela tse nyehelang ho Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP).Boemong ba tsa Matjhaba, baetapele ba babedi ba dumellane ka ho matlafatsa kgoeletso bakeng sa tlhabollo ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng ka ho qolleha Lekgotla la Tshireletso la UN, molemong wa lefatshe le ntseng le tswela pele.
tgt: Xa zizonke zenza igalelo ekuphunyezweni kwesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP).Kwimiba yezehlabathi, ezi nkokheli zimbini zivumelene ukuba makuqiniswe isimemo sokuhlaziywa nokuziza iinguqu kuMbutho weZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) ingakumbi iBhunga loKhuselo le-UN, ukuze lincede nezizwe ezinoqoqosho elisakhulayo.

src: Diphetho tsena di matlafaditse Leeto la Tshebetso la Moporesidente ho ya United Arab Emirates (UAE) moo dipuso ka bobedi di ntjhafaditseng boitlamo ba tsona ho lebiseng matlafatsong le kgodisong ya dikamano tsa bobedi, ka ho qolleha kgwebisanong, matseteng le mapatlelong a moruo hore e be bolekane ba lewa le pharalletseng.
tgt: Ezi ziphumo zomeleza uTyelelo lukaMongameli oluyiNxalenye yomsebenzi kwi-United Arab Emirates (i-AEU) apho omabini la mazwe ahlaziye khona isivumelwano sawo ekudibaniseni nasekuphakamiseni ubudlelwane benkululeko, ingakumbi kwezorhwebo, kwimiba yotyalo-mali neyezoqoqosho kubudlelwane bobuchule obudibeneyo.

src: Sena se ahella hodima Leeto la Puso la Moporesidente Jacob Zuma ka Pudungwana 2011 moo ho bonahetseng ho thehwa ha Khomishene e Kopanetsweng ya SA-UAE e akofisitseng lebelo la kgwebisano e phethahetseng dipakeng tsa dinaha tse pedi tsena ho tloha ho R13 bilione ka 2011 ho ya ho R27 bilione ka 2015.Aforika Borwa le UAE hape di dumellane ho eketsa tshebedisano-mmoho ho sebetsana le menyetla ho Moruo wa Lewatle, ho hodisa ho romellwa dinaheng tse ka ntle ha dihlahiswa tsa temo tsa Aforika Borwa, dihlahiswa tse entsweng difemeng mme ka ho qolleha theko ya tsa tshireletso le bomphato.
tgt: Oku kwakhela phezu koTyelelo lukaMongameli uJacob Zuma lwasebuRhulumenteni lwenyanga yeNkanga yowama-2011 nolwakhokelela ekusekweni kweKhomishini eDibeneyo yoMzantsi Afrika ne-Unite Arab Emirates olwathi lwakhawulezisa isantya esipheleleyo sorhwebo phakathi kwala mazwe mabini ukususela kwiibhiliyoni zeerandi ezili-13 ngowama-2011 ukuya kwiibhiliyoni zeerandin ezingama-27 ngowama-2015.UMzantsi Afrika ne-United Arab Emirates ukwavumelene ngokwandisa intsebenziswano yokusebenzisa ithuba elivela kuQoqosho laseLwandle, ukuthumela kumazwe angaphandle, iimveliso zezolimo zaseMzantsi Afrika, iimveliso ezenziweyo kwaye ngokukodwa ukuthengwa kwezixhobo zokhuselo nobudlelwane.

src: Leeto hape le hodisitse bokgoni ba Aforika Borwa ba ho aha meralo ya motheo ho shebanwe le menyetla bakeng sa dikhamphani tsa Aforika Borwa ho EXPO 2020 ho la Dubai, hammoho le tshebedisano-mmoho lepatlelong la kgotso le botsitso.
tgt: Olu tyelelo lukwakhuthaza ukuxhotyiswa kolwakhiwo lweziseko ezingundoqo olugxile ekunikeni iinkampani zaseMzantsi Afrika amathuba kwi-EXPO 2020 eDubai, kwakunye nentsebenziswano kwicandelo lezoxolo, ukhuseleko nozinzo.

src: Kabinete e amohetse mehato e tiileng e kentsweng tshebetsong ke Letona la Dipapadi le Boikgathollo Fikile Mbalula ho aha botjha maemo a qhetsohileng le ho ba le kgethollo e tebileng ho tsa dipapadi le boikgathollo ka tshebediso ya Tjhata ya Diphethoho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwamkele amanyathelo angqongqo athe amiselwa nguMphathiswa wezeMidlalo noLonwabo uFikile Mbalula ngokusebenzisa uXwebhu lweNguqu ukwakha ngokutsha imbonakalo yezemidlalo nolonwabo eqhekekileyo nenocalucalulo olunzulu.

src: Sena se tla akofisa diphethoho tse tla lebisang tsamaisong e kopaneng ya dipapadi e thehilweng hodima dipehelo tsa demokerasi, tekatekano, ponaletso le boemedi ho ya ka mekgahlelo e fapaneng ya setjhaba, phumantsho le bonkakarolo bo eketsehileng ho ipapisitswe le ditabatabelo tsa NDKabinete e amohela dipuo tsa ditekanyetso tse ntseng di tekwa ke mafapha a fapafapaneng le ditlaleho tse batsi tse supang kgatelopele e entsweng bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa bophelo ba maAforika Borwa.
tgt: Oku kuza kukhawulezisa inguqu ebhekisele kwinkqubo yezemidlalo emanyeneyo exhaswa yimigomo yolawulo lwentando yesininzi, umakulingwane, ukwenza elubala, ukuqinisekisa ukuba wonke ubani uthatha inxaxheba, ukufikelela nokwanda kokuthathwa kwenxaxheba ngokweenjongo ze-NDIKhabhinethi iyazamkela iingxoxo-mpikiswano zohlahlo lwabiwo-mali ezenziwa ngamasebe ngamasebe nengxelo ezingena nzulu ekucaciseni inkqubela eseyenziwe ukuphucula ubomi babemi baseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Sena se bontsha ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Moralo wa Lewa la Nako e Bohareng (MTSF) o re atametsang haufi le ho fihlellwa ha Pono ya 2030 ya NDP.
tgt: Oku kubonakalisa ukufezekiswa kweNkqubo-sikhokelo yesiCwangciso-qhinga sesiGaba esiPhakathi nesisisondeza ekufezekisweni koMbono wama-2030 wesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ho latela dipuo tsa ditekanyetso mapatlelong a fapafapaneng a boraditaba bakeng sa ho utlwisisa betere ka Lenaneo la Mmuso la Tshebetso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba bamamele futhi bazibukele ezi ngxoxo-mpikiswano zohlahlo lwabiwo-mali kuwo onke amajelo eendaba ukuze bayiqonde ngcono iNkqubo yokuSebenza kaRhulumente.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso bakeng sa boitlamo bo tswellang mabapi le diphetho tse bonahalang dibakeng tsa mosebetsi ho itshetlehilwe hodima diphetho ho tswa ho Tlaleho ya Selemo ka seng ya Khomishene ya bo-16 ya Tekatekano Mosebetsing bakeng sa bahiri ba tobilweng e thakgotsweng tlasa mookotaba “Diphethoho di bohlokwa kgwebong”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela ukuzibophelela okuqhubekayo ukwenza inguqu enentsingiselo emisebenzini ngenxa yeziphumo ezivela kwiNgxelo yoNyaka yeKhomishini ye-16 kaMakulingwane eMisebenzini kubo bonke abaqeshi abachongiweyo neyathi yamiselwa phantsi komxholo othi “Iinguqu zibalulekile”.

src: Tlaleho ena e thusa mmuso ho utlwisia maemo a tekatekano mosebetsing ka hara naha le kgatelopele ya yona ho diphethoho mosebetsing bakeng sa selemo sa 2015.
tgt: Le Ngxelo iyamnceda urhulumente ukuba abuqonde ubume bomakulingwane emisebenzini kweli lizwe nenkqubela yakhe ekwenziweni kwenguqu emisebenzini kunyaka wama-2015.

src: Kabinete e thoholeditse Lefapha la Bodulo ba Batho ka phano ya matlo a 4, 3 milione le menyetla ya matlo ho tloha mathwasong a demokerasi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana neSebe lezokuHlaliswa koLuntu ngokunikezela ngezigidi eziyi-4,3 zezindlu namathuba ezezindlu ukususela mhla kwafika ulawulo lwentando yesininzi.

src: Menyetla ena e kenyeletsa matlo a tsheheditsweng ka botlalo a 2, 806 235 (matlo a BNG), matlo a hiriswang/kahisano a 121 784, a 6329 a Lenaneo le Hoketsweng ho Ditshehetso tsa Ditjhelete tsa ka Bomong le ditentshe tse nang le ditshebeletso tse 986 608.Mokolokotwane ona o etsang nalane o fane ka bodulo ho batho ba fetang 20 milione mme ho keteka phihlello ena mmuso o thakgotse letsholo la naha la ho bontsha katleho ya naha.
tgt: La mathuba aquka izindlu zenkxaso epheleleyo ezingama-2, 806 235 (izindlu ze-BNG), izindlu zezentlalo/zokurenta ezingama-121 784, izindlu zeNkqubo yeNkxaso-mali yoMntu ngaMnye ezingama-121 784 kunye neziza ezifumana iinkonzo ezingundoqo ezingama-986 608.Le mpumelelo iyimbali ibonelele ngezindlu abantu abangaphezulu kwezigidi ezingama-20 kwaye ukubhiyozela le mpumelelo isebe limisele iphulo lesizwe lokubonakalisa le mpumelelo yesizwe.

src: Ho thakgolwa ha morero ona wa naha ho etsahetse COSMO City, e leng e nngwe ya diporojeke tse kopanetsweng tse ka sehloohong ho potoloha le naha eo hape e ketekang dilemo tse leshome e le teng.
tgt: Oku kumiselwa kwesizwe kwenzeke e-COSMO City, neyenye yeeprojekthi eziphambili ezidibeneyo kwilizwe jikelele nekwabhiyozela iminyaka elishumi yabakho.

src: Kabinete e lebohile maAforika Borwa kaofela bakeng sa dinyehelo tsa ona, boitelo le mosebetsi o matla wa ho netefatsa hore seriti sa maAforika Borwa a hlokang se babaletswe ka bodulo ba batho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibulela bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ngegalelo labo, lokuzinikela nokusebenza kwabo ngamandla ekuqinisekiseni ukuba isidima sabemi baseMzantsi Afrika abahlelelekileyo siyabuyiselwa ngezokuhlaliswa koluntu.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Mongodikakaretso wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng ka ho hlophisa Mokete wa Maemo a Hodimo wa ho Saena Tumellano ya Paris, e amohetsweng ke Mekga e 176 ka Tshitwe 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamncoma uNobhala Jikelele weZizwe eziManyeneyo ngokuqhuba uMsitho wokuTyikitya okwiNqanaba eliPhezulu wesiVumelwano saseParis, nesithe samkelwa ngaMazwe angamaLungu ali-176 kweyoMnga yowama-2015.

src: Ho saenwa ha Tumellano ya Paris ho tshwaile mohato wa pele ho kenngweng tshebetsong ha yona o tla tataisa mekutu ya matjhaba ya ho fokotsa ho ntshwa ha dikgase tse kotsi le ho mekamekana le diphephetso kaofela tse amanang le ho fetofetoha ha tlelaemete.
tgt: Ukutyikitywa kwesiVumelwano saseParis kuphawula inyathelo lokuqala ekuphunyezweni kwaso nokuzakukhokela amalinge ehlabathi ekunciphiseni ukukhutshwa kweegesi ezingcolisa umoya nokukwazi ukulwa imingeni ehambelana nako ebangelwa kukuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu.

src: Kabinete e lebeletse ka tshepo sephetho sa ditsamaiso tsa tiisetso tsa lehae, ke bohle, ho thusa hore ho be le ho kenngwa ka nako ka botlalo ha Tumellano ya Paris ka 2020.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikulinde ngomdla ukuqukunjelwa kweenkqubo zokugunyaziswa zalapha ekhaya, ngawo onke, ukuvumela ukungena kwangexesha ukwenzela ukufezekiswa ngokupheleleyo kwesiVumelwano saseParis ngowama-2020.

src: Kabinete hape e ananetse hore Lefapha la Merero ya Tikoloho le entse semphato le Lefapha la Bohahlaudi bakeng sa ho fana ka dilaboratori tsa sehlooho se reng “Biodiversity Lab: Re hodisa nyehelo ya moruo ya mehlodi ya Aforika Borwa ya tlhaho” ho tloha ka la 10 Mmesa ho isa la 13 Motsheanong 2016.Sepheo ke ho elellwa bokgoni ba moruo ba diphapang tsa tlhaho tse ruileng tsa Aforika Borwa tse tekilweng ho moralo wa Lewa la Naha la Moruo wa Tlhaho o tjhaelletsweng monwana ke Kabinete ka Phupu 2015 hore setjhaba se nke karolo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwaqaphela ukuba iSebe lezeNdalo lizibandakanye neSebe lezoKhenketho ekuqaliseni iilebhu zokubonelela ezinesihloko esithi “iLebhu yeNzululwazi ngeZilwanyana neziTyalo: Ikhulisa igalelo loqoqosho lwemithombo yobunzululwazi ngezilwanyana nezityalo yaseMzantsi Afrika” ukususela ngomhla we-10 kuTshazimpuzi ukuya kowe-13 kwekaCanzibe yowama-2016.Injongo kukuphumeza amandla oqoqosho lobutyebi bezenzululwazi ngezilwanyana nezityalo zaseMzantsi Afrika achazwe kuyilo lwesiCwangciso-qhinga soQoqosho lweNzululwazi ngeziLwanyana neziTyalo seSizwe esiphunyezwe yiKhabhinethi kweyeKhala yowama-2015 ukwenzela ukuthatha inxaxheba koluntu.

src: Diqeto tsa bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Izigqibo zeKhabhinethi ezingundoqo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Moralo wa Tshebetso wa Leano la Diindaseteri (IPAP) 2016/17 – 2018/19, e leng tshiya ya bohlokwa ya Moralo wa Dintlha tse Robong wa Moporesidente o lebisang ho kenngweng tshebetsong ha NDP.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isamkele isiCwangciso soMgaqo-nkqubo wokuSebenza kwezoShishino (i-IPAP) sowama-2016/17 – 2018/19, nesiyintsika engundoqo yesiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba sikaMongameli kwaye senza igalelo ekuphunyezweni kwesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso.

src: Sena ke ho phetwa ka tatelano ha borobedi ha selemo ka seng ha meralo ya mmuso ya akofiso ya diindaseteri ho ahellang hodima diphihlello, mapatlelo a leano le mananeo a ho phetwa ho fetileng.
tgt: Oku kukuphindaphindwa kwaminyaka le kwesibhozo kwesicwangciso sikarhulumente semizi-mveliso esiyimpumelelo nesakhelwa kwiimpumelelo, amaqonga emigaqo-nkqubo neenkqubo zokuphindaphindwa kwangaphambili.

src: IPAP 2016/17 e rerile ho fihlella leano la diindaseteri le nang le kgahlamelo e batlang e phahame maemong a boima a moruo.
tgt: I-IPAP yowama-2016/17 iinjongo zayo kukwenza impembelelo enkulu kumgaqo-nkqubo wezoshishino phantsi kweemeko ezinzima zezoqoqosho.

src: Tsena di kenyeletsa dikgahlamelo tse ntseng di tswela pele tsa ho thefuleha ha moruo wa lefatshe ho kenyeletswa le koduwa ya diindaseteri tsa tshepe le ho putlama ha thepa hammoho le komello e matla le mathata a mang a ka lapeng.
tgt: Ekukho phakathi kwazo impembelelo eqhubekayo yokudodobala kwezoqoqosho kwihlabathi jikelele kuquka iimeko emaxongo kurhwebo lwezesinyithi kunye nezimbiwa kwakunye nembalela enkulu neminye imiqobo ebalulekileyo yalapha ekhaya.

src: Diphihlello tsa ho tswa selemong se fetileng di kenyeletsa ho baballwa ha mesebetsi e ka bang 67 000 le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi e hlamatsehang e metjha e ballwang ho 7 000 lekaleng la Diaparo le Masela le Dieta.
tgt: Imisebenzi eyimpumelelo yonyaka ophelileyo iquka ukusindiswa kwemisebenzi emalunga nama-67 000 nokudalwa kwemisebenzi emitsha endilisekileyo ethelekelelwa kuma-7 000 kwicandelo leMpahla nelezeziKhumba neZihlangu.

src: Lekala la tlatsetso la dihlahiswa tsa Temo ke le leng la makala a maholo a tlhahiso la phano ya mesebetsi, e ballwang ho mesebetsi e 216 090 ka 2015 ha ho bapiswa le e 208 822 ka 2014.Matsete a boleng ba R600 milione a ile a hohelwa ka 2015/16, mme a etsa motheo bakeng sa ho matlafatsa ntshetsopele ya kgwebo ho tsepamisitswe maikutlo hodima badudi ba mahaeng.
tgt: Icandelwana elisebenza phantsi kokucolwa nokulungiswa kweemveliso zezolimo lelinye lamacandelo okuvelisa amakhulu apha ekhaya ngokwengqesho, abonelela ngemisebenzi ethelekelelwa kuma-216 090 ngowama-2015 xa kuthelekiswa nama-208 822 ngowama-2014.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Moralo o Kopanetsweng wa Ntshetsopele ya Ditoropo wa ho Phethela le Moralo wa ho Kenya Tshebetsong wa 2016/19.
tgt: Lutyalo-mali olungaphezulu kwezigidi ezingama-600 zeerandi athe atsalwe ngowama-2015/16, elusisiseko sokomeleza uphuhliso lwamashishini amancinci olugxile kuluntu lwasemaphandleni.

src: Sephetho ka kakaretso sa Moralo o Kopanetsweng wa Ntshetsopele ya Ditoropo ke ho fetola qaqolohano ya dibaka tsa bodulo.
tgt: Khabhinethi iyamkele iNkqubo-sikhokelo yokuGqibela yoPhuhliso lweeDolophu oluDibeneyo nesiCwangciso sokuPhumeza sowama-2016/19.

src: Sena se tshwaya tsamaiso e ntjha ya metsemeholo le ditoropo tsa Aforika Borwa, sena se tla tataisetsa kgolo ya ditoropo ho lebiseng ho motlolo wa kgolo wa moshwelella o kopaneng, o hokahanyang le ho kopanya metsemeholo le ditoropo, tse bolokehileng, tse nang le mehlodi e hlwahlwa le ho ba dibaka tse ntle tsa ho sebetsa le ho dula ho tsona.
tgt: Iziphumo ezipheleleyo zeNkqubo –sikhokelo yoPhuhliso lweDolophu oludibeneyo yinguqu ngokwabala omhlaba.

src: Sena se arabela ho taelo ya NDP la ho hodisa leano la ntshetsopele ya ditoropo le tla netefatsa moralo o nepahetseng, matsete a meralo ya motheo le taolo ya ho tshehetsa bokgoni ba kgolo le ho bula bokgoni ba moruo ba metsemeholo le ditoropo tsa rona.
tgt: Oku kuza notshintsho olutsha kwizixeko needolophu zaseMzantsi Afrika, nokuza kuqhubela uhlumo lwasezidolophini kwindlela eluqilima yohlumo oluzinzileyo, iqhagamshelanise ize iququzelele izixeko needolophu, neziyindawo ekhuselekileyo, ezinemithombo esebenzayo futhi neziyindawo elungileyo ukuba umntu angasebenza ahlale kuzo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Moralo wa Leano la Naha la Ntshetsopele ya Ditshebeletso tsa Makala a Thuto – Re aha Tsamaiso e hlwahlwa le e Kopanetsweng ya Ntshetsopele ya Ditshebeletso tsa Makala a Thuto bakeng sa Aforika Borwa, Koranteng ya Mmuso bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: Oku kusabela kumyalelo wesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso wokuqulunqa umgaqo-nkqubo wophuhliso lwedolophu oza kuqinisekisa ngokucwangcisa okufanelekileyo, utyalo-mali kwiziseko ezingundoqo nolawulo lokuxhasa uhlumo nokuvulela amandla ezoqoqosho lwezixeko needolophu.

src: Moralo ona wa Leano hang feela ha o kentswe tshebetsong o tla fana ka katamelo e kopanetsweng bakeng sa ditshebeletso tsa ntshetsopele ya makala a thuto a boleng bakeng sa baahi kaofela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukupapashwa kweDrafti yoMgaqo-nkqubo weSizwe weeNkonzo zoPhuhliso lwamaKhondo – uKwakhela uMzantsi Afrika iNkqubo esebenzayo neDibeneyo yeeNkonzo zoPhuhliso lwamaKhondo, kwiPhephandaba loMbuso ukwenzela ukuba uluntu luhlomle.

src: Sena se tla ba thusa ho etsa diqeto tse kgabane tsa makala a thuto hore ba thole mesebetsi, ba nyehele setjhabeng le ho aha moruo wa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Le drafti yoMgaqo-nkqubo xa sele iphunyeziwe iza kubonelela ngendlela edibeneyo yeenkonzo zophuhliso lwamakhondo asemgangathweni kubo bonke abemi.

src: Ditshebeletso tsa Ntshetsopele ya Makala a Thuto di bapala karolo ya bohlokwa mabapi le ho thusa mebaraka ya rona ya mosebetsi hore e sebetse le hore mekgwa ya thuto e fihlelle merero ya yona.
tgt: Oku kuza kubenza bakwazi ukuthatha izigqibo zokukhetha amakhondo afanelekileyo ukuze bakwazi ukufumana imisebenzi, benze igalelo kuluntu nasekwakheni uqoqosho lwaseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Sena se nyehela ho lebiseng ha phihlello ya dikgothaletso tsa NDP tsa ho hlasimolla kgolo ya moruo le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi, le ho matahanya basebeletsi le mesebetsi e loketseng eo ba e etsang le ho eketsa ntshetsopele ya maitsebelo le palo ya ba nang le mangolo a diyunivesithi.
tgt: IiNkonzo zoPhuhliso lwamaKhondo zidlala indima engundoqo ekuncedeni umsebenzi wokubonelela ngemisebenzi nenkqubo yezemfundo ukuba zifikelele kwiinjongo zazo ezijongise kuzo.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Tsamaiso ya Naha ya Tekolo le ho tjhaella monwana Tlaleho ya Selemo ka seng ya 2014/15 le Moralo wa Naha wa Tekolo bakeng sa 2016/17 ho ya ho 2018/19, jwaloka karolo ya boikitlaetso ba ho ntlafatsa phano ya ditshebeletso.
tgt: Oku kwenza igalelo ekuphumezeni izindululo zesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso sokukhuthaza uhlumo lwezoqoqosho nemisebenzi, ukuthelekisa abasebenzi abaphangelayo nemisebenzi nokwandiswa kophuhliso lwezakhono kunye noninzi lwabo banezidanga zasedyunivesiti.

src: Tsamaiso ya Naha ya Tekolo e tswa ho Moralo wa Leano la Naha la Tekolo o netefatsang hore bopaki bo tshepahalang le bo hlokang tshekamelo ho tswa ho ditekolo bo kenyeletswa tsamaisong ya ho etsa meralo, ho etsa ditekanyetso tsa ditjhelete, ntlafatso ya mekgatlo, tjhebo-botjha ya maano, hammoho le lenaneo le tswellang le taolo ya diporojeke ka morero wa ho ntlafatsa tshebetso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngokuphunyezwa kweNkqubo yoVavanyo yeSizwe yaza yamkela iNgxelo yonyaka wama-2014/15 kunye nesiCwangciso soVavanyo seSizwe sesihlanu seminyaka yowama-2016/17 ukuya kowama-2018/19, njengenxalenye yendlela yokuphucula unikezela lweenkonzo.

src: Meralo ya ntlafatso e 14 e ntse e kenngwa tshebetsong mme kgatelopele ho tsena e bontsha diphethoho tse hlamatsehang, bakeng sa ho pharalatsa sekgahla.
tgt: INkqubo yoVavanyo yeSizwe ivela kwiNkqubo-sikhokelo yoMgaqo-nkqubo woVavanyo weSizwe oqinisekisa ukuba ubungqina bovavanyo obuthembakeleyo nobungakhethe-cala buyafakwa kwiinkqubo zokucwangcisa, ukwenza uhlahlo lwabiwo-mali, ukuphuculwa kweziko, uhlaziyo lomgaqo-nkqubo, kwakunye nolawulo lwenkqubo oluqhubekayo nolawulo lweprojekthi ukuze kuphuculwe indlela ekusetyenzwa ngayo.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka diphetho tsa tekolo le ho tjhaella monwana dikgothaletso ka morero wa ho eketsa sekgahla ho tswa ho ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Lekala la Kahisano la Lenaneo la Katoloso ya Mesebetsi ya Setjhaba (EPWP-SS).Lenaneo lena le bapala karolo ya bohlokwa bakeng sa tshireletso ya kahisano bakeng sa batho ba baholo ba ntseng ba itekanetse ba sa sebetseng, ka ho ba hulela mosebetsing o nang le tlhahiso le ho amohela ditlhapiso tsa kgwedi ka palohare ya tjhelete e etsang R1 517.
tgt: Luvavanyo olungama-47 eselugqityiwe okanye olusaqhutywayo, lubandakanya imali ezibhiliyoni ezingama-75 zeerandi enkcitho karhulumente.

src: Boholo ba mananeo a lekala la kahisano a fana ka ditshebeletso tse ikgethang ho badudi ba kotsing le ba fumanehileng.
tgt: Zingxelo zovavanyo ezili-15 esezamkelwe ize ibe zezi-12 ezithiwe theca phambi kweKhabhinethi ukuza kutsho ngoku.

src: EPWP-SS e hotse ka potlako pakeng tsa mokgahlelo wa pele le wa bobedi, ho tloha ho mananeo a 5 ho isa ho a 22 a bakileng hore lekala le fihlelle menyetla ya mesebetsi e 175 769 mokgahlelong wa pele le menyetla e 866 246 mokgahlelong wa bobedi, e leng se ka nqane ho sepheo sa 750 000.Dikgothaletso di tsepamisitse maikutlo hodima ntlafatso ya ho kenngwa tshebetsong bakeng sa ho fokotsa dikgaello tabeng ya ho etsa diqeto, ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha (ditefello le ditlhapiso) le phano ya thupello, hammoho le kgokahano.
tgt: Izicwangciso zokuphucula ezili-14 ziyaphunyezwa kwaye inkqubela kuzo ibonakalisa iinguqu ezinkulu, ukuvula umsantsa wempembelelo.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka diphetho le ho tiisetsa dikgothaletso tsa moralo le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha tekolo ya Thuso ya Ditjhelete ya Ntshetsopele ya Bodulo ba Ditoropong le Moralo wa Ntlafatso ya tsona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngeziphumo zovavanyo nezindululo ezamkelweyo ngenjongo yokwandisa impembelelo yokuphunyezwa kweCandelo lezeNtlalo leNkqubo yeMisebenzi yoLuntu eNatyisiweyo (i-EPWP-SS).

src: Diphetho di tshehetsa ho baballwa ha Thuso ya Ditjhelete ya Ntshetsopele ya Ditoropo jwaloka thuso ya tshehetso e thusang ka matlole mohopolo wa bodulo ba batho ba moshwelella le bo lekalekanang molemong wa bafumanehi le malapa a lekeno le mahareng.
tgt: Le Nkqubo idlala indima ebalulekileyo kukhuseleko lwezentlalo lwabantu abadala abakwaziyo ukusebenza abangaphangeliyo, ngokubatsalela kumsebenzi onenkqubela baze bafumene ukuvuzwa kwenyanga okungumyinge we-R 1 517.

src: Sena ke sa bohlokwa bakeng sa ho fihlella merero ho tswa ho Moralo wa Lewa la Nako e Bohareng phano ya menyetla e 1 495 milione ya bodulo ditikolohong tsa boleng ka 2019.
tgt: Uninzi lweenkqubo zecandelo lezentlalo zibonelela ngeenkonzo ezikhethekileyo kuluntu oluhlelelekileyo noluhluphekayo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana tlaleho ya Ho kenngwa Tshebetsong le Tekolo ya Kgahlamelo ya Thekenoloji le Mehlodi ya Batho bakeng sa Lenaneo la Diindaseteri, karabelo ya botsamaisi ho tlaleho le moralo wa ntlafatso o kentsweng ke Lefapha la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri.
tgt: I-EPWP-SS ikhule ngokuphindaphindeneyo phakathi kwesigaba sokuqala nesigaba sesibini, ukususela kwiinkqubo ezintlanu ukuya kwezi ngama-22 nezikhokelele ekubeni eli candelo lifikelele kumathuba emisebenzi engama-175 769 kwisigaba sokuqala namathuba emisebenzi engama-866 246 kwisigaba sesibini, ngaphezulu kakhulu kuma-750 000 ebesizimisele kuwo.

src: Lenaneo lena le ile la hlahiswa ke Lefapha la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri ka 1992 ho matlafatsa ntshetsopele ya maitsebelo ho tsa saense, boenjinere le thekenoloji.
tgt: Ezi zindululo zigxile ekuphuculeni ukuphunyezwa ukuze kunciphe ukungathathwa kakuhle kwezigqibo, ukuphunyezwa (iintlawulo nokuvuzwa) nokubonelelwa koqeqesho, kwakunye nokuququzelela.

src: Le nyehela ho tlhahiso ya mesebetsi ka ho hlahisa phallo ya bafuputsi ba nang le maitsebelo a maholo le batsamaisi ba thekenoloji bakeng sa diindaseteri le ho ntlafatsa bophehisani ba mekgatlo ya kgwebo e nkang karolo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngeziphumo yaza yazivuma izindululo zokuyilwa nokuphunyezwa kovavanyo lweSibonelelo soPhuhliso lezokuHlaliswa eziDolophini neSicwangciso sokuPhuculwa kwaso.

src: Lenaneo lena ke la sebele, la bohlokwa le ho ba ntlha e hlwahlwa ya tshehetso ya ntjhafatso e fanang ka boleng ba tjhelete bo hlamatsehang ka bobedi mabapi le ntshetsopele ya thekenoloji le ho ntshetsapele mehlodi ya batho le maitsebelo a tsamaelanang le diindaseteri.
tgt: Ezi ziphumo zixhasa ukugcinwa kweSibonelelo soPhuhliso lezokuHlaliswa eziDolophini njegesibonelelo soxabangelo nesiyinkxaso-mali yombono obanzi wezokuhlaliswa koluntu ozinzileyo nolinganayo ukwenzela ukuba kuxhamle abahluphekileyo namakhaya amkela imivuzo ephakathi.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka diphetho tsa dipatlisiso tsa Tlaleho ya Moifo wa Tshebetso wa Matona mabapi le dipelaelo tsa ‘thekiso ya dikgeo tsa mosebetsi tsa matitjhere’ tse amang batho ka bo mong, mekgatlo ya matitjhere le bahlanka ba Mafapha a itseng a Thuto a Diporofense.
tgt: Oku kuyanceda ekufikeleleni kummiselo ovela lwiNkqubo-sikhokelo yesiCwangciso-qhinga sesiGaba esiphakathi ukubonelela ngamathuba ezindlu azizigidi ezi-1 495 kwimeko yezokusingqongileyo yokuhlala okusemgangathweni ngowama-2019.

src: Kabinete e ile ya thathiselletsa dikgothaletso tsa ho sebetsa hantle le ho tobana le diphetho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele ingxelo engokuphunyezwa nokuVavanywa kweMpembelelo yezobuChwepheshe nemiCimbi yezaBasebenzi yeNkqubo yezoShishino, indlela abalawuli abayihlangabeza ngayo le ngxelo nesiCwangciso sokuphucula esifakwe liSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino.

src: Tlaleho ya ho Qetela ya Moifo wa Tshebetso wa Matona e fana ka thunthetso ya karolo e bapetsweng ke bankakarolo bohle tsamaisong ya thonyo le ho thaothwa ha matitjhere.
tgt: Le Nkqubo yaveliswa liSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino ngowe-1992 ukomeleza uphuhliso lwezakhono kwezenzulu-lwazi, ezobunjineli nobuchwepheshe.

src: Hape e ananela mathata a maholo tsamaisong ya hajwale ya dithonyo dikgeong tsa mosebetsi lekaleng la thuto ya motheo le ho fana ka dikgothaletso ho thusa Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo le lekala la thuto ya motheo ka kakaretso ho sebetsana le diphephetso tse hlwailweng.
tgt: Yenza igalelo ekudalweni kwemisebenzi ngokuvelisa igquba labaphandi-nzulu abanezakhono ezikudidi oluphezulu nabalawuli bezobuchwepheshe boshishino nangokuphucula ukukhuphisana kwemibutho yamashishini athatha inxaxheba.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa ha Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Naha ya Meru Palamenteng.
tgt: Le Nkqubo iyasebenza, ibalulekile kwaye iluphawu olusebenzayo kwinkxaso yokuvelisa izinto ezintsha ebonelela ngexabiso elivakalayo ngemali ngokophuhliso lwezobuchwepheshe nophuhliso lwemicimbi yezabasebenzi nezakhono ezihambelana noshishino.

src: 84 wa 1998).Ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha dihlomathiso ho tla ntlafatsa taolo ya moshwelella ya meru le hape ho kgothaletsa bonkakarolo ba dihlopha tse kotsing, tse itshetlehileng hodima tjalo ya meru bakeng sa bophelo ba tsona, ka hara Lekgotla la Naha la Boeletsi la Meru.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngeziphumo zeNgxelo yeQela loMphathiswa eliphanda ngezityholo ‘zokuthengiswa kwezithuba zootitshala’ ezibandakanya abantu abathile, imibutho yootitshala namagosa wamaSebe ezeMfundo kuMaphondo athile.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka meralo ya Lefapha la Bonono le Botjhaba ya ho tshwara mokete wa Kgwedi ya Aforika ka Motsheanong 2016 tlasa mookotaba: “Re aha Aforika e Betere le Lefatshe le Betere” jwaloka karolo ya kontinente ya ho keteka ho thehwa ha Kopano ya Mokgatlo wa Aforika, oo hajwale e leng Kopano ya Aforika le mosebetsi oo e o entseng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukungeniswa koMthetho siHlomelo wezamaHlathi weSizwe ePalamente.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o tla thakgola Kgwedi ya Aforika ka Letsatsi la Naha la Thapelo ka la 29 Mmesa 2016.Ka 2016 Kgwedi ya Aforika e tla tsepamisa maikutlo hodima boikitlaetso ba ntshetsopele ya basadi le batjha, ha re ntse re hopola selemo sa bo-60 sa Mohwanto wa Basadi le selemo sa bo-40 sa Merusu ya Batjha ya Soweto.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uhlomela uMthetho wezamaHlathi weSizwe, we-1998 (uMthetho onguNombolo 84 we-1998).Ukuphunyezwa kwezi zihlomelo kuza kuphucula ulawulo lwezamahlathi oluzinzileyo kukhuthaze nokuthatha inxaxheba kwabahlelelekileyo, abaxhomekeke kwezamahlathi ukuze baphila, bathathe inxaxheba kwiBhunga leeNgcebiso lezamaHlathi leSizwe.

src: MaAforika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho nka karolo lenaneong lena la dintlha tse ngata le kenyeletsang diketsahalo tse pharaletseng tse akgang ka hare bonono ba pono, theatara, mmino, dithuto le dipuisano hammoho le sehopotso sa bo-10 sa Letlole la Lefatshe la Lefa.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kuzimasa umsitho wokubekwa esihlalweni nokufungiswa kukaMongameli uYoweri Museveni wase-Uganda eKampala ngomhla we-12 kuCanzibe wama-2016.

src: Kgwedi ya Aforika e sebetsa jwaloka lepatlelo la ho kopana botjha le ho itlama botjha ho boAforika le Tsoseletso ya Aforika ka ho etsa hore batho ba kontinente ba atamelane ho feta.
tgt: Olu tyelelo luphumayo luza kuqhubeka ukomeleza ubudlelwane bala mazwe mabini, uMzantsi Afrika ne-Uganda.

src: Ka la 20 Motsheanong 2016 mmuso o tla etella pele mokete wa naha wa dilemo tse lekgolo wa Yunivesithi ya Fort Hare khemapaseng ya Alice ho la Kapa Botjhabela.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kukhokela uSuku loMthandazo leSizwe eliza kubanjelwa kumaBala ase-ABSA eDurban ngomhla wama-29 kuTshazimpuzi wama-2016.

src: Bakeng sa boitokisetso ba mokete o moholo, Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o thehile Komiti ya Matona (IMC) ho rera le ho hokahanya mokete ona o etsang nalane wa dilemo tse lekgolo.
tgt: Iinkokheli zakwaLizwi kunye neenkokheli zemibutho yoluntu ziza kuzibandakanya norhulumente ekuthandazeleni ukuqhubeka komanyano lwentando yesininzi, umanyano lwesizwe, intlalo- ntle kwakunye noNyulo looRhulumente beeNgingqi lowama-2016 oluza kuba noxolo futhi lube yimpumelelo.

src: Setheo sena sa thuto se etsang nalane se sebeditse jwaloka mokolokotwane nakong ya ntwa ya tokoloho mme hape e tsebahala jwaloka “pitsa ya boetapele ba Aforika” hape e le setsi sa thuto sa mehleng sa batho bao e neng e le bahale ba ntwa kgahlanong le mmuso wa kgethollo ba kang ZK Matthews, Nelson Mandela, Robert Sobukwe, Oliver Tambo le Govan Mbeki.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngezicwangciso zeSebe lezobuGcisa neNkcubeko zokusingatha iNyanga ye-Afrika kuCanzibe yowama-2016 phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukwakha i-Afrika eNgcono neHlabathi eliNgcono” njengenxalenye yemibhiyozo yelizwekazi yokusekwa koMbutho weManyano ye-Afrika (i-OAU), ngoku ebizwa ngokuba yiMbumba yaMazwe ase-Afrika (i-AU) kunye nemisebenzi eyenzileyo.

src: Ke yona feela yunivesithi ya Aforika e Borwa e hlahisitseng dihlooho tsa puso tse hlano: Nelson Mandela wa Aforika Borwa, Yusuf Lule wa Uganda, Robert Mugabe wa Zimbabwe, Ntsu Mokhehle wa Lesotho le Sir Seretse Khama wa Botswana.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kumphehlelela iNyanga ye-Afrika ngoSuku loMthandazo leSizwe ngomhla wama-29 kuTshazimpuzi yowama-2016.Ngowama-2016 iNyanga ye-Afrika iza kugxila kumalinge wophuhliso lwabantu basetyhini nolutsha, ngeli xesha siza kube sibhiyozela unyaka wama-60 woMngcelele wooMama nonyaka wama-40 woVukelo loLutsha eSoweto.

src: Jwaloka karolo ya ho keteka dilemo tse lekgolo tsa Yunivesithi ya Fort Hare Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho Baithuti ba Mehleng le ditho tsa setjhaba ho arolelana mehopolo ya bona ya Fort Hare bakeng sa letsholo la Re arolele Pale ya Hao ka ho sebedisa hashtag #MyFortHare.
tgt: Abemi baseMzantsi Afrika bayabongozwa ukuba bathathe inxaxheba kule nkqubo iqulathe iindidi ngeendidi zemisitho nemibhiyozo equka eyobugcisa obubonwayo, izifundo ngedrama, umculo, izifundo neentetho eziqhelekileyo kwakunye ngesikhumbuzo seminyaka eli-10 yeNgxowa-mali yamaFa eHlabathi ase-Afrika.

src: Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa o tla etella pele kemedi ya Aforika Borwa ho Foramo ya bo-26 ya Moruo wa Lefatshe (WEF) ya Aforika ho la Rwanda pakeng tsa la 11 le 13 Motsheanong 2016.
tgt: Le Nyanga ye-Afrika isebenza njengeqonga lokuqhagamshelanisa ngokutsha nokuzibophelela kwethu ngokutsha kuko konke okusenza sibe ngama-Afrika neBuyambo yase-Afrika ngokudibanisa abantu belizwekazi basondelelane.

src: Foramo e tla tshwarwa tlasa mookotaba: “Re hokahanya Mehlodi ya Aforika ka Diphethoho tsa Dijithale”.Mmuso ka Moralo wa ona wa Dintlha tse Robong o ntshetsapele diphethoho tsa ona tsa dijithale.
tgt: Ngomhla wama-20 kuCanzibe wama-2016 urhulumente uza kukhokela umbhiyozo wesizwe wokugqiba kweDyunivesithi iFort Hare iminyaka elikhulu yabakho kwiziko layo eliseDikeni eMpuma Koloni.

src: E fana ka mokgahlelo wa pele wa boikitlaetso ba marangrang a phatlaletseng a tla hokela ditheo tsa mmuso tse 5 000 ka hara bomasepala ba setereke ba robedi nakong ya dilemo tse tharo.
tgt: Ukulungiselela umsitho omkhulu wokubhiyoza, uMongameli uJacob Zuma umisele iKomiti yabaPhathiswa (i-IMC) ukuba yenze izicwangciso ize iququzelele lo mbhiyozo wenkulungwane uyimbali.

src: INDABA 2016 e tla tshwarwa Setsheng sa Dikopano sa Inkosi Albert Luthuli ho la Durban ho tloha ka la 7 ho isa ho la 9 Motsheanong 2016, ke lepatlelo la Bo-Aforika le tla kgothaletsa dihlahiswa tsa bohahlaudi ho bareki ba matjhaba.
tgt: Eli ziko lemfundo liyimbali belisebenza njengenqaba yethemba ngexesha lomzabalazo wethu wenkululeko kwaye laziwa “njengeziko lokupheka iinkokeli ze-Afrika” libe liyidyunivesithi ekwakufundwa kuyo ziinkokheli ezazikumzabalazo wokulwa ucalucalulo ezifana neengqanga oo-ZK Matthews, Nelson Mandela, Robert Sobukhwe, Oliver Tambo noGovan Mbeki.

src: Bohahlaudi, jwaloka e nngwe ya ditshiya tse tsheletseng tsa kgolo ya NDP, bo nyehetse R357 bilione ho GDP ya rona ka 2014 le ho tshehetsa diphesente tse 9 tsa mesebetsi ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Kuphela kwedyunivesithi yaseMazantsi e-Afrika evelise iintloko zoorhulumente ezintlanu: uNelson Mandela waseMzantsi Afrika, uYusuf Lule wase-Uganda, uRobert Mugabe waseZimbabwe, uNtsu Mokhehle waseLesotho no-Sir Seretse Khama waseBotswana.

src: Lekgotla la Lefatshe la Boeti le Bohahlaudi le akanya hore bohahlaudi bo tla nyehela R560 bilione ho GDP ya rona ka 2025 mme e tla tshehetsa mesebetsi e fetang dimilione tse pedi.
tgt: Njengenxalenye yemibhiyozo yenkulungwane iDyunivesithi iFort Hare iKhabhinethi imema bonke abantu ababefunda kule dyunivesithi noluntu jikelele ukuba babalisane ngeenkumbulo zabo ngedyunivesithi iFort Hare nephulo likaBalisa iBali Lakho ngokusebenzisa i- #MyFortHare.

src: Kgodiso ya kgahlamelo ya Bohahlaudi ho Moruo wa Mawatle ke tshiya e hlokolosi ya Moralo wa Dintlha tse Robong, ha ho shejwa hore ho na le bokgoni bo so kang bo sibollwa hantle ba mawatle a rona, bo ka nyehelang kgolong ya moruo.
tgt: USekela-Mongameli uCyril Ramaphosa uza kukhokela igqiza loMzantsi Afrika ukuya kwingqungquthela yama-26 yeQonga lezoQoqosho leHlabathi (i-WEF) e-Afrika e-Rwanda phakathi komhla we-11 nowe-13 kuCanzibe yowama-2016.

src: Moruo wa mawatle le bohahlaudi di fana ka menyetla e matla bakeng sa kgolo ya moruo le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi.
tgt: Eli qonga lisingathwe phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukuqhagamshelanisa iMithombo ye-Afrika ngeNguqu yezebuChwepheshe”.Urhulumente uqhubela phambili inguqu kwezobuchwepheshe yeli lizwe ngesiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa baithuti ba Kereiti 12 learners ho qala ho hula diforomo tsa kopo kapa ba etse dikopo ka inthanete ho ditsha tsa thuto e phahameng jwaloka karolo ya Letsholo la Apply Now/ Khetha Career Guidance.
tgt: Uza kusungula isigaba sokuqala sephulo lakhe lamaza osasazo aza kufaka uqhagamshelwano kumaziko karhulumente angaphezulu kwama-5 000 kwizithili zoomasipala ezisibhozo kwixesha leminyaka emithathu.

src: Letsholo lena le nkuwang selemo ka seng ke Lefapha la Thuto e Phahameng le Thupello, le tsamaya naha ka bophara ho fihlela ka Loetse 2016 le ho thusa baithuti ho etsa kgetho e hlokolosi ha ba etsa dikopo ho ditsha tsa thuto e phahameng.
tgt: INDABA YOWAMA-2016 ebanjelwe kwiZiko leNgqungquthela Inkosi Albert Luthuli eDurban ukususela kumhla we-7 ukuya kowe-9 kuCanzibe yowama-2016, liqonga lokuzingca ngako konke okusenza sibe ngama-Afrika eliza kukhuthaza iimveliso zokhenketho kubathengi behlabathi.

src: Baithuti ba kgothaletswa ho ikopanya le Setsha sa Ditshebeletso tsa Ntshetsopele ya Makala a Thuto ka SMS kapa “please call me” ho 072 204 5056 kapa 086 999 0123, imeile EMAILTOKEN,Feisebukung ho WEBTOKEN kapa Twitter ho WEBTOKEN Maemo a Kabinete Mabapi le Dintlha tsa Bohlokwa Maemong a Hajwale.
tgt: Ukhenketho, njengenye yeentsika ezintandathu zohlumo lwezoqoqosho kwisiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso, lenze igalelo eliyimali ezibhiliyoni ezingama-357 kwiSambuku seMveliso yeSizwe (i-GDP) ngowama-2014 laza laxhasa i-9% kwingqesho epheleleyo yaseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa bankakarolo ba amehang ho tshwaela ka moralo wa Tjhata e Shebilweng botjha ya Matlafatso e Pharaletseng ya Matlafatso ya Batho ba Batsho Moruong mabapi le indaseteri ya Aforika Borwa ya Merafo le Diminerale ya 2016 e ileng ya phatlalatswa Koranteng ya Mmuso.
tgt: IBhunga lezoHambo eHlabathini noKhenketho lithelekelela ukuba ukhenketho lenze igalelo elizibhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama-560 kwi-GDP yethu ngowama-2015 kwaye luza kuxhasa imisebenzi engaphezulu kwezigidi ezibini.

src: Moralo o shebile botjha Tjhata ya Merafo le ho tswela pele ho kopanya maano a mmuso a diphethoho le melao bakeng sa ho matlafatsa bobebe ba ho kena kgwebong, ho hlahisa tlhakiso ya taolo, bokgoni ba tjhebelopele le bonnete.
tgt: Ukukhulisa impembelelo yezoKhenketho kuQoqosho lwaseLwandle yintsika ebaluleke kakhulu kwisiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba, ngokubangelwa ngamandla akhoyo kumalwandle wethu, nanokuba negalelo kuhlumo loqoqosho.

src: Hape e matahantswe le dipehelo tsa Molao wa Matlafatso ya Moruo o Pharaletseng wa Batho ba Batsho, 2003 (Molao No.
tgt: Uqoqosho lwaselwandle nokhenketho lubonelela ngamathuba angumangaliso ohlumo lwezoqoqosho nokudala imisebenzi.

src: Kabinete e ananela ho tjhaellwa monwana ha kgapo e lohothwang ya SAB Miller ke AB InBev e ntseng e shebisiswa ke ba ka taolong ba diphehisano.
tgt: Kwisikhumbuzo soSuku lwabaSebenzi ngomhla woku-1 kuCanzibe wowama-2016, iKhabhinethi iyakuphinda ukuzibophelela kwayo ekukhuseleni amalungelo wabasebenzi ngemithetho yezabasebenzi enenkqubela.

src: Kabinete e amohela katamelo eo ho dumellanweng ka yona ke Letona la Ntshetsopele ya Moruo le AB InBev le ba ka taolong ba phehisano mabapi le letoto la dintlha tse amang kgahleho ya setjhaba.
tgt: Ukususela ngowe-1994 urhulumente uwaqhubele phambili amalungelo wabasebenzi ngemithetho efana noMthetho woBudlelwane bezaBasebenzi, uMthetho weeMeko zoMsebenzi ezisiSiseko, uMthetho womakuLingwane eMsebenzini nezeMpilo noKhuseleko eMsebenzini.

src: Boitlamo ba khamphani bo sebetsa jwaloka tataiso, hodima dintlha tsa kgahleho ya setjhaba, ho dikhamphani tse ding tse maemong a ho kopana le kgapo tse ikemiseditseng seo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza abafundi beBanga le-12 ukuba baqalise ukuprinta iifomu zokufaka izicelo okanye bafake izicelo kwi-intanethi kumaziko emfundo ephakamileyo njengenxalenye yephulo lika-Apply Now/Khetha Career Guidance Campaign.

src: Sena se kenyeletsa boitlamo boo ho dumellanweng ka bona ke khamphani ho sebedisa R1 bilione nakong ya dilemo tse hlano tse tlang bakeng sa ho hodisa dihwai tse nyenyane le ntshetsopele ya bafani ba lehae, dikgwebo tse ntjha, dithekenoloji tsa eneji le metsi tse hlwahlwa le ntshetsopele ya batjha.
tgt: Eli phulo liqhutywa rhoqo ngonyaka liSebe lezeMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho, liza kuqhutya esizweni jikelele kude kube yinyanga yoMsintsi yowama-2016 kwaye linceda abafundi ekukhetheni ngokufanelekileyo xa befaka izicelo kumaziko emfundo ephakamileyo.

src: Boitlamo ho tsa mesebetsi ho kenyeletswa le maikemisetso a ho qoba phokotso mosebetsing eo e seng ya boithaopo ya basebetsi ka lebaka la ho kopanngwa le ho baballa maemo a kgiro khamphaning bakeng sa dilemo tse hlano tse tlang, ke karolo ya tumellano ya bohlokwa pakeng tsa khamphani le mmuso ho tshehetsa ntlafatso ya indaseteri, ntshetsopele ya dikgwebo tse nyane le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi.
tgt: Abafundi bayakhuthazwa ukuba baqhagamshelane neZiko leNkonzo zoPhuhliso lwaMakhondo ngokuthumela i-SMS okanye u-“please call me” kua-072 204 5056 okanye 086 999 0123, i-imeyili: EMAILTOKEN, kwikhasi lika-Facebook kwa: WEBTOKEN okanye basebenzise i-Twitter kwa: WEBTOKEN Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba esematheni.

src: Ntlheng e nngwe e ka thoko, Kabinete e lemoha ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha dipehelo tsa Sehlomathiso sa Molao wa Phehisano se etsang hore e be tlolo ya molao ya batsamaisi le bolaodi ho etsa mmommori wa ho henahena ditheko, dithenda kapa mebaraka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza abadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo abachaphazelekayo ukuba bahlomle kwidrafti ehlaziyiweyo yoXwebhu lwamaLungelo ngokuXhotyiswa kwabaNtsundu kwezoQoqosho ngokuBanzi (i-BBBEE) kuShishino lwezeMigodi neziMbiwa zaseMzantsi Afrika, lowama-2016 nolwapapashwa kwiPhephandaba loMbuso.

src: Dipehelo tsena ke karolo ya ho matlafatsa ntwa kgahlanong le maqulwana a senyang moruo le ho beha ditheko tse hodimo bakeng sa WEBTOKEN ipiletsa ho dikgwebo ka hara Aforika Borwa ho phehisana ho itshetlehilwe hodima ditheko tse tlase, ntlafatso e eketsehileng, boleng bo ntlafetseng ba thepa e fanwang kapa tshebeletso e phahameng ho bareki ho na le mmommori.
tgt: Le draftio ihlaziyiweyo yoXwebhu lwezeMigodi ibandakanya imigaqo-nkqubo yenguqu karhulumente nemithetho ngakumbi.

src: Kabinete lemohile kamoo lekala la dibanka le laolwang haholo ka teng Aforika Borwa – le lefatsheng, le tlhokeho ya Aforika Borwa ya ho imatahanya le maemo a matjhaba a kang Basel III le melao e kgahlanong le tshebediso ya tjhelete ka bolotsana ya Lebotho la Tshebetso la Ditjhelete (FATF), tseo esale di tjhaellwa monwana ke Kabinete.
tgt: Ikwahambelana namasolotya oMthetho wokuXhotyiswa kwabaNtsundu kwezoQoqosho ngokuBanzi, wama-2003 (uMthetho onguNombo 53 wama-2003) kunye neKhowudi yokuSebenza kaKuhle (iiKhowudi zakwa-DTI).

src: Mokgwa wa Twin Peaks le ona o tla laola boitshwaro ba mmaraka ka hara lekala la dibanka le a mang a phatlaletseng a ditjhelete.".
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphela ukuba ukugunyaziswa kokuthengwa kweSAB Miller ngu-AB InBev kusaqwalaselwa ngamaqumrhu ezokhuphiswano.

src: Kabinete e amohela diphetho ho tswa ho Kopano ya Selemo ya Letlole la Ditjhelete la Matjhaba le Dihlopha tsa Banka ya Lefatshe ya 2016 e neng e tshwerwe tlasa mookotaba:“diphephetso tsa Lefatshe, Ditharollo tsa Lefatshe”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela indlela ekuvunyelwene ukuba mawuphathwe ngayo lo mba nguMphathiswa woPhuhliso lwezoQoqosho ne-AB InBev umaqumrhu okhuphiswano kuluhlu lwemiba ehambelana neemfuno zoluntu.

src: Katamelo ya dintlha tse tharo ya ho rotetsa kgolo maemong a lefatshe e ile ya sisinngwa, e le ho kgothaletsa dinaha ho sebedisa dibetsa tsohle tsa ho akofisa kgolo, ke hore, ditlhabollo tsa tjhelete, matlotlo le tsa sebopeho.
tgt: Isivumelwano esenziwe yile nkampani siza kusebenza njengesikhokelo, kwimiba ebalulekileyo kuluntu, nakwezinye iinkampani ezithenga okanye ezizimanya nezinye phantsi kweemeko ezikwafanayo.

src: Dinaha tse nang le sebaka sa ditjhelete le matlotlo di ile tsa kgothaletswa ho etsa haholwanyane bakeng sa ho matlafatsa tlhokeho leha ho le jwalo, ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha ditlharollo tsa sebopeho ho ne ho le hlokolosi bakeng sa bohle.
tgt: Oku kuquka isibhambathiso ekuvunyelwene ngaso yile nkampani sokuchitha imali eyibhiliyoni yeerandi kule minyaka mihlanu izayo ukukhuthaza amafama afuyela ukuziphilisa efuya ngomyinge omncinci nophuhliso lababoneleli-zinkonzo balapha ekhaya, amashishini amatsha asakhulayo, ezamandla nobuchwepheshe bokusebenzisa kakuhle amanzi nophuhliso lolutsha.

src: Ho ba bangata sena se kenyeletsa matsete ho meralo ya motheo, ntjhafatso le ntlafatso ya tikoloho ya bolaodi, hara tse ding.
tgt: Isibophelelo ngokwemisebenzi siquka ukuthintela ukudendwa ngenkani kwabasebenzi ngenxa yendibanisela yeenkampani nokugcina izinga lengqesho kule nkampani kule minyaka mihlanu ilandelayo, oko yinxalenye yesivumelwano sokuhlahla indlela phakathi kwale nkampani norhulumente ukuxhasa ukwanda kwemizi-mveliso, uphuhliso lwamashishini amancinci nokudala imisebenzi.

src: Kabinete e hopotsa bakgethi bohle ba tshwanelehang ba so kang ba ingodisa le ho netefatsa dintlha tsa bona hore ba ka nna ba etsa jwalo ka ho etela Kantoro ya bona ya lehae ya Khomishene e Ikemetseng ya Dikgetho (IEC).
tgt: Komnye omba, iKhabhinethi iqaphela ukuba ukuqalisa ukusebenza kwamasolotya oMthetho-siHlomelo woKhuphiswano owenza ukuba kungabikho mthethweni ukuba abalawuli nabaphathi basebenzisane ukwenze iyelenqe lokunyusa amaxabiso, kwiziniki-maxabiso okanye kurhwebo.

src: Sena se a hlokahala ho netefatsa lebitso la hao lenaneng la bakgethi e leng se tla thusa bakgethi ba tshwanelehang ho sebedisa tokelo ya bona ya demokerasi ka la 3 Phato 2016.Kabinete e kgothaletsa bakgethi ho netefatsa hore ba kgotsofatsa ditlhokeho tsa ho fana ka diaterese tsa bona kantorong ya Lehae ya Khomishene e Ikemetseng ya Dikgetho (IEC).Dipotso ka ditaba tsa dikgetho di ka lebiswa setsheng sa mehala sa IEC ho 0800 11 8000, se bulwang Mantaha ho isa Labohlano, ho tloha ka 7 hoseng ho isa ka to 9 bosiu.
tgt: La masolotya ayinxalenye yamanyathelo okunyusa izinga lokulwa amaqela enza amayelenqe enzakalisa uqoqosho ngokuthi abize abathengi amaxabiso aphezulu.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Transnet, Bolaodi ba Naha ba Botjhutjhisi, SABC le Mafapha a Thuto e Phahameng le Thupello, Dikamano tsa Matjhaba le Tshebedisano, le la Toka le Ntshetsopele ya Molaotheo ka ho nkuwa e le “Bahiri ba nang le Kgohedi ka ho fetisisa” ka hara Aforika Borwa ke khamphani ya matshwao, UNIVERSUKabinete e thoholetsa Letona la Saense le Thekenoloji, Naledi Pandor, ya amohetseng Kgau ya Bokgabane ho tswa ho Riphaboliki ya Bofederale ya Jeremane bakeng sa nyehelo ya hae ho tsa saense lefatsheng.
tgt: Sicela onke amashishini aseMzantsi Afrika ukuba mawakhuphisane ngamaxabiso aphantsi, ngokuba nobuchule obuthe chatha, ukuphucuka komgangatho wezinto abonelela ngazo okanye ukunika abathengi inkonzo ekwizinga eliphezulu kunokwenza amayelenqe.

src: Kgau e fuwa batho ba ho tswa lefatsheng ka bophara bakeng sa diphihlello tsa bona mapatlelong a sepolotiki, a kahisano le a mautlwela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphele ukuba icandelo leebhanki lilawulwa ngokwezinga eliphezulu eMzantsi Afrika – nasehlabathini jikelele, kunye nemfuneko yokuba uMzantsi Afrika uhambelane nemigangatho yehlabathi efana ne-Basel III nemithetho yeQela lezemiSebenzi yezeZimali (i-FATF) yokulwa ukuthutyeleziswa kwemali, neyayamkelwe ngaphambili yiKhabhinethi, yaxhaswa yimithetho engundoqo eyayamkelwe ngurhulumente.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Motsamaisi-Kakaretso wa Lefapha la Merero ya Tikoloho Nosipho Ngcaba bakeng sa ho amohela Kgau ya 2015/16 Lifetime Achievement Eco-Logic ho tswa ho phatlalatso ya Enviropaedia.
tgt: Inkqubo yokuGunyaziwe Ababini nayo iza kulawula indlela oluziphatha ngayo urhwebo kwicandelo leebhanki necandelo lezezimali ngokubanzi.”.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa setaki Kemang Wa Lehulere bakeng sa ho ba "Setaki sa sa Selemo" bakeng sa 2017 e leng se tshehetswang ke Deutsche Bank.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamkela iziphumo zeNgxowa-mali yeMali yeHlabathi yowama-2016 neNdibano yaseNtlakohlaza yamaQela eeBhanki zeHlabathi eqhubeke phantsi komxholo othi “IMingeni yeHlabathi, iziSombululo zeHlabathi”.

src: Wa Lehulere, ya sibollang kamano ya pontsho ya bonono ka hara Aforika Borwa ya kamora mmuso wa kgethollo, o tla pepesa dipontsho tsa hae a le mong Jeremane sebakeng sa Deutsche Bank KunstHalle ho la Berlin selemong se tlang.
tgt: Kuphakanyiswe indlela embaxa yokuvuselelwa kohlumo kwinqanaba lehlabathi, kukhuthazwa amazwe ukuba asebenzise onke amandla okunyusa akwimigaqo-nkqubo yawo ukukhuthaza uhlumo, oko kuthetha olungokwemali, olungokwemali kaRhulumente nokulungiswa kwezakhiwo.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Lefapha la Bohahlaudi bakeng sa ho hapa moputso wa Leano/Tshehetso ya Setjhaba e Ipabotseng ka ho fetisisa ho Dikgau tsa 2016 tsa Bohahlaudi bo nang le Boikarabelo.
tgt: Amazwe anesithuba ngokwemali nangokwemali kaRhulumente akhuthazwa ukuba enze ngakumbi ukuphucula imfuneko noxa kunjalo, ukuphunyezwa kokulungiswa kwezakhiwo kubaluleke kakhulu kunako konke okunye.

src: Makgabane ana a abelwa lefapha la lekala la setjhaba, bolaodi kapa setheo se entseng boitelo bo hlakileng le nyehelo bakeng sa ho hodisa bohahlaudi bo nang le boikarabelo.
tgt: Kuninzi oku kuquka utyalo-mali kwiziseko ezingundoqo, ubuchule bokuvelisa izinto ezintsha nokuphucula ukusebenza kolawulo, phakathi kokunye.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa sebapadi sa kolofo Branden Grace bakeng sa ho hapa papadi ya hae ya pele ya PGA Tour ho RBC Heritage ho la Hilton Head, Amerika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhumbuza bonke abo bangabavoti abaselungelweni abangekabhalisi baqinisekise nangeenkcukhacha zabo ukuba bangakwenza oko ngokutyelela ii-Ofisi zeKhomishini yoNyulo eziMeleyo (i-IEC) ezikufutshane kubo.

src: Kabinete e utlwisitswe bohloko ke lefu la Bertie Lubner ya entseng nyehelo e kgolo bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya Aforika Borwa jwaloka moetapele wa kgwebo, mosebeletsi wa batho le modulasetulo wa tlotlo wa bophelo bohle wa Mokgatlho wa maJuta a Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Oku kuyadingeka ukuqinisekisa ngokubakho kwegama lakho kuluhlu lwabavoti okuza kwenza ukuba abavoti abaselungelweni bakwazi ukusebenzisa ilungelo labo lomgaqo-siseko ngomhla we-3 kweyeThupha yowama-2016.IKhabhinethi ibongoza bonke abavoti abaselungelweni ukuba baqinisekise ukuba banazo zonke izinto ezifunekayo zokunikezela ngeedilesi zabo kwi-ofisi yeKhomishini yoNyulo eziMeleyo (i-IEC).

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso a yona a tswang boteng ba pelo ho metswalle le bamalapa a mahlatsipa (Tiisetso Tselo, Sesi Mtshali, Sana Sibeko, Mphikeleli Malindi, Gugulethu Sithole, Vusi Nkabinde, Daphney Linda, Sicelo Kheswa, Sphamandla Gedle le Simphiwe Nhlapo) a kotsi e sisimosang ya bese ha ba ne ba kgutla Raling ya Mohoo wa Dikgetho wa ANC Port Elizabeth.
tgt: Imibuzo ngonyulo ingabhekiswa kwiziko loqhagamshelwano le-IEC kwa-0800 11 8000, elivula ngoMvulo ukuya kuLwesihlanu, ukusukela ngentsimbi yesi-7 kusasa ukuya kweye-9 ngokuhlwa.

src: Kabinete e fetiseditse matshidiso a yona ho lelapa le metswalle ya Ngaka Herman Nditsheni Netshidzivhani, setsebi sa pele sa Aforika Borwa sa motho e motsho sa bokgoni ba pelehi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana nabakwa-Transnet, iGunyabantu lezoTshutshiso, iZiko lezoSasazo loMzantsi Afrika (i-SABC) neSebe lezeMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho, iSebe lezoBudlelwane baMazwe ngamazwe neNtsebenziswano, kunye neSebe lezobuLungisa noPhuhliso loMgaqo-siseko ngokuthi anikwe iwonga lokuba kudidi lokuba “Ngabona baQeshi banoMtsalane” eMzantsi Afrika yinkampani esebenza ngamagama abaqeshi, i-UNIVERSUIKhabhinethi yothulela umnqwazi uMphathiswa wezeNzululwazi nobuChwepheshe, uNaledi Pandor, othe wafumana imbasa i-Order of Merit kwiFederation Republic of Germany ngegalelo lakhe kuphuhliso lwezenzululwazi ehlabathini jikelele.

src: Jwaloka mothei wa tliliniki ya bokgoni ba pelehi ka hara Sepetlele sa Park Lane ho la Johannesburg, Netshidzivhani o thusitse maAforika Borwa a mangata ho qala malapa.
tgt: Eli wonga belinikezelwa kubantu behlabathi jikelele ngeempumelelo zabo kwinqanaba lezepolitiki, lezentlalo okanye kwelobungqondi.

src: Kabinete e fetiseditse matshediso a yona ho lelapa le metswalle ya Dene Smuts, Setho sa Mehleng sa Palamente sa Democratic Alliance.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana noMlawuli-Jikelele weSebe lezeNdalo uNosipho Ngcaba ngokufumana imbasa ebizwa i-Lifetime Achievement Eco-Logic Award evela kwimagazini yezendalo, i-The Enviropeadia.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa nyehelo ya hae e babatsehang bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya demokerasi ya rona ya molaotheo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqhwabela izandla igcisa uKemang Wa Lehulere ngokuba “Ligcisa loNyaka” lowama-2017 elixhaswa yi-Deutsche Bank.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le Moporesidente President Jacob Zuma bakeng sa ho lakaletsa Mama Winnie Madikizela-Mandela pholo e potlakileng le ho kgothaletsa ho hlomphuwa ha boinotshi ba lelapa nakong ena.
tgt: UWa Lehulere, ophonononga imisebenzi yobugcisa emva koCalucalulo eMzantsi Afrika, uza kwenza umboniso wakhe wokuqala eyedwa eGermanu kwiholo eDeutsche Bank KunstHalle eBerlin kulo nyaka uzayo.

src: Winnie Mandela o hlomphuwa hohle ka lebaka la karolo ya hae ntweng ya tokoloho e nyehetseng ho phediso ya maano a kgatello le ho tlisa demokerasi Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana neSebe lezoKhenketho ngokuphumelela ibhaso lokuba Yelona Nkonzo kaRhulumente inoMgaqo-nkqubo/Nkxaso eNgcono kwiMbasa yoKhenketho oluFanelekileyo e-Afrika lowama-2016.

src: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di ho ya ka netefatso ya mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang.
tgt: Eli wonga linikezelwa kwisebe lecandelo laseburhulumenteni, ugunyaziwe okanye iqumrhu elithe labonakalisa ukuzinikela okucacileyo negalelo lokuqhubela phambili ukhenketho.

src: Paul Steenkamp ho Lekgotla la Naha la Boeletsi ka Ntlafatso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana nomdlali wegalufa uBranden Grace ngokuphumelela imbasa yakhe yokuqala,i-PGA Tour e-RBC Heritage e-Hilton Head, e-U IKhabhinethi ilusizi ngokushiywa kwethu nguBertie Lubner nothe wenza igalelo elincomekayo kuphuhliso loMzantsi Afrika njengenkokeli kwezoshishino, umthandi wabantu nowawongelwa ukuba abe ngusihlalo ubomi bakhe bonke we-SA Jewish Board of Deputies.

src: Clarinda Elizabeth Simpson jwaloka Mohlanka ya ka Sehloohong wa Ditjhelete wa SENTECLumko Caesario Mtimde jwaloka Mohlanka ya ka Sehloohong wa Phethahatso wa Ditshebeletso tsa Lefatshe le Lekala la Phihlello la Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa uvelwano olunzulu kubahlobo nosapho lwamaxhoba alishumi (uTiisetso Tselo, uSesi Mtshali, uSana Sibeko, uMphikeleli Malindi, uGugulethu Sithole, uVusi Nkabinde, uDaphney Linda, uSicelo Kheswa, uSphamandla Gedle noSimphiwe Nhlapo) engozi yebhasi emasikizi eyenzeke ngethuba ebebuya kwiNgqungquthela yoMqulu weziThembiso ye-ANC eBhayi.

src: Ho thonngwa hape ha Moatefokate Rory Wayne Voller jwaloka Motlatsi wa Mokhomishenara wa Khomishene ya Dikhamphani le Thepa ya Mautlwela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwanqwenela abo bathe bonzakala ukuba bachache ngokukhawuleza.

src: Ho kenngwa Tshebetsong ha Mananeo a Bohlokwa a Mmuso.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ezingundoqo.

src: Kabinete e lemohile tlalehelo ya Letona la Ditjhelete ho Moporesidente, mabapi le kgatelopele ya dipuisano tsa Mmuso le lekala la poraefete le la mesebetsi ka moruo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele ingxelo eyenziwe nguMphathiswa wezeMali kuMongameli, ngenkqubela yokufakana imilomo kukarhulumente naboshishino lecandelo labucala kunye nemibutho yabasebenzi ngoqoqosho.

src: Moporesidente o romme Letona hore le etelle pele ditherisano le balekane ba kahisano ho rala lewa le ho tla ka mekgwa ya ho hodisa moruo le ho baballa maemo a naha sekaleng sa mekitlane.
tgt: UMongameli ebegunyazise uMphathiswa ukuba akhokele ezi ndibano zokufakana imilomo nala mahlakani ezentlalo ukuba kuboniswane ngesicwangciso-qhinga kunye nokuveza amalinge okukhulisa uqoqosho nokugcina indawo ilizwe elibekwa kuyo ngokwezoqoqosho.

src: Kabinete e thabile ka hobane mosebetsi ona o tswetse boikitlaetso bo bonahalang bo tla ntlafatsa menyetla ya naha ya moruo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inovuyo lokuba lo msebenzi uphele ekuveliseni amanyathelo okuqala aluqilima aza kuphucula amathemba kumbono wezoqoqosho weli lizwe.

src: Moporesidente o tsebisitse dintlha tse seng kae tsa boikitlaetso bo ka sehloohong ka Mantaha, tse kenyeletsang: (1) letlole le kopanetsweng la lekala la poraefete le la setjhaba bakeng sa Tshehetso ya Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane, (2) ho sebetsana le ditshita bakeng sa ho eketsa matsete hore ho tle ho akofiswe kgolo e kenyeletsang, (3) matsete a kopanetsweng ke mmuso le lekala la poraefete ho meralo ya motheo ho itshetlehilwe hodima boiphihlelo ba katleho ya Lenaneo la Bahlahisi ba Matla ba Ikemetseng le (4) ho matlafatsa Dikgwebo tsa Mmuso ho netefatsa maemo a tsona a ditjhelete a moshwelella le ho matlafatsa botjha karolo ya tsona bakeng sa ho kganna ntshetsopele.
tgt: NgoMvulo uMongameli ubhengeze amaphulo aphambili aliqela, aquka: (1) ingxowa-mali edibeneyo yabezoshishino labucala norhulumente yeNkxaso yamaShishini amaNcinane, (2) ukuhlangabezana neengxaki eziphazamisa utyalo-mali olwandayo khona ukuze kukhawuleziswe uhlumo oluquka wonke umntu, (3) utyalo-mali oludibeneyo lukarhulumente nabezoshishino labucala kwiziseko ezingundoqo kusetyenziswa umzekelo weNkqubo yabaVelisi baMandla oMbane abaZimeleyo ebe yimpumelelo kunye (4) nokomeleza amaShishini kaRhulumente ukuqinisekisa uzinzo lwawo lwezezimali nokomeleza indima yawo ekuqhubemi uphuhliso.

src: Ditsebiso tsena ke bopaki ba seo naha ena e ka se fihlellang ha balekane bohle ba kahisano ba ka ikopanya mmoho ho sebeletsa ho fihlella morero o tshwanang.2 Kabinete e dula e na le boitshepo ba hore matlafatso e matla ya matlotlo, pokeletso e etsang nalane ya R1 trilione ke Tshebeletso ya Lekgetho ya Aforika Borwa le boitshunyako ba dintlha tse hlano ba nako e kgutshwane bo tsebisitsweng haufinyana tjena, kaofela di tshehetsa moralo wa Dintlha tse Robong hore ho tle ho netefatswe dintlafalo katlehong ya rona ya moruo.
tgt: Ezi zibhengezo zibubungqina bokuba yintoni enokwenziwa leli lizwe xa onke amahlakani ezentlalo edibene esebenzisana kwaye ejongise kwinjongo enye.2 IKhabhinethi ihleli iqinisekile ukuba uhlengahlengiso olumandla lwezoqoqosho, ukuqokelela kweNkonzo yezeRhafu yaseMzantsi Afrika (i-SARS) imali efikele kwitriliyoni yeerandi okokuqala ezimbalini kwakunye nokubhengezwa kwakutsha nje kwamanyathelo okungenelela amahlanu exesha elifutshane, zonke nje zongeza kwisicwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba ngeenjongo zokuqinisekisa ngokwenzeka kwenguqu kuqoqosho lweli lizwe.

src: Pokeletso e eketsehileng ya lekeno ke SARS e tla boela e thuse Mmuso ho fana ka ditshebeletso tse tla ntlafatsa boleng ba bophelo ba baahi ba ona.
tgt: Ukwanda kwerhafu eqokelelweyo ngabakwa-SARS kuza kongeza ukwenza ukuba uRhulumente anikezele iinkonzo eziza kuphucula umgangatho wobomi babo bonke abemi beli.

src: Kabinete e amohela tsebiso ya lekala le methang maemo a mekitlane, Moody’s Investor Services, leo beke e fetileng le tiiseditseng botjha hore ho methwa ha mekitlane ke dikoto tse pedi ho feta sekala se tlase-tlase sa matsete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isibhengezo esenziwe yi-arhente yokuhlela, iMoody’s Investor Services, ethe kwezi veki zimbini zidlulileyo yaphinda yaliqinisekisa inqanaba eli lizwe elibekwa kulo kwezoqoqosho engamanqanaba amabini ngaphezulu kwenqanaba elilelona liphantsi nelamnkelekileyo kubatyali-zimali.

src: Bakeng sa ho tiisetsa ho methwa hona, ba ha Moody ba lemohile hore Aforika Borwa e atamela ntlha ya phethoho kamora dilemo tsa kgolo e fokolang le mekgwa e bohale ya matlafatso ditekanyetsong tsa 2016 di tla tsitsisa sekoloto sa mmuso ho GDP selemong sena se hodimo.
tgt: Ekungqineni eli nqanaba, abakwaMoody’s baphawule okokuba uMzantsi Afrika uya uyiguqula imeko emva kweminyaka yohlumo olubuthathaka kwaye amanyathelo okuhlengahlengisa nokomeleza uqoqosho owama-2016 aza komeleza ityala likarhulumente kwiSambuku seMveliso yeLizwe (i-GDP) kulo nyaka.

src: Mekga yohle e dumellana hore mekutu ya tshebedisano e lokela ho matlafatswa ho fana ka sekgahla tlhasimolohong ya moruo.
tgt: Onke amaqela ayangqinelana ukuba amalinge entsebenziswano adinga ukomelezwa ukunika amandla ekuphucukeni koqoqosho.

src: Re boela re lemoha hore mosebetsi wa Letona la Ditjhelete le balekane ba kahisano ho kenyeletsa motjha wa tshebetso wa ho methwa ha mekitlane ho tla hlwaya ditlhabollo tse ka bang teng le boitshunyako bakeng sa ho baballa mebaraka e matla ya ditjhelete ya Aforika Borwa le ho methwa ha maemo a sekala sa mekitlane.
tgt: Sikwaqaphela ukuba umsebenzi woMphathiswa wezeMali kunye namahlakani ezentlalo ukwaquka umsebenzi oluthotho wohlolo lwemali ilizwe elinayo oza kuchonga uhlaziyo olunokwenziwa nongenelelo lokugcina urhwebo olomeleleyo lwemali eyinkunzi yaseMzantsi Afrika nomlinganiselo wohlolo lwemali yotyalo-mali.4 UMongameli uyazibulela iiVoti zoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali ezenziwa ngabaPhathiswa ngokwahlukeneyo nezithi zihlangabezane neemfuno zabo bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Moporesidente o ananela Dipuo tsa Ditekanyetso ka Matona ka ho latelana tse shebaneng le ditlhoko tsa maAforika Borwa kaofela.
tgt: Iingxelo zenkqubela nezicwangciso eziphuma kwezi Voti zoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali zamaSebe zibonakalisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika usisizwe esisebenzayo, apho urhulumente akhokelayo khona, ekwakheni ubomi obungcono kumntu wonke.

src: Ditlaleho tsa kgatelopele le meralo e tswang ho Dipuo tsa Ditekanyetso tsa Mafapha di bontsha hore Aforika Borwa ke setjhaba se keneng mosebetsing, ka mmuso o supang tsela, bakeng sa ho aha bophelo bo botle bakeng sa bohle.
tgt: Kumiselwe amanyathelo aluqilima ukunciphisa impembelelo embi yokudodobala koqoqosho ehlabathini jikelele kuqoqosho lweli lizwe, nokulungiselela uhlumo lwezoqoqoqsho oludlamkileyo xa uqoqosho seluguquke lwathembisa.

src: Mekgwa e bonahalang e se e kentswe tshebetsong ho fokotsa sekgahla se sebe sa ho wa ha moruo wa lefatshe hodima moruo wa rona, le ho itokisetsa kgolo e matla ha tsamao ya moruo e bontsha ho loka.
tgt: Sikwasebenza ngamandla ukususa imiqobo yalapha ekhaya kwezohlumo.

src: Dipuo tsa ditekanyetso hape di bontsha hore mmuso, lekala la mesebetsi le dikgwebo di sebetsa mmoho, ho feta ka nako efe kapa efe, ho fumana ditsela tsa ho rotetsa botjha kgolo le kaho ya bophelo bo betere bakeng sa bohle.
tgt: Ezi voti zohlahlo lwabiwo-mali zikwabonakalisa ukuba urhulumente, imibutho yabasebenzi nabezoshishino basebenzisana, kakhulu kunangaphambili, ukufumanisa ngeendlela zokuvuselela uhlumo nokwakha ubomi obungcono kumntu wonke.

src: Sena se kenyeletsa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ho matla ha Moralo wa Dintlha tse Robong, o tsebisitsweng ke Moporesidente Jacob Zuma ho Puo ka Maemo a Setjhaba ya 2015 hammoho le Operation Phakisa, e reretsweng ho potlakisa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha ditharollo tsa dibaka tsa ntshetsopele tse hlokolosi.
tgt: Oku kuquka ukufezekiswa ngamandla kwesiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba, esathi sabhengezwa nguMongameli uJacob Zuma kwiNtetho engoBume beSizwe yowama-2015 kwakunye nephulo i-Operation Phakisa, elamiselwa ukukhawulezisa ukufezekiswa kwezisombululo kwimimandla apho uphuhliso ludingeka ngamandla khona.

src: Mananeo ana a sebetsana le dintlha tse hlokolosi ho tswa ho Lewa la Naha la Ntshetsopele, tse kang ho fokotsa bofuma le tlhokeho ya mesebetsi.
tgt: Ezi nkqubo zihlangabezana nemiba ebaluleke kakhulu kwisiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP), efana nokuncitshiswa kwendlala nentswela-ngqesho.5 IKhabhinethi iqinisekisa kwakhona abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba iimeko yentswela-ngqesho kweli lizwe kuhlangatyezwana nayo ngokufezekiswa kwesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP) seli lizwe, ngongenelelo lwezoqoqosho lwesiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba esenzelwe ukuvuselela uhlumo size sikhulise imisebenzi kumacandelo angundoqoqo kuqoqosho lwethu.

src: Kabinete e netefaletsa maAforika Borwa hore boemo ba naha ba tlhokeho ya mesebetsi ho ntse ho sebetsanwa le bona ka ho kenngwa tshebetsong Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP) ka boitshunyako ba moruo ka Moralo wa Dintlha tse Robong oo sepheo sa ona e leng ho rotetsa kgolo le ho matlafatsa mesebetsi makaleng a bohlokwa a moruo wa rona.
tgt: Intsebenziswano yecandelo lezoshishino labucala ibaluleke kakhulu ukuze kufumaneke iziphumo ezihle.

src: Tshebedisano ya lekala la poraefete ke taba e ka sehloohong bakeng sa sephetho se atlehileng.
tgt: Urhulumente usebenzisa onke amaphulo akhoyo kuquka nesiCwangciso sokuSebenza koMgaqo-nkqubo wezoShishino (i-IPAP) ukudala iimveliso eziza kuthatha abasebenzi abongezelelekileyo namacandelo eenkonzo ukuhlangabezana nentswela-ngqesho ethe yaphinda yongezwa bubunzima beemeko zezoqoqosho zehlabathi jikelele nezalapha ekhaya.

src: Mmuso o sebedisa dintlha tsohle tsa boikitlaetso tse teng ho kenyeletswa le Moralo wa Tshebetso wa Leano la Diindaseteri (IPAP) ho bopa tlhahiso e hohelang basebetsi haholwanyane le makala a ditshebeletso ho sebetsana le tlhokeho ya mesebetsi ho mpefaditsweng ho feta ke maemo a boima a moruo wa lefatshe le wa lehae.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezoRhwebo noShishino uRob Davies umisele owesibhozo umfuziselo wonyaka we-IPAP2016/17 ukuya kowama-2018-19 ngomhla we-9 kuCanzibe wowama-2016 kwinkampani yokunyibilikisa isinyithi negilasi enabanikazi abaNtsundu ngokupheleleyo eGauteng.

src: Letona la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri, Rob Davies le thakgotse ho phetwa ka tatelano ha borobedi ha selemo ka seng ha IPAP 2016/17 ho isa ho 2018-19 ka la 9 Motsheanong 2016 femeng ya metjhini ya kwari ya tshepe eo beng ba yona e leng batho ba batsho ka 100% ho la Gauteng.
