tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalibethelela kwakhona ikhwelo eyalihlabayo lokuba umthetho nawo awuzikuhleka kwabo nabo baphula umthetho.4 IKhabhinethi icela onke amahlakani ukuba angqubanise iintloko ngeenjongo zokusombulula imiba ekungabonwa ngasonye ngayo e-Ennerdale, Eldorado Park naseColigny.

src: Moporesidente o entse kgoeletso ka selemo sa 2015 Nakong ya Puo ya Maemo a Naha, a ipiletsa ho Moifo wa Toka, Thibelo ya Botlokotsebe le Tshireletso (JCPS) ho sebetsana ka matla le boipelaetso bo tletseng merusu le tshenyo.
tgt: Umthetho-sihlomelo oyilwayo weziko lolwaphulo-mthetho kwezezimali (i-FICA)5.1 IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukutyikitywa koMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo weZiko loLwaphulo-mthetho kwezeziMali (i-FICA) nguMongameli Zuma ukuba ube ngumthetho.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa kgoeletso ena ya hore ba tlolang molao ba tla tobana le letsoho le matla la molao.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika njengelizwe eliyinxalenye yamazwe alwa unaniselwano ngemali olungekho mthethweni, nawo uza kuzayamanisa namanyathelo ehlabathi okungenelela afuna ukulwa ukuthutyeleziswa kwemali kunye nokuncediswa ngemali kwamaphulo obunqolobi.2 Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uza kuba negalelo ekwenzeni inkqubo yezezimali eMzantsi afrika ukuba ihlonitshwe futhi yenze izinto elubala, futhi oko kuza kwenza ukuba kube nzima kwabo baphula umthetho bayinxalenye yabo bangahlawuli zirhafu, bathubelezisa imali futhi bananiselana ngemali ngokungekho mthethweni ngeenjongo zokufihla imali kusetyenziswa ubuxhaka-xhaka neenkqubo zezimali zoMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho sennwa ha Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Setsi sa Mautlwela a Ditjhelete (FICA) hore e be molao keMoporesidenteZuma.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ungomnye weminye imithetho esinayo njengelizwe lokulwa ulwaphulo-mthetho oluqhutywa zizifundiswa kurhulumente nakumashishini abucala.3 IKhabhinethi ixelelwe nguMphathiswa wezeMali ukuba iintlanganiso zokubonisana ziyaqhuba kwaye ziza kuqukunjelwa kungekudala ukuze kuqinisekiswe ngenkqubo yokubhengezwa kwemithetho nemigaqo eza kuchaphazela uMthetho we-FICIzigqibo zekhabhinethi.1 UMphathiswa wezeMali unike iKhabhinethi amagqabantshintshi ngeentlanganiso zeNtwasahlobo zeNgxowa-mali yeHlabathi yeziMali (i-IMF) neBhanki yeHlabathi, namaPhulo okuTsala abaTyali-mali kunye neentlanganiso ze-WEFUye wanika neenkcukacha ngesiVumelwano se-G20 neziphakamiso ze-Afrika kunye neenkxalabo zabatyali-zimali kunye nee-arhente ezihlela amazwe ngokwesakhono sawo sokubhatala izikweliti.

src: Aforika Bowa jwaloka karolo ya badudi ba lefatshe e imatahantseng le ho lwantsha diketso tse seng molaong tsa ditjhelete, e tla imatahanya le boitshunyako ba matjhaba bo batlang ho lwantsha ho pata mohlodi wa tjhelete le ho thusa boferakanyi ka ditjhelete.
tgt: Kubekho iingxoxo ezinzulu ngemeko yoqoqosho lwehlabathi nolwengingqi nokuba kufuneka senze ntoni ukulungisa le ngxaki yokubekwa kwelona zinga lisezantsi ngokwesakhono sokukwazi ukuhlawula izikweliti.2 IKhabhinethi iphinde yakubethelela ukuba isazimisele nokuqhubeleka nemigaqo-nkqubo yezezimali eyayicaciswe kwiNtetho yoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali lowama-2017, ukuqaliswa kwenguqu ukuze kuphuculwe ulawulo kumashishini karhulumente ukugcina umyinge wemali ebekelwe inkcitho nokuqinisekisa ukuba amatyala karhulumente awanyuki.

src: Bili ena hape e tla nyehela mabapi le ho matlafatsa ponaletso le seriti tsa tsamaiso ya ditjhelete ya Aforika Borwa le ho etsa hore ho be thata bakeng sa ditlokotsebe ho baleha ho lefa lekgetho, ho pata mohlodi wa tjhelete le ho pata phallo e seng molaong ya ditjhelete ba sebedisa mekgwa ya tsamaiso ya ditjhelete ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Inkqubo karhulumente yokukhawulezisa ukuqaliswa kweenguqu kwiindlela uqoqosho olumi ngayo ukuze lukhule njengoko kutshiwo kwisiCwangciso esiManqaku aliThoba iseyiyo enokusetyenziswa ukusabela kweminye yemiba ephakanyiswe ngabatyali-mali.3 IKhabhinethi iyayamkela ingxelo ebesanda ukukhutshwa yinkampani i-EY Consultancy emalunga noTyalo-mali lwangaPhandle oluza Ngqo e-Afrika.

src: E bopa se seng sa disebediswa tse ngata tseo re nang le tsona jwaloka naha bakeng sa ho lwantsha botlokotsebe ba maemo a hodimo makaleng ka bobedi a poraefete le a mmuso.
tgt: Le ngxelo iwuchaza uMzantsi Afrika njengelinye lamazwe anoqoqosho olukhulu kwaye ubekwa kwindawo yesibini kuLuhlu lowama-2017 lwase-Afrika lokuba Nomtsalane.4 IKhabhinethi iye yaxelelwa nangohambo lwee-Arhente zokuHlela iSakhono sokuBhatala iziKweliti oluzayo oluza kweli ukuze zingqubanise iintloko nemibutho emininzi kunye nezikhulu zikarhulumente.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ke Letona la Ditjhelete hore ditherisano di ntse di tswela pele mme di tla phethelwa haufinyana ho netefatsamotjha wa phatlalatso ya melawana e tla kenya tshebetsong Molao wa FICDiqeto tsa KabineteLetona la Ditjhelete le tsebisitse Kabinete ka dikopano tsa haufinyana tjena tsa Selemo tsa Letlole laLefatshe la Ditjhelete (IMF)/ tsa Banka ya Lefatshe, dikopano tsa Leeto la Dipontsho le Batsetedi le tsa WEF ya Aforika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyivumile iDrafti yesiCwangciso-qhinga esiHlaziyiweyo sezoThutho emaPhandleni.

src: Hape le tsebisitse ka ditshisinyo tsa Aforika ho G20 Compact le matshwenyeho a batsetedi le makala a Balekodi ba mekitlane.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga sisabela kanye kwimiba ephambili koomasipala bezithili zasemaphandleni nakumaphondo anemimandla emininzi engamaphandle ngokusombulula umba wokungabikho kweziSeko ezinguNdoqo neeNkonzo ezifanelekileyo zezoThutho emaPhandleni into leyo ephazamisa uphuhliso lezoqoqosho.

src: Ho bile le dipuisano tse matla mabapi le tjhebahalo ya moruo wa lefatshe le wa lebatowa le seo re lokelang ho se etsa ho etsolla ho theolwa ha maemo a moruo.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kwesi sicwangciso-qhinga kuza kuncedisa ekukhuliseni uqoqosho loomasipala nolwamaphondo ngokwenza izithuthi zikawonke-wonke zifikeleleke.

src: Kabinete e boeleditse hore e dula e itlamme bakeng sa boemo ba leano la ditjhelete tsa mmuso le tekilweng Puong ya Ditekanyetso ya selemo sa 2017, ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha diphethoho bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa taolo ya dikhamphani tsa mmuso ho baballa sekepele se amohelehang sa ditshenyehelo le ho netefatsa botsitso ba mekitlane ya mmuso.
tgt: Oku kuza kwenza ukuba kube lula ebantwini ukusuka emaphandleni baye ezidolophini, ngeenjongo zokunceda imimandla yasemaphandleni ukuba ikwazi ukuthatha inxaxheba kuqoqosho lwelizwe ngobubanzi.6 IKhabhinethi iwuvile uMgaqo-nkqubo oBanzi wezoThutho zaseManzini.

src: Lenaneo la Mmuso la ho akofisa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha diphethoho tsa dibopeho tse reretsweng ho matlafatsa kgolo ya moruo jwaloka ha di tekilwe ho Moralo wa Dintlha tse Robong le dula le nepahetse bakeng sa ho tobana le dintlha tse ding tse hlahisitsweng ke batsetedi.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo ubonakalisa ukuzimisela kukarhulumente kuhlumo, uphuhliso kunye nokutshintsha icandelo lezothutho lwasemanzini loMzantsi Afrika, ukuze luxhase uphuhliso lwezoqoqosho nolwezentlalo ngeli thuba lifaka igalelo kurhwebo lwehlabathi.

src: Kabinete e amohela tlaleho e lokolotsweng haufinyana ke feme ya boeletsi ya EY Consultancy mabapi le Matsete a Otlolohileng ka hara Aforika.
tgt: Oku kuhambelana nemiba ekhokeliswa phambili ngurhulumente ngokumayelana ne-Operation Phakisa ngokukhuliswa koQoqosho lwaseLwandle.

src: Tlaleho e supa Aforika Borwa jwaloka setsi se seholo ka ho fetisisa sa moruo le ho behwa maemong a bobedi ho Lenane la Kgohedi la Aforika la selemo sa 2017.Kabinete hape e tsebisitswe ka leeto le tlang la Makala a Bolekodi ba mekitlane ho buisana le mekgatlo e mengata le bahlomphehi ba phethahatso ba mmuso.
tgt: Futhi kukwahambelana neenjongo ezibanzi zokusebenzela ukukhulisa uqoqosho kunye nokuncedisa kumaphulo okudala imisebenzi, njengoko kucacisiwe kwisiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe (i-NDP) kunye nesiCwangciso seSizwe seziSeko ezinguNdoqo.7 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa kweDrafti yesiCwangciso-qhinga seziThuthi Ezingenzi Monakalo kwiNdalo ukuze uluntu luhlomle kuyo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Moralo wa Lewa le Shebilweng Botjha la Dipalangwang tsa Metse ya Mahae.
tgt: Icandelo lezothutho lidlala indima ebalulekileyo ekwenzeni ukuba urhwebo lwehlabathi luqhutywe ngeendlela engazikuthibaza uqoqosho, futhi yenze umonakalo kwezentlalo nakwindalo.

src: Lewa lena le arabela ho dintlha tse ka sehlohlolong tsa bomasepala ba setereke le diporofense, ka ho tobana le phano e sa lokang ya Meralo ya Motheo ya Dipalangwang tsa Metse ya Mahae le ditshebeletso e fokotsang ntshetsopele ya moruo wa kahisano.
tgt: Icandelo lezothutho liyintsika yoqoqosho nentlalo eMzantsi Afrika kuba linceda abantu batsho bakwazi ukuya kwiindawo abafuna ukuya kuzo neempahla zithuthwe.

src: Ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha lewa lena ho tla nyehela bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya moruo wa lehae le wa porofense ka ho ntlafatsa phumantsho ya dipalangwang tsa setjhaba.
tgt: Nangona kunjalo, imisi ekhutshwa zizithuthi inegalelo elikhulu kwiigesi ezichaphazela iqondo lobushushu bomhlaba (i-GHG), zona izithuthi ezihamba ezindleleni zikhupha umsi omninzi.

src: Sena se tla eketsa kgokahanyo pakeng tsa dibaka tsa ditoropo le tsa mahae, ka morero wa ho kenyeletsa tikoloho tsa mahaeng ka hara moruo o bataletseng.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga siphakamisa amanyathelo okungenelela aza kunciphisa iigesi ezenza i-GHG ngokwemimiselo yophuhliso oluzinzileyo.8 IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ube lilungu loMfelandawonye wezobuChwepheshe wase-Afrika.

src: Sena se supa boitlamo ba mmuso bakeng sa kgolo, ntshetsopele le diphethoho tsa lekala la dipalangwang tsa mawatleng tsa Aforika Borwa, mabapi le ho tshehetsa ntshetsopele ya moruo wa kahisano ha ka nqa e nngwe le nyehela kgwebisanong ya matjhaba.
tgt: Eli liphulo lokusebenzisana elikhokelwa ngamazwe ase-Afrika futhi ligxile ekuqambeni izisombululo ezifanelekileyo nokwabelana ngezixhobo zokusebenza ukuze kuliwe imingeni yezophuhliso eli lizwekazi elijamelene nayo.

src: Sena se tsamaelana le dintlha tse ka sehlohlolong tsa mmuso tse amanang le Operation Phakisa mabapi leho hodisa Moruo wa Mawatle.
tgt: Eli liphulo likhokelisa phambiil iintlobo zokuxhakaxhaba bobuchwepheshe bolwazi nonxibelelwano kwi-Ajenda yezoPhuhliso yowama-2063 yamazwe ase-Afrika.

src: Hape se tsamaelana le merero e bataletseng ya ho hodisa kgolo ya moruo le ho matlafatsa tlhahiso ya mesebetsi, jwaloka ha ho tekilwe ho NDP le Moralo wa Naha wa Meralo ya Motheo.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uza kuzuza ngokwezoqoqosho kunye nangokwezopolitiko ngokuthatha inxaxheba kulo Mfelandawonye wezobuChwepheshe wase-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Moralo wa Lewa la Dipalangwang tse Hlwekileng bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: Ngokulungelelanisa icandelo lezobuchwepheshe loMzantsi Afrika kunye nobunganga balo neenkqubo zophuhliso zoMfelandawonye wezobuChwepheshe wase-Afrika, uMzantsi Afrika uz a kuncedisa kuhlumo lwamashishini eli lizwekazi.9 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukuphunyezwa koMgaqo-nkqubo weSizwe weSebe leMfundo esisiSeko weNtsholongwane kaGawulayo (i-HIV), iziFo ezoSulela ngokuLalana (ii-STI) kunye neSifo sePhepha (i-TB).Umgaqo-nkqubo wowe-1999 wawugxininisa kuzo zonke iindlela zokulumkela kunye neendlela zokuzikhusela ezisekelwe kunyango, ungawuseli so kakhulu umba wezinto zeendlela ubomi bethu esibuphila ngayo, iimeko zezentlalo kwakunye neendlela esiziphethe ngazo njengezinto ezibalulekileyo ezibangelala i-HIV.

src: Dipalangwang di bapala karolo ya bohlokwa mabapi le ho kgontsha kgwebisano ya matjhaba ka mokgwa o tla bang wa moshwelella ho tsa moruo, kahisano le tikoloho.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo ucebisa ukuba masiyitshintshe yonke indlela esiyibona ngayo i-HIV siyibone njengesifo ekufuneka silawulwe kusetyenziswa indlela esetyenziswa ukulawula iinkonzo zezempilo zoluntu, kunye nokukhokeliswa phambili kwengxaki ye-TB ezikolweni, phakathi kwezinye izinto.

src: Mekgwa ya Dipalangwang e bopa mokokotlo wa mesebetsi ya moruo wa kahisano ka ho thusa ka ho tsamaiswa ha batho le dithoto.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo uza kusetyenziswa uquke abantu abaninzi uquke abafundi, ootitshala kunye namagosa kwizikolo zikarhulumente ngokunjalo nakwezizimeleyo.

src: Leha ho le jwalo, mesi e tswang lekaleng la dipalangwang e nyehela ho palo kaofela ya ho ntshuwa ha dikgase tse kotsi (GHG), moo makoloi e leng ona a nyehelang haholo.
tgt: Imithetho Eyilwayo.1 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa ePalammente koMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo weeNkampani yeziKhululo zeeNqwelo-moya wowama-2017, kunye noMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo weeNkonzo zezoLawulo lweeNqwelo-moya eMoyeni nobuChwepheshe bokuLawula iiNqwelo-moya eMoyeni.

src: Lewa lena le rerile ho sisinya maitshunyako a tla fokotsa mesi ya GHG ka hara dipehelo tsa ntshetsopele ya moshwelella.
tgt: Izilungiso kule Mithetho-sihlomelo zilungiselelwe ukunika umthetho osisigxina.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana hore Aforika Borwa e kenele Smart Africa Alliance.
tgt: Ezi zilungiso zinika nethuba lokuba kumiselwe iikomiti zokubhena, eziza kusetyenziselwa ukusombulula iimbambano.

src: Sena ke tshebedisano e etelletsweng pele ke Aforika mabapi le ho hlahisa le ho abelana mehlodi ya ho tobana le diphephetso tsa ntshetsopele tse shebaneng le kontinente.
tgt: Imisitho ezayo.1 UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kwenza intetho yokuvula i-Indaba yezoKhenketho yowama-2017 eza kube ibanjelwe kwiziko i-Inkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre eDurban phakathi komhla we-16 nowe-18 kuCanzibe wowama-2017.Le yingqungquthela yehlabathi eza kubonisa ngeemveliso zoMzantsi Afrika zecandelo lezokhenketho nelokuntenda.

src: E beha Dithekenoloji tsa Tlhahisoleseding le Dikgokahanyo bohareng ba lenaneo la ntshetsopele la selemo sa 2063 la dinaha tsa Aforika.
tgt: Le Indaba iza kukhuthaza futhi ixhase amaphulo aqhubayo okuzisa iinguqu kunye nophuhliso kwicandelo lezokhenketho loMzantsi Afrika ingakumbi ngokwendima edlalwa ngoosomashishini abasakhasayo kunye nabanikazi bamashishini amancinci.

src: Ka ho beha diindaseteri tsa Aforika Borwa bohareng ba lenaneo la ntshetsopele la Smart Africa, Aforika Borwa e tla nyehela kgolong ya kgwebo ya lehae ka hara lebatowa.
tgt: Ngabakhenkethi abavela kumazwe angaphandle abangaphezulu kwizigidi ezili-10 abangena eMzantsi Afrika ngowama-2016, into leyo ithetha ukuba bangaphezulu nge-13% kwabo bowama-2015.Eli zinga lingaphezulu kakhulu kumyinge oyi-3% ongumyinge wehlabathi wokunyuka kwamanani wabakhenkethi ngeli xesha linye.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwanaphatlalatso ya Leano la Naha la Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo ya (HIV), Ditshwaetso tse Fetiswang ka Thobalano (di-STI) le Lefuba (TB).Leano lena la selemo sa1999 le tsepamisitse maikutlo hodima ditemoso tse tlwaelehileng le dintlha tsa bophelo tsa bongaka tsa thibelo, le hanyenyane hodima mekgwa ya boitshwaro ya dibopeho le ya kahisano e hlohleletsang HIV.
tgt: Ngeli thuba uMzantsi Afrika uza kube usingathe le Indaba yezoKhenketho uza kuxhamla ngokuza kwenkitha yabathunywa abaza kutyelela eli lizwe lakuthi.2 UMphathiswa wezaMandla uNksz Mmamoloko Kubayi uza kukhokela iphulo leNyanga yaMandla kule nyanga phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukukhuthaza iintlobo zamandla ezahlukeneyo ezifikelelekayo nezizinzileyo ngeenjongo zokuxhasa ingunqu ezimandla zezentlalo nezoqoqosho’.Eli phulo liza kufundisa, lazise futhi linike namathuba okufakana imilomo noluntu malunga nemiba yokusebenzisa amandla ngobunono, ubukho bamandla aneleyo kunye nezinye iintlobo zamandla nokuba ibaluleke kangakanani indlela amakhaya, abezoshishini kunye nemizi-mvelisi eyisebenzisa ngayo umbane.3 IiVoti zoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali zamaSebe zowama-2017 eziza kubanjwa kuCanzibe ngowama-2017 ziza kunika amasebe ithuba lokuba axelelele ipalamente kunye noluntu ngobubanzi ngendlela aza kuyisebenzisa ngayo imali ayabelwe ngowama-2017.Amasebe aza kusebenzisa eli thuba acacisele uluntu ukuba iinkqubo zawo zalo nyaka-mali umiyo ziza kube ziqulathe ntoni na.

src: Leano lena le sisinya tsela ya ho swaela lehakoreng la ho bona HIV jwaloka taba e bohareng ya bolaodi ho sebediswa katamelo ya bophelo bo botle ba setjhaba, hammoho le ho kenyeletswa ha TB jwaloka ntlha e ka sehlohlolong ka hara dikolo, hara tse ding.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela uluntu ukuba luzifunde luzicokise ezi Voti zoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali njengoko ziza kube zinikezelwa epalamente ngokweenkqubo zepalamente.

src: Ho phatlalla ha tshebediso ho pharaleditswe ho ya baneng, matitjhereng le ho bahlanka, dikolong tsa mmuso le tsa poraefete.
tgt: ISebe lezaManzi noGutyulo liza kusingatha iVeki yezoGutyulo phakathi komhla we-16 nowama-22 kuCanzibe ngowama-2017 phantsi komxholo othi: UGutyulo luSetyenziselwa iMpilo neSidima Sabantu”.

src: DibiliKabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho hlahiswa haSehlomathiso sa Bili ya Khamphani ya Maemafofane, ya selemo sa 2017 le Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Ditshebeletso tsa Sephethephethe sa Moyeng le Tsamaiso ya Difofane Palamenteng.
tgt: Urhulumente uzimisele ukubuyisela abemi boMzantsi Afrika isidima sabo ngokubabonelela ngeenkonzo zogutyulo.

src: Diphetoho dibiling tsena tse pedi di reretswe bakeng sa ho fana ka Sebopeho sa Taolo sa moshwelella.
tgt: Ngale veki kuza kugxininiswa kakhulu ekukhokeliseni phambili iNkqubo yokuPhelisa Amabhakethi.

src: Hape diphethoho di fana ka monyetla wa ho theha dikomiti tsa mekgwa ya maipiletso, tse tla sebetsa mabapi le ho rarolla dikgang dife kapa dife.
tgt: Ngethuba lale veki kuza kunikezelwa izindlu zangasese ezigungxulwayo kubantu abakuMasipala weNgiqi waseNketoane, eFreyistatha kunye noMasipala weNgingqi iDavid Kruiper eMntla Koloni njengenxalenye yokukhawulezisa iinkonzo zogutyulo ukuze kupheliswe inkqubo yokusebenzisa amabhakethi njengezindlu zangasese.5 UMzantsi Afrika ubhiyozela iNyanga ye-Afrika phantsi komxholo othi: Ukwakha i-Afrika eNgcono neHlabathi eliNgcono.

src: Diketsahalo tse tlangMoporesidente Jacob Zuma o tla fana ka puo ya pulo ya Indaba ya Bohahlaudi ya selemo sa2017 e tla tshwarelwa Setsing sa Matjhaba sa Dikopano sa Inkosi Albert Luthuli Durban pakeng tsa la 16 le la 18 Motsheanong 2017.Ena ke indaba ya matjhaba eo hape e tla pepesa dihlahiswa le ditshebeletso tsa Aforika Borwa ka hara lekala la bohahlaudi le bodulo ba baeti.
tgt: ISebe lezobuGcisa neNkcubeko liza kukhokela imisitho emininzi eza kugxininisa kubumbano lwe-Afrika.

src: Indaba ya Bohahlaudi ya 2017 hape e tla hodisa le ho tshehetsa diphethoho tse ntseng di tswela pele le ntshetsopele ya indaseteri ya bohahlaudi ya Aforika Borwa ka ho qolleha karolo e bapalwang ke baetapele ba dikgwebo le beng ba dikgwebo tse nyenyane.
tgt: Le misitho iza kufikela kuvuthondaba ngomhla wama-25 kuCanzibe kowama-2017 apho uMongameli eza kusingatha umsitho osisidlo esisesikweni eSefako Makgatho Presidential Guesthouse.

src: Ka haraAforika Borwa ho fihlile bahahlaudi ba matjhabeng ba fetang 10 milione ka selemo sa 2016, 13% ho feta selemong sa 2015.
tgt: Abantu abamenyiweyo kwesi sidlo zinkokeli zemibutho yabantu abaphuma kumazwe angaphandle abahlala apha eMzantsi Afrika uMongameli ebekhe wadibana nabo ngowe-20.

src: Nakong ya indaba ena ya Bohahlaudi, Aforika Borwa e tla kgola molemo ho tswa palong ya baemedi ba tla kena naheng ya bo rona.
tgt: Ukutyalwa komkhosi wezokhuselo wesizwe womzantsi afrika (I-SANDF)9.1 IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isigqibo sikaMongameli uJacob Zuma sokwandisa ixesha elibekelwe amajoni e-SANDF atyalwe eDemocratic Republic of Congo (e-DRC).Ukwenza oku kukuncedisa kumalinge okudala uxolo nozinzo kweli lizwekazi le-Afrika ingakumbi kulo mmandla ngokuhambelana noxanduva lwethu njengelizwe eliyinxalenye yamazwe ehlabathi kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo weli wezangaphandle wokuncedisa kumaphulo okudala i-Afrika kunye nehlabathi elingcono.2 Ngamajoni e-SANDF angama-1 371 atyalwe e-DRC ukuya kuncedisa kwiPhulo lokuZisa uZinzo loMbutho weZizwe eziManyeneyo.

src: Letona la Eneji Mmamoloko Kubayi kgweding ena o tla etella peleletsholo la Kgwedi ya Eneji tlasa mookotaba,“Re kgothaletsa motswako wa eneji e kgonehang le ya moshwelella mabapi le ho tshehetsa diphethoho tse matla tsa moruo wa kahisano”.
tgt: Ixesha aza kulichitha e-DRC la majoni landisiwe lisuka kumhla woku-1 kuTshazimpunzi ngowama-2017 laya kutsho kumhla wama-31 kweyoKwindla ngowama-20.3 Ukutyala kwethu amajoni kweli lizwekazi kulilinge lokuxhasa amaphulo alo mmandla naweli lizwekazi okuzama ukulwa izixholo-xholo, ukukhuthaza uxolo nokhuseleko, ukomeleza ubudlelwane phakathi kwemimandla yeli lizwekazi, ukunyusa izinga lokurhwebelana phakathi kwamazwe ase-Afrika kunye nokulwela uphuhliso oluzinzileyo e-Afrika.

src: Letsholo le tla ruta, le bope temoso le ho buisana le setjhaba mabapi le bokgabane ba eneji, polokeho ya eneji, dintlha tsa eneji e nngwe e fapaneng le kamoo e leng tsa bohlokwa bakeng sa tshebediso ya malapa, dikgwebo le diindaseteri.
tgt: Iimbasa zesizwe.1 IKhabhinethi ibaqhwabela izandla bonke abathe bawongwa ngeeMbasa zeSizwe ngo-ngowama-2017.

src: Dingangisano tsa Ditekanyetso tsa Mafapha tsa selemo sa2017ka Motsheanong2017 di hlahisa monyetla wa mafapha a ho hlahisa Palamenteng le setjhabeng ka kakaretso kamoo a tla sebedisang Ditekanyetso tseo a di abetsweng tsa selemo sa 2017.
tgt: Kulo nyaka ka-OR Tambo, basibonisile ukubaluleka kokusebenzela uMzantsi Afrika ongcono nesizwe esingcono.

src: A tla sebedisa dintlha tsena hape hore a abelane le setjhaba hore ke eng seo mananeo a ona a se fupereng bakeng sa selemo sa hajwale sa ditjhelete.
tgt: Sifunda kwimisebenzi yabo emihle, ukuzinikela kwabo, ukuthanda nokubonakalisa umdla ongazenzisiyo wokulwela uluntu nobuntu.

src: Lefapha la Metsi le Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere le tla tshwara Beke ya Dikgwerekgwere pakeng tsa la 16 le la 22 Motsheanong 2017 tlasa mookotaba: “Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere bakeng sa Bophelo bo botle le Seriti”.Mmuso o itlamme ho tlisa seriti ho maAforika Borwa ka phano ya ditshebeletso tsa tsamaiso ya dikgwerekgwere.
tgt: I-Order of Ikhamanga yeGolide (mnye), i-Order of Ikhamanga yeSilivere (basixhenxe), i-Order of Ikhamanga yeBronzi (mnye), i-Order of the Baobab yeGolide (mnye), i-Order of the Baobab yeSilivere (babini), i-Order of the Baobab yeBronzi (babini), i-Order of Luthuli yeSilivere (bangama-29), i-Order of Luthuli yeBronzi (mnye), i-Order of Mapungubwe yeSilivere (babini), i-Order of the Companions of OR Tambo yeGolide (mnye).2 Ukukhutshwa kweNgxelo ye-17 yeKhomishini yoLungelelwaniso lwezeNgqesho nguMphathiswa wezabaSebenzi uNksz Mildred Oliphant kubonakalisa indlela esihamba kancinci ngayo isantya sokuzisa iinguqu kwimisebenzi emininzi apha eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Ntlha e ka sehloohong e tla tsepamisetswa maikutlo bekeng ena e tla ba taba e ka sehlohlolong ya Lenaneo la Phediso ya Mabakete.
tgt: Le ngxelo ibonakalisa ukuba sisekude kakhulu ekufikeleleni kwisizwe apho abasebenzi bebonakalisa iintlanga ezahlukeneyo zoMzantsi Afrika ngokulinganayo.

src: Sena se tla bonahala ka phano ya dintlwana tse sebedisang metsi Masepala wa Lehae waNketoana, ho la Freistata le Masepaleng wa Lehae wa Dawid Kruiper, ho la Kapa Leboya jwaloka karolo ya ho akofisa ditshebeletso bakeng sa ho fedisa matlwana a mabakete.
tgt: Abantu abaNtsundu, abantu basetyhini kunye nabantu abakhubazekileyo ngabona bantu bavinjwa amathuba kuwo onke amabakala oLungelelwaniso kwezeNgqesho.3 Le ngxelo ibonisa ukuba abantu abamhlophe ngabo abakwizikhundla eziphezulu ezingama-68% zeli lizwe kurhulumente nakumashishini abucala, inani elo lilinani eliphindwe kathandathu labantu abamhlophe asele bekwinqanaba lokusebenza.

src: Aforika Borwa e keteka Kgwedi ya Aforika tlasa mookotaba: Aforika e Betere le Lefatshe le Betere.
tgt: Abantu abantsundu bona bakwizikhundla eziphezulu ezili-14.4% kuphela.4 Njengoko umba wokuzisa iinguqu nowohlumo oluza kuxhanyulwa ngumntu wonke ingxamiseke kakhulu xa kungoku, la manani eenkcukacha zengqesho kwizikhundla eziphezulu awamkelekanga kwaphela.

src: Diketsahalo tse ngata di ntse di tswela pele tse eteletsweng pele ke Lefapha la Bonono le Botjhabatse reretsweng ho kgothaletsa bonngwe ba Aforika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isibhengezo esenziwe nguMphathiswa wezabaSebenzi sokuba baza kuthathelwa amanyathelo aqatha abo bophula umthetho.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, la 24 Motsheanong 2017, Tuynhuys, Motse Kapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibibambe intlanganiso ngoLwesithathu, umhla wama-24 kuCanzibe kowama-2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Dintlha Tsa Hajwale.
tgt: Imiba engundaba-mlonyeni.

src: Kabinete e tshwenyehile ka diketsahalo tse ntseng di phahama tsa tlhekefetso le merusu kgahlanong le basadi ka hara setjhaba sa bo rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ixhalabile ziziganeko ezifuna ukuthatha unyawo zoxhatshazo kunye nobundlobongela obujoliswe kwabasetyhini kweli lizwe.

src: Diketsahalo tsa haufinyana tjena tsa merusu ya balekane ba ratanang di bonahetse ha basadi ba sebete ba ema ka maoto ho bua kgahlanong le kgatikelo ya ditokelo tsa bona.
tgt: Iziganeko zakutsha nje ziquka ubundlobongela obenziwa zizinqanda-mathe ezithe zakhokelela ekubeni abantu basetyhini abaninzi babonakalise isibindi nokungoyiki ngokuthi bathethe phandle bekhalimela ukunyhashwa kwamalungelo abo.

src: Kabinete e ananela hore jwaloka naha re ntse re tswela pele ho ba le setjhaba se laolwang ke banna mme ke kahoo ho nang le boipiletso ba hore ho sebetswe ho feta bakeng sa ho lwantsha koduwa ya dipolao tsa basadi le kgwebisano ka batho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuma ukuba njengelizwe siyaqhubeleka nokuba sisizwe esilawulwa ngogonyamelo labantu abangamadoda kangangokuba iyakubethelela ukuba kuninzi ekufuneka kwenziwe ukulwa umkhuba wokubulawa ngolunya kwabantu basetyhini kunye nokurhweba ngabantu.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho makala kaofela a setjhaba ho ipopa bakeng sa ho lwantsha koduwa ena, ho hanyetsana le mokgwa ofe kapa ofe wa merusu e etswang kgahlanong le basadi le bana, le ho sebetsa le sepolesa le tsamaiso ya toka bakeng sa ho tshwara baetsi ba diketso tsena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kuwo onke amacandelo kweli lizwe ukuba abambisane kuliwe nalo mkhwa mbi kangaka, azikhabe zonke iintlobo zobundlobongela ezenziwa kwabasetyhini nabantwana, nokuba asebenzisane namapolisa kunye necandelo leenkundla ukuze bonke abenzi bobubi badityaniswa nomthetho.

src: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o entse boipiletso ba hore ho emiswe ka tlhekefetso ya basadi le bana e ntseng e tswela pele.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma umemelele ukuba mawuphele lo mkhuba uqhubekekayo wokuxhatshazwa kwabantu basetyhini nabantwana.

src: Kabinete e laetse Sehlopha sa Tshireletso ya Kahisano, sa Ntshetsopele ya Badudi le Setjhaba ho tla ka lenaneo la tshebetso le tla kgannela naha ntweng ya ho emisa ka tlhekefetso ya basadi le bana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalele iNtlanganisela yoKhuseleko ekuHlaleni, uPhuhliso loLuntu naBantu ukuba imisele inkqubo yokusebenza eza kuba sisikhokelo esiza kunceda isizwe kwidabi lokulwa ukuxhatshazwa kwabasetyhini nabantwana.

src: Kabinete e amohela sephetho sa Aforika Borwa sa Tekolo ya Maemo a Setjhaba ka Kakaretso le a Bophelo bo Botle ya 2016 e entsweng ke Lefapha la Dipalopalo la Aforika Borwa (Stats SA), e methang maemo a bophelo bo botle ba maAforika Borwa, le phihlello le boleng ba mananeo a bophelo bo botle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamkela iziphumo zoPhando loMzantsi Afrika lowama-2016 leNani laBantu nezeMpilo liziko lezeNkcukacha-mani loMzantsi Afrika (i-Stats SA), eliphonononga imeko yempilo yabemi boMzantsi Afrika, kunye nomgangatho kunye nenani labantu abaxhamlayo kwiinkqubo zezempilo.

src: Tekolo ena hara tse ding e tlaleha hore ho na le phokotseho ya 20% ya ho shwa ha masea le phokotseho ya 11% palong ya basadi le banna ba tsubang.
tgt: Olu phando, phakathi kwezinye izinto, lunike ingxelo ezichaza ukuba inani labantwana abaswelekayo lihle ngama-20% nokuba elabantu basetyhini namadoda abatshaya icuba lona lihle nge-11%.Ezi ziphumo zibonakalisa ukuba imigaqo-nkqubo emiselwe ngulo mbuso uphantsi kukaMongameli Zuma iza neziphumo ezincumisayo.

src: Sephetho sena se bontsha hore maitshunyako a maano a behilweng ke tsamaiso ya Moporesidente Zuma a beha ditholwana tse ntle.
tgt: Noko kunjalo, iKhabhinethi ixhalabile linani labemi beli ababelana ngesondo namaqabane amaninzi ahlukeneyo bengasebenzisi zikhuseli.

src: Kabinete, le ha ho le jwalo, e tshwenyehile ka palo ya maAforika Borwa e ntseng e tswela pele ho kena thobalanong e sa tshireletsehang le balekane ba bangata.
tgt: Abantu basetyhini abangama-32% kunye nabangamadoda abangama-42% bathe zange baye kuhlolela iNtsholongwana kaGawulayo (i-HIV) nangoku sele kukho amaphulo amaninzi karhulumente okufundisa abantu malunga nokubaluleka kokuvavanyelwa i-HIV.

src: Se ka etsang 32% le 42% ya basadi le banna ka tatelano se bontshitse hore ha ba e so ka ba kenela diteko tsa HIV leha mmuso o entse mekutu ya ho hlahisa temoso ka ho kenela diteko tsa HIV.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bayazi into yokuba impilo yabo kunye nobomi babo busezandleni zabo, nokuba mabasebenzise izikhuseli xa besabelana ngesondo futhi bazihlole i-HIV kunye nazo zonke ezinye izifo ezosulelayo nezingosuleliyo.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho nka boikarabelo bakeng sa bophelo ba bona bo botle le boitekanelo, ho kena thobalanong e tshireletsehileng le ho dula ba kenela diteko tsa HIV le mafu kaofela a tshwaetsanang le a sa tshwaetsaneng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela abazali nabagcini-bantwana ukuba baqinisekise ukuba abantwana babo bazigonyelwe izifo zabantwana.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho batswadi le bahlokomedi ho netefatsa hore bana ba bona ba thola diente kgahlanong le mafu a bana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isazimisele ukuqinisekisa ukuba bayagonywa ukuze kuliwe izifo ezosulelayo eziyingozi.

src: Kabinete e dula e itlamme mabapi le ho etsa bonnete ba hore bana ba sireletsehile bakeng sa ho fedisa mahloko a tshwaetsanang a behang bophelo ba bana kotsing.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqinisekisa abazali kunye nabagcini-bantwana ukuba amayeza akhutshwa liSebe lezeMpilo awanabungozi.

src: Kabinete e tiisetsa batswadi le bahlokomedi hore meriana e fanwang ke Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle e bolokehile.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isigaba sokuqala sokuhlaziywa kweMizi-mveliso yaseVulindlela Heights eMthatha eMpuma Koloni.

src: Kabinete e amohetse mokgahlelo wa pele o tsoseleditsweng wa Setsi sa Diindaseteri sa Vulindlela Heights Mthatha ho la Kapa Botjhabela.
tgt: Oku kuyinxalenye yeNkqubo yesizwe yokuHlaziya imiMandla yeMizi-mveliso.

src: Sena ke karolo ya Lenaneo la Tsoseletso ya Diphaka tsa Diindaseteri.
tgt: Lo msebenzi ngowesibini eMpuma Koloni futhi lo mmandla wemizi-mveliso ngomnye wemithandathu evuselelwayo kweli lizwe.

src: Ke ya bobedi ya mofuta wa yona ho la Kapa Botjhabela le ho ba ya botshelela ya diphaka tse ntseng di tsoseletswa ho phatlalla le naha.
tgt: Urhulumente uhlaziya imimandla yemizi-mveliso ukuze kudaleke imisebenzi futhi kubekho nohlumo oluxhanyulwa ngumntu wonke.

src: Mmuso o tsoseletsa diphaka tsa diindaseteri ho matlafatsa tlhahiso ya mesebetsi le ho netefatsa kgolo e kenyeletsang.
tgt: Ukususwa kwemizi-mveliso norhwebo ezidolophini nako kuyinxalenye yamalinge karhulumente okuzisa iinguqo zezoqoqosho.

src: Ho suthisa mesebetsi ya moruo ho tloha ditsing tsa metse ya ditoropo hape ke karolo ya mekutu ya mmuso ya ho tlisa diphethoho moruong.
tgt: Iinkcukacha malunga nokuba ubani angawasebenzisa njani amathuba akhoyo kule mimandla yemizi-mveliso, ukufumana inkxaso karhulumente kunye neenkqubo zezibonelelo zikarhulumente, kunye namathuba otyalo-malo kumacandelo ahlukeneyo ziyafumaneka kule webhusayithi: WEBTOKEN okanye ngokutsalela umnxeba kwiZiko lemiBuzo leSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino (i-dti) kule nombolo: 0861 843 384.

src: Tlhahisoleseding e mabapi le kamoo o ka nkang monyetla wa menyetla e teng diphakeng tsa rona tsa diindaseteri, ho fihlella tshehetso ya mmuso le mananeo a ditsiane, le menyetla ya matsete makaleng a fapafapaneng e a fumaneha ho WEBTOKEN kapa ka Setsi sa Mehala sa Lefapha Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri (dti) ho 0861 843 384.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivile futhi idanisiwe sisigqibo sika-General Motors South Africa (GMSA) (Pty) Ltd sokuyeka ukwenza kunye nokuthengisa iimoto zakwa-Chevrolet kweli lizwe.

src: Kabinete e lemohile ka maswabi qeto ya General Motors South Africa (GMSA) (Pty) Ltd ya ho fedisa tlhahiso le thekiso ya makoloi a Chevrolet ka hara naha.
tgt: Oku kuzindaba ezimbi ngenene kuqoqosho lweli kwakunye nabo baza kuphulukana nemisebenzi.

src: Sena se fupere ditlamorao tse bohloko bakeng sa ba tla lahlehelwa ke mesebetsi ya bona le bakeng sa moruo wa rona.
tgt: Urhulumente nangoku usazimisele ukuxhasa icandelo lezeemoto, elilicandelo elibaluleke kakhulu kuqoqosho lweli kunye nakumalinge okudala imisebenzi.

src: Mmuso o dula o itlamme bakeng sa ho tshehetsa lekala la naha la tlhahiso ya makoloi, e leng le hlokolosi bakeng sa moruo le tlhahiso ya WEBTOKEN dti ba tswela pele ho sebetsa le bankakarolo kaofela ho bebofatsa sekgahla sa sena.
tgt: I-dti iyaqhubeleka nokusebenzisana nawo onke amahlakani ukuba enze iinzame zokuphungula umonkalo oza kwenziwa koku.

src: Bakeng sa ho eketsa tlhahiso, tlhahiso ya mesebetsi le matlafatso ya dihlahiswa tse rekiswang ka ntle, haufinyana tjena re thakgotse mokgahlelo wa borobong wa Moralo wa Leano la Tshebetso la Diindaseteri (IPAP) bakeng sa ho tataisa mesebetsi ya rona.
tgt: Ukunyusa izinga lokuvelisa, ukudala imisebenzi nokunyusa umthamo wempahla zorhwebo ezithunyelwa kumazwe angaphandle, siphehlelele isigaba sesithoba sesiCwangciso sokuSebenza soMgaqo-nkqubo wezoShishino (i-IPAP) ukuze sibe sisikhokelo sethu.

src: Kabinete e ananela hore Isuzu, eo esale e le selekaneng le GMSA ka dilemo tse ngata ka hara Aforika Borwa, e tla nka ditshebetso tsa GMSKabinete e lemohile ho mpefala ha maemo a komello ka hara Kapa Bophirima le Kapa Botjhabela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukuba inkampani yakwa-Isuzu, ebikade isebenzisana no-GMSA iminyaka emininzi eMzantsi Afrika, yiyo ngoku eza kungena endaweni ka-GMSIKhabhinethi iwuqaphela umba wembalela ethathe unyawo eNtshona Koloni naseMpuma Koloni.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho badudi ho tshehetsa dithibelo tsa tshebediso ya metsi tse tsebahaditsweng ke diporofense.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela uluntu ukuba nalo luncedise kwiinkqubo eziqaliswe ngala maphondo zokunciphisa indlela amanzi ankinkishwa ngayo.

src: Moifo o bopilweng ka bahlanka ho tswa ho Lefapha la Metsi le Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere, Komiti ya Naha ya Taolo ya Dikoduwa o sebetsa mmoho le diporofense le mmuso wa lehae, esale o phathahane mabapi le ho netefatsa hore ditharollo tsa nako e kgutshwanyane ho isa ho tsa nako e bohareng di a akofiswa bakeng sa ho tiisetsa polokeho ya metsi ya porofense bakeng sa nako e telele.
tgt: Iqela elakhiwe ngamagosa aphuma kwiSebe lezaManzi noGutyulo, kunye neKomiti yeSizwe yoLawulo lweeNtlekele lisebenzisana namaphondo kunye noomasipala, lifakana imilomo ngeenjongo zokuqinisekisa ukuba izisombululo ezikhawulezileyo nezexesha elide ziyakhawuleziswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba kukho amanzi aneleyo kula maphondo aza kusetyenziswa ixesha elide.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho kenyeletswa basebedisi ba malapeng, dikgwebo, lekala la merafo, makala a eneji le a temo ho sebetsa mmoho le ho sebedisa metsi ka polokeho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika kuquka nabantu emakhaya, kwicandelo lezoshishino, elezemigodi, elezamandla kunye nelezolimo ukuba basebenzisane futhi basebenzise amanzi ngononophelo.

src: Kabinete e amohetse tokomane ya dipuisano e lokolotsweng ya Lewa Kgahlanong le Bobodu, e tla matlafatsa Lewa la Naha le Kgahlanong le Bobodu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukukhutshwa koxwebhu ekuza kuxoxwa phezu kwalo lesiCwangciso-qhinga sokuLwa noRhwaphilizo, eliza kusetyenziswa njengesikhokelo sesiCwangciso-qhinga seSizwe sokuLwa noRhwaphilizo.

src: Kabinete e mema setjhaba ho etsa diphehiso tse ngotsweng ka websaete ya Lefapha la Meralo, Bodisa le Tlhatlhobo ya Tshebetso: www.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela uluntu ukuba luhlomle luvakalise izimvo zalo ngolu xwebhu ngokuthumela ezo zimvo kwiwebhusayithi yeSebe lezokuCwangcisa, ukuHlola nokuVavanya ethi: www.

src: Ntwa kgahlanong le bobodu e dula e le e nngwe ya dintlha tse ka sehlohlolong tsa mmuso.
tgt: Idabi lokulwa urhwaphilizo lusengumba ophambili kurhulumente.

src: Bobodu le ho nyehla ha seriti ho ka bobedi makala a mmuso le a poraefete di na le kgahlamelo e kotsi hodima ntshetsopele ya naha ya bo rona.
tgt: Urhwaphilizo nokungathenjwa kwabasemagunyeni kurhulumente nakwicandelo lamashishini kuneziphumo ezibi kuphuhliso lwelizwe.

src: Kabinete e hlahisitse ngongoreho ka tlhaselo ya lefatshe ka marangrang a dikgokahano ya haufinyana tjena, e tlalehilweng e le tlhaselo e kgolo ka ho fetisisa ho fihlela hajwale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise ukuxhalaba sisenzo sakutshanje sobukrelemqa kweze-intanethi kwihlabathi, esichazwe njengesona senzo sobukrelemqa kweze-intanethi esakhe sasikhulu ezimbalini.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa kaofela ho nka mehato ya tlhokomelo ha ba sebedisa mekgwa ya dikgokahanyo ya elektroniki le ho etsa ditumellano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba balumke kangangoko xa besebenzisa ubuxhaka-xhaka beteknoloji xa benxibelelana okanye bethumela, bekhupha okanye befakelwa imali.

src: Ho sebedisa disebediswa tsa antivaerase ya khomphyutha kgafetsa tse tla hlahloba tikoloho e sa lokang inthaneteng le tsona di a kgothaletswa.
tgt: Abantu bayakhuthazwa ukuba basebenzise iinkqubo zekhompyutha ezinesakhono esihlaziywa rhoqo sokulwa nezinye iinkqubo zekhompyutha ezinjongo yazo ikukuba nokutshabalalisa ulwazi olukwikhompyutha.

src: Kabinete e ngongorehile ka tse ntseng di etsahala haufinyana tjena Eskom.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ixhalatyisiwe zizinto ezenzeka kwa-Eskom.

src: Kabinete e ananela hore taba ya ho hirwa hape ha Monghadi Brian Molefe jwaloka Mohlanka e Moholo wa Phethahatso (CEO) wa Eskom e makgotleng a dinyewe le ka hara Palamente, mme ka hona e tla hlompha ditsamaiso tsena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakuqonda ukuba umba wokuqeshwa kwakhona kukaMnu Brian Molefe njengeGosa eliPhezulu lesiGqeba (i-CEO) usezinkundleni zamatyala nasePalamente ke ngoko ayizikuphazamisana neenkqubo zala macandelo karhulumente.

src: Moporesidente, le ha ho le jwalo, o thehile Komiti e Kopanetsweng ya Matona (IMC) e bopilweng ka Letona la Dikgwebo tsa Mmuso, la Eneji, la Ditjhelete le la Toka le Ditshebeletso tsa Tlhabollo ya Batshwaruwa.
tgt: Noko kunjalo, uMongameli umisele iKomiti yaBaphathiswa (i-IMC) eyakhiwe nguMphathiswa wamaShishini kaRhulumente, owezaMandla, owezeMali kunye nowezobuLungisa neeNkonzo zoLuleko.

src: IMC e kopuwe ho bokeletsa dintlha mabapi le ho tataisa Kabinete kamoo e tla sebetsanang le dintlha tse jwalo nakong e tlang.
tgt: Le IMC inikwe umsebenzi wokuqokelela iinkcukacha eziza kunceda iKhabhinethi ukuba ikwazi ukusombulula nokuphendula imiba efana nale kwixa elizayo.

src: Moetapele ke Letona la Toka le Ditshebeletso tsa Tlhabollo ya Batshwaruwa, Monghadi Michael Masutha.
tgt: Umququzeleli wale IMC nguMphathiswa wezobuLungisa neeNkonzo zoLuleko uMichael Masutha.

src: Diqeto tsa kabinete.
tgt: Izigqibo zekhabhinethi.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Tjhata e Shebilweng Botjha ya Matlafatso e Pharaletseng ya Batho ba Batsho Moruong bakeng sa Indaseteri ya Aforika Borwa ya Merafo le Diminerale ka selemo sa 2017.Letona la Mehlodi ya Diminerale Mosebenzi Zwane o tla fana ka tsebiso hang feela ha tjhata e se e kentswe koranteng ya mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa ngowama-2017 koMqulu oHlaziyiweyo wezoPhuhliso oluBanzi lwabaMnyama kwezoQoqosho wecandelo lezeMigodi neziMbiwa loMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e amohetse Moralo wa Naha wa Maqhubu a Radio wa selemo sa 2017 o tjhaelletsweng monwana ke Lefapha la Meralo ya Motheo ya Dikgokahanyo le Ditshebeletso tsa Poso.
tgt: UMphathiswa wemiThombo yeziMbiwa uza kunika amagqabantshintshi wakuba lo mqulu upapashiwe kwigazethi.

src: Ho ajwa ha maqhubu ke Pitso ya Lefatshe ya Dikgokahanyo tsa Radio ho na le kgahlamelo ya bohlokwa kgolong ya moruo wa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isivumile isiCwangciso seSizwe saMaz’omoya ezoNxibelelwano sowama-2017 esamkelwe liSebe leziSeko zoNxibelelwano neeNkonzo zePosi.

src: Moralo wa Naha wa Maqhubu a Radio wa selemo sa 2017 ke mohlodi o pharaletseng wa kabo ya ho phatlalla ha maqhubu a radio bakeng sa ditshebeletso tse fapaneng tsa dikgokahanyo tsa radio.
tgt: Lo mthamo wamaza omoya eli lizwe liwabelwe kwiNkomfa yeHlabathi yezoNxibelelwano ngaMaz’omoya uza kudlala indima enkulu kuhlumo loqoqosho loMzantsi Afrika.

src: Moralo o shebilweng botjha wa Naha wa Maqhubu a Radio wa selemo sa 2017 o netefatsa hore Aforika Borwa e matahantswe le Melawana ya Matjhaba ya Radio e tjhaelletsweng monwana e ileng ya amohelwa ka selemo sa 2015 ho Pitso ya Matjhaba ya Meralo ya Motheo ya Dikgokahanyo (ITU).
tgt: IsiCwangciso seSizwe saMaz’omoya ezoNxibelelwano sowama-2017 sisikhokelo esityebileyo esicacisa indlela amaza omoya abiwe ngayo esabelwa iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo ezisebenzisa amaza omoya kwezonxibelwano.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Lewa la Boipaballo ba ka hara Naha ba Metsing.
tgt: IsiCwangciso seSizwe saMaz’omoya ezoNxibelelwano sowama-2017 siza kuqinisekisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika uthobela iMithetho yeHlabathi yezaMaz’omoya eyamkelwa kwinkomfa yowama-2015 yoMfelandawonye weHlabathi weziSeko zoNxibelelwano.

src: Lewa lena, ka Bolaudi ba Boipaballo ba Mawatleng ba Aforika Borwa, le beha maemo le ho ntlafatsa ditsamaiso mabapi le ho dumella le ho etsa ditlhophiso tsa dilaesense bakeng sa diketswana tse sebedisang ditsela tsa rona tsa metsi tsa ka hara naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isamkele isiCwangciso-qhinga soKhuseleko kwiMijelokazi neMilambo Emikhulu.

src: Sena se tla netefatsa boipaballo ba dikepe tse nyenyane ditseleng tsa ka hara naha tsa metsi tsa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga, ngokusebenzisa iQumrhu loMzantsi Afrika lezoKhuseleko eManzini, simisela imigangatho kwaye siphucula iinkqubo zokunika amaphepha-mvume kunye neelayisenisi kumaphenyane asebenza kule milambo mikhulu nemijelokazo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Lewa la Mebila la Tsamaiso ya Dithoto.
tgt: Oku kuza kuqinisekisa ukuba la maphenyana asebenza kule milambo mikhulu nemijelokazi akhuselekile.

src: Lewa lena le rerile ho hlahisa moralo o kopanetsweng wa taolo le tshebetso, o tla kgontsha Aforika Borwa ho fihlella maemo a hlwahlwa ka ho fetisisa a matjhaba a ditshebetso tsa mebila ya tsamaiso ya dithoto.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isivumile isiCwangciso-qhinga sokuHambisa imiThwalo eziNdleleni.

src: Dikgothaletso leweng lena di tla matlafatsa bohlwahlwa ba qobello, ho hodisa boipaballo mebileng, ho matlafatsa tshireletso ya meralo ya motheo, ho fokotsa dikgahlamelo tsa tikoloho, le ho bopa moralo o kopanetsweng wa phehisano e laolwang ho ya ka boleng boo ka hara lekala la tsamaiso ya dithoto le ka tswelang pele ho sebeletsa ditlhoko tsa moruo wa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga silungiselelwe ukubhala imithetho ehlanginisiweyo kunye nesicwangciso sokusebenza, into leyo eza kubangela ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ukwazi ukufikelela kumgangatho wehlabathi ophezulu kwezokuhanjiswa kwemithwalo ezindleleni.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana meralo ya Khamphani ya Mente ya Aforika Borwa bakeng sa dikhoine tsa sehopotso le tse tla sebediswa tsa dilemo tsa 2017 le 2018.Ka tshebedisano le Kabinete, ho hlahisitswe letoto le letjha le emelang botjhaba, tokoloho le demokerasi tlasa mookotaba: “Re keteka Aforika Borwa”.
tgt: Iziphakamiso ezi kwesi sicwangciso-qhinga ziza kuphucula indlela imithetho enyanzeliswa ngayo, zikhuthaze ukhuseleko ezindleni, zikhokelise phambili ukukhuselwa kweziseko ezingundoqo, kuphungulwe umonakalo kwindalo, zidale isicwangciso esihlangeneyo sokhuphiswano olusekelwe kwiimveliso neenkonzo ezisemgangathweni icandelo lezohanjiso lweempahla ezindleleni eliza kulusebenzisa ukuze lizalisekise izidingo zoqoqosho loMzantsi Afrika.

src: Tswalo ya Molwanedi wa Tokoloho ya dilemo di lekgolo Oliver Reginald Tambo e kgethilwe e le sehlooho sa pele se tla bontshwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilwamkele uhlobo lwengqekembe olwenziwe yi-South African Mint Company lweengqekembe zowama-2017 nowama-2018 ezisisikhumbuzo neziza kusetyenziswa luluntu.

src: Ho hlahiswa ha R50 (1aonse, silifera ya seteling) e ntjha ya khoene, R500 (1aonse, 24 dikharata tsa gauta) ya khoene le R50 (metale wa motheo) ya khoene ho keteka sehopotso sa dilemo tse 100 tsa letsatsi la tswalo la OR Tambo.
tgt: Ngokusebenzisana neKhabhinethi, olu hlobo lutsha lweengqekembe lwenzelwe ukuphawula inkcubeko, inkululeko nolawulo lwentando yesininzi phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukubhiyozela uMzantsi Afrika”.

src: Meralo ya letoto la dikhoene tse latelang tsa dilemo tsa 2017 le 2018 tsa sehopotso di hlahisitswe:a. Letoto la dikhoene la selemo sa 2017: Mokete wa Dilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Oliver Reginald Tambob.
tgt: Isikhumbuzo seminyaka elikhulu sokuzalwa kweGqala loMzabalazo u-Oliver Reginald Tambo sakhethwa njengomba ekuza kusekelwa phezu kwawo xa kuzotywa ezi ngqekembe.

src: Dikhoene tse tla sebediswa naheng tsa selemo sa 2017: khoene ya R5 e bontshang Tlotlo ya Metswalle ya OR Tamboc.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kwengqekembe ye-R50 entsha (i-1oz, nesilivere ye-sterling), ingqekembe ye-R500 (i-1oz, negolide eneekharathi ezingama-24) kunye nengqekembe ye-R50 (eyenziwe ngesinyithi) zokubhiyozela iminyaka elikhulu yokuzalwa kuka-OR Tambo.

src: Letoto la dikhoene la selemo sa 2017 la Protea: Bophelo ba Mohale – Nelson Mandelad.
tgt: Zenziwe iintlobo zengqekembe zezi ngqekembe zesikhumbuzo zilandelayo zowama-2017 nowama-2018:a. Iingqekembe zowama-2017: Umbhiyozo wemiNyaka eliKhulu ka-Oliver Reginald Tambob.

src: Letoto la dikhoene tsa 2017 tsa R1: Dihahabi tsa Aforika Borwa – Marabee.
tgt: Iingqekembe zowama-2017 eziza kusetyenziswa: ingqekembe ye-R5 ebonisa imbasa i-Order of the Companions of OR Tamboc.

src: Letoto la dikhoene tsa selemo sa 2018 la Mokgatlo wa Thuto, Saense le Botjhaba wa Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UNESCO) la Motho le Sebaka sa Bophelo: Resefe ya Sebaka sa Bophelo ya Waterbergf.
tgt: Iingqekembe ze-Protea zowama-2017: Ubomi beSithwalandwe – uNelson Mandelad.

src: Letoto la dikhoene la selemo sa 2018: Mokgatlo wa Naha wa Sebopeho sa Naha ‘Boikitlaetso ba Dikatse tse Kgolo’ – Taug.
tgt: Iingqekembe ze-R1 zowama-2017: Izirhubuluzi zoMzantsi Afrika - Irhambae.

src: Dikhoene tsa selemo sa 2018: FIFA World Cup RussiaTDiketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Iingqekembe zowama-2018 zaBantu neBhayosfiye zoMbutho we-UN wezeMfundo, ezeNzululwazi nezeNkcubeko: UMyezo weBhayosfiye waseWaterbergf.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho tshehetsa Beke ya Tshireletso ya Bana ho tloha ka la 28 Motsheanong ho isa ka la 4 Phuptjane tlasa mookotaba: “Bohle ha re tshireletseng bana bakeng sa ho ntshetsa Aforika Borwa pele”.
tgt: Iingqekembe zowama-2018: i-National Geographic Society ‘iPhulo leziLwanyana eziziKati zaseNdle eziNkulu - Ingonyamag.

src: Tshireletso ya bana ba rona ke mosebetsi le boikarabelo ba maAforika Borwa kaofela batswadi, bahlokomedi, batho ka bo mong le badudi.
tgt: Umba wokukhuselwa kwabantwana ngumsebenzi noxanduva lwabemi boMzantsi Afrika, abazali, abagcini-bantwana, abantu kunye noluntu.

src: Jwaloka ka setjhaba, ke mosebetsi wa rona ho etsa ho hongata ho netefatsa hore ba tsietsing ka ho fetisisa ka hara setjhaba sa rona ha ba hlekefetswe.
tgt: Njengesizwe sinoxanduva lokwenza konke esinakho ukwenza ukuze siqinisekise ukuba abantu abasemngciphekweni wokuba ngamaxhoba okuxhatshazwa kwesi sizwe abaxhatshazwa baphathwe kakubi.

src: Ho diatleng tsa rona ho kgina motsamao wa ho nyahlatsa, ho hlekefetsa, merusu le ho ja bana tsuo.
tgt: Kusezandleni zethu ukuba siphelise umkhuba oxakileyo wokungakhathalelwa, ukuxhatshazwa, ubundlobongela nokuphathwa kakubi kwabantwana.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa makala oohle a setjhaba ho sebetsa mmoho bakeng sa ho bopa metse e bolokehileng le ho itekanela hore bana ba rona e tle e be batho setjhabeng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela ukuba bonke abantu kweli lizwe badale iimeko ezikhuselekileyo nezifanelekileyo zokunceda abantwana bakhule, bantingele ezinkwenkwezini.

src: Nakong ya mokete wa dilemo tse lekgolo tsa OR Tambo, Aforika Borwa e tla tshwaya Kgwedi ya Batjha ka Phuptjane 2017 tlasa mookotaba: “Selemo sa OR Tambo: Re ntshetsapele Bonkakarolo ba Batjha Moruong.”Kgweding eo kaofela mmuso o tla kenela diketsahalo tse mmalwa ho kenyeletswa dipontsho tsa batjha, dipuisano le dibaka tsa baetapele ba dikgwebo ba batjha ho pepesa menyetla e teng bakeng sa batjha, le ho ba hlohlelletsa ho ikgapela ditlwaelo tsa thuto le boetapele tsa OR Tambo.
tgt: Kule mibhiyozo yeminyaka elikhulu yokuzalwa kuka-OR Tambo, uMzantsi Afrika uza kubhiyozela iNyanga yoLutsha ngeyeSilimela yowama-2017 phantsi komxholo othi: “UNyaka ka-OR Tambo: Ukuqhubela Phambili Indima Edlalwa Lulutsha kuQoqosho.”Ngale nyanga, urhulumente uza kubamba iindibano eziliqela, eziquka imiboniso engezolutsha, iindibano zokubonisana kunye neengqungquthela ezingendima yolutsha kwezoshishino ukuze kucaciswe ngamathuba akhoyo okunceda abantu abatsha, futhi nokubakhuthaza ukuba bafunde iimpawu zobunkokeli ezibonakalisa nezixabise imfundo, izakhono ezo u-OR Tambo naye awayesimelele ngazo.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa batjha bohle ho fihlella mananeo a fapafapaneng a tshehetso le thuto ao mmuso o a hlahisitseng bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa menyetla le ho ntshetsapele bonkakarolo ba bona moruong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza bonke abantu abatsha ukuba bazisebenzise iinkqubo zoncedo nezemfundo eziqulunqwe ngurhulumente ukulungisela bona ukuze kuphuculwe izakhono zabo ukuze amathuba abo okuthatha inxaxheba evakalayo kuqoqosho abe mahle.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho bahiri ho nka karolo kgoeletsong ya tloho le ngwana wa ngwanana mosebetsing ka la 25 le la 26 Motsheanong.
tgt: IKhabinethi icela bonke abaqeshi ukuba bafake isandla kwiphulo elibizwa i-Take a girl child to work ngomhla wama-25 nowama-26 kuCanzibe.

src: Sepheo ke ho hlahisetsa banana ba etsang Kereiti 10 ho ya ho 12 makala a fapaneng a thuto.
tgt: Injongo yeli phulo kukunika abantwana abangamantombazana abafunda kwiBanga le-10 nele-12 ithuba lokuba bazibonele ngokwabo iintlobo zamakhondo ezahlukeneyo.

src: Moporesidente Zuma ka Labone, la 25 Motsheanong 2017, o tla tshwara mokete wa naha wa selemo sa 2017 wa Letsatsi la Aforika Ntlong ya Baeti ba Boporesidente ya Sefako Makgatho Pretoria.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma ngoLwesine, umhla wama-25 kuCanzibe wowama-2017, uza kubamba umsitho wokubhiyozela uSuku lwesizwe lwe-Afrika eSefako Makgatho Presidential Guesthouse ePitoli.

src: Sena ke phethelo ya diketsahalo le mananeo a tshwayang Kgwedi ya Aforika tlasa mookotaba: “Selemo sa OR Tambo: Re aha Aforika e Betere le Lefatshe le Betere”.
tgt: Lo msitho uza kube uluvuthondaba lwemibhiyozo neenkqubo eziphawula iNyanga ye-Afrika phantsi komxholo othi: “UNyaka ka-OR Tambo: Ukwakha i-Afrika eNgcono kunye neHlabathi eliNgcono”.

src: Sehopotso sa selemo ka seng sa Letsatsi la Aforika se tshwaya ho thehwa ha Mokgatlo wa Kopano ya Aforika (OAU) ka selemo sa 1963.Ha re phethela Kgwedi ya Aforika, Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela le maAforika a bo rona a dulang ka hara Aforika Borwa le dibakeng tse ding ka hara kontinente ho netefatsa tswelopele ya lebatowa la rona le Aforika ka bophara.
tgt: Lo mbhiyozo woSuku lwe-Afrika ubanjwa rhoqo ngonyaka uphawula ukusungulwa koMbutho weMbumba ye-Afrika (i-OAU) ngowe-1963.Xa siqukumbela le Nyanga ye-Afrika, iKhabhinethi icela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba babambisane namanye ama-Afrika ahlala apha eMzantsi Afrika nabo bakwamanye amazwe kweli lizwekwazi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba lo mmandla wethu kunye ne-Afrika iphela inekamva eliqaqambileyo nelizele amathamsanqa.

src: Ho mahetleng a bohle ba dulang ka hara meedi ya rona, maAforika Borwa le melata ka ho tshwana ho imatahanya le melao ya naha.
tgt: Kubalulekile nokuba bonke abo bahlala ngaphakathi kwemida yeli, oko kukuthi abemi boMzantsi Afrika kunye nabanye abantu bamazwe angaphadle abakweli, bayihloniphe futhi bayithobele imithetho yeli lizwe.

src: Mmoho re lokela ho lwantsha koduwa ya kgwebisano ka batho, dikwetelo, le tlhekefetso ya basadi le bana.
tgt: Sisonke masilwe isihelegu sokurhweba ngabantu, ukuthinjwa kunye nokuxhatshazwa kwabasetyhini nabantwana.

src: Melaetsa ya thoholetso.
tgt: Amazwi okuvuyisana.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa moifo wa bongaka wa Yunivesithi ya Stellenbosch le Sepetlele sa Dithuto sa Tygerberg o bopilweng ka Moporofesara Andre van der Merwe, Ngaka Alexander Zuhlke, Moporofesara Rafique Moosa, Ngaka Amir Zarrabi le Ngaka Zamira Keyser.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilothulela umnqwazi iqela leengcungela zoogqirha leDyunivesiti yaseStellebosch kunye ne-Tygerberg Academic Hospital eliquka uNjing Andre van der Merwe, uGq Alexander Zuhlke, uNjing Rafique Moosa, uGq Amir Zarrabi kunye noGq Zamira Keyser.

src: Haufinyana tjena ba entse oporeishene ya bobedi ya ho kenya setho sa botona, hore e be setsi sa pele sa bongaka sa ho etsa mosebetsi ona habedi.
tgt: Basandula ukwenza utyando nofakelo lwelungu lobudoda lwesibini, into leyo eyenze esi yasisibhedlela sokuqala ehlabathini ukwenza olu qhaqho-tyando ngempumelelo izihlandlo ezibini.

src: Katleho ya ketsahalo ena matsohong a moifo wa oporeishene ena ke bopaki ba boitsebelo ba boemo bo hodimo le botsebi bo teng ka hara lekala la kalafo ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Ukwenza lo msebenzi ungaka ngempumelelo usenziwa zingcali zoqhaqho-tyando zeli kububungqina bokuba ngenene icandelo lezempilo loMzantsi Afrika kumaziko karhulumente lineengcaphephe ezingoompondo-zihlanjiwe ezikumgangatho wehlabathi.

src: Kabinete e thoholeditse Phaka ya Mokgwabo ya iSimangaliso bakeng sa ho amohela Kgau ya Boqhetseke ba Tlhatlhobo ho tswa ho Setheo sa Bahlanka ba Tshebediso ya Ditjhelete sa Aforika Borwa (SAICA) ka Dikgau tsa Boqhetseke ho Lekala la Mmuso pejana kgweding ena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithumele amazwi okuvuyisana kwi-iSimangaliso Wetland Park ngokufumana iMbasa yokuGqwesa kwezoPhicotho-zincwadi kumsitho we-South African Institute of Chartered Accountants (i-SAICA) weeMbasa zokuGqwesa kuRhulumente ekuqaleni kule nyanga.

src: Kgau ena ke kananelo ya Phaka ya ho fumana bohlahlobi ba ditjhelete bo hlokang sekodi bakeng sa dilemo tse hlano ka tatelano.
tgt: Le mbasa bawongwe ngayo ngokuba befumene iziphumo zophicotho-ncwadi ezingenachaphaza nezingabonisi nasikhwasilimo iminyaka emihlanu ilandelelana.

src: iSimangaliso e ile ya tsebahatswa e le Setsha sa pele sa Lefatshe sa Botjhaba ka Tshitwe 1999.
tgt: Umyezo iSimangaliso Wetland Park wabhengezwa njengeSiza esiliLifa seHlabathi sokuqala soMzantsi Afrika ngeyoMnga ngowama-1999.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa lenaneo la Working on Fire mabapi le ho amohela polaka ho tswa ho Mmuso wa Alberta Canada e le sehopotso sa thuso e fannweng ke lenaneo lena mabapi le ho laola mello ya hlaha ka hara Porofense ya bona ka selemo sa 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana nenkqubo yokuSebenza ngoMlilo ngokufumana imbasa kuRhulumente wePhondo lase-Alberta eCanada ngoncedo lwayo kumsebenzi omkhulu wocimo-mlilo kweliya Phondo ngowama-2016.

src: Working on Fire ke Lenaneo la Katoloso ya Mesebetsi ya Setjhaba (EPWP) le reretsweng bakeng sa ho fana ka menyetla ya mosebetsi ho banna le basadi ba batjha.
tgt: Inkqubo yokuSebenza ngoMlilo yinxalenye yeNkqubo eNatyisiweyo yeMisebenzi kaRhulumente (i-EPWP) enjongo zayo ikukunika amathuba emisebenzi kubantu abatsha basetyhini nabangamadoda.

src: Melaetsa ya matshediso.
tgt: Amazwi ovelwano.

src: Kabinete e ipapisa le Moporesidente Zuma le badudi ba matjhaba ka ho tshwela ka mathe ka matla tlhaselo ya boferekanyi Sebakeng sa Boithabiso sa Manchester ho la Manchester Engelane, e bakileng mafu a madimabe le ditemalo tsa bana ba bangata le batjha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nayo njengoMongameli Zuma kunye nehlabathi jikelele ilugxeka kabukhali uhlaselo lobunqolobi olwenziwe eManchester Arena eManchester e-England, elikhokelele kwintlungu yokusweleka nokonzakala kwabantu abatsha nabantwana abaninzi.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso a yona ho mmuso le batho ba United Kingdom, ka ho qolleha malapa le baratuwa ba ba hlokahetseng, le ho lakaletsa ba lemetseng ho fola kapele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithi tutwini kurhulumente nakubantu base-United Kingdom, ingakumbi iintsapho, izizalwane nezalamane zabo bathe baphulukana nobomi babo, kwaye inqwenelela abo bathe bafumana umonzakalo ukuba bachache ngokukhawuleza.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, la 7 Phuptjane 2017, Tuynhuys, Motse Kapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibibambe intlanganiso yayo ngoLwesithathu, umhla wesi-7 kweyeSilimela kowama-2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: DINTLHA TSA HAJWALE Kabinete e boeletsa kgoeletso ya Moporesidente Jacob Zuma bakeng sa hore maAforika Borwa a ipope kgahlanong le dikgoka le tlhekefetso ya basadi le bana, le ho ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho nka mehato e potlakileng ho fedisa koduwa ena ka hara metse ya bo rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalibethelela ikhwelo ebelihlatywe nguMongameli Jacob Zuma lokuba abemi boMzantsi Afrika babambisane balwe ubundlobongela noxhatshazo olwenziwa kwabasetyhini nabantwana, kwaye icela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bathathe amanyathelo akhawulezileyo okusiphula neengcambu lo mkhuba mbi kangaka kwisizwe sethu.

src: Sena se latela leeto la Moporesidente Elsies River ho la Motse Kapa mabapi le ho tshehetsa Imbizo ya Ntwa e kgahlanong le Botlokotsebe.
tgt: Oku kulandela utyelelo obelwenziwe nguMongameli lusiya e-Elsies River eKapa ngeenjongo zokuxhasa iMbizo yokuLwa uLwaphulo-mthetho.

src: Leeto lena hape le hlakisitse ho ba kotsing ha basadi le bana ka hara setjhaba sa rona.
tgt: Le Mbizo iphinde yawucacisa ngokuphandle umba wokuba sesichengeni kwabasetyhini nabantwana kweli lizwe lethu.

src: Moporesidente o ikemiseditse ho kgutlela sebakeng seo ho ya fatisisa diphephetso tse ngata tsa botlokotsebe le dipolao, ka ho qolleha tsa bana le kamoo balaodi ba qobello ya molao ba ka ntlafatsang ditshebeletso tsa bona ho badudi.2 Kabinete e amohela ho lokollwa ha Diphuputso tse Akaretsang tsa Malapa tsa selemo sa 2016, tse tswellang ho bontsha kgatelopele mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha mananeo a mmuso a ho ntlafatsa maphelo a maAforika Borwa, haholoholo badudi ba neng ba tingwe menyetla pele.
tgt: UMongameli waye wathembisa ukuba uza kuphinda eze kule ndawo aze kuqwalasela iingxaki zeziganeko ezininzi zolwaphulo-mthetho nokubulawa kwabantu, ingakumbi abantwana kunye nokuba ii-arhente zogcino-mthetho zingenza njani ukuze ziphucule indlela ezisebenza ngayo ukunceda uluntu.

src: Dipalopalo di bontsha hore mmuso e etsa menyabuketso mabapi le ho fana ka bodulo, moo malapa a maAforika Borwa a dulang ka hara matlo a ‘RDP’ kapa matlo a tsheheditsweng ke mmuso a phahameng ho tloha ho 5% ka selemo sa 2002 ho ya ho 13,5% ka selemo sa 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukukhutshwa koPhando lowama-2015 ngaMakhaya Ngokubanzi, olubonisa inkqubela kumba wokufezekiswa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ukuze kuphuculwe ubomi babemi boMzantsi Afrika, ingakumbi abantu abaphuma kwmimandla eyayihlelelekile ngaphambili.

src: Diphuphutso tsena hape di bontsha hore mananeo a mmuso a thuso ya kahisano a supa keketseho ho tloha ho 12,7% ka selemo sa 2003 ho ya ho 29,7% ka selemo sa 2016.Hape ho na le keketseho e bonahalang ho phumantsho ya metsi, motlakase le tsamaiso ya dikgwerekgwere, e leng letshwao la bohlokwa bakeng sa maikemisetso a Mmuso wa Aforika Borwa wa ho lokisa dimpe tsa mmuso wa kgethollo le ho fana ka ditshebeletso tsa mantlha ho batho kaofela.
tgt: Iinkcukacha-manani zibonakalisa ukuba liyanda inani labantu elakhelwe izindlu ngurhulumente, kangangokuba inani labantu beli abahlala kwizindlu ezisisibonelelo sikarhulumente linyuke lisuka kwi-5% ngowama-2002 laya kutsho kwi-13,5% ngowama-2016.Olu phando lubonakalisa nokuba iinkqubo zezibonelelo zikarhulumente zinyuke zisuka kwi-12,7% ngowama-2003 laya kutsho kuma-29,7% ngowama-2016.Kwakhona nenani labantu abafakelwe amanzi, umbane kunye nezindlu zangasese ezigungxulwayo linyuke kakhulu, into eluphawu olubalulekileyo olubonisa ukuzimisela kukaRhulumente woMzantsi Afrika ukulungisa umonakalo owashiywa ngumbuso wocalu-calulo ngokusa iinkonzo ezisisiseko kubo bonke abantu.

src: Kabinete, leha ho le jwalo, e lemohile hore ha boingodiso thutong e phahameng bo ntse bo eketseha, leha e le ka monyebe, ebile feela 3,3% ya maAforika Borwa a ba Batsho a dilemong tse 18 ho ya ho tse 29 a neng a ithuta papisong le 18,8% ya baithuti ba maIndia/maAsia le 17,5% ya makgowa sehlopheng sa ba dilemong tsena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphele nokuba nangona inani labantwana ababhalisela ukufunda kumaziko emfundo ephakamileyo linyuka, noxa linyuka kancinci, ngabantu abantsundu abaneminyaka yobudala eli-18 ukuya kwengama-29 abayi-3,3% kuphela abafundayo xa kuthelekiswa ne-18,8% yamaNdiya nama-Asiya kunye ne-17,5% yabamhlophe nabo abayile ntanga.

src: Ke feela 3,5% ya ba Mmala ba neng ba ithuta nakong ya selemo sa 2016.Diphuputso ho ya pele di supile phokotseho ho tloha ho 23,8% ho ya ho 11,8% ya malapa a neng a phela ka tlala, e leng se bontshang kgatelopele mabapi le ho shebana le malapa a phelang bofutsaneng bo feteletseng.3 Kabinete e lemohile Diphuputso tsa Kotara ka Nngwe tsa Lebotho la Basebetsi bakeng sa kotara ya pele ya selemo tse bontshitseng hore moruo o ekeditse mesebetsi ka mesebetsi e 144 000.
tgt: Abantwana bebala abebefunda ngowama-2016 bona bebeyi-3,5% kuphela.

src: Dipalo tsena di thuntheditswe ke keketseho ya batho ba neng ba batla mosebetsi ba 433 000.
tgt: Olu phando luphinde labonakalisa ukuhla kwenani lamakhaya athwaxwa yindlala lisuka kuma-23,8% laya kutsho kwi-11,8%, into leyo ebonakalisa ukuba uyabonakala umsebenzi owenziwayo ukulwa indlala kwimimandla ethwaxwa kakhulu yindlala.

src: Kabinete e thathiselleditse boitlamo ba yona ba ho tswela pele ho theha selekane le lefapha la poraefete le basebetsi maitekong a yona a ho sebetsana le diphephetso tsa naha tsa tlhokeho ya mesebetsi.4 Kabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa ha Phaka ya Diindaseteri ya Babelegi e ntjhafaditsweng ho la Hammanskraal jwaloka karolo ya meralo ya mmuso ya ho akofisa ntshetsopele ya moruo le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi sebakeng seo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iluqaphele uPhando lweKota leCandelo lezeMisebenzi lekota yokuqala yonyaka olubonisa ukuba uqoqosho lweli ludale imisebenzi engama-144 000.

src: Porojeke ena ya R42-milione ke karolo ya mmuso ya Lenaneo la Tsoseletso ya Diphaka Tsa Diindaseteri le e nngwe ya diphaka tse tsheletseng tse ntseng di tsoseletswa ho phatlalla le naha bakeng sa ntshetsopele e pharaletseng ya moruo le diindaseteri.
tgt: Umtyhi oze nenani lezi zithuba zemisebenzi uphinde waphelela emoyeni ngenxa yenani labantu abafuna imisebenzi elinyukileyo, langabantu abangama-433 000.IKhabhinethi iyaphinda iyakubethelela ukuzibophelela kwayo kumba wokusebenzisa namashishini abucala kunye nabasebenzi kumalinge ayo okulwa ingxaki ehlupha ilizwe yokunqongophala kwemisebenzi.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa diindaseteri le dikgwebo tsa lehae ho sekaseka ho atolosetsa ditshebetso tsa bona ho ya sebakeng sena sa diindaseteri bakeng sa ho fumantshwa mekgwa e fapafapaneng ya tshehetso e teng bakeng sa ho hodisa dikgwebo tsa bona ho ya pele.5 Kabinete e tsebisitswe ke Letona la Ditjhelete, Monghadi Malusi Gigaba, mabapi le dipalo tsa moraorao tsa Palohohle ya Dihlahiswa tsa Aforika Borwa (GDP), e honyetseng ka 0,7% kotareng ya pele ya selemo sa 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuvulwa kweBabelegi Industrial Park elungiswe ngokutsha eseHammanskraal njengenxaleye yezicwangciso zikarhulumente zokukhawulezisa uphuhliso loqoqosho nokudala imisebenzi kulo mmandla.

src: Sephetho sena sa GDP se mpefetseng ho feta kamoo ho neng ho lebeletswe se tlase haholo ho feta Tjhebobotjha ya Ditekanyetso tsa selemo sa 2017, e neng e lepile kgolo ya GDP ya selemo sa 2017 ho ba 1,3%.
tgt: Le projekthi ityabule imali ezizigidi ezingama-42 zeerandi iyinxalenye yeNkqubo kaRhulumente yokuVuselela imiMandla yeMizi-mveliso kwaye iyenye yeeprojekthi ezintandathu zemimandla yemizi-mveliso ehlaziyiweyo kwilizwe liphela ukuze incedise kuphuhliso olubanzi loqoqosho namashishini.

src: Sena se bakuwe ke, hara tse ding, ho honyela ha tlhahiso, kgwebisano, diindaseteri tsa phano ya dijo le bodulo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza imizi-mveliso namashishini eli ukuba acinge ngokuvula amanye amasebe namacandelo kule mimandla yemizi-mveliso ukuze nawo axhamle kwezi zibonelelo zenkxaso zikwezi ndawo ukuze bakhulise nangakumbi amashishini wabo.

src: Leha ho le jwalo moruo o ile wa tshehetswa ke kgolo merafong le diindasetering tsa dikwari e eketsehileng ka 12.8%.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi nguMphathiswa wezeMali, uMnu Malusi Giba malunga namanani akutsha nje eMveliso yeLizwe yoNyaka (i-GDP) yoMzantsi Afrika, enciphe ngo-0,7% kwikota yokuqala yowama-2017.Esi siphumo se-GDP sibi kuneso besilindelwe singaphantsi kakhulu kuHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali oluHlaziyiweyo lowama-2017, ebeliqikelele ukuba i-GDP yowama-2017 iza kuhluma ngo-1.3%.

src: Diindaseteri tsa temo, meru le ditlhapi di ile tsa hlasimoloha kotareng ya pele ya selemo sa 2017 ka keketseho ya 22,2%.Ho na le matshwao a tshepisang a hore naha e ka itseka bakeng sa ho matlafatsa tjhebahalo ya yona ya kgolo ya moruo.
tgt: I-GDP yenziwe ngenxa yokungaqhubi kakuhle kwecandelo lezemizi-mveliso, elezorhwebo, elezokutyisa nelezokuhlalisa iindwendwe.

src: Tsena di kenyeletsa kgolo ya ho kenella lefatsheng, ho tsitsisa ditheko tsa phahlo, maemo a matle a tlelaemete, phepelo e tshepahalang ya motlakase le dikamano tse batlang di tsitsitse tsa basebetsi.
tgt: Noko kunjalo, uqoqosho luxhaswe luhlumo kwicandelo lezemigodi nelekwari wona akhule nge-12,8%.

src: Jwaloka taba e potlakileng, Kabinete e ipiletsa ho dikgwebo, basebetsi le setjhaba ka kakaretso ho theha selekane le mmuso bakeng sa ho matlafatsa lenaneo la rona la kgolo le ho ntlafatsa tshepahalo bakeng sa ho kgina ho fokola le ho beha moruo maemong a batlang a phahame, ho fihlella kgolo ya moruo e kenyeletsang.
tgt: Icandelo lezolimo, elezamahlathi kunye nelezokuloba aqhube kakuhle kwikota yokuqala yowama-2017 kuba akhule nge-22.2%.Zikhona iimpawu ezibonakalisa ukuthembisa eli lizwe elinokuzisebenzisa ukunceda uhlumo loqoqosho lwalo.

src: Ntlheng ena Letona la Ditjhelete le tla kopana le baetapele ba dikgwebo ka morero wa ho bopa mawa a ho lwantsha ho putlama ha moruo le ho fihlella kgolo e kenyeletsang.
tgt: Ezi ziquka uhlumo oluncumisayo loqoqosho lwehlabathi, ukuphucuka kwamaxabiso ezimbiwa, iimeko zezulu ezintle, imeko yombane ezinzileyo kunye nobudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabasebenzi nabaqeshi.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana kopano ya boraditaba le Letona la Ditjhelete bakeng sa ho arolelana le maAforika Borwa maitshunyako ao mmuso o tla a etsang ka hara meralo ya ditekanyetso tsa hajwale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela amashishini, imibutho yabasebenzi kunye noluntu ngobubanzi ukuba basebenzisane norhulumente ukuze kuqiniswe inkqubo yokuhlumisa uqoqosho nokunyusa izinga eli lizwe elithenjwe ngalo ngabatyali-mali ukuze sinqade ukuwa koqoqosho size ngolo hlobo sibuyisele uqoqosho lweli kwimeko yohlumo, ukuze kubekho uhlumo oluxhanyulwa ngumntu wonke.

src: Kabinete hape e thathiselletsa moralo o amohetsweng wa ditekanyetso bakeng sa naha.6 Lekala la tekolo la Fitch le la Standard & Poor’s a thathiselleditse ditekolo tsa Aforika Borwa tsa mekitlane ya ditjhelete tsa maatjhabeng tsa nako e telele tsa ‘BB+’.Sena se tla hara nako eo dipuisano tsa Letona Gigaba le lekala la poraefete bakeng sa ho netefatsa hore mosebetsi o kopanetsweng wa mmuso, dikgwebo, basebetsi le setjhaba ka kakaretso di ntseng di tswela pele, le hore maitlamo a entsweng a ya phethahatswa.
tgt: Ke ngoko uMphathiswa wezeMali uza kudibana neenkokeli zezoshishino bagwadle iqhinga lokulwa le ngxaki yokudodobala koqoqosho lutshintshe luhlume ngenxela eza kuxhanyulwa ngumntu wonke.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa hore maAforika Borwa a lokela ho tswela pele ho sebetsa e le ntho e le nngwe, haholoholo dinakong tse thata le ho sebetsa ka thata ho feta ho netefatsa hore naha e tseke maemo a yona a tekolo ya matsete.7 Kabinete e ananela ditherisano tse thakgolwang kgetlo la pele tsa Komiti e Kopanetsweng ya Tsamaiso bakeng sa Mmaraka o Tshwanang wa Borwa (MERCOSUR) le Mokgatlo wa Lekgetho la Madiboho a Dinaha tsa Aforika e Borwa (SACU (SACU) tse neng di tshwerwe haufinyana tjena ka hara naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba uMphathiswa wezeMali abambe intlanganiso nonoondaba aze axelele abemi boMzantsi Afrika ngamanyathelo okungenelela urhulumente aza kuwathatha kolu hlahlo lwabiwo-mali lwalo nyaka-mali.

src: Mekga e dumellane hore ka kopanelo e tla sekaseka menyetla ya ho hodisa Tumellano e ka Sehloohong ya Kgwebisano (PTA) ya MERCOSUR-SACU ka ho kenyeletsa makala a yona a kgodiso ya kgwebisano, mekgatlo ya kgwebo, lekala la poraefete, le matlo a bona a bonqosa le dikantoro tsa matjhabeng ka ho latelana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaphinda iyazibophelela ekubeni iyaluxhasa uhlahlo lwabiwo-mali lweli lizwe.

src: PTA ya MERCOSUR-SACU e neha ba romellang thepa ya lehae ka ntle monyetla wa ho kenella mmarakeng wa batho ba fetang 280-milione.
tgt: I-arhente zokuhlela amazwe u-Fitch kunye no-Standard & Poor’s aziyitshintshanga indawo obekwa kuyo uMzantsi Afrika ngokwasakhono sokubhatala isikweliti setyala langaphandle, indawo leyo engu-‘BB+’.Oku kwenzeke ngenxa yeentlanganiso uMphathiswa Gigaba ebezibambile namashishini abucala ukuqinisekisa ukuba umsebenzi oqhutywa ngokubambisana phakathi kukarhulumente, amashishini, imibutho yabasebenzi kunye nemibutho yoluntu uyaqhubeka, kwaye nezithembiso ezenziweyo ziyazalisekiswa.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho ba romellang thepa ka ntle ho nka monyetla ona wa PTA kaha jwale dihlahiswa tsa mona hae di kgona ho kena lepatlelong la MERCOSUR ka dikgahla tse kgothaletswang tsa lekgetho.8 Kabinete e hlahisitse tshwabo ya yona ka qeto ya Amerika (USA) ya ho ikgula Tumellanong ya Paris.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakubethelela ukuba abemi boMzantsi Afrika kufuneka batsale ngamxhelo-mnye, ingakumbi ngala maxesha anzima futhi basebenze ngokuzimisela ukuqinisekisa ukuba eli lizwe libuyiselwa kwiindawo yalo ngokwesakhono sokukwazi ukubhatala izikweliti.

src: Tumellano ya Paris, e tla sebetsa ka botlalo ka selemo sa 2020, e thehilwe hodima dinyehelo tse tekilweng ke dinaha ka botsona mabapi le merero ya lefatshe eo ho dumellanweng ka kopanelo ka yona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamkela iingxoxo zendibano yeKomiti yoLawulo eHlangeneyo phakathi koMbutho ongaHlawulisani Rhafu yoRhwebo wamaZwe elizwekazi leMelika eseMazantsi (i- (MERCOSUR) noMbutho wamaZantsi e-Afrika ongaHlawulisani Rhafu yoRhwebo (i-SACU) ebibanjwe kwezi ntsuku zimbalwa zidlulileyo kweli.

src: Aforika Borwa e ipileditse ho USA ho sekaseka botjha boemo ba yona le ho itlama botjha tsamaisong e kopanetsweng ke dinaha ka bongata.9 Memorandamo wa Kutlwano (MoU) pakeng tsa Novartis, Lekgotla la Aforika Borwa la Diphuputso tsa Bongaka le Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji, o betla tsela ya ho matlafatsa mothamo le boleng ba diteko tsa bongaka le ho aha bokgoni ba diphuputso ka hara kontinente.
tgt: Amazwe abekulo ndibano avumile ukuba kufuneka asebenzisane akhangele amathuba okukhuthaza isiVumelwano sokweNzelelelana kwezoRhwebo (i-PTA) se-MERCOSUR ne-SACU ngokubandakanya ii-arhente zezorhwebo, amaqumrhu ezoshishino, amashishini abucala kunye namaziko kunye nezindlu zozakuzo zamazwe angaphandle.

src: Tumellano e tla thusa bakeng sa mananeo a kopanetsweng a diphuputso mahlokong a kgethilweng a tshwaetsanang le a sa tshwaetsaneng, ho ntlafatsa phumantsho ya bakudi ba Aforika Borwa ya meriana e ntjhafatsang, le ho aha bokgoni ba naha le ba kontinente ba diphuputso le ntshetsopele.
tgt: Isivumelwano esiphakathi kwe-MERCOSUR ne-SACU siza kunika oosomashishini beli abarhweba ngokuthumela iimpahla ngaphandle ithuba lokuba bathengisele abantu abazizigidi ezingama-280 iimveliso zabo.

src: Kabinete e dumela hore ho na le sebaka bakeng sa bolekane bo eketsehileng ba mmuso le ba poraefete, le ho kgodiseha hore tsena di ka bula tsela ya ho sebetsana le diphephetso tse ngata tse matla tseo re tobaneng le tsona.10 Kabinete e amohela Tlaleho ya selemo sa 2017 ho tswa ho Mokgatlo wa Khonkerese ya Matjhaba le Khonvenshene, e tswellang ho beha Aforika Borwa jwaloka sebaka se ka hodimo sa ho tshwara diketsahalo tsa kgwebo ka hara Aforika le Botjhabela bo Hare.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubo bonke oosomashishini abarhweba ngokuthumela iimpahla kumazwe angaphandle lokuba mabawasebenzise la mathuba eza ne-PTA njengoko iimveliso zeli zikwazi ngoku ukuthunyelwa kumazwe angamalungu e-MERCOSUR zibhatalelwe irhafu yorhwebo enesaphulelo.

src: Aforika Borwa e dula e le se seng sa dibaka tse tummeng ka ho fetisisa sa bohahlaudi lefatsheng le ho tswela pele ho nka maemo a hodimo hape ho lenaneo la bophehisane la Foramo ya Moruo wa Lefatshe la ho eta le bohahlaudi lefatsheng jwaloka ha le lokolotswe ka Mmesa 2017.Kabinete e rata ho bona bongata ba ditoropo le metsemeholo e menyenyane ya Aforika Borwa e iketa bakeng sa dikopano tse nyenyane moo di ka kgonang ho imatahanya le ditlhokeho tsa ho tshwara dikopano.
tgt: IsiVumelwano saseParis, esiza kuqala ukusebenza ngokupheleleyo ngowama- 2020, sixhomekeke kwimali ehlawulwa ngamazwe angamalungu elungiselelwa ukufezekisa iinjongo zamazwe ehlabathi ekuvunyelwene ngazo.

src: Sena se tla thusa ho ntlafatsa qaqolohano ho ya ka sebopeho sa naha bakeng sa bohahlaudi ka nqane ho ditsi tse kgolo le ho ala moruo o fehlilweng ke diketsahalo tsena ka tsela e batlang e lekalekana.11 Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela hore a fadimehele ditaba tsa leshano, ka ho qolleha keketseho ya ho maneha ditaba tse fosahetseng ho marangrang a ditaba a kahisano mabapi le banana le basadi ba lahlehileng, ba kwetetsweng le ba hapilweng ka mahahapa.
tgt: UMzantsi Africa ucela i-USA ukuba isicingisise esi sigqibo isithathileyo ibuyele kwakhona kwesi sivumelwano samazwe ngamazwe.

src: Ho ropoha ha haufinyana tjena ha merusu KwaMashu, pela Durban ka lebaka la ditlaleho tse fosahetseng tsa hore bana ba nkuwa ka mahahapa sebakeng seo le ho belaellwa ha ho hapuwa ka mahahapa ha ngwanana Naledi, ho la Soweto ke batho ba tsamayang ka Toyota Quantum ho kenyeleditswe le nomoro ya yona ya boingodiso e ileng ya phatlalla ho marangrang a ditaba a kahisano, moo ho tholahetseng hamorao hore ha se nnete.
tgt: IsiVumelwano sokuQondana phakathi kukaNovartis, iBhunga loMzantsi Afrika loPhando ngezoNyango kunye neSebe lezeNzululwazi nobuChwepheshe, siza kunceda ukwandisa umthamo nokuphucula umgangatho wamaphulo ophando ngezonyango futhi siqeqeshe abantu kwizakhono zezophando kweli lizwekazi.

src: Meritaoke ena, ditaba tsa leshano le ho tsamaisa tlhahisoleseding e fosahetseng ho baka pherekano ka hara metse ya bo rona le ho senya nako le mehlodi ya sepolesa.
tgt: Esi sivumelwano siza kunceda ukuba kuqhutywe amaphulo ophando ngokubambisana ngezifo ezithile ezosulelayo nezingosuleliyo, kuphuculwe indlela izigulane zoMzantsi Afrika eziwafumana ngayo amayeza aluncedo, nokwakha izakhono zezophando nophuhliso zeli lizwekazi.

src: Re ipiletsa ho batho hore ba seke ba pheta ho maneha le ho tsamaisa ditaba tsa leshano ho marangrang a ditaba a kahisano, ho fihlela ba tiisitse bonnete ba tsona.12 Kabinete e lemohile ka ngongoreho e kgolo ditlaleho tsa ditaba ka ‘diimeile tse nyenyelepisitsweng tse hlokang nnete’ tseo ho hopolwang hore di beha Matona, bahlanka ba mmuso le batho ba poraefete ka mosing ba belaellwa hore ba entse tse sa lokang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikholelwa ukuba akhona namathuba okungena kwizivumelwano zentsebenziswano phakathi kukarhulumente namashishini abucala, kwaye iqinisekile ukuba izivumelwano ezifana nezi zingaluncedo kakhulu ekusombululeni imingeni enzima emininzi esijamelene nayo.

src: Kabinete e dula e itlamme bakeng sa puso e hlwahlwa le ka nako e le nngwe, hape e ananela hore batho kaofela ba nkuwa ba hloka molato ho fihlela ba bonwe molato ho ya ka dipehelo tsa Molaotheo wa rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela iNgxelo yowama-2017 yoMbutho weeNkomfa neeNggqungquthela zeHlabathi, ebeka uMzantsi Afrika kwiindawo ephezulu kumazwe okubamba imisitho yezoshishino e-Afrika nakuMbindi-Mpuma.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa bohle ba nang le tlhahisoleseding ka molato ofe kapa ofe o etswang ke bahlanka ba mmuso kapa Matona ho tsebisa makala a qobello ya molao hore ho tle ho etswe dipatlisiso.
tgt: Oku kuza kunceda ukuba amaqithi-qithi ecandelo lezokhenketho kunye nemali eyingeniso eyenziwa ngokusingatha le misitho ixhanyulwe kwiindawo zonke zeli ingapheleli nje kwizixeko ezikhulu ezaziwayo.

src: Kabinete e hlokometse hore ho se ho na le dinyewe tse ritetsweng, mme sepolesa se ntse se etsa dipatlisiso tse lokelang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilumkisa abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bahlale bevundlile bakwazi ukuzihluza iindaba zokwenyani kwezingeyonyani, ingakumbi ngoku sekukho iimbalelwano ezingenabunyani ezipapashwa kumakhasi onxibelelwano ezimalunga namantombazana nabantu basetyhini ekuthiwa balahlekile, babiwe nekuthiwa baxhwiliwe.

src: Bohle ba anngweng ke diimeile tseo ba kgothaletswa ho sebetsa mmoho le makala a qobello ya molao.
tgt: Udushe oluqhambuke kutsha nje KwaMashu, kufutshane neDurban olubangelwe zingxelo ezingeyonyani zabantwana abaxhwiliweyo kula ndawo kunye nezentombazana yaseNaledi eSoweto ekutyholwa ngokuba ixhwilwe ngabantu abahamba ngemoto eyi-Toyota Quantum ekuye kwakhutshwa nenombolo yayo yokubhalisa bezigcwele kumakhasi onxibelelwano.

src: Bodisa ba Kabinete hodima ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Lewa la Meralo ya Nako e Bohareng (MTSF) la 2014 ho isa ho 2019, bo baka phano ya ditshebeletso e ntlafetseng.
tgt: Ukusasazwa kwezi ndaba zingeyonyani nolwazi olububuxoki kubangela ukuba abantu bakuthi bahlale besexhaleni besoyika kwaye oku kuchitha ixesha labantu futhi kudlala ngamapolisa.

src: Sena se re atametsa phihlellong ya Tjhebelopele ya 2030 ya Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP).Mmuso o entse kgatelopele e bonahalang mabapi le ho kenya tshebetsong diphetho tsa ona tse 14 tse ka sehlohlolong le ho kgannela pele merero ya NDDiphephetso tse amang ho kenngwa tshebetsong le mehato e batlehang bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa phano e ile ya hlwauwa.
tgt: Siyababongoza abantu ukuba bangazigqithisi futhi bazisasaze kumakhasi onxibelelwano iindaba ezingeyonyani, phambi kokuba baziqinisekise ukuba ziyinyani na ngenene.

src: Tsamaiso ya Dikgokahanyo le Tlhahisoleseding ya Mmuso (GCIS) e ntse e hlophisa dikopano tsa boraditaba tsa dibaka ka ho fapana, tse reretsweng ho etsahala ho tloha ka la 9 ho isa ka la 18 Phuptjane 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhathazekile zingxelo zoonondaba ezimalunga nee-imeyile ezipapashwe ngaphandle kwemvume ekuthiwa zinezityholo ezijoliswe kuBaphathiswa, amagosa karhulumente kunye nabanye abantu ezimalunga nezenzo ezinxamnye nomthetho.

src: Lenaneo le hlophisitsweng hantle le tla manehuwa ho WEBTOKEDIKETSAHALO TSE TLANG.1 Moporesidente Zuma o thakgotse Kgwedi ya Batjha tlasa mookotaba “Selemo sa OR Tambo: Re Ntshetsapele Matlafatso ya Batjha Moruong”, ka kopano ya Sehlopha sa Tshebetso sa Batjha sa Kantoro ya Moporesidente.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izimisele kulawulo olungenaziphene kwaye ifuna nokugxininisa ukuba ngokoMgaqo-siseko weli abantu bathathwa ngokuba bamsulwa kude kuziswe ngaphambili ubungqina obuzeleyo obuthi banetyala.

src: Sena se bokantse mmoho mmuso le baetapele ba mekgatlo ya batjha, ba lekotseng kgatelopele ntshetsopeleng ya moruo wa kahisano wa batjha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonke abanolwazi olumalunga nezenzo ezinxamnye nomthetho ezenziwayo ngamagosa karhulumente okanye abaphathiswa ukuba balugqithisele kwii-arhente zogcino-mthetho ukuze ziphandwe.

src: Matona le Batlatsi ba Matona ba tla kenella diketsahalong tse fapafapaneng tse reretsweng ho kgothaletsa ntshetsopele le matlafatso ya batjha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakuqonda ukuba akhona amanye amatyala asele evuliwe, kwaye namapolisa sele eqalisile ngophando.

src: Selemo sena se tshwaya selemo sa bo-41 sa Merusu ya Soweto mme sehopotso se sebetsa jwaloka kgopotso ya hore batjha ka hara naha ba ne ba le ka pele Ntweng.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uzikhabile izityholo ezipapashwe kumaphephandaba angeCawa zokuba uthenge indlu eDubai e-United Arab Emirates.
