tgt: IQela labaPhathiswa eliThweliswe uXanduva ngeMbalela, likhokelwa liSebe loLawulo lweNtsebenziswano neMicimbi yeMveli, liyaqhubekeka ukubeka esweni iimeko zembalela nokubonelela ngenkxaso efanelekileyo ngamasebe wamacandelo afanelekileyo ukuthomalalisa iimeko.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa dikgoeletso ho bohle ba ka hara Aforika Borwa ho netefatsa hore paballo ya metsi e ba teng jwaloka karolo ya bophelo ba bona ba letsatsi ka leng.
tgt: Urhulumente wabe imali engama-74 zezigidi zeerandi ngenkxaso-mali yoncedo ukuhlangabezana nembalela engapheliyo eNtshona Koloni.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le Mopresidente Zuma mabapi le ho tshwela ka mathe dipolao tse hlokang kelello tsa Molaodi wa Lebotho la Tshireletso la Lesotho, Mokgenerale Khoantle Motšomotšo.
tgt: ISebe lezaManzi noGutyulo nalo liqhuba kakuhle kakhulu ngamalungiselelo okuqaliswa kwe-Berg River to Voelvlei Augmentation Scheme.

src: Ketsahalo ena ya morao-rao ya dikgoka ha e amohelehe.
tgt: Iinkcukacha zesigqibo soHlolo lweFuthe Loku kokusiNgqongileyo kufanele zinikezelwe ekupheleni kweyoMsintsi.

src: Jwale ho matsohong a batho le boetapele ba Lesotho ho netefatsa hore kgutso le maemo a tlwaelehileng a kgutlisetswa ka hara Borena e le taba e potlakileng.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezaManzi noGutyulo, uNksz Nomvula Mokonyane, ususela ngoko uyalele uGunyaziwe weTonela iTrans-Caledon ukuba lifune imali kuze kuqaliswe le projekthi.

src: Re dula re na le tshepo ya hore Ketapele ya Matona e Batlisisang Dinnete ya Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tse ka Borwa ba Aforika (SADC) e tla kgona ho thusa Lesotho ho teka maitshunyako a nepahetseng.
tgt: Sebeqalisile ukuthetha nabasebenzisi abangabona bakhulu kwaye baza kuya kuMphathiswa kungekudala ukwenzela uvumelwano kunye noMphathiswa wezeMali ukwenzela ukuba bayazi ukuba ingakanani na imali enokubolekwa eza kusetyenziswa kule projekthi.

src: SADC e dula e tiile mererong ya yona ya ho matlafatsa, ho tshireletsa le ho baballa demokerasi, kgotso, polokeho le botsitso ka hara lebatowa mme e sebedisana le boetapele ba Lesotho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyoleka kwizibongozo ezibhekiswa kubo bonke abaseMzantsi Afrika ukuba baqinisekise ukuba amanzi ayongiwa njengenxalenye yobomi babo bemihla ngemihla.

src: Kabinete e amohela diphetho tsa Komiti ya Boemo bo Phahameng ya Kopano ya Aforika (AU) e mabapi le Libya Boemong ba Dihlooho tsa Dipuso le Mebuso e neng e tshwaretswe Brazzaville, ho la Riphabliki ya Congo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nayo njengoMongameli uZuma iyakugxeka ukubulawa ngolunya kweNkumanda yoMkhosi wezoKhuselo waseLesotho, uNjengele uKhoantle Motšomotšo.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o ne a nkile karolo Komiting ya Boemo bo Phahameng, e tshohlileng le ho sheba botjha mekutu e lebisitseng ho tholeng tharollo ya moshwelella mabapi le diqabano tse tswellang ho ba teng ka hara Libya.
tgt: Esi sehlo sakutsha nje sobundlobongela asamkeleki.

src: Jwaloka setho sa Komiti ya Boemo bo Phahameng e mabapi le Libya, Aforika Borwa e tshehetsa mekutu kaofela ya AU e reretsweng ho tlisa tharollo ya kgotso bakeng sa koduwa ya Libya.
tgt: Eli lixesha lokuba abantu kunye neenkokheli zaseLesotho mabaqiniseke ukuba kubuyelwa kwinzolo nemeko yesiqhelo ngokukhawuleza kweliya lizwe.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa maikutlo a Moporesidente Zuma a hore Aforika Borwa e malala-a-laotswe ho thusa Libya mekutung ya Kamora Kaho Botjha le Ntshetsopele le ho arolelana le yona boiphihlelo ba naha ya bo rona ho tsa poelano, kaho ya molaotheo le phethoho ya demokerasi ya puso.
tgt: Sisathembile ukuba iQela labaPhathiswa eliza kuPhanda loMbutho woPhuhliso lwaMazwe e-Afrika eseMazantsi (i-SADC) liza kukwazi ukunceda iLesotho kugqitywe ngamanyathelo okungenelela afanelekileyo.

src: Kabinete hape e boeletsa bohlokwa ba dipuisano tsa matjhaba tse hokahaneng tse nang le kutlwano ka hara Libya.
tgt: I-SADC ayigungqi kwinjongo yayo yokomeleza, ikhusele ize igcine ulawulo lwentando yesininzi, uxolo, ukhuselo nozinzo kulo mmandla ngokusebenzisana neenkokheli zaseLesotho.

src: Kabinete e ananela hore Aforika Borwa, jwalo ka mosaenedi ho Khonvenshene ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) ya Twantsho ya Mahwatata, e nka karolo Tulong ya bo-13 ya COP13 e ntseng e tswela pele hajwale Ordos, PRC ho tloha ka la 6 ho isa ka la 16 Loetse Ho lebeletswe hore pitso ena e tla phethela le ho amohela moralo o motjha wa lewa bakeng sa 2018-2030 e hlophisitsweng tlasa mookotaba “Re Lebisa Lefatsheng le Itekanetseng bakeng sa Meloko ya Hajwale le ya Kamoso”.
tgt: IKhabinethi iyazamkela iziphumo ezivela kwiKomiti yeNqanaba eliPhezulu yeMbumba yaMazwe ase-Afrika (i-AU) malunga neLibya kwiNqanaba leeNtloko zeMibuso nooRhulumente, nebibanjelwe eBrazzaville, kwiRiphabliki yaseCongo.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla sebetsa ka matla ho netefatsa hore maano a fetolwa ho ba diketso tse phethahalang.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uthathe inxaxheba kwiKomiti yeNqanaba eliPhezulu, ebixoxa ikwahlola amalinge abhekisele ekufumaneni isisombululo esohlala sihleli kule mbambano yaseLibya.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla sebetsa le dinaha kaofela ka hara Aforika mabapi le ho ntshetsapele maemo a naha le a kontinente.
tgt: Njengelungu leKomiti yeNqanaba eliPhezulu ngeLibya, uMzantsi Afrika uyawaxhasa onke amalinge we-AU ajolise ekuziseni isisombululo soxolo kungquzulwano olwenzeka eLibya.

src: Karolo ya Boemo bo Phahameng ba pitso ena bo tla sekaseka le ho fana ka tataiso ya sepolotiki mabapi le diphephetso tsa dintlha tse ntseng di runya mabapi le mahwatata, ho theoha ha maemo a mobu le komello.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasiphinda isibhengezo esenziwe nguMongameli uZuma sokuba uMzantsi Afrika ukulungele ukunceda iLibya kumalinge asemva kokwaKhiwa ngokuTsha noPhuhliso nokuxelela eliya lizwe ngezinto eli lizwe elazifundayo ngomba woxolelwano, ukwakha umgaqo-siseko kunye nenguqu yolawulo lwentando yesininzi kuMbuso.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho tshireletsa le ho hlokomela tikoloho bakeng sa ho e baballa bakeng sa meloko ya kamoso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwaphinda nokubaluleka kothethathethwano lwezizwe-ngezizwe oluququzelweyo nolunemvisiswano.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe diketsahalo tsa dikgoka, ho tjheswa ha makoloi a beng ba thepa le diketso tsa ditshoso pakeng tsa Beng ba Ditekesi tsa Dimithara le Balekane ba E-Hailing tse etsahetseng Sandton, Johannesburg.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuma ukuba uMzantsi Afrika, njengelinye lamazwe atyikitya isiVumelwano sokuThintela ubuNtlango seZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN), uthatha inxaxheba kwiSeshoni ye-13 ye-COP13 eqhubeka e-Ordos, eChina ukususela ngomhla we-6 ukuya kowe-16 kweyoMsintsi yowama-20.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho makala a qobello ya molao ho sebetsana le baetsi ba dikgoka le ditshoso ka hara dipehelo tsa Molaotheo.
tgt: Kulindeleke ukuba le nkomfa iza kugqibezela ize yamkele inkqubo-sikhokela yobuchule entsha yexesha elisuka kowama-2018 – 2030 neququzelelwe phantsi komxholo othi “Ngokubhekisele kumhlaba oseMpilweni ukwenzela isiZukulwana saNgoku neseXesha Elizayo”.

src: Diketsahalo tsena di sutha mekutung ya naha ya ho bopa maemo a kgwebo e lokolohileng le tlhodisano e hlokang leeme.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uza kusebenzela ukuqinisekisa ukuba imigaqo-nkqubo esephepheni itshintshe ibe yimisebenzi ebonakalayo.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe ditlhaselo le dipolao tsa balekgotla ka hara diporofense tse ding le ho fetisetsa matshediso a yona ho malapa le metswalle ya ba bolauweng.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uza kusebenzisana nawo onke amazwe ase-Afrika uvakalise izimvo zeli lizwe kunye nezo zelizwekazi.

src: Sena se kgahlanong le dipehelo tsa boitshwaro tsa Molaotheo, le ho sutha demokerasing ya rona ya tswelopele le tokelo ya batho ya ho kgetha baemedi ba bona ba setjhaba.
tgt: ICandelo elikwiNqanaba eliPhezulu lale nkomfa liza kuqwalasela lize libonelele ngesikhokelo sezopolitiko kwimingeni kwimiba evelayo ngokuba yintlango, ukuhla kwezinga lomhlaba nembalela.

src: Esale ho tloha qalong ya selemo, ho bile le mafu a mmalwa ka hara KwaZulu-Natal, mme haufinyana tjena, ho tlalehilwe mafu ka hara Kapa Botjhabela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bakhusele futhi bakhathalele indalo esingqongileyo khona ukuze siyilondolozele izizukulwana ezizayo.

src: Dikgoka tsena di nkile maphelo a balwanedi ba tokoloho ba batjha, ho kenyeletswa le Mongodi Kakaretso wa mehleng wa Liki ya Batjha ya ANC (ANCYL) Sindiso Magaqa, ya neng a sa ntsane a na le se sengata seo a ka se nyehelang mabapi le ho aha Aforika Borwa e tswetseng pele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazigxeka izenzo zobundlobongela, ukutshiswa kwezithuthi zabolu shishino kunye nezenzo zokugrogrisa phakathi kwaboshishino lwee-Meter Taxi kunye nabe-E Hailing Partners olwenzeke eSandton, eRhawutini.

src: Re ipiletsa ho mekga ya dipolotiki ho kgothaletsa mamellano hara ditho tsa yona le ho ipiletsa ho badudi ho tshehetsa ba Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa ya Aforika Borwa (SAPS) diphuputsong tsa bona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela ii-arhente zogcino-mthetho ukuba zithathe amanyathelo ngabenzi bobu bundlobongela nokugrogrisa ngokuhambelana noMgaqo-siseko.

src: Kgwedi ena e tsamaelana le dilemo tse lekgolo tsa letsatsi la tswalo la OR Tambo, Morati wa naha ya habo ya Aforika, ya bontshitseng boitelo bo sa thekeseleng ba ho sebeletsa batho ba Aforika Borwa, kontinente le lefatshe.
tgt: Ezi zenzo ziphazamisa amalinge eli lizwe enziwe ngamxhelo-mnye okudala imeko yorhwebo olukhululekileyo nokhuphiswano olungenamkhethe.

src: Hape re tshwaile sehopotso sa bo-40 sa lefu la Steve Bantu Biko, ya ileng a bolawa ka sehloho ke mmuso wa kgethollo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakugxeka ukuhlaselwa nokubulalwa kooceba kumaphondo athile ikwavakalisa namazwi ovelwano kwiintsapho nabahlobo babo bagetyengiweyo.

src: Letona la Bonono le Botjhaba, Monghadi Nathi Mthethwa, o lokolotse lenaneo la mekete ya kgweding ena.
tgt: Oku kuchasene nomoya kunye nemithetho ekuMgaqo-siseko, kwaye kuphazamisa kumalinge ethu okumilisela ulawulo lwentando yesininzi kunye nelungelo labantu lokuzikhethela abameli babo.

src: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka ditlaleho tsa pele tsa tshebetso tsa kgatelopele ya kotara ka nngwe bakeng sa 2017/18 mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha diphetho tsa dintlha tse ka sehlohlolong bakeng sa nako e dipakeng tsa Mmesa le Phuptjane 2017.
tgt: Ukususela ekuqaleni konyaka, baninzi abantu abaswelekayo KwaZulu-Natal,, kwezi ntsukwana zimbalwa zidlulileyo kuvele neengxelo ezithi lo mkhuba ugqithele naseMpuma Koloni.

src: Mmuso o tswela pele ho etsa kgatelopele e bonahalang mabapi le ho kenya tshebetsong diphetho tsa dintlha tse 14 tse ka sehlohlolong, tse itshetlehileng hodima Moralo wa Lewa wa Nako e Bohareng (MTSF) 2014-2019, o re atametsang tabeng ya ho fihlella Tjhebelopele ya 2030 ya NDKabinete hape e ile ya tsebiswa ka dibaka tse ileng tsa ba le ditiehiso mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong le ho tsebiswa ka mehato e batlehang ho akofisa phano.
tgt: Ubundlobongela bubulale amatsha-ntliziyo asematsha, kuquka negorha lowayesakuba nguNobhala-Jikelele wePhiko loLutsha lwe-African National Congress (i-ANCYL), uSindiso Magaqa, obesenegalelo elikhulu abenokulenza ekwakheni uMzantsi Afrika ohlumayo.

src: Dikopano tsa boraditaba tsa Matona a Dikarolo ka ho fapana di tla tshwarwa ho tsebisa ka diphetho tsa ditlaleho tsena bekeng ya la 6 ho fihlela ka la 15 Mphalane 2017.
tgt: Sicela amaqela ezopolitiko ukuba akhuthaze ukunyamezelana phakathi kwamalungu wawo sikwabongoza uluntu ukuba lixhase amaPolisa oMzantsi Afrika kuphando lawo.

src: Sekejule se tla lokiswa kgafetsa le ho manehwa ho WEBTOKEKabinete e tjhaelletse monwana tshisinyo ya hore Aforika Borwa e tshware Dipontsho tsa Lefatshe tsa Kopano ya Telecom tsa Matjhaba tsa Meralo ya Motheo ya Dikgokahanyo tsa Mehala ka Loetse 2018.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba baqhubeke ngokuphawula iNyanga yaMafa yalo nyaka phantsi komxholo othi: “Unyaka ka-Oliver Reginald Tambo: Sibhiyozela iNkululeko Yethu Elilifa”.

src: Tsena ke dipontsho tsa selemo ka seng le foramo bakeng sa mmuso le baetapele ba diindaseteri ho fuputsa diphephetso, dilekane le ditharollo, le ho hlwaya menyetla ya matsete le ditlwaelo tse ntle ka ho fetisisa bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya moruo wa kahisano ka Dithekenoloji tsa Tlhahisoleseding le Dikgokahanyo (di-ICT).Sena e tla be e le lekgetlo la pele ketsahalo ena e tshwarelwa Aforika.
tgt: Le nyanga ingqamana neminyaka elikhulu yokuzalwa kuka-Tambo, um-Afrika onguMthandi-weSizwe, owabonakalisa ukuzinikela ngokungagungqiyo ekukhonzeni abantu baseMzantsi Afrika, belizwekazi nabehlabathi.

src: Nakong ya ketsahalo ena, indaseteri ya ICT ya Aforika Borwa e tla thola monyetla wa ho pepesa dihlahiswa tsa yona ka ho latelana.
tgt: Sikwaphawula neminyaka engama-40 yokusweleka kuka-Steve Bantu Biko, nowabulawa ngokungenalusini ngurhulumente wocalucalulo.

src: Lekala la naha la bohahlaudi le lona le tla kgola molemo nakong ena.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezobuGcisa neNkcubeko, uMnu Nathi Mthethwa, ukhuphe inkqubo yokubhiyozela le nyanga.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla etella pele kemedi ya Aforika Borwa ho Tulo ya bo-72 e Tlwaelehileng ya Kopano Kakaretso ya UN tlasa mookotaba “Re Tsepamisa Maikutlo Bathong: Re Tsitlallela Kgotso le Bophelo bo Khabane bakeng sa Bohle Polaneteng ya Moshwelella” ho la New York, Amerika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iye yaxelelwa ngeengxelo zenkqubela yokusebenza yoku-1 yekota nekota yowama-2017/18 ekufezekisweni kweziphumo eziphambili zexesha eliphakathi kwekaTshazimpunzi neyeSilimela yowama-2017.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla tswela pele ho sebeletsa ho fihlella diphetho ho UN ha e tla be e nka karolo Tulong ya bo-72.
tgt: Urhulumente uyaqhubeka ukwenza inkqubela ebonakalayo ekufezekiseni iziphumo ezili-14 eziphambili, ezivela kwiNkqubo-sikhokelo yobuChule yesiGaba esiPhakathi (i-MTSF) yowama-2014 – 2019, nesisondezayo ekuphumezeni uMbono wama-2030 we-NDIKhabhinethi yazisiwe nageendawo ezifumana ukulibaziseka ekufezekisweni nokuhlolwa kumanyathelo alindelekileyo ukukhawulezisa ukunikezela.

src: Moporesident Jacob Zuma jwaloka Modulasetulo wa SADC, o tla bitsa Seboka sa Double Troika sa Dihlooho tsa Dipuso le Mebuso ka la 15 Loetse 2017 Pretoria.
tgt: Kuza kubanjwa iintlanganiso noonondaba ngabaPhathiswa beeNtlanganisela ezahlukeneyo ukuze bacacise malunga neziphumo zezi ngxelo kula veki yomhla we-6 kweyeDwarha ukuya kumhla we-15 kweyeDwarha yowama-2017.

src: Seboka sa Double Troika se tla tshwarwa ka lebaka la diketsahalo tsa haufinyana tjena tsa dipolotiki le polokeho ka hara Borena ba Lesotho.3 Kemedi ya boemo bo phahameng ya Aforika Borwa e tla teka boiketo ba yona ba pele ba ho tshwara Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Rakbi wa 2023 London ka la 25 Loetse 2017.
tgt: Iinkcukacha ngamaxesha neentsuku eziza kubanjwa ngazo ezi ntlanganiso ziza kulungiswa rhoqo zifakwe kule webhusayithi: WEBTOKEIKhabhinethi isamkele isiphakamiso sokuba uMzantsi Afrika usingathe umboniso obizwa i-International Telecommunication Union Telecom World Exhibition kweyoMsintsi yowama-2018.

src: Aforika Borwa e na le rekoto e matla e nang le bopaki ya ho tshwara diketsahalo tse kang eno.
tgt: Lo ngumboniso owenziwa rhoqo ngonyaka noliqonga leenkokeli zikarhulumente nezoshishino ukuba zihlalutye imingeni, zingene kwizivumelwano zokusebenzisana zikhangele nezisombululo, zize zichonge amathuba otyalo-mali neendlela ezingcono zokusebenza ngophuhliso lwezentlalo noqoqosho ngobuChwepheshe boLwazi noNxibelelwano (i-ICTs).Oku iza kuba kokokuqala ukuba lo msitho ubanjelwe e-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e lakatsa ho boeletsa tshehetso ya yona e matla ya Boiketo bona le ho ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ho tshehetsa Boiketo bona bo tla nyehela haholo mabapi le momahano ya setjhaba le kaho ya setjhaba le ho sebetsa hape jwaloka sethusi bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya dipapadi.
tgt: Ngexesha lalo msitho, icandelo le-ICT laseMzantsi Afrika liza kunikwa ithuba lokubonisa iimveliso zalo ezahlukeneyo.

src: Kabinete e lakaletsa baahi ba Jeremane katleho yohle ha ba itokisetsa dikgetho tsa Bofederale ka la 24 Loetse 2017 ho kgetha ditho tsa Bundestag ya bo-19, eo ka nqa e nngwe e tla kgetha Motjhanselara le ho bopa mmuso o motjha.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uza kukhokela igqiza loMzantsi Afrika ukuya kwiSeshoni yama-72 yaRhoqo yeNdibano eNkulu yeZizwe eziManyeneyo phantsi komxholo othi, “Ukugxila eBantwini: Ukuzamela uXolo noBomi obuNdilisekileyo kuMntu Wonke kwiHlabathi eliZinzileyo” eNew York, e-United States of America.

src: Jeremane ke motsetedi e moholo ka hara Aforika Borwa, ya ikemiseditseng dikamano tse tswelang pele, tshebedisano le bolekane.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uza kuqhubeka ukusebenzela ukuba kuqaliswe iinguqu kwi-UN futhi ihlaziywe njengokuba uthatha inxaxheba kwiSeshoni yama-72.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso a yona ho Caribean hammoho le dikarolo tsa Cuba le Amerika ho latela tshenyo e bakuweng ke Sefefo sa Irma.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma njengoSihlalo we- -SADC, uza kubiza iNgqungquthela ye-Double Troika yeeNtloko zaMazwe nooRhulumente ngomhla we-15 kweyoMsintsi yowama-2017 ePitoli.

src: Re fetisetsa matshediso a tswang botebong ba dipelo ho baratuwa ba ba lahlehetsweng ke maphelo le thepa ya bona koduweng ena.
tgt: Le Ngqungquthela ye-Double Troika ibanjwa ngenxa yezakutsha nje zopolitiko nokhuseleko eLesotho.3 Igqiza eliphezulu loMzantsi Afrika liza kufaka ingxelo yalo yokuqala yesicelo sokusingatha iNdebe yeHlabathi yeBhola yoMboxo yowama-2023 eLondon ngomhla wama-25 kweyoMsintsi yowama-2017.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le setjhaba mabapi le ho thoholetsa Kevin Anderson mabapi le ho fihlella makgaolakgang a US Open.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika unobungqina obaziwayo obuliqima bokusingatha imisitho ekumila kunje.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, 27 Loetse 2017, Union Buildings, Pretoria.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibidibene ngoLwesithathu, umhla wama-27 kweyoMsintsi yowama-2017, kwiZakhiwo zoMdibaniso, ePitoli.

src: Dintlha tsa Hajwale.
tgt: Imiba enguNdaba-mlonyeni.

src: Kopano Kakaretso ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UNGA).
tgt: INdibano eNkulu yeZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UNGA).

src: Kabinete e amohetse puo ya Moporesidente Jacob Zuma ho Tulo e Tlwaelehileng ya bo-72 ya UNGA New York, Amerika ka la 12 Loetse 2017, tlasa mookotaba “Re Tsepamisa Maikutlo Bathong: Re tsitlallela Kgotso le Bophelo bo Kgabane bakeng sa Bohle Polaneteng ya Moshwelella”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele intetho kaMongameli uJacob Zuma ebeyenze kwiSeshoni yama-72 yaRhoqo yeNdibano eNkulu yeZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UNGA) e-New York, e-United States of America ngomhla we-12 kweyoMsintsi yowama-2017, phantsi komxholo othi “Ukugxila eBantwini: Ukuzamela uXolo noBomi obuNdililsekileyo kuMntu Wonke kwiHlabathi eliZinzileyo”.

src: Dipuisano di ne di tsepamisitse maikutlo hodima, hara tse ding, Merero ya Ntshetsopele ya Moshwelella (di-SDG) ho fetofetoha ha tlelaemete le ditaba tsa kgotso le tshireletso le diphethoho tsa UN, ka ho qolleha diphethoho tsa Lekgotla la Tshireletso la UMoporesidente Zuma hape o saenne Tumellano e mabapi le Thibelo ya Dibetsa tsa Nutleleya, e bontshang boitlamo bo tswellang ba Aforika Borwa mabapi le ho fihlella lefatshe le hlokang tshoso e bakwang ke dibetsa tsa nyutleleya le ho netefatsa hore thekenoloji ya nutleleya e sebedisetswa merero ya kgotso feela.
tgt: Iingxoxo zigxile, phakathi kwezinye izinto, kwiiNjongo zoPhuhliso eziZinzileyo (ii-SDG): ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu imiba yokhuselo nokhuseleko kunye neengunqu kwi-UN, ingakumbi iinguqu kwiBhunga loKhuselo le-UUMongameli uZuma ukwatyikitye isiVumelwano soThintelo lweziXhobozeNyukliya, nokukwabonakalisa ukuzinikela okuqhubekayo koMzantsi Afrika okubhekisele ekumiseleni ihlabathi elingenangxaki ezibangelwa kukusetyenziswa kwezixhobo zenyukliya nokuqinisekiswa ukuba ubuchwepheshe nezixhobo zenyukliya zisetyenziselwa iinjongo zoxolo kuphela.

src: Mopresidente Zuma o ne a hlophisitse dijo tsa mantsiboya tsa ho keteka dilemo tse lekgolo ho hlompha mofu Moporesidente wa mehleng wa African National Congress (ANC), Monghadi Oliver Reginald Tambo.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma usingathe umbhiyozo weminyaka elikhulu yokuhlonipha ongasekhoyo owayesakuba nguMongameli we-African National Congress (i-ANC), uMnu Oliver Reginald Tambo.

src: Kgwedi ya Bojalefa.
tgt: INyanga yaMafa.

src: Kabinete e leboha maAforika Borwa kaofela bakeng sa ho keteka Kgwedi ya Bojalefa ka Loetse le ho boeletsa molaetsa wa Moporesidente Zuma wa Letsatsi la Bojalefa hore bohle ba ka hara naha ba hahamalle kopano e matla le ka hara diphapang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibulela bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ngokubhiyozela iNyanga yaMafa kweyoMsintsi nokuzeka mzekweni kumyalezo kaMongameli uZuma woSuku lwaMafa wokuba sonke kwilizwe lethu masizame umanyano olukhulu kwiiyantlukwano zethu.

src: Jwaloka ha naha e phethela Kgwedi ya Bojalefa tlasa mookotaba “Selemo sa Oliver Reginald Tambo: ho keteka tokoloho ya letlotlo la bojalefa ba rona”, maAforika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho ahella hodima dipehelo tsa bophelo tse ka hara Molaotheo le ho matlafatsa mekutu ya ho aha setjhaba se hlokang bofuma, tlala, ho hloka bodulo le ho se lekalekane.
tgt: Njengokuba ilizwe lethu liqukumbela iNyanga yaMafa phantsi komxholo othi “Unyaka ka-Oliver Reginald Tambo: UkuBhiyozela iNkululeko Yethu Elilifa”, abemi baseMzantsi Afrika bayakhuthazwa ukuba bakhele kwizithethe ezixhaswa nguMgaqo-siseko nokomeleza amalinge okwakha isizwe esingenantlupheko, ndlala, ukungabi namakhaya nokungalingani.

src: Bakeng sa ho tiisa moya wa bojalefa, Kabinete e amohela tumellano e saennweng pakeng tsa Aforika Borwa le Tanzania, e reretsweng ho baballa nalane ya ntwa ya tokoloho.
tgt: Ekukhuthazeni umoya wamafa, iKhabhinethi isamkele isivumelwano esityikitywe phakathi koMzantsi Afrika neTanzania, nesijongise ekugcineni imbali yomzabalazo wenkululeko.

src: UN e fafielletse ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Porojeke ya Ditsela tse Lebisang Boikemelong ka hara Aforika.
tgt: I-UN ikugunyazisile ukufezekiswa kweProjekthi yeeNdlela eziSingise eNkululekweni e-Afrika.

src: Ka ho ketekwa ha moya wa bonngwe le tshebedisano-mmoho hara mekgatlo ya tokoloho ya Aforika mme e tla baka ho ahuwa ha museamo, laeborari le dibaka tsa polokelo ya nalane.
tgt: Ngumbiyozo wokubhiyozela umoya wentlalo-ntle nentsebenziswano phakathi kwemibutho yenkululeko yase-Afrika nezakukhokelela ekwakhiweni kwemuziyamu, ithala leencwadi noovimba beenkcukacha.

src: Letsatsi la Lefatshe la Bohahlaudi.
tgt: USuku loKhenketho lweHlabathi.

src: Aforika Borwa, tlasa boetapele ba Letona la Bohahlaudi, Mofumahadi Tokozile Xasa, e nkile karolo ho Letsatsi la Lefatshe la Bohahlaudi (27 Loetse 2017) le ho Kgwedi ya Bohahlaudi, tlasa mookotaba, “Bohahlaudi ba Moshwelella – Sesebediswa sa Ntshetsopele”.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika, phantsi kokukhokelwa nguMphathiswa wezoKhenketho, uNksz Tokozile Xasa, uthathe inxaxheba kuSuku loKhenketho lweHlabathi (27 kweyoMsintsi yowama-2017) neNyanga yoKhenketho, phantsi komxholo othi “UKhenketho oluZinzileyo – IsiXhobo soPhuhliso”.

src: Sena se fana ka lepatlelo bakeng sa ho tshehetsa diphethoho leanong, ditlwaelong tsa dikgwebo le boitshwaro ba basebedisi ba bohahlaudi, tse lebisitseng ho lekala la bohahlaudi la moshwelella, le ka nyehelang ka matla mabapi le ho fihlellwa ha di-SDNakong ya Letsatsi la Lefatshe la Bohahlaudi, dinaha le ditso tse fapaneng di keteka bongata ba diketsahalo tse itshetlehileng mabatoweng tse kang kgothaletso ya dikepele tse ikgethang le/kapa ho batalatsa ho fihlella dibaka, ho dumellwa ho kena ka bongata mahala diphakeng le dirapeng, le dipuisano tse fapafapaneng le bangkakarolo.
tgt: Oku kubonelela ngeqonga lokuxhasa iinguqu kwimigaqo-nkqubo, ukuqhutywa koshishino nokuziphatha kwabakhenkethi, olubhekisele kwicandelo lezokhenketho elizinze ngokuthe chatha, nelinokwenza igalelo elingqongqo ekuphunyezweni kwee-SDNgoSuku loKhenketho lweHlabathi, amazwe neenkcubeko ezahlukeneyo zibhiyozele imisebenzi ehambelana nemimandla emininzi neyahlukahlukeneyo efana nokukhuthazwa kwemirhumo ekhethekileyo kunye nokwandiswa kofikelelo kumaziko okanye ukwandiswa kofikelelo kumaziko, ufikelelo loluntu oluninzi olusimahla kwiipaka nezitiya, kunye nothethathethwano olwahlukeneyo nabadlali-ndima ebalulekileyo.

src: Aforika Borwa e atlehile bakeng sa ho hodisa bohahlaudi ka dibaka tsa yona tse fapafapaneng tse nang le kgohedi tse kang diphaka tsa rona, mabopo a rona a lewatle a maemo a hodimo, le ditsha tsa bojalefa tse tjhaelletsweng monwana ke lefatshe.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika ube nempumelelo ekukhuthazeni ukhenketho ngamaziko ayo anomtsalane awohlukenyo afana nemiyezo yeli yezilwanyana neyendalo, iilwandle zethu eziqinisekiswe ukuba zicocekile, kunye neziza zamafa ezivunyiweyo ehlabathini.

src: Bokgoni ba Bohahlaudi ba ho amohela basebetsi e dula e le sebetsa se seholo kgahlanong le tlhokeho ya mesebetsi.
tgt: Icandelo lezoKhenketho elinesakhono sokukwazi ukuqesha abantu abaninzi liselelona lisisixhobo singundoqo sokulwa intswela-ngqesho.

src: Jwaloka sebaka sa bohahlaudi, Aforika Borwa e tobane le kgonahalo ya ho hodisa makala a yona a parolang le makala a mang a moruo ho kgonahatsa bokgoni bo matla ba moruo ka makala a mang a mehleng eo esale a le ka sehloohong a moruo.
tgt: Njengelizwe elithandwayo ngabakhenkethi, uMzantsi Afrika usethubeni elihle lokukhulisa icandelo lwalo lezokhenketho oluneentlobo ezininzi zokhenketho ukuze kuvulelwe amathuba amaninzi ezoqoqosho kusetyenziswa la macandelo ezokhenketho esiqhelo.

src: Ana a kenyeletsa bohahlaudi ba dibaka tsa mahae, tsa bongaka, tsa temo le tsa botjhaba.
tgt: La macandelo esiqheloaquka ukhenketho lwasemaphandleni, olwezonyango, olwezolimo nolwenkcubeko.

src: Tumellano ya ho beha ditheko tsa meriana ya HIKabinete e amohela tumellano e etsang pale ya ditefello e fihlelletsweng ke Letona la Bophelo bo Botle, Ngaka Aaron Motsoaledi, ka tshebedisano le mekgatlo e mengata ya matjhaba, ho akofisa boteng ba mokgahlelo wa pele wa pidisi e le nngwe ya kalafo ya HIHo akanngwa hore ho fokotswa ha tefello ho tla baka dipoloko tse ka fihlang ho R.7 bilione dilemong tse tsheletseng tse tlang.
tgt: Isivumelwano sokumiselwa kwexabiso lamachiza athomalalisa iNtsholongwane kaGawulayo (ii-ARV).

src: Tumellano ya ditefello e etsa hore moriana wa Dolutegravir, o kgothaletswang ke Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Bophelo bo Botle (WHO), o kgonahale bakeng sa mebuso ya dinaha tsa lekeno le tlase le le mahareng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isivumelwano esinguvulindlela sokumiselwa kwamaxabiso ekufikelelwe kuso nguMphathiswa wezeMpilo, uGq Aaron Motsoaledi, ngokusebenzisana neqela lemibutho yehlabathi, ukukhawulezisa umthetho wokufumaneka okokuqala kweyeza leNtsholongwane kaGawulayo (i-HIV) eliyipilisi enye.

src: Ho ya ka tumellano ya ditefello, Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle le rera ho tsebahatsa motswako wa ho nowa ho tsitsitseng ha meriana e meraro, Tenofovir, Lamivudine le Dolutegravir ka Mmesa 2018.
tgt: Kuthelekelelwa ukuba ukuncitshiswa kwexabiso kuza kukhokelela ekongiweni kwemali engafikelela kwiibhiliyoni ezili-11.7 zeerandi kule minyaka mithandathu izayo.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela a a seng a le maemong a ho kena ho tsa thobalano, ka ho qolleha batjha, ho tswela pele ho phela bophelo bo itekanetseng ba ho amohela mekgwa ya thibelo e kang ho dula ba kena thobalanong e bolokehileng ka ho ikgula thobalanong, ho tshepahala le ho sebedisa dikgohlopo, le ho kenela diteko tsa HIV kgafetsa.
tgt: Oku kuza kunika ithuba uMzantsi Afrika ukuba ubhalise izigulana ezininzi eziza kufumana unyango.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa ha lehlakore le letjha la Sepetlele sa Cecilia Makiwane Mdantsane, ho la Kapa Botjhabela.
tgt: Isivumelwano sokumiselwa kwexabiso senza ukuba ichiza i-Dolutegravir, nelinconywayo nguMbutho wezeMpilo weHlabathi (i-WHO), lifikeleleke ngakumbi koorhulumente bamazwe anabantu abamivuzo mincinci nabamivuzo iphakathi.

src: Ke mokolokotwane o lebisitseng ho kenngweng tshebetsong ha Inshorense ya Naha ya Bophelo bo Botle e tla baka hore ho be le phano ya tlhokomelo ya kalafo ya boleng, ka ho qolleha ho badudi ba futsanehileng.
tgt: Ngenxa yesi sivumelwano sokumiselwa kwamaxabiso, iSebe lezeMpilo liceba ukuvelisa umxube odibanisa amachiza amathathu, i-Tenofovir, Lamivudine ne-Dolutegravir kwekaTshazimpunzi yowama-2018.

src: Sepetlele sena sa dithuto tse hodimo sa maemo a lefatshe ke matsete a ho fihlella tjhebelopele ya Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP) le di-SDG tsa UN tsa tlhokomelo ya kalafo ya lefatshe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika abazibandakanya ekwabelaneni ngezesondo, ingakumbi ulutsha, ukuba luqhubeke ukuphila ubomi obusempilweni nobukhokelisa phambili amanyathelo okuzikhusela njengokuqhubeka bezikhusela xa besabelana ngesondo ngokuzila ezesondo, ngokunyaniseka nokusebenzisa ikhondomu, nokuzivavanyela i-HIV rhoqo.

src: Sepetlele sena sa dibethe tse 526 se tshehetswa ke tsamaiso e kopanetsweng e tla matlafatsa phano ya tlhokomelo ya kalafo ya boleng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuvulwa ngokusesikweni kwecandelo elitsha kwisiBhedlele iCecilia Makhiwane eMdantsane, eMonti.

src: E sebedisa ntjhafatso ya thekenoloji ho fokotsa dinako tsa badudi tsa ho ema, e ntlafatsa ho hlahlojwa le ho thusa ka boitshunyako bo potlakileng ba kalafo bakeng sa bakudi.
tgt: Oku kuyimpumelelo enkulu nebalulekileyo ekufezekisweni kwe-Inshorensi yezeMpilo yeSizwe (i-NHI) nezakubonelela ngeenkonzo zezempilo ezisemgangathweni, ingakumbi kubantu abahluphekileyo.

src: Matsete ana a meralo ya motheo a R1 bilione a tla tshehetsa ntshetsopele ya moruo wa lehae ka hara makeishene.
tgt: Esi sibhedlele sineengcungela zogqirha sikumgangatho wehlabathi sibaluleke kakhulukumalinge okufezekiswa kombono wesiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe (i-NDP) kunye neenjongo zoPhuhliso eziZinzileyo (ii-SDG) zeZizwe eziManyeneyo (UN) ezigxininisa ukubaluleka kokufumaneka kweenkonzo zezempilo ezifanelekileyo kumntu wonke jikelele.

src: Ha re ntse re tsoseletsa meralo ya motheo ya boitekanelo ba setjhaba, hape re atolosa menyetla bakeng sa badudi ba lehae ya ho ntlafatsa maphelo a bona ka tlhahiso ya mesebetsi le ntshetsopele ya dikgwebo tsa lehae.
tgt: Esi sibhedlele sinebhedi ezingama-526 sixhaswa yinkqubo edibeneyo eza kuthi iqinisekise ukuba kunikezelwa ngeenkonzo zezempilo ezisemgangathweni.

src: Kgwedi ya Ntshetsopele ya Kahisano e tshwarwa selemo ka seng ho hopola menyabuketso e mengata e entsweng ke naha, mabapi le ho fana ka thuso ya kahisano ho ba fumanehileng le ba tsietsing haholo ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Esi sibhedlela sisebenzisa ubuchule bobuchwepheshe bokunciphisa ixesha lokulinda kwezigulana, obuphucule ukwenziwa koxilongo nexesha elithathwayo ukubonwa kwesigulo, loo nto yenze ukuba kuthathwe amanyathelo okungenelela akhawulezileyo ukunceda izigulana.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla thakgola semmuso sehopotso sa Ntshetsopele ya Kgwedi ya Kahisano ka Labohlano, 29 Loetse 2017.
tgt: Esi sibhedlele sakhiwe ngemali eyibhiliyoni yeerandi siza kuxhasa uphuhliso loqoqosho lweelokishi zalo mmandla.

src: Kabinete e lakaletsa ka mofuthu maqheku kaofela le batho ba hodileng Letsatsi le monate la Batho ba hodileng, le tla hopolwa ka Sontaha sa, la 1 Mphalane 2017.
tgt: Njengokuba sivuselela iziseko ezingundoqo zezempilo zikarhulumenteu, sikwanabisela uluntu lwasekuhlaleni amathuba okuphucula ubomi balo ngokudala imisebenzi nophuhliso lwamashishini ale ngingqi.

src: MaAforika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho sebedisa kgwedi ya Mphalane ho ananela karolo le sehlabelo sa bohlokwa se entsweng ke batho ba hodileng mabapi le ho fihlella tokoloho ka hara naha ya bo rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba baqhubeke ukunceda abo bahlelelekileyo kunokuba bezinceda bona buqu njengoko sisiya kwiNyanga yoPhuhliso loLuntu kweyeDwarha.

src: Ke mosebetsi wa baahi mmoho ba bo rona, e seng feela mmuso, ho fana ka tlhokomelo e eketsehileng ho maqheku a rona le dihlopha tse tsietsing.
tgt: INyanga yoPhuhliso loLuntu ibanjwa rhoqo ngonyaka ukukhumbula umsebenzi omkhulu osele wenziwe leli lizwe, ekuboneleleni abahluphekileyo kunye nabo basemngciphekweni ombi wokuba ngamaxhoba endlala ngezibonelelo zezentlalo eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Lenaneo la Mmuso wa Aforika Borwa la dithuso tsa setjhaba le thehilwe hodima tumelo e tiileng ya hore dithuso tsa polokeho ya setjhaba ke tokelo ya motheo ya botho mme di bohlokwa bakeng sa ho kgutlisa seriti sa baahi ba yona.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uza kumisela ngokusesikweni iNyanga yoPhuhliso loLuntu ngoLwesihlanu, umhla wama-29 kweyoMsintsi yowama-2017.

src: Dithuso tsa setjhaba di imolla mathata a ditjhelete a dimilione tsa malapa mme ka ho sebetsa mmoho le mmuso di matlafatsa ba tsietsing hore maemo a bona a bophelo a ntlafale a be le seriti.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inqwenela bonke abemi asebekhulile kunye nabantu abadala uSuku lwaBantu abaDala olumnandi, noluza kukhunjulwa ngeCawa, umhla wo-1 kweyeDwarha yowama-2017.

src: Kabinete e lakaletsa baithuti kaofela tse molemo, ka ho qolleha ba etsang Kereiti 12, jwaloka ha ba itokisetsa dihlahlobo tsa mafelo a selemo.
tgt: Inkqubo yezibonelelo zezentlalo yoRhulumente waseMzantsi Afrika imiselwe kwinkolelo yokuba izibonelelo zezentlalo lilungelo elingundoqo kwaye zingundoqo ekubuyiseleni isidima sabemi bakhe.

src: Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo (DBE) le malala-a-laotswe bakeng sa dihlahlobo tsa materiki tse qalang ka la 16 Mphalane 2017 tse tla ngolwa ke baithuti ba fetang 798 000 ba ingodisitseng.
tgt: Izibonelelo zezentlalo zinika izigidi zamakhaya umnconwana wemali akwazi ukuqhawulisa izinto ezibalulekileyo kwaye ezi zibonelelo zincediswa ngurhulumente ziphucula iimeko zokuphila zabantu abangathathi ntweni.

src: DBE e fana ka tshehetso e eketsehileng ho baithuti ba materiki ka dithuto tsa tlatsetso hona sekolong kamora dihora tsa sekolo, le mafelong a beke le ka matsatsi a phomolo ya dikolo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inqwenela bonke abafundi okuhle, ingakumbi abo benza iBanga 12, njengoko belungiselela iimviwo zokuphela konyaka.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho batswadi le bahlokomedi ho fana ka tshehetso e batlehang ho baithuti ha ba ntse ba itokisetsa dihlahlobo.
tgt: ISebe leMfundo esiSiseko (i-DBE) lizilungiselele iimviwo zematriki eziqala ngomhla we-16 kweyeDwarha yowama-2017 eziza kubhalwa ngabafundi abangaphezulu kwama-798 000 ababhalisiweyo.

src: Mmuso o phethetse ka katleho Beke ya Selemo ka seng ya selemong sena ya Thusong Service Centre, e etsahetseng ho tloha ka la 18 ho isa ka la 22 Loetse 2017 tlasa mookotaba: “Selemo sa OR Tambo – Re Ntshetsapele Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane, tse Mahareng le tse Kgolo ho di-Thusong Service Centre”.
tgt: I-DBE ibonelela abafundi bematriki ngenkxaso eyongezelelweyo yokufundela esikolweni ukuphuma kwesikolo, nangeempela-veki nangeeholide zesikolo.

src: Sena se bopile karolo ya Kgwedi ya Tshebeletso ya Mmuso le ho kgothaletsa Lenaneo la Thusong ka ho pepesa lenaneo le kopanetsweng la ho fihlella dibaka ka dibaka le bokgabane ba lona mabapi le ho arabela ditlhoko tsa baahi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela abazali nabalondolozi babantwana ukuba baxhase abafundi kangangoko njengoko belungiselela iimviwo.

src: Di-Thusong Services Centre di tlisa mokeke wa ditshebeletso tsa mmuso le tlhahisoleseding haufi le batho.
tgt: IVeki yeeThusong Service Centre yoNyaka.

src: Lenaneo lena le fihlella bakgolamolemo ba akanngwang ho dimilione tse tsheletseng selemo ka seng ka Lenaneo le Kopanetsweng la Phihlello ya Dibaka ka Dibaka la Phihlello, Beke ya Selemo ka seng ya Thusong Service Centre le mapatlelo a mang a Tsamaiso ya Dikgokahanyo le Tlhahisoleseding ya Mmuso (GCIS).
tgt: Urhulumente uyiqukumbele ngokuyimpumelelo iVeki yeeThusong Service Centre yoNyaka yalo nyaka, nebiqhubeka ukususela kumhla we-18 ukuya kowama-22 kweyoMsintsi yowama-2017 phantsi komxholo othi: “Unyaka ka-OR Tambo – ukuqhubela Phambili amaShishini amaNcinci, aPhakathi naHlumayo kwiThusong Service Centre.” Oku kube yinxalenye yeNyanga yeeNkonzo zikaRhulumente yaza yakhulisa iphakamisa iNkqubo yeeThusong Service Centre ngokubonisa inkqubo yokuzisa iinkonzo eluntwini edibeneyo nengumahamba-nandlwana nokusebenza kwayo kakuhle ekuhlangabezeni iimfuno zabemi.

src: Ka lenaneo lena, mmuso o tswela pele ho lokisa ho se lekalekane ha nako e fetileng ka ho tlisa ditshebeletso tsa boleng haufi le badudi bao pele ba neng ba qheletswe ka thoko ntshetsopeleng e tlwaelehileng ya moruo wa kahisano.
tgt: IiThusong Service Centre zizisa iintlobo ezahlukeneyo yeenkonzo zikarhulumente nolwazi lube kufutshane eluntwini.

src: Di-Thusong Service Centre hape di matlafatsa badudi ka maitsebelo le thupello e hlokehang bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa maphelo a bona, ka bolekane bo teng le mmuso, ditheo tse thuswang ke mmuso le lekala la poraefete.
tgt: Le nkqubo ifikelela kubantu abamalunga nezigidi ezithandathu qho ngonyaka ngeNkqubo yokuZisa iiNkonzo eLuntwini enguMahamba-naNdlwana, ngeVeki yeeThusong Service Centre kunye namanye amaqonga eZiko lezoNxibelelwano nokuSasazwa koLwazi lukaRhulumente (i-GCIS).

src: Kabinete e boeletsa kgoeletso ya yona ho badudi ho tswela pele ho sebedisa di-Thusong Service Centre ho fihlella ditshebeletso tse kang tsa Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae, la Mesebetsi, la Toka, Lekala la Aforika Borwa la Dithuso tsa Setjhaba (SASA) le Letlole la Dikotsi tsa Mebila (RAF).
tgt: Ngale nkqubo, urhulumente uyaqhubeka ukulungisa ukungalingani kwangaphambili ngokuzisa iinkonzo zoluntu ezisemgangathweni kufutshane kuluntu olwalusakubekelwa bucala ngaphambili kude kumjelo wophuhliso lwezentlalo noqoqosho.

src: Aforika Borwa e tshehetsa pehelo ya Mongodi-Kakaretso wa UN, Monghadi António Guterres, ya tobokeditseng boikarabelo ba Mmuso wa Myanmar ba ho fana ka tshireletso ho badudi bohle ba amehang, le hape ho kopa makala a thekolohelo ya botho ho fumantshwa phihlello ya badudi ba hlokang thuso le tshireletso.
tgt: IiThusong Service Centre zikwaxhobisa uluntu ngezakhono ezifanelekileyo noqeqesho lokuphucula ubomi balo, ngokusebenzisa ubudlelwane obukhoyo norhulumente, amaqumrhu karhulumente nabecandelo labucala.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa mahlakore kaofela ho fedisa merusu le ho thibela ho tswela pele ha tshotleho ya batho le ho ipiletsa hore boemo ka hara Puso ya Rakhine bo rarollwe ho itshetlehilwe hodima molao.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaphinda icela uluntu ukuba luqhubeke lusebenzisa iiThusong Service Centres ukuze lufumane iinkonzo ezingundoqo ezifana nezeSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya, ezabaSebenzi, ezobuLungisa, i-Arhente yeziBonelelo zezeNtlalo noMhlala-phantsi yaseMzantsi Afrika (i-SASSA) neNgxowa-mali yeeNgozi zeNdlela (i-RAF).

src: Angola.
tgt: E-Myanmar.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le Moporesidente Zuma mabapi le ho thoholetsa Riphabliki ya Angola ka ho hlophisa Dikgetho tsa Naha tsa Ketsamolao tse atlehileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ixhalabile malunga nentlungu yabantu baseRohingya nabathe babaleka beshiya amakhaya wabo.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o ne a kenetse Mokete wa Tlhomamiso ya Moporesidente João Manuel Gonçalves Lourenço Luanda ka Labobedi, la 26 Loetse 2017.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uyayixhasa intetho eyenziwe nguNobhala Jikelele weZizwe eziManyeneyo, uMnu António Guterres, nothe wagxininisa ethetha ngoxanduva lukarhulumente waseMyanmar lokukhusela bonke abantu abachaphazelekileyo, aze ukongeza apho ucele ii-arhente ezinceda ngezibonelelo zezentlalo nemibutho yesisa ukuba zinikwe indlela yokufikelela kubantu abadinga uncedo nokhuseleko.

src: Aforika Borwa le Riphabliki ya Angola di na le nalane e tshwanang ya ntwa kgahlanong le bokoloniale le mmuso wa kgethollo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza onke amaqela ukuba aphelise ubundlobongela ukuthintela okunye ukubulaleka koluntu ikwabongoza ukuba imeko yePhondo lase-Rakhine isonjululwe ngokusemthethweni.

src: Angola ke e nngwe ya balekane ba baholohadi ba kgwebisano ba Aforika Borwa kontinenteng ya Aforika le ho tswela pele ho hodisa maqhama a yona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nayo njengoMongameli uZuma ivuyisana neRiphabliki yase-Angola ngokuqhuba uNyulo lweNdlu yoWiso-mthetho lweSizwe ngokuyimpumelelo.

src: MaAforika Borwa kaofela a lokela ho tshwela ka mathe botlokotsebe bo kang bona bo tshosang lekala la rona le dulang le hola la bohahlaudi.
tgt: Omabini la mazwe, uMzantsi Afrika kunye neRiphabliki yase-Angola, ayayazi inzima yomzabalazo wokulwa ubukoloniyali nocalucalulo.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho setjhaba ho tla ka tlhahisoleseding leha e le efe e ka thusang balaodi ba qobello ya molao le ho etsa kgoeletso ya tshebediso ya letsoho le matla la molao bakeng sa ba tla fumanwa ba le molato.
tgt: Ukususela ngowe-1994, la mazwe mabini aqhubile ukukhulisa nokwandisa amakhonkco aphakathi kwawo aluqilima.

src: Ho thakgolwa ha buka ya melao ya setso ya Bakoena Ba Mopeli.
tgt: I-Angola lelinye lawona mazwe makhulu angamaqabane ezorhwebo noMzantsi Afrika kwilizwekazi le-Afrika kwaye asaqhubekeka ukukhulisa ubudlelwane obuphakathi kwala mazwe mabini.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa ho thakgolwa ha buka, Bakoena Ba Mopeli Customary Law of Succession and Genealogy, jwaloka phihlello ya mokolokotwane bakeng sa boetapele ba setso ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakugxeka ukukhuthazwa kwakutsha nje kwabakhenkethi abasuka eNetherlands nabathe balandelwa besuka kwiSikhululo seeNqwelo-moya saMazwe ngamazwe i-R. Tambo.

src: Letona la Kopanelo ya Puso le Merero ya Botjhaba, Monghadi Des van Rooyen, le Motlotlehi Morena Letsie III, Hlooho ya Puso ya Borena ba Lesotho, ba ne ba kenetse ketsahalo ena ka Mantaha wa, la 25 Loetse 2017.
tgt: Bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika mabalugxeke olu hlobo lolwaphulo-mthetho lubeka emngciphekeni icandelo lethu lezokhenketho oluhleli lukhula.

src: Lefapha la Kopanelo ya Puso le Merero ya Botjhaba le qadile ho hlophisa ditokomane tsa nalane ya dikarolo tse 13 tsa Borena/Bofumahadi ka selemo sa 2011.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ukongeza apho imema iNkonzo yezobuPolisa yaseMzantsi Afrika (i-SAPS) ukuba yenze konke okusemandleni ukubamba abenzi bolu lwaphulo-mthetho.

src: Buka ena e tla thusa ho utlwisisa nalane ya Bakoena Ba Mopeli le tlhahlamano ya madi bakeng sa ho baballa nalane ya rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza uluntu ukuba luzise ngaphambili ulwazi olunganceda ii-arhente zogcino-mthetho kwaye icela ukuba umthetho udlale indima yawo ngokungenalusini kwabo banokufunyaniswa benetyala ngesi senzo.

src: Porothokole ya Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tse ka Borwa ba Aforika (SADC).
tgt: Ukupapashwa ngokusesikweni kwencwadi yomthetho wemveli yaBakoena Ba Mopeli.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho amohelwa ha Porothokhole ya SADC ya Taolo ya Tikoloho bakeng sa Ntshetsopele ya Moshwelella, ke Palamente.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikothulela umnqwazi ukupapashwa ngokusesikweni kwencwadi enesihloko esithi: Bakoena Ba Mopeli Customary Law of Succession and Genealogy, njengomsebenzi omhle kakhulu noyimbali kwiinkokeli zemveli eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Sepheo sa porothokhole ke ho kgothaletsa taolo ya tikoloho e parolang le meedi, e leng tabatabelo ya ditho tsa dipuso tsa SADAforika Borwa, jwaloka Modulasetulo wa SADC ho tloha ka Phato 2017 ho isa ka Phato 2018, e itlama ho matlafatsa mekutu ya lebatowa ya ho baballa mehlodi ya tlhaho ya ho parola le meedi le ho kgothaletsa ntshetsopele ya moshwelella ka hara lebatowa la SADSena se matahantswe le NDP, e behileng ka sehlohlolong ho tebisa kopanelo ya lebatowa la SADC hammoho le ho netefatsa paballo ya moshwelella ya tikoloho le diphethoho tse lekalekanang tse lebisang moruong wa khabone e tlase.
tgt: UMphathiswa woLawulo lweNtsebenziswano nemiCimbi yezeMveli, uMnu Des van Rooyen, noHloniphekileyo uKumkani Letsie III, oyiNtloko yoMbuso welizwe laseLesotho, bazimase lo msitho ngoMvulo, umhla wama-25 kweyoMsintsi yowama-2017.

src: Pitso ya Matona ya Bolekane bakeng sa Tshebetso mabapi le Moruo wa Tlhaho.
tgt: ISebe loLawulo lweNtsebenziswano nemiCimbi yezeMveli seliqalisile ukuqokelela libhale imbali yeeKumkani/neeKumkanikazi zezizwe ezili-13 ngowama-2011.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tshwarwa ha Pitso ya Matona ya Bolekane bakeng sa Tshebetso mabapi le Moruo wa Tlhaho ka Loetse 2018.
tgt: Le ncwadi iza kuncedisa ekuqondeni imbali yaBakoena Ba Mopeli nokulandelelana ngokomnombo khona ukuze kugcineke imbali yethu.

src: Lepatlelo lena le tshehetsa dinaha le mabatowa ho beha paballo ya moshwelella motsong wa maano a moruo le ditlwaelo bakeng sa ho ntshetsapele Lenaneo la 2030 la Ntshetsopele ya Moshwelella.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukugunyaziswa kwesiVumelwano se-SADC esingoLawulo lezokusiNgqongileyo loPhuhliso oluZinzileyo, yiPalamente.

src: Ke lenaneo la UN le kopanyang mmoho botsebi ho tswa Makaleng a mahlano a UN e leng Lenaneo la Tikoloho la UN Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Basebetsi (ILO) Lenaneo la Ntshetsopele la UN Mokgatlo wa Ntshetsopele ya Diindaseteri wa UN le Setheo sa Thupello le Diphuputso.
tgt: Injongo yesi sivumelwano kukukhuthaza ukusetyenziswa ngokuzinzileyo kolawulo lokusingqongileyo olungaphaya kwemida, olubalulekileyo kumazwe angamalungu e-SADUMzantsi Afrika, njengoSihlalo we-SADC ukususela kweyeThupha yowama-2017 ukuya kweyeThupha yowama-2018, uzimisele ekomelezeni amalinge ommandla okulondoloza imithombo yendalo engaphaya kwemida nokukhuthaza uphuhliso oluzinzileyo ngaphakathi kommandla we-SADOku kuhambelana ne-NDP, ebeka phambili ukungena nzulu kwindibanisela yommandla we-SADC kwakunye nokuqinisekiswa kozinzo lezokusingqongileyo nokuguqukela kuqoqosho oluvelisa umoya omdaka omncinci.

src: Ho tshwara Pitso ya Matona ho tla ntshetsapele lenaneo lena, ka lapeng le kontinenteng ya Aforika, la kgolo e kenyeletsang mabapi le ho amohela motjha wa khabone e tlase le wa moruo o itsekang.
tgt: INgqungquthela yaBaphathiswa engobuDlelwane ngamaNyathelo oQoqosho olungenabuNgozi kokusiNgqongileyo IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukusingathwa kweNgqungquthela yabaPhathiswa engobuDlelwane ngamaNyathelo oQoqosho olungenabuNgozi kokusiNgongileyo kweyoMsintsi yowama-2018.

src: Boto ya Metsi ya Umngeni.1 Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka maemo a Boto ya Metsi ya Umngeni e leng ya bobedi e kgolohadi ka hara naha e nang le boleng selemo ka seng ba se ka fetang R2,4 bilione le ditekanyetso tsa Ditjeho tsa Tjhelete ya Sehlooho e fetang R7 bilione.
tgt: Eli qonga lixhasa amazwe nemimandla ukuba akhokelise ngozinzo kumbindi wemigaqo-nkqubo yawo yezoqoqosho nemisebenzi yokuqhubela phambili i-Ajenda yowama-2030 yoPhuhliso oluZinzileyo.

src: Kabinete hape e tsebisitswe ka dipuisano tseo lefapha la metsi le tsamaiso ya dikgwerekgwere le neng le di tshwere le batsetedi ba lona.2 Bakeng sa ho tsitsisa dintlha tsa taolo tsa Boto, Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho thonngwa ha Boto ya Nakwana ha Letona le ntse le akofisa motjha wa ho thonya ka ho phethahala Boto ya Metsi ya Umngeni.
tgt: Le Ngqungquthela yinkqubo ye-UN ehlanganisa ndawonye iingcali ezivela kwii-arhente ze-UN ezintlanu ezizezi iNkqubo yezokusiNgqongilseyo ye-UN uMbutho wabaSebenzi weHlabathi iNkqubo yoPhuhliso ye-UN uMbutho woPhuhliso lwamaShishini we-UN kunye neZiko loQeqesho noPhando-nzulu le-UUkusingatha iNgqungquthela yabaPhathiswa kuza kuqhubela phambili umbono, apha kweli nakwilizwekazi le-Afrika, wohlumo oluxhanyulwa ngumntu wonke ngokuba kwamkelwe indlela yoqoqosho enekhabhoni encinci nekwaziyo ukumelana neemeko zezulu ezitshintsha-tshintshayo.

src: Kabinete e kgotsofaditswe ke mosebetsi o etswang ke Letona mabapi le ho tsitsisa Boto ya Metsi ya Umngeni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe namagqabantshintshi nangeengxoxo eziphakathi kwesebe lezamanzi nogutyulo kunye nabatyali-mali balo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Tekolo ya Mobu bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: Khona ukuze kuzinziswe imiba yezolawulo lale Bhodi iKhabinethi ikugunyazisile ukuchongwa kweBhodi yeThutyana ngeli xesha uMphathiswa ekhawulezisa inkqubo yokumiselwa kweBhodi yaManzi yaseMngeni epheleleyo nesisigxina.

src: Bili ena e fetola Molao wa Tekolo ya Mobu, wa 1997 (Molao wa bo-8 wa 1997).
tgt: IKhabhinethi yanelisekile ngumsebenzi owenziwa nguMphathiswa ekuzinziseni iBhodi yaManzi yaseMngeni.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Melao ya Saense le Thekenoloji sa 2017.
tgt: UmThetho-siHlomelo ongokuCandwa koMhlaba.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Melao ya Saense le Thekenoloji sa 2017 bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukupapashwa komThetho-siHlomelo ongokuCandwa koMhlaba ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: Bili e sisinya ho tlisa tsamaelano le ho lokisa maemo a dipehelo tse laolang ditshebetso le taolo ya ditheo tsa setjhaba tse ikarabellang ho Letona la Saense le Thekenoloji.
tgt: Lo mThetho usaYilwayo uhlomela umThetho woCando loMhlaba, wowe-1997 (umThetho uNombolo 8 wowe-1997).

src: Sena se tla netefatsa botsitso ditlhokong tsohle tse lokelang ho fihlellwa le metjha e lokelang ho latelwa ke ditheo jwaloka ha di amana le taolo.
tgt: Ezi zihlomelo zikhulisa imimandla yokuphendula nolawulo nokubonelela ngokuchongwa kwamalungu athile eBhodi yeMimiselo yoCando, khona ukuze komelezwe imimiselo yokucandwa komhlaba eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Jwaloka ha Mphalane 2017 e tshwaya Kgwedi ya Dipalangwang tlasa mookotaba: “Mmoho re ntshetsa Aforika Borwa Pele”, Kabinete e ipiletsa ho bohle ho sebetsa mmoho ho netefatsa hore meralo ya motheo ya naha ya dipalangwang e tswela bohle molemo le ho kgothaletsa basebedisi ba mebila ho nka boikarabelo le ho sebedisa boipaballo mebileng jwaloka karolo ya bophelo ba bona ba letsatsi ka leng.
tgt: Lo mThetho usaYilwayo uzama ukulawula ukucandwa komhlaba eMzantsi Afrika ngokuxhobisa uNocanda Jikelele oyiNtloko ukuba enze umsebenzi wokuhlola wesizwe nolawulo lokucandwa komhlaba kulungiswa izigingqi namathambeka omhlaba, ucando lomhlaba kuzotywa futhi kujongwa amaqolo neekhonto zawo, nocando olunokwenza nocando-mida nobunini bomhlaba, nocando oluphonononga luhlalutye umhlaba kunye neenkonzo zolwazi ngomhlaba.

src: Nakong ya Kgwedi ya Dipalangwang, mmuso – o eteletswe pele ke Lefapha la Dipalangwang le ditheo tsa lona – o tla hlakisa melemo ya moruo ya lekala lena ka ho pepesa ditshebeletso tsa meralo ya motheo ho tsa bofofisi, mawatle, dipalangwang tsa setjhaba, tsa mebileng le diterene.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukupapashwa koMthetho-siHlomelo weMithetho yezeNzululwazi nobuChwepheshe wowama-2017 ukwenzela ukuba uluntu luhlomle.

src: Ho thakgolwa ha naha ho tshwaretswe Lebaleng la dipapadi la Sinaba Daveyton ka hara Motsemoholo wa Ekurhuleni ka la 29 Loetse 2017.
tgt: Lo mThetho usaYilwayo uceba ukungqinelanisa nokubeka emgangathweni amagatya alawula ukusebenza nolawulo lwamaqumrhu karhulumente aphantsi koMphathiswa wezeNzululwazi nobuChwepheshe.

src: Matsete lekaleng la dipalangwang a hlasimolla ntshetsopele le ho hlahisa mesebetsi jwaloka karolo ya Aforika Borwa ya Moralo wa Dintlha tse Robong, o reretsweng ho hodisa moruo le ho hlahisa mesebetsi e hlokahalang haholo.
tgt: Oku kuza kuqinisekisa ngokungaguquki kwazo zonke izinto ezifunekayo ekufanele zifezekiswe kunye neenkqubo ekufanele zilandelwe ngamaqumrhu ngokubhekisele kulawulo.

src: Matsete ana a tla netefatsa ho ahuwa ha marangrang a dipalangwang tsa setjhaba a kopanetsweng ho phatlalla le naha.
tgt: Njengokuba eyeDwarha yowama-2017 iyiNyanga yezoThutho phantsi komxholo: “Sikunye siqhubela uMzantsi Afrika Phambili”.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla tshwara Tulo ya bo-2 ya Khomishene ya Dinaha tse Pedi (BNC) ya Africa Borwa-ZimbabweMoporesidente Jacob Zuma o tla amohela wa mphato wa hae wa Zimbabwe, Mohlomphehi Moporesidente Robert Mugabe, ya tla ba teng Aforika Borwa ka la 03 Mphalane 2017 lebakeng la Tulo ya bo-2 ya BNC ya Aforika Borwa-Zimbabwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isimema sonke ukuba sisebenzisane ukuqinisekisa ukuba iziseko ezingundoqo zezothutho zisebenzela wonke umntu ikwakhuthaza abasebenzisi beendlela ukuba bathathe uxanduva baze basebenzise ukhuseleko lwezendlela njengenxalenye yobomi babo bemihla ngemihla.

src: Aforika Borwa le Zimbabwe di na le dikamano tse ntle tsa bobedi bona tsa sepolotiki, moruo le kahisano tse fafielletsweng ka maqhama a nalane ya dilemo tse ngata.
tgt: NgeNyanga yezoThutho, urhulumente – ekhokelwa liSebe lezoThutho kunye namaqumrhu alo – uza kuqaqambisa igalelo lezoqoqosho leli candelo ngokwenza imiboniso yeenkonzo zeziseko ezingundoqo zezothutho zasemoyeni, ezasemanzini, ezezithuthi zikawonkewonke, ezeendlela nezemizila yoololiwe.

src: Zimbabwe ke e nngwe ya balekane ba Aforika Borwa ba bahlano ba ka hodimo ka ho fetisisa ka hara kontinente ka dipalopalo tse bontshang kgolo selemo ka seng.
tgt: Utyalo-mali kwicandelo lezothutho luvuselela uphuhliso luze ludale nemisebenzi njengenxalenye yesiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba saseMzantsi Afrika, sigxile ekukhuliseni uqoqosho size sidale nemisebenzi edingeka kakhulu.

src: Ka selemo sa 2016, Diyantle tsa Aforika Borwa ho ya Zimbabwe di ne di akanyetswa ho R.3 bilione.
tgt: Ezi ndidi zotyalo-mali ziza kuqinisekisa ngokwakhiwa kwecandelo lezithuthi zikawonkewonke elidibeneyo kweli lizwe jikelele.

src: Letsatsi la Tswalo – Mama Winnie Madikizela-Mandela.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uza kusingatha iseshoni yesi-2 yeKhomishoni ePhakathi koMzantsi Afrika neZimbabwe (i-BNC)UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kundwendwelwa ngugxa wakhe waseZimbabwe, oHloniphekileyo uMongameli uRobert Mugabe, oza kuba lapha eMzantsi Afrika ngomhla we-03 kweyeDwarha yowama-2017 kumsitho weSeshoni yesi-2 ye-BNC yoMzantsi Afrika neZimbabwe.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le naha kaofela mabapi le ho lakaletsa Mama Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, ya tsebahalang jwaloka Mme wa Setjhaba, letsatsi la tswalo le monate ha a ne a qeta dilemo tse 81 ka Labobedi, 26 Loetse 2017.
tgt: Isivumelwano sokusekwa kwe-BNC satyikitywa kwekaTshazimpunzi yowama-2015 saza saphehlelelwa kweyeDwarha yowama-2016 eHarare, eZimbabwe.

src: Mama Madikizela-Mandela ke e mong wa diqhoku tsa ntwa ya tokoloho tse babatswang ka ho fetisisa.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika neZimbabwe zinobudlelwane obuhle ngokwepolitiki, ezoqoqosho nobezentlalo obuxhaswa ngamakhonkco entsebenziswano nobudlelwane akudala.

src: Kabinete e mo leboha bakeng sa tshebeletso ya hae Ntweng ya tokoloho ya rona e lwanetsweng ka thata le ho mo lakaletsa selemo se latelang se tletseng mahlohonolo bakeng sa hae le baratuwa ba hae le ba lelapa.
tgt: IZimbabwe lelinye lamazwe okuqala angamaqabane oMzantsi Afrika – amaqabane ezorhwebo akwisihlanu sokuqala esiphezulu kwilizwekazi, apho iinkcukhacha-manani zorhwebo zibonisa ukukhula rhoqo ngonyaka.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Banyana Banyana mabapi le ho hapa Bompodi ba Basadi ba 2017 ba COSAFA kamora ho hlola ka 2-1 ho makgaola kgang kgahlanong le Zimbabwe ho la Bulawayo.
tgt: Ngowama-2016, urhwebo lokuthunyelwa kweemveliso zaseMzantsi Afrika eZimbabwe lufikelela kwimali emalunga neebhiliyoni ezingama-29.3 zeerandi.

src: Banyana Banyana ba phahamisitse folakga ya naha ka motlotlo mme mesebetsi ya bona e tswela pele ho kgothatsa ba bang ba batjha ba maAforika Borwa ba nang le talente ya ho ipabola ka makgabane.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nayo njengelizwe lonke ithi kuMama uWinnie Madikizela-Mandela, nowaziwa njengoMama weSizwe, akhule akhokhobe xa ebegqiba iminyaka engama-81 ezelwe ngoLwesibini, umhla wama-26 kweyoMsintsi yowama-2017.

src: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di lokelwa ke ho tiisetswa ka mangolo a thuto le tumellano e amehang.
tgt: UMama uMadikizela-Mandela ngomnye wezona zithwalandwe namagqala enkululeko ahlonitshwa kakhulu ngabantu.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho thonngwa ha Boto ya Nakwana ya Boto ya Metsi ya Umgeni:a. Mofumahadi Ziphozethu Mathenjwa (Modulasetulo)b. Mofumahadi Nompumelelo Chamanec.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyambulela ngegalelo lakhe kumzabalazo wenkululeko yethu eyalwelwa nzima kwaye imnqwenela unyaka osikelelekileyo yena nezihlobo kunye nosapho lwakhe.

src: Ditho tse tla sebetsa ho Phanele ya Bolaodi ba Phethisetso:a. Monghadi Sandile Bubele Siyaka (sehla sa bobedi)b. Monghadi Ntshengedzeni Anthony Michael Tshivhase (sehla sa bobedi)c. Monghadi Christopher Ewing (sehla sa bobedi)d. Monghadi Ebrahim Aboobaker Moolla (sehla sa bobedi)e. Mofumahadi Nonzukiso Zukie Siyotula lef.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nayo njengoMongameli uZuma ithi akuhlanga lungehliyo kuMongameli u-Enrique Peña Nieto wase-United Mexican States nabantu base-Mexico emva kwenyikima, itsunami nenkanyamba ezitshabalalise, zaza zakhokelela ekuswelekeni kwabantu abangaphezulu kwama-225 nokonakala kweziseko ezingundoqo eziliqela.

src: Mofumahadi Nocamagu Nomfundo Mbulawa.
tgt: IzikhundlaZonke izikhundla zixhomekeke ekuqinisekisweni kwamabakala ezemfundo kunye nokuqinisekiswa okufanelekileyo kwezokhuselo.

src: Batsamaisi bao seng ba phethahatso ho Boto ya Inshorense ya Koporasi ya Mekitlane ya Thepa ya Diyantle ya Aforika Borwa - SOC Limited:a. Monghadi Dhevendren Dharmalingam (Modulasetulo)b. Mofumahadi Vuyelwa Matsiliza (o thontswe hape) lec.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuchongwa kweBhodi yeThutyana yeBhodi yezaManzi yaseMngeni: a. Nksz Ziphozethu Mathenjwa (uSihlalo)b. Nksz Nompumelelo Chamanec.

src: Mofumahadi Siobhain O’Mahony (o thontswe hape).
tgt: Mnu Visvin Reddyd.

src: Monghadi Patrick Khulekani Dlamini o thontswe hape jwaloka Mohlanka e Moholo wa Phethahatso (CEO) wa Banka ya Ntshetsopele ya Aforika e ka Borwa le ho ba Motsamaisi wa Phethahatso wa Boto.
tgt: Mnu David Dikokoe.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, la 18 Mphalane 2017, Tuynhuys, Motse Kapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibibambe intlanganiso ngoLwesithathu, umhla we-18 kweyeDwarha ngowama-2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Dintlha tsa Hajwale.
tgt: Imiba enguNdaba-mlonyeni.

src: Letsatsi la Tokoloho ya Boraditaba.
tgt: USuku lweNkululeko yamaJelo eeNdaba.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le maAforika Borwa mabapi le ho hopola Letsatsi la Tokoloho ya Boraditaba ka Labone, 19 Mphalane 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nayo njengabemi boMzantsi Afrika ibhiyozela isikhumbuzo soSuku lweNkululeko yamaJelo eeNdaba ngoLwesine, umhla we-19 kweyeDwarha ngowama-2017.

src: Boraditaba ba bapetse karolo e hlokolosi ntweng e neng e le kgahlano le mmuso wa kgethollo, ba pepesa sehloho le bokgopo bo entsweng ke mmuso wa kgethollo.
tgt: Amajelo eendaba adlala indima ebalulekileyo kwidabi lokulwa ucalu-calulo, ukubhentsisa izenzo zenkohlakalo ezazisenziwa ngurhulumente wocalu-calulo.

src: Selemo sena se tshwaya dilemo tse 40 esale mmuso wa kgethollo o thibela dikoranta tse neng di pepesa kgethollo tse kang the World, the Weekend World le the Voice.
tgt: Kulo nyaka siphawula iminyaka engama-40 ukusukela oko urhulumente wocalu-calulo wavala umlomo amaphephandaba ayegxininisa inkqubela nobulungisa afana ne-World, i-Weekend World kunye ne-Voice.

src: Kajeno, tokoloho ya boraditaba e kenyeleditswe ka matla ka hara Molaotheo wa Aforika Borwa le ho dula e le letshwao la motheo la setjhaba sa bo rona se tswelang pele.
tgt: Namhlanje, inkululeko yamajelo eendaba ibethelelwa nangakumbi kuMgaqo-nkqubo woMzantsi Afrika kwaye ibaluleke kakhulu kweli lizwe lethu likhulayo.

src: Kabinete ho feta moo e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa ho tswela pele ho kgothaletsa phumantsho ya tlhahisoleseding le ho sebedisa tokelo ya tokoloho ya boraditaba ka boikarabelo ho thusa ho aha Aforika Borwa e kopaneng, e hlokang semorabe, e sa kgetholleng ho ya ka bong, ya demokerasi le e tswang pele bakeng sa bohle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba baqhubeke nokukhuthaza ukufumaneka kolwazi kunye nokusebenzisa inkululeko yamajelo eendaba ngenkathalo ukuze sikwazi ukwakha uMzantsi Afrika wethu sonke omanyeneyo, ongenabuhlanga, ongacaluli ngokwesini, olawulwa ngokwentando yesininzi nonekamva elihle kuye wonke umntu.

src: Moruo wa Mawatle.
tgt: UQoqosho lwaseLwandle.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Moporesidente Jacob Zuma mabapi le ho fana ka tlaleho ya kgatelopele ho bankakarolo ka ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Operation Phakisa bakeng sa Moruo wa Mawatle le ho ipiletsa ho bankakarolo bohle ho tswela pele ho aha selekane le mmuso bakeng sa ho bula bokgoni ba moruo ba mawatle a rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imqhwabela izandla uMongameli Jacob Zuma ngokunika amahlakani ekubanjiswene nawo ingxelo ngomsebenzi oselwe wenziwe malunga nokuqaliswa kwe-Operation Phakisa yoQoqosho lwaseLwandle kwaye icela onke amahlakani ukuba aqhubeleke nokusebenzisana norhulumente ukuze kuvulwe amathuba ezoqoqosho kwiilwandle zethu.

src: Moruo wa Mawatle o se o nyehetse se ka etsang 4.4% ho Palohohle ya Dihlahiswa tsa Naha (GDP) tsa Aforika Borwa mme tlaleho ya Moporesidente ho bankakarolo e bontsha ka matla mekutu e kopanetsweng le tshehetso bakeng sa balekane bohle ba mmuso ba itahletseng ka setotswana ka hara bokgoni bona bo batsi.
tgt: UQoqosho lwaseLwandle sele ligalele i-.% kwiMveliso yoNyaka yoMzantsi Afrika (i-GDP) kwaye ingxelo kaMongameli ebeyinika amahlakani ibonakalisa amalinge kunye nenkxaso enikwa amahlakani axhamla obu butyebi.

src: Diporojeke tsa Moruo wa Mawatle ho fihlela mona di se di butse matsete a kopaneng a R.6 bilione ho tswa mmusong le lekaleng la poraefete, le ho bopa mesebetsi e fetang 6 500.
tgt: Iiprojekthi zezoQoqosho lwaseLwandle ukuza kuthi ga ngoku zezivulele utyalo-mali oluxabisa imali ezibhiliyoni ezingama-24.6 zeerandi kurhulumente nakwicandelo labucala, kwaye zidale imisebenzi engaphezulu kwama-6 500.

src: Matsete a maholo ka ho fetisisa Moruong wa Mawatle, a hlahisitsweng ka ditsiane tsa mmuso, a lebisitswe ho ntshetsopele ya meralo ya motheo, haholo maemakepe, ho tsa tlhahiso, kaho ya dikepe, kgodiso ya diphedi tsa lewatle le diphuputso tsa saense le lekala la kgase.
tgt: Olona tyalo-mali lukhulu kuQoqosho lwaseLwandle, olwenzeke ngenxa yezibonelelo zikarhulumente, beluye kuphuhliso lweziseko ezingundoqo, ikakhulu amazibuko, icandelo lezemizi-mveliso, ukwenziwa kweenqanawa, ezolimo zaselwandle kunye nemisebenzi yophando-nzulu kwicandelo leze-oli nelezegesi.

src: Mmuso o rera ho theha sebaka se le seng se seholohadi sa kaho ya dikepe ka hara Aforika e ka borwa.
tgt: Urhulumente uceba ukuvula iziko elinye lokwenza iinqanawa elilelona likhulu kumazantsi Afrika.

src: Phaka ya Kaho ya Dikepe ya KwaZulu-Natal ka hara Boemakepe ba Durban e tla kotula bokgoni ho tswa matseteng a matjha, diyantle le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi.
tgt: Iziko Lokwenziwa kweeNqanawa laKwaZulu-Natal kwiZibuko laseDurban liza kuzuza kolu tyalo-mali lutsha, kwiimpahla ezithunyelwa kumazwe angaphandle nasekudaleni imisebenzi.

src: Leeto la Puso ho ya Zambia.
tgt: UTyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni eZambia.

src: Kabinete e amohela diphetho tsa Leeto la Puso la Mopresidente Zuma la ho etela Riphabliki ya Zambia ho tloha ka la 12 ho isa ka la 13 Mphalane 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamkela iziphumo zoTyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni lukaMongameli Zuma eRiphablikhi yaseZambia ukusuka ngomhla we-12 ukuya kowe-13 kweyeDwarha ngowama-2017.

src: Dipuisano pakeng tsa Moporesidente Zuma le wa mphato wa hae wa Zambia Edgar Lungu di matlafaditse dikamano tse ntle tse ntseng di le teng tsa sepolotiki, tsa moruo le tsa botjhaba pakeng tsa dinaha ka bobedi, tse hlakiswang ke maqhama a matla a nalane ya dilemo tsa ntwa ya tokoloho.
tgt: Iintlanganiso phakathi kukaMongameli Zuma nogxa wakhe waseZambia uMongameli Edgar Lungu ziqinise ubudlelwano obuhle bezopolitiko, bezoqoqosho kunye nobezenkcubeko phakathi kwala mazwe mabini, asukela kumoya wentsebenziswano wakudala osuka kwiminyaka yomzabalazo wenkululeko.

src: Dihlooho tsa Dipuso tse pedi tsena di butse semmuso setsha sa Naha sa Bojalefa sa OR Tambo Chelstone, ho la Lusaka, mabapi le ho tlotla nyehelo ya OR Tambo ntweng ya tokoloho ya Aforika e ka borwa.
tgt: Aba Mongameli babini bavule ngokusesikweni i-OR Tambo National Heritage Site eChelstone, eLusaka, ehlonipha igalelo lika-OR Tambo kwidabi lomzalabo emazantsi e-Afrika.

src: Zambia e dula e le e nngwe ya balekane ba ka sehloohong ba kgwebisano le Aforika Borwa ka hara lebatowa le ka hara kontinente.
tgt: IZambia iselelinye lamazwe aphambili arhweba noMzantsi Afrika kulo mmandla nakweli lizwekazi.

src: Tshebedisano ho tsa moruo pakeng tsa Aforika Borwa le Zambia e tswela pele ho hola, ka diyantle tsa Aforika tse yang Zambia tse akantsweng ho fihla ho R30 bilione ka selemo sa 2016.
tgt: Urhwebo lwezoqoqosho phakathi koMzantsi Afrika neZambia buyaqhuba nokukhula, kangangokuba iimpahla zorhwebo ezithunyelwa nguMzantsi Afrika eZambia bezixabisa imali emalunga neebhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama-30 ngowe-2016.

src: Dinaha tsena tse pedi di sebedisana mmoho dibakeng tse fapafapaneng, ho kenyeletswa kgwebisano le matsete, saense le thekenoloji, tshireletso, temo, tikoloho, eneji le bophelo bo botle.
tgt: La mazwe mabini ayasebenzisana kumacandelo ahlukeneyo, kuquka elezorhwebo notyalo-mali, elezenzululwazi nobuchwepheshe, elezokhuselo, elezolimo, elezokusingqongileyo, elezamandla kunye nelezempilo.

src: Leeto la tshebetso ho ya Nigeria.
tgt: UTyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni oluya eNigeria.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Moporesidente Zuma mabapi le ho tlotlwa ka seemahale le hore mmila o rehellwe ka yena Nigeria, nakong ya leeto la tshebetso bakeng sa ho matlafatsa dikamano tsa moruo wa kahisano le mabaka a mang a tshebedisano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imqhwabela izandla uMongameli Zuma ngokuwongwa ngokuba kwakhiwe umfanekiso oqingqiweyo wakhe futhi kuthiywe nesitalato ngegama lakhe, ngethuba ekutyelelo lokuqinisa ubudlelwano bezentlalo nobezoqoqsho kunye nezinye iintlobo zokusebenzisana.

src: Mmusisi wa Puso ya Imo, Rochas Okorocha, o tlotlile Moporesidente Zuma ka Kgau ya Tlhompho ya Imo, e leng kgau e kgolo ka ho fetisisa Pusong eo le ho abelwa ba entseng phapang ntshetsopeleng ya badudi ba habo bona.
tgt: IRhuluneli yePhondo lase-Imo, uRochas Okorocha, uwonge Mongameli Zuma ngembasa yokugqwesa, i-Imor Merit Award, eyiyeyona mbasa iphezulu kweliya Phondo enikwa umntu owenze umahluko omkhulu kuphuhliso lwabantu belizwe lakhe.

src: Kopano ya bo-17 ya Rim ya Lekgotla la Matona a Dikgaolo tsa Lewatle la India (IORA).
tgt: INtlanganiso ye-17 yeBhunga labaPhathiswa le-Indian Ocean Rim Association (i-IORA).

src: Aforika Borwa e nkile Bodulasetulo ba IORA nakong ya kopano ya bo-17 o tshwaretsweng Durban ho tloha ka la 14 ho isa ka la 18 Mphalane 2017.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uthathe isikhundla sokuba nguSihlalo we-IORA ngethuba lentlanganiso ye-17 ebibanjelwe eDurban ukusuka ngomhla we-14 ukuya kowe-18 kweyeDwarha ngowe-2017.

src: Mookotaba wa Aforika bakeng sa nako ya yona ya bodulasetulo o re “Re kopanya Batho ba Aforika, Asia, Australasia le Botjhabela bo Hare ka Tshebedisano e Matlafetseng bakeng sa Kgotso, Botsitso le Ntshetsopele ya Moshwelella”.
tgt: Umxholo woMzantsi Afrika ngethuba inguwo uSihlalo uthi: Ukumanyanisa Abantu base-Afrika, e-Asiya, e-Australasia nabaseMbindi-Mpuma ngeNtsebenziswano eMandla yoXolo, uZinzo noPhuhliso oluZinzileyo”.

src: Kabinete e boeleditse boitlamo ba yona ka bodulasetulo bona ho ntshetsa pele tshebedisano ya lebatowa mabakeng a kang a moruo wa mawatle matlafatso ya basadi moruong kgodiso ya dikgwebo tse nyenyane, tse mahareng le tse kgolo matlafatso ya batjha, le tshebedisano ho tsa thuto, saense le thekenoloji.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde yakugxininisa ukuzibophelela kwayo ngokusebenzisa esi sikhundla ukuba iza kuqinisa amakhonco entsebenziswano kulo mmandla kwimiba efana noqoqosho lwaselwandle, ukuphuhliswa kwabasetyhini ngezoqoqosho ukuphuhlisa amashishini amancinci, aphakathi namancinane uphuhliso lolutsha, kunye nentsebenziswano phakathi kweengqondi zamaziko emfundo ephakamileyo, nakwinzululwazi nobuchwepheshe.

src: Dikopano tsa selemo ka seng tsa Letlole la Matjhaba la Ditjhelete (IMF) le Banka ya Lefatshe.
tgt: Intlanganiso yonyaka yeNgxowa-mali yeziMali yeHlabathi (i-IMF) kunye neyeBhanki yeHlabathi.

src: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ke Letona la Ditjhelete, Monghadi Malusi Gigaba, ho latela bonkakarolo ba Aforika Borwa dikopanong tsa selemo ka seng tsa 2017 tsa IMF le Banka ya Lefatshe, tse neng di tshwerwe ho tloha ka la 13 ho isa ka la 15 Mphalane 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi nguMphathiswa wezeMali, uMnu Malusi Gigaba, kulandela ukuthatha inxaxheba koMzantsi Afrika kwintlanganiso yonyaka yowama-2017 ye-IMF neyeBhanki yeHlabathi, ebezibanjwe phakathi komhla we-13 nowe-15 kweyeDwarha ngowama-2017.

src: Dikopano di fane ka monyetla wa ho lekola kgatelopele ya matjhaba mabapi le dintlha tsa tswelopele le ho hlakisa maikitlaetso a Aforika Borwa bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya moruo wa kahisano, kgolo e kenyeletsang, tlhahiso ya mesebetsi le phediso ya bofuma.
tgt: Ezi ntlanganiso zinike ithuba lokuba kuvavanywe umgama osele uhanjwe lihlabathi malunga nemiba yophuhliso kuze oku kusetyenziswe kumaphulo oMzantsi Afrika ophuhliso lwezentlalo nezoqoqosho, uhlumo oluxhanyulwa ngumntu wonke, ukudalwa kwemisebenzi kunye nokuliwa kwendlala.

src: Kabinete hape e tsebisitswe mabapi le kopano e neng e tshwerwe ke Letona Gigaba le makala a ikemetseng a tekolo ya mekitlane le batsetedi ho tiisetsa botjha maano a hajwale a Aforika Borwa le katamelo ya boitshwaro bo botle ba tshebediso ya ditjhelete tsa mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe namanye amagqabantshintshi ngeziphumo zentlanganiso uMphathiswa uGigaba ebezibambe nee-arhente zokuhlela isakhono samazwe sokukwazi ukuhlawula izikweliti kunye nabatyali-mali apho ebecacisa le migaqo-nkqubo yoMzantsi Afrika ikhoyo kunye nendlela eli lizwe elizilawula ngayo izimali.

src: Kabinete e kgotsofetse ka tiisetso botjha e fuweng batsetedi mabapi le meralo ya mmuso ya ho hodisa moruo le boitlamo ba mmuso ba ho sebetsana le dintlha tsa taolo dikgwebong tsa rona tsa mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yanelisekile yingxelo eqinisekisayo enikwe abatyali-mali ngezicwangciso zikarhulumente zokukhulisa uqoqosho kunye nokuzimisela kukarhulumente ekulungiseni iingxakana ezikhoyo ngezolawulo kumaqumrhu karhulumente.

src: Pehelo ya Leano la Ditekanyetso tsa Nako e Bohareng (MTBPS) e tla tekwa Palamenteng, Motse Kapa, ka la 25 Mphalane mme e tla hlakisa meralo ya mmuso ya tshebediso ya ditjhelete dilemong tse tharo tse tlang.
tgt: INgxelo yoMgaqo-nkqubo woHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali lwesiGaba esiPhakathi (i-MTBPS) iza kuthiwa thaca ePalamente, eKapa ngomhla wama-25 kweyeDwarha kwaye iza kunika inkcukacha ngezincwangciso zenkcitho karhulumente kule minyaka mithathu izayo.

src: Ntshetsopele ya Meralo ya Motheo.
tgt: Ukuphuhliswa kweziseko ezingundoqo.

src: Kabinete e thoholeditse matlafatso e kgolo mabapi le ntshetsopele ya mmuso ya meralo ya motheo ka ho nehelana semmuso ka marokgo a mararo Botlokwa ho la Limpopo ke Moporesidente Zuma ka la 17 Mphalane 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwuqhwabela izandla umsebenzi owenze igalelo elimandla kumaphulo karhulumente ophuhliso lweziseko ezingundoqo wokunikezelwa ngokusesikweni kweebhulorho ezintathu eBotlokwa eLimpopo nguMongameli Zuma ngomhla we-17 kweyeDwarha ngowama-2017.

src: Lekala la Mebila ya Naha la Aforika Borwa le ahile marokgo a Botlokwa, e leng borokgo bo le bong ba makoloi le a mabedi a ditaaso hodima mmila wa N1 pakeng tsa Polokwane le Makhado.
tgt: I-Arhente yoMzantsi Afrika yeeNdlela zeSizwe (i-Sanral) yakhe ezi bhuloro zaseBotlokwa, eziyibhulorho enye yeemoto kunye nezimbini zeenyawo kuhola wendlela u-N1 phakathi kwePolokwane neMakhado.

src: Kabinete e dumela hore porojeke ena e tla ntlafatsa haholo maemo a ho tsamaya le polokeho bakeng sa basebedisi kaofela ba mebila sebakeng seo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inethemba lokuba le projekthi iza kuluphucula ukhuseleko kunye neemeko abahamba phantsi kwazo bonke abo basebenzisa iindlela kulo mmandla.

src: Dikgwebo tse nyenyane le tse mahareng.
tgt: Amashishini amancinci naphakathi.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane bakeng sa ho tshwara mmoho Dipontsho tsa Matjhaba tsa Tjhaena tsa Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane le tse Mahareng (SME) tsa selemong sena, kaha di nyehela bakeng sa ho bula mmaraka wa Tjhaena bakeng sa dikgwebo tse nyenyane le dikoporasi tsa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iliqhwabela izandla iSebe lezoPhuhliso lwamaShishini Amancinci ngokuba lelinye lamaqumrhu asingethe uMboniso walo nyaka waseChina wamaShishini amaNcinci naPhakathi (i-SME), njengoko ivulela amashishini amancinci nookopolotyeni baseMzantsi Afrika amathuba okurhweba eChina.

src: Dipontsho tsa di-SME di tshwaretswe Guangzhou, ho la Tjhaena ho tloha ka la 10 ho isa ka la 27 Mphalane 2017.
tgt: Lo Mboniso wee-SME uyaqhuba eGuangzhou, eChina.

src: Dikgwebo tse nyenyane ke motso wa moruo wa rona le motjhini bakeng sa kgolo ya moruo le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi ka hara Aforika Borwa, mme bonkakarolo ba rona dipontshong tsena tsa kgwebo bo kgothaleditse phihlello ya mmaraka le menyetla ya ho hodisa dikgwebo.
tgt: Amashishini amancinci abaluleke kakhulu kuqoqosho lweli lizwe kwaye ngawo aqhuba uhlumo loqoqsho naphambili kumaphulo okudala imisebenzi eMzantsi Afrika, kwaye ukuthatha kwethu inxaxheba kulo mboniso worhwebo kusinike iqonga lokuba sibone iindawo nabantu esinokubathengisela iimveliso zethu kunye namathuba okukhulisa amashishini ethu.

src: Kabinete e na le tshepo ya hore sena se bontsha boitlamo ba mmuso morerong wa ho kgothaletsa le ho baballa moshwelella boetapele ba dikgwebo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqinisekile ukuba oku kubonakalisa ukuba urhulumente uzimisele ukukhulisa amashishini amancinci angazikutshona.

src: Ho tsetela dikgwebong tse nyenyane ho tla thusa naha ho arabela diphephetso tsa hajwale tsa moruo wa kahisano.
tgt: Ukutyala imali kumashishini amancinci kuza kunceda eli lizwe likwazi ukumelana nezi ngxaki zidl’umzi ngoku zezentlalo nezoqoqoqsho.

src: Bohahlaudi.
tgt: Ezokhenketho.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa ha Lenaneo la Naha la Balebedi ba Bohahlaudi Soweto, ka Labobedi, 17 Mphalane 2017, le reretsweng ho matlafatsa boiphihlelo ba baeti hammoho le ho matlafatsa polokeho ya bahahlaudi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuphehlelelwa kweNkqubo yeSizwe yabaHloli bezoKhenketho, eSoweto, ngoLwesibini, umhla we-17 kweyeDwarha.

src: Lefapha la Bohahlaudi, ka bomphato le Bolaodi ba Bohahlaudi ba Gauteng, le thakgotse lenaneo lena Seterateng sa Vilakazi, e leng sona feela seterata lefatsheng se ikgantshang ka bodulo ba Baamohedi ba babedi ba Kgau ya Kgotso ya Nobel – Moporesidente wa mehleng Nelson Mandela le Archbishop Emeritus Desmond Tutu.
tgt: Le Nkqubo ilungiselelwe ukuntenda abakhenkethi kangangoko kwakunye nokuphucula ukhuseleko lwabo xa bekweli.

src: Lenaneo lena le matahantswe le maikemisetso a Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP) mme le rerile ho hlahisa mesebetsi bakeng sa batjha ba 200, ba tla rupellwa ho ba balebedi ba dibaka tsa bohahlaudi bakeng sa nako ya dikgwedi tse Kabinete e kgothaletsa beng ba dikgwebo le badudi ba Gauteng ho sebetsa mmoho le balebedi ho ntlafatsa polokeho ya bahahlaudi le ho qhaneha bokgoni ba moruo ho tswa indasetering ena.
tgt: ISebe lezoKhenketho, lisebenzisana ne-Arhente yezoKhenketho yaseGauteng, liphehlelele le nkqubo eVilakazi Street, esisitrato ekukuphela kwaso kwihlabathi liphela esinezindlu zabantu abaphumelela iMbasa kaNobel – abo bantu ngulowo wayenguMongameli uNelson Mandela kunye noBhishophu oMkhulu oSele Esidla uMhlalaphantsi uDesmond Tutu.

src: Kabinete e amohela le ho thoholetsa borasaense ba nkileng karolo ho diphuputso tsa ditheleskhoupu tsa Bolekodi ba Dinaledi ba Aforika Borwa (SAAO) le Thelesekhoupu e Kgolo ya Aforika e Borwa (SALT).
tgt: Le nkqubo ihambelana neenjongo zesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP) kwaye ilungiselelwe ukudalela abantu abatsha abangama-200 imisebenzi.

src: Sena se bakile tshebedisano ya matjhaba e so kang e ba teng esale ho batlisisa motso wa temoho ya pele ya maqhubu a lefatshe a hlahisitsweng ke dinaledi tse pedi tsa dinyotrone ha di thulana.
tgt: Abo bantu batsha baza kuqeqeshwa ukuba babe ngabahloli bezokhenketho kwiindawo ezithandwa ngabakhenkethi isithuba esizinyanga ezingama-36.

src: Ho thulana hape ho bakile ho phatloha ha kganya ha kilonova.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza abanikazi bamashishini kunye nabantu baseGauteng ukuba basebenzisane nabahloli bezokhenketho ukuze baphucule ukhuseleko lwabakhenkethi baze baqinisekise nokuba eli candelo liyaqhubeleka nokwenza umahluko wezoqoqosho kangangoko.

src: Kilonova ke ketsahalo ya dinaledi e etsahalang mokgweng wa maemo a mabedi ha dinaledi tse pedi tsa nyotrone kapa naledi ya nyotrone le lesoba le letsho di kopana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazibulela futhi iziqhwabela izandla iingcali zezenzululwazi ngeenkwenkwezi ezithathe inxaxheba kuphando obelusenziwa ngezibonakude (iitheleskophu) zeZiko loMzantsi Afrika lezobuNzululwazi ngeeNkwenkwezi (i-SAAO) kunye nesiBonakude esiKhulu se-Afrika eseMazantsi (i-SALT).

src: Tshibollo ena e tshwaya tswalo ya sehla se setjha ho tsa astrofisiksi, e leng ketsahalo ya pele ya sepakapakeng e kileng ya lekolwa ho ka bobedi maqhubu a lefatshe le kganya.
tgt: Oku kukhokelele kuphando olukhulu lokuqala ebeliqhutywa ngamazwe ehlabathi ukuphanda ngokuba aqala aviwa phi na amaza ombizelane enzeka xa kungqubana iinkwenkwezi ezincinci ezimbini.

src: Ditheleskhoupu tsa SALT le SAAO di fanne ka datha e nngwe ya pele ho seo se bonahalang e le ketsahalo eo ho ithutwang ka yona ka ho fetisisa ya astrofisiksi.
tgt: Oku kungqubana kweenkwenkwezi kubangela uqhashumbo-dubulo kuphahlake ukhanyo olubizwa ngokuba yi-kilonova.

src: SALT le SAAO di hara dibaka tsa tekolo ya dinaledi tse fumanwang fatshe le sebakeng tse 70 tse kileng tsa lekola ho phatloha ha sebakeng ha dinaledi tse pedi tsa nyotrone, hang feela kamora maqhubu a tsona a ho thothomela ha lefatshe a ne a lemohuwa ke Laser Interferometer Gravitational-Wave Observatory ya Amerika le Virgo detector ya Yuropa.
tgt: I-kilonova luqhashumbo-dubulo olukhulu olwenzeka emajukujukwini apho iinkwenkwezi ezincinci kakhulu ezimbini zijikelezanayo okanye inkwenkwezi encinci iginywa yi-black hole.

src: Mokete wa Lefatshe wa Batjha le Baithuti.
tgt: Ukufunyanwa kolu hlobo lwamaza lutsha kubaluleke kakhulu kwinzululwazi ngeenkwenkwezi, kusisiganeko sokuqala ukwenzeka kumaza ombizelane nokhanyo.

src: Sepheo sa mokete ke ho bokella mmoho batjha ba lefatshe mabapi le mohopolo wa toka, ho matlafatsa dikamano tsa matjhaba, le ho ntshetsapele dikamano tsa merabe e kopaneng le botjhaba bo kopanetsweng.
tgt: I-SALT nezinye izibonakude ze-SAAO zinike iziphumo zokuqala ngesi siganeko kungoku nje ekungathi sisesona sihlalutywa nesiphandwa kakhulu ezimbalini ngenzululwazi ngeenkwenkwezi.

src: Kabinete e hlahisitse matshwenyeho a yona ho latela ditlaleho tse nyarosang tsa ditlolo tsa molao kgahlanong le bana, tsa moraorao ka ho fetisisa e leng moo ho belaellwang tlhekefetso ka motabo ya baithuti ba fetang 80 ba Sekolo sa Poraemari sa AB Xuma Orlando, ho la Soweto ke molebedi wa sekolo.
tgt: I-SALT kunye ne-SAAO ziphakathi kwamaziko anezibonakude ezisemhlabeni nezisemajukujukwini eziye zabona olu qhushumbo-dubulo lokungqubana kweenkwenkwezi ezincinci ezimbini, okwenzeke nje emva kokuba amaza ombizelane azo ethe aviwa yi-Laser Interferometer Gravitational-Wave Observatory ese-United States kunye ne-Virgo ese-Europe.

src: Lefapha la porofense le thoholetswa bakeng sa karabelo e potlakileng ka ho tlosa hanghang, bolaodi bo ka sehloohong ba sekolo seo, ho tlisa basebeletsi ba setjhaba le ho etsa dipatlisiso ka tshebediso ya lekala le ikemetseng.
tgt: UMnyhadala weHlabathi woLutsha nabaFundi.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho badudi bohle ka hara Aforika Borwa ho sebetsa mmoho bakeng sa ho sireletsa bana bohle kgahlanong le sebopeho sefe kapa sefe sa kotsi kapa tlhekefetso, le ho sebetsa le sepolesa bakeng sa ho etsa hore metse ya rona e bolokehe.
tgt: Ilizwe laseRussia liza kusingatha uMnyhadala wama-2017 weHlabathi woLutsha nabaFundi ukusuka ngomhla we-14 ukuya kowama-22 kweyeDwarha, oza kuzinyaswa ngabantu abatsha abangaphezulu kwama-20 000 abaphuma kumazwe ali-150.

src: Kabinete e na le tshepo ya hore ditlhatlhobo tsa mafelo a selemo tsa dikolo di tla tswela pele ntle le tshitiso ho latela boipilaetso ba bongata bo neng bo eteletswe pele ke Mokgatlo wa Basebetsi wa Matitjhere wa Aforika Borwa (SADTU).
tgt: Injongo yalo mnyhadala kukudibanisa abantu abatsha abaphuma mbombo zone zeli limiweyo apho baza kugwadla imiba yezobulungisa, ukuqinisa ubudlelwana phakathi kwamazwe ehlabathi, ukwakhiwa kobudlelwano phakathi kweentlobo zenkcubeko kunye neentlanga ezahlukeneyo.

src: SADTU e fanne ka memorandamo ho Letona la Thuto ya Motheo, Mofumahadi Angie Motshekga, ya itlammeng ho rarolla dintlha tsa ngongoreho kapele kamoo ho ka kgonehang.
