src: Kabinete e Kopane ka Laboraro, la 15 Pudungwana 2017 Tuynhuys, Motse Kapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibihlangene ngoLwesithathu, umhla we-15 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2017 eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Dintlha tsa Hajwale.
tgt: Imibandela Engundaba-mlonyeni.

src: Matsete.
tgt: Utyalomali.

src: Kabinete e amohela matsete a Khamphani ya Makoloi ya Ford a R3 bilione ka hara Polante ya Silverton, Pretoria, Gauteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalwamkela utyalomali olwenziwe yiFord Motor Company oluyimali ezibhiliyoni ezintathu zeerandi kuMzi-mveliso wakwaFord oseSilverton, ePitoli, eGauteng.

src: Matsete ana a tla baka hore ho boptjwe mesebetsi e otlolohileng le e meng ya tlatsetso ka lebaka la keketseho e lebeletsweng ya tlhahiso ya motlolo wa yona wa Ford Ranger.
tgt: Olu tyalomali luza kudala amathuba emisebenzi kulo mzi-mveliso ngqo nakumanye amashishini asebenzisana nawo ngenxa yemveliso ekulindeleke ukuba inyuke yohlobo lwemoto yakwaFord, oluyi-Ford Ranger.

src: Matsete ana a tiisetsa mosebetsi oo re tswelang pele ho o etsa jwaloka mmuso mabapi le ho hodisa moruo le ho sebetsana le diphephetso tsa tlhokeho ya mosebetsi.
tgt: La maphulo otyalomali abubungqina bomsebenzi esisoloko siwuqhuba njengorhulumente wokukhulisa uqoqosho nowokulwa imingeni yentswela-ngqesho.

src: Ka sekema sa mmuso sa ditsiane tsa R.8 bilione ka hara Tlhahiso ya Makoloi le Lenaneo la Ntshetsopele, ho buletswe matsete a poraefete a R.5 bilione.
tgt: Ngenxa yesibonelelo-mali sikarhulumente esizibhiliyoni zeerandi eziyi-7.8 esiya kwiNkqubo yokuVelisa noKwakha iziThuthi, iinkampani zabucala ziye nazo zatyala imali ezibhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama-.

src: Tsena di kenyeletsa tsebiso ya Toyota ya ho etsa dimotlolo tsa yona tse ntjha tsa Toyota Hilux le Fortuner e le karolo ya matsete a etsang R.1 bilione.
tgt: Olu tyalomali luquka isibhengezo sakwaToyota sokwenza iintlobo zabo ezintsha ze-Toyota Hilux ne-Fortuner njengenxenye yotyalomali oluzibhiliyoni zeerandi eziyi-.

src: Hape, BMW e rera ho aha lebenkele la maemo a hodimo a etsang R6 billone a ditopo tsa makoloi.
tgt: Kwakhona, u-BMW unesicwangciso sokwakha umzi-mveliso wala maxesha wokuvelisa iimoto oxabisa imali ezibhiliyoni ezintandathu zeerandi.

src: Koporasi ya Matjhaba ya Makoloi ya Beijing e rera ho tsetela R11 bilione polanteng ya tlhahiso ya makoloi ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: I-Beijing Automobile International Corporation iceba ukutyala imali ezibhiliyoni zerandi ezili-11 kumzi-mveliso wokwenziwa kwezithuthi eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Sehla sa Lekgetho sa 2017.
tgt: Ixesha leRhafu ngowama-2017.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa diteboho ho balefi bohle ba lekgetho ba seng ba kentse ditokomane tsa bona tsa lekgetho bakeng sa selemo sa lekgetho sa 2016/17.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibabulela kakhulu bonke abahlawuli berhafu asebezingenisile iifomu zabo zerhafu zonyaka werhafu wama-2016/2017.

src: Kuno e fehlilweng ke lekgetho la lekeno e netefatsa hore mmuso o na le bokgoni ba ho fana ka ditshebeletso tse batlehang haholo le tshehetso ya kahisano ho dimilione tse hlokang menyetla tsa maAforika Borwa.
tgt: Ingeniso efunyenwe kwirhafu ebalwa ngokwengeniso yomrhafi iqinisekisa ukuba urhulumente uyakwazi ukunikela ngeenkonzo ezidingeka kakhulu kunye nezibonelelo zentlalo ezinikwa izigidi zabantu baseMzantsi Afrika abasweleyo.

src: Kabinete e hopotsa balefi ba lekgetho hore letsatsi la ho qetela la ho kenya ditokomane tsa lekgetho ke Labohlano la 24 Pudungwana 2017 le ho ba kgothaletsa ho kenya ditokomane tsa bona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhumbuza abahlawuli berhafu ukuba usuku lokugqibela lokufaka iifomu zerhafu zabo lungoLwesihlanu, umhla wama-24 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2017 kwaye bayakhuthazwa ukuba bazingenise iifomu zabo zerhafu.

src: Pitso ya Naha ya ho Thakgolwa ha Ntshetsopele ya Moruo wa Lehae (LED).
tgt: INkomfa kaZwelonke yokuQala yoPhuhliso loQoqosho lweeNgingqi (i-LED).

src: Kabinete e thabile mabapi le diphetho tsa Pitso ya Naha ya LED e neng e tshwerwe haufinyana tjena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikholiwe ziziphumo zeNkomfa ye-LED kaZwelonke ebibanjwe kutshanje.

src: E ne e tshwerwe tlasa boetapele ba Letona la Puso e Kopanetsweng le Merero ya Botjhaba, Monghadi Des van Rooyen le Letona la Ntshetsopele ya Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane, Mofumahadi Lindiwe Zulu.
tgt: Le Nkomfa ibikhokelwe nguMphathiswa woLawulo lweNtsebenziswano neMicimbi yeMveli, uMnu Des van Rooyen kunye noMphathiswa woPhuhliso lwaMashishini amaNcinci, uNksz Lindiwe Zulu.

src: E hlahisitse monyetla wa ho rala lenaneo le letjha la LED ya Aforika Borwa le tataiswang ke dintlha tse ka sehlohlolong tsa Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP).
tgt: Inike ithuba lokuqingqa ngobugcisa i-ajenda entsha yaseMzantsi Afrika yoPhuhliso loQoqosho lweeNgingqi ngokukhokelwa yimicimbi ephambili kwisiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP).

src: Diphetho tsa yona di kenyeleditse ho thakgolwa ha Lekgotla la Ntshetsopele ya Moruo la Aforika Borwa (EDCSA) la pele, le rerileng ho etsa hore lekala la ntshetsopele ya moruo e be la seporofeshenale.
tgt: Iziphumo zayo ziquke ukusekwa kweBhunga laseMzantsi Afrika loPhuhliso loQoqosho (i-EDCSA) lokuqala, elineenjongo zokwenza icandelo lophuhliso loqoqosho libe lelobungcali.

src: Jwaloka setheo sa seporofeshenale, EDCSA e tla tsamaisa le ho beha leihlo boitshwaro ba seporofeshenale ba bankakarolo ba bangata ba teng maikitlaetsong a fapaneng a ntshetsopele.
tgt: Njengequmrhu lobungcali, i-EDCSA iya kulawula iphinde ibeke iliso kwindlela yokuziphatha emsebenzini kweengcali ezininzi ezinenxaxheba kumaphulo ahluka-hlukileyo ophuhliso.

src: Kabinete hape e ananetse ho thakgolwa ho etsang nalane ha Beke ya Lefatshe ya Boetapele ba Dikgwebo (GEW) nomorong ya 22 ho la Sloane, e leng khempase e ntjha ya qalo, ka la 10 Pudungwana 2017, moo Letona Zulu a neng a amohetse kwakwariri ya lefatshe ya baetapele ba dikgwebo, Monghadi Richard Branson.
tgt: Kwakhona iKhabhinethi iphawule ngokuphehlelelwa okuyimbali kweVeki yeHlabathi yoShishino lwabasaQalayo (i-GEW) e-22 on Sloane, iziko losungulo lwamashishini, ngomhla we-10 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2017, apho uMphathiswa uZulu ebesingethe ingqanga yehlabathi kwezosungulo lwamashishini, uMnumzana Richard Branson.

src: Khempase ena ke ya pele ya ho bulwa ke Marangrang a Boetapele ba Dikgwebo ba Lefatshe.
tgt: Eli ziko lelokuqala ukuvulwa liQumrhu leHlabathi loSungulo lwaMashishini.

src: E fana ka ditshebeletso tsa tshehetso ka kotloloho le ka inthanete ho phatlalla le Aforika hammoho le phumantsho ya matjhaba ya marangrang a batataisi, batsetedi le mekgatlo ya tshehetso ya baetapele ba dikgwebo.
tgt: Linikela ngoncedo ngqo koosomashishini abasaqalayo nangoncedo olunikezelwa nge-intanethi kuyo yonke i-Afrika ngokunjalo nendlela yokufikelela kubacebisi ehlabathini, kubatyali-mali nakwimibutho yenkxaso yabasunguli bamashishini.

src: Nakong ya GEW, batho ba ka etsang 10 milione ba nka karolo diketsahalong tse 35 000, mesebetsing le ditlhodisanong dinaheng tse fetang 165 ho phatlalla le lefatshe.
tgt: Ngethuba le-GEW, zizigidi ezimalunga nezili-10 abathathi-nxaxheba abathathe inxaxheba kwimisitho, iindibano kunye nemidlalwano yokhuphiswano engama-35 000, kumazwe angaphezu kwali-165 ehlabathini jikelele.

src: Tlaleho ya Khomishene ya Heher.
tgt: INgxelo yeKomishoni kaHeher.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho lokollwa ka Mantaha, 13 Pudungwana 2017 ha Tlaleho ya Khomishene ya Dipatlisiso mabapi le Kgonahalo ya ho etsa hore Thuto e Phahameng le Thupello e be mahala ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphawule ngokukhutshwa ngoMvulo, umhla we-13 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2017 kweNgxelo yeKomishoni yoPhando Malunga Nokubaba iMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho Ingasimahla Na eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho hlahloba tlaleho ena le ditlamorao tsa yona bakeng sa naha ha dikgothaletso tsa teng di ntse di sekwasekwa ke mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ekubeni bayifunde nzulu le ngxelo nokuqukwa yiyo malunga nelizwe ngelixa iingcebiso zisaqwalaselwa ngurhulumente.

src: Moporesidente o tla etsa tsebiso ka tlaleho ena ha nako e ntse e tsamaya kamora ho sekwasekwa ke Komiti e Kopanetsweng ya Matona ya Matlole a Ditjhelete tsa Thuto e Phahameng le Komiti ya Ditjhelete ya Boporesidente.
tgt: UMongameli uya kwenza isaziso ngexesha elifanelekileyo emva kokuba igqithe kwiKomiti yabaPhathiswa Abahlukeneyo malunga neNkxasomali yeMfundo ePhakamileyo kunye neKomiti yeNgxowamali ye-Ofisi kaMongameli.

src: Mmuso o dula o ikemiseditse ho rarolla ditshita tsa phumantsho ya thuto e phahameng, mme e shebetse pele ho phethela tharollo ya moshwelella bakeng sa thuso ya ditjhelete tsa thuto e phahameng.
tgt: URhulumente usazimisele ukususa imiqobo ebangela ukuba imfundo ephakamileyo ingafikeleleki, kwaye izimisele ukufumana isisombululo esiza kuhlala ixesha elide malunga nenkxasomali yemfundo ephakamileyo.

src: Komello.
tgt: Imbalela.

src: Maemo a hajwale a matamo ka hara naha e dula e le matshwenyeho kaha ho na le moyafalo e ngata ho feta pula.
tgt: Umthamo wamanzi emadamini elizwe uyaxhalabisa kuba amanzi ala madama atsha ngaphezu kokuba efumana imvula.

src: Taba ya hore Aforika Borwa ha e so fumane pula e lekaneng ho tsosolosa mehlodi ya rona ya metsi ho fihlella maemong a nepahetseng ho bolela hore naha hae e so tswe ka hara boemo ba komello.
tgt: Into yokuba uMzantsi Afrika awukafumani mvula yaneleyo enokugcwalisa amadama ethu amanzi abe nomthamo owaneleyo ithetha ukuba ilizwe alikaphumi kwimeko yembalela.

src: Bolepi bo bonela pele hore naha e tla fumana feela pula e ngata ho tloha maqalong a Pherekgong 2018.
tgt: Iingxelo zoqikelelo lwemozulu zithi ilizwe liza kuzifumana iimvula ezinkulu kuphela ekuqaleni kweyoMqungu ngowama-2018.

src: Kabinete e lakatsa ho netefaletsa setjhaba hore mmuso wa naha, mebuso ya diporofense le ya lehae e a thusana le ho sebetsa mmoho ho netefatsa hore Aforika Borwa ha e fellwe ke metsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ifuna ukuqinisekisa uluntu ukuba urhulumente kazwelonke, owamaphondo nowemimandla (oomasipala) babambisene kwaye bayasebenzisana ukuqinisekisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika awuphelelwa ngamanzi.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa mang le mang ho bapala karolo ya hae mabapi le ho baballa le ho sebedisa metsi ka bohlale le ka hloko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza wonke umntu ukuba enze indima yakhe ekulondolozeni nasekusebenziseni amanzi ngononophelo nangokuwonga.

src: Zimbabwe.
tgt: IZimbabwe.

src: Kabinete e tshehetsa boitshunyako ba Moporesidente Jacob Zuma, boemong ba hae jwaloka Modulasetulo wa Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tse ka Borwa ba Aforika (SADC) ho arabela maemong a Zimbabwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaluxhasa ungenelelo olwenziwe nguMongameli Jacob Zuma, ngokwesikhundla sakhe njengoSihlalo woMbutho woPhuhliso laMazwe eAfrika eseMzantsi (i-SADC) ukusabela kwimeko yaseZimbabwe.

src: O rometse Baemedi ba Ikgethang, Letona la Tshireletso le Mekaubere ya Ntwa, Mofumahadi Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula le Letona la Tshireletso ya Puso, Moatefokate Bongani Bongo.
tgt: Uthumele abaThunywa boMbuso abaBodwa, uMphathiswa wezoKhuselo namaGqala eMfazwe, uNksz Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula kunye noMphathiswa woKhuseleko lweLizwe, u-Adv Bongani Bongo.

src: Ba tla kopana le Moporesidente Robert Mugabe le Sesole sa Tshireletso sa Zimbabwe.
tgt: Bafanele ukudibana noMongameli Robert Mugabe noMkhosi woKhuselo waseZimbabwe.

src: Kamora moo, ba tla tsebisa Moporesidente wa Angola João Lourenço boemong ba hae jwaloka Modulasetulo wa Lekala la Dipolotiki, Tshireletso le Polokeho la SADKantoro ya Moporesidente e tla fana ka tse ntseng di etsahala mabapi le taba ena.
tgt: Emva koko, baza kunika ingxelo emfutshane kuMongameli wase-Angola uJoão Lourenço ngokwesikhundla sakhe njengoSihlalo weCandelo le-SADC lezoPolitiko, ezoKhuseleko nezoKhuselo.

src: Sekwere Kilomithara sa Array (SKA).
tgt: IsiBonakude esiyiKhilomitha Ubude Nobubanzi (i-SKA).

src: Kabinete e amohela diphihlello tsa ntshetsopele ya moruo le kahisano lebatoweng la SKA ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawamkela amaphulo ophuhliso loqoqosho nezentlalo enzeke ngenxa yotyalomali olujolise kuphuhliso lwentlalo kummandla we-SKA eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Badudi ba dulang haufi le sebaka sa SKA ba tswela pele ho kgola molemo ka diporojeke tsa thuto le thupello e betere, matsete dikgwebong tse nyenyane le menyetla ya mesebetsi e eketsehileng.
tgt: Iindawo ezimelene nommandla weSKA ziyaqhuba ngokuxhamla ngemfundo ephucukileyo neeprojekthi zoqeqesho, utyalomali kumashishini amancinane namathuba engqesho andileyo.

src: Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji, tlasa boetapele ba Letona la Saense le Thekenoloji, Mofumahadi Naledi Pandor, o tla tshwara lenaneo la bonkakarolo ba setjhaba ho keteka diphihlello le badudi ba dibaka tse bapileng le Carnarvon, ho la Kapa Leboya ho tloha ka la 16 ho isa ka la 19 Pudungwana 2017.Diqeto tsa Kabinete.
tgt: ISebe lezeNzululwazi nobuChwepheshe, eliphantsi koMphathiswa wezeNzululwazi nobuChwepheshe, uNksz Naledi Pandor, liza kubamba iindibano zokufakana imilomo noluntu ukuze kubhiyozelwe imisebenzi ebeyimpumelelo nabantu bemimandla melene neCarnarvon, eMntla Koloni ukususela ngomhla we-16 ukuya kowe-19 kweyeNkanga wama-2017.IziGqibo zeKhabhinethi.

src: Ditlaleho tsa Bobedi tsa Kgatelopele ya tshebetso ya kotara ka nngwe bakeng sa 2017/1.
tgt: Iingxelo zenkqubela zekota yesibini zomgangatho wokusebenza zowama-2017/1.

src: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka Ditlaleho tsa Bobedi tsa Kgatelopele ya kotara ka nngwe bakeng sa 2017/18 (Phupu ho isa ka Loetse 2017) ke dikarolo kaofela tse hlano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yaziswe ngokusesikweni ngeengxelo zenkqubela zekota yesibini zomgangatho wokusebenza zowama-2017/18 (ukususela kweyeKhala ukuya kweyoMsintsi ngowama-2017) zizo zonke zontlanu iintlanganisela.

src: Sena se bopa karolo ya lenaneo le pharaletseng la Kabinete la bodisa le tekolo ya Lenaneo la Tshebetso le itshetlehileng hodima Moralo wa Lewa la Nako e Bohareng (MTSF) la selemo sa 2014 ho isa ho sa 2019.
tgt: Oku yinxalenye yomsebenzi obanzi owenziwa yiKhabhinethi wokuhlola nokuvavanya iNkqubo yokuSebenza esuka kwisiCwangciso-sikhokelo esiQiqisisiweyo sesiGaba esiPhakathi (i-MTSF) sowama-2014 ukuya kowama-2019.

src: Lefapha la Merero, Bodisa le Tekolo ya Tshebetso le dikomiti tsa Karolo ya Matona di tla bitsa dikopano tsa boraditaba ho pahlolla kgatelopele ya ditlaleho tsena.
tgt: ISebe lezokuCwangcisa, ukuHlola nokuVavanya kunye neekomiti yeeNtlanganisela zabaPhathiswa liza kubamba iintlanganiso noondaba ukuze kuhlalutywe ezi ngxelo zenkqubela.

src: GCIS e tla hokahanya dikopano tsa boraditaba le ho phatlalatsa lenaneo la tsona ho WEBTOKEN ha nako e ntse e tsamaya.
tgt: IZiko lezoNxibelelwano nokuSasazwa koLwazi lukaRhulument (i-GCIS) liza kuququzelela ezi ntlanganiso noonondaba lize lipapashe uluhlu lwamaxesha neendawo eziza kubanjelwa kuzo WEBTOKEN ngexesha elifanelekileyo.

src: Ho behwa sehlohlolong mabapi le maikitlaetso a ho kgwahlapisa diaterese le phano ya diaterese.
tgt: Ingxelo entsha ngephulo lokukhangela nokunika iidilesi.

src: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka tlaleho ya kgatelopele mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Kahlolo ya Lekgotla la Molaotheo ya ho fana ka diaterese lenaneong la bakgethi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yaziswe ngokufutshane ngomgama osele uhanjiwe malunga nokuqaliswa kwemigqaliselo eyayiphakanyiswe sisiGwebo seNkundla yoMgaqo-siseko sokuba kufakwe iidilesi kumqulu wabavoti.

src: Kabinete e ananetse boimatahanyo ka botlalo le ditlaleho tsa kgatelopele ya dikgwedi kang tse tsheletseng tse iswang Lekgotleng la Molaotheo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphakamise ukuthotyelwa ngokupheleleyo kweengxelo zenkqubela ezinikelwa kwiNkundla yoMgaqo-siseko qho emva kweenyanga ezintandathu.

src: Ho fihlela lena Khomishene e Ikemetseng ya Dikgetho (IEC), ka ho sebedisana le makala a mang a puso, e fihlelletse katleho ya se ka fihlang ho 75% mabapi le ho bokella diaterese tsa batho ba ka nnang ba kenela dikgetho.
tgt: Kude kube ngoku iKomishoni yoNyulo eziMeleyo (i-IEC), ngokusebenzisana nezinye ii-arhente zombuso, sele iqokelele iidilesi zabavoti ezieziphantse zibe ngama-75%.

src: Kabinete e tsebisitswe hape ka lenaneo le rerilweng ke Kantoro ya Poso ya Aforika Borwa (SAPO) ho thusa ba hlokang diaterese tsa bodulo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde yanikwa ingxelo emfutshane ngenkqubo ecetywa yi-SAPO yokunceda abo bangenazo iidilesi zeendawo abahlala kuzo.

src: Kabinete e thabisitswe ke kgatelopele le ketso ya tshebedisano e entsweng ke SAPO, IEC le makala a mang a puso mosebetsing wa porojeke ya diaterese.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikholiwe yinkqubela nangumsebenzi wobambiswano oqhutywa yi-SAPO, yi-IEC nezinye ii-arhente zombuso ezenza umsebenzi kwiprojekthi yeedilesi.

src: Kabinete e boela e ipiletsa ho ba so kang ba lokisa diaterese tsa bona ho etsa jwalo nakong ya beke ya boingodiso bo tlang ba bakgethi ka Hlakubele 2018.Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinda icela abo bangekazihlaziyi iidilesi zabo ukuba benze njalo kwiveki yobhaliso lwabavoti elandelayo kweyoKwindla wama-2018.Imisitho Ezayo.

src: Tulo ya bone ya Khomishene ya Dinaha tse pedi (BNC) ya Aforika Borwa-Botswana.
tgt: Iseshoni yesine yeKomishoni yaMazwe Amabini, uMzantsi Afrika neBotswana (i-BNC).

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla nka leeto la tshebetso bakeng sa ho nka karolo le ho ba modulasetulo mmoho ho Tulo ya Bone ya BNC ya Aforika Borwa-Botswana e tla tshwarelwa Gaborone, ho la Botswana ka Labohlano, 17 Pudungwana 2017.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uza kutyelela ngomsebenzi ukuze abe nenxaxheba kwaye abe ngomnye woosihlalo beSeshoni yesiNe ye-BNC yoMzantsi Afrika neBotswana eza kubanjelwa eGaborone, eBotswana ngoLwesihlanu, umhla we-17 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2017.

src: Aforika Borwa le Botswana di kopana selemo ka seng boemong ba Dihlooho tsa Dipuso ka hara moralo wa BNC ho sheba botjha tshebedisano ya bobedi bona le ho tshohla dintlha tse amang dinaha ka bobedi.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika neBotswana zihlangana ngonyaka ngamnye kwinqanaba leeNtloko zeMibuso ngokwesikhokelo-nkqubo se-BNC sokuphengulula ubambiswano lwamacala amabini nokuxoxa ngemibandela ebalulekileyo kula mazwe omabini.

src: Dinaha ka bobedi di na le dikamano tse kgahlisang tsa kutlwano tse bontshwang ke maqhama a botjhaba le bohaufi ba dinaha tsena.
tgt: La mazwe mabini anobudlelwane bobuhlobo obulawulwa likhonkco leenkcubeko kunye nobumelwane.

src: Di sebedisana mabakeng a mangata a kenyeletsang, dipalangwang, kgwebisano le matsete, bophelo bo botle, mabaka a tikoloho, jwalojwalo.
tgt: Abambisana kwimibandela eliqela kuquka, uthutho, urhwebo notyalomali kunye nemibandela yezokusingqongileyo, njalo njalo.

src: Aforika Borwa ke e nngwe ya balekane ba baholo ba kgwebisano le Botswana, ka dikhamphani tse batlang di ba ngata tsa Aforika Borwa tse sebetsang ka hara naha eo.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika ngomnye wamazwe aphambili iBotswana erhweba nawo, kwaye iinkampani ezininzi zaseMzantsi Afrika zishishina kweliya lizwe.

src: Leeto la Moporesidente wa Puso ya Angola.
tgt: Utyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni nguMongameli wase-Angola.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla amohela Motlotlehi, Moporesidente wa Riphabliki ya Angola, João Lourenço, bakeng sa Leeto la Puso le etsang nalane ka hara Aforika Borwa ho tloha ka la 23 Pudungwana 2017.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uza kwamkela oHloniphekileyo, uMongameli weRiphablikhi yase-Angola, uJoão Lourenço, kuTyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni oluyimbali oluza kwilizwe lethu ukususela ngomhla wama-23 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2017.

src: Sena e tla be e le Leeto la hae la Puso la pele ka hara naha ya rona kamora hoba a hlomamiswe.
tgt: Olu luza kuba luTyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni lwakhe lokuqala kwilizwe lethu oko wabekwa esikhundleni.

src: Dinaha ka bobedi di na le maqhama a nalane le a bomphato a ballwang dilemong tse fetileng tsa ntwa ya tokoloho ha Angola e ne e bolokile le ho tshehetsa balwanedi ba tokoloho ba Aforika Borwa dikampong tse fapafapaneng ka hara naha eo.
tgt: La mazwe mabini anobudlelwano ngokuba emelene futhi obaqala kudala ngexesha lomzabalazo wenkululeko xa i-Angola yayilikhaya futhi ixhasa amatshantliziyo ayesilwela inkululeko yaseMzantsi Afrika kwiikampi ezahlukeneyo kweliya lizwe.

src: Kgwebisano le tshebedisano ho tsa moruo pakeng tsa dinaha ka bobedi e ho hotse haholo, ho fihlella moo Aforika Borwa e leng molekane wa mantlha wa Angola ka hara kontinente.
tgt: Ubambiswano kurhwebo nakuqoqosho phakathi kwala mazwe mabini lukhule kakhulu, kangangokuba uMzantsi Afrika ulelona lizwe liphambili elirhwebelana ne-Angola kweli lizwekazi.

src: Dikhamphani tse ngata tsa Aforika Borwa di tsamaisa kgwebo ka hara Angola makaleng a fapafapaneng a kenyeletsang, a kaho, merafo, matlo, mabenkele, dijo le dino, dihotele le boikgathollo, dibanka le ditshebeletso tsa bongaka.
tgt: Iinkampani ezininzi zaseMzantsi Afrika ziqhuba ushishino e-Angola kumacandelo ngamacandelo kuquka elezokwakha, elezemigodi, elobonelelo lwezindlu, elezevenkile ezinkulu, elezokutya neziselo, iihotele nolonwabo, iinkonzo zokubhanka nezonyango.

src: Nakong ya leeto la hae, Moporesidente Lourenço hape o tla tshwara Kopano ya Thuto ka Labohlano, la 24 Pudungwana 2017 moahong wa OR Tambo ho la Pretoria.
tgt: Ngelixa lolu tyelelo, uMongameli uLourenço uza kwenza intetho yesiFundo ngoLwesihlanu, umhla wama-24 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2017 kwiSakhiwo iOR Tambo ePitoli.

src: Matsatsi a16 a Thibelo ya Diketso tsa Dikgoka.
tgt: Iintsuku ezili-16 zobuTshantliziyo.

src: Kabinete e imatahanya le maAforika Borwa kaofela a emang kgahlanong le Diketso tsa dikgoka ho basadi le tlhekefetso ya bana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabaxhasa bonke abantu baseMzantsi Afrika ababonakalisa ukuchasa ukuxhatshazwa kwamabhinqa nabantwana.

src: Matsatsi a 16 a letsholo la Thibelo ya Diketso tsa Dikgoka kgahlanong le Basadi le Bana le tla etsahala pakeng tsa la 25 Pudungwana le la 10 Tshitwe 2017.
tgt: Iphulo leentsuku ezili-16 zobuTshantliziyo zokuLwa uBundlobongela oBenziwa kooMama nasebaNtwaneni liqhutywa phakathi komhla wama-25 kweyeNkanga nowe-10 kweyoMnga wama-2017.

src: Sena ke selemo sa bo-19 sa letsholo lena ka hara Aforika Borwa mme le tla tswela pele tlasa mookotaba: “Mpalleng le Nna: Mmoho re Ntshetsapele Aforika Borwa e Hlokang Dikgoka”.
tgt: Lo ngunyaka we-19 weli phulo eMzantsi Afrika kwaye liza kuqhutywa phantsi komxholo othi: “Ndibale Njengomnye Nam: Sisonke Siwuqhubela uMzantsi Afrika ongenaBundlobongela Phambili”.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tla thakgola letsholo la Matsatsi a 16 a Thibelo ya Dikgoka ho la Kapa Botjhabela ka Moqebelo, wa la 25 Pudungwana 2017.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uza kuphehlelela iphulo leentsuku ezili-16 zobuTshantliziyo eMpuma Koloni ngoMgqibelo, umhla wama-25 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2017.

src: Le tla tsepamisa maikutlo hodima phano e tswellang ya Dipuisano tsa Naha, tse kgothaletsang batho ho bua ka kgoba ya dikgoka tse itshetlehileng hodima bong.
tgt: Eli phulo liza kugxininisa ekuqhutyweni kweeNgxoxo zeSizwe, ezikhuthaza abantu ukuba bathethe ngomkhuba wobundlobongela obusekelwe kwisini.

src: Sena se tla etellwa pele ke Letsatsi la Matjhaba la Banna ka Sontaha, sa la 19 Pudungwana 2017, le ipiletsang ho banna ho bapala karolo ya bona mabapi le ho aha setjhaba se bolokehileng le sa kahisano e momahaneng.
tgt: Oku kuza kukhokelwa luSuku lweHlabathi lwaMadoda ngeCawa, ngomhla we-19 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2017, olumema amadoda ekubeni enze indima yawo ekwakhiweni kwesizwe esikhuselekileyo nesimanyeneyo ngokwentlalo.

src: Lefapha la Toka le Ntshetsopele ya Molaotheo le tla hlophisa letsholo la bobedi la diradio tsa badudi tlasa letoto la tsona la Let’s Talk Justice, le tlisang ditshebeletso tsa mmuso bathong ka ho neha bamamedi monyetla wa ho buisana le bahlanka ba mmuso ka ditaba tse ka sehloohong.
tgt: ISebe lezobuLungisa noPhuhliso loMgaqo-siseko liza kuqhuba iphulo lesibini likanomathotholo woluntu phantsi kwinkqubo yalo ethi: Let’s Talk Justice, ezisa iinkonzo zikarhulumente ebantwini ngokunika ithuba kubaphulaphuli lokubamba iingxoxo namagosa aseburhulumenteni ngemibandela esematheni.

src: Ho thakgolwa ha Lekgotla la Dinyewe la Ditlolo tsa Molao tsa Motabo nakong ya letsholo hape ho tla netefatsa phumantsho e betere ya tsamaiso ya toka.
tgt: Ukuvulwa ngokusesikweni kweNkundla yoLwaphulo-mthetho lwezeSondo ngethuba leli phulo nako kuza kuqinisekisa ukuba bonke abantu bayazixhamla iinkonzo zezobulungisa.

src: Kabinete e na le tshepo ya hore ka ho sebetsa mmoho re ka qeta motsamao wa tlhekefetso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqinisekile ukuba ngobambiswano sinakho ukuwuphelisa umkhuba woxhatshazo.

src: Ka mekutu ya rona e kopanetsweng re ka sebetsa ho thibela tlhekefetso ha ka nqa e nngwe re netefatsa setjhaba se bolokehileng bakeng sa basadi le bana.
tgt: Xa sinokusebenzisana singakuthintela ukuxhatshazwa ngelixa siqinisekisa ukuba kukho isizwe esikhuselekileyo kumabhinqa nasebantwaneni.

src: Batho bohle ba Aforika Borwa ba kgothaletswa ho apara ribone tse tshweu e le letshwao la boitlamo bakeng sa ho fedisa kgoba ena ka hara setjhaba.
tgt: Bonke abantu eMzantsi Afrika bayacelwa ukuba banxibe iribhoni okanye isipeliti esimhlophe esiluphawu lokuxhasa idabi lokulwa lo mkhuba kwisizwe sethu.

src: Boitokisetso ba Letsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDKabinete e ipiletsa setjhabeng kaofela ho nka karolo ho qaleng ha mesebetsi ya Labohlano la Ribone e Kgubedu pele ho Letsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDS ka la 1 Tshitwe le ho fihla mafelong a kgwedi eo.
tgt: Amalungiselelo oSuku lweHlabathi lweSifo sikaGawulayo (i-AIDS).

src: Ho apara diribone tse kgubedu ke letshwao la bonngwe le boitlamo mabapi le ntwa kgahlanong le HIV le AIDLetsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDS ke monyetla bakeng sa motse ka mong ho ikopanya ntweng e kgahlanong le HIV, ho bontsha tshehetso bakeng sa batho ba phelang ka HIV le ho hopola ba hlokahetseng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema wonke umntu ukuba athathe inxaxheba kwimisitho engamaqalela eRed Ribbon Friday eyandulela uSuku lweHlabathi lweSifo sikaGawulayo ngomhla woku-1 kweyoMnga kude kube sekupheleni kwale nyanga.

src: Ketsahalo ya selemong sena e tla tshwarwa tlasa mookotaba: “Tokelo ya ka ya ho Tseba Maemo a Ka, Thibelo ke Boikarabelo ba ka”, e hokahanang le mookotaba wa lefatshe: “Tokelo ya Bophelo bo Botle”.
tgt: Ukunxiba iribhoni ebomvu ngumqondiso wokuzimanya nokuzinikela ekulweni iNtsholongwane kaGawulayo (i-HIV) ne-AIDUSuku lweHlabathi lwe-AIDS lithuba lokuba wonke umntu azibandakanye kwidabi lokulwa i-HIV, ukubonisa inkxaso ebantwini abane-HIV nokukhumbula abo balishiyileyo eli limagad’ahlabayo.

src: Sena se matlafatsa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Lewa la Morero wa Naha la AIDS la Aforika Borwa, Lefuba le mahloko a Tshwaetsanang ka Motabo 2017 - 2022 (NSP), e leng tshiya ya bohlokwa kgatelopeleng ya Aforika Borwa e lebisitseng phihlellong ya tlhokomelo ya kalafo ya lefatshe jwaloka ha e hlahella ho NDP, e kgothaletsang setjhaba se itekanetseng, se matla le se nang le tekatekano.
tgt: Isikhumbuzo salo nyaka siza kuba phantsi komxholo othi: “ILungelo loKwazi iMeko yam, uThintelo luXanduva Lwam”, nesihambelana nomxholo wehlabathi othi: “ILungelo leMpilo”.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho badudi ho kenela ho nka karolo bekeng e tlang ya Beke ya Naha ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo ya bo-7, e lebeletsweng ho tshwarwa ho tloha ka la 27 Pudungwana ho isa ka la 3 Tshitwe 2017.
tgt: Oku kuxhasa ukuphunyezwa kwesiCwangciso esiQiqisisiweyo seSizwe (i-NSP) soMzantsi Afrika se-HIV, iSifo sePhepha (i-TB) neziGulo eziSulela ngokuDibana ngeSondo sowams-2017 – 2022, esiyintsika esentloko kumalinge oMzantsi Afrika okuqinisekisa ukuba iinkonzo zezempilo zifunyanwa ngumntu wonke njengoko kugxininiswa kwi-NDP, ekhuthaza isizwe esinempilo, esomeleleyo nesinolingwano.

src: E etsahala ka hara mohopolo wa dilemo tse lekgolo tsa Oliver Reginald Tambo, ya neng a kgothaletsa tekatekano ya bong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela uluntu ukuba luthathe inxaxheba kwiVeki eseyiza kufika yesixhenxe yeSizwe yokuGxininisa kwiiMmbizo, ekulindeleke ukuba ibanjwe ukusuka kumhla wama-27 kweyeNkanga ukuya kowesi-3 kweyoMnga ngowama-2017.

src: Diketsahalo tsena di reretswe ho tshehetsa letsholo la Matsatsi a 16 a Ntwa kgahlanong le Dikgoka le Tlhekefetso ya Basadi le Bana.
tgt: Le Veki iza kukhokelwa liZiko lezoNxibelelwano nokuSasazwa koLwazi lukaRhulumente (i-GCIS), iliqonga elikhuthaza ukufakana imilomo kunye nokubonisana phakathi kwamalungu eKhabhinethi noluntu.

src: Diketsahalo di tla manehwa khalendareng ya naha le ho arolelanwa websaeteng ya mmuso (WEBTOKEN).Dibili.
tgt: Le Veki iza kubanjwa ngethuba kubhiyozelwa iminyaka elikhulu yokuzalwa kuka-Oliver Reginald Tambo, owayexhasa ukuphathwa ngokufanayo kwamadoda nabafazi.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya tsebiso ho ya ka karolo 74(5) ya Molaotheo wa Riphabliki ya Aforika Borwa wa selemo sa 1996.
tgt: Ezi ndibano ziza kubanjwa kule Veki zijoliswe ekuxhaseni iphulo lobuTshantliziyo leeNtsuku ezili-16.

src: Morero ka sena ke ho qala tsamaiso ya ditherisano tsa naha le diporofense ka merero ya ho tlisa diphethoho meeding ya diporofense mabapi le Masepala wa Lehae wa Matatiele ho la Kapa Botjhabela le dibakeng tse itseng tsa Ba Ga Mothibi ho la Leboya Bophirima.
tgt: Imisitho eza kubanjwa iza kufakwa kuluhlu lwezinto eziza kwenziwa sisizwe ize ifakwe kwiwebhusayithi karhulumente (WEBTOKEN).Imithetho eYilwayo.

src: Maikemisetso ka ho ralwa botjha ha meedi ya diporofense ho hlahisitswe ke badudi ba dibaka tse boletsweng ba batlang ho kgutlisetswa diporofenseng tse mabapi.
tgt: Injongo kukusungula inkqubo kazwelonke neyamaphondo yokucela izimvo ngeenjongo zokutshintsha imida yamaphondo kuMasipala woMmandla waseMatatiele eMpuma Koloni kunye neendawo ezithile eBa Ga Mothibi eMntla Ntshona.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa naha ya Fora jwalo ka thatohatsi e tla tshwara Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Rakbi wa selemo sa 2023 le ho leboha kemedi ya mmuso, e neng e eteletswe pele ke Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa, Letona la Dipapadi le Boithapollo Thulas Nxesi le Kopano ya Rakbi ya Aforika Borwa, bakeng sa mosebetsi wa ho kgothaletsa boiketo ba Aforika Borwa ba ho tshwara ketsahalo ena.
tgt: Injongo ekujoliswe kuyo yokusikwa ngokutsha kwemida yamaphondo isuka kuluntu lweendawo ezichaphazelekayo oluqwenela ukufuduselwa kwamanye amaphondo angabamelwane.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Letona Pandor, ya abetsweng Kgau ya Titjhere e ka Sehlohlolong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana neFrance njengelizwe elikhethelwe ukusingatha iNdebe yeHlabathi yeBhola yoMbhoxo ngowama-2023 kwaye iyababulela abathunywa bakarhulumente, ebebekhokelwe nguSekela-Mongameli uCyril Ramaphosa, uMphathiswa wezeMidlalo noLonwabo uThulas Nxesi kunye noMbutho weBhola yoMbhoxo eMzantsi Afrika (i-SARU), ngomsebenzi omhle abawenzileyo wokufaka isicelo soMzantsi Afrika sokusingatha le tumente.

src: Kgau ena e ile ya nehwa Letona Pandor ke Motjhanselara wa Yunivesithi ya Aforika Borwa, Moporesidente wa mehleng Thabo Mbeki.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana noMphathiswa Pandor, owongwe ngeBhaso loMhlohli weMfundo oBalaseleyo.

src: Kgau ya Titjhere e ka Sehlohlolong, e leng e nngwe ya mekgahlelo e mene, e ananela nyehelo ya titjhere leha e le efe e ipabotseng kapa e ntsheditseng pele ho ruta, ho ithuta, ntshetsopele ya maitsebelo le/kapa diphutso lekaleng la yona la botsebi.
tgt: Eli bhaso linikelwe kuMphathiswa Pandor yiNgqonyela yeYunivesithi yoMzantsi Afrika (i-Unisa), owayesakuba nguMongameli uThabo Mbeki.

src: Kabinete e babatsa mosebetsi o entsweng ke Seteishene sa Aforika Borwa sa Tsebo ya Dinaledi, e leng karolo ya moifo wa ditsomi tsa dipolanete wa Wide Angle Search for Planets o sibollotseng dipolanete tse tharo tse ntjha.
tgt: IBhaso loMhlohli weMfundo oBalaseleyo, elinye kwizintlu ezine, libalula igalelo lakhe nawuphi umhlohli wemfundo obalaseleyo ongumpondo zihlanjiwe okanye okhuthaze intumekelelo yokufundisa, ukufunda, uphuhliso lwezakhono zobuchule okanye nophando kwinkalo ayingcaphephe kuyo.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa bankakarolo le bahlodi ba Dikgau tsa selemo sa 2017 tsa Govan Mbeki, tse tlotlang batho ba lekala la kaho ba ipabotseng ka phano ya matlo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi incoma umsebenzi owenziwe liZiko loMzantsi Afrika leNzululwazi ngeeNkwenkwezi (i-SAAO), eliyinxalenye yeqela leWide Angle Search for Planets elizingela iiplanethi elibhaqe iiplanethi ezintathu ezintsha.

src: Kabinete e bokane bakeng sa kopano ya ho qetela ya selemo sa 2017 Union Buildings ho la Pretoria.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibihleli intlanganiso yayo yokugqibela yowama-2017 kwiZakhiwo zoMdibaniso, ePitoli.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete.
tgt: IZigqibo zeKhabhinethi.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Lewa la Naha la Lekala la Bohahlaudi (NTSS) 2016-2026 bakeng sa ho kenngwa tshebetsong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuphunyezwa kwesiCwangciso-qhinga seCandelo lezoKhenketho seSizwe (i-NTSS) sowama-2017-2026.

src: NTSS e thehilwe hodima ditshiya tse hlano tsa lewa, e leng ho le bapatsa, ho thusa ka phihlello e bobebe bakeng sa bahahlaudi, ho matlafatsa boiphihlelo ba baeti, bolaodi ba dibaka tsa ketelo le melemo e pharalletseng.
tgt: I-NTSS izinze kwiintsika ezintlanu ezibalulekileyo, ezo ke lubhengezo-thengiso, ukuqinisekisa ukuba abakhenkethi bayakwazi ukungena nokuhamba lula kweli, ukuphucula indlela abaphathwa bantendwe ngayo abakhenkethi, ulawulo lwendawo ezityelelwa ngabakhenkethi nezibonelelo ezibanzi.

src: Tokomane ka botlalo e fumaneha websaeteng ya Lefapha la Bohahlaudi: WEBTOKEKabinete e tjhaelletse monwana moralo bakeng sa ho thehwa ha Khamphani ya Naha ya Marangrang a Pharalletseng.
tgt: Ixwebhu elipheleleyo liyafumaneka kwiwebhusayithi yeSebe lezoKhenketho, eyile: WEBTOKEIKhabhinethi iyamkele inkqubo-sikhokelo yokusekwa kweNkampani yeSizwe ye-Intanethi Ekhawulezayo.

src: E tla boptjwa ka ho kopanngwa ha Sentech le Broadband Infraco.
tgt: Iza kusekwa ngendibanisela kaSentech noBroadband Infraco.

src: Sena se tla thusa ka phano ya dintlha tse ikemetseng ka kopanelo ka mokgwa o hokahaneng le ho bopa mampodi wa marangrang a pharalletseng.
tgt: Oku kuza kukhawulezisa umsebenzi wokuqaliswa kwamacandelo asebenzisanayo ngendlela engenamagingxi-gingxi kuze kudalwe inkampani enkulu engumakhwekhwetha kweze-intanethi ekhawulezayo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Tlaleho ya Kgatelopele ya Pele ya Selemo ka seng mabapi le ho Kenngwa Tshebetsong ha Tokomane ya Moralo ya Ditokelo tsa Batho ba Nang le Boqhwala (WPRPD).
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele iNgxelo yeNkqubela yokuQala yoNyaka engokuPhunyezwa koMgaqo-nkqubo ongamaLungelo waBantu abaKhubazekileyo (i-WPRPD).

src: Tlaleho e akaretsa nako ya ho tloha ka la 1 Pherekgong ho isa ka la 31 Tshitwe 2016.Tlaleho e fana ka tekolo ya boemo bo phahameng ya tsela eo mafapha a mmuso a qadileng ho theha ditshupiso tsa leano la WPRPD ka hara ditsamaiso tsa ona tsa meralo, ditekanyetso, le phano ya ditshebeletso le ho tlaleha ka tatelano.
tgt: Le ngxelo iquka ixesha elisuka kumhla woku-1 kweyoMqungu ukuya kowama-31 kweyoMnga wama-2016.Le ngxelo inika uvavanyo olukwizinga eliphezulu ngomgama osele uhanjiwe ngamasebe karhulumente ukufaka imigaqo-nkqubo ye-WPRPD kwizicwangciso zawo, uhlahlo lwabiwo-mali, nenkqubo yonikezelo-nkonzo neyokwenza ingxelo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Lewa la Moralo wa Leano la Boqhwala bakeng sa Tsamaiso ya Thuto le Thupello ya kamora Materiki bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukupapashwa kweNkqubo-sikhokelo yoMgaqo-nkqubo wabaKhubazekileyo wobuChule weNkqubo yezeMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka sephetho sa ho Shejwa botjha ha Lenaneo la ho Thusa Boraditekesi ka Ditjhelete le hlophisitsweng ho tloha ka Pudungwana 2015 ho fihla ka Loetse 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngeziphumo zokuHlaziywa kweNkqubo yokuVuselelwa kweeTeksi okwenziwe ukususela kweyeNkanga yowama-2015 ukuya kweyoMsintsi yowama-2016.

src: Lenaneo lena ke karolo ya Lewa la Dipalangwang tsa Setjhaba le Bataletseng, le reretsweng ho fana ka tsamaiso e kopanetsweng le ho ba hlwahlwa ha dipalangwang ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Le nkqubo iyinxalenye yesiCwangciso-qhinga seziThuthi zikaWonkewonke, nesijolise ekuboneleleni ngenkqubo yezothutho edibeneyo, ekhuselekileyo nesebanzayo eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ntlha ya hore ho be le dipuisano le mosebetsi o mongata le mafapha a amehang pele Lefapha la Naha la Dipalangwang le ka kenya tshebetsong katamelo e hlabollotsweng botjha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuba kubanjwe ezinye iindibano zokufakana imilomo namasebe achaphazelekayo phambi kokuba iSebe lezoThutho leSizwe libe nokusebenzisa le ndlela yokusebenza ihlaziyiweyo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho lokollelwa setjhaba ha kgatiso ya bo-8 ya Ditshupane tsa Ntshetsopele (2016).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukukhutshwa koshicilelo lwe-8 lwezaLathisi zoPhuhliso (2016).

src: Tlaleho ya Tshupane ya Ntshetsopele e tsepamisa maikutlo hodima ntshetsopele ya Aforika Borwa esale ho tloha qalong ya demokerasi mme e beha leihlo ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP): Tjhebelopele ya Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana mekgwa ya ho matlafatsa bolaodi ba boitshwaro ba basebeletsi ba setjhaba mabapi le bahlanka ba etsang dikgwebo le makala a puso.
tgt: INgxelo yezaLathiso zoPhuhliso igxile kuphuhliso loMzantsi Afrika ukususela oko kwangena ulawulo lwentando yesininzi ize ibeke phantsi kweliso umsebenzi wokuphunyezwa kwesiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe: uMbono wama-2030.

src: E fana ka sefutho ho Melawana ya Tshebeletso ya Mmuso ya selemo sa 2016, e thibelang basebeletsi ba mmuso hore ba se ke ba kena kgwebong le Puso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwamkele amanyathelo okomelezwa kolawulo lwendlela yokuziphatha kwabasebenzi bakarhulumente ngokumalunga nokwenza ushishino namaqumrhu karhulumente.

src: Ho tloha ka la 1 Hlakubele, Lefapha la Matlotlo a Naha, le tsheheditswe ke Lefapha la Tshebeletso ya Mmuso le Tsamaiso (DPSA), le tla beha leihlo hodima boingodiso kaofela bo botjha ho marangrang a inthanete a Dathabeisi e Bohareng ya Bafani ba Ditshebeletso (CSD) kgahlanong le Tsamaiso ya Persale.
tgt: Iqalisa ukusebenza kweMimiselo yeNkonzo kaRhulumente yowama-2016, ethintela abasebenzi bakarhulumente ukuba bangenzi lushishino norhulumente.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Bolaodi bo Botjha ba Tshebetso le Tsamaiso ya Ntshetsopele ya Dihlooho tsa Mafapha, bo bontshang ka nepo kgokahano pakeng tsa motho ka bo mong le tshebetso ya setheo ka kakaretso.
tgt: Ukususela ngomhla woku-1 kweyoKwindla, uNondyebo weSizwe, exhaswa liSebe lezabaSebenzi bakaRhulumente noLawulo (i-DPSA), iza kuhlola zonke izicelo zokubhalisa ezintsha kuLuhlu lweSizwe lwabaNikeli-zinkonzo olukwi-intanethi zize zithelekiswe neNkqubo ye-Persal.

src: E tla qala ho sebetsa ka la1 Mmesa Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tsebahatswa le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Moralo wa Sekema sa ho Thaothwa ha Dirutehi tsa Tshebeletso ya Mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele iNkqubo eNtsha yoLawulo loKwenziwa koMsebenzi noPhuhliso yeeNtloko zaMasebe, nebonakalisa ngokuchanekileyo uqhagamshelwano phakathi kokwenziwa komsebenzi ngumntu buqu kunye nokwenziwa komsebenzi liziko.

src: Sena se bopa karolo ya lenaneo la ntshetsopele ka hara Tshebeletso ya Mmuso ho hohella dirutehi tse nang le talente ka hara Tshebeletso ya Mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuveliswa nokufezekiswa kweNkqubo-sikhokelo yeSkimu sokuFumana abaThweswa-zidanga seNkonzo kaRhulumente.

src: Moralo o kenyeletsa ho supa diphesente tsa dikgeo tsa mesebetsi tsa lefapha ka leng bakeng sa ho thaothwa ha dirutehi mesebetsing e haellang.
tgt: Oku kwenza inxalenye yenkqubo yophuhliso ngaphakathi kwiNkonzo kaRhulumente ukutsala abathweswa-zidanga bangene kwiNkonzo kaRhulumente.

src: Letona la DPSA hape le tla matahanya moralo ona le Lenaneo la Tshebeletso ya Kgiro ya Batjha.
tgt: Le nkqubo-sikhokelo iquka ukubekela bucala inani elithile lezithuba ezikhoyo kwisebe ngalinye kusenzelwa ukuba kuzo kuqeshwe abathweswa-zidanga kwimisebenzi enezakhono ezinqabileyo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana bakeng sa phatlalatso ya Ditsebiso tse latelang Koranteng ya Mmuso tse amanang le Tokiso ya Dikahlolo tsa Makgotla a Dinyewe, e reretsweng ho eketsa phihlello ya toka bakeng sa batho ba neng ba qheletswe ka thoko pele le metsana ya mahae e sa tholeng ditshebeletso tse lokelang.
tgt: UMphathiswa wabaSebenzi bakaRhulumente noLawulo uza kwenza ukuba le nkqubo-sikhokelo ihambelane neNkqubo yeNkonzo yokuQeshwa koLutsha.

src: Tokiso ena e diterekeng tsa bomaseterata Freistata le Kapa Leboya, le ho tloswa ha Ditereke tsa Bomaseterata tse itseng ho Karolo ya Lekgotla le Phahameng la Dinyewe la Gauteng le ho di beha tlasa bodisa ba Karolo ya Lekgotla le Phahameng la Dinyewe la Leboya Bophirima.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukupapashwa kwezi Zaziso zilandelayo kwiPhepha-ndaba loMbuso zinxulumene nokuQwalaselwa Ngokutsha koMmandla woLawulo lweeNkundla, okugxile ekwandiseni indlela ubulungisa obufikeleleka ngayo kwabo babehlelelekile ngaphambili kunye neelali ezingafumani zinkonzo ngokwaneleyo.

src: Melawana ena e fana ka hore motsetedi ya nang le kgang mabapi le mohato o nkuweng ke mmuso o amang matsete, ho kopa Lefapha la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri (dti) ho kenella ka mokgwa wa bonamodi o ka bang teng.
tgt: Oku kuqwalaselwa ngokutsha kuza kwenzeka kwizithili zomantyi eFreystata naseMntla Koloni, kwakunye nokususwa kweZithili zoMantyi ezithile kwiCandelo leNkundla ePhakamileyo yaseGauteng zaze zafakwa phantsi kommandla wolawulo weCandelo leNkundla ePhakamileyo yaseMntla Ntshona.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho bitswa le ho tshwarwa ha dipitso tse latelang:Pitso ya Ditherisano ya Naha ya Lenaneo la Ntshetsopele ya Basebeletsi ba Badudi ya selemo sa 2018 ke DPSA.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele iMimiselo yeMithetho yoLamlo ngokwemimiselo yoMthetho woKhuselo loTyalo-mali, wama-2015 (uMthetho 22 wama-2015).

src: Pitso ya bo-23 ya Selemo ka seng ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Batjhutjhisi, e tla tshwarwa ke Bolaodi ba Naha ba Botjhutjhisi ho la Durban ka Loetse 2018.Foramo ya Lefatshe ya Saense ya selemo sa 2021 ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Le mimiselo inceda umtyali-mali onesikhalazo esimalunga namanyathelo athathwe ngurhulumente athe achaphazela utyalo-mali lwakhe, acele iSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino (i-dti) ukuba lingenelele ngendlela yolamlo efanelekileyo.

src: Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji le tla buisana le Komiti ya Tsamaiso ya Foramo ya Lefatshe ya Saense ka kgonahalo ya ho tshwara pitso ena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuqhutywa nokusingathwa kwezi ngqungquthela zilandelayo:INgqungquthela yeSizwe yokuCebisana yeNkqubo yaBasebenzi boPhuhliso loLuntu yowama-2018 liSebe lezabaSebenzi bakaRhulumente noLawulo (i-DPSA).INgqungquthela yoNyaka yama-23 yoMbutho wabeTshutshisi weHlabathi, eza kusingathwa liGunyabantu lezoTshutshiso (i-NPA) eDurban kwinyanga yoMsintsi yowama-2018.

src: Dipuisano tsa Boemo bo Phahameng tsa 2017 tsa Kopano ya Aforika (AU), e tla tshwarwa ke DPSA ho tloha ka la 6 ho isa ka la 8 Tshitwe Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana bakeng sa meralo ya letoto la dikhoine tsa sehopotso tsa babokelli le potoloho hore di ntshuwe ka selemo sa 2018.Meralo ya dikhoine, le diphatlalatso tsa tsona, di tla hatiswa Koranteng ya Mmuso: 2018 2oz, 22-dikharate tsa gauta tsa Krugerrand 2018 24-dikharate tsa gauta tsa letoto la dikhoine tsa Natura (Kgolo ya Sube – Archosauria) 2018 24-dikharate tsa letoto la dikhoine tsa gauta tsa R1 (Dihahabi tsa Aforika Borwa – kgudu)2018 khoine ya ditshepe tse pedi ya R5 e potolohang (Dilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Nelson Mandela)2018 24-dikharate tsa letoto la dikhoine tsa Protea tsa gauta le steling sa silifera (Bophelo ba Mohale – Nelson Mandela)2018 letoto la steling sa silifera sa Korone ya R2 le letoto la Teke ya 2 ½ (Ditshibollo tsa Aforika Borwa – Ditshwantsho tsa mahlasedi a X-ray tse entsweng ka khompyutha le 2018 letoto la dikhoine tse kentsweng mebala tsa steling sa silifera (Dinonyana le Dipalesa tsa Resefe ya Tlhaho ya Waterberg).Dintlha tsa Hajwale.
tgt: IiNgxoxo ezikwiZinga eliPhezulu zeMbumba yase-Afrika (AU) zowama-2017, ziza kusingathwa yi-DPSA ukususela ngomhla we-6 ukuya kowe-8 kweyoMnga yowama-20.

src: Sephetho sa Palohohle ya Dihlahiswa tsa Naha (GDP)Kabinete e thabisitswe ke kgolo ya moruo wa Afrika Borwa o hotseng ka sekgahla sa 2% tsa selemo ka seng kotareng ya boraro ya selemo sa 2017, ho tloha ho phahameng ho shebuweng botjha ha 2.8% kotareng ya bobedi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba iingqekembe ezintsha ezisikhumbuzo zabaqokeleli-zingqekembe neziza kusasazwa eluntwini zikhutshwe kowama-2018.Ezi ngqekembe, nokwaziswa kwazo, ziza kupapashwa kwiPhephandaba loMbuso: I-Krugerrand eyi-20z yowama-2018 yegolide eneekhathi ezingama-22Iingqekembe ze-Natura zowama-2018 zegolide eneekharathi ezingama-24- (Ukuvuka kwezidla-mlilo, idaynaso – Archosauria)Iingqekembe ze-R1 zowama-2018 zegolide eneekharathi ezingama-24- (Izirhubuluzi zaseMzantsi Afrika – uhlobo lwefudo olubizwa i-parrot beaked padloper)Ingqekembe ye-R5 yowama-2018 eza kusasazwa kuwonke-wonke eyenziwe ngeentlobo ezimbini zesinyithi (Isikhumbuzo seminyaka elikhulu kaNelson Mandela)Iingqekembe zesiQwane zowama-2018 zegolide eneekharathi ezingama-24 kunye nesilivere engxengwe kancinci (i- sterling-silver) (Ubomi beSithwalandwe -uNelson Mandela)Iingqekembe ze-R2 Crown neTiki eyi-2½ zowama-2018 zesilivere engxengwe kancinci(Izinto eziQanjwe eMzantsi Afrika – i-Computed Tomography) kunyeneeNgqekembe zowama-2018 ezenziwe ngesilivere engxengwe kancinci (Iintaka neeNtyatyambo zoMyezo woLondolozo-ndalo wase-Waterberg).Imiba engundaba-mlonyeni.

src: Tshebetso ena e matla kamoo ho neng ho sa lebellwa ke ka lebaka la kgolo e matla e ntseng e tswela pele lekaleng la temo, le nyehetseng ka dintlha tsa diphesente tse moruong ka kakaretso ha ho shejwa kgolo ya 44.2% kotara-le-kotara.
tgt: Iziphumo zeSambuku seMveliso yeLizwe (i-GDP)IKhabhinethi ixolile luhlumo loqoqoqsho lwaseMzantsi Afrika nolukhule ngomlinganiselo wonyaka ozi-2% kwikota yesithathu yowama-2017, ususela kumlinganiselo otshintshiweyo ophezulu oyi-2.8% kwikota yesibini.

src: Tshebetso e matla ho tsa temo, e bileng le kgolo e matla ka dikotara tse tharo tse latelanang, ke ka lebaka la dimela tsa masimong (tse kang poone) dibakeng tsa pula ya lehlabula le dihlahiswa tsa ditshingwaneng.
tgt: Ukusebenza okungaphezulu kunokuba kulindelekile ubukhulu becala benzeke ngenxa yohlumo oluhle oluqhubekekayo kwicandelo lezolimo, nolwenze igalelo oluyi-0.9% kuhlumo olupheleleyo emva kohlumo lwama-44.2% ikota-nekota.

src: Merafo le difeme tsa tlhahiso di nyehetse kgolong e rekotuweng, moo merafo le dikwari di phahameng ka 6.6% le ho nyehela dintlha tse tsa diphesente kgolong ya moruo.
tgt: Ukuqhuba kakuhle kakhulu kwezolimo, apho kubekho uhlumo oluhle kwiikota ezintathu zilandelelana, kwenzeke ngenxa yemveliso ephezulu yezityalo zasemasimini (ezifana nombona) kwimimandla efumana iimvula ehlotyeni nakwiimveliso zolimo ezilinywa ezigadini nasezitiyeni.

src: Lekala la motlakase ke lona le hulanyang maoto ka ho fetisisa, le theohile ka 5.5%.
tgt: Ezezimbiwa neemveliso zezinto ezenziweyo nazo zenze igalelo kolu hlumo, apha icandelo lezezimbiwa neekwari lihlume nge-6.6 % into leyo eligalelo eliyi-0.5% kuhlumo lulonke.

src: Kgolo bakeng sa dintho tse sebediswang malapeng ya 2.6% ke ka lebaka haholo la ho reka thepa ya nako e telele, e bakileng keketseho ya dintlha tsa diphesente tse tsa keketseho ya 2.6%.
tgt: Icandelo lezombane ibe lelona lisileleyo, lehle nge-5.5%.

src: Kgolo ena e neng e sa lebellwa le ho shejwa botjha ho phahameng ha sephetho sa kgolo ya kotara ya bobedi e bolela hore kgolo e ka fihla ho 0.9% ka selemo sa 2017.Sena se ka hodimo ho feta 0.7% e neng e lebeletswe nakong ya Pehelo ya Leano la Ditekanyetso tsa Nako e Bohareng (MTBP).
tgt: Uhlumo kwizinto ezisetyenziswa emakhaya oluyi-2.6% lubangelwe ikakhulu yinkcitho kwizinto ezihlala ixesha elide, nezenze igalelo le-1.6% koku kukhula kwe-2.6%.

src: Mmuso o lokela ho netefatsa hore lebelo lena la kgolo le dula le le jwalo ka ho tswela pele ho kenya tshebetsong mekgwa e 14 ya ho matlafatsa tshepo e hahellang hodima ho ntlafatsa tshepo ya basebedisi le ho kgutlisetsa tshepo ya borakgwebo.
tgt: Uhlumo olungaphezu kunokuba kulindelekile kunye nokutshintshwa komlinganiselo wohlumo unyuswe kwikota yesibini kungakhokelela ekubeni uhlumo lulonke lufikelele kwi-0.9% ngowama-2017.Oku kungaphezulu kwi-0.7% ibithelekelelwe ngexesha loHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali lwesiGaba esiPhakathi (i-MTBPS).

src: Lebenkele le Abelanang Tsohle la InvestSAKabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa ha Lebenkele le Abelanang Tsohle la InvestSA KwaZulu-Natal ke Moporesidente Jacob Zuma e le karolo ya mekutu ya ho ntlafatsa bobebe ba ho etsa dikgwebo ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Urhulumente kufuneka aqinisekise ukuba esi santya uqoqosho luhluma ngaso asitshintshi ngokuthi aqalise ukufezekisa amanyathelo ali-14 okuphucula indlela oluthenjwe ngayo uqoqosho lweli ancedisayo ekuphuculeni indlela uqoqosho lweli oluthenjwa ngayo ngabathengi nangabezoshishino.

src: Le reretswe ho bopa tikoloho e nepahetseng ka ho fana ka sebaka sa boikopanyo bakeng sa batsetedi hore ba fumane ditshebeletso tsohle bakeng sa ho akofisa diporojeke le ho fokotsa metjha e mengatangata ya mmuso ha motho a qala kgwebo.
tgt: Iziko, i-InvestSA One-Stop ShopIKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuvulwa ngokusesikweni kweziko elinezinto zonke, i-InvestSA One-Stop Shop, kwiphondo laKwaZulu-Natal nguMongameli uJacob Zuma njengelinye lamalinge okuphucula ukwenza kube kulula ukuqhuba ushishino eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Ho saennwe ditumellano tse latelang: Memorandamo wa Kutlwano (MoU) mabapi le ho boptjwa ha Khomishene ya Boporesidente ya Dinaha tse Pedi, MoU wa Tshebedisano Lepatlelong la Tikoloho, Ditataiso tsa ho Kenngwa Tshebetsong ha pebofatso ya phumantsho ya divisa, Porothokhole ya Tshebedisano ya Sepolesa le Tumellano ya Thusano Mabakeng a Tsamaiso ya Makgetho a Madiboho.
tgt: Iinjongo zalo kukudala iimeko ezifanelekileyo ngokuba la ngamaziko aluncedo kubatyali-mali abanokuya kuyo xa befuna uncedo olukhawulezayo nokunciphisa ubucukubhede bukarhulumente obusokolisayo xa umntu eqala ishishini.

src: Seboka sa Bohlano sa AU le Kopano ya Yuropa (EU)Kabinete e amohela sephetho sa Seboka sa Bohlano sa AU le ESeboka sena se fanne ka monyetla bakeng sa Aforika Borwa ho matlafatsa mawa a dikamano tsa moruo le bodiplomate ka dipuisano tse fapafapaneng sebokeng sena le diketsahalong tse ka thoko tse kang Foramo ya Kgwebo le Seboka sa Batjha, ka ho tsepamisa maikutlo hodima kgolo ya moruo e kenyeletsang kgiro ya batjha le boetapele ba dikgwebo.
tgt: Ubudlelwane boMzansi Afrika ne-AngolaIKhabhinethi iyazamkela izivumelwano ezityikitywe ngexesha loTyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni eMzantsi Afrika nguMongameli wase-Angola uJoão Manuel Gonçalves Lourenço.

src: Kgwebisano ya Bokgoba ya Bafalli ba batho batsho ba maAforikaKabinete e imatahanya le badudi ba matjhaba mabapi le ho tshwela ka mathe ditlaleho tsa ho fantiswa ha bafalli ba batho batsho ba maAforika ho la Libya jwaloka makgoba.
tgt: Kutyikitywe ezi zivumelwano zilandelayo: iSivumelwano sokuQondana (i-MoU) esingokudalwa kweKhomishini yooMongameli beZizwe eziBini, i-MoU yeNtsebenziswano kwicandelo lezokusiNgqongileyo, iMigaqo yokuPhunyezwa kweMithetho yokuNqunyanyiswa koMthetho oNyanzelisa ukuphathwa kwe-visa, isiVumelwano kwiNtsebenziswano yamaPolisa nesiVumelwano sokuNcedana kulawulo ngeMiba engeRhafu yeeMpahla eziNgenayo neziPhumayo.

src: Diketso tse jwalo tse hlokang botho di kgahlanong le mehopolo ya AU, le disebediswa tse amehang tsa Aforika le tsa matjhabeng, ho kenyeletswa Tjhata ya Aforika le Ditokelo tsa Botho le tsa Batho.
tgt: INgqungquthela yesiHlanu yeMbumba ye-Afrika (i-AU) neManyano yaMazwe aseYurophu (i-EU)IKhabhinethi iyazamkela iziphumo zeNgqungquthela yesiHlanu yeMbumba ye-Afrika (i-AU) neManyano yaMazwe aseYurophu (i-EU).

src: Kabinete e amohela tsebiso ka ba ka sehloohong ya hore ba tla hlophisa mokgwa wa dipalangwang le phalliso ho la Tripoli bakeng sa baphaphathehi le bafalli ba hlokang tshireletso ya matjhaba.
tgt: Le ngqungquthelo inike uMzantsi Afrika ithuba lokomeleza ubudlelwane bezoqoqosho nobudlelwane bezozakuzo ngokuthi ubambe iindibano ezahlukeneyo ngethuba kuqhuba le ngqungquthela.

src: Ho ropoha ha ListeriosiseKabinete e ipiletsa ho batho bohle ho nka mehato ya ho itlhokomela – e jwaloka ho hlapa matsoho pele ba lokisa dijo le ho phema dijo tse tala kapa tse sa phehuwang – ho thibela ho nama ha Listeriosise, ha dipatlisiso di ntse di tswela pele bakeng sa ho tiisetsa mohlodi wa baktheria ena.
tgt: Ezi ndibano zifana neQonga lezoShishino neNgqungquthela yoLutsha, ebezigxile kakhulu kuhlumo loqoqosho oluxhanyulwa ngumntu wonke, ukuqweshwa kolutsha kunye noshishino olusakhulayo.

src: Lefu lena le bakwa ke baktheria e fumanwang mobung, metsing, dimeleng le dihlahisweng tsa lebese tse sa hlwekisiswang, mme le ka baka matshwao ao e kang ke a ntaramane e kopaneng le letshollo.
tgt: Ukuthengiswa kwembaca zase-Afrika njengemakhobokaIKhabhinethi nayo njengehlabathi iyazigxeka iingxelo zokuthengiswa kwiifandesi kweembacu zase-Afrika njengamakhoboka eLibya.

src: Le ka phekolwa ka katleho ka diantibayothiki, haeba e ka hlokomelwa ka nako.
tgt: Izenzo ezikumila kunje ezingenabuntu zichasene nemithetho ye-AU, kunye nezivumelwano ezifanelekileyo zase-Afrika nezehlabathi, kuquka noMqulu wase-Afrika ongamaLungelo Aabantu.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho tswela pele ho sebedisa metsi ka paballo kaha naha e ntse e tswela pele ho ba ka hara komello.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isibhengezo esenziwe ngabasemagunyeni sokuba baza kuvula iziko lokunceda iimbacu ezifuna uncedo lwemibutho yehlabathi eTripoli.

src: Ho sa tsotellwe dipula tse ntseng di na, maemo a matamo a ntse a tswela pele ho theoha ka hara naha.
tgt: Ukuqhambuka kwesifo se- ListeriosisIKhabhinethi ibongoza bonke abantu ukuba bathathe amanyathelo okhuseleko afanelekileyo – afana nokuhlamba izandla phambi kokwenza ukutya kwaye bangakusebenzisi ukutya okukrwada okanye okungaphekwanga – ukunqamla ukwanda kwesifo se-Listeriosis, ngeli xesha uphando lokukhangela eyona nto ingunobangela wale ntsholongwane lusaqhuba.

src: Sena ke ka lebaka la dithempheretjha tse hodimo hammoho le hore ha re so fumane dipula tse tsitsitseng.
tgt: Esi sifo sibangelwa yintsholongwane efumaneka emhlabeni, emanzini, kwizityalo neemveliso zobisi ezingabiliswanga ukuze kubulawe iintsholongwane, kwaye oko kungabangela iimpawu ezifana nomkhuhlane ohambisa isisu.

src: Kabinete e kgothatswa ke ditherisano tse hatetseng pele le bomasepala ba kolotang haholo tse lebisitseng tharollong ya sekoloto sa bomasepala.
tgt: Singanyangeka ngokuyimpumelelo nge-antibiotics, ukuba sibhaqeke kwangethuba.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Dithuso tsa Kahisano ya selemo sa 2017Bili ena e fana ka melemo e ntlafaditsweng mabapi le dithuso tsa mmuso tsa ditshehetso tsa ditjhelete bakeng sa bana ba dikgutsana le ba tsietsing, ho kenyeletswa le ba dulang malapeng a eteletsweng pele ke bana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba baqhubeke ngokusebenzisa amanzi ngobunono njengokuba eli lizwe lisaqhubeka ukuthwaxwa yimbalela.

src: Bili ya Ditsebi tsa Thepa ya Matlo ya selemo sa 2017Bili e fedisa Molao wa hajwale wa Merero ya Makala a Matlo, 1976 (Molao wa bo-112 wa selemo sa 1976).
tgt: Nakubeni zibekhona iimvula kutsha nje, umthamo wamadama elizweni jikelele usaqhubeka ukwehla.

src: E bopa tikoloho e kgontshang bolaodi bakeng sa ho matlafatsa mosebetsi wa moruo ka hara indaseteri ya matlo ha hape e sebetsana le tlhokeho ya ho netefatsa diphethoho ka hara lekala lena.
tgt: Oku kungenxa yamaqondo obushushu aphezulu kunye nento yokuba asikafumani mvula ina ngokuqhubekekayo.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Moralo wa Naha wa Mangolo a Thuto ya selemo sa 2016Bili ena e matlafatsa Molao wa hajwale wa Moralo wa Naha wa Mangolo a Thuto, 2008 (Molao wa bo-67 wa selemo sa 2008).
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuya zingxoxo eziqhuba kakuhle zokufuna isisombululo noomasipala abanamatyala amakhulu.

src: E tsebahatsa mekgwa ya ho sebetsana le dintlha tsa mafosi le ho beha ditlamorao ho batho ba fanang ka mangolo a thuto a fosahetseng kapa mekgatlo e fanang ka mangolo a thuto a sa nepahalang.
tgt: UMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo weziBonelelo zikaRhulumente wama-2017Lo Mthetho usaYilwayo ungokuphuculwa kwezibonelelo zabantwana abazinkedama okanye abahlelelekileyo, kuquka abo bahlala kumakhaya angenabantu badala.

src: Bili ya Botlokotsebe ba Matjhaba ya selemo sa 2017Bili e fana ka moralo wa ketsamolao o ntlafaditsweng ho sebetsana le botlokotsebe ba matjhaba bo entsweng ka hara Aforika Borwa le mose ho meedi ya rona.
tgt: UMthetho osaYilwayo wabaThengisa uMhlaba neZindlu wowama-2017Lo Mthetho usaYilwayo uguzula uMthetho weMicimbi yabaThengisi-mihlaba neZakhiwo, wowe-1976 (uMthetho 112 wowe-1976).

src: Hape e fana ka tshireletso le toka bakeng sa mahlatsipa a botlokotsobe ba matjhaba.
tgt: Udala imeko yezolawulo ekwazekayo ukomeleza imigushuzo yezoqoqosho ngaphakathi kushishino lwemihlaba nezakhiwo ngelixesha ikwahlangabezana nezidingo zokuqinisekisa ngenguqu kweli candelo.

src: Moporesidente Emmerson Dambudzo Mnangagwa ka ho hlomamiswa ha hae e le Moporesidente wa Rephabliki ya Zimbabwe.
tgt: UMongameli Uhuru Kenyatta ekubekweni kwakhe njengoMongameli weRhiphabliki yaseKenya nokuba abekwe isihlandlo sesibini njengoMongameli kweliya lizwe.

src: Kabinete e ikemiseditse ka ho tswela pele ka dikamano tse matla tsa tshebetso le Mmuso wa Zimbabwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izimisele ukuqhubeka ngokwakhela kubudlelwane obuliqilima obukhoyo phakathi kwala mazwe wethu mabini.

src: Majoro Seitebatso Pearl Block ka ho hapa Kgau ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) ya Moemedi wa Selemo wa Bong ka hara Sesole.
tgt: UMongameli Emmerson Dambudzo Mnangagwa ekubekweni kwakhe njengoMongameli weRhiphabliki yaseZimbabwe.

src: Kgau ena e ananela boitelo le mekutu ya mmaballi wa kgotso mabapi le ho kgothaletsa dipehelo ka hara Lekgotla la Tshireletso la UN ho ya ka Tumellano ya 1325, e ipiletsang ho mekga yohle e lwanang ho tshireletsa basadi le banana kgahlanong le tlhekefetso ka motabo le dikgoka tse itshetlehileng hodima bong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izimisele ukuqhubeka ngobudlelwane bentsebenziswano obuliqilima kunye noRhulumente waseZimbabwe.

src: Ladysmith Black Mambazo, ba fumaneng dithonyo tse pedi bakeng sa Dikgau tsa Grammy tsa selemo sa 2018.
tgt: UNjengele Seitebatso Pearl Block ngokuphumelela iMbasa yoNyaka yokuMela amaLungelo eSini eMkhosini yeZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN).

src: Ya pele ke ya mokgahlelo wa Alebamo e Ipabotseng ka ho Fetisisa ya Mmino wa Lefatshe bakeng sa Alebamo ya bona ya Shaka Zulu Revisited: Mokete wa Sehopotso wa bo-30, mme ya bobedi ke ya mokgahlelo ho Alebamo e Ipabotseng ka ho Fetisisa ya Bana bakeng sa Songs of Peace & Love for Kids & Parents Lefatsheng ka Bophara.
tgt: Le mbasa ihlonipha ukuzinikela namalinge omgcini-xolo ngamnye ekukhuliseni imigomo ngaphakathi kwisiNdululo seBhunga loKhuselo le-UN uNombolo 1325, elimema onke amaqela axabanayo ukuba akhusele abantu basetyhini namantombazana kubundlobongela obugxile kwisini nakwezesondo.

src: Dikgau tsa Grammy di reretswe ho etsahala ka la 28 Pherekgong 2018.
tgt: Iqela lesicathamiya, iLadysmith Black Mambazo, ethe yafumana ukuchongwa kwiiNdidi ezimbini zeeMbasa ze-Grammy.

src: Chad Le Clos, ka ho ba sesesi sa pele sa monna naheng ya rona sa ho hapa letoto la dikola tsa Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Disesi wa FINRe motlotlo ka diphihlello tsa hae hape re na le tshepo ya hore o tla tswela pele ho emela Aforika Borwa ka boqhetseke.
tgt: Udidi slokuqala yi-Best World Music Album ngecwecwe layo elithi: Shaka Zulu Revisited: 30th Annivesary Celebration, luze udidi lwesibini lube yi--Best Children Album: Songs of Peace & Love for Kids & Parents around the World.

src: SuperSport United, ka ho fihlella makgaolakgang a Mohope wa Bolaodi ba Bolo wa Aforika.
tgt: IiMbasa ze-Grammy zimiselewe ukuba ziza kubanjwa ngomhla wama-28 kweyoMqungu yowama-2018.

src: Mofumahatsana wa Aforika Borwa, Demi-Leigh Nel-Peters, ka ho rweswa sekola sa Mofumahatsana wa Mmabotle Lefatsheng ka bophara tlhodisanong ya bo-66 ya bommabotle haufinyana tjena ho la Amerika (USA).
tgt: UChad Le Clos, ngokuba yindadi yokuqala eyindoda ukuphumelela kane uthotho lweetaytile zeNdebe yeHlabathi ye-FINSiyazingca ngempumelelo yakhe kwaye sinethemba lokuba uza kuqhubeka ukumela uMzantsi Afrika ngokuyimpumelelo egqithisileyo.

src: Ngaka Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma, ya abetsweng Kgau ya Lifetime Achievement ke Foramo ya Lefatshe ya Baetapele ba Basadi ba Dipolotiki.
tgt: I-SuperSport United, ngokufikelela kumdlalo wamagqibela kankqoyi wendebe i-Confederation Cup yeManyano yeBhola eKhatywayo yase-Afrika (i-CAF).

src: Mmuso le batho ba Egepeta ho latela tlhaselo ya boferekanyi moskeng o Penensuleng ya Sinai moo ho bolauweng batho ba fetang 300 le ho ntsha kotsi ba bang ba mmalwa.
tgt: UNobuhle woMzantsi Afrika, Demi-Leigh Nel-Peters, ngokuthweswa isithsaba sokuba nguNobuhle kulo lonke elimiweyo, u-Miss Universe, kukhuphiswano lwama-66 olusanda kubanjwa kutsha nje, e-United States of America.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe tlhaselo ena e hlokang kelello ho baahi ba se nang molato.
tgt: UGq Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma, nothe wafumana iMbasa ye-Lifetime Achievement kwiQonga leeNkokheli zezoPolitiko zabaseTyhini zeHlabathi (i-Women Political Leaders Global Forum).

src: Mmuso le batho ba Nigeria ho latela ho qhoma ha bomo ya moipolai ka la 21 Pudungwana 2017 e bolaileng batho ba fetang ba 50 le ho ntsha kotsi ba bang ba bangata.
tgt: Urhulumente nabantu base-Egypt emva kohlaselo lobunqolobi kwisakhiwo secawe yamaSilamsi, i-mosque, eSinai Peninsula noluthe lwabulala abantu abangaphezulu kwama-300 kwaza kwangxwelerheka iqela labantu.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa ho tshwela ka mathe ho itlhomphileng le ho hlokang ho qeaqea ha yona ha boferekanyi le dikgoka tse nyedisehang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalugxeka oluhlaselo lobundlavini ebantwini abamsulwa.

src: Lelapa le metswalle ya Ngaka Mochubela ‘Wesi’ Seekoe, mokaubere wa ntwa ya tokoloho le Lenqosa la mehleng la Aforika Borwa ho la Federeishene ya Russia.
tgt: Urhulumente nabantu baseNigeria emva koqhushumbo lwesiqhushumbisi sokuzibulala ngomhla wama-21 kweyeNkanga yowama-2017 noluthe lwabulala abantu abangaphezulu kwama-50 lwaza lwangxwelerha uninzi lwabanye.

src: O sebeleditse naha ka boqhetseke jwaloka Lenqosa la Aforika Borwa ho la Russia le jwaloka Modulasetulo wa Koporasi ya Eneji ya Nutleleya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isahleli imi kwimithetho-siseko yayo yokuzichasa nokuzikhaba ngawo omane izenzo zobunqolobi nobundlobongela babanxaxhi.

src: Moporesidente Zuma o tsebahaditse Lepato le Ikgethang la Semmuso la Porofense bakeng sa hae.
tgt: Usapho nezihlobo zikaGq Mochubela ‘Wesi’ Seekoe, igqala lomzabalazo nowayesakuba nguNozakuzaku woMzantsi Afrika kwilizwe lase-Russia.

src: Lelapa le metswalle ya qhoku ya Ntwa ya Tokoloho le motshwaruwa wa mehleng wa Sehlekehleke sa Robben, Monghadi Eddie Daniels, ya hlokahetseng haufinyana tjena.
tgt: Ulisebenzele ngokuzinikela eli lizwe njengoNozakuzaku waseMzantsi Afrika eRussia nanjengoSihlalo weQumrhu lezaMandla eNyukliya laseMzantsi Afrika.

src: O tla hopolwa bakeng sa boitelo ba hae bo neng bo hloka boinahanelo le tshebeletso ho batho ba Aforika Borwa.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma ubhengeze ukuba uza kukhatshwa ngomngcwabo oKhethekileyo wasebuRhulumenteni wePhondo.

src: Lelapa le metswalle ya Letona la Tshireletso le Mekaubere ya Sesole, Mofumahadi Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula, ka ho hlokahala ha ntate wa hae, Monghadi Douglas Mapisa.
tgt: Usapho nabahlobo begqala loMzabalazo nowayesakuba libanjwa esiqithini i-Robben Island, uMnu Eddie Daniels, osanda kusweleka kutsha nje.

src: O hlokahaletse Sepetlele sa Cecilia Makiwane East London, ho la Kapa Botjhabela a na le dilemo tse 96.Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Uza kukhunjulwa ngokuzinikela nokuzidina kwakhe kunye nokusebenzela abantu baseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Sehopotso sa Dilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Nelson MandelaKabinete e imatahanya le maAforika Borwa mabapi le ho kenela sehopotso sa bone sa ho hlokahala ha Nelson Mandela ka la 5 Tshitwe 2013.
tgt: Usapho nezihlobo zoMphathiswa wezoKhuselo naMagqala eMfazwe, uNksz Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula, ngokusweleka kukatata wakhe, uMnu Douglas Mapisa.

src: Ka selemo sa 2018 naha e tla tshwaya sehopotso sa dilemo tse lekgolo tsa bophelo ba Mandela mme maAforika Borwa kaofela a kgothaletswa ho imatahanya le mekete ya selemo kaofela ha re tla be re isa tlhompho ho e mong wa bara ba bohlokwa ka ho fetisisa ba Aforika.
tgt: Isikhumbuzo seminyaka elikhulu kaNelson MandelaIKhabinethi nayo njengabemi baseMzantsi Afrika iza kukhumbula unyaka wesine emva kokusweleka kukaNelson Mandela ngomhla we-5 kweyoMnga yowama-2013.

src: Kabinete e leboha maAforika Borwa kaofela bakeng sa bonkakarolo ba bona diketsahalong tse fapafapaneng tsa sehopotso sa OR Tambo ho phatlalla le naha mme e shebile hore ho tla ba le bonkakarolo bo tshwanang ha re hopola qhoku ya rona le Moporesidente wa pele ya kgethilweng ka tsela ya demokerasi wa Aforika Borwa, Madiba.
tgt: Ngowama-2018 eli lizwe lizakuphawula iminyaka elikhulu yobomi bukaMandela kwaye bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika bayakhuthazwa ukuba bathathe inxaxheba kule mibhiyozo iza kuthatha unyaka wonke njengoko siza kube sihlonipha uMadiba omde, ithole lomthonyama elidume kulo lonke eli limiweyo.

src: Sehla sa MonyakaKabinete e lakaletsa maAforika Borwa kaofela sehla sa monyaka se tletseng thabo le se bolokehileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibulela bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ngokuthatha kwabo inxaxheba kwimisitho eyahlukeneyo yesikhumbuzo sika-Tambo elizweni jikelele kwaye ikwalindele izinga elifanayo lokuthatha inxaxheba njengokuba sizakuba sikhumbula isithwalandwe sethu noMongameli wokuqala woMzantsi Afrika owonyulwa ngokwentando yesininzi, uMadiba.

src: Re ipiletsa ho bohle ba tla kena mebileng ho netefatsa hore dipalangwang tsa bona di maemong a loketseng tsela.
tgt: IXesha leziYunguma zeKrisimesiIKhabhinethi inqwenela bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ixesha leeholide neziyunguma zeKrisimesi elimyoli nelikhuselekileyo.

src: Basebedisi bohle ba mebila, bakganni le ditaaso ba lokela ho ikobela melao ya tsela.
tgt: Sibongoza bonke abo baza kuhamba ngezithuthi baqinisekise ukuba izithuthi zabo zisemgangathweni olungele indlela.

src: Letona la Dipalangwang, Monghadi Joe Maswanganyi, o thakgotse letsholo la Arrive Alive Bela-Bela, ho la Limpopo ka la 5 Tshitwe.
tgt: Bonke abasebenzisi bendlela, abaqhubi nabahambi-ngeenyawo kufuneka bathobele imithetho yezendlela.

src: Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa sa Aforika Borwa (SAPS) e tla kenya tshebetsong letsholo la yona la naha ka bophara bakeng sa sehla sa monyaka se bolokehileng mme bohle re na le boikarabelo ba ho tshehetsa SAPS ka ho ikobela molao le ho itshwara ka tsela e nang le boikarabelo.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezoThutho uJoe Maswanganyi, umisele iphulo lika-Arrive Alive (Fika uPhila) eBela-Bela, eLimpopo ngomhla we-5 kweyoMnga.

src: Lefapha la merero ya Lehae le tla tsebisa meralo ya sehla sa monyaka sa 2017/18 bakeng sa tikoloho ya meedi ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: INkonzo yezobuPolisa yaseMzantsi Afrika (i-SAPS) ifezekisa iphulo layo lexesha leziyunguma neeholide zeKrisimesi elikhuseleke ngokuthe chatha elizweni jikelele kwaye sonke sinoxanduva lokuba sibaxhase abe-SAPS ngokuthobela umthetho nokuziphatha ngendlela esezingqondweni.

src: Sena ke mabapi le ho thusa hore ho be bobebe le bolaodi bo matlafetseng ba ho tsamaya ha batho le thepa ho kena le ho tswa ka hara Aforika Borwa nakong ena e hlokolosi.
tgt: ISebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya lizakubhengeza izicwangciso zexesha leeholide neziyunguma zeKrisimesi zowama-2017/18 zemida yaseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Hape re ipiletsa ho batswadi le bahlokomedi hore ba se tlohele bana ba le bang kaha e le mosebetsi wa rona ho hlokomela bana ba rona.
tgt: Oku kwenzelwa ukuba iimpahla nabantu bakwazi ukuhamba nje kakuhle benqumla imida yoMzantsi Afrika ngeli xesha lokuxakeka.

tgt: Imiba enguNdaba-mlonyeni.

src: Puo ya Ditekanyetso tsa Ditjhelete tsa Naha.
tgt: INtetho engoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali lweSizwe.

src: Kabinete e ananela boitshepo bo tlokomang bo bonahaditsweng ke Ditekanyetso tsa Ditjhelete tsa Naha tsa 2018 tse ileng tsa tekwa Palamenteng, Motse Kapa, bekeng e fetileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakubulela ukwamkelwa ngokupheleleyo koHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali lweSizwe lowama-2018 oluthe lwangeniswa ePalamente, eKapa, kule veki iphelileyo.

src: Maemong a moraorao a ntjhafatso a hlwibitseng setjhaba sa habo rona se kgabane, Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho ikamahanya le mmuso ho hodisa moruo wa rona esita le ho thea mesebetsi ena e hlokehang ka ho fetisisa.
tgt: Kumoya omtsha wokuhlaziyeka kwakutshanje ogqubayo kweli, iKhabhinethi ibongoza bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba basebenzisane norhulumente ekukhuliseni uqoqosho lweli lizwe nokudala imisebenzi edingeka kakhulu.

src: Phokotso ya tshebediso ya tjhelete e kaalo ka R85 bilione nakong ya dilemo tse tharo tse tlang, e bontsha boikitlaetso ba mmuso ho bokellweng ha ditjhelete esita le kabong e hlokolotsi ya mehlodi ya ho hodisa moruo.
tgt: Ukuncitshiswa kwenkcitho ngemali engama-85 eebhiliyoni zeerandi kule minyaka mithathu izayo kubonakalisa ukuzinikela kukarhulumente ekubopheni ibhanti nokwabiwa kwemali ngobunono ukukhulisa uqoqosho.

src: Dikgato tse tsebisitsweng tsa ho sisithehisa sekgahla sa keketseho ya mekitlane esita le ho kgina kgaello ya ditekanyetso tsa ditjhelete, di ntlafatsa moralo wa rona wa tsa ditjhelete ka bokgabane ebile di fa maAforika Borwa boitshepo matsapeng a bokamoso ba moruo wa rona.
tgt: Amanyathelo okuthoba isantya sokukhulisa amatyala karhulumente nokuqinisekisa ukuba ityala likarhulumente alikhuli nathe abhengezwa ayiphucule kakhulu inkqubo-sikhokelo yethu yezezimali aza anika abemi boMzantsi Afrika ithemba kuqoqosho lwethu ukuya phambili.

src: Kabinete e kgodisehile hore bokenadipakeng bo tla bonahala kgolong ya moruo wa rona, bo tiise boemo ba moruo bo be bo tshireletse maemo a ho theoha ha botsetedi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqinisekile ukuba la manyathelo okungenelela aaza kubonakala kuhlumo loqoqosho lwelizwe lethu, aphucule ubume bezoqoqosho aze aqinisekise nokuba eli lizwe alithotywa kwizinga elibekwa kulo ngokwezotyali-mali ali.

src: Ditekanyetso tsa Ditjhelete tsa Naha tsa 2018 di tshehetsa bafutsana setjhabeng sa rona ka lenaneo le phethahetseng la thusetso ya setjhaba, le thuto ya boemo bo phahameng ya mahala bakeng sa baithuti ba tswang malapeng a futsanehileng.
tgt: UHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali lweSizwe lowama-2018 luxhasa abahluphekileyo kwisizwe sethu ngenkqubo yoncedo lwesibonelelo sezentlalo edibeneyo kunye nemfundo ephakamileyo esimahla kubafundi abaphuma kumakhaya angathathi ntweni.

src: Ho arabela dingongorehong tse hlahisitsweng mabapi le dikeketseho tse sisintsweng tsa Lekgetho la Boleng bo Ekeditsweng (VAT), Kabinete e lohotha ho atolla lenane la disebedisuwa tsa mantlha tse sa angweng ke VADilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Nelson Mandela.
tgt: Ngelokuphendula kwizikhalazo eziphakanyiswe luluntu ngokunyuswa kweRhafu eyoNgezwa kwiXabiso (i-VAT), iKhabhinethi iceba ukulwandisa uluhlu lwezinto ezingundoqo ezingenayo irhafu ye-VAImiNyaka eliKhulu yokuZalwa kukaNelson Mandela.

src: Kabinete e kgema mmoho le Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa kgoeletsong ya hae ho maAforika Borwa, ya ho tiisa botjha boikitlaetso bo abelanwang ba ho sebeletsa setjhaba, jwalokaha re tswelapele ho keteka dilemo tse lekgolo tsa tswalo ya Moporesidente wa mehleng Nelson Mandela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nayo njengoMongameli uCyril Ramaphosa ihlaba ikhwelo kubemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba baqinisekise ukuba baza kuzinikela bebonke ekusebenzeleni abantu njengokuba siqhuba sibhiyozela iminyaka elikhulu wazalwayo owayesakuba nguMongameli uNelson Mandela.

src: Madiba ke Moporesidente wa pele wa Aforika Borwa ya Demokrasi mme o ne a tla qeta le dilemo tse 100 ka la 18 Phupu 2018.
tgt: UMadiba nguMongameli wokuqala woMzantsi Afrika oPhantsi koLawulo lweNtando yeSininzi kwaye ebeza kugqiba iminyaka eli-100 wazalwayo ngomhla we-18 kweyeKhala yowama-2018.

src: Madiba ke thatohatsi ya lefatshe lohle e tlotlehang lefatshe ka bophara e le Mampodi wa Ditokelo tsa Botho, ho se kgetholle ka morabe le ka bong.
tgt: UMadiba sisithwalandwe esihlonitshwa lihlabathi jikelele futhi uthathwa njengeNtshatsheli yamaLungelo oLuntu, yokungacalucaluli ngokobuhlanga nangokwesini.

src: O bile le seabo sa bohlokwa ho kopanyeng maAforika Borwa, esita le ho kgothaletsa kopano ya demokrasi Aforika ka bophara le lefatshe ka bophara.
tgt: Wadlala indima enkulu kakhulu ukumanyanisa abemi boMzantsi Afrika, nokuvuselela umanyano lolawulo lwentando yesininzi kwi-Afrika iphela nasehlabathini jikelele.

src: Moketjana wa pele wa dilemo tse lekgolo tsa Nelson Mandela o bile nakong ya Seboka sa Kopano ya Aforika Addis Ababa, Ethiopia ka Pherekgong ya 2018.
tgt: Umbhiyozo wokuqala weminyaka elikhulu yokuzalwa kukaNelson Mandela ububanjwe kwiNgqungquthela yeManyano ye-Afrika (i-AU) ebise-Addis Ababa, e-Ethiopia kweyoMqungu yowama-2018.

src: Diketsahalo tse ngatanyana di tla tshwarwa naha ka bophara monongwaha, ho hetla morao bophelong ba Tata Madiba.
tgt: Kuza kubanjwa imisitho eliqela kweli jikelele kulo nyaka ukukhumbuza ngobomi bukaTata uMadiba.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa ohle hore a ikamahanye le meketjana ya dilemo tse lekgolo a le mesebetsing, dikolong, dikerekeng le mekgatlong ya setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bathathe inxaxheba kule mibhiyozo yeminyaka elikhulu emisebenzini, ezikolweni, ezinkonzweni nakwimibutho yasekuhlaleni.

src: E etsa kgoeletso ho e mong le e mong wa rona hore re hate menyabuketsong ya Nelson Mandela ka ho sebetsa ka mekgwa ya rona e fapaneng ho aha naha e kopaneng, e se nang kgethollo ya morabe, le ya bong e bile e le e atlehileng.
tgt: Ibongoza umntu ngamnye apha kuthi kulo nyaka ukuba sihambe ezinyaweni zikaNelson Mandela ngokuthi ngokweendlela zethu ezahlukeneyo sisebenzele ukwakha ilizwe elimanyeneyo, elingenacalucalulo ngokobuhlanga, elingenacalucalulo ngokwesini nelihlumayo.

src: Naha ena e boela e keteka dilemo tse lekgolo tsa e mong wa baradi ba kgabane ba Aforika, Mama Albertina Sisulu, ya ileng a nyehela bophelo ba hae a lwanela tokoloho ya basadi le ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Eli lizwe likwabhiyozela iminyaka elikhulu yokuzalwa kwenye yeentombi ezibaluleke kakhulu zase-Afrika uMama u-Albertina Sisulu, neyanikela ngobomi bayo ekulweleni ukukhululeka kwabantu basetyhini nenkululeko yoMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kopanong ya yona e latelang, Kabinete e tla rala lenaneo la ho keteka Dilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Mama Albertina Sisulu.
tgt: Kwintlanganiso yeKhabhinethi elandelayo siza kucacisa ngenkqubo yokubhiyozela imiNyaka eliKhulu yokuZalwa kukaMama u-Albertina Sisulu.

src: Komello.
tgt: Imbalela.

src: Kabinete e ananela matsapa a matla a entsweng ke Komiti ya Matona a Kopaneng ka komello, hammoho le ba amehang makaleng ohle a mmuso le kahisanong ho sebetsaneng le maemo a ntseng a ja setsi a komello a thefutseng dikarolo tse ngatanyana tsa naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawabulela amalinge anzima enziwa yiKomiti yabaPhathiswa malunga neMbalela kunye nabadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo kuwo onke amaqoqo karhulumente nawesizwe ukulwa imbalela engapheliyo nechane imimandla eliqela kweli.

src: Ntle le taba ya hore Aforika Borwa ke naha e nang le leqeme la metsi, ditlamorao tsa phuthumalo ya lefatshe lohle di tswelapele ho ama mokgwa oo pula e nang ka wona, mme seo se etsa hore mothamo wa matamo a rona o dule o le tlase.
tgt: Ngaphandle kokuba uMzantsi Afrika ulilizwe elinqatyelweyo ngamanzi, iziphumo zokutshintsha kwamaqondo obushushu omhlaba kuyaqhubeka nokuchaphazela indlela ena ngayo imvula, le nto ibangela ukuba umthamo wamadama wethu uhlale usezantsi.

src: Sehlopha sa Tshebetso sa Matona a Kopaneng se sebetsanang le Komello se tswelapele ho hlophisa mosebetsi dipakeng tsa mmuso wa naha, wa diprofense le wa bomasepala dibakeng tsohle tse thefutsweng ke komello.
tgt: IQela labaPhathiswa eliThweliswe uXanduva leMbalela liyaqhubeka ukuququzelela umsebenzi phakathi kukarhulumente wesizwe, abamaphondo noomasipala kuyo yonke imimandla echatshazelwe yimbalela.

src: Sena se akga ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha dikgato tsa nako e kgutshwane, e mahareng esita le e telele ho rarolla le ho nolofatsa ditlamorao tse ka etsahalang tsa komello ena.
tgt: Oku kuquka ukufezekiswa kwamanyathelo exesha elifutshane, eliphakathi nelide ukulwa nokuthomalalisa umonakalo onokubangelwa yile mbalela.

src: Mmuso o bokelletse tjhelete ya ho fana ka thuso ya nako e kgutshwane diprofenseng tse amehileng.
tgt: Urhulumente unikezele ngemali yokubonelela ngoncedo lwexesha elifutshane kumaphondo achaphazelekayo.

src: O fane ka dithuso tsa ditjhelete tsa kinolo maqakabetsing tse kaalo ka R473 milione esita le R6 bilione e tla eketswa selemong sa ditjhelete sa 2018/19 ho tlatseletsa meralong ya motheo ya metsi Kapa Bophirimela, Kapa Botjhabela le Kapa Leboya.
tgt: Ubonelele ngoncedo oluxabisa malunga nama-473 zezigidi zeerandi kunye ne-6 seebhiliyoni zeerandi kunyaka-mali wama-2018/19 ukongeza iziseko ezingundoqo zamanzi eNtshona Koloni, Mpuma Koloni naseMntla Koloni.

src: Mmuso o etsa kgoeletso ho bohle ho tswelapele ho sebetsa le mmuso ho bolokeng metsi, ka ho a sebedisa ka boikarabelo le ka paballo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasibongoza sonke ukuba siqhubeke ukusebenzisana norhulumente ekongeni amanzi nokuwasebenzisa ngobunono.

src: Kabinete e dula e ntse e ikitlaelleditse ho etsa Aforika Borwa hore e be naha e tla kgethwa ke baeti le ke botsetedi ka ho tshwanang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihleli izimisele ekwenzeni uMzantsi Afrika ukuba ube lilizwe elithandwayo ngabakhenkethi nabatyali-mali ngokunjalo.

src: Dipolao tsa Mapolesa.
tgt: Ukugetyengwa kwamapolisa.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona ho ba malapa le metswalle ya bahlanka ba bahlano ba sepolesa mmoho le lesole la mehleng, ba sa tswa fenethwa ka sehloho tlhaselong ya Motebo wa Sepolesa wa Ngcobo Kapa Botjhabela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithumela amazwi ovelwano kwiintsapho nezihlobo zamapolisa amahlanu nejoni ebelisidla umhlala-phantsi abathe bagetyengwa ngokumasikizi kuhlaselo olwenzeke kwiSikhululo samaPolisa saseNgcobo eMpuma Koloni.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe polao efe kapa efe ya banna le basadi ba habo rona ba mapolesa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugxeka kabukhali ukugetyengwa kabuhlungu kwamadoda nabasetyhini abasebenzela isizwe.

src: Ho shwa ha mohlanka a le mong wa sepolesa, lesole kapa motho e mong ofe kapa ofe ya sebetsang mosebetsi wa ho tshireletsa kahisano le batho ba habo rona, ha e a amoheleha.
tgt: Ukusweleka kwepolisa elinye, ijoni okanye kwakhe nabani na osebenzela ukukhusela isizwe nabantu bakuthi akwamkelekanga tu.

src: Kabinete e ikitlaeditse, ka Letona la Sepolesa, ho etsa kahohlehohle kamoo e ka kgonang kateng ho matlafatsa metebo ya habo rona ya sepolesa, e le ho thibela ditlhaselo tse jwalo kamoso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi, ngoMphathiswa wezamaPolisa, izimisele ukwenza konke okusemandleni ukuxhobisa izikhululo zethu zamapolisa ukukhusela ukuba lungaphinde lwenzeke uhlaselo olukumila kunje kwixesha elizayo.

src: Kabinete e boela e ipiletsa ho batswadi le setjhaba ka kakaretso ho netefatsa hore bana ba bolokehile ka nako tsohle, esita le ho sebedisana le makala a kenyang molao tshebetsong, ho tshireletsa ditokelo tsa bana ba rona.
tgt: Ukongeza apho iKhabhinethi ibongoza abazali noluntu ngokubanzi ukuba luqinisekise ukuba abantwana basoloko begcinwe bekhuselekile ngalo lonke ixesha kwaye kusetyenziswane nee-arhente zogcino-mthetho ukukhusela amalungelo wabantwana bethu.

src: Mokgwa ofe kapa ofe wa tlhekefetso kgahlanong le ngwana, o tlameha ho pepeswa o be o tlalehwe hanghang.
tgt: Makudizwe naluphi na uhlobo lokuxhatshazwa nokuphathwa gadalala kwabantwana kuze kubikwe kwabezomthetho ngoko nangoko.

src: Ha re sebetsa mmoho, re ka boloka dibaka tsa rona di bolokehile ra ba ra netefatsa hore baetsi ba ditlolo tsa molao ha ba fumane sekoti sa ho ipata.
tgt: Ngokusebenzisana, singagcina iindawo ezihlala abantu bakuthi zikhuselekile kwaye siqinisekise ukuba ulwaphulo-mthetho alunandawo yakuzimela.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete.
tgt: IziGqibo zeKhabhinethi.
