src: Kabinete e ananetse Moralo wa Leano le Lekotsweng Botjha la Pampiri e Tshweu ho tsa Dipalangwang tsa Naha le tla phatlalatswa bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iluphumezile iDrafti eHlaziyiweyo yoMgaqo-nkqubo wezoThutho weSizwe ukuba upapashwe ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: Leano le habile ho fana ka mokgwatsamaiso wa dipalangwang o tlamahanngwang le merero e meng e amanang le lekala ho etsetsa hore ho fokotswe ditjeo tsa ho eta le tsa ho etsa kgwebo.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo ulungiselelwe ukuba uze nenkqubo yezothutho edibeneyo nezinye izicwangciso ezinxulumeneyo zecandelo khona ukuze kuncitshiswe indleko zokukhwela nokuhamba ngezithuthi.

src: Le boela le nyalanya merero ya dipalangwang ya naha ena le ditlwaelo tsa dipalangwang tsa lefatshe lohle.
tgt: Ikwalungelelanisa nezicwangciso zezothutho zelizwe lethu zihambelane nezehlabathi.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Pampiri e Tala Leanong la tsa Mebila la Aforika Borwa, e tla phatlalatswa bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iliphumezile iPhepha loGayo-zimvo loMgaqo-nkqubo woMzantsi Afrika wezeNdlela ukuba upapashwe ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: Leano le fana ka moralo o ka sehloohong o netefatsang hore mebila ya Aforika Borwa e laoleha betetshana, e batla e bolokehile mme e kenyeletsa mefuta yohle ya dipalangwang hore e fane ka mokgwa o tsitsitseng wa bolaodi ba mebila.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo ubonelela ngenkqubo-sikhokelo equka konke ukuqinisekisa ukuba iindlela zaseMzantsi Afrika zilawulwa ngcono, zikhuselekile kwaye ziquka zonke iindidi zezithuthi ukunikezela ngendlela ezinzileyo yokulawulwa kweendlela.

src: Le tataisa melawana ya tsela, meralo ya motheo, polokeho, ditjhelete tsa mebila le dipalangwang tseo e seng makoloi.
tgt: Unika isikhokelo kwimithetho yezendlela, iziseko ezingundoqo, ukhuseleko, inkxaso-mali yezendlela nezithuthi ezingenanjini.

src: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka diphumano tsa Tshekatsheko ya Naha ya Tswelopele ya Diphuputso le Boithutwane (R&D Survey).R&D ke karolo ya bohlokwa ya tswelopele ya moruo wa kahisano naheng ena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikiwe amagqabantshintshi malunga neziphumo zoPhando lweSizwe loPhando-nzulu noPhuhliso loMfuniselo lowama-2015/16 (uPhando lwe-R&D).I-R&D ibaluleke kakhulu kuphuhliso lwezentlalo noqoqosho lweli lizwe.

src: Ana e bile matsapa a kopanetsweng a mmuso, diindasteri le ditheo tsa diphuputso.
tgt: La ibe ngamalinge karhulumente, abezoshishino namaziko ezophando-nzulu.

src: Tlaleho e a fumaneha websaeteng ya Lefapha la Saense le Theknolji (DST) ya: WEBTOKEKabinete e ananetse metako e fapaneng ya lethathama la 2018 la tjhelete ya sehopotso e lewana, le tla hlahiswa ke khamphane ya Minte ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Le ngxelo iyafumaneka kwiwebhusaythi yeSebe lezeNzululwazi nobuChwepheshe: WEBTOKEIKhabhinethi iluphumezile uyilo lweengqekembe zemali ezisisikhumbuzo ezingasasazwayo kuwonke-wonke zowama-2018, nezizakuveliswa yinkampani yokwenza imali yaseMzantsi Afrika, i-South African Mint Company.

src: Pokello ya 2018 ya metako e fapaneng e tla keteka Dilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Nelson Mandela.
tgt: Ezi ngqekembe zowama-2018 ziza kubhiyozela imiNyaka eliKhulu yokuZalwa kukaNelson Mandela.

src: Dipokello tsena di ne di leleketswe ke tjhelete e lewana ya sehopotso ya 2017 e neng e keteka Aforika Borwa tlasa mokotaba wa Tokoloho, Demokrasi le Botjhaba.
tgt: Ezi ngqekembe ziza emva kweengqekembe ezisisikhumbuzo zowama-2017 ezazibhiyozela uMzantsi Afrika phantsi komxholo othi iNkululeko, uLawulo lweNtando yeSininzi neeNkcubeko.

src: Dibili.
tgt: ImiThetho esaYilwayo.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya Lebollo la Setho ya 2018 Palamenteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa koMthetho osaYilwayo weSiko loLwaluko lweSintu wama-2018 ePalamente.

src: Bili e habile ho tshireletsa, ho kgothaletsa le ho laola karolo ya tsamaiso ya lebollo la setho.
tgt: Lo mThetho usaYilwayo uzama ukukhusela, ukukhuthaza nokulawula indima yendlela elenziwa ngayo isiko lolwaluko lwesintu.

src: E fana ka ditlwaelo le maemo a naha, tse reretsweng tshireletso ya bophelo le thibelo ya ditemalo esita le mefuta yohle ya ditlhekefetso tseo babolotsuwa ba di etswang.
tgt: Unika imigangatho yesizwe egxile ekukhuseleni ubomi nokukhusela umonzakalo nazo zonke iindidi zempatho-mbi ezithi zenziwe ebakhwetheni.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya 2016 ya Sehlomathiso sa Moralo wa Naha wa Mangolo a Thuto Palamenteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa koMthetho siHlomelo weNkqubo-sikhokelo wamaBakala eMfundo eSizwe wama-2016 ePalamente.

src: Bili ena, e hlomathisang Molao wa Moralo wa Naha wa Mangolo a Thuto, 2008 (Molao wa 67 wa 2008), e matlafatsa Molao ka ho ntlafatsa dikgato tsa ho sebetsana le maemo a ho se bue nnete, e qobella hore ho be teng ditlamorao bathong ba sa bueng nnete ka mangolo a bona a thuto kapa mekgatlo e ntshang mangolo a thuto a seng molaong.
tgt: Lo mThetho usaYilwayo, nohlomela umThetho weNkqubo-sikhokelo wamaBakala eMfundo eSizwe, wama-2008 (umThetho 67 wama-2008), womeleza lo mThetho ngokuphucula amalinge okusebenza ngemiba yabantu abangathethi nyani nabanika iinkcukacha ezingezizo ngeziqinisekiso zamabakala emfundo yabo, ukubeka izinto eziza kuba ziziphumo emazilindelwe ngumntu othe wanika inkcaza engeyonyani ngeziqinisekiso zamabakala wakhe emfundo okanye imibutho okanye amaqumrhu athi akhuphe iziqinisekiso zamabakala emfundo ezingekho mthethweni.

src: E boela e sisinya hore ho be teng melawana ya ho netefatsa hore mangolo a thuto a boqhekanyetsi a fetisetswa mekgatlong ya seporofeshenale e tshwanelehileng (pokello ya lenane la batho ba sa bueng nnete ka mangolo a bona a thuto).
tgt: Ukwacebisa ngemimiselo yokuqinisekisa ukuba iziqinisekiso zamabakala emfundo zobuqhetseba zithunyelwa kwimibutho elawulwa amacandelo ahlukeneyo efanelekileyo (uluhlu oluneeenkcukhacha zabantu abathe banika inkcaza engeyonyani ngeziqinisekiso zamabakala emfundo yabo).

src: E boela e rarolla taba ya kananelo ya mangolo a thuto a tswang dinaheng tse ding.
tgt: Ikwalungisa nemeko yokugunyaziswa nokuqinisekiswa kweziqinisekiso zamabakala emfundo aphunyelelwe kumazwe angaphandle.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Bili ya 2017 ya Polokeho Ditereneng, e tla phatlalatswa bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba umThetho osaYilwayo ongoKhuselo kooLoliwe wama-2017 ukuba upapashwe ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: Bili e habile ho ntlafatsa polokeho ya ditereneng esita le ho thea lekgotla la tsamaiso le lekolang mosebetsi wa Bolaodi ba Polokeho Ditereneng ba Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lo mThetho usaYilwayo uzama ukuphucula ukhuselo koololiwe nokumisela amaqumrhu olawulo aza kuba liliso eliqwalasela umsebenzi weQumrhu lwaseMzantsi Afrika eliLawula uKhuseleko kooLoliwe.

src: E boetse e amahanngwa le Leano la Naha la Diterene mabapi le ho matlafatsa bodisa ba polokeho, esita le ho kgothaletsa le ho qobella boteng ba polokeho ditereneng tsa rona.
tgt: Ukwahambelana noMgaqo-nkqubo weSizwe wooLoliwe ngokumalunga nokuphuculwa kwendlela olubekwa ngayo esweni ukhuseleko, nokukhuthaza nokunyanzeliswa ukuthotyelwa kwemithetho yezokhuseleko koololiwe.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Moralo wa Bili ya 2017 ya Taolo ya Ditshenyehelo Ditereneng, e tla phatlalatswa bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba le dipuisano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyivumile iDrafti yoLawulo lwezoQoqosho yomThetho osaYilwayo wezoThutho wowama-2017 ukuba upapashwe ukwenzela ukuba uluntu luhlomle futhi lucebise.

src: Bili e rarolla taba ya dikgaello tsa taolo le bokgoni mabapi le phano ya mekgwatsamaiso ya dipalangwang e sa senyeng tjhelete ebile e le e sebetsang ka bokgabane.
tgt: Lo mThetho usaYilwayo uvala izikhewu ezikhoyo ngokwemithetho elawulayo futhi ulungisa nengxaki yokunqongophala kwabantu abanezakhono ezifanelekileyo, izinto ezo ezithi zichaphazele inkqubo yezothutho ziyenze ingakwazi ukusebenza ngokufanelekileyo futhi ingabizi kakhulu.

src: Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: Imisitho Ezayo.

src: Aforika Borwa, e le Modulasetulo, e tla tshwara Seboka sa Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tse ka Borwa ba Aforika (SADC) sa Matona a tsa Bosebetsi, Kgiro le Tshireletso ya Setjhaba, ho tloha ka la 1 ho isa ho la 2 Hlakubele 2018 Setsing sa Diboka tsa Matjhaba sa Motse Kapa (CTICC).
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika, njengoSihlalo, uza kubamba iNgqungquthelaso yabaPhathiswa bezabaSebenzi, ezeNgqesho zezeNtlalo zoLuntu boMbutho woPhuhliso lwaMazwe e-Afrika eseMazantsi (i-SADC), ukusukela ngomhla woku-1 ukuya kowe-2 kweyoKwindla yowama-2018 kwiZiko leeNgqungquthela zamaZwe ngamaZwe laseKapa (i-CTICC).

src: Mookotaba wa seboka o re: “Kgonahalo ya mosebetsi o motle: Ho ntshetsapele bohokahanyi, momahano le ho kenyeletsa ba bangata”.
tgt: Umxholo wale ngqungquthela uthi: “Ithemba lomsebenzi ondilisekileyo: Ukuqhubela phambili uqhagamshelwano, ukunamathelana nokubandakanya wonke umntu”.

src: Ba tla nka seabo ba tla akga balekane ba kahisanong – dikgwebo tse kgolo, tsa bosebetsi hammoho le setjhaba.
tgt: Abathathi-nxaxheba baza kuquka amahlakani kwezentlalo – imibutho yezoshishino, abasebenzi noluntu.

src: Boemong ba hae e le Modulasetulo wa SADC, Moporesidente Ramaphosa o tla kena maetong a dipontshano ho ya Angola, Botswana le Namibia ho tloha ka la 2 ho isa ho la 3 Hlakubele 2018.
tgt: UMongameli uRamaphosa kwisikhundla sakhe njengoSihlalo we-SADC uza kuba notyelelo lokubonsana nokufakana imilomo e-Angola, Botswana naseNamibia ukususela ngomhla we-2 ukuya kowe-3 kweyoKwindla yowama-2018.

src: O tla felehetswa ke Letona la Dikamano le Tshebedisano ya Matjhaba, Lindiwe Sisulu le Letona la Lebotho la Tshireletso le Mekaubere ya Sesole, Nosiviwe Maphisa Nqakula.
tgt: Uza kukhatshwa nguMphathiswa wezobuDlelwane bamaZwe ngamaZwe neNtsebenziswano uLindiwe Sisulu kunye noMphathiswa wezoKhuselo namaGqala eMfazwe uNosiviwe Maphisa-Nqakula.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla tshwara Seboka sa Lefatshe sa bo-17 se mabapi le Kwae kapa Bophelo bo Botle (WCTOH) ho tloha ka la 7 ho isa ho la 9 Hlakubele 2018 Motse Kapa, katlasa mookotaba o reng: “Ho kopanya lefatshe bakeng sa Moloko o Lokolohileng ditlamong tsa Kwae”.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uza kuba ngomnye wabasingathi beNgqungquthela yeHlabathi ye-17 yeCuba okanye iMpilo (i-WCTOH) ukususela ngomhla we-7 ukuya kowe-9 kweyoKwindla yowama-2018 eKapa phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukumanyanisa iHlabathi ukwenzela isiZukulwana esingaChaphazelekiyo kwiCuba”.

src: Sena ke seboka sa pele sa ho tshwarelwa Aforika.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela kokokuqala ukuba isingathwe e-Afrika.

src: WCTOH e etsa kgoeletso ya hore ho be teng kgato ya boitlamo ebile e fana ka lepatlelo la mebuso, mekgatlo ya setjhaba, makgotla a Matjhaba a Kopaneng, mekgatlo ya matjhaba, basebeletsi ba bophelo bo botle le ba bang ba amehang ho okgelana tsebo le ho thakelana malebela, haholoholo mabapi le batjha le basadi ba pepesehileng tshebedisong ya kwae.
tgt: I-WTCOH ifuna ukuba kuthathwe amanyathelo angqingqwa kwaye inika nethuba lokuba oorhulumente, imibutho yoluntu, ii-arhente zeZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN), imibutho yehlabathi, abasebenzi bezempilo nabanye abadlali-ndima ukuba baxoxe ngezinto ezaziwayo ngala mahlakani onke, ngokukodwa ezichaphazela ulutsha nabantu basetyhini abasengxakini yokuhlala nokuphila kwiindawo ezinabantu abatshaya icuba.

src: Ho tshwara seboka ho a thusa mabapi le ho tla le ditharollo tsa sepheo sa Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha ka ho etsa tlhokomediso le thuto ka ditlamorao tse kotsi tsa tshebediso ya kwae, le tlhokeho ya ho matlafatsa dikgato tsa taolo ya kwae.
tgt: Ukusingatha le ngqungquthela kunegalelo ekuhlangabezeni iinjongo zesiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe (i-NDP) kuba ifundisa ngobungozi bokutshaywa kwecuba, nokudingeka kokuqiniswa kwamanyathelo okulawula icuba.

src: Mohla la 10 le 11 Hlakubele, IEC e tla bula Ditsi tsa Boingodiso ba ho Vouta hore batho ba tle ba tlo ingodisa ba be ba hlahlobe dintlha tsa bona tsa boingodiso.
tgt: Ngomhla we-10 nowe-11 kweyoKwindla iKomishoni yoNyulo eziMeleyo (i-IEC) iza kuvula amaZiko okuBhalisela uVoto ukwenzela ukuba abantu bazokubhalisa baze bakhangele neenkcukacha zabo zobhaliso.

src: Kabinete e kopa bakgethi bohle ba tshwanelehileng ho ya diteisheneng tsa bona tsa ho voutela, ho tsoseletsa lenane la bakgethi e le ho hlophisetsa dikgetho tse akaretsang tsa 2019.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza bonke abaselungelweni lokuvota ukuba baye kwizikhululo zabo zokuvota ukuze balungise iinkcukacha zabo zokuvota ukulungiselela unyulo lukawonkewonke lowama-2019.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso, haholoholo ho ba tla be ba vouta lekgetlo la pele, ho netefatsa hore ba ba le seabo tokelong ya bona ya demokrasi ya molaotheo ya ho vouta, ka ho ya ba ilo ingodisetsa ho vouta.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo ngokukodwa kwabo baza kuvota okokuqala ukuba baqinisekise ukuba bathatha inxaxheba kwilungelo labo elikumgaqo-siseko lokuvota ngokuhamba bayokubhalisela ukuvota.

src: Mafelo ana a beke a boingodiso, ke katleho e kgolo mabapi le pheletso ya projeke ya dilemo tse pedi ya ho fumana diaterese tsa bodulo tsa bakgethi bohle ba ingodisitseng.
tgt: Le mpela-veki yobhaliso ibaluleke kakhulu ekuqukunjelweni kwephulo leminyaka emibini yokufumana iidilesi zokuhlala zabo bonke abavoti ababhalisiweyo.

src: Diteishene tsa ho voutela di tla bulwa dipakeng tsa 08:00 hoseng le 17:00 mantsiboya ho thusa bakgethi ba qalang hore ba ingodisetse ho vouta, le ho dumella bakgethi ba seng ba ingodisitse ba falletseng dibakeng tse ding hore ba ingodise botjha diterekeng tsa bona tse nepahetseng tsa ho voutela, ba be ba lokise dintlha tsa diaterese tsa bona lenaneng la bakgethi.
tgt: Izikhululo zovoto ziza kuvulwa phakathi kwentsimbi ye-08:00 neye-17:00 ukuncedisa abantu abaza kuvota okokuqala ukuba babhalisele ukuvota, futhi zinike ithuba nabavoti ababhalisiweyo abazitshintshileyo iindawo zokuhlala ukuba babhalise kwakhona kwizithili zabo zokuvota ezichanekileyo baze balungise neenkcukacha zabo zeedilesi kuluhlu lwabavoti.

src: Melaetsa.
tgt: Imiyalezo.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa matitjhere ohle a ileng a tlotlwa moketjaneng wa Dikgau tsa bo18 tsa Naha tsa Botitjhere, o neng o le Johannesburg ka Moqebelo wa la 17 Hlakola 2018.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibaqhwabela izandla bonke ootitshala abathe bawongwa kumsitho woNikezelo-mbasa wooTitshala weSizwe we-18 nothe waqhubeka eRhawutini ngoMgqibelo, umhla we-17 kweyoMdumba yowama-2018.

src: Dikgau di ne di ananela botitjhere le boetapele bo tswileng matsoho mekgahlelong e fapaneng, ho akga le Kgau ya Katleho ya Bophelo Bohle ya Nelson Mandela, le Kgau ya Moprofesara Kader Asmal.
tgt: Ezi mbasa zihlonipha ukufundisa okugqwesileyo nobunkokheli kumacandelo athile, kuquka nembasa ebizwa i-Nelson Mandelo Lifetime Achievement Award nebizwa i-Professor Kader Asmal Award.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona ho Motlatsi wa Letona Obed Bapela ka ho hlokahallwa ke mofumahadi wa hae Constance Bapela, ya neng a sebeletsa naha e le molekgotla nakong ya ho hlokahala ha hae.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulisa umyalezo wovelwano kuSekela-Mphathiswa u-Obed Bapela ngokushiywa kwakhe yinkosikazi yakhe u-Constance Bapela, nobesebenza njengoceba ngexesha lokusweleka kwakhe.

src: Kabinete e ikamahanya le Moporesidente Ramaphosa ho fetisetseng matshediso ho ba lelapa, metswalle le bomphato ba moikonomi wa sepolotiki ebile e le mongodi, Moprofesara Johannes “Sampie” Terreblanche, ya hlokahetseng a na le dilemo tse Kabinete e thoholetsa Letona Naledi Pandor ho ananelweng ha hae ke Yunivesithi ya Leiden e Netherlands e le Moeti ya Tlotlwang wa Oort wa Moporofesara wa Astronomi le Ntshetsopele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nayo njengoMongameli uRamaphosa ithi akwehlanga lungehlanga kusapho, abahlobo kunye nabo wayesebenza nabo usoqoqosho wezopolitiko nokwangumbhali, uNjingalwazi Johannes “Sampie” Terreblanche, othe wasweleka eminyaka ingama-.

src: Sena se etswa e le kananelo ya katleho e tswileng matsoho eo Letona le e entseng ka ho tlamahanya saense, haholoholo astronomi, e le sesebediswa bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya lefatshe lohle ebile e le molemong wa setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imothulela umnqwazi uMphathiswa uNaledi Pandor ngokwamkelwa yi-Leiden University e-Netherlands njengoNjingalwazi oTyeleleyo oHloniphekileyo we-Oort kwezeNzululwazi ngeeNkwenkwezi noPhuhliso.

src: DithonyoDithonyo tsohle di emetse netefaletso ya mangolo a thuto esita le topollo e tshwanelehileng.
tgt: Oku kweziwa ngokwentlonipho kwimpumelelo engaqhelekanga yokusebenzisa ezenzululwazi, ingakumbi ngeenkwenkwezi, njengesixhobo sophuhliso lwehlabathi nokunceda uluntu.

src: Lerato Mataboge e le Motlatsi wa Molaodi e Moholo (DDG): Kgwebisano le Botsetedi Aforika Borwa, Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Diindasteri (dti).
tgt: UNksz Lerato Mataboge njengoSekela-Mlawuli-Jikelele (i-DDG): uRhwebo noTyalo-mali lwaseMzantsi Afrika, kwiSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino (i-dti).

src: Shandokane Evelyn Masotja e le DDG: Taolo ya tsa Boreki le Dikgwebo tse Kgolo, dti.
tgt: UNksz Shandokane Evelyn Masotja njengo-DDG: kuLawulo lwabaThengi noShishino, kwi-dti.

src: Vuyelwa Vumendlini e le DDG: Leano la Moruo la Matjhaba le Lebatowa, Lefapha la Matlotlo a Setjhaba.
tgt: UNksz Vuyelwa Vumendlini njengo-DDG: kuMgaqo-nkqubo wezoQoqosho weHlabathi noMmandla, kuNondyebo weSizwe.

src: Joseph Tebogo Leshope e le Mohlanka e Moholo wa tsa Tshebetso wa SENTECMof.
tgt: UMnu Joseph Tebogo Leshope njengeGosa eliyiNtloko yoKwenziwa koMsebenzi kwa-SENTECUNksz Vuyo Zitumane njengeGosa eliyiNtloko lesiGqeba (i-CEO) le-Amatola Water.

src: Vuyo Zitumane e le Mohlanka e Moholo wa Phethahatso (CEO) wa Amatola Water.
tgt: U-Adv Seeng Catherine Ntsaba-Letele njengoNozikhalazo oyiNtloko weNkonzo yeZikimu zoLuntu zooNozikhalazo.

src: Moadvokheiti Seeng Catherine Ntsaba-Letele e le Molekodi e Moholo wa Tshebeletso ya Molekodi ya Dikema tsa Setjhaba.
tgt: UMnu Edward Mamadise njenge-CEO yeQumrhu eliLawula iMigaqo esisiNyanzelo yeSizwe.

src: Edward Mamadise e le CEO ya Bolaodi ba Naha ba Ditotobatsuwa tse Tlamang.
tgt: UGq Sagren Moodley njengommeli ovela kwa-DST kwiBhunga lamaKhondo ezeNzululwazi yeNdalo laseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Ngaka Sagren Moodley e le moemedi wa DST Lekgotleng la Diporofeshene tsa Saense ya Tlhaho la Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Ukuqeshwa kwakhona kwiBhodi yoVavanyo lweNto eQanjiweyo:a. UNksz Shanaaz Tiry Mahomedb.

src: Dithonyo botjha ho Boto e Pepeneneng ya Ditlhahlobo:a. Mof.
tgt: UNksz Sandra Cleilandc.

src: Shanaaz Tiry Mahomedb.
tgt: UNjing Christiena Maria van der Bank kunyed.

src: Pehelo ka Kopano ya Kabinete ya la 14 Hlakubele 2018Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, 14 Hlakubele 2018, Tuynhuys, Motse KapaDintlha tsa Maemo a jwale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibihlangene ngoLwesithathu, umhla we-14 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2018, eTuynhuys, eKapaImiba Esematheni.

src: Kgolo ya moruo.
tgt: Uhlumo Loqoqosho.

src: Kabinete e amohela kgolo ya moruo ya 1.3% ka 2017.
tgt: IKahbhinethi iyazamkela indaba ezincumisayo zokuhluma koqoqosho ngesantya esiyi-1.3% ngowama-2017.

src: Sena ke keketseho ya ho tloha ho 0.3% ka 2016.
tgt: Esi santya sinyuke nge-0.3% ngowama-2016.

src: Tshebetso ya moruo tlasa maemo a thata e lepa tse ntle bakeng sa menyetla ya kamoso ya moruo wa naha.
tgt: Le ndlela luqhuba ngayo uqoqosho phantsi kwezi meko zinzima iza kube negalelo elihle kwindlela eliza kuqhuba ngayo kule minyaka izayo.

src: Manane a kgolo ke letshwao la hore moruo o mathuleng a ho phahama, moo Lefapha la Matlotlo a Naha le lebeletseng hore moruo o hole ka 1.5% selemong sena o be o akofele ho 2.1% ka 2020.
tgt: La manani abonakalisa ukuba uqoqosho lweli luyakhula, futhi uNondyebo weSizwe ulindele ukuba lukhule nge-1.5% kulo nyaka, luze lukhule nge-2.1% ngowama-2020.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho makala ohle a setjhaba ho ahella hodima mokoka o motle wa 2017, a be a sebetse le mmuso ho lokisa meralo ya ona hore e be kgato e tiileng ya ho tsitlallela kgolo ya moruo le ho thea mesebetsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kumacandelo ahlukeneyo kweli ukuba akhele kwesi santya sohlumo sowama-2017, asebenzisane norhulumente kutshintshwe izicwangciso zakhe zingabi yimibono nje esephepheni koko zibe ngamanyathelo abonakalayo aza kunceda ukwenza ukuba singehli esi santya sohlumo futhi kudaleke nemisebenzi.

src: Tlhabollo ya Mobu Kabinete e amohela tshisinyo e ananetsweng ya ho hlomathisa Molaotheo wa Riphaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa 1996 bakeng sa ho dumella kamoho ya mobu ntle le ditlhapiso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela esi siphakamiso senziweyo sokuba kutshintshwe uMgaqo-siseko weRiphablikhi yoMzantsi Afrika wowe-1996 wenziwe ukuba ukuvumele ukuthathwa komhlaba ngaphandle kwembuyekezo.

src: Haesale ho tloha ka 1994 mmuso o sebetsa ka matla ho sotholla masalla a ho nkelwa naha tlasa bokoloniale le mmuso wa kgethollo.
tgt: Ukususela ngowe-1994, urhulumente ebesebenza ubusuku nemini ezama ukulungisa intlungu yokuhluthelwa kwabantu umhlaba ngumbuso wobukholoniyali nowocalucalulo.

src: Mmuso, o sebetsa o itshetlehile ka molao, o se o entse boholo ho netefatsa tlhahiso e tswelang pele ya ditswamobung, ha ka nqa e nngwe o akofisa motjha wa ho lokisa botjha bakeng sa ba anngweng ke ho nkelwa mobu.
tgt: Mninzi umsebenzi urhulumente asele ewenzile ukuqinisekisa ukuba umhlaba uyaqhubeka nokuvelisa ukutya ngeli xesha sikhawulezisa amaphulo okubuyisela umhlaba abo bantu babehluthelwe umhlaba.

src: Taba ena e fetiseditswe ho Komiti ya Tjhebobotjha ya Molaotheo, e tlamehang ho tlalehela Palamente ka la 30 Phato 2018.
tgt: Lo mba ugqithiselwe kwiKomiti yokuHlaziya uMgaqo-siseko, yona ekufuneka inike ingxelo ePalamente ngomhla wama-30 kweyeThupha ngowama-2018.

src: Dikgothaletso tse iswang ho Seboka sa Naha di tlasusumetswa ke letoto la dipitso tsa nonyo ya maikutlo a setjhaba tse tla latelwa ke dikopano tsa komiti.
tgt: Izindululo zeNdlu yoWiso-mthetho yeSizwe ziza kusekelwe kwiziphumo zeendibano zokufakana imilomo nokubonisana eziza kubanjwa nolunto, zona eziza kulandelwa zintlanganiso zeekomiti.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho bohle ba amehang hore ba tshwaele nakong ya mothati ona wa dipuisano, o tla tataisa ho utollweng ha ditharollo tse tla ntshetsa naha ya habo rona pele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kuwo onke amahlakani ukuba athathe inxaxheba kwezi ndibano kuba zizo eziza kuza nezisombululo kulo mba.

src: Re lemmuso o tsotellang o bile o sebetsa le batho, bohle ba amehang ba tla kenyeletswa nakong ya mothati ona.
tgt: Njengorhulumente onenkathalo nosekelwe kwintando yoluntu, bonke abachapahzelekayo baza kunikwa ithuba lokuba bavakalise izimvo zabo ngethuba kubanjwe ezi ndibano.

src: Kabinete e boela e kopa setjhaba ho lesa ho inkela mobu ho seng molaong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela noluntu ukuba lahlukane nokungena emihlabeni engeyoyabo ngokungekho mthethweni.

src: Re naha e ikokobeletsang molao ebile e rata kgotso, ka mekgwa e amohelehileng ya ho rarolla diqaka, ho akga le qaka ya mobu.
tgt: Sisisizwe esiwuhloniphileyo umthetho nesithanda uxolo futhi nesineendlela ezifanelekileyo zokusombulula izinto, kuquka nomba womhlaba.

src: Aforika Borwa e dula e butse menyetla bakeng sa kgwebo, mme botsetedi ho tsa temo le bohwai bo amohetswe.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uyaqhubeka nokwenza imisebenzi yawo yemihla ngemihla kwaye utyalo-mali kwezolimo nezokuvula iifama lufunwa ngamehlo abomvu.

src: Ho molemong wa Aforika Borwa hore e be le dihwai tsa kgwebo mme mothati ona o ka netefatsa hore re bile re na le manane a hodimo a dihwai tsa kgwebo tse atlehileng.
tgt: Kubalulekile eMzantsi Afrika ukuba abekho amafama arhwebayo kwaye le nkqubo yokubuyiselwa komhlaba iza kuqinisekisa ukuba liyanda inani lamafama aqhuba kakuhle.

src: Porojeke ya setjhaba sa Nofingxana ya Double Drift Wildlife Economy.
tgt: I-Double Drift Wildlife Economy Project yabantu baseNofingxana.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa ha Porojeke ya setjhaba sa Nofingxana ya Double Drift Wildlife Economy, Serapeng sa Diphoofolo tse Hlaha sa Double Drift Kapa Botjhabela ke Letona la Merero ya Tikoloho, Ngaka Edna Molewa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkelwa ukuphehlelelwa kweDouble Drift Wildlife Economy Project yabantu baseNofingxana eDouble Drift Nature Reserve eMpuma Koloni nguMphathiswa wezeNdalo uGq Edna Molewa.

src: Sena se ne se kenyeleditse ho fana ka lengolo la bonga thepa ho Mokgatlo wa Likhaya Lethu Communal Property (CPA) lebitsong la Letona la Ntshetsopele ya Dibaka tsa Mahae le Tlhabollo ya Mobu, Mofumahadi Maite Nkoana-Mashabane.
tgt: Lo msitho ubuquka ukunikezelwe kwelungelo lobunini-mhlaba kwiLikhaya Lethu Communal Property Association (i-CPA) egameni loMphathiswa woPhuhliso lwamaPhandle noBuyekezo lwemiHlaba, uNksz Maite Nkoana-Mashabane.

src: Setjhaba sa Double Drift se ne se nkelwe ditokelo tsa bodudi le tsa makgulo ke Molao wa Mobu wa 1913.
tgt: Abantu baseDouble Drift bahluthelwa umhlaba wokuhlala namadlelo okutyisa imfuyo nguMthetho weMihlaba wowe-1913.

src: Ka 1994, setjhaba sena se ile sa kenya tseko ya mobu e ileng ya rarollwa ka 2012, moo ho ileng ha thehwa Likhaya Lethu CPLikhaya Lethu CPA e na le ditho tsa Setjhaba sa Double Drift tse 1 500 mme e amohetse R6 milione e tswang Lefapheng la Merero ya Tikoloho, ho ntshetsapele boiteko ba kgwebo ya diphoofolo tse hlaha polasing ya Naudeshoek (1 400 ya dihektara).
tgt: Ngowe-1994, abantu balapha bafaka ibango lomhlaba owathi wabuyiselwa ngowama-2012, into leyo eyabangela ukuba kuswekwe iLikhaya Lethu CPILikhaya Lethu CPA inabantu baseDouble Drift abali-1 500 kwaye bafumene imali ezizigidi ezithandathu zeerandi kwiSebe lezeNdalo yokuba baqalise ishishini elime ngezilwanyana zasendle kwifama iNaudeshoek (ezihektare ezili-1 400).

src: Selekane se ile sa sebetswa ka Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Dibaka tsa Mahae le Tlhabollo ya Mobu.
tgt: Ngethuba kusenziwa yonke le nkqubo yokubuyiselwa kwalo mhlaba bekusetyenziswa iSebe loPhuhliso lwamaPhandle noBuyekezo lweMihlaba.

src: Banka ya VBS Mutual.
tgt: I-VBS Mutual Bank.

src: Kabinete e nketse hloohong tsebiso ya Banka ya Resefe ya Aforika Borwa mabapi le Banka ya VBS Mutual.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivile ngesaziso esenziwe yiBhanki yoMzantsi Afrika enguVimba malunga ne-VBS Mutual Bank.

src: Bohlokomedi bo thontsweng bo tla tshehetsa Banka ya VBS Mutual ho busetsa bokgoni ba yona ba maemo a ditjhelete bo be bo sebetsane le ditabatabelo tsa setjhaba esita le ba kwalletseng tjhelete VBKabinete e dula e ikitlaelleditse ho se tshwaneng le ho fetoleng lekala la tsa dtjhelete ntle le ho beha ditabatabelo tsa ba kwallang tjhelete tlokotsing.
tgt: Lo mgcini ubekiweyo uza kuxhasa i-VBS Mutual Bank itsho ilungise iingxaki zayo zezimali iqhubeleke inikezela ngenkonzo eluntwini kunye nabo bagcinise imali yabo kuyo.

src: Kabinete e amohela letsholo la ‘CEOs Know’ la Brand South Africa, ka tshebedisano le Boetapele ba Kgwebo ba Aforika Borwa, ho phahamisa Aforika Borwa jwaloka sebaka seo ho ka tsetelwang ho sona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isazibophelele kwiphupho layo lokuba icandelo lezimali livuvuleleke kubantu abahlukeneyo futhi liqalise iinguqu, oku kwenzeke ngaphandle kokubeka izimali zabantu ezigcinwe ezibhankini emngciphekweni.

src: Sena se ahella hodima meralo ya rona ya motheo e maemong a hodimo, ka Lebenkele le Rekisang Tsohle la InvestSA, bokgoni ba diphuputso le ntshetsopele, ntlafatso le motheo o tsitsitseng wa tlhahiso ho tshehetsa batsetedi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalamkela iphulo i-‘CEOs Know’ eliqhutywa yiBrand South Africa, ibambisene neBusiness Leadership South Africa (i-BLSA), lokuthengisa uMzantsi Afrika njengelizwe elinamathuba amaninzi otyalo-mali.

src: Dibaka tse ntjha tsa kgolo le tsona di butswe moruong wa mawatle, ho eneji e hlwekileng, moruo o sa senyeng tikoloho le ho phopholetsa kgase ya shale.
tgt: Oku kwakhela kwiziseko ezingundoqo zeli ezikumgangatho wehlabathi ezize neziko elinakho konke, i-InvestSA One-Stop Shop, izakhono zophando-nzulu, uphuhliso nokuqamba izinto ezintsha kunye neziseko zemizi-mveliso zokuxhasa abatyali-zimali.

src: Letsholo lena le kenyeletsa Bahlanka ba Baholo ba Phethahatso (di-CEO) ba tswang dikgwebong tsa dinaha tse ngata empa di tsepame kahara Aforika Borwa, tse thakelanang tsebo ya tsona mabapi le botsetedi bo tswelang pele Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Amacandelo amatsha anamathuba avulelekile kuqoqosho lwaselwandle, kumandla ombane ohlaziyekayo, uqoqosho olungenzi monakalo kwindalo kunye namaphulo okukhangelwa kwesheli-gesi.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa kaofela ka moya wa “Thuma Mina” (Roma Nna) o fokang naha ka bophara hore ba be le seabo sa bona ka ho arolelana dipale tse monate mabapi le ho aha lebitso le letle la naha ya habo rona esita le ho hodisa boipiletso ba yona ba botsetedi.
tgt: Eli phulo liqhutywa ziZikhulu eziPhezulu zeziGqeba (ii-CEO) zeenkampani ezinkulu ezirhweba kwihlabathi ezilapha eMzantsi Afrika apho zithi zibalise ngezinto ezidibana nazo kunye namanye amaqithi-qithi afumanekayo ngokutyala imali eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e e etse hloko taba ya nyewe ya Lekgotla le Phahameng e hlahletsweng ke mekgatlo e mmedi eo e seng ya mmuso mabapi le qeto ya mmuso ya ho tekena ditumellano tsa theko ya motlakase le di-IPP tse Taba ena e tla phethelwa ke Lekgotla le Phahameng ka la 27 Hlakubele 2018.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba mabavuselelwe ngulo moya woku-‘Thuma Mina’ ugqubayo kulo lonke eli, badlale eyabo indima ngokubalisa awabo amabali amnandi ngezinto abagagene nazo ukuze bancedise ekuthengiseni nasekubabazeni eli lizwe lize liqhubeleke nodumo lwalo lokwaziwa njengelizwe elithandwa ngabatyali-zimali.

src: Ka moya wa matla a molaotheo le taelo ya molao, ho tekena ho tjhetjhisitswe.
tgt: INkqubo yokuThenga kubaVelisi boMbane Abazimeleyo (i-IPP).

src: Kabinete e tiisa boikitlaetso ba ho rarolla diqaka tse amanang le mananeo ana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivile ngetyala elifakwe kwiNkundla ePhakamileyo yimibutho engekho phantsi kukarhulumente (ii-NGO) emibini elimalunga nesigqibo sikarhulumente sokutyikitya izivumelwano zee-IPP ezingama-27 zokuthenga umbane.

src: Lenaneo la Phumantsho la Bahlahisi ba Ikemetseng ba Eneji e Hlwekileng ba Matla a Motlakase, le tla netefatsa hore basebedisi naheng ya rona ba fumantshwa eneji e theko e tlase ebile e le e hlwekileng, mme le tla tlisa matsete a hlokehang haholo kwano Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lo mba uza kuqukunjelwa yiNkundla ePhakamileyo ngomhla wama-27 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2018.

src: Diporojeke tsena di tla fana ka mesebetsi ya moshwelella e 61 600, moo 95% ya yona e tla ba ya baahi ba Aforika Borwa, ho tsepamisitswe maikutlo haholo ho batjha.
tgt: Kuba sililizwe elihlonipha umgaqo-siseko kunye nemithetho yeli, ukutyikitywa kwezi zivumelwano kumisiwe.

src: Kabinete e tiisa botjha boikitlaetso ba yona ba selekane se tiileng sa lekala la mmuso le la poraefete ha re ntse re hahamallela mererong ya rona ya kamoso ya diphetoho ho tsa eneji esita le bophelo bo betere bakeng sa bohle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaqinisekisa ukuba izibophelele ekusombululeni iingxaki ezihambelana nezi nkqubo.

src: Sena se a hlokahala ho tlisa botsitso bo batlehang haholo ba maano le bolaodi, le ho baballa boemo ba Aforika Borwa jwaloka sebaka se setle se ka kgethelwang botsetedi ho tsa eneji.
tgt: INkqubo yokuThenga kubaVelisi Abazimeleyo boMbane oHlaziyekayo iza kuqinisekisa ukuba abathengi kweli lizwe bayawufumana umbane ongabizi kakhulu futhi nongenabungozi kokusingqongileyo, kwaye kuza kuzisa utyalo-mali olufunwa ngabomvu eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso a yona a tswang botebong ba pelo ho metswalle le ba malapa a ba ileng ba hlokahala kamora ho tshwarwa ke Listeriosisi, mme e lakaletsa ba ntseng ba hlaphohelwa hore ba fole ka potlako.
tgt: Ezi projekthi ziza kudala imisebenzi esisigxina engama-61 600, futhi kule misebenzi, engama-95% iza kubanjwa ngabemi boMzantsi Afrika, kwaye iza kunikwa ulutsha ikakhulu.

src: Kabinete e kgothatswa ke matsapa a matla a Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle, Setheo sa Naha sa Mafu a Tshwaetsang (NICD) le Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Bophelo bo Botle (WHO) ho kgina kokwanahloko ya listeria hore e se ke ya jaleha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isazibophelele kwizivumelwano ezingqingqwa zentsebenziswano phakathi kukarhulumente necandelo labucala njengoko ngoku singena kwixesha lokusebenzisa iintlobo ezahlukeneyo zombane zale mihla kunye nobomi obungcono babo bonke abantu kweli.

src: Ho tswela pele ho matlafatsa matsapa ana, Letona la Bophelo bo Botle, Ngaka Aaron Motsoaledi, le tla kopana le Lekgotla la Baoki la Aforika Borwa (SANC) ka Labone, mohla la 15 Hlakubele 2018.
tgt: Oku kubalulekile kuba kuza kususa oku kungaqondi nokungaqiniseki kukhoyo ngeyona mithetho iza kulandelwa kweli, kuze kuwugcine uMzantsi Afrika ulilizwe elithandwayo ngabatyali-zimali becandelo lezamandla.

src: Kabinete e ananela kgatelopele e ntle e entsweng mabapi le ho hlwaya le ho kotela sesosa sa ho ropoha ha Listeriosisi ena e bolayang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithi akuhlenga lungehlanga kwizihlobo neentsapho zabo babulewe yi-Listeriosis, kwaye inqwenelela abo balele ngandletyana-nye ngenxa yesi sifo ukuba bachache ngokukhawuleza.

src: Kgato e latetsweng ya ho tloswa ha dihlahiswa tsa dijo tse tswang ditsing tse tharo tsa tshebetso ya nama tsa Enterprise le Rainbow – moo ho kokwanahloko e fumanweng teng – e ne e le nako ya bohlokwa ya ho kgina ho ropoha hona.
tgt: Bangaphezulu kwe-180 abantu abasweleke ngenxa yesi sifo baze babengama-940 abantu abafunyaniswe benesi sifo eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Listeriosisi ke lefu le kotsi empa le ka thibelwang la ba la alafuwa ka katleho ka tshebediso ya diantibayothiki.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwaqhwabela izandla amalinge eSebe lezeMpilo, iZiko lesiSizwe leziFo ezoSulelayo (i-NICD) kunye noMbutho wezeMpilo weHlabathi (i-WHO) okunqanda intsholongwane ye-Listeriosis ukuba yande.

src: Ba kotsing ka ho fetisisa ke basadi ba immeng, masea a manyane haholo, metsofe le batho bao masole a bona a mmele a fokolang haholo.
tgt: Ukuphucula la malinge nangakumbi, uMphathiswa wezeMpilo, uGq Aaron Motsoaledi, uza kuba nentlanganiso neBhunga laBongikazi loMzantsi Afrika (i-SANC) ngoLwesine, umhla we-15 kweyoKwindla kowama-2018.

src: Batho ba bontshang matshwao a feberu, mesifa e opang, ho nyekelwa ke pelo kapa letshollo ba lokela ho ya ngakeng kapa ditliliniking tse haufi hanghang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawubona umsebenzi owenziweyo ekukhangeleni unobangela we-Listeriosis nasekuxeleleni uluntu ngaye.

src: Kabinete e na le tshepo ya hore Aforika Borwa e tla hlola ho ropoha ha lefu lena mme e kopa batho bohle ho lemoha melawana e mehlano ya boipaballo dijong nakong ena:Hatlela ka sesepa le metsi pele o tshwara dijo, le kamora ho sebedisa ntlwanaPhehisisa dijo mme o se ke wa ja dijo tse sa butswang kaha kokwanahloko e shwa ha dijo di butswitseO seke wa tshwara dijo tse tala le tse phehilweng mmohoBoloka dijo motjhesong o nepahetseng mmeEtsa bonnete ba hore dihlahiswa tsohle tsa lebese di hlwekile kapa bonnyane di hakonositswe o be o hlatswe dijo tse sa phehwang ka metsi a hlwekileng a phallang pele o di ja, kapa ka metsi a neng a bedisitswe.
tgt: Ukuyalelwa kweevenkile ukuba ziyeke ukuthengisa ukutya okwenziwa kwimizi-mveliso emithathu yakwa-Enterprise no-Rainbow ehlela iimveliso zenyama – apho intsholongwane ye-Listeriosis ibhaqwe khona – kube linyathelo elikhulu kwimizamo yokuthintela ukunwenwa kwesi sifo.

src: Ba nang le qeaqeo efe kapa efe e amanang le Listeriosisi, ba ka ikopanya le NICD ho 011 386 Ditjhelete tsa dithuso tsa setjhaba.
tgt: Esi sifo sifumaneka ekutyeni saqala ukubonwa ngeyeSilimela ngowe-2017.

src: Kabinete e thasisetsa boikitlaetso ba yona lenaneong la mmuso la thuso ya tsa kahisano, le tsepameng setsiketsing sa dikgato tsa rona tsa phediso ya bofuma ebile le le bohlokwa pusetsong ya seriti sa batho ba habo rona.
tgt: I-Listeriosis sisifo esiyingozi kodwa esithintelekayo esinokunyangwa siphele ngee-antibiotics.

src: Kabinete e kgotsofetse ka hore bakgolamolemo ba dithuso tsa ditjhelete tsa setjhaba ba tla lefuwa ka la 1 Mmesa 2018.Dikarete tsa hajwale tsa SASSA di tla dula di sebetsa ho fihlela ka Tshitwe 2018.
tgt: Abona bantu bahlaseleka lula sesi sifo ngoomama abakhuleleweyo, iintsana, abantu abadala kunye nabantu abanamajoni omzimba angomelelanga.

src: Mothati wa ho fetola dikarete tsa bakgolamolemo o tla etswa ka mokgwa o sa belaetseng ebile e le o sa tlo sitisa ho lefuwa ha ditjhelete tsa dithuso.
tgt: Abantu ababonisa iimpawu zomkhuhlane, izihlunu ezibuhlungu, isicaphu-caphu okanye ukuhambisa mabaye kwagqirha okanye kwiklinikhi ekufutshane.

src: Bakgolamolemo bohle ba tla fumana ditjhelete tsa bona tsa dithuso tsa mmuso ka makala a bona a ditefo a akgang dibanka, Posong ya Aforika Borwa (SAPO) le mabenkeleng a mang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inethemba lokuba esi sifo siza kuliwa sohlulwe kwaye icela abantu ukuba balandele le miqathango mihlanu xa bephethe ukutya:Hlamba izandla ngesepha namanzi phambi kokuphatha ukutya nasemva kokusebenzisa indlu yangaseseUkutya kuphekisise futhi ungakutyi ukutya okungavuthisiswanga njengoko intsholongwane ye-Listeria isifa xa ukutya kuphekisisiweUngaphathi ukutya okukrwada nokuphekiweyo ngexesha elinyeUkutya kugcine kumaqondo obushushu afanelekileyoUqinisekise nokuba zonke iimveliso zobisi zibilisiwe uze ukutya okungaphekwayo ukuhlambe ngamanzi acocekileyo phambi kokuba ukutye okanye ukuhlambe ngamanzi aqale abiliswa.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho ba se nang diakhaonte tsa banka ho leba makaleng a haufi le bona a Poso hore ba ilo bula diakhaonte.
tgt: Abo bangaqinisekanga nge-Listeriosis bangaqhakamshelana ne-NICD ku-011 386 Izibonelelo-mali zikarhulumente.

src: Kabinete e laetse SASSA, mmoho le Tsamaiso ya Dikgokahanyo le Tlhahisoleseding ya Mmuso (GCIS), ho etsa ka hohle kamoo e ka kgonang ka teng ho tsebisa bakgolamolemo bohle ka diphetoho dife kapa dife tse ka bang teng motjheng wa diphetoho tsa ho tloha ho CPS ho ya mmotlolong o motjha o kopantsweng habedi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi ngamalungiselelo esele iwenzile i-Arhente yeziBonelelo zeNtlalo noMhlalapantsi kaRhulumente (i-SASSA) okuqalisa le nkqubo intsha yokubhatala imali yendodla nenkam-nkam ebantwini ngomhla woku-1 kuTshazimpunzi ngowama-2018.

src: Kabinete e dula e ikitlaelleditse ho netefatsa hore mmuso o ikokobeletsa kahlolo ya ConCourt.
tgt: Oku kuhambelana nesigwebo esiwiswe yiNkundla yoMgaqo-siseko (i-ConCourt) esinyanzelise ukuba sandiswe esi sivumelwano sikhoyo ngoku noCash Paymaster Services (u-CPS) siqhube kude kufike umhla wama-31 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2018.

src: Dikantoro tsa SASSA di tla bulwa mme di tla be di le malala-a-laotswe ho sebetsana le dikopo tse ntjha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaphinda iyazibophelela kwelokuba izimisele ukuhambisa izibonelelo-mali zikarhulumente, kuba amaphulo karhulumente okulwa indlala emi ngezi zibonelelo futhi zibuyisela nabantu bakuthi izidima zabo.

src: Kabinete e kopa setjhaba sohle, haholoholo bakgolamolemo le ba malapa a bona, ho ikopanya le SASSA ho 0800 60 10 11 kapa ho etela kantoro e haufi ya SASSA, ha o batla ho tseba haholwanyane.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yanelisekile yindlela aqhuba ngayo amalungiselelo kwaye iqinisekile ukuba imali yenkam-nkam iza kuhlawulwa kubantu bayo ngomhla woku-1 kuTshazimpunzi WEBTOKEN makhadi ka-SASSA akhoyo ngoku aseza kusetyenziswa kude kufike inyanga yoMnga yowama-2018.

src: Kabinete e ikamahanya le Khomishene e Ikemetseng ya Dikgetho (IEC) le Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa ho leboheng maAforika Borwa ohle a arabetseng kgoeletso ya ho ingodisetsa dikgetho kapa ho lokisa dintlha tsa diaterese tsa bona letsholong la bekeng e fetileng la boingodiso ba bakgethi.
tgt: Bonke abantu abafumana imali yenkam-nkam baza kuyifumana imali yabo kwiindawo abaqhele ukuyifumana kuzo, eziquka iibhanki, iPosi yoMzantsi Afrika (i-SAPO) nasezivenkileni ezinkulu.

src: Sena ke mokolokotwane mabapi le boitokisetso ba dikgetho tsa botshelela tsa naha le tsa diporofense tse lebeletsweng ho tshwarwa ka 2019.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonke abo bangenazo ii-akhawunti zebhanki ukuba baye kwiPosi yoMzantsi Afrika ekufutshane nabo bayokuvula i-akhawunti.

src: Kapa Botjhabela e bile le boemo bo phahameng ba boingodiso ka 87%, ha latela Freistata hanyane ka hodima 82%, le KwaZulu-Natal, Limpopo le Kapa Leboya ka 79% ka tatelano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalele u-SASSA kunye neZiko lezoNxibelelwano nokuSasazwa koLwazi lukaRhulumente (u-GCIS), ukuba benze konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuba abantu abamkela imali yenkam-nkam bayaziswa ngotshintsho olunokuthi lwenzeke ngeli thuba kutshintshwayo kwinkqubo yangaphambili yokusebenzisa u-CPS kusiwa kule intsha.

src: IEC e tlalehile hore jwale lenane la bakgethi le na le bakgethi ba 26 250 939, e leng se ka lekanang le 75% ya batho ba nang le tokelo ya ho kgetha, ho itshetlehilwe hodima dikgakanyong tsa Lefapha la Dipalopalo la Aforika Borwa (StatsSA) tsa dilemo tsa baahi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela abantu ngokubanzi, ingakumbi abo bamkela imali yenkam-nkam kunye neentsapho zabo, ukuba baqhakamshelane no-SASSA kule nombolo: 0800 60 10 11 okanye baye kwi-ofisi ka-SASSA ekufutshane ukuze bafumane ulwazi oluthe vetshe.

src: Baahi ba ka bang 300 000 ba etetseng diteishene tsa ho voutela, ba hara bakgethi ba ka fihlang ho milione bao IEC e neng e se na diaterese tsa bona pele ho mafelo ao a beke ya boingodiso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nayo njengeKhomishini eziMeleyo yoNyulo (i-IEC) kunye noMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa ibabulela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika abalisabeleyo ikhwelo lokuba baphume ngobuninzi babo baye kubhalisela uvoto okanye baye kulungisa iinkcukacha zedilesi zabo kwiphulo lale veki iphelileyo lokubhalisela uvoto.

src: Lenane la bakgethi le lokisitsweng ebile e le le nepahetseng le tiisa tshepahalo ya lenane la bakgethi mme le matlafatsa demokerasi ya rona ka ho netefatsa dikgetho tse lokolohileng, tse hlokang leeme ebile e le tse tshepahalang.
tgt: Eli linye lamanqanaba abalulekileyo kumalungiselelo onyulo lukazwelonke nolwamaphondo oluza kubanjwa ngowama-2019.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ohle a sa kgonang ho etela diteishene tsa ona tsa ho voutela mafelong a fetileng a beke, ho etela kantoro e haufi ya IEC ho ya netefatsa esita le ho lokisa diaterese tsa ona.
tgt: Abantu abazizi-2 767 139 bebonke baye kwizikhululo zovoto kule mpela-veki igqithileyo.

src: Ka nqa e nngwe, sesebedisuwa sa IEC sa inthanete ho WEBTOKEN le app ya yona, di dula di fumaneha ka dihora tse 24 ka letsatsi bakeng sa bakgethi ba ingodisitseng ho lekola le ho lokisa dintlha tsa diaterese tsa bona.
tgt: Kubantu abangaphezulu kwizigidi eziyi-2.76 abaye kwizikhululo zovoto:Abangaphezulwana nje kwizigidi eziyi-1.3 babhalisile kwakhona kwizithili zovoto zabo ngokuAbangaphezulu kwama-800 000 batshintshe izithili zovoto ababebhalise kuzo ngaphambili babhalisa kwezitshaAbantu abamalunga nama-500 000 ibingabavoti abaza kuvota okokuqalaKwaba bantu baza kuvota okokuqala, ama-82% ngabantu abaneminyaka yobudala engaphantsi kwama-30 futhi abamalunga nama-54% ibingabantu basetyhiniAbantu abaninzi ababebhalisa okokuqala ibingabephondo laseGauteng.

src: Kabinete e ikamahanya le Letona la Dipapadi le Boithapollo, Mofumahadi Thokozile Xasa, mabapi le ho tshwela ka mathe ketso ya bosoto ya tlhaselo kgahlanong le moatlelete ya motjha dilemong, Mhlengi Gwala, ya hlasetsweng ka sakga ya difate ha a ntse a palame baesekele KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Bebeyi-23.69%, baze balandelwe ngabephondo laKwaZulu-Natal bona abebeyi-18.78%, kuze iLimpopo yona ibinabantu abayi-17.03%.

src: Kabinete e lakaletsa moatlelete enwa hore a fole ka potlako mme e fetisetsa diteboho tse mofuthu ho moifo wa bongaka wa Sepetlele sa St Augustine o ntseng o mo hlokometse.
tgt: Iphondo laseMpuma Koloni belinabona bantu baninzi bebephumile ukuyobhalisa.

src: Ditlolo tsa molao ha di na sebaka setjhabeng sa habo rona mme Kabinete e ipiletsa ho badudi ho sebetsa mmoho le makala a qobello ya molao hore ho tshwarwe batlodi ba molao.
tgt: Bebeyi-87%, baze balandelwe ngabaseFreyistatha bona abebengaphezulwana nje kwi-82%, ize iKwaZulu-Natal, Limpopo kunye noMntla Koloni zona zibe ne-79%.

src: Komello e tsebahatswa e le koduwa ya naha.
tgt: Abantu abebephumile baya kubhalisa kwiphondo laseGauteng bebeyi-67.3%.

src: Tlasa boetapele ba Letona la Kopanelo ya Mmuso le Merero ya Botjhaba Zweli Mkhize, mmuso o tsebahaditse boemo ba naha ba koduwa ho sebetsana le bothata ba naha ba komello le metsi.
tgt: I-IEC inike ingxelo ethi umqulu woluhlu lwabavoti ngoku unabavoti abazizi-26 250 939, into leyo ethetha ukuba le yi-75% yabantu bebonke abanelungelo lokuvota.

src: Kabinete e fetisetsa kananelo ya yona ho bao ba tswelang pele ho boloka metsi ka hara Aforika Borwa, esita le matsapa a sa sisinyeheng a entsweng ke Komiti ya Matona a Kopaneng e mabapi le Komello, hammoho le ba amehang makaleng ohle a mmuso le a setjhaba, mabapi le ho sebetsana le maemo a sa sutheng a komello a thefutseng dikarolo tse ngatanyana tsa naha.
tgt: La manani asekelwe kuqikelelo lweziko lezeeNkcukacha-manani zoMzantsi Afrika (i-StatsSA) lwabantu abakwiminyaka ekuvumelayo ukuvota.

src: Ntle le taba ya hore Aforika Borwa ke naha e haellwang ke metsi, Kabinete e kgodisehile hore re dula re ntse re le sebaka se ratwang ke bahahlaudi.
tgt: Abemi beli abangama-300 000 abaye kwizikhululo zovoto bayinxalenye yabavoti abaphantse babe zizigidi eziyi-2.8 i-IEC ibingenazo iidilesi zabo phambi kwale mpela-veki yobhaliso.

src: Sepheo sa FIP ke ho ntlafatsa maano a tsa ditjhelete le botsetedi a Dinaha tseo e leng Ditho, hore di tsamaisane le merero ya SADSena se tla netefatsa hore diphetoho dife kapa dife maanong a tsa ditjhelete le botsetedi Naheng e le nngwe eo e leng Setho ha di tlise diphetoho tse sa batleheng ho Dinaha tse ding tseo e leng Ditho.
tgt: Umqulu woluhlu lwabavoti oneenkcukacha ezichanekileyo wenza ukuba umqulu woluhlu lwabavoti uthembakale kwaye oku kudlala indima enkulu ukuphucula ulawulo lwethu lwentando yesininzi ngokuqinisekisa ukuba kukho unyulo olukhululekileyo, olungenzi makhwiniba futhi noluthembakeleyo.

src: Dihlomathiso tsena di habile ho baballa tokelo ya mebuso ya ho laola dintho molemong wa setjhaba, esita le ho tsitsisa ditokelo le ditshwanelo tsa batsetedi le mebuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika abangakhange bakwazi ukuya kwizikhululo zovoto zabo kule mpela-veki igqithileyo ukuba baye kwi-ofisi ye-IEC ekufutshane nabo baye kuqinisekise futhi balungise iinkcukacha zedilesi zabo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tekwa ha Melawana e Boemong bo Tlase e Shebilweng Botjha ya ba ya Rehwa Botjha ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) bakeng sa Tshwaro e Ntle ya Batshwaruwa (“Melawana ya Nelson Mandela”), Palamenteng.
tgt: Kungenjalo, abo babhalisileyo bangasebenzisa iwebhusayithi ye-IEC eyile: WEBTOKEN nanina ukujonga nokulungisa iinkcukacha zabo zedilesi.

src: Ho rehwa botjha ha Melawana ya Boemo bo Tlase ya “Melawana ya Nelson Mandela” ho tlotla lefa la Moporesidente wa rona wa mehleng, ya qetileng dilemo tse 27 tjhankaneng.
tgt: Iminqweno emihle kwimbaleki uMhlengi Gwala.

src: Ho boetse ho bile le katoloso ya lefatshe ka bophara ya lepatlelo la Letsatsi la Matjhaba la Nelson Mandela, le hlomphuwang ke Dinaha tseo e leng Ditho tsa UN, ka la 18 Phupu, ho phahamisa maemo a botho a botshwaruwa, ho matlafatsa tlhokomediso mabapi le batshwaruwa hore ke karolo ya setjhaba esita le ho tlotla mosebetsi wa basebeletsi ba ditjhankana e le tshebeletso ya kahisano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nayo njengoMphathiswa wezeMidlalo noLonwabo, uNksz Thokozile Xasa, ibugxibha kabukhali ubundladiya nobundlavini obenziwe kwimbaleki eselula yeentlobo ezahlunekeyo zombaleko uMhlengi Gwala ngokuthi ahlaselwe ngesarha yetsheyina ngethuba ekhwele ibhayisekile kwiphondo laKwaZulu-Natal.

src: Melawana ena e tla thusa Aforika Borwa ho akofisa diphetoho tse mabapi le tsamaiso ya batho ya ntshetsopele ya tshokollo ya batshwaruwa e tsamaisanang le dipehelo le ditataiso tse fapafapaneng tsa matjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inqwenelela le mbaleki ukuba ichache ngokukhawuleza kwaye ibulela nakoogqirha base-St Augustine Hospital abamnyangayo.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Bili ya Thibelo le Twantsho ya Ditlolo tsa Molao tsa Lehloyo le Puo ya Lehloyo ya 2018 hore e tekwe Palamenteng.
tgt: Ulwaphulo-mthetho alwamkelekanga kwaphela kweli lizwe kwaye iKhabhinethi icela uluntu ukuba lusebenzisane nee-arhente zogcino-mthetho kuzingelwe ezi zigila-mkhuba zibanjwe.

src: Bili e habile ho bopa ditlolo tsa molao tsa lehloyo le puo ya lehloyo, esita le ho kenya tshebetsong mekgwa ya ho thibela le ho lwantsha ditlolo tsena tsa molao.
tgt: Phantsi koMphathiswa woLawulo lweNtsebenziswano nezeMicimbi yeMveli, uMnu Zweli Mkhize, urhulumente uye wabhengeza ngokusesikweni ukuba sikwisimo yentlekele yesizwe ukuze sikwazi ukulwa ingxaki yembalelo nokunqogophala kwamanzi.

src: E rerile ho sebetsana le dikgoka kgahlanong le batho ka lebaka la kgethollo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibulela ngokungazenzisiyo kwabo bantu eMzantsi Afrika baqhubekayo nokonga amanzi kwakunye nomsebenzi omhle kakhulu owenziwe yiKomiti yabaPhathiswa eJongene noMba weMbalela, kunye nawo onke amahlakani kuwo onke amaqoqo karhulumente nakwisizwe ngokubanzi, wokulwa nale mbalela ingapheliyo ithwaxa indawo ezithile kweli.

src: E tla boela e fana ka tshusumetso ditshwanelong tsa Aforika Borwa ho ya ka disebedisuwa tsa matjhaba tsa ditokelo tsa botho.
tgt: Ngaphandle kokuba uMzantsi Afrika ulilizwe elinengxaki yokunqongaphala kwamanzi, iKhabhinethi iqinisekile ukuba siselilizwe elithandwa kakhulu ngabakhenkethi.

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Bili ya Setheo sa Naha sa Boitsebelo ba Inthanete sa iKamva (iNeSI) ya 2018 hore e kenngwe Palamenteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba isiVumelwano esiLungisa isiHlomelo 1 (iNtsebenziswano kwezoTyalo-mali) sesiVumelwano soMbutho woPhuhliso lwaMazwe aseMazantsi e-Afrika (i-SADC) seziMali noTyalo-mali (i-FIP) masithiwe thaca ePalamente ukuze siqinisekiswe ngokusesikweni.

src: Bili e fana ka ho thehwa ha iNeSI jwaloka setheo se molaong se nang le boetsamolao boo e leng ba sona ho sebetsana le diphephetso tsa bokgoni ba boitsebelo ba inthanete (boitsebelo ba dijithale) ka hara naha.
tgt: Injongo ye-FIP kukulungelelanisa imigaqo-nkqubo yezimali neyotyalo-mali yaMazwe angamaLungu e-SADC ukuze ihambelane neenjongo eziphambili ze-SADOku kuza kuqinisekisa naluphi na utshintsho kwimigaqo-nkqubo yezezimali neyotyalo-mali olwenziwe lelinye iLizwe eliliLungu alunyanzelise ukuba kwenziwe utshintsho olungafunekiyo kwimigaqo-nkqubo yamanye amaZwe angamaLungu.

src: Ntshetsopele ya bokgoni ba boitsebelo ba inthanete e nkuwa e le e nngwe ya dintlha tse ka sehloohong tsa mmuso mabapi le ho aha moruo o kenyeletsang bohle, esita le ho thea naha e nang le bokgoni ebile e le e tswelang pele.
tgt: Ezi zilungiso zilungiselelwe ukukhusela ilungelo loorhulumente lokumisela imithetho eza kuba lunceda kubantu belo lizwe, futhi nokuqinisekisa ukuba amalungelo noxanduva lwabatyali-zimali nawoorhulumente ayahambelana.

src: INeSI e tla sebetsa jwaloka sethusi sa tshebedisano le diphetoho, bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya boitsebelo ba dijithale le bokgoni ba ditlhophiso ka hara naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba kungeniswe ePalamente imiThetho eyiYona isiSiseko eHlaziyiweyo neThiywe ngokuTsha yeZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) yeNdlela yokuPhathwa kwamaBanjwa (“iMithetho kaNelson Mandela”).

src: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Bili ya Dibopeho tsa Metsing ya 2018 hore e lelekelwe Palamenteng.
tgt: Ukunikwa igama elitsha kwemiThetho eyiYona isiSeko kuthiwe “yiMithetho kaNelson Mandela” kuhlonipha igama nemisebenzi yalowo wayenguMongameli, futhi nowachitha iminyaka engama-27 ethothoza entolongweni.

src: Bili e habile ho ananela le ho fana ka maemo a ketsamolao Kantorong ya Setsebi sa Dibopeho tsa Metsing, eo esale e le teng ka hara Lefapha la Lebotho la Tshireletso (Lebotho la Lewatleng la Aforika Borwa) haesale ho tloha tshimolohong ya ditshebeletso tsa dibopeho tsa metsing ka hara Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Wongeziwe umxholo woSuku lweHlabathi lukaNelson Mandela, olubhiyozelwa ngaMazwe angamaLungu e-UN rhoqo ngomhla we-18 kweyeKhala, ukuba ngoku uquke ukulwela ukuphucula iimeko amabanjwa agcinwa phantsi kwazo ezintolongweni, ukufundisa amabanjwa ngokubaluleka kokuthatha inxaxheba kwizinto ezenziwa luluntu kunye nokuhlonipha nokuxabisa umsebenzi wabantu abasebenze ezintolongweni uthathwe njengokuba ngumsebenzi wenkonzo yezentlalo.

src: E tla thusa Setsebi sa Dibopeho tsa Metsing sa Lebotho la Lewatleng la Aforika Borwa ho ananelwa jwaloka Setsebi sa Naha sa Dibopeho tsa Metsing.
tgt: Le mithetho iza kunceda uMzantsi Afrika ukuba ulikhawulezise iphulo lawo leenguqu ezifuna ukufikelela kwinkqubo yezoluleko yokuphuhlisa ehambelana nemigaqo nemimiselo yehlabathi.

src: Diketsahalo tse tlang.
tgt: ImiThetho eYilwayo.

src: Kgwedi/Letsatsi la Ditokelo tsa BothoMekete ya sehopotso sa Kgwedi/Letsatsi la Naha la 2018 la Ditokelo tsa Botho e tla tshwarwa tlasa mokotaba o reng: “Selemo sa Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela: ho phahamisa le ho tebisa tlwaelo ya ditokelo tsa botho setjhabeng ka bophara”.Ketsahalo ena ya naha e tla tshwarwa ka la 21 Hlakubele 2018 Lebaleng la Kirikete la George Thabe, Sharpeville ho la Vereeniging.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho oYilwayo wowama-2018 wokuThintela nokuLwa uLwaphulo-mthetho lweNtiyo neNtetho yeNtiyo.

src: Kabinete e kopa makala ohle ho hlompha letsatsi lena la Naha, le ketekang setso sa ditokelo tsa botho sa Aforika Borwa esita le ho tlotla batho ba kang Madiba ya ileng a intsha sehlabelo molemong wa phihlello ya topollo le tokoloho tseo re nang le tsona kajeno.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uneenjongo zokwenza ukuba ulwaphulo-mthetho oluphenjelelwe yintiyo nentetho yentiyo luthathwe njengetyala, kunye nokumisela amanyathelo okuthintela nokulwa ezi ntlobo zamatyala.

src: Beke ya Naha ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo ya ImbizoBeke ya Naha ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo ya Imbizo e tla ba ho tloha ka la 9 ho isa ho la 15 Mmesa 2018 tlasa mokotaba o reng: “Re le mmoho re Ntshetsa Aforika Borwa Pele”.
tgt: Ulungiselelwe ukulwa ingxaki yobundlobongela obenziwa ebantwini kuba becalulwa.

src: Monongwaha, Mokete wa Dilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Mandela o bopa karolo e kgolo ya beke ya tsepamiso ya maikutlo, tlasa mookotaba o monyane o reng: “E ba karolo ya lefa”.
tgt: Uza kusabela ngqo kuxanduva loMzantsi Afrika olunikwe ngokwemithetho nemigaqo-nkqubo yehlabathi yamalungelo oluntu.

src: Kgiro ya Batjha Moporesidente Ramaphosa o lebeletswe ho thakgola bopulamadiboho ba kgato ya Ditshebeletso tsa Kgiro ya Batjha Setsing sa Thuthuhiso ya Dikgwebo sa Riversands ho la Diepsloot ka la 27 Hlakubele 2018.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba ungeniswe ePalamente uMthetho oYilwayo wowama-2018 weZiko leSizwe lezaKhono zobuChwepheshe i-iKamva (i-INeSI).

src: Kgato ena, ka tshebedisano le lekala la poraefete, e habile ho matlafatsa batjha ba milione dilemong tse hlano tse tlang hore ba kene kgabong ya moruo, mohlomong e le ditho tsa setlamo sa basebetsi kapa ba itsamaisetsa dikgwebo tseo e leng tsa bona kapa ba iphumanele tjantjello ya seo ba ratang ho ntshetsa dithuto tsa bona pele ka sona.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo unika amagunya okuba kumiselwe i-iNeSI njengequmrhu elisemthethweni elinemithetho yalo elilawulayo ukuze kungenelelwe kule ngxaki yokunqongophala kwezakhono zale mihla zobuchwepheshe kweli lizwe.

src: Maeto a tshebetso ho ya Mozambique le ZimbabweMoporesidente Ramaphosa o tla nka maeto a tshebetso ho ya Riphaboliking ya Mozambique le Riphaboliking ya Zimbabwe ka tatelano, ka Moqebelo wa la 17 Hlakubele 2018.
tgt: Ukuphuhliswa kwezakhono zobuchwepheshe kubonwa njengomnye wemiba ekhokeliswe phambili ngulurhumente kumalinge okwakha uqoqosho oluxhanyulwa ngumntu wonke, kunye nokwakha urhulumente onezakhono nogxininisa kuphuhliso.

src: Maeto ana a tla tsepamisa maikutlo matlafatsang ya dikamano tsa dinahapedi le dinaha tse qollotsweng ka hodimo mona.
tgt: I-iNeSI iza kusebenza njengequmrhu lesizwe elikhokela utshintsho, kumaphulo okuxhobisa abantu namasebe karhulumente ngezakhono zobuchwepheshe bale mihla.

src: Moporesidente o tla boela a thaka maikutlo ka dintho tse amanang kgotso le polokeho ka hara lebatowa esita le kontinenteng, a boele a tshohle ka dintlha tsa lefatshe tse molemong wa dinaha tsena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho oYilwayo wowama-2018 weNzululwazi ngeeMeko zaseLwandle, i-Hydrography.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Ntsiki Biyela, Mosadi wa pele wa motho e motsho wa Aforika Borwa wa serathodi sa veine ya thakgotseng veine ya letshwao la hae la boitsebahatso.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo wenzelwe ukunika i-Ofisi yeNgcali yoMkhosi ngeeMeko zaseLwandle, i-Hydropher, isidima negunya elisemthethweni.

src: Jwalokaha a na le lengolo la kgerata ya tsebo ya thitelo ya veine la Yunivesithing ya Stellenbosch hammoho le malebela a dilemo tse 13 a sebetsa, ka 2018 Diveini tsa hae tsa Aslina di tla rekisa dibotlolo tse 12 000 Dinaheng tse Kopaneng tsa Amerika, Jeremane, Taiwan le Ghana.
tgt: Le Ofisi iyinxalenye yeSebe lezoKhuselo (kuMkhosi woMzantsi Afrika waseLwandle) yabakho oko eMzantsi Afrika kwaqaliswa ngeenkonzo zenzululwazi ngeemeko zaselwandle.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa Caster Semenya ka ho roba rekoto ya Aforika Borwa ya 1 000m ya dilemo tse 35 mabelong a Athletix Grand Prix a neng a tshwaretswe Tuks ho la Pretoria.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uza kwenza iNgcali yoMkhosi yeeMeko zaseLwandle yoMkhosi waseLwandle woMzantsi Afrika ukuba yaziwe futhi ihlonitshwe njengeNgcali yoMkhosi yeSizwe yeeMeko zaseLwandle.

src: Thope ya rona ya pabala e hapile lebelo leo ka nako ya 2:35:44, a hlola rekoto ya kgale ya 1983 ya Ilze Wicksell ka metsotswana e ka bang e mmedi.
tgt: Uza kuqinisekisa ukuba umsebenzi wecandelo leenkonzo zenzululwazi ngeemeko zaselwandle waziswa ngokusesikweni futhi ubhaliswa ngokusemthethweni.

src: Kabinete e boela e thoholetsa Semenya ka ho fihlella peelo ya hae ya nako e telele ya ho fumana mangolo a thuto a yunivesithi, ha a ne a phethela lengolo la hae la Diploma ho tsa Saense ya Dipapadi Yunivesithing ya Leboya Bophirima ho la Potchefstroom.
tgt: Oku kuhambelana nemigaqo yoMbutho weHlabathi wezaseLwandle (i-IMO) kunye nesiVumelwano seHlabathi sokuKhuselwa kwaBantu eLwandle, esisisivumelwano sehlabathi ngemiba yaselwandle esinika imiqathango nezikhokelo emazilandelwe zokhuseleko xa kusakhiwa iinqanawa nezixhobo ezisetyenziswa kwiinqanawa ezirhweba elwandle kwakunye nendlela ezisetyenziswa ngayo.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona ho metswalle le ba lelapa ba Setho se Hlomphehang sa Palamente, Mofumahadi Loliwe Fazeka, ya hlokahaletseng kotsing ya koloi Kapa Botjhabela, bekeng e fetileng.
tgt: INyanga/uSuku lwamaLungelo oLuntuImibhiyozo yeNyanga/yoSuku leSizwe lwamaLungelo oLuntu iza kubanjwa phantsi komxholo othi: UNyaka kaNelson Rolihlahla Mandela: ukukhuthaza nokubethelela uthando lwamalungelo oluntu kwisizwe siphela”.Umsitho wesizwe uza kubanjwa ngomhla wama-21 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2018 eGeorge Thabe Cricket Pitch, eSharpeville eVereeniging.

src: Kabinete e boela e fetisa matshediso a yona ho baratuwa ba Lenqosa la Aforika Borwa naheng ya Sweden, Mofumahadi Faith Radebe, ya hlokahetseng ka Labobedi, mohla la 13 Hlakubele 2018.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kuye wonke umntu ukuba aluhloniphe olu suku.

src: DithonyoDithonyo tsohle di emetse ho netefatswa ka mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang ya tlhathlobisiso.
tgt: Olu suku lubhiyozela imizamo namalinge enziwe nguMzantsi Afrika ukulwela amalungelo oluntu kwaye luhlonipha amaqhawe afana noMadiba namanye awawayo anikela ngobomi bawo esilwela le nkululeko siyixhamlayo namhlanje.

src: Ngaka Philemon Mjwara e le Motsamaisi-Kakaretso wa Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji bakeng sa konteraka e ekeditsweng ya dilemo tse tharo, ho tloha ka la 1 Mmesa Mofumahadi Memme Sejosengwe e le Mongodi-Kakaretso Kantorong ya Moahlodi e Moholo bakeng sa konteraka e ekeditsweng ya dilemo tse tharo, ho tloha ka la 1 Mmesa Mofumahadi Thuli E Radebe, e le Motsamaisi wa Phethahatso Setsing sa Ntlafatso ya Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba bakeng sa konteraka e ekeditsweng ya dikgwedi tse tsheletseng.
tgt: IVeki yeSizwe yokuGxininisa kwiiMbizoIVeki yeSizwe yokuGxininisa kwiiMbizo iza kubanjwa ukusuka ngomhla wesi-9 ukuya kowe-15 kuTshazimpunzi kowama-2018 phantsi komxholo othi: “Sisonke siqhubela uMzantsi Afrika phambili”.

src: Monghadi Thilivhali Archibald Ramawa jwaloka Mohlanka e Moholo wa tsa Ditjhelete wa Setheo sa Naha sa Mehlodi ya Ditaba tsa Elektroniki sa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Kulo nyaka, iveki yokugxininisa kwiimbizo iza koyama kakhulu kumbhiyozo wemiNyaka eliKhulu yokuZalwa kukaMandela, phantsi komxholo othi: “Yiba ngumzekelo wemisebenzi yakhe”.

src: Boto ya Sentech SOC Limited:a. Monghadi Magatho Mello (o thontswe hape e le Motsamaisi le Modulasetulo eo e seng wa Phethahatso)b. Monghadi Lumko Mthimde (o thontswe hape e le Motsamaisi eo e seng wa Phethahatso)c. Ngaka Sandile Malinga (Motsamaisi eo e seng wa Phethahatso) led.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nooSekela-Baphathiswa baza kubamba iindibano zokufakana imilomo nokubonisana noluntu kwiindawo ezahlukeneyo kweli lizwe.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro mohla la 25 Mmesa 2018, Tuynhuys, Motse KapaDitaba tsa Tikoloho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibibambe intlanganiso ngoLwesithathu, umhla wama-25 kuTshazimpunzi ngowama-2018 eTuynhuys, eKapaImiba EnguNdaba-mlonyeni.

src: Mapato a baitseki le mekaubere.
tgt: Imingcwabo yamagqala nezidwangube.

src: Kabinete e leboha batho bohle lefatsheng ka bophara, haholoholo maAforika Borwa, ka karabelo ya bona e mofuthu ebile e le mosa nakong ya ho hlokahala ha ‘imbokodo’ Mama Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, Moitseki wa ntwa ya tokoloho Ngaka Zola Skweyiya le moetapele wa mokgatlo wa basebetsi Archie Sibeko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibamba ngazibini kubo bonke abantu behlabathi, ingakumbi abemi boMzantsi Afrika ngokuthumela amazwi ovelwano, baphume ngendlu baye kukhusa imiqolo bekhunga esi sizwe ngethuba kuwe umth'omkhulu, imbokodo ngokwayo, uMama Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, ingwevu yaseMaNtakwendeni nekwaligqala loMzabalazo, uGq Zola Skweyiya kunye netshantliziyo elalilwela amalungelo abasebenzi u-Archie Sibeko.

src: Baitseki ba rona ba nyehetse maphelo a bona boikitlaetsong ba Aforika Borwa e ntlafetseng, mme banna le basadi ba naha ya rona ba kgothatswa ba bile ba susumetswa ke ditshotleho tsa bona.
tgt: Ezi ngangalala zanikela ngobomi bazo kwidabi lokulwela uMzantsi Afrika ongcono kwaye umlisela nomthinjana weli baqamela futhi befunda lukhulu kwimisebenzi yabo.

src: Kabinete e boetse e ikamahanya le Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa ho iseng hlompho ho mofu Mokaubere wa modiplomate, Moambasadara George Nene, ya sebeleditseng Aforika Borwa ka bokgabane le boitelo nakong ya hae ya ha a ne a le palehong, ho ngoka lebatowa le kontinente ya rona ho netefatsa tokoloho ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nayo njengoMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa imothulela umnqwazi unkonka kwezozakuzo nongasekhoyo, uNozakuzaku uGeorge Nene, osebenzele eli lizwe ngokuzinikela futhi enomsebenzi ongenachaphaza ngethuba eselubhacweni etyhutyha lo mmandla neli lizwekazi liphela ehambisa ivangeli yomzabalazo wenkululeko yoMzantsi Afrika.

src: Biopelaetso ba Leboya Bophirima.
tgt: Izidube-dube zaseMntla Ntshona.

src: Kabinete e sekasekile boemo bo hlokang botsitso bo ropohileng Leboya Bophirima, bo ammeng ditshebeletso tse ngatanyana, haholoholo ditshebeletso tsa bophelo bo botle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyigwadlile imeko emaxongo eyambethe iphondo laseMntla Ntshona, echaphazele ukuhanjiswa kweenkonzo ezininzi, ingakumbi iinkonzo zezempilo.

src: Jwaloka mmuso o tsotellang, Kabinete e ananetse mehato e mmedi ya hanghang ya bokenadipakeng ho busetsa kgutso le botsitso sebakeng seo.
tgt: Njengorhulumente onenkathalo, iKhabhinethi ivume amanyathelo akhawulezileyo okungenelela amabini ukuze kubuyiselwe uzinzo kweliya phondo.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho sebediswa ha Karolo ya 100(1) ya Molaotheo wa Riphaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa 1996, ho rarolla koduwa ena, haholoholo lekaleng la bophelo bo botle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba kusetyenziswe iCandelo 100(1) loMgaqo-siseko weRiphablikhi yoMzantsi Afrika wowe-1996 ukuze kulungiswe le ngxaki, ingakumbi kwicandelo lezempilo.

src: Sepheo se ka sehloohong sa bokenadipakeng bona e tla ba ho:busetsa tshepo le boitshepo dipakeng tsa basebetsi le mmusothusa porofense ho ntlafatsa mekgwatsamaiso le bokgoni ba yona tlwaelong e ntjhanetefatsa boikamahanyo le moralo wa mmuso wa ketsamolao le taolotsitsisa tikoloho ya basebetsi, ho kgutlisa phano ya ditshebeletso ya nako e telele, ho netefatsa tshireletseho ya basebetsi le ho ntlafatsa tsamaiso ya ditjhelete.
tgt: Iinjongo eziphambili zeli nyathelo:kukubuyisela ukuthembana phakathi kukarhulumente nabasebenzikukuncedisa iphondo likwazi ukuphucula iinkqubo zalo zokusebenza zikwazi ukumelana nale mingeni mitshakukuqinisekisa ukuba indlela ekusetyenzwa ngayo iyahambelana nemithetho karhulumente.

src: Kabinete e boetse e laetse sehlopha sa tshebetso sa Matona ho etela Leboya Bophirima ho fumana dintlha tsa sebele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imisele neqela labaPhathiswa eliza kuya eMntla Ntshona liyokusabela lizivele ngokwalo eyona nto iyintsusa nengunobangela wezi zidube-dube.

src: Matona a lebelletswe hore a fane ka tlaleho dibekeng tse pedi tse tlang.
tgt: Kulindeleke ukuba eli qela lingenise ingxelo kwezi veki zimbini zizayo.

src: Tlaleho ena e tla thusa ho fumana haeba ho na le bokenadipakeng bo bong bo ka nnang ba hlokeha.
tgt: Le ngxelo iza kunceda kutsho kwazeke ukuba ngawaphi na amanye amanyathelo okungenelela afunekayo.

src: Sehlopha seo sa Tshebetso se akga Matona a Thero, Bodisa le Tlhahlobo (Mohlophisi) Bophelo bo Botle tsa Ditjhelete Kopanelo ya Puso le Merero ya Setso hammoho le Setlamo sa Matona a Toka, Thibelo ya Ditlolo tsa Molao le Tshireletso.
tgt: AbaPhathiswa abakweli qela nguMphathiswa wezokuCwangcisa, ukuHlola nokuVavanya (onguMququzeleli) owezeMpilo, owezeziMali, owoLawulo lweNtsebenziswano neMicimbi yezeMveli kunye nabaPhathiswa abakwiNtlanganisela yezobuLungisa, ukuThintelwa koLwaphulo-mthetho noKhuseleko.

src: Leha e lemoha ditletlebo tse hlahisitsweng ke setjhaba, Kabinete e seolla ka matla diketso tsa dikgoka, boinyafelo le bosenyi ba thepa tse neng di tsamaisana le mehwanto ya boipelaetso dibakeng tse ding tsa porofense.
tgt: Nangona iKhabhinethi iziva izikhalazo eziphakanyiswa luluntu, izigxeka kabukhali izenzo zobundlobongela, zokutyhuthulwa kweevenkile kunye nokonakaliswa kweempahla ebezihamba nezi zidube-dube kwezinye iindawo zeli phondo.

src: Ditherisano tsa meputso lekaleng la setjhaba.1 Kabinete e ile ya tlalehelwa ka ditherisano tsa hajwale tsa meputso ya Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba.
tgt: Iingxoxo zemivuzo yabasebenzi bakarhulumente.1 IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi ngeendlela eziqhuba ngayo iingxoxo zemivuzo.

src: Kabinete e kopile Lefapha la Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba le Tsamaiso hammoho le komiti e fanang ka matla hore di sebetse ka boikitlaetso ho rarolla ho se utlwisisane ho teng mabapi le ditherisano tsa meputso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icele iSebe lezabaSebenzi bakaRhulumente noLawulo kunye nekomiti egunyazisayo ukuba bagxabha-gxabhise kusonjululwe la maqhina kuxingwe kuwo.

src: Seteraeke sa dibese.
tgt: Ugwayimbo lwabaqhubi beebhasi.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho baamehi bohle lekaleng la dipalangwang tsa setjhaba ho fedisa seteraeke sa naha sa dibese ka potlako.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubo bonke abachaphazelekayo kwicandelo lezothutho ukuba benze konke okusemandleni baphelise ugwayimbo oluqhutywa kuzwelonke lwabaqhubi beebhasi.

src: Re kopa baamehi bohle hore ba kgutlele ditherisanong ho etsetsa hore ho tle ho fihlellwe tumellano e molemong wa bohle ba amehang esita le naha.
tgt: Sicela onke amaqela achaphazelekayo ukuba abuyele kwizithebe zeengxoxo ukuze kukhangelwe izisombululo eziza kwanelisa bonke abachaphazelekayo kunye nesizwe ngokubanzi.

src: Merusu Lebaleng la Moses Mabhida.
tgt: Ubundlobongela eMoses Mabhida Stadium.

src: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe diketso tsa merusu le bosenyi bo soto ba thepa tse entsweng ke balatedi ba bolo ya maoto kamora hore ba itahlele ka Lebaleng la Moses Mabhida, Durban, nakong ya papadi ya Liki e Kgolo ya Bolo ya Maoto (PSL) mafelong a beke.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izigxeka kabukhali izenzo zobundlobongela kunye nezokonakaliswa kwempahla ngabalandeli bebhola ekhatywayo emva kokuba betyhoboze bangena ebaleni ekudlalelwa kulo eMoses Mabhida Stadium eDurban ngethuba kubanjwe umdlalo we-Premier Soccer League kule mpelaveki sivela kuyo.

src: Ditheo tsa qobello ya molao di koptjwa ho netefatsa hore bohle ba bileng le letsoho bosenying le diketsong tsa merusu papading eo, ba nka boikarabello bakeng sa diketso tsa bona.
tgt: Ii-arhente zogcino-mthetho ziyacelwa ukuba ziqinisekise ukuba bonke abo bachaphazelekayo kwezi zenzo zobundladiya nezobundlobongela ngethuba kubanjwe lo mdlalo bajongane nengqumbo yomthetho.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ya hore ho etswe dipatlisiso tse potlakileng le hore ho kenngwe tshebetsong mehato e tiileng ya tshireletso ho netefatsa polokeho ya babohi le bahlanka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphakamisa ukuba kwenziwe uphando olukhawulezileyo nokuba kuqaliswe iinkqubo ezingqingqwa zokuqinisekisa ukuba ababukeli kunye namagosa akhuselekile emidlalweni.

src: E kopa bohle ba amehang hore ba be le tshebedisano mmoho dipatlisisong, ho thibela hore kamoso diketso tse tjena di se ke tsa etsahala hape.
tgt: Icela bonke abathathi-nxaxheba ukuba baluxhase olu phando ukuze kuthintelwe izenzo ezifana nezi ngenye imini.

src: Diteishene tsa seyalemoya sa setjhaba.
tgt: Izikhululo zosasazo zoluntu.

src: Kabinete e amohela tumellano e fihletsweng ya ho hokela botjha diteishene tse 15 tsa seyalemoya tse neng di kwetswe ke Sentech hobane di sa lefa ditefello tsa kabo ya leqhubu la kgaso, ha ho ntse ho batlwa ditharollo tsa nako e telelele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isivumelwano ekufikelelwe kuso sokuba ziphinde zivulwe izikhululo zosasazo zoluntu ezili-15 ebezicinyiwe zanqunyanyiswa nguSentech ngenxa yokuba zingayibhatalanga imali yokufumana amaza osasazo ngeli thuba kusakhangelwa izisombululo eziza kuthintela imeko efana nale.

src: Tumellano e fihletswe kamora hore mmuso o be le kopano le Sentech, Foramo ya Naha ya Seyalemoya sa Setjhaba, Lekgotla la Ntshetsopele ya Mehlodi ya Ditaba le ho se Tshwane (MDDA) esita le Lekgotla le Ikemetseng la Dikgokahanyo la Aforika Borwa (ICASA).
tgt: Isivumelwano kuye kwafikelelwa kuso emva kokuba urhulumente edibene noSentech, i-National Community Radio Forum, i-Arhente yoKwahlukahlukana kunye noPhuhliso lwamaJelo eeNdaba (i-MDDA) kunye noMbutho oziMeleyo wezoNxibelelwano waseMzantsi Afrika (i-Icasa), Izikhululo zosasazo zoluntu zingamaqonga onxibelelwano abaluleke kakhulu axhobisa uluntu ngolwazi nasebenza njengezixhobo zokwakha isizwe esinolwazi.

src: Lekala la seyalemoya sa setjhaba ke lepatlelo la bohlokwa la kgokahanyo le fang batho ba habo rona phihlello ho tlhahisoleseding, ebile e le tsela ya ho bopa setjhaba se nang le tsebo.
tgt: Onke la maqela avumile ukuba kuphindwe kubuyelwe etafileni ngokukhawuleza ukuze kuphekwe isisombululo esiza kusebenza ixesha elide nesiza kukhokelela ekubeni ezi zikhululo zosasazo zingaphindi zibe semngciphekweni.

src: Bohle ba amehang ba dumellane ka ho kopana haufinyane ho tla le tharollo ya nako e telele e tla tlisa boitjaro diteisheneng tsena.
tgt: INdibano yeeNtloko zooRhulumente baMazwe Ayesakuba ngamaThanga.

src: Kabinete e amohela kananelo ya Lenaneo la Tshebetso la Mokgatlo wa Dinaha tsa Selekane bakeng sa dilemo tse pedi tse tlang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyiswa kukwamkelwa kweNkqubo yokuSebenza yaMazwe Ayesakuba ngamaThanga yale minyaka mibini izayo.

src: Moporesidente Ramaphosa o etelletse pele Moifo wa Aforika Borwa Kopanong ya Dihlooho tsa Mebuso ya Mokgatlo wa Dinaha tsa Selekane (CHOGM 2018) tlasa mookotaba o reng: “Ho hahamalla Bokamosong bo Tshwanang” ho tloha ka la 19 ho isa ho la 20 Mmesa 2018.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa ebekhokela iGqiza loMzantsi Afrika ebeliye kwiNtlanganiso yeeNtloko zooRhulumente baMazwe Ayesakuba ngamaThanga (i-CHOGM) phantsi komxholo othi: "Ukusebenzela iKamva Lethu Sonke" ebibanjwe ukusuka ngomhla we-19 ukuya kowe-20 kuTshazimpunzi ngowama-2018.

src: Ha a teka Aforika Borwa e le se seng sebaka sa botsetedi se hlahelletseng ka mahetla mebarakeng e thuthuang, Moporesidente Ramaphosa o boetse a teka puo Kopanong ya Baetapele ba Aforika ba Foramo ya Kgwebo ya Mokgatlo wa Dinaha tsa Selekane, a ba a dula majwana le batsetedi ba baholo ba matjhaba hammoho le baetapele ba kgwebo.
tgt: Ngelinge lokuzama ukwenza uMzantsi Afrika ukuba ube lilizwe eliphambili emazweni asahlumayo elithandwa ngabatyali-zimali, uMongameli Ramaphosa uye wenza intetho kwiQumrhu leeNkokeli zase-Afrika leQonga lezoShishino loMbutho waMazwe Ayesakuba ngamaThanga, waza wabamba neengxoxo kunye nabatyali-zimali neenkokeli eziphezulu zezoshishino.

src: O boetse a fetisa memo ho batsetedi ba itlhommeng pele esita le baetapele ba kgwebo hore ba be teng Kopanong ya Botsetedi e hlophiseditsweng hore e tshwarwe hamorao selemong sena.
tgt: Uye wamema nabatyali-zimali abaphambili kunye neenkokeli zezoshishino ukuba zizimase iNgqungquthela yezoTyalo-mali elindwe ngabomvu eza kubanjwa emaphelo alo nyaka.

src: Tlasa boetapele ba Moporesidente Ramaphosa, moifo wa Aforika Borwa o boetse wa sebedisa monyetla ona o tlisitsweng ke CHOGM hore ba tswele pele ho thaothela bonkgetheng ba Aforika Borwa ho Lekgotla la Tshireletso la Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) bakeng sa sehla sa 2019 – 2020.
tgt: IGqiza loMzantsi Afrika, likhokelwa nguMongameli Ramaphosa, liphinde lasebenzisa i-CHOGM lacela amazwe ebezimase lo msitho ukuba axhase umkhankaso woMzantsi Afrika wokuba lilungu leBhunga loKhuselo leZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) ukusuka ngonyaka wama-2019 ukuya kowama-2020.

src: Dikgetho tsena di hlophiseditswe ho tshwarwa ka la 8 Phuptjane 2018 ho la New York, Amerika (USA).
tgt: Ulonyulo lweli lizwe eliza kuba lilungu leli Bhunga luza kubanjwa ngomhla wesi-8 kweyeSilimela ngowama-2018 eNew York, e-USUtyalo-mali.

src: Kabinete e amohela thonyo ya Mopresidente Ramaphosa ya maqosa a kgethehileng mabapi le botsetedi hore a dule majwana le batsetedi ba lapeng esita le ba dinaheng tsa bolata ka menyetla ya moruo e Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuchongwa kwabathunywa abakhethekileyo bezotyalo-mali ukuba bafakane imilomo bebonisana nabatyali-zimali balapha ekhaya nabamazwe angaphandle ngamathuba ezoqoqosho akhoyo eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Maqosa ana a laetswe hore a hohele botsetedi ka tsela e tsepameng ebile e le e ditjeo di tlase.
tgt: Aba bathunywa banikwe umsebenzi wokupheka amaqhinga okutsala utyalo-mali besebenzisa amacebo angqalileyo nangazikubiza mali ininzi.

src: Tjantjello ena ya botsetedi e tla fihla sehlohlolong ka ho tshwarwa ha seboka se seholo sa botsetedi ho ella mafelong a selemo, ho bokella tjhelete e kahodimo ho R1 trillion botseteding bo botjha ka dilemo tse hlano.
tgt: Eli phulo lokutsalela utyalo-mali kweli liza kufikelela kuvuthondaba xa kubanjwe inkomfa yotyalo-mali ekupheleni kwalo nyaka apho kuza kuqokelelwa imali eyitriliyoni yeerandi kule minyaka mihlanu izayo.

src: Kgakolo ya Setsi sa Gauteng sa Ntho Tsohle tsa Botsetedi ba Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Ukuphehlelelwa kweziko elinguNtozonke le-InvestSA laseGauteng.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa ka matla batsetedi ba lapeng le ba matjhaba hore ba sebedise ditsi tsa botsetedi tsa Ntho Tsohle tsa Diporofense, tse ntseng di kgakolwa ho potoloha le naha – moo sa morarorao e leng Setsi sa Ntho Tsohle sa Gauteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza abatyali-zimali beli kunye nabamazwe angaphandle ukuba bazisebenzisa izixhobo zotyalo-mali ezikumaZiko angooNtozonke amaPhondo avulwa kulo lonke eli - elisanda ukuvulwa yiZiko elinguNtozonke le-InvestSA lseGauteng.-.

src: Setsi sa Ntho Tsohle tsa Botsetedi sa Aforika Borwa ke lenaneo la moporesidente la ho bapatsa le ho nolofatsa botsetedi Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Inkqubo yamaZiko angooNtozonke e-InvestSA yinkqubo kamongameli elungiselelwe ukukhuthaza nokuncedisa kumaphulo otyalo-mali eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Hajwale, Setsi sa Ntho Tsohle tsa Botsetedi sa Aforika Borwa se se se kentswe tshebetsong ka katleho KwaZulu-Natal le Kapa Bophirima.
tgt: La maZiko angooNtozonke e-InvestSA avuliwe futhi ayasebenza kwiphondo laKwaZulu-Natal nelaseNtshona Koloni.

src: Ditsi tsa Ntho Tsohle tsa Botsetedi di ntse di fanwa diporofenseng tsohle, mme di tla sebedisetswa ho hlophisa le ho momahanya mabatowa a kgethehileng a moruo, ditheo tsa botsetedi ba diporofense, makgotla a lehae le mafapha a tshwanelehileng a mmuso a amehang ho tsa taolo, ngodiso, mangolo a tumello le ditaba tsa dilaesense.
tgt: La Maziko oTyalo-mali angooNtozonke aza kuvulwa kuwo onke amaphondo kwaye aza kusebenzisana nemimandla yezoqoqosho ekhethekileyo, ii-arhente zotyalo-mali zamaphondo, oomasipala kunye namasebe karhulumente afanelekileyo aphambili kwimiba yokuqulunqwa kwemithetho, ubhaliso lwamashishini kunye nokukhutshwa kwamaphepha-mvume neelayisenisi.

src: Dikarete tse ntjha tsa Posong tsa-SASSA tsa Banka ya Posong.
tgt: Amakhadi amatsha asePosini, u-SASSA nasePostbank.

src: Kabinete e amohela katleho ya ho bula madiboho ya phano ya dikarete tse ntjha tsa Lekgotla la Tshireletso ya Setjhaba la Aforika Borwa (SASSA) diposong tse kgethilweng Kapa Bophirima, ho dumella majalefa a ditjhelete tsa dithuso tsa setjhaba ho fapanya dikarete tsa bona tsa hajwale hore ba fumane tse ntjha tsa Posong ya Aforika Borwa (SAPO)-SASSA tsa Banka ya Posong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalamkela iphulo elibe yimpumelelo lokukhupha amakhadi amatsha akwa-SASSA kwiiposi ezithile eNtshona Koloni aza kuvumela abantu abamkela imali yenkam-nkam ukuba batshintshe la makhadi banawo ngoku ngamatsha asePosini, kwa-SASSA nasePostbank.

src: Baamohedi ba ditjhelete tsa dithuso tsa setjhaba le beng ba dikarete ba ntse ba kgona ho sebedisa dikarete tsa bona tsa hajwale ho fihlela ka Tshitwe 2018, empa Kabinete e kgothalletsa majalefa ho ya fapanya dikarete tsa bona tsa kgale ka ho etela SASSA kapa SAPO tsa bona tse haufi ho tloha ka la 2 Motsheanong ho fihlela mafelong a Lwetse Thuto e Phahameng.
tgt: Abantu abamkela imali yenkam-nkam kunye nabo banamakhadi baza kukwazi ukusebenzisa la makhadi banawo ngoku kude kufike inyanga yoMnga kulo nyaka.

src: Kabinete e amohela kgatelopele e etswang ho kenngweng tshebetsong ha thuto ya mahala jwalokaha ho tobokeditswe ke Letona la Thuto e Phahameng le Thupelo.
tgt: Noko kunjalo, iKhabhinethi icela abantu abamkela imali yenkam-nkam ukuba batshintshe amakhadi wabo amadala ngokuthi baye kwii-ofisi yakwa-SASSA okanye ePosini ekufutshane.

src: Phatlalatso ya keketso ya bohlokwa kabong ya motheo ya tjhelete ya NSFAS ho tloha ho R9,849 bilione ka 2017/18 ho ya ho R35,321 bilione ka 2020/21, e bontsha boikitlaetso ba Mmuso ho thuseng baithuti ba tswang malapeng a kojwana di mahetleng esita le a mokgahlelo wa basebetsi.
tgt: Bangaqalisa ukwenza oku ukusuka ngomhla wesi-2 kuCanzibe kude kube sekupheleni kweyoMsintsi kulo nyaka wama-20.

src: Kabinete e amohela kgakolo ya Phahamiso ya Khiro ka Lenaneo la Tshehetso ya diSMME, leo e leng selekane dipakeng tsa Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane (DSBD) le Kopano ya Dinaha tsa Yuropa (EU).
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawubulela umgama osele uhanjiwe kwiphulo lokuqalisa ngemfundo yasimahla njengoko kucacisiwe nguMphathiswa weMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho.

src: Le tla tshehetsa diSMME ka ditshebeletso tsa ntshetsopele ya kgwebo, le di thuse ka phihlello mebarakeng, le ntlafatse phihlello ya tsona ho tsa ditjhelete, le be le thuse ho fokotsa boima ba tsamaiso le taolo dikgwebong tse nyenyane.
tgt: Isibhengezo esenziwe malunga nochatha omhle kakhulu kwimali eyabelwe u-NSFAS yasuka kwiibhiliyoni eziyi-9,849 zeerandi yaya kutsho kwiibhiliyoni ezingama-35,321 zeerandi ngowama-2020/21 kubonakalisa ukuba uRhulumente uzibophelele futhi uzimisele ngenene ukunceda abafundi abaphuma kumakhaya angathathi ntweni nabo banabazali abamkela imivuzo ephantsi.

src: Kabinete e rorisa bohle ba kentseng letsoho botenng ba ZACUBE-2, e leng sathalaete ya tjhubu e kgolokgolo ebile e le e hatetseng pele ka ho fetisisa Aforika.
