tgt: Eli dama liza kunceda amakhaya angama-2 690 anabantu abaqikelelwa kwabangama-10 674, liza kunceda kwingxaki yokunqongophala kwamanzi eWarden nase-Ezenzeleni kuMasipala weNgingqi yasePhumelela.2 UMzantsi Afrika usenengxaki yokunqongophala kwamanzi ebangelwe yimbalela ke ngoko iKhabhinethi icela abantu ukuba basebenzise amanzi ngononophelo nangobunono.

src: Kabinete e hlahisitse ngongoreho ka dinyollo le ditlamorao tse babang ho bareki ka kakaretso, ho akga le ditlamorao tse amanang le sekgahla sa nyollo ya ditheko ka ha bahlahisi ba fetisetsa dinyollo lekaleng la barekisetsi.
tgt: Ezemfundo.1 IKhabhinethi iliqhwabela izandla iSebe leMfundo esiSiseko (i-DBE) ngokuvula ngokusesikweni -Delft South Primary School, cebu kuhle neKapa eNtshona Koloni.2 Esi sikolo sakhiwe ngePhulo lesebe lokuKhawulezisa uKwakhiwa kweziSeko ezinguNdoqo zeZikolo (i-ASIDI) kwaye sityabule imali ezizigidi ezingama-75 zerandi.

src: Ha a ne a nkela sena hloohong, Letona la Eneji, Monghadi Jeff Radebe, o entse bokenadipakeng bo kgethehileng lebitsong la mmuso ka ho inola setjhaba kgahlanong le ho hlwa mekwalaba ho hong hape thekong ya mafura, ntle le nyollo ya disente tse lithara kanngwe sekepeleng sa Thekiso ya peterole ho lokisetsa nyollo ya meputso ya selemo le selemo ya basebetsi, ba kang ba tshelang peterole diteisheneng tsa mafura.
tgt: Sinamagumbi okufundela angama-45, iziko leekhompyutha nelebhu yezobunzulwazi, ithala leencwadi kunye neziko lokutyela.

src: Nakong ena eo moruo o thefulwang ke difefo tsa lefatshe lohle, Kabinete e motlotlo ka hore bokenadipakeng bona ha bo ame pokello ya ditjhelete tsa setjhaba ka ha bo sebedisa ditjhelete tse seng di le morerong wa theko ya mafura.
tgt: Esi sikolo sinobuxhaka-xhaka bale mihla sinazo zonke izixhobo ezifunekayo zokufunda nokufundisa abantwana besikolo baseDelft abamalunga ne-1 5.3 Esi sisikolo sokugqibela kwezingama-25 ebezinikezelwa ngokusesikweni eNtshona Koloni ezakhiwe nge-ASIDI ye-DBUkuza kuthi ga ngoku, inkqubo ye-ASIDI sele yakhe izikolo zale mihla ezingama-205 kuzwelonke.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa ohle hore a sebedise ngangisano e amanang le tlhabollo ya mobu, ho matlafatsa kaho ya setjhaba esita le momahanyo ya setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyiswa kakhulu ngabafundi abathe bafaka izicelo zenkxaso-mali ngobuninzi babo emva kokuba ixesha lokufaka izicelo ze-NSFAS livulwe ngokusesikweni ngomhla wesi-03 kweyoMsintsi.

src: Mesebetsi e ntseng e tswelapele ya palamente e tla tlisa tlhakisetso ebe e re dumelle ho hatela pele re le setjhaba.
tgt: Ngabafundi abasafunda iBanga 12 nabafunda kumaziko emfundo ephakamileyo abangaphezulu kwama-45 000 abangene kwiwebhusayithi ye-NSFAS ngosuku lokuqala ixesha lokufaka izicelo livuliwe.

src: Mosebetsi o nang le ponaletso, o theilweng ka melawana le molaotheo o tsamaisana le boikitlaetso ba rona ba hore re le mmoho re fihlelle ditharollo molemong wa ntlafatso ya setjhaba.
tgt: Mninzi umsebenzi osele wenziwe kumalinge okubhatala abafundi abebengekabhataleki.2 Inkqubo yokufaka izicelo isekelwe kwinkqubo entsha eqwalasela izicelo zenkxaso-mali ngokukhawuleza futhi neyenze indlela yokugcwaliswa kwezicelo ngabafundi yalula nokuba umfundi uphi na.

src: Kabinete e kgodisehile hore mosebetsi ona o tla re dumella ho utolla mokgwa wa tlhabollo ya mobu o sebeletseng bohle.
tgt: I-Listeriosis.1 IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isibhengezo esenziweyo sokuba isifo i-Listeriosis asisekho kwinqanaba likabhubhane.

src: Ka ho sebetsa mmoho, re ka aha setjhaba se betere moo ditoro le ditabatabelo tsa batho bohle ba habo rona di tla fihlellwa.
tgt: Oku kubonisa iziphumo zesicwangciso sentsebenziswano esingxamisekileyo seSebe lezeMpilo (i-DoH) kunye neZiko leSizwe leZifo ezoSulelayo, exhaswa nguMbutho wezeMpilo weHlabathi (i-WHO), sokulwa nokuphelisa esi sifo.

src: Kabinete e kgotsofetse ka hore Lefapha la Metsi le Bohlweki le phethetse kaho ya Letamo la Nokeng ya Cornelis Freistata.
tgt: I-DoH isebenzisa inkqubo yokugada ukuze esi sifo singaphindi siqhambuke.

src: Letamo lena, le reretsweng ho thusa malapa a 2 690 le batho ba hakanyetswang ho 10 674, le tla bebofatsa diphephetso tsa metsi tseo setjhaba sa Warden le Ezenzeleni se tobaneng le tsona katlasa Masepala wa Sebaka wa Phumelela.
tgt: Zonke iifektri ezenza ukutya osele kuvuthiwe okwenziwa ngenyama ebomvu neyenkukhu kufuneka zibe neenkqubo zokugada ukuba ukutya kungabiyongozi, njengoko usitsho uMthetho R607 owapapashwa ngomhla we-14 kweyeSilimela 2018.

src: Aforika Borwa e ntse e na le dikgaello tsa metsi ka lebaka la maemo a komello, mme Kabinete e ipiletsa bathong bohle hore ba sebedise sesebediswa sena ka paballo ba be ba dule ba le sedi ka metsi.
tgt: Amaphulo okuhlola iifetri aza kuqhuba, njengoko imithetho yezococeko yakutsha nje isitsho.

src: Kabinete e thoholeditse Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo (DBE) ka ho neelana ka katleho ka Sekolo sa Poraemare sa Delft South, ka thoko ho Motse Kapa profenseng ya Kapa Bophirimela.
tgt: Izityholo zokutya okungafanelekanga nokuphelelwe lixesha.1 IKhabhinethi iyambulela uMphathiswa wezeMpilo, uGq Aaron Motsoaledi ngokungalibazisi aqwalasele ngokukhawuleza izityholo ebezenziwe ngokutya okwenziwe ngezithako ezingezizo nokudlulelwe lixesha eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Sekolo sena se ahilwe ka thuso ya Kgato e Potlakisitsweng ya Phano ya Meralo ya Motheo ya Dikolo (ASIDI) ka ditjeo tsa R75 milione.
tgt: I-DoH ifumene izikhalazo ezininzi futhi izibonile neevidiyo ezingaqinisekiswanga ezingokutya ezisasazwa kumakhasi ezonxibelelwano loluntu.2 Ukususela ngenyanga yeThupha, bekuqhutywa amaphulo ogqogqo aliqubuliso kwiindawo ezithengisa ukutya futhi aza kuqhuba nakwiindawo ezahlukeneyo kweli lizwe.3 Ukongeza koko, icandelo lezokutya liceliwe ukuba liqinisekise ukuba ingaba ziyinyani na izityholo zokutya okwenziwa ngezithako ezingezizo ngeli thuba ezinye ii-arhente zomthetho zikarhalulumente eziphuma kwisebe lezoLimo, amaHlathi nezokuLoba, elezoRhwebo noShishino, kunye neKomishinni yeSizwe yabaThengi (i-NCC), nazo zincedisa kumalinge okuqinisekisa ezi zityholo zenziwe luluntu zokuba kubekho izenzo zokuvelisa ukutya okungekho mgangathweni.

src: Se na le diphaposi tsa ho rutela tse 45, laboratori ya dikhomphyutha le saense, polokelo ya dibuka esita le setsi seo ho jellwang ho sona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlabe ikhwelo kuluntu ukuba luhlale lubaze iindlebe luqwalasele zonke izinto ezingaqondakaliyo ekutyeni.

src: Sekolo sena se setjha sa maemo a hodimo se tla fana ka tikoloho e ntle ya ho ruta le ho ithuta baithuting ba ka bang 1 578 ba sebakeng sa Delft.
tgt: Umbhalo othi 'best-before' kwiimveliso ezithengiswayo ubhekisa kwixesha elinokuhlalwa zimveliso ezisetotini nezingenamanzi, aluthethi nto ngakulungela ukutyiwa kwemveliso.

src: Sena ke sekolo sa ho qetela dikolong tse 25 tse neelanweng Kapa Bophirimela ka kgato ya DBHo fihlela kajeno, lenaneo la ASIDI le ahile dikolo tsa maemo a hodimo tse 205 naha ka bophara.
tgt: Umbhalo othi 'sell-by’ ubhekiswa kukudla okonakala ngokukhawuleza kona ekugcinwa efrijini.

src: Kabinete e amohela ho tla ka bongata ha baithuti ba tshwanelehileng kamora ho bulwa semmuso ha mosebetsi wa dikopo tsa 2019 tsa NSFAS ka la 3 Loetse.
tgt: Ukusuka kwinyanga yeKhala kulo nyaka, awusazikuphinda usetyenziswe lo mbhalo, ngokwee-arhente zehlabathi.

src: Ke baithuti ba tshwanelehileng le ba ha jwale ba kahodimo ho 45 000 ba keneng websaeteng ya NSFAS ka letsatsi la pele.
tgt: Umbhalo othi 'use-by' okanye i'-expiry date' uchaza umhla obekiweyo wokuphelelwa kwaye uthetha ukuba ukutya okubhalwe lo mbhalo akusakulungelanga ukutyiwa emva kwalo mhla.

src: Kgatelopele ya ho fedisa tshallomorao ya ditefo tsa ditjhelete tsa baithuti e se e entswe.
tgt: Ekutyeni okonakalayo, lo mhla uthetha ukuba oku kutya akusakulungelanga ukutyiwa emva kwayo.

src: Mosebetsi wa dikopo o tsepamisitswe mokgwatsamaisong o motjha o potlakisang diqeto tsa ho fana ka tjhelete ka ha diforomo tsa dikopo jwale di tlatswa habobebe ke baithuti, ho sa natsehe hore na ba dula hokae.
tgt: 'Iimveliso zomgunyathi' zibhekisa kwiimveliso ezithengiswa ngegama lenye inkampani ngaphandle kwemvume kuze kona 'ukutya okungagqibanga' okuthethwa ngako kumakhasi ezonxibelelwano kubhekise kukutya okungenazithako zifanelekileyo zokutya.

src: Kabinete e amohela tsebiso ya hore sewa sa Listeriosis se fedile ebile e bontsha ka matla sekgahla sa morero wa karabelo o kopanetsweng wa tshohanyetso wa Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle (DoH) le Setheo sa Naha sa Mafu a Tshwaetsang, ba tsheheditswe ke Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Bophelo bo Botle, ho laola le ho fedisa sewa sena.
tgt: nIKhabhinethi iyaphinda iyabacela abantu ukuba beze ngaphambili nobungqina obubambekayo bokutya obenziwa ngezithako namachiza anganobungozi.6 Ngaphezu koku, iKhabhinethi izigxeka kabukhali izenzo zohlaselo nokutyhuthulwa kweevenkile ngenxa yezityholo zokuthengiswa kokutya okukrokrelekayo.

src: DoH e beile mokgwa wa bodisa ba ho thibela hore e se ke ya ropoha hape.
tgt: Izenzo zolwaphulo-mthetho ezifana nezi azizukunyanyezelwa futhi ii-arhente zogcino-mthetho ziza kubabamba futhi zibatshutshise abantu abafunyaniswe ukuba ngabo abakhokela okanye abenza ezi zenzo zolwaphulo-mthetho.

src: Difeme tsohle tse hlahisang dinama tse seng di loketse ho jewa, di tshwanela ho ba le mekgwatsamaiso ya taolo ya polokeho ya dijo, ho ya ka Molawana wa R607 o phatlaladitsweng ka la 14 Phupjane 2018.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela abantu abanolwazi ngoku kutya kukrokrelekayo ukuba batsalele umxeba kwiziko loncedo le-DoH ku-011 386 2003/6 kunye ne-NCC ku-012 428 Ukuhlawulwa kwezibonelelo zezentlalo IKhabhinethi iyayamkela ingxelo enika iinkcukacha ngomsebenzi osele wenziwe yoMphathiswa wezoPhuhliso loluNtu uSusan Shabangu, malunga nesivumelwano sentsebenziswano phakathi kwe-Arhente yeziBonelelo zezeNtlalo noMhlala-phantsi yaseMzantsi Afrika (i-SASSA) kunye nePosi yoMzantsi Afrika (i-SAPO) apho la maqumrhu eza kuthatha umsebenzi wokuhlawula imali yendodla ku-Cash Paymaster Services ukusukela ngomhla woku-1 eyeDwarha 2018.

src: Ditlhahlobo tsa difeme di dula di ntse di tswelapele, ho ya ka melawana e ntjhafaditsweng ya tlhweko.
tgt: Ukuza kuthi ga ngoku u-SASSA sele etshintshe amakhadi amadala asisigidi esinesiqingatha ngamakhadi akwa-SASSA amatsha agolide.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa kgato e potlakileng e nkilweng ke Letona la Bophelo bo Botle, Ngaka Aaron Motsoaledi, ho shebisisa diqoso tsa dijo mmotwana le dijo tse felletsweng ke nako Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonke abantu abasasebenzisa amakhadi amadala ukuba bawatshintshe.3 I-SAPO iza kuqalisa ukuhlawula ngokwayo imali ebantwini abangakhange bakwazi ukutsala imali yabo kwii-ATM okanye ezivenkileni.

src: DoH e fumane lenane le hodimo haholo la ditletlebo yaba ya lemoha le dingongoreho ka dividiyo tse sa netefatswang tse amanang le dijo, tse ntseng di potoloha marangrang a dikgokahano tsa setjhaba.
tgt: Abantu abamkela imali yendodla abafuna iinkcukacha ezithe vetshe bangatsalela le nombolo ingahlawulelwayo yakwa-SASSA ithi 0800 60 10 11 ngamaxesha omsebenzi.

src: Haesale ho tloha ka Phato, ditlhaselo tsa bohlahlobi di entswe ditsheng tse fapaneng tsa tlhahiso ya dijo, ebile di ntse di tswelapele dibakeng tse fapaneng tsa naha.
tgt: Iingozi zikaloliwe IKhabhinethi inqwenelela ukuchacha ngokukhawuleza abakhweli abafumene umonzakalo ngethuba oololiwe ababini bakwaMetrolrail betshayisana e-Eloff Extension eSelby, emazantsi eRhawuti kwaye ifuna ukuba uphando likanobangela wale ngozi lwenziwe ngokukhawuleza ukunqanda ukuba ingaphinde yenzeke ingozi efana nale.

src: Ho feta moo, indasteri ya dijo e kopilwe ho netefatsa bonnete ba kgonahalo ya dihlahiswa tsa bolotsana tsa dijo, ha makgotla a mang a taolo a mmuso ho tloha ho Mafapha a Temothuo, Meru le Botshwasi ba Ditlhapi, le Kgwebisano le Indasteri, ho akga le Khomishene ya Naha ya tsa Boreki (NCC), a se a le kgabong ya ho netefatsa dipelaelo tsa setjhaba tsa maemo a sa natsweng a boleng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba zikhutshwe iiNkcukacha-manani zeSizwe zoLwaphulo-mthetho nguMbutho wezamaPolisa oMzantsi Afrika (i-SAPS).1 Ezi nkcukacha-manani zonyaka zolwaphulo-mthetho zinceda urhulumente azibone indlela aqhuba ngayo kwiinjongo eziphambili azibekele zona, ingakumbi umba wokuphungulwa kwezenzo zolwaphulo-mthetho oluhambisa umzimba oluxeliweyo kwabasemagunyeni, njengoko kucacisiwe kwisiCwangciso-sikhokelo esiQiqisisiweyo sesiGaba esiPhakathi (i-MTSF) sowama-2014-2019.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa setjhabeng hore se be sedi haholo mantsweng a fapaneng e amanang le dijo:Lentswe la best-before Date le bolela bolelele ba bophelo ba tshebediseho ya dihlahiswa tse ommeng le tse ka dikotikoting, mme seo ha se sesupo sa polokeho ya tsona.
tgt: Iinkcukacha-manani zolwaphulo-mthetho zingasetyenziswa njengezixhobo zokubona umonakalo kwangethuba ukuze kuphuculwe amaphulo namaqhinga amasebe ahlukeneyo karhulumente okuthintela ulwaphulo-mthetho.

src: Lentswe la sell-by Date le sebedisetswa dijo tse bolang tse atisang ho bolokwa dihatsetsing mme ho tloha ka Phupu ya monongwaha ha le sa sebetsa, ho ya ka makgotla a nang le matla a lefatshe lohle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi ngomsebenzi osele wenziwe kumba wokuziphatha kwabasebenzi bakarhulumente abaqhuba ushishino namaqumrhu ombuso.

src: Lentswe la use-by Date kapa la expiry Date, ke letsatsi la ho fellwa ke nako ha sehlahiswa mme seo se bolela hore dijo tse nang le letshwao lena ha di ka ke tsa boela tsa hlabosa kamora letsatsi lena.
tgt: Ukukhuthaza ukuthathwa kwamanyathelo asekelwe kubulungisa nangadleleleliyo ngamagosa aphezulu karhulumente kubaluleke kakhulu kumalinge okwakha umbuso owenza izinto elubala nophendulayo ngemisebenzi yakhe, njengoko usitsho uMgaqo-siseko weRiphablikhi yoMzantsi Afrika wowe-1996 kunye nokwakha umbuso ekubhekiswa kuwo kuMbono wowama-2030 wesiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe (i-NDP).1 Mhle umgama osele uhanjiwe malunga nokuphunyenzwa koMthetho 13 weMithetho yeeNkonzo zikaRhulumente (i-PSR) wowama-2016 othintela abasebenzi bakarhulumente ukuba baqhube ushishino namaqumrhu ombuso, kwakunye noMthetho 18 we-PSR yowama-2016, onyanzelisa ukuba abasebenzi abayinxalenye yabaPhathi abaPhezulu (i-SMS) bayichaze imvelaphi yengeniso eyimali neyeyabucala.2 IKhabhinethi iphinde yavuma ukuba iGosa elinamaGunya afanelekileyo kumasebe karhulumente kufuneka liwubeke phantsi kweliso umba wokuphunyezwa koMthetho 13 we-PSR yowama-2016, lithathe amanyathelo oluleko afanalekileyo lize lingenise ingxelo ngako konke oku kuMphathiswa wezabaSebenzi bakaRhulumente noLawulo (i-MPSA) ekupheleni konyaka-mali ngamnye.

src: Dijong tse bolang teng, letshwao lena le bolela hore ha di ka ke tsa boela tsa jewa.“Thepa ya bolotsana” ke thepa e rekiswang tlasa lebitso la boitsebahatso la khamphane enngwe, ha lereo la “dijo mmotwana” lona le sebedisitswe marangrang a dikgokahano tsa setjhaba ho bolela dijo tseo dikateng tsa tsona di se nang metswako ya sebele ya dijo.
tgt: Ingxelo yokuqala ifanele ukungeniswa ku-MPSA ngomhla wama-31 kweyoKwindla 20.3 Ngonyaka wama-2016 nowama-2017, iSebe lezabaSebenzi bakaRhulumente noLawulo liye labona abasebenzi bakarhulumente ababhaliswe kuLuhlu lukaZwelonke lwabaBoneleki-zinkonzo (i-CSB), lona ebelukhutshwe nguNondyebo weSizwe.

src: Diketso tse jwalo tsa ditlolo tsa molao ha di ka ke tsa mamellwa, mme ditheo tse sebetsanang le qobello ya molao ha di ka ke tsa qeaqea ho tshwara le ho tjhutjhisa batho ba hlohleletsang kapa ba etsang diketso tsena tsa ditlolo tsa molao.
tgt: Amasebe aye acelwa ukuba afundise abasebenzi ngalo mba, aqinisekise iinkcukacha aze anike ingxelo ngomsebenzi osele wenziwe malunga namanyathelo athatyathelwe abo bophule umthetho.4 Ekupheleni kwenyanga kaTshazimpunzi ngowama-2018, amalungu e-SMS ayi-96% ebesele ewangenisile amaxwebhu awo aneenkcukacha zengeniso esebenzisa inkqubo i-eDisclosure System.

src: Kabinete e kopa ditho tsohle tsa setjhaba tse nang le tsebo ka dijo tse belaetsang ho letsetsa mohala o qollehileng wa DoH ho 011 386 2003/6 le NCC ho 012 428 Ho lefshwa ha ditjhelete tsa dithuso tsa setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi ngomsebenzi oselwe wenziwe malunga neNkqubo yokuXhasa ngeMali yokuFunda yeSikolo sikaRhulumenete seSizwe (i-NSG).

src: Kabinete e amohela tlaleho ya kgatelopele ya Letona la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba Susan Shabangu, ka selekane se dipakeng tsa Lekgotla la Tshireletso ya Setjhaba la Aforika Borwa (SASSA) le Poso ya Aforika Borwa (SAPO) ka ho nka mosebetsi wa ditefo tsa dithuso tsa setjhaba ho Cash Paymaster Services ho tloha ka la 1 Mphalane 2018.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilwamkele uluhlu lwezifundo zoqeqesho ezinyanzelekileyo nezinganyanzelekanga eziza kulingwa yi-NSG eziza kunceda kuqeqesho nophuhliso lwezakhono olukhawulezileyo nelokwenza iinkonzo zikarhulumente icandelo elinazakhono ezisemgangathweni ophezulu.

src: Ho fihlela ha jwale, SASSA e se e fane ka dikarete tse ntjha tsa kgauta tsa SASSA tse ka bang dimilione tse hlano le halofo, tse nkang sebaka sa dikarete tsa kgale, empa diketekete tsa tsona di ntse di hloka ho tjhentjhwa.
tgt: Umba wokuba izifundo zoqeqesho ezinyanzelekileyo zihlawulwe ngqo ngamasebe aqeshe abasebenzi abo kwibhajethi yawo yoqeqesho nophuhliso lwabasebenzi nawo uvunyiwe.2 Oku kuza kukhokelela ekubeni sibe nombuso okhokelisa uphuhliso futhi othatha amanyathelo asingisele ekuzalisekiseni uMbono wama-2010 we-NDP ngokuthi "wakhe isizwe esinezakhono nesikhokelisa uphuhliso, esithi ngokusebenzisana nabemi abathatha inxaxheba, sikhokele iphulo elizingileyo lokulwa indlala, intswela-ngqesho nokungalingani."4.

src: Kabinete e etsa boipiletso bo matla ho beng ba dikarete tsa kgale hore ba ilo di tjhentjha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba kupapashwe iPhepha eliCacisa uMgaqo-nkqubo wezeNzulwazi, ezobuChwepheshe nezoYilo wowama-2018 ukuze uluntu luhlomle kuwo.

src: Bakeng sa ho tseba haholwanyane, baamohedi ba dithuso tsa ditjhelete tsa mmuso ba ka letsetsa mohala wa mahala wa SASSA ho 0800 60 10 11 dihoreng tsa mosebetsi.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezeNzulwazi nobuChwepheshe, uNksk Mmamoloko Kubayi-Ngubane uza kunika iinkcukcha ezigcweleyo kwalapho ekuhambeni kwexesha.

src: Kabinete e lakaletsa bapalami ba ileng ba lemala ha diterene tse pedi tsa Metrorail di ne di tjhaisana Eloff Extension Selby, ka borwa ba Johannesburg, hore ba fole kapele ebile e etsa kgoeletso ya hore phuphutso ya sesosa sa kotsi e potlakiswe e le ho thibela phetapheto ya ketsahalo ya mofuta oo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba kupapashwe isiCwangciso-qhinga seSizwe soKwandiswa kweeNdawo eziKhuselweyo (i-NPAES) ukuze uluntu luhlomle.1 I-NPAES sisicwangciso esiqiqisisiweyo seminyaka engama-20 esihambelana ne-NDP, esigxile ekwandiseni iindawo ezikhuselweyo, kugxininiswa kakhulu kuhlumo loqoqosho, iinguqu kunye nozinzo.2 I-NPAES igxininisa indlela imali kunye nabasebenzi abanezakhono ezinqongopheleyo ekufuneka basetyenziswa ngayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba indlela eyandiswa ngayo imimandla ekhuselweyo ayidli mali kakhulu, kwaye ayinabungozi kokusingqongileyo kwaye iyakwazi nokumelana nengxaki yokutshintsha kwemozulu.3 Iindawo ezikhuselweyo zoMzantsi Afrika ziquka iziza ezingamafa, imiyezo yesizwe, imiyezo yolondolozo lwendalo, imiyezo yolondolozo ekhethekileyo, imimandla yokusingqongileyo ekhuselweyo, iindawo zaselwandle ezikhuselweyo, iintlambo nemithombo ehlala amanzi asuka ezintabeni, amahlathi akhuselwe ngokukodwa kunye namahlathi olondolozo lwendalo.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho ntshuwa ha Dipalopalo tsa Naha tsa Ditlolo tsa Molao tsa 2017/18 ke Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa sa Aforika Borwa (SAPS).
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyivumile iMiba uMzantsi Afrika oza kuXoxa Phezu Kwayo kwiNgqungquthela ye-13 yamaZwe Atyikitye isiVumelwano saseRamsar esingemiMandla eliJojo (i-Ramsar COP 13) eza kubanjelwa eDubai, e-United Arab Emirates, ukusuka ngomhla wama-21 kuya kowama-29 kweyeDwarha ngowama-20.1 Iinjongo ezibanzi zesiVumelwano saseRamsar kukuqinisekisa ukuba imihlaba elijojo iyalondolozwa futhi isetyenziswa ngononophelo.

src: Dipalopalo tsa ditlolo tsa molao tsa selemo le selemo di thusa mmuso ho disa dibaka tsa bohlokwa, haholoholo phokotso ya ditlolo tsa molao tse mpempe tse tlalehilweng, jwalo ka ha ho tekilwe Moralong wa Lewa la Nako e Bohareng wa 2014-2019.
tgt: EMzantsi Afrika, imihlaba elijojo yiyona isemngciphekweni yokuphazamiseka kuyo yonke indalo esingqongileyo, kangangokuba ama-45% ale mihlaba asemngciphekweni wokuphazamiseka.2 Oku kudlala indima enkulu kumba wolondolozo lwamanzi njengenxalenye yamalinge okukhawulela umonakalo onokwenziwa zimbalela.

src: Dipalopalo tsa ditlolo tsa molao di ka boela tsa sebediswa e le matshwao a kgalemo ho sa kganya, hore ho matlafatswe ditshebetso tsa thibelo ya ditlolo tsa molao le mawa a mafapha a fapaneng a mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba upapashwe uMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo weMbuyekezo yokoNzakala nokuFumana iziFo eMsebenzini wowama-2018 ukuze uluntu luhlomle.1 Lo Mthetho-sihlomelo, ulungisa uMthetho weMbuyekezo yokoNzakala nokuFumana iziFo eMsebenzini wowe-1993, (uMthetho uNombolo 130 wowe-1993) uyababala abasebenzi abancedisa emakhaya, ababengabalwa kulo Mthetho wangaphambili, ukuba nabo ngabasebenzi ukwenzela ukuba nabo baxhamle kumalungelo axhanyulwa ngabasebenzi, kunye nokuba aphaculwe la malungelo axhanyulwa ngabasebenzi.2 Ezi zilungiso ziza kuphucula izibonelelo ezibhatalwa kubasebenzi nabantu abaxhomekeke kubo, kwaye ulungiselelwe ukunceda abasebenzi abonzakeleyo okanye abaswelekileyo ukuba bancediswe ngonyango belungiselelwa ukuba babuyele emsebenzini naphakathi koluntu.

src: Kabinete e ile ya hlajwa malotsana ka kgatelopele e entsweng bolaoding ba kgalemo ya basebetsi ba tshebeletso ya setjhaba, ba etsang kgwebo le ditheo tsa mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba ungeniswe ePalamene uMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo wezoBulungisa baBantwana wowama-20.1 Lo Mthetho-sihlomelo wenza izilungiso kuMthetho woBulungisa baBantwana wowama-2008 (uMthetho uNombolo 75 wowama-2008) ukuze kutshintshwe eyona minyaka yobudala imiselweyo yokuba umntwana abe angakwazi ukubekwa ityala inyuke isuka kwiminyaka eli-10 iye kweli-12.

src: Ho kgothaletsa diketso tsa toka le bosiyo ba leeme ho bahlanka ba baholo ba mmuso, ke karolo ya bohlokwa ya ho aha mmuso o bonaletsang o bile o na le boikarabello, jwalo ka ha ho lohothilwe ho Molaotheo wa Riphaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa 1996 esita le kaho ya mmuso o nang le bokgoni jwalo ka ha ho radilwe ho Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP): Tjhebelopeleng ya 2030.
tgt: Lo Mthetho-sihlomelo awupheleli nje apho uyaqhubeleka ugxininisa nomba wokubaluleka kokuhlonitshwa kwamalungelo abantwana abenza izinto ezinxamnye nomthetho.2 Lo Mthetho-sihlomelo uzama nokwahlukanisa umba wesakhono somntu sokukwazi ukwenza isenzo solwaphulo-mthetho nowokuba umntu afumene isohlwayo esingesinye endaweni yokuba avelelwe ejele, ngokuthi umba wesakhono somntu sokukwazi ukwenza isenzo solwaphulo-mthetho njengento ekuqala kujongwe yona xa umntu eza kunikwa esinye isohlwayo esingesokuvalelwa ejele naxa kusenziwa uphando lwaphambi kokuchotshelwa kwetyala.

src: Kgatelopele e se e entswe mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Molawana wa 13 wa Melawana ya Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba (PSR) wa 2016, o hanelang basebetsi ba tshebeletso ya setjhaba ho etsa kgwebo le ditheo tsa mmuso, esita le Molawana wa 18 wa PSR wa 2018, o hlokang hore ditho tsa Tshebeletso ya Bolaodi bo Boholo (SMS) di pepese ditabatabelo tsa tsona tsa boikunuto ba tsa ditjhelete le tse ding.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba kungeniswe ePalamente uMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo wezoPhapho lwaBantu wowama-20.1 Lo Mthetho-sihlomelo, owenza izilungiso kuMthetho wezoPhapho lwaBantu wowama-2009 (uMthetho uNombolo 13 wowama-2009), uza kuphucula ukhuseleko nokhuselo kwezophapho kunye nemithetho yokukhuselwa kokusingqongileyo kwezophapho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba kukho uzinzo kwicandelo lezophapho loluntu.2 Oku kuza kuqinisekisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika uyaqhubeleka nokuthobela izivumelwano zehlabathi ozityikileyo ezinxulumene necandelo lezophapho, into leyo eza kuba negalelo elimandla kuphuhliso loqoqosho kwaye esisixhobo esinokusetyenziswa ukukhulisa urhwebo, ezokhenketho kunye nesantya sokudalwa kwemisebenzi.3 Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ukwanamasolotya avumela ukuba uphando lweengozi zeenqwelomoya kunye nezinye iziganekwana ezenzeka kwiinqwelo-moya lwenziwe zi-arhente ezizimeleyo, ukuze kulungiswe ingxaki yokungasetyenziswa kwemithetho neendlela ezifanayo kunye nezinye izinto ezibangela umsebenzi ube nebatha.

src: Kabinete e boetse ya ananela hore Lekgotla la Phethahatso le nang le matla le tshwanelehileng la mafapha a mmuso, le lokela ho disa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Molawana wa 13 wa PSR wa 2016, le nke dikgato tsa kgalemo tse tshwanelehileng le be le kenye tlaleho ya tsona ho Letona la Lefapha la Tshebeletso le Tsamaiso ya Setjhaba (DPSA) mafelong a selemo se seng le se seng sa ditjhelete.
tgt: IVeki yeeThusong Service Centre.1 Njengoko ibanjwe kanye ngeNyanga yeeNkonzo zikaRhulumente iVeki yonyaka yeeThusong Service Centre eza kubanjwa ukusuka ngomhla we-17 ukuya kowama-21 kweyoMsintsi 2018 phantsi komxholo othi: "Thuma Mina: Sisa iiNkonzo zikaRhulumente eBantwini", ilelinye iqonga likarhulumente lokusa iinkonzo zikarhulumente ebantwini.2 Ii-Thusong Service Centre ngamaziko angoontozonke aneenkonzo kunye nolwazi lukarhulumente, kwaye ezi Thusong Service Centre zili-133 zifumaneka mbombo zone zeli zingamaziko ethemba, okufumana ulwazi, okulungisa umonakalo wangaphambili, olingwano nawokuphuhlisa abantu ababehlelelekile ngaphambili bengavumelekanga ukuba bathathe inxaxheba kuphuhliso loqoqosho nolwezentlalo lwezwelonke.3 Urhulumente wenza iindlela zokufakela iNkqubo yokuLawula imiGca Emide kula maziko, nkqubo leyo iza kukwazi ukulawula indlela ekufolwa ngayo kunye nesantya abantu abancedwa ngaso ukuze kuphungulwe ixesha elichithwa ngabantu belinde uncedo emigceni.

src: Ka 2016 le 2017, DPSA e hlwaile basebetsi ba tshebeletso ya setjhaba ba ngodisitsweng e le bafani ba ditshebeletso ho Dathabeisi e Bohareng ya Bafani ba Ditshebeletso (CSD), jwalo ka ha e neelanwe ke Lefapha la Matlotlo a Setjhaba.
tgt: Le nkqubo yokulawula imigca iza kufakelwa kuwo onke amaziko kulo lonke eli kugxininiswa kakhulu kumba wokufakelwa kobuxhaka-xhaka bobuchwepheshe bolwazi nonxibelelwano, bona obubaluleke kakhulu kumaphulo okuhambisa iinkonzo.

src: Mafapha a ile a koptjwa ho etsa tlhokomediso, ho netefatsa lesedi le ho tlaleha kgatelopele ka ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha dikgato tse nkilweng kgahlanong le bao ba molato.
tgt: 2018 INkomfa yeHlabathi ye-Telecom ye-ITU yowama-2018 ye-ITU.1 IKhabhinethi iyayamkela iNkomfa yeHlabathi yeTelecom yowama-2010 yoMbutho weHlabathi weziSeko zoNxibelelwano (i-ITU) eza kubanjelwa eDurban ukusuka ngomhla wesi-9 ukuya kowe-13 kweyoMsintsi 2018 phantsi komxholo othi "Ukuqamba kusenzelwa uPhuhliso lobuXhaka-xhaka be-Intanethi bale Mihla".

src: Mafelong a Mmesa 2018, 96% ya ditho tsohle tsa SMS di kentse dipepeso tsa tsona, di sebedisa Mokgwatsamaiso wa eDisclosure.
tgt: Lo msitho, uza kubanjelwa kweli lizwekazi le-Afrika okokuqala, uza kunika ithuba lokuba amazwe ase-Afrika athathe inxaxheba ngamandla kumaphulo okuphuhlisa i-ICT e-Afrika, esesinye sezixhobo zophuhliso nokuqamba izinto ezintsha.2 Le nkomfa ibanjwa minyaka le iza kuzinyaswa ngabathunywa abangaphezulu kwama-9 000 abaphuma mbombo zone leli limiweyo, apho abaphathi abaphezulu kwicandelo likarhulumente nele-ICT baza kucweya bekhangela amathuba otyalo-mali kunye neendlela ezizezona zifanelekileyo zophuhliso loqoqosho nezentlalo kusetyenziswa i-ICImiba ephambili eza kugwadlwa iquka: i-5G yophuhliso lobuxha-xhaka be-intanethi bale mihla, ukusebenzisana kwimiba yokhuseleko kweze-intanethi, iinkonzo zezimali eziqhutywa nge-intanethi kunye neesathelayithi zokuncedisa kumaphulo ophuhliso lobuxhaka-xhaka be-intanethi bale mihla.3 INkomfa yeHlabathi yeTelecom yowama-2018 ye-ITU ibanjwe kanye ngexesha apho uMzantsi Afrika uqalisa iiprojekthi zesizwe eziphambili eziquka isiCwangciso-qhinga seSizwe se-Intanethi sikaRhulumente esigxininisa kumba wokutshintsha iinkonzo zikarhulumente zisebenzise ubuxha-xhaka be-intanethi kunye nesiCwangciso-qhinga seSizwe se-ICT sokuXhasa amaShishini amaNcinci, aPhakathi namaNcinane (ii-SMME), sona esilungiselelwe ukuvulela amathuba icandelo le-ICT kwii-SMME zoMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e ile ya hlajwa malotsana ka kgatelopele e seng e entswe Mmotlolong wa Phano ya Ditjhelete Sekolong sa Naha sa Thupello ya Bahlanka ba Mmuso (NSG).
tgt: Ezi zixhobo zidala iimeko ezikhuthazayo nezivumayo ukuba eli candelo likhule futhi lizinze.

src: Kabinete e ananetse sebopeho sa mananeo a tlamang a thupello, a tla kgakolwa ke NSG hore a thakgole bokenadipakeng bo potlakileng ba ntshetsopele ya bokgoni esita le ho etsa tshebeletso ya setjhaba hore e be le boporofeshenale.
tgt: Amazwi ovelwano.1 IKhabhinethi ithi tutuni:kusapho eliphantsi kwelifu elimnyama kunye neDyunivesiti yobuChwepheshe yaseTshwane (i-TUT) emva kokusweleka kukaKatlego Monareng.

src: Tefo e otlolohileng bakeng sa mananeo a tlamang ho NSG e etswang ke mafapha a tshwanelehileng ho tswa ditjheleteng tsa ona tsa thupello, le yona e ile ya ananelwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela ukuba kuzolwe ngeli thuba amapolisa aqhuba uphando ukuze aqinisekise ukuba abo babe nesandla kwintlungu yokusweleka kukaKatlego baziswa ngaphambili.

src: Sena se tla lebisa tsamaisong ya setjhaba e hatelang pele, e hahamallelang pele ho fihlelleng Tjhebelopele ya 2030 ya NDP ka “ho aha naha e nang le bokgoni e hatelang pele, eo haeba e sebetsa mmoho le boahi bo mahlahahlaha, e tla etella pele tjantjello e matla kgahlanong le bofuma, leqeme la mesebetsi le ho se lekane setjhabeng.”4.
tgt: kwintsapho nezihlobo zabantu abasibhozo abasweleka kuqhambuko-dubulo olwenzeka kwifektri yakwaDenel yokwenza iimbumbulu nezixhobo eseSomerset West eNtshona Koloni.

src: Kabinete e ananetse phatlalatso ya Tokomane ya Tataiso ho Saense, Theknoloji le Tshibollo ya 2018, bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele.
tgt: izihlobo nezalamane zabo bathe basweleka kumlilo obusitsha kwisakhiwo esisetyenziswa nangala masebe kaRhulumente wePhondo laseGauteng: elezeMpilo, elezokuHlaliswa koLuntu kunye neloLawulo lweNtsebenziswano.

src: Letona la Saense le Theknoloji, Mofumahadi Mmamoloko Kubayi-Ngubane, o tla fana ka tlaleho e phethahetseng ha mmela o ntse o puta.
tgt: Amazwi okuvuyisana.1 IKhabhinethi ithumele amazwi okuvuyisana kubantu baseZimbabwe abathe batshintshela kumbuso omtsha okhokelwa nguMongameli Emmerson Mnangagwa ngaphandle kwamagingxi-gingxi, yena obekwe ngokusesikweni ngomhla wama-26 eyeThupha 2018.

src: Kabinete e boetse ya ananela phatlalatso ya Lewa la Katoloso la Dibaka tsa Naha tse Tshireleditsweng (NPAES) bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphona naye njengeenkokeli zeli lizwekazi ebeye eHarare eyekuzimasa lo msitho.

src: NPAES ke morero wa lewa la dilemo tse 20 o itshetlehileng ka NDP, o tsepamisitseng maikutlo katolosong ya setsha sa dibaka tse tshireleditsweng, ka tjhadimo e tsepameng kgolong ya moruo, phetoho le botsitso ba nako e telele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawaxhasa amalinge nemizamo kaMongameli Ramaphosa okusebenzisana ngokumandla neZimbabwe ukuze la mazwe aqinise amaqhina entsebenziswano ezopolitiko nawobuhlobo aqala kudala, egxininisa ikakhulu kumba wokomoleza intsebenziswano kwimiba yezoqoqsho phakathi kwala mazwe mabini.2 IKhabhinethi iliqhwabela izandla iBhunga lezoPhando lezeNzululwazi nezoShishino (i-CSIR), ingakumbi iingcali zophando-nzulu zasetyhini zeli Bhunga, ngophando-nzulu ngezempilo eliqhutywayo kulungiselelwa ukuphucula inkqubo yeenkonzo zezempilo zeli.

src: Kabinete e ile ya kopanela Union Buildings Pretoria, ka Laboraro, mohla la 19 Loetse 2018.Dintlha tsa Ha jwale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibibambe intlanganiso ngoLwesithathu, umhla we-19 kweyoMsintsi 2018 kwiZakhiwo zoMdibaniso, ePitoli.

src: Moruo.
tgt: Imiba engundaba-mlonyeni.

src: Kabinete e amohela thuso e nanabetswang ke ba kgwebo bakeng sa ho romelwa ha baporofeshenale ba lekala la poraefete mmusong.
tgt: Imiba yezoqoqosho IKhabhinethi iyalamkela uncedo olunikwe ngabezoshishino lokuba bangakhulula abasebenzi abazingcali becandelo labucala ukuba baye kuncedisa kurhulumente.

src: Sena se ropohile kopanong ya boitlhophisetso e neng e tshwerwe ke Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa le baetapele ba kgwebo, maqosa a kgethehileng a botsetedi le Mokgakolo wa Bahlanka ba Baholo ba Phethahatso (CEO), pele ho Seboka se tlang sa Mesebetsi le Botsetedi.
tgt: Oku kuvele ngethuba kubanjwe intlanganiso yokuqukumbela amalungiselelo eNgqungquthela yezeMisebenzi kunye neNkomfa yoTyalo-mali ezayo nguMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa kunye neenkokeli zezoshishino, abathunywa abakhethekileyo bezotyalo-mali kunye namalungu e-CEO Initiative.

src: Kopano e dumellane ka hore tsosoloso ya moruo wa Aforika Borwa e batla ho kenngwa tshebetsong ho potlakileng ha mokgekgetho wa diqholotsi le ditlhabollo tse tshepisitsweng tse ntlafatsang kgolo.
tgt: Kule ntlanganiso kuye kwavunyelwana ukuba umba wokuvuselelwa koqoqosho loMzantsi Afrika ufuna siqukunjelwe ngokukhawuleza isicwangciso soncedo lwezezimali oluvela kurhulumente futhi ziqaliswe iinguqu ezikhuthaza uhlumo loqoqosho ebekuthenjiswa ngazo.

src: Ditshisinyo di ile tsa boela tsa tshohlwa mabapi le ho thea mokgakolo wa ntshetsopele ya meralo ya motheo e kenyang ditjhelete tse tswang lekaleng la poraefete esita le botsebi bo hodimo ba phano ya ditshebeletso.
tgt: Kuxoxiwe nangeziphakamiso zokuba kumiselwe iphulo lophuhliso lweziseko ezingundoqo eliza kuxhaswa ngemali licandelo labucala futhi lifumane noncedo lweengcali ngeendlela zokuliphumeza.

src: Thahasello ya botsetedi.
tgt: Iphulo lotyalo-mali.

src: Kabinete e boela e amohela thahasello ya botsetedi kwana Japan, e etelletsweng pele ke Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Indasteri (dti).
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalixhasa iphulo lotyalo-mali obeliqhutywa eJapan likhokelwa liSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino.

src: Thahasello ena e habile ho hohela matsete a boleng ba US$ 100 bilione moruong wa Aforika Borwa nakong ya dilemo tse hlano tse tlang.
tgt: Eli phulo lifuna ukungenisa utyalo-mali oluxabisa imali ezibhiliyoni ezili-100 ze-US$ kuqoqosho loMzantsi Afrika kule minyaka mihlanu izayo.

src: Haesale Japan e le molekane wa ba leshome ba kahodimodimo wa batsetedi ba nako e telele Aforika Borwa, ka dikhamphane tsa yona tse kahodimo ho 140 tse sebetsang naheng ena ya rona, e bonwang e le kgubu ya lebatowa la tlhahiso ya ho kena Aforika.
tgt: IJapan lilizwe ekudala likuluhlu lwamazwe ali-10 aphezulu angamahlakani ethu kwezotyalo-mali.

src: Kabinete e kgothaletsa dikhamphane ho tsetela le ho nama Aforika Borwa.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika ubonwa njengelizwe elingumakhonya kwicandelo lezemizi-mveliso kwi-Afrika iphela.

src: Kabinete e amohela kgakolo ya projeke ya thupello ya R22-milione ke Letona la tsa Mesebetsi, Mofumahadi Mildred Oliphant, e tla thea mesebetsi makaleng a bofofisi, a kgwebo ya ho qwela metsing a lewatle esita le a temothuo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza iinkampani ukuba zityale imali kweli futhi zandise nobukhulu bazo.

src: Projeke ena e sebetswa ka selekane le Setheo sa Ngaka John Langalibalele Dube esita le Letlole la Inshorense ya ba Feletsweng ke Mesebetsi (UIF), eo e leng setheo sa Lefapha la tsa Bosebetsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuphehlelelwa kweprojekthi yoqeqesho exabise imali ezizigidi zeerandi ezingama-22 nguMphathiswa wezabaSebenzi, uNksz Mildred Oliphant.

src: Projeke ena e tla shadimana le ba kentseng letsoho ho UIF ba feletsweng ke mesebetsi.
tgt: Le projekthi iza kudala imisebenzi kwicandelo lezophapho, elezokuntywila elwandle usenzela ingeniso kunye nelezolimo.

src: Sehlopha sa pele sa ba tla fola molemo se akga ba 50 ba kentseng letsoho ba tswang Boemafofaneng ba Virginia bo Durban ba 50 ba tswang projekeng ya kgwebo ya ho qwela metsing a lewatle e Scottsburg, KwaZulu-Natal, athe basadi ba mahaeng ba 100 ba tswang Emadungeni ba tla rupellwa hore ba thee koporasi ya ho lema le ho jala ditholwana, meroho le khothene tse holang ka mokgwa wa tlholeho, ho akga le ho lokisetswa ha thekiso ya tsona.
tgt: Le projekthi iqhutywa ngentsebenziswano ne-Dr John Langalibalele Dube Institute kunye neNgxowa-mali ye-Inshorensi yabaPhelelwe yimiSebenzi (i-UIF), yona eliqumrhu leSebe lezabaSebenzi.

src: Dikoporasi tsena di tekenne tumellano le Pick ‘n Pay bakeng sa ho e fepela ka meroho, hammoho le Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba bakeng sa ho fumana disebedisuwa tsa ho roka diyunifomo tsa dikolo.
tgt: Le projekthi iza kugxininisa kakhulu kwabo babetsalelwa imali ye-UIF baze baphelelwa yimisebenzi.

src: Kabinete e amohela pulo ya semmuso ya dikantoro tse ntjha tsa Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae tse Hluhluwe KwaZulu-Natal ke Moporesidente Ramaphosa.
tgt: Abantu bokuqala abaza kuxhamla kule projekthi baquka abantu abangama-50 ababetsalelwa imali yi-UIF besebenza eVirginia Airport eDurban abangama-50 ababeqeshwe kwiprojekthi yokuntywila eScottsburg kwiphondo laKwaZulu-Natal, bona oomama abali-100 belali yaseMadungeni baza kuqeqeshwa kwizakhono zokuseka ukopolotyeni ukuze bakwazi ukulima bashishine ngeziqhamo, imifuno nomqhaphu ongakhuliswanga ngomgquba onamachiza.

src: Nanabetso ena e atollotsweng ya ditshebeletso tsa setjhaba dibakeng tse neng di kotetswe, e na le seabo sa bohlokwa ho dumelleng le ho tebiseng demokrasi le toka setjhabeng.
tgt: Olu qeqesho luza kuquka neendlela zokuthatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo kunye neendlela zokulungisa nokuhlela iimveliso zilungiselelwe ukuthengiswa.

src: Sena se etsa karolo ya boikitlaetso ba mmuso ho atametseng ditshebeletso bathong.
tgt: Aba kopolotyeni batyikitye isivumelwano noPick n Pay apho baza kumthengisela imifuno kunye neSebe lezoPhuhliso loLuntu, lona eliza kuthenga amalaphu okwenza iiyunifomu zesikolo.

src: Lenaneo la ho Fallela Kgasong e Ntjha ya Dijithale.
tgt: ISebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya IKhabhinethi iyavuyiswa kukuvulwa ngokusesikweni nguMongameli Ramaphosa kwe-ofisi entsha yeSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya eHluhluwe kwiphondo laKwaZulu-Natal.

src: Kabinete e kgotsofetse ka kgatelopele e entsweng ya ho falla ha naha ho tloha kgasong ya kgale ya analoko ho ya ho e ntjha ya dijithale.
tgt: Amaphulo andisiweyo okuhambisa iinkonzo zisiya kwimimandla ehlelelekileyo adlala indima enkulu ekuqinisekiseni ukuba wonke ubani uyaluxhamla ulawulo lwentando yesininzi kunye nobulungisa bezentlalo.

src: Sena se tsamaisana le boikitlaetso boo ho dumellanweng ka bona le Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Meralo ya Dikgokahano.
tgt: Oku kuyinxalenye yamalinge karhulumente okusondeza iinkonzo ebantwini.

src: Letsholo la dikgokahanyo le se le thakgotswe ho netefatsa hore malapa ohle a ba malalaalaotswe bakeng sa ho tingwa hona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yanelisekile ngomsebenzi osele wenziwe malunga nokutshintsha uhlobo losasazo lwe-analogu kuyiwe kweledijithali kweli lizwe.

src: Malapa a nang le dithelevishene (TV) tse sebetsang ka analoko a batlang ho reka tse ntjha, a eletswa ka hore a reke tse nang le konopo ya dijithale e seng e hoketswe.
tgt: Njengenxalenye yamalungiselelo omcimbi oza kubanjwa ngeyoMnga kowama-2018 apho kuza kube kukho umsitho waseFreyistata wokuCinywa kweePali eziSasaza nge-Analogu, ipali yokuqala esasaza nge-analogu eseSenekal eFreyistata iza kucinywa ngomhla wama-20 kweyoMsintsi 2018.

src: Malapa a nang le lekeno le kahodimo ho sekepele sa R3 200 ka kgwedi a na le kgetho ya ho reka TV e ntjha e seng e hoketswe dijithale ebile e le e nang le dikhoudara ya TV ya Dijithale e bopelletsweng kahare, e fumanehang mabenkeleng a maholo a rekisang thepa.
tgt: Oku kuhambelana nesivumelwano esenziweyo noMbutho weHlabathi weziSeko zezoNxibelelwano (i-ITU).

src: Ho ya ka kgoeletso ya Moporesidente Ramaphosa ya ho kginwa nakwana ha dipukutlo tsa mesebetsi ka lebaka la maemo a moruo naheng ena, Kabinete e thasisetsa boipiletso ba yona ho bahiri hore taba ya ho heletswa mesebetsing e mpe e be ntho ya ho qetela eo ba ka e nahanang, le hore mekgwa e meng e teng ya sejwalejwale ya ho notla ditjeo e shebisiswe ka hloko molemong wa ho boloka mesebetsi ka nako e telele.
tgt: Liyaqhuba iphulo lokwazisa uluntu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba amakhaya ayazi futhi akulungele ukucinywa kweepali ezisasaza nge-analogu.

src: Kabinete e bo tjhaella monwana bokenadipakeng ba Setlamo sa tsa Toka, Thibelo ya Ditlolo tsa Molao le Tshireletso, ba ho tshetshetha ka potlako ka lewa le phethahetseng la ho lwantshana le dintho tse fapaneng tse ropohang dipalopalong tsa ditlolo tsa molao tse sa tswa ntshuwa.
tgt: Amakhaya anoomabonakude (ii-TV) abasasaza nge-analogu afuna ukuthenga oomabonakude abatsha ayacetyiswa ukuba athenge abo banobuxhaka-xhaka obuza kukwazi ukusasaza ngedijithali.

src: Sena se akga Seboka sa Naha ho Thibelo ya Ditlolo tsa Molao le Merusu se neng se tshwerwe haufinyane katlasa mookotaba wa, “Ho aba dibaka tse bolokehileng ka mokgwa o kopantsweng ebile e le o tswelang pele wa thibelo ya ditlolo tsa molao le merusu”, e leng se ileng sa rala tjhebelopele ya kopanelo ho tsa polokeho e le boikarabello bo kopanetsweng, sa ba sa fana ka lepatlelo bakeng sa ba amehang ba ka sehloohong esita le ditsebi ho tshetshetha ka ho kenngwa tshebetsong ho kgabane ha Tokomane ya Tataiso ya 2016 ho tsa Polokeho le Tshireletso makaleng ohle.
tgt: Amakhaya amkela umvuzo ongaphezulu kwalo umiselweyo ungama-3 200 eerandi ngenyanga angakhetha ukuthenga oomabonakude abatsha abanobuxha-xhaka obuza kukwazi ukusasaza ngedijithali abaphuma nedikhowuda ye-TV eSasaza ngeDijithali, efumaneka ezivenkileni ezinkulu.

src: Diketsahalo tsa merusu.
tgt: Ukudendwa kwabasebenzi.

src: Kabinete e ngongorehile haholo ka sekgahla sa merusu setjhabeng sa habo rona mme e etsa kgoeletso makaleng ohle, dibakeng tsohle esita le ditheong tsa qobello ya molao hore ho sebetswe mmoho ho netefatsa hore dikolo le dibaka tsa setjhaba di bolokehile ebile di tshireletsehile.
tgt: Njengoko uMongameli Ramaphosa ebecele ukuba ukhe umiswe umba wokudendwa kwabasebenzi owenzeka ngenxa yeemeko zezoqoqosho ezingentlanga kweli lizwe, iKhabhinethi nayo iyababongoza abaqeshi ukuba umba wokudenda abasebenzi babhenele kuwo njengeqhinga lokugqibela xa sele bezame onke amacebo futhi kuzanywe namanye amacebo okonga imali ukuze kungadendwa abasebenzi.

src: Ho ropoha ha bohloko ba Klebsiella.
tgt: Iinkcukacha-manani zolwaphulo-mthetho.

src: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso malapeng a masea a tsheletseng a hlokahetseng kamora ho ropoha ha bohloko ba Klebsiella pneumoniae Sepetleleng sa Thelle Mogoerane se Vosloorus.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakuvuma ukungenelela kweNtlanganisela yezobuLungisa, uThintelo loLwaphulo-mthetho noKhuseleko ukuze igwadle iqhinga elibanzi eliza kusabela kwimiba emininzi evele kwiinkcukacha-manani zolwaphulo-mthetho ebezisanda kukhutshwa kwezi veki zimbalwa zidlulileyo.

src: Letona la Bophelo bo Botle, Ngaka Aaron Motsoaledi, o se a entse tsebiso ya hore masea le bomma ona sepetleleng sena ba tla fetisetswa Sepetlele sa Bana sa Nelson Mandela le Sepetlele sa Dithuto sa Charlotte Maxeke Johannesburg ka tatelano.
tgt: La maqhinga aquka iNgqugquthela yeSizwe engoLwaphulo-mthetho noBundlobongela ibisanda kubanjwa kutsha nje phantsi komxholo othi "Ukwakha isizwe esikhuselekileyo ngokusebenzisa iindlela ezihlangeneyo neziphuhlisayo zokulwa ulwaphulo-mthetho nobundlobongela", apho kuthiwe kwaqulunqwa umbono ekubanjiswene ngawo wokhuseleko oluluxanduva lwethu sonke, kwaye le ngqungquthela isebenze njengeqonga apho amahlakani abalulekileyo kunye neengcali athe abonisana ngeendlela zokuphumeza iPhepha lowama-2016 eliCacisa uMgaqo-nkqubo wezoKhuselo noKhuseleko kuwo onke amacandelo.

src: Sena se fa lefapha la bophelo bo botle la profense monyetla wa ho hlwekisa tikoloho, esita le ho rarolla ditaba tsa sebopeho sa sepetlele, ntle le tshitiso ya letho.
tgt: Izenzo zobundlobongela IKhabhinethi ixhalabe kakhulu ngamazinga obundlobongela kweli lizwe lethu kwaye ihlaba ikhwelo kuwo onke amacandelo, uluntu ngokubanzi kunye nee-arhente zogcino-cwangco ukuba basebenzisane kuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba izikolo kunye namaziko oluntu akhuselekile.

src: Mokgekgetho wa diqholotsiKabinete e tshohlile yaba ya ananela mokgekgetho wa diqholotsi o sisintsweng, o sisinyang mehato ya ho tsosolosa moruo wa rona ho tswa ditshebetsong tse ngatanyana tse amanang le wona.
tgt: Ubundlobongela obenzeke eendaweni ezininzi zeli abamkelekanga kwaphela kwaye bunxamnye futhi bukhabana noMgaqo-siseko.

src: Seboka sa ditaba se etelletsweng pele ke Moporesidente Ramaphosa se tla tshwarwa ka Labohlano mohla la 21 Loetse ho teka mokgekgetho ona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwuqhwabela izandla uMbutho wamaPolisa oMzantsi Afrika (i-SAPS) ngokuba abambe ngokukhawuleza abo kurhaneleka ukuba bathathe inxaxheba kwizenzo zobundlobongela obenziwe esidlangalaleni kunye nabo bafunyenwe beneempahla ekukrokreleka ukuba zibiwe.

src: Ditlhabollo tse amanang le VISAKabinete e boetse ya amohela tlaleho ya kopanelo e tswang ho Matona a Merero ya Lehae le Bohahlaudi ka tatelano, mabapi le ditlhabollo tse ngatanyana tse amanang le visa tse tla nolofaletsa bahahlaudi, bahwebi le barutehi ho tla Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Ukuqhambuka kwe-Klebsiella IKhabhinethi ithi akuhlanga lungehliyo kwiintsapho zeentsana ezintandathu ezithe zasweleka ngethuba kuqhambuka isifo i-Klebsiella pneumoniae eThelle Mogoerane Hospital eVosloorus.

src: Ditlhabollo tsena di akga dihlomathiso melawaneng e sebetsang ho melata ya bana e etelang Aforika Borwa, tse tla phatlalatswa kaseteng ya mmuso ka Mphalane.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezeMpilo, uGq Aaron Motsoaledi, sele ebhengezile ukuba ezi ntsana kunye noonina bazo ziza kutshintshwa zithunyelwe eNelson Mandela Children's Hospital naseCharlotte Maxeke Johannesburg Academic Hospital.

src: Ditherisano tsa ho nyahlatswa ha ditlhoko tsa di-visa le ho nyehliswa ha ditlhoko tsa di-visa bakeng sa dinaha tse itseng, le tsona di a phethelwa.
tgt: Oku kuza kunika ithuba isebe lezempilo lephondo ukuba licoce lize libulale iintsholongwane zesi sifo kwesi sibhedlela, futhi lilungise neengxaki ezinxulumene nendlela esisebenza ngayo esi sibhedlela ngaphandle kokuphazanyiswa.

src: Kabinete e ananetse Dibili tse latelang bakeng sa ho phatlalatswa hore setjhaba se tshwaele ka tsona:.
tgt: Isicwangciso soncedo lwezimali IKhabhinethi isigwadlile yaze yasamkela isicwangciso soncedo lwezimali esiqulethe amanyathelo okukhwezela uqoqosho lweli asuka kumacandelo namasebe anxulumeneyo.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya 2017 ya Tekano Mesebetsing.
tgt: Kuza kubanjwa intlanganiso noonondaba ngoLwesihlanu umhla wama-21 kweyoMsintsi apho kuza kwenziwa intetho ngesi sicwangciso soncedo lwezimali.

src: Dihlomathiso tsena di habile ho matlafatsa mekgwa ya boikamahanyo mme di tla dumella ho ralwa ha dipeelo tsa lenane le badilweng tsa tekano mesebetsing ya makala a totobaditsweng.
tgt: Imithetho enxulumene nee-VISAIKhabhinethi iyifumene nengxelo yoMphathiswa weMicimbi yezeKhaya nowezoKhenketho, emalunga nemithetho enxulumene nee-VISA eza kwenza ukuba kube lula kubakhenkethi, oosomashishini kunye nezifundiswa ezifuna ukuza eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Letona la tsa Bosebetsi, ka pontshano le ba amehang lekaleng, ba tla kgona ho rala dipeelo tsa lenane le badilweng tsa tekano mesebetsing ya makala a totobaditsweng.
tgt: Le mithetho iquka izilungiso kwimithetho echaphazela abantwana abangabemi bangaphandle abeza eMzantsi Afrika, eziza kufakwa kwigazethi ngenyanga yeDwarha.

src: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya 2018 ya Melao ya Lekala la tsa Ditjhelete: Dihlomathiso tsena di habile ho matlafatsa ditlhoko tsa poloko ya matlotlo bakeng sa dibanka, ho akga le dibanka tsa kopanelo le tsa dikoporasi, le tse ding tse itseng tseo e seng dibanka.
tgt: Ziyaqukunjelwa iingxoxo malunga nomba wokungafunwa kwee-visa kunye nokuphungulwa kobucukubhede bee-visa obufunwa kubemi bamanye amazwe.

src: Letsatsi la Bojalefa.
tgt: ImiThetho esaYilwayo.

src: Keteko ya Letsatsi la Bojalefa la 2018 katlasa mookotaba o reng: “Selemo sa Nelson Mandela: Ho ntshetsa pele phetoho lepatlelong la bojalefa ba Aforika Borwa”, e tshwarelwa Lebaleng la Dipapadi la Riverview Kokstad, KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba le Mithetho isaYilwayo ipapashwe ukuze uluntu luhlomle:.

src: Ena ke karolo ya lenaneo le le lelele la kgwedi kaofela la diketsahalo tse rarollang dintho tse amanang le phetoho, phahamiso le paballo ya mohlahlwe wa bojalefa le manoni a Aforika Borwa.
tgt: UMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo woBulungisa kwezeNgqesho wowama-2017 Ezi zilungiso zenzele ukuphucula iinkqubo zokunyanzelisa ukuthotyelwa komthetho kwaye ziza kuvumela ukuba kubekwe umlinganiselo wecandelo ngalinye wenani labantu ekufanele baqeshwe ngenkqubo yokuzisa ubulungisa kwenzengqesho.

src: Keteko ena ya Letsatsi la Bojalefa e etsetswa ho tlotla Adam Kok le ditjhaba tsa Makgerikwa ka sebete, boikitlaetso le matla a bona ka ho hanana le boipehi ba bokoloniale.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezabaSebenzi, emva kokuba efakene imilomo namahlakani ecandelo lezabasebenzi, uza kube lo mmiselo uza kuba ngowecandelo ngalinye.

src: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho setjhaba hore se keteke kopano ya sona ka mohlahlwe wa sona, jwalo ka ha re sebetsa mmoho ho aha naha eo batho bohle ba yona ba hlomphanang ba bile ba tsotellana.
tgt: UMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo weMithetho yeCandelo lezeziMali wowama-2018: Ezi zilungiso zifuna ukucacisa umba wamagosa anyuliweyo ukuba athathe iintambo zolawulo xa ibhanki ibhengezwe njengenolawulo lwezimali oluqhwalelayo, kuquka neebhanki ezibizwa ngokuba zi-mutual bank kunye nezo zaziwa ngokuba zi-cooperative bank kunye namanye amaqumrhu abonelela ngeenkonzo zezimali kodwa engezozibhanki.

src: Kopano ena e reretswe ho ananela tsebiso ya selekane sa sepolotiki e duletsweng majwana ke Dinaha tseo e leng Ditho tsa UNGSena se etsahala kamora dipuisano tsa Baemedi ba Moshwelella mokgatlong wa UN ba Aforika Borwa le Ireland, ba sebetsang e le bahlophisetsi, hammoho le mebuso e mmedi ena ka dikateng tsa tsebiso ena ya selekane.
tgt: Ezi zilungiso ziza kuqinisekisa ukuba xa ethe amaziko ezimali aneengxaki akwazi ukufumana uncedo ngendlela eza kukhusela abantu abangathathi ntweni abagcinise imali kuyo kungakhange kubekho phazamiseko lungako kwinkqubo yezezimali kunye noqoqosho ngobubanzi.

src: MatshedisoKabinete e fetisetsa matshediso a yona ho malapa a lahlehetsweng ke baratuwa ba ona ho swahlamaneng ha bese ho etsahetseng mmileng wa N1-25 haufi le Tobias, Masepaleng wa Setereke sa Waterberg Limpopo.
tgt: USuku lwaMafa Umbihiyozo woSuku lweSizwe lwaMafa lowama-2018 phantsi komxholo othi: Unyaka kaNelson Mandela: Ukuqhubela phambili iinguqu kwezamafa eMzantsi Afrika" uza kubanjelwa eRiverview Stadium eKokstad, KwaZulu-Natal.

src: DithoholetsoKabinete e thoholetsa Letona la Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane, Mofumahadi Lindiwe Zulu, ka hore a amohelwe boemong bo hodimodimo ba Tlotlo ya Rio Branco (Ordem de Rio Branco), le Grand Cross ho tswa Mmusong wa Brazil.
tgt: Lo mbhiyozo uyinxalenye yemisitho eza kuqhuba inyanga yonke eza kube ingemiba equka iinguqu, ukuhlonitshwa nokulondoloza amafa neenkcubeko ezityebileyo nezahlukeneyo zoMzantsi Afrika, igama kunye nobuzwe bethu kunye nomba wokuhlalisana ngoxolo phakathi kweentlanga ezahlukeneyo.

src: Sena se entswe ka lebaka la matsapa a Letona a ntseng a tswelapele a ho ntlafatsa dikamano tsa dinaha tse pedi dipakeng tsa Brazil le Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Imibhiyozo yoSuku lwaMafa ihlonipha u-Adam Kok kunye nesizwe samaGriqua ngobugorha, isibindi nokukhalipha ngethuba besilwa inkqubo yobukholoniyali.

src: Tlotlo ena ya Brazil e fuwa bao ba ipabotseng ka diketso tsa tshebeletso e tswileng matsoho esita le makgetha a setjhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kuthi sonke lokuba sizidle futhi sibambisane njengabantwana besizwe esineentlanga ezahlukeneyo kodwa ezimanyeneyo kumalinge namaphulo okwakha ilizwe apho abantu bebonakalisa ukukhathalelana nokuhloniphana.

src: Letona Zulu e ne e le Leqosa la Aforika Borwa Brazil dipakeng tsa 2004 le 2008.DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di lokela ho netefatswa ka mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang.
tgt: Njengelinge lokufaka isandla kumaphulo okubhiyozela iminyaka elikhulu yokuzalwa kukaMongameli wangaphambili uNelson Mandela, ngomhla wama-24 kweyoMsintsi 2019 i-UNGA iza kubamba intlanganiso ephezulu eza kugwadla umba woxolo kwihlabathi ebizwa ngokuba yiNgqungquthela yoXolo kaNelson Mandela.

src: Boto ya Rand Water:a. Moadvokheiti Faith Matshidiso Hashatse (Modulasetulo)b. Mofumahadi Massacha Khulekelwe Glynnis Mbonambi (Motlatsi wa Modulasetulo)c. Monghadi LL Makibinyaned.
tgt: Injongo yale Ngqungquthela kukuhlonipha nokubhiyozela iminyaka elikhulu yokuzalwa kukaMadiba.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, 10 Mphalane 2018 Tuynhuys, ho la Motse Kapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibibambe intlanganiso ngoLwesithathu, umhla we-10 kweyeDwarha ngowama-2018 eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Dintlha tsa Hajwale Letsholo la moruo le tsetelo Kabinete e amohela diketso tsa tshebetso tse jwalo ka boitlamo ba ho reka dihlahiswa tse entsweng kahare ho naha, katamelo e matla ho feta ya ho eketsa dihlahiswa tse rekiswang kantle ho naha, mesebetsi kgwebong ya temo le tshehetso bakeng sa dikgwebo tse nyane le tse mahareng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawamkela amanyathelo okungenelela abonakalayo afana nokuzibophelela ekuthengeni iimveliso zeli, kuzanywe ngamandla ukunyusa umthamo weempahla ezithunyelwa kumazwe angaphandle, ukungenelela kumacandelo asebenza ngeemveliso zezolimo kunye nokuxhasa amashishini amancinci naphakathi.

src: Diphatlalatso tsena di hlahile Kopanong ya Mesebetsi ya matsatsi a mabedi e sa tswa tshwarwa, e tshwerweng tlasa Khansele ya Naha ya Ntshetsopele ya Moruo le Mesebetsi.2 Sephetho sa Kopano ya Mesebetsi se latela phatlalatso ya Morero wa Tsosoloso le Ntjhafatso ya Moruo, e rerileng ho tsosolosa kgolo ya moruo ya ho theha mesebetsi e hlokehang e le kannete.
tgt: La manyathelo aza kuthathwa aphakanyiswe kwiNgqungquthela yemiSebenzi eentsuku-mbini ibisanda kubanjwa, ebibizwe liBhunga leSizwe loPhuhliso loQoqoqsho nezaBasebenzi (i-Nedlac).

src: Tumellano e Ntjha ya Merafo – e phethetsweng ka tshebedisanommoho le indasteri ya merafo, kgwebo le ditjhaba tse amehileng le baamehi ba bang – e hlakisa dintlha tsa bohlokwa tsa kgolo, phehello le phetoho.3 Kabinete e kopa baamehi bohle ho sebetsana le Tumellano ya Merafo e le ho phethela le ho theha botsitso kgwebong ya merafo.
tgt: Isiphumo seNgqungquthela yemiSebenzi silandele ukwaziswa kwesiCwangciso sokuVuselela nokuHlumisa uQoqosho, esineenjongo zokubuyisela uqoqosho kuhlumo nokudala imisebenzi efunwa ngabomvu.

src: Ofisi ya Merero ya Lehae ya Kokstad le phano ya mangolo a beng ba matlo Kabinete hammoho le Mopresidente Cyril Ramaphosa ba lebohisa Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae bakeng sa ho bula ofisi ya Kokstad ho la KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: UMqulu wezeMigodi omtsha - obhalwe ngokusebenzisana kunye necandelo lezemigodi, abasebenzi, abantu bemimandla echaphazelekayo kunye namanye amahlakani - ucacisa imiba enxulumene nohlumo, uzinzo neenguqu.

src: Mopresidente o butse ofisi ya Merero ya Lehae jwalo ka karolo ya lenaneo la mmuso la ho atolosa kgato ya dibaka tsa phano ya ditshebeletso ya Merero ya Lehae ho kgotsofatsa ditlhoko tsa baahi bakeng sa dikarete tsa boitsebiso (di-Smart ID) le ditokomane tse ding.2 Ho feta moo, Mopresidente Ramaphosa o fane ka mangolo a beng ba matlo a 443 ho bajalefa ba Projeke ya Franklin Housing.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kuwo onke amahlakani ukuba awuhlalutye uMqulu wezeMigodi ukuze uqukunjelwe kuze kubekho uzinzo kwicandelo lezemigodi.

src: Tumellano ya phethelo mabapi le sepeketeramo Kabinete e amohela tumellano ya phethelo e fihletsweng tabeng e kenyelletsang Memo ya ho etsa Kopo bakeng sa kabo ya sepeketeramo sa tlhoko e phahameng.
tgt: I-ofisi yeSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya yaseKokstad kunye nokunikezelwa kweetayitile zezindlu.

src: Sena se fana ka botsitso ba pholisi lekaleng ka theknoloji ya tlhahisoleseding le dikgokahano (ICT).2 Tumellano ena ya phethelo e tsamaellana le pitso ya Mopresidente Ramophosa ya ho qala tshebetso ya kabo ya dilaesense tsa seyalemoya tsa sepeketeramo sa tlhoko e phahameng.4 E le ho kenya letsoho ka tsela tse eketsehileng ho tshebetso ya Tokomane ya Tataiso ya Pholisi e Kopantsweng ya Naha ya ICT, baamehi ba nang le kgahleho ba ka fana ka ditlatsetso tse ngotsweng ho fihlela la 8 Pudungwana 2018 ho pholisi e sisintsweng le tjhebo ya yona ho ba boholong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nayo njengoMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa iliqhwabela izandla iSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya ngokuvula enye i-ofisi eKokstad kwiphondo laKwaZulu-Natal.

src: Dikoporasi tsa pele tsa Aforika Borwa tse nyane tsa ditlhapi Kabinete e amohela dikoporasi tsa pele tsa Aforika Borwa tse nyane lekaleng la tsa ditlhapi, e leng dikoporasi tsa Port Nolloth le Hondeklipbaai ho la Kapa Leboya, tse hlomamisitsweng ke Letona la Temothou, Meru le Ditlhapi, Monghadi Senzeni Zokwana.2 Tlhomamiso e tshwaya ho kengwa tshebetsong ha pholisi ya ditheo tse nyane tsa ditlhapi.
tgt: UMongameli uvule ngokusesikweni le ofisi yeSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya njengenxalenye yenkqubo karhulumente yokwandisa amaziko ahambisa iinkonzo zeSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya ukuze kuncedakale abemi beli batsho bafumane amaKhadi-sazisi kunye namanye amaxwebhu.

src: Ditokelo tsa ditlhapi di fa batjhehi ba ditlhapi ba lehae seriti, ba neng ba tjheha ditlhapi ka ntle ho molao, ka hore jwale ba se ba sireleditswe ka lekgetlo la pele.3 Ditjhaba tse pedi tsa boraditlhapi ba banyenyane tse tla una molemo pholising ena di fumane thupelo ya motheo mabapi le dikoporasi mme di thusitswe ho ngodisa dikoporasi bakeng sa ho etsa dikopo tsa ditokelo tsa dilemo tse 15 tsa ho tjheha ditlhapi.
tgt: Ngaphezu koku, uMongameli Ramaphosa unikezele nangeetayitile zezindlu ezingama-443 ebantwini abaza kufumana izindlu kwiphulo lokwakha izindlu, i-Franklin Housing Project.

src: Sehla sa lekgetho.1 Kabinete e lebohisa balefi ba lekgetho ba haufi ho dimilione tse tharo ba tlatsitseng diforomo tsa bona tsa lekgetho, tseo ho tsona tse fetang halofo di nehelanweng ka eFiling.
tgt: Oku kuyinxalenye yenkqubo yokubuyisela abantu izidima zabo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba abo bafumene izindlu bawaxhamla onke amaqithi-qithi ahambelana nokuba nendlu kwaye bayakwazi ukuba nendlu enexabiso enokuthengiseka.

src: Balefi ba lekgetho bao eseng ba nakwana ba kgethang ho faela diforomo tsa bona ka eFiling ba ka etsa jwalo ho fihlela la 31 Pherekgong 20.2 Pokeletso e nepahetseng e sebetsang hantle e netefatsa matla a nahana a busang tjhelete ya yona, mme dinehelano tse etswang ka nako le ka nepo di netefatsa hore balefi ba lekgetho ba latela molao wa lekgetho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ifuna nokuthatha eli thuba ikhuthaze ebemi kangangoko ukuba baye kuthatha iincwadi-zasizi zabo ngokukhawuleza emva kokuba befumene imbalelwano ethi zikhona.

src: Tjhelete ya lekgetho e thusa mmuso ho fana ka tjhelete bakeng sa diprojeke tsa naha tsa phano ya ditshebeletso le mananeo a mang a ntshetsopele ya setjhaba le moruo.
tgt: Isivumelwano malunga namaza osasazo IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isivumelwano ekufikelelwe kuso kumba omalunga nokuba kuVulelekile ukuFaka iziCelo zokuba kukhutshwe amaza osasazo asetyenziswa kakhulu.

src: Ditefo tsa digrante tsa setjhaba Kabinete e tlalehetswe ke Komiti ya Mafapha a Kopaneng: Digrante tsa Setjhaba, eo modulasetulo wa yona e leng Letona Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma.
tgt: Oku kuwenza utsho ucace umgaqo-nkqubo weli kulo mba wecandelo lezobuchwepheshe bolwazi nonxibelelwano (i-ICT).

src: Ho tloha ka la 1 Mphalane 2018, bajalefa ba fetang dimilione tse 10 ba lefilwe ka tshebediso ya e nngwe ya mekgwa ena – Ofisi ya Poso ya Aforika Borwa (SAPO)/Postbank Grindrod Bank hammoho le barekisi ba bang ba jwalo ka Boxer, Shoprite, le Pick n Pay.2 Mmuso o atlehile ho tlosa tefo ya digrante tsa setjhaba ho tloha ho Cash Paymaster Services (CPS) jwalo ka ha ho laetswe ke Kahlolo ya Lekgolo la Molaotheo.
tgt: Esi sivumelwano sihambelana nesicelo ebesenziwe nguMongameli Ramaphosa sokuba kuqaliswa ngenkqubo yokukhutshwa kweelayisenisi zamaza osasaso asetyenziswa kakhulu.

src: Bajalefa bohle ba kontane ba lefuwang ke CPS ba fetiseditswe mme CPS e se e tsebisitswe ka phediso ya konteraka ho tloha ka la 30 Loetse 20.3 Kabinete e leboha mosebetsi o motle wa botsamaisi o neng o etelletswe pele ke Komiti ya Mafapha a Kopaneng e tsheheditswe ke Sehlopha sa Mosebetsi wa Botekgeniki sa Balaodikakaretso.
tgt: Ngelinge lokuzama ukufaka igalelo kwiphulo lokuphumeza iPhepha eliCacisa uMgaqo-nkqubo weSizwe oHlanganisiweyo we-ICT, abo banomdla banikwe kude kube ngumhla wesi-8 kweyeNkanga ngowama-2018 ukuba bangenise kwabasemagunyeni izimvo zabo ezibhalwe phantsi ngalo mgaqo-nkqubo ucetywayo kunye nendlela ekufuneka usebenze ngayo.

src: E boetse e fetisetsa diteboho tsa yona ho basebeletsi ba SAPO, Setheo sa Aforika Borwa sa Tshireletseho ya Setjhaba (SASSA) le, lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba la Meralo ya Dikgokahanyo le Ditshebeletso tsa Poso la Merero, Bodisa le Tlhatlhobo ya Tshebetso la Matlotlo a Setjhaba Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa ya Aforika Borwa (SAPS) le Tsamaiso ya Dikgokahanyo le Tlhahisoleseding ya Mmuso (GCIS).4 Kabinete e leboha bajalefa bohle ba digrante tsa setjhaba bakeng sa tshebedisanommoho ya bona nakong ya phetoho ena.
tgt: Ookopolotyeni boMzantsi Afrika bokuqala abancinci becandelo lezokuloba IKhabhinethi iyabamkela ookopolotyeni bokuqala abancinci becandelo lezokuloba eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Diketekelo tsa Dilemokgolo tsa Mme Albertina Sisulu Kabinete e tlalehetswe ka ditokiso tsa ketekelo ya dilemokgolo tsa Mama Albertina Sisulu tse tla etsahala nakong ya kgwedi ya hae ya tswalo ya Mphalane.
tgt: Aba kopolotyeni ngaba: owasePort Nolloth nowaseHondeklipbaar eMntla Koloni, ophehlelelwe nguMphathiswa wezoLimo, amaHlathi nezokuLoba, uMnu Senzeni Zokwana.

src: Mama Sisulu o hlahile ka la 21 Mphalane 1918 mme Modulasetulo wa IMC bakeng sa Diketekelo tsa Dilemokgolo, Letona Jeff Radebe, o teng mona ho tla hlalosa diketsahalo tse tlang tse amanang le mokete wa dilemokgolo.
tgt: Ukusekwa kwaba kopolotyeni kukuqala kokuphunyezwa komgaqo-nkqubo wamaqumrhu amancinci ezokuloba.

src: Kahlolo ya ntate wa Springs.1 Kabinete e amohela kahlolo ya monna ya hlekefetsang, ya tsejwang ka hore ke Kgodumodumo ya Springs.
tgt: Amalungelo okuloba abuyisela isidima sabalobi bezi ndawo ebebekade beloba ngokungekho mthethweni, kuba ngoku bakhuselwe ngumthetho okokuqala ezimbalini.

src: O ahloletswe ho hlola dilemo tse 35 tjhankaneng bakeng sa teko ya ho bolaya mora wa hae, tlhekefetso ya bana le ho se tsotelle bana, hammoho le ho sebedisa le ho hweba ka dithethefatsi.
tgt: Ezi ndawo zimbini zinabalobi aboloba umthamo omncinci ziza kuxhamla kulo mgaqo-nkqubo zifumene uqoqosho olusisiseko ngeendlela zokuqhuba ookopolotyeni kwaye ziza kuncedwa ukuba zibhalise ookopolotyeni ukuze zikwazi ukufaka izicelo zelungelo lokuloba eliza kuqhuba iminyaka eli-.

src: Tlhekefetso ya bong e dula e le bothata bo boholo setjhabeng sa rona, jwalo ka ha re bone ka peto e sa tswa etsahala ya ngwana e monyane sebakeng sa ho jella sa Dros, Silverton.2 Kabinete e hatisella dikgoelletso tsa hore ditheo tsa tshebetso ya molao di etse tsohle tse matleng a tsona ho qosa baetsi ba ditlolo tsena tsa molao tse harosang dibete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyababulela abahlawuli berhafu abamalunga nezigidi ezithathu abasele bezingenisile iingxelo zabo zerhafu, oninzi lwabo bazingenise ngokusebenzisa i-intanethi, i-e-Filing.

src: E boetse e hoella le rona bohle hore re sebetseng mmoho ho emisa tlhekefetso ya ditokelo tsa bana le ditho tsa setjhaba tse sa bolokehang ka ho fetisisa.
tgt: Ngomhla wama-31 kweyeDwarha, ixesha lokungenisa iingxelo zerhafu lowama-2018 liyavala kwabo bamkela umvuzo endaweni enye kwakunye nabo banemithombo emininzi yengeniso bakhetha ukungenisa iingxelo zabo zerhafu kwii-ofisi zeQumrhu leRhafu loMzantsi Afrika (i-SARS).

src: Boipelaetso ba Westbury Kabinete e amohela tshebetso ya Letona la Sepolesa Bheki Cele ho la Westbury, eo e leng karolo ya moralo o pharalletseng wa ho lwantsha bothata ba dithethefatsi le dintwa tse amanang le maqulwana sebakeng seo.2 Tshebetso ena e kenyelletsa ho romelwa ha Sehlopha sa Tshebetso e Radilweng sa Thibelo ya Botlokotsebe (TRT - Maberete) le boteng bo eketsehileng ba sepolesa.
tgt: Abo baneminye imithombo yengeniso bakhethe ukungenisa iingxelo zabo zerhafu besebenzisa i-intanethi bavumelekile kude kube ngumhla wama-31 kweyoMqungu ngowama-2019 ukuba benze oko.

src: Sa bohlokwa ke hore, ho boetse ho tla ba le dipatlisiso mabapi le manyofonyofo a etsahalang kahare ho Seteishene sa Sepolesa sa Westbury.3 Kabinete e bitsa setjhaba sa Westbury le ditjhaba tsohle hore di sebetse le sepolesa ho netefatsa hore re fatolla diteketso tsa botlokotsebe, dithethefatsi le maqulwana dibakeng tse fapaneng tse ba dulang ho tsona.
tgt: Ukuqokelela irhafu ngendlela efanelekileyo nangobuchule kuqinisekisa ukuba eli lizwe liyakwazi ukuqokelela irhafu ngendlela ezimeleyo, kwaye ukungeniswa kwamaxwebhu engxelo yexesha elifanelekileyo nangokuchanekileyo kuqinisekisa ukuba abahlawuli-rhafu bathobela umthethho.

src: Botlokotsebe.1 Kabinete e lebohisa ditheo tsa molao ka ho etsa dipatlisiso tse matla tsa makala a fapaneng tse amanang le diketsahalo tsa dimolong, mabenkeleng le dimoskeng tse lebisitseng ho ho tshwarwa ha babelaellwa ba Di ne di kenyelletsa Sehlopha sa Toka, Thibelo ya Botlokotsebe le Tshireletso.
tgt: Imali yerhafu inceda urhulumente ukuba akwazi ukuxhasa iiprojekthi zonikezelo-nkonzo kunye nezinye inkqubo zophuhliso loqoqosho nezentlalo.

src: Babelaellwa ba bararo ba tshwerwe mabapi le disebediswa tsa diqhomane sebakeng sa Durban, ho kenyelletswa le Mosque wa Verulam.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe ingxelo yiKomiti yabaPhathiswa abaHlukeneyo: yeziBonelelo zezeNtlalo zikaRhulumente, usihlalo wayo onguMphathiswa uNkosazana Dlamini-Zuma.

src: Ho lebelletswe hore babelaellwa bohle ba tla shebana le diqoso tse kenyelletsang polao, teko ya polao le ho tlola Molao wa Diqhomane.2 Kabinete e netefalletsa maAforika Borwa hore ho lwantshwa botlokotsebe ho bohlokwa haholo le hore mmuso o tla tswelapele ho nka mehato e hlokehang ho netefatsa hore ho ba le tikoloho e bolokehileng hape e sireletsehileng bakeng sa baahi bohle ba Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Ukusukela ngomhla woku-1 kweyeDwarha 2008, abantu abamkela inkam-nkam abangaphezulu kwizigidi ezili-10 bafumene imali yabo kwezi ndawo zilandelayo: ePosini yoMzantsi Afrika/Postbank eGrindrod Bank kwakunye nakwivenkile ezinkulu ezifana noBoxer, Shoprite kunye noPick n Pay.

src: Diphetolo tsa mabitso: Makhanda Kabinete e amohela phetolo ya lebitso la Grahamstown, ho la Kapa Botjhabela, hore e be Makhanda, ho tlotla moprofeta wa moXhosa, rafilosofi le lesole le neng le lwana kgahlanong le bokoloniale.2 Phetoho ena ke karolo e bohlokwa ya leeto la rona la demokrasi mme e tla thusa ho aha katamelano ya setjhaba e eketsehileng le ho aha kutlwisiso e tebileng ya nalane ya rona eo re e arolelanang.
tgt: Urhulumente uyithathile inkqubo yokuhlawulwa kwemali yenkam-nkam kwaCash Paymaster Services (u-CPS) njengoko isiGwebo seNkundla yoMgaqo-siseko sasitshilo.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete Kabinete e amohetse mmotlolo o shebilweng botjha wa phano ya ditshebeletso wa Projeke ya Phetolo ya Phatlalatso ya Dijithale.
tgt: Bonke abantu abebesamkela imali yabo kwa-CPS ngoku batshintshiwe kwaye u-CPS ebesithunyelwe isaziso sokuba isivumelwano siyaphela ngomhla wama-30 kweyoMsintsi 2018.

src: Mmotlolo ona o sebedisa mokgwa o kgannwang ke mmaraka/mabenkele ka tshebedisanommoho le dikamano le lekala la poraefete le indasteri.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibamba ngazibini kumsebenzi omhle kakhulu wokuba liliso obukhokelwe yiKomiti yabaPhathiswa abaHlukeneyo ixhaswa liQela leeNgcali labaLawuli-Jikelele.

src: Ka mokgwa ona, mmuso o ke ke wa hlola o nka karolo patlong ya mabokose a ‘set-top’, poloko ya tsona dibakeng tse kgolo tsa poloko, tsamaiso ya tsona le ho kengwa ha disebediswa tsena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwabulela nomsebenzi owenziwe ngamagosa asePosini, i-Arhente yeziBonelelo zezeNtlalo noMhlala-phantsi yaseMzantsi Afrika (u-Sassa) kunye neSebe lezoPhuhliso loLuntu, eleziSeko zoPhuhliso zezoNxibelelwano neeNkonzo zePosi, elezokuCwangcisa, ukuHlola nokuVavanya, uNondyebo weSizwe uMbutho wamaPolisa oMzantsi Afrika (i-SAPS) kunye neZiko lezoNxibelelwano nokuSasazwa koLwazi lukaRhulumente (i-GCIS).

src: Sena se fa Aforika Borwa motjha wa ho phethela projeke ka tsela e kenyelletsang bohle, e theko e tlase hape e sebetsang hantle mme e fokotsang kotsi bakeng sa mmuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyababulela nabantu abamkela imali yenkam-nkam ngokusebenzisana norhulumente ngethuba kutshintshwe le ndlela yokuhlawula imali yabo.

src: Sena se tla sutumelletsa phetoho ya bobohi ba dijithale hore bo be palong e ka bang 85% le ho feta, ho lebisa ho ho tingwa ha diphatlalatsi tsa analoko.
tgt: UMbhiyozo weMinyaka eliKhulu ka-Albertina Sisulu IKhabhinethi inikwe ingxelo ngamalungiselo ombhiyozo weminyaka elikhulu yokuzalwa kukaMama Albertina Sisulu oza kubanjwa kule nyanga yeDwarha, eyinyanga yakhe yokuzalwa.

src: Kabinete e amohetse Tokomane ya Aforika Borwa ya Botebo bo Tshwanang, e tla nehelanwa ho Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN).
tgt: USihlalo we-IMC yeMibhiyozo yeMinyaka eliKhulu, uMphathiswa Jeff Radebe ukhona apha phakathi kwethu, kwaye uza kunika ingcaciso ngemisitho eza kubanjwa enxulumene nemibhiyozo yeminyaka elikhulu.

src: Tokomane ena e fana ka kgatelopele e nang le tlhahisoleseding ya mofuta o akaretsang, wa nnete le wa dipalopalo ho tatelo ya Aforika Borwa ya ditshwanelo tse hoketsweng ho ditumellano tse robong tse tekennweng tsa UN.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukugwetywa kwendoda ibixhaphaza abantu, ebizwa ngokuba sisiGebenga saseSprings.

src: Diketsahalo tse TlangPolelo ya Pholisi ya Tekanyetso ya Nako e Bohareng (MTBPS)Letona la Ditjhelete Tito Mboweni le tla fana ka Polelo ya Pholisi ya Tekanyetso ya Nako e Bohareng (MTBPS) ka Laboraro, la 24 Mphalane 2018, le tla hlahisa diphetolo ho bajete ya naha ho netefatsa tshwarello ya tsa ditjhelete.
tgt: Ugwetywe iminyaka engama-35 ethothoza kwesimnyama isisele ngenxa yokufuna ukubulala unyana wakhe, ukuxhaphaza abantwana nokungakhathaleli abantwana, kwakunye nokuthengisa iziyobisi.

src: Kgwedi ya Dipalangwang Lenaneo la selemo sena la Kgwedi ya Dipalangwang le tla hatisella bohlokwa ba disebediswa tsa dipalangwang, jwalo ka lekala la tsa lewatle, la difofane, la diporo le la ditsela jwalo ka dikganni tsa kgolo ya moruo.
tgt: Ubundlobongela obujoliswe kwabesini esithile kuseyingxaki embi kakhulu kweli lizwe lethu njengoko sibone inyala lokudlwengulwa komntwana eDros eSilverton.

src: Kabinete e kopa setjhaba hore se sebedise dipalangwang tsa setjhaba le ho kenya tshebetsong matsholo a polokeho mebileng selemo ho pota.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaliphinda ikhwelo layo lokuba ii-arhente zogcino-mthetho zenze konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuba abenzi bezi zenzo zolwaphulo-mthetho zihambisa umzimba bayatshutshiswa.

src: Ha re sebediseng kgwedi ena ho keteka le ho busetsa tlwaelo ya mekgatlo ya ho tsamaya mmoho ho ya mosebetsing ho fokotsa sephethephethe mebileng ya rona.
tgt: Iyaphinda iyasibongoza thina sisonke ukuba sisebenzisana size siphelise umkhuba wokunyhashwa kwamalungelo abantwana kunye nabo basesichengeni sokuba ngamaxhoba okuxhatshazwa.

src: Polokeho mebileng ya rona e ntse e le bothata bo boholo, mme bakganni le ditaaso di lokela ho sebedisa mebila ka boikarabello.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakubulela ukungenelela koMphathiswa wezaMapolisa uBheki Cele, okuyinxalenye yesicwangciso esibanzi sokulwa ingxaki yeziyobisi nobundlobongela obunxulumene namaqela emigulukudu obuqhutywa kule ndawo.

src: Melaetsa Ditebohiso Theleskoupu ya seyalemoya ya Aforika Borwa, e leng MeerKAT, e tla kenya letsoho ho Breakthrough Listen, e leng letsholo la matjhaba le batlang matshwao a bophelo bo bohlale sepakapakeng.
tgt: Ukungenelela apha kuquka ukutyalwa kweCandelo lamaPolisa eliQeqeshwe laGqibelela (TRT — amaBharethe) kunye nokuqinisekisa ukuba amapolisa ayabonakala ezitalatweni kule ndawo.

src: E supa botsebi ba rona bo tsejwang lefatsheng ka bophara le meaho.
tgt: Kodwa okubalulekileyo kukuba kufuneka ziphandwe izityholo zorhwaphilizo kwiSikhululo samaPolisa saseWestbury.

src: Theleskoupu ya seyalemoya ya Aforika Borwa ya dikotlolo tse 64 ya MeerKAT, e hlomamisitsweng ka Phupu selemong sena, ke theleskoupu e utlwellang haholo ho fetisisa lefatsheng lohle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubantu baseWestbury kunye nakubo bonke abantu ukuba basebenzisane namapolisa ukuze baqinisekise ukuba isitshulwa neengcambu ingxaki yolwaphulo-mthetho, iziyobisi kunye neyamaqela emigulukudu noonqevu.

src: Kabinete e lebohisa sehlopha sa bafuputsi ba Yunivesithi ya Wits se entseng phetolo e atlehileng ya nalane ho tlosa sebete ho tswa ho Mme ya nang le tshwaetso ya HIV ho ya ho ngwana wa hae ya senang HISehlopha sa dingaka se ne se kenyelletsa Moprofesara Jean Botha, Ngaka Francesca Conradie, Ngaka Harriet Etheredge, Ngaka June Fabian le Moprofesara Caroline Tiemessen.
tgt: Ulwaphulo-mthetho IKhabhinethi iziqhwabela izandla ii-arhente zogcino-mthetho ngokuqhuba uphando lwamacandelo amaninzi olunxulumente nezenzo kumaziko anodederhu lweevenkile, ezivenkileni ezinkulu nakwii-mosque, uphando olo lukhokelele ekubanjweni kwabarhanelwa abali-19.

src: Letona Molewa o ipabotse mesebetsing le matsholong a mangata, ho tloha ho tlatsetso ya hae ntweng ya tokoloho ho isa ho ntweng ya tekatekano ya basadi setjhabeng.
tgt: Olu phando luquke iNtlanganisela yezobuLungisa, uThintelo loLwaphulo-mthetho noKhuseleko.

src: E boetse e bile mampodi wa naha le wa matjhaba bakeng sa poloko ya tikoloho bakeng sa lefatshe le tswellang le ka arolelanwang le ho natefelwa ke bohle.
tgt: Abanye abarhanelwa abathathu baye babanjelwa izityholo ezimayelana neziqhushumbisi kummandla waseDurban, oquka i-Verulam Mosque.

src: Kabinete e lebisa matshediso ho mmuso le batho ba Indonesia.
tgt: Bonke abarhanelwa kulindeleke ukuba babekwe amatyala aquka ukubulala kunye nokuzama ukubulala kunye nokwaphula uMthetho weziQhushumbisi.

src: Mmuso o se o tshepisitse tshehetso ya ona, moo ho hlokehang, mme Kabinete e tlotla basebetsi ba maAforika Borwa ba thuso ba nkileng karolo mesebetsing ya thuso Sehlekehlekeng sa Indonesia sa Sulawesi, se otluweng ke ho reketla ha lefatshe le tsunami.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabaqinisekisa kwakhona abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba umba wokulwa ulwaphulo-mthetho ukhokeliswa phambili kwaye urhulumente uza kuqhubeleka ethatha amanyathelo afunekayo ukuqinisekisa ukuba bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika bakhuselekile.

src: Kabinete e lebisa matshediso ho lelapa le basebetsimmoho ba Mofumahatsana Rowena Baird ya hlokahetseng bekeng ena.
tgt: Ukutshintshwa kwegama: eMakhanda IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukutshintshwa kwegama elithi 'Grahamstown', ledolophana yaseMpuma Koloni, langu-'Makhanda', ukuhlonipha inkuntsela yemboni, isisele netsili lolwazi kunye negorha leemfazwe ezazisilwa inkqubo yobukholoniyali.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, 24 Mphalane 2018 ho la Tuynhuys, Motse Kapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibibambe intlanganiso ngoLwesithathu, umhla wama-24 kweyeDwarha ngowama-2018 eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Dintlha tsa Hajwale.
tgt: Imiba engundaba-mlonyeni.

src: Polelo ya Pholisi ya Tekanyetso ya Nako e Bohareng (MTBPS)1.1 Kabinete e amohela MTBPS ya pele ka Letona la Ditjhelete Tito Mboweni, e thehilweng hodima tumelo e matla ya hore Afrika Borwa e ka ntjhafatswa.2 MTBPS ya 2018 e totobatsa dikgetho tsa thata tsa moruo le lekgetho tse tjametseng mmuso nakong ya dilemo tse tharo tse tlang.
tgt: INtetho yoMgaqo-nkqubo woHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali lwesiGaba esiPhakathi (i-MTBPS).

src: Kgolo ya moruo bakeng sa 2018 e fetoletswe tlase ho tloha ho 1.5% ho ya ho 0.7%, mme tikoloho ya lefatshe e dula e ntse e le thata bakeng sa meruo ya mebaraka e thuthuwang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela i-MTBPS yokuqala yoMphathiswa wezeMali uTito Mboweni, esekelwe kumoya ongagungqiyo wokuba uMzantsi Afrika ungakhutshwa kule ntsunguzi.

src: MTBPS ya 2018 e qala tshebetso ya morero wa Mopresidente wa tsosoloso ya kgolo ya moruo le puseletso, tse tla tshehetswa ke botsitso ba tsa lekgetho le ditjhelete.3 Mmuso o dula o itlametse botsitso ba tsa lekgetho, empa ho bile le phokotseho esale ho tloha ka puo ya Ditekanyetso ya 2018 ka Hlakola selemong sena.
tgt: I-MTBPS yowama-2018 igxininisa imeko enzima yezoqoqosho neyezezimali urhulumente aseza kujamelene nayo kule minyaka mithathu izayo.

src: Papisong le tikoloho e phephetsang ya moruo le tsa lekgetho, karolo e sisingwang ya lekeno e tswelapele ho beha sehlohlolong mananeo a tshebediso e hodimo ya tjhelete a tshehetsang ditshebeletso tsa thuto ya motheo, bophelo bo botle, boiketlo ba setjhaba, metsi, tlhwekiso le motlakase.
tgt: I-MTBPS yowama-2018 izalisekisa isicwangciso sikaMongameli sokuvuselela nokuhlumisa uqoqosho, sona esisekelwe kuzinzo kwimali zombuso nakwimali-nzala.

src: Kopano ya Mopresidente ya Bophelo bo Botle Kabinete e amohela diphetho tsa Kopano ya Mopresidente ya Bophelo bo Botle tse reretsweng ho sebetsana le diphephetso tse fapaneng tseo sistimi ya setjhaba ya bophelo bo botle e tobaneng le tsona.
tgt: Urhulumente uzimisele ekuqinisekiseni ukuba kukho uzinzo kwizimali zakhe, kodwa kuye kwakhona ukuyekelela kwisandla solawulo lwezimali ukususela kuHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali lowama-2018 ngeyoMdumba kulo nyaka.

src: Diphetho di tla matlafatsa ditukisetso tsa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Inshorense ya Naha ya Bophelo bo Botle.
tgt: Urhulumente uzimisele ukungaqhubeleki eboleka aze aliphungule netyala lakhe.

src: Phetolo ya lefatshe Kabinete e amohela ho kenngwa tshebetsong ho tsitsitseng ha mananeo a phetolo le pusetso ya lefatshe a lokisang tlhokeho ya toka ya nako e fetileng le ho thusa ho hodisa moruo.2 Mopresidente Cyril Ramaphosa o etelletse pele mokete wa pusetso ya lefatshe, moo dihektere tse 4 586 tsa lefatshe di fuweng setjhaba sa KwaMkhwanazi ho la Empangeni, KwaZulu-Natal.3 Setjhaba sa KwaMkhwanazi se boetse se tla fumana dikapana tsa kamora phallo le tshehetso tse tla ba thusa ho fihlella tshebediso e hodimodimo ya leruo la lefatshe leo.
tgt: Phantsi kwezi meko zezimali nezoqoqosho zimaxongo, olu lwabiwo-mali lucetywayo lisaqhubeleka nokukhokelisa phambili ukugalela imali kwinkcitho yeenkqubo zezentlalo ezixhasa imfundo esisiseko, iinkonzo zempilo, intlalontle yoluntu, iinkonzo zamanzi, ezogutyulo nothutho lwelindle kunye nombane.

src: Sena se tlosa ditjhaba ho tloha ho hoba dihwai tsa malapa a bona hore ebe dihwai tsa kgwebo le beng ba dikgwebo mekgahlelong e fapaneng ya matsete a lefatshe la bona.4 Mmuso o ikemiseditse ho tshehetsa boteng ba dikgwebo tse thuthuhang tsa temo, ho akgang diprojeke tse 262 tse amanang le phetolo ya lefatshe ho fa batjha le basadi molemo diporofenseng tsohle.
tgt: INgqungquthela yezeMpilo kaMongameli IKhabhinethi iyazamkela iziphumo zeNgqungquthela yezeMpilo kaMongameli ebilungiselelwe ukulungisa imingeni emininzi inkqubo yezempilo karhulumente ejamelene nayo.

src: Tshenyo ya disebediswa tsa setjhaba Kabinete e hlahisitse ngongoreho mabapi le tshenyo ya disebediswa tsa dipalangwang.
tgt: Iziphumo zale Ngqungquthela ziza kunceda kakhulu kumalungiselelo okuqalisa i-Inshorensi yezeMpilo yeSizwe (i-NHI).

src: Sena se nyotobetsa boitlamo ba mmuso ba ho isa ditshebeletso ho ditjhaba tse neng di sotlehileng nakong ya kgale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuqhutywa ngokuthe gqolo kwenkqubo yokubuyekezwa nokubuyiswa komhlaba elungisa umonakalo ombi wangaphambili futhi nenceda kuhlumo loqoqosho.

src: Leha batho ba ka se kgotsofale ka tsela e kgolo, ha baa lokela ho senya thepa ya setjhaba.
tgt: UMongameli Cyril Ramaphosa ebekhokela umsitho wokubuyiselwa komhlaba, apho umhlaba ozihektare ezingama-4 586 unikezelwe abantu baKwaMkhwanazi Empangeni, kwiphondo laKwaZulu-Natal.

src: Tshenyo ena e hlokisa batho ba sotlehileng ditshebeletso tseo ba di hlokang e le kannete.2 Kabinete e kopa ditho tsa setjhaba hore di be sedi mme di sebetse mmoho le ditheo tsa molao hore ba ikarabellang diketsong tsena ba tshwarwe.
tgt: Abantu baKwaMkhwanazi baza kufumana isibonelelo kunye noncedo lasemva kokubuyiselwa umhlaba eliza kubanceda batsho bakwazi ukuxhamla bonke ubutyebi obukuwo.

src: Kabinete e boetse e lemohile hore Sehlopha sa Toka, Thibelo ya Botlokotsebe le Tshireletso se tla sebetsana le taba ena ka nepo.
