src: Ditaba tse Itlhommeng Pele Lekgotla la Kakaretso la Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UNGA) Kabenete e ananetse puo e tshetlehilweng ke Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa ho UNGA ya bo-78 e neng e tshwaretswe New York, Amerika ho tloha ka la 18 ho ya ho la 26 Loetse 2023.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele intetho kaMongameli u-Cyril Ramaphosa kwi-UNGA yama-78 nebibanjelwe e-New York, e-United States of America ukusuka ngomhla we-18 ukuya kowama-26 kweyoMsintsi ngowama-2023.

src: Puo ya Moporesidente e ananetsweng ke ba bangata e tobokeditse boemo ba Afrika Borwa ba ho lwanela ditabatabelo le seabo se nang le tekano le matla tsa kontinente ya Afrika le Dinaha tse Ntseng di Tswela Pele, ka kakaretso, ho UN le dibakeng tse ding tse kopanyang dinaha tse fapaneng.
tgt: Intetho kaMongameli eyamkelwe ngokubanzi iphinde yaqinisekisa kwakhona isikhundla soMzantsi Afrika ekukhuthazeni umdla, kunye nasekuthatheni inxaxheba okulinganayo kwaye okunentsingiselo kwelizwekazi i-Afrika kunye namazwe akwi-Global South jikelele kwi-UN kunye nakwezinye iiforam zamazwe ngamazwe.

src: Puo e boetse ya toboketsa maikemisetso a Afrika Borwa ho batleng tshehetso bakeng sa:
tgt: Le ntetho ikwaphinde yaqinisekise ukuzinza koMzantsi Afrika ekuhlanganiseni inkxaso:a) ukuzinikela ngokutsha kumanyano lwamazwe ngamazwe, olusekwe kwimithetho ecacileyo kwaye exhaswa ngamaziko asebenzayo.

src: tsoseletso ya boinehelo tshebedisanong ya dinaha, ho itshetlehilwe melaong e hlakileng mme tshebedisano ena e tshehetswa ke ditheo tse sebetsang hantle.
tgt: b) uhlaziyo lweBhunga lezoKhuseleko le-UN (i-UNSC), ukunika intsingiselo kumthetho-siseko wokulingana kwezizwe ezizimeleyo kunye nokwenza ukuba i-UNSC iphendule ngempumelelo kwizinto ezenzekayo ngoku kwiipolitiki zelizwe.

src: ho tliswa ha diphetoho Lekgotleng la Tshireletseho la Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UNSC), molemong wa ho hlakisa motheo wa tekano ya dinaha tse ikemetseng le ho thusa UNSC ho arabela ka katleho maemo a teng pakeng tsa dinaha tse fapaneng.
tgt: c) izizwe ezityebileyo mazandise inkxaso mali ukuze kuphunyezwe i-Ajenda yama-2030 yoPhuhliso oluZinzileyo kunye nokufezekisa iinjongo zabo zokutshintsha kwemozulu ngendlela ebanzi kwaye edibeneyo, kubandakanywa nesidingo sokusebenza ngokukhawuleza kwengxowa-mali i-Loss and Damage Fund yamazwe asemngciphekweni wokuhlaselwa kakhulu yintlekele yemozulu, njengoko kwakuvunyelwene kwiSeshini yama-27 yeNkomfa yamaQela neyayibanjelwe e-Egypt ngeyeNkanga wama-2022.

src: hore dinaha tse tswetseng pele di eketse thuso ya tsona ya ditjhelete molemong wa ho kenya tshebetsong Morero wa 2030 wa Ntshetsopele ya Moshwelella, le hore di fihlelle maikemisetso a tsona a diphetoho tsa tlelaemete ka mokgwa o phethahetseng le o momahaneng, ho kenyeletsa tlhokeho ya ho potlakisa ho kenya tshebetsong Letlole la Tahlehelo le Tshenyehelo la dinaha tse kotsing tse anngweng habohloko ke dikoduwa tsa tlelaemete, jwalokaha ho dumellanwe Sesheneng ya Seboka sa Dinaha le Mekgatlo sa bo-27 se neng se tshwaretswe Egepeta ka Pudungwana 2022.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa ukuqinisekisile ukuzinikela koMzantsi Afrika ekuqhubekeni kujongana nokutshintsha kwemozulu kunye nokubeka eli lizwe njengenkokeli kumandla ahlaziyekayo, i-hydrogen eluhlaza kunye noshishino oluzinzileyo.

src: Moporesidente Ramaphosa o tobokeditse le boinehelo ba Afrika Borwa ba ho tswela pele ka ho sebetsana le diphetoho tsa tlelaemete le ho beha naha boemong ba boetapele ntlheng tse amanang le motlakase wa mehlodi ya tlhaho, motlakase o hlahiswang ka metsi, le ho thehwa ha diindasteri tsa ho ya ho ile.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa ukwathethe kwiNgqungquthela eQhubela Phambili ukuThintela, ukuLungela kunye nokuSabela kuBhubhani, kwisikhundla sakhe sobuNtshatsheli kuManyano lwama-Afrika ukuSabela kwiSifo seNtsholongwana i-Corona (i-COVID-19).

src: Moporesidente Ramaphosa o boetse a tshetleha puo Sebokeng sa ho Ntshetsa Pele Thibelo ya Sewa, ho Itokisetsa sewa le ho se Lwantsha, jwaloka Moetapele wa Kopano ya Afrika Twantshong ya Lefu la Vaerase ya Corona (COVID-19).
tgt: Inkqubo yamazwe amabini yoMzantsi Afrika esecaleni kwe-UNGA yama-7.

src: Lenaneo la Afrika Borwa la Dikopano le Dinaha tse Ding ka Thoko ho UNGA ya bo-78 Moporesidente Ramaphosa o etelletse pele moifo wa mmuso ka thoko ho UNGA ya bo-78, molemong wa ho tshwara dikopano tse fapaneng le dinaha tse ding tseo sepheo ka tsona e leng ho matlafatsa dikamano tsa mawa, dipolotiki, matjhaba le tsa kgwebisano.
tgt: Ecaleni kwe-UNGA yama-78, uMongameli Ramaphosa ukhokele igqiza likarhulumente elibambe iintlanganiso ezininzi zamazwe amabini ezijolise ekuqiniseni ubudlelwane kubuchule, kwezopolitiko, kwezozakuzo kunye nakurhwebo.

src: Moporesidente o kopane le Volodymyr Zelensky wa Ukraine ba buisana ka kgatelopele e bonahalang mehatong ya ho aha boitshepo e etellwang pele ka mokgwa wa Boiteko ba Kgotso ba Afrika, le tse ding.
tgt: UMongameli udibene nogxa wakhe wase-Ukraine u-Volodymyr Zelensky ukuze baxoxe ngenkqubela phambili eyenziwayo kwiNyathelo lwase-Afrika loXolo - olukhokelwa ngamanyathelo okwakha ukuzithemba kunye nolunye uphuhliso.

src: Moporesidente Ramaphosa o boetse a tshwara dikopano le: Moporesidente Recep Tayyip Erdoğan wa Türkiye, mabapi le ho tiiswa ha dikamano pakeng tsa Afrika Borwa le Turkey, le ho buisana ka maiteko a kgotso a amanang le ntwa pakeng tsa Russia le Ukraine.
tgt: Mongameli Recep Tayyip Erdoğan wase-Türkiye, malunga nokuqinisa ubudlelwane phakathi koMzantsi Afrika kunye ne-Turkey, kunye nokwazisana ngamaphulo oxolo kungquzulwano oluphakathi kwe-Russia ne-Ukraine.

src: Moporesidente Bola Tinubu wa Nigeria, ka ho matlafatsa maqhama pakeng tsa Afrika Borwa le Nigeria.
tgt: Mongameli Bola Tinubu we-Federal Republic of Nigeria, malunga nokuqinisa ubudlelwane phakathi koMzantsi Afrika kunye ne-Nigeria.

src: O boetse a behwa sehlohlolong ka boiteko bo etellwang pele ke Mokgatlo wa Moruo wa Dinaha tsa Bophirima ba Afrika mabapi le ho tsohelwa ha puso matla Niger, le ka maiteko a ho kgutlisa puso ya demokrasi lebatoweng la Sahel.
tgt: Uye wafumana ezihlaziyiweyo malunga nenyathelo loQoqosho lwaMazwe aseNtshona Afrika elikhokelwa lubhukuqo-mbuso e-Niger kunye neenzame ngokubanzi zokubuyisela ulawulo lwentando yesininzi e-Sahel.

src: Moporesidente Emmerson Mnangagwa wa Zimbabwe, ka maiteko a mmuso wa Zimbabwe a ho tiisa kahobotjha ya naha eo kamora dikgetho tsa morao tjena.
tgt: Mongameli Emmerson Mnangagwa weRiphabhlikhi yaseZimbabwe, kumalinge karhulumente waseZimbabwe okuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa ngokutsha kwela lizwe emva kolonyulo olunemvisiswano lwakutsha nje.

src: Moporesidente Ramaphosa o boetse a ba le seabo Dipuisanong tsa Kgwebo tsa Amerika (US) le Afrika Borwa tsa Kgwebisano le Botsetedi, tse neng di kenyeletsa baetapele ba tsa kgwebo ba Afrika Borwa le Amerika.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa ukwathathe inxaxheba kwiNgxoxo yoShishino ngezoRhwebo kunye noTyalo-mali lweMelika (i-US) noMzantsi Afrika, equka iinkokeli zoshishino zaseMzantsi Afrika kunye nezaseMelika.

src: Amerika e na le dikhampani tse fetang 600 Afrika Borwa, mme puisano tsena di ne di le bohlokwa matlafatsong e ntseng e tswella ya maqhama pakeng tsa Afrika Borwa le Amerika.
tgt: Ngeenkampani ezingaphezu kwama-600 zase-US ezisebenza eMzantsi Afrika, olu thethathethwano lwalubalulekile ekuqiniseni ubudlelwane phakathi koMzantsi Afrika kunye ne-UNgeli xesha, kwenziwa isaziso esisesikweni sokuba iForam yama-20 ye-US-Sub-Saharan Africa Trade and Economic Cooperation Forum, (iForam ye-AGOA) iza kubanjelwa eRhawutini ukusuka ngomhla wesi-2 ukuya kowesi-4 kweyeNkanga wama-2023.

src: Nakong eo ho tsebahaditswe semmuso hore Kopano ya bo-20 e mabapi le Tshebedisano Kgwebisanong le Moruong ya Amerika le Dinaha tse borwa ba Lehwatata la Sahara, Afrika (AGOA), e tla tshwarelwa Johannesburg ho tloha ho la 2 ho ya ho la 4 Pudungwana 2023.
tgt: Le foram iza kuphinda ibe nomboniso othi ‘Made in Africa Exhibition’ oza kubonisa amakhonkco ewonke eemveliso zommandla kwilizwekazi.

src: Kopano ena e tla boela e be le ‘Pontsho ya tse Entsweng Afrika’ e tla pepesa metjha ya dihlahiswa ya mabatowa, Afrika.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa uphinde wangqina isibhengezo sentsebenziswano phakathi kwe-Novo Nordisk kunye ne-Aspen.

src: Moporesidente Ramaphosa o bile teng tsebahatsong ya tshebedisano pakeng tsa Novo Nordisk le Aspen.
tgt: Le ntsebenziswano iza kubona ukuveliswa kweyeza leswekile (i-insulin) kwiziko le-Aspen eGqeberha, eMpuma Koloni.

src: Ka tshebedisano ena ho tla hlahiswa insulin, khampaning ya Aspen e hlahisang meriana, Gqeberha, Kapa Botjhabela.
tgt: Le ntsebenziswano ijolise ekuboneleleni ngamathamo eyeza leswekile angaphezulu kwe-16 lezigidi ngowama-2024, neza kunyuswa ngowama-2026.

src: Sena se tla matlafatsa phihlello ya pheko ena kontinenteng ka bophara, eseng Afrika Borwa feela.
tgt: Oku kuya kuphucula kakhulu ufikelelo kunyango lweswekile, kungapheleli nje eMzantsi Afrika, kodwa nakwilizwekazi liphela.

src: Motlakase.
tgt: Ezamandla.

src: Kabinete e ananetse ho nehwa ha Khampani ya Naha ya Phetiso ya Afrika Borwa dikopo tsa dilaesense tsa ho hweba le ho tlisa/romela, ke Bolaodi ba Naha ba Eneji Afrika Borwa, mme sena se bula ditsela tsa ho fumana motlakase lebatoweng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukunikwa koMlawuli wezaMandla weSizwe woMzantsi Afrika izicelo zempepha-mvume zokurhweba kunye nokungenisa/ukuthumela ngaphandle kwiNkampani yeSizwe yoThumelo lwezaMandla yoMzantsi Afrika, kuvulwa indlela yokuthengwa kwamandla kuwo wonke ummandla.

src: Ho kgutla ha tshebetso Yuniting ya Bone ya Seteishene sa ho fehla Motlakase sa Kusile kamora hore e lokiswe ho kgutliseditse dimekawate tse 800 keriting.
tgt: Ukusebenza kwakhona kwesiKhululo soMbane saseKusile Yunithi yesi-4 kulungiso olucwangcisiweyo noluthe lwabuyisa iimegawathi ezingama-800 kuthungelwano lwethu lombane.

src: Ketsaholo ena e bohlokwa ntlafatsong ya ho fehlwa ha motlakase bakeng sa keriti ya naha, le twantshong ya ho kgaolwa ha phepelo kgafetsa.
tgt: Esi siganeko singundoqo ekuphuculeni umthamo wokuvelisa uthungelwano lwesizwe kunye nasekukhawulelaneni namaxesha okucinywa kombane.

src: Kabinete e boetse ya tsebiswa ka kgatelopele Diyuniting tsa 1, 2, le 3 tsa Kusile tse kgutletseng tshebetsong pele ho nako e behuweng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde yachazelwa ngenkqubela yokubuyisela iYunithi yoku-1, yesi-2 kunye neyesi-3 kwiSikhululo soMbane iKusile phambi kwexesha elimiselweyo.

src: Kabinete e ananetse diqeto tsa hlahlobo ya Tshebeletso ya Matsete ya Moody’s e reng ho na le botsitso Eskom, e leng botsitso bo tla ntlafatsa ho tshepelwa ha Eskom ho lefa ditjhelete tseo e di adimilweng, mme sena se thuse khampani ena ho itokisetsa ho kenya tshebetsong merero ya yona ya ho lokisa disebediswa tsa ho fehla motlakase.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkele izinga elizinzileyo lika-Eskom elenziwe yi-Moody’s Investors Service, nto leyo eza kuphucula ukufaneleka kwetyala leli ziko lombane lize likwazi ukucwangcisa kwangaphambili ukuphumeza ulungiso olucetyiweyo lwezithuthi zalo zokuvelisa.

src: Paballo ya Metsi Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka matsapa a ho sebetsana le mathata a metsi a amang dibaka tse ngata naheng ena.
tgt: Ukufumaneka kwamanzi.

src: Letona la Metsi le Bohlweki, Monghadi Senzo Mchunu le boramotse ba metsemeholo e meng Gauteng ba tla fana ka tsa moraorao mabapi le maiteko a ho tsitsisa phepelo ya metsi provenseng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi malunga namalinge okujongana nemingeni yamanzi nechaphazela iindawo ezininzi kwilizwe liphela.

src: Kabinete e hopotsa bohle hore Afrika Borwa ke naha e nang le kgaello ya metsi.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezaManzi noGutyulo, uMnu Senzo Mchunu kunye noosodolophu abalawulayo kwezinye zezixeko zaseRhawutini baza kubonelela ngohlaziyo longenelelo oluqhubekayo lokuzinzisa ukuhanjiswa kwamanzi kweli phondo.

src: Maafrika Borwa le bohle ba naheng ena ba tlameha ho baballa metsi le ho a sebedisa ka hloko.
tgt: Bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika kunye naye wonke umntu okweli lizwe kufuneka onge kwaye asebenzise amanzi ngononophelo.

src: Ditaba tsa Kgwebisano Kopano ya Khomeshene ya Dinaha tse Pedi ya Afrika Borwa le Lesotho (BNC) le Dihlopha tsa Matona.
tgt: IKomishoni yeZizwe eziManyeneyo eziMbini yoMzantsi Afrikane-Lesotho (i-BNC) kunye neNtlanganiso yeQela laBaphathiswa.1 INtlanganiso ye-BNC yoMzantsi Afrika ne-Lesotho kunye neQela laBaphathiswa ebibanjwe ukusuka ngomhla wama-25 ukuya kowama-28 kweyoMsintsi 2023 igxile kwintsebenziswano yezoqoqosho, kwimiba yokuwela imida, kunye nokuhamba ngokukhululekileyo kwabantu, iimpahla neenkonzo phakathi kwala mazwe mabini.2 UMongameli Ramaphosa kunye neNkulumbuso u-Samuel Ntsokoane Matekane baza kujongana neSeshoni yokuQalwa kwe-BNC phakathi koMzantsi Afrika ne-Lesotho ngoLwesine, umhla wama-28 kweyoMsintsi 2023.

src: Kopano ya Afrika Borwa le Lesotho ya BNC le Dihlopha tsa Matona e neng e tshwerwe ho tloha ka la 25 ho ya ho la 28 Loetse 2023 e ne e tsepame tshebedisanong ho tsa moruo, dintlha tse amang meedi le bolokolohi ba ho itsamaela ha batho, ba ho tsamaiswa ha thepa le ditshebeletso pakeng tsa dinaha ka bobedi.
tgt: I-BNC iza kubandakanya ubudlelwane kwezozakuzo, kukhuselo nokhuseleko, amanzi, ezothutho, umbane kunye nakwezorhwebo.2 UPhando lweNtengiso kwiQonga elikwi-Intanethi.1IKhabhinethi ifumene ingxelo evela kwiKomishoni yoKhuphiswano malunga neziphumo kunye namanyathelo okulungisa malunga noPhando lweNtengiso kwiQonga elikwi-Intanethi.

src: Moporesidente Ramaphosa le Tonakgolo Samuel Ntsokoane Matekane e tla ba baduladitulo Kopanong ya Pele ya BNC pakeng tsa Afrika Borwa le Lesotho ka Labone la la 28 Loetse 2023.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwuncomile umsebenzi wekhomishini ekujonganeni neenkxalabo kumaqonga edijithali, kubandakanywa urhwebo lwe-ecommerce, ii-arhente zokuhamba ezikwi-intanethi, ukuhanjiswa kokutya, iivenkile ze-app, ababoneleli abakhethiweyo kunye neenjini zokukhangela.2 IKhabhinethi iyalele abaPhathiswa bamasebe karhulumente achaphazelekayo ukuba aqhubele phambili athethathethane ngezindululo zokuphucula, baqwalasele iziphumo zomgaqo-nkqubo baze benze utshintsho oluyimfuneko kumgaqo-nkqubo, oluya kunceda abantu baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba bathathe inxaxheba ngokufanelekileyo kunye namashishini amancinci naphakathi kushishino olukhulayo olenziwa nge-intanethi.

src: BNC e tla shebana le tse amanang le maqhama pakeng tsa dinaha tsena tse pedi, tshireletso le polokeho, metsi, dipalangwang, motlakase le kgwebisano.
tgt: Umkhuhlane weentaka IKhabhinethi iqaphele uqhambuko lwangoku loMkhuhlane obangela izifo (i-HPAI) H5 kunye ne-H7 kushishino lweenkukhu eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e thoholeditse mosebetsi wa khomeshene wa ho shebana le dingongoreho tsa monopholi mapatlelong a dikgwebo tsa inthanete a kenyeletsang dikgwebo, mekgatlo ya inthaneteng ya boeti, tsamaiso ya dijo, mabenkele a di-app, dipapatso tsa dihlahiswa le ditshebeletso le motjha wa ho batla lesedi inthaneteng.
tgt: INtshona Koloni kunye neKwaZulu-Natal ziye zafumana ukuqhambuka kwe-HPAI H5 ngelixa i-HPAI H7 iye yachazwa kumaphondo iRhawutini, i-Limpopo, iMpumalanga kunye naseMntla Ntshona.

src: Kabinete e laetse Matona a mafapha a mmuso a amehang ho ikamahanya le dikgothaletso tsa patlisiso ena molemong wa ntlafatso, le ho lekola kamoo e ka amang maano kateng le hore mafapha a sebedise diphetho ho tlisa diphetoho maanong a mafapha molemong wa hore beng ba dikgwebo tse nyenyane, tse bohareng le tse kgolo ba be le seabo se matla kgodisong ya dikgwebo inthaneteng.
tgt: Amanyathelo okulawula ukusasazeka koku kuqhambuka akhona kwaye amafama ayakhuthazwa ukuba athathele ingqalelo amanyathelo amiselweyo okhuseleko lwendalo.

src: Kabinete e hlokometse ho qhoma ha jwale ha vaerase e bakang lefu la ntaramane ya mefuta ya (HPAI) H5 le H7 indastering ya dikgoho Afrika Borwa.
tgt: Uqhambuko lubeka imingcipheko yokhuseleko lokutya kwaye amanyathelo orhwebo okungenisa elizweni ukuze kulawulwe ukufumaneka kwamaqanda kunye nenyama yenkukhu anokuphunyezwa.

src: Kapa Bophirima le KwaZulu-Natal di hlasetswe ke ho qhoma ha HPAI H5 ha HPAI H7 e tlalehwa diprovenseng tsa Gauteng, Limpopo, Mpumalanga le Bokone Bophirima.
tgt: ISebe lezoLimo, uHlengahlengiso loMhlaba noPhuhliso lwasemaPhandleni, uGunyaziwe woLawulo lweeMveliso zezeMpilo eMzantsi Afrika kunye noshishino baphonononga izicelo zokubhaliswa kwamayeza okugonya anokubakho, ezi namanyathelo okuthotyelwa kwezinto ezinxulumene nokhuseleko, ukusebenza kakuhle kunye nomgangatho zezona zinto zibalulekileyo ekubhalisweni kwezitofu zokugonya.

src: Ho kentshwe tshebetsong mehato ya ho laola ho ata ha mafu ana mme beng ba dipolasi ba kgothaletswa ho latela metjha e behilweng ya ho lwantsha lefu lena.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele ingxelo yakutsha yokulwa ulwaphulo-mthetho, nethe yanikwa isizwe nguMphathiswa wamaPolisa, uNjengele Bheki Cele, kunye neCandelo leSizwe lokuSebenza okuDityanelweyo nobuNtlola.

src: Ho qhoma ha lefu lena ho sitisa paballo ya dijo mme ho ka nna ha kenngwa tshebetsong mehato ya kgwebisano ya ho romela dihlahiswa kantle le ho laola phumaneho ya mahe a qhotswang, a jewang le nama ya kgoho.
tgt: Iphulo leendidi ngeendidi malunga nokombiwa kwemigodi ngokungekho mthethweni kunye nofuduko eMntla Koloni kukhokelele ekubanjweni kwabantu abangama-867, uninzi lwabo lusuka e-Lesotho, e-Zimbabwe, e-Mozambique kunye nabemi abathile boMzantsi Afrika.

src: Lefapha la Temo, Kabobotjha ya Naha le Ntshetsopele ya Metse ya Mahae, Bolaodi ba Dihlahiswa tsa Bophelo bo Botle Afrika Borwa le indasteri di hlahloba dikopo tsa ho ngodiswa ha diente tse ka sebediswang, ka mehato ya ho ikobela melao e nkang polokeho, tshebetso e ntle le boleng di le bohlokwa bakeng sa ho ngodiswa ha diente tseo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise uluvo lwee-arhente zogcino-mthetho lokuba abemi boMzantsi Afrika abagcine abaphuli-mthetho ababandakanyeka kwizenzo zokombiwa kwemigodi ngokungekho mthethweni baya kujongana nengalo yomthetho.

src: Ntwa e Momahaneng Kgahlano le Bosenyi Kabinete e ananetse ho behwa sehlohlolong ka ntwa kgahlano le bosenyi, le setjhaba sa behwa sehlohlolong ke Letona la Mapolesa Mokgenerale Bheki Cele, le Popeho e Kopanetsweng ya Tshebetso le Mautlwela ya Naha.
tgt: Iimeko zemozulu ezimbi kakhulu zelizwe zigxininisa ifuthe lokutshintsha kwemozulu kubomi bethu kunye nesidingo sokuthatha amanyathelo azinzileyo okuphelisa ikhabhoni kuqoqosho lwethu ngelixa sizama uphuhliso oluzinzileyo.

src: Motjha wa makala a fapaneng hodima ho rafa le ho falla ho seng molaong Kapa Leboya ho bakile hore ho tshwarwe batho ba 867, bongata ba bona e le ba tswang Lesotho, Zimbabwe, Mozambique le Maafrika Borwa a seng makae.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaziswa ngomonakalo obangelwe zizaqhwithi ezimandla kunye nezikhukula ezise Mpuma Koloni, eNtshona Koloni kunye naseRhawutini, nto leyo ebonisa ukuba oku kunganwenwa nakwamanye amaphondo.3 IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kuluntu ukuba luhlale luphaphile kwaye lujonge izilumkiso ezingakumbi zemozulu, nezinokuzisa umonakalo ongakumbi kwilizwe liphela.

src: Kabinete e bile ntswe leng le mekgatlo e kenyang molao tshebetsong e reng Maafrika Borwa a patang disenyi tse rafang di sa dumellwa a tla nkelwa mehato ya molao.
tgt: Urhulumente usaqhubeka nokuxhasa iinkonzo zongxamiseko kunye namaziko olawulo lweentlekele ukulungiselela imisebenzi yokuhlangula kunye nokubonelela ngenkxaso kuluntu.

src: Maemo a lehodimo a fetelletseng a naha ke sesupo sa kameho ya diphetoho tsa tlelaemete maphelong a rona le tlhokeho ya mehato ya moshwelella e lokelang ho nkuwa e kenyeletsang diphetoho tlhahisong ya motlakase nakong eo ho tsitlalletsweng ntshetsopele ya ho ya ho ile.
tgt: I-Winnie Mandela Avenue IKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukuthiywa ngokutsha kwe-William Nicol Drive e-Sandton ukuba ibe yi-Winnie Mandela Avenue njengenyathelo elibalulekileyo lokubhala ngokutsha imbali yoMzantsi Afrika ukuze ibonise igalelo labo babesilwela inkululeko yethu.

src: Kabinete e ntse e behwa sehlohlolong ka tshenyo e bakilweng ke difefo tse matla le merwallo Kapa Botjhabela, Kapa Bophirima le Gauteng, mme ho na le ditlhokomediso tsa hore maemo ana a ka fetela diprovenseng tse ding.
tgt: Lo mnyhadala ubungqamene nomhla wokuzalwa kuka-Winnie Madikizela-Mandela ngomhla wama-26 kweyoMsintsi 2023.Izigqibo zeKhabhinethiISicwangciso-qhinga esiHlaziyiweyo seNyama yeeNyamakazi eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho baahi ho dula ba le sedi bakeng sa ditlhokomediso tse ding tsa maemo a feteletseng a lehodimo, a ka bakang tshenyo e nngwe e mpe naheng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukuphunyezwa kwesiCwangciso-qhinga esiHlaziyiweyo seNyama yeeNyamakazi eMzantsi Afrika, esijonge ukumisela ngokusesikweni kunye nokuguqula ishishini lenyama yenyamakazi.

src: Mmuso o tswela pele ho tshehetsa ba ditshebeletso tsa tshohanyetso le ditsi tsa taolo ya dikoduwa tsa pholoso le ho fana ka dithuso ho ba di hlokang.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga sijolise ekuqiniseni icandelo lenyama yenyamakazi njengomboneleli wokufumaneka kokutya kunye necandelo lohlumo kuqoqosho elinokunceda ekudaleni imisebenzi.

src: Mmila wa Winnie Mandela Kabinete e ananetse ho rehwa botjha ha Mmila wa William Nicol Sandton e eba Mmila wa Winnie Mandela jwaloka mohato wa bohlokwa ho ngolweng botjha ha nalane ya Afrika Borwa le ho bontsha seabo sa ba lwanetseng tokoloho ya rona.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika ubekwe kwindawo yokuqala kwilizwekazi i-Afrika ngenxa yemveliso yenyama yenyamakazi.

src: Ketsahalo ena e bile ka letsatsi leo Winnie Madikizela-Mandela a ka beng a qetile dilemo tse 87 ka lona la 26 Loetse 2023.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga sijonge ukuqinisekisa ukudalwa kwemisebenzi engama-202 666 ezinzileyo kushishino lwenyama yenyamakazi ngowama-2030.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete Leano le Lokisitsweng la Nama ya tse Hlaha la Afrika Borwa Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Leano le Lokisitsweng la Nama ya tse Hlaha la Afrika Borwa, leo sepheo ka lona e leng ho hlophisa le ho tlisa diphetoho indastering ya nama ya tse hlaha.
tgt: Isicwangciso-qhinga siya kupapashwa kwiwebhusayithi yeSebe lamaHlathi, ezokuLoba nokusiNgqongileyo ku: www.

src: Afrika Borwa e boemong ba pele kontinenteng ya Afrika ka tlhahiso ya nama ya tse hlaha.
tgt: IsiCwangciso esiPhambili seCandelo lezoKhenketho.

src: Leano lena le tla netefatsa hore ho thehwa mesebetsi e 202 666 indastering ya nama ya tse hlaha pele ho feta 2030.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukulungelelaniswa kwesiCwangciso sokuBuyisela iCandelo lezoKhenketho kwisiCwangciso esiPhambili soKhenketho esitsha.

src: Leano le tla phatlalatswa websaeteng ya Lefapha la Meru, Botshwasi le Tikoloho e leng: WEBTOKELeano le Leholo la Lekala la Bohahlaudi Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana ho amahanngwa ha Morero wa Tsoseletso ya Lekala la Bohahlaudi le Morero o motjha o Moholo wa Bohahlaudi.
tgt: Inxalenye nebalulekileyo yesiCwangciso esiPhambili kukunciphisa iimpembelelo zobhubhani we-COVID-19 kwicandelo lezokhenketho.

src: Karolo ya bohlokwa ya Morero o Moholo ke ho bebofatsa kameho ya sewa sa COVID-19 lekaleng la bohahlaudi.
tgt: Ikwabonelela ngemephu yendlela yokubuyisela ngokupheleleyo ukhenketho elizweni.

src: E boetse e fana ka tataiso ya kamoo bohahlaudi bo ka tsoseletswang kateng le ka ho phethahala naheng ena.
tgt: Nangona iSicwangciso soBuyisela seCandelo lezoKhenketho saphuhliswa ukuququzelela ukuchacha ngcono kweli candelo, ukugcina imisebenzi kunye nokukhusela iindlela zokuphila, esi Sicwangciso siPhambili siya kuwuthatha lo msebenzi siwuse kwelinye inqanaba kwaye siququzelele amathuba amatsha kweli candelo.

src: Erekaha sepheo ka Morero wa Tsoseletso ya Lekala la Bohahlaudi e ne e le ho bebofatsa ho pholoswa ha lekala lena, ho boloka mesebetsi le ho sireletsa mekgwa ya boiphediso, Morero o Moholo o tla lebisa mosebetsi ona boemong bo bong mme o thuse ho thehweng ha menyetla e metjha lekaleng lena.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso siphakamisa izicwangciso-qhinga zongenelelo ezisixhenxe ukuqinisekisa ukuba icandelo lezokhenketho libuyela kwiintsuku zalo zodumo, kwanokuba libe liziko lokudala imisebenzi kunye noshishino.

src: Morero ona o sisinya mawa a supileng a mekgwa ya ho thusa, ho netefatsa hore lekala la bohahlaudi le kgutlela maemong a lona a pele a matle, le hore lekala le kgontsha ho thehwa ha mesebetsi le dikgwebo.
tgt: Ishishini lezokhenketho linegalelo elibalulekileyo kuqoqosho kwaye lalixhase imisebenzi engama-725 000 phambi kobhubhani we-COVID-19.

src: Indasteri ya bohahlaudi e na le seabo sa bohlokwa moruong mme e thehile mesebetsi e 725 000 pele ho sewa sa COVID-19.
tgt: Imithetho eYilwayoUMthetho oYilwayo weQumrhu loSasazo laseMzantsi Afrika (i-SABC) wama-2023.

src: Bili ya Lekgotla la Kgaso la Afrika Borwa (SABC) ya 2023.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho oYilwayo we-SABC wama-2023.

src: Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana tlhahiso ya Bili ya SABC ya 2023 palamenteng.
tgt: Wakuba upasisiwe ube ngumthetho, lo Mthetho uYilwayo uya kukhokelela ekurhoxisweni koMthetho woSasazo okhoyo ngoku, we-1999 (uMthetho wesi-4 we-1999).

src: Ha e se e le molao, Bili e tla hlakola Molao wa jwale wa Kgaso wa 1999 (Molao wa 4 wa 1999).
tgt: Ezi zihlomelo ziza kuqinisa ukusebenza kakuhle kosasazo loluntu.

src: Diphetoho tsena di tla matlafatsa tshebetso e kgabane kgasong ya setjhaba.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ukwaphakamisa iinguqu kwindlela yenkxaso-mali ye-SABC kunye nenkqubo yokukhutshwa kweelayisenisi zikamabonakude.

src: Bili ena e boetse e hlahisa hore ho be le diphetoho mokgweng wa SABC wa ho iketsetsa ditjhelete le mokgwatshebetsong wa dilaesense tsa dithelevishene.
tgt: UMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo weeNkonzo zaManzi.

src: Moralo wa Bili ya Tlhomathiso wa Ditshebeletso tsa Metsi Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana phatlalatso ya Bili ya Tlhomathiso wa Ditshebeletso tsa Metsi hore setjhaba se ntshe maikutlo ka yona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa koMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo weeNkonzo zaManzi ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: Maikemisetso a ka sehloohong ka Bili ke ho matlafatsa boikarabelo ba ba fanang ka ditshebeletso tsa metsi le ho tlisa botshepehi.
tgt: Iinjongo eziphambili zalo Mthetho uYilwayo kukuqinisa ukuphendula kwababoneleli ngeenkonzo zamanzi kunye nokwazisa ukungafihlwa kwezinto.

src: Diphetoho Molaong wa Ditshebeletso tsa Metsi wa 1997 (Molao wa 108 wa 1997) di tla netefatsa hore ba fanang ka ditshebeletso tsa metsi ba nehelana ka metsi a boleng bo hodimo e le karolo ya dipehelo tsa dilaesense.
tgt: Izihlomelo kuMthetho weeNkonzo zaManzi, wowe-1997 (uMthetho we-108 wowe-1997) ziza kuqinisekisa ukuba ababoneleli ngeenkonzo zamanzi bahambisa amanzi akumgangatho ophezulu njengenxalenye yemiqathango yabo yokufumana iimpepha-mvume.4Ezi zihlomelo ziza kujongana nobuthathaka obuthe bachongwa kwicandelo leenkonzo zamanzi.

src: Diphetoho di tla boela di sebetsane le bofokodi bo hlwauweng lekaleng la ditshebeletso tsa metsi.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ubeka imigangatho emincinane yokusebenza kwababoneleli ngeenkonzo zamanzi, nekufuneka inyanzeliswe ngabasemagunyeni beeNkonzo zaManzi.

src: Moralo wa Bili ya Tlhomathiso ya Naha ya Metsi Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana phatlalatso ya moralo wa Bili ya Tlhomathiso ya Naha ya Metsi hore setjhaba se ntshe maikutlo ka yona.
tgt: UMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo waManzi weSizwe.

src: Bili ena e lokisa Molao wa Naha wa Metsi wa 1998 (Molao 36 wa 1998).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa koMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo waManzi weSizwe ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: Diphetoho tsena di tla ntlafatsa melawana mme di netefatse hore mehlodi ya metsi ya naha e laolwa, e sireletswe le ho baballwa hantle.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uhlomela uMthetho waManzi weSizwe, we-1998 (uMthetho wama-36 we-1998).

src: Setshwantsho sena sa molao se boetse se etsa ditshisinyo tse mabapi le ho fediswa ha ho se lekane kabong ya metsi ho bakilweng ke kgethollo, mme se fana ka metjha ya kahare ya ho rarolla dikgohlano e sebetsang hantle le ka potlako.
tgt: Ezi zihlomelo ziza kuphucula imimiselo kwaye ziza kuqinisekisa ukuba imithombo yamanzi yelizwe ilawulwa kakuhle, iyakhuselwa kwaye iyongiwa.

src: Khiro Mangolo a thuto a ba hirwang a a netefatswa mme ho netefatswe le hore ha ba e so ka ba tlola molao.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo wenza izindululo zokuphelisa ukungalingani kwangaphambili ngokunxulumene nokwabiwa kwamanzi, kwaye ubonelela ngeendlela ezisebenzayo nezikhawulezayo zokusombulula iingxabano zangaphakathi.

src: Monghadi Sihle Ngubane jwaloka Motsamaisi Kakaretso: Botsamaisi ba Ditshebetso Mesebetsing ya Bohatisi ya Mmuso.
tgt: IzikhundlaZonke izithuba zengqesho zixhomekeke ekungqinisisweni kwamabakala ezemfundo kunye nokuqinisekiswa okufanelekileyo kwezokhuseleko.

src: Mme Mmolaeng Mooki jwaloka Motsamaisi Kakaretso: Ditshebeletso tsa Tshehetso Mesebetsing ya Bohatisi ya Mmuso.
tgt: UMnu Kuberndran Moodley njengoMphathi Jikelele: Ukwenziwa kweMveliso nobuNjineli kwi-Government Printing Works.

src: Khiro ya Balaodi bao e seng ba Phethahatso Botong ya Mokgatlo wa Inshorense ya Dikotsi tse Ikgethang wa Afrika Borwa.
tgt: UMnu Sihle Ngubane njengoMphathi Jikelele: uLawulo lweMisebenzi kwi-Government Printing Works.

src: Mme Deshnie Subbiah le.
tgt: UNksz Mmolaeng Mooki njengoMphathi Jikelele: IiNkonzo zeShishini kwi- Government Printing Works.

src: Khiro ya Balaodi bao e seng ba Phethahatso Botong ya Banka ya Ntshetsopele ya Afrika e Borwa.
tgt: Ukuqeshwa kwabalawuli abangekho kwisigqeba seBhodi ye-South African Special Risk Insurance Association.

src: Monghadi Bongani Nqwabana (o hirilwe hape).
tgt: UNksz Deshnie Subbiah kunye.

src: Monghadi Jonathan Muthige.
tgt: noMnu Jannie Venter.

src: Monghadi Joel Netshitenzhe Profesa Edgar Pieterse le.
tgt: UMnu Bongani Nqwabana (uqeshiwe kwakhona).

src: Mme Angie Motshekga, Letona la Thuto ya Motheo, ka ho kgethwa ke Mongodi e Moholo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng, Monghadi Antonio Guterres, ho ba Moifong wa Lefatshe wa Boemo bo Hodimo o tla mo eletsa ka mekgwa eo dinaha di ka tlisang diphetoho mekgwatshebetsong ya thuto ya tsona.
tgt: UMnu Joel Netshitenzhe .UNjingalwazi Edgar Pieterse kunye.

src: Ho kgethelwa ha Letona ho ba moifong ona o hodimo ho bontsha boemo ba botsebi ba hae ho tsa thuto mme ho boetse ke sesupo sa tshepo ho tsa thuto Afrika Borwa.
tgt: INyanga yezoThutho yalo nyaka iza kukhunjulwa phantsi komxholo othi: “Siyakha - Sakha iziseko ezingundoqo ezingcono ukukhulisa uMzantsi Afrika”.

src: Moifo o kenyeletsa baemedi ba Mokgatlo wa Basebetsi wa Matjhaba, Mokgatlo wa Matitjhere wa Tshebetso wa Thuto, Saense le tsa Setso, Mekgatlo ya Lefatshe ya Matitjhere le Matona a Mararo a Thuto.
tgt: INyanga yezoThutho yowama-2023 iza kugxila kutyalo-mali olukhulu kwiziseko ezingundoqo zezothutho, kwaye ihlaba ikhwelo lokuba kukhuselwe iziseko ezingundoqo zezothutho kubusela kunye nasekonakalisweni.

src: Baporesidente ba mehleng ba babedi e ne e le baduladitulo ba moifo.
tgt: Usuku looTitshala lweHlabathi.

src: Ditudiyo tsa Cape Town Film, dibapadi tsa naha ena tsa ditshwantshiso le dibapadi tsa dikarolo tse kotsi, ka seabo sa bona filiming ya Netflix, One Piece, e fihlelletseng boemong ba pele lefatsheng ka bophara motjheng ona wa kgaso ya inthanete.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uza kujoyina ihlabathi liphela ekubhiyozeleni uSuku looTitshala lweHlabathi ngoLwesine, umhla wesi-5 kweyeDwarha 2023, phantsi komxholo othi: “Ootitshala esibadingayo kwimfundo esiyifunayo: Kunyanzelekile kwihlabathi jikelele ukunciphisa ukunqongophala kootitshala”.

src: Sebaka sa Tsino sa Van Ryn, ka ho fumana kgau ya Boranti bo tswang pele Lefatsheng bakeng sa boranti ba yona bo tsinnweng habedi ba dilemo tse lshome le metso e mmedi, Tlhodisanong ya Matsina ya Matjhaba ya 2023 London.
tgt: Olu suku lujolise ekukhuliseni ulwazi, ukuqonda kunye nokuxabisa igalelo elibaluleke kakhulu elenziwa ngootitshala kwimfundo nakuphuhliso kwihlabathi jikelele.

src: MatshedisoKabinete e lebisitse matshediso malapeng le metswalleng ya: Monghadi Aziz Goolam Hoosein Pahad (82), eo e neng e le moitseki kgahlano le mmuso wa kgethollo le eo e bileng Motlatsa-Letona la Ditaba tsa Kantle wa pele wa mmuso wa Demokrasi wa Afrika Borwa ho tloha ka 1994 ho ya ho 2008.
tgt: ImiyalezoAmazwi okuvuyisanaIKhabhinethi idlulise amazwi okuvuyisana kunye neminqweno emihle kwaba:UNjengele Bheki Cele, uMphathiswa wamaPolisa, ofumene iMbasa ye-Great Wall Commemorative evela e-People’s Republic of China ngegalelo leNkonzo yamaPolisa oMzantsi Afrika kwintsebenziswano ebanzi yokuthotyelwa komthetho phakathi kwala mazwe mabini.

src: Molefthenente Mokhomanda Gillian Elizabeth Hector, Master Warrant Officer William Masela Mathipa, le Warrant Officer Class One Mmokwapa Lucas Mojela, ba hlokahalletseng mosebetsing ba le sekepeng SAS Manthatisi, pela Kommetjie, Kapa Bophirima.
tgt: UNks Angie Motshekga, uMphathiswa weMfundo esiSiseko, ekukhethweni kwakhe nguNobhala-Jikelele we-UN, uMnu Antonio Guterres, ukuba asebenze kwi-Global High-Level Panel ukumcebisa ngendlela amazwe angaziguqula ngayo iinkqubo zawo zemfundo.

src: Basebetsi ba 22 ba morafong wa Taemane wa Venetia, Limpopo, ba timetseng kotsing ya mmileng Musina (Seterekeng sa Vhembe).
tgt: Ukukhethwa kukaMphathiswa u-Motshekga kwiphaneli yomgangatho ophezulu kubonisa inqanaba lobuchule bakhe kwinkalo yezemfundo kwaye kubonakalisa ukuthemba indlela eqhuba ngayo imfundo yaseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Mme Zoleka Mandela (43), mongodi le moitseki, setloholo sa bahale ba ntwa kgahlano le mmuso wa kgethollo Nelson Mandela le Winnie Madikizela-Mandela.
tgt: Le phaneli ibandakanya abameli abavela kuMbutho weHlabathi wezaBasebenzi, uMbutho waMazwe aManyaneyo ezeMfundo, ezeNzululwazi kunye nezeNkcubeko, i-Teacher Task Force, uManyano looTishala kwiHlabathi jikelele (i-Global Teachers Union) kunye nabaPhathiswa abathathu bezemfundo.

src: Batho ba leshome le motso ba hlokahetseng ka lebaka la maemo a mabe haholo a lehodimo a hlasetseng dibaka tse fapaneng naheng ya rona bekeng e fedileng.
tgt: Eli gqiza belichotshelwe ngooMongameli ababini bangaphambili.

src: Maemo a Renang 2023 Bommampodi ba Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Rugby Kabinete e ile ya lebohisa di-Springboks ka tlholo ya tsona ya Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Rugby wa 2023 e ileng ya etsa hore Afrika Borwa e be yona feela naha e hapileng Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Rugby ka makgetlo a mane le ya bobedi ho hapa mohope oo ka ho latellana.
tgt: Imiba enguNdaba-mlonyeni IiNtshatsheli zeNdebe yoMhlaba yeBhola yoMbhoxo yama-2023 IKhabhinethi ivuyisene neqela lama-Springboks kwimpumelelo yalo yeNdebe yoMhlaba yeBhola yoMbhoxo yama-2023 eyenze ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ube lilizwe ekukuphela kwalo ukuphumelela iNdebe yoMhlaba yeBhola yoMbhoxo amaxesha amane (4) kunye nelesibini ukuyiphumelela amaxesha elandelelana.

src: Historing ya rugby Afrika Borwa, sehlopha sena sa di-Springboks ke sona se nang le merabe e fapaneng ka ho fetisisa ho latela boemedi ba palo ya batho ya Afrika Borwa.
tgt: Kwimbali yebhola yombhoxo eMzantsi Afrika, eli qela le-Springboks lelona lineyantlukwano ngokwentlanga eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Sebopeho sena sa sehlopha sa merabe e fapaneng hase ketso e iketsahalletseng feela, empa ke boiteko bo rerilweng ke basebetsi ba tsamaiso le ba kwetlisang ba di-Springboks ho kgetha sehlopha se kenyelletsang bohle.
tgt: Ukwakhiwa kweqela elineyantlukwano enjalo ibingesosenzo sebhaqo, kodwa ibingumzamo wangabom wabaphathi kunye nabasebenzi abaqeqeshayo be-Springboks abaye bakhetha iqela eliquka zonke iintlanga.

src: Qeto eo e bontshang sebete sa mokwetlisi Rassie Erasmus le sehlopa sa hae e tswela pele ho bontsha Maafrika Borwa le lefatshe lohle, hore motho e mong le e mong ya nang le bokgoni, haeba a fuwa monyetla le tshehetso, a ka hlahella – le bopaki ba hore re Matla Mmoho.
tgt: Eso sigqibo sokuthatha umngcipheko somqeqeshi welo xesha u-Rassie Erasmus kunye neqela lakhe sisaqhuba ukubonisa abantu baseMzantsi Afrika kunye nehlabathi ngokubanzi, ukuba wonke umntu onesakhono, xa enikwe ithuba nenkxaso, angagqwesa – oku kusisiqiniseko sokuba soMelele xa Sikunye.

src: Sa bohlokwa le ho feta, mamello le boikemisetso ba di-Springboks lebaleng la dipapadi, ho phethahatsa moelelo wa nnete wa se bolelwang ke ho ba Moafrika Borwa, e leng se etsang hore naha ena e kgolo e eme kgahlanong le ditshitiso tsohle le mathata e le hore e hlahe e le mohlodi.
tgt: Okubaluleke kakhulu, ukunyamezela kunye nokuzimisela kwe-Springboks kwibala lezemidlalo ngumfuziselo wokuba ngumNtu waseMzantsi Afrika wokwenene, oko okwenza ukuba esi sizwe sikhulu kangaka silwe noloyiso nangona sijongene neenzingo, ekugqibeleni siphume soyisile.

src: Tse ding tsa dibapadi tse hlwahlwa tsa sehlopha sena sa di-Springboks di ile tsa lokela ho hlola mathata tseleng ya tsona e lebisang katlehong e kgolo.
tgt: Abathile kwabona badlali bagqwesileyo beli qela le-Springboks kuye kwafuneka endleleni yabo ebhekise empumelelweni boyise iinzingo zobomi babo.

src: Kabinete e ile ya lebohisa Siyamthanda “Siya” Kolisi, mokapotene wa di-Springboks tse hapileng ka makgetlo a mabedi Mohope wa Lefatshe bakeng sa ho etella pele sehlopha ho se lebisa boemong ba Greatest of All Time (GOAT) mme ho keteka ho lokela ho tswela pele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise ukuvuyisana kwayo noSiyamthanda “Siya” Kolisi, ikapteni ebikhokele i-Springboks iqela eliphumelele iNdebe yeHlabathi kabini ngokulandelelana de labe lifikelela kwiwonga lokuba liqela eliphambili elake Laba liKhulu ngeXesha lalo i-Greatest of All Time (i-GOAT) mayiqhube ke imibhiyozo.

src: Foramo ya AGOA Kabinete e thabetse tiisetso ya botsamaisi ba Amerika le seboka ka boikemisetso ba tsona ba ho atollosa AGOA, e leng se tlisang bonnete ho setjhaba sa matsete sa dinaha tse tshwanelehang bakeng sa AGOKabinete e boetse ya amohela ho tshwarelwa ha Foramo ya AGOA ya 2023, lekgetlo la pele Johannesburg ho tloha ka la 2 – 4 Pudungwana 2023 moo ho bileng le bankakarolo ba emetseng dinaha tsa Afrika tse 32 ba tswang mmusong, kgwebong, mekgatlong ya setjhaba le mekgatlong ya basebetsi hammoho le baemedi ba mmuso wa Amerika.
tgt: I-Forum ye-AGOA IKhabhinethi isamkele isiqinisekiso esisuka kulawulo lwase-United States kunye nenkongolo esimalunga nenjongo yokolula i-AGOA, nto leyo izisa isiqinisekiso kuluntu lotyalomali kumazwe afanelekileyo ukuxhamla kwi-AGOKanajalo iKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukusingathwa kwe-forum ye-AGOA yama-2023 ebibanjelwe e-Johannesburg ngomhla we-2 ukuya mhla we-4 kweyeNkanga 2023 nebizinyaswe ngabathathi nxaxheba abavela kumazwe ase-Afrika angama-32 avela kurhulumente, uShishino, uluntu ngokubanzi kunye nabezemisebenzi ebebehambele lo msitho okokuqala kuquka kunye nabameli bakarhulumente wase-United States.

src: Kabinete kamehla e tiisa hore AGOA e fana ka monyetla wa hore Amerika e matlafatse maqhama a moruo le Afrika mme kahoo e lokela ho ekeletswa nako ya ho ba tshebetsong ka nako e bonahalang, e nang le moelelo, ho etsa hore e be le mosola le tshusumetso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isoloko ikuqinisekisa ukuba i-AGOA ibonelela i-United States of America ngethuba lokomeleza ubudlelwane bayo bezoqoqosho ne-Afrika yiloo nto ke kufuneka le AGOA yolulwe ukuze ibenethuba eloneleyo lokuthela iziqhamo, kwaye yenziwe luqilima ukuze ibe neempembelelo ezintle kananjalo ibenawo nomtsalane.

src: Seboka sa Matona a Bohahlaodi a BRICS Kabinete e thabetse sephetho se atlehileng sa Seboka sa Matona a Bohahlaodi a BRICS sa 2023 se neng se tshwaretswe Cape Town, se ileng sa etsa hore dinaha tseo e leng ditho di sebedisane ka ho felletseng ho ntshetsa pele bohahlaodi ba ka hare ho BRICS, ho ntlafatsa ditsela bakeng sa motsamao o betere wa bohahlaudi le kgokahanyo hara dinaha tseo e leng ditho.
tgt: INtlanganiso yobaPhathiswa bezoKhenketho be-BRICS IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuqukunjelwa ngempumelelo kweNtlanganiso yabaPhathiswa bezoKhenketho be-BRICS yama-2023 ebibanjelwe eKapa, apho amazwe angamalungu azibophelele kwintsebenziswano enzulu kunye nasekukhuthazeni ukhenketho phakathi kwi-BRICS, ukuphuhlisa iindlela zokuhamba nonxulumano phakathi kwamazwe angamalungu.

src: Sena se tla matlafatsa le ho feta lefapha la Afrika Borwa la bohahlaodi le seng le ntse le bontsha matshwao a ho ntlafala.
tgt: Oku kuza komeleza nangakumbi icandelo lezokhenketho laseMzantsi Afrika esele libonisa iimpawu zokuvuka ke noko.

src: Bakeng sa dikgwedi tsa pele tse 8 tsa 2023, naha e ile ya ba le baeti ba dimilione tse e leng se ileng sa bontsha keketseho ya dipersente tse ho tloha ho nako e tshwanang ka 2022.
tgt: Kwiinyanga ezisi-8 zokuqala zika-2023, ilizwe lamkele i-5.5 yezigidi zabantu abafikayo oko okubonakalise ukonyuka ngama-63.4% xa kuthelekiswa neli thuba linye lango-2022.

src: Ngodiso ya Dikgetho IEC e phatlaladitse la 18 le la 19 Pudungwana 2023 e le mafelobeke a pele a ho ingodisetsa ho kgetha bakeng sa Dikgetho tsa Kakaretso tsa 2024.
tgt: UkuBhalisela ukuVota I-IEC yabhengeza umhla we-18 nowe-19 kweyeNkanga 2023 njengempelaveki yokuqala yokubhalisela ukuvota kuNyulo Jikelele luka-2024.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho bohle ba tshwanelehang ho kgetha ho ingodisetsa ho kgetha bakeng sa Dikgetho tsa Kakaretso tsa 2024 diteisheneng tsa hao tsa ho kgetha tse haufinyane.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abavoti abafanelekileyo ukuba babhalisele ukuvota kuNyulo Jikelele luka-2024 kwizikhululo zokuvota ezikufutshane nabo.

src: Ngodiso ya ho kgetha ya inthanete e butswe ho tloha ka Hlakola 2023 mme baahi ba koptjwa ho sebedisa setsi sena ho ingodisa kapa ho ntlafatsa dintlha tsa bona.
tgt: Ukubhalisela ukuvota nge-intanethi kuvulwe ukususela ngeyoMdumba wama-2023 kwaye abemi bayabongozwa ukuba basebenzise esi sibonelelo ukubhalisa okanye ukuhlaziya iinkcukacha zabo.

src: Maafrika Borwa a kentseng dikopo tsa di-ID a kgothalletswa ho etela ofisi ya Meroro ya Lehae ya sebakeng sa habo bona bakeng sa ho ya di nka.
tgt: Abantu baseMzantsi Afrika abafake izicelo zabo zee-ID bayakhuthazwa ukuba bazilande ngokuthi batyelele i-Ofisi yeSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya.

src: Ho na le dikarete tsa di-smart ID tse fetang 500 000 tse lokelang ho latwa diofising tsa Merero ya Lehae naha ka bophara.
tgt: Angaphezulu kwama-500 000 amakhadi ee-ID ekusafuneka ukuba ayolandwa kwii-ofisi zeSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya elizweni ngokubanzi.

src: Motlakase Letona ofising ya Mopresidente le ikarabellang bakeng sa Motlakase le fane ka dintlha tse hlakileng ka boemo ba motlakase naheng.
tgt: Umbane UMphathiswa kwi-Ofisi kaMongameli onoxanduva lokujonga imicimbi yezoMbane unike amagqabantshintshi abanzi ngemeko yombane elizweni.

src: Kabinete e ile ya thoholetsa boiteko ba Mmuso wa Profinse ya Gauteng o sebetsang le Eskom ho tsosollosa motlakase dibakeng tsa Gauteng tse nnileng tsa ba lefifing ka lebaka la boshodu kapa ho senyeha ha di-transformer.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iziqhwabele izandla iinzame zikaRhulumente wePhondo lase-Gauteng zokusebenza ne-Eskom ukubuyisela umbane kwimimandla yase-Gauteng ebithwaxwa kukucima kombane ngenxa yokwebiwa okanye umonakalo kwizixhobo ezihambisa amandla ombane.

src: Bosiung bo fetileng, di-transformer tse tsheletseng tse ntjha tsa motlakase di ile tsa kenngwa Kagiso, sebakeng sa West Rand ka mora hore baahi ba sale ba se na motlakase ka dilemo tse fetang tse tharo.
tgt: Izolo ebusuku, kuye kwalayitwa izixhobo ezihambisa amandla ombane ezithandathu eKagiso, kummandla weNtshona Randi emva kokuba uluntu lwashiyeka lungenambane isithuba esingaphezulu kweminyaka emithathu.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho baahi bana hore ba sirelletse disebediswa tsena tsa bohlokwa boshodung, le tshenyong tse bakwang ke dikgokelo tse seng molaong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema olu luntu ukuba luzikhusele iziseko zophuhliso ezibalulekileyo ekwebiweni, ekonakalisweni kunye nomonakalo obangelwa luqhagamshelo olungekho mthethweni.

src: Tjhefo ya Dijo Kabinete e tshwenyehile ka ho ata ha bana ba kudiswang ke tjhefo ya dijo eo ba e fumaneng ha ba ja dijo tse felletsweng ke nako le tse silafetseng tseo ba di rekileng mabenkeleng a spaza le ho barekisi ba seterateng.
tgt: UkuTyhefeka kokuTya IKhabhinethi ixhalabile yindlela ekonyuke ngayo iziganeko zabantwana abatya ityhefu ngenxa yokutya ukutya okuphelelwe lixesha kunye nokutya okungcolisekileyo kwasespaza kunye nokwabathengisi basesitalatweni.

src: Kabinete e kgothaditswe ke boiteko ba tshebetso ya molao ba ho tiisa hore ho latelwa melao ya polokeho ya dijo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthazwa ziinzame ezenziwa ngabanyanzelisi bomthetho zokunyanzelisa ukuthotyelwa kokhuseleko ekutyeni.

src: Seboka sa Matjhaba se Buang ka Diketso tsa ho Falla se Kwetlisang Boramotse le Marena Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka Seboka sa Matjhaba se Buang ka Diketso tsa ho Falla se Kwetlisang Boramotse le Marena se neng se tshwerwe ke Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae ka bonkakarolo ba Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Dikgwebo tse Nyenyanane, Lefapha la Puso ya Kopanelo le Ditaba tsa Borena Lefapha la Bodulo ba Batho le marena le boramotse ho tswa bomasepaleng ba ditoropo le ba ditereke, se neng se tsepamisitswe ho ditlamorao tse bakwang ke ho falla ho seng molaong, ho kenyelletsa tsamaiso ya mabenkele a spaza.
tgt: INtlanganiso yeeNgxoxo nooSodolophu kunye neenkokeli zeMveli ngeMfuduko yeHlabathi IKhabhinethi yanikwa amagqabantshintshi malunga nentlanganiso yeengxoxo ngemfuduko yehlabathi eyayisingethwe liSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya ngothatho nxaxheba lwe-DSBD, i-COGTA, iSebe leeNdawo zokuHlaliswa kwabaNtu kunye neenkokeli zemveli noosodolophu abavela koomasipala abambhaxa kunye nabezithili eyayijolise ekunqandeni iziphumo zemfuduko engekho mthethweni, kuquka noshishino lwezipaza.

src: Sephetho se ka sehloohong se akaralletsa ho kenyelletswa ha melawana ya dintho tse fapaneng bakeng sa ho lokisa mathata a amanang le phethahatso ya melawana ya kgwebo ke bomasepala le balaodi ba setso.
tgt: Iziphumo ezingundoqo ziquka ukwaziswa kwemithetho equka konke kamasipala ukuze ithathele ingqalelo imingeni enxulumene nokunyanzeliswa kokusetyenziswa kwemithetho yendawo inyanzeliswa ngoomasipala kunye nabasemagunyeni kulawulo lwemveli.

src: Ho tla ba le ditlhahlobo tsa hanghang tse kopanetsweng tsa dikgwebo, ka ho kgetheha tsa mabenkele a spaza ke mafapha a mosebetsi, a bophelo bo botle, a ntshetso pele ya dikgwebo tse nyenyane le dihlopha tsa tlhahlobo ya ho falla tsa Merero ya Lehae, bakeng sa ho qobella boikamahanyo le melao e sebetsang.
tgt: Kuza kubakho uhlolo nophando olukhawulezileyo oluza kuqhutywa ngokuhlanganyelweyo lokujonga ukusetyenziswa kwemithetho yamashishini, ingakumbi izipaza lisebe lezemisebenzi, elezempilo, elophuhliso lwamashishini amancinci kunye namaqela ahlola imfuduko eSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya, ukunyanzelisa ukuthotyelwa kwemithetho elindelekileyo kumashishini.

src: Tlhahlobo ho mabenkele a spaza metseng le makeisheneng, le mekgwa ya ho a ngodisa e tla sebediswa ke baetapele ba setso le bomasepala.
tgt: Ukuphicothwa kwezipaza ezilalini nasezilokishini, kunye neendlela zokuzibhalisa ezingasetyenziswa ziinkokeli zemveli kunye noomasipala nako kuza kwenziwa.

src: Ho boetse ho na le boiteko ba ho tshehetsa balaodi ba setso ho boloka tlaleho ya batho ba tswang kantle ho naha metseng ya bona.
tgt: Kukwakho neenzame zokuxhasa oogunyaziwe bemveli ukuba bagcine uluhlu lwamagama abemi bangaphandle kwiindawo abahlala kuzo.

src: Molao wa laesense ya kgwebo o fetotswe bakeng sa ho tshehetsa bohle ba lakatsang ho hweba mafapheng a sa laolweng ke mmuso.
tgt: Kulungiswa umthetho wokunikwa kwelayisenisi kumashishini ngelo kuxhasa bonke abo banqwenela ukurhweba kwicandelo lweshishini elingekho sikweni.

src: Ntwa ya Kopanelo Kgahlanong le Botlokotsebe Kabinete e babatsa SAPS ka kotlo e kgolo ho mekgatlo ya matjhaba ya dithethefatsi ka mora ho fumana khokheine ya boleng ba dimilione tse R80 tse ileng tsa tshwarwa ka la 20 Mphalane 2023 ntlong ya polokelo Boemakepeng ba Dube Trade ka hare ho Boemafofane ba Matjhaba ba King Shaka.
tgt: UMlo woLwaphulomthetho oHlanganyelweyo IKhabhinethi iyincomile i-SAPS ngokufumana iqela elithubelezisa iziyobisi kumazwe angaphandle kulandela ukufunyanwa kwe-cocaine exabisa ama-R80 ezigidi ebanjwe ngowama-20 kweyeDwarha 2023 kumzi wokugcina impahla i-Dube Trade Port kwisikhululo seenqwelomoya i-King Shaka International Airport.

src: Matsatsi a mabedi pele ho kgapo eo, khokheine e nngwe ya boleng ba dimilione tse R70 le yona e ile ya fumanwa ka khontheinareng Boemakepeng ba Durban.
tgt: Kwiintsuku ezimbini eziphambi koku, kubanjwe enye i-cocaine exabisa ama-R70 ezigidi kwiZibuko laseThekwini.

src: Kabinete e thoholetsa SAPS bakeng sa mosebetsi wa bona wa ho sitisa le ho senya tlolo ya molao e hlophisitsweng ya matjhabeng e leng tshokelo e kgolo ho setjhaba sa habo rona le ho naha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqhwabela izandla i-SAPS ngomsebenzi wayo ekuphazamiseni kunye nasekunqandeni ulwaphulomthetho oluququzelelweyo lwamazwe amaninzi olusisigrogriso esikhulu kwiindawo zethu esihlala kuzo nakwisizwe siphela.

src: Letsholo la Tshireletseho Nakong ya Matsatsi a Phomolo le se ntse le beha ditholwana ka ho tshwara ha mapolesa babelaellwa ba fetang 140, ho kenyelletsa le eo ho thweng ke nkokonono ya morafo o seng molaong, le ho hapuwa ha dithunya tse se nang laesense.
tgt: IPhulo le-Operation Safer Festive Season sele liveza iziphumo ngamapolisa abambe ngaphezulu kwe-140 yabarhanelwa, kuquka norhanelwa ngokuba ngungqondongqondo ekumbiweni kwemigodi okungekho mthethweni, kunye nokuthathwa kwemipu engenazilayisenisi.

src: Ketelo ya ho Hlahloba ya Mopresidente Kabinete e thabetse Ketelo ya ho Hlahloba ya Mopresidente Masepaleng wa Emfuleni, e ileng ya latelwa ke dikopano le setjhaba nakong ya ketelo ya Mohlala wa Ntshetsopele ya Ditereke ya 2022.
tgt: UTyelelo lukaMongameli lokuyoKhangela Ukuqhubekeka koMsebenzi IKhabhinethi ilwamkele uTyelelo lukaMongameli lokuyoKhangela Ukuqhubekeka koMsebenzi kuMasipala wase-Emfuleni, obelulandelela ukujonga iziphumo zothetha-thethwano zendibano noluntu elalibanjwe ngo-2022 kwiNkqubo yoPhuhliso lweZithili.

src: Ketelo ya 2022 Emfuleni e qoollotse mathata a tlhokomelo e mpe ya ditshebeletso ke masepala.
tgt: Utyelelo luka-2022 Emfuleni lwachonga imiba yokungalungiswa kakuhle kweziseko zophuhliso ngumasipala.

src: Ka ho kenella ha Lefapha la Metsi le Bohlweki, ho bile le tswelopele e bonahalang tabeng ya ho rarolla mathata a ditshebeletso tsa metsi le bohlweki tse felletseng ka ho putlama ha tsamaiso ya Metsi a Ditshila Vaal.
tgt: Ngongenelelo lweSebe lezaManzi noGutyulo, kube khona inkqubela ebonakalayo ekuthatheleni ingqalelo imingeni yeziseko zophuhliso zamanzi nezogutyulo ekhokelele ekuweni kwenkqubo ye-Vaal Waste Water.

src: Mosebetsi o entswe bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa phano ya metsi, tshebetso e nepahetseng ya tsamaiso ya metsi a ditshila mme kahoo ha fediswa bothata ba metsi a dikgwerekgwere tse ditshila a mathang diterateng le dijareteng tsa batho.
tgt: Sowuqalile umsebenzi wokuphukcula unikezelo lwamanzi, ukusebenza ngokufanelekileyo kweziseko zophuhliso zamanzi amdaka kwaye oko kuphelisa ingxaki yemibhobho ehambisa amanzi amdaka ebesele egxagxaza ezitalatweni nakwiiyadi zabantu.

src: Tswelopele e hlokomelehang nakong ya ketelo ena e kenyelletsa ntlafatso diphaepheng tse ngata tsa bohlokwa le diteisheneng tsa ho pompa metsi, ho ntjhafatswa le ho tiiswa ha ditsela, hammoho le tlhahiso e kgolo ya mabone a seterateng bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa kganya le polokeho.
tgt: Inkqubela eqatshelweyo kolu tyelelo iquka uphuculo kwimibhobho yamanzi emininzi kunye nakwizikhululo zeempompo zamanzi, ukulungiswa ngaphezulu kunye nokutywinwa kweendlela, kunye nokufakwa ngobuninzi kwezibane zasesitalatweni ngelokuphucula ukukhanya nokhuseleko.

src: Leano Bakeng sa Tsamaiso ya Thepa Afrika Borwa Lefapha la Dipalangwang le tswetsepele ho qala dipuisno ka Leano le mabapi le Tsamaiso ya Thepa Afrika Borwa, e le karolo ya mehato ya ho rarolla mathata ao lefapha la tsamaiso ya thepha le tobanang le ona le ho matlafatsa boiteko ba ho ntlafatsa moruo wa Afrika Borwa.
tgt: ISicwangciso seNkqubo yoThutho lweMpahla eMzantsi Afrika ISebe lezoThutho liqalise iindibano kwiSicwangciso seNkqubo yoThutho lweMpahla eMzantsi Afrika, njengenxenye yamanyathelo okuthathela ingqalelo imingeni ejongene necandelo lokuthuthwa kwempahla kunye nokomelezwa kweenzame zokubuyiselwa koqoqosho eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Ntshetsopele ya Mehaho le Tlhokomelo Kabinete e thabetse tswelopele e entsweng ho ntshetsopele ya mehaho le tlhokomelo ka ho phethwa ha kaho ya marokgo a mahaeng a 36 tlasa Welisizwe Rural Bridges, le kaho e ntseng e tswelapele diprojekeng tse 20 dibakeng tsa bodulo ba batho, ditseleng le metsi.
tgt: UPhuhliso nokuGcinwa kweziSeko zoPhuhliso IKhabhinethi iyamkele inkqubela eyenziweyo ngophuhliso kunye nokugcinwa kweziseko zophuhliso ngokugqitywa kweebhulorho zasezilalini ezingama-36 phantsi kwenkqubo yeWelisizwe Rural Bridges, kunye nokwakhiwa okuqalayo kweeprojekthi ezingama-20 kwiindawo zokuhlaliswa kwabantu, iindlela, namanzi.

src: Ho Thakgolwa Botjha ha Ditsela tsa Matjhaba tsa South African Airways (SAA) Kabinete e thabetse ho thakgolwa botjha ha ditsela tsa matjhaba tsa SAA ka ho kenyelletsa botjha maeto a sefofane dikhonthinenteng tse ding a yang São Paulo, Brazil, e leng se boetseng sa tshwaya ho kgutla ha tshebeletso ya nako e telele ka ntle ho Cape Town le Johannesburg.
tgt: UkuPhehlelelwa ngokuTsha kweendlela zehlabathi zeQumrhu leeNqwelomoya loMzantsi Afrika (i-SAA) IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuphehlelelwa ngokutsha kweendlela zehlabathi ze-SAA ngokubuyiswa ngokutsha kwehambo yayo yenqwelomoya ehamba phakathi kwamazwekazi eya e-São Paulo, e-Brazil, ephawule kananjalo ukubuya kwenkonzo ehamba ihambo ende esuka eKapa nase-Johannesburg.

src: Ho kgutla ha SAA ditseleng tsa matjhaba ho tla tlatsetsa ka ho toba kgolong ya ketelo ya matjhabeng naheng ya rona, le ho kgolo lefapheng la bohahlaodi ka mora tshenyo e bakilweng ke sewa sa COVID-19.
tgt: Ukubuyela kwe-SAA kwiindlela zehlabathi kuza kufaka isandla ngqo ekuqhubeni ukukhula kokusetyenziswa kwezithuthi ezihamba kweli lizwe, kunye nokukhula kwecandelo lezokhenketho emva kokuba ligqugqiswe ngubhubhane we-COVID-19.

src: Afrika Borwa e Thakgotse Drone e Kgolo ka ho Fetisa Afrika Kabinete e lebohisitse ba Sesole le khampani ya difofane ya Milkor ka katleho ya yona ya ho thakgola sefofane se sa hlokeng ho palangwa hore se fofiswe (UAV) sa Milkor 380, e leng se behang Afrika Borwa hara dinaha tse tswelang pele ho etsa kgatelo pele theknolojing ya di-drone.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uphehlelela eyona drone inkulu e-Afrika IKhabhinethi ivuyisene noMkhosi kunye nenkampani yobuchwepheshe bokubhabha emoyeni kweenqwelomoya i-Milkor ngokuphehlelela kwabo ngempumelelo i-Milkor 380 okusisithuthi esizihambelayo emoyeni (i-UAV), oku kubeka uMzantsi Afrika phakathi kwamazwe aqhubayo ukwenza imitsi emide kubuchwepheshe beenqwelomoya ezizihambela emoyeni ii-drone.

src: Milkor 380 ke drone e kgolo ka ho fetisisa e entsweng Afrika mme e tla sebediswa ke masole ha ho na le dintwa, ha ba disa moedi, ha ba disa dimela le diphoofolo tse hlaha, ho kenyelletsang twantso ya ho tsoma ho seng molaong.
tgt: I-Milkor 380 yeyona drone inkulu eyakhiwe e-Afrika kwaye iza kusetyenziswa licandelo lezokhuselo ngeenjongo zokulwa, ulawulo lomda, ulondolozo lwendalo kuquka nokulwa ukuzingela okungekho mthethweni.

src: Ditlhahlobo tsa Metriki le tsa Sekolo tsa Qetellong ya Selemo Kabinete e thabetse qalo e tsamaileng ka thello ya ditlhahlobo tsa 2023 tsa National Senior Certificate (metriki), tse qadileng ka la 30 Mphalane 2023.
tgt: Iimviwo zeMatriki kunye nezokuphela konyaka ezikolweni IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuqala kakuhle kweemviwo zeSatifiketi esiPhezulu seSizwe (iMatriki) zama-2023, eziqale ngowama-30 kweyeDwarha 2023.

src: Batswadi le bahlokomedi ba kgothalletswa ho tswela pele ba tshehetsa baithuti nakong ena ya bohlokwa.
tgt: Abazali nabagcini babantwana bayakhuthazwa ukuba baqhubeleke nokuxhasa abafundi ngeli xesha libaluleke kangaka.

src: Kabinete e boetse ya romela ditakaletso tse molemo ho baithuto bohle ba tla beng ba dutse bakeng sa ditlhahlobo tsa bona tsa qetellong ya selemo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithumela iminqweno emihle kubo bonke abafundi abaza kuchophela iimviwo zabo zokuphela konyaka.

src: Diqeto tsa Kabinete Boemo Palestina Kabinete e swabisitswe ke ho hana ha mmuso wa Iseraele ho hlompha molao wa matjhaba le ho tswela pele ho nyenyefatsa diqeto tsa Matjhaba a Kopaneng bakeg sa ho kenya tshebetsong ho emisa ntwa ntle ho kotlo.
tgt: Izigqibo zeKhabhinethi IMeko yase-Palestine Idanile iKhabhinethi kukwala kukarhulumente wakwaSirayeli ukuthobela umthetho wehlabathi kunye nokuqhubeka kwayo ijongela phantsi izigqibo zeZizwe eziManyeneyo zigqibo ezo ezifuna kubekwe phantsi izikhali ngaphandle kokohlwaywa.

src: Ditsela tsa ho baleha bakeng sa batho ba Palestina di ntse di thibetswe ka phello ya ditlamorao tse bohloko bakeng sa bana, basadi le baahi ba se nang molato.
tgt: Iindlela zokunika uncedo kubantu base-Palestine zisavaliwe kuza neziphumo ezimbi ebantwaneni, abasetyhini nabemi abangenatyala.

src: Ditlhaselo tsa batho ba Palestina ka difofane tsa mmuso wa Iseraele, di tswelapele mme palo ya batho ba shwang e a eketseha mo e kenyelletsang basadi le bana.
tgt: Uhlaselo lwasemoyeni olubulala abantu ngobuninzi olwenziwa ngurhulumente wakwaSirayeli ebantwini base-Palestine, luyaqhuba lubonakala ngamanani okusweleka kwabantu anyukayo aquka abasetyhini nabantwana.

src: Matsatsing a mabedi a fetileng, lefatshe le ile la sheba ho se letho leo le ka se etsang le shebelletse ha tlhaselo ya difofane e ba matla ho Gaza le ho West Bank moo dikolo, dipetlele, diambulense le mahae a baahi hammoho le ditsela tseo ho thweng di sireletsehile tse yang ka Borwa ho Gaza di thuntshwa.
tgt: Kwiintsuku ezimbini ezidlulileyo, ihlabathi liye lahlala lijongile nje kungekhonto linokuyenza, njengoko uhlaselo lwasemoyeni olonyukayo lwase-Gaza nase-West Bank lutshabalalise izikolo, izibonelelo zempilo, iinqwelo zezigulane neziseko zophuhliso zabantu kunye nezo ndlela kuthiwa zikhuselekile eziya kuMzantsi we-Gaza.

src: Bakeng sa dintlha tsena, Kabinete e entse qeto ya ho bitsa bodiplomate bohle ba Afrika Borwa ho tswa Tel Aviv ho tla hlalosa hore hantlehantle ke eng se etsahalang mono.
tgt: Ngenxa yoku, iKhabhinethi igqibe ekubeni ibuyise bonke oonozakuzaku baseMzantsi Afrika abase-Tel Aviv ukuze kudityanwe nabo.

src: Kabinete e boetse e hlokometse dipuo tse nyenyefatsang tse tswelang pele tsa lenqosa la Iseraele ho Afrika Borwa, Monghadi Eliav Belotsercovsky, kgahlahonong la Maafrika Borwa, boetapele ba Afrika Borwa ka hare le ka ntle ho mmuso ho kenyelletsa le setjhaba se buang kgahlanong le polao e sehlooho e etswang ke mmuso wa Iseraele kgahlanong le Mapalestina.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iziqaphele kananjalo ngokukhathazeka izimvo ezinyhatshayo ezenziwa ngunozakuzaku wakwaSirayeli eMzantsi Afrika, uMnu Eliav Belotsercovsky, ezibhekisele kubantu baseMzantsi Afrika, ubunkokeli baseMzantsi Afrika kuquka uluntu ekuhlaleni oluthetha phandle ngokubulawa ngobuninzi kwabantu okwenziwa ngurhulumente wakwaSirayeli ebantwini base-Palestine.

src: Dipuo tse nyenyefatsang tsa Lenqosa Belotsercovsky di fapane le dipolelo tsa manqosa a mehleng a mabedi a Iseraele ho Afrika Borwa (Illan Baruch le Dr. Alon Liel) a nnileng a dula a tsitsitse ha a hlalosa diketso tsa mmuso wa bona kgahlanong le Palestinians e le Kgethollo le Lehloyo la Morabe o mong.
tgt: Ezi zimvo zinyhatshayo zikaNozakuzaku Belotsercovsky ziyaphikiswa ziingxelo zabo babengoonozakuzaku bakwaSirayeli eMzantsi Afrika ababini (u-Illan Baruch noGqr Alon Liel) abo babengangungqi ekuchazeni izenzo zikarhulumente wabo ezichasene nabantu base-Palestine njengezenzo zengcindezelo.

src: Dipuo tsa nyenyefatsang kgahlanong le ba buang kgahlanong le tlhekefetso le baetapele ba naha di etsa hore boemo ba lenqosa Belotsercovsky e be bo sa hlokomelweng le ho feta.
tgt: Izimvo ezinyhatshayo ezibhekiswe kwabo bathethela phandle kunye nakwiinkokeli zelizwe zenza isikhundla sikanozakuzaku Belotsercovsky singakhuseleki okanye angafumani khuseleko.

src: Kahoo Kabinete e laetse Lefapha la Dikamano tsa Matjhaba le Tshebedisano hore le fetisetse molao wa mmuso ka molao wa metjha ya bodiplomate wa ho se thabele se etswang ke lenqosa lena la bodiplomate.
tgt: Ke ngoko iKhabhinethi iyalele iSebe lezobuDlelwane beHlabathi neNtsebenziswano ukuba livakalise ukungoneliseki kukarhulumente waseMzantsi Afrika ngalo nozakuzaku oko kuzakwenziwa kulandelwa amajelo ozakuzo afanelekileyo.

src: Polelo ya Leano la Bajete ya Tekanyetso ya Nako e Mahareng Kabinete e thabetse Bajete ya Tekanyetso ya Nako e Mahareng ya 2023 (MTBPS), e faneng ka tekanyo e tshepahalang ya boemo ba moruo ba hona jwale mme ya bontsha ho tshwarella ka tiyo ha mmuso ditjheleteng tsa naha hara dikgaello tse boima tsa tjhelete.
tgt: INgxelo yoMgaqonkqubo woHlahlo Lwabiwomali leXesha eliPhakathi IKhabhinethi iyamkele iNgxelo yoMgaqonkqubo yoHlahlo Lwabiwomali yeXesha eliPhakathi (i-MTBPS) yama-2023, enike uvavanyo olucacileyo lwemo yezoqoqosho ekhoyo ngoku kwaye yabonisa ukugcinwa kakuhle kwemali yethu yelizwe ngurhulumente nangona ephakathi kwemiqobo enzima.

src: Diqeto tsa MTBPS di ntlafatsa moralo wa ditjhelete wa rona di ntlafatsa kgolo ya moruo ha ka nako e tshwanang di lekalekanya boitlamo ba rona setjhabeng bo tshehetsang mafutsana naheng ya rona.
tgt: Izigqibo ezikwi-MTBPS ziphucula inkqubosikhokelo yethu yezemali zivuselela ukukhula koqoqosho ngexa ingqinelanisa izibophelelo zethu zasekuhlaleni ezixhasa abo basesichengeni elizweni lethu.

src: Leano la Ntlafatso le Kahobotjha ya Moruo di bile le seabo ho ditholwana tse ngata tse ntle ho moralo wa ditjhelete moruong wa rona.
tgt: ISicwangciso soKwakha ngokuTsha eMva kweNtlekele sibe negalelo kwiimpawu zokuqala zokuphucuka kuqoqosho lwethu.

src: Ho Ahuwa ha Seporo sa Terene ya Lebelo le Phahameng Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana Ho Ahuwa ha Seporo sa Terene e Tsamayang ka Lebelo le Phahameng mme Letona la Dipalangwang le la Ditjhelete ba tla tshohla taba ya ditjhelete tse tla hlokahalang bakeng sa ho kenya monahano ona tshebetsong.
tgt: UPhuhliso loMzila wooLoliwe abaHamba ngeSantya esiPhezulu IKhabhinethi ivume iNkqubosikhokelo yoPhuhliso loMzila wooLoliwe abaHamba ngeSantya esiPhezulu kwaye iimpembelelo zemali ekuphunyezweni koku kuza kuxoxwa ngazo phakathi kwabaPhathiswa owezoThutho nowezeMali.

src: Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana ho potlakiswa ha marangrang a diphaseje tsa Johannesburg ho ya Durban bakeng sa boithuto bo felletseng ba kgonahalo e jwalo, le ho tloha Johannesburg ho ya Polokwane ho isa Musina, le Johannesburg ho ya Mbombela di tla behwa mmarakeng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukubekwa phambili komzila osuka e-Johannesburg uya eThekwini ngophononongo olucazululiweyo loko kunokwenzeka, kwaye osuka e-Johannesburg nase-Polokwane uya eMusina, kunye nosuka e-Johannesburg uya eMbombela ziza kubekwa emarikeni.

src: Moralo wa Tokomane ya Leano la Mmuso ho Boahi, Ho Falla le Tshireletso ya Baphaphathehi Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana kgatiso ya Tokomane ya Leano la Mmuso ho Boahi, ho Falla le Tshireletso ya Baphaphathehi bakeng sa maikutlo a setjhaba.
tgt: IPhepha leNgcaciso-Nkqubo eliQulunqwayo ngoBumi, iMfuduko kunye noKhuselo lweeMbacu IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa kwePhepha leNgcaciso-Nkqubo ngoBumi, iMfuduko kunye noKhuselo lweeMbacu ukuze ulunike izimvo uluntu.

src: Moralo wa Leano lena o reretswe ho fana ka motheo bakeng sa tataiso ya ho fana ka bodulo le boahi ho batho ba tswang kantle ho naha, hammoho le tshireletso ya baphaphathehi le ya phaphathehi ba dipolotiki ka hare ho Afrika Borwa, ka ho lemoha dithahasello tsa tshireletso ya naha tsa Rephabliki le ho ikobela tumellano ya matjhaba le melao ya ho falla eo Afrika Borwa e leng karolo ya yona.
tgt: UMgaqonkqubo oqulunqwayo ujolise ekunikeni inkqubosikhokelo yokukhokela ekunikweni kobuhlali nobumi kubemi bamazwe angaphandle, ngokunjalo nokukhuselwa kwembacu kunye nabafuni gwiba eMzantsi Afrika, kuthathelwa ingqalelo okubalulekileyo kukhuselo lwesizwe lweRiphabliki kunye nokuthotyelwa kwezivumelwano neeprotokoli zehlabathi ekufudukeni ezo uyinxenye yazo uMzantsi Afrika.

src: Tlaleho ya Selemo sa bo6 ya Kgatelopele ya Tokomane ya Leano ho Ditokelo tsa Batho ba Holofofetseng Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana ho phatlalatswa koranteng ya mmuso ha Tlaleho ya Selemo sa bo6 ya Kgatelopele ya Tokomane ya Leano ho Ditokelo tsa Batho ba Holofofetseng ho kenngwa tshebetsong.
tgt: INgxelo yeNkqubela yoNyaka yesi-6 ngokuphunyezwa kwePhepha leNgcaciso-Nkqubo ngamaLungelo abaNtu abanokuKhubazeka

src: Phatlalatso ya tlaleho ena e tla tsamaisana le sehopotso sa matjhaba sa Kgwedi ya Tlhokomediso ya Ditokelo tsa Batho ba Holofetseng ho tloha ka la 3 Pudungwana ho isa ho la 3 Tshitwe.
tgt: .IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa kwigazethi karhulumente kweNgxelo yeNkqubela yoNyaka yesi-6 ngokuphunyezwa kwePhepha leNgcaciso-Nkqubo ngamaLungelo abaNtu abanokuKhubazeka.

src: Tlaleho ya tswelopele e boetse e bontsha kgolo morerong wa tekatekano ya khiro ho tloha ho bonyenyane ba dipersente tse 2 ho isa ho tse 3 bakeng sa batho ba holofetseng ho tloha selemong sa ditjhelete sa 2024/2025, ho isa ho bonyenyane ba dipersente tse 7 tsa morero wa tekatekano ya khiro bakeng sa batho ba holofotseng ka 2030.
tgt: Ukupapashwa kwengxelo yenkqubela kuza kudibana nokukhunjulwa kwihlabathi kweNyanga yokuQondwa kwamaLungelo okuba nokuKhubazeka ukusukela ngowe-3 kweyeNkanga ukuya kowe-3 kweyoMnga.

src: Dibili Moralo wa Bili ya Tsosoloso ya Afrika le Letlole la Tshebedisano ya Matjhaba (ARF) Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana tlhahiso ya Phetoho ya Bili ya ARF Palamenteng.
tgt: Ingxelo yenkqubela ikhombisa kananjalo ukonyuka kujoliso lolingano lobuncinane bengqesho ukusuka kwi-2% ukuya kwi-3% ebantwini abanokukhubazeka ukusukela kunyakamali ka-2024/2025, ngokubhekisele kubuncinane be-7% yojoliso lolingano kwingqesho ebantwini abanokukhubazeka ngowama-2030.

src: Bili ena e reretswe ho fetola Molao wa ARF (Molao wa bo51 wa 2000) le ho theha Mokgatlo wa Ntshetsopele ya Maqhama ya Afrika Borwa, o tla sebetsa jwalo ka thuluse bakeng sa ho tshehetsa ntshetsopele ya Afrika Borwa le tshebedisano le dinaha tse mabapi ka ho kgothalletsa demokrasi, bookamedi bo molemo, thibelo le tharollo ya dikgohlano, ntshetsopele ya moruo setjhabeng le kopanyo.
tgt: ImiThetho eYilwayo UmThetho oYilwayo weNgxowamali yokuZalwa ngokuTsha kwe-Afrika kunye neNtsebenziswano (i-ARF) IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa komThetho oYilwayo oTshintshiweyo we-ARF ePalamente.

src: Ho Thonngwa Pele batho bohle ba thonngwa, ho hlahlobisiswa mangolo a bona a thuto le a mang a hlokahalang.
tgt: UmThetho oYilwayo ufuna ukutshitsha umThetho we-ARF (umThetho wama-51 ka-2000) kwaye useka i-Arhente yeNtsebenziswano yoPhuhliso loMzantsi Afrika, eza kusebenza njengendlela yokuxhasa uphuhliso loMzantsi Afrika kunye nentsebenziswano namazwe osebenzisana nawo oko kusenziwa ngokukhuthazwa kwentando yesininzi, ulawulo olululo, uphuhliso kunye nokuhlanganisa okunxulumene nezentlalo nezoqoqosho.

src: Ho thonngwa ha Monghadi Ebrahim Rasool jwalo ka Modulasetulo wa Ntshetsopele ya Banka ya Afrika Borwa.
tgt: Abaqeshiweyo Zonke izikhundla zixhomekeke ekuqinisekisweni kwamabakala ezemfundo kunye nokuqinisekiswa okufanelekileyo kwezokhuselo Ukuqeshwa kukaMnu.

src: Ho thonngwa ha Mme Margaret Mosibudi Phiri jwalo ka setho sa Boto ya Taolo ya Nuclear ya Naha.
tgt: Ebrahim Rasool njengoSihlalo weBhanki yoPhuhliso yamaZantsi e-Afrika.

src: Diketsahalo tse Tlang Puisano ya Ntwa Kgahlanong le Bobodu Puisano ya Ntwa Kgahlanong le Bobodu e tla tshwarwa ka la 8 le la 9 Pudungwana 2023 Birchwood Hotel e Ekurhuleni bakeng sa ho hlomella setjhaba twantshong ya bobodu tumellanong le Leano la Naha la Ntwa Kgahlanong le Bobodu la naha ya rona.
tgt: IMisitho Ezayo INgxoxo emayelana nokuLwa noRhwaphilizo INgxoxo emayelana nokuLwa noRhwaphilizo iza kubanjwa ngowe-8 nowe-9 kweyeNkanga 2023 kwiHotele i-Birchwood Ekurhuleni ukuhlanganisa uluntu kumlo ochasene norhwaphilizo ngokungqinelana neSicwangciso esiLwa uRhwaphilizo seSizwe.

src: Kabinine, ka Pudungwana 2020, e tjhaetse monwana Leano la Naha la National Anti-Corruption Strategy (NACS 2020-2030).
tgt: IKhabhinethi, ngeyeNkanga 2020, yasivuma iSicwangciso esiLwa uRhwaphilizo seSizwe (i-NACS 2020-2030).

src: Lena ke leano la naha le reretsweng ho theha setjhaba se lokokohileng bobodung ha ka nako e tshwanang le kgothalletsang baahi hore ba se ke ba mamella bobodu mme ba ikobele ditaelo tsa molao.
tgt: Esi sisicwangciso selizwe esijolise ekudaleni indawo yoluntu engenalo urhwaphilizo ngexa kananjalo sikhuthaza abemi ukuba bangalunyamezeli kwaphela urhwaphilizo kwaye bathobele ulawulo lomthetho.

src: Letsholo la Matsatsi a 16 la 2023 la Thibelo ya Tlhekefetso ya Basadi le Bana Selemo sena se tshwaya sehopotso sa bo25 sa ho nka karolo ha Afrika Borwa ho Letsholo la Matsatsi a 16 bakeng sa Thibelo ya Tlhekefetso ya Basadi le Bana, se tla ketekwa tlasa sehlooho se reng: “Ho tiisa mehato ya ho fedisa Tlhekefetso ya Bong le Polao ya Basadi (GBVF): Ho se siye mang kapa mang morao”.
tgt: IiNtsuku ezili-16 zePhulo lobuTshantliziyo lokuChasa ubuNdlobongela obuBhekiswe kwabaseTyhini nabaNtwana lika-2023 Lo nyaka uphawula isikhumbuzo seminyaka engama-25 sothatho nxaxheba loMzantsi Afrika kwiiNtsuku ezili-16 zePhulo lobuTshantliziyo ekuChaseni ubuNdlobongela obubhekiswe kwabaseTyhini nabaNtwana eliza kuqwalaselwa phantsi komxholo: “Ukukhawulezisa amanyathelo okuphelisa ubuNdlobongela obuSekelwe kwiSini nokuBulawa kwabaseTyhini (i-GBVF): Kungashiywa mntu emva”.

src: Letsholo lena la lefatsheng ka bophara le ba teng ho tloha ka la 25 Pudungwana, Letsatsi la Matjhaba bakeng sa ho Fedisa Tlhekefetso kgahlanong le Basadi ho isa ho la 10 Tshitwe, Letsatsi la Matjhaba la Ditokelo tsa Botho.
tgt: Eli phulo lehlabathi liqhuba ukusukela kowama-25 kweyeNkanga, uSuku lweHlabathi lokuPheliswa kobuNdlobongela obuBhekiswe kwabaseTyhini ukuya kowe-10 kweyoMnga, uSuku lwamaLungelo oluNtu lweHlabathi.

src: Le reretswe ho fedisa tlhekefetso kgahlanong le basadi ha ka nako e tshwanang le tshehetsa ditokelo tsa botho.
tgt: Lijolise ekulweni ubundlobongela obubhekiswe kwabasetyhini ngexa lisagcine amalungelo oluntu.

src: Foramo ya bo14 ya Dipuisano tsa Maano Afrika Borwa e tla ba moamohedi mmoho ho Foramo ya bo14 ya Dipuisano tsa Maano e sebedisana mmoho le UNESCO International Teacher Task Force bakeng sa Thuto (TTF) ka Pherekgong 2024 tlasa sehlooho se reng “Ho rarollo bothata ba kgaello ya matitjhere le ho etsa hore mosebetsi ona o kgahle”.
tgt: IQonga leNgxoxo yoMgaqosiseko ye-14 UMzantsi Afrika uza kusingatha iQonga leNgxoxo yoMgaqosiseko ye-14 idibene noMsebenzi oWenziwa ngooTitshala kwiMfundo weHlabathi (i-TTF) we-UNESCO ngeyoMqungu ka-2024 phantsi komxholo “Ukuthathela ingqalelo ukunqongophala kootitshala kunye nokuwenza ube nomtsalane ngakumbi umsebenzi lo”.

src: Foramo ena e tla kopanya basebetsi ba mmuso, di-NGO, matitjhere le ditsebi tsa thuto bakeng sa ho tshohla ditaba tsa bohlokwa tse mabapi le maemo a tshebetso bakeng sa matitjhere, ditaba tsa boikemelo le boikarabelo ba matitjhere hammo le kamoo ho ka etswang hore botitjhere e be mosebetsi o kgahlang.
tgt: Iqonga liza kuhlanganisa kunye amagosa karhulumente, ii-NGO, ootitshala kunye nengcali zemfundo ukuxoxa ngemiba ebalulekileyo ephathelene neemeko zengqesho kootitshala, imiba yokuzimela nokuthatha uxanduva kootitshala ngokunjalo nendlela yokwenza ube nomtsalane umsebenzi wokufundisa.

src: Naledi ya lebelo la Moto GP Brad Binder eo hona jwale a tshwereng rekoto ya maemo a hodimo a primiyamo bakeng sa Afrika Borwa ka mora ho ba ya itlhommeng pele hara bahlodi ba bararo ba qetileng lebelo la Thailand Grand Prix.
tgt: Umqhubi wemoto yomdyarho ye-Moto GP u-Brad Binder waseMzantsi Afrika ngoku onerekhodi yodidi oluphezulu kwiphodiyam emva kokugqiba kwakhe ephezulu ekwindawo yesithathu kuMdyarho weeMoto wase-Thailand.
